description.en: Community catalog built with repo-level verification: the repository is reachable, its package.json declares a plugin bundle, and the version is a real release. The current entries come from the DSH-side community directory.
description.zh: 社区插件目录，逐条做过仓库级核实：仓库可达、package.json 声明了组合包、版本号来自包本身。当前条目来源为 DSH 生态的社区站点。
DSH 界面右下角的常驻小鲸鱼余额挂件，实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、今日已用与每轮对话消耗，支持拖拽吸附、Q 弹动画与音效，开箱即用。
description.en: A resident whale widget in the DSH interface corner that displays DeepSeek balance, daily usage, and per-turn cost, with drag-and-drop, squishy animation, and sound effects.

description.zh: 为 Windows 版 DeepSeek Harness 提供独立 bash 与 PowerShell 7 运行环境，并附带 Rust 高性能文件读写、搜索、替换工具，减少 shell 报错带来的 token 浪费。
description.en: Gives Windows DeepSeek Harness a bundled bash and PowerShell 7 runtime plus Rust-powered file read, search and replace tools, cutting token waste from repeated shell failures.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的服务化侧边栏工作台插件，把文件编辑、终端、Git 变更、子代理任务与侧边对话整合进右侧栏与底部面板，并开放 ctx.betterSidebar 供其他 DSH 插件注册新页面。
description.en: A service-oriented sidebar workbench for DeepSeek Harness that bundles file editing, terminal, Git changes, sub-agent tasks and side chat into the right sidebar and bottom panel, while exposing ctx.betterSidebar so other DSH plugins can register new pages.

description.zh: ModLens 是 DeepSeek Harness 的视觉插件，为纯文本模型外挂视觉能力，粘贴图片即得结构化 JSON 证据（OCR、版面、语义）。
description.en: ModLens is a vision plugin for DeepSeek Harness, giving text-only models sight: paste an image and get structured JSON evidence (OCR, layout, semantics).

description.zh: DSH plugin 一键换背景：从本机 Wallpaper Engine 素材库选图或视频应用到界面，并联动深/浅色主题。
description.en: A DSH plugin to switch background from local Wallpaper Engine library with one click, and sync DSH theme.

description.zh: DSH plugin 上下文可视化与管理插件，提供 Context 面板与 /context 命令，透视上下文组成、演进与压缩事件。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for context insight and management, offering a Context dashboard and /context command to visualize composition, evolution, and compression events.

description.zh: billion-context 是面向所有 AI 编码代理的通用上下文压缩代理，作为 DSH plugin 挂载后把已消耗的对话折叠成分层摘要，让单个会话跑满数十亿 token 而不爆窗口。
description.en: billion-context is a universal context-compression proxy for AI coding agents; mounted as a DSH plugin it folds consumed conversation into layered summaries so one session can push billions of tokens without blowing the context window.

description.zh: 将IM机器人接入DeepSeek Harness，支持飞书、微信、钉钉等九种渠道，通过扫码或凭据配置，统一管理多机器人连接。
description.en: Connect IM bots to DeepSeek Harness via QR code or credentials, supporting 9 channels like Feishu, WeChat, DingTalk, with unified multi-bot management.

description.zh: dsh-pocket 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供独立移动端 Web 页面，手机浏览器即可查看会话、实时输出与工具调用，并反向发送指令、处理提问审批。
description.en: dsh-pocket gives DeepSeek Harness a dedicated mobile web UI: browse sessions, live output and tool calls from a phone browser, send prompts back, and answer questions or approvals.

description.zh: dsh-agent-teams 将 DeepSeek Harness 会话变为队长，可组建持久子代理团队、拆分依赖感知任务并通过私信协作，无需独立工作流引擎。
description.en: dsh-agent-teams turns a DeepSeek Harness session into a captain that assembles durable sub-agent teams, splits goals into dependency-aware tasks, and coordinates via direct messaging—no separate workflow engine needed.

description.zh: deja-vu 把本机各 coding agent 已落盘的会话历史建成索引，让 DeepSeek Harness 等 34 种 agent 共享同一份记忆，无需模型与向量即可毫秒级召回旧修复。
description.en: deja-vu indexes the session history your coding agents already wrote to disk, giving DeepSeek Harness and 34 other agents one shared memory with millisecond recall — no LLM, no embeddings, one local Go binary.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 文本型 Agent 提供视觉能力：内置免费视觉链与像素级视觉工具（问答、定位、裁剪、像素差异、OCR、SVG 描摹、抠图、截图），一条命令安装，无需 Python，图像轮次如同普通工具调用。
description.en: Eyes for text-only DeepSeek Harness agents: built-in free vision chain and pixel-level vision tools (Q&A, grounding, crop, pixel diff, OCR, SVG trace, cutout, screenshots). One-command install, no Python, image turns work like ordinary tool-calling turns.

description.zh: 这个 DSH plugin 每天替你刷一轮 B站：按关键词搜索、逐条读字幕原文筛选，把值得看的写成 Markdown 日报，特别值得的还会留评论 @ 你。
description.en: A DSH plugin that scrolls Bilibili for you daily: it searches by keyword, reads full subtitles to judge what's worth watching, writes a Markdown digest, and @-mentions you on the best finds.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让桌面端与 Android 端安全连接并操作远程 Harness，延续会话、发送指令并复用原生界面。
description.en: A DSH plugin enabling desktop and Android clients to securely connect to and operate a remote Harness, continuing sessions and sending instructions via the native UI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边栏绘画页与全局图库的 DSH 生图插件，支持对话中直接生图改图，并可自定义服务商端点与代理。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that adds a sidebar painting page and global gallery, letting the agent generate and edit images in chat with custom provider endpoints and proxies.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中的纯文本模型补上视觉能力：粘贴图片即可问答，支持长截图 OCR、UI 还原与 GUI 视觉任务，并内置视觉工作流 Skill。
description.en: Gives text-only models in DeepSeek Harness real vision: paste an image to ask questions, plus long-screenshot OCR, UI rebuilding, and GUI visual tasks via a bundled Skill.

description.zh: 将本机登录的 WorkBuddy 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供只读积分概览与模型管理，是 DSH plugin。
description.en: Connect locally signed-in WorkBuddy models to DeepSeek Harness with read-only credits overview and model management.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供长篇小说创作能力：统一创作 Agent、90 个小说工具与原生工作台，覆盖规划、写章、审稿与导出。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for long-form novel writing, bundling a unified writing agent, 90 novel tools and a native workbench for planning, drafting, reviewing and export.

description.zh: ModSearch 是 DeepSeek Harness 的免费联网搜索插件，免注册免 API key，为无原生联网的模型提供网页搜索、X 搜索与页面抓取，返回结构化 JSON 证据。
description.en: ModSearch is a free web search plugin for DeepSeek Harness, no signup or API key required, providing web search, X search, and page fetch for models without native web access, returning structured JSON evidence.

description.zh: dsh-genui 让 DeepSeek Harness 的回复从纯文本变成可交互界面：图表、表单、计算器、仪表盘等小应用内联渲染，操作结果回流给模型继续对话。
description.en: dsh-genui turns DeepSeek Harness replies from plain text into interactive UI: charts, forms, calculators, dashboards, and mini apps rendered inline, with actions flowing back to the model.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可组合的分层记忆：运行时记忆、项目文档与记忆空间按需召回，来源与策略皆可插拔，并可在界面中查看与编辑。
description.en: Composable, layered memory for DeepSeek Harness: runtime memory, project documents and memory spaces recalled on demand, with pluggable sources and strategies you can inspect and edit in the UI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供免 API key 的多引擎网页搜索插件，内置 Bing、DuckDuckGo 等免费引擎，支持自动回退、设置页切换与平台搜索。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin offering keyless multi-engine web search with Bing, DuckDuckGo and more, featuring auto-failover, settings UI and platform search.

description.zh: DSH plugin 手机端 Web UI：在同一局域网用手机浏览全部会话、看流式回复并继续对话，桌面左下角提供二维码入口。
description.en: A DSH plugin that serves a mobile web UI over your LAN, letting you browse all sessions, watch streaming replies and continue conversations from a phone, with a QR entry in the desktop corner.

description.zh: ClearAI 是原生 DeepSeek Harness 插件，把 Epistemic Loop 引入 DSH：让结论必须凭证据成立，而非由模型自行宣告完成。
description.en: ClearAI is a native DeepSeek Harness plugin that brings the Epistemic Loop to DSH, so a conclusion must earn its status from delivered evidence instead of being declared done by the model.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 AnySearch 实时网络与垂直搜索，支持网页抓取、批量并发搜索，无需 API key 即可快速上手。
description.en: Integrates AnySearch real-time web and vertical search into DeepSeek Harness, with web fetch, concurrent batch search, and no API key required to start.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 注入 Univer 办公环境，支持电子表格、文档、演示、多维表格与画布，可创建编辑并导出标准 Office 文件，变更经审核后安全合并。
description.en: The DSH plugin brings Univer office suite into DeepSeek Harness, enabling spreadsheets, docs, slides, bases, and canvases with safe review and export to standard Office formats.

description.zh: dsh-synapse 是 DeepSeek Harness 的可视化会话地图插件，将同一工作区的会话、追问和分支组织成可拖拽缩放的画布，并保留 DSH 原生会话为唯一事实来源。
description.en: dsh-synapse is a visual conversation map plugin for DeepSeek Harness, organizing sessions, follow-ups, and branches into a draggable, zoomable canvas while keeping DSH native sessions as the single source of truth.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话头部嵌入实时成本芯片，按桶统计 token 用量、峰谷电价与下次切换倒计时，点击可查看分模型费用明细。
description.en: A DSH plugin that embeds a live cost chip in the DeepSeek Harness conversation header, showing per-bucket token usage, peak/off-peak tariff and a switch countdown, with a per-model breakdown modal.

description.zh: DSH 大肥鱼是一款由 DeepSeek Harness 真实工作状态驱动的桌面伴侣插件，以始终置顶的透明窗口实时展示 Agent 的思考、工作、等待与完成状态。
description.en: DSH Dafeiyu is a desktop companion plugin driven by real DeepSeek Harness agent status, displaying thinking, working, waiting, and completion states in an always-on-top transparent window.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让用户在 web 编辑器中输入 @ 快速引用工作区文件，内容自动注入模型上下文，免去复制粘贴。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets you type @ in the web composer to reference workspace files, injecting their content into the model context automatically.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化、可搜索的项目记忆：决策、规则与会话上下文存入 DuckDB，规则注入每次模型请求，并提供 Web 管理界面。
description.en: Persistent, searchable per-project memory for DeepSeek Harness: decisions, rules, and session context in DuckDB, with rules injected into every model request and a full management UI.

description.zh: 将ChatGPT、Claude、Grok订阅作为DeepSeek Harness的LLM提供商，无需API密钥，支持OAuth登录与用量统计。
description.en: Use ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok subscriptions as LLM providers in DeepSeek Harness, no API keys, with OAuth login and usage tracking.

description.zh: DSH plugin 按角色路由模型：规划者用 deepseek-v4-pro，委派子代理用 flash，附提示段与 pro-flash-routing 技能，降低推理成本。
description.en: A DSH plugin that routes models by role: planner on deepseek-v4-pro, delegated subagents on flash, with a prompt section and pro-flash-routing skill to cut reasoning costs.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 QQ 机器人，支持 OneBot 11 与 QQ 官方开放平台，每个 QQ 会话独立持久 Agent，并挂载完整工具链。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects DeepSeek Harness to QQ bots via OneBot 11 or QQ Official Platform, with per-chat persistent agents and full toolchain.

description.zh: DSH plugin 表情包插件：纯文本斗图、情绪主动发图、AI 自动学图、自定义表情包，多种风格随意切换，让对话更有趣。
description.en: A DSH plugin for memes: text-based meme battles, proactive emotion-driven sending, AI auto-learning, custom packs, and multiple styles.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Command Code 的 LLM provider 插件，通过 /alpha/generate 协议接入，支持所有套餐（含 Go 计划），并自动发现模型与离线缓存。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds Command Code as an LLM provider via /alpha/generate, works with all plans including Go, with model discovery and offline cache.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置面板中管理已安装技能：浏览完整目录、搜索、停用/启用、删除进可恢复回收站，桌面与 Web 通用。
description.en: Manage installed DeepSeek Harness skills from Settings: browse full catalog, search, disable/enable without uninstalling, and delete to a restorable trash. Works on desktop and web.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 DeepSeek Harness 内集成插件中心，支持浏览市场、查看排行榜、管理安装与更新，无需离开工作区即可发现并审阅插件。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings the plugin hub into DeepSeek Harness, enabling browsing, rankings, and install management without leaving the workspace.

description.zh: whale-girl 是 DSH Web GUI 的桌面宠物插件，以 QQ 宠物形态悬浮右下角，可拖拽、投喂、玩耍，并通过任务与陪伴积累等级、称号和记忆。
description.en: whale-girl is a DSH Web GUI desktop pet plugin in QQ-pet style, floating bottom-right, draggable, feedable, and playable, accruing seniority, titles, and memories from tasks and companionship.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页 GUI 打造的 Claude Code 桌面主题，复刻象牙白与暖黑画布、陶烬橙强调色及权限分段、模型选择器等交互细节。
description.en: A Claude Code Desktop theme for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, recreating its ivory and warm-black canvases, terracotta accent, permission segments and model picker.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在对话中提供实时 iOS 模拟器与 USB 真机控制，含 22 个 agent 工具、可交互侧边栏面板，支持构建运行、UI 自动化与 SwiftUI 预览热重载。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings a live iOS Simulator and USB-connected iPhone into the conversation, with 22 agent tools, an interactive sidebar panel, build & run, UI automation, and SwiftUI preview hot reload.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 桌面操控能力，基于 MCP 与 UIA 的 22 个工具，让 agent 能看能点真实应用。
description.en: Windows computer use for DeepSeek Harness: MCP stdio server + PowerShell UIA backend with 22 desktop tools for agent to see and operate real apps.

description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 登录过的所有账号自动并入一个 DeepSeek Harness 模型池，某账号被限流 429 时请求自动切换到下一个可用账号，实现零配置多账号容错轮换。
description.en: Automatically pools every account signed in to the WorkBuddy desktop app into one DeepSeek Harness model pool, failing over to the next healthy account on 429 rate limits for zero-config multi-account rotation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 滑动变阻器皮肤，通过滑块直观调节模型推理强度，并支持人物背景与自适应配色。
description.en: A DSH plugin skin with a sliding rheostat to intuitively adjust model reasoning intensity, featuring character backgrounds and adaptive color schemes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的跨会话七层长期记忆插件，基于 SQLite 存储 soul/user/project/fact/lesson/topic/rules，支持 BM25 检索与按窗口的梦境整理，让 AI 记住跨会话的关键信息。
description.en: A cross-session memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness with a seven-layer SQLite store (soul/user/project/fact/lesson/topic/rules), BM25 retrieval, and per-window dream consolidation.

description.zh: dsh-taskboard 为 DeepSeek Harness 嵌入本地优先的任务看板，支持看板/列表/甘特/工作流/仪表盘多视图，数据存于本地 SQLite，并支持自动认领任务与 AI 对话。
description.en: dsh-taskboard embeds a local-first task board into DeepSeek Harness, offering Kanban/list/Gantt/workflow/dashboard views with local SQLite storage, auto-claim of tasks, and per-task AI chat.

description.zh: DSH 插件：复用 Codex CLI 本地登录凭证，在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 ChatGPT 订阅模型，无需 API Key。
description.en: DSH plugin: reuse your Codex CLI local login to use ChatGPT subscription models in DeepSeek Harness, no API key required.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 87 个逆向工程与授权渗透测试 SKILL.md 封装为 Cordis 插件，随包分发、自动注册，供模型与用户调用。
description.en: A DSH plugin packaging 87 SKILL.md for reverse engineering and authorized pentesting as a Cordis plugin, auto-registering skills for model and user invocation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生换肤、壁纸、强调色与主题包分享的 DSH plugin，内置 8 套 Mirage 主题，纯 token 实现，装一次用很久。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings native theming, wallpapers, accent colors, and shareable theme packs to DeepSeek Harness, with 8 Mirage themes, all implemented via pure tokens.

description.zh: dsh-tianshu-tui 是 DeepSeek Harness 的交互式终端 UI 插件，自研 ANSI 极简渲染引擎，支持流式 Markdown、工具卡、16+ 主题、slash 命令、输入历史与记忆召回，带来丝滑的 coding 体验。
description.en: dsh-tianshu-tui is an interactive terminal UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness, featuring a custom ANSI minimal rendering engine, streaming Markdown, tool cards, 16+ themes, slash commands, input history, and memory recall for a smooth coding experience.

description.zh: DSH plugin 精准监控 DeepSeek 用量与余额，以鲸鱼娘动画呈现扣费、峰谷计费与三层费用统计，让模型消耗一目了然。
description.en: A DSH plugin that precisely monitors DeepSeek usage and balance, visualizing costs with whale animations, peak/off-peak billing, and three-level fee statistics.

description.zh: DSH Config Manager 是 DeepSeek Harness 的备份与迁移插件，一键导出、导入、同步完整配置（含插件、MCP、技能），跨机器迁移无忧。
description.en: DSH Config Manager is a DeepSeek Harness backup & migration plugin that exports, imports, and syncs your full configuration (plugins, MCP, skills) for one-click cross-machine migration.

description.zh: DSH plugin 可将 Claude Code、Codex、ChatGPT 等 19 种 Agent 的聊天历史导入 DeepSeek Harness，作为可继续对话的会话，支持完整保真、反向导出与双向同步。
description.en: A DSH plugin that imports chat history from 19+ AI coding tools into DeepSeek Harness as resumable sessions, with full-fidelity, reverse export, and bidirectional sync.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上归档会话管理中心，可按日期、工作区筛选历史会话，批量取消归档，并用可撤销策略自动清理会话列表。
description.en: Adds an archived-session management center to DeepSeek Harness: browse archived sessions by date or workspace, unarchive in bulk, and run a reversible auto-cleanup policy.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 装上 mattpocock/skills 的 25 个工程技能，并把 GitHub issue 变成右侧边栏里可筛选、可派活的任务板，点一下就把指令填进输入框。
description.en: Bundles mattpocock/skills' 25 engineering skills into DeepSeek Harness and turns GitHub issues into a filterable, actionable task board in the right sidebar, filling prompts into the input box with one click.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Office 文档预览与编辑：对话内交付卡片、Office 标签页、侧栏与全屏编辑器，还能把 Agent 的 Markdown 回复生成真实 DOCX 文件。
description.en: Brings Office document preview and editing into DeepSeek Harness: inline delivery cards, an Office tab, side-panel and fullscreen editors, plus real DOCX generation from the agent's Markdown replies.

description.zh: DSH Codex UI 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供 Codex 风格侧栏、工作区会话树、全局搜索与轮次导航，重塑界面体验。
description.en: DSH Codex UI brings a Codex-style sidebar, workspace session tree, global search, and turn navigation to DeepSeek Harness Web.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自动审批审查：需扩权的操作先交独立 Reviewer 模型判断，配合原生沙盒、拒绝熔断与 WebUI/TUI 状态提示，减少反复确认。
description.en: An auto-review approval plugin for DeepSeek Harness: operations that need elevated permissions are first judged by an independent Reviewer model, working with the native sandbox, rejection circuit breakers, and WebUI/TUI status indicators to cut down repeated confirmations.

description.zh: DSH Bridge 是 DeepSeek Harness 的本地会话间消息插件，支持会话发现、直接投递与状态管理，为 dsh-weave 等传输提供受控入口。
description.en: DSH Bridge is a local session-to-session messaging plugin for DeepSeek Harness, enabling session discovery, direct delivery, and state management, with a controlled inbound seam for transports like dsh-weave.

description.zh: DSH 插件，同窗口内一键回退对话到任意更早消息，不新建分支，可一并还原工作区文件，完整 Claude Code /rewind 语义。
description.en: DSH plugin for in-window conversation rewind to any earlier message without forking, with optional workspace file restore, full Claude Code /rewind semantics.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 Web UI 的“Deep diving…”状态标签替换为打字机动画彩虹短语，支持实时模板、标签页标题、状态胶囊与弹幕，让界面更生动有趣。
description.en: A DSH plugin that replaces the 'Deep diving…' status label with typewriter-animated rainbow phrases, live templates, tab titles, status pill, and danmaku for a livelier UI.

description.zh: pi2dsh 是打通 Pi 与 DeepSeek Harness 生态的兼容层，让未经修改的 Pi 插件直接作为原生 DSH plugin 运行，无需改写或适配。
description.en: pi2dsh is a compatibility layer bridging the Pi and DeepSeek Harness ecosystems, letting unmodified Pi extensions run as native DSH plugins with no fork or per-package adapter.

description.zh: DSH 预设增强插件，提供预设编辑器，支持一键破甲（jailbreak），可自定义系统提示词并导入导出分享。
description.en: A DSH plugin that provides a preset editor with one-click jailbreak, allowing custom system prompts and import/export sharing.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供行业与公司研究能力：产业链图谱、公开信息跟踪、公司卡片与可溯源研究报告，每个数字都可回溯来源。
description.en: An industry and company research domain pack for DeepSeek Harness: chain maps, public-source tracking, company cards and auditable reports where every figure traces to a source.

description.zh: dsh-find-plugin 让 DeepSeek Harness 智能体在会话内实时搜索 GitHub 上的 DSH 插件生态，按星标排序并附带安装命令，帮助用户快速发现和安装所需插件。
description.en: dsh-find-plugin enables the DeepSeek Harness agent to search the DSH plugin ecosystem on GitHub in-session, ranked by stars with install commands, helping users discover and install plugins quickly.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可验证研究报告引擎：每条论断绑定不可篡改的证据快照，逐字节核验后密封为带清单哈希的版本化报告。
description.en: A verifiable research-report engine for DeepSeek Harness: every claim is bound to immutable evidence snapshots, byte-checked, and sealed into a versioned report with a recomputable manifest hash.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenCode Go 与 Zen 实时模型目录，展示 token 费率、零费率过滤、协议选择与会话亲和路由。
description.en: Brings live OpenCode Go and Zen model catalogs into DeepSeek Harness, with token rates, zero-rate filtering, protocol selection and session-affinity routing.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将真实 Android 设备（模拟器或 USB 手机）实时流式接入对话，通过 adb 驱动 20 个 Agent 工具完成构建、运行、UI 操作与 OCR 识别。
description.en: A DSH plugin that streams a live Android device (emulator or USB phone) into the conversation, driving 20 agent tools via adb for build, run, UI control, and OCR.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加可弹出式侧边栏，展示产物与文件树，支持多类型预览，并可一键弹出为独立浏览器标签页，拖至另一显示器观看。
description.en: Adds a popout sidebar to DeepSeek Harness that lists artifacts and a file tree with multi-format preview, and can pop out into a separate browser tab for a larger view.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 Agent 提供可组合的工作状态、思考策略、质量门禁与自进化控制，支持人工审阅的跨会话规则学习。
description.en: A DSH plugin offering composable task controls for working state, reasoning strategy, quality gates, and self-evolution with human-reviewed cross-session rule learning.

description.zh: DSH OpenPencil 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，让 Agent 在对话中预览、检查并编辑真实的 .op 设计文档，提供多帧精确预览、交互式画布与托管编辑器。
description.en: DSH OpenPencil is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets agents preview, inspect, and edit real .op design documents in conversation, with exact multi-frame previews, an interactive canvas, and a managed editor.

description.zh: TokenLedger 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供零配置的 Token 用量记账，自动归属到实际服务请求的中转站，无需凭据即可查看用量、余额与订阅配额。
description.en: TokenLedger provides zero-config token usage accounting for DeepSeek Harness, attributing usage to the relay site that served each request, with no credentials needed to view usage, balances, and subscription quotas.

description.zh: Engramory 是 DeepSeek Harness 的便携式记忆协议，以零基础设施的 Markdown 文件与索引实现长期记忆，通过常驻规则加载，并附带校验器。
description.en: Engramory is a portable memory protocol for DeepSeek Harness, using zero-infrastructure Markdown files and an index for long-term memory, loaded as standing rules with a validator.

description.zh: DSH Agency Agents 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 271 名可召唤的专业智能体，按需启用专家并一键召唤子代理，助力任务完成。
description.en: DSH Agency Agents provides 271 summonable specialist agents for DeepSeek Harness, enabling on-demand expert activation and one-shot subagent summoning.

description.zh: DSH plugin 终端聊天界面，让 DeepSeek Harness 在终端里与智能体持续对话，交互与官方 web 客户端对齐，无需浏览器。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing a terminal chat UI for DeepSeek Harness, enabling continuous agent conversations in the terminal with web-aligned interactions, no browser needed.

description.zh: DSH 崩溃救援插件：配置与插件代码一键撤销回滚、密钥脱敏快照、一键安全模式，DSH 启动不了时还有离线 CLI/GUI/WebUI 兜底。
description.en: DSH crash-rescue plugin: one-click undo/rollback for config & plugin-code changes, secret-safe snapshots, one-click SAFE MODE, plus offline CLI/GUI/WebUI that work even when DSH won't boot.

description.zh: dsh-crew 让 Claude Code 和 Codex 在 dsh 会话中以真实终端面板运行，人类可实时观看并键入，DSH agent 通过五个工具调度它们。
description.en: dsh-crew runs Claude Code and Codex as live terminal panes inside dsh sessions, letting humans watch and type, while the DSH agent orchestrates them via five tools.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 QQ 机器人，支持 OneBot 11 与 QQ 官方开放平台，每个 QQ 会话独立持久 Agent，并挂载完整工具链。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects DeepSeek Harness to QQ bots via OneBot 11 or QQ Official Platform, with per-chat persistent agents and full toolchain.

description.zh: dsh-token-usage 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 token 用量与成本分析插件，在 Web 设置面板新增用量统计页，提供汇总卡片、GitHub 风格热力图和官方峰谷价自动换算的预估费用。
description.en: dsh-token-usage is a token usage and cost analytics plugin for DeepSeek Harness, adding a Usage Stats page to the Web settings panel with summary cards, a GitHub-style heatmap, and estimated spend auto-converted at official peak/off-peak rates.

description.zh: 将本机登录的 Trae 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供只读的积分与模型管理，让 DSH 本地执行工具调用。
description.en: Connect locally signed-in Trae models to DeepSeek Harness with read-only credits overview and local tool execution.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供回合级自动续接：当对话因 429 限流、配额耗尽或空响应中断时，自动等待并重发 continue，让长任务不再中途停死。
description.en: A DSH plugin that auto-resumes a turn killed by a 429 rate limit, exhausted quota or empty response, resending "continue" so long tasks survive instead of stopping dead.

description.zh: DSH Web UI 移动端适配插件，让 DeepSeek Harness 在手机竖屏下好用：侧栏变抽屉、弹窗变浮层、状态栏避让、大 JSON 自动压缩，平板限宽居中，桌面无操作。
description.en: Mobile adaptation plugin for DSH Web UI, making DeepSeek Harness usable on portrait phones: sidebar becomes drawer, modals become sheets, safe-area handling, automatic JSON compression, tablet width limiting, no-op on desktop.

description.zh: 通过 ChatGPT OAuth 将 OpenAI Codex 模型与图像生成接入 DeepSeek Harness，保留流式、工具调用与审批等原生能力。
description.en: Connect ChatGPT OAuth to DeepSeek Harness for OpenAI Codex models and image generation, retaining native streaming, tool calls, and approvals.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上原生持久记忆：以类型化 Markdown 文件存储，MEMORY.md 索引自动注入系统提示，跨会话记住用户与项目信息，无需外部服务。
description.en: Native persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness: typed Markdown memory files with a MEMORY.md index auto-injected into the system prompt, so your agent remembers across sessions with no external services.

description.zh: DSH plugin 搜番工具，对话内多源搜索番剧，卡片展示 Bangumi 评分与详情，支持复制磁力链接与流媒体播放。
description.en: A DSH plugin for anime search: multi-source search in chat, cards with Bangumi ratings and details, magnet copy and streaming.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化、可搜索的项目记忆：决策、规则与会话上下文存入 DuckDB，规则注入每次模型请求，并提供 Web 管理界面。
description.en: Persistent, searchable per-project memory for DeepSeek Harness: decisions, rules, and session context in DuckDB, with rules injected into every model request and a full management UI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供模型驱动的上下文压缩：由 LLM 自行决定何时压缩、压缩什么，写入高保真摘要并支持解压与检索，让长任务不再被硬截断。
description.en: Model-driven context management for DeepSeek Harness: the LLM decides when and what to compress into high-fidelity summaries, with decompress and context search so long tasks survive hard truncation.

description.zh: 插件桥是 DSH 的外部插件管理工具，让 Claude Code、Codex 等旧插件保持原目录与语义直接接入 DeepSeek Harness，统一管理安装、启停与更新。
description.en: Plugin Bridge is a DSH plugin that lets legacy Claude Code and Codex plugins run inside DeepSeek Harness with their original layout and semantics, managing install, enable/disable and updates in one place.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自动模式：通过 LLM 审查工具调用，自动批准、阻止或请求确认，减少人工干预。
description.en: DSH plugin auto mode: routes permission-gated tool calls through an LLM review to auto-approve, block, or ask for confirmation.

description.zh: DSH Web 选中批注插件：在回复或文件预览中选文字写批注，回车随消息发送，气泡内隐藏批注块，模型按 Annotation N 逐条对照回复。
description.en: A selection-annotation plugin for DSH Web: select text, add a note, and press Enter to send it with your message; the model answers each Annotation N in turn.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入文生图能力的 DSH plugin：模型可直接调用 generate_image 画图并显示在对话中，输入框按钮还能实时修改接口、模型与 API Key，无需重启。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings text-to-image to DeepSeek Harness: the model calls generate_image and images render inline, while an in-composer button lets you edit endpoint, model and API key live without restarting.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供受控浏览器自动化能力，通过 agent_browser 工具驱动 agent-browser CLI 操作 Chromium，并防护失效引用、标签漂移与敏感信息泄露。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness controlled browser automation: an agent_browser tool drives the agent-browser CLI against Chromium, guarding against stale refs, tab drift and secret leakage.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 引入多模型审议：多个模型独立作答、匿名互评，再由仲裁模型给出可审查的最终结论。
description.en: Adds multi-model deliberation to DeepSeek Harness: models answer independently, review each other anonymously, and an arbiter delivers an inspectable final decision.

description.zh: 为 DSH 接入本地 ComfyUI 的生产技能包，提供环境体检、零依赖 API 客户端、工作流改造与崩图排查，让 agent 真正把图跑出来。
description.en: A production skill pack that connects DeepSeek Harness to a local ComfyUI: environment checks, a zero-dependency API client, workflow rework, and broken-image diagnosis so agents can actually generate images.

description.zh: dsh-win32 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 原生修复与诊断工具，无需 WSL，一键检查官方 PowerShell 与 Workspace Write 组件、修复已知故障并创建桌面快捷方式。
description.en: dsh-win32 is a DSH plugin that fixes and diagnoses DeepSeek Harness on native Windows without WSL, checking official PowerShell and Workspace Write components, applying safe repairs, and creating a desktop shortcut.

description.zh: 为 DSH 本地编码 Agent 提供有界文件记忆：用 ME.md 与项目 MEMORY.md 注入新会话，配合 Memory 侧栏人工审核收件箱，无向量库与 LLM 调用。
description.en: Bounded-file memory for local coding agents in DeepSeek Harness: inject a short ME.md and project MEMORY.md into new sessions, with a Memory rightbar for human-curated inbox promotion — no embeddings, no LLM calls.

description.zh: 通过 UUMit 隧道把本机 DSH 开放到手机或另一台电脑，无需桌面客户端即可远程使用聊天、终端、文件与设置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that exposes your local DeepSeek Harness through a UUMit tunnel, so you can use chats, terminal, files and settings from your phone or another computer without a desktop client.

description.zh: DSH Turn Rewind 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供对话与工作区状态回退，基于持久化 Change Ledger 引擎，支持预览、选择性恢复与安全回滚。
description.en: DSH Turn Rewind provides conversation and workspace state rewind for DeepSeek Harness, powered by a persistent Change Ledger engine with preview, selective restore, and safe rollback.

description.zh: dsh-agy-link 将 Google Antigravity 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持多账号池化轮换、官方配额监控、浏览器一键登录与流式输出，由官方 agy CLI 驱动。
description.en: dsh-agy-link integrates Google Antigravity models into DeepSeek Harness with multi-account pooling, official quota monitoring, one-click OAuth login, and streaming output via the native agy CLI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Claude Code 风格的声明式权限规则：用 YAML 编写有序 allow/deny/ask 规则，按工具名、参数与工作区路径匹配，在工具执行前拦截并记录审计日志。
description.en: Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness: an ordered allow/deny/ask YAML ruleset matched on tool name, arguments and workspace paths, gating every tool call before execution with audit logging.

description.zh: DSH Noema 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久、可检查的长期记忆，通过召回工具与设置页管理，让 Agent 跨会话保留知识。
description.en: DSH Noema provides durable, inspectable long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness, with recall tools and a settings page for cross-session knowledge retention.

description.zh: Scientific Figure Library 是本地优先的 DSH 插件，把科研图表与代码导入磁盘库，审阅后发布为不可变版本，供各项目复用同一模板。
description.en: Scientific Figure Library is a local-first DSH plugin that imports scientific figures with their code into an on-disk library, reviews and publishes immutable releases, then reuses the exact template across projects.

description.zh: DSH plugin 一键安装极简模式 Git Bash 预设，将 bash 调用映射到 Git for Windows 的 bash，让 Windows 上极简模式真正可用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that installs the Minimal (Git Bash) agent preset, mapping bash calls to Git for Windows' bash so the minimal mode works on Windows.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通过 WebSocket 网关让 iPhone 等移动设备接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持局域网与公网配对、设备鉴权及二维码管理。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects mobile devices to DeepSeek Harness via WebSocket gateway, supporting LAN and public network pairing with device authentication and QR code management.

description.zh: superpowers-dsh 为 DeepSeek Harness 移植 obra/superpowers 的 14 个核心技能（TDD、调试、规划、协作），注册到 host 技能表，让每个 agent 会话可直接用 skill 工具加载。
description.en: superpowers-dsh ports 14 core skills (TDD, debugging, planning, collaboration) from obra/superpowers to DeepSeek Harness, registering them in the host skill registry for direct use via the skill tool.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供最无感的消息撤回与气泡原位重编辑，惰性提交、无痕替换，并支持版本翻页与草稿自动备份。
description.en: A DSH plugin offering the most seamless message recall and inline bubble re-edit for DeepSeek Harness Web, with lazy commit, seamless replacement, version pager, and auto-backup.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，在模型读取前撤回已发送的插话消息，支持单条与全部撤回，未读条带即装即用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that recalls sent-but-unread text messages before the model reads them, one-by-one or all at once, with an unread strip that works out of the box.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness GenUI 让 Agent 为当前任务生成聚焦的 React 界面，保存用户选择与输入，供下一轮 Agent 读取并继续任务，是 DSH plugin 的生成式 UI 能力。
description.en: DeepSeek Harness GenUI lets an Agent create a focused React interface for the current task, saving user selections and inputs for the next Agent turn, as a DSH plugin for generative UI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上原生持久记忆：以类型化 Markdown 文件存储，MEMORY.md 索引自动注入系统提示，跨会话记住用户与项目信息，无需外部服务。
description.en: Native persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness: typed Markdown memory files with a MEMORY.md index auto-injected into the system prompt, so your agent remembers across sessions with no external services.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Tabbit 浏览器自动化能力，通过 tabbit-cli 驱动真实页面、登录态与交互，支持网页自动化、信息提取、QA 与基准测试。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives the agent control over Tabbit Browser via tabbit-cli, enabling real-page web automation, information extraction, QA, and benchmarks.

description.zh: DSH 个人中心插件，在设置中新增「个人」分区，提供真实用量统计、成本估算、自定义指令注入与桌面宠物，纯本地运行不联网。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a 'Personal' section to settings, offering real usage stats, cost estimation, custom instructions, and a desktop pet, all running locally without network.

description.zh: 歸藏设计是 DSH plugin，把网页 PPT、图文卡片、网页排版、去 AI 味四个 skill 和一套设计系统装进 DeepSeek Harness，附作品库与语气档案。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings Guizang's content-production skills—web PPT, social cards, page layout, and de-AI-ifying—plus a shared design system, work library, and voice profile to DeepSeek Harness.

description.zh: DSH IM Connect 将钉钉、飞书、微信、企业微信、QQ、Telegram 等主流 IM 接入本机 DeepSeek Harness，让用户直接在聊天中下任务、看回复并批准工具。
description.en: DSH IM Connect connects major messaging platforms like DingTalk, Feishu, WeChat, WeCom, QQ, and Telegram to local DeepSeek Harness, letting users send tasks, view replies, and approve tools directly in chat.

description.zh: DSH plugin 用于从 DeepSeek Harness 会话中删除一个完整轮次，无需删除整个会话，保留后续对话与审计日志。
description.en: A DSH plugin to delete one complete turn from a DeepSeek Harness session without deleting the session, preserving later turns and audit logs.

description.zh: dsh-video-lens 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件，让纯文本 Agent 理解本地视频：提供视频元数据探测、场景感知帧采样与 ASR 转录，并融合视觉模型输出结构化证据，支持时间锚定问答。
description.en: dsh-video-lens is a DSH plugin that gives text-only agents eyes and ears on video: probe metadata, scene-aware frame sampling with optional ASR, fused with any OpenAI-compatible vision model into structured evidence, plus time-anchored Q&A.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自动审批门控：Flash 预判沙箱越界，安全操作自动放行，硬风险操作转人工确认，支持确认制学习与界面化审查。
description.en: DSH plugin approval gate: Flash predicts sandbox escapes, auto-approves safe actions, escalates risky ones to human review, with confirmation-based learning and UI review.

description.zh: local-shell-mcp 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供受控的 shell 执行环境，支持文件、浏览器自动化、远程机器控制等 MCP 工具，让 AI 安全操作真实终端。
description.en: local-shell-mcp provides DeepSeek Harness with a controlled shell execution environment, offering MCP tools for files, browser automation, and remote machine control, enabling AI to safely operate real terminals.

description.zh: dsh-run2skill 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，自动将你明确教给 Agent 的纠正、约束与工作流整理成可审核、可复用的原生 Skill，确认后才落盘。
description.en: dsh-run2skill is a DSH plugin that automatically turns corrections, constraints, and workflows you explicitly teach the Agent into reviewable, reusable native Skills, saving only after your confirmation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增强 todo_write 任务清单工具，新增优先级标签、完整清单渲染与会话内浮动任务面板，支持胶囊态收起与主题自适应。
description.en: An enhanced todo_write task-list plugin for DeepSeek Harness, adding priority tags, full checklist rendering and an in-session floating task panel with a collapsible capsule mode.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 WSL 工作区支持，在 GUI 中直接添加 WSL 发行版工作区，无需在 WSL 内再装 dsh，bash 与文件读写全部走 Linux 路径。
description.en: WSL workspace support for DeepSeek Harness: add a WSL distro workspace straight from the GUI, with no dsh install inside WSL, so bash and file tools all run on Linux paths.

description.zh: DSH plugin 聚合 User-Agent 改写、HTTP/SOCKS5 代理与请求自动重试，在 Web 设置的网络设置页统一配置，提升网络请求的灵活性与稳定性。
description.en: A DSH plugin bundling User-Agent rewriting, HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy, and auto-retry, all configured from a single Network tab in Web settings.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让 Agent 直接生成实时 React 界面，在聊天内联渲染或画布面板展示，支持流式输出与主题适配。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets the agent answer with live React interfaces, rendered inline in chat or in a canvas panel, with streaming and theme support.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话管理：迁移工作区与会话到新目录、导出导入 .dshsess 包，并用 WebDAV 跨机器同步。
description.en: Session management for DeepSeek Harness: migrate workspaces and sessions to new directories, export/import .dshsess bundles, and sync across machines over WebDAV.

description.zh: memory-eternal 是 DeepSeek Harness 的记忆插件，对话结束自动沉淀知识卡到本地 Markdown Vault，支持去重、CJK 检索、知识图谱与审核中心，Agent 通过 memory_recall 按需召回历史上下文，零人工干预。
description.en: memory-eternal is a DeepSeek Harness memory plugin that automatically distills knowledge cards into a local Markdown Vault after conversations, with deduplication, CJK search, knowledge graph, and review center, enabling agents to recall relevant context via memory_recall with zero manual intervention.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通用 MCP 连接器，连接 MCP Server、发现工具与 Prompt，支持 OAuth/PKCE、API Key 与 JSON 导入，并内置连接器市场与 Registry。
description.en: A general-purpose MCP connector for DeepSeek Harness, connecting MCP servers, discovering tools and prompts, with OAuth/PKCE, API Key, JSON import, and a built-in connector marketplace.

description.zh: dsh-strata 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的会话记录滚动条提供按比例、颜色编码的迷你地图，突出显示用户消息并提供可点击锚点，让您一眼看清整个运行轨迹。
description.en: dsh-strata turns the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI transcript scrollbar into a to-scale, color-coded minimap of the whole run, with user messages emphasized and clickable anchors.

description.zh: 基于GB/T 9704国标的公文全流程处理DSH插件，支持格式检查修复、内容优化、模板生成、Markdown转公文等能力。
description.en: A DSH plugin for full-process official document processing based on GB/T 9704, supporting format check/fix, content optimization, template generation, and Markdown-to-docx conversion.

description.zh: DSH plugin 用量计费仪表盘：从会话日志实时聚合真实用量，按多厂商官方价估算费用，侧边栏与全屏仪表盘一屏看清成本。
description.en: A DSH plugin usage-billing dashboard: aggregates real usage from session logs, estimates costs with live multi-provider pricing, and surfaces it all in a sidebar card and full-screen dashboard.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供统一能力菜单，以 Exposed/Progressive/Blocked 三档管理 MCP 工具与技能，节省 token 和上下文。
description.en: Unified capability menu for DeepSeek Harness, managing MCP tools & skills via Exposed/Progressive/Blocked tiers to save tokens and context.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 回答加上 GPT 式引用角标、来源面板与正文配图，让联网搜索的结果图文并茂、可一键跳转核对。
description.en: Adds GPT-style citation badges, a source panel and inline images to DeepSeek Harness Web answers, so search results render richly and stay verifiable.

description.zh: DeepCanary 是 DeepSeek Harness 的本地注意力收件箱，将审批、提问、失败与完成汇总集中一处，让长任务安静运行，需要你时再提醒。
description.en: DeepCanary is a local attention inbox for DeepSeek Harness, aggregating approvals, questions, failures, and completions so long tasks run quietly and alert you only when needed.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 官方 MCP 客户端提供管理控制台：在设置页增删改 MCP 服务器，并通过 /mcp 命令做健康诊断与工具试调用。
description.en: A management console for the official DeepSeek Harness MCP client: add, edit and remove MCP servers from a settings page, with /mcp health diagnostics and tool trial calls.

description.zh: dsh-smooth-stream 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 带来流畅的流式渲染与丝滑滚动，文字、Markdown、代码块、表格随输出自然呈现，页面平稳跟随，保持连贯的视觉节奏。
description.en: dsh-smooth-stream brings fluid streaming rendering and silky scrolling to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with text, Markdown, code blocks, and tables appearing naturally as output grows, and the page following smoothly to maintain a coherent visual rhythm.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex 集成：ChatGPT OAuth 登录、Codex 模型、图片输入与流式恢复，社区维护的非官方 DSH plugin。
description.en: Community Codex plugin for DeepSeek Harness: ChatGPT OAuth, Codex models, image input, and reliable stream recovery.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供人设库：内置大肥鱼、阿茶等人设，支持导入自定义人设，并在设置页免重启切换，自动注入到该 profile 下所有会话的系统提示词。
description.en: A persona library plugin for DeepSeek Harness: ships built-in personas, lets you import your own, and switches the active persona from the settings page without restarting, injecting it into every session's system prompt in that profile.

description.zh: DSH Tether 是 DeepSeek Harness 的移动客户端插件，通过 iroh 点对点直连，让手机跨网络远程使用开发机上的 DSH，无需服务器中转。
description.en: DSH Tether is a mobile client plugin for DeepSeek Harness, using iroh for peer-to-peer connection to remotely use DSH on your dev machine from your phone across networks, no server in between.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 一键换上 38 款 opencode 护眼配色，按色系分组、搜索即切，并支持字体与字号独立调节，缓解长时间编程的眼部疲劳。
description.en: Swap DeepSeek Harness into 38 eye-friendly opencode color schemes with one click, grouped by hue and searchable, plus independent font and size controls for long coding sessions.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy 账号模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，通过本地代理免 API Key 使用，并实时显示登录状态。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy models into DeepSeek Harness via a local proxy, no API key needed, with live login status widget.

description.zh: DSH 执行迷宫：将 Agent 真实干活过程画成时间轴，含数据轨道、失败恢复链与多会话对比，确定性分析不调 LLM。
description.en: The execution maze for DeepSeek Harness: visualize agent trajectories with timeline, data tracks, failure recovery chains, and multi-session comparison—deterministic, no LLM.

description.zh: 千星沙箱模拟器作为 DeepSeek Harness 插件，让 AI 在游戏外运行 Lua 脚本、编辑 UI 并试玩，完成编写到验证的开发闭环。
description.en: A Miliastra sandbox simulator DSH plugin that lets AI run Lua scripts, edit UI and playtest outside the game, closing the loop from coding to verification.

description.zh: DSH plugin 的 Prompt 工具箱：24 条深度模板随手点，/prompt 与智能推荐主动兜底，装好即用、可自定义。
description.en: A prompt toolbox for DeepSeek Harness: 24 deep templates at a click, with /prompt and smart suggestions as backup; out of the box, fully customizable.

description.zh: dsh-knowledge 是 DeepSeek Harness 的知识库插件，支持本地 SQLite 与远程中央知识库，提供多知识库管理、按需检索、自动回写及笔记工作区。
description.en: dsh-knowledge is a knowledge base plugin for DeepSeek Harness, supporting local SQLite and remote central knowledge bases with multi-KB management, on-demand retrieval, auto-writeback, and a note workspace.

description.zh: DSH plugin，在DeepSeek Harness Web右上角提供可折叠A股自选股实时行情弹窗，支持分组、分时K线、目标价提醒与投资研究。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a collapsible A-share watchlist popup to the top-right of DeepSeek Harness Web, with real-time quotes, groups, intraday/K-line charts, target price alerts, and investment research.

description.zh: dsh-secure-audit 是 DeepSeek Harness 的只读安全与合规插件，提供提示注入检测、中文 PII 脱敏及本地配置审计，并生成可复现的脱敏报告。
description.en: dsh-secure-audit is a read-only security & compliance plugin for DeepSeek Harness, offering prompt-injection detection, Chinese-PII redaction, and local configuration audit with reproducible redacted reports.

description.zh: DeepSeek Flow 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的可视化工作流编辑器，以 Markdown 为源，支持画布编辑、双向同步与 AI 辅助，让工作流设计直观且可移植。
description.en: DeepSeek Flow is a visual, Markdown-first workflow editor for DeepSeek Harness, offering canvas editing, two-way sync, and AI assistance for portable workflow design.

description.zh: dsh-pentester 是 DeepSeek Harness 的渗透测试插件，基于 PTES 流程编排子代理，通过 Docker 工具箱执行安全测试并生成报告。
description.en: dsh-pentester is a pentesting plugin for DeepSeek Harness, orchestrating subagents via PTES workflow and executing security tests through a Docker toolbox.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通过 ChatGPT 订阅接入 GPT 系列模型，提供 OAuth 登录、额度展示与子代理模型配置。
description.en: DSH plugin that uses ChatGPT subscription to access GPT models, with OAuth login, quota display, and subagent model configuration.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 桌面操作能力：截图、鼠标、键盘、窗口与剪贴板，由内置 Rust 助手完成原生调用。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness agents real Windows desktop control — screenshots, mouse, keyboard, windows and clipboard — powered by a bundled native Rust helper.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加服务器级认证网关，实现登录认证、自动 HTTPS、多租户权限与配额控制，使其可安全公网部署。
description.en: Adds a server-grade authentication gateway to DeepSeek Harness, enabling login, auto HTTPS, multi-tenant permissions and quotas for secure public deployment.

description.zh: DSH plugin 用于在每次对话请求前注入自定义系统提示词与参考对话，实现部署级提示词前缀控制，且不写入会话日志。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects custom system prompts and reference conversations ahead of every request, enabling deployment-level prompt prefix control without session-log writes.

description.zh: dsh-notify-me 是 DeepSeek Harness 的桌面提醒插件，当模型需要你审批、确认方案或提问，以及回复在后台跑完时，用系统通知、提示音和标签页标题把你叫回来。
description.en: dsh-notify-me is a desktop notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness that alerts you with system toasts, sounds and tab-title badges when the model needs your approval, plan review or answer, or when a reply finishes in the background.

description.zh: dsh-agent-team 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多智能体团队协作：以持久化 Workspace、Channel、Task 组织任务，让 Agent 作为真正协作者参与会话。
description.en: dsh-agent-team brings multi-agent team collaboration to DeepSeek Harness: durable Workspaces, Channels, and Tasks let agents act as true collaborators in sessions.

description.zh: dsh-web-search-pro 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供增强型持久化网页搜索，集成多引擎搜索、SQLite 缓存、平台搜索与 Playwright 渲染，共 11 个工具。
description.en: dsh-web-search-pro is an enhanced, persistent web search plugin for DeepSeek Harness, bundling multi-engine search, SQLite cache, platform backends, and Playwright rendering into 11 tools.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 控制中心，实时监控余额与用量、峰谷计费提醒、加密多账户切换、健康检查、充值与会话控制，让 DSH plugin 的账户状态尽在掌握。
description.en: DeepSeek Harness control center for live balance and usage monitoring, peak/off-peak pricing alerts, encrypted multi-account switching, health checks, recharge, and session controls.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Catppuccin 主题的 DSH plugin，支持 Latte/Frappé/Macchiato/Mocha 四色一键切换，并内置可调节的玻璃质感效果。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings Catppuccin themes to DeepSeek Harness, offering Latte/Frappé/Macchiato/Mocha palettes with one-click switching and adjustable glassmorphism.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 语音朗读插件，用豆包 TTS 自然音色朗读 AI 回复，支持点读、暂停与继续，BYOK 保护隐私。
description.en: A DSH plugin that reads AI replies aloud with Doubao TTS natural voices, featuring click-to-read, pause/resume, and BYOK privacy.

description.zh: dsh-taskboard 为 DeepSeek Harness 嵌入本地优先的任务看板，支持看板/列表/甘特/工作流/仪表盘多视图，数据存于本地 SQLite，并支持自动认领任务与 AI 对话。
description.en: dsh-taskboard embeds a local-first task board into DeepSeek Harness, offering Kanban/list/Gantt/workflow/dashboard views with local SQLite storage, auto-claim of tasks, and per-task AI chat.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生 Rapid-MLX 模型提供商，自动从服务器读取模型事实，免去手写配置，并支持模型管理工具。
description.en: A native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness that reads model facts from the server instead of settings.yaml, plus model management tools.

description.zh: DSH Remote 让手机安全访问 Mac 上运行的 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面，需本地明确授权后启动 FRPC 隧道，并在设置中提供二维码配对与逐机撤销。
description.en: DSH Remote lets a phone securely reach the DeepSeek Harness Web UI running on a Mac, starting a verified FRPC tunnel only after explicit local consent, with QR pairing and per-phone revocation in Settings.

description.zh: dsh-think-translate 是 DeepSeek Harness 的思维链翻译插件，实时将思考过程、任务卡片与回答翻译成 8 种语言，仅作用于显示层，不污染模型上下文。
description.en: dsh-think-translate is a DSH plugin that translates the thinking chain, task cards, and answers into 8 languages in real time, purely on the display layer without affecting model context.

description.zh: DSH plugin 喵丝滑，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供移动端 UI 交互优化与跨端通知，让手机端真正可用，支持 Tailscale 远程连接。
description.en: A DSH plugin that enhances DeepSeek Harness mobile UI interactions and cross-device notifications, making mobile truly usable with Tailscale remote access.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供完整的 Blender 3D 建模、重建、渲染、验证与导出工作流，注册 30 个技能与 13 个工具。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness a complete Blender 3D modeling, reconstruction, rendering, validation, and export workflow, registering 30 skills and 13 tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供中国公募基金确定性研究报告：输入基金代码即产出可溯源 Markdown 报告，每个关键数字都对应哈希快照，缺口如实声明。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns a Chinese public mutual fund code into a deterministic, versioned research report, where every key figure traces back to a hashed source snapshot and gaps are declared rather than invented.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在官方模型页卡片内为第三方模型提供推理努力级别与图像输入模态的编辑与自动适配，无需手写配置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings reasoning-effort and input-modality editing for third-party models into the official Models page card, with auto-adaptation.

description.zh: Codingns4DSH 把外部 Agent CLI、持久终端、Git 面板与局域网/中继远程访问装进 DSH 原生界面，让 DeepSeek Harness 成为统一编码工作台。
description.en: Codingns4DSH brings external agent CLIs, persistent terminals, Git panels and LAN/relay remote access into the native DSH interface, turning DeepSeek Harness into one unified coding workbench.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让 dsh web 支持远程启动与用户名/密码认证，安全暴露浏览器界面。
description.en: A DSH plugin enabling remote web launch with username/password auth for secure browser access.

description.zh: DSH with ChatGPT 让网页版 ChatGPT 直连本地项目，自主读写文件、跑命令与测试，并把复杂长任务交给原生 DSH 会话持续执行，省下大量 Token。
description.en: DSH with ChatGPT connects web ChatGPT to your local project so it can read and edit files, run commands and tests, then hand long-running work to native DSH sessions to save tokens.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件开发者提供 10 章开发指南、官方文档存档、迁移说明与 dsh-plugin-dev CLI 脚手架，作为 DSH 技能随会话按需加载。
description.en: A DSH plugin-development knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: a 10-chapter guide, official docs archive, migration notes and the dsh-plugin-dev CLI, loaded as an agent skill on demand.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 桌面操作能力：截图、鼠标、键盘、窗口与剪贴板，由内置 Rust 助手完成原生调用。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness agents real Windows desktop control — screenshots, mouse, keyboard, windows and clipboard — powered by a bundled native Rust helper.

description.zh: DeepRead 是 DSH plugin，为 AI Agent 提供证据优先的深度阅读，将文章、书籍、PDF 转化为可追溯的主张、证据、置信度与知识图谱。
description.en: DeepRead is a DSH plugin that enables evidence-first deep reading for AI agents, turning articles, books, and PDFs into traceable claims, evidence, confidence levels, and knowledge maps.

description.zh: 把 Qoder 国内版与国际版订阅模型通过 PAT 接入 DeepSeek Harness，双变体独立配置凭证与模型目录，支持侧栏额度展示与上下文窗口一键切换。
description.en: Connect Qoder CN and international subscription models to DeepSeek Harness via PAT, with independent credentials and catalogs per variant, sidebar quota cards, and one-click context window switching.

description.zh: dsh-agy 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Google Antigravity 模型访问，支持 OAuth 登录、多账号池、429 自动轮换、设备指纹及 CLI/Web 管理。
description.en: dsh-agy provides Google Antigravity model access for DeepSeek Harness, with OAuth login, multi-account pool, automatic 429 rotation, device fingerprinting, and CLI/Web management.

description.zh: DSH plugin 蕾米埃尔桌宠：由 DeepSeek Harness 真实会话事件驱动的多宠物网页桌宠，以贴纸动画与状态气泡实时汇报任务进展，支持桌面悬浮窗。
description.en: A DSH plugin pet desktop companion driven by real DeepSeek Harness session events, showing task progress via sticker animations and status bubbles, with optional desktop floating window.

description.zh: DSH plugin 侧边栏划选即问，内嵌问答不打断主对话，支持上下文摘要、嵌套追问与追问记录，实现类 Codex 侧边提问。
description.en: A DSH plugin enabling sidebar inline Q&A by selecting text, with context summarization, nested follow-ups, and follow-up history, without interrupting the main conversation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通过 unity CLI 驱动 Unity 编辑器，让 Agent 创建项目、执行场景命令、运行 C# 代码、测试与构建，实现 AI 辅助游戏开发。
description.en: A DSH plugin that drives the Unity Editor via the unity CLI, enabling agents to create projects, run scene commands, eval C#, test, and build games.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页上养一只会随任务、工具调用和会话状态切换表情的 Live2D 风格桌宠，支持拖动、缩放、互动与状态反馈。
description.en: Raise a Live2D-style desktop pet in DeepSeek Harness that switches expressions based on tasks, tool calls, and session states, with drag, zoom, and interaction support.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 Web 会话中的工具卡片与思考块自动折叠成一行摘要，让界面只保留模型回复，还原 VSCode Codex 式折叠体验。
description.en: A DSH plugin that auto-collapses tool cards and think blocks into one-line summaries in the Web chat, keeping only the model's reply for a Codex-like folding experience.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将中华传统智慧（玄枢）技能封装为本地优先的传统文化咨询工作流，支持八字、紫微、六爻、风水等排盘推演，并附带可视化 Dashboard。
description.en: A DSH plugin packaging the Chinese Traditional Wisdom (Xuan Shu) skill into a local-first consultation workflow, covering Bazi, Ziwei, Liuyao, Fengshui and more, with a visual Dashboard.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 better-sidebar 提供 Office 三件套（.docx/.xlsx/.pptx）预览，独立 bundle 瘦身主体，注册三个文件查看器。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds Office-suite preview (.docx/.xlsx/.pptx) to better-sidebar as a separate bundle, slimming the core by registering three file viewers.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供交付质量门禁：先拷问需求六维度，再以红绿测试与对抗评审证明交付，最后给出可交付或返工的判定。
description.en: A delivery quality gate for DeepSeek Harness: interrogate requirements, prove implementation with red/green evidence and adversary review, then gate the handoff with a deliverable-or-rework verdict.

description.zh: DSH 插件：任务结束或需要用户决策时，通过跨窗口悬浮面板、网页 toast 和系统通知弹窗提醒，类似 Codex / Claude Code 的体验。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pops up cross-window floating panels, web toasts, and system notifications when tasks finish or user decisions are needed, similar to Codex / Claude Code.

description.zh: dsh-quant 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 原生量化交易插件，提供 59 个工具覆盖数据、因子、回测、风控与执行，支持端到端量化研究流水线。
description.en: dsh-quant is an AI-native quant trading plugin for DeepSeek Harness, offering 59 tools across data, alpha, backtesting, risk, and execution with an end-to-end research pipeline.

description.zh: ax-feishu-bridge 是 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的飞书/Lark 消息桥接插件，让你在飞书聊天界面中远程与本机 DSH 持续协作，支持扫码建机器人、私聊群聊、图片附件与流式回复。
description.en: ax-feishu-bridge is a DSH plugin bridging Feishu/Lark messaging, letting you collaborate with your local DSH from chat, with QR bot setup, group chat, attachments, and streaming replies.

description.zh: DSH plugin 的 IM 网关，将微信等即时通讯桥接进 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent 会话，支持扫码登录与斜杠命令控制。
description.en: An IM gateway DSH plugin that bridges messengers like WeChat into DeepSeek Harness agent sessions, with QR login and slash command control.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中手声明的 llm-pi-ai 模型添加可配置的推理强度级别，支持多语言设置与子代理默认值，让推理控制更灵活。
description.en: Adds configurable reasoning effort levels to hand-declared llm-pi-ai models in DeepSeek Harness, with bilingual settings and subagent defaults.

description.zh: DSH Token Pet 是 DeepSeek Harness 的悬浮桌面宠物插件，用 12 个逐帧动作实时反馈请求、工具调用与上下文压缩，并可视化 Token 用量、Lifetime Ledger 与小时趋势。
description.en: DSH Token Pet is a desktop pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness that visualizes token usage and context with 12 frame-by-frame animations reflecting requests, tool calls, and context compression.

description.zh: dsh-ntr 让 DSH 网页/桌面端直接对接任意 ACP agent，用 DSH 界面与 CodeBuddy、Claude Code 等对话，推理与工具执行由外部 agent 自治完成。
description.en: dsh-ntr connects any ACP agent to the DSH web/desktop UI, so you chat with CodeBuddy, Claude Code and others through DSH while reasoning and tool execution stay inside the external agent.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让 AI 像资深测试工程师一样工作：全生命周期 QA Agent Skills 框架，含方法论、10 个 Skills 与可复现 Benchmark，覆盖需求分析到测试报告。
description.en: A DSH plugin that empowers AI to work like a senior QA engineer: a full-lifecycle QA Agent Skills framework with methodology, 10 skills, and reproducible benchmarks, from requirement analysis to test reports.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供确定性数据剖析、清洗与校验能力，全部计算由 TypeScript 完成，模型不参与算数，并通过 ctx.dataQuality 服务暴露三个模型工具。
description.en: Deterministic data profiling, cleaning and verification for DeepSeek Harness: all math runs in plain TypeScript, exposed as three model tools plus a ctx.dataQuality service seam.

description.zh: 把可编辑的 drawio 画布放进 DSH 右侧栏，并给模型 diagram_read / diagram_apply 两个工具，让人和 AI 就地读写同一份 .drawio 文件。
description.en: An editable drawio canvas in the DSH right sidebar plus diagram_read / diagram_apply tools, letting you and the model edit the same .drawio file in place.

description.zh: DSH plugin，在每次模型请求入口对工具输出进行可逆、结构感知的压缩，显著降低token成本而不损失模型智能。
description.en: A DSH plugin that reversibly and structure-aware compresses tool outputs at every model request entry, cutting token cost without sacrificing model intelligence.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于事件溯源的消息编辑、重掷、重试与版本时间线，支持分支式会话版本切换。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that enables event-sourced message editing, reroll, retry, and version timeline with branch-based session switching.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 加载并编辑 SillyTavern 预设，按顺序表在请求前注入消息，并按模式或会话精细控制工具开关与分组。
description.en: Loads and edits SillyTavern presets in DeepSeek Harness, injecting messages before requests and controlling tool switches and groups per mode or session.

description.zh: dsh-zotero 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Zotero 插件，让 Agent 直接检索文献、提取证据段落、打开 PDF 并生成引用，将文献库变为证据库。
description.en: dsh-zotero is a DSH plugin that turns your Zotero library into an evidence store, enabling agents to search papers, extract passages, open PDFs, and generate citations.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供俄语本地化：注册 30 个核心命名空间的俄语词典，并在语言列表中添加“俄语”选项，支持复数形式、排版优化和拼写检查。
description.en: Russian localization for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: registers Russian dictionaries for 30 core namespaces and adds a Russian option to the language list, with plural forms, typography, and spellcheck.

description.zh: YOLO 是 DeepSeek Harness 的个人智能助理插件，从对话中自动整理待办、目标和里程碑，跨会话保存、同步变化并按时提醒，帮你持续跟进重要事项。
description.en: YOLO is a personal assistant plugin for DeepSeek Harness that automatically extracts todos, goals, and milestones from conversations, saves them across sessions, tracks changes, and reminds you on time.

description.zh: DSH plugin 深度定制 Web 界面外观：自定义主题色、图片/视频壁纸，以及各界面部件的透明度与模糊度调节，并支持主题配置导出导入。
description.en: A DSH plugin to fully customize the Web UI: theme color, image/video wallpapers, per-part opacity & blur, with config export/import.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 Garmin Connect 健身与健康数据接入 DeepSeek Harness，让 AI 通过自然语言查询活动、睡眠、步数、心率等，并提供个性化跑步指导。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings Garmin Connect fitness and health data into DeepSeek Harness, enabling AI to query activities, sleep, steps, heart rate, and more via natural language, plus personalized running coaching.

description.zh: dsh-full-remote 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供带认证的反向代理网关，支持手机扫码、设备会话、Host/Origin 重写，实现安全的远程访问。
description.en: dsh-full-remote provides an authenticated reverse proxy gateway for DeepSeek Harness, enabling mobile QR access, per-device sessions, and Host/Origin rewrite for secure remote access.

description.zh: DSH 插件，将 DeepSeek 官方按量计费搜索一键切换为免费网页搜索（Parallel 默认 + Exa 备用，匿名免 key），并提供兼容 Claude Code / Codex 的双传输 MCP server。
description.en: DSH plugin that switches DeepSeek's metered search to free web search (Parallel default + Exa backup, anonymous no key), and provides a dual-transport MCP server compatible with Claude Code / Codex.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 WebUI 会话消息列渲染竖直时间轴，刻度对应每条用户消息，支持悬浮摘要、点击跳转与逐条导航，深浅色自适应。
description.en: A DSH plugin that renders a vertical timeline in the WebUI conversation column, with ticks per user message, hover summaries, click-to-jump, and step navigation, adapting to light/dark themes.

description.zh: DSH 插件，向模型暴露 MinerU 文档解析工具，将 PDF、图片、DOCX、PPTX、XLSX 等文件转换为结构化 Markdown/JSON，支持同步与异步解析。
description.en: A DSH plugin that exposes MinerU document-parsing tools to the model, converting PDF, images, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX into structured Markdown/JSON with sync and async parsing.

description.zh: DSH 插件，通过 CDP 操控浏览器：复用 Chrome 登录态、导航、截图、抓取控制台与网络错误、执行任意 JS，并注册为 agent 的 browser_* 工具。
description.en: DSH plugin for browser control via CDP: reuse Chrome login state, navigate, screenshot, capture console/network errors, eval JS, and register browser_* tools for agents.

description.zh: DSH plugin 会话树插件，可在任意历史回答上发起独立分支追问，并支持无限层级嵌套，主对话保持干净。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets you branch follow-up questions from any past answer into isolated, recursively nestable sessions while keeping the main conversation clean.

description.zh: dsh-emoji 为 DeepSeek Harness 回复加入可切换、自定义的行内表情，支持 Bilibili、小红书等多平台表情包，并允许上传自定义表情包。
description.en: dsh-emoji adds switchable, custom inline emojis to DeepSeek Harness replies, supporting emoji packs from Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, and more, plus custom uploads.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话长期记忆：自动摄取并蒸馏用户偏好与项目约定，混合检索随时召回，越用越准。
description.en: A cross-session long-term memory DSH plugin: it ingests and distills user preferences and project conventions, then recalls them via hybrid retrieval that improves with use.

description.zh: DSH PUA 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供任务推进能力：当 Agent 反复失败或未验证就宣称完成时，引导它换思路、查原因并给出证据。
description.en: DSH PUA pushes DeepSeek Harness agents to try another approach and verify results: when an agent keeps failing or claims completion without checking, it prompts investigation and evidence.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 /btw 侧边问答浮窗，输入框上方即时弹出答案，不打断也不污染主 Agent 循环。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness side-assistant dock that answers /btw quick questions in a floating banner above the composer without interrupting or polluting the main agent loop.

description.zh: Agent Team 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，可组建多智能体团队，每个成员独立模型、技能、MCP 工具与上下文，共享工作区协作。
description.en: Agent Team is a DSH plugin for building multi-agent teams with independent models, skills, MCP tools, contexts, and a shared workspace.

description.zh: Knit 把工作区里的 Markdown、图片与视频列进 DSH 侧边栏，按当前对话相关性排序并就地预览，同一排序还作为 knit_docs 工具供 agent 调用，零模型零联网。
description.en: Knit lists your workspace Markdown, images and video in the DSH sidebar, ranked by relevance to the current conversation with inline preview — the same ranking is exposed as a knit_docs tool so your agent reads one doc instead of five, with zero model calls and zero network.

description.zh: DSH 插件：在对话右缘提供节点导航条，按用户消息生成节点，悬停预览、点击跳转，支持固定窗口与历史加载，提升长对话浏览效率。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a node navigation rail on the right edge of conversations, with hover preview, click-to-jump, fixed window, and earlier-history loading for efficient long-chat browsing.

description.zh: DSH 消息撤回插件，一键将工作区文件和对话历史回退到消息发送前的状态，支持快照管理与增量存储。
description.en: DSH plugin for message recall, reverting workspace files and conversation history to the state before a message was sent, with snapshot management and delta storage.

description.zh: dsh-filesnap 是 DeepSeek Harness 的对话与文件回退插件，由 Rust 引擎驱动，无需 Git 即可把对话和它改过的文件一起恢复到某一轮之前，并支持 /redo 撤销回退。
description.en: dsh-filesnap is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that rewinds a conversation together with the files it changed, powered by a Rust core and requiring no Git, with /redo to undo a rewind.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供类 VSCode Remote-SSH 的远程开发能力，通过 SSH 连接远程服务器，在 DSH 内置文件与终端页签中直接操作远程文件和终端。
description.en: A DSH plugin offering VSCode Remote-SSH-like remote development, connecting to remote servers via SSH to operate remote files and terminal directly in DSH's built-in tabs.

description.zh: DSH plugin 科研论文写作守卫：去 AI 腔、守住证据、校准目标期刊风格，并检测交付物泄漏，全程本地离线运行。
description.en: A DSH plugin that guards academic writing: reduces AI-style, preserves evidence, calibrates journal fit, and detects delivery leakage, all local and offline.

description.zh: DSH plugin 会话工作台：对历史会话进行全文搜索与召回，并管理会话视图标签栏的显示/隐藏与拖拽排序，让旧会话触手可及。
description.en: A DSH plugin session workbench: full-text search and recall across past sessions, plus conversation-view tab management (show/hide + reorder).

description.zh: DSH plugin 让主对话直接驱动 SSH 运维，右侧提供实时终端，内置文件管理、端口转发与数据库管理，并带高危命令保护。
description.en: A DSH plugin that drives SSH ops from the main conversation, with a live right-side terminal, file management, port forwarding, and database management, plus high-risk command protection.

description.zh: DSH 个人工作台插件，集成日历、树状任务列表与 AI 澄清/拆解/执行/复盘，将 DeepSeek Harness 变为高效任务管理中枢。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns DeepSeek Harness into a personal workbench with calendar, hierarchical tasks, and AI-assisted clarify/decompose/execute/review workflow.

description.zh: DSH plugin 可复现科学工作台：agent 驱动单元格、内联图表反馈重绘、manifest 溯源与环境快照，让每个图与产物可追溯、可一键重跑。
description.en: A reproducible science workbench for DeepSeek Harness: agent-driven cells, inline figures with feedback/rerun, manifest provenance, and environment snapshots.

description.zh: DSH Remote 让手机安全访问 Mac 上运行的 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面，需本地明确授权后启动 FRPC 隧道，并在设置中提供二维码配对与逐机撤销。
description.en: DSH Remote lets a phone securely reach the DeepSeek Harness Web UI running on a Mac, starting a verified FRPC tunnel only after explicit local consent, with QR pairing and per-phone revocation in Settings.

description.zh: DSH-Code 是 DeepSeek Harness 的终端编码界面，将 Agent、模型、工具与持久会话带入 TUI，支持会话管理、模型切换动画与完整编码工作流。
description.en: DSH-Code is a terminal coding interface for DeepSeek Harness, bringing agents, models, tools, and persistent sessions into a TUI with session management, model-switch animations, and a full coding workflow.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中的纯文本模型借来一只眼睛，通过工具调用实现设计稿与实现的视觉比对，并附基准测试与原始输出。
description.en: Lend any text-only model in DeepSeek Harness an eye: a tool that enables visual design-fidelity QA against mockups, with a benchmark and raw transcripts included.

description.zh: dsh-lark-link 是 DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 双向桥接插件，扫码 30 秒上线，支持多模式 Agent、卡片化命令、零丢失消息与多媒体交互，让 DSH 智能体随时随地可用。
description.en: dsh-lark-link is a Feishu/Lark bridge plugin for DeepSeek Harness, enabling QR-code setup in 30 seconds, multi-mode agents, card-based commands, zero-loss messaging, and media in/out for on-the-go interaction.

description.zh: 通过腾讯官方 QQ 机器人平台把手机 QQ 接到 DSH，让你在手机上远程驱动 DeepSeek Harness 智能体收发文件、切换会话与模型。
description.en: Connects mobile QQ to DSH through Tencent's official QQ bot platform, letting you drive the DeepSeek Harness agent from your phone to send files, switch sessions and pick models.

description.zh: DSH plugin 用于审查 agent 刚修改的文件，在 Diff 面板查看变更、撤销编辑并添加评论，支持标准、PTC 和 Creator 模式。
description.en: A DSH plugin to review files an agent just changed, view diffs, undo edits, and comment on changes, supporting Standard, PTC, and Creator modes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 换上《你的名字。》电影主题：彗星蓝玻璃拟态、壁纸与 Logo 替换、输入卡重绘，一条 dsh plugin 命令安装，卸载即完全还原。
description.en: A Kimi no Na wa (Your Name) theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: comet-blue glassmorphism, movie wallpaper and logo swap, redesigned input card — installed with one dsh plugin command and fully reverted on uninstall.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 Web 输入框添加技能选择器，一键搜索点选已装技能并插入官方 /技能名 手势，随消息自动加载执行。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a skill picker to the composer, letting you search and pick installed skills, inserting the official /skill-name gesture to load them with your message.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上工作区目录视图：会话头部「Workspace Files」胶囊按钮弹出文件树面板，点击或拖拽文件即可把引用插入输入框，UI 与 DSH 原生风格一致。
description.en: Adds the missing workspace directory view to DeepSeek Harness: a "Workspace Files" pill in the session header opens a file tree panel where clicking or dragging a file inserts its reference into the composer, styled to match native DSH.

description.zh: Vibe Mathematics 是运行在 DeepSeek Harness 内的多代理数学求解与验证框架，提供四代 agent preset，支持断点续跑、人工干预与多代理交叉验证。
description.en: Vibe Mathematics is a multi-agent math solving and verification framework for DeepSeek Harness, offering four agent presets with resume, human intervention, and cross-validation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供可交互组件、HTML/SVG 图解与动画，模型可生成测验、图表、表单等原生界面并保存参数。
description.en: Interactive components, HTML/SVG diagrams and animation for DeepSeek Harness Web, letting the model render quizzes, charts and forms with persisted parameters.

description.zh: DSH plugin，将微信私聊桥接到 DeepSeek Harness，支持文本、图片、文件、音视频双向传输，并在微信内还原原生 slash 命令、审批卡与扫码登录体验。
description.en: A DSH plugin bridging WeChat private chats to DeepSeek Harness, enabling bidirectional text/image/file/audio transfer, native slash commands, approval cards, and QR login in WeChat.

description.zh: dsh-better-edit 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于哈希锚点的编辑工具，替代行号定位，减少 token 消耗，提升编辑准确性。
description.en: Hash-anchored read/edit/undo tools for DeepSeek Harness, reducing token usage and improving edit accuracy.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让 DeepSeek Harness 在 Windows 上全面使用 Git Bash，替换 PowerShell 执行器并为各模式物化 Git Bash 版 agent preset，解决 WSL 占位问题。
description.en: DSH plugin that makes DeepSeek Harness use Git Bash on Windows, replacing the PowerShell executor and materializing Git Bash agent presets for all modes.

description.zh: DSH plugin 纯前端界面定制插件，提供壁纸毛玻璃主题、强调色、快捷键、用量统计、历史记录条、用户消息 Markdown 渲染与动效，零 shell 改动。
description.en: A pure-frontend DSH plugin for customizing the web surface: wallpaper & frosted-glass themes, accent colors, custom shortcuts, usage stats, history strip, user-message Markdown, and motion effects — zero shell edits.

description.zh: DSH Local Share 是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于将选中的会话轮次本地导出为 Markdown、自包含 HTML 或长图，支持隐私脱敏且无需上传。
description.en: DSH Local Share is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that exports selected conversation turns locally as Markdown, self-contained HTML, or long PNG, with privacy-first redaction and no uploads.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入飞书/Lark，扫码即用，支持流式卡片、并行任务、多角色 Agent、跨会话通知及崩溃自愈的安全网守护。
description.en: A DSH plugin bridging DeepSeek Harness into Feishu/Lark with scan-to-connect, streaming cards, parallel tasks, multi-role agents, cross-session notify, and a self-healing safety net.

description.zh: DSH plugin 桥接 Better DeepSeek 浏览器扩展，通过 webServer 提供握手与 SSE 事件流，支持会话创建、任务提交与结果获取。
description.en: A DSH plugin bridging the Better DeepSeek Chrome extension, offering HTTP handshake and SSE event streams via webServer for session management and task execution.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 的创建、读取与更新工具，路径安全且支持 PPT 图片嵌入。
description.en: Office tools for DeepSeek Harness: create/read/update Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files with workspace-safe paths and PPT image embedding.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多任务「减震」模式：主对话只做规划与汇总，文件读写、命令、搜索、构建全部交给子代理执行，主上下文只保留高价值信息。
description.en: A multitask "shock absorber" mode for DeepSeek Harness: the main chat only plans and summarizes, while file reads, commands, search and builds all run inside subagent contexts, keeping the main context clean.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供局域网/远程访问支持，通过注入 polyfill 修复非安全上下文下 crypto.randomUUID 缺失导致的会话与模型无法渲染问题。
description.en: Provides LAN/remote access support for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI by injecting a polyfill to fix crypto.randomUUID unavailability in insecure contexts, which otherwise breaks session and model rendering.

description.zh: 将 OpenCode Zen 免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，自动同步模型目录与元数据，支持 1M 上下文，即装即用。
description.en: Integrate OpenCode Zen free models into DeepSeek Harness, auto-syncing model catalog and metadata with 1M context support, ready to use after install.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话事件感知 Galgame 引擎与界面插件，工作间隙与鲸鱼娘等多位模型娘互动，支持桌宠、小剧场与好感度养成。
description.en: A cross-session event-aware Galgame engine and UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness, letting you interact with whale girl and other model girls during work breaks, with desktop pet, mini-dramas, and affection system.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Q 版蓝发鲸鱼女仆桌宠，陪伴工作、统计任务完成用时与 Token 花费，支持睡眠、天气、喂食与完整设置面板。
description.en: A chibi blue-haired whale maid desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness, accompanying your work, tracking task time and token costs, with sleep, weather, feeding, and full settings panel.

description.zh: dsh-genui 让 DeepSeek Harness 的回复从纯文本变成可交互界面：图表、表单、计算器、仪表盘等小应用内联渲染，操作结果回流给模型继续对话。
description.en: dsh-genui turns DeepSeek Harness replies from plain text into interactive UI: charts, forms, calculators, dashboards, and mini apps rendered inline, with actions flowing back to the model.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供悬浮工具箱面板，统一管理 MCP 服务与技能：查看工具 JSON Schema、双作用域启停、跨客户端导入与技能市场安装。
description.en: A floating toolbox panel for DeepSeek Harness Web that manages MCP servers and skills in one place: inspect tool JSON Schemas, toggle dual-scope configs, import from other clients, and install from the skill market.

description.zh: dsh-interconnect 是 DSH plugin，实现跨实例消息互通与事件通知，支持持久 WebSocket 链路、活性探测与双向事件推送。
description.en: dsh-interconnect is a DSH plugin enabling cross-instance messaging and event notification over persistent WebSocket links with liveness probing and bidirectional event streaming.

description.zh: DSH plugin 本地优先跨会话项目记忆：JSON SSOT 与 PROJECT_MEMORY.md、有界 Hot Memory、BM25 召回、生命周期与来源追踪，无需 embedding 或外部服务。
description.en: Local-first cross-session project memory for DeepSeek Harness: JSON SSOT + PROJECT_MEMORY.md, bounded Hot Memory, BM25 retrieval, lifecycle and provenance, no embeddings or external services.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上会话真删除能力：在会话菜单中彻底移除日志、工作区记录与投影检查点，并以树状视图展示该会话派生的子智能体与分叉对话，支持批量勾选删除。
description.en: Adds real conversation deletion to DeepSeek Harness: a Delete row in each session menu that removes logs, workspace records and projection checkpoints, plus a tree view of the subagents and forked conversations a session spawned for bulk selection.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的助手回复添加 Xiaomi MiMo TTS 语音朗读，支持流式播放、自定义音色与文本清洗。
description.en: Adds Xiaomi MiMo TTS voice playback to DeepSeek Harness assistant replies, with streaming, custom voices, and text cleaning.

description.zh: DSH plugin 原生侧边栏用量面板，实时展示官方余额与基于会话日志的 token 用量历史，零额外进程与跨域调用。
description.en: A native sidebar usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: live official balance and token usage history from session logs, with zero footprint.

description.zh: AI4Scholar 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 38 个学术工具，覆盖 Semantic Scholar、PubMed、Google Scholar、arXiv 等，支持搜索、下载、自动引用与科学绘图。
description.en: AI4Scholar delivers 38 native academic tools for DeepSeek Harness, covering Semantic Scholar, PubMed, Google Scholar, arXiv, with search, download, auto-cite, and scientific figure tools.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 综合性增强插件，提供界面优化、布局调整、提示词注入等功能，支持中文补全、统计全显示、自动展开思考、自动归档等。
description.en: A comprehensive enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness, offering UI polish, layout tweaks, prompt injection, and more, including Chinese completion, full stats display, auto-expand thinking, auto-archive, etc.

description.zh: UltraMath 是 DeepSeek Harness 生态首个数学建模竞赛专用 DSH 插件，以 5 角色预设 + 33 篇模型库驱动「读题到审稿」全流程，内置三席盲评与学术诚信门控。
description.en: UltraMath is the first math modeling contest plugin in the DeepSeek Harness ecosystem, driving the full pipeline from problem reading to review with 5 agent presets and a 33-doc model library, featuring triple-blind review and academic integrity gates.

description.zh: 为 DSH 的 IM 机器人本体 dsh-im 加上「助理与家」面板：哪个工作区有助理在管、是否在线一屏看清，拖拽即可搬家，并增强原生会话状态提示。
description.en: A DSH plugin that layers an assistant-and-home panel onto the dsh-im bot: see which workspace each assistant lives in and whether it is online, drag to relocate, plus enhanced native session status.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上归档会话管理入口，在 Web UI 设置面板中列出、恢复或彻底删除已归档会话，操作即时生效无需重启。
description.en: Adds a missing archive-session manager to DeepSeek Harness: list, restore, or permanently delete archived sessions from the Web UI settings panel, with changes applied instantly and no restart.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 精读工作流插件：输入书籍、论文、视频或网页，由并行子代理分块精读并合并，输出带引用与质量校验的 Obsidian 笔记。
description.en: A DSH plugin that deep-reads books, papers, videos, or web pages via parallel subagents, merging into an Obsidian-ready note with citations and quality checks.

description.zh: dsh-automation 让 DeepSeek Harness 用户用一句话调度一次性或周期性 Agent 任务，支持精确时间、RRULE 复发规则与权限控制，并在侧边栏统一管理。
description.en: dsh-automation lets DeepSeek Harness users schedule one-time or recurring Agent tasks with a single sentence, supporting precise times, RRULE recurrence, and permission control, all managed from the sidebar.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 注入赛博朋克 2077 夜之城主题：CRT 扫描线、Kiroshi 锁定、合成音效与彩蛋，纯浏览器端零音频资源。
description.en: A Cyberpunk 2077 Night City theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, featuring CRT scanlines, Kiroshi lock-on, synthesized SFX and easter eggs, all client-side with zero audio assets.

description.zh: DSH plugin 技能中枢：在 dsh Web 界面内浏览、搜索、启用/禁用、诊断并新建本地技能，基于官方 ctx.skills 注册表，支持市场导入与统计。
description.en: In-GUI skill hub for DeepSeek Harness: browse, search, toggle, diagnose and scaffold local skills from the official ctx.skills registry, with market import and stats.

description.zh: 把 Obsidian 变成自组织 AI 第二大脑的 DSH plugin，提供 wiki 检索、写入、体检与脚手架工具及配套技能，让笔记库可被 Agent 直接读写维护。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns Obsidian into a self-organizing AI second brain, exposing wiki query, write, lint and scaffold tools plus matching skills so agents can read and maintain your vault.

description.zh: dsh-tavern 是 DeepSeek Harness 的角色卡/世界书管理插件，导入 SillyTavern 格式角色卡即可开始角色扮演，支持多预设与智能关键词注入。
description.en: dsh-tavern is a DSH plugin for managing character cards and world books, enabling roleplay by importing SillyTavern-format cards, with multi-preset support and smart keyword injection.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 Minecraft 开发提供技能、工具与子代理，覆盖 Paper/Fabric/Forge/NeoForge 全时代模组与插件开发。
description.en: DSH plugin providing skills, tools, and subagents for Minecraft development across Paper/Fabric/Forge/NeoForge eras.

description.zh: picturereader 是 DeepSeek Harness 的视觉插件，为纯文本模型提供看图、OCR、文档转图与本地修图能力，支持隐私/智能/严谨三模式路由。
description.en: picturereader is a DSH plugin that gives text-only models image reading, OCR, document-to-image, and local editing, with privacy/smart/strict routing.

description.zh: DSH plugin 的飞书 UI，面板驱动控制台：每个斜杠命令都是卡片按钮，卡内审批与提问，流式卡片，扫码一键配置。
description.en: The Feishu UI for DeepSeek Harness: a panel-driven control console where every slash command is a button, with in-card approvals, live streaming cards, and one-QR setup.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供三栏工作台，集成智能终端、Agent 控制平面、用量面板、Ultra Slash 命令与 Canvas 预览，增强开发与调试体验。
description.en: A workbench plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web UI, adding a three-column layout with smart terminal, Agent Control Plane, Usage panel, Ultra Slash commands, and Canvas previews to boost development and debugging.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一站式 MCP 与技能管理面板，支持工具级开关、密钥打码、场景记忆与技能回收站，八栏界面即装即用。
description.en: A unified MCP and skills manager for DeepSeek Harness, with per-tool toggles, secret masking, scenario memory and a skill trash bin in an eight-tab panel.

description.zh: DSH plugin 常驻注入 Ponytail 懒高级工程师规范，精简版系统提示词按会话切换档位，完整规则与 5 个同伴技能落盘为仅用户可调用的 / 技能。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects the Ponytail lazy-senior-engineer ruleset, with a compact always-on system prompt switchable per session and the full ruleset plus 5 companion skills as user-only / skills.

description.zh: DSH plugin 流萤主题，为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供萤火绿霓虹配色、动态壁纸、开屏动画、氛围粒子、背景音乐与打字音效。
description.en: A DSH plugin theme for DeepSeek Harness Web UI, featuring firefly neon colors, dynamic wallpapers, splash animation, ambient particles, background music, and typing sounds.

description.zh: DSH 远程与移动端安全网关插件，零改动底层代码安全开放 Tailscale 与局域网访问，支持扫码配对、RSA 加密与防暴力破解。
description.en: DSH plugin for secure remote & mobile access, safely exposing Tailscale/LAN with zero core modifications, QR pairing, RSA encryption & brute-force defense.

description.zh: DSH 语音输入插件：点按或按住 Alt 说话，实时转文字插入输入框，支持本地离线、浏览器及云端多引擎，零配置开箱即用。
description.en: Voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness: tap or hold Alt to talk, get text in the composer, with local offline, browser, and cloud ASR engines, zero-config by default.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补齐 LSP 动作面：诊断、格式化、补全、代码操作、符号、签名帮助、内联提示与重命名，让 Agent 在真实语言服务器反馈下写改代码。
