description.en: Completes the LSP action surface for DeepSeek Harness: diagnostics, formatting, completion, code actions, symbols, signature help, inlay hints and rename, giving agents real language-server feedback while editing code.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自动备份会话、配置与自定义目录，支持定时或手动打包为 zip 并自动轮换，保障数据安全。
description.en: A DSH plugin that automates backups of sessions, config and custom directories, packing them into zip archives with scheduled or manual runs and rotation.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 QA 编排插件：让 Agent 像真实用户一样探索应用并留存证据，再把路径导出为确定性回放场景，每次发版自动重跑。
description.en: A QA orchestration plugin for DeepSeek Harness: an agent explores your app like a real user with evidence-backed findings, then exports the explored path as a deterministic replay scenario you rerun every release.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加专用 Claude 提供商类型，自动发现 Anthropic 模型并写入原生推理参数，免去手动编辑 settings.yaml。
description.en: Adds a dedicated Claude provider type to DeepSeek Harness, with native Anthropic model discovery and automatic reasoning-parameter defaults, eliminating manual settings.yaml edits.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 编码代理接入飞书/Lark 群聊的 DSH plugin：一个群对应一个项目目录与固定运行时，消息直达代理并流式回帖。
description.en: A DSH plugin that bridges DeepSeek Harness coding agents into Feishu/Lark group chats — one group, one project directory, one pinned runtime, with streamed replies.

description.zh: DSH 会话管理插件，在侧边栏原生界面中搜索归档会话、一键恢复历史，并安全永久删除聊天记录，保护隐私。
description.en: A DSH plugin to manage chat history from the native sidebar: search archives, restore sessions, and safely delete conversations.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 Live2D 桌宠，实时镜像 Agent 状态并支持互动陪伴，内置多款宽松许可模型。
description.en: Adds a Live2D desktop pet to DeepSeek Harness, mirroring agent state in real-time with interactive companionship and curated permissive-license models.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供多套可热切换的品牌皮肤，支持壁纸、标语与通透度个性化，一键即可回到官方界面。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness Web multiple hot-swappable brand skins, with per-skin wallpaper, tagline and translucency customization and one-click return to the official UI.

description.zh: 一只住在 DeepSeek Harness 里也能独立上桌的养成小猪，可成长、上学、打工、钓鱼、换肤，零 token 消耗。
description.en: A virtual pet pig living inside DeepSeek Harness or on your desktop, with growth, school, jobs, fishing and skins — zero token cost.

description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供只读的DWG/DXF工具，可检查、提取并导出CAD图纸，支持SVG/PNG预览和DWG转DXF，不修改源文件。
description.en: Read-only DWG/DXF tools for DeepSeek Harness: inspect, extract and export CAD drawings with SVG/PNG previews and DWG-to-DXF conversion, without modifying the source file.

description.zh: dsh-advisor 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供独立模型审查：每步工具调用后由审查模型审计操作，发现风险时注入 [advisor] 指导，帮助 Agent 自我纠正。
description.en: dsh-advisor provides independent-model advisory review for DeepSeek Harness: after each tool step, a reviewer model audits operations and injects guidance when concerns are found.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏摆一盘 15×15 五子棋，让 DeepSeek 或任意已配置模型执子对弈，还能双 AI 对战、分侧编辑黑白提示词。
description.en: A DSH plugin that puts a 15×15 Gomoku board in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, letting DeepSeek or any configured model play you, or two AIs battle it out with separately editable prompts.

description.zh: DSH Origin Plugin 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 对话直接驱动本机 Origin 科学绘图软件，自动绘制折线、散点、柱状等图表并导出 PNG/SVG，实现期刊级排版与统计批处理。
description.en: DSH Origin Plugin lets DeepSeek Harness AI chat drive local Origin scientific plotting via MCP, auto-creating line/scatter/column charts and exporting PNG/SVG with journal-grade styling and statistics.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的论文伴读工作台：PDF 转录检索、内置阅读器与原生会话伴读，选中即问、引用跳页、中英对照，像老师一样带读文献。
description.en: A paper-reading workbench plugin for DeepSeek Harness: PDF transcription and search, a built-in PDF.js reader, and native session-based tutoring with ask-on-select, citation jump and bilingual text.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供提醒音效：Agent 等待审批或任务完成时播放提示音、发送系统通知并在任务栏标题标记，看过即静音。
description.en: A DSH plugin that chimes when the agent needs your decision or finishes a task, with OS notifications and a taskbar title mark that go quiet once seen.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在发送框左侧加星形按钮，一键把草稿重写为更清晰的提示词，可恢复原文，并支持自定义模板。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a star button beside the composer send action to rewrite your draft into a clearer prompt, with one-click restore and editable templates.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框旁一键改写草稿提示词，自动补全目标、格式与边界，只改不发，可随时撤销。
description.en: A DSH plugin that rewrites your composer draft in place, filling in goal, format and boundaries without ever sending it — undo anytime.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 Web 界面提供会话完成、失败、提问、权限请求四种状态的通知，支持声音与浏览器系统通知，可自定义音频。
description.en: A DSH plugin that notifies you on session completion, failure, question, and permission request, with sounds and browser notifications, plus custom audio.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 Wallpaper Engine 动态壁纸实时同步为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面背景，支持场景壁纸动效与视觉调节。
description.en: A DSH plugin that syncs Wallpaper Engine dynamic wallpapers as the DeepSeek Harness web background, with scene effects and visual adjustments.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 DeepSeek 官网右侧对话导航栏 1:1 移植到 DeepSeek Harness 聊天界面，支持书签标记、丝滑跳转与回退撤回联动。
description.en: A DSH plugin that ports DeepSeek's official right-side chat navigation rail (ScrollNav) 1:1 into the DeepSeek Harness chat UI, with bookmarking, smooth jump, and rewind integration.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 MCP 服务与 Skills 管理面板：在侧边栏增删改 MCP 行、扫描导入其他 Agent 配置，并统一管理技能启停与编辑。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds an MCP server and Skills management panel to DeepSeek Harness: edit MCP entries, import configs from other agents, and manage skill toggles and edits.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness web 提供 Codex 风格侧边聊天与划选注释，可 fork 主会话至侧栏多轮对话，并将选中文本与注解作为上下文发送。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings Codex-style side chat and selection annotations to DeepSeek Harness web, forking sessions into a persistent side panel and quoting selections into context.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化、可搜索的项目记忆：决策、规则与会话上下文存入 DuckDB，规则注入每次模型请求，并提供 Web 管理界面。
description.en: Persistent, searchable per-project memory for DeepSeek Harness: decisions, rules, and session context in DuckDB, with rules injected into every model request and a full management UI.

description.zh: persona-forge 是一款 DSH plugin，能把导出的聊天记录蒸馏成可扮演的人设，让 AI 用对方的语气说话，并支持直接对话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that distills exported chat logs into a playable persona, letting the AI talk in that person's style and hold conversations with it.

description.zh: 深迹 DeepTrace 是 DSH 插件，从会话事件日志生成日报/周报/月报/年报及自定义区间报告，提供确定性洞察与协作复盘，只读不改写历史。
description.en: DeepTrace is a DSH plugin that generates daily/weekly/monthly/yearly/custom reports from session event logs, offering deterministic insights and collaboration review, read-only without altering history.

description.zh: 把 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 与 Hermes 的会话、记忆、技能和斜杠命令迁移进 DeepSeek Harness，转成可续聊的 DSH 会话，只读复制且需审批。
description.en: A DSH plugin that migrates Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Hermes sessions, memories, skills and slash commands into DeepSeek Harness as resumable sessions — copy-only and approval-gated.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供统一检查点：每次改动前自动快照工作区、会话与配置三态，一条 /rewind 命令即可整体或分项回滚。
description.en: Unified checkpoints for DeepSeek Harness: snapshot workspace, session cursor and config before every mutation, then roll any of the three back with a single /rewind command.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 llm-pi-ai 模型按路由维护准确的 contextWindow，避免长会话被误判为上下文溢出，让回答与 /compact 压缩正常完成。
description.en: Maintains accurate per-route contextWindow values for llm-pi-ai models in DeepSeek Harness, preventing long sessions from being misflagged as context overflow so replies and /compact keep working.

description.zh: dsh-codex-sync 是 DeepSeek Harness 与 OpenAI Codex 的双向桥接插件，实现会话同步、技能挂载与 MCP 镜像，让开发者在两个工具间无缝切换。
description.en: dsh-codex-sync is a two-way bridge between DeepSeek Harness and OpenAI Codex, enabling chat sync, skills mounting, and MCP mirroring for seamless workflow continuity.

description.zh: DSH 视频创作技能插件，安装即注册 Remotion 官方移植技能，支持 React 编程式视频制作，含 38 个规则文件。
description.en: DSH plugin that registers the official Remotion skill for programmatic video creation with React, including 38 rule files.

description.zh: DSH plugin 会话档案中心：按工作区浏览、全文搜索归档聊天，支持只读预览、历史恢复为副本、ZIP 备份与可撤销回收站，数据全留本机。
description.en: A local-first session archive center for DeepSeek Harness: browse and full-text search archived chats, with read-only preview, restore-as-copy, ZIP backups, and a reversible recycle bin.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供受控浏览器自动化能力，通过 agent_browser 工具驱动 agent-browser CLI 操作 Chromium，并防护失效引用、标签漂移与敏感信息泄露。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness controlled browser automation: an agent_browser tool drives the agent-browser CLI against Chromium, guarding against stale refs, tab drift and secret leakage.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供办公效率技能专家组，通过标准技能注册表安装 excel2insights 与 sum2slides-pro 两个纯本地技能，无需手动复制文件。
description.en: Provides an office productivity skill suite for DeepSeek Harness, installing excel2insights and sum2slides-pro via the standard skills registry with no manual file copying.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Web 侧栏与右上角提供子代理实时监控面板，展示运行状态、用量明细与总体看板，支持逐层查看与自由摆放。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding a subagent monitor panel to the Web sidebar and top-right corner, showing live status, usage details, and an overview dashboard with drill-down navigation.

description.zh: 把 Qoder 国内版与国际版模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持多账号池、每日签到、积分只读概览与自动换号故障转移。
description.en: Connects Qoder (Lingma CN and international) models to DeepSeek Harness with a multi-account PAT pool, daily check-in, read-only credits overview, and automatic failover.

description.zh: DSH plugin 邮件工具，让 agent 通过 IMAP/SMTP 查收、阅读、搜索、发送邮件及附件，内置八大邮箱预设，纯 Node 全平台。
description.en: Email tools for DeepSeek Harness agents: list, read, search, send mail and attachments via IMAP/SMTP, with presets for eight providers, pure Node cross-platform.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏叠加工作区主题分组树，支持 emoji 分组、筛选搜索、三级拖拽排序与批量归档、安全永久删除。
description.en: A DSH plugin that overlays a topic-group tree onto the native workspace sidebar, adding emoji groups, filtering, drag-and-drop ordering, batch archive and safe permanent deletion.

description.zh: 为中国传统色打造 DeepSeek Harness 主题包，49 种锚色 × 明暗共 98 套主题，覆盖全部 token 词汇并满足 WCAG AA 对比度。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness theme pack of Chinese traditional colors, offering 98 themes (49 anchors × light/dark) with full token coverage and WCAG AA contrast.

description.zh: DSH plugin 记录项目踩坑与用户编码习惯，在后续对话中自动注入记忆，让 AI 越用越懂你。
description.en: A DSH plugin that records project pitfalls and user coding habits, injecting them into future conversations so the AI gets smarter with use.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 GitHub 仓库与 issue 检索、详情及文件读取工具，匿名可用，可选只读 token 解锁代码搜索。
description.en: A DSH plugin that equips DeepSeek Harness with GitHub repository and issue search, detail retrieval, and file reading tools, anonymous by default with optional read-only token for code search.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 移植 Matt Pocock 的 25 个真实工程师技能，注册到 host 技能表，供 agent 会话加载使用。
description.en: Ports Matt Pocock's 25 real-engineer skills to DeepSeek Harness, registering them in the host skill registry for agent sessions.

description.zh: 为 DSH 会话界面标签栏新增 Git 页，直接在浏览器里查看改动、暂存提交、看 diff、翻历史、切分支与推拉。
description.en: Adds a Git tab to the DSH conversation view, letting you review changes, stage and commit, read diffs, browse history, switch branches, and push or pull right in the browser.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通过本地 OAuth 接入 SuperGrok、ChatGPT Codex、Kimi Code、Claude Code 等订阅服务，无需粘贴 API key 即可在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings coding-subscription OAuth (SuperGrok, ChatGPT Codex, Kimi Code, Claude Code) into DeepSeek Harness without pasting API keys.

description.zh: 把本地 ChatGPT Web 会话桥接成 DeepSeek Harness 的零成本模型提供商，无需 API Key 即可流式输出 Markdown 与代码。
description.en: Bridges your local ChatGPT Web session into DeepSeek Harness as a $0 API-free model provider, streaming Markdown and code without any OpenAI API key.

description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端的历史消息可原地编辑，支持正文、附件、文件引用与模型设置修改，并可分支重生成、切换版本时间线。
description.en: Lets DeepSeek Harness desktop edit past messages in place, covering text, attachments, file references and model settings, with branch regeneration and a version timeline.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将内置 web_search 工具接入 TinyFish Search API，每次查询仅一次 GET 请求，无需模型调用，快速且免费。
description.en: A DSH plugin that backs the built-in web_search tool with the TinyFish Search API — one GET per query, no model call, fast and free.

description.zh: DSH plugin 用量统计面板：按天 Token 趋势、GitHub 风格活跃热力图、缓存命中率曲线与按模型用量拆分，在设置页新增“使用统计”页面。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing a usage statistics panel with per-day token trends, GitHub-style activity heatmap, cache hit-rate curve, and per-model breakdown, adding a "Usage Statistics" page to settings.

description.zh: 面向 aeval 的 DSH 评测控制插件，一次性注入实验变量、预算封顶与 fork 血统，并把证据归属密封成可校验的 bundle descriptor。
description.en: A host-side DSH plugin for aeval that injects experiment variables, budget caps and fork lineage in one shot, sealing evidence attribution into a verifiable bundle descriptor.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 桌面操作能力：截图、鼠标、键盘、窗口与剪贴板，由内置 Rust 助手完成原生调用。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness agents real Windows desktop control — screenshots, mouse, keyboard, windows and clipboard — powered by a bundled native Rust helper.

description.zh: DSH plugin 红头公文生成器，两阶段流水线（LLM 结构化提纲 + 确定性 Word 2003 XML 渲染）产出标准版式公文。
description.en: A DSH plugin that generates standard red-head official documents via a two-stage pipeline (LLM structured outline + deterministic Word 2003 XML rendering).

description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，复用本机登录状态，模型分组自动出现在模型选择器里，零配置即可使用。
description.en: Bridges WorkBuddy desktop app models into DeepSeek Harness, reusing the local login so model groups appear in the model picker with zero configuration.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web profile 提供树外认证 Bundle，通过公共认证代理保护 HTTP、RPC、SSE 与 WebSocket，支持账号、IP 白名单、验证码与会话管理。
description.en: An out-of-tree auth bundle for DeepSeek Harness Web profile, protecting HTTP, RPC, SSE and WebSocket via a public auth proxy, with accounts, IP whitelist, captcha and session management.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框下方提供实时余额读数：用本机 token 消耗推算 API 余额与可用时长，按峰谷分档计价并自动校准。
description.en: A live balance readout for DeepSeek Harness: it projects your API balance and time-to-empty from this machine's own token usage, priced by peak/off-peak tiers with self-calibration.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web composer 添加本地文件上传按钮，支持多选、粘贴文件，自动存入工作区 .dsh-uploads/ 目录并生成 @ 引用，全程本地传输。
description.en: Adds a local-file upload button to the DeepSeek Harness Web composer, supporting multi-select and paste, storing files in .dsh-uploads/ with @ references, all over local loopback.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让用户通过飞书或 Lark 直接与 Harness Agent 对话，复用模型、工具、系统提示与会话存储，无需公网服务器。
description.en: DSH plugin enabling chat with Harness Agent via Feishu or Lark, reusing models, tools, prompts and sessions without a public server.

description.zh: dsh-ears 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供语音输入能力，支持本地 GPU Whisper 与主流 STT API，并带 LLM 润色整理，让纯文本对话拥有一对耳朵。
description.en: dsh-ears adds voice input to DeepSeek Harness, supporting local GPU Whisper and mainstream STT APIs with LLM text polishing, giving plain-text conversations a pair of ears.

description.zh: Flowglass 是 DeepSeek Harness 的英文版会话流程可视化插件，把用户消息、助手回复、工具调用、并行任务与子代理渲染成可交互的执行图谱，并集成原生右侧边栏。
description.en: Flowglass is an English-only session flow visualizer DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that renders user messages, assistant replies, tool calls, parallel work, and subagents as an interactive execution graph inside the native right sidebar.

description.zh: DSH 暂停插件在 agent/pre-step 处拉门，让 DeepSeek Harness 在下一轮模型请求前停下等你按回车放行，输入框照常可打字插话，模型上下文完整无感知。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gates the agent at pre-step, pausing DeepSeek Harness right before its next model request until you press Enter; the composer stays usable for steering and the model never notices.

description.zh: DSH plugin 深度定制 DeepSeek Harness 界面外观：主题色、壁纸/视频背景、毛玻璃与半透明效果，实时生效，WebUI 与桌面端通用。
description.en: A DSH plugin for deep UI customization in DeepSeek Harness: theme colors, wallpaper/video backgrounds, glassmorphism and translucency, applied live across WebUI and Desktop.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供长期记忆：四通道检索融合加后台记忆演化，让 agent 跨会话记住项目约定、决策与踩过的坑。
description.en: A long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): four-channel retrieval fusion plus background memory evolution, so agents recall project conventions, decisions and pitfalls across sessions.

description.zh: dsh-router-laya 是一个 DSH 插件，用本地微调小模型为每条消息自动选择 low/high/max 思考档位，省钱提速且文本不出本机。
description.en: dsh-router-laya is a DSH plugin that uses a locally fine-tuned classifier to auto-pick low/high/max thinking effort per message, cutting cost and latency while keeping prompts on-device.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的嵌入式 C/C++ 固件开发插件，提供 FreeRTOS、Keil、HardFault 等 8 项技能与 1% Rule 纪律，助力固件工程。
description.en: A DSH plugin for embedded C/C++ firmware engineering, offering 8 skills (FreeRTOS, Keil, HardFault, etc.) and 1% Rule discipline.

description.zh: DSH 插件，完整移植 obra/superpowers 的 14 个中文技能，注入 ctx.skills，开箱即用，强制方法论驱动开发。
description.en: A DSH plugin porting obra/superpowers with 14 Chinese skills injected into ctx.skills, ready to use, enforcing methodology-driven development.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提示词优化器，将随手写的指令自动改写成专业、可直接使用的提示词，支持迭代改写、情境感知与自迭代学习，提升 AI 输出质量。
description.en: A DSH plugin that rewrites casual instructions into professional, ready-to-use prompts, with iterative refinement, context awareness, and self-improving learning to boost AI output quality.

description.zh: pptwise 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 PPT 生成插件，让 AI 根据你的内容在本地生成可编辑的 PPTX 文件，无需注册或 API 密钥。
description.en: pptwise is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that generates editable PPTX files locally from your content, no account or API key required.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）桌面端换上 Claude Code Desktop 风格外观的主题插件，提供浅色/深色主题、紧凑侧栏、模型与推理强度选择器，还有一只可点击互动的像素小鲸鱼。
description.en: A Claude Code Desktop-style theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Desktop, bringing light/dark themes, a compact sidebar, model and reasoning-effort pickers, and an interactive pixel whale.

description.zh: 为 DSH 提供基于角色的模型重试与备用链：当请求重试耗尽、鉴权失败、配额超限或限流时，自动切换到备用 provider/model，当前步骤不中断。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds role-based LLM retry and fallback chains: when retries are exhausted, auth fails, quota is exceeded, or rate limits hit, it switches provider/model so the current step continues uninterrupted.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 MCP 服务器管理：在 Web 设置页或 Agent 工具中增删改启停并测试 stdio 与 Streamable HTTP 服务器，运行时热生效无需重启 DSH。
description.en: MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness: add, edit, enable, test and remove stdio or Streamable HTTP MCP servers from the Web settings page or agent tools, taking effect at runtime with no DSH restart.

description.zh: 把 Qoder 订阅接入 DeepSeek Harness 的社区适配插件，用 PAT 配置全球或中国区服务，即可在 DSH 中调用 Qoder 模型并查看额度。
description.en: A community DSH plugin that plugs your Qoder subscription into DeepSeek Harness, letting you chat with Qoder models via a PAT and inspect quota.

description.zh: DSH Harbor 为 DeepSeek Harness 已安装插件提供只读审计台账，以 file:line 证据盘点能力、核对声明与检测、追踪版本漂移与变更时间线。
description.en: DSH Harbor is a read-only ledger for installed DeepSeek Harness plugins, offering capability inventory with file:line evidence, declared-vs-detected reconciliation, version drift, and change timeline.

description.zh: 泡泡猫的影视工具是 DSH 全局浮层创作面板，集成文生图、图生图、文生视频与短剧剧本拆解，支持六大厂商模型，边聊边创作不堵对话框。
description.en: Bubble Cat Studio is a DSH plugin overlay panel for AI film creation, covering text-to-image, image-to-video and short-drama script breakdown across six model providers without blocking the chat.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨设备会话同步：把会话库镜像到自建 git 仓库，冲突时保留双方、绝不静默覆盖，并提供 /sync 命令与 sync_* 工具。
description.en: Cross-device session sync for DeepSeek Harness: mirror your session store into your own git remote with keep-both conflict resolution, plus a /sync command and sync_* tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地 GPT-SoVITS 语音朗读，把助手回复用定制音色读出来，配可拖拽吉祥物与一键安装器。
description.en: Local GPT-SoVITS text-to-speech for DeepSeek Harness that reads assistant replies aloud in a custom voice, with a draggable mascot and one-click installer.

description.zh: DSH plugin 实现持续自我进化：从会话轨迹提炼版本化、可审计、可回滚的 Harness 状态，并带基准驱动的验证循环。
description.en: A DSH plugin for continual self-evolution: versioned, auditable, rollback-safe harness state refined from session trajectories, with a benchmark-driven validation loop.

description.zh: DSH plugin 集成 Antigravity OAuth 登录，为 LLM 路由、搜索、图像生成与视频理解提供统一认证与配额可视化。
description.en: A DSH plugin integrating Antigravity OAuth login, providing unified auth and quota visualization for LLM routing, search, image generation, and video understanding.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按模型切换背景的外观插件：用有序模型规则列表为每个模型绑定专属壁纸、主题色与模糊透明度，切换模型即换背景。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness appearance plugin that switches wallpapers by model: an ordered rule list binds each model to its own wallpaper, theme color, opacity and blur, so the background changes with the model.

description.zh: DSH 插件：复用 Codex CLI 本地登录凭证，在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 ChatGPT 订阅模型，无需 API Key。
description.en: DSH plugin: reuse your Codex CLI local login to use ChatGPT subscription models in DeepSeek Harness, no API key required.

description.zh: DSH 便携酒馆插件：RPG 式 SillyTavern 角色卡生成器与角色扮演聊天一体，支持世界书、角色卡导入导出与本地音乐。
description.en: A portable tavern plugin for DeepSeek Harness: RPG-style SillyTavern character card generator and roleplay chat, with world book, import/export, and local music.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注入过程纪律系统提示与确定性进度提醒，让 Agent 在连续静默工具调用后主动汇报进展。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects process-discipline system-prompt rules and a deterministic nudge, making agents narrate progress instead of running silent tool steps.

description.zh: DSH 视频创作技能插件，注册 HyperFrames 五件套，用 HTML 写视频，支持合成、动画、字幕、配音及网址转视频。
description.en: DSH plugin that registers the HyperFrames skill suite for video creation with HTML, covering composition, animation, subtitles, TTS, and website-to-video.

description.zh: DSH 小说写作助手插件，提供章节库管理、句式分析、风格画像、伏笔登记、本地语义检索与 AI 续写辅助，助力中文小说创作。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for novel writing: chapter library, sentence pattern analysis, style profiling, plot tracking, local semantic search, and AI-assisted continuation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话视图提供 Git 风格里程碑导航条，悬停查看元信息，点击跳转任意消息，支持搜索与深链接。
description.en: A Git-style milestone timeline for DeepSeek Harness, letting you hover for metadata and click to jump to any message, with search and deep links.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 挂上一只透明置顶的鲸娘桌宠，实时用表情、动作与气泡反映 DSH 的空闲、忙碌、审批、出错等运行状态。
description.en: A transparent always-on-top whale-girl desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness that mirrors DSH runtime states — idle, busy, approval, error — through expressions, animations and bubbles.

description.zh: dsh-vscode-mode 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来类 VSCode 的 Agent 文件编辑器与差异审查体验，支持 Monaco 编辑、侧边栏文件管理、MCP 可视化管理与会话性能优化。
description.en: dsh-vscode-mode brings a VSCode-like agent file editor and diff review experience to DeepSeek Harness, featuring Monaco editing, sidebar file management, MCP visual management, and session performance tuning.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供统一的 shell 工具，在 Windows 上执行 PowerShell、Git Bash 与 WSL 命令，并支持交互式终端会话与后台任务。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing a unified shell tool to run PowerShell, Git Bash, and WSL commands on Windows, with interactive terminal sessions and background jobs.

description.zh: dsh-chatgpt-bridge 是 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的 MCP 桥接插件，让 ChatGPT Web 通过官方 Model Context Protocol 创建、查看、继续并监督本地或自托管的 DSH 代理会话，零核心改动。
description.en: dsh-chatgpt-bridge is an MCP bridge plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that lets ChatGPT Web create, view, continue, and supervise local or self-hosted DSH agent sessions via the official Model Context Protocol, with zero core modifications.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Command Code Go API provider，通过 /alpha/generate 流式接入订阅模型，自动同步模型列表与推理档位。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing Command Code Go API provider, streaming models via /alpha/generate with auto-synced model list and reasoning effort.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面换上 Anthropic 字体，覆盖界面、对话与代码，中文自动回退思源字体。
description.en: Apply Anthropic fonts to the DeepSeek Harness web UI, covering interface, chat, and code, with Chinese fallback to Source Han fonts.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 MCP 服务器与技能管理面板，在设置页即可增删启停、重启、健康检查与备份，无需手改配置文件。
description.en: A DSH plugin that manages MCP servers and skills from a Settings UI, letting you add, toggle, restart, health-check and back up without editing config files by hand.

description.zh: BetterInput 是 DSH 的输入增强套件，提供语音识别、AI 润色、提示词优化及多格式文件转 Markdown，让喂给智能体的每种输入都更顺。
description.en: BetterInput is a DSH plugin input-enhancement suite offering voice recognition, AI polishing, prompt optimization, and file-to-Markdown conversion for better agent inputs.

description.zh: DSH 世界书驱动的小说创作插件：导入 Tavern/SillyTavern 角色卡与世界书，落地为本地 Markdown 设定，按关键词触发并生成小说正文。
description.en: A DSH plugin for lorebook-driven fiction writing: import Tavern/SillyTavern character cards & world books, save as local Markdown, trigger by keywords and generate novel prose.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨平台原生桌面控制能力，可截图、读取窗口无障碍树并执行点击、输入、滚动等操作，每步都经审批与审计，且不抢占前台焦点。
description.en: Cross-platform native desktop control for DeepSeek Harness: screenshot and read window accessibility trees, then click, type, scroll or send keys — every action approval-gated, audited and never stealing foreground focus.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供提示注入、越狱与密钥泄露防护的 DSH 插件，基于 Aho-Corasick 检测，在用户消息、工具参数与结果三处执行 allow/ask/block 拦截并记录脱敏审计事件。
description.en: A DSH plugin that defends DeepSeek Harness against prompt injection, jailbreaks and secret leaks with Aho-Corasick detection, allow/ask/block interception on user messages, tool arguments and tool results, plus sanitized audit events.

description.zh: dsh-plugin-lookatstudy 将任意 Markdown、文件夹或 GitHub 学习仓库转化为 DeepSeek Harness 中的 AI 导师课程，支持概念掌握追踪、间隔重复与考试模式。
description.en: dsh-plugin-lookatstudy turns any markdown, folder, or GitHub learning repo into a guided AI-tutor course inside DeepSeek Harness, with concept mastery tracking, spaced repetition, and exam mode.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏添加「开启生图模式」入口，点击后全屏播放过场动画并跳转 PosterFlow 生图站点，可配置跳转地址与动画。
description.en: Adds an "Enable Image Generation Mode" entry to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar that plays a full-window transition animation and jumps to PosterFlow, with configurable target URL and animation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Ollama 本地模型：发现、拉取与管理本地模型，按任务类型或关键词路由并自动回退云端。
description.en: Brings Ollama local models into DeepSeek Harness: discover, pull and manage local models, route by task type or keyword with automatic cloud fallback.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地文档知识库：导入 md/txt 后做语义+关键词混合检索，带引用校验与索引诊断，零模型下载。
description.en: A local document knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: import md/txt files, run hybrid semantic + keyword retrieval with citation checks and index diagnostics, no model downloads.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent 装上心跳节律：定时醒来维护记忆与画像、按兴趣闲逛，再按分寸决定是否开口。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness agents a heartbeat rhythm: waking on schedule to maintain memory and profiles, browse by interest, and decide with restraint whether to speak.

description.zh: DSH plugin 增强 @ 菜单，统一引用命令、Skills、文件、Agent 会话、云盘及网页 Chatbot 对话，让万物引用触手可及。
description.en: A DSH plugin that enhances the @ menu to uniformly reference commands, skills, files, agent sessions, cloud drives, and web chatbot conversations.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将头脑风暴拆成独立 Session 的思考树，自动生成 Handoff 与分支建议，支持可视化回放，让 DeepSeek Harness 的探索更清晰可控。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns brainstorming into a tree of isolated Sessions with automatic Handoffs and branch suggestions, plus a visual thinking tree for DeepSeek Harness.

description.zh: DSH plugin 一键读取任意 URL，自动识别编码并提取干净正文，输出 token 高效的紧凑文本或 Markdown，零依赖、无需 API key。
description.en: DSH plugin to fetch any URL, auto-detect encoding, extract clean main content, and return token-efficient compact text or Markdown with zero deps and no API key.

description.zh: DSH 插件，支持导入 Tavern 角色卡 V2/V3，在 DeepSeek Harness 原生会话中游玩角色扮演。
description.en: A DSH plugin that imports Tavern Character Cards V2/V3 and enables roleplay in native DeepSeek Harness conversations.

description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板中统一管理技能与 MCP 服务器，支持全局/项目级分层、工具筛选与一键重连，改完即生效。
description.en: Manage skills and MCP servers from the DSH settings panel, with global/project layering, per-server tool filtering and one-click reconnect — changes take effect immediately.

description.zh: 把已登录的 Claude Code CLI 变成 DeepSeek Harness 的一等模型提供商，无需 API Key，即可在 dsh 里选 Claude 模型对话，并复用其登录、权限与 MCP 配置。
description.en: Turns your logged-in Claude Code CLI into a first-class DeepSeek Harness model provider: no API key, pick any Claude model in dsh and reuse its login, permission modes and MCP setup.

description.zh: DSH Spotlight 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供键盘优先的命令面板，一键唤起原生斜杠命令、最近会话、界面动作与插件设置，全程无需离开键盘。
description.en: DSH Spotlight is a keyboard-first command palette for DeepSeek Harness Web, letting you find native slash commands, recent sessions, UI actions, and plugin settings without leaving the keyboard.

description.zh: DSH plugin 内置 84 种设计风格、192 个调色板与 99 条 UX 规范，离线提供 design_recommend / design_review / design_search 三个模型工具，中文优先、零网络依赖。
description.en: A DSH plugin bundling 84 design styles, 192 palettes, and 99 UX rules, offering offline design_recommend / design_review / design_search model tools with Chinese-first output and zero network dependency.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 web_fetch 提供可配置的非公网地址白名单，解决 Fake-IP 与内网目标被拦截问题，同时保持模型侧用法不变。
description.en: Provides configurable non-public address allowlists for DeepSeek Harness's web_fetch, solving Fake-IP and intranet target blocking while keeping model-side usage unchanged.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 pen.dev 官方 Pencil 画布嵌入 DeepSeek Harness，提供会话绑定工作区、实时 Agent 编辑与 7 个 MCP 设计工具，让 DeepSeek 作为设计代理直接完成 .pen 设计任务。
description.en: A DSH plugin that embeds the official pen.dev Pencil canvas into DeepSeek Harness, offering conversation-bound workspaces, live agent edits, and 7 MCP design tools for AI-driven design workflows.

description.zh: dsh-zen-remote 让 DeepSeek Harness 变成可公网安全访问的手机 App：移动端界面重排、配对认证网关、PWA 与锁屏推送。
description.en: dsh-zen-remote turns DeepSeek Harness into a securely accessible phone app: mobile UI rework, pairing-code gateway, PWA, and Web Push.

description.zh: 论衡是 DeepSeek Harness 的 bundle 插件，用 9 张角色卡把深度长文生产拆成检索、分析、写作、批判、审计等流水线，产出带证据底座与独立审计的交付物。
description.en: Lunheng is a DSH bundle plugin that orchestrates 9 role cards into a deep-article pipeline—retrieval, analysis, writing, critique, audit—delivering evidence-backed, independently audited outputs.

description.zh: sage-mem 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 markdown 文件的跨会话记忆，支持从 Claude Code 无损迁移，记忆透明可检查，按需注入。
description.en: sage-mem provides file-based cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness, with lossless migration from Claude Code, transparent and inspectable memory, and on-demand injection.

description.zh: OMK 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于证据的提示词、RAG、技能与 Agent 评估，支持 A/B 对比、可观测性与版本发布决策。
description.en: OMK provides evidence-backed evaluation and observability for prompts, RAG, skills, and agents in DeepSeek Harness, enabling A/B comparison and release decisions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供设置页内的 MCP 服务管理界面，可增删改查注册的 MCP 服务器并执行真实握手测试，快速排查连接状态。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding an MCP service management page in Settings, letting you list/add/edit/delete MCP servers and run real initialize handshakes to verify connectivity.

description.zh: dsh-better-markdown 是 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件，用 markstream-react 替换流式 Markdown 渲染，支持 Mermaid、KaTeX 与安全回退。
description.en: dsh-better-markdown is a DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that replaces streaming Markdown rendering with markstream-react, supporting Mermaid, KaTeX, and safe fallback.

description.zh: dsh-pdf-mineru 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 MinerU 的高精度 PDF 解析能力，支持云端与私有化部署、后台异步任务与智能缓存，让 Agent 轻松提取文档中的公式、表格与图文内容。
description.en: dsh-pdf-mineru brings MinerU-powered high-precision PDF parsing to DeepSeek Harness, supporting cloud and self-hosted providers, background async jobs, and smart caching for extracting formulas, tables, and images.

description.zh: DSH 会话导航面板，在对话页右侧悬浮展示按轮折叠的大纲，支持关键词过滤、点击跳转、位置跟踪与多种显示形态，提升长对话浏览效率。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a floating conversation navigator panel, showing a turn-collapsed outline with keyword filtering, click-to-jump, position tracking, and multiple display modes.

description.zh: Subagent Director 为 DeepSeek Harness 的子代理指定 LLM 供应商与模型，并通过角色模板规划主代理与子代理的分工。
description.en: Subagent Director assigns LLM providers and models to subagents in DeepSeek Harness, with role templates to orchestrate delegation.

description.zh: 把 QQ 接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 DSH plugin：支持 QQ 官方机器人与 OneBot v11 双通道收发消息，关键词规则自动回复，并全量写入审计日志。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects QQ to DeepSeek Harness via the official QQ bot or OneBot v11, with keyword auto-replies and full audit logging.

description.zh: DSH plugin 生态透明排行与推荐：自动抓取 dsh-plugin 话题仓库，按公开评分模型排序，提供榜单查询、检索、推荐与趋势工具。
description.en: Transparent rankings and recommendations for the DSH plugin ecosystem: automatically scrapes dsh-plugin repos, scores them with an open model, and offers ranking, search, recommendation, and trend tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供设置页一键重启服务的 DSH plugin，重启行固定于通用设置底部，重启后自动重连并显示绿色已连接状态。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that adds a one-click restart row at the bottom of Settings → General, with automatic reconnection and a green Connected state after restart.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供八项双语安全审计技能与 plugin_vet 供应链预装扫描门禁，覆盖密钥扫描、依赖审计、提示注入审查与事件响应，可在安装前拦截高风险插件。
description.en: A DSH plugin bundling eight bilingual security-audit skills plus the plugin_vet supply-chain gate for DeepSeek Harness, covering secret scanning, dependency audit, prompt-injection review and incident response to block risky installs.

description.zh: DeepSpider 是 DSH 上的 AI 原生爬虫与 JavaScript 逆向工程插件，借助 Patchright/CDP 采集浏览器证据，恢复参数生成逻辑并交付可验证 Solver。
description.en: DeepSpider is an AI-native web scraping and JavaScript reverse-engineering DSH plugin that uses Patchright/CDP browser evidence to recover parameter-generation logic and deliver verifiable Solvers.

description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 聊天界面变为 GalGame 风格，与 DeepSeek 娘立绘互动，纯视觉层不干扰工作，随时可切回常规聊天。
description.en: Transform the DeepSeek Harness web chat into a GalGame-style interface, interacting with a DeepSeek girl sprite, purely visual and switchable back anytime.

description.zh: DSH plugin 钉钉群机器人通知插件，让 agent 单向推送 Markdown 或纯文本消息到钉钉群，支持 HMAC 加签，零依赖全平台。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DingTalk group robot notifications, enabling agents to push Markdown or plain text messages one-way with HMAC signing, zero-dependency and cross-platform.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供右侧浮动文件树抽屉，展示当前会话工作目录，支持拖拽文件路径插入对话框、双击打开文件或目录，并随会话切换自动跟随工作目录。
description.en: A file explorer plugin for the DSH Web GUI: a floating file-tree drawer on the right showing the current session workspace, with drag-and-drop path insertion into the chat box and double-click to open files or folders.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Web UI 中提供 IDEA 风格分支选择器与 worktree 隔离管理，支持就地切换分支、创建独立工作区并自定义存储路径。
description.en: A DSH plugin offering an IDEA-style branch picker and worktree isolation in the Web UI, enabling in-place branch switching, isolated workspaces, and configurable storage root.

description.zh: dsh-harmony 是 DeepSeek Harness 的运行时补丁协调库，支持在运行时对 DSH 插件进行修补、替换与装饰，无需维护分支即可改变其他插件行为。
description.en: dsh-harmony is a runtime patch coordination library for DeepSeek Harness, enabling patching, replacing and decorating DSH plugins at runtime without maintaining a fork.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话长期记忆：自动分层蒸馏（L0-L3）并注入上下文，区分生活与工作记忆，零配置无感运行。
description.en: Adds cross-session long-term memory to DeepSeek Harness: auto-distills layered memories (L0-L3) and injects them into context, keeping personal and work memories separate, zero-config.

description.zh: DSHcraft 将 DeepSeek Harness 变成可游玩的 Minecraft 风格 Agent 工作空间，以体素世界承载原生会话、模型与工具操作。
description.en: DSHcraft turns DeepSeek Harness into a playable Minecraft-style agent workspace, using a voxel world to host native sessions, models, and tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 引入独立的 LLM 裁判复核机制，通过四个工具对候选方案进行成对比较、锦标赛选优与进度追踪，并支持 Web 设置页可视化配置。
description.en: Introduces an independent LLM verifier mechanism for DeepSeek Harness, offering pairwise comparison, tournament selection, and progress tracking via four tools, with a Web settings page for configuration.

description.zh: 复刻 DeepSeek Harness 官方首页的 DSH plugin 主题，提供流体背景、鼠标弹性网格与双小鱼动态效果，不改动页面结构与交互。
description.en: A DSH plugin theme replicating the DeepSeek Harness official homepage, adding fluid background, elastic mouse grid, and two fish animations without altering page structure or interaction.

description.zh: DSH plugin 音乐/小说播放器，在 DeepSeek Harness 网页内播放本地音乐、在线 QQ/酷狗音乐，并支持 AI 朗读本地小说。
description.en: A DSH plugin music/novel player that plays local music, online QQ/Kugou music, and AI-narrates local novels within the DeepSeek Harness web UI.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 opencode 模型请求自动注入会话 ID 与相关头，零配置即可让 wire 请求携带 x-opencode-session，实现会话隔离与追踪。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects session IDs and related headers into opencode model requests, zero-config, enabling session isolation and tracking on the wire.

description.zh: DSH PPT 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 插件，一句话生成原生可编辑 PPTX，支持智能排版、自动图表与 AI 视觉审稿，让 PPT 制作回归内容本身。
description.en: DSH PPT is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that generates natively editable PPTX from a single sentence, with smart layout, auto charts, and AI visual review.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供人设卡与长期记忆：在设置里填写卡片名称与内容即可，插件自动把人格注入系统提示，并让 AI 跨会话读写、演化自己的记忆。
description.en: Persona cards and long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: name a card in Settings, and the plugin injects it into the system prompt while letting the agent read, write and evolve its own memory across sessions.

description.zh: dsh-sentinel 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件安全体检官，静态扫描与运行时副作用追踪，为 DSH 插件提供安装前安全审计，覆盖 13 类攻击链检测。
description.en: dsh-sentinel is a security auditor for DeepSeek Harness plugins, performing static scanning and runtime side-effect tracking to provide pre-install security reports covering 13 attack chains.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话视图新增「执行图」标签页，用 React Flow 画布把单轮对话的请求、回复、工具调用与结果重建为纵向时间线，支持节点详情、折叠与 PNG 导出。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds an "Execution graph" tab to the conversation view, rebuilding one session turn's request, reply, tool calls and results as a vertical React Flow timeline with node details, folding and PNG export.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 PTC 模式提供会话绑定的持久 TypeScript REPL，让 run_code 跨调用复用变量、导入与结果，减少重复发送与 token 消耗。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives PTC mode a session-bound persistent TypeScript REPL, reusing variables, imports, and results across run_code calls to cut redundant sends and token usage.

description.zh: DSH plugin 更新管理：自动检测 DeepSeek Harness 主程序与第三方插件更新，支持一键更新、备份回滚与看门狗重启，保障升级安全。
description.en: DSH plugin for update management: auto-checks DeepSeek Harness and third-party plugin updates, with one-click update, backup/rollback, and watchdog restart.

description.zh: dsh-pi-tui 是 DeepSeek Harness 的终端前端，采用 pi 的观感与交互，提供流式 Markdown、thinking 折叠、工具卡片、会话持久化等完整 TUI 体验。
description.en: dsh-pi-tui is a terminal frontend for DeepSeek Harness with pi's look and feel, offering streaming Markdown, thinking folding, tool cards, and session persistence.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通过 AI 模拟目标用户，在开发阶段扫描 React/Vue 前端代码，定位 UX 问题并给出可执行的优化建议。
description.en: A DSH plugin that uses AI to simulate target users, scanning React/Vue frontend code during development to pinpoint UX issues and suggest concrete fixes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件，让纯文本模型拥有视觉：将图片或视频关键帧发送给当前视觉模型，并在 Web UI 右侧面板展示可复制的分析结果。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives text-only models eyes: forwards images or video keyframes to the current vision model and shows copyable results in a Web UI right panel.

description.zh: 把黑塔（Herta）作为 DSH plugin 装进 DeepSeek Harness，带来她的人格、记忆货架、80 条语音与专属会话界面四层体验。
description.en: Installs Herta into DeepSeek Harness as a DSH plugin, bringing her persona, memory shelf, 80 voice clips and a dedicated conversation UI.

description.zh: dsh-approve-for-me 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，通过规则门控自动审批 Shell/PowerShell 沙箱提权，支持可选 LLM 审查、一次性授权与固定高风险检查，不确定请求回退人工审批。
description.en: dsh-approve-for-me is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for rule-gated automatic approval of Shell/PowerShell sandbox escalations, with optional LLM review, one-time grants, fixed high-risk checks, and native human fallback.

description.zh: 把 pi、opencode、codex、claude-code 的会话历史与 agents 一键导入 DeepSeek Harness，导入后可像原生会话一样继续对话，agents 转为 DSH 技能。
description.en: Imports pi, opencode, codex, and claude-code sessions, chat history, and agents into DeepSeek Harness as resumable native sessions, converting agents into DSH skills.

description.zh: DSH plugin 复用本地 Codex CLI 的 ChatGPT 登录态，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 GPT 认证设置、LLM 路由、网页搜索与图像生成能力。
description.en: A DSH plugin that reuses the local Codex CLI ChatGPT login to add GPT Auth settings, LLM routing, web search, and image generation to DeepSeek Harness.

description.zh: 掌上 DSH 是 DeepSeek Harness 的手机端 PWA 客户端，不用装 App，浏览器即可查看会话、实时对话、交付文件与后台任务，并附带 GUI 侧边栏面板。
description.en: DSH in hand is a phone-side PWA client for DeepSeek Harness with no app to install: browse sessions, chat live, view delivered files and background tasks, plus a GUI sidebar panel.

description.zh: dsh-focus-chat 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供聚焦会话视图，将冗长对话折叠为摘要行，只关注最终产出，让阅读更轻松。
description.en: dsh-focus-chat adds a focus chat view to DeepSeek Harness, collapsing long conversations into summary lines to focus on final outcomes for easier reading.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Honcho 持久记忆：会话开始自动注入用户画像与项目结论，全程捕获对话，并提供搜索、追问与记忆写入工具。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness persistent memory via Honcho: it injects your profile and project conclusions at session start, captures every turn, and adds search, dialectic chat, and remember tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的非官方粉丝主题插件，将界面变成虚拟主播轴伊Joi 的两间房间，提供双衣装、状态演出与原生外观切换。
description.en: Unofficial fan theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness, transforming the UI into two rooms of VTuber Joi, with dual outfits, status animations, and native appearance toggle.

description.zh: DSH plugin 原生鸿蒙开发助手：hdc 设备闭环调试、设备面板、离线官方知识层与 DevEco CLI 构建/签名/模拟器控制。
description.en: DSH plugin for native HarmonyOS development: hdc device loop, live device panel, offline official knowledge, and DevEco CLI build/sign/emulator control.

description.zh: 把 DSH 的会话、附件、设置与工作区文件同步到你的 GitHub 私有仓库，换台电脑也能接着聊、接着做。
description.en: Sync your DeepSeek Harness sessions, attachments, settings and workspace files to your own private GitHub repo, so you can pick up the same chat and project on another machine.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供带类型与推理能力的本体插件，让 Agent 在模式约束下声明、校验并查询持久化领域知识。
description.en: A typed, inference-capable ontology plugin for DeepSeek Harness, letting the agent declare, validate, and query durable domain knowledge under schema constraints.

description.zh: DSH plugin 长期记忆插件，跨会话注入 SOUL.md 人格与记忆，支持 remember/recall/consolidate/forget 及 git 自动提交，让 Agent 拥有可迁移的持久记忆。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing persistent, cross-session long-term memory with SOUL.md persona injection, remember/recall/consolidate/forget workflows, and git auto-commit.

description.zh: dsh-knowledge 是 DeepSeek Harness 的知识库插件，支持本地 SQLite 与远程中央知识库，提供多知识库管理、按需检索、自动回写及笔记工作区。
description.en: dsh-knowledge is a knowledge base plugin for DeepSeek Harness, supporting local SQLite and remote central knowledge bases with multi-KB management, on-demand retrieval, auto-writeback, and a note workspace.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供只追加的多分支会话树：任意历史节点可分叉、克隆分支，并在 WebUI 中以合并图谱浏览整条会话谱系。
description.en: Append-only multi-branch conversation trees for DeepSeek Harness: fork any historical node, clone branches into new sessions, and browse the whole lineage as one merged WebUI graph.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于角色的 Codex、Claude Code 与 ACP 子代理，支持可续接子会话、会话恢复与分层权限委派。
description.en: Role-based Codex, Claude Code and ACP subagent providers for DeepSeek Harness, with continuable children, durable session recovery and layered permission delegation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 CSV/Excel/JSON 数据一键转换为交互式 ECharts HTML，支持多文件合并、LLM 数据转换与完全离线渲染。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns CSV/Excel/JSON data into interactive ECharts HTML with multi-file merging, LLM-driven transformation, and fully offline rendering.

description.zh: DSH Task Engine 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供工程化开发工作台，把需求、设计、开发、验证与提交审核组织成可追踪的任务阶段，并支持技能与规则挂载复用。
description.en: DSH Task Engine gives DeepSeek Harness a personal engineering workbench that turns requirements, design, development, verification and commit review into trackable task stages, with reusable skills and rules bound to each stage.

description.zh: Mineradio 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端带来电影感玻璃拟态主题，移植自 Mineradio 音乐播放器的香槟金美学，支持动态壁纸、光晕光标与一键还原。
description.en: Mineradio brings a cinematic glassmorphism theme to DeepSeek Harness Desktop, porting the champagne-gold aesthetic of the Mineradio music player with fluid wallpaper, glow cursor, and one-click reset.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中接入 PackyCode（PackyAPI）API Key，自带模型分组路由、多 Key 顺序轮换与余额显示，无需改配置。
description.en: Use a PackyCode (PackyAPI) API key inside DeepSeek Harness with a built-in model group, ordered multi-key rotation and balance display, no config edits needed.

description.zh: 为 Apple Silicon macOS 上的 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地会议转录：导入音频或录制麦克风与系统声音，生成带时间戳和说话人标签的文稿。
description.en: Unofficial local meeting transcription for DeepSeek Harness on Apple Silicon macOS: import audio or record mic and system sound into timestamped, speaker-labeled transcripts.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供密码认证与 TOTP 双因素认证的 DSH plugin，在网关层真实拦截每个 HTTP 与 WebSocket 请求，并内置防爆破、会话管理与登录审计。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds password auth and TOTP two-factor authentication to DeepSeek Harness Web, intercepting every HTTP and WebSocket request at the gateway with brute-force protection, session management, and login audit.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可续跑的后台子代理与持久团队房间，让你边对话边指挥子代理持续工作，重启后仍可恢复。
description.en: Adds continuable background subagents and persistent team rooms to DeepSeek Harness, letting you steer child agents while chatting, with state surviving restarts.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 输入框带来终端式输入历史：方向键边缘召回、草稿与光标精确还原、Ctrl+R 反向搜索，并支持压缩摘要的上下文回忆。
description.en: Terminal-style input history for the DeepSeek Harness web composer: edge-first arrow recall with exact draft and caret restore, Ctrl+R reverse search, and sliding-context aware recall.

description.zh: DSH plugin 接入腾讯 CodeBuddy，浏览器登录免 API Key，即可在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 CodeBuddy 模型列表。
description.en: A DSH plugin integrating Tencent CodeBuddy, enabling browser sign-in without API key to use CodeBuddy's model list in DeepSeek Harness.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧边栏会话菜单添加「删除会话」入口，支持二次点击、弹窗确认或直接删除三种模式，可彻底清除不需要的会话。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that adds a Delete session item to the sidebar session menu, with click-again, dialog, or instant confirmation modes for thoroughly removing unwanted sessions.

description.zh: dsh-diagram 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，将文章理解转化为可编辑的 Excalidraw 画布，支持实时预览、自动保存与导出，告别一次性 Mermaid 输出。
description.en: dsh-diagram is a DSH plugin that turns article understanding into editable Excalidraw canvases with live preview, autosave, and export, replacing disposable Mermaid output.

description.zh: DSH plugin 节点连线式 AIGC 画布，向模型暴露文生图/视频/音频等工具，生成结果自动连线并持久化。
description.en: A node-link AIGC canvas for DSH plugin, exposing text-to-image/video/audio tools with auto-linking and persistence.

description.zh: AWiki 身份与消息插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供统一身份登录、端到端加密消息、群组与 AI 摘要，并带可拖拽启动器。
description.en: AWiki identity and messaging plugin for DeepSeek Harness, offering unified identity login, encrypted messaging, groups, AI summaries, and a draggable launcher.

description.zh: DSH plugin 常驻注入 Ponytail 懒高级工程师规范，精简版系统提示词按会话切换档位，完整规则与 5 个同伴技能落盘为仅用户可调用的 / 技能。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects the Ponytail lazy-senior-engineer ruleset, with a compact always-on system prompt switchable per session and the full ruleset plus 5 companion skills as user-only / skills.

description.zh: dsh-search-boost 是 DeepSeek Harness 的搜索增强插件，融合多引擎搜索、聚焦抓取、X 搜索与深度研究，并注入主动搜索策略。
description.en: dsh-search-boost is a DSH plugin that boosts search with multi-engine fusion, focused fetching, X search, and deep research, plus an injected proactive-search policy.

description.zh: dsh-speak 是 DeepSeek Harness 的语音播报插件，任务完成或需要审批时用自然语音朗读回复，让你无需盯屏。
description.en: dsh-speak is a DSH plugin that reads final replies aloud via system speech synthesis, so you hear when a long task is done or approval is needed.

description.zh: DSH 远程访问插件，通过 Cloudflare 隧道或局域网 HTTPS 直连，支持微信/飞书机器人远程控制，免配置公网访问。
description.en: DSH plugin for remote access via Cloudflare tunnel or LAN HTTPS, with WeChat/Feishu bot control and zero-config public access.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入知乎开放平台官方 API，提供站内检索、全网索引与直答三个工具，结果均附可引用来源链接，让回答有据可查。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness official Zhihu Open Platform search tools — on-site search, global index search and Zhida answers — each returning citable source links instead of unsourced summaries.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 集成 Codex 对话后端，在 DSH Web UI 中直接使用 Codex 模型，支持工作区、终端、审批与 DSH 工具。
description.en: Integrates Codex as a conversation backend into DeepSeek Harness, enabling native Codex conversations in the DSH Web UI with workspace, terminal, approval, and DSH tool support.

description.zh: DSH plugin 风控规则挖掘工具，蒸馏《100天风控专家》方法论，对数据集自动完成质检、单规则挖掘、并行规则最优组合并生成 HTML 报告，提升风控策略效率。
description.en: A DSH plugin for risk-control rule mining, distilling the '100-Day Risk Control Expert' methodology to automate data profiling, single-rule mining, optimal parallel rule combination, and HTML report generation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 登录门：为 DeepSeek Harness 网页版提供口令或共享令牌认证、会话 cookie、登录限速与用户管理 CLI，保护公开部署的实例。
description.en: A login gate for DeepSeek Harness web instances: password or shared-token authentication, session cookies, rate limiting, and a user-management CLI.

description.zh: DSH plugin 动态心情图标，让 favicon 与 logo 随会话状态播放 bloub 动画，并内置桌面启动，把 DSH 变成 Dock 里的独立 App。
description.en: A DSH plugin that animates favicon and logo with bloub mood based on session state, plus desktop launch to turn DSH into a standalone Dock app.

description.zh: dsh-claude 将本地 Claude Code CLI 作为 DSH 插件的一等会话提供者，保留其原生 agent 循环、工具、技能、hooks 和 MCP 集成，让 Claude 在 DSH 中作为主 agent 运行。
description.en: dsh-claude runs the local Claude Code CLI as a first-class conversation provider in DSH, preserving its native agent loop, tools, skills, hooks, and MCP integrations.

description.zh: dsh-clawrouter 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加安全审查门：在危险工具调用执行前由更强模型裁决放行/拒绝/升级，并接入 BlockRun 钱包按次付费的 67 模型路由。
description.en: dsh-clawrouter adds a safety gate to DeepSeek Harness: a stronger model reviews dangerous tool calls before execution, and registers a BlockRun provider route for pay-per-request access to 67 models from one wallet.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可视化看板：任务卡片绑定专属 Agent 会话，拖动列即自动派发实现、评审、部署等指令，并与 Gitea/Forgejo 双向同步。
description.en: A visual Kanban board for DeepSeek Harness: each card owns a dedicated agent session, and moving cards across workflow columns dispatches implement, review, and deploy instructions with 2-way Gitea/Forgejo sync.

description.zh: dsh-freeroute 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册 freeroute 模型提供商，聚合多个免费额度上游并自动故障转移，配置一个 API 密钥即可使用。
description.en: dsh-freeroute registers a freeroute model provider for DeepSeek Harness, aggregating multiple free-tier upstreams with automatic failover; configure one API key and go.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设置界面新增「MCP 管理」页面，可查看、启停、编辑、重启、删除与添加 MCP 服务器，并自动识别多种工具的配置格式。
description.en: Adds an MCP Management page to the DeepSeek Harness settings sidebar, letting you view, enable/disable, edit, restart, delete and add MCP servers, with automatic config-format detection for many tools.

description.zh: dsh-memory-eternal 为 DeepSeek Harness 装上第二大脑：对话自动沉淀知识卡到本地 Markdown Vault，支持去重、CJK 检索与知识图谱，跨会话按需召回，零人工干预。
description.en: dsh-memory-eternal gives DeepSeek Harness a second brain: automatically distills conversations into knowledge cards in a local Markdown Vault, with dedup, CJK-aware retrieval and knowledge graph, enabling on-demand recall across sessions.

description.zh: TeamFlow 团队研发流水线 DSH plugin，将一句话需求转化为多 Agent 研发流水线，涵盖 PRD、设计、开发、QA 与验收，并带可视化团队工作台。
description.en: TeamFlow is a DSH plugin that turns a one-line requirement into a multi-agent R&D pipeline with PRD, design, development, QA and acceptance, plus a visual team dashboard.

description.zh: dsh-mobile-hanui 是 DeepSeek Harness 的手机网页优化插件，自动将桌面界面适配为触屏布局，修复侧边栏、弹窗等不适配问题。
description.en: dsh-mobile-hanui is a DSH plugin that optimizes the web UI for mobile, automatically adapting the desktop layout to touch screens and fixing sidebar and modal issues.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将文件改动审查移植为 dsh-better-sidebar 侧边栏 Tab，提供行级红绿 diff、撤销与对话尾部审查行深链，让开发者在 DeepSeek Harness 中高效审查代码改动。
description.en: A DSH plugin that ports file-change review into a dsh-better-sidebar tab, offering line-level diffs, undo, and deep links from the chat review row for efficient code review in DeepSeek Harness.

description.zh: DSH plugin 可配置子代理 profile 系统，单一 subagent 工具配合 profile 参数，支持 Web UI 设置、实时进度与子代理树。
description.en: Configurable subagent profile system for DSH plugin: single subagent tool with profile param, featuring Web UI settings, real-time progress, and subagent tree.

description.zh: DSH 软工作流插件：在画布上拖拽设计流程并编译成计划提示词，由模型按计划执行，进度实时回写画布，无需执行引擎。
description.en: A soft-workflow DSH plugin: design flows on a canvas, compile them into plan prompts, and let the model execute them while progress syncs back to the canvas — no execution engine required.

description.zh: 把社区装进 DeepSeek Harness：在 DSH 面板内注册账号、自建或加入社区，实时聊天、@ 提醒、贴图传文件并管理成员权限，还能分享与克隆 DSH 会话。
description.en: Bring a Discord-like community into DeepSeek Harness: register, create or join communities inside the DSH panel, chat in real time with @mentions, file uploads, roles and permissions, plus shareable and clonable DSH sessions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自动审批能力的 DSH 插件，用关键词与审核模型判定表决定工具调用放行或拒绝，拿不准时仍交回 Web 审批弹窗由人确认。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that auto-approves or rejects tool calls using keywords and a judge-model criteria table, falling back to the original Web approval dialog when uncertain.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）提供文件编码守护，接管 read/write/edit 工具，让 AI 读写 GBK、Big5、Shift-JIS 等非 UTF-8 文件及带 BOM 文件时保持原编码不被破坏。
description.en: A file-encoding guard for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that takes over the read/write/edit tools so the AI can read and write GBK, Big5, Shift-JIS and other non-UTF-8 or BOM files without corrupting their original encoding.

description.zh: dsh-compaction-instant 是 DeepSeek Harness 的免 LLM 近无损上下文压缩引擎，毫秒级确定性压缩历史会话，保留原始 token，并附带 recall/search 工具实现无损回溯。
description.en: dsh-compaction-instant is an LLM-free, near-lossless context compaction engine for DeepSeek Harness, compressing shadowed history in milliseconds with zero model calls, plus recall/search tools for lossless recovery.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让 DeepSeek Harness 在 Windows 上默认使用 Git Bash，并保留 read-only、workspace-write 和 full-access 权限控制。
description.en: A DSH plugin that makes DeepSeek Harness use Git Bash on Windows by default, preserving read-only, workspace-write, and full-access permission semantics.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加 Godot Creator 模式，让 AI 通过 Godot AI 搭场景、改脚本、做 UI 并运行验证游戏，附带 16 个 Skills 与创作台。
description.en: Adds a Godot Creator mode to DeepSeek Harness so the AI can build scenes, edit scripts, craft UI and run-verify games via Godot AI, with 16 skills and a creation console.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供 Codex 风格的对话轮次时间线点阵与悬浮历史概览卡片，支持鱼眼动效与点击直达。
description.en: Adds a Codex-style conversation turn timeline rail and hover overview cards to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with fish-eye effects and click-to-jump.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 dsh-web 增加登录门禁，支持用户名密码认证、scrypt 哈希与 AES-256-GCM 加密存储，并提供 CLI 管理账号，是 DSH plugin 的安全加固方案。
description.en: Adds a login gate to dsh-web in DeepSeek Harness, with username/password auth, scrypt hashing, AES-256-GCM encrypted storage, and CLI account management—a security hardening DSH plugin.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 Mermaid 代码块渲染为 SVG 图表，支持图表/代码切换、流式输出、暗色模式与安全防护。
description.en: A DSH plugin that renders Mermaid code blocks as SVG diagrams with diagram/code toggle, streaming, dark mode, and strict security.

description.zh: 牛来桌宠是DSH plugin的趣味桌面宠物，在web界面角落养一只小牛，任务完成时它会蹦出来喊「妈~~妈~~」，支持多种皮肤、动作和语音互动。
description.en: Niulai Pet is a fun desktop pet plugin for DSH, raising a little cow in the corner of the web UI that pops out to call 'Mama~~' when tasks complete, with multiple skins, actions, and voice interaction.

description.zh: dsh-movein 将 Claude Code、Codex 与 OpenCode 的配置一键迁移至 DeepSeek Harness，导入技能、命令、代理、钩子、权限规则与 MCP 配置，支持预览与干跑。
description.en: dsh-movein migrates Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode setups into DeepSeek Harness, importing skills, commands, agents, hooks, permission rules, and MCP config with preview and dry-run support.

description.zh: DSH plugin 常驻注入 Ponytail 懒高级工程师规范，精简版系统提示词按会话切换档位，完整规则与 5 个同伴技能落盘为仅用户可调用的 / 技能。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects the Ponytail lazy-senior-engineer ruleset, with a compact always-on system prompt switchable per session and the full ruleset plus 5 companion skills as user-only / skills.

description.zh: DSH plugin 修复沙箱权限提权误报，忽略不高于当前权限的无效请求，保留真实提权审批与参数校验，避免 AI 与权限管理冲突。
description.en: A DSH plugin that fixes sandbox escalation false positives, ignoring invalid requests not wider than current permissions while preserving real escalation approval and validation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在设置面板中实时调整对话界面，提供代码字号、表格样式、GitBar、归档管理、任务提醒等可开关的 UI 增强功能。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets you tweak the conversation UI in real time from the settings panel, with toggles for code font size, table style, GitBar, archive management, and task reminders.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 Unreal Engine 5.8 提供适配层，复用官方 Unreal MCP 服务器，注册三个 Unreal Skills，实现 AI 驱动的 UE 工具调用与技能创作。
description.en: A DSH plugin bundle that adapts Unreal Engine 5.8 via the official Unreal MCP server, registering three Unreal Skills for AI-driven tool invocation and skill authoring.

description.zh: DSH 插件：让纯文本 DeepSeek 也能识图，GUI 附加图片自动经 VLM 转译成文字后交给 DeepSeek 作答，支持百炼/智谱/Ollama 等任意 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets text-only DeepSeek see images: GUI-attached images are auto-transcribed into text via a VLM before being sent to DeepSeek, supporting any OpenAI-compatible vision model like DashScope, Zhipu, or local Ollama.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通过 ACP 协议在 DeepSeek Harness 会话中接入 Devin、Codex、Kimi、Claude 等外部 AI 代理，复用其模型、工具与登录状态。
description.en: A DSH plugin that integrates external AI agents like Devin, Codex, Kimi, and Claude into DeepSeek Harness sessions via the ACP protocol, reusing their models, tools, and login states.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页中查看、启停和管理本地 Agent Skills，自动扫描多个技能目录，支持自定义路径与文件监听。
description.en: Manage local Agent Skills within DeepSeek Harness settings: auto-scan skill directories, toggle skills, and watch for file changes.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 bash 执行器中自动将符合条件的命令路由到 rtk（Rust Token Killer），压缩工具输出、节省 token，且不改变命令语义。
description.en: A DSH plugin that routes eligible shell commands through rtk (Rust Token Killer) inside the bash executor to compress tool output and save tokens, with zero semantic change.

description.zh: dsh-doc 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供全本地文档智能，解析 PDF、Office、图片并支持离线 OCR，无需 Docker 或 API 密钥。
description.en: dsh-doc gives DeepSeek Harness fully local document intelligence, parsing PDF, Office, images with offline OCR, no Docker or API keys.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏提供 IDE 级 Git 工具窗口，含分支树、提交图谱、变更与提交详情及 JetBrains 风格操作。
description.en: An IDE-grade Git tool window for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, with branch tree, commit graph, changes and commit details plus JetBrains-style actions.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先文献知识库 RAG 插件，把 PDF 与 Zotero 库索引进单个 SQLite，用段落级证据回答并给出章节、页码与 DOI 直达原文。
description.en: A local-first literature RAG plugin for DeepSeek Harness that indexes PDFs and Zotero libraries into one SQLite file, answering with passage-level evidence plus section, page, and clickable DOI.

description.zh: dsh-noname-kit 是 DeepSeek Harness 的无名杀扩展开发工坊，让 AI 按规范写武将技能与卡牌，经确认协议、静态校验与专用写入通道兜底，覆盖前自动备份。
description.en: dsh-noname-kit is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns AI into a Noname (Sanguosha) extension workshop: it writes hero skills and cards to spec, gated by confirmation protocol, static validation and a guarded write channel with automatic backups.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注入按会话区分的 x-opencode-session 请求头，修复 OpenCode Go 的 400 MissingSessionID 报错，仅作用于 opencode.ai 且无需重启即可开关。
description.en: Injects a per-conversation x-opencode-session header for DeepSeek Harness, fixing OpenCode Go's 400 MissingSessionID errors while staying scoped to opencode.ai and switchable without a restart.

description.zh: dsh-Kingdom 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，在 DSH 中建立多 Agent 治理王国，赋予角色、权限与领地，通过事实验证与权威账本确保执行可核验、可追溯。
description.en: dsh-Kingdom is a DSH plugin that builds a governed multi-agent kingdom with roles, permissions, and territories, ensuring verifiable and auditable execution via fact-checking and authoritative ledger.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在设置页新增「技能与MCP」分区，可视化管理技能、MCP服务器与市场，支持从 Claude Code、Codex 导入配置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a 'Skills & MCP' section to settings, enabling visual management of skills, MCP servers, and marketplace, with import from Claude Code and Codex.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 扩展工作区可写范围，让 Agent 在保留原生读写与 bash 工具的同时，可同时读写一个主根加多个附加根目录，跨仓库协作无需反复切换会话。
description.en: Extends the DeepSeek Harness workspace so the agent can read and write one primary root plus multiple extra roots at once, keeping native read/write/edit/bash tools and avoiding session switching across repositories.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Playwright 的语义化多标签浏览器自动化，支持快照、截图、导航与标签管理，让 DSH 智能体获得持久的浏览器控制能力。
description.en: Playwright-powered semantic multi-tab browser automation for DeepSeek Harness, offering snapshots, screenshots, navigation, and tab management for persistent browser control.

description.zh: 百度贴吧 DSH 插件：自动读帖、生成日报、每日签到，可选回帖并带频率与内容限制，支持人设、日记与峰谷后台运行。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin for Baidu Tieba: auto-reads threads, writes daily digests and signs in, with optional rate-limited replies, persona, diary and off-peak background runs.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 浏览器界面自动展开新到达的工具调用卡片，并在侧栏提供展开、不干预、折叠三态开关，档位持久化且随主题自适应。
description.en: A DSH plugin that auto-expands newly arrived tool-call cards in the DeepSeek Harness web UI, with a sidebar toggle cycling through expand, do-nothing and collapse states that persist and follow the theme.

description.zh: DSH plugin 基础工具增强：持久 bash、结构化 read、多模式 edit、原子 write、全文搜索与图像直读，一个插件全覆盖。
description.en: A DSH plugin enhancing core tools: persistent bash, structured read, multi-mode edit, atomic write, full-text search, and direct image reading in one package.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 token 用量分析与模型能力排行榜的 DSH plugin，扫描宿主会话日志，按提供商和模型统计消耗趋势、缓存命中率，并对比可调用模型的能力排名。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for token usage analytics and model capability rankings: it scans the host's own session logs, breaks consumption trends and cache hit rates down by provider and model, and ranks every callable model on a public leaderboard.

description.zh: DSH plugin，通过真实浏览器驱动网页版DeepSeek聊天，免API计费，并将对话迁移至DeepSeek Harness会话作为开发上下文。
description.en: A DSH plugin that drives chat.deepseek.com via a real browser for web chat without API billing, and transfers conversations into DeepSeek Harness sessions as development context.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Google Antigravity 能力：私有 OAuth PKCE 登录、多模型路由与 Nano Banana 2 图像生成编辑，并带配额可视化设置面板。
description.en: Brings Google Antigravity capabilities to DeepSeek Harness: private OAuth PKCE login, multi-model LLM routing, Nano Banana 2 image generation and editing, plus a quota-visualizing settings panel.

description.zh: oh-my-dsh 是 DSH plugin 组合包，为 DeepSeek Harness Web 端一次性带来手机界面、登录、文件与 Git 侧栏、MCP 管理、搜索切换与 Codex 支持。
description.en: oh-my-dsh is a DSH plugin bundle that equips DeepSeek Harness Web with a mobile UI, login, file/Git sidebar, MCP management, search provider switching and Codex support in one install.

description.zh: dsh-argp 是 DeepSeek Harness 的零 LLM 调用上下文压缩引擎，通过原子引用图剪枝实现确定性压缩与选择性遗忘，支持 recall 取回。
description.en: dsh-argp is a zero-LLM context compaction engine for DeepSeek Harness, using atomic reference-graph pruning for deterministic compression and selective forgetting with recall.

description.zh: DSH plugin 全量用量看板，按模型、供应商、工作区与时间范围分析 Token、缓存与 DeepSeek 余额，支持热力图与 CSV 导出。
description.en: A DSH plugin usage dashboard analyzing tokens, cache, and DeepSeek balance by model, provider, workspace, and time range, with heatmap and CSV export.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Auto 权限档提供 LLM 辅助自动审批与超时兜底，通过静态规则、LLM 分类、人工倒计时和熔断机制，实现安全高效的自动审批。
description.en: Provides LLM-assisted auto approval with timeout fallback for DeepSeek Harness Auto preset, using static rules, LLM classification, human countdown, and circuit breaker for safe automated approval.

description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness Web界面提供Claude风格皮肤：暖黑画布、陶橙点缀，支持Anthropic字体切换与亮暗主题跟随。
description.en: A Claude-style skin for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with warm-black canvas, clay accents, Anthropic font switching, and light/dark theme support.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通过本地 Obsidian/Markdown 仓库为 AI 提供持久记忆，注册 5 个文件工具并在侧边栏显示仓库状态。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives your AI agent persistent memory via a local Obsidian/Markdown vault, registering 5 file tools and a sidebar panel.

description.zh: DSH Web 插件，一键将 git diff 转为独立双列代码审查页，支持语法高亮与行内评论，提升代码审查效率。
description.en: DSH web plugin that turns git diff into a standalone two-column code review page with syntax highlighting and inline comments.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话彻底删除能力：侧边栏一键删除对话，并连带清理日志、缓存、附件与子会话等本地残留数据。
description.en: A DSH plugin that permanently deletes a conversation from the sidebar along with every local copy of its data, including session logs, projection caches, attachments and subagent sessions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自定义模式设置页：可新建多个助手模式、选择基础模式、逐行开关插件，并直接编辑系统提示词，保存后下一步模型调用即生效，无需重启或新建会话。
description.en: A settings page for DeepSeek Harness that lets you create multiple custom agent modes, pick each one's base mode, toggle mounted plugin rows, and edit its system prompt — changes take effect on the next model step, with no restart or new session.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让每次 agent 编辑都可审批：侧边栏集中展示 diff，支持逐文件/逐块保留或回退，并可导入 Git/SVN/Perforce 本地改动。
description.en: Make every agent edit approvable in DeepSeek Harness: review full-diff in sidebar, keep/revert per-file or per-block, and import VCS local changes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 装上 12 角色专家团：一句话组队，走 9 阶段门控流水线交付代码，全程留痕可复核。
description.en: A DSH plugin that spins up a 12-role expert team in DeepSeek Harness, delivering code through a 9-stage gated pipeline with full auditable artifacts.

description.zh: dsh-dock 是 DeepSeek Harness 的功能坞插件，用一张管理面板统一注册、开关模型余额、用量记录、任务动画等小功能，每个功能独立模块，即插即用。
description.en: dsh-dock is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides a unified dashboard to register and toggle small features like model balance, usage tracking, and task animations, with each feature as an independent module.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 设置面板中编辑 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md 全局规则，保存后新会话立即生效，零构建、即装即用。
description.en: Edit ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md global rules from the DeepSeek Harness web settings panel; changes take effect immediately for new sessions, zero-build and ready to use.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 web_search 和 web_fetch 接入 Firecrawl，提供 JS 渲染、反爬处理和 PDF 解析，无需新增工具即可增强网页检索与抓取能力。
description.en: Integrates Firecrawl into DeepSeek Harness's web_search and web_fetch tools, adding JS rendering, anti-bot handling, and PDF parsing without new tools.

description.zh: DSH plugin 多对话面板，并排查看并与多个 Agent 会话同时交互，支持拖拽与深浅色模式。
description.en: Multiple chat panels for DeepSeek Harness: view and interact with several Agents side by side, with drag-and-drop and dark/light mode.

description.zh: DSH 提示词库插件，在聊天栏注入提示词库按钮，管理可复用 prompt 片段，支持一键插入、AI 润色与角色定制，自动学习输入内容。
description.en: A DSH prompt library plugin that adds a prompt library button to the chat bar, enabling management of reusable prompts with one-click insert, AI polish, and persona customization, plus auto-learning of input.

description.zh: DSH 通知中心插件：对话/任务完成、报错、等待批准等事件触发浏览器系统通知与 21 种提示音效，切窗不遗漏。
description.en: DSH notification center plugin: triggers browser system notifications and 21 sound effects on events like conversation/task completion, errors, and approval waits, so you never miss a thing.

description.zh: dsh-router 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenAI 兼容路由插件，内嵌于 DSH web，提供模型路由、账号池、用量看板等能力。
description.en: dsh-router is an OpenAI-compatible routing plugin for DeepSeek Harness, embedded in DSH web, offering model routing, account pool, and usage dashboard.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 增加技能管理页，集中查看、下载、上传、重命名、启停与编辑 SKILL.md，并列出插件内置与无文件技能。
description.en: Adds a Skills page to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI for inspecting, downloading, uploading, renaming, enabling and editing SKILL.md files, including plugin-bundled and file-less skills.

description.zh: dsh-soup 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加右侧文件树、会话内预览、多行 GoalBar 与实时速率徽标等 UI 调料，让 DSH 界面更美味好用。
description.en: dsh-soup adds UI seasonings to DeepSeek Harness: a right-side file tree, in-session preview, multi-line GoalBar, and a live token-rate badge, making the DSH interface tastier and more usable.

description.zh: SGME 拾光记忆引擎为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话、多智能体共享的长期记忆，自动沉淀对话为结构化记忆并按场景注入，同时统一管理技能库与 WIKI 知识库。
description.en: SGME (ShiGuang Memory Engine) gives DeepSeek Harness a shared long-term memory across sessions and agents, distilling conversations into structured memories injected by scenario, plus unified skills and wiki knowledge management.

description.zh: dsh-auxiliary 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供视觉理解、上下文压缩、审批审查、子代理、会话标题与图片生成等辅助模型路由，不触碰主对话模型。
description.en: dsh-auxiliary provides dedicated model routes for vision, context compaction, approval reviews, subagents, session titles, and image generation in DeepSeek Harness, without touching the main conversation model.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面加一只可拖动的大肥鱼宠物，随 Agent 工作节奏切换动画与台词，并支持替换角色包。
description.en: A draggable Bigfish pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that reacts to agent activity with animations and lines, plus swappable character packs.

description.zh: 将 Cline 免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness（DSH plugin），自动同步并过滤所有免费模型，配置 API Key 即可使用。
description.en: Integrate Cline free models into DeepSeek Harness (DSH plugin), auto-sync and filter free models, just configure API key.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来生成式交互界面：DSH plugin 让 Agent 自主选择纯文本、26 种原生组件或沙箱实时小组件，随回答流式渲染，排序、筛选、滑块等交互在浏览器本地即时响应。
description.en: Generative, interactive UI for DeepSeek Harness: this DSH plugin lets the agent choose plain text, 26 native components or a sandboxed live widget, streamed progressively with local sorting, filtering and sliders.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通过 OpenAI Codex OAuth 接入 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 的 Codex 模型，支持流式、工具调用、推理、自动刷新令牌等能力，无需 Pi 安装。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that brings ChatGPT Plus/Pro Codex models via OpenAI Codex OAuth, with streaming, tool calls, reasoning, and automatic token refresh.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 AI 智能体提供持续学习能力：持久记忆、跨会话知识共享、定期审查与自动优化，失败时自动回滚，形成自我改进闭环。
description.en: A DSH plugin enabling self-improving AI agents with persistent memory, cross-session knowledge sharing, periodic review-and-refine, and automatic rollback.

description.zh: DSH 插件回归评测门禁：YAML 用例驱动真实 agent 跑测，解析 session trace 断言，对比 baseline 输出 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告与 CI 退出码。
description.en: Regression eval harness for DeepSeek Harness plugins: YAML cases drive real agent runs, assert on session traces, compare against baseline for PASS/WARN/FAIL gates and CI exit codes.

description.zh: DSH plugin 助你在超长会话中快速查看、搜索并跳转到所有你发送的消息，即使历史已被压缩或未加载。
description.en: A DSH plugin to quickly view, search, and jump to all your sent messages in long conversations, even those compacted or not yet loaded.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 GitHub 工作流插件，基于 gh CLI 打通 PR、Issue 与 Actions CI 诊断，提供 Agent 工具、Slash 指令与原生 Web UI 面板。
description.en: A GitHub workflow plugin for DeepSeek Harness built on the gh CLI, covering PRs, Issues and Actions CI diagnosis with agent tools, slash commands and native Web UI panels.

description.zh: 把 Jev 判定模型接入 DeepSeek Harness：在工具结果进入上下文前精简长输出、筛查网页注入指令，并在宣布完成前核对证据。
description.en: Wires the Jev judgment model into DeepSeek Harness: pruning long tool output before it enters context, screening fetched pages for injected instructions, and gating completion claims on evidence.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在侧边栏新对话按钮下方添加「网页对话」入口，一键打开 chat.deepseek.com，桌面端支持独立子窗口。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a 'Web Chat' button below the new-chat button in the sidebar, opening chat.deepseek.com, with desktop multi-window support.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 开启局域网访问的 DSH 插件，带口令门与防火墙自动放行，并针对手机竖屏优化官方界面触控体验。
description.en: A DSH plugin that opens LAN access for DeepSeek Harness with a passphrase gate and automatic firewall rules, plus touch-friendly portrait UI tuning for phones.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加 Codex 风格左侧消息导航轨道，在长会话中快速定位历史用户消息，支持悬停预览与点击跳转。
description.en: Adds a Codex-style left message rail to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI for quickly navigating long conversations, with hover preview and click-to-jump.

description.zh: dsh-mask 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 PII 脱敏中间件，在消息抵达模型前把手机号、邮箱、身份证、银行卡、密钥等替换为占位符，并在宿主侧保留可还原映射表，明文永不进入会话日志。
description.en: dsh-mask is a PII masking middleware for DeepSeek Harness: it replaces phones, emails, ID cards, bank cards and keys with placeholders before messages reach the model, keeping a host-side restore table so plaintext never enters the session log.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供单核写作插件，含子代理并发设置与完整小说创作预设，面向量化小模型精简工具并加固输出，可在本机跑长篇小说流水线。
description.en: A single-author novel-writing plugin for DeepSeek Harness, featuring a subagent concurrency setting and a full novel-creation preset, slimmed for quantized small models to run a full-length pipeline locally.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 OpenTelemetry 与 Langfuse 可观测性导出，把会话事件转成 turn/step/tool/LLM 追踪与 token 成本指标，默认关闭。
description.en: OpenTelemetry and Langfuse observability exporter for DeepSeek Harness, turning session events into turn/step/tool/LLM spans plus token and cost metrics, off by default.

description.zh: 为路由到 OpenCode / OpenCode Go 的模型调用自动附加 x-opencode-session 请求头，修复 400 MissingSessionID 报错，并按 DSH 会话保持稳定会话 ID 以复用上游缓存。
description.en: A DSH plugin that automatically attaches the x-opencode-session header to model calls routed to OpenCode / OpenCode Go providers, fixing 400 MissingSessionID errors while keeping one stable session id per DSH conversation for upstream cache affinity.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Langfuse 可观测性，将每次会话导出为 OpenTelemetry 追踪树并发送至 Langfuse，支持反馈评分与子代理追踪。
description.en: Langfuse observability for DeepSeek Harness: exports agent sessions as OpenTelemetry trace trees to Langfuse, with feedback scores and subagent lineage.

description.zh: DSH plugin 替代 Web 工作区侧栏，顶部展示全局最近会话，提供 Workspace→Session 二级菜单与面包屑导航，并按日期分组会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin replacing the Web workspace sidebar with top recent sessions, a two-level Workspace→Session menu, breadcrumbs, and date-grouped sessions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供持久化输出风格：在设置页选择内置风格或自建 Markdown 风格，选中后自动注入每个 Agent 的系统提示词，无需重启。
description.en: Persistent output styles for DeepSeek Harness Web: pick a built-in style or create named Markdown styles from Settings, and the chosen style is injected into every agent's system prompt without a restart.

description.zh: 预设工坊是 DeepSeek Harness 的透明预设工作台，可管理人设、系统提示词、工具与技能，并预览请求的实际组成。
description.en: Preset Workshop is a transparent preset workbench for DeepSeek Harness, letting you manage personas, system prompts, tools and skills while previewing the actual request composition.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏提供会话与工作区置顶的 DSH 插件，支持两级置顶、8 色行色标、看板标签与 /goto 导航整理。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pins sessions and workspaces to the top of the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, with two pin levels, 8-color row swatches, boards, tags and /goto navigation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供移动端体验优化：会话 Tab Bar、侧栏滑动开合、输入法适配等 13 项可开关功能。
description.en: Mobile-first quality-of-life plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: session tab bar, swipeable sidebar, IME and touch adaptations across 13 toggleable features.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供办公效率技能专家组，通过标准技能注册表安装 excel2insights 与 sum2slides-pro 两个纯本地技能，无需手动复制文件。
description.en: Provides an office productivity skill suite for DeepSeek Harness, installing excel2insights and sum2slides-pro via the standard skills registry with no manual file copying.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供侧边会话：从当前会话分叉出临时对话，共享同一 agent 与工具，能真实编辑工作区文件而不污染主对话记录。
description.en: A side chat for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI that forks the current session into an ephemeral conversation sharing the same agent and tools, so it can really edit workspace files without polluting the main transcript.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供侧边会话：从当前会话分叉出临时对话，共享同一 agent 与工具，能真实编辑工作区文件而不污染主对话记录。
description.en: A side chat for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI that forks the current session into an ephemeral conversation sharing the same agent and tools, so it can really edit workspace files without polluting the main transcript.

description.zh: DSH plugin 能力库，一站式可视化管理 SKILL 与 MCP：按需加载、会话内热重载，并可在插件内查看描述。
description.en: A DSH plugin for one-stop visual management of SKILLs & MCPs: on-demand loading, in-session hot reload, and descriptions viewable in the plugin.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 AI 驱动的 SSH 连接管理与多标签终端面板，支持模型自主连接、执行命令及实时查看输出。
description.en: AI-driven SSH connection manager and multi-tab terminal panel for DeepSeek Harness, enabling model-driven connect, exec, and live output viewing.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造可视化 agent 团队：常驻队友、共享任务列表、成员邮箱与 2.5D 协作室，让多智能体协作一目了然。
description.en: Add a visible agent team to DeepSeek Harness: named long-lived teammates, shared task list, member mailbox, and a 2.5D team room for transparent multi-agent collaboration.

description.zh: dsh-sync 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 配置同步插件，可选择性同步设置与 profile，自动排除密钥和本地值，支持逐行审查与冲突处理。
description.en: dsh-sync is a DSH plugin for Git-based sync of settings and profiles, with selective sync, secret exclusion, per-line review, and conflict handling.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨 11 家厂商的参数翻译与确定性 JSON 修复：/translate 映射 temperature、top_p 等参数，修复层在不编造数据的前提下修好坏掉的工具 JSON 输出。
description.en: Vendor parameter translation and deterministic JSON repair for DeepSeek Harness: /translate maps temperature, top_p and more across 11 vendors, while the repair layer fixes broken JSON tool output without ever inventing data.
