description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供回合与步骤折叠：工具调用与 Think 自动收成折叠栏，运行中实时显示耗时、token 与缓存命中率。
description.en: A DSH plugin that folds tool calls and Think blocks into collapsible step and turn bars, showing live latency, token usage and cache hit rate.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 叠加 VS Code 风格本地开发工作台，集成资源管理器、编辑器、搜索、Git 与提交图表。
description.en: A DSH plugin that overlays a VS Code-style local dev workbench on DeepSeek Harness, with explorer, editor, search, Git and commit graph.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话回收站与永久删除功能，支持侧边栏一键删除、批量恢复或彻底清除，并保护活跃会话。
description.en: Adds a session recycle bin and permanent delete for DeepSeek Harness, with sidebar delete, batch restore/purge, and live-session protection.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注入多智能体编排层，提供 autopilot、ralph、team 三种执行模式与 19 个角色卡、40 个双语技能，一句话即可驱动从需求到流水线的全流程自动协作。
description.en: A multi-agent orchestration layer for DeepSeek Harness, adding autopilot, ralph and team execution modes with 19 role cards, 40 bilingual skills and a bundled MCP state server for end-to-end automated collaboration.

description.zh: tencentcloud-agentobs-sdk-dsh 是 DeepSeek Harness 的可观测插件，将 session、agent loop、LLM stream 与 tool 生命周期转换为腾讯云 CLS 的 5 层 span 模型并直接上报，无需额外部署 OTLP 收集器。
description.en: tencentcloud-agentobs-sdk-dsh is a DeepSeek Harness observability plugin that converts session, agent loop, LLM stream, and tool lifecycle into Tencent Cloud CLS's 5-layer span model and uploads directly without extra OTLP collector.

description.zh: 师弟（shidi）是运行在 AI IDE 中的科研工作流技能，为 DeepSeek Harness 等 Agent 提供文献调研、实验方案、科研作图、论文精读等能力，交付可交叉验证的文件。
description.en: Shidi is a research workflow skill for coding agents, enabling literature review, experiment design, figure generation, and paper reading with file-based, cross-verifiable deliverables.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 A2A 协议双端能力：可同时托管多个入站 Agent 服务并连接多个出站远端，远端技能直接变成模型工具。
description.en: An A2A dual-end plugin for DeepSeek Harness that hosts multiple inbound agent servers and connects multiple outbound remotes, exposing remote skills as model tools.

description.zh: DSH plugin 实时监控 DeepSeek Harness 推理链的锚定状态，三频段检测思维漂移，并自动执行 L1/L2/L3 分级干预，附带玻璃态可视化面板。
description.en: A DSH plugin that monitors chain-of-thought anchoring in DeepSeek Harness in real time, detects drift via three-band fingerprinting, and applies tiered L1/L2/L3 interventions with a glass UI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供受控浏览器自动化能力，通过 agent_browser 工具驱动 agent-browser CLI 操作 Chromium，并防护失效引用、标签漂移与敏感信息泄露。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness controlled browser automation: an agent_browser tool drives the agent-browser CLI against Chromium, guarding against stale refs, tab drift and secret leakage.

description.zh: DSH plugin 造书工作台：把教材 PDF 加工成 AI 教学蓝本的 6 阶段流水线，主 AI 全程把关，你只需上传、拍板、抽查。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns textbook PDFs into AI teaching blueprints via a 6-stage pipeline, with the main AI handling quality and you just uploading, approving, and reviewing.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供动态上下文裁剪：由模型自行把历史折叠成摘要，并自动去重重复的工具输出，缓解长会话上下文压力。
description.en: Dynamic context pruning for DeepSeek Harness: model-driven compaction of history into summaries plus automatic deduplication of repeated tool output to relieve long-session context pressure.

description.zh: dsh-cron 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 /cron 斜杠命令，支持按 cron 表达式定时触发循环 Agent 任务，可暂停、恢复并跨重启持久化。
description.en: dsh-cron adds a /cron slash command to DeepSeek Harness for cron-scheduled recurring agent loops, with pause, resume, and persistence across restarts.

description.zh: DSH plugin 接管 edit/write 工具卡片，用近线性行级 diff 消除内置 DiffBlock 的重复渲染，仅显示真实差异并高亮行内改动字符。
description.en: A DSH plugin that takes over edit/write tool cards, using near-linear line-level diff to eliminate duplicate rendering of the built-in DiffBlock, showing only real changes with inline character highlighting.

description.zh: DSH Expert Mode 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供专家模式预设，内置首席协调官与 17 位领域专家子代理，自动委派任务，实现全栈多智能体协作。
description.en: DSH Expert Mode is an agent-preset plugin for DeepSeek Harness, featuring a chief coordinator and 17 domain-expert subagents that auto-delegate tasks for full-stack multi-agent collaboration.

description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 能力封装为 MCP 服务器，让任何 MCP 客户端（如 Hermes）驱动 Harness 执行真实编码任务，实现脑臂协同。
description.en: Expose DeepSeek Harness agent capabilities as an MCP server, enabling any MCP client (e.g., Hermes) to drive Harness for real coding tasks.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 Web GUI 提供安卓真机 Logcat 调试面板：自动连接 adb 设备、实时日志过滤、崩溃快照、投屏操控，并开放 30 个 agent 工具，助力实机调试与逆向。
description.en: A DSH plugin bringing an Android Logcat debugging panel to the Web GUI: auto-connect adb devices, live filtered logs, crash snapshots, screen mirroring, plus 30 agent tools for on-device debugging and reverse engineering.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上多模态能力：一个 mmx_bridge 工具即让纯文本模型看图、画图、生视频、语音合成、音乐与翻唱、联网搜索及查额度。
description.en: Adds full MiniMax multimodality to DeepSeek Harness: a single mmx_bridge tool lets text-only models see images, generate pictures and videos, do speech, music and covers, web search and quota checks.

description.zh: dsh-overleaf 通过 OverleafMCP 将多个 Overleaf 项目接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持浏览、读取与写回 LaTeX 文件，助力理解项目、修复编译错误与统一术语。
description.en: dsh-overleaf connects multiple Overleaf projects to DeepSeek Harness via OverleafMCP, enabling browsing, reading, and writing back LaTeX files to fix errors and unify terminology.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让 DeepSeek Harness 在局域网内可被手机、平板、电脑浏览器直接访问，无需 SSH 或内网穿透，并自动适配窄屏移动端。
description.en: A DSH plugin that makes DeepSeek Harness accessible over LAN from phones, tablets, and computers via browser, no SSH or tunneling needed, with automatic mobile adaptation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 桌宠小鲸鱼，随 agent 状态实时切换动画，纯 DOM 零依赖，为 DeepSeek Harness 界面增添趣味。
description.en: A desktop pet whale for DeepSeek Harness, animating with agent states, pure DOM and zero dependencies.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供结构化代码智能：内置 tree-sitter 索引器与查询工具，让 Agent 直接查清符号在哪声明、被谁调用、改动会波及什么。
description.en: Structural code intelligence for DeepSeek Harness: a built-in tree-sitter indexer plus query tools that tell the agent where a symbol is declared, who calls it, and what a change reaches.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地 Word、PDF、演示文稿与电子表格的创建、读取和编辑能力，并支持侧边栏预览标注与修改请求。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness local Word, PDF, presentation and spreadsheet creation, reading and editing, plus sidebar preview annotations and revision requests.

description.zh: DSH plugin 联合工作区插件，将多个目录合并到一个会话，让 AI 同时访问所有成员目录，并支持可配置的写入权限范围。
description.en: A DSH plugin that merges multiple directories into one session, letting the AI access all member directories with configurable write scopes.

description.zh: DSH 排队消息增强面板，支持编辑、删除、插话、排序与批量删除，让排队消息管理更高效。
description.en: Enhanced DSH queue panel with edit, delete, interject, reorder, and batch delete for efficient queue management.

description.zh: DSH Reasoning Slider 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供模型感知的推理努力度滑块，支持原生与 WebGL 能量场两种模式，并适配明暗主题。
description.en: DSH Reasoning Slider adds a model-aware reasoning effort slider to DeepSeek Harness, with Native and WebGL energy field modes and light/dark themes.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 append-only 会话日志变成可交互回放：时间线播放、token 账单、安全审计、fork 血缘树与双会话对比，全部内嵌在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns append-only session logs into interactive replays: timeline playback, token billing, security audit, fork tree, and side-by-side comparison, all embedded in the DeepSeek Harness web UI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件做多维度质量评分：从安装成功率、维护活跃度、文档、安全与协议合规五方面打分，结论均有 CLI 证据与审计时间戳支撑。
description.en: Multi-dimensional quality scoring for DeepSeek Harness plugins: install success, maintenance, docs, security and protocol compliance, with every verdict backed by real CLI evidence and audit timestamps.

description.zh: DSH plugin，在Web设置页提供Skill管理面板，可启停技能，停用的技能对Agent运行时完全不可见。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing a settings-page panel to enable/disable skills; disabled skills are never discovered by agents at runtime.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件提供隔离的安装与冒烟测试：在一次性 profile 中安装、校验补丁层与启动日志，输出结构化通过/失败矩阵并自动清理临时目录。
description.en: Isolated install-and-smoke test drives for DeepSeek Harness plugins: install into a throwaway profile, verify the bundle patch layer and boot logs, emit a structured pass/fail matrix, and quarantine all temp directories.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Tavily 联网搜索：注册 ctx.web 搜索 provider，并提供搜索、正文抽取、爬取、站点地图与深度研究五个工具及设置页。
description.en: Adds Tavily web search to DeepSeek Harness: registers a ctx.web search provider plus search, extract, crawl, map and research tools with a settings page.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供闭环轨迹控制平面，管理任务阶段、验证债务与性能回归，确保 Agent 行为可验证、可追踪。
description.en: A closed-loop trajectory control plane for DeepSeek Harness, managing task episodes, verification debt, and performance regression to keep agent behavior verifiable and traceable.

description.zh: DSH 低成本视频理解插件：将 B站或本地视频压缩为 AVIS 信息层，实现摘要与问答，token 压缩 99.95%+。
description.en: Low-cost video understanding plugin for DSH: compresses Bilibili or local videos into an AVIS info layer for summarization and Q&A, with 99.95%+ token compression.

description.zh: 鲸鱼电表为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 token 用量与费用面板，支持多厂商 46 个模型精准计价、段位统计与涨价对比，数据全在本机。
description.en: Whale Meter is a DSH plugin that tracks token usage and costs, with precise pricing for 46 models across 6 providers, tier stats, and price-change comparison, all local.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供远程工作区能力：在 DSH 内管理 SSH 主机、打开远程终端、浏览编辑远程文件与 Git，并把远程目录添加为工作区，让 Agent 的读写与命令都跑在远程机器上。
description.en: A remote workspace plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): manage SSH hosts, open remote terminals, browse and edit remote files and Git, and add remote directories as workspaces so the Agent's file operations and commands run on the remote machine.

description.zh: DSH plugin 数据保险箱，自动备份聊天记录与工作区数据，检测清空并一键恢复，保护 DeepSeek Harness 数据安全。
description.en: A DSH plugin data vault that auto-backs up chat history and workspace data, detects wipes, and restores with one click to safeguard DeepSeek Harness data.

description.zh: DSH plugin 用于按轮次控制推理强度（reasoning_effort），支持手动固定或根据工具调用历史自动调度，让简单工具调用保持低成本，复杂任务获得充足思考。
description.en: A DSH plugin for per-round reasoning_effort control, offering manual wire levels or auto scheduling based on tool-call history to keep cheap rounds cheap and heavy work well-resourced.

description.zh: WeShop 电商视觉工作区插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供无限画布与 AI 创意技能，支持商品图、模特试穿、背景替换等电商创作。
description.en: WeShop e-commerce visual workspace plugin for DeepSeek Harness, offering an infinite canvas with AI creative skills for product photography, virtual try-on, and background editing.

description.zh: DSH plugin 修复 OpenCode ZEN 免费模型 429 限流错误，通过补丁让自定义 User-Agent 请求头生效，识别为 opencode 客户端。
description.en: A DSH plugin that fixes the OpenCode ZEN free model 429 rate limit error by patching request headers to identify as the opencode client.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Catppuccin 柔和配色主题，内置四种风味，可在设置中一键切换，并记住你的选择。
description.en: A soothing Catppuccin pastel theme for DeepSeek Harness, offering four flavors with per-browser preference persistence.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 /context 命令与右侧悬浮卡，以环形图实时展示上下文 token 用量、压缩收益与费用估算，对标 Claude Code 的 /context。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a /context command and a floating sidebar card, visualizing token usage, compaction savings, and cost estimates in a donut chart, similar to Claude Code's /context.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上归档会话管理中心，可按日期、工作区筛选历史会话，批量取消归档，并用可撤销策略自动清理会话列表。
description.en: Adds an archived-session management center to DeepSeek Harness: browse archived sessions by date or workspace, unarchive in bulk, and run a reversible auto-cleanup policy.

description.zh: 这款 DSH plugin 为主会话和所有子代理注入全局系统提示词，让内部推理与回复统一使用简体中文，无需依赖项目 AGENTS.md。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that injects a global system-prompt policy so the main session and every subagent reason and reply in Simplified Chinese, without relying on a project AGENTS.md.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 添加多媒体输入与工作区附件功能，支持文件/文件夹选择、拖拽上传，发送时自动复制到 Agent 工作区。
description.en: Adds multimedia input and workspace attachments to the DeepSeek Harness WebUI, supporting file/folder selection and drag-and-drop, with files copied to the Agent workspace on send.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 在 Windows 上提供 Git Bash 与 WSL2 bash 工具，支持 bwrap 沙箱、审批模式与后台任务，补齐官方 bash 缺失。
description.en: Provides Git Bash and WSL2 bash tools for DeepSeek Harness on Windows, with bwrap sandbox, approval mode, and background tasks, filling the gap of missing official bash.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按工作区或会话分发 system prompt 人设的能力，多套人设可精确匹配、优先级排序并设默认兜底，全部在 Web 设置页管理。
description.en: A DSH plugin that assigns system-prompt personas per workspace or session, with precise matching, priority ordering and an optional default fallback, all managed from the Web settings page.

description.zh: DSH 角色扮演插件，让 Agent 扮演任意角色对话，支持角色卡导入导出、自然语言建卡，内置默认角色，保留干活能力。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets your Agent cosplay any character, with character card import/export, natural language card creation, and a built-in default character, while keeping its working abilities.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Web UI 中提供 IDEA 风格分支选择器与 worktree 隔离管理，支持就地切换分支、创建独立工作区并自定义存储路径。
description.en: A DSH plugin offering an IDEA-style branch picker and worktree isolation in the Web UI, enabling in-place branch switching, isolated workspaces, and configurable storage root.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边栏绘画页与全局图库的 DSH 生图插件，支持对话中直接生图改图，并可自定义服务商端点与代理。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that adds a sidebar painting page and global gallery, letting the agent generate and edit images in chat with custom provider endpoints and proxies.

description.zh: DSH plugin，用 GitHub 账号登录即可在 DeepSeek Harness 内调用 Copilot 全系模型（GPT-4.1、Claude、Gemini 等），并支持图片输入。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets you sign in with GitHub and use every Copilot model (GPT-4.1, Claude, Gemini, etc.) inside DeepSeek Harness, with vision support.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web UI 增加日语本地化，收录 1257 条界面文案并自动套用日文字体，语言选择随设置持久保存。
description.en: Adds Japanese localization to the DeepSeek Harness web UI, shipping 1,257 translated UI strings with Japanese system fonts and a persisted language preference.

description.zh: dsh-notify-windows 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 插件，在任务完成、等待审批或 Agent 提问时向 Windows 推送系统桌面通知，让你离开屏幕也不错过待办。
description.en: dsh-notify-windows is a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that fires native Windows desktop notifications when a task finishes, an approval is pending, or the agent asks a question, so you never miss a hand-off while away from the screen.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面加载 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸的 DSH plugin：支持 mpkg/创意工坊目录、视频/网页/图片壁纸、多时段切换、轮播、磨砂虚化与主题色，几乎每个外观细节都可调。
description.en: A DSH plugin that loads Wallpaper Engine wallpapers as the DeepSeek Harness web background: supports mpkg/Steam Workshop folders, video/web/image wallpapers, time-of-day switching, carousel, frosted blur and theme color, with nearly every visual detail adjustable.

description.zh: 把 AI 开发进度翻译成产品视角仪表盘，DSH 插件用三份人话 Markdown 生成离线单文件网页，并可在右侧栏面板随时查看与拍板。
description.en: Turns AI-assisted development into a product-level dashboard: this DSH plugin renders three plain-language Markdown files into a single offline HTML page and pins it to the sidebar panel for review and sign-off.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 dsh web 界面右下角显示各 AI provider 的配额/余额，自动发现已配置密钥的 provider，支持用量窗口、代理与主题，零 npm 依赖。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows provider quota/balance in the dsh web UI, auto-discovers configured providers, supports usage windows, proxy, theming, zero npm deps.

description.zh: DSH 插件 dsh-repeat-guard 持续监测模型思考过程，命中白名单短句且仍要继续思考时强行打断并注入续跑指令，遏制 deepseek-v4.1-flash 等模型的复读与无端长思考，避免空耗 token。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that watches the model's reasoning stream, force-interrupts when a whitelisted filler sentence appears and thinking would otherwise continue, then injects a resume prompt to stop deepseek-v4.1-flash style looping and token waste.

description.zh: dsh-self-improved 为 DeepSeek Harness 注入跨会话长期记忆与自我进化能力，自动提炼对话要点、注入相关记忆并合成技能，全程本地运行。
description.en: dsh-self-improved adds cross-session long-term memory and self-evolution to DeepSeek Harness: auto-distills conversation insights, injects relevant memories, and synthesizes skills, fully local.

description.zh: DSH plugin 网页抓取与分析工具，注册 scrape_webpage 模型工具，提取标题、正文、标题结构、链接与关键词，支持图片下载与识图插件接入。
description.en: A DSH plugin for web scraping and analysis, registering the scrape_webpage model tool to extract titles, content, headings, links, keywords, and optionally download images for vision analysis.

description.zh: DSH 插件，将流式输出改为按段落分批淡入呈现，支持平滑滚动跟随、思考摘要与八种入场动画，显著提升阅读体验。
description.en: A DSH plugin that batches streaming output into paragraphs with fade-in reveals, smooth scroll-follow, thinking summaries, and 8 entrance animations for a better reading experience.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Web GUI 底部统计条中实时估算当前会话的 DeepSeek API 费用，按命中/未命中/输出分项展示，并自动适配峰谷计价。
description.en: A DSH plugin that estimates the DeepSeek API cost for the current session in the web GUI stats strip, breaking down hit/miss/output and adapting to peak/off-peak pricing.

description.zh: DSH Web 界面的大模型余量与用量监控插件，会话头部实时余量徽标，主区用量页签，本地 SQLite 记录 token 与费用。
description.en: A DSH plugin for monitoring LLM quota and usage in the web UI, with real-time quota badges and a usage tab, storing token and cost data in local SQLite.

description.zh: DSH plugin 写文引擎，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供长篇网文创作能力：独立 key 分流生成、设定管理、语义检索与书库，保障长篇一致性。
description.en: A DSH plugin writing engine that empowers DeepSeek Harness with long-form web-novel creation: separate-key parallel generation, lore management, semantic retrieval, and a corpus library for consistency.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在设置页提供 Token 用量统计：KPI、活跃热力图、按模型堆叠柱状图与环形图，并支持导出。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds token usage analytics under Settings → Usage: KPIs, activity heatmap, per-model stacked bars and donut chart, with export.

description.zh: 为 DSH WebUI 提供持久化登录认证的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，未认证浏览器无法加载资源、调用接口或建立实时连接，并修复反代 Host 改写下的登录跳转。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin adding persistent WebUI authentication so unauthenticated browsers cannot load assets, call APIs, or open live connections, plus a redirect fix for proxy Host rewriting.

description.zh: oh-my-dsh 是 DSH plugin 组合包，为 DeepSeek Harness Web 端一次性带来手机界面、登录、文件与 Git 侧栏、MCP 管理、搜索切换与 Codex 支持。
description.en: oh-my-dsh is a DSH plugin bundle that equips DeepSeek Harness Web with a mobile UI, login, file/Git sidebar, MCP management, search provider switching and Codex support in one install.

description.zh: Hermes Loop 是 DeepSeek Harness 的自动复盘插件：对话收尾后自动蒸馏经验为可复用技能，并把长期事实与偏好写入跨会话记忆。
description.en: Hermes Loop is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that auto-reviews finished conversations, distilling experience into reusable skills and persisting durable facts and preferences into cross-session memory.

description.zh: 映流是 DSH plugin 视频工作台：在对话中生成图文分镜与前端动画，逐帧调整镜头并导出本地 MP4。
description.en: Yingliu is a DSH plugin video studio: generate storyboards and front-end animations in chat, fine-tune shots, and export local MP4 files.

description.zh: RainSkills 是一组面向 DeepSeek Harness 等 Agent 的开源技能包，让 Agent 复用当前项目上下文，把应用部署到 Rainbond 并完成页面与 API 交付验证、排障、快照与回滚。
description.en: RainSkills is an open-source Agent Skills bundle for DeepSeek Harness and other agents, letting them reuse the current project context to deploy apps on Rainbond and verify pages and APIs, with troubleshooting, snapshots and rollback.

description.zh: 为 DSH 网页端提供双向语音：说话即转写进输入框，回复自动朗读，麦克风持续监听。
description.en: A two-way voice DSH plugin for the web app: speak to dictate into the composer, hear replies read aloud, with the mic kept listening.

description.zh: walioffice-dsh-plugin 是 DeepSeek Harness 的办公工具插件，一次注册 PPT、Word、Excel、图表等 10 个工具并注入 WaLiOffice Web 界面，无需复制源码。
description.en: walioffice-dsh-plugin is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that registers 10 office tools (PPT, Word, Excel, charts, etc.) and injects the WaLiOffice Web UI in one install.

description.zh: dsh-relay 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页配置提供带认证的远程访问，通过 TLS、密码登录、QR/配对码设备绑定及按设备撤销，在保持环回监听的同时安全地从手机访问。
description.en: dsh-relay provides authenticated remote access for a DeepSeek Harness web profile, with TLS, password sign-in, QR/passcode device pairing, and per-device revocation, while keeping the harness on loopback.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框下方提供实时余额读数：用本机 token 消耗推算 API 余额与可用时长，按峰谷分档计价并自动校准。
description.en: A live balance readout for DeepSeek Harness: it projects your API balance and time-to-empty from this machine's own token usage, priced by peak/off-peak tiers with self-calibration.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供能力面板，实时展示当前会话中技能、MCP 服务器与系统工具的真实上下文状态，并支持按会话或预设一键开关。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness panel showing the live session's skills, MCP servers, and system tools with their true in-context state, plus per-session and per-preset switches.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供审批、回答、完成、错误四类通知声音与中文语音提醒，并带专属设置页。
description.en: Adds notification sounds and Chinese voice alerts for approval, answer, completion, and error events in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, with a dedicated settings page.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让 DeepSeek Harness 原生支持中文技能名，无需改英文即可用 /私 补全、/私家大厨 直达，并打通 skill() 调用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that enables native Chinese skill names in DeepSeek Harness, supporting /私 completion, /私家大厨 direct trigger, and skill() calls without renaming.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面换上《鸣潮》清宵主题的 DSH plugin：冰蓝月白配色、可换背景画卷、毛玻璃面板与剑气流光粒子。
description.en: A DSH plugin that reskins the DeepSeek Harness web GUI with a Qingxiao (Wuthering Waves) theme: ice-blue palette, swappable background art, frosted-glass panels and sword-light particles.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 的聊天输入框换成 CodeMirror 6 代码编辑器风格面板，支持普通、悬浮、侧栏标签三态单实例，保留官方 / @ 触发、模型权限控件与草稿持久化。
description.en: Replaces the DeepSeek Harness WebUI composer with a CodeMirror 6 code-editor style input panel — inline, floating or sidebar tab, always exactly one — keeping the official / and @ triggers, model and permission controls, stats and draft persistence.

description.zh: duet 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来全双工语音交互，边听边说即可输入、发送、切换会话，任务完成后语音播报结果。
description.en: duet brings full-duplex voice control to DeepSeek Harness: speak to type, send, and switch sessions, with spoken result announcements when tasks finish.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供统一的静态图像生成路由，一个 image_generate 工具即可按配置调度 OpenAI Images、智谱 CogView 等兼容端点，并带健康感知回退、工作区附件持久化与会话配额统计。
description.en: A unified static-image generation router for DeepSeek Harness: one image_generate tool that routes across OpenAI Images, Zhipu CogView and any compatible endpoint, with health-aware fallback, durable workspace attachments and per-session quota accounting.

description.zh: dsh-ecc 将 ECC 操作员系统的 274 个技能渐进移植到 DeepSeek Harness，通过 host 层注册技能提供者，无需配置即可用 skill 工具加载。
description.en: dsh-ecc progressively ports 274 ECC operator-system skills to DeepSeek Harness, registering a skill provider at the host layer for zero-config loading via the skill tool.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供只读性能诊断：观测会话事件流，报告加载耗时、spill、压缩次数、上下文注入量与 LLM 缓存命中率。
description.en: Read-only performance diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness: observes the session event stream to report load timing, spill, compaction, context-injection volume and LLM cache hit rate.

description.zh: dsh-fate-spectrum 是 DeepSeek Harness 的八字与紫微斗数确定性排盘插件，离线计算四柱、十神、十二宫等命盘事实，供 AI Agent 直接调用。
description.en: dsh-fate-spectrum is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for deterministic Bazi and Zi Wei Dou Shu chart calculation, providing offline, structured fate-chart facts for AI agents.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按提供商 API 密钥轮换的 DSH plugin，自动故障转移、冷却与恢复，并带设置界面。
description.en: Per-provider API key rotation for DeepSeek Harness: key pool, auto failover, cooldown & recovery, Settings UI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 对话区叠加 B 站风格弹幕，在消息、回复、工具调用与任务完成时飘过预设或 LLM 生成的吐槽，并支持分会话弹幕库。
description.en: A DSH plugin that overlays Bilibili-style danmaku on the DeepSeek Harness Web chat area, firing preset or LLM-generated quips on messages, replies, tool calls and task completion, with per-session pools.

description.zh: DSH 插件：在设置中调整 LLM 自动重试次数与退避时间，实时生效，并可勾选额外可重试错误码，默认补入 INVALID_REQUEST 以处理 OpenAI thinking 模式 HTTP 400。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets you tune LLM auto-retry count and backoff in Settings, with live effect, plus configurable extra retryable codes, defaulting to INVALID_REQUEST for OpenAI thinking-mode HTTP 400.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在侧边栏展示 OpenCode GO 订阅配额（滚动5小时/周/月），并支持 /opencode-go 命令查询，助你实时掌握用量。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows your OpenCode GO plan quota (rolling 5h/weekly/monthly) in the sidebar and via /opencode-go command.

description.zh: 为 DSH 项目添加副工作目录：在输入框「+」菜单里管理，用 @ 直接引用其中文件，Agent 获得同等读写与执行权限。
description.en: Secondary working directories for a DSH project: manage them from the composer "+" menu, reference their files with @, and give the agent equal read/write/exec rights.

description.zh: dsh-roost 是 DSH 插件，把 QQ 消息接入 DSH 会话，让机器人用上工具、三层记忆与上下文压缩。
description.en: dsh-roost is a DSH plugin that bridges QQ messages into DSH sessions, giving bots tools, layered memory and context compaction.

description.zh: DSH plugin 可复现科学工作台：agent 驱动单元格、内联图表反馈重绘、manifest 溯源与环境快照，让每个图与产物可追溯、可一键重跑。
description.en: A reproducible science workbench for DeepSeek Harness: agent-driven cells, inline figures with feedback/rerun, manifest provenance, and environment snapshots.

description.zh: DSH plugin 连接 OOMOL Connector，通过渐进式 MCP 发现已连接应用并执行 Actions，无需暴露提供商凭据。
description.en: DSH plugin connects to OOMOL Connector, enabling progressive MCP discovery and execution of Actions without exposing provider credentials.

description.zh: dsh-searxng 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册基于 SearXNG 的免费、自托管、免密钥搜索提供商，让 Agent 通过 web_search 能力联网搜索，替代付费的 Exa/Perplexity API。
description.en: dsh-searxng registers a SearXNG-backed, free, self-hosted, key-less search provider into DeepSeek Harness, enabling web_search for agents as an alternative to paid Exa/Perplexity APIs.

description.zh: DSH plugin 记忆回廊在上下文压缩前把较早的完整对话逐轮归档到工作区 memory-palace/ 目录，支持按类别检索与按轮次读回原文。
description.en: A DSH plugin that archives older conversation turns verbatim into a workspace-local memory-palace/ directory before compaction, then lets the model search and read the original wording back.

description.zh: DSH 插件工作室为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可视化开发工作台，通过事件流、插件管理、工具与技能管理、预设管理等七个页签，让插件开发与调试变得直观可操作。
description.en: DSH Plugin Studio is a visual development workbench for DeepSeek Harness, offering seven tabs for event flow, plugin management, tool/skill management, and preset management to make plugin development and debugging intuitive.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的社区串口控制台插件，让用户与模型共享同一可审计串口会话，支持板卡日志查看、终端交互与模型工具调用。
description.en: A community serial console DSH plugin that lets users and models share one auditable serial session, with board log viewing, real terminal interaction, and model tool calls.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 Web GUI 右侧栏提供 VS Code 风格文件浏览器与完整 Git 源代码控制，支持差异编辑、语法高亮、终端等开发功能。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding a VS Code-style file explorer and full source control to the Web GUI right sidebar, with editable diff, syntax highlighting, and terminal.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生工具搜索的 DSH 插件，按需用 BM25 或 Ollama/OpenAI 向量检索发现内置、插件与 MCP 工具，并动态加载或卸载工具 schema。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness native tool search, discovering built-in, plugin and MCP tools on demand via BM25 or Ollama/OpenAI embeddings and loading or unloading their schemas.

description.zh: dsh-trellis 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Trellis 工作流集成插件，注入 workflow-state 面包屑、同步子代理并支持 /trellis 命令。
description.en: dsh-trellis integrates Trellis workflows into DeepSeek Harness, injecting workflow-state breadcrumbs, syncing subagents, and providing /trellis commands.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边栏用量面板，实时显示 API 余额与今日花费，并按官方峰谷定价估算 token 成本。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a sidebar usage widget showing live API balance and today's spend, estimating token cost with official peak/off-peak pricing.

description.zh: dsh-token-usage 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 token 用量与成本分析插件，在 Web 设置面板新增用量统计页，提供汇总卡片、GitHub 风格热力图和官方峰谷价自动换算的预估费用。
description.en: dsh-token-usage is a token usage and cost analytics plugin for DeepSeek Harness, adding a Usage Stats page to the Web settings panel with summary cards, a GitHub-style heatmap, and estimated spend auto-converted at official peak/off-peak rates.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在会话启动时挂载 Superpowers 技能并注入 using-superpowers 方法论引导，让 Agent 通过 skill 工具加载技能。
description.en: A DSH plugin that mounts Superpowers skills and injects using-superpowers methodology guidance at session start, enabling the agent to load skills via the skill tool.

description.zh: 一条命令把 DeepSeek Harness 装进自己的 VPS：零依赖登录网关加自动 HTTPS，公网浏览器随时访问原版 DSH 界面，设置、API Key 与插件市场全部可用。
description.en: Deploy DeepSeek Harness on your own VPS with one command: a zero-dependency login gateway plus automatic HTTPS expose the stock DSH web UI — settings, API keys and the plugin marketplace — from any browser.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供零配置 Exa 网页搜索的 DSH plugin，免 API 密钥即可通过匿名 MCP 搜索，配置密钥后自动升级为 REST 路径。
description.en: Zero-config Exa web search provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): keyless anonymous MCP fallback by default, auto-switching to keyed REST when an API key is set.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 web_fetch 工具提供 Playwright/CDP 后端，真实浏览器渲染页面，经 Readability 与 DOMPurify 去噪后返回 Markdown。
description.en: A DSH plugin giving the built-in web_fetch tool a Playwright/CDP backend: renders pages in a real browser, denoises them, and returns Markdown.

description.zh: DShScan 是 DSH plugin 安全扫描器，对插件源码做静态与语义双通道检查，内置 DSH 攻击面规则、npm audit 与批量扫描，输出带严重等级与证据的 HTML 报告。
description.en: DShScan is a security scanner for DSH plugins, performing static and semantic passes over plugin source with DSH-specific attack-surface rules, npm audit, and batch scanning, producing HTML reports with severity and evidence.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供上下文折叠：把已完成的工作包成命名任务并折叠成简短摘要，需要时用 fold_recall 还原原始消息，让长会话更快更省。
description.en: Context folding for DeepSeek Harness: wrap finished work in named tasks, collapse each span into a short titled summary, and recall the exact original messages on demand to keep long sessions fast and cheap.

description.zh: Novel Studio 是 DeepSeek Harness 的小说创作工作台，提供大纲、人物、世界观、伏笔、禁写规则等管理，让长篇小说设定不失控。
description.en: Novel Studio is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns AI chat into a novel-writing workspace, managing outlines, characters, worldbuilding, foreshadowing, and writing rules to keep long-form fiction consistent.

description.zh: DSH 插件让模型用 openui-lang 程序作答，Web GUI 在聊天中实时渲染可编辑的表格、滑块与图表等交互界面。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets the model answer with openui-lang programs, which the Web GUI renders as live, editable interactive UIs inside the chat.

description.zh: DSH 的 Agent Client Protocol (ACP) 服务器插件，让 Zed 等 ACP v1 客户端通过 stdio 或 HTTP+SSE 驱动 DeepSeek Harness 编码代理，支持会话、任务、目标、技能与代理树。
description.en: An Agent Client Protocol (ACP) server plugin for DeepSeek Harness, letting Zed or any ACP v1 client drive dsh coding agents over stdio or HTTP+SSE with sessions, jobs, goals, skills and the agent tree.

description.zh: DSH 生态中最好的工作台基座插件，提供 VSCode 风格布局外壳与 ctx.workbench 开放注册表，让功能插件即插即用，构建 IDE 级工作台。
description.en: The best workbench base plugin for DSH: provides a VSCode-style layout shell with the open ctx.workbench registry for plug-and-play plugins, enabling an IDE-level workbench.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 原生 POSIX bash 执行器，基于 Rust brush 引擎，无需 WSL 或 MSYS 兼容层，支持三档权限策略与后台作业。
description.en: A native Windows POSIX bash executor for DeepSeek Harness, built on the Rust brush engine without WSL or MSYS layers, supporting DSH's three-tier permission policies and background jobs.

description.zh: DSH 动画优化插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面带来 Claude Code 风格外观，并将思考块与工具输出改造成实时流式播放。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings Claude Code-style appearance to the DeepSeek Harness web UI and presents thinking blocks and tool output as a live stream.

description.zh: dsh-agy-safe 将本机已登录的 Antigravity CLI（agy）无头会话接入 DeepSeek Harness，作为一级模型提供方，支持主对话与子代理调用，提供一致的流式生成与工具分发体验。
description.en: dsh-agy-safe connects the local logged-in Antigravity CLI (agy) headless session to DeepSeek Harness as a first-class model provider, supporting both main chat and subagents with consistent streaming and tool dispatch.

description.zh: dsh-bridges 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，将已配置 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等 Agent 的项目无缝桥接进 DSH，无需迁移即可复用其技能、命令、记忆与钩子。
description.en: dsh-bridges is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that bridges projects configured for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, etc. into DSH, reusing their skills, commands, memory, and hooks without migration.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 在右侧栏嵌入完整 Chromium DevTools 工作台，提供 30 个浏览器工具，让 Agent 能读 DOM、抓请求、下断点、解析 Source Map 并留存现场证据。
description.en: Embeds a full Chromium DevTools workbench into DeepSeek Harness's right sidebar with 30 browser tools, letting the agent inspect the DOM, capture requests, set breakpoints, resolve source maps and preserve on-site evidence.

description.zh: Browser4 是面向 AI 代理的浏览器引擎，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供网页自动化、智能数据提取与大规模抓取能力。
description.en: Browser4 is an AI-native browser engine for DeepSeek Harness, enabling autonomous web automation, intelligent extraction, and large-scale crawling.

description.zh: 复用 CodeBuddy CLI 登录态，把 GLM、DeepSeek、Kimi 等模型零配置接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持多账号切换、积分查看与每日签到。
description.en: Reuses your CodeBuddy CLI login to plug GLM, DeepSeek, Kimi and other models into DeepSeek Harness with zero config, plus multi-account switching, credit tracking and daily check-in.

description.zh: DSH plugin 硬性预算控制：超支即拦截、自动降级到廉价模型，防止超额调用被计费。
description.en: DSH plugin for hard budget enforcement: blocks over-budget calls, auto-downgrades to cheaper models, preventing billing for excessive usage.

description.zh: DSH 的 Chrome 伴侣插件，侧边栏嵌入完整 dsh Web UI，并让 Agent 感知当前页面、抓取 HTTP 流量、控制浏览器。
description.en: A DSH plugin that embeds the full dsh web UI in a Chrome side panel, enabling the agent to perceive pages, capture HTTP traffic, and control the browser.

description.zh: DSH plugin 一键移植 Codex 官方插件全家桶为 DSH 技能，实测 186 插件、583 技能，frontmatter 自动转换、幂等跳过。
description.en: A DSH plugin that batch-ports the Codex official plugin family into DSH skills, with automatic frontmatter conversion and idempotent skipping.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Command Code 的 LLM provider 插件，通过 /alpha/generate 协议接入，支持所有套餐（含 Go 计划），并自动发现模型与离线缓存。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds Command Code as an LLM provider via /alpha/generate, works with all plans including Go, with model discovery and offline cache.

description.zh: dsh-dream 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent 通过会话回放、反思与梦境日记巩固记忆，并将高频教训幂等写入 AGENTS.md，实现长期记忆。
description.en: dsh-dream enables DeepSeek Harness agents to consolidate memory via session replay, reflection, and dream journaling, bridging frequent lessons into AGENTS.md for long-term memory.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自动记录所有执行模式的工具失败错因，去重计数排序后沉淀进 skill 实录区段，让 Agent 越用越少错。
description.en: A DSH plugin that automatically records tool failure causes across all execution modes, dedupes, counts, and ranks them into a skill's auto-log section so the agent fails less over time.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在本地 llama.cpp 上运行 Qwen3.8-27B，激进压缩会话历史，保持 prompt 小而快，实现零 API 成本的大窗口体验。
description.en: A DSH plugin running Qwen3.8-27B on local llama.cpp to aggressively compact conversation history, keeping prompts small and fast for a big-window experience with zero API cost.

description.zh: DSH 视频处理插件，提供探测、剪辑、拼接、转码、字幕烧录、抽帧与 GIF 制作等七种 ffmpeg 工具，安全无 shell 注入，零运行时依赖。
description.en: DSH plugin for video processing: probe, cut, concat, encode, subtitle, extract, and GIF creation via ffmpeg, with safe argv-based execution and zero runtime dependencies.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Deep diving 状态行下方显示坤宠动画，以进度条 0%→100% 展示回答进度，每 20% 切换动作与文案，完成时播放「你干嘛~哎哟」语音。
description.en: A DSH plugin that fills the row under the Deep diving status line with an ikun pet, showing a 0%→100% progress bar with new animation and text every 20%, and a voice cue at completion.

description.zh: dsh-iris 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供渐进式能力路由，按需向模型暴露工具、技能和 MCP 能力，保持上下文精简。
description.en: dsh-iris provides progressive capability routing for DeepSeek Harness, exposing tools, skills, and MCP capabilities on demand to keep context minimal.

description.zh: DSH插件：在设置页一键启停本地llama.cpp模型，双槽位×双模态×8组参数，自动注册为会话模型，装完即用。
description.en: DSH plugin: one-click start/stop local llama.cpp models from Settings, dual-slot × dual-modal × 8 param presets, auto-registers as chat model, ready to use.

description.zh: DSH plugin 实时统计流式 Token 速率与首字延迟，用 DeepSeek 分词表估算并校准偏差，识别模型是否溺水卡死。
description.en: A DSH plugin that streams real-time token rate and TTFT stats, estimating with DeepSeek tokenizer and reconciling deviations to detect stalled model output.

description.zh: 毛颖是 DeepSeek Harness 的网文创作辅助插件：主 agent 化身主编，调度大纲、正文、审校、设定、考据五个帮手，用 novel/ 文件化书稿与七阶段工作流把新书从零带到滚动更新。
description.en: Maoying is a DSH plugin for web-novel writing: the main agent acts as editor-in-chief, dispatching five helpers for outlining, drafting, review, lore and research, with a file-based novel/ manuscript and a seven-stage workflow.

description.zh: DSH Mini TUI 是 DeepSeek Harness 的极简终端界面插件，将工具执行收进后台，让终端专注输入与模型回答，保留完整 Agent 能力。
description.en: DSH Mini TUI is a minimal terminal UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness, keeping tool execution in the background so the terminal focuses on input and model answers while retaining full agent capabilities.

description.zh: DSH plugin MCP Lens 将上千个MCP工具压缩为两个模型接口，按需揭示精确schema，大幅降低输入成本与上下文占用。
description.en: DSH plugin MCP Lens shrinks large MCP catalogs to a two-tool model surface, revealing exact schemas on demand to cut input cost and context usage.

description.zh: dsh-imessage 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Photon 托管的 iMessage 传输通道与设置界面，让用户通过 iMessage 收发 DSH 提示和回复。
description.en: dsh-imessage adds a Photon-hosted iMessage transport and settings UI to DeepSeek Harness, enabling iMessage-based prompts and replies.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 DeepSeek Harness 运行成本以 OpenTelemetry 追踪、指标和日志形式发送至 GreptimeDB，并提供 Grafana 仪表盘，用于查询 token、费用与耗时。
description.en: A DSH plugin that sends DeepSeek Harness telemetry to GreptimeDB as OpenTelemetry traces, metrics, and logs, with Grafana dashboards to query token, cost, and time.

description.zh: dsh-novel-craft 是 DeepSeek Harness 上的小说写作工作台：你只需点赞点踩，模型把偏好压成写作规律，再开新章、批注微调并做张力与伏笔体检。
description.en: dsh-novel-craft is a novel-writing workbench for DeepSeek Harness: you just like or dislike passages, and the model distills them into writing rules used for drafting new chapters, annotation-based revision, and tension and foreshadowing checks.

description.zh: DSH plugin 广告拦截器，四层独立防御拦截 dsh-ads 插件的所有广告位，右下角徽章实时记录拦截数量。
description.en: A DSH plugin ad blocker with four independent defense layers targeting all ad slots of the dsh-ads plugin, with a badge showing blocked count.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在模型回合结束后自动生成 3 条批判性跟进建议，点击即发送，提升对话深度与反思效率。
description.en: A DSH plugin that generates 3 critical follow-up suggestions after each model turn, click-to-send to deepen conversation.

description.zh: DSH 插件，暴露 run_python/run_node 工具，通过 stdin 执行代码并返回输出，支持解释器路径配置。
description.en: DSH plugin exposing run_python/run_node tools that execute code via stdin and return output, with interpreter path configuration.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页侧边栏添加会话文件夹，支持拖拽分组、重命名、归档与恢复，服务端持久化，无需修改框架。
description.en: Adds session folders to the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar: drag-and-drop grouping, rename, archive & restore, server-side persistence, no harness changes.

description.zh: dsh-moa 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Mixture of Agents 插件，让多个参考模型并行分析同一问题，再由主模型综合总结，适合架构评审、方案对比等多视角交叉验证场景。
description.en: dsh-moa is a Mixture of Agents plugin for DeepSeek Harness that runs multiple reference models in parallel and synthesizes their outputs with the main model, ideal for multi-perspective cross-validation.

description.zh: 面向自托管 DeepSeek Harness Web 的一站式运维面板，提供安全重启、健康诊断、模型用量与额度查询、会话管理、备份与权限维护、任务通知及技能与子代理模型路由。
description.en: All-in-one operations panel for self-hosted DeepSeek Harness Web, offering safe restart, health diagnostics, model usage & quota lookup, session management, backup & permission maintenance, task notifications, and skills & subagent model routing.

description.zh: 为 DSH 提供项目级 MCP 自动加载：在 .dsh/mcp.yml 或 mcp.json 写配置即自动挂载，支持热重载与按会话隔离。
description.en: A DSH plugin that auto-loads project-level MCP servers from .dsh/mcp.yml or mcp.json, with hot reload and per-session tool scoping.

description.zh: DSH plugin：输入 /simplify 让 agent 只审查你刚改动的代码行，提出清晰度、一致性与可维护性改进，并自动运行测试。
description.en: A DSH plugin: type /simplify to have the agent review only the lines you just changed, offering clarity, consistency, and maintainability improvements, and run tests automatically.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 cron 定时任务能力：到点自动新建 agent 会话并提交提示词，也可手动立即执行，配全屏管理界面与执行记录。
description.en: A DSH plugin that schedules cron tasks to automatically spin up new agent sessions with preset prompts, with manual run, a full-screen manager and run history.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 17 段可配置状态栏，实时展示状态、模型、上下文、token 消耗、TPS、成本与任务队列，一眼看清 agent 动态。
description.en: A configurable 17-segment status bar for DeepSeek Harness, showing status, model, context, token burn, TPS, cost and jobs at a glance.

description.zh: DSH UI Harmonizer 是 DeepSeek Harness 的界面统一层，通过 CSS 覆盖与 DOM 协调归一化官方 UI、调和插件样式冲突，并基于官方设计令牌提供实时 UI 定制。
description.en: DSH UI Harmonizer is a UI polish layer for DeepSeek Harness that normalizes the official UI, reconciles plugin style conflicts, and offers live UI customization via official design tokens.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Web 界面内嵌完整 code-server，agent 写文件时自动弹出红绿 diff 跟随，实现所见即所得地观察 AI 编辑。
description.en: A DSH plugin that embeds a full code-server in the web UI, auto-showing red/green diffs as the agent writes files for WYSIWYG observation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加独立动态壁纸层的 DSH plugin，支持内置图库、自定义上传及 Wallpaper Engine 库，含叠加、模糊、亮度与安全缩放调节。
description.en: A DSH plugin that puts an independent animated wallpaper layer under the DeepSeek Harness web UI, with built-in wallpapers, custom uploads, and Wallpaper Engine library support, plus overlay, blur, brightness, and safe zoom adjustments.

description.zh: DSH 插件，将 DeepSeek 官方按量计费搜索一键切换为免费网页搜索（Parallel 默认 + Exa 备用，匿名免 key），并提供兼容 Claude Code / Codex 的双传输 MCP server。
description.en: DSH plugin that switches DeepSeek's metered search to free web search (Parallel default + Exa backup, anonymous no key), and provides a dual-transport MCP server compatible with Claude Code / Codex.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏一键打开官方 chat.deepseek.com 网页版，用真实窗口承载登录态，不再自建聊天界面。
description.en: Opens the official chat.deepseek.com web app from a DeepSeek Harness sidebar entry in a real browser window that keeps your web login, instead of reimplementing the chat UI.

description.zh: dsh-tidychat 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 会话整理插件，自动折叠已完成轮次、分隔思考与结论，并提供左缘全局定位条，让长会话可扫读、可跳转。
description.en: dsh-tidychat is a DSH plugin that tidies web sessions by auto-collapsing completed turns, separating thoughts from conclusions, and adding a left-edge navigation rail for scannable, jumpable long conversations.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 打造的动漫女仆鲸鱼桌面宠物，用 Token 喂养，联动 LLM 心情与气泡对话。
description.en: An anime maid whale desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, fed with Tokens and linked to LLM mood and speech bubbles.

description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 DSH plugin，带侧栏额度卡与中栏仪表盘，支持多账号轮换、额度展示和推理档位检测。
description.en: A DSH plugin that wires WorkBuddy desktop app models into DeepSeek Harness, with a sidebar quota card, dashboard panel, multi-account rotation and reasoning-tier detection.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 显式声明的工作区目录预置 Windows ACL 授权，让 dsh 文件沙箱能正常启动受限进程，免去会话升权与确认弹窗。
description.en: Pre-grants a Windows ACL entry for workspaces you explicitly declare in DeepSeek Harness, so the dsh file sandbox can launch restricted processes without session elevation or confirmation prompts.

description.zh: snapgrep 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供进程内三元组索引代码搜索，比 ripgrep 快 20-70 倍，结果逐字节一致，无需旁路进程。
description.en: snapgrep is a DSH plugin providing an in-process trigram index for code search, 20-70x faster than ripgrep with identical results and no sidecar process.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧栏工作台：工作区与会话管理、文件树浏览、多标签预览、会话置顶与运行状态指示，并增强 @ 文件引用与输入历史召回。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns the native sidebar into a full workbench: workspace and session management, file tree browsing, multi-tab previews, pinned sessions, live run status, plus @ file references and input history recall.

description.zh: Task Passport 是 DeepSeek Harness 的任务交接协议插件，让任务带着验证过的状态在多个 AI Harness 间接力，不搬运聊天记录。
description.en: Task Passport is a DSH plugin for task handoff, carrying verified state across AI harnesses without copying chat logs.

description.zh: Upstream Radar 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件提供持续兼容性测试，在隔离的 GitHub VM 中验证插件与 DSH 主机的精确匹配，并生成可修复的上游问题报告。
description.en: Upstream Radar provides always-on compatibility testing for DeepSeek Harness plugins, validating exact plugin-host pairs in isolated GitHub VMs and producing fixable upstream issue reports.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Busabase 知识库与数据库，让 Agent 检索可信文档、操作结构化数据，并把每次写入提交人工审核。
description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Busabase so agents can search trusted knowledge, work with structured data, and route every write through human review.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 添加自定义背景图片，支持上传本地图片或粘贴链接，可调不透明度、遮罩、面板透明与毛玻璃模糊，实时预览并自动保存。
description.en: Add custom background images to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: upload local images or paste URLs, with adjustable opacity, scrim, panel transparency, and frosted-glass blur, live preview and auto-save.

description.zh: DSH Agent Bridge 通过 ACP 将 Grok Build 作为根 Agent 接入 DeepSeek Harness Web，在原生会话界面中直接使用 Grok 编码能力。
description.en: DSH Agent Bridge integrates Grok Build as a root agent into DeepSeek Harness Web via ACP, enabling Grok coding within the native DSH interface.

description.zh: 把本地多源资料库渲染成 DeepSeek Harness 原生面板，内置 11 种预览器与十源论文检索，支持分类、编辑与拖拽分组。
description.en: Renders local multi-source libraries as a native DeepSeek Harness panel with 11 previewers, ten-source paper search, editing and drag-and-drop grouping.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上归档会话管理中心，可按日期、工作区筛选历史会话，批量取消归档，并用可撤销策略自动清理会话列表。
description.en: Adds an archived-session management center to DeepSeek Harness: browse archived sessions by date or workspace, unarchive in bulk, and run a reversible auto-cleanup policy.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话添加书签功能：可给助手回复添加备注和标签，跨会话集中管理，并一键导出 Markdown。
description.en: A DSH plugin that bookmarks assistant replies in DeepSeek Harness: add notes and tags, manage across sessions, and export to Markdown.

description.zh: DSH 聊天窗口自动调用生图工具（API 或本机 CLI：mmx/codex/agy）并展示图片，也支持用 CLI 识别图片，让任何模型都能读图。
description.en: Automatically invoke image generation tools (API or local CLIs: mmx/codex/agy) in DSH chat and display results, plus CLI-based image recognition for any model.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话里直接改写任意 AI 回复正文与思维链，保存后整个会话只认你的版本，让模型彻底按你的方向推理。
description.en: Edit any assistant reply and its reasoning chain directly inside DeepSeek Harness; once saved, the whole conversation follows your version of the answer and thinking.

description.zh: DSH Claude TUI 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Claude Code 风格的终端界面，一条命令即可使用真实模型、会话、工具、审批与子代理。
description.en: DSH Claude TUI brings a Claude Code-style terminal interface to DeepSeek Harness, letting you use real models, sessions, tools, approvals, and subagents in one command.

description.zh: dsh-code-index 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供语义化代码库索引：基于 tree-sitter 的符号索引、排序搜索与自动更新的仓库地图，让 Agent 快速定位代码。
description.en: dsh-code-index gives DeepSeek Harness a semantic codebase map: tree-sitter symbol index, ranked search, and an auto-updating repo map for the agent.

description.zh: dsh-codex-migrate 是一款 DSH plugin，可将 Codex CLI 的对话、MCP 服务器与记忆迁移为 DeepSeek Harness 原生会话与配置，按项目挂载并支持续聊。
description.en: dsh-codex-migrate is a DSH plugin that migrates Codex CLI conversations, MCP servers, and memories into native DeepSeek Harness sessions and configs, mounted per project for continued chat.

description.zh: dsh-continue 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供安全无人值守的任务继续、网络恢复、推荐答案与决策学习，所有能力默认关闭，确保 fail-closed 安全边界。
description.en: dsh-continue is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for safe unattended task continuation, network recovery, recommended answers, and decision learning, with all capabilities off by default for fail-closed safety.

description.zh: dsh-deeppilot 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 iPhone 原生配套插件，让你在手机上浏览会话、发送提示、审批与接收通知，并通过安全配对实现远程访问。
description.en: dsh-deeppilot is a native iPhone companion plugin for DeepSeek Harness, enabling mobile session browsing, prompt sending, approvals, and notifications with secure remote access.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 打造的一站式增强插件，提供天气特效、玻璃拟态、时间线导航、项目文件夹、提示词库、对话导出、Mermaid 渲染、引用回复及余额/用量面板等丰富功能。
description.en: A comprehensive enhancement suite for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, adding weather FX, glass effects, timeline navigation, project folders, prompt library, conversation export, Mermaid rendering, quote reply, and balance/usage panels.

description.zh: dsh-file 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 VS Code 风格文件管理器，在侧边栏浏览工作区文件，中间列用 Monaco 编辑器编辑，支持 Markdown 预览与主题导入导出。
description.en: dsh-file is a VS Code-style file manager plugin for DeepSeek Harness, letting you browse workspace files in the sidebar and edit them in the center column with Monaco, plus Markdown preview and theme import/export.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Web 悬浮用量面板，实时显示官方余额与 Token 用量曲线，免去频繁打开官方用量页。
description.en: A floating web usage panel for DeepSeek Harness showing live official balance and token usage trends, so you no longer need to open the official usage page.

description.zh: DSH plugin 视觉语言网关：为纯文本 DeepSeek 模型增加贴图能力，图片直通原生视觉端点或由 Qwen-VL 描述成文字，零改动官方仓库。
description.en: Vision-language gateway plugin for DeepSeek Harness: adds image understanding to text-only DeepSeek models, routing images to native vision endpoints or describing them via Qwen-VL.

description.zh: DSH 插件：模型故障自动回退备用模型，并提供 fanout、pipeline 等五种模式编排子智能体，让长任务可靠并行推进。
description.en: A DSH plugin that automatically fails over to backup models and orchestrates subagents in five modes (fanout, pipeline, etc.) for reliable parallel execution of long tasks.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 中文汉化插件，运行时将系统提示词、工具描述、前端 UI 文本全部翻译成中文，零源码修改，即插即用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that localizes system prompts, tool descriptions, and UI text into Chinese at runtime, with zero source modification.

description.zh: DSH plugin 热管理器：装一次、重启一次，之后插件安装、卸载、升级全部即时生效，无需再重启。
description.en: A DSH plugin that makes installing, removing and upgrading plugins take effect instantly — restart once, then never again.

description.zh: DSH plugin，通过让模型在写作前深入理解理论并成为作者，消除中文文本的AI痕迹，支持创作与润色两种模式。
description.en: A DSH plugin that removes AI traces from Chinese text by having the model internalize theory and become the author before writing, supporting both creation and polishing modes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供团队离线知识库：侧栏全页浏览、全文检索与 raw 素材上传，上传即由 agent 按 schema 自动蒸馏成文，沉淀跨会话可复用的知识。
description.en: A team knowledge base plugin for DeepSeek Harness: browse, full-text search and upload raw material in a sidebar page, with agent-driven distillation into schema-based wiki pages for cross-session reuse.

description.zh: 梁相是 DeepSeek Harness 的 WebUI 插件，将 Token 消耗凝成香火，参与社区夯拉投票，显相梁位，趣味互动。
description.en: Liangxiang is a DSH WebUI plugin that converts token usage into incense, enabling community voting and ranking for fun.

description.zh: dsh-mcp-bridge 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供精选且经 CI 验证的 MCP 服务器捆绑包，一次安装即可获得演示、记忆、文件系统、GitHub、Playwright 和远程 HTTP 等 MCP 服务器，并附带连通性验证器。
description.en: dsh-mcp-bridge is a curated, CI-verified MCP server bundle for DeepSeek Harness, offering demo, memory, filesystem, GitHub, Playwright, and remote HTTP MCP servers in one install, with a connectivity verifier.

description.zh: DSH plugin 消息提醒信使，通过系统通知、浏览器通知及飞书、企业微信、钉钉、Telegram、Discord 推送任务状态，支持交互、完成、出错触发。
description.en: A DSH plugin messenger that pushes task status via system, browser, and third-party channels like Feishu, WeCom, DingTalk, Telegram, and Discord.

description.zh: dsh-mineru 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 MinerU 多模态文档解析插件，将 PDF、Word、PPT、Excel、HTML 和图片转为结构化 Markdown，支持免 Token 的 Agent API 与精准解析双模式。
description.en: dsh-mineru is a MinerU-powered multimodal document parsing plugin for DeepSeek Harness, converting PDF, Word, PPT, Excel, HTML, and images into structured Markdown with tokenless Agent API and Precision API modes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供轻拟物与磨砂玻璃风格的主题插件，含浅色/深色双主题、环境光、材质纹理与细腻微交互。
description.en: A Neumorphism + glassmorphism theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web, offering light/dark palettes, ambient lighting, material texture, and subtle micro-interactions.

description.zh: DSH plugin 技能，将对话中的结论、错题、项目按七步流程与两级校验整理进 Obsidian 知识库，检索优先、合并优先，只提炼长期价值。
description.en: A DSH plugin skill that ingests conclusions, mistakes, and projects from conversations into an Obsidian vault via a 7-step workflow with two-level validation, prioritizing retrieval and merging over duplication.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供类 opencode 的终端 UI（TUI），在 dsh 进程内启动聊天客户端，渲染会话事件流、工具卡片与审批提示，并支持上下文计量与流式动画。
description.en: An opencode-inspired terminal UI (TUI) for DeepSeek Harness, booting a chat client inside the dsh process, rendering session event streams, tool cards, and approval prompts with context metering and flowing animations.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 左侧栏装上纸面风格工作台：便签、纸页笔记、日历待办与画纸，数据存本机不联网。
description.en: A paper-style workspace for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar with sticky notes, page notes, a calendar to-do list and a drawing pad, all stored locally offline.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在模型生成时于右下角弹出小游戏菜单，内置 Wordle、消消乐及 192 款参数化小游戏，支持第三方注册扩展，让等待不再寂寞。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pops up a mini-game menu in the bottom-right corner while the model generates, featuring Wordle, Match-3, and 192 parametric mini-games with an extensible registry.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让用户在 DeepSeek Harness 中悬停任意 LaTeX 公式即可复制 TeX 源码或导出为独立的 SVG 矢量图，完全离线可用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets you hover over any LaTeX formula in DeepSeek Harness to copy the TeX source or export it as a standalone SVG vector image, fully offline.

description.zh: DSH 插件，向模型暴露 sleep 工具，按指定毫秒暂停执行后返回，支持取消与时长钳制，适合等待条件成立或退避重试场景。
description.en: A DSH plugin exposing a sleep tool that pauses for specified ms then returns, with cancellation and clamping, ideal for waiting conditions or retry backoff.

description.zh: DSH 分层提示词管理器：条目可按全局、工作区、会话三级投放，内置段落与运行时上下文可禁用或覆盖，并附逐行 diff 与真实装配快照。
description.en: A layered prompt manager for DeepSeek Harness: deliver reusable entries at global, workspace, or session level, disable or override built-in sections and runtime contexts, with line-level diffs and real assembly snapshots.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上动图视觉能力：粘贴的 GIF/WebP 在界面里继续播放，模型则收到按时间轴抽帧并标注序号与时刻的帧图集。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets the agent actually see animated GIFs and WebP: the pasted animation keeps playing in the UI while the model receives a labelled sheet of frames sampled across its timeline.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 dsh-router 提供 CodeBuddy 模型供应商，支持 OAuth 轮询登录、token 自动刷新、模型拉取与签到积分，需配合核心使用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that registers the CodeBuddy model supplier for dsh-router, featuring OAuth polling login, auto token refresh, model fetching, and daily check-in credits.

description.zh: DSH 沙箱扩展插件，为默认沙箱增加可配置的可信可写目录，支持通配符与命令白名单，让沙箱内命令和文件工具免审批写入工作区外目录。
description.en: A DSH plugin that extends the default sandbox with configurable trusted writable directories, supporting wildcards and command allow-lists for approval-free writes outside the workspace.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话智能标题：每轮对话后用 LLM 总结改写会话标题，支持节流、冻结与手动改名保护。
description.en: Smart session titles for DeepSeek Harness: after each turn an LLM summarizes and rewrites the session title, with throttling, freezing and manual-rename protection.

description.zh: DSH plugin 个性化设置插件，配置 Agent 昵称、回复风格、语调和自定义指令，支持人设预设与 /soul 命令。
description.en: A DSH plugin for personalization settings, configuring the Agent's nickname, response style, tone, and custom instructions, with persona presets and /soul commands.

description.zh: DSH plugin 服务器卡片仪表盘，实时展示在线状态、CPU、内存、磁盘与延迟，点击卡片即可进入 xterm 交互终端，支持 SSH 配置一键导入。
description.en: DSH plugin server card dashboard showing status, CPU, memory, disk and latency, with one-click xterm terminal and SSH config import.

description.zh: 为 DSH plugin 提供工具调用自愈层：在 tools/execute 管线中自动补全参数、修正路径并安全重试，把可见错误率从 7.95% 降到 2.20%，并在设置面板展示修复明细。
description.en: An auto-healing layer for DeepSeek Harness tool calls: it repairs schema mismatches, paths and safe retries on the tools/execute pipeline, cutting visible error rates from 7.95% to 2.20% with a dashboard of every heal.

description.zh: 将 ~/.dsh/agents/*.md 定义的自定义 agent 注册为 DSH plugin 可调用的 subagent，支持中断续跑与后台交互式追问。
description.en: Register locally-defined custom agents (~/.dsh/agents/*.md) as callable subagents in DeepSeek Harness, with resume and background follow-up support.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供美股行情、历史数据、财报、分析师观点、新闻与持股等结构化数据工具，基于 yahoo-finance2，让 Agent 告别网页抓取。
description.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with structured US stock data tools—quotes, history, financials, analyst views, news, ownership—powered by yahoo-finance2, replacing ad-hoc web scraping.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 移植腾讯云四层记忆系统，自动捕获对话、抽取结构化记忆并在每次提问时注入相关回忆。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness port of TencentDB Agent Memory: it captures every turn, extracts structured long-term memories, and injects relevant recall into each prompt.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness插件，自动统计会话模型调用并按官方定价分段计费，提供图表化用量面板与预算告警。
description.en: A DSH plugin that automatically tracks model usage and billing, with charts and budget alerts.

description.zh: dsh-usage-chart 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供实时 token 用量、成本估算、逐轮图表和账户余额面板，帮助用户监控推理开销。
description.en: dsh-usage-chart adds a real-time token usage, cost estimation, per-round charts, and account balance dashboard to DeepSeek Harness Web.

description.zh: DSH plugin 视觉识别插件：在 Web 编辑器粘贴图片，由主机端调用 GLM-4V 识别，并将结果作为隐藏上下文注入对话，让主模型基于图片内容作答。
description.en: A DSH plugin for vision recognition: paste images into the Web composer, recognize them via GLM-4V on the host side, and inject the result as hidden context so the main model answers based on the image.

description.zh: DSH plugin 工时统计看板，将活跃时长、token 与调用量按日/周/月/学年汇总，并以修仙境界趣味呈现，数据全本地存储。
description.en: A DSH plugin worktime dashboard that aggregates active time, tokens, and calls by day/week/month/school year, gamified as cultivation realms, with all data stored locally.

description.zh: github-explore 是 DeepSeek Harness 的技能插件，围绕 gh CLI 提供多维度仓库发现、趋势探索、代码搜索与仓库摘要，帮助 AI 代理高效检索 GitHub。
description.en: github-explore is a DSH plugin skill wrapping gh CLI for multi-axis repo discovery, trending, code search, and repo summaries, enabling AI agents to explore GitHub efficiently.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供纯客户端 CSS 覆盖层，修复窄屏（≤700px）下的移动端布局问题，无需改动产品源码。
description.en: A DSH plugin that ships a pure client-side CSS overlay to fix mobile layout breakages in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI on narrow (≤700px) viewports, without touching product source.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加鲸鱼娘·小鱼傲娇人设 Agent 预设，附带独立持久记忆文件，自动注入系统提示。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds whale-girl persona Agent presets to DeepSeek Harness, each with its own persistent memory file auto-injected into the system prompt.

description.zh: harness-lark 是 DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 渠道插件，通过 WebSocket 长连接收发消息，支持流式卡片回复、文档/表格操作、审批卡片及斜杠命令，让 DSH 智能体无缝接入飞书。
description.en: harness-lark is a Lark/Feishu channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness, enabling message exchange via WebSocket, streaming card replies, document/spreadsheet operations, approval cards, and slash commands, seamlessly integrating DSH agents into Feishu.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 部署猫娘 Yuike 人格预设，剥离 DSH 强制注入的附加提示词，只保留工具链与猫娘基准人格作为唯一系统提示。
description.en: Deploys the catgirl Yuike persona preset for DeepSeek Harness, stripping DSH's forced extra prompts so only the toolchain and the base catgirl persona remain as the sole system prompt.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 添加 Git worktree 管理面板，在侧边栏中按项目→工作树→会话层级组织，支持分支切换、会话启动与一键创建工作树。
description.en: A Git worktree management panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, adding a project→worktree→session hierarchy to the sidebar with branch switching, session launch, and one-click worktree creation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加像素鲸鱼桌宠，实时反映 Agent 状态，审批时敲玻璃提醒，支持成长系统与自定义桌宠。
description.en: A pixel-art whale companion for DeepSeek Harness that mirrors agent status, taps the glass on approvals, and supports growth and custom pets.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供可视化 Git 工作台，可检查仓库状态、执行常用 Git 操作并安全运行 AI 生成的工作流。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings a visual Git workbench to DeepSeek Harness Web, enabling repository inspection, common Git actions, and safe execution of AI-generated workflows.

description.zh: dsh-airdrop 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供拖拽上传能力，支持本地与远程服务器，任意格式文件分块直传会话工作区，发送前可预览。
description.en: dsh-airdrop adds drag-and-drop file upload to DeepSeek Harness, supporting local and remote servers, with chunked transfer of any file type to the session workspace and preview before sending.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多智能体编排模式：主智能体分解分派任务，worker 全网格互通，支持逐 worker 指定模型与思考强度。
description.en: Provides a multi-agent orchestration mode for DeepSeek Harness: a main agent decomposes and dispatches tasks, workers communicate across the mesh, with per-worker model and effort settings.

description.zh: dsh-bill 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供逐轮成本显示与成本归因报告，基于 llm-pricing 实时定价，支持预算与多币种，帮助用户清晰掌握每次对话的花费去向。
description.en: dsh-bill adds per-turn cost lines and a cost attribution report to DeepSeek Harness, priced via llm-pricing with budget and multi-currency support.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 空白聊天区带来 ASCII 鲸群游动动画与中性毛玻璃输入框，颜色、数量、速度等均可在设置中调节。
description.en: Brings drifting ASCII whale animations and a neutral frosted-glass composer to the DeepSeek Harness blank chat area, with colors, count and speed tunable in settings.

description.zh: DSH 底栏统计与预估费用插件，可自定义显示分段、拖拽排序，实时展示 token 用量与费用估算，支持峰谷定价。
description.en: A DSH plugin that enriches the bottom bar with customizable stats and cost estimation, featuring draggable segments and real-time token usage.

description.zh: 基于 Playwright 的浏览器自动化插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供快照优先、稳定引用的无障碍树交互，内置 17 个 browser_* 工具，支持多标签页、截图与结构化提取。
description.en: Playwright-powered browser automation for DeepSeek Harness: snapshot-first accessibility-tree interaction with stable refs, 17 browser_* tools, per-session contexts, tabs, screenshots, and structured extraction.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在对话栏左侧常驻大纲，按轮次列出提问与回复，点击即可定位，支持过滤与轨迹视图跳转，提升长会话导航效率。
description.en: A DSH plugin that keeps a persistent outline on the left of the chat, listing turns for quick navigation, with filtering and trajectory view jumps.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加基于模型的权限审批模式（approve-for-me），由独立审查模型代替人类决定 ALLOW/DENY/ESCALATE，仅在无法决断时转交人工。
description.en: Adds a model-based permission approval mode (approve-for-me) to DeepSeek Harness, where a separate reviewer model answers approval requests with ALLOW/DENY/ESCALATE, escalating to humans only when undecided.

description.zh: DSH 插件：在界面悬浮一行显示阿里云代金券与账户余额合计，悬停即可查看券面值、已用与最早失效时间，只读 BSS 存量不做消费统计。
description.en: A DSH plugin that floats a single line showing your Aliyun coupon plus account balance, with hover details for face value, usage and earliest expiry — read-only BSS queries, no spending analytics.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端聊天区做交互优化的 DSH 插件：思考行与过程组自动开合、气泡起飞动效、输入框毛玻璃、缓存命中率与上下文占用饼等读数重绘。
description.en: A DSH plugin that polishes the DeepSeek Harness web chat area: auto-collapsing thinking and process groups, message-flight animation, frosted-glass composer, plus redesigned cache-hit and context-usage readouts.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 接到 Cheat Engine，通过 ce_* 工具做内存扫描、断点调试、指针与基址分析，实现单机游戏数值查找与资源锁定。
description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness agents to Cheat Engine via ce_* tools for memory scanning, breakpoint debugging, pointer and base-address analysis, enabling single-player game value hunting and resource locking.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话导出为可读的 Markdown、HTML、纯文本或 ZIP 文字稿，完整保留思考块、工具调用、代码块与图片，弥补官方原始日志不可读的缺口。
description.en: Export DeepSeek Harness sessions into readable Markdown, HTML, plain text or ZIP transcripts, keeping thinking blocks, tool calls, code blocks and images intact where the official raw log is unreadable.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供上下文压缩能力：模型通过 mind_map 与 clear_mind 工具把已完成的历史改写成自写检查点，释放注意力与 token 预算，人类侧记录原样保留可审计。
description.en: Context compaction for DeepSeek Harness: the mind_map and clear_mind tools let the model rewrite finished history into self-written checkpoints, freeing attention and token budget while the human-side log stays intact and auditable.

description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏提供商汤 Token Plan 积分面板，登录一次即可实时查看积分余额、额度窗口与每模型消耗，令牌自动续期，还可选把商汤模型接入 DSH 对话。
description.en: A SenseNova Token Plan credit panel for the DSH sidebar: log in once to track credit balance, quota windows and per-model usage, with automatic token renewal and optional SenseNova model access in DSH.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自定义 WebUI 背景：图库扫描、自由裁切、效果调节与多图轮播，所有调整实时生效并持久化。
description.en: A DSH plugin to customize WebUI background: gallery scanning, free cropping, effect adjustments, and cross-fade slideshow, all changes apply in real time and persist.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 长会话提供 Codex 风格的时间线导航栏，支持会话搜索、预览与可靠跳转，提升长对话浏览效率。
description.en: Adds a Codex-style turn timeline and local conversation search to DeepSeek Harness Web, enabling preview, reliable navigation, and efficient browsing of long sessions.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的 dsh web 服务注册为自启动、自愈的后台守护进程，watchdog 定时健康检查并在连续失败后自动重启。
description.en: Registers the DeepSeek Harness dsh web server as an auto-start, self-healing background daemon, with a watchdog that health-checks and restarts it after repeated failures.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 ClineBot / ClinePass 订阅，提供专属设置页、实时配额仪表盘、UI 内密钥保存与模型同步。
description.en: Native ClineBot / ClinePass provider companion for DeepSeek Harness, adding a dedicated settings page, live quota dashboard, in-UI key storage and model sync.

description.zh: DevQuest 是一款 DSH 插件，将开发过程 RPG 化：回合、工具调用、待办和 tokens 自动换算 XP，解锁成就、称号、每日挑战与赛季商店，让编码充满乐趣。
description.en: DevQuest is a DSH plugin that turns development into an RPG: turns, tool calls, todos, and tokens convert to XP, unlocking achievements, titles, daily challenges, and a season shop, making coding fun.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供单条消息级删除：通过官方 surface-replace 契约把用户消息、某一步或整条助手回复移出模型上下文，并从转录中隐藏，且不改写 append-only 日志。
description.en: Per-message deletion for DeepSeek Harness: remove a user message, a single step, or a whole assistant reply from the derived model context via the official surface-replace contract, hiding it from the transcript without rewriting the append-only log.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏提供全局 Markdown 文档阅读面板，任何工作区随时可读，支持大纲跳转与外部编辑器打开。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a global Markdown docs panel to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, readable in any workspace, with outline navigation and external editor opening.

description.zh: DSH 的 drawio 插件：为 agent 提供画图工具（模板/编辑/校验/渲染）与侧栏实时 SVG 画板，内嵌 diagrams.net 官方编辑器，实现所见即所得的 .drawio 文件编辑。
description.en: A DSH plugin for drawio: provides agent drawing tools (template/edit/validate/render) and a sidebar live SVG canvas with embedded diagrams.net editor for WYSIWYG .drawio editing.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上「改一句再重来」：悬停任意用户消息或模型回答即可就地改写，插件按官方 surface-replace 契约回退会话并重跑该轮，append-only 日志原样不改。
description.en: Adds "edit and re-run" to DeepSeek Harness: hover any user turn or assistant reply to rewrite it inline, and the DSH plugin rolls the conversation back via the official surface-replace contract and re-prompts the agent, leaving the append-only session log untouched.

description.zh: DSH plugin 点击定位源码检查器，在开发页面点击任意 UI 元素，一键定位 Vue/React/Svelte/Angular 源码并直达 DSH 聊天，兼容 dsh-better-sidebar。
description.en: A DSH plugin click-to-source inspector: click any UI element in your dev page to jump to its Vue/React/Svelte/Angular source in the DSH chat, dsh-better-sidebar compatible.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 DeepTutor 辅导能力，提供深度讲解、自测题、学习路径规划、个人知识库检索（RAG）与笔记归档，让 agent 化身学习助手。
description.en: A learning-assistant extension for DeepSeek Harness that brings DeepTutor tutoring to your agent — deep explanations, self-test questions, learning paths, personal knowledge-base search (RAG), and note archiving.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中的 Agent 加装证据门禁：结论落笔前先经 evidence_gate 校验，与真实工具活动交叉核对，未经验证的猜测当场降级并记入会话台账。
description.en: Adds an evidence gate to DeepSeek Harness agents: load-bearing conclusions must pass the evidence_gate tool, are cross-checked against real session tool activity, and unverified guesses are downgraded and logged in a per-session ledger.

description.zh: DSH 免费视觉插件，让纯文本模型获得看图能力，支持截图、报错、UI 分析、OCR 等，优先使用各平台免费视觉模型，零 MCP 配置。
description.en: Free vision plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), enabling image understanding for text-only models with free-tier vision models and zero MCP configuration.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面提供 HTTPS 加密与账号登录的远程访问网关，作为 DSH plugin 安装，无需外部程序，装上即用。
description.en: A self-contained HTTPS + login gateway for the DeepSeek Harness web surface, installable as a DSH plugin with no external programs needed.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来六人无限注德州扑克，一名人类玩家对战五位 LLM 智能体，在 Web GUI 中直接游玩。
description.en: Six-max No-Limit Hold'em for DeepSeek Harness: one human vs five LLM agents, playable directly in the Web GUI.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web GUI 安全开放到局域网或公网，自带密码鉴权与可选 TLS，并支持可视化配置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that securely exposes DeepSeek Harness's Web GUI to LAN or public internet, with built-in password auth and optional TLS.

description.zh: dsh-lanmode 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web UI 在局域网设备上完整可用，修复设置面板、插件配置和剪贴板等功能在非 localhost 下失效的问题。
description.en: dsh-lanmode makes the DeepSeek Harness Web UI fully functional on LAN devices, fixing settings panels, plugin configs, and clipboard that break on non-localhost origins.

description.zh: DSH Literature 是 DeepSeek Harness 的文献侧窗插件，在侧边栏识别 DOI/arXiv/标题，抓取元数据与全文，内置 PDF 阅读器与本地文献库。
description.en: DSH Literature is a DeepSeek Harness sidebar plugin that detects DOIs, arXiv IDs and titles, fetches metadata and full text, and ships a built-in PDF reader with a local library.

description.zh: Loom（织机）是 DeepSeek Harness 的可验证演进控制面，让插件组合像事务一样原子升级、验证与回滚，实现受控自演进。
description.en: Loom is a verifiable evolution control plane for DeepSeek Harness, treating plugin combinations as atomic, verifiable, and recoverable transactions for controlled self-evolution.

description.zh: dsh-loop-engine 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 web 界面提供可切换的 Agent 循环引擎，像切换模型一样在设置中选择内置进程、Claude Code CLI、Codex CLI 或 Pi CLI 驱动你的 Agent，无需改动主仓库。
description.en: dsh-loop-engine lets you switch the agent loop engine of DeepSeek Harness web like switching a model, choosing among in-process, Claude Code CLI, Codex CLI, or Pi CLI drivers from Settings.

description.zh: DSH 跨会话记忆插件，自动提取、语义召回并整合记忆，防止上下文爆炸，赋予 Agent 持久记忆与全局身份。
description.en: Cross-session memory plugin for DSH with auto-extraction, semantic recall, and consolidation, preventing context explosion and giving agents persistent memory and global identity.

description.zh: DSH plugin 的 MCP 与技能管理面板，实时启停 MCP 服务器与 Skill 目录，释放上下文占用，并支持 AI 中间层按需调用。
description.en: A DSH plugin settings panel to toggle MCP servers and skills on/off in real time, freeing context, with optional AI middleware for on-demand invocation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化记忆管理，按项目保存结构化记忆，支持 ZCode 导入、自动注入对话上下文及 Agent 记忆工具。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings persistent memory management to DeepSeek Harness, storing structured memories per project with ZCode import, auto-injection into context, and agent memory tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补齐官方缺失的消息回滚、单条删除与恢复能力，通过会话头部按钮和悬停操作即可遮蔽或撤销任意消息，并复用官方 session/fork 实现分支。
description.en: A DSH plugin that fills gaps in DeepSeek Harness by adding message rollback, single-message deletion and restore, driven from the session header and hover actions while reusing the official session/fork for branching.

description.zh: DSH plugin 模型 Pro 为 llm-pi-ai 提供商提供全生命周期管理 UI，涵盖 CRUD、智能路由、组合提供商、连通性测试与观测，卸载时保证模型数据零丢失。
description.en: Model Pro is a DSH plugin offering full lifecycle management UI for llm-pi-ai providers, including CRUD, smart routing, composite providers, connectivity tests, and observability, with zero data loss on uninstall.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供移动端远程操控能力：自带无头宿主入口，通过 relay 隧道与局域网配对，让手机受限 API 远程管理会话与工作区。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets phones remotely control the host: it ships a headless host entry, relay tunnel and LAN pairing, exposing a restricted mobile API for sessions and workspaces.

description.zh: DSH Notch 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 macOS 刘海插件，把会话运行状态、待答问题与未读结果放到屏幕边缘，可直接作答并点击跳回对应会话。
description.en: DSH Notch is a macOS notch plugin for DeepSeek Harness that surfaces session status, pending questions and unread results at the screen edge, letting you answer inline and jump back to the session.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供系统通知与 macOS/Linux 状态栏鲸鱼图标，实时显示任务进度、待办与花费。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds native system notifications and a macOS/Linux status-bar whale showing task progress, pending items and spend.

description.zh: 面向数学笔记的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，驻留 Obsidian 右侧栏，可读写笔记并维护分层长期记忆与统一检索。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for math notes that lives in Obsidian's right sidebar, reading and writing notes while maintaining layered long-term memory and unified retrieval.

description.zh: DSH plugin，在DeepSeek官方高峰时段自动拦截官方provider请求，可切换至备用provider或阻止请求，避免高峰拥堵。
description.en: A DSH plugin that intercepts official DeepSeek provider requests during peak hours, optionally routing to a fallback provider or blocking them to avoid congestion.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补齐 OpenCode Zen 与 Go 免费模型所需的会话头、来源标识与工具 schema，让免费额度调用不再报 403/400。
description.en: A DSH plugin that restores the session headers, CLI origin proof and tool schemas OpenCode Zen and Go free-tier gateways require, so free models stop failing with 403/400.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供 PDF 解析工具集，支持提取文本、渲染页面及字体信息，内置混合引擎，可处理非嵌入中文字体的 PDF。
description.en: A DSH plugin offering PDF parsing tools for text extraction, page rendering, and font info, with hybrid engines for non-embedded CJK fonts.

description.zh: dsh-plugin-claude-bridge 将 Claude Code 的记忆、技能与全局配置无缝桥接至 DeepSeek Harness，零迁移、即插即用，让 DSH plugin 直接复用 Claude 生态资产。
description.en: dsh-plugin-claude-bridge bridges Claude Code's memory, skills, and global config into DeepSeek Harness with zero migration, enabling DSH plugin to reuse Claude ecosystem assets directly.

description.zh: 将 open-mcp-apps 应用带入 DeepSeek Harness，以侧边栏容器形式呈现，每个应用拥有独立会话与工作区，并支持聊天中内联渲染。
description.en: Bring open-mcp-apps into DeepSeek Harness as sidebar containers with their own sessions, plus inline widget rendering during chat.

description.zh: 把个人微信变成 DeepSeek Harness 的远程控制面：在微信里发消息，DSH Agent 在本机开会话执行并把结果回发微信。
description.en: Turns personal WeChat into a remote control surface for DeepSeek Harness: send a message in WeChat and the DSH Agent runs a local session, sending the reply back to WeChat.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 输入框带来类 Linux shell 的提示词历史：↑/↓ 召回、Ctrl+R 反向搜索、复制引用与右键粘贴，零配置。
description.en: Brings bash-like prompt history to the DSH web composer: ↑/↓ recall, Ctrl+R reverse search, copy/quote and right-click paste, zero config.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供网络代理配置的 DSH 插件，可在设置页统一设置全局代理，或为单个模型提供商指定代理或直连，保存即生效无需重启。
description.en: A DSH plugin that configures network proxies for DeepSeek Harness: set one global proxy in Settings, or give individual model providers their own proxy or a direct route, applied on save without restarting.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 claude-code、codex、reasonix、zcode 的历史聊天记录导入为 DeepSeek Harness 会话，支持工作区绑定与工具能力，导入后可直接续聊。
description.en: A DSH plugin that imports chat history from claude-code, codex, reasonix, and zcode into DeepSeek Harness sessions, with workspace binding and tool support for seamless continuation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 PTC 创造模式 preset，融合 Code Mode 工具编排与自引用 Cordis 工具，支持创作 agent preset。
description.en: Provides a PTC creation mode preset for DeepSeek Harness, combining Code Mode tool orchestration with self-referencing Cordis tools for authoring agent presets.

description.zh: 把 REA（Reverse Engineer Anything）MCP 服务器接入 DeepSeek Harness，以 mcp__rea__* 工具提供逆向分析能力，并附带安装检查与配置页面。
description.en: A DSH plugin that mounts the REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP server as mcp__rea__* tools, with a setup-check and configuration page.

description.zh: 为 DSH 接入的第三方模型服务商补上「思考强度」配置面板，内置 GPT、Claude、Grok、GLM、MiMo 推荐档位，一键套用即可在模型选择器中切换思考强度。
description.en: Adds a reasoning-effort panel for third-party model providers in DSH, with built-in presets for GPT, Claude, Grok, GLM and MiMo so you can switch effort levels right in the model picker.

description.zh: DSH Web GUI 专用插件，在对话流中直接展示 read_image 读取的图片，支持多图合并、透明棋盘格与页面内全精度放大。
description.en: A DSH plugin for the Web GUI that displays images read via read_image in the conversation, with multi-image grouping, transparency checkerboard, and in-page full-precision zoom.

description.zh: DSH plugin 需求对齐插件，在执行前建立需求基线，监控漂移并在方向改变时征询用户决策，保持长任务与用户意图一致。
description.en: A DSH plugin for requirement alignment that establishes a baseline, monitors drift, and asks user decisions to keep long-running agents aligned with intent.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一键重启：网页按钮或 dsh_restart 工具把重启交给独立助手进程，页面自动重连，启动失败时在页内与恢复控制台显示报错。
description.en: One-click restart for DeepSeek Harness: a web button or the dsh_restart tool hands relaunch to a detached helper, the page reconnects itself, and boot failures surface in an overlay plus a recovery console.

description.zh: RiskProof 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于数据来源的风险感知审批层，追踪工具输入来源，检测跨工具数据流，并在副作用执行前阻止高风险操作。
description.en: RiskProof is a provenance-aware approval layer for DeepSeek Harness, tracking tool input origins, detecting risky cross-tool data flows, and blocking high-risk side effects before execution.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的研究工作台插件，把会话整理成研究主题与可溯源知识卡片，支持图谱浏览、AI 提取与 Markdown 导出。
description.en: A research workbench DSH plugin that turns conversations into research topics and traceable Knowledge Cards, with graph browsing, AI extraction, and Markdown export.

description.zh: DSH 插件，支持导入 Tavern 角色卡 V2/V3，在 DeepSeek Harness 原生会话中游玩角色扮演。
description.en: A DSH plugin that imports Tavern Character Cards V2/V3 and enables roleplay in native DeepSeek Harness conversations.

description.zh: dsh-session-bridge 是一个 DSH plugin，通过本地回环 HTTP 桥接与 stdio MCP 服务器，让 Claude Code 等 MCP 客户端打开、发送、等待并读取 DeepSeek Harness 会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that bridges DeepSeek Harness sessions to MCP clients: a token-guarded loopback HTTP bridge plus a stdio MCP server let Claude Code open, send, wait on, and read sessions.

description.zh: dsh-session-fork 是 DeepSeek Harness 的会话分支管理插件，将分支作为对话管理的基本单元，支持并行工作流、可合并的连续对话记忆，并可视化分支图。
