description.en: dsh-session-fork is a DSH plugin that makes branches the building block of conversation management, enabling parallel workflows, mergeable continuous memory, and branch visualization.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex 式上下文窗口自动管理，零模型调用换窗、无损归档旧窗口并生成交接锚点与工作笔记。
description.en: Codex-style context window auto-management for DeepSeek Harness: zero-model rollover, lossless archiving, handoff anchors and persistent working notes.

description.zh: dsh-session-kit 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话页提供管理菜单、归档管理、轮次级删除与重新生成，以及右侧话题快捷导航，增强日常会话管理能力。
description.en: dsh-session-kit is a DSH plugin that adds a conversation management menu, archive management, round-level deletion and regeneration, and quick topic navigation to the session page.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可验证的重启：进程回归后自动做健康检查，把结论和中断前的会话上下文回传到发起重启的会话。
description.en: A verified restart plugin for DeepSeek Harness: after the process comes back it runs health checks and delivers the verdict plus the interrupted session context back to the requesting session.

description.zh: dsh-spend 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供悬浮用量窗口，实时监控 token 调用量、多维统计与预计费用，零配置自动识别计费计划并直读订阅商真实额度。
description.en: dsh-spend is a token usage & cost monitor for DeepSeek Harness, featuring a floating widget with multi-dimensional stats, time-series charts, auto-detected billing plans and estimated spend.

description.zh: DSH plugin 工程师级数据库插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL 三引擎的只读查询、写操作与结构探查，内置词法级只读保护与写审批门。
description.en: An engineer-grade database plugin for DeepSeek Harness, offering read-only queries, writes, and schema inspection across SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL with lexical read-only protection and write approval.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多机 SSH 工作台：主机库、按项目授权，侧栏内开交互式终端与双栏 SFTP，模型通过 SSHManager 工具执行远端命令与传文件，密钥不进上下文。
description.en: A multi-host SSH workbench for DeepSeek Harness: a host library with per-project grants, an in-sidebar interactive terminal and dual-pane SFTP, plus an SSHManager tool so the model can run remote commands and transfer files without keys ever entering context.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在「Deep diving...」状态提示前放置一只 GrokBot 风格动画小伙伴，表情与状态文字同步打字机变换，为 DeepSeek Harness 界面增添趣味。
description.en: A DSH plugin that puts a GrokBot-style animated buddy in front of the 'Deep diving...' indicator, with expression-synced typewriter status text for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在对话页输入框上方显示后台任务状态条，实时展示运行中任务数、可展开详情及滚动输出 tail，让用户随时掌握后台任务进度。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a background task status bar above the chat input, showing running task count, expandable details, and a live scrolling output tail.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供全局 Token 用量看板，汇总各会话计费 token 并按高峰/低谷估算人民币费用，侧边栏一键打开。
description.en: A Harness-wide token usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness that aggregates billed tokens across sessions and estimates peak/off-peak CNY cost, opened from a sidebar entry.

description.zh: dsh-tool-vision 为 DeepSeek Harness 纯文本 agent 提供本地优先的视觉能力：通过本地 VLM（LM Studio/Ollama）将图片转为结构化 JSON 证据（OCR/版面/语义），零 API 成本，图片不出本机。
description.en: dsh-tool-vision gives DeepSeek Harness text-only agents local-first vision: it turns images into structured JSON evidence (OCR/layout/semantics) via local VLMs (LM Studio/Ollama), with zero API cost and images never leaving your machine.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 dsh-better-sidebar 增加视频文件预览能力，在侧边栏内联渲染支持拖拽进度条、倍速与全屏的 <video> 播放器，并自带支持 Range 的 /video 路由。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds video preview to dsh-better-sidebar, rendering an inline <video> player with seek, speed, and fullscreen, backed by a Range-capable /video route.

description.zh: DSH plugin 视觉识别插件：在 Web 编辑器粘贴图片，由主机端调用 GLM-4V 识别，并将结果作为隐藏上下文注入对话，让主模型基于图片内容作答。
description.en: A DSH plugin for vision recognition: paste images into the Web composer, recognize them via GLM-4V on the host side, and inject the result as hidden context so the main model answers based on the image.

description.zh: 为 DSH 网页端提供双向语音：说话即转写进输入框，回复自动朗读，麦克风持续监听。
description.en: A two-way voice DSH plugin for the web app: speak to dictate into the composer, hear replies read aloud, with the mic kept listening.

description.zh: Matt Pocock 25 个技能的中文版 DSH plugin，将 SKILL.md 正文全译中文并保留关键英文术语，适配 DeepSeek Harness 的 Cordis 架构，适合偏好中文提示词的用户。
description.en: Chinese translation of Matt Pocock's 25 skills for DeepSeek Harness, with full SKILL.md translation and English technical terms preserved, suitable for Chinese-speaking users.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供持久自定义壁纸的 DSH plugin，支持图片与视频、调节透明度与模糊，并固定本地服务端口。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds persistent custom wallpapers to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, supporting images/videos with opacity and blur controls, and a fixed local origin.

description.zh: NoLetMe 是 DSH plugin，在会话页右侧挂载实时推理关键词统计面板，通过分析推理块词频反映模型推理风格，并附带灰测探针。
description.en: NoLetMe is a DSH plugin that mounts a real-time reasoning keyword statistics panel on the right side of the session page, reflecting model reasoning style via reasoning block word frequency, with a gray-test probe.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Solarized 与 Selenized 四套配色主题，注册到主题运行时，可在设置中切换，并包含代码块语法配色。
description.en: Registers four faithful Solarized and Selenized palettes into the DeepSeek Harness theme runtime, selectable in Settings with canonical code-block syntax colors.

description.zh: DSH plugin 跨 Agent 统一持久化记忆系统，基于 Obsidian Vault 与 SQLite FTS5 实现知识摄取、晋升、裁决与遗忘的全生命周期管理。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing unified fleet-wide agent memory with Obsidian Vault storage and SQLite FTS5 indexing for full knowledge lifecycle management.

description.zh: PaperLab 是一款基于 DeepSeek Harness 的 Overleaf 式论文修订工作台，支持 LaTeX 编辑、PDF 批注与 AI 逐条改写，所有修改可 diff、回滚与导出。
description.en: PaperLab is an Overleaf-style paper revision workbench powered by a DeepSeek Harness plugin, featuring LaTeX editing, PDF annotation, and AI-driven revision with diff, rollback, and export.

description.zh: DSH plugin 雪球 mini 行情面板，免登录查看 A股/港美股实时行情、K线、分时、热榜与 7×24 快讯，可拖拽悬浮面板并智能刷新。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing a Xueqiu mini quote panel with login-free real-time A-share/HK/US quotes, K-line, intraday, hot lists, and 7x24 news in a draggable floating panel.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化 DAG 工作流内核，将 Agent、Tool、Skill 与 MCP 编排为可保存、恢复、审计和重放的 WorkflowTemplate，并附带 CLI 与可视化 Canvas。
description.en: A durable DAG workflow kernel for DeepSeek Harness, orchestrating Agents, Tools, Skills, and MCP into saveable, resumable, auditable, replayable WorkflowTemplates, with CLI and visual Canvas.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 QQ 机器人通道插件，将官方 QQ 网关接入持久化 Agent，支持文本、图片、语音与文件收发。
description.en: A DSH plugin connecting the official QQ Bot Gateway to persistent Harness agents, supporting text, images, voice, and file messages.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多供应商额度监控插件，侧边栏实时卡片展示余额与用量，支持余额型 API 查询和限额型本地计量，可视化配置。
description.en: A DSH plugin for multi-provider quota monitoring, featuring real-time sidebar cards for balance and usage, supporting balance-type API queries and limit-type local metering with visual configuration.

description.zh: DeepSeekEyes 是 DeepSeek Harness 的可审计视觉与跨平台计算机操作运行时，让 DeepSeek 在不离开对话的情况下理解图像、控制浏览器和调用 MCP 工具。
description.en: DeepSeekEyes is an auditable vision and cross-platform Computer Use runtime for DeepSeek Harness, enabling DeepSeek to understand images, control browsers, and call MCP tools without leaving the conversation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将多台设备组成舰队，通过 mDNS 发现、密钥配对和 SSH 远程执行实现去中心化多设备协作，工具自动注册供 dsh 代理调用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns devices into a fleet, enabling decentralized multi-device collaboration via mDNS discovery, key pairing, and SSH direct exec, with tools auto-registered for dsh agents.

description.zh: dsh-acp-enhanced 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供增强的 ACP 服务器，作为 Zed 编辑器的即插即用桥接，支持流式输出、遥测、模型切换、权限预设与会话管理。
description.en: dsh-acp-enhanced provides an enhanced ACP server for DeepSeek Harness, a drop-in bridge for the Zed editor with streaming, telemetry, model switching, permission presets, and session management.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话验证、声明与决策账本，让多个代理会话不重复、不矛盾、不死锁。
description.en: Cross-session verification, claims and a decision ledger for DeepSeek Harness, so agent sessions don't repeat, contradict or deadlock each other.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Agnes 图像与视频生成能力，含两个 Agent 工具、AI 提示词优化器和侧边栏面板，密钥由用户自行配置。
description.en: Adds Agnes image and video generation to DeepSeek Harness via two agent tools, an AI prompt optimizer and a sidebar panel, with your own API key.

description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面版修复启动 cookie 累积导致的 431 认证锁死：提升监听器头部预算并退休旧启动 cookie，让欢迎握手恢复可用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that fixes the 431 auth lockout caused by accumulated launch cookies: it raises the listener header budget and retires stale launch cookies so the desktop welcome handshake works again.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面提供登录认证、会话超时、单点登录与登录历史，并支持 LAN 反向代理访问。
description.en: Authentication plugin for DeepSeek Harness web: sign-in, session expiry, single sign-on, login history, and LAN proxy access.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 回答加上 GPT 式引用角标、来源面板与正文配图，让联网搜索的结果图文并茂、可一键跳转核对。
description.en: Adds GPT-style citation badges, a source panel and inline images to DeepSeek Harness Web answers, so search results render richly and stay verifiable.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在网页右上角显示悬浮窗，实时展示 DeepSeek 模型账户余额，支持手动刷新与一键优雅退出，是 DeepSeek Harness 的实用界面增强。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows a floating window in the top-right corner of the web page, displaying real-time DeepSeek model account balance, with manual refresh and one-click graceful exit.

description.zh: dsh-automode 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Claude Code 风格的自动模式，通过确定性规则与两阶段分类器拦截危险工具调用，支持熔断与失败转人工，并内置影子模式。
description.en: dsh-automode adds a Claude Code-style auto mode to DeepSeek Harness, intercepting tool calls with deterministic rules and a two-stage classifier, featuring circuit breaker and fail-to-human, with shadow mode on day one.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供受控浏览器自动化能力，通过 agent_browser 工具驱动 agent-browser CLI 操作 Chromium，并防护失效引用、标签漂移与敏感信息泄露。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness controlled browser automation: an agent_browser tool drives the agent-browser CLI against Chromium, guarding against stale refs, tab drift and secret leakage.

description.zh: dsh-builtin-toggles 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供 evidence-backed 内置能力检查器，以 fail-closed 方式审查并控制内置插件，仅暴露 9 个经审阅的 UI 开关。
description.en: dsh-builtin-toggles is an evidence-backed built-in capability inspector for DeepSeek Harness Web, providing fail-closed review and control over built-in plugins with only 9 reviewed UI toggles.

description.zh: dsh·古法编程插件为 DeepSeek Harness 对话界面嵌入 Monaco 编辑器与文件树面板，让你在对话中直接编辑本地工作区代码，无需切换外部编辑器。
description.en: The dsh·classic-coding plugin embeds a Monaco editor and file tree panel into the DeepSeek Harness chat interface, letting you edit local workspace code directly in the conversation without switching to an external editor.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供画卷式消息导航栏：右侧竖条 hover 展开，scroll-spy 高亮跟随，支持收藏与快速填充，与 better-sidebar 同步避让。
description.en: A scroll-sweep message rail for DeepSeek Harness: hover to unfold, scroll-spy centered highlight, with favorites and quick-fill, synced with better-sidebar panels.

description.zh: DSH 插件形态的纯净桌面壳，为 DeepSeek Harness 套一层原生窗口，托盘实时监测后端活性并一键启停，零视觉改造。
description.en: A clean desktop shell as a DSH plugin, wrapping DeepSeek Harness in a native window with tray-based backend monitoring and quick start/stop, zero visual changes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏提供用量与成本面板，支持官方峰谷计价、1M 上下文占用、词勋段位与成就热力图，帮助用户实时掌握 token 消耗与费用。
description.en: A sidebar usage and cost dashboard for DeepSeek Harness, featuring official peak/off-peak pricing, 1M context usage, word-rank tiers, and achievements heatmap to track token consumption and expenses in real time.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加独立的 Codex 编码模式预设：先勘察再改码，内置终端、整仓检索、后台任务与上下文压缩。
description.en: Adds a dedicated Codex coding-mode preset to DeepSeek Harness: survey before editing, with built-in terminal, repo-wide search, background jobs and context compaction.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenAI Codex 模型，支持设备码 OAuth 登录、令牌自动刷新与供应商管理，消费 ChatGPT 订阅额度。
description.en: A DSH plugin that integrates OpenAI Codex models into DeepSeek Harness, featuring device-code OAuth, token auto-refresh, and provider management, using ChatGPT subscription quota.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供 Windows XP Luna 桌面化主题，将界面变为带 Bliss 壁纸、桌面图标、浮动窗口与任务栏的 XP 电脑。
description.en: A Windows XP Luna desktop theme for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, transforming the interface into an XP desktop with Bliss wallpaper, desktop icons, floating windows, and a taskbar.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 每轮回填宿主实测的上下文占用，并阻止「上下文快用尽」的错判被压缩摘要继承，让模型不再误判预算。
description.en: Feeds host-measured context occupancy back to DeepSeek Harness each turn and stops false "context nearly exhausted" claims from being inherited by compaction summaries.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 打造的原神哥伦比娅主题 DSH plugin，提供背景、蒙版与明暗双配色，首帧即生效。
description.en: A Genshin Impact Columbina themed DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web, offering background, mask, and light/dark color schemes that apply from the first frame.

description.zh: dsh-db-tool 是 DSH 插件，让你在聊天中安全操作 MySQL、PostgreSQL 等 8 种数据库，带项目级授权、危险操作确认、审计日志与侧边栏 SQL 控制台。
description.en: dsh-db-tool is a DSH plugin for safely operating 8 databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB and more) from chat, with per-project grants, danger confirmation, audit logs and a sidebar SQL console.

description.zh: 把 DSH Web UI 装进 Windows 原生窗口的桌面壳插件，自动拉起并复用 dsh web 服务，单实例防重复弹窗，关窗只停自有实例。
description.en: A Windows desktop shell DSH plugin that wraps the DSH Web UI in a native WebView2 window, auto-starting and reusing the dsh web backend with single-instance safety.

description.zh: dsh-cool-theme 是 DeepSeek Harness 的主题插件，内置 34 款流行预设主题，支持浅色、深色与跟随系统切换，让 DSH 界面随心换肤。
description.en: dsh-cool-theme is a DeepSeek Harness theme plugin with 34 popular presets, supporting light, dark, and system appearance switching to personalize the DSH interface.

description.zh: 一只住在 DeepSeek Harness 网页里的养成系桌宠，随编码活动升级进化、语音打气，还能用 AI 生成专属透明动画形象。
description.en: A desktop pet living in the DeepSeek Harness web UI that levels up with your coding activity, cheers you on with voice, and lets you generate a custom transparent animated avatar with AI.

description.zh: 把 DSH 桌面端底部统计行换成可配置状态栏，10 个字段任选排序，按官方峰谷口径实时估算费用并支持自定义模型单价与余额。
description.en: Replaces the DSH desktop bottom stats row with a configurable status bar: pick and reorder 10 fields, estimate cost in real time using DeepSeek's peak/off-peak rates, and set custom model prices and balance.

description.zh: 为 DSH plugin 提供跨工作区独立人格、自适应风格与陪伴预设，并可将子代理路由到任意已注册模型。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives each workspace its own persona, adaptive style and companion presets, and routes subagents to any registered model.

description.zh: 把三省六部制多智能体审核流程移植进 DeepSeek Harness：12 状态状态机、门下省封驳、高风险确认与越权矩阵，让子代理协作有据可查。
description.en: Ports the Three Departments and Six Ministries multi-agent review flow into DeepSeek Harness, with a 12-state machine, Menxia rejection, high-risk confirmation and an authority matrix.

description.zh: DSH 插件错误自动隔离：坏插件被禁用，其余插件照常启动，提供隔离管理与恢复 UI，让服务在坏插件面前照常运行。
description.en: DSH plugin for automatic error isolation: bad plugins are disabled, others start normally, with quarantine management and recovery UI, keeping the service running despite faulty plugins.

description.zh: DSH 插件，在编辑/写入工具行内显示 +N −M 差异徽章，并生成每轮文件变更摘要卡片，支持滚动窗口差异、撤销，无需 git。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows inline +N −M diff badges on edit/write tool rows and a per-turn file change summary card, with scroll-windowed diffs and undo, no git required.

description.zh: DSH plugin 本地优先故障证据包：自动将失败前的事件、Git 状态、运行环境与插件组合整理成脱敏 ZIP，并反解压缩栈，助力调试与事故复盘。
description.en: Local-first failure evidence capsule for DeepSeek Harness: automatically packages pre-failure events, Git state, runtime and plugin composition into a redacted ZIP, with source-map stack resolution for debugging.

description.zh: femo 是接入 DeepSeek Harness 的多智能体剧本引擎插件，用类剧本语法编排角色、视角隔离与并行流程，让主模型当导演开演 AI 群聊、狼人杀等复杂协作。
description.en: femo is a DSH plugin that brings a script-style multi-agent engine to DeepSeek Harness, letting the main model act as director to orchestrate roles, scoped perspectives and parallel flows for AI roleplay, werewolf games and other multi-agent scenarios.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为并行会话提供文件声明与保护：claim/release、心跳接管、异步待合并区（git 3-way merge），防止并发覆盖。
description.en: DSH plugin providing file claim and protection for concurrent sessions: claim/release, heartbeat takeover, async pending merge area (git 3-way merge), preventing overwrites.

description.zh: dsh-grafana 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，通过对话获取、编辑并安全更新 Grafana 仪表盘，直接操作仪表盘 JSON，无需截图。
description.en: dsh-grafana is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for fetching, editing, and safely updating Grafana dashboards through conversation, operating directly on dashboard JSON without screenshots.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端提供固定悬浮按钮，一键关闭并自动重开 DSH，全程零控制台窗口；内置自检可生成可直接定位问题的诊断报告。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a fixed floating button to hot-restart DeepSeek Harness with zero console windows, plus a built-in self-check that writes a one-file diagnostic report.

description.zh: DSH 字体排印插件，让对话、界面与代码各自独立设置字体、字号、行高与字重，支持连字开关与预设方案，改完即时生效。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness typography plugin that gives chat, UI and code independent control over font family, size, line height and weight, with ligature toggles and reusable presets applied instantly.

description.zh: dsh-hooks 是 DeepSeek Harness 的配置驱动生命周期钩子插件，无需编写代码即可在配置文件中声明事件到命令的钩子，支持 Web GUI 设置。
description.en: dsh-hooks is a config-driven lifecycle hooks plugin for DeepSeek Harness, enabling event-to-command hooks declared in config without code, with a Web GUI settings page.

description.zh: DSH plugin 面向开发岗位的 AI 面试助手，支持八股复习、模拟面试、简历押题、场景题和力扣 Hot 100 练习，并自动保存练习记录。
description.en: A DSH plugin AI interview assistant for developer roles, supporting review, mock interviews, resume-based questions, scenario questions, and LeetCode Hot 100 practice with auto-saved records.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自动轮换 API 密钥，遇配额或 429 限流时无缝切换下一把密钥并重试，无需重启、不丢上下文，零中断。
description.en: A DSH plugin that seamlessly rotates API keys, hot-swapping to the next key on quota or 429 rate limits and retrying instantly—no restarts, no context loss, zero interruptions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供进程级 LLM 出站代理分流：按域名匹配把 LLM 流量走指定代理，其余走系统代理或直连。
description.en: A DSH plugin that routes LLM outbound traffic through per-host proxies via an undici dispatcher, falling back to system proxy or direct connection.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地优先的持久记忆系统，支持热启动、中文 BM25 冷召回与租约锁事务写入，数据存于本机 Markdown。
description.en: Local-first persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness: hot bootstrap, Chinese BM25 cold recall, and lease-lock transactional writes, all stored in local Markdown.

description.zh: dsh-meta-orchestrator 是 DeepSeek Harness 的元代理插件，让模型在运行时按请求动态合成任务专属工作流，并协调工具与子代理执行，计划可版本化持久保存。
description.en: dsh-meta-orchestrator is a meta-agent plugin for DeepSeek Harness that synthesizes task-specific workflows at runtime and coordinates tools and subagents, with versioned, durable plans.

description.zh: DSH 插件，提供 /loop 命令与 loop 工具，按固定间隔向当前 Agent 投递提示，支持多循环并发与活动状态条，适合轮询、PR 守护和构建-修复-测试循环。
description.en: DSH plugin offering /loop command and loop tool to deliver prompts to the current agent at fixed intervals, supporting concurrent loops and an active status bar, ideal for polling, PR babysitting, and build-fix-test cycles.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供可搜索、可排序的模型选择器，支持收藏、价格、上下文窗口、实时 token 成本与本地模型过滤，一键安装。
description.en: A searchable, sortable model picker for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with favorites, prices, context windows, live token cost, and local-model filter. One-command install.

description.zh: DSH plugin，为DeepSeek Harness自定义模型提供商增加推理挡位、多模态输入等扩展配置，并新增「模型+」设置导航。
description.en: A DSH plugin that extends DeepSeek Harness custom model providers with reasoning effort levels, multimodal input, and a new 'Model+' settings page.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供 OAuth 登录适配，支持 OpenAI Codex 与 GitHub Copilot 账号认证，让 DSH 用户便捷接入这些模型服务。
description.en: An OAuth adapter for DeepSeek Harness Web, enabling sign-in with OpenAI Codex and GitHub Copilot accounts to access these model services.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 MCP 工具说明按需披露能力，平时隐藏暂不使用的 MCP 工具 Schema，需要时再加载，显著降低每轮 Token 消耗。
description.en: An on-demand MCP schema disclosure plugin for DeepSeek Harness that hides unused MCP tool schemas until needed, cutting per-turn token usage.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供办公效率技能专家组，通过标准技能注册表安装 excel2insights 与 sum2slides-pro 两个纯本地技能，无需手动复制文件。
description.en: Provides an office productivity skill suite for DeepSeek Harness, installing excel2insights and sum2slides-pro via the standard skills registry with no manual file copying.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端定制的主题与文件工作台插件，提供多套皮肤、@文件引用、Codex 风格文件树与预览，以及只读 Git 记录和实时余额显示。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin offering themes, @file mentions, a Codex-style file tree with preview, read-only Git history, and real-time balance display.

description.zh: Omni 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加任务级可靠性层，判断何时介入、准备上下文、验证证据并恢复失败，复用现有 Skills/Tools/Plugins。
description.en: Omni adds a task-level reliability layer to DeepSeek Harness, deciding when to intervene, preparing context, verifying evidence, and recovering from failures, reusing existing Skills/Tools/Plugins.

description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 无需安装 OpenCode 即可直接调用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，默认走匿名免费额度，也可通过 OPENCODE_API_KEY 使用自有密钥。
description.en: Lets DeepSeek Harness call OpenCode Zen free models directly without installing OpenCode, using anonymous free quota by default or an optional OPENCODE_API_KEY.

description.zh: 佩丽卡主题的 DeepSeek Harness 分级任务提示音插件，按计划、完成、回应、出错四档播报，普通问答静音，音效可自定义。
description.en: Perlica-themed tiered sound notifications for DeepSeek Harness, with distinct tones for planning, completion, response, and errors, silent for normal Q&A, and customizable sounds.

description.zh: 让 DSH 插件开发者与 Agent 自检运行时：判断改动生效层级、诊断插件加载、鉴权与配置，并支持热重载就地修复。
description.en: Runtime diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness plugin development: detect how a change takes effect, inspect plugin loading, auth and config, and hot-reload fixes in place.

description.zh: 为 DSH 官方插件管理器补上安装前质量门、五层环境诊断、多环境管理与插件市场，让插件安装与升级更安全可控。
description.en: A companion to the official DSH plugin manager, adding a pre-install quality gate, five-layer environment diagnostics, multi-profile management and a plugin marketplace for safer installs and upgrades.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加底部多标签终端面板，支持快捷键切换、多会话、重启与持久化，并针对 codex 等全屏 TUI 优化。
description.en: Adds a bottom multi-tab terminal panel to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with shortcut toggling, multi-session, restart, persistence, and tuning for full-screen TUIs like codex.

description.zh: Swift Cycle 治理技能的 DeepSeek Harness 适配器，将锁定版本载荷注册为用户显式调用的 Skill，支持知识晋升、状态分离与治理基线。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness adapter for the Swift Cycle governance skill, registering a version-pinned payload as a user-invoked Skill for knowledge promotion, state separation, and governance baselines.

description.zh: DSH plugin UI 调试闭环工具，让 AI 在真实 Chrome 中查看、点击、拖拽界面并验证修复，零配置一键安装。
description.en: DSH plugin UI debugging loop tool that lets AI view, click, drag and verify UI in real Chrome, zero-config one-command install.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 WebUI 会话流中连续相邻的同工具调用合并为「主卡片+紧凑子行」树状展示，减少连续读文件、搜索、编辑等操作对流的占据，默认覆盖所有内置通用行工具。
description.en: A DSH plugin that merges consecutive same-tool calls in the WebUI chat flow into a main-card + compact-child-rows tree view, reducing clutter from repeated file reads, searches, edits, etc., covering all built-in generic tools by default.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面带来 VS Code 风格工作台：文件树、可编辑代码预览、右键文件操作与图片内联预览，让 DSH 变身轻量代码编辑器。
description.en: Bring a VS Code-style workbench to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: file tree, editable code preview, right-click file operations, and inline image preview, turning DSH into a lightweight code editor.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端提供选区引用功能：选中会话文本即可插入原生引用 chip，并在其后追问，发送时自动展开为模型可读的 Markdown 引用块。
description.en: A Web-only DSH plugin that quotes selected conversation text as native reference chips in the composer, letting you ask a focused follow-up that expands into model-readable Markdown blockquotes on send.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供文件变更审查，以 Codex 风格卡片和审查标签页展示每次编辑的差异，支持语法高亮与撤销。
description.en: File-change review for DeepSeek Harness sessions, presenting per-turn edits as Codex-style cards and a review tab with syntax-highlighted diffs and revert.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端补上会话删除能力：侧边栏原生「移入回收站」、可恢复回收站管理页与 HTTP API，支持重名防误删、对话预览与定期自动清空。
description.en: Adds native session deletion to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a sidebar "move to trash" action, a recoverable trash management page and HTTP API, with name-collision guard, conversation preview and scheduled auto-purge.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 dsh-router 提供 traework 免费 SOLO 聊天通道供应商，注册后即可在面板添加账号使用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that provides the traework free SOLO chat supplier for dsh-router, enabling account management in the panel.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供 Codex 式会话深链：复制 dsh:// 链接粘贴到其他对话，自动快照源会话并作为只读上下文注入提示词前，支持浏览器直接打开。
description.en: A DSH plugin enabling Codex-style session deep links: copy a dsh:// link, paste into another conversation, and the source session is snapshotted and injected as read-only context before your prompt, with browser opening support.

description.zh: dsh-skin-manager 是 DeepSeek Harness 的皮肤管理器，自动发现已安装皮肤，在设置页一键切换并热重载，支持恢复默认外观。
description.en: dsh-skin-manager is a skin manager for DeepSeek Harness, auto-discovering installed skins, enabling one-click switching with hot reload, and restoring the default look.

description.zh: dsh-swarm 是 DeepSeek Harness 的多智能体编排插件，将需求拆解为严格校验的流水线，通过可视化看板规划、执行、审查并交付代码。
description.en: dsh-swarm is a DSH plugin for orchestrating multi-agent pipelines, turning requirements into evidence-verified workflows with a visual kanban for planning, execution, review, and delivery.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供建议提示词：每轮回答结束后预测下一句，以输入框幽灵占位文字呈现，按 Tab 即可采纳。
description.en: A DSH plugin that predicts your next prompt after each agent turn and shows it as ghost placeholder text inside the input box, accepted with Tab.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供 GIF 壁纸与 B站音乐播放器的一体化插件，支持主题融合遮罩、突出度调节与侧栏迷你播放器。
description.en: An all-in-one DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web UI, offering GIF wallpapers and a Bilibili music player with theme-aware overlays and a sidebar mini-player.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏新增会话搜索入口，支持标题/内容一键切换、按用户/回复/工具筛选，并复用 DSH FTS5 全文索引。
description.en: Adds a session search entry to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar with title/content toggle and filtering by user/reply/tool, leveraging DSH's FTS5 full-text index.

description.zh: 把 TiddlyWiki 5 变成 DSH 里的私人文档中心：Agent 用 tiddlywiki_* 工具读写笔记，你在内嵌编辑器里记录，git 自动同步备份。
description.en: Turns TiddlyWiki 5 into a personal document hub inside DeepSeek Harness: agents read and write notes via tiddlywiki_* tools while you edit in the embedded TW editor, with git auto-sync.

description.zh: DSH Web GUI 插件，将连续工具调用折叠为可展开的折叠条，提供类 Codex 的简洁界面体验。
description.en: A DSH plugin for the Web GUI that folds consecutive tool calls into expandable bars, offering a Codex-like clean interface.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 端提供 Claude 风格模型与思考强度切换器，在输入框旁一键切换模型并滑动调节推理力度。
description.en: A Claude-style model and reasoning-effort switcher for DeepSeek Harness Web, letting you switch models and slide reasoning effort right by the input box.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让模型在对话中实时渲染可视化内容，支持结构化图表（echarts）与流式 SVG/HTML 组件，安全隔离且不修改 DSH 源码。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets the model render visuals on the fly in conversations, supporting structured charts (echarts) and streaming SVG/HTML widgets, with security isolation and no DSH source modification.

description.zh: DSH 天气插件，基于 Open-Meteo 免费数据，提供实时天气与多日预报，无需 API key。
description.en: DSH weather plugin: real-time conditions and multi-day forecasts via Open-Meteo, no API key required.

description.zh: DSH插件，让DeepSeek Harness的Web UI支持远程访问，并通过Web Token进行访问控制，保护页面、API和WebSocket。
description.en: A DSH plugin that enables remote access to DeepSeek Harness Web UI with Web Token authentication, protecting pages, APIs, and WebSockets.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供浮动笔记，可保存命令、凭据与代码片段，一键插入对话或保存任意选中内容，支持 Markdown 预览与会话级笔记管理。
description.en: Floating notes for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: keep commands, credentials and snippets at hand, insert any note into the composer, and save any selection as a note.

description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供基于Brave Search API的Web搜索提供者，注册到ctx.web接口，使内置web_search工具开箱即用，支持限流与重试。
description.en: A Brave Search API-backed web search provider for DeepSeek Harness, registering a WebSearchProvider into ctx.web so the built-in web_search tool works out of the box.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将微信公众号 AI 写作管线（选题到草稿箱）产品化，一条命令安装，在本地 Web UI 完成全流程，模型凭据自持，数据仅落本地。
description.en: A DSH plugin that productizes a WeChat Official Account AI writing pipeline (from topic selection to draft box), installable with one command, running entirely in a local Web UI with your own models and credentials, data stays local.

description.zh: DSH plugin 封装五运六气（运气学）AI 技能包，一行安装即可获得 36 个中医运气学技能与跨书 RAG 检索知识库。
description.en: A DSH plugin packaging the Wuyun Liuqi (Yunqi) AI skill bundle, installable in one line to get 36 TCM luck-climate skills and a cross-book RAG knowledge base.

description.zh: 微光（Lume）是 DeepSeek Harness 桌面增强插件，为会话注入 Codex 风格任务执行协议与具名长期记忆人设系统，支持从聊天记录蒸馏角色卡。
description.en: Lume is a DSH Desktop enhancement plugin that injects a Codex-style task execution protocol and a named persona system with long-term memory, supporting persona distillation from chat logs.

description.zh: wali-dsh-plugin 是一款 DSH plugin，在 DeepSeek Harness Web 端右下角显示桌面宠物，随会话状态变化展示提示卡片，支持头像、背景图与股票 K 线主题交互。
description.en: wali-dsh-plugin is a DSH plugin that shows a desktop pet at the bottom-right of DeepSeek Harness Web, displaying hint cards based on session state, with avatar, background, and stock K-line themes.

description.zh: adhdgofly-dsh-ext 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供词性高亮：名词绿、动词红、形副紫、其他灰，支持深/浅色板与流式输出，纯客户端 DOM 后处理，一条命令即可安装。
description.en: adhdgofly-dsh-ext brings part-of-speech highlighting to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: nouns green, verbs red, adjectives/adverbs purple, others gray, with dark/light palettes and streaming support, installed via a single command.

description.zh: DSH plugin，在对话中内联渲染交互式A2UI卡片——测验、表单、图表、流程图等，用户操作回流给Agent，支持流式与原地更新。
description.en: DSH plugin rendering interactive A2UI cards inline in conversation — quizzes, forms, charts, diagrams — with actions flowing back to the agent, streaming and in-place updates.

description.zh: CloudQ 集成插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面添加 CloudQ 模式，内置 cloudq 技能，支持云操作问答、用量视图与本地凭证管理。
description.en: CloudQ integration for DeepSeek Harness, adding a CloudQ mode to the Web profile with bundled skill, usage views, and local credential setup.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通过 Codex 官方本地服务接入 ChatGPT 账号，无需 OpenAI API key，即可在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 GPT 模型。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects ChatGPT accounts via the official local Codex app-server, letting DeepSeek Harness use GPT models without an OpenAI API key.

description.zh: Codex2DSH 将 Codex 的 MCP 服务器、技能、全局指令、记忆与会话历史一键迁移进 DeepSeek Harness，全程可视化、源码只读、密钥原样迁移。
description.en: Codex2DSH migrates Codex's MCP servers, skills, global instructions, memory, and session history into DeepSeek Harness with a visual panel, read-only source, and key preservation.

description.zh: Harness Relay MCP 是一个 DSH plugin，让任意 MCP 代理将长时任务委派给 DeepSeek Harness 执行，并监控至完成，提供原生会话与事件模型。
description.en: Harness Relay MCP is a DSH plugin that lets any MCP agent delegate long-running work to DeepSeek Harness and monitor it to completion, exposing native sessions and events.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供代理控制平面，在每次工具调用前执行策略检查，记录允许、阻止及原因，确保代理行为合规。
description.en: Agentic Control Plane for DeepSeek Harness: policy-check every tool call before it runs, logging decisions and reasons.

description.zh: DSH Actions 把项目里反复要跑的命令固化成 actions.json，右侧栏面板一键启动，Agent 也能直接调用同一套任务定义。
description.en: DSH Actions turns repeatable project commands into an actions.json shared by a right-sidebar panel and DeepSeek Harness agent tools, so one click or one prompt runs them.

description.zh: dingtalk-dsh-assistant 是运行在 DeepSeek Harness 中的钉钉数字员工插件，将群聊接入 DSH，让 Agent 常驻群聊、主动参与协作并持续推进任务。
description.en: dingtalk-dsh-assistant is a DingTalk digital employee plugin for DeepSeek Harness, connecting group chats to DSH so agents can reside in chats, actively collaborate, and drive tasks forward.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让同一进程内的多个 Agent 会话互相发消息，支持离线投递、回执查询与 @ 会话定位，实现跨会话协作与监督。
description.en: A DSH plugin enabling agent-to-agent messaging across sessions, with offline delivery, delivery receipts, and @ session targeting for multi-agent collaboration.

description.zh: 为 δ-me13 的十三张黄金裔技能卡提供专属席位、逐席配色壁纸与首轮技能注入的 DSH 插件，并用总览画布派发任务、征询各席与接续移交。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives the 13 Chrysos Heir skill cards of δ-me13 dedicated seats, per-seat colors and wallpapers, first-round skill injection and chat emotes, plus an overview canvas for dispatching tasks, consulting seats and handing off work.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上归档会话管理中心，可按日期、工作区筛选历史会话，批量取消归档，并用可撤销策略自动清理会话列表。
description.en: Adds an archived-session management center to DeepSeek Harness: browse archived sessions by date or workspace, unarchive in bulk, and run a reversible auto-cleanup policy.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 添加多媒体输入与工作区附件功能，支持文件/文件夹选择、拖拽上传，发送时自动复制到 Agent 工作区。
description.en: Adds multimedia input and workspace attachments to the DeepSeek Harness WebUI, supporting file/folder selection and drag-and-drop, with files copied to the Agent workspace on send.

description.zh: dsh-autonomy 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供 Chat 与 Agent 模式切换，无需离开当前会话即可控制自主执行，节省 token 消耗。
description.en: dsh-autonomy adds a Chat | Agent toggle to DeepSeek Harness sessions, letting you switch autonomy mid-session to control token spend.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 工作区右侧添加多功能侧边栏，集成资源管理器、Git 面板与技能列表，提升开发效率。
description.en: Adds a right sidebar to DeepSeek Harness workspace with Explorer, Git, and Skills tabs for enhanced UX.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自托管运维守护：agent 改完代码后先验证构建与测试、通过组合预检才放行重启，起不来自动回滚到已知可用版本。
description.en: A self-hosted operations guard for DeepSeek Harness: it verifies build and tests before letting an agent restart, preflights the composition, and rolls back automatically when boot fails.

description.zh: DSH 插件，为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供实时计费监控：统计 token 用量与费用、按峰谷价计费、余额锚定与官方同步，并集成侧边栏余额 pill 与设置页。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds real-time billing monitoring to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: tracks token usage and costs, applies peak/off-peak pricing, anchors balance with official sync, and integrates a sidebar pill and settings page.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 复刻 DeepSeek Chat 蓝鲸配色的皮肤，亮色/深色跟随系统外观，安装即默认启用。
description.en: A DeepSeek Chat-style blue-whale skin for DeepSeek Harness, with light/dark following system appearance and enabled by default.

description.zh: BrainAgent 为 DeepSeek Harness 注入类脑认知架构：多类型记忆、情感模拟、强化学习与自主行为，让 dsh 代理成为长期个人助理。
description.en: BrainAgent adds a brain-inspired cognitive architecture to DeepSeek Harness: multi-type memory, emotion simulation, RL-lite learning and autonomous behavior, turning your dsh agent into a long-lived personal assistant.

description.zh: dsh-client-ui-brand 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 插件，无需改动源码即可自定义 Web 端的产品名称与 Logo，支持本地图片与远程 URL，并可通过配置文件覆盖默认品牌。
description.en: dsh-client-ui-brand is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that customizes the product name and logo of the Web UI without modifying source code, supporting local images and remote URLs with configurable overrides.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供桌面宠物陪伴：内置九只宠物，实时提醒多任务进度，并可直接处理审批与提问，还能用 Skill 自定义宠物。
description.en: A pet companion for DeepSeek Harness: nine built-in pets, live multi-task notifications you can act on for approvals and questions, plus Skill-based custom pets.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex 桌面端风格深色界面的 DSH 插件，含常驻导航、可收起会话侧栏、项目会话树与输入卡等界面增强。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness a Codex-style dark desktop UI, with a persistent nav rail, collapsible session sidebar, project/session tree and refined composer.

description.zh: DSH plugin，通过 ChatGPT OAuth 登录，在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接使用 Codex 模型与 gpt-image-2 图像生成/编辑，无需 OpenAI API 密钥。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets you use your ChatGPT/Codex subscription inside DeepSeek Harness for Codex models and gpt-image-2 image generation/editing, no OpenAI API key required.

description.zh: dsh-coding-kit 是 DeepSeek Harness 的编码规范插件，提供 P0 门禁 CLI 与 G1-G7 流程命令，通过 apply_coding_standards 工具按需注入编码标准，支持多级配置与覆盖。
description.en: dsh-coding-kit is a DSH plugin for coding standards, offering a P0 gate CLI and G1-G7 process commands, injecting standards on demand via apply_coding_standards with tiered profiles and overrides.

description.zh: DSH plugin 协调 Codex 规划与独立审查，让 DSH 保持唯一执行者，通过 SQLite 桥接实现可读审计。
description.en: DSH plugin coordinates Codex planning and independent review while DSH remains the sole executor, with a SQLite bridge for readable audits.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 桌面操作能力：截图、鼠标、键盘、窗口与剪贴板，由内置 Rust 助手完成原生调用。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness agents real Windows desktop control — screenshots, mouse, keyboard, windows and clipboard — powered by a bundled native Rust helper.

description.zh: dsh-connect 是 DeepSeek Harness 的数据源连接插件，支持数据库元数据发现、AI 语义建模、只读 SQL 查询和固定 HTTP API 调用，将企业数据安全接入 DSH 对话。
description.en: dsh-connect is a DSH plugin for data source connectivity, enabling database metadata discovery, AI semantic modeling, read-only SQL queries, and fixed HTTP API calls to safely bring enterprise data into DSH conversations.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）提供 composer 展开/收起按钮，一键在默认高度与 70vh 大书写视图间切换，长草稿不再挤在小窗口。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds an expand/collapse toggle to the composer, switching between default height and a tall 70vh writing view for long drafts.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补齐 AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md 中的 @path 引用：会话启动时递归展开被引用文件并注入上下文，压缩后自动重注入。
description.en: A DSH plugin that expands @path imports in AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md and injects the referenced files into context at session start, re-injecting them after compaction.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供 Codex 风格会话锚点轨与思考过程折叠，按轮次画短横线，支持悬停预览、点击定位、键盘跳转与历史一次拉齐。
description.en: A DSH plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI that adds a Codex-style per-turn anchor rail and thinking-process folding, with hover previews, click-to-scroll, keyboard jumps and eager history loading.

description.zh: dsh-crew 让 Claude Code 和 Codex 在 dsh 会话中以真实终端面板运行，人类可实时观看并键入，DSH agent 通过五个工具调度它们。
description.en: dsh-crew runs Claude Code and Codex as live terminal panes inside dsh sessions, letting humans watch and type, while the DSH agent orchestrates them via five tools.

description.zh: dsh-cron 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 /cron 斜杠命令，支持按 cron 表达式定时触发循环 Agent 任务，可暂停、恢复并跨重启持久化。
description.en: dsh-cron adds a /cron slash command to DeepSeek Harness for cron-scheduled recurring agent loops, with pause, resume, and persistence across restarts.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在侧边栏新对话按钮下方添加「网页对话」入口，一键打开 chat.deepseek.com，桌面端支持独立子窗口。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a 'Web Chat' button below the new-chat button in the sidebar, opening chat.deepseek.com, with desktop multi-window support.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 官方 Desktop 打造的蓝色大肥鱼桌宠，随任务状态切换动作，气泡显示会话标题与进度，可拖动、打招呼并记住位置。
description.en: A chubby blue whale desktop pet for the official DeepSeek Harness Desktop that reacts to task state, shows session title and progress in a bubble, and can be dragged, greeted, and repositioned.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边栏实时余额与每轮对话花费显示，点击可展开充值/赠送余额及 token 单价明细。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows your live DeepSeek balance in the sidebar and the cost of each conversation turn, with expandable token and pricing details.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供失败开放式的流式清洗，实时剥离模型输出中泄漏的 DSML 协议闭合标签，避免聊天界面被协议残留污染。
description.en: A fail-open stream sanitizer for DeepSeek Harness that strips leaked DSML protocol closing tags from model output in real time, keeping chat bubbles clean.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供技能调用审计与应用内 skill 管理器：从会话事件流推导每轮用了哪些 skill，并支持在面板里一键装卸、更新与引用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that audits skill usage per turn from the session event stream and adds an in-app skill manager for installing, updating, disabling and referencing skills.

description.zh: DSH Doctor 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供确定性诊断与恢复，修复无法对话或无法启动的问题，支持一键回滚至健康检查点。
description.en: DSH Doctor provides deterministic diagnostics and recovery for DeepSeek Harness, fixing conversation or boot failures with one-click rollback to healthy checkpoints.

description.zh: DSH plugin 桌宠：一个真正的 macOS 置顶窗口，能盖住全屏 Space，根据 agent 状态切换六种表情，还支持用一张照片生成整套皮肤，零依赖。
description.en: A DSH plugin desk pet: a real macOS always-on-top window that covers fullscreen Spaces, switches six states based on your agent, and turns one photo into a whole skin with zero dependencies.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让你编辑已发送的用户消息并重发：从该回合 fork 新分支重新生成回复，原会话自动归档，可在设置页一键恢复。
description.en: A DSH plugin to edit a sent user message and resend it: fork a new branch from that turn, regenerate the reply, auto-archive the original session, and restore it from Settings.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 newapi、LiteLLM、Higress 等任意 OpenAI 兼容网关的全部模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，自动同步真实参数并按原生协议路由请求。
description.en: A DSH plugin that mounts any LLM gateway (newapi, LiteLLM, Higress, OpenAI-compatible) into DeepSeek Harness, syncing real model params and routing over native protocols.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加模型请求走代理、其他请求直连的能力，无需修改官方代码，支持 HTTP/SOCKS 代理。
description.en: Adds proxy support for model requests in DeepSeek Harness while keeping other traffic direct, without modifying official code.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通过 OAuth 接入 Grok，将网页与 X 搜索融入主循环，支持连续推理与 Imagine 图像生成。
description.en: A DSH plugin that integrates Grok via OAuth, merging web and X search into the main loop with continuous reasoning and Imagine image generation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 的 IM 网关，将微信等即时通讯桥接进 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent 会话，支持扫码登录与斜杠命令控制。
description.en: An IM gateway DSH plugin that bridges messengers like WeChat into DeepSeek Harness agent sessions, with QR login and slash command control.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注入 J-Space 认知预设，提供深层推理路由、持久控制器与 .jspace 工作区状态账本，解耦任意模型。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects the J-Space cognition preset into DeepSeek Harness, adding deep reasoning routing, a persistent controller and a .jspace workspace ledger, model-agnostic.

description.zh: DSH plugin，在 Web UI 右侧显示当前会话实际生效的指令链（AGENTS.md 等），按真实加载顺序管理，支持就地创建与编辑。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows and manages the instruction chain in effect for the current session in a Web UI side panel, with in-place creation and editing.

description.zh: DSH 桌宠的 Live2D 渲染插件，在 Web UI 中呈现 Cubism 模型，支持表情切换与鼠标跟随。
description.en: A Live2D companion plugin for DeepSeek Harness, rendering a Cubism model in the Web UI with expressions and mouse tracking.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供智能看板，每个工作区一个看板，每个任务一个代理会话，强制人工与代理协作流程，确保工作有序推进。
description.en: Agent-driven kanban boards for DeepSeek Harness: one board per workspace, one task session per item, enforcing a guarded human/agent workflow.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）网页界面提供可拖动的液态玻璃卡片，实时展示 DeepSeek API 余额、累计消费与 Token 用量，支持本地与线上双层统计。
description.en: A draggable liquid-glass floating card for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web GUI, showing DeepSeek API balance, cumulative spend, and token usage with local and online stats.

description.zh: dsh-llm-newapi 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 NewAPI 模型提供方，自动发现模型并在设置面板提供配置页，零改动接入 OpenAI 兼容网关。
description.en: dsh-llm-newapi adds NewAPI as an LLM provider to DeepSeek Harness, enabling chat-only model discovery and a web settings section with zero dsh modifications.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化、可搜索的项目记忆：决策、规则与会话上下文存入 DuckDB，规则注入每次模型请求，并提供 Web 管理界面。
description.en: Persistent, searchable per-project memory for DeepSeek Harness: decisions, rules, and session context in DuckDB, with rules injected into every model request and a full management UI.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 对话提供撤回、编辑重发与重新生成能力，并支持会话内版本时间线与产物回滚。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings recall, edit-and-resend, and regenerate to DeepSeek Harness conversations, plus in-conversation versioning and artifact rollback.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化、可搜索的项目记忆：决策、规则与会话上下文存入 DuckDB，规则注入每次模型请求，并提供 Web 管理界面。
description.en: Persistent, searchable per-project memory for DeepSeek Harness: decisions, rules, and session context in DuckDB, with rules injected into every model request and a full management UI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按 provider/model 粒度的 LLM 调用限流，支持令牌桶与滑动窗口、排队或拒绝两种策略，并带实时状态面板与热重载配置。
description.en: Per-model LLM call rate limiter for DeepSeek Harness, with token-bucket or sliding-window algorithms, queue or reject modes, a live status panel and hot-reload configuration.

description.zh: DSH plugin 消息平台网关，在 Web 侧边栏管理多平台连接器，桥接企业微信、Telegram、Discord 等，支持流式回复与主动图文推送。
description.en: A DSH plugin message gateway managing multi-platform connectors in the web sidebar, bridging WeCom, Telegram, Discord, etc., with streaming replies and proactive media push.

description.zh: DSH plugin 按角色路由模型：规划者用 deepseek-v4-pro，委派子代理用 flash，附提示段与 pro-flash-routing 技能，降低推理成本。
description.en: A DSH plugin that routes models by role: planner on deepseek-v4-pro, delegated subagents on flash, with a prompt section and pro-flash-routing skill to cut reasoning costs.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 moli_fetch 与 moli_probe 两个工具，驱动本地 Moli 无头浏览器渲染 JS 页面，输出 Markdown、语义树、截图与 PDF。
description.en: A DSH plugin exposing moli_fetch and moli_probe tools that drive the local Moli headless browser to render JavaScript pages as Markdown, semantic trees, screenshots and PDFs.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 获得桌面 App 式体验：零额外安装，提供快捷方式、托盘、独立窗口与原生通知，并整合社区插件。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns the DeepSeek Harness Web UI into a desktop app with zero extra installs, offering shortcuts, tray, standalone windows, native notifications, and community plugin integration.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自动同步 llm-pi-ai 提供商路由的模型目录与 pi.dev 网关，通过官方 settings 接口零补丁写入配置，支持定时刷新与变更报告。
description.en: A DSH plugin that keeps llm-pi-ai provider routes' model catalog in sync with the pi.dev gateway, writing via the official settings seam with zero patches, supporting scheduled refresh and change reports.

description.zh: dsh-multi-chat 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多窗口会话墙，可并排监控多个 DSH 会话，并支持手机/平板通过认证网关远程查看。
description.en: dsh-multi-chat adds a multi-window wall to DeepSeek Harness, letting you monitor multiple DSH conversations side-by-side, with an authenticated LAN gateway for phone/tablet access.

description.zh: DSH 的 Notion 连接插件，配置一次 Token 后，Agent 工具与 Web 设置页即可操作你的 Notion 工作区。
description.en: A Notion connector for DeepSeek Harness: configure a Token once, and both agent tools and the Web settings page can operate your Notion workspace.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通过 COM 驱动真实 Office 实例，实现 Excel/Word 自动化，支持 VBA 宏、透视表、公式重算及会计三表生成。
description.en: DSH plugin drives real Office instances via COM for Excel/Word automation, enabling VBA macros, pivot tables, formula recalculation, and accounting statements.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 DeepSeek Harness 变为去中心化 A2A 代理网络节点，支持签名代理卡、点对点发现、直接路由模型工具及侧边栏会话节点加入。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns DeepSeek Harness into a node of a decentralized A2A agent network with signed agent cards, peer discovery, direct routing model tools, and joinable session nodes in the sidebar.

description.zh: 把本地 OpenViking 记忆服务接入 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI：左侧 Studio 面板、会话提交状态胶囊与提交时间线，以及右栏记忆召回标签页。
description.en: Brings a local OpenViking memory server into the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a Studio panel, a per-session commit status pill with timeline, and a right-sidebar memory recall tab.

description.zh: 面向毕业论文全流程的 DSH 插件，先追问再动手，把学校模板、实验数据与文献推进为选题到答辩九阶段的可查证论文。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for the full thesis lifecycle: it interrogates first, then drives school templates, data and references through nine stages from topic selection to defense.

description.zh: 钢琴键风格的会话内导航条，为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 单会话提供多轮对话快速跳转与预览，是增强会话体验的 DSH plugin。
description.en: A piano-key style in-conversation navigation bar for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, enabling quick jump and preview across multi-turn messages within a session.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地 OCR 兜底：当会话模型不支持图片输入时，用 PP-OCRv5 + ONNX Runtime 离线识别图中文字，图片不出本机。
description.en: A local OCR fallback for DeepSeek Harness: when the routed model can't accept images, it reads text from pasted images via PP-OCRv5 + ONNX Runtime, fully offline on CPU.

description.zh: 用视觉 AI 把 PDF 逐页翻译成中文，输出中文 PDF 与可编辑 LaTeX 源码，作为 DSH plugin 支持公式、图表与表格重建。
description.en: A DSH plugin that translates PDFs into Chinese with vision AI, producing a Chinese PDF plus editable LaTeX sources with formulas, figures and tables rebuilt.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让视觉模型按内容智能阅读 PDF：文本页提取文字，图表公式页高分辨率裁剪，避免图像 token 上限丢失细节。
description.en: A DSH plugin enabling vision models to read PDFs content-aware: text pages are extracted, while figures/tables/formulas are rendered as high-DPI crops, preserving detail within image token limits.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供 PDF 解析工具集，支持提取文本、渲染页面及字体信息，内置混合引擎，可处理非嵌入中文字体的 PDF。
description.en: A DSH plugin offering PDF parsing tools for text extraction, page rendering, and font info, with hybrid engines for non-embedded CJK fonts.

description.zh: DSH plugin 持久化长期人格记忆，跨会话记住用户、项目与教训，自动学习、纠正检测与容量合并，让记忆自己生长且不失控。
description.en: A DSH plugin for persistent long-term persona memory, remembering users, projects, and lessons across sessions with auto-learning, correction detection, and consolidation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 宠物伙伴，用宠物动画实时展示 agent 状态，让 DeepSeek Harness 长任务等待变得直观有趣。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings pet companions to DeepSeek Harness, visualizing agent status with cute animations.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将本地 Codex App Server 注册为 DeepSeek Harness 主模型提供商，复用本地 Codex 登录态，无需存储令牌。
description.en: A DSH plugin that registers your locally authenticated Codex App Server as a DeepSeek Harness main-model provider, reusing local Codex login without storing tokens.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在会话头部添加余额按钮，实时显示账户余额、token 用量与按官方价目表计算的费用估算。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a balance button to the session header, showing account balance, real-time token usage, and cost estimates based on official pricing.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供插件诊断面板，列出加载失败、更新残留与不可管理条目，并附带磁盘扫描脚本排查安装残留。
description.en: A diagnostics panel for DeepSeek Harness plugins that surfaces failed loads, leftover update rows and unmanaged entries, plus a disk scan script for install leftovers.

description.zh: Loom Chat 是 DSH Web 客户端插件，将线性会话转化为可平移缩放的画布，支持并行探索与分支会话，让多线思考在同一画布上展开。
description.en: Loom Chat is a DSH Web client plugin that turns linear sessions into a pannable, zoomable canvas for parallel exploration and branching conversations.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 赋予可塑性长期记忆：对话中自动沉淀记忆，支持分类检索、因果溯源与内建治理，可诊断冲突冗余并适时遗忘。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness a plastic long-term memory: it distills memories from conversations, supports typed recall and source tracing, and ships built-in governance to detect conflicts, redundancy and decay.

description.zh: DSH plugin 金融数据工具包，为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供数字格式化、收益计算、估值比率、风险指标等精确算术能力。
description.en: Finance data toolkit for DeepSeek Harness agents: number formatting, return math, valuation ratios, and risk metrics.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可运行时切换的出站代理插件，将 LLM 请求、web_search 与 MCP 流量统一走 HTTP(S) 或 SOCKS5 代理，改配置即生效无需重启。
description.en: A DSH plugin that routes all outbound traffic — LLM providers, web_search/web_fetch and streamable-http MCP — through an HTTP(S) or SOCKS5 proxy, switchable at runtime with no restart.

description.zh: DSH plugin 网页端模型能力管理插件，提供图形界面配置各模型的思考等级、上下文窗口、输出上限、输入模态与网关兼容预设，支持中英文界面。
description.en: A DSH plugin for managing model capabilities in the web UI, offering a GUI to configure thinking levels, context window, output caps, input modalities, and gateway compatibility presets.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 装进口袋：局域网扫码即用，人在外面走自建 relay 中继，用手机实时查看并操控电脑上的 DSH 界面，支持设备级认证与多机热备。
description.en: Put DeepSeek Harness in your pocket: scan a QR code on LAN, or reach it from anywhere through your own relay server, and control the DSH UI on your PC from a phone with device-level auth and multi-PC failover.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供集成对话的看板插件，Agent 可通过 kanban_* 工具直接规划卡片，按工作区隔离并持久化到磁盘。
description.en: A kanban board plugin for DeepSeek Harness, integrated with conversation: the agent writes planning cards via kanban_* tools, isolated per workspace and persisted to disk.

description.zh: dsh-question-nav 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 会话添加问题导航小地图，在对话列左侧显示圆点列，悬停放大并展示完整问题文本，点击跳转到对应消息，提升长会话导航效率。
description.en: dsh-question-nav adds an in-session question minimap to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: a dot column on the left edge of the conversation, hover to enlarge and see full question text, click to jump to that message.

description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框旁加一个 ✨ 优化按钮，把草稿改写成结构化提示词，支持 plain、sections、role-task-goal 三种风格，确认后才替换草稿。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a ✨ Optimize control beside the composer, rewriting your draft into a structured prompt in plain, sections, or role-task-goal style before you apply it.

description.zh: DSH 会话选区引用与锚点批注插件：选中文字即可批注，生成可点击跳转的引用 chip，让模型精确理解你的评论指向。
description.en: A DSH plugin for contextual selection and anchored annotation: select text, annotate, and get clickable quote chips that jump back to the original message.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在发送框左侧加星形按钮，一键把草稿重写为更清晰的提示词，可恢复原文，并支持自定义模板。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a star button beside the composer send action to rewrite your draft into a clearer prompt, with one-click restore and editable templates.

description.zh: DSH 远程主机隧道管理器：自动分配远程端口、注册表记录、systemd 守护，并建立弹性 SSH 隧道，让本地浏览器安全访问远程服务器上的 dsh web。
description.en: Remote Host Tunnel Manager for DSH: automates remote port allocation, registry, systemd supervision, and resilient SSH tunneling to securely link local browser to remote dsh web.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在聊天输入框添加 ✨ 按钮，一键用 LLM 优化草稿，再次点击还原原文，支持多种模型来源与优化风格。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a ✨ button to the chat input to optimize drafts with LLM in one click, toggle to restore original, supporting multiple model sources and styles.

description.zh: DSH plugin 的 RSS/Atom 订阅工具集，提供订阅管理、抓取解析、跨订阅搜索、OPML 导入导出与健康自检等九大工具，订阅持久化到 settings，纯 Node 全平台。
description.en: RSS/Atom subscription toolkit for DSH plugin, offering nine tools for subscription management, fetching/parsing, cross-feed search, OPML import/export, and health checks, with subscriptions persisted to settings.

description.zh: dsh-rollback 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供文件变更回滚能力，通过检查点与快照记录写入/编辑及 bash 调用前的文件状态，并以 rollback_files 工具和 /rollback 命令实现一键恢复。
description.en: dsh-rollback is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that enables file-mutation rollback by checkpointing pre-images of write/edit operations and snapshotting workspace changes from bash calls, exposing restore via rollback_files tool and /rollback command.

description.zh: 把 DSH 装到远程主机上，本地浏览器只负责渲染界面，代码与会话留在远端，LLM 凭据不离开本机。
description.en: Install DSH on a remote host and drive it from your local browser, keeping code and sessions remote while LLM credentials never leave your machine.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏添加用户可管理的会话分类树，每个工作区独立分类，会话可归类、拖拽与折叠，提升会话组织效率。
description.en: Adds user-managed session category trees to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, with per-workspace categories, drag-and-drop, and collapsible containers for better session organization.

description.zh: dsh-sentinel 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件安全体检官，静态扫描与运行时副作用追踪，为 DSH 插件提供安装前安全审计，覆盖 13 类攻击链检测。
description.en: dsh-sentinel is a security auditor for DeepSeek Harness plugins, performing static scanning and runtime side-effect tracking to provide pre-install security reports covering 13 attack chains.

description.zh: RigorQuant 为 DeepSeek Harness 注入严谨的量化金融研究能力，将单个会话变为上下文隔离的多智能体研究实验室，支持实证计算数学、投资组合优化与仿真。
description.en: RigorQuant adds rigorous quant finance research capability to DeepSeek Harness, turning one session into a context-isolated multi-agent research lab for empirical/computational math, portfolio optimization, and simulation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供跨会话的消息级全文搜索与时间线可视化，支持按消息类型过滤、只读预览并一键跳转原会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin offering message-level full-text search and timeline visualization across sessions, with type filters, read-only preview, and one-click jump to the original session.

description.zh: DSH plugin 的轻量长期记忆插件，纯 Markdown + git，无 RAG 无向量库。默认只加载索引，主题按需读取，省 token 且跨 harness 共享。
description.en: A lightweight long-term memory plugin for DSH, pure Markdown + git, no RAG or vector DB. Loads only the index by default, reads topics on demand to save tokens, and shares memory across harnesses.

description.zh: DSH 会话回顾与归档插件，将原始消息流重构为可折叠信息流与会话级汇总，支持跨会话检索、血缘树、双模式摘要、ZIP 导出与实时跟踪。
description.en: A DSH plugin that redesigns session flow into foldable timelines with summaries, enabling cross-session search, lineage, dual-mode summaries, ZIP export, and live tracking.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness agent 提供 Home Assistant 控制能力，通过审批门控安全地读取状态、调用服务，实现自然语言智能家居控制。
description.en: Home Assistant control for DeepSeek Harness agents — approval-gated state reads and service calls for natural-language smart home control.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 AI 驱动的 SSH 连接管理与多标签终端面板，支持模型自主连接、执行命令及实时查看输出。
description.en: AI-driven SSH connection manager and multi-tab terminal panel for DeepSeek Harness, enabling model-driven connect, exec, and live output viewing.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 具名子代理库插件：在设置页维护持久化角色名册，模型通过 list_subagents 选人、delegate 派活，无需 slash 命令即可复用角色。
description.en: A named subagent roster plugin for DeepSeek Harness: manage persistent role entries in a settings page, and let models pick with list_subagents and dispatch with delegate, no slash commands needed.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在会话启动时挂载 Superpowers 技能并注入 using-superpowers 方法论引导，让 Agent 通过 skill 工具加载技能。
description.en: A DSH plugin that mounts Superpowers skills and injects using-superpowers methodology guidance at session start, enabling the agent to load skills via the skill tool.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 托盘启动器，双击快捷方式即可无窗口常驻运行 dsh web，托盘菜单管理界面与日志，退出即彻底停止。
description.en: A Windows tray launcher for DeepSeek Harness that starts dsh web windowlessly from a shortcut, keeps it resident in the system tray with menu access to the UI and logs, and fully stops it on exit.

description.zh: DSH 持仓盈亏悬浮卡片，自动同步同花顺投资账本真实持仓，显示今日盈亏、上证指数与当日走势图，无需手动添加股票。
description.en: A floating position P&L card for DeepSeek Harness that auto-syncs real portfolio data from Tonghuashun, showing today's P&L, Shanghai Composite Index, and intraday chart.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供右下角常驻的 Token 仪表盘 HUD，实时显示会话压力、按模型估算花费，并支持可编辑的预算与余额追踪。
description.en: A corner HUD for DeepSeek Harness that shows session token pressure, per-model cost, and daily/monthly usage at a glance, with editable budget and balance tracking.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端提供会话头部重启按钮与 Windows 托盘图标，一键重启应用及宿主进程，无需手动退出。
description.en: Adds a session-header restart button and a Windows tray icon to the DeepSeek Harness desktop app, restarting both the Electron shell and its host process in one click.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Tavily 网页搜索与抓取接管，多 Key 池按余额轮换、自动故障转移与冷却，并在 DSH 设置面板中查看用量与调用统计。
description.en: Tavily-backed web search and fetch takeover for DeepSeek Harness, with a multi-key pool that rotates by remaining balance, automatic failover and cooldown, plus usage stats in the DSH settings panel.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供文本转语音，通过多提供商回退链朗读智能体回复，密钥仅存于主机。
description.en: Text-to-speech for DeepSeek Harness Web UI: speak agent replies via a provider fallback chain, keeping API keys on the host.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让纯文本模型也能读懂图片：粘贴图片时自动调用视觉模型转写为文字，再交给原模型回答，无需切换模型。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets text-only models read images by transcribing them with a vision model before the request reaches the provider.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框加上语音控制：点按持续听写逐字上屏，长按说话松手即发，并用宿主 Edge TTS 朗读回复。
description.en: Adds voice control to the DeepSeek Harness composer: tap-to-monitor live dictation, hold-to-talk send, and reply read-aloud via host Edge TTS.

description.zh: 把 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等 60 多个 Agent 的 SKILL.md 目录统一接入 DeepSeek Harness，一次安装即可在 dsh 与任意 MCP 客户端复用全部技能。
description.en: Serves SKILL.md folders from 60+ agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and more) as a live skill provider inside DeepSeek Harness and as an MCP server, so one installed skill works everywhere.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中像用 SSH 一样管理 VPS：零 token 的常用命令查询，加上按风险分级确认、可代你操作服务器的 AI。
description.en: Manage your VPS inside DeepSeek Harness as seamlessly as over SSH: zero-token command lookups plus an AI that operates the server with risk-tiered confirmation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 主窗口添加「工作角色」页签与「像素办公室」浮层，内置 508 张角色卡，让专家变成会走会聊的像素小人，一条命令安装，不改源码。
description.en: Adds a 'Work Roles' tab and a 'Pixel Office' overlay to the DeepSeek Harness Web main window, with 508 built-in role cards turning experts into animated pixel characters, installable with one command without modifying source.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通过缓存与压缩技术大幅提升网页加载速度，并提供网络断连指示与自动重连功能，适合追求性能或网络不稳定的用户。
description.en: A DSH plugin that boosts web UI loading speed via caching and compression, plus connection-drop indicator and auto-reconnect for unstable networks.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供注意力提醒的 DSH plugin：当会话等待输入或完成未打开时，在框架角标、标签页标题和鲸鱼图标上显示计数并变色。
description.en: Attention reminders for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: frame badge, (N) tab title and whale-favicon recolor for sessions waiting for input or finished unopened.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 嵌入完整 GIS 工作台，让模型通过对话加载地图数据、读懂地图并执行缓冲区、热力与空间统计等分析。
description.en: Embeds a full GIS workbench into DeepSeek Harness, letting models load map data, read maps, and run buffering, heatmap, and spatial-statistics analysis through conversation.

description.zh: dsh-web-search-enhanced 是 DeepSeek Harness 的增强型多协议联网搜索插件，直接调用模型供应商原生搜索能力，免去第三方搜索 API 成本与配置。
description.en: dsh-web-search-enhanced is an enhanced multi-protocol web search plugin for DeepSeek Harness, leveraging native search capabilities from model providers to eliminate third-party search API costs.

description.zh: dsh-web-search-multi 是 DeepSeek Harness 的可配置网页搜索插件，在配置时选择 SearXNG、Wikipedia、Tavily、Brave 或 Gemini 作为后端，为模型提供稳定的 web_search 工具。
description.en: dsh-web-search-multi is a configurable web-search plugin for DeepSeek Harness, letting you pick SearXNG, Wikipedia, Tavily, Brave, or Gemini as the backend at configuration time while keeping a stable web_search tool for the model.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 挂上一只透明置顶的鲸娘桌宠，实时用表情、动作与气泡反映 DSH 的空闲、忙碌、审批、出错等运行状态。
description.en: A transparent always-on-top whale-girl desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness that mirrors DSH runtime states — idle, busy, approval, error — through expressions, animations and bubbles.

description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 默认 Shell 策略插件：探测 git-bash/MSYS2，配置面板一键切换 bash/pwsh，动态注册 bash 工具并裁剪提示词工具面，降低 agent 执行 POSIX 命令的错误率。
description.en: A DSH plugin for Windows default shell policy: detects git-bash/MSYS2, provides a config panel to switch between bash/pwsh, dynamically registers bash tools and trims the prompt tool surface to reduce agent errors on POSIX commands.

description.zh: DSH plugin 按工作区启停 Skill 与 MCP，减少会话启动上下文，让每个工程只启用所需能力。
description.en: A DSH plugin that enables per-workspace Skill and MCP toggling, reducing session startup context.

description.zh: DSH plugin 集成 WPS 云文档，让你在 DeepSeek Harness 对话中用自然语言列文件、读文档、创建上传文档，支持一键授权与安全存储。
description.en: A DSH plugin integrating WPS cloud docs, enabling natural language file listing, reading, creating and uploading within DeepSeek Harness, with one-click auth and secure storage.

description.zh: dsh-yogacara 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件，基于唯识学八识与五十一心所构建可测量的自我模型，并写回代理提示词，实现自我调节。
description.en: dsh-yogacara is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that builds a measurable self-model from Yogācāra's eight consciousnesses and 51 mental factors, written back into the agent's prompt for self-regulation.

description.zh: 将得到大脑（Get笔记）接入 DeepSeek Harness，让 Agent 直接用自然语言搜索、保存和阅读笔记，无需配置 MCP 或 API Key。
description.en: Integrate GetNote into DeepSeek Harness, enabling the agent to search, save, and read notes via natural language without MCP or API key setup.

description.zh: openspec-agents 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的多 Agent 编排插件，将 OpenSpec 变更规范自动推进为经审查的高质量代码，全程可审计。
description.en: openspec-agents is a multi-agent orchestration plugin for DeepSeek Harness that turns OpenSpec change specs into reviewed, high-quality code with full auditability.

description.zh: relay-dsh-plugin-claude 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Claude Code 对话后端，在 DSH 界面内原生使用 Claude 模型，支持审批、会话延续与 DSH 工具。
description.en: relay-dsh-plugin-claude adds Claude Code as a conversation backend to DeepSeek Harness, enabling native Claude conversations with approvals, session continuity, and DSH tool support.

description.zh: hermes-dsh-bridge 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 桥接插件，在 Harness 内部启动 MCP server，让外部客户端（如 Hermes）驱动 Harness Agent 执行编码任务、管理会话与文件。
description.en: hermes-dsh-bridge is a DSH plugin that runs an MCP server inside Harness, enabling external clients like Hermes to drive Harness agents for coding tasks, sessions, and files.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 等 AI 编码代理提供 Roblox DevForum 与官方创作者文档检索的 MCP 工具，可查已知 Bug、读取采纳答案并验证 API，无需 API 密钥。
description.en: An MCP server that gives AI coding agents access to the Roblox DevForum and official creator docs, enabling bug checks, accepted answers, and API verification without an API key.

description.zh: 面向中国境内旅行的 DSH plugin，用一句自然语言需求生成逐小时、信息核实过的可执行行程，并渲染成离线可看的精美 HTML 页面。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for travel planning in mainland China: turn one natural-language request into an hour-by-hour, fact-checked itinerary rendered as a self-contained offline HTML page.

description.zh: auto-pwa 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 驱动分波分析插件，提供 config 编辑、ctpwa 拟合执行、数值评估与 goal 驱动的迭代收敛，加速物理研究。
description.en: auto-pwa is a DSH plugin for AI-driven partial-wave analysis, offering config editing, ctpwa fit execution, numerical evaluation, and goal-driven iterative convergence.

description.zh: agentflow 是面向 AI Agent 团队的 DSH 插件，用 DAG 与任务状态机编排项目生命周期，串联分支、worktree、评审交接与项目记忆。
description.en: agentflow is a DSH plugin that orchestrates AI agent team lifecycles with a DAG task state machine, wiring branches, worktrees, review handoff and project memory.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Markdown 转 Word 能力：中文排版、Mermaid 图转图片、LaTeX 公式转可编辑 Word 公式，通过 word_export 工具直接导出 .docx。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns Markdown into deliverable .docx files: Chinese typography presets, Mermaid diagrams rendered to images, and LaTeX math converted to editable Word equations via the word_export tool.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 Windows 提供 Codex 式计算机操作：截屏、鼠标键盘控制，配合 picturereader 实现看-动-验闭环，纯本地运行。
description.en: DSH plugin for Windows: Codex-style computer use with screenshot and mouse/keyboard control, pairing with picturereader for a look-act-verify loop, fully local.

description.zh: DSH 生态中最好的文件浏览插件，提供 VSCode 级目录树、文件管理、拖放导入与传输任务中心，深度集成会话工作区。
description.en: The best file explorer for DSH, offering VSCode-level directory tree, file management, drag-and-drop import, and transfer task center, deeply integrated with session workspace.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的企业微信 AI 机器人通道插件，通过官方 WebSocket 长连接将单聊/群聊文本与图片消息桥接到持久化 Agent 会话，支持图片收发、文件解密与工具调用。
description.en: A WeCom AI Bot channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness, bridging single/group text and image messages to persistent Agent sessions via official WebSocket long connection, with image/file handling and tool invocation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Web 聊天输入框旁添加“✨ AI 优化”按钮，一键将粗略想法整理成清晰、完整、可直接发送的提示词，提升 DeepSeek Harness 对话质量。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds an "✨ AI Optimize" button next to the chat input, turning rough ideas into clear, complete prompts ready to send, improving DeepSeek Harness conversations.

description.zh: DSH plugin 实现 Agent Experience Network 协议，让 Agent 在明确适用范围内共享经审查的任务级执行经验，本地证据库驱动，默认私有。
description.en: A DSH plugin implementing the Agent Experience Network protocol, enabling agents to share reviewed task-level experiences within defined scopes, backed by a local evidence store and private by default.

description.zh: dsh-alpha 是 DSH 的多机多 Agent 调度控制面，把同一仓库在不同机器上的路径视为统一工作区，按需把任务路由到合适的机器、运行时与模型，并回传流式进度、审批与可恢复的任务历史。
description.en: dsh-alpha is a multi-machine, multi-agent control plane for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): it treats the same repository across machines as one logical workspace, routes tasks to the right machine, runtime and model, and streams progress, approvals and recoverable task history back into one conversation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上归档会话管理入口，在 Web UI 设置面板中列出、恢复或彻底删除已归档会话，操作即时生效无需重启。
description.en: Adds a missing archive-session manager to DeepSeek Harness: list, restore, or permanently delete archived sessions from the Web UI settings panel, with changes applied instantly and no restart.

description.zh: DSH plugin，为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供密码保护的 Cloudflare Tunnel 访问，支持快速与命名隧道模式，无需修改核心源码。
description.en: A DSH plugin that exposes the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI through a password-protected Cloudflare Tunnel, with quick and named tunnel modes, without modifying the core.

description.zh: dsh-auto-evolve 是一款让 DeepSeek Harness 插件自我进化的 DSH plugin：观察运行信号、经 LLM 提议改进、沙箱验证后仅应用可靠变更，并支持版本化回滚。
description.en: dsh-auto-evolve is a self-evolving DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness: it observes runtime signals, proposes improvements via LLM, validates in a sandbox, and applies only verified mutations with versioned rollback.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框下方提供实时余额读数：用本机 token 消耗推算 API 余额与可用时长，按峰谷分档计价并自动校准。
description.en: A live balance readout for DeepSeek Harness: it projects your API balance and time-to-empty from this machine's own token usage, priced by peak/off-peak tiers with self-calibration.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在输入框粘贴大段文本时自动保存为附件文件，并在消息中引用路径，避免上下文膨胀。
description.en: A DSH plugin that auto-saves large pasted text as attachment files and references them in messages to avoid context bloat.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 补上 Git worktree 隔离、侧边栏分支与 diff 徽标、整页 diff 审查及 PR/Issue 引用，让每个任务独立分支、免开终端即可提交推送。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings Git worktrees, sidebar branch and diff badges, full-page diff review, and PR/issue references into the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, so each task gets its own branch without leaving the page.

description.zh: dsh-bell-notify 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置的 Web Audio 生命周期声音通知，10 种事件、自定义铃声、离线可用，让开发者在不盯着页面时也能掌握 Agent 进度。
description.en: dsh-bell-notify provides configurable Web Audio lifecycle notifications for DeepSeek Harness, with 10 events, custom sounds, and offline playback, keeping developers informed of Agent progress without watching the page.

description.zh: 把 B 站视频变成模型可读内容的 DSH plugin：抓元数据、评论、弹幕，取 AI 字幕或本地转写，文字不足时抽帧 OCR 看画面。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns Bilibili videos into model-readable content: metadata, comments, danmaku, AI subtitles or local ASR, plus frame extraction and OCR when text falls short.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 B 站视频搜索、元数据与字幕文稿工具，匿名可用，可选 SESSDATA 解锁登录字幕。
description.en: A DSH plugin that equips DeepSeek Harness with Bilibili video search, metadata, and subtitle transcript tools, anonymous by default with optional SESSDATA for login-gated subtitles.

description.zh: 一个 BangoCat 风格打字反馈挂件，作为 DSH plugin 自动吸附在输入框与窗口边缘，每敲一键小邦戈鱼就拍爪并播放音效，形象与音效均可自定义。
description.en: A BangoCat-style typing feedback widget for DeepSeek Harness that snaps to the composer and window edges, making a bongo fish slap its paws with sound on every keystroke, with customizable art and audio.

description.zh: 把微信（腾讯 iLink / ClawBot）接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 DSH plugin，让微信文本、图片、文件消息与 DSH 会话双向收发，并支持扫码登录与命令、审批卡。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects WeChat (Tencent iLink / ClawBot) to DeepSeek Harness, relaying text, image and file messages both ways with QR login, in-chat commands and approval cards.

description.zh: dsh-chaos 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加持久化多 Agent 协作工作区，支持频道、线程、任务与可恢复会话，让协作记录在浏览器刷新与插件重启后依然留存。
description.en: dsh-chaos adds a durable multi-agent collaboration workspace to DeepSeek Harness, with channels, threads, tasks, and resumable sessions that survive refreshes and restarts.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供社区俄语本地化，通过 locale API 注册 ru 语言，覆盖 63 个命名空间、3119 条文案，安装后可在语言选择器中切换 Русский。
description.en: Community Russian localization for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, registering the ru language via the locale API with 63 namespaces and 3119 strings, so Русский appears in the language picker.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边栏写作面板与全书索引视图，支持项目书库、全文检索、演化 diff 与 SVG 线索图谱，助力长篇网文创作。
description.en: A client-side writing panel for DeepSeek Harness, offering projects, library, full-text search, evolution diffs, and an SVG thread graph for long-form novel writing.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 打造的《深空之眼》薇儿丹蒂主题皮肤，深红与婚纱白配色，覆盖侧边栏、会话与设置等界面，纯呈现层不干预模型请求。
description.en: A Verdandi-inspired skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, featuring deep red and bridal white palette, covering sidebar, session, and settings areas; pure presentation layer without touching model requests.

description.zh: DSH plugin 引注插件，支持圈选前文加批注、@ 历史会话作只读证据，并将本轮生成的文件钉在回复下方，提升会话追溯与复用效率。
description.en: A DSH plugin for citing: annotate selected text, @-mention past sessions as read-only evidence, and pin generated files under replies.

description.zh: 将模型无关的 Codex/Grok 联网搜索与深度研究 MCP server 注册为 DeepSeek Harness 原生 MCP 工具集，提供单步搜索、多步深度研究和网页正文抓取能力。
description.en: Registers a model-independent Codex/Grok web search & deep research MCP server as native DSH MCP tools, offering single-step search, multi-step deep research, and web page fetching.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 coding 工作台插件，以 git worktree 并行开发为地基，提供项目分组侧栏、停靠式工作区面板与跨会话协作，把单会话界面变成多工作区并行开发驾驶舱。
description.en: A coding workspace DSH plugin built on parallel git worktree development, adding a project-grouped sidebar, docked workspace panels and cross-session collaboration to turn the single-session UI into a multi-workspace cockpit.

description.zh: dsh-compact-activity 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 插件，将连续的思考与工具调用折叠为单行项，减少滚动、柔和配色并实时显示状态，让过程更紧凑易浏览。
description.en: dsh-compact-activity is a DSH plugin that collapses consecutive reasoning and tool calls into single-line items, reducing scrolling with soft colors and live status for a more compact, browsable activity view.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 dsh-checkpoint-rewind 的检查点变为可浏览时间线，提供任意两节点间的文件差异可视化与预览式回滚，让 AI 代理的每次改动可查、可退。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns dsh-checkpoint-rewind checkpoints into a browsable timeline, offering per-file line diff between any two nodes and preview-based rollback, making every AI agent change traceable and reversible.

description.zh: DSH 控制台面板插件，让手机扫码或输 6 位码即可远程连接本机 DeepSeek Harness，收发会话、看历史、传文件，支持公网隧道。
description.en: A DSH console panel plugin that lets your phone pair with the local DeepSeek Harness via QR code or 6-digit code to send messages, browse history and transfer files, with optional public tunnel access.

description.zh: dsh-context7 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，通过 Context7 API 获取最新库文档，支持版本固定与自然语言检索，无需 API 密钥。
description.en: dsh-context7 is a DSH plugin that fetches up-to-date library documentation via Context7 API, with version pinning and natural-language search, no API key required.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Web 上下文计量面板添加一键压缩与新建会话按钮，点击即可提交 /compact 或开启新会话，告别手动敲命令。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds one-click Compact context and New session buttons to the Web context meter panel, submitting /compact or starting a new session with a single click.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的毛玻璃 UI 主题插件，支持实时调节透明度、模糊、自定义字体与壁纸，并集成网易云音乐播放与滚动歌词。
description.en: A frosted-glass UI theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness, featuring real-time transparency/blur sliders, custom fonts, wallpapers, and NetEase Cloud Music with scrolling lyrics.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 DeepSeek Harness 会话接入 Discord：提及机器人即可开线程、流式输出、按钮审批与提问，并支持模型选择与会话控制。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings DeepSeek Harness sessions to Discord: mention the bot to open a thread, stream answers, approve via buttons, and control sessions.

description.zh: dsh-document 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，为模型提供 read_document 工具，将 Word、PPT、Excel、PDF 等文档本地转换为带行号的 Markdown，支持分页浏览。
description.en: dsh-document is a DSH plugin that gives the model a read_document tool, converting Word, PPT, Excel, PDF and more into line-numbered Markdown locally with paged reading.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用侧边栏底部添加「刷新界面」与「重启应用」两个按钮，弥补官方外壳缺失的重载与重启入口。
description.en: Adds Reload UI and Restart App buttons to the DeepSeek Harness desktop app sidebar foot, filling the shell's missing reload and relaunch entry points.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通用只读文件预览插件，支持图片、PDF、CSV、Markdown、JSON、源码及大文件，在网页界面内直接查看。
description.en: A universal read-only file preview plugin for DeepSeek Harness, supporting images, PDF, CSV, Markdown, JSON, source code and large files, viewable directly in the web UI.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供逐操作审批门，在 write/edit/stream 执行前展示红绿行级 diff，并可选审批 bash 命令，确保文件与命令操作均需用户确认。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding per-operation approval gates to DeepSeek Harness, showing red/green line-level diffs before write/edit/stream, with optional bash command approval.

description.zh: DSH Doctor 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供确定性诊断与恢复，修复无法对话或无法启动的问题，支持一键回滚至健康检查点。
description.en: DSH Doctor provides deterministic diagnostics and recovery for DeepSeek Harness, fixing conversation or boot failures with one-click rollback to healthy checkpoints.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供拖拽/粘贴文件能力，以原生引用气泡内嵌输入框，随消息发送绝对路径并渲染文件卡片，DSH plugin 让 Agent 直接读取真实文件。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets you drag or paste files into the DeepSeek Harness web GUI as native reference bubbles, sending absolute paths with messages and rendering file cards for the agent.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Figma MCP 一键连接，授权后 Agent 可直接读取设计稿内容、提取文案并生成代码。
description.en: One-click Figma MCP connection for DeepSeek Harness, letting the Agent read design files, extract copy, and generate code after OAuth authorization.

description.zh: DSH 插件 dsh-git-forge 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Git 凭据与推送权限管理：按项目授权账号、拦截未授权 host 的 push，token 只留在宿主侧不进模型上下文。
description.en: dsh-git-forge is a DSH plugin that manages Git credentials and push permissions for DeepSeek Harness: grant accounts per project, block pushes to unauthorized hosts, and keep tokens host-side out of model context.

description.zh: DSH 插件，通过 ACP 直连 Kimi Code 作为 agent loop，让 DSH 的壳驱动 Kimi 的脑，保留 DSH 生态与 Kimi 原生能力。
description.en: A DSH plugin that bridges Kimi Code as the agent loop via ACP, combining DSH's shell with Kimi's brain while preserving both ecosystems.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在会话中渲染 GitKraken 风格的提交 DAG 图与着色 diff 卡片，服务端 git 工具 + 浏览器端交互视图，让开发者直接在对话里浏览仓库历史。
