description.en: A DSH plugin that renders GitKraken-style commit DAG and colored diff cards in conversation, with server-side git tools and interactive browser views for exploring repo history.

description.zh: DSH plugin 集成 Gitea/Forgejo，为 AI 智能体提供 20+ 工具，覆盖 issue、PR、CI、release 与分支管理，并在 Web UI 显示 Git 状态芯片。
description.en: A DSH plugin bridging DeepSeek Harness to Gitea/Forgejo, offering 20+ tools for issues, PRs, CI, releases, and branch management, plus a live Git status chip in the Web UI.

description.zh: dsh-github-skills 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来 Skill-first 的 GitHub 工作流：PR 分流、Review 反馈处理、CI 诊断与安全发布，让 Agent 正确、安全地组织 GitHub 能力。
description.en: dsh-github-skills brings Skill-first GitHub workflows to DeepSeek Harness: PR triage, review feedback, CI diagnosis, and safe publishing, enabling agents to organize GitHub capabilities correctly and safely.

description.zh: DSH plugin 事件驱动的任务守护引擎，通过断言规则、纠正检测与编辑审查队列，实时监控会话并注入提醒，守护任务质量。
description.en: Event-driven mission guardian for DeepSeek Harness: assertion rules, correction detection, and review queue with live reminders.

description.zh: dsh-hindsight 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Hindsight 的跨会话记忆，通过斜杠命令和模型工具实现记忆的召回、保存与图谱遍历。
description.en: dsh-hindsight brings Hindsight-backed cross-session memory to DeepSeek Harness, enabling recall, save, and graph traversal via slash commands and agent tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中不具备作图能力的模型接上外部生图服务，注册 image_generate 与 image_edit 两个工具，支持多服务商、主备模型自动切换，全部在 Web 界面配置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that bridges image-less models to external OpenAI-compatible image services, registering image_generate and image_edit tools with multi-provider support and automatic primary/backup model failover, all configured in the web UI.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 GitHub 工作台嵌入侧边栏，提供仓库目录树、Issues/PR/Actions 页签，支持建 Issue、发 PR、评论、合并与重跑 CI，让开发操作不离开对话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that embeds a GitHub workbench into the sidebar, offering repo tree, Issues/PR/Actions tabs, and supports creating issues, PRs, commenting, merging, and re-running CI.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将腾讯 IMA 知识库问答注册为原生 ima_ask 工具，支持按语义检索并返回引用资料，补足官方 skill 仅靠标题关键字搜索的局限。
description.en: A DSH plugin that registers Tencent IMA knowledge base Q&A as a native ima_ask tool, enabling semantic retrieval with citations, overcoming the title-keyword-only search limitation of the official skill.

description.zh: DSH plugin：输入框点一下 ✦ 就把草稿改写成 Agent 能直接执行的提示词，支持一键撤回，并用保真闸与长度闸确保硬事实零丢失、不膨胀。
description.en: A DSH plugin that rewrites your draft into an agent-ready prompt with one ✦ click, with one-click undo plus fidelity and length gates that keep hard facts intact and prevent bloat.

description.zh: dsh-kit 为 DeepSeek Harness 浏览器界面加装终端坞、文件树、源代码管理、后台任务、技能管理与手机访问等页面能力，每项独立可选，全部关闭即还原原版。
description.en: dsh-kit adds optional page capabilities to the DeepSeek Harness browser UI: terminal dock, file tree, source control, background jobs, skill pool, and phone access, each independent and optional.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在会话停止工作（等待交互、出错、完成、阻塞、退避、停滞或进程死亡）时，通过 lark-cli 实时发送飞书/Lark 通知，确保每次停止都必达。
description.en: A DSH plugin that sends real-time Feishu/Lark notifications via lark-cli whenever a session stops working—waiting for input, error, completion, blocked, backoff, stalled, or process death—ensuring every stop is notified.

description.zh: dsh-later 是 DSH 会话内定时提醒插件，用 /schedule、/later 或定时面板设定时间，到点由服务端准时送达消息，关掉网页、换设备也不丢。
description.en: dsh-later is a DSH plugin for in-session scheduled reminders: set a time via /schedule, /later or the schedule panel, and the server delivers the message on time even if you close the page or switch devices.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接入飞书/Lark 的双向桥接插件：扫码建应用即可私聊群聊对话、点卡片切模式、回审批跑任务，并支持全程本机离线语音转写。
description.en: A Feishu/Lark bridge plugin for DeepSeek Harness: scan to create an app, then chat in DMs or groups, switch modes via cards, answer approvals and run tasks, with fully local offline voice transcription.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 LLM-as-a-Verifier 细粒度概率化验证工具，支持候选比较、N选一锦标赛与逐步进度追踪，提升智能体自我评估能力。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings LLM-as-a-Verifier fine-grained probabilistic verification to DeepSeek Harness, enabling candidate comparison, tournament selection, and step-by-step progress tracking.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接使用 Kimi Code 会员订阅，支持 OAuth 登录、额度显示与订阅模型路由，无需按量计费密钥。
description.en: A DSH plugin to use Kimi Code subscription in DeepSeek Harness with OAuth login, quota display, and subscription model routing, no pay-as-you-go keys needed.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为对话 Markdown 提供 4 套内置主题与用户自定义主题，浅深双档跟随系统切换，并支持版本回滚。
description.en: A DSH plugin that themes conversation Markdown with 4 built-in themes and user-defined themes, light/dark modes with system switching, plus version rollback.

description.zh: DSH Uni Editor 将 MCP Apps 编辑器统一接入 DeepSeek Harness 对话，保留编辑器自身 UI 与工具，实现人机编辑的可验证交接。
description.en: DSH Uni Editor brings MCP Apps editors into DeepSeek Harness chat, preserving their UI and tools with verifiable human-agent handoff.

description.zh: dsh-map-tools 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供驾车/公交/步行/骑行路线规划、地理编码与 POI 搜索等 7 个原生地图工具，模型可直接调用，无需 MCP 服务器。
description.en: dsh-map-tools provides DeepSeek Harness with 7 native map tools for driving/transit/walking/cycling route planning, geocoding, and POI search, directly callable by the model without MCP.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 用户消息气泡接入宿主 Markdown 管线，让发出的标题、列表、代码、表格与公式按格式渲染，引用 chip 与操作条原样保留。
description.en: Renders your own DeepSeek Harness chat bubbles through the host Markdown pipeline, so headings, lists, code, tables and math display properly while reference chips and the action strip stay intact.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化、可搜索的项目记忆：决策、规则与会话上下文存入 DuckDB，规则注入每次模型请求，并提供 Web 管理界面。
description.en: Persistent, searchable per-project memory for DeepSeek Harness: decisions, rules, and session context in DuckDB, with rules injected into every model request and a full management UI.

description.zh: dsh-meter 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供分时电价计量表，在输入框下方实时显示会话成本、当前费率与切换倒计时，并支持悬停查看费率时钟、缓存经济学与账户余额。
description.en: dsh-meter is a time-of-use cost meter for DeepSeek Harness, showing session cost, current tariff, and countdown under the composer, with hover details on tariff clock, cache economics, and balance.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供两级模型熔断与故障转移，当模型或提供商连续失败时自动路由到备用模型，提升稳定性。
description.en: Two-level model circuit breaker with failover for DeepSeek Harness: trips a model or provider after repeated failures and routes to a fallback.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为自定义供应商模型自动预填上下文长度、输出上限、显示名与输入模态等元数据，数据源自 models.dev，且不覆盖手动设置。
description.en: DSH plugin auto-fills metadata (context window, max tokens, display name, input modalities) for custom-provider models from models.dev, without overwriting manual settings.

description.zh: 把手机变成 DeepSeek Harness 的极简遥控器：移动端只显示你发出的指令与 AI 最终结论，工具调用、文件读写与思考过程全部留在电脑上。
description.en: Turns your phone into a minimal remote for DeepSeek Harness: mobile shows only your prompts and the final answer, while tool calls, file edits and reasoning stay on the desktop.

description.zh: DSH plugin 的 IM 渠道桥，将微信、QQ、飞书消息接入 agent 会话，支持主动推送与远程审批监控。
description.en: DSH plugin IM channel bridge connecting WeChat, QQ, and Feishu to agent sessions, with proactive push and remote approval monitoring.

description.zh: 通过官方 Notion MCP 服务器，以 OAuth 2.0 + PKCE 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 Notion，实现搜索、读写页面、数据库与评论。
description.en: Connect DeepSeek Harness to Notion via the official Notion MCP with OAuth 2.0 + PKCE, enabling search, read, and write of pages, databases, and comments.

description.zh: DSH 通知插件，在任务完成、出错、运行中、等待审批或回答时提醒用户，支持系统通知与自定义桌面浮窗，点击可跳转对应会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that notifies users on task completion, errors, running, awaiting approval or answer, with system notifications and custom desktop toasts that jump to the session.

description.zh: DSH plugin 界面增强插件：一键打开工作区、编辑器自动发现、DeepSeek 网页版同款用户消息导航条、会话待办标记与硬性重启，提升 DeepSeek Harness 操作效率。
description.en: A DSH plugin that enhances the DeepSeek Harness UI with one-click workspace opening, editor auto-discovery, a DeepSeek web-style user message nav bar, session todo markers, and hard restart.

description.zh: DSH 插件，将 nuphus-mcp 桌面自动化 MCP 服务器挂载为原生工具，为 Agent 提供计算机操作能力。
description.en: DSH plugin that mounts nuphus-mcp desktop automation MCP server as native tools, enabling computer use for agents.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框换上可搜索、按 provider 分组的模型选择器，并把思考档位拆成独立滑杆控件。
description.en: Replaces the DeepSeek Harness input-box model picker with a searchable, provider-grouped list and splits the thinking level into its own slider control.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 编辑器添加通用附件停靠栏，支持粘贴、拖放或选择文件，统一管理并传递本地路径给 Agent 工具。
description.en: Adds a universal attachment dock to the DeepSeek Harness Web composer, letting you paste, drop, or choose files and manage them before sending paths to your tools.

description.zh: DSH Ox-Horse Office 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web UI 插件，将多智能体会话实时渲染为像素风办公室，每个会话化身牛马员工，老板可点击互动、审批工具调用。
description.en: DSH Ox-Horse Office is a DeepSeek Harness web plugin that renders multi-agent sessions as a live pixel-art office, where each session becomes an ox/horse worker and you, the boss, can click to interact and approve tool calls.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 人设切换插件，可在会话中途只替换角色人设与语言风格，工具、技能与模型保持宿主默认不变，并支持设置页可视化管理角色库。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness persona-switching plugin that swaps only the role identity and speaking style mid-session, leaving tools, skills and model selection untouched, with a settings page for managing the role library.

description.zh: dsh-pin 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏会话添加置顶功能，支持工作区内置顶和全局置顶，多会话置顶并精确还原位置，零依赖。
description.en: dsh-pin adds pinning to DeepSeek Harness sidebar conversations, supporting workspace-level and global pinning with multi-pin and exact restore, zero dependencies.

description.zh: DSH 插件，操作本地 Obsidian 知识库，提供搜索、读写笔记、双向链接、批量整理及小说导出，支持文件直读与 Local REST API 双通道。
description.en: A DSH plugin that operates local Obsidian vaults, offering search, note read/write, backlinks, batch organization, and novel export via both file and Local REST API channels.

description.zh: dsh-phoenix 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供优雅重启、客户端自动重连与跨重启目标续跑，让插件更新不再打断运行中的任务，实现自进化循环。
description.en: dsh-phoenix brings graceful restart, client auto-reconnect, and cross-restart goal continuation to DeepSeek Harness, so plugin updates never interrupt running tasks and enable a self-evolving loop.

description.zh: AgentFlow 是 DeepSeek Harness 的可视化编排画布插件，把 LLM、MCP 与调度节点连成 DAG，一键导出为 DSH 预设，在对话中直接调用。
description.en: AgentFlow is a visual orchestration canvas for DeepSeek Harness that wires LLM, MCP and dispatcher nodes into a DAG and exports the board as a DSH preset you can pick in chat.

description.zh: DSH plugin 健康审计工具：将 GitHub dsh-plugin 主题同步为本地目录，探测 npm、静态安全扫描、评分并生成网页排行榜，帮助挑选值得安装的插件。
description.en: Health audit for DSH plugins: sync the GitHub dsh-plugin topic into a local catalog, probe npm, static-scan for security, score plugins, and rank them in a web leaderboard.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按物理像素采集的高清截屏与录屏能力，支持网页按目标尺寸光栅化，并随插件自动安装 capture-sharp 技能。
description.en: A DSH plugin that captures native-pixel screenshots and high-frame-rate screen recordings, rasterizes web pages to a target width, and auto-installs the capture-sharp skill.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在停止回复后，将上一条用户消息回填到输入框，支持直接编辑重发，免去重新输入的麻烦。
description.en: A DSH plugin that restores the last user message into the composer after stopping a turn, letting you edit and resend without retyping.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供结构化长期记忆系统，通过单元、记录和索引组织记忆，并自动注入相关摘要到上下文。
description.en: Structured long-term memory system for DeepSeek Harness, organizing memories with units, records, and index, with auto-injection of relevant briefs.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）新增 Net Access 权限模式，在保持文件写保护的同时恢复 Windows 沙箱内 curl.exe 的 HTTPS 访问。
description.en: Adds a Net Access permission mode to DeepSeek Harness (DSH), restoring HTTPS access for curl.exe inside the Windows sandbox while keeping file-write protection.

description.zh: DSH 插件，通过全局快捷键一键截取当前窗口，自动作为图片上下文挂入 DeepSeek Harness 的 Composer，让 Agent 直接分析你眼前的界面。
description.en: A DSH plugin that captures the current window via global hotkey and attaches it as image context to the DeepSeek Harness Composer, letting the Agent analyze what's on your screen.

description.zh: DSH 插件让会话无需绑定工作区即可独立存在，侧边栏平铺显示，原生工作区体验不变。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets conversations exist independently without a workspace, listing them flat in the sidebar while preserving the native workspace experience.

description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 桌面通知插件，在每轮回答结束时自动弹出系统通知，支持子代理提醒、多渠道投递与自定义文案模板。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that posts a desktop notification whenever a turn ends, with subagent alerts, auto-selected delivery channels and customizable text templates.

description.zh: DSH 远程访问插件，为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供局域网和公网隧道连接，生成带认证的访问链接，支持从其他设备控制完整 Web UI。
description.en: DSH plugin for remote access, enabling LAN and public tunnel connections to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with authenticated links for control from other devices.

description.zh: 灰度侦察是一款 DSH plugin，通过探测会话的流式思维链打分，判断你的账号被分配到哪个对话模型，命中旧模型立即中止，帮你识别灰度发布。
description.en: Rollout Scout is a DSH plugin that scores probe conversations' live chain-of-thought to detect which conversation model your account is served, aborting old-model rounds immediately.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可写、可回滚的人格自我：每轮注入人格文件，支持受限自改、日志反思与设置页人格标签。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness a writable, git-versioned self: persona files injected every turn, gated self-editing, journal-to-dream reflection, and a Settings persona tab.

description.zh: dsh-plugin-uisfx 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来语义化 UI 音效，任务开始/成功/失败、按钮点击均有对应提示，设置页可即时试听并切换 12 种音色包，支持其他插件调用。
description.en: dsh-plugin-uisfx brings semantic UI sound effects to DeepSeek Harness: task start/success/failure and button clicks get audio feedback, with instant preview in settings and 12 sound packs to switch, callable by other plugins.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在聊天流中悬挂一根皮鞭，甩动鞭梢即可向 agent 发送“go work!”消息，鞭策它干活。
description.en: A DSH plugin that hangs a whip in the chat stream; flick the tip to send the agent a "go work!" message.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Token 用量统计的 DSH plugin：按天或自定义范围查看 Token、调用次数与成本，支持模型筛选、可配置定价与年度热力图。
description.en: A DSH plugin that tracks token usage for DeepSeek Harness: daily or custom-range views of tokens, call counts and cost, with model filters, configurable pricing and a yearly heatmap.

description.zh: DSH plugin 用量仪表：在输入框下实时显示 token 用量、费用与余额，提供按模型堆叠柱状图、预算提醒和跨会话账本。
description.en: A DSH plugin usage meter: real-time token usage, cost and balance under the input box, with per-model stacked bar charts, budget alerts, and cross-session ledger.

description.zh: 为 Obsidian wiki 知识库提供原生 DeepSeek Harness 工具，实现查询、写入、健康检查等机械核心，让模型专注内容综合。
description.en: Native DeepSeek Harness tools for an Obsidian wiki vault, implementing query, write, and lint mechanics so the model focuses on synthesis.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 claude-obsidian 知识库技能（wiki、wiki-ingest、wiki-query、wiki-lint、save）打包为只读技能提供者，支持知识库搭建、摄取、查询与维护。
description.en: A DSH plugin bundling claude-obsidian-derived knowledge-suite skills (wiki, wiki-ingest, wiki-query, wiki-lint, save) as a read-only provider for vault setup, ingestion, query, and maintenance.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供经典 25/5/15 番茄钟，可关联会话任务，自带全年热力图统计与 CSV 导出。
description.en: A Pomodoro timer DSH plugin with classic 25/5/15 cycles, session-task linking, a year heatmap stats panel, and CSV export.

description.zh: DSH PPT 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 插件，一句话生成原生可编辑 PPTX，支持智能排版、自动图表与 AI 视觉审稿，让 PPT 制作回归内容本身。
description.en: DSH PPT is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that generates natively editable PPTX from a single sentence, with smart layout, auto charts, and AI visual review.

description.zh: Prompt Vault 是 DeepSeek Harness 的提示词库插件，在输入框上方提供 📚 面板，点条目即可一键填入或追加 prompt，支持编辑、搜索与本地持久化。
description.en: Prompt Vault is a DSH plugin that adds a prompt library above the input box, letting you fill prompts with one click, plus edit, search, and local persistence.

description.zh: dsh-pulse 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话用量与成本监控仪表盘，展示趋势热力图、模型分时定价、官方余额及对账，全部在 UI 层运行，零 token 消耗。
description.en: dsh-pulse is a DSH plugin offering a cross-session usage and cost observatory with trend/heatmap dashboards, per-model peak-hour pricing, official balance and spend reconciliation, all running on the UI plane with zero token cost.

description.zh: DSH plugin 主动限流插件，在请求发出前按提供商令牌桶控制速率，超限时排队延迟而非失败，避免上游 429 错误。
description.en: A proactive rate limiter plugin for DeepSeek Harness that controls per-provider request rate via token bucket before sending, queuing over-limit requests to avoid 429s.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 QA 编排插件：让 Agent 像真实用户一样探索应用并留存证据，再把路径导出为确定性回放场景，每次发版自动重跑。
description.en: A QA orchestration plugin for DeepSeek Harness: an agent explores your app like a real user with evidence-backed findings, then exports the explored path as a deterministic replay scenario you rerun every release.

description.zh: DSH plugin 用于回退或重编辑对话上下文，避免错误上下文干扰，支持一键回退与编辑后重新提问。
description.en: DSH plugin to recover or re-edit conversation context, preventing interference from erroneous context, with one-click rollback and re-ask after editing.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供参考文献真实性检查工具，逐条核对论文文献于 Crossref/OpenAlex/arXiv，并生成更正版引用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that verifies references against Crossref/OpenAlex/arXiv and generates corrected citations.

description.zh: dsh-role-router 是 DeepSeek Harness 的多角色模型路由插件，按 default/planner/subagent 角色自动切换模型，并附带设置卡片与 composer 摘要。
description.en: dsh-role-router is a role-based model routing plugin for DeepSeek Harness, automatically switching models per default/planner/subagent roles, with a settings card and composer summary.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让 DeepSeek Harness 会话可通过 URL 直接访问和分享，打开链接即恢复指定会话，并自动同步地址栏。
description.en: A DSH plugin that makes DeepSeek Harness sessions directly addressable and shareable via URL, restoring sessions from links and syncing the address bar.

description.zh: 像资源管理器一样管理 DSH 会话：目录树、标签、备注、回收站与导出，不改动会话文件布局。
description.en: Manage DSH sessions like a file explorer — folder tree, tags, notes, recycle bin and export, without moving session files.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话标题加上可自定义的 Emoji 状态前缀，一眼区分进行中、阻塞、待验收与已完成，并提供 /state 命令、模型工具与设置页。
description.en: Adds customizable emoji status prefixes to DeepSeek Harness session titles, so you can tell wip, blocked, review and done apart at a glance, with a /state command, a model tool and a settings panel.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话状态总览：标题栏状态条、Windows 通知与任务栏红黄绿状态点，一眼看清哪些会话在运行、等待、未读或失败。
description.en: A session status hub for DeepSeek Harness: a title-bar rail, Windows toast notifications and a red-yellow-green taskbar dot that show which Sessions are running, waiting, unread or failed.

description.zh: DSH 插件，提供 /! 单命令执行与 /terminal 交互式终端，将 shell 输出交给模型分析，灵感源自 Claude Code 的 ! 手势。
description.en: A DSH plugin bringing /! single-command execution and /terminal interactive PTY popup, delivering shell output to the model for analysis, inspired by Claude Code's ! gesture.

description.zh: dsh-sidebar-manager 是 DSH plugin，让侧栏扩展入口与会话视图标签支持折叠、排序和隐藏，设置自动保存。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets you collapse, reorder and hide the sidebar extension entries and conversation view tabs, with settings saved automatically.

description.zh: DSH 技能驾驶舱插件：一页列出本机全部技能、说明技能为何不可见、统计各技能调用次数，并支持单文件开关。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives you one cockpit page listing every skill the machine exposes, explaining why a skill is invisible, counting per-skill usage, and toggling each one by renaming its entry file.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 12 个可共享工作流技能，覆盖交接、分诊、规格、工单、路由、教学与夜间执行等场景，注册为文件系统技能提供者。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing 12 shareable workflow skills for DeepSeek Harness, covering handoffs, triage, specs, tickets, routing, teaching, and overnight execution, registered as a filesystem skill provider.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供内置 aria2 的多线程下载插件，自动探测服务器能力选择并发或 curl 回退，支持断点续传与实时进度查询。
description.en: A DSH plugin that bundles aria2 for multi-threaded downloads, probing server capability to pick parallel or curl fallback, with resume support and live progress queries.

description.zh: dsh-specflow 是 DeepSeek Harness 的规范驱动开发工具包，将想法转化为可审查的规格、计划、任务列表和可恢复的 DSH 目标，跨会话持久化工作进度。
description.en: dsh-specflow is a specification-driven development toolkit for DeepSeek Harness, turning ideas into reviewable specs, plans, task lists, and resumable DSH goals with durable progress across sessions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 AI 驱动的 SSH 连接管理与多标签终端面板，支持模型自主连接、执行命令及实时查看输出。
description.en: AI-driven SSH connection manager and multi-tab terminal panel for DeepSeek Harness, enabling model-driven connect, exec, and live output viewing.

description.zh: DSH plugin 子 Agent 派发方案化插件：按任务指定预设、模型、推理强度与工具范围，常用组合存为命名方案一键派发，内置成本护栏。
description.en: A DSH plugin that profiles subagent dispatch: pick preset, model, reasoning effort, and tool scope per subtask, save named profiles for one-click dispatch, with built-in cost guardrails.

description.zh: DSH 输入预测插件：回合结束后由辅助 LLM 预测下一条提示词，草稿为空时以幽灵文本显示在输入框，Tab 整条采纳、→ 逐词采纳，输入中则按会话历史做前缀补全。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) input-prediction plugin: after each turn an auxiliary LLM predicts your next prompt and renders it as ghost text in the empty composer, while non-empty drafts get zsh-style prefix completion from session history. Accept with Tab or word-by-word with →.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在任务完成或代理回合结束时发送原生系统通知，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux，零运行时依赖，防刷屏限流。
description.en: A DSH plugin that sends native OS notifications when tasks complete or agent turns end, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux with zero runtime dependencies and anti-spam rate limiting.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供结构化安全 Git 工具集，包含状态、差异、日志、提交等操作，并内置破坏性命令防护门。
description.en: Structured safe Git tool family for DeepSeek Harness: status, diff, log, commit, stash, etc., with a destructive-command guard.

description.zh: dsh-ui-mobile 是 DeepSeek Harness 的移动端插件，在手机宽度下提供抽屉导航、触控输入区、PWA 安装与任务完成通知，桌面布局保持不变。
description.en: dsh-ui-mobile is a mobile plugin for DeepSeek Harness, offering drawer navigation, touch-friendly input, PWA install, and task completion notifications on phones while keeping desktop layout intact.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在会话头部注册 tools 标签页，按派发顺序展示每次工具调用的名称、参数、结果与状态，帮助调试工具执行。
description.en: A DSH plugin that registers a tools tab in the conversation header, listing each tool call's name, arguments, result, and status in dispatch order for debugging.

description.zh: Tensorlake 沙箱插件将 DeepSeek Harness 的文件、子进程、Bash、终端与 LSP 操作迁移到短生命周期微VM中，提供隔离、安全的远程执行环境。
description.en: The Tensorlake sandbox plugin moves DeepSeek Harness file, subprocess, Bash, terminal, and LSP operations into short-lived microVMs, providing an isolated and secure remote execution environment.

description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 变为随身值班办公室：通过 Telegram 消息触发任务、全局审批转发、值班/本地切换，空闲零 token 消耗。
description.en: Turn DeepSeek Harness into a pocket duty office: trigger tasks via Telegram messages, forward global approvals, toggle duty/local, with zero idle token cost.

description.zh: DSH 更新器与官方文档同步插件：一键 npm 更新 DeepSeek Harness 并实时显示进度，增量同步官方文档，提供文档搜索与阅读工具。
description.en: DSH updater and official docs sync plugin: one-click npm update with live progress, incremental docs sync, and doc search/read tools.

description.zh: DSH plugin 壁纸背景插件：从本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库加载背景，用 Rust/WebGPU（wasm）在浏览器渲染 scene 壁纸，并支持视频、web 与图片壁纸回退，为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web GUI 增添动态桌面背景。
description.en: A DSH plugin that loads Wallpaper Engine wallpapers as backgrounds for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, rendering scene wallpapers via Rust/WebGPU (wasm) and supporting video, web, and image fallbacks.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供版本更新设置菜单，支持一键安装/降级、快照回滚与自动化更新策略，是 DSH plugin 的版本管理利器。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a version update menu to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, enabling one-click install/downgrade, snapshot rollback, and automated update policies.

description.zh: DSH plugin 双向同步滴答清单任务，基于官方 OAuth 2.0 API，支持拉取、创建、更新、完成、删除及去重同步。
description.en: Two-way task sync with TickTick/Dida365 for DeepSeek Harness via official OAuth 2.0 API, supporting pull, create, update, complete, delete, and dedupe sync.

description.zh: 为 DSH 网页端提供双向语音：说话即转写进输入框，回复自动朗读，麦克风持续监听。
description.en: A two-way voice DSH plugin for the web app: speak to dictate into the composer, hear replies read aloud, with the mic kept listening.

description.zh: 为 DSH 网页端提供双向语音：说话即转写进输入框，回复自动朗读，麦克风持续监听。
description.en: A two-way voice DSH plugin for the web app: speak to dictate into the composer, hear replies read aloud, with the mic kept listening.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Gemini 4 Argon，自动聚合 Vertex AI 与 Gemini API 双通道，修复 thinkingBudget 报错并打通原生三档思考与签名工具调用。
description.en: Brings Gemini 4 Argon to DeepSeek Harness via dual Vertex AI and Gemini API routes, fixing thinkingBudget errors and enabling native thinking levels with signed tool-call replay.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 AnySearch 网页搜索后端，可在插件设置卡片中一键切换官方 DeepSeek 搜索与 AnySearch，保存后下一次 web_search 立即生效。
description.en: An AnySearch-backed web search provider for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that lets you switch the web_search backend between the official DeepSeek endpoint and AnySearch from a Plugins settings card, taking effect on the next call.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 SearXNG 元搜索的网页搜索提供者，无需厂商 API Key 与账号，查询不被单一身份关联。
description.en: A web-search provider that plugs a SearXNG metasearch instance into DeepSeek Harness, requiring no vendor API key or account to tie queries together.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供网页搜索提供方插件，把内置 web_search 工具接到 OpenAI 兼容 Responses API 或智谱搜索接口，返回结构化引用来源。
description.en: A DSH plugin that backs the built-in web_search tool with OpenAI-compatible Responses API or Zhipu search backends, returning structured citation sources.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 挂上一只透明置顶的鲸娘桌宠，实时用表情、动作与气泡反映 DSH 的空闲、忙碌、审批、出错等运行状态。
description.en: A transparent always-on-top whale-girl desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness that mirrors DSH runtime states — idle, busy, approval, error — through expressions, animations and bubbles.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供可扩展的右侧 widget 面板，实时展示会话统计、用量热力图与 OpenCode Go 配额，支持多列网格与连续放大。
description.en: An extensible right-hand widget rail for DeepSeek Harness Web UI, offering live session stats, usage heatmap, and OpenCode Go quota with multi-column grids and continuous magnification.

description.zh: DSH 微信桥接插件，通过腾讯官方 iLink 协议将手机微信接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持流式回复、扫码登录、会话持久化、定时任务与网页抓取。
description.en: A DSH plugin bridging WeChat to DeepSeek Harness via Tencent's official iLink protocol, enabling streaming replies, QR login, session persistence, cron jobs, and web fetch.

description.zh: dshX 是一个基于 DeepSeek Harness 的优化版 TUI 终端编程应用，内置 prefab 预设与 j-space 技能，一条命令启动 Claude Code 风格交互。
description.en: dshX is an optimized TUI terminal coding app built on DeepSeek Harness, bundling prefab presets and j-space skills, launched with a single command for Claude Code-style interaction.

description.zh: DSH 写作三件套的 host 侧数据通道，通过 Typert remote 将项目、书库与检索数据暴露给客户端写作面板，只读数据与编排触发，写操作仍在引擎侧完成。
description.en: Host-side data channel for the DSH writing suite, exposing project, library and search data to the client writing panel via Typert remote, with read-only data and orchestration triggers while writes stay in the engine.

description.zh: 基于 maa-cli 的 DeepSeek Harness 技能，让 DSH 直接驱动 MaaCore 自动完成《明日方舟》刷关、基建、招募等日常任务。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness skill built on maa-cli that lets DSH drive MaaCore directly to automate Arknights daily routines such as stage farming, base management and recruitment.

description.zh: 把手机微信接到本机 DeepSeek Harness：微信消息经 iLink 桥驱动 DSH 原生会话执行任务，并提供设置页实时状态面板与预设切换。
description.en: Bridges your phone's WeChat to a local DeepSeek Harness: WeChat messages drive native DSH sessions through an iLink bridge, with a live status settings panel and agent-preset switching.

description.zh: Logic Probe 是 DeepSeek Harness 的声明核查插件，逐条核验设计文档与重构计划中的可验证声称，覆盖状态机、数据模型与并发风险，提供结构化证据与回归验证。
description.en: Logic Probe is a DSH plugin for claim verification, checking design docs and refactoring plans against the codebase, covering state machines, data models, and concurrency risks with structured evidence.

description.zh: MoneyPal 是面向 DSH 的个人记账插件，用自然语言查询与维护本地 Beancount 复式账本，查余额、看流水、生成报表，并在确认后完成记账。
description.en: MoneyPal is a DSH plugin for personal bookkeeping: query and maintain a local Beancount double-entry ledger in natural language, checking balances, listing transactions, generating reports, and posting entries after confirmation.

description.zh: oh-my-deepseek-harness 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多智能体编排，内置 5 个专业智能体与 4 个工作流技能，支持并行任务执行与模型预设切换。
description.en: oh-my-deepseek-harness brings multi-agent orchestration to DeepSeek Harness with 5 specialized agents and 4 workflow skills, enabling parallel task execution and runtime model preset switching.

description.zh: DSH plugin 一键 OAuth 授权接入企查查 MCP，自动刷新 token，安全持久化，对话即可管理连接。
description.en: DSH plugin for one-click OAuth connection to Qichacha MCP services, with auto token refresh and secure persistence.

description.zh: Maestro Skills 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的统一 AI 技能库，内置 31 个技能，覆盖 Govard、Magento 2、Laravel 开发与 superpowers 方法论，助力编码代理高效开发。
description.en: Maestro Skills is a unified AI skills library for DeepSeek Harness, bundling 31 skills covering Govard, Magento 2, Laravel development and the superpowers methodology to boost coding agents.

description.zh: Prompt for Me（Prompt 嘴替）为 DeepSeek Harness 编辑器提供自动幽灵建议，一键起草下一条消息，提升对话效率。
description.en: Prompt for Me provides automatic ghost suggestions and one-click next-message drafting for the DeepSeek Harness composer, boosting conversation efficiency.

description.zh: 腾讯云 ADP 的 DSH plugin，将 DeepSeek Harness 接入腾讯云 ADP，提供混元模型网关、AI 搜索、API/MCP 插件市场、技能广场及 ADP 应用调用等能力。
description.en: Tencent Cloud ADP plugin for DeepSeek Harness, connecting DSH to ADP for Hunyuan model gateway, AI search, API/MCP plugin marketplace, skill plaza, and ADP apps as tools.

description.zh: 把 Codex、Claude Code 等 Agent 的当前工作状态同步到 Discord Rich Presence，DSH plugin 通过本地服务展示会话摘要与耗时。
description.en: Syncs your active Codex, Claude Code and other agent work into Discord Rich Presence, with this DSH plugin using one local service to show session summaries and elapsed time.

description.zh: AgentDuel DSH 插件将代码对战游戏融入 DeepSeek Harness，让你编写或让 AI 编写 Agent 代码，提交对战、观看回放并持续优化，冲击排位。
description.en: AgentDuel DSH plugin brings code-battling game into DeepSeek Harness, letting you code or have AI code your agent, submit to fights, watch replays, and keep optimizing for the leaderboard.

description.zh: ArchGraph 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的架构图驱动 Agent 工程框架，通过 ARGO MCP 统一部署技能、规则与代理，实现图驱动的智能体开发。
description.en: ArchGraph is an architecture-graph driven framework for Agentic Engineering on DeepSeek Harness, deploying skills, rules, and agents via ARGO MCP.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造个性化工作台：空状态横幅、回合完成彩带庆祝、外语微学习与可执行任务板，让日常使用更愉悦高效。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns DeepSeek Harness into a personal workbench with a hero banner, confetti celebrations, Duolingo-style language micro-learning, and an executable task board.

description.zh: Coding Coach（编程教练）是面向非开发人员的DeepSeek Harness Agent预设，提供从想法到上线的八段式产品编排流水线及35个技能，全程用通俗语言引导。
description.en: Coding Coach is a DeepSeek Harness agent preset for non-developers, offering an 8-stage product pipeline and 35 skills to guide from idea to launch in plain language.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 消息通道插件，基于官方 WebSocket 实现文本、图片和文件收发，无需公网回调服务器，支持私聊与群聊。
description.en: A Feishu/Lark channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness, using official WebSocket transport to send and receive text, images, and files without a public callback server, supporting direct and group chats.

description.zh: 大肥鱼（不吃白饭版）是一款 DSH plugin，在 Windows 桌面养一只由 DeepSeek Harness 真实工作状态驱动的 Agent 宠物，可查余额、桌面答题、点按互动。
description.en: Dafeiyu (buchibaifan edition) is a DSH plugin that puts a Windows desktop pet driven by real DeepSeek Harness agent status, with balance lookup, on-desktop Q&A and click interactions.

description.zh: Claude2DSH 将 Claude Code 的会话、技能、记忆与插件资产迁移为 DSH 原生可续会话，并支持安全回写，是 DSH plugin 的多工具迁移层。
description.en: Claude2DSH migrates Claude Code conversations, skills, memory, and plugin assets into DeepSeek Harness as native resumable sessions, with safe write-back, acting as a multi-tool migration layer for DSH plugins.

description.zh: ast-mcp-server 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于真实编译器 AST 的 TypeScript/JavaScript 结构读取与受审阅编辑能力，减少上下文消耗并提升编辑正确性。
description.en: ast-mcp-server provides DeepSeek Harness with compiler-backed AST structural reads and reviewed TypeScript/JavaScript edits, reducing context usage and improving edit correctness.

description.zh: 住进 Instagram 的 DSH 助理插件：带着人格与记忆，把真实 DSH 使用数据变成 Story 与 Note，只有主人私信能指挥它。
description.en: An Instagram assistant DSH plugin with persona and memory that turns real DSH usage into Stories and Notes, controllable only by the owner's own DMs.

description.zh: dock-git 是 DSH 生态中最好的 Git 历史可视化插件，提供泳道式提交图、分支/标签徽标、三栏 diff、暂存提交推送及远端管理，将 VSCode 的 Git 面板搬进 DSH 工作台。
description.en: dock-git is the best Git history viewer for DSH, featuring swimlane commit graph, branch/tag badges, three-column diff, stage/commit/push, and remote management, bringing VSCode's Git panel into the DSH workbench.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的学术插件，接入本机 Zotero 文库与 arXiv、PubMed 等七大检索源，支持全文精读、引文导出与参考文献核验，并内置 11 个论文写作与审稿技能。
description.en: An academic DSH plugin that connects your local Zotero library with arXiv, PubMed and five other search sources, supporting full-text reading, citation export and reference verification, plus 11 built-in skills for paper writing and peer review.

description.zh: DSH 生态中最好的图片查看插件，支持 PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/BMP/SVG/ICO/AVIF 八种格式，SVG 安全渲染，为 dock-files 文件域提供 image 查看器。
description.en: The best image viewer for DSH, supporting PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/BMP/SVG/ICO/AVIF with safe SVG rendering, providing an image viewer for dock-files.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接入 QQ 官方机器人单聊，可在 QQ 里直接对话并执行编码任务，与 DSH Web UI 实时双向同屏同步、审批联动。
description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the official QQ bot C2C chat, letting you talk to the agent and run coding tasks from QQ with real-time two-way sync and shared approvals in the DSH Web UI.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让 Agent 自主调用 context_compact，将选中的对话跨度压缩为自写的检查点，保留开头与近期上下文，最小化信息丢失。
description.en: DSH plugin that lets the agent autonomously call context_compact to compress a chosen conversation span into a self-written checkpoint, preserving the opening and recent context to minimize information loss.

description.zh: DSH plugin 本地多 Agent 通信中继总线，基于 HMAC 鉴权与回环架构，实现 dsh、Codex、Claude Code 等 Agent 间的安全消息路由与协作。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing a local multi-agent relay bus with HMAC auth and loopback-first architecture, enabling secure message routing and collaboration among dsh, Codex, Claude Code, and more.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供活动会话总览窗格，集中展示并行会话、子代理层级、运行统计与等待行动提醒，帮助重度用户掌控全局。
description.en: A DSH plugin that provides an activity pane for DeepSeek Harness, centralizing running sessions, subagent hierarchies, runtime stats, and action-required alerts for heavy users.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 AgentTeams 多智能体团队补充美术系统：随包自带 17 厂商 × 10 岗位头像与厂商徽标，按成员模型路由自动匹配，支持自定义美术目录与中文岗位名。
description.en: An artwork add-on for the AgentTeams multi-agent plugin in DeepSeek Harness: ships 17 vendor × 10 role avatars and vendor brand badges, auto-matched from each member's model route, with custom artwork directory and Chinese role labels.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供常驻置顶的刘海条，实时显示哪些会话正在工作、需要你或已完成，双击即可切回主窗口。
description.en: An always-on-top notch for DeepSeek Harness that shows which sessions are working, waiting on you, or done, with double-click to bring the app forward.

description.zh: dsh-agentmemory 将 agentmemory 本地记忆服务器接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供完整 memory_* 工具集、自动捕获钩子与上下文注入，无需 MCP 桥接。
description.en: dsh-agentmemory connects the agentmemory local memory server to DeepSeek Harness, exposing the full memory_* tool set, automatic capture hooks, and context injection over the local REST server without MCP.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上轮次级编辑、重跑与删除能力，一次安装即把四个组件合成一行，让每轮对话都像 AI Studio 般可反复打磨。
description.en: Adds turn-level edit, re-run and delete to DeepSeek Harness: one install bundles four components into a single plugin row, making every turn a reworkable AI Studio-style playground.

description.zh: DSH plugin 全局无感热身层：任何会话首轮自动热身，第二轮起恢复完整模式，避免第一真实请求出现 'Let me'。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing a global frictionless warm-up layer: any session auto-warms on first turn, then resumes full mode from the second turn, preventing 'Let me' on the first real request.

description.zh: DSH 插件，导入本地 Claude、Codex、Grok、Gemini、Copilot 等登录配置，支持 OAuth 登录与 CC Switch 模型发现，并可在模型选择器中启用所需模型。
description.en: A DSH plugin that imports local login state and provider configs from Claude, Codex, Grok, Gemini, Copilot, etc., supports OAuth login and CC Switch model discovery.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加介于工作区写入与完全访问之间的自动审批权限层级，自动批准无害命令及可信区域内的操作，其余请求仍交由用户审批。
description.en: Adds a middle permission tier to DeepSeek Harness between workspace-write and full access, auto-approving harmless commands and operations in trusted areas while deferring everything else to the user.

description.zh: dsh-automation 让 DeepSeek Harness 用户用一句话调度一次性或周期性 Agent 任务，支持精确时间、RRULE 复发规则与权限控制，并在侧边栏统一管理。
description.en: dsh-automation lets DeepSeek Harness users schedule one-time or recurring Agent tasks with a single sentence, supporting precise times, RRULE recurrence, and permission control, all managed from the sidebar.

description.zh: 白泽（Baize）是一款 DeepSeek Harness 插件，在对话开始时把用户设定的全局、会话或项目级「必须做／禁止做」纯文本规则注入模型，让行为基线持久生效。
description.en: Baize is a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that injects user-defined plain-text must-do / must-not rules — global, session or project scoped — into the model at conversation start so your behavioral baseline persists.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在侧边栏底部显示所有已配置模型 Provider 的余额摘要，点击打开面板查看模型列表、密钥状态与余额明细，支持 DeepSeek 官方余额接口及自定义接口。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows balance summaries for all configured model providers in the sidebar footer, with a clickable panel for model lists, key status, and balance details, supporting DeepSeek official and custom balance APIs.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 默认模型实测 API 节点速度并推荐稳定 IP，可按需显式应用，帮助缓解节点慢与不稳定问题。
description.en: Benchmarks the API nodes of your DeepSeek Harness default model, recommends a stable IP, and applies it only on explicit request to ease slow or unstable endpoints.

description.zh: DSH 生物信息学「许愿式分析」插件：48 个语义化工具 + bio_python 执行器（Biopython 全功能、出版级绘图、代谢建模/FBA、合成生物学设计）+ 46 个 skill，零安装自举私有 Python 环境。
description.en: A DSH plugin for bioinformatics wish-coding: 48 semantic tools + bio_python executor (full Biopython, publication-grade plotting, metabolic modeling/FBA, synthetic biology design) + 46 skills, with zero-install private Python environment.

description.zh: DSH 插件，让 agent 通过 File System Access 授权读写浏览器所在机器的本地文件，经 WebSocket 中继，含非安全上下文兼容模式。
description.en: DSH plugin enabling agents to read/write local files on the browser machine via File System Access authorization, relayed over WebSocket, with non-secure-context compatibility.

description.zh: DSH Bridge 是 DeepSeek Harness 的本地会话间消息插件，支持会话发现、直接投递与状态管理，为 dsh-weave 等传输提供受控入口。
description.en: DSH Bridge is a local session-to-session messaging plugin for DeepSeek Harness, enabling session discovery, direct delivery, and state management, with a controlled inbound seam for transports like dsh-weave.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web GUI 嵌入 3D 模型库与 CAD 查看器，agent 用 CadQuery 建的模型可直接入库、在线查看并导出十种格式。
description.en: Embeds a 3D model library and full CAD viewer into the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, so CadQuery models built by the agent land in the library for online viewing and export to ten CAD, mesh and drawing formats.

description.zh: dsh-calendar 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供全局会话日历视图，聚合所有会话的交互事件，实时展示每日活跃会话、时长与事件列表。
description.en: dsh-calendar provides a whole-harness calendar surface for DeepSeek Harness, aggregating interaction events from all sessions with real-time updates and per-day session details.

description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的对话目录插件，在聊天区右缘显示目录窄条，悬停展开、点击跳转，支持搜索、收藏与大纲导出。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding a table-of-contents bar to the right edge of the chat, with hover expand, click-to-jump, search, favorites, and outline export.

description.zh: DSH plugin 画板预览插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 AI 生成网页产物的实时预览与 PNG/JPG/SVG 一键高清导出，对标 Gemini Canvas 体验。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings Gemini Canvas-style live preview and one-click high-res PNG/JPG/SVG export of AI-generated HTML artifacts to DeepSeek Harness.

description.zh: DSH plugin 对话区宽度调节插件，滑块即时调整消息列与用户气泡宽度，一键恢复默认。
description.en: A DSH plugin to adjust chat area width with sliders for message column and user bubble, instantly effective and resettable.

description.zh: ChatVoice 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供免费免 API key 的语音输入与 AI 回复朗读，基于浏览器原生 Web Speech API，零配置零成本。
description.en: ChatVoice adds free, keyless voice input and AI reply read-aloud to DeepSeek Harness, powered by the browser's native Web Speech API with zero config and zero cost.

description.zh: DSH plugin 声音提醒：Agent 完成、需授权、提问等十类事件独立开关与音量，浏览器合成音加跨平台系统蜂鸣，工作区快捷静音，默认零版权负担。
description.en: A DSH plugin for sound alerts: ten event types with independent toggles and volume, using browser-synthesized tones plus cross-platform system beeps, with per-workspace mute and royalty-free defaults.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供玻璃拟态主题的 DSH 插件，把顶栏、侧边栏、输入框与轨迹视图变成磨砂玻璃面板，支持壁纸、粒子鲸鱼与一键还原。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives the DeepSeek Harness web UI a glassmorphism theme, turning the header, sidebar, composer and trajectory view into frosted-glass panes with wallpapers, a particle whale and one-switch restore.

description.zh: DSH plugin 代码研读教练：用五段研读法交互式引导你研读论文对应的开源代码，从技术栈锚定到核心映射再到闭环验证，让读代码有章可循。
description.en: A DSH plugin that interactively coaches you through reading open-source code behind papers using a five-stage method, from anchoring the tech stack to mapping core ideas and closing the loop.

description.zh: DSH plugin 注册 ChatGPT Codex 的三个工具：网页搜索、图像生成与图像视觉，复用现有 Codex 登录态。
description.en: A DSH plugin registering three ChatGPT Codex tools: web search, image generation, and image vision, reusing an existing Codex login.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让编码 Agent 通过 SSH 在远程 Linux 服务器上运行，零远程安装，文件、搜索、编辑与终端全部透明落地远端。
description.en: A DSH plugin that runs the coding agent on a remote Linux server over SSH with zero remote install, transparently redirecting files, search, editing and terminal to the remote box.

description.zh: dsh-commander 是 DeepSeek Harness 的指挥官插件，将一个对话升级为指挥官，通过 <dsh-dispatch> 协议派发任务给其他 worker 会话并行执行，自动汇总回执，实现多窗口无人值守协作。
description.en: dsh-commander is a commander plugin for DeepSeek Harness that upgrades a conversation into a commander, dispatching tasks to worker sessions via <dsh-dispatch> protocol blocks, with automatic result receipts for unattended multi-window orchestration.

description.zh: 为 DSH plugin 在输入框旁加一枚小环，实时显示上下文占用，提示何时压缩、交接或锁定消息，避免长会话被静默压缩。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a small ring beside the composer showing context usage and when to compact, hand off, or pin messages, so long sessions never get compacted by surprise.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 端的输入框增强插件，可自定义发送与换行键位、右键菜单、快捷指令与提示词优化，并记忆设置面板尺寸。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web composer enhancement plugin: configurable send/newline keys, a native-style context menu, quick-command prompts with an optimizer, and persisted settings-panel size.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 新增「电脑操作模式」，通过屏幕截图与鼠标键盘控制操作没有 agent 接口的 GUI 软件，并读取只存在于屏幕上的信息。
description.en: Adds a computer-use mode to DeepSeek Harness, letting the agent drive GUI software with no agent-facing integration via screen capture plus mouse and keyboard synthesis.

description.zh: DSH plugin 并发请求监控与门闩插件，挂钩 llm/stream 总线统计在途模型请求，并发超限时 FIFO 排队，防止供应商锁号，自带 WebUI 面板与 HTTP 端点。
description.en: DSH plugin for monitoring and gating concurrent model requests, hooking the llm/stream bus, FIFO queueing on overflow to prevent provider lockouts, with WebUI panel and HTTP endpoint.

description.zh: DSH plugin 请求上下文分析器，对比每次模型请求的变化与缓存复用情况，帮助定位缓存命中率下降的原因。
description.en: A DSH plugin that profiles request context, showing what changed between model requests and how cache reuse shifted.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供模型自主的上下文窗口滚动：模型可主动结束当前窗口并在新窗口继续，靠持久笔记与最近原文尾部保留状态，不做摘要压缩。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness bundle for model-driven context rollover: the model can end one context window and continue in a fresh one, preserving durable notes and a verbatim recent tail with no summarization.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 的助手 Markdown、工具调用和 Think 内容提供可自定义的语义配色，内置多套主题并支持深浅色模式。
description.en: Provides customizable semantic color accents for assistant Markdown, tool calls, and Think blocks in DSH Web, with multiple built-in themes and light/dark mode support.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上对话之间的横向通信：同一进程里的对话可互相发现、按昵称收发消息、查看进度并给自己设工具护栏。
description.en: Adds lateral conversation-to-conversation messaging to DeepSeek Harness: peers in the same process can discover each other, exchange messages by nickname, check progress, and set their own tool guardrails.

description.zh: DSH plugin 按真实 token 用量折算 LLM 调用费用，提供调用级、会话级与全局统计页，UI 对齐 CC Switch 风格。
description.en: A DSH plugin that converts real token usage into LLM costs, offering per-call, per-session and global usage dashboards in CC Switch style.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的可自定义主题 DSH plugin，壁纸、明暗配色、欢迎语与表情均可改，并支持配置导入导出。
description.en: A customizable theme DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness: tweak wallpaper, light/dark palettes, greeting text and stickers, with config import/export.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将提交快捷键从 Enter 改为 Ctrl/Cmd+Enter，覆盖主对话框与 Agent 提问卡片，可在设置中随时开关。
description.en: A DSH plugin that changes the submit shortcut from Enter to Ctrl/Cmd+Enter, covering the main composer and agent question cards, with a toggle in settings.

description.zh: DSH 数据洞察技能插件，将 CSV 等数据源转化为含指标、图表的结构化 Markdown 分析报告，零依赖、五阶段流水线。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns CSV and other data sources into structured Markdown insight reports with metrics and charts, zero-dependency with a five-stage pipeline.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面添加右下角额度血条，直观显示余额、今日与本月用量及会话费用，支持拖动折叠。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding a bottom-right quota blood-bar to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, showing balance, today/month spend, and session cost, draggable and collapsible.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自动采集抖音来客与巨量本地推三源数据，计算指标并生成 A4 版式 OEM 投流日报/周报 docx，支持邮件通知与 Windows 定时任务。
description.en: A DSH plugin that automatically collects Douyin local-promotion OEM data, computes metrics, and generates A4-format daily/weekly ad reports as docx, with optional email and scheduled tasks.

description.zh: dsh-driftwatch 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供行为漂移报告：对比两份会话日志，量化工具调用序列、文件操作、推理量与重试等变化，零依赖且可直接接入 CI。
description.en: dsh-driftwatch produces behavior-drift reports for DeepSeek Harness agents: it compares two session logs and quantifies changes in tool-call sequence, file targets, reasoning volume, retries and timing — zero dependencies and CI-ready.

description.zh: 头歌（EduCoder）作业自动化 DSH 插件，全量扫描账号内未完成作业并一次做完；选择题零 token，仅代码题调用模型。
description.en: A DSH plugin that automates EduCoder homework: it sweeps every unfinished assignment in your account and completes them in one pass, spending zero tokens on multiple-choice and calling the model only for coding tasks.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 账户余额常驻在 DSH 左侧栏底部的状态环里，点开可看总额、赠送与充值拆分及数据新鲜度，并在插件设置页配置币种、预警阈值与刷新节奏。
description.en: Keeps your DeepSeek account balance in a persistent status ring at the bottom of the DSH sidebar, with a popover for totals, granted vs. topped-up split and data freshness, plus plugin settings for currency, alert thresholds and refresh cadence.

description.zh: DSH 插件自动识别项目所用的包管理器（pnpm、uv 等），拦截 agent 误用 npm 或 pip 的命令，并直接给出正确的等价命令。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that detects a project's package manager (pnpm, uv, etc.), blocks the agent's mismatched npm or pip commands, and hands back the correct equivalent command.

description.zh: dsh-factory 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化依赖图任务工厂，支持循环 Agent 工作、安全检出通道、队列、Triage 与产物管理。
description.en: dsh-factory provides a durable dependency-graph task factory for DeepSeek Harness, enabling recurring Agent work, safe checkout lanes, first-class queues, Triage, and artifacts.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 Exa 神经搜索与抓取引擎挂载为原生 agent 工具，通过内置 MCP 桥接官方端点，零代码、纯配置即插即用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that mounts Exa's neural search and fetch engine as native agent tools via the built-in MCP bridge, zero-code and pure-configuration.

description.zh: FileScope 为 DeepSeek Harness 工作区提供右侧抽屉式文件浏览器，支持实时预览与只读浏览，是实用的 DSH plugin。
description.en: FileScope adds a right-drawer file explorer with live preview to DeepSeek Harness workspaces, offering read-only browsing as a DSH plugin.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话长期记忆与陪伴伙伴，自动整理认知、经历、共鸣与自我四类记忆，新会话也能接上。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness a persistent companion with cross-session memory, auto-curating knowledge, experiences, resonance and self-notes.

description.zh: DSH plugin 本地优先文件转换工具，支持图片、PDF、数据、音视频及办公文档共 26 种转换，无需 API 密钥或上传，文件不出本机。
description.en: A DSH plugin for local-first file conversion, supporting images, PDF, data, media and office docs with 26 conversions—no API keys, no uploads, files never leave your machine.

description.zh: DSH 右侧栏 Excel 编辑插件，支持 xlsx 预览、单元格编辑、公式实时计算、合并单元格与格式设置，并保存回原文件。
description.en: A DSH right-sidebar Excel editor plugin for previewing, editing, and saving .xlsx files with live formula calculation and formatting.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框提供全屏编辑面板，可在整屏空间写多行提示词，支持拖动缩放、引用与附件共用同一份草稿。
description.en: A fullscreen input panel for DeepSeek Harness that lets you compose multi-line prompts on a full screen, with drag, resize, and shared draft for references and attachments.

description.zh: dsh-fold-turns 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 插件，自动折叠已完成的对话轮次，保留用户消息和最终答案，将推理、上下文注入和工具活动折叠为紧凑的时长行，点击可展开查看原始过程。
description.en: dsh-fold-turns is a Web plugin for DeepSeek Harness that automatically folds completed chat turns, keeping user message and final answer visible while collapsing reasoning, context injection, and tool activity into a compact duration row, expandable on click.

description.zh: 为 zhipuai/glm-5.3-flash 调优的 DeepSeek Harness 编码 Agent 预设，装上即得 PTC 程序化工具调用、GLM 专属自动压缩，以及思考死循环与工具空转双层守卫。
description.en: A tuned coding-agent preset for zhipuai/glm-5.3-flash in DeepSeek Harness, bundling PTC programmatic tool calling, GLM-specific auto-compaction, and dual reasoning-loop plus tool-spin guards.

description.zh: DSH web 插件，在 composer 工具行实时显示当前 git 分支，支持不离开聊天界面即可切换分支，并自动处理工作区脏状态。
description.en: A DSH web plugin that shows the current git branch in the composer tool row and lets you switch branches without leaving the chat UI, with dirty-state safety.

description.zh: dsh-git 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 与源码控制插件套件，提供本地 git 及 GitHub、GitLab 等五大平台操作，并具备自进化记忆能力。
description.en: dsh-git is a Git & source-control plugin suite for DeepSeek Harness, offering local git and five major platform operations with self-evolving memory.

description.zh: 梦回高三：DSH 插件在桌面右下角挂一块可拖拽小黑板，显示高考倒计时，AI 干活间隙自动抽背 Markdown 知识卡，支持收藏、关联跳转与导入自有知识库。
description.en: Dream Back to Senior Year: a DSH plugin that floats a draggable countdown blackboard in the corner and quizzes you with Markdown knowledge cards while the AI works, with favorites, wikilink jumps and custom knowledge base import.

description.zh: dsh-gauge 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供精确缓存命中率、token 用量与费用估算，修正官方统计行的四舍五入误导，并支持峰谷计价与调价对比。
description.en: dsh-gauge provides precise cache hit rate, token usage, and cost estimation for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, correcting the rounding misleading of official stats and supporting peak/off-peak pricing.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 graft 代码图谱：把每个符号的 file:line 位置与调用关系同时呈现给你和模型，提供五个查询工具、状态芯片与自动重建索引。
description.en: A DSH plugin that puts graft's prebuilt code graph — every symbol, its file:line span and caller relationships — in front of both you and the model, with five query tools, a status chip and auto-rebuild.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的语音朗读插件，双模式可选：Edge 云端零配置即用（20+ 免费音色），或 GSV 本地离线音色克隆，支持一键朗读、自动朗读与音色市场。
description.en: A DSH plugin for speech synthesis with dual modes: Edge cloud zero-config with 20+ free voices, or GSV local offline voice cloning, supporting one-click read-aloud and a voice marketplace.

description.zh: DSH plugin bundle，将 Git Ship Done 阶段循环引入 DeepSeek Harness，以规范化的工件驱动流程取代默认 agent 循环。
description.en: A DSH plugin bundle that brings the Git Ship Done phase loop to DeepSeek Harness, replacing the default agent loop with a disciplined, artefact-driven engineering flow.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入飞书、Telegram 等 IM 渠道，提供持久会话、流式输出与 40 个飞书 MCP 工具。
description.en: A DSH plugin bridging DeepSeek Harness to IM channels like Feishu and Telegram, with persistent sessions, streaming output, and 40 Feishu MCP tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供只读 Git 面板，展示分支、ahead/behind、改动与差异，并归因本会话改过哪些文件、跑了哪些工具。
description.en: A read-only Git panel for DeepSeek Harness showing branch, ahead/behind, changes and diffs, plus per-session attribution of edited files and tool activity.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 Kimi Code Swarm 模式移植进 DeepSeek Harness，提供 swarm_batch 工具与 /swarm 命令，实现批量并行子 Agent 调度，并带聊天内实时进度条，官方基准下效率最高提升 4.5 倍。
description.en: A DSH plugin that ports Kimi Code Swarm mode into DeepSeek Harness, offering the swarm_batch tool and /swarm command for batch parallel subagent orchestration with in-chat progress bars, boosting efficiency up to 4.5x in official benchmarks.

description.zh: dshgo 是一个 DSH 插件，把只监听 127.0.0.1 的 dsh web 安全暴露到局域网，附带二维码入口、可选访问密码与移动端布局，让手机平板也能用 DeepSeek Harness。
description.en: dshgo is a DSH plugin that safely exposes the loopback-only dsh web server to your LAN, adding a QR-code entry, optional access password and mobile layout so phones and tablets can use DeepSeek Harness.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让 deepseek-v4 等不能看图的模型也能处理聊天图片，通过内置 analyze_image 工具调用视觉 API 获取描述。
description.en: A DSH plugin that enables vision-less models like deepseek-v4 to handle chat images by converting them to file paths and using the built-in analyze_image tool with a vision API.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供三档输入队列（打断/插队/排队）与高峰会话冻结，支持队列编辑、排序和会话隔离，帮助错峰省钱。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a three-tier input queue (interrupt/steer/queue) and session freeze for DeepSeek Harness web GUI, with queue editing, reordering, and session isolation to save costs during peak hours.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入飞书/Lark 私聊，离开电脑也能在手机上派任务、聊方案、续接话题，会话独立不抢占桌面端。
description.en: Adds a Feishu / Lark private chat to your DeepSeek Harness so you can hand off tasks, discuss plans and resume topics from your phone, with its own separate sessions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 装上「收口者」自我：灵魂卡四字段定义身份，边界判断纪律约束输出，海马体记忆循环沉淀事实并自我进化。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness a closing-mind self: a four-field soul card, boundary-judgment discipline, and a hippocampus memory loop that consolidates facts and self-evolves.

description.zh: dsh-lit-search 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供学术文献搜索、引用格式化和 BibTeX 生成工具，支持 Crossref 与 OpenAlex 合并检索，并可作为 CLI 或技能使用。
description.en: dsh-lit-search provides academic literature search, citation formatting, and BibTeX generation for DeepSeek Harness, with merged Crossref/OpenAlex search, usable as a plugin, CLI, or skill.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供 provider 回退链：主模型失败时自动切换备用 provider，带 Web 配置面板，保障对话不中断。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing provider fallback chains: automatically retries on backup providers when the primary fails, with a Web UI config panel.

description.zh: DSH plugin 适配器，驱动 vLLM 本地部署的 Qwen 模型，支持多模态开关、可配置推理档位与双语设置页。
description.en: DSH plugin adapter driving locally deployed Qwen models via vLLM, with per-model multimodal switch, configurable reasoning efforts, and bilingual settings UI.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中搭建长篇中文小说工作台，用章节、时间线、事实账本、伏笔与注意力评分管理全书，AI 生成与审稿均先落提案再进正文。
description.en: A long-form Chinese novel workbench for DeepSeek Harness that tracks chapters, timelines, fact ledgers, foreshadowing and attention scores, with AI drafting and review landing as proposals before entering the manuscript.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供以本地 Markdown 仓库为唯一数据源的长期记忆，含侧边栏管理页、四个模型工具与按 token 预算的召回。
description.en: Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness that stores everything as a local Obsidian-compatible Markdown vault, with a sidebar management page, four model tools, and token-budgeted recall.

description.zh: 为 AI Agent 提供长期工作记忆的 DSH plugin：过程日志、索引台账与经验手册三层结构，支持跨工作区记忆注入与检索。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives AI agents long-term work memory: process journals, index ledgers and lessons, plus cross-workspace memory injection and recall.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化、可搜索的项目记忆：决策、规则与会话上下文存入 DuckDB，规则注入每次模型请求，并提供 Web 管理界面。
description.en: Persistent, searchable per-project memory for DeepSeek Harness: decisions, rules, and session context in DuckDB, with rules injected into every model request and a full management UI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness（dsh web）添加一只可拖动的卡通猫狗悬浮伙伴，随会话状态换表情、说短句，陪伴你干活。
description.en: Adds a draggable animated cat/dog companion to DeepSeek Harness (dsh web), reacting to session states with expressions and phrases.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在模型消息中选中文本复制时，自动将剪贴板内容重写为 Markdown，保留链接、LaTeX 源码和代码围栏语言信息。
description.en: A DSH plugin that rewrites copied text from model messages into Markdown, preserving links, LaTeX sources, and code fence language info.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自动修复 messages 数组中的孤儿 tool_calls 与 tool 消息配对，杜绝 400 INVALID_REQUEST 导致的会话卡死，让对话持续进行。
description.en: A DSH plugin that auto-repairs orphan tool_calls and tool message pairing in the messages array, preventing 400 INVALID_REQUEST session crashes and keeping conversations alive.

description.zh: DSH 实时思维导图插件，Agent 与你在同一棵树上共编，改动即时互相同步，支持停靠分屏与全屏专注两种视图。
description.en: A real-time mind map plugin for DeepSeek Harness: the agent and you co-edit one shared tree with instant two-way sync, in docked split or fullscreen focus view.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让 DeepSeek Harness Web 代理在对话中检查与搜索 Milvus 部署，支持标量查询、BM25 全文检索及混合检索，所有操作只读。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets DeepSeek Harness Web agents inspect and search Milvus deployments from chat, supporting scalar queries, BM25 full-text search, and hybrid retrieval, all read-only.

description.zh: DSH plugin 的 Telegram 消息网关，让您通过 Telegram 与 Harness 代理对话，支持语音、图片、文档、会话管理与 TTS 语音回复。
description.en: A DSH plugin Telegram messenger gateway to chat with your Harness agent from Telegram, with voice, photos, documents, session management, and TTS voice notes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供提供商与模型高级管理台，可在设置中新增、编辑、排序模型并测试连通性，保存即热生效。
description.en: An advanced provider and model management console for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), letting you add, edit, reorder and connectivity-test models in settings with hot-reload on save.

description.zh: dsh-mnemosyne 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地优先、SQLite 支撑的跨会话记忆层，支持记忆的存储、回忆与整合。
description.en: dsh-mnemosyne brings a local-first, SQLite-backed cross-session memory layer to DeepSeek Harness, enabling remember, recall, and consolidation across sessions.

description.zh: DSH plugin，在 DeepSeek Harness 创建或编辑自定义模型时手动选择输入类型（文本/图片），让多模态能力声明与模型真实能力一致。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets you manually select input types (text/image) when creating or editing custom models in DeepSeek Harness, aligning capability declarations with actual model support.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在模型目录编辑器内为每个模型行添加图像支持与思考等级控件，并可按 models.dev 预设自动填充容量，免手写 settings.yaml。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds image support and reasoning effort controls to each model row in the model directory editor, auto-filling capacities from models.dev presets, eliminating manual settings.yaml edits.

description.zh: DSH plugin 电子木鱼：右下角小肥鲸，敲头记功德，模型忙碌时自动敲，等 loop 时摸摸鱼头。
description.en: A DSH plugin featuring an electronic wooden fish: a little whale in the corner, tap to earn merit, auto-taps while the model is busy, pet it while waiting for loop.

description.zh: 通过 NapCat 将 QQ 群聊与私聊接入 DeepSeek Harness，让 DSH Agent 收发消息、检索历史、管理记忆与表情包。
description.en: Connects QQ group and private chats to DeepSeek Harness via NapCat, letting the DSH agent send messages, search history, and manage memory and stickers.

description.zh: DSH Web GUI 跨工作区会话迁移插件，一键将空闲会话原封不动复制到其他工作区，完整保留上下文、历史、Agent 预设与模型选择，支持保留或归档原会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin for moving sessions across workspaces in the Web GUI, duplicating idle sessions intact with full context, history, agent presets and model selection, with options to keep or archive the original.

description.zh: DSH 通用皮肤插件，提供可视化绘制模式与实时预览，在真实页面上改样式、文字与字体，皮肤为可逆覆盖层，可打包成 .dshskin 导入导出。
description.en: A universal skin plugin for DeepSeek Harness with a visual draw mode and live preview: restyle real pages, text and fonts through a fully reversible overlay, packaged as portable .dshskin bundles.

description.zh: 让 DSH 直接操控你日常使用的 Chrome：复用已登录标签页，提供低延迟语义观察、可靠操作与可见的人机交接。
description.en: A DSH-native browser runtime that lets DeepSeek Harness drive the Chrome you already use, with low-latency semantic observation, reliable actions and visible human handoff.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生 Jupyter 风格笔记本，集成持久 ipykernel 与 VS Code 风格单元格 UI，支持 tqdm 进度、内联图表及逐格 AI 修订。
description.en: Native Jupyter-style notebook for DeepSeek Harness with persistent ipykernel sidecar and VS Code-aligned cell UI, featuring tqdm progress, inline figures, and per-cell AI revision.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的纯文本小说写作工作台，从大纲导入、道藏与大世界设定、卷章规划到逐章生成 3000-4000 字正文、九维审稿与全本导出，一站式完成整本书的 AI 编译。
description.en: A text-only AI novel writing workbench for DeepSeek Harness: import an outline, build story bible and world settings, plan volumes and chapters, generate 3,000-4,000-character chapters, run 9-dimension AI review, and export the finished book.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在侧边栏展示 OpenCode GO 订阅配额（滚动5小时/周/月），并支持 /opencode-go 命令查询，助你实时掌握用量。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows your OpenCode GO plan quota (rolling 5h/weekly/monthly) in the sidebar and via /opencode-go command.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的一页式小说创作工作台，自动汇总剧情总结、大纲与人物卡生成写作包，支持候选稿抽卡、情节体检与偏好档案跨书继承。
description.en: A one-page novel-writing workbench for DeepSeek Harness that assembles plot summaries, outlines and character cards into a writing pack, with draft candidates, plot health checks and cross-book preference profiles.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中接入 OpenDesign Go 订阅的 12 个模型，支持用量统计、额度读取、多账号切换与逐模型参数配置。
description.en: Brings the 12 OpenDesign Go subscription models into DeepSeek Harness, with usage stats, quota reading, multi-account failover and per-model parameter overrides.

description.zh: DSH 插件：在设置页配置 OpenRouter 提供商列表与量化限制，注入 provider.only/order 路由参数，并持久化到设置文档。
description.en: A DSH plugin that configures OpenRouter provider lists and quantization limits in settings, injecting provider.only/order routing params with persistence.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在会话头部显示高峰/闲时计费徽标，自动压缩长会话以节省上下文费用，并实时统计本会话与每轮 token 消耗金额。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows peak/off-peak pricing badges in the conversation header, auto-compacts long sessions to save context costs, and tracks token spend per session and per turn.

description.zh: dsh-open-file 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供任意格式文件的上传、读取、本地 OCR 与渲染能力，通过拖拽或粘贴即可将文件带入会话，并内置四个 Agent 工具供模型调用。
description.en: dsh-open-file brings arbitrary file upload, reading, local OCR, and rendering to DeepSeek Harness, letting you drag or paste files into conversations with four agent tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供确定性优先、失败即拒绝的权限门控，按 P0 硬拒绝到 P4 审批的固定优先级链裁决每次工具调用，并记录完整审计。
description.en: A deterministic-first, fail-closed permission gate for DeepSeek Harness that adjudicates every tool call through a fixed P0-to-P4 priority chain with a full audit trail.

description.zh: DSH Web 输入框右侧添加回形针按钮，点击或拖拽选择文件，内容自动插入输入框，方便将代码/文本直接发给 agent。
description.en: Adds a paperclip button to the DSH web composer: click or drag & drop to select files, and insert their contents into the textarea for handing code/text to the agent.

description.zh: DSH plugin 权限规则引擎，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Claude Code 风格四级权限拦截与可视化规则编辑器，保护敏感文件与命令。
description.en: A DSH plugin permission rule engine that brings Claude Code-style four-level access control and a visual rule editor to DeepSeek Harness, safeguarding sensitive files and commands.

description.zh: DSH plugin 兼容宿主，让可信的 Pi 扩展在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接运行，无需源码转换。
description.en: A DSH plugin compatibility host that runs trusted Pi extensions inside DeepSeek Harness without source conversion.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 客户端 plan 模式审批卡片增加「压缩后执行」选项：先把计划提交前的上下文压成摘要检查点，再批准计划，模型带着逐字保留的计划开始执行。
description.en: Adds a "Compact & Execute" option to the DSH Web client's plan-mode approval card: it compacts the pre-plan context into a summary checkpoint, then approves the plan so the model executes with the plan kept verbatim.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 代理提供学术写作工具包：论文大纲、标题/摘要骨架、GB/T 7714/APA/MLA 引文、措辞检查及投稿前清单。
description.en: Academic writing toolkit for DeepSeek Harness agents: paper outlines, title/abstract skeletons, GB/T 7714/APA/MLA citations, phrasing QA, and pre-submission checklist.

description.zh: 这款 DSH 插件通过 adb 让模型直接操作安卓手机，提供设备发现、截图与 UI 树感知、点击滑动输入按键及应用管理等 10 个工具。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets the model drive an Android phone over adb, exposing 10 tools for device discovery, screenshot and UI-tree perception, tap/swipe/text/key input, and app management.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件开发知识库：官方文档完整镜像与主题导航，让 dsh 插件开发任务自动加载知识库，按场景定位文档。
description.en: A DSH plugin development knowledge base: full mirror of official docs with topic navigation, enabling dsh plugin development tasks to auto-load the KB and locate docs by scenario.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久记忆的 DSH plugin：分层存储对话、项目与 Vault 语义记忆，按需注入并支持自动检索，让 agent 不再失忆。
description.en: Persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness: layered per-conversation, project and Vault semantic memory with selective injection and automatic retrieval, so agents never forget.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设置页添加「安装」标签页，输入包名即可安装任意第三方插件，无需终端或插件市场。
description.en: Adds an 'Install' tab to DeepSeek Harness settings, letting you install any third-party plugin by package name without terminal or marketplace.

description.zh: dsh-plugin-greet 是一个面向初学者的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件，演示如何通过 defineTool() 注册一个可被模型调用的问候工具，支持中英文与友好/正式风格，并输出结构化结果。
description.en: dsh-plugin-greet is a beginner-friendly DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that demonstrates registering a model-callable greet tool via defineTool(), supporting English/Chinese and friendly/formal styles with structured output.

description.zh: 为 DSH plugin 提供多宿主兼容性矩阵、官方 format-1 市场索引生成与 Windows/WSL 安装诊断，帮你提前发现升级断点。
description.en: A DSH plugin health toolkit: multi-host compatibility matrix, official format-1 market index builder, and a Windows/WSL install doctor that catches upgrade breakage early.

description.zh: DSH plugin 集成 Herdr 控制平面，在 DeepSeek Harness 会话中通过 19 个 herdr_* 工具观察和驱动终端工作区管理器，并提供会话级 UI 与 Herdr 模式。
description.en: A DSH plugin that integrates Herdr's control plane, letting you observe and drive the terminal workspace manager from DeepSeek Harness sessions via 19 herdr_* tools, with session-scoped UI and Herdr mode.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端提供液态玻璃美化，把输入框、消息气泡、侧栏与顶栏换成玻璃材质，可搭配壁纸插件（仅深色模式）。
description.en: A liquid-glass beautification plugin for DeepSeek Harness desktop, turning the composer, message bubbles, sidebar and top bar into glass material; pairs with wallpaper plugins (dark mode only).

description.zh: DSH plugin 的 MCP 服务器管理面板，提供 GUI 增删改 MCP 配置、工具浏览及 agent 面 mcp_* 管理工具，配置写入 cordis.patch.yml 并支持 HMR 实时挂载。
description.en: A DSH plugin that provides a GUI panel for managing MCP servers, including add/edit/delete configs, tool browsing, and agent-side mcp_* management tools, with HMR hot-mounting.

description.zh: 鲸鱼娘 Mimi 是 DeepSeek Harness 的桌面宠物插件，随 DSH 启动唤醒，跟随思考与工具调用做动作、气泡显示回复，并内置 Windows Computer Use 与好感度系统。
description.en: Whale-girl Mimi is a DeepSeek Harness desktop pet plugin that wakes with DSH, reacts to thinking and tool calls with speech bubbles, and bundles Windows Computer Use plus an affinity system.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在聊天消息中渲染 Mermaid 代码块，提供图表/源码切换与主题联动，让 DeepSeek Harness 网页端轻松展示流程图。
description.en: A DSH plugin that renders Mermaid code blocks in chat with a chart/source toggle and theme sync, bringing diagrams to the DeepSeek Harness web client.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 Web UI 添加可自定义铃声，任务完成或需人工介入时播放提示音，支持按工作区配置、TTS 语音播报和自定义音频上传。
description.en: A DSH plugin for the Web UI that plays customizable ringtones when tasks finish or human attention is needed, with per-workspace settings, TTS announcements, and custom audio upload.

description.zh: 将 opencode 的技能与配置无缝桥接至 DeepSeek Harness，实现零迁移复用，作为 DSH plugin 提升开发效率。
description.en: Bridge opencode skills and configuration into DeepSeek Harness with zero migration, as a DSH plugin for enhanced development workflow.

description.zh: Windows 上的 DSH plugin，将 pwsh 工具路由到 PowerShell 7，缺失时自动按用户安装并弹出 Web 安装对话框。
description.en: A Windows DSH plugin that routes the pwsh tool to PowerShell 7, auto-installing it per-user with a Web setup dialog when missing.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的每个 Agent 预设自动挂载渐进式工具发现层，保持模型可见工具前缀稳定，同时支持工具注册、限制与遮蔽。
description.en: An automatically mounted progressive tool discovery layer for every DeepSeek Harness Agent preset, keeping the model-visible tool prefix stable while enabling tool registration, restriction, and shadowing.

description.zh: DSH plugin 安全体检工具，静态扫描第三方插件源码，识别恶意模式、越权路径与未检查依赖，让盲装变知情安装。
description.en: A DSH plugin security vetting tool that statically scans third-party plugin source code to detect malicious patterns, over-privileged paths, and unchecked dependencies, turning blind installs into informed ones.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供项目看板：卡片组管父项目、卡片管任务，每张卡片关联落盘项目记忆、挂载仓库与会话，从卡片开的会话自动带上项目上下文。
description.en: A project board plugin for DeepSeek Harness: card groups track parent projects and cards track tasks, each card linked to on-disk project memory, mounted repos and sessions, so sessions opened from a card inherit project context automatically.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 输入栏添加一键润色按钮，将粗糙请求重写为结构化专业提示词，非破坏性且可审查。
description.en: Adds a one-click polish button to the DeepSeek Harness WebUI input toolbar, rewriting rough requests into structured professional prompts, non-destructive and reviewable.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供助手回复朗读能力，接入 Edge TTS 等语音服务并边生成边流式播放音频，可调语速、音色并跳过代码块。
description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud in DeepSeek Harness via text-to-speech providers, streaming audio as it is generated with adjustable voice, speed and code-skipping.

description.zh: 这款 DSH plugin 拦截 Agent 对 lockfile 与生成代码的手工写入和编辑，并提示正确的重新生成命令。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that blocks agents from hand-editing lockfiles and generated code, telling them how to regenerate instead.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可拖动悬浮用量球，自动识别各 Provider 路由并实时展示余额与用量窗口，一眼看清额度是否将耗尽。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that floats a draggable usage ball over the Web GUI, auto-detecting provider routes and showing live balances and usage windows at a glance.

description.zh: dsh-protect-tests 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，在编辑测试文件前拦截 .skip、删除断言、弱化断言等削弱测试的改动，让测试保持失败直到代码真正修好。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that inspects every edit to test files and blocks changes that weaken tests, such as .skip, deleted assertions, or weakened checks, so tests keep failing until the code is truly fixed.

description.zh: DSH plugin为工作区提供Python虚拟环境管理，支持发现、创建、安装与删除venv，规避沙箱与网络陷阱。
description.en: A DSH plugin for workspace-scoped Python virtual environment management, enabling discovery, creation, installation, and removal of venvs without sandbox or network pitfalls.

description.zh: DSH plugin 四源一体文献检索：PubMed、Europe PMC、PubTator3 与 Semantic Scholar，提供实体级检索、跨源去重、被引数据与个人文献知识图谱，让科研筛库更精准高效。
description.en: DSH plugin for unified literature search across PubMed, Europe PMC, PubTator3 and Semantic Scholar, featuring entity-aware search, cross-source dedup, citation data, and a personal knowledge graph.

description.zh: 把 QQ 私聊与群聊接成 DeepSeek Harness 前端，经 OneBot v11 与 NapCat 让同一个 Agent 持久对话，支持语音转文字、戳一戳、表情与点赞。
description.en: Bridges QQ private and group chats into DeepSeek Harness via OneBot v11 and NapCat, letting one persistent Agent chat with voice-to-text, pokes, reactions and likes.

description.zh: DSH plugin 修复本地 qwen3.8-27b 在上下文压缩时因过度思考耗尽输出预算导致截断的问题，仅对压缩调用关闭思考并应用推荐采样参数。
description.en: A DSH plugin that fixes local qwen3.8-27b truncation during context compaction by disabling thinking for compaction calls and applying recommended sampling parameters.

description.zh: 把另一台电脑变成 DSH 的远程 Agent 同事：任务在副机本地持久运行，主机只收 handoff 摘要与产物清单，成品需显式拉取。
description.en: Turns another computer into a remote agent worker for your DSH: tasks run and persist locally on the worker, while the hub only receives a handoff summary and artifact manifest, with artifacts pulled on demand.

description.zh: 让经反向代理访问的 DSH 页面被当作可信本机，修复设置界面报「settings are unavailable」的问题，使模型提供商目录正常加载。
description.en: Makes a reverse-proxied DSH page count as a trusted host, fixing the "settings are unavailable in this browser" error so the Settings surface and model provider catalog load normally.

description.zh: DSH plugin 研究债务守卫：当 Agent 本地试错成本升高时，自动注入检索提示，引导其查阅文档或联网搜索，避免陷入低效循环。
description.en: A DSH plugin research-debt guard that auto-injects retrieval nudges when local trial-and-error becomes costly, guiding agents to consult docs or search the web.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供「只看结果」开关，折叠思考与工具调用行，仅保留最终回复，并支持按回合展开过程详情。
description.en: A results-only toggle for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI that folds thinking and tool-call rows, keeping only final replies, with per-turn expandable traces.

description.zh: RiverMind 是 DeepSeek Harness 上的德州扑克训练场，让 AI 玩家 Iris 拥有独立策略、长期记忆与可追溯决策，支持复盘与规则陪练。
description.en: RiverMind is a Texas Hold'em training table for DeepSeek Harness, giving the AI player Iris its own strategy, long-term memory and traceable decisions, with replay and rule-based sparring.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 打造的 Chrome 恐龙风小游戏，在 Agent 回复等待时游玩，从梁子一路跑到梁圣。
description.en: A Chrome-dino-style mini-game for DeepSeek Harness Web: play while waiting for the agent, score from 梁子 to 梁圣.

description.zh: dsh-rules 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 glob 的规则提示注入，当 Agent 读写匹配文件时自动激活规则并注入对话，兼容 Claude Code 规则格式。
description.en: dsh-rules provides glob-activated rule prompts for DeepSeek Harness, injecting rules into the conversation when the agent reads or edits matching files, compatible with Claude Code rule format.

description.zh: dsh-scope 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex 风格的上下文透镜与会话热力图，实时展示 token 占用与历史用量，帮助用户直观掌握上下文窗口状态。
description.en: dsh-scope adds a Codex-style context lens and a GitHub-style usage heatmap to DeepSeek Harness, visualizing token occupancy and historical usage for every session.

description.zh: 司察 Scout 是 DeepSeek Harness 的证据驱动公司尽调与岗位背调插件，通过证据等级约束结论，生成带证据边界的尽调报告与面试问题清单。
description.en: Scout is an evidence-driven company and job due-diligence plugin for DeepSeek Harness, enforcing evidence levels to generate reports with evidence boundaries and interview questions.

description.zh: DSH 划词解读插件：在 Web 界面选中文字即浮出按钮，弹窗流式给出专业中英翻译，并结合当前会话上下文详解这段文字在此处的确切含义。
description.en: A DSH plugin for selection-based explanation: select any text in the web UI to get a streaming professional translation plus an in-context explanation of what it actually means here.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入商汤日日新多 Key 轮换池，填入多把 Key 即可用全部模型，遇 429 限流自动切换下一把，零配置无感。
description.en: Adds a SenseNova multi-key rotation pool to DeepSeek Harness: paste several keys to use all models, with automatic failover on 429 rate limits and zero configuration.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Web GUI 底部统计条中实时估算当前会话的 DeepSeek API 费用，按命中/未命中/输出分项展示，并自动适配峰谷计价。
description.en: A DSH plugin that estimates the DeepSeek API cost for the current session in the web GUI stats strip, breaking down hit/miss/output and adapting to peak/off-peak pricing.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的会话管理 DSH 插件，可在设置页统一浏览、搜索、归档与删除遗留会话，并把 Claude Code、Codex 的历史会话全保真导入为可续聊的原生会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that unifies session browsing, search, archiving and deletion in the settings page, and imports Claude Code or Codex history as fully resumable native sessions.

description.zh: DSH 插件，提供 provider 级智能搜索与抓取池，多引擎故障转移、加权轮询、额度感知熔断，零模型 token 消耗，并带 Web GUI 设置面板。
description.en: DSH plugin providing a provider-level smart search and fetch pool with multi-engine failover, weighted rotation, quota-aware circuit breaking, zero model token usage, and a Web GUI settings panel.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 会话提供健康诊断、可信备份与一键安全修复，解决因工具调用身份丢失导致的会话无法加载问题。
description.en: A DSH plugin that diagnoses, backs up, and safely repairs DeepSeek Harness web sessions, fixing load failures caused by identity-loss in tool calls.

description.zh: DSH plugin 会话时间轴插件，在会话左侧渲染横短横线时间轴，支持当前消息定位、点击跳转、圆角预览 tooltip 与收起展开，助力长会话快速导航。
description.en: A DSH plugin that renders a horizontal timeline on the left side of a session, enabling quick navigation with current-message tracking, click-to-jump, rounded tooltip previews, and collapsible UI.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的会话工具包，整合会话身份、全局与工作区提示词、会话自动恢复、重启服务及会话间通信等能力。
description.en: A session toolkit for DeepSeek Harness that bundles session identity, global and per-workspace prompts, session auto-resume, a web restart service, and peer-session messaging.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供动态模型切换的 DSH plugin：Agent 通过 set_model / list_models 工具按任务难度自主切换 provider、模型与推理档位，Plan 模式自动升降级，并带白名单与 token 护栏。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that lets agents switch provider, model and reasoning effort on the fly via set_model / list_models tools, with automatic Plan-mode staging plus provider whitelist and token-budget guardrails.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件提供统一设置页 UI 套件与浮动面板套件，通过 ctx.settingsUi 服务快速构建风格一致的设置界面，无需手写组件与状态逻辑。
description.en: A unified settings-page UI kit and floating-panel kit for DeepSeek Harness plugins, exposing the ctx.settingsUi service for consistent, polished settings surfaces without hand-rolling components or state logic.

description.zh: dsh-sight 为 DeepSeek Harness 文本模型注入视觉能力，内置免费 VLM 预设，支持多图批量分析，无需切换模型。
description.en: dsh-sight adds vision to text-only DeepSeek Harness models with built-in free VLM presets and multi-image batch analysis.

description.zh: DSH plugin，在Web设置页提供Skill管理面板，可启停技能，停用的技能对Agent运行时完全不可见。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing a settings-page panel to enable/disable skills; disabled skills are never discovered by agents at runtime.

description.zh: DSH plugin 皮肤切换器：在设置界面新增「皮肤」页，一键切换已安装皮肤并支持恢复默认外观。
description.en: A DSH plugin for switching skins in the Web GUI settings panel, with one-click activation and default restore.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex 兼容的 apply_patch 自由格式编辑工具，替代原生 edit，让模型直接以 diff 表达改动，减少精确字符串匹配失败与 token 开销。
description.en: A DSH plugin that swaps the native edit tool for a Codex-compatible freeform apply_patch, letting models express changes as diffs and cutting exact-match failures and token overhead.

description.zh: DSH Web 定时发送插件，在输入框旁提供定时发送按钮，支持智能时段与自定义时间，多任务排队，localStorage 持久化，刷新后自动恢复。
