description.en: A DSH plugin for scheduled sending in DSH Web, adding a timer button beside the input box with smart time slots and custom datetime, multiple queued tasks, localStorage persistence, and auto-restore after refresh.

description.zh: 为 DSH 四档工作步骤模式增强运行中的思考与工具流式展示，自动展开当前过程窗口并平滑逐字揭示，零配置即用。
description.en: A zero-config DSH plugin that enhances live thinking and tool streaming across all four Work details modes, auto-expanding the active process window with smooth character reveal.

description.zh: dsh-ssh-tui 是专为 SSH 环境优化的 DeepSeek Harness 终端界面，纯 ANSI 渲染，无需浏览器，支持弱网增量绘制、思考折叠、工具卡片与子代理卡片。
description.en: dsh-ssh-tui is a DeepSeek Harness terminal UI optimized for SSH environments, rendered with pure ANSI, no browser needed, supporting incremental drawing on weak networks, collapsible thoughts, tool cards, and subagent cards.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通过模式匹配自动注入 steering rules，不占用系统上下文，精准控制 Agent 行为边界。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects steering rules on pattern match without wasting context, precisely controlling agent behavior boundaries.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将思源笔记变为 Agent 的个人知识库，通过 30+ 工具实现文档读写、全文搜索、反向链接与批量导入导出。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns SiYuan Note into an Agent's personal knowledge base, offering 30+ tools for document CRUD, full-text search, backlinks, and batch import/export.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加订阅会员 OAuth 登录，支持 ChatGPT、Claude、Grok、Kimi 订阅账号接入模型推理，替代 API key。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds subscription OAuth login to DeepSeek Harness, enabling ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, and Kimi subscription accounts for model inference instead of API keys.

description.zh: dsh-swarmdrop 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件，让 Agent 将文件直接推送到手机，并支持引用手机发回的内容，无需账号、无需公网 IP，端到端加密。
description.en: dsh-swarmdrop is a DSH plugin that lets your agent push files straight to your phone and reference what your phone sent back—no account, no public IP, end-to-end encrypted.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生与岛屿两套护眼主题，可切换暖纸、豆绿、暖灰等低眩光配色，并适配深色模式。
description.en: An eye-care theme DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness offering native and island looks with switchable low-glare palettes and dark-mode support.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在新会话界面展示 GitHub 风格 token 用量热力图，支持年份切换、多配色及今日/本月/累计统计。
description.en: A DSH plugin that renders a GitHub-style token-usage heatmap on the new-session screen, with year switching, color schemes, and today/month/all-time totals.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 token 用量分析与模型能力排行榜的 DSH plugin，扫描宿主会话日志，按提供商和模型统计消耗趋势、缓存命中率，并对比可调用模型的能力排名。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for token usage analytics and model capability rankings: it scans the host's own session logs, breaks consumption trends and cache hit rates down by provider and model, and ranks every callable model on a public leaderboard.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话 Token 用量、请求次数与成本统计的 DSH 插件，自带侧边栏入口与独立仪表盘页面，支持多时间范围切换与模型定价配置。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that tracks cross-session token usage, request counts and optional costs, with a sidebar entry and a standalone dashboard page supporting multiple time ranges and model pricing config.

description.zh: dsh-tool-codegraph 是 DeepSeek Harness 的代码图导航插件，封装 codegraph CLI 为十个聚焦的 Agent 工具，支持符号搜索、调用关系、影响分析等，帮助开发者快速理解代码库。
description.en: dsh-tool-codegraph is a DSH plugin that wraps the codegraph CLI into ten focused agent tools for code navigation, including symbol search, callers/callees, impact analysis, and more.

description.zh: DeepSeek Lens 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的高性能 AST 代码图与架构分析插件，提供模块依赖、调用层级、循环依赖审计、影响分析等深度代码拓扑洞察。
description.en: DeepSeek Lens is a high-performance AST code graph and architecture analysis plugin for DeepSeek Harness, offering module dependency, call hierarchy, circular dependency audit, and impact analysis.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通过任意 OpenAI 兼容视觉端点，让纯文本模型也能看懂图片，并附赠鲸鱼娘桌宠与余额查询。
description.en: A DSH plugin that enables text-only models to see images via any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint, plus a whale pet and balance checker.

description.zh: DSH plugin「基元律动费用中心」将 tokenrhythm.studio 的模型清单、账户余额、用量、密钥管理与服务状态集中到侧栏底部可拖拽面板，支持多账号切换与余额预警。
description.en: DSH plugin 'TokenRhythm Bill Center' consolidates model list, account balance, usage, key management and service status from tokenrhythm.studio into a draggable sidebar panel with multi-account switching and balance alerts.

description.zh: DSH 工具管理插件，可按 Agent Preset 开关工具并分组，让低频工具像 Skill 一样按需加载，减少模型上下文占用。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that toggles and groups tools per Agent Preset, loading low-frequency tools on demand like Skills to cut model context usage.

description.zh: DSH plugin 跨会话持久记忆，将 Hermes 式有界纯文本记忆注入 system prompt，支持增删改查与后台自动沉淀。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing cross-session persistent memory, injecting Hermes-style bounded plain-text memories into the system prompt with CRUD tools and background auto-consolidation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 工具箱，提供会话管理、回收站、子目录、全文搜索、预设与配置编辑，并支持定时心跳与长消息折叠。
description.en: A DSH plugin toolbox offering session management, trash, subdirectories, full-text search, preset/config editing, plus scheduled heartbeat and long-message collapse.

description.zh: DSH Track Bridge 是 DeepSeek Harness 的嵌入式任务管理引擎，将念头、决策与任务结构化，提供捕获墙、决策账本、任务生命周期、会话执行图与日历纱线，零外部依赖。
description.en: DSH Track Bridge is an embedded task management engine for DeepSeek Harness, structuring thoughts, decisions, and tasks with capture wall, decision ledger, task lifecycle, session graphs, and calendar yarn, zero external dependencies.

description.zh: Tower 是 DeepSeek Harness 的多代理编排 DSH plugin：把会话变成控制塔，worker 在隔离 Git worktree 中执行 mission，经审查门禁合并回基线分支。
description.en: Tower is a multi-agent orchestration DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness: it turns a session into a control tower where workers implement missions in isolated Git worktrees and merge back through review-gated checks.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 聊天输入框加一圈流动彩虹边框，并用颜色实时反映 agent 运行、待审批与出错状态。
description.en: Adds a flowing rainbow marquee border to the DeepSeek Harness chat composer, using color to reflect agent running, pending approval, and error states.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供上下文撤销/重做功能，可回滚模型上下文至上一个完成步骤并恢复，同时还原工具修改的工作区文件。
description.en: Provides durable undo/redo for DeepSeek Harness, rewinding model context to the last completed step and restoring workspace files changed by tools.

description.zh: dsh-trivium 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供进程内图记忆内核，基于 TriviumDB，每个工作区一个 .tdb 文件，无需额外服务。
description.en: dsh-trivium provides an in-process graph memory kernel for DeepSeek Harness, backed by TriviumDB, one .tdb per workspace, no extra server.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为模型提供 generate_ui 工具，让模型自行编写 A2UI 文档并在聊天中流式渲染为交互式界面，如图表、KPI 卡片、表格、表单和仪表盘。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives the model a generate_ui tool to author A2UI documents and render them as interactive surfaces inline in the chat, such as charts, KPI cards, tables, forms, and dashboards.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为对话列添加悬浮药丸导轨，悬停预览、点击跳转、分页加载，左右贴边可切换，提升长对话导航效率。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a floating pill timeline to the conversation column, enabling hover preview, click-to-jump, pagination, and side switching for efficient long-conversation navigation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 数据保险箱，自动备份聊天记录与工作区数据，检测清空并一键恢复，保护 DeepSeek Harness 数据安全。
description.en: A DSH plugin data vault that auto-backs up chat history and workspace data, detects wipes, and restores with one click to safeguard DeepSeek Harness data.

description.zh: DSH Verification Receipt 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供隐私极简的逐轮验证摘要，记录工具调用与验证信号，不证明测试运行或代码正确。
description.en: DSH Verification Receipt provides privacy-minimal per-turn verification summaries for DeepSeek Harness, logging tool calls and verification signals without proving test execution or correctness.

description.zh: 把一条跑通的短视频生产流水线以 19 个 skill 内置进 DeepSeek Harness 技能目录，覆盖配音、出图、运镜、合成、核验到多平台发布与数据复盘。
description.en: Bundles a proven short-video production pipeline into DeepSeek Harness as 19 built-in skills, covering voiceover, image and video generation, composition, verification, multi-platform publishing and data review.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内用对话生成影片，支持即时预览、多轨剪辑与 MP4 导出，让想法直接成为成片。
description.en: An AI video creation and multitrack editing workbench for DeepSeek Harness: generate from chat, preview instantly, edit on a timeline, and export MP4.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 fake-ip 感知的 WebFetchProvider，在 mihomo/Clash TUN 与 fake-ip DNS 下让 web_fetch 工具照常可用，无需关闭 fake-ip 或设置代理环境变量。
description.en: A fake-ip-aware WebFetchProvider for the DeepSeek Harness web seam that keeps the web_fetch tool working under mihomo/Clash TUN mode with fake-ip DNS, without disabling fake-ip or setting proxy environment variables.

description.zh: DSH plugin 语音对话插件，点🎤说话，AI 回复自动语音朗读，支持转述、静音与快捷键。
description.en: A DSH plugin for voice chat: tap 🎤 to speak, AI replies are read aloud, with rewrite, mute, and hotkeys.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 ctx.web 接缝提供统一网页搜索，内置 DeepSeek、Tavily、Brave 等九大后端，可在设置中一键切换引擎。
description.en: A unified web-search provider for DeepSeek Harness's ctx.web seam, bundling nine backends (DeepSeek, Tavily, Brave, etc.) switchable from settings.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入模型提供商服务端联网搜索能力，让会话直接发起搜索并查看网页内容，显著降低 token 消耗与耗时。
description.en: Adds server-side web search to DeepSeek Harness via the model provider's own capability, letting sessions search and read page content directly with far fewer tokens and less latency.

description.zh: DSH plugin 第三方网页搜索插件，用可配置的 SearXNG、Tavily、Bing 等引擎替换官方搜索，支持抓取网页全文，让模型既能搜索也能阅读。
description.en: A DSH plugin for configurable third-party web search, replacing the official search with SearXNG, Tavily, Bing, etc., and fetching full page content for the model to read.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 打造的 Dieter Rams 风格主题，以暖纸白、细线边框与信号橙点缀重塑整套设计令牌，支持明暗双模式。
description.en: A Dieter Rams-inspired theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, remapping the whole design-token graph to warm paper whites, hairline borders and a single signal-orange accent, in both light and dark modes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 原生能力包，包含剪贴板、系统通知、hosts 文件查看与网络诊断等安全 PowerShell 工具。
description.en: Windows-native capability pack for DeepSeek Harness (DSH plugin): clipboard, notifications, hosts file inspection, and network diagnostics via safe PowerShell.

description.zh: DSH plugin 开发沙盒与体检工具：隔离 DSH_HOME 搭建开发沙箱、生成插件骨架，并对第三方插件做三阶段安全体检，不动真实配置。
description.en: A DSH plugin dev sandbox and vetting tool: isolates DSH_HOME to build dev sandboxes, scaffolds plugins, and runs 3-phase security vetting on third-party plugins without touching real config.

description.zh: DSH Workbench Layout 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供三栏工作区：左侧导航、中间文件与终端、右侧原生对话，并集成 Git 与 Markdown 编辑能力。
description.en: DSH Workbench Layout provides a three-column workspace for DeepSeek Harness Web: navigation on the left, files and terminals in the middle, and the native DSH conversation on the right, with Git and Markdown editing.

description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，登录后即可在 DSH 模型选择器里直接选用，并管理账号、积分与模型启停。
description.en: Brings WorkBuddy models into DeepSeek Harness so you can pick them right in the DSH model selector, with account, credit and per-model toggle management.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供写入内容守卫：按可配置正则规则在 edit/write 执行前拦截违规内容，并在失败后临时禁用 pwsh 防止绕过。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that blocks edit/write content matching configurable regex rules before execution and temporarily disables pwsh after a failure to prevent bypasses.

description.zh: 为 DSH 提供基于 Git worktree 的多仓库隔离工作区：每个任务在源码树之外生成独立空间，各仓库各占一个 worktree，让并行 Agent 互不冲突。
description.en: A DSH plugin that builds isolated multi-repo workspaces with Git worktrees: each task gets its own space outside the source tree, with a separate worktree per repository so parallel agents never collide.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 Zotero 技能插件，可检索本机文献库、导出 BibTeX、给 LaTeX 与 Markdown 草稿插入引用并读取附件全文。
description.en: A Zotero skill plugin for DeepSeek Harness that searches your local library, exports BibTeX, inserts citations into LaTeX and Markdown drafts, and reads attachment full text.

description.zh: DSH plugin 喜马拉雅播客插件，在 Web 界面搜索、播放、收藏专辑，支持播放条与 ximalaya_play 模型工具。
description.en: A DSH plugin for Ximalaya podcasts: search, play, and favorite albums in the web UI, with a persistent player bar and the ximalaya_play model tool.

description.zh: DSH 插件市场更新助手：一键检查并更新 dshmarket，先卸载旧版再装新版，避免市场自更新时把自己卸载掉。
description.en: A DSH plugin that safely updates the dshmarket plugin: it checks the latest npm release, uninstalls the old market, installs the new one, and verifies the version.

description.zh: free-vision-skill 是 DeepSeek Harness 的本地化识图技能，基于 macOS Vision 实现 OCR、表格提取与图像描述，图片全程不出本机。
description.en: free-vision-skill is a fully-local vision skill for DeepSeek Harness, using macOS Vision for OCR, table extraction, and image description without uploading images.

description.zh: Knotline（运筹）是 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的项目作战地图，把请求、代理、执行、评审与交付画在一张画布上，连线即触发真实可恢复的 DSH 会话执行。
description.en: Knotline is a project operations map for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, putting requests, agents, execution, review, and delivery on one canvas where a line triggers real, resumable DSH conversations.

description.zh: DSH plugin 面向数学建模与竞赛题，以 Claim→Obligation→Evidence 机制驱动验证，拒绝把“代码跑通”当结论，证据不足即返回 INCONCLUSIVE。
description.en: A DSH plugin for mathematical modeling and competitions, driven by Claim→Obligation→Evidence verification, refusing to treat 'code runs' as proof and returning INCONCLUSIVE when evidence is insufficient.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供无状态对话压缩，模拟人类遗忘曲线，让 LLM 会话消息数恒定、永不溢出上下文。
description.en: Stateless dialogue compression for DeepSeek Harness that mimics human forgetting, keeping LLM conversations bounded forever with no context overflow.

description.zh: ncm-player 是一款运行在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面中的网易云音乐浮窗播放器 DSH plugin，支持搜索、歌词、队列与扫码登录。
description.en: ncm-player is a NetEase Cloud Music floating player DSH plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, featuring search, lyrics, queue, and QR login.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 以 ACP 适配器接入 Obsidian，在笔记应用内直接发起 DSH 会话与任务，并支持会话列表、分支与归档。
description.en: An ACP adapter that bridges DeepSeek Harness (DSH) into Obsidian, letting you run DSH conversations and tasks inside your vault with session list, fork and archive support.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Endeavour 与 Challenger 一对持久配对代理，前者规划与验收、后者执行任务，通过持久协议协作，无需按任务重复创建。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pairs a persistent Endeavour planner/verifier agent with a Challenger executor chat, coordinating them through a durable protocol instead of re-spawning agents per task.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 装进手机：通过微信小程序远程下发指令、看流式输出、审批工具调用与回答问题，载荷级端到端加密，中继可自托管。
description.en: Control DeepSeek Harness from your phone via a WeChat mini program: send prompts, watch streaming output, approve tool calls and answer questions, with payload-level end-to-end encryption and a self-hostable relay.

description.zh: rolebox 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 等 Agent 框架的角色编排插件，用 YAML 定义专属角色，各自拥有提示词、模型、技能与权限，并借助图执行引擎实现多代理调度与持久记忆。
description.en: rolebox is a DSH plugin for major agent harnesses that lets you define YAML specialist roles with their own prompts, models, skills and permissions, then runs them as a team through a graph execution engine with persistent memory.

description.zh: SpecWorkflow 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一套可分享的工作流技能包，引导 Agent 从需求澄清、规格编写、执行到评审修复的完整开发路径。
description.en: SpecWorkflow is a shareable workflow skill pack for DeepSeek Harness, guiding agents through requirement grilling, spec writing, execution, review, and repair.

description.zh: widget-dock 是 DeepSeek Harness 的界面插件，在对话两侧提供网格对齐的卡片工作台，集中展示余额、Token、成本、上下文、GitHub 等 27 张小组件卡片。
description.en: widget-dock is a DSH plugin that adds a grid-aligned widget dock beside conversations, offering 27 mini-cards for balance, tokens, cost, context, GitHub, and more.

description.zh: Apify 官方 DeepSeek Harness 插件，让 DSH 直接搜索、运行并构建 Apify Actors，内置 MCP 服务器与六个技能，可抓取 15+ 平台数据。
description.en: Official Apify plugin for DeepSeek Harness that lets DSH search, run, and build Apify Actors, bundling an MCP server and six skills for scraping 15+ platforms.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Ultra Slash 插件，在会话输入框 / 菜单中提供独立的插件命令组，支持 /steer 引导模型下一步、/new 开启新会话、/skill 保存技能、/docs 生成文档，并可为常用命令设置短别名。
description.en: Ultra Slash plugin for DeepSeek Harness adds a separate plugin command group in the chat input / menu, enabling /steer to guide the model's next step, /new to start a fresh session, /skill to save skills, /docs to generate docs, and custom short aliases.

description.zh: DSH 插件：用真实 ChatGPT Pro 网页会话做可恢复的多轮调研，按判据逐轮裁决并落盘本地报告。
description.en: A DSH plugin that runs resumable multi-round research through a real ChatGPT Pro web session, judging each round against criteria and saving local reports.

description.zh: AiFP 记忆感知系统为 DeepSeek Harness 等 AI 工具提供跨会话持久记忆，支持语义纠错、感知链关联与本地私有存储，一套记忆全 AI 共享。
description.en: AiFP memory-aware system provides persistent cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness and other AI tools, with semantic correction, associative recall, and fully local private storage—one memory shared by all AIs.

description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接查看并操作 Windows 桌面软件：窗口截图、读取控件、点击填表，共 16 个工具，带会话授权与审批审计。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets DeepSeek Harness see and operate Windows desktop apps — window screenshots, UI Automation controls, mouse and keyboard input — with 16 tools plus per-session consent and approval auditing.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地图像、语音、音乐与音效生成，并记住角色与声线，让同一角色跨调用保持一致，失败结果绝不冒充成功。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness local image, speech, music and SFX generation with a memory of what it made, so the same character and voice stay consistent across calls and failed generations are never passed off as success.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 计费插件，在会话头部展示账户余额、本轮对话花费与今日总花费，消息操作栏显示每轮成本，详情面板含今日会话花费排行。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows account balance, session spend, and today's total spend in the session header, per-turn cost in the message actions, and a today session-spend ranking in the detail panel.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的钉钉渠道插件，基于官方 Stream WebSocket，无需公网回调服务器，支持文本、图片、语音转写、文件收发及完整 Agent 循环。
description.en: A DingTalk channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness, powered by official Stream WebSocket, requiring no public callback server, supporting text, image, voice transcription, file I/O, and full Agent Loop execution.

description.zh: DSH plugin 桌面壳，以 Tauri 原生窗口运行 DeepSeek Harness Web UI，提供托盘、主题同步、会话标签栏、交互终端与系统通知。
description.en: A DSH plugin desktop shell that runs the DeepSeek Harness Web UI in a native Tauri window, offering tray, theme sync, session tabs, interactive terminal, and system notifications.

description.zh: 将智谱 GLM Coding Plan 的 MCP 能力接入 DeepSeek Harness，替换内置搜索与网页读取后端，并新增三个 GitHub 仓库工具，全部可在设置卡片中开关。
description.en: Integrates Zhipu GLM Coding Plan MCP servers into DeepSeek Harness, replacing built-in search and web fetch backends, and adding three GitHub repository tools, all toggleable via settings cards.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的微信私聊渠道插件，基于腾讯官方 ClawBot/iLink 协议，支持二维码登录、文本/图片/文件收发，并复用 Harness 会话与工具执行。
description.en: A Weixin private-chat channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness, using Tencent's official ClawBot/iLink protocol with QR login, text/image/file messaging, and full Harness session/tool integration.

description.zh: DSH 生态中最好的文本编辑插件，提供撤销重做、Ctrl+S 保存、未保存确认、二进制检测与窗口几何记忆，是 dock-files 的默认文本查看器。
description.en: The best text editor plugin for DSH, offering undo/redo, Ctrl+S save, unsaved-change confirmation, binary detection, and window geometry memory; serves as the default viewer for dock-files.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 等文本模型赋予视觉能力，将图片路由至任意 OpenAI 兼容视觉服务并返回文字描述，零配置自动生效。
description.en: Give text-only models in DeepSeek Harness vision by routing images to any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint, returning text descriptions automatically.

description.zh: DSH 生态中最好的 Markdown 查看插件：GFM 渲染、DOMPurify 消毒、文档大纲、相对路径图片/链接解析，一键切换编辑，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供编辑器级 Markdown 体验。
description.en: The best Markdown viewer for DSH: GFM rendering, DOMPurify sanitization, document outline, relative image/link resolution, and one-click switch to editing, delivering editor-grade Markdown experience in DeepSeek Harness.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 ExHentai 风格的画廊皮肤，以炭黑背景、浅灰文字重塑会话列表与输入框，让 DSH plugin 界面焕然一新。
description.en: An ExHentai-inspired gallery skin for DeepSeek Harness, restyling the session list and composer with a charcoal background and light-gray text.

description.zh: dsh-adb 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 ADB 设备与台架操作能力，涵盖设备发现、logcat、APK 安装、文件传输、性能快照与一键健康报告，助力车载与台架调试。
description.en: dsh-adb gives DeepSeek Harness agents direct control over Android devices and automotive bench rigs: device discovery, logcat, APK install, file transfer, performance snapshots, and one-click health reports.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 引入 advisor 策略：执行模型跑主线，关键节点把整段会话交给更强的审查模型，取回 plan、纠偏或停止信号。
description.en: Adds an advisor strategy to DeepSeek Harness: a fast executor runs the main line while a stronger reviewer model returns plan, correction, or stop signals at key checkpoints.

description.zh: dsh-agent-canvas 是 DSH plugin，将 Agent、Subagent、Workflow 与工具调用实时渲染为可交互力导向画布，帮助用户从全局视角洞察任务拆分与调度。
description.en: dsh-agent-canvas is a DSH plugin that renders Agents, Subagents, Workflows, and tool calls as an interactive force-directed canvas, offering a global view of task decomposition and orchestration.

description.zh: dsh-agent-hub 是 DeepSeek Harness 的群聊式多智能体协作台，把多个 Agent 组织成群聊房间，由统筹大脑自主拆解、派单、验收与返工，全程可见可追溯。
description.en: dsh-agent-hub is a group-chat style multi-agent collaboration console for DeepSeek Harness, organizing agents into a room where a coordinator brain plans, dispatches, verifies and reworks tasks with full visibility.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供运行时熔断保护，识别工具调用与助手输出的重复循环并提前中断，避免 token 与 API 额度被无限重试耗尽。
description.en: A fail-closed runtime guard for DeepSeek Harness that detects and breaks repeated tool-call and assistant-output loops, preventing runaway retries from draining tokens and API credits.

description.zh: dsh-agnes 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Agnes AI 图像与视频生成工具，支持文生图、图生图、文生视频等，并带设置面板调整默认参数。
description.en: dsh-agnes is a DSH plugin that brings Agnes AI image and video generation to DeepSeek Harness, with a settings panel for defaults.

description.zh: DSH plugin 集成 AIGC Radar 精选库，在编码前主动检索成熟开源项目，以原生搜索卡片呈现结果，避免重复造轮子。
description.en: A DSH plugin that integrates the curated AIGC Radar library, proactively searching for mature open-source projects before coding, with results rendered as native search cards.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上阿拉伯语支持：按脚本占比逐块判定方向的 bidi 安全 RTL 渲染，让阿拉伯文与英文代码混排不再错乱，并提供含 3228 条文案的完整阿拉伯语界面语言包。
description.en: Adds Arabic to DeepSeek Harness: bidi-safe RTL rendering that decides direction per block by script dominance, so mixed Arabic prose and English code stop looking scrambled, plus a full Arabic UI language pack with 3,228 strings.

description.zh: dsh-asc 是 DeepSeek Harness 的上下文压缩插件，由模型自主决定何时压缩，压缩决策作为可回放、可搜索、可逆的会话日志事件持久化。
description.en: dsh-asc is a context-compaction plugin for DeepSeek Harness where the model decides when to compact, and each compaction is committed as a replayable, searchable, reversible session-log event.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供A股个股研究工具：搜索股票、解读公告、财报白话卡、估值画像与信号科普，并内置合规 skill。
description.en: A DSH plugin offering A-share stock research tools: stock search, announcement interpretation, financial plain-language cards, valuation profiles, and signal education, with a built-in compliance skill.

description.zh: dsh-ai-soul为DeepSeek Harness提供持久化灵魂层，独立于模型保存身份、记忆与关系，实现跨模型连续性。
description.en: dsh-ai-soul provides a persistent Soul layer for DeepSeek Harness, storing identity, memory, and relationships independent of the model for cross-model continuity.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为沙箱外操作提供独立模型驱动的自动审批，内置 Codex Guardian 策略，支持熔断与审计，失败时安全回退人工。
description.en: A DSH plugin that routes approval requests to a fixed reviewer model with Codex Guardian policy, circuit breaker, and fail-closed fallback to human.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自动审批能力的 DSH 插件，用关键词与审核模型判定表决定工具调用放行或拒绝，拿不准时仍交回 Web 审批弹窗由人确认。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that auto-approves or rejects tool calls using keywords and a judge-model criteria table, falling back to the original Web approval dialog when uncertain.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 替换原生 goal 的目标管理插件，保留持久目标与自动续跑，补上阻塞时立即暂停、可控提问等待与更简洁的目标操作。
description.en: A DSH plugin that replaces the native goal system with persistent goals, auto-continuation, immediate pause on blockers, and simpler goal actions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自动审批审查：需扩权的操作先交独立 Reviewer 模型判断，配合原生沙盒、拒绝熔断与 WebUI/TUI 状态提示，减少反复确认。
description.en: An auto-review approval plugin for DeepSeek Harness: operations that need elevated permissions are first judged by an independent Reviewer model, working with the native sandbox, rejection circuit breakers, and WebUI/TUI status indicators to cut down repeated confirmations.

description.zh: DSH plugin 内置自动更新插件，在设置页一键检查更新，通过退出时安装、健康校验与自动回滚实现安全升级。
description.en: A built-in auto-update plugin for DeepSeek Harness, adding a check-for-updates UI and guarded update transaction with rollback.

description.zh: DSH 插件在 shell 命令执行前拦截会等待输入或永不退出的命令，并告知模型原因与替代写法，避免回合卡死超时。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that inspects each shell command before it runs, blocking input-waiting or non-terminating calls and telling the model what to run instead.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在写入前拦截含「// ... existing code ...」等占位注释的编辑，并拒绝大幅缩水整文件写入，避免真实代码被悄悄删掉。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that blocks edits containing placeholder comments like `// ... existing code ...` and rejects whole-file writes that drop most of a large file, so real code is never silently deleted.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供 AI 音频生成能力：多厂商 TTS、音乐、音效与声音设计，支持侧边栏面板、模型对比、资源库及 Agent 工具。
description.en: AI audio generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness web GUI: multi-vendor TTS, music, sound effects and voice design with sidebar panel, model comparison, resource library and Agent tools.

description.zh: DSH plugin 的救援控制台：当插件故障导致 Web UI 无法启动时，自动识别可疑插件、临时跳过并恢复工作区，无需依赖正常加载链。
description.en: A rescue console for DSH plugin: when a broken plugin prevents the Web UI from starting, it identifies suspects, temporarily skips them, and restores the workspace without relying on the normal loading chain.

description.zh: 把命令提交为脱离 DSH 进程的后台任务，关闭 DSH 仍持续运行，并提供实时网页面板与离线 CLI/GUI 管理。
description.en: Submits commands as background jobs that keep running after DSH exits, with a live web panel plus offline CLI/GUI management.

description.zh: DSH plugin 导入 CCSwitch 的 Codex 配置，并在设置中管理每个模型的推理深度。
description.en: A DSH plugin that imports CCSwitch Codex profiles and manages per-model reasoning in settings.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供受控浏览器自动化能力，通过 agent_browser 工具驱动 agent-browser CLI 操作 Chromium，并防护失效引用、标签漂移与敏感信息泄露。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness controlled browser automation: an agent_browser tool drives the agent-browser CLI against Chromium, guarding against stale refs, tab drift and secret leakage.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上 cd 工具，让模型在会话内原地切换工作目录，使文件工具的相对路径与 bash 默认工作目录跟随新目录，按会话隔离且缓存安全。
description.en: Adds a cd tool to DeepSeek Harness so the model can switch the working directory in-session, making relative paths in file tools and the bash default workdir follow the new directory, per-session and cache-safe.

description.zh: DSH Brand Studio 是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，通过设置面板自定义网页、PWA 与桌面端共用的侧边栏品牌名称、徽章、logo 字标和页面标题，支持即时预览与一键恢复官方外观。
description.en: DSH Brand Studio is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that customizes the shared web UI branding across Web, PWA and Desktop, letting you set the sidebar name, badge, local logo and wordmark images, and page title with live preview and one-click restore.

description.zh: DSH Chat是DeepSeek Harness的群聊界面插件，在Chatrooms工作区提供房间会话、@提及投递与成员管理，支持本地及可信远程节点。
description.en: DSH Chat is a group chat UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness, offering room sessions, @-mention delivery, and member management in a Chatrooms workspace, supporting local and trusted remote nodes.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自动检测回合中断、报错或超长，宽限期后自动发送「继续」重试，无需切换模型，并自带设置卡片与防护措施。
description.en: A DSH plugin that auto-sends 'continue' after a turn is interrupted, errored, or overlong, with a grace period and safety guards, no model switching.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加任务完成提示音，后台标签页也能响铃，内置 10 种预设音效并支持自定义导入与音量调节。
description.en: Adds a task-completion chime to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, ringing even in background tabs, with 10 presets, custom sound import, and volume control.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 注入可拖拽、可喂食的咸鱼桌面宠物与工程师壁纸的 DSH plugin，纯前端展示，带来趣味陪伴。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects a draggable, feedable salted fish desktop pet and engineer wallpapers into the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, pure front-end fun.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为会话轨迹提供中文优先、零 token 消耗的分类视图，含合计面板与思维导图画布，让每次对话一目了然。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns raw trajectory into a Chinese-first, zero-token summary view with a summary panel and mind-map canvas.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 注入可拖拽、可喂食的咸鱼桌面宠物与工程师壁纸的 DSH plugin，纯前端展示，带来趣味陪伴。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects a draggable, feedable salted fish desktop pet and engineer wallpapers into the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, pure front-end fun.

description.zh: 把网页版 DeepSeek 内嵌进 DSH 桌面端侧栏面板，网页回答可一键带回 agent 会话，agent 回答也能填回网页输入框，双向搬运不耗 API 额度。
description.en: Embeds the DeepSeek web chat as a DSH desktop sidebar panel, letting you move web answers into agent sessions and agent replies back into the web input box, all without API quota.

description.zh: 为 DSH 工作区挂载跨盘符共享子目录，让会话在 workspace-write 权限下读写多根目录，无需 full-access，方便多项目开发。
description.en: Mounts shared subdirectories across drives into a DSH workspace, letting sessions read and write multiple roots under workspace-write without full access.

description.zh: Code Studio 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面提供实时文件修改监视与代码编辑：Agent 改动落盘瞬间逐行 Diff 自动浮现，内置语法高亮编辑器，可查看、编辑、还原工作区文件，无需离开浏览器。
description.en: Code Studio brings real-time file-change monitoring and code editing to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: line-by-line diffs appear the moment the agent edits files, with a syntax-highlighted editor to view, edit, and revert workspace files without leaving the browser.

description.zh: 面向编程学习者的 DSH 插件，在会话右侧悬浮窗内提供代码编辑器、多语言执行、课程关卡评判与进度笔记，代码分析可直投当前对话由主模型输出。
description.en: A DSH plugin for programming learners: a floating in-session panel with a code editor, multi-language execution, course-level grading, progress and notes, plus code analysis sent straight into the current conversation.

description.zh: 把本地 ComfyUI 接入 DeepSeek Harness 的「绘图模式」预设，提供 19 个 comfyui_* 工具，覆盖出图、LoRA 搜索下载、Danbooru 角色 tag、PNG 元数据解析与复刻自检。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) drawing-mode preset that wires your local ComfyUI into 19 comfyui_* tools covering generation, LoRA search and download, Danbooru character tags, PNG metadata parsing and reproduction checks.

description.zh: dsh-chat-nav 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web UI 提供对话问题导航栏，悬浮预览、点击跳转、自动补齐历史，提升长会话浏览效率。
description.en: dsh-chat-nav is a DSH plugin that adds a conversation navigator to the Web UI, with hover previews, click-to-jump, and auto history loading for efficient long-session browsing.

description.zh: DSH plugin 任务完成通知：任务结束时播放提示音并弹出页面内 toast 或系统通知，附带运行统计与一句话小结，纯浏览器方案零系统依赖。
description.en: A DSH plugin that plays a chime and shows a toast or system notification when a task completes, with run stats and a recap, pure browser-based with zero system dependencies.

description.zh: DSH 的 Web 界面插件，将 Composer 停靠到右侧，让长回答与详细草稿并排显示，提升长文写作效率。
description.en: A DSH Web plugin that docks the Composer to the right side, keeping long answers and detailed prompts side by side for efficient long-form writing.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来 Claude Code 同款 Concise 输出风格：composer 一键开关，结果先行少废话，每轮回答附「说人话」摘要卡，划选即复制。
description.en: Brings Claude Code's Concise output style to DeepSeek Harness: a one-click composer toggle that leads with the result, plus a plain-language digest card on every reply that copies on selection.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 Windows 提供计算机操作能力：窗口发现、UI Automation 元素定位、遮挡感知截图及安全门控的鼠标键盘输入，支持 ModLens 视觉定位。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing Windows computer use: window discovery, UI Automation element targeting, occlusion-aware screenshots, and safety-gated input with ModLens visual grounding.

description.zh: DSH plugin 会话地图，在对话区右侧渲染可拖动的代码地图，预览整段会话并快速滚动。
description.en: A DSH plugin that renders a draggable conversation minimap on the right side of the chat area, allowing quick preview and scrolling through the entire conversation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 集成腾讯云 COS 云存储，提供文件浏览、上传下载、临时链接及 AI 会话附件能力，密钥安全托管于 Host。
description.en: A DSH plugin integrating Tencent Cloud COS storage, offering file browsing, upload/download, temp links, and AI session attachments with credentials secured in Host.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设置页新增「上下文长度」面板，可按渠道与模型自定义上下文窗口与思考强度，保存后写入 settings.yaml 即时生效。
description.en: Adds a Context Length panel to the DeepSeek Harness settings page, letting you set per-provider, per-model context windows and reasoning effort levels that take effect once saved.

description.zh: DSH plugin 额度插件：跟随当前模型显示官方余额或 OpenCode Go 订阅用量，支持本会话估算、跨会话累计消耗与可视化设置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that displays account balance or OpenCode Go subscription usage following the current model, with session estimation, cross-session consumption tracking, and visual settings.

description.zh: DSH 插件，在 Web 设置页直接编辑全局 AGENTS.md 自定义指令，支持模板、历史与并发保护，对所有聊天生效。
description.en: A DSH plugin to edit global AGENTS.md custom instructions in the Web settings page, with templates, history, and concurrency protection.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话视图新增 Statistics 标签页，实时展示 token 用量、耗时、工具与技能活动统计。
description.en: Adds a Statistics tab to the DeepSeek Harness conversation view, showing live token usage, timing, and tool and skill activity.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话视图新增 Statistics 标签页，实时展示 token 用量、耗时、工具与技能活动统计。
description.en: Adds a Statistics tab to the DeepSeek Harness conversation view, showing live token usage, timing, and tool and skill activity.

description.zh: 面向企业名单的 DeepSeek Harness 数据清洗插件，可上传 CSV/XLSX/JSON 完成去重、字段补全与画像，并可选接入企查查 MCP 补全企业信息后导出。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for enterprise list cleaning: upload CSV/XLSX/JSON to dedupe, normalize, profile and enrich fields, with optional Qichacha MCP enrichment and export.

description.zh: DSH Web UI 分屏阅读插件，将 agent 消息在右侧详情栏独立滚动展示完整 markdown，支持一键开合，提升长消息阅读体验。
description.en: A DSH plugin that splits the Web UI, displaying agent messages in a right-side detail panel with independent scrolling for full markdown, toggled with one click.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧边栏实时显示 DeepSeek 与 MiMo 平台余额、消费与 Token 用量的 DSH 插件，支持每 30 秒自动刷新与一键更新。
description.en: A DSH plugin that displays real-time balance, usage and token consumption for DeepSeek and MiMo platforms in the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar, with auto-refresh every 30 seconds and one-click updates.

description.zh: DSH 本地工具箱插件，提供侧边栏页面、/toolbox 命令及配置驱动的 agent 工具，内置 52 个纯本地小工具，数据不出本机。
description.en: A DSH plugin offering a local toolbox with sidebar page, /toolbox command, and config-driven agent tools, featuring 52 local utilities that keep data on-device.

description.zh: DevEco CLI 将 HarmonyOS 开发工具链封装为统一命令行，内置 ohpm、hvigor、hdc 等，并作为 DSH plugin 注册 deveco_cli 工具，支持项目脚手架、文档检索与 MCP 服务。
description.en: DevEco CLI wraps the HarmonyOS toolchain into a unified CLI with ohpm, hvigor, hdc, etc., and as a DSH plugin registers the deveco_cli tool for scaffolding, doc search, and MCP.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在设置-模型-DeepSeek 卡片内集成余额与用量监控，并在输入框工具行显示实时余额 chip，助你随时掌握账户消耗。
description.en: A DSH plugin that embeds balance and usage monitoring into the Settings-Models-DeepSeek card, plus a live balance chip in the composer tool row.

description.zh: DSH plugin 钉钉群机器人通知插件，让 agent 单向推送 Markdown 或纯文本消息到钉钉群，支持 HMAC 加签，零依赖全平台。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DingTalk group robot notifications, enabling agents to push Markdown or plain text messages one-way with HMAC signing, zero-dependency and cross-platform.

description.zh: DSH plugin 容器管理工具集，提供 docker_ps/images/logs/inspect/exec/manage 六个工具，走官方 subprocess 服务、argv 无 shell 注入、exec 审批门，零运行时依赖。
description.en: DSH plugin container management toolkit offering six tools (docker_ps/images/logs/inspect/exec/manage) via official subprocess service, argv without shell injection, exec approval gate, zero runtime dependencies.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加悬浮钱包卡片，实时显示 DeepSeek API 余额、今日消费与当前对话费用，并在模型思考时播放钞票飞舞动画。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a floating wallet card to the web GUI, showing DeepSeek API balance, today's consumption and live conversation cost, with banknotes flying while the agent thinks.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的灵动岛玻璃伴侣，实时呈现 Agent 思考、工具调用、审批与完成状态，零依赖、低打扰。
description.en: A Liquid Glass Dynamic Island for DeepSeek Harness, surfacing agent thinking, tool calls, approvals, and completion in a zero-dependency, low-disturbance overlay.

description.zh: DSH 插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 VS Code 风格代码编辑器，内置文件树、Monaco 编辑器、跨文件搜索替换、Markdown 预览与 Git diff。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings a VS Code-style code editor to DeepSeek Harness, featuring file tree, Monaco editor, cross-file search/replace, Markdown preview, and Git diff.

description.zh: dupguard 是 DeepSeek Harness 的实时重复输出守卫，模型复读时立即停止生成，已生成内容正常提交，并提供图形化设置页调整阈值与白名单。
description.en: dupguard is a real-time repetition guard for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that halts generation the moment the model starts looping, commits the text already produced, and exposes a graphical settings page for thresholds and whitelists.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供教育模式：DSH 插件会搜集权威资料、系统讲解知识点、写入课程笔记并用测验检验你的理解。
description.en: An education mode for DeepSeek Harness: this DSH plugin gathers authoritative sources, teaches a subject properly, writes course notes, and quizzes you before claiming you have learned it.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供电脑环境自检面板：实时探测监听端口并一键安全释放，展示 CLI 工具链版本、模型凭据存在性与已加载 DSH 插件。
description.en: A DSH plugin that audits your machine: live port inspection with one-click safe release, plus CLI toolchain versions, model credential presence and loaded DSH plugins.

description.zh: dsh-envsel 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按会话选择 Python、R 与 CLI 环境的插件，支持 conda、独立 R、WSL 及自定义路径，通过 /env 命令、session_env 工具与头部下拉菜单管理。
description.en: dsh-envsel is a DSH plugin for per-session environment selection of Python, R, and CLI slots from conda, standalone R, WSL, or custom paths, managed via /env, session_env, and a header dropdown.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供事实核查技能：不依赖模型记忆，通过国内外多源并行检索、对抗式复查与可溯源引用，输出结论先行的核查报告。
description.en: A fact-checking skill for DeepSeek Harness that verifies claims against the open web rather than model memory, using parallel domestic and international multi-source cross-checking, adversarial re-search, and fully traceable, conclusion-first reports.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 web 会话输入框增加拖入/粘贴/上传按钮附加文件能力：文档落盘到工作区并插入 @ 引用，图片走草稿流程，多文件批量处理。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets you attach files to the web chat input via drag-and-drop, paste, or an upload button: documents are saved to the workspace with @ references, images follow the draft flow, and multiple files are handled in batch.

description.zh: DSH plugin 会话收藏夹：把任意会话星标收藏，用文件夹分类、备注与自定义名称管理，并支持继续会话、Fork 派生、统计与 fork 关系图。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns any session into a starred favorite, organized in folders with notes and custom names, plus resume, fork, stats and a fork lineage graph.

description.zh: dsh-fleet 是 DSH 多机算力组网插件，将朋友、局域网及云上 ECS 的闲置算力汇聚成分布式 AI 算力池，支持任务派发与多团队管理。
description.en: dsh-fleet is a DSH plugin for multi-machine compute pooling, aggregating idle compute from friends, LAN, and cloud ECS into a distributed AI compute pool, supporting task dispatch and multi-team management.

description.zh: 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的家庭助手 DSH plugin，为多位长辈各自绑定微信，提供独立对话、提醒、个性化日报与 Owner 工作台。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness family-assistant DSH plugin that binds each elder to their own WeChat for independent chats, reminders, personalized daily briefings, and an owner console.

description.zh: DSH 插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供接近原生质感的附件上传，支持拖入、粘贴、回形针，图片与文件混排显示。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings native-feeling attachment upload to DeepSeek Harness, supporting drag-in, paste, and paperclip, with mixed image and file display.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供专注模式：全屏阅读视图，隐藏标题与输入区，将 AI 工具调用折叠为摘要，只保留对话本身。
description.en: Focus mode for DeepSeek Harness: fullscreen reading view, hides title and input areas, collapses AI tool calls into summaries, keeping only the conversation.

description.zh: dsh-forge 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自托管 Gitea/Forgejo 的只读工具，可读取仓库、议题、PR 与 Actions 上下文。
description.en: dsh-forge adds read-only tools for self-hosted Gitea/Forgejo to DeepSeek Harness, exposing repository, issue, PR, and Actions context.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek 模型桥接 Gemini 多模态能力，自动路由视觉识别、图像生成与编辑，并带自检闭环，无需手动切换模型。
description.en: A DSH plugin bridging DeepSeek with Gemini multimodal capabilities, auto-routing vision, image generation and editing with self-check loop, no manual model switching.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 vercel-labs/skills 开放技能生态接入 DeepSeek Harness，让 LLM 自主搜索、安装并管理临时/项目/全局作用域的技能。
description.en: A DSH plugin bridging the vercel-labs/skills ecosystem, enabling LLM-driven skill search, install, and lifecycle management for temp/project/global scopes.

description.zh: dsh-git-gui 是 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的 Git 图形界面插件，在浏览器中查看、暂存、提交和还原项目变更，并实时展示 Agent 对工作区文件的每次修改。
description.en: dsh-git-gui is a Git GUI plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, enabling view, stage, commit, and revert of project changes in the browser, with real-time visibility into every Agent modification.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Review 标签页与围栏式 Git 工作台，用文件树、差异对比和提交图呈现 Agent 改动，并支持带确认保护的暂存、提交、分支与冲突处理。
description.en: A Review tab and fenced git workbench for DeepSeek Harness: file tree, diffs and commit graph for agent changes, with guarded stage, commit, branch and conflict operations.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 GitHub 仓库与 issue 检索、详情及文件读取工具，匿名可用，可选只读 token 解锁代码搜索。
description.en: A DSH plugin that equips DeepSeek Harness with GitHub repository and issue search, detail retrieval, and file reading tools, anonymous by default with optional read-only token for code search.

description.zh: dsh-github-router 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供只读 GitHub 访问，通过多路由（API、gh CLI、git 协议、页面 HTML、镜像）加载 PR、Issue、文件与 API 数据，避免代理/TLS 失败。
description.en: dsh-github-router provides read-only GitHub access for DeepSeek Harness, loading PRs, issues, files, and API data through multi-route fallback (API, gh CLI, git protocol, page HTML, mirrors) to avoid proxy/TLS failures.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 设置页新增「全局指令」分区，直接编辑用户全局指令文件 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md，免去手动翻找 .dsh 目录。
description.en: Adds a Global instructions section to the DeepSeek Harness Web settings UI so you can edit the user-global ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md file directly, no manual digging into the .dsh folder.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为会话界面新增 Git tab，展示仓库概况、文件状态、提交历史、分支图与贡献日历，并支持暂存、提交、推送、拉取及在 macOS 终端打开仓库或启动代理 app。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding a Git tab to the conversation UI, showing repo overview, file status, commit history, branch graph, and contribution calendar, with staging, commit, push, pull, and macOS terminal/agent launching.

description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供实时X(Twitter)搜索、作者画像、趋势与事实核查工具套件，基于SuperGrok OAuth认证。
description.en: Real-time X (Twitter) search, author profiling, trends, and fact-checking tool suite powered by SuperGrok OAuth for DeepSeek Harness.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 引入 Goal Mode：把复杂目标拆成里程碑并自主多轮推进，顶部常驻横幅实时显示进度、耗时与暂停/恢复控制。
description.en: Adds Goal Mode to DeepSeek Harness: it decomposes complex objectives into milestones, drives autonomous multi-turn execution, and shows a sticky banner with live progress, elapsed time, and pause/resume controls.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在模型动手前先问清目标、交付物与验收标准，把模糊需求整理成可确认的任务说明，减少返工。
description.en: A DSH plugin that asks clarifying questions before the model starts, turning vague requests into a confirmable task sheet to cut rework.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 输入框加上「长按说话」语音输入：按住鼠标说话、浮层边说边出字，松手即写入草稿，识别由本机 SenseVoice 离线完成，免密钥、音频不出本机。
description.en: Hold-to-talk voice input for the DeepSeek Harness web composer: hold the mouse on the input box, speak with a live overlay transcript, and release to drop the text into the draft — offline local SenseVoice ASR, no API key, audio never leaves the machine.

description.zh: DSH plugin 配置迁移工具：将本机 DSH 配置打包为 .dshmig 文件，在另一台 Windows 上还原为新 profile，全程校验并自动回滚。
description.en: A DSH plugin that packages local DSH config into a .dshmig file and restores it as a new profile on another Windows machine, with validation and automatic rollback.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Claude Code 风格的 hooks，通过 .dsh/hooks.json 在智能体与工具生命周期事件上运行 shell 命令，支持热重载与子代理触发。
description.en: Claude Code style hooks for DeepSeek Harness: run shell commands on agent/tool lifecycle events via .dsh/hooks.json, with hot reload and subagent support.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 dsh web 界面换上首页同款深海流体、点线网格与数字鲸鱼背景，支持深浅双主题，让 DSH plugin 界面更具沉浸感。
description.en: Give the dsh web interface the DeepSeek Harness homepage background with deep-sea fluid, dot-line grid, and digital whale, supporting light and dark themes.

description.zh: 把 JetBrains 式 IDE 工作台搬进 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏，集成项目树、编辑器、Git 提交、Diff 与真实终端，并与聊天同屏协作。
description.en: Brings a JetBrains-style IDE workbench into the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, with project tree, editor, Git commit, diff and a real terminal working side by side with chat.

description.zh: dsh-im-hub 是 DeepSeek Harness 的多平台 IM 网关插件，将 DSH agent 接入飞书、企业微信和 Telegram，支持白名单访问、多轮上下文与空闲回收，无需公网端点。
description.en: dsh-im-hub is a multi-platform IM gateway plugin for DeepSeek Harness, connecting your DSH agent to Feishu, WeCom, and Telegram with whitelist access, multi-turn context, and no public endpoint required.

description.zh: DSH plugin 图片查看器，提供缩放、原图下载、图库浏览与区域标注，可独立卸载，增强 DeepSeek Harness 的图片查看体验。
description.en: A DSH plugin image viewer with zoom, original download, gallery browsing and region annotation, independently uninstallable, enhancing image viewing in DeepSeek Harness.

description.zh: DSH plugin 无痕会话插件，一键开启独立临时子 Agent，完全隔离上下文与工作目录，关闭即焚毁，主会话零记录、磁盘零痕迹。
description.en: DSH plugin for incognito sessions: launch an isolated temporary sub-agent with no inherited context, isolated workspace, and self-destruct on close, leaving no trace in the main session or disk.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通过 MCP 驱动真实 Jiey 浏览器，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供打开、导航、快照、读取、操作、截图等浏览器自动化工具。
description.en: DSH plugin that drives real Jiey Browser over MCP, giving DeepSeek Harness browser automation tools like open, navigate, snapshot, read, act, and screenshot.

description.zh: DSH 常驻插件，在侧边栏 Dock 中统一查看、启动与停止本机 dsh 实例，并支持连接受信任的远程实例。
description.en: A DSH resident plugin providing a sidebar Dock to view, start, and stop local dsh instances, with support for trusted remote peers.

description.zh: DSH plugin 洞察面板，只读展示 DeepSeek Harness 配置的构成：每个插件、服务、工具和模型的来源、配置层归属及运行状态。
description.en: A read-only insight panel for DeepSeek Harness profiles, showing where every plugin, service, tool and model came from, which config layer inserted or disabled it, and what is running now.

description.zh: Kimi WebBridge 插件包为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 15 个原生浏览器工具，让 Agent 在用户真实浏览器中导航、点击、截图、执行 JS 并上传文件。
description.en: Kimi WebBridge plugin bundle gives DeepSeek Harness 15 native browser tools, letting agents navigate, click, screenshot, run JS, and upload files in the user's real browser.

description.zh: 拾页是 DSH plugin，把网页、文本与字幕采集到本地资料库，按分类专题整理，供 Agent 检索引用并生成带来源的知识笔记。
description.en: Shiye is a local-first DSH plugin that captures web pages, text and subtitles into a personal library, organizes them by category and topic, and lets the Agent search, cite and turn them into sourced notes.

description.zh: DSH plugin 配置驱动的开发任务编排插件，支持多工作流管理、任务绑定执行、阶段进度可视化与断点续跑，助你高效推进开发流程。
description.en: Config-driven development-task orchestration plugin for DeepSeek Harness: manage workflows, bind tasks, visualize stage progress, and resume from checkpoints.

description.zh: dsh-jenkins 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Jenkins 管理插件，集中配置多台服务器与任务，支持一键触发构建、实时跟踪队列与结果、查看日志并停止构建，界面中英双语。
description.en: dsh-jenkins is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for Jenkins management, centralizing multiple servers and jobs, enabling one-click build triggering, real-time status tracking, log viewing, and build cancellation with a bilingual UI.

description.zh: KolmoPDF 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供高保真 PDF 解析、翻译与格式转换工具，支持 API 密钥持久化与 CLI 配置。
description.en: KolmoPDF tools for DeepSeek Harness: high-fidelity PDF parsing, translation, and format conversion with durable API-key settings and CLI configuration.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接入飞书/Lark，让机器人在私聊或群聊里跑任务、看图片文件、设提醒，并在卡片中实时同步进度。
description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness into Lark/Feishu so your bot can run tasks, read images and files, and set reminders, with live progress cards in chat.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 Lead 模式的 DSH plugin：内置预设与工作方法 skill，让模型像 Lead 一样拆分、委派并验收任务，并自检依赖、提醒启用官方 Agent Teams。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a Lead mode to DeepSeek Harness: a preset plus a working-method skill so the model splits, delegates and accepts work like a Lead, with a dependency self-check and reminders to enable the official Agent Teams.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供零配置 lint 反馈闭环：编辑后自动注入新增诊断，并用 lint_repair 只修复本轮引入的回归问题，历史债务不打扰。
description.en: A zero-config lint feedback loop for DeepSeek Harness: after each edit it injects only newly introduced diagnostics and uses lint_repair to fix just this turn's regressions, leaving pre-existing debt alone.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加液态玻璃效果，一键让整个界面通透，支持透明度滑杆与自定义全页背景，让 Agent 住进风景里。
description.en: Add liquid glass to DeepSeek Harness: one toggle makes the whole shell translucent, with an opacity slider and custom full-page background.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面 Web 界面加一层带密码门禁的反向代理，默认自签名 HTTPS 与二维码，让手机等局域网设备安全访问官方 UI。
description.en: A gated reverse proxy DSH plugin that safely exposes the desktop DeepSeek Harness Web UI to your LAN with password auth, self-signed HTTPS and QR access.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的本地自维护记忆库：对话与决策写入单个 SQLite，夜间巡逻去重合并、时间衰减、冲突检测并构建知识图谱，七路信号 RRF 混合召回。
description.en: A self-tending local memory base for DeepSeek Harness: conversations and decisions land in one SQLite file, then a nightly patrol dedupes, merges, decays, flags conflicts and builds a knowledge graph, with seven-signal RRF hybrid recall.

description.zh: dsh-live-canvas 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供交互式浏览器画布，实时预览 HTML、React 组件、SVG 与图表，支持 SSE 热重载，并集成代码编辑器、时间旅行调试与一键部署等 30 个 Agent 工具。
description.en: dsh-live-canvas brings an interactive in-browser canvas to DeepSeek Harness for real-time preview of HTML, React components, SVGs, and diagrams with SSE hot-reload, plus code editor, time-travel debugging, and 30 Agent tools.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让纯文本 LLM（DeepSeek）能“看见”图片：自动将聊天中的图像路由到视觉模型（Qwen3-VL）生成描述，再交给 DeepSeek 继续对话，实现多模态体验。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets text-only LLMs (DeepSeek) "see" images: automatically routes image attachments to a vision model (Qwen3-VL) for description, then feeds the text to DeepSeek to continue the conversation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy 账号模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，通过本地代理免 API Key 使用，并实时显示登录状态。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy models into DeepSeek Harness via a local proxy, no API key needed, with live login status widget.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 输入卡添加 kube.io 液态玻璃折射效果，含五层玻璃质感与弹簧按压动画，仅 Chromium 浏览器可见折射。
description.en: Adds a kube.io liquid-glass refraction effect to the DSH Web GUI input card, with five glass layers and springy press animation; refraction visible only in Chromium browsers.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供零依赖本地 Bing 网页搜索工具，无需 API key 即可抓取并解析标题、链接与摘要，web_search 报 403 时可直接顶上。
description.en: A zero-dependency local Bing web search tool for DeepSeek Harness that needs no API key, fetching and parsing titles, links and snippets when web_search returns 403.

description.zh: DSH plugin 本地向量记忆插件：本地 embedding 向量化、SQLite 存储、自动召回注入、冲突检测与回收站，实现完全本地化的长期记忆管理。
description.en: A DSH plugin for fully local vector memory: local embeddings, SQLite storage, automatic recall injection, conflict detection, and recycle bin.

description.zh: dsh-markdown-preview 是 DeepSeek Harness 的插件，让生成文件在对话内直接预览，支持 Markdown 渲染、代码高亮与图片预览，无需打开系统应用。
description.en: dsh-markdown-preview is a DSH plugin that renders produced files inline in chat, with Markdown rendering, code highlighting, and image preview, no native app needed.

description.zh: DSH plugin 数学建模竞赛论文全自动撰写流水线：粘贴赛题后以 /loopbegin 触发，八步多轮迭代、专家子智能体质疑驱动，自动产出可提交的 Markdown 定稿论文。
description.en: A DSH plugin that automates mathematical modeling competition paper writing: paste the problem, trigger with /loopbegin, and an 8-step iterative pipeline with expert subagents produces a final Markdown paper.

description.zh: DSH 插件自动读取仓库中已有的 Cursor、Copilot、Windsurf 等 AI 规则文件，按各工具原意注入上下文，让 DeepSeek Harness 遵循团队既有约定。
description.en: A DSH plugin that loads the Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf and other AI rule files already in your repo, feeding them to DeepSeek Harness with each tool's intended scoping.

description.zh: Loom（织机）是 DeepSeek Harness 的可验证演进控制面，让插件组合像事务一样原子升级、验证与回滚，实现受控自演进。
description.en: Loom is a verifiable evolution control plane for DeepSeek Harness, treating plugin combinations as atomic, verifiable, and recoverable transactions for controlled self-evolution.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏集中管理 MCP 服务器：查看连接状态、一键启停与删除，支持从官方目录搜索、AI 安装、手动添加或从其他客户端导入。
description.en: Manage MCP servers inside DeepSeek Harness from a sidebar console: view status, toggle and remove servers, and add them via the official registry, AI, manual config, or imports from other clients.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上 Agent 循环守卫：当模型只叙述下一步动作却没调用工具时，自动追问并续跑该轮，避免半成品被误判完成。
description.en: A DSH plugin that guards the agent loop: when the model narrates its next action without calling a tool, it steers the same turn to run one more step instead of closing as completed.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供简洁优雅的 MCP 工具管理器，在设置里添加服务器、填写请求头、测试连通性并逐工具开关，停用的工具不注册进模型、不占上下文。
description.en: A clean, elegant MCP tool manager for DeepSeek Harness: add servers in settings, fill request headers Postman-style, test connectivity, and toggle each tool so disabled ones never register into the model.

description.zh: dsh-mcp-view 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面添加一个 MCP 工具面板，按服务器分组展示所有 MCP 工具，含 JSON schema、实时搜索与真实会话日志中的最近使用时间。
description.en: dsh-mcp-view adds an MCP tools panel to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, listing every MCP server and tool grouped by server, with JSON schemas, live search, and last-used times from real session logs.

description.zh: dsh-mem 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话持久化记忆，通过 memory_save/recall/forget/list 工具将事实与偏好存储到本地 JSON 文件。
description.en: dsh-mem gives DeepSeek Harness durable cross-session memory via memory_save/recall/forget/list tools persisting facts and preferences to a local JSON file.

description.zh: DSH plugin将Markdown文件实时渲染为思维导图，AI编辑文档，右侧面板即时更新，支持缩放、导出图片等。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns Markdown files into live mindmaps, with AI editing and real-time panel updates, zoom, and PNG export.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化、可搜索的项目记忆：决策、规则与会话上下文存入 DuckDB，规则注入每次模型请求，并提供 Web 管理界面。
description.en: Persistent, searchable per-project memory for DeepSeek Harness: decisions, rules, and session context in DuckDB, with rules injected into every model request and a full management UI.

description.zh: dsh-model 把 WorkBuddy、Codex、Kimi 等多家模型来源汇成一个 OpenAI 兼容地址，DeepSeek Harness 与其他软件填同一地址和 key 即可调用全部模型。
description.en: dsh-model merges multiple model sources such as WorkBuddy, Codex and Kimi behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, so DeepSeek Harness and other tools use every model with a single address and key.

description.zh: dsh-mnemos 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供受管控、自进化、跨会话的记忆能力，所有写入经审批门控，数据本地存储于 SQLite 并同步至 git。
description.en: dsh-mnemos gives DeepSeek Harness governed, self-evolving, cross-session memory with approval-gated writes, local SQLite storage, and git-versioned sync.

description.zh: DSH plugin 移动端 UI 适配插件，提供抽屉导航、安全区适配、玻璃卡片设计与版本兼容检测，为 DeepSeek Harness 带来原生移动端体验。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adapts DeepSeek Harness for mobile with overlay drawer, safe-area support, glassmorphism cards, and compatibility detection.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供多供应商真实账户余额显示，在模型选择器前展示余额胶囊，切换模型即时刷新。
description.en: Displays real account balances from multiple providers in the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, showing a balance pill before the model selector with instant refresh on model switch.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 DeepSeek Harness 变成手机上的完整 PWA：安全远程访问、添加到主屏、离线可用、触屏手势与任务完成推送。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns DeepSeek Harness into a full mobile PWA: secure remote access, install-to-homescreen, offline support, touch gestures, and agent-done push.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通过 WebDriverAgent 驱动 iOS 模拟器，提供截图、点击、找元素、打开 URL 等移动自动化能力，让 agent 直接操控手机。
description.en: A DSH plugin that drives iOS simulators via WebDriverAgent, enabling screenshots, taps, element lookup, and URL opening for mobile automation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自动同步 llm-pi-ai 提供商路由的模型目录与 pi.dev 网关，通过官方 settings 接口零补丁写入配置，支持定时刷新与变更报告。
description.en: A DSH plugin that keeps llm-pi-ai provider routes' model catalog in sync with the pi.dev gateway, writing via the official settings seam with zero patches, supporting scheduled refresh and change reports.

description.zh: DSH 模型选择器增强插件：一级菜单快速选模型与思考档位，支持自定义模型别名，并实时显示高峰低谷计价倒计时。
description.en: Enhanced model selector for DSH: quick model and thinking-tier selection in one menu, custom model aliases, and peak/off-peak pricing countdown.

description.zh: dsh-monitor 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久后台监视器，监听文件或命令输出，新内容到达时自动唤醒代理并注入消息，是 Claude Code Monitor 的替代方案。
description.en: dsh-monitor arms persistent background watchers on files or command output for DeepSeek Harness, waking the agent with new content—a drop-in replacement for Claude Code's Monitor.

description.zh: dsh-mqtt 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 MQTT 协议驱动，将 DSH 进程变为可通过 MQTT 寻址的 Agent worker 网关，支持提交任务、注入上下文、取消与接收结果。
description.en: dsh-mqtt is an MQTT protocol driver and agent worker gateway for DeepSeek Harness, turning a DSH process into an MQTT-addressable agent worker for submitting work, injecting context, canceling, and receiving results.

description.zh: dsh-msg-rewind 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话回退命令，支持 /undo、/rewind 及可视化回退，截断模型上下文与可见记录，并持久化重写 JSONL 文件，重启后依然生效。
description.en: dsh-msg-rewind adds conversation rewind commands to DeepSeek Harness, including /undo, /rewind, and visual rewind, truncating model context and visible transcript while durably rewriting the JSONL artifact.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 主脑提供多模型编排能力：复杂任务自动拆解，按各路由特长分派给 GLM、Kimi、Qwen 等子代理模型，并统计每个模型的 token 用量。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns the main brain into a multi-model orchestrator: it decomposes complex tasks, dispatches subtasks to the best-fit sub-agent route (GLM / Kimi / Qwen or any OpenAI-compatible provider), and tracks per-model token usage.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏底部提供多 provider 用量与余额玻璃卡片，跟随当前会话模型自动切换，展示 5h/7d 剩余额度与账户余额。
description.en: A glass-style quota and balance card for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar footer, auto-switching with the current session model to show 5h/7d remaining quota and account balances across 11 providers.

description.zh: 墨言是一款 DeepSeek Harness 插件，在 WebUI 左下角安静展示一句名言、古诗词或游戏台词，语料可自定义，风格克制不喧宾夺主。
description.en: Moyan is a DSH plugin that quietly displays a quote, poem, or game line in the bottom-left of the WebUI, with customizable corpus and a restrained style.

description.zh: dsh-my-go 是构建于 DeepSeek Harness 之上的智能体编排系统，以星型拓扑调度 Sisyphus 主会话与 7 个专业子智能体，按任务难度分配工种、单线阻塞审查，实现按量付费。
description.en: dsh-my-go is an agent orchestration system built on DeepSeek Harness, using star topology to coordinate the Sisyphus main session with 7 specialized subagents, assigning tasks by difficulty with single-line blocking review for pay-as-you-go efficiency.

description.zh: DSH plugin 负面知识账本，记录被证伪的路径（失败命令、缺失文件等），依据证据自动失效，防止 Agent 重复踩坑。
description.en: A DSH plugin negative-knowledge ledger that records disproven paths (failed commands, missing files) and auto-invalidates based on evidence, preventing agents from repeating mistakes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供可切换的液态玻璃主题，让顶栏、侧边栏、输入框与会话面板变成磨砂玻璃浮层，关闭后即恢复原生界面。
description.en: A switchable liquid-glass theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, turning the header, sidebar, composer and conversation pads into frosted glass panes over a fluid backdrop, with the stock UI restored once disabled.

description.zh: 为 DSH plugin 的输入框加上 shell 风格的提示词历史回溯：空输入框按 ↑ 逐条回看、按 ↓ 前进，历史按工作区隔离并持久化。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds shell-style prompt history recall to the composer: press ↑ in an empty composer to walk back through past prompts and ↓ to walk forward, with history isolated per workspace and persisted to disk.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的唯一 shell 执行器换成 Windows 原生 Niubash，并预检拒绝 PowerShell/CMD 方言，教会模型写 Bash。
description.en: Replaces DeepSeek Harness's only shell executor with Windows-native Niubash, pre-screens PowerShell/CMD dialect slips, and teaches the model to write Bash.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在聊天界面左侧添加消息指针导轨，点击短横条即可跳转到对应用户消息，悬停显示预览气泡，支持键盘快捷键与拖拽快速滚动。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a vertical message pointer rail to the chat area, allowing quick jump to user messages via clickable dash markers, with hover preview bubbles and keyboard shortcuts.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供工作区级便签画布：框选会话内容一键存为 Markdown 便签，可 AI 提炼，并以结构化引用发回模型处理。
description.en: A workspace-level noteboard canvas for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): capture selected conversation text as Markdown sticky notes, optionally AI-distilled, and send them back to the model as structured references.

description.zh: DSH 通知插件，在 Web GUI 设置页新增通知分区，实现事件驱动的声音提醒与企业微信/飞书消息推送。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a notification section to the Web GUI settings, enabling event-driven sound alerts and WeCom/Feishu message push.

description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面端提供 Windows 原生 toast 通知与分场景提示音，会话结束、出错或等待你确认时及时提醒，点击即可唤回窗口。
description.en: Windows toast notifications and per-situation sounds for the DSH desktop app, alerting you when a session finishes, fails or waits on you, with click-to-focus.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 原生通知，任务完成或需要输入时弹出 toast 并闪烁任务栏。
description.en: DSH plugin adds native Windows toast and taskbar flash notifications to DeepSeek Harness when tasks finish or input is needed.

description.zh: 小说工坊是 DSH plugin，在时间线上写小说：作品绑定会话，由 Agent 生成章节正文、大纲与世界快照。
description.en: Novel Studio is a DSH plugin for writing novels along a timeline, binding each work to a session where the agent generates chapters, outlines and world snapshots.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体补上 Word/Excel 读写能力，纯 JS 免装 Office 即可读取、查询、新建、编辑 docx/xlsx 并套打模板、转换格式。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives AI agents native Word/Excel read and write tools — pure JavaScript, no Office install needed, covering docx/xlsx reading, querying, creation, editing, template filling and format conversion.

description.zh: DSH OAuth Bridge 通过浏览器 OAuth 将 ChatGPT Codex 与 Gemini Code Assist 订阅接入 DeepSeek Harness，免 API Key，在 Web UI 中完成登录与动态挂载 provider。
description.en: DSH OAuth Bridge integrates ChatGPT Codex and Gemini Code Assist subscriptions into DeepSeek Harness via browser OAuth, no API keys needed, with login and dynamic provider mounting in the web UI.

description.zh: 为 DSH plugin 提供会说话的任务完成通知：Windows TTS 语音播报，空闲门等子代理全部结束才播报，避免误报完成。
description.en: A DSH plugin that speaks task-completion notifications on Windows via local TTS, with an idle gate that waits for all subagents to finish before announcing done.

description.zh: 用「哦鲸鲸」形象替换 DeepSeek Harness 智能体团队面板成员行的状态图标，纯 CSS 皮肤实现，不注册槽位、不改官方组件，装完刷新即见效果。
description.en: Replaces the status icons in the DeepSeek Harness agent team panel member rows with the "ohjingjing" whale character, delivered as a pure CSS skin that registers no slots and patches no official components.

description.zh: DSH plugin 原生终端 TUI，保留滚动回看，支持自主视觉子代理、图片直贴、行内审批与状态栏，让 DeepSeek Harness 在终端中高效交互。
description.en: A native terminal TUI for DeepSeek Harness, preserving scrollback, with autonomous vision subagent, inline image paste, inline approval, and status bar for efficient terminal interaction.

description.zh: 把 DSH 右侧侧边栏变成小说阅读器，并为 AI 提供读写正文、提纲、人物与设定的工具，边对话边看小说成形。
description.en: Turns the DSH right sidebar into a real novel reader and gives the AI tools to read and edit chapters, outlines, characters and settings as the story takes shape.

description.zh: DSH plugin 的 OneBot v11 适配器，支持 HTTP 与正向/反向 WebSocket，将 QQ 等平台消息接入 DeepSeek Harness 智能体。
description.en: OneBot v11 adapter for DSH, supporting HTTP and forward/reverse WebSocket to connect messaging platforms to DeepSeek Harness agents.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenAI Sign in with ChatGPT 的社区 LLM provider 插件，用 ChatGPT 订阅额度直接调用模型。
description.en: A community LLM provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that connects via OpenAI Sign in with ChatGPT, letting DSH call models with your ChatGPT plan.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中通过兼容协议接入 OpenCode 免费模型，自动同步模型列表并支持流式输出、工具调用与可选代理故障切换。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings OpenCode free models into DeepSeek Harness via a compatible client protocol, with automatic model list sync, streaming, tool calls and optional proxy failover.

description.zh: DSH plugin 配置型组合包，让 DeepSeek Harness 父会话通过原生订阅登录，将独立任务委托给 Claude Code 与 GitHub Copilot CLI 的 Gemini。
description.en: A config-only DSH plugin bundle that lets a DeepSeek Harness parent delegate standalone tasks to Claude Code and Gemini via native subscription logins.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 输入框带来 Cherry Studio 式粘贴：长代码或文本自动折叠为带语言标签的可折叠卡片，支持卡内编辑、一键删除，发送时还原为围栏代码块。
description.en: Cherry Studio-style pasting for DeepSeek Harness Web: long code or text collapses into a collapsible, language-tagged card with in-card editing, one-click removal, and fenced-code restore on send.

description.zh: 面向 PDF 的 DeepSeek Harness 编辑插件，用自然语言改文字并锁定原版式，支持批量替换、换版式与插入新页，中文与大文件处理友好。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for PDF editing: rewrite text via natural language while locking the original layout, with batch replacement, layout switching and page insertion for Chinese and large files.

description.zh: 为 DSH 的 dsh-TUI 提示行加上峰谷计费时钟、实时 DeepSeek 余额与单轮花费，并提供 /hist 令牌历史网格。
description.en: Adds a peak/off-peak billing clock, live DeepSeek balance and per-turn cost to the dsh-TUI prompt line, plus a /hist token-history grid.

description.zh: DSH plugin 峰谷计费闸门：高峰时段发送前确认，可静音或排队至空闲时段半价自动发送，并支持拖拽悬浮队列窗口管理待发消息。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gates sends during peak pricing hours with confirmation, optional mute, and queueing to off-peak half-price auto-send, plus a draggable floating queue window.

description.zh: DSH plugin 像素皮肤（Agent Xi 风格），为 DeepSeek Harness 提供四款像素主题一键切换，并可随时回到现代默认 UI。
description.en: A DSH plugin pixel skin (Agent Xi style) that brings four pixel themes to DeepSeek Harness with one-click switching and easy return to the modern default UI.

description.zh: dsh-pixluna 将 PixLuna 图片获取能力移植为 DeepSeek Harness 插件，注册模型可调用的工具，支持多图源、R18 控制与 Pixiv 集成。
description.en: dsh-pixluna ports PixLuna's image fetching capability into a DeepSeek Harness plugin, registering model-callable tools with multi-source support, R18 control, and Pixiv integration.

description.zh: persona-forge 是一款 DSH plugin，能把导出的聊天记录蒸馏成可扮演的人设，让 AI 用对方的语气说话，并支持直接对话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that distills exported chat logs into a playable persona, letting the AI talk in that person's style and hold conversations with it.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供由 Agent 状态驱动的环境音效，从 AudioLib.ai 流式播放超过 10 万首无版权曲目，曲目完整播放不被打断。
description.en: Ambient soundtrack for DeepSeek Harness, driven by agent state, streaming 100k+ cleared tracks from AudioLib.ai with uninterrupted playback.

description.zh: DSH plugin 统一接入 88api 四款图像模型，支持文生图、多参考图编辑、2K/4K 输出与批量任务，并安全配置 Key。
description.en: A DSH plugin that unifies four 88api image models for text-to-image, multi-reference editing, 2K/4K output, and batch tasks with secure Key setup.

description.zh: DSH plugin 健康审计工具：将 GitHub dsh-plugin 主题同步为本地目录，探测 npm、静态安全扫描、评分并生成网页排行榜，帮助挑选值得安装的插件。
description.en: Health audit for DSH plugins: sync the GitHub dsh-plugin topic into a local catalog, probe npm, static-scan for security, score plugins, and rank them in a web leaderboard.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 注入动态背景：WebGL2 流体、字符鲸鱼游动、发光鱼群与点线网格，让界面更沉浸。
description.en: Adds a dynamic backdrop to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: WebGL2 fluid, character whale swimming, glowing fish schools, and dot-grid mesh for an immersive interface.

description.zh: DeepEye 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供视觉能力，支持图片描述、OCR、视觉问答、UI 布局分析和剪贴板截图分析，让纯文本模型也能看懂图片。
description.en: DeepEye gives DeepSeek Harness vision capabilities: image description, OCR, VQA, UI layout analysis, and clipboard screenshot analysis, enabling text-only models to see images.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通过 grok2api 为智能体提供图片/视频生成与识图能力，支持文生图、文生视频及 Grok 多模态识别，并可将媒体保存到工作区。
description.en: A DSH plugin that enables agents to generate images/videos and recognize images via grok2api, supporting text-to-image, text-to-video, and Grok multimodal recognition with workspace saving.

description.zh: DSH plugin 可拖动的 API 余额/配额悬浮卡片，自动发现 DeepSeek、Moonshot、Kimi For Coding 等 provider，分档变色并实时刷新。
description.en: A draggable API balance/quota card for DeepSeek Harness, auto-detecting providers like DeepSeek, Moonshot, Kimi For Coding, with tiered colors and real-time refresh.

description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端的历史消息可原地编辑，支持正文、附件、文件引用与模型设置修改，并可分支重生成、切换版本时间线。
description.en: Lets DeepSeek Harness desktop edit past messages in place, covering text, attachments, file references and model settings, with branch regeneration and a version timeline.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在设置页新增「插件管理」子页面，卡片式管理已安装插件，支持启停、详情、卸载与一键更新。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a plugin manager page under Settings, offering card-based management of installed plugins with enable/disable, details, uninstall, and one-click update.

description.zh: DSH plugin 心跳插件：定时唤醒 agent 主动汇报进展、风险与卡点，支持退避间隔、硬停保护与轻量唤醒，让 agent 在冷场时主动开口。
description.en: A heartbeat plugin for DeepSeek Harness that wakes the agent on a configurable interval to proactively report progress, risks, and blockers, with backoff, hard-stop, and lightweight wake features.

description.zh: 基于Midscene的DSH插件，让模型通过自然语言描述定位并操作真实Android设备或Chrome页面，提供android_ui和web_ui两个工具。
description.en: Midscene-based DSH plugin enabling AI-driven UI automation on real Android devices or Chrome, with android_ui and web_ui tools.

description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 桌面通知插件，在每轮回答结束时自动弹出系统通知，支持子代理提醒、多渠道投递与自定义文案模板。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that posts a desktop notification whenever a turn ends, with subagent alerts, auto-selected delivery channels and customizable text templates.

description.zh: dsh-plugin-nlbi 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自然语言数据库查询与 BI 报表能力，将对话转化为可编辑 SQL、交互表格与可复用图表。
description.en: dsh-plugin-nlbi brings natural-language database queries and BI reports to DeepSeek Harness, turning conversations into editable SQL, interactive tables, and reusable charts.

description.zh: DSH plugin为DeepSeek Harness Web会话头部添加胶囊拆分按钮，一键在当前工作区打开VS Code、终端和文件资源管理器，支持自定义启动器与拖拽排序。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a capsule split button to the DeepSeek Harness Web conversation header, launching VS Code, terminal, and file explorer in the current workspace with customizable launchers.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自托管插件仓库，支持跨设备同步、安装与管理非官方插件，并提供 HTTP API 与模型工具。
description.en: Self-hosted plugin repository for DSH plugin, enabling cross-device sync, install and management of non-official plugins, with HTTP API and model tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的星际舰桥式多 agent 编排看板：用大白话下达命令，大副拆解成带验收标准的任务书，子代理编队在各工作区自主执行，配 3D 星域视图与可追溯账本。
description.en: An RTS-style multi-agent orchestration board for DeepSeek Harness: issue plain-language orders, let a staff agent draft acceptance-checked task orders, and deploy typed subagent squads across isolated workspaces, with a 3D starfield view and append-only traceable logs.

description.zh: DSH plugin 弱网适配插件，在 llm/stream 瀑布层透明拦截，通过指数退避重试、本地缓存与心跳自动重连，保护模型回复链条在弱网下不断裂。
description.en: A DSH plugin that transparently intercepts the llm/stream waterfall to keep model reply chains alive on flaky networks via exponential-backoff retries, local caching, and heartbeat auto-reconnect.

description.zh: DSH plugin 安全审计工具，提供静态扫描、LLM 审计协议、评分卡及运行时监控，守护插件安装与运行安全。
description.en: Security audit tool for DSH plugins: static scan, LLM-driven audit protocol, scorecard, and runtime guard to secure plugin installation and execution.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 输入栏添加一键润色按钮，将粗糙请求重写为结构化专业提示词，非破坏性且可审查。
description.en: Adds a one-click polish button to the DeepSeek Harness WebUI input toolbar, rewriting rough requests into structured professional prompts, non-destructive and reviewable.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供对话宽度滑块与界面增强：按下即全屏预览实时调节宽度，并整合思考块交互、界面中文化、会话删除、工作区分页与入场动效。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a conversation-width slider with press-to-preview live adjustment, plus thinking-block controls, UI localization, session deletion, workspace tabs and entrance animations.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的访前尽调智能体，调用企查查 MCP 完成客户背景调查、工商核验与风险整理，输出可下载的八段尽调报告。
description.en: A pre-visit due diligence agent for DeepSeek Harness that calls Qichacha MCP tools to run customer background checks, business registration verification and risk briefs, then delivers a downloadable eight-section report.

description.zh: 把 DSH 接入 QQ 官方机器人，用 QQ 单聊远程接管工作区会话，支持流式输出、Markdown 渲染与文件收发。
description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness to the official QQ bot API, letting you drive existing workspace sessions over QQ direct chat with streaming output, Markdown rendering and file transfer.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 扩展可用模型服务商：内置 39 家预设，粘贴 API Key 点启用即可写入官方 llm-pi-ai 路由与凭据，免改配置、免重启。
description.en: Expands the providers available to DeepSeek Harness: 39 built-in presets, paste an API key and press Enable to write the official llm-pi-ai route and credential - no config edits, no restart.

description.zh: 在 DSH 回复中选中文字即弹出浮动工具条，可把片段作为引用块写入输入框草稿、就这段内容开侧边对话线程，或直接复制。
description.en: Select text in a DSH reply and a floating toolbar lets you quote it into the composer draft, open a side chat about it, or copy it.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话加上划词批注与引用：选中文字生成带锚点的引用 chip，输入框下方常驻引用导航条，点击即可跳回原文并高亮，发送时序列化为含轮次与角色的结构化引用块。
description.en: Adds quote-and-annotate to DeepSeek Harness sessions: select text to mint an anchored quote chip, with a persistent quote bar under the input that jumps back to and highlights the source, serialized on send into a structured quote block with turn and role.

description.zh: dsh-reach 是 DeepSeek Harness 的多渠道决策与远程控制桥：把任意工作区的审批与提问卡片推送到微信、Telegram、飞书等 IM，并可直接在聊天里回复处理。
description.en: dsh-reach is a multi-channel decision and remote-control bridge for DeepSeek Harness: it pushes approval and question cards from any workspace to IM channels such as WeChat, Telegram and Feishu, and lets you answer them straight from chat.

description.zh: DSH Remote Control 插件通过扫码与本机批准，把手机浏览器接入你的 DeepSeek Harness，复用官方 Web GUI，并提供临时公网隧道、局域网直连与设备授权管理。
description.en: A DSH plugin that links your phone browser to DeepSeek Harness via QR pairing and host-side approval, reusing the official Web GUI with temporary public tunnels, LAN access and device authorization management.

description.zh: DSH plugin 修复远程访问时目录选择器故障，强制使用浏览器内 browse 交互，替代远程无法驱动的原生对话框。
description.en: DSH plugin that fixes the directory picker for remote access, forcing in-browser browse interaction instead of native dialogs that remote browsers can't drive.

description.zh: dsh-recall 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话历史回忆能力，通过字面/模糊/语义三层检索找回每一段过往对话，完全本地离线，让 AI 永不遗忘你告诉过它的事。
description.en: dsh-recall gives DeepSeek Harness a memory maze: literal/fuzzy/semantic retrieval of every past conversation, fully local & offline, so the AI never forgets what you told it.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供 RTK 命令改写建议与工具输出压缩，全局拦截 bash/grep/read 调用，减少 token 消耗。
description.en: A DSH plugin offering RTK command rewrite suggestions and tool output compaction, globally intercepting bash/grep/read calls to reduce token usage.

description.zh: DSH 规则执行引擎插件，将 AGENTS.md 作为唯一真相源，动态解析规则并通过工具守卫、文本检测、时序检查与审计台账强制执行用户规则，确保规则被机器化遵守。
description.en: A DSH plugin that treats AGENTS.md as the single source of truth, dynamically parses rules and enforces them via tool guards, text detection, timing checks, and audit logs, ensuring rules are mechanically followed.

description.zh: DSH-Reforge 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，从有测试依据的 Python Bug 修复中积累可追溯经验，并在后续相似任务中按范围检索参考。
description.en: DSH-Reforge is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that accumulates traceable experience from test-verified Python bug fixes and retrieves it for later similar tasks.

description.zh: DSH plugin 每日聚合46个精选RSS源，用已配置模型编辑成主编级要闻日报，通过webhook投递到微信/Telegram等，并零上下文插播在对话中。
description.en: DSH plugin aggregates 46 curated RSS sources daily, uses your configured LLM to edit an editor-level news digest, delivers via webhook to WeChat/Telegram etc., and inserts in chat with zero context cost.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供 Trae 风格的一键撤回：回滚工作区代码与对话历史，支持 git 提交或硬链接快照，让每次交互都可撤销。
description.en: Trae-style withdraw for DeepSeek Harness Web: one-click rollback of workspace code and conversation via git commits or hard-link snapshots.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供不可逆密钥脱敏防护，在写入会话日志与发起模型请求前，用正则规则把访问密钥、Bearer Token、私钥等敏感片段替换为占位符，避免泄露。
description.en: An irreversible secret-scrubbing guard for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that regex-redacts access keys, bearer tokens and private key blocks into placeholders before they reach the session log or model request.

description.zh: DSH plugin 检测粘贴的密钥，存入官方凭据库，并以 [secret:REF] 占位符发送给模型，防止明文泄露。
description.en: A DSH plugin that detects pasted secrets, stores them in the credentials seam, and sends [secret:REF] placeholders to the model.

description.zh: dsh-rules 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 glob 的规则提示注入，当 Agent 读写匹配文件时自动激活规则并注入对话，兼容 Claude Code 规则格式。
description.en: dsh-rules provides glob-activated rule prompts for DeepSeek Harness, injecting rules into the conversation when the agent reads or edits matching files, compatible with Claude Code rule format.

description.zh: DSH plugin 把用户本人当主角的 RPG 养成插件，对话后随机触发奇遇，六维属性跨会话持久化，并带可视化设置页。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns the user into an RPG protagonist, triggering random encounters after conversations with persistent six-attribute growth and a settings UI.

description.zh: DSH 会话注意力提醒插件：agent 完成、提问或请求审批时，仅在切出 DeepSeek Harness 后弹出系统通知与提醒音，并用悬浮球展示活跃会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that alerts you when an agent finishes, asks a question, or requests approval — only after you switch away from DeepSeek Harness, with native notifications, sounds, and a floating active-session ball.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供新会话自动接续：注入约 55 token 的接续指针，无交接文档时直接复用 DSH 已有压缩摘要，不调模型、不额外生成。
description.en: Auto-continues new sessions in DeepSeek Harness by injecting a ~55-token continuity pointer, reusing DSH's existing compaction summary when no handoff doc exists — no model calls, no extra generation.
