description.zh: DSH plugin 基准驱动自我进化：让 Agent Profile 在冻结 Benchmark 上迭代，严格优于才接受，否则精确回滚。
description.en: Benchmark-driven self-evolution for DeepSeek Harness: iterates Agent Profile on frozen benchmarks, accepting only strictly better changes and rolling back otherwise.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端提供划词引用：选中对话文本即可加入引用卡片，随下一条消息一起发送。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that turns selected conversation text into quote cards, sent along with your next message.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏会话菜单补上缺失的删除会话能力，支持强制一步删净日志、缓存与注册表，不留幽灵行。
description.en: Adds the missing Delete session action to DeepSeek Harness sidebar menus, with one-click force delete that purges logs, caches and registry entries without ghost rows.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏加上置顶栏、最近活动视图、项目 emoji 图标与可折叠分区，让你在一个面板里管理整个工作区而非单个会话。
description.en: A Codex-style sidebar for DeepSeek Harness: pin projects and conversations to one band, switch to a recently-used activity view with answer previews, give each project an emoji icon, and collapse sections you don't need.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供会话通知（回复/提问/审批）与会话内梯子目录导航，提升多任务下的会话体验。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding session notifications (reply/ask/approval) and an in-conversation ladder outline to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供会话快捷键的 DSH plugin，像切换浏览器标签页一样用键盘管理会话，支持自定义键位与多平台预设。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings session hotkeys to DeepSeek Harness Web, letting you switch sessions from the keyboard like browser tabs, with rebindable keys and platform presets.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话级鲁棒重试：官方 5 次重试耗尽后，对超时、限流、5xx、SSE 断流等瞬时失败在同一 step 上继续重试，直到成功、取消或暂停。
description.en: A DSH plugin that keeps a session alive after the official 5 retries: transient failures like timeouts, rate limits, 5xx and SSE stream breaks are retried on the same open step until success, cancel or pause.

description.zh: DSH 网页插件，启动时预热投影缓存，让左侧边栏立即显示每个会话的主题，无需点击进入会话。
description.en: DSH web plugin that warms the projection cache on startup so the left sidebar shows every session's theme immediately, no click required.

description.zh: DSH 会话生命周期管理插件：自动归档一次性子代理、空闲会话，容量保底并清理 projcache，从源头防止缓存膨胀卡顿。
description.en: DSH session lifecycle management plugin: auto-archives one-shot subagents and idle sessions, enforces capacity cap, and cleans projcache to prevent cache bloat stalls.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补齐会话工具箱：图片草稿备份、会话迁移、归档池、项目分组、引用回复与文件检查点恢复，数据只存本机。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a session toolbox to DeepSeek Harness: image draft backup, session migration, archive pool, project groups, quoted replies and file checkpoint restore, with all data kept locally.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设置页左侧导航加上拖拽排序、显隐与抽屉收纳，一键整理并自动持久保存。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds drag-to-reorder, show/hide toggles and collapsible drawers to the DeepSeek Harness settings sidebar, with changes saved automatically.

description.zh: DSH plugin 侧边栏文件树插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 添加会话/文件标签栏与懒加载文件树，支持按扩展名彩色图标、复制路径及发送给 Agent。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding a Sessions/Files tab strip and lazy file tree to DeepSeek Harness, with per-extension icons, copy-path and send-to-agent.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供侧边会话：从当前会话分叉出临时对话，共享同一 agent 与工具，能真实编辑工作区文件而不污染主对话记录。
description.en: A side chat for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI that forks the current session into an ephemeral conversation sharing the same agent and tools, so it can really edit workspace files without polluting the main transcript.

description.zh: dsh-showcase 是一款 DSH 插件，读取目标项目的 Git 改动、测试回执与截图，生成可核验的中文交付报告、Markdown 摘要和自包含 HTML 海报，全程本地运行不上传文件。
description.en: dsh-showcase is a DSH plugin that reads a project's Git changes, test receipts and screenshots to produce verifiable Chinese delivery reports, Markdown summaries and self-contained HTML posters, all running locally.

description.zh: DSH plugin 分组管理 Skills、过滤模型技能目录、独立开关 MCP 服务器，左侧面板一键管理，提升 DeepSeek Harness 会话效率。
description.en: A DSH plugin that groups Skills, filters the model skill catalog, toggles MCP servers independently, and manages everything from a left panel.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 注入近 24 小时拟真生活事件上下文，并提供 life_react 工具把感受、思考与行动回填到生活日志，让模型生活在持续演化的世界里。
description.en: Injects a simulated-life context of the past 24 hours into DeepSeek Harness agents and adds a life_react tool that writes feelings, thoughts and actions back to the life log, so the model lives in a continuously evolving world.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 界面添加自定义背景图与毛玻璃蒙版的皮肤增强 DSH plugin，可调适配方式、蒙版浓度与虚化程度，颜色文字气泡仍沿用原主题。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds custom background images and a frosted-glass overlay to the DeepSeek Harness UI, with adjustable fit mode, mask opacity and blur while keeping the original theme colors.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供多套可热切换的品牌皮肤，支持壁纸、标语与通透度个性化，一键即可回到官方界面。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness Web multiple hot-swappable brand skins, with per-skin wallpaper, tagline and translucency customization and one-click return to the official UI.

description.zh: DSH 的 Slack 双向通信插件，提供 slack_notify/channels/inbox/reply 四工具，Socket Mode 免公网回调，支持自定义 slackApiUrl 对接代理网关。
description.en: DSH plugin for two-way Slack messaging, offering slack_notify/channels/inbox/reply tools with Socket Mode and configurable slackApiUrl for proxy gateways.

description.zh: dsh-smart-approval 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供故障关闭的三模式自动审批，独立于访问权限，智能区分安全、高风险与恶意请求，保障工作流安全。
description.en: dsh-smart-approval is a fail-closed three-mode approval plugin for DeepSeek Harness, independent of access permissions, intelligently distinguishing safe, high-risk, and malicious requests to secure workflows.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 一键启动器，双击即现一笔一划描边动画，后台拉起 dsh web 并无缝淡入 GUI，关闭自动停服务。
description.en: A Windows one-click launcher for DeepSeek Harness that plays a stroke-by-stroke splash animation, boots dsh web in the background, and fades into the GUI seamlessly.

description.zh: DSH 学习教练插件，把一门课拆成知识地图，逐单元记录掌握度、排每日任务，并提供 /study 网页面板查看进度。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns a course into a knowledge map, tracking mastery per unit and daily tasks, with a /study web panel to see progress.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 输入框换上平滑彗星光标，修复空输入、双向划词、换行与滚动裁剪等显示问题，并新增 500ms 呼吸节拍。
description.en: A patched DSH plugin that replaces the DSH Web composer caret with a smooth comet-style animated cursor, fixing empty-input, reverse-selection, soft-break and scroll-overflow cases and adding a 500ms breathing blink.

description.zh: DSH Web 专用插件，在已验证的 compatibility profile 上自动跳过 BrowserAuth，打开 Web 地址即可直接使用，无需每次把启动 URL 里的随机 token 抄进浏览器。
description.en: A DSH plugin for the Web profile that automatically skips BrowserAuth on verified compatibility profiles, so you can open the Web URL directly without copying the random token from the launch URL each time.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供实时语音输入与任务完成后的语音摘要，让编码智能体听得见、说得出。
description.en: Adds real-time voice input and spoken answer summaries to DeepSeek Harness, letting you talk to your coding agent and hear concise results.

description.zh: 面向考研备考的 DSH 学习工作台插件，提供 Notion 式待办墙、按复习时长点亮的热力图、间隔重复复习队列与跨面板存活的番茄钟，数据存本机 JSON 并可导出 Markdown。
description.en: A DSH plugin study desk for exam prep: a Notion-style task wall, a heatmap lit by actual review minutes, spaced-repetition review queues, and a pomodoro timer that survives panel switches, with local JSON data and Markdown export.

description.zh: 将 sub2api 网关接入 DeepSeek Harness，统一 OpenAI/Claude/Grok/Gemini 多提供商路由，支持模型发现、用量查询与设置页面。
description.en: Connect sub2api gateway to DeepSeek Harness, unifying OpenAI/Claude/Grok/Gemini routes behind one base URL with model discovery, usage lookup, and a settings page.

description.zh: dsh-spec-collab 是 DeepSeek Harness 的需求编辑校样台，将原始需求澄清为研发与开发 AI 可直接理解的 Ready Spec，支持多角色评审与 Git 版本化协作。
description.en: dsh-spec-collab is a requirement editing proofing desk for DeepSeek Harness, clarifying raw requirements into Ready Specs understandable by dev AI, with multi-role review and Git versioned collaboration.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 子代理委派提供模型路由：新增 subagent_model 工具，可指定 provider、model 与输出上限，或用 model:"auto" 策略按任务档位自动选型、失败升级与换路，并保留可审计理由。
description.en: Model-routed subagent delegation for DeepSeek Harness: a subagent_model tool that picks provider, model and output cap per call, or delegates to a model:"auto" policy with task tiers, failure escalation, rerouting and auditable reasons.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 每条回复末尾生成可点击的下一步建议按钮，点一下即作为消息发出，省去自己组织语言。
description.en: Adds clickable next-step suggestion buttons at the end of every DeepSeek Harness reply, sending the chosen line as your message in one click.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 每轮回复后预测下一句提示词，显示在输入框上方，按 Tab 即可填入草稿，支持中英文与开关设置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that predicts your next prompt after each turn and shows it above the input box; press Tab to accept, with bilingual support and a settings toggle.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供 subagent_with_model 工具，支持按调用指定模型/提供商，并附带实时多面板子代理查看器，让子代理运行状态一目了然。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding a subagent_with_model tool for per-call model/provider override, plus a live multi-panel subagent viewer.

description.zh: DSH Web 预测回复插件，在输入框上方生成可点击填入草稿的下一步消息候选，提升对话效率。
description.en: A DSH Web plugin that generates clickable next-message suggestions above the input box, filling drafts to boost conversation efficiency.

description.zh: STARDUSTLC 插件全家桶，一条命令为 DeepSeek Harness 装入 18 个 DSH 插件，覆盖办公流、媒体工坊、DevOps、通知与预设五条产品线。
description.en: The STARDUSTLC plugin suite installs 18 DSH plugins into DeepSeek Harness with one command, covering office workflow, media studio, DevOps, notifications, and presets.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在任务完成或代理回合结束时发送原生系统通知，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux，零运行时依赖，防刷屏限流。
description.en: A DSH plugin that sends native OS notifications when tasks complete or agent turns end, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux with zero runtime dependencies and anti-spam rate limiting.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在任务完成或代理回合结束时发送原生系统通知，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux，零运行时依赖，防刷屏限流。
description.en: A DSH plugin that sends native OS notifications when tasks complete or agent turns end, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux with zero runtime dependencies and anti-spam rate limiting.

description.zh: Tacit 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 插件，自动学习你提示词中未言明的习惯，并注入系统提示词，让 Agent 每次对话都更懂你。
description.en: Tacit is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that learns what you leave unsaid in prompts and injects directives into the system prompt, so the agent understands you every conversation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话头部注入「Tasks」标签页，提供三列看板，拖入进行中即真实创建 DSH 会话执行任务并回传进度。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects a Tasks tab into the DeepSeek Harness conversation header, offering a three-column kanban that really executes cards via new agent sessions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供对话任务停止提醒：任务完成、出错或 Agent 等待回答时弹出系统通知并播放提示音，点击即可回到会话提问位置。
description.en: Conversation task-stop reminders for DeepSeek Harness: system notifications and Web Audio chimes when a task finishes, errors, or the agent waits for your answer, with one click back to your question.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Tavily 联网搜索：注册 ctx.web 搜索 provider，并提供搜索、正文抽取、爬取、站点地图与深度研究五个工具及设置页。
description.en: Adds Tavily web search to DeepSeek Harness: registers a ctx.web search provider plus search, extract, crawl, map and research tools with a settings page.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话的多智能体团队房间，成员、消息总线、共享任务板与时间线在重启后依然保留。
description.en: Persistent, cross-session multi-agent team rooms for DeepSeek Harness — members, a message bus, a shared task board and a shared timeline that survive restarts.

description.zh: DSH plugin 实现长时多智能体任务编排：lead 规划带评审的 DAG，成员执行节点，常驻协调器在模型故障、中断与重启后持续推进任务。
description.en: A DSH plugin for long-horizon multi-agent tasks: a lead plans a reviewed DAG, members execute nodes, and a resident reconciler keeps tasks moving across failures and restarts.

description.zh: 为 DSH 长任务提供持久化监督：计划评审、DAG 进度追踪与阶段/完成校验，主 Agent 执行、Supervisor 独立复核。
description.en: Persistent supervision for long DSH tasks: plan review, DAG progress tracking and stage/completion checks, with the main Agent executing and a Supervisor reviewing independently.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化多智能体团队：队长生成成员子代理，把目标拆成带依赖的任务 DAG，并通过信箱消息协同，配全 SVG 活动面板。
description.en: Turns a DeepSeek Harness session into a durable multi-agent team: a captain spawns member subagents, splits goals into a dependency-aware task DAG, and coordinates via mailbox messages with an all-SVG activity panel.

description.zh: DSH plugin 主题包，为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供 30 款即插即用主题，含浅色/深色双变体，零依赖集成。
description.en: A DSH plugin theme pack offering 30 ready-to-use themes for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, each with light/dark variants, zero-dependency integration.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供苹果 Liquid Glass 毛玻璃主题，支持 SVG 边缘折射、动态壁纸与实时自定义，让界面呈现通透的玻璃质感。
description.en: A genuine Liquid Glass theme for DeepSeek Harness Web UI, featuring SVG edge refraction, dynamic wallpapers, and real-time customization for a translucent glass look.

description.zh: DSH plugin 可视化定制 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面主题，背景、文字、框线、细节全可调，预设可导出分享，刷新不丢。
description.en: A DSH plugin to visually customize DeepSeek Harness web UI themes—backgrounds, text, borders, details—with exportable presets that persist across refreshes.

description.zh: DSH plugin 主题包，为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供 30 款即插即用主题，含浅色/深色双变体，零依赖集成。
description.en: A DSH plugin theme pack offering 30 ready-to-use themes for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, each with light/dark variants, zero-dependency integration.

description.zh: dsh-tg-bridge 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Telegram 桥接插件，让你在手机端用文字、语音和图片驱动 DSH 代理，每个话题独立会话与工作目录。
description.en: A Telegram bridge DSH plugin that lets you drive DeepSeek Harness from a bot with text, voice and photos, giving each forum topic its own session and working directory.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 打造宋式美学主题插件，提供宣纸浅色与夜墨深色两套配色，以汝窑青承载交互状态、窑铜点缀引用，并遵循瑞士国际主义排版规范。
description.en: A Song-dynasty aesthetics theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, offering Xuanzhi light and Yemo dark variants with Ru celadon for interactive states and kiln copper for editorial accents, disciplined by Swiss International Style.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供甘城猫猫主题皮肤，包含壁纸与蓝白配色，支持明暗模式，提升界面美观度。
description.en: A Nachoneko-themed skin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, featuring wallpaper and blue-white palette with light/dark variants.

description.zh: dsh-thinkbar 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 界面插件，把模型思考等待变成由蓝到金的动态升温条，零侵入展示推理与工具执行状态。
description.en: dsh-thinkbar is a DeepSeek Harness UI plugin that turns model reasoning waits into a blue-to-gold thermal progress bar, showing thinking and tool activity non-intrusively.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 在输入框下方加一枚药丸，实时显示峰价/谷价、切换倒计时与账户余额，点开可看节假日标记与充值明细。
description.en: A pill for DeepSeek Harness below the input box showing peak/off-peak pricing, switch countdown and account balance, expandable for holiday markers and top-up details.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供纯思考空转熔断：挂在 agent/assistant-stream 上，按超时、思考量与退化复读三重判定，命中即取消回合并注入继续指令。
description.en: A circuit breaker for DeepSeek Harness that hooks agent/assistant-stream and trips on thinking-only timeouts, reasoning volume, and degenerate repetition, cancelling the turn and injecting a continue prompt.

description.zh: dsh-tidewatch 是 DeepSeek Harness 的悬浮徽章插件，实时显示峰谷时段、倒计时与本次会话费用，支持人民币/美元切换。
description.en: dsh-tidewatch is a DeepSeek Harness floating badge plugin showing peak/off-peak status, countdown, and session cost with currency toggle.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的每个 Session 提供桌面悬浮红绿灯，让运行、等待、完成和失败状态一眼可见，无需紧盯 DSH 页面。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives each Session a desktop floating traffic light, making running, waiting, completed and failed states visible at a glance without staring at the DSH page.

description.zh: DSH plugin 用户偏好记忆插件，让 agent 跨会话记住你的语言习惯、沟通风格与项目背景，新会话自动注入画像，无需重复自我介绍。
description.en: A DSH plugin that persists user preferences across sessions, auto-injecting your profile into system prompts so agents know you from the start.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供确定性、可恢复的工具结果压缩与缓存感知上下文压缩，降低 token 占用并支持 spill 精确回取。
description.en: Deterministic, recoverable tool-result compression and cache-aware compaction for DeepSeek Harness, cutting token usage while keeping spill retrieval exact.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化的 token 用量侧边栏，展示今日、昨日与累计用量，并集成原生设置页与 SQLite 账本。
description.en: A DSH plugin that keeps provider-reported token usage locally, offering a persistent sidebar summary (Today/Yesterday/Total) and a native Settings page backed by a scalable SQLite ledger.

description.zh: DSH plugin 视觉增强工具：将图片交由外部视觉模型分析，输出带坐标化视觉原语的纯文本证据，让不支持多模态的文本模型也能理解图片、截图与文档。
description.en: A DSH plugin that enhances text-only models with vision by delegating image analysis to an external vision model and returning coordinate-based visual primitives as text evidence.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供树形任务流：把多步任务组织成目标→任务→子任务三级树，节点完成时由模型提交结果，插件随即折叠该节点的执行过程，只留结果，避免长任务上下文被过程撑爆。
description.en: A tree task flow plugin for DeepSeek Harness: organize multi-step work into a goal → task → subtask tree, let the model submit a result when a node finishes, and fold that node's execution process out of context so only the result remains.

description.zh: dsh-trellis 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Trellis 工作流集成插件，注入 workflow-state 面包屑、同步子代理并支持 /trellis 命令。
description.en: dsh-trellis integrates Trellis workflows into DeepSeek Harness, injecting workflow-state breadcrumbs, syncing subagents, and providing /trellis commands.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Web 聊天界面实时显示每轮 Token 花费、会话总花费与账户余额，支持 USD/CNY 估算。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows per-message token cost, session total, and account balance in the Web chat UI, with USD/CNY estimation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 划词引用：在 DeepSeek Harness Web 聊天中选中文字一键引用到输入框，发送时携带完整原文，无需复制粘贴。
description.en: A DSH plugin for quote selection: select text in DeepSeek Harness Web chat and quote it into the composer with full context.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供树形会话分支视图：编辑旧消息即分叉，各版本在同一棵树里切换、重命名与收起，侧栏始终只留一条。
description.en: Tree-view conversation branching for DeepSeek Harness: editing an old message forks a version, and all versions live in one tree you can switch, rename and collapse while the sidebar keeps a single entry.

description.zh: DSH plugin 归档会话回收站：列出、预览并恢复已归档的会话到原工作区，附带可选的归档二次确认，避免误归档造成损失。
description.en: An archived-session recycle bin for DeepSeek Harness: list, preview and restore archived sessions to their original workspace, with an optional archive confirmation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent loop 提供无上限模型请求重试，指数退避并设延迟上限，附带实时 Settings 面板，让长时间无人值守运行不再因瞬时网络错误中断。
description.en: Unbounded model-request retry for the DeepSeek Harness agent loop, with exponential backoff, a delay ceiling, and a live Settings panel so long unattended runs survive transient network errors.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供简洁优雅的余额与 Token 用量面板，支持供应商自动发现、本地用量聚合与热力图展示。
description.en: A compact provider balances and local token-usage analytics panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with auto-discovery, aggregation, and heatmap.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）web 端提供右侧轮次导航，每轮一条横线，悬停展开大纲面板，点击跳转，实时跟随滚动。
description.en: Right-edge turn navigation for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web: one dash per user turn, hover to expand an outline panel, click to jump, with live scroll tracking.

description.zh: DSH plugin 模型用量仪表盘，在设置页新增用量板块，按服务商/模型汇总 token 用量，支持今日、近 7 天、近 30 天趋势图。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a usage dashboard to settings, aggregating token usage by provider/model with today/7d/30d trend charts.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的用量统计 DSH plugin，在侧边栏展示 Token 总量、每日趋势、模型分布与调用明细，并支持 CSV/JSON 导出。
description.en: A usage analytics DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that shows token totals, daily trends, model distribution and call details in the sidebar, with CSV/JSON export.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边栏用量仪表盘，展示 API 余额、今日花费、按模型统计与调用日志，并额外计入外部视觉模型调用。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness sidebar usage dashboard showing API balance, today's spend, per-model stats and call logs, with extra accounting for external vision-model calls.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在聊天输入框旁实时显示 DeepSeek API 的 tokens 用量、花费与真实余额，支持官方及自定义模型。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows real-time token usage, cost, and wallet balance right next to the chat input, for official and custom models.

description.zh: dsh-token-usage 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 token 用量与成本分析插件，在 Web 设置面板新增用量统计页，提供汇总卡片、GitHub 风格热力图和官方峰谷价自动换算的预估费用。
description.en: dsh-token-usage is a token usage and cost analytics plugin for DeepSeek Harness, adding a Usage Stats page to the Web settings panel with summary cards, a GitHub-style heatmap, and estimated spend auto-converted at official peak/off-peak rates.

description.zh: dsh-token-usage 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 token 用量与成本分析插件，在 Web 设置面板新增用量统计页，提供汇总卡片、GitHub 风格热力图和官方峰谷价自动换算的预估费用。
description.en: dsh-token-usage is a token usage and cost analytics plugin for DeepSeek Harness, adding a Usage Stats page to the Web settings panel with summary cards, a GitHub-style heatmap, and estimated spend auto-converted at official peak/off-peak rates.

description.zh: Vision Mix 是 DeepSeek Harness 的视觉增强插件，将文本、视觉与图片生成模型组合为 Mix 模型，支持识图、跨轮追问与生图编辑。
description.en: Vision Mix is a vision enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness, combining text, vision, and image generation models into a Mix model for image recognition, follow-up queries, and image generation/editing.

description.zh: DSH 视觉能力全家桶：注册 vision_understand 工具，支持粘贴、拖拽、按钮三入口识图，让 DeepSeek 纯文本模型也能看懂图片。
description.en: A DSH plugin bundle that adds vision_understand tool with paste/drag/button image input, enabling DeepSeek text models to see images.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供持续语音对话：云端语音识别加 Edge TTS 播报，并把需要项目工具的任务委派给后台 Agent。
description.en: Persistent voice conversations for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, combining cloud speech recognition and Edge TTS with background Agent delegation for project tasks.

description.zh: 为 DSH 网页端提供免手语音助手：关键词唤醒、语音听写、口述编辑命令与中文朗读，本地 sherpa-onnx WASM 离线识别，不依赖 Google 服务。
description.en: A hands-free voice assistant plugin for DSH web: wake word, speech dictation, spoken edit commands and Chinese TTS, powered by on-device sherpa-onnx WASM ASR with no Google dependency.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent 赋予可主动呼出的语音能力：agent 通过 offer_call 发起来电，人类接听/拒接/稍后再说，本地 TTS/STT 引擎离线合成，9 种音色含中文方言。
description.en: Give a DeepSeek Harness agent a voice it owns: agent initiates calls via offer_call, human picks up/declines/snoozes, local TTS/STT engines synthesize offline, 9 voices incl. Chinese dialects.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 编辑器添加麦克风，支持语音输入，可配置豆包或 OpenAI 语音模型，是 DSH plugin 的语音输入增强工具。
description.en: Add a microphone to the DeepSeek Harness composer for voice input, with support for Doubao Voice and OpenAI models.

description.zh: DSH 的 WakaTime 插件，自动追踪 AI 编码活动、代码行数与耗时，并上报 WakaTime 分析。
description.en: WakaTime plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that tracks AI coding activity, lines of code, and time spent, reporting to WakaTime.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面增强体验：逐轮对话导航、思考链默认展开，以及官方 API 会话成本实时计量。
description.en: A DSH plugin that enhances the DeepSeek Harness web UI with turn-by-turn navigation, default-expanded thinking chains, and a live session cost meter for the official API.

description.zh: DSH plugin：`dsh web` 启动完成后自动打印完整 GUI 链接并打开默认浏览器，跨平台、零依赖、故障安全，省去手动复制粘贴。
description.en: DSH plugin: when `dsh web` is ready, automatically prints the full GUI URL and opens it in your default browser. Cross-platform, zero runtime deps, fail-safe.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在浏览器标签页 favicon 上实时显示会话状态（待机/运行/提问/完成），后台标签也能一眼掌握 Agent 动态，支持多种动画特效与实时配置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that reflects session state (idle/running/asking/done) on the browser tab favicon, letting you monitor agents at a glance with animated effects and live config.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的浏览器录制插件，attach 或自启有头浏览器，记录点击、输入与网络请求，导出 Markdown 时间线报告供模型分析并沉淀接口级 skill。
description.en: A browser-recording DSH plugin that attaches to or launches a headed browser, logs clicks, inputs and network traffic, then exports a Markdown timeline report for the model to analyze and turn into API-level skills.

description.zh: 基于 Firecrawl 的搜索提供方插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 的 web 能力接缝（ctx.web）提供网页搜索功能。
description.en: Firecrawl-backed search provider plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ctx.web).

description.zh: DSH plugin 聚合网页搜索提供者，通过优先级队列整合 AnySearch、Tavily 等九大搜索源，支持多密钥轮换与有序回退，为 DeepSeek Harness 的 web_search 工具提供高可用搜索能力。
description.en: An aggregated web-search provider for DeepSeek Harness, serving web_search through a prioritized queue over nine search engines with multi-key rotation and ordered fallback.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏工作区列表增加分类与日期分组层，支持自定义分类、排序与折叠，让 DSH plugin 的项目管理更顺手。
description.en: Adds a category and date grouping layer to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar workspace list, with custom categories, sorting and collapsing for easier project management.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 write 仅创建约束：目标文件已存在时在工具执行前直接拒绝并提示改用 edit，防止模型误覆写已有内容。
description.en: A DSH plugin that makes the write tool create-only: if the target file already exists, the call is denied before execution and the model is told to use edit instead, preventing accidental overwrites.

description.zh: 为运行在 WSL 中的 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 桌面快捷方式与系统托盘启动器，支持守护进程自动重启与状态监控。
description.en: Provides a Windows desktop shortcut and system-tray launcher for DeepSeek Harness running in WSL, with a watchdog daemon for auto-restart and status monitoring.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏提供 VS Code 风格的工作区分类树，把工作区按自建分类折叠归类，并直接展开查看与新建会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that replaces the sidebar workspace browser with a VS Code-style collapsible category tree, grouping workspaces into custom categories with inline session lists.

description.zh: DSH Web 客户端插件，在输入框旁提供常用词面板，支持全局与项目词条存储、一键插入，提升 DeepSeek Harness 输入效率。
description.en: A DSH Web GUI plugin adding a common words panel beside the input box, with global and project-scoped storage and one-click insertion.

description.zh: DSH plugin 皮肤插件，为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供侧栏皮肤面板，支持本地图片或 URL 背景、暗化模糊调节与跨会话持久化。
description.en: A DSH plugin skin for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, offering a sidebar skin panel with local image or URL backgrounds, dim/blur adjustments, and cross-session persistence.

description.zh: 把小爱音箱接进 DeepSeek Harness 的 DSH plugin：喊唤醒词即对话，回复由音箱念出，也能让 agent 主动播报。
description.en: A DSH plugin that bridges XiaoAI speakers into DeepSeek Harness: wake-word conversations with spoken replies, plus agent-initiated announcements.

description.zh: DSH 小宇宙播客插件：在 DeepSeek Harness Web 会话框注入播放条与面板，支持免登录播放、扫码登录、订阅同步、搜索及 podcast_play 工具，让 AI 直接播放播客。
description.en: A DSH plugin for Xiaoyuzhou podcast: injects a player bar and panel into DeepSeek Harness Web, enabling login-free playback, QR login, subscription sync, search, and the podcast_play tool for AI-driven playback.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 WebUI 插件可视化开发工作室，提供实时界面检查、源码编辑、构建与补丁验证，无需将未完成代码加载到稳定宿主。
description.en: A visual-first studio for building DSH WebUI plugins, offering real interface inspection, source editing, builds, and patch validation without loading unfinished code into your stable DSH Host.

description.zh: 玄机阁是 DeepSeek Harness 的玄学算命插件，内置八字、紫微、六爻、塔罗等 16 个确定性本地排盘工具，模型只负责解读。
description.en: Xuanji is a fortune-telling DSH plugin bundling 16 deterministic local engines for Bazi, Ziwei, Liuyao, Tarot and more, with the model only interpreting results.

description.zh: dsh-yolo-mode 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用大模型自动裁决沙箱升权申请，支持预设与自定义权限层级，fail-closed 确保安全。
description.en: dsh-yolo-mode is a DSH plugin that uses LLM to auto-approve sandbox escalation requests, with built-in presets and custom permission levels, fail-closed for safety.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 打造的 NieR:Automata 风格 YoRHa 工业终端主题，用沙色纸面、炭黑结构与琥珀状态标记重塑工作区、会话列表与输入框，保留原有交互与明暗模式。
description.en: A NieR:Automata YoRHa-inspired industrial terminal theme for DeepSeek Harness Web, restyling the workspace, session list, composer and overlays with sand-toned paper, charcoal lines and amber markers while keeping native interactions and light/dark modes.

description.zh: Emotion Pet 是 DeepSeek Harness 的情绪球桌宠，根据 Agent 状态展示 32 种表情，支持对话内停靠与桌面端，陪伴任务过程。
description.en: Emotion Pet is a DeepSeek Harness desktop pet that displays 32 expressions based on Agent state, dockable in chat and on desktop.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供专家市场：稀疏检出浏览安装 50+ 内置专家与团队，注册为仅用户可调用的技能，输入 /expert-名称 或点「＋专家」即注入角色定义。
description.en: An expert marketplace for DeepSeek Harness: browse and install 50+ built-in experts and teams via sparse checkout, registered as user-only skills so /expert-name or the "+ Expert" button injects the role definition.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 GitHub (gh)、Gitea (tea) 与 npm 引入 Agent，提供引导式认证、Issue 管理与包发布能力。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings GitHub (gh), Gitea (tea), and npm into the agent with guided auth, issue management, and package publishing.

description.zh: Kabutack 是 DSH 插件，统一管理插件、Skill 与 MCP，按角色一键切换能力组合，让 AI 工作台随场景灵活装配。
description.en: Kabutack is a DSH plugin that centrally manages plugins, Skills, and MCP, enabling one-click role-based switching of capability sets.

description.zh: get-fable 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 插件，通过 25 个关联技能和生命周期管理，让现有编码代理具备更严谨的规划、测试、验证与恢复能力，提升编码循环的纪律性。
description.en: get-fable is a DSH plugin that equips your existing coding agent with 25 connected skills and a lifecycle for disciplined planning, testing, verification, and recovery, fostering a stronger coding loop.

description.zh: KnowLP-RAG 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供双知识图谱 RAG 检索，将 Markdown 笔记构建为会衰减遗忘的图谱，输出带阅读路径的排序结果。
description.en: KnowLP-RAG provides dual knowledge-graph RAG retrieval for DeepSeek Harness, turning Markdown notes into a decaying memory graph with reading-path-ranked results.

description.zh: 把 Pare 的 AI 磁盘调查能力接入 DeepSeek Harness：DSH 插件以只读工具扫描磁盘垃圾，经审批后把文件移入可撤销隔离区而非直接删除。
description.en: Brings Pare's AI disk investigation into DeepSeek Harness: the DSH plugin scans disk waste with read-only tools and, after approval, moves files into a reversible quarantine instead of deleting them.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 等 Agent 提供分层长期记忆 MCP 服务器，将对话沉淀为可语义检索的三层记忆，回答“我们上次聊到哪了”时带出完整上下文。
description.en: A layered long-term memory MCP server for DSH plugin and other LLM agents, distilling conversations into three semantic-searchable memory layers to recall full context.

description.zh: Gitee AI 员工是 DeepSeek Harness 的插件，在 issue 中 @ 机器人即可自动克隆仓库、开发并提交 PR，支持自动合并与关闭 issue，还能进行安全扫描。
description.en: Gitee AI Employee is a DSH plugin that, when mentioned in an issue, automatically clones the repo, develops the change, and opens a PR, with optional auto-merge and issue closing, plus security scanning.

description.zh: new-project-init 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的提问驱动技能，以存量完善为核心，帮项目理顺文档、固化 AI 分角色协作流程，支持中途加入与新项目初始化。
description.en: new-project-init is a question-driven skill for DeepSeek Harness, focused on optimizing existing project docs and AI-collaboration workflows, also supporting mid-way joining and new project scaffolding.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框加入带刻度的推理强度滑块，与模型选择器同处一个胶囊，支持主题变量与中英法多语言。
description.en: A notched reasoning-effort slider for DeepSeek Harness that shares one pill with the model picker in the composer, with theme-variable styling and i18n.

description.zh: DSH 插件：一键 OAuth 授权接入企查查法律数据 MCP，自动刷新 token，对话即可查询法规法条与司法案例。
description.en: DSH plugin: one-click OAuth connect to Qichacha legal-data MCP with auto token refresh; query regulations and case law via chat.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供只读的哈希链证据收据，记录工具结果与会话事件，留下可本地校验的执行痕迹而不存储明文。
description.en: An observe-only hash-chained evidence receipt plugin for DeepSeek Harness, logging tool results and session events to leave a locally checkable execution trail without storing plaintext.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通过提问即可查询 DeepSeek API 账户余额，注册 query_api_balance 工具并返回原始余额数据。
description.en: A DSH plugin that queries DeepSeek API balance by asking a question, registering the query_api_balance tool and returning raw balance data.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 聊天输入框打造彗星光标插件，将闪烁光标替换为平滑滑动的发光彗星，支持自定义拖尾、强调色与粗细，并适配 IME。
description.en: A DSH plugin that replaces the blinking cursor in DeepSeek Harness Web chat input with a smooth glowing comet, featuring customizable trails, accent colors, and thickness, with IME support.

description.zh: Spritely 是 DSH 的桌面精灵插件，在界面角落放置会动的小精灵，随智能体待命、思考、撰写、调用工具等状态实时变换姿态，并支持拖拽、自定义背景与划词工具条。
description.en: Spritely is a DSH plugin that places an animated desktop sprite in the corner of the interface, reacting in real time to the agent's idle, thinking, writing and tool-calling states, with drag-and-drop, custom backgrounds and a text-selection toolbar.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的插件与模型调用过程可视化成 3D 数字办公室，插件即员工、工位即岗位，谁在干活、交付了什么一眼可见。
description.en: Turns DeepSeek Harness plugin and model calls into a 3D digital office where each plugin is an employee at a fixed desk, so you can see who is working and what they deliver.

description.zh: 把思源笔记官方 MCP 桥接进 DeepSeek Harness，注册 mcp__siyuan__ 笔记工具与思源内置 AI，支持只读、写作、完全三档权限。
description.en: Bridges SiYuan Notes' official MCP into DeepSeek Harness, registering mcp__siyuan__ note tools plus SiYuan's built-in AI, with readonly, authoring and full permission profiles.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供高度可定制的主题插件，默认玉绿“魈”风格，支持配色、徽章、语音与毛玻璃背景调节。
description.en: A highly customizable theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness web UI, featuring a jade-green 'Xiao' look with adjustable colors, badge, voice, and frosted background.

description.zh: wechat-clawbot 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，通过微信 ClawBot 桥接让 DSH agent 接入微信，支持图片理解、文件传输、长期记忆、定时提醒与权限审批。
description.en: wechat-clawbot is a DSH plugin that bridges your DeepSeek Harness agent into WeChat via ClawBot, enabling native vision, file transfer, long-term memory, scheduled reminders, and in-chat approvals.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供全网搜索能力，涵盖网页、图片、视频检索及垂域结构化数据，作为实时问答依据。
description.en: Provides web-wide search for DeepSeek Harness, covering web, image, video retrieval and vertical structured data as real-time Q&A evidence.

description.zh: 紫白桌宠实时监控 CPU/内存/GPU/NVMe 温度与硬件信息，支持边缘停靠吸附，是 DeepSeek Harness 的 DSH 插件，可一键安装。
description.en: A purple-white desktop pet that monitors CPU/memory/GPU/NVMe temperatures and hardware info in real time, with edge docking and snap, as a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin.

description.zh: 让本地 DeepSeek Harness Agent 通过 BailingHub 安全查询数据、更新记录并执行业务系统授权操作，保留审批与审计轨迹。
description.en: Enable a local DeepSeek Harness Agent to query data, update records, and run authorized actions in business systems via BailingHub, with governance and audit.

description.zh: balance-dsh 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，在 Web UI 侧边栏显示账户余额与当前会话 token/费用，支持高峰/空闲时段计费。
description.en: balance-dsh is a DSH plugin that shows DeepSeek account balance and session token/cost in the sidebar, with peak/off-peak billing.

description.zh: DSH 插件，同步 cc-switch 各 provider 余额，按日/月/总量统计 token 用量与花费，支持币种与汇率设置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that syncs cc-switch provider balances and tracks token usage and costs by day/month/total, with currency and exchange rate support.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 界面注入死亡搁浅主题皮肤，并添加随 Agent 思考与工具执行而跳动的实时心跳监护仪，保留品牌鲸鱼蓝。
description.en: A Death Stranding skin for DeepSeek Harness UI plus a live heartbeat feed that pulses with agent thinking and tool execution, keeping the brand whale blue.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设置面板加入 Command Code 分区，实时展示额度余额、5 小时与每周用量窗口及模型目录同步。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a Command Code section to the DeepSeek Harness settings panel, showing credit balances, 5-hour and weekly usage windows, and model-catalog sync.

description.zh: 上下文剃刀是一款 DSH plugin，逐条列出会话上下文并估算 token 占比，勾选后精确裁剪，不经 LLM 总结，让你自己决定删什么。
description.en: Context Razor is a DSH plugin that lists every session context entry with token estimates and share, letting you precisely prune selected items without LLM summarization.

description.zh: cot-lint 是一款 DSH plugin，用于检测仓库文档与注释中 AI 助手遗留的思维链泄漏痕迹，帮助开发者保持代码注释的清晰与可读。
description.en: cot-lint is a DSH plugin that lints your repo for chain-of-thought leakage left by AI assistants in docs and comments, keeping prose clean and reviewable.

description.zh: DSH plugin 数据库连接器，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL 安全查询、模式内省、写审批与 JSONL 审计日志。
description.en: A DSH plugin database connector bundle for DeepSeek Harness, offering safe SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL queries, schema introspection, write approval, and JSONL audit trail.

description.zh: cordis-transfer-plugin 是一个持久化的 DSH 插件，用于导入导出动态 Cordis 插件，提供模型工具与浏览器设置面板，方便打包和恢复插件。
description.en: cordis-transfer-plugin is a persistent DSH plugin for importing and exporting dynamic Cordis plugins, offering model tools and a browser settings panel for bundling and restoring plugins.

description.zh: DSH plugin 专为 Linux kernel 开发提供 L1-L4 验证金字塔与 graph 层治理，内置 Goodhart 防护与 P1-P12 特性审计，帮助开发者规避结构性问题。
description.en: A DSH plugin for Linux kernel development, offering L1-L4 verification pyramid and graph-level governance with Goodhart guards and P1-P12 feature audit to prevent structural issues.

description.zh: DSH 的 Rust 开发验证插件，提供 fmt/clippy/build/miri/audit 验证金字塔与语义实践卡，强化 Rust 项目质量与供应链安全。
description.en: A DSH plugin for Rust development verification, offering a fmt/clippy/build/miri/audit verification pyramid and semantic practice cards to enhance Rust project quality and supply chain security.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏会话补上官方缺失的「删除会话」：红色菜单项、二次确认、运行中自动置灰，并真正清除注册表与磁盘数据。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds the missing Delete-session action to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, with a red menu row, confirmation dialog, liveness guard, and true removal of registry entries and on-disk data.

description.zh: Drive9 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化 agent 工作区与不可变、有界的工具证据存储，支持 revision CAS 文件系统与结果检索工具。
description.en: Drive9 provides persistent agent workspaces and durable, bounded tool evidence for DeepSeek Harness, with a revision-CAS filesystem and result search tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供点阵鲸鱼动态壁纸的 DSH 插件，用约 1750 个 WebGL2 粒子渲染呼吸游动的鲸鱼，指针划过会形成液态漩涡，并自带明暗双主题。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a live dot-matrix whale wallpaper to the DeepSeek Harness web UI, rendering ~1,750 breathing WebGL2 particles that swirl around your pointer, with light and dark themes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 A2A 协议双端能力：可同时托管多个入站 Agent 服务并连接多个出站远端，远端技能直接变成模型工具。
description.en: An A2A dual-end plugin for DeepSeek Harness that hosts multiple inbound agent servers and connects multiple outbound remotes, exposing remote skills as model tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供批量审查收件箱，暂存、检查、编辑并批准工具副作用，确保外部写入安全可控。
description.en: A batch review inbox for DeepSeek Harness to stage, inspect, edit, and approve tool side effects safely.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供基于模型能力的推理档位滑块，支持无级拖动、吸附对齐与像素风火焰特效，并保留官方模型选择与 /model 命令。
description.en: A capability-aware reasoning-effort slider for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, featuring stepless dragging, snap-on-release, and pixel-art fire effects while preserving the official model selector and /model command.

description.zh: dsh-1bot 将 OneBot 11（QQ）桥接为 DeepSeek Harness 的 UI 表面，每个聊天对应一个 agent 会话，通过 onebot_send 工具显式发送消息。
description.en: dsh-1bot bridges OneBot 11 (QQ) as a UI surface for DeepSeek Harness, mapping each chat to an agent session and sending messages explicitly via the onebot_send tool.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 Web GUI 提供任务完成与需要输入时的系统级通知，点击气泡即可打开会话，并集成官方设置页。
description.en: DSH plugin that delivers system-level notifications for task completion and input requests in the Web GUI, with click-to-open session and settings integration.

description.zh: DSH plugin 管理员验证网关，通过 Cloudflare Tunnel 零成本公网暴露，提供密码登录、会话 Cookie、防暴力破解与 DNS rebinding 防护，未认证流量到不了 dsh 本体。
description.en: A DSH plugin admin auth gateway that securely exposes dsh web via Cloudflare Tunnel, with password login, session cookies, brute-force and DNS rebinding protection.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness agent 提供专属邮件收件箱，入站邮件按线程绑定会话，支持发送、搜索、审批与跟进，让 agent 真正收发邮件。
description.en: Give a DSH plugin agent its own email inbox, with inbound mail bound to one session per thread, plus send, search, approval and follow-up tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供文件浏览器 Web 应用，支持面包屑导航、搜索、预览及 AI 分析，并暴露 browse_files/read_file 模型工具。
description.en: A file-browser web app for DeepSeek Harness with breadcrumbs, search, preview, and AI analysis, plus browse_files/read_file model tools.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理 Android SDK 与模拟器：23 个原生 android_* 工具覆盖环境探测、AVD 生命周期、Kotlin/Compose 脚手架、Gradle 构建运行与安装启动，并提供设置页。
description.en: Manage Android SDK and emulators inside DeepSeek Harness: 23 native android_* tools cover environment checks, AVD lifecycle, Kotlin/Compose scaffolding, Gradle build and run, install and launch, plus a settings page.

description.zh: 将 Claude Code OAuth（Pro/Max/Team）无缝桥接至 DeepSeek Harness，自动刷新令牌并同步模型目录，无需硬编码密钥。
description.en: Bridge Claude Code OAuth (Pro/Max/Team) into DeepSeek Harness with auto-refresh and model catalog sync, no hardcoded keys.

description.zh: dsh-antv-ava 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，让模型以流式叙述文本与 AntV 图表自动呈现数据密集型回答，无需手工配置。
description.en: dsh-antv-ava is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets the model present data-heavy answers as streaming narrative text and AntV charts automatically.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中接入 Google 官方 Antigravity ACP 作为主模型，工具调用仍由 DSH 校验、审批与执行，并可查看额度与预热连接。
description.en: Brings Google's official Antigravity ACP agent into DeepSeek Harness as a primary model while DSH keeps owning tool validation, approval and execution, with quota pills and connection warm-up.

description.zh: dsh-api-runner 是 DSH plugin，让模型按 YAML 配置调用后端接口、启停本地 Java 服务并按字节偏移增量读日志，改完代码即可自行验证。
description.en: dsh-api-runner is a DSH plugin that lets the model call backend APIs from YAML config, start/stop local Java services, and tail logs by byte offset, so it can verify its own code changes.

description.zh: dsh-alive 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供零 token 消耗的在线状态指示器，在会话头部常驻显示在线/离线状态点，每 15 秒自动检测。
description.en: dsh-alive is a zero-token online status indicator for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, showing an always-visible online/offline dot in the conversation header with 15-second auto-refresh.

description.zh: DSH plugin 基于统一 LLM 路由自动应答审批请求，支持 fail-closed 策略与多种审批模式，提升审批效率与安全性。
description.en: A DSH plugin that auto-answers approval requests via the unified LLM route with fail-closed policy checks, supporting multiple approval modes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上归档会话管理中心，可按日期、工作区筛选历史会话，批量取消归档，并用可撤销策略自动清理会话列表。
description.en: Adds an archived-session management center to DeepSeek Harness: browse archived sessions by date or workspace, unarchive in bulk, and run a reversible auto-cleanup policy.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上会话删除能力：任意会话可移入可还原的回收站或彻底删除，支持批量清理与失效条目自动对账。
description.en: Adds session deletion to DeepSeek Harness: move any session to a restorable trash or purge it permanently, with batch cleanup and automatic pruning of stale entries.

description.zh: DSH 插件，为审批面板提供快捷键：Enter 批准一次，Esc 拒绝，适用于所有审批来源，提升操作效率。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding hotkeys to approval panels: Enter approves once, Esc rejects, working across all approval sources for faster interaction.

description.zh: dsh-assembly.resume 是一个 DSH plugin，可将本地 Codex 与 Claude Code 会话导入 DeepSeek Harness，并绑定工作区后继续对话。
description.en: dsh-assembly.resume is a DSH plugin that imports local Codex and Claude Code sessions into DeepSeek Harness, binding workspaces to continue conversations.

description.zh: dsh-ATN 是 DeepSeek Harness 的自适应拓扑多智能体网络预设，让节点自主组网、点对点派发任务并共享白板，附带实时拓扑可视化面板。
description.en: dsh-ATN is an adaptive-topology multi-agent network preset for DeepSeek Harness, letting peer nodes self-organize, dispatch tasks and share a board, with live topology visualization.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 添加多媒体输入与工作区附件功能，支持文件/文件夹选择、拖拽上传，发送时自动复制到 Agent 工作区。
description.en: Adds multimedia input and workspace attachments to the DeepSeek Harness WebUI, supporting file/folder selection and drag-and-drop, with files copied to the Agent workspace on send.

description.zh: 把 AstrBot 接到本机 DeepSeek Harness 的 HTTP ingress 插件：AstrBot 继续当 QQ/OneBot 等 IM 网关，DSH 负责写代码，聊天窗口发 /dsh 即可驱动本地 Agent。
description.en: An HTTP ingress DSH plugin that bridges AstrBot to a local DeepSeek Harness agent: AstrBot stays the QQ/OneBot IM gateway while DSH does the coding, driven by a simple /dsh command in chat.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自动恢复被中断的会话：web 重启或网络故障后，扫描会话流并注入「继续」指令，让任务无缝接续。
description.en: A DSH plugin that auto-resumes interrupted sessions: after web restart or network failure, it scans session streams and injects a 'continue' instruction to seamlessly resume tasks.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自动处理 429 限流与配额耗尽，自动发送 continue 恢复对话，连续失败 20 次才停止，成功一次即清零。
description.en: A DSH plugin that automatically handles 429 rate limits and quota exhaustion by sending continue to resume conversations, stopping after 20 consecutive failures and resetting on success.

description.zh: DSH plugin，在DeepSeek Harness执行长任务时主动提醒你利用碎片时间进行微活动，将等待变成有产出的时间，并生成碎片利用报告。
description.en: A DSH plugin that proactively reminds you to engage in micro-activities during long-running DeepSeek Harness tasks, turning idle waiting into productive time and generating a utilization report.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 界面设置背景图的 DSH 插件，支持网络图、本地图与预设渐变，并可调透明度、磨砂模糊与分区效果。
description.en: A DSH plugin that sets a background image for the DeepSeek Harness interface, supporting web images, local files and preset gradients with opacity, frosted-glass blur and per-region tuning.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框下方提供实时余额读数：用本机 token 消耗推算 API 余额与可用时长，按峰谷分档计价并自动校准。
description.en: A live balance readout for DeepSeek Harness: it projects your API balance and time-to-empty from this machine's own token usage, priced by peak/off-peak tiers with self-calibration.

description.zh: dsh-backstory 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 插件，基于 git 历史与 agent 会话记录，为任意代码行解答其功能与存在缘由，让代码溯源有据可依。
description.en: dsh-backstory is a DSH plugin that grounds code provenance in git history and agent session logs, telling you what each line does and why it's here.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏实时展示 DeepSeek、Kimi、智谱与 TeamoRouter 的余额与用量，支持按会话自动刷新与插件内更新。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM and TeamoRouter balances and usage in the DSH Web sidebar, with per-session auto refresh and in-plugin updates.

description.zh: dsh-better 是 DSH plugin，为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web GUI 提供归档会话管理、任务通知、模型路由等增强功能，随装随用。
description.en: dsh-better is a DSH plugin that enhances DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with archived session management, task notifications, model routing, and more.

description.zh: 这款 DSH plugin 把第三方模型的思考强度与输入模态声明搬回官方「模型」页编辑卡，支持一键自动适配与请求头编辑，让模型在 Composer 里可选思考档位、可传图片。
description.en: This DSH plugin brings per-model reasoningEfforts and input modality declarations back into the official Models page edit card, with one-click auto-adaptation and header editing, so third-party models get reasoning tiers and image input in the Composer.

description.zh: dsh-better-overleaf 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Overleaf 集成，通过 git 桥接与 cookie 快照将 Overleaf 项目镜像到本地，并支持侧边栏文件预览与同步。
description.en: dsh-better-overleaf integrates Overleaf into DeepSeek Harness, mirroring projects locally via git bridge and cookie snapshots, with sidebar file preview and sync.

description.zh: DSH 网页端 UX 增强套件，提供会话行操作、大模型选择器、移动端优化与全局字体缩放，提升 DeepSeek Harness 操作效率。
description.en: A web UX kit for DeepSeek Harness: session row actions, a large model picker, mobile optimization, and global font scaling.

description.zh: 用本地视频替换 DSH 启动页并淡入应用的界面插件，支持随机播放、淡出时长与点击进入等可调参数。
description.en: A DSH plugin that replaces the startup page with a local video and dissolves into the app, with configurable playback, fade timing and click-to-enter controls.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 加一段视频开机片头：启动时全屏播放 mp4，点击或 Esc 跳过，还能导入自己的视频并自动转码。
description.en: Adds a full-screen mp4 boot splash to DeepSeek Harness: plays on startup, skippable with a click or Esc, and supports importing your own video with automatic transcoding.

description.zh: 面向中国大陆市场的 DSH 中文合规与工程技能集，打包 7 个离线技能，覆盖对外文案合规红线、AI 生成内容标识、个人信息保护对照、应用市场上架预检、GB/T 9704 公文排版、发布前自检与密钥扫描。
description.en: A China-focused DSH plugin bundle of 7 offline skills covering Chinese compliance red lines, AI-generated content labeling, personal information protection checks, app store preflight, GB/T 9704 document formatting, release self-checks and secret scanning.

description.zh: 为 DS Bot 提供浮动看板的 DSH plugin：只读展示每个 Bot 正在运行、卡住还是等你处理，无需逐个打开对话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a floating board for DS Bot, showing read-only which Bots are running, stuck, or waiting on you without opening each chat.

description.zh: DSH plugin，在每轮首条 assistant 回复下方以黄色单行提示提示缓存未命中，展示重计费 token、命中量与 TTFT，帮助监控模型推理成本。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows a yellow one-line prompt cache miss notice under the first assistant reply of each turn, displaying re-billed tokens, cached tokens, and TTFT to help monitor model inference costs.

description.zh: CacheScope 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供提示缓存可观测性与逻辑输入诊断，展示模型调用的缓存用量及相邻输入差异，并附带桌面仪表盘。
description.en: CacheScope brings prompt-cache observability and logical-input diagnostics to DeepSeek Harness, showing cache usage of model calls and differences between adjacent inputs, with a desktop dashboard.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版换上动态背景的 DSH 插件：内置 10 种场景渲染器、壁纸素材库与分区透明，并附带复刻的 Appearance 设置面板。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives the DeepSeek Harness desktop app animated backgrounds: 10 scene renderers, a wallpaper library, per-region surface transparency, and a faithful Appearance settings panel.

description.zh: dsh-carbon 为你的 DeepSeek Harness 会话估算碳足迹，按 token 用量与公开因子给出区间与置信说明，并在终端与网页 GUI 中展示历史趋势。
description.en: dsh-carbon estimates the carbon footprint of your DeepSeek Harness sessions from token counts and sourced factors, with confidence bands, durable local history, and a terminal plus web GUI view.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自动归档闲置会话，按闲置阈值隐藏于侧边栏但完整保留数据，可随时恢复，并提供独立设置界面与预览脚本。
description.en: A DSH plugin that auto-archives idle conversations, hiding them from the sidebar while preserving data, with configurable thresholds and a preview script.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在聊天中内联显示图片，支持灯箱放大、下载（另存为）及左右切换，增强对话中的图片浏览体验。
description.en: A DSH plugin that displays images inline in chat with lightbox zoom, download (save-as), and prev/next navigation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 监视 GitHub Actions 新失败，将原始日志转为结构化诊断卡，并通过签名账本识别复发问题，让 CI 失败在打开日志前就得到诊断。
description.en: DSH plugin that watches GitHub Actions for new failures, turns raw logs into structured diagnosis cards, and uses a signature ledger to flag repeat failures before you open the logs.

description.zh: 猫咪主题工坊（Catnap Studio）为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供三套原创猫咪主题与可互动桌面猫咪，并保留任务、文件、统计等完整工作台能力。
description.en: Catnap Studio is a DSH plugin that brings three original cat themes and an interactive desktop cat to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, while retaining full workbench capabilities like tasks, files, and stats.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面添加聊天头像：AI 回复左侧、用户输入右侧各一个，两侧可独立上传图片、调尺寸与形状。
description.en: Adds chat avatars to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: one on the left of each AI reply and one on the right of each user message, each side independently configurable.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将自包含编码子任务委派给本地 Claude Code 订阅执行，支持 resume 跨轮记忆、后台异步任务、额度监控与结构化输出，让 DSH 当 leader、Claude Code 当 worker。
description.en: A DSH plugin that delegates self-contained coding subtasks to local Claude Code subscription, featuring resume memory, background async tasks, usage monitoring, and structured output, with DSH as leader and Claude Code as worker.

description.zh: dsh-cipher 将 cipher 的持续思考、三中台与四类记忆以 UNNI/LOOP 会话模式接入 DeepSeek Harness，自动沉淀并跨会话召回记忆。
description.en: dsh-cipher brings cipher's persistent thinking, three platforms, and four memory types to DeepSeek Harness via UNNI/LOOP session modes, with automatic memory sedimentation and cross-session recall.

description.zh: 把 DSH 默认的推理强度下拉框换成 Claude 风格拖拽滑块，内置 23 种 Canvas 粒子动效、档位音效、主题配色与手柄图标自定义。
description.en: Replaces DSH's default reasoning-effort dropdown with a Claude-style drag slider, bundling 23 Canvas particle effects, snap sounds, theme colors and handle-icon customization.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供社区俄语本地化，通过 locale API 注册 ru 语言，覆盖 63 个命名空间、3119 条文案，安装后可在语言选择器中切换 Русский。
description.en: Community Russian localization for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, registering the ru language via the locale API with 63 namespaces and 3119 strings, so Русский appears in the language picker.

description.zh: DSH plugin将DeepSeek Harness对话历史一键生成概念、流程图、对比、总结等九种知识卡片，支持多格式下载与分享。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns DeepSeek Harness chat history into nine types of knowledge cards—concepts, flowcharts, comparisons, summaries, and more—ready to download and share.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端提供基于配置文件的键盘快捷键，支持问答、审批流程及会话与工作区导航，提升操作效率。
description.en: Profile-aware keyboard shortcuts for the DeepSeek Harness Web Client, enabling keyboard-driven question, approval, session, and workspace navigation.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页管理 MCP 服务器：运行时添加、编辑、启停、重连与删除，实时状态与自动重连，中英双语界面。
description.en: Manage MCP servers from the DeepSeek Harness settings page: add, edit, enable/disable, reconnect and delete at runtime, with live status and auto-reconnect.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Cloudflare Zero Trust 远程接入，插件自动管理 Access 应用、访问策略、Tunnel 与 DNS，主机无需公网 IP 或入站端口即可安全访问。
description.en: Cloudflare Zero Trust remote access for DeepSeek Harness: the DSH plugin manages Access apps, policies, Tunnel and DNS so a self-hosted Harness is reachable over HTTPS with no public IP or inbound ports.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 AI 写完代码后自动执行三步全面检查（构建运行、功能完整性、真实用户模拟），把问题反馈给 AI 修复直至返回“没有问题”，并附带 GUI 仪表盘与 CLI。
description.en: A DSH plugin that runs a three-step comprehensive check (build & run, feature completeness, real-user simulation) after AI writes code, reports issues back for fixing until clean, with optional GUI dashboard and CLI.

description.zh: DSH Web 插件，一键将 git diff 转为独立双列代码审查页，支持语法高亮与行内评论，提升代码审查效率。
description.en: DSH web plugin that turns git diff into a standalone two-column code review page with syntax highlighting and inline comments.

description.zh: DSH 代码安全审查插件：确定性规则引擎扫描 40+ 安全规则，支持 git diff 增量审查、修复验证、基线接受与 SARIF 导出，零运行时依赖。
description.en: DSH plugin for deterministic code security review: 40+ rules, git diff incremental scan, fix verification, baseline acceptance, and SARIF export with zero runtime dependencies.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桥接 Codebase Memory MCP，注册六个知识图谱代码工具，支持代码搜索、AST 片段、架构分析与调用链追踪，并自动启动图谱 Web UI。
description.en: A Codebase Memory MCP bridge plugin for DeepSeek Harness that registers six knowledge-graph code tools for code search, AST snippets, architecture analysis and call-graph tracing, with an auto-started graph Web UI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex 集成：ChatGPT OAuth 登录、Codex 模型、图片输入与流式恢复，社区维护的非官方 DSH plugin。
description.en: Community Codex plugin for DeepSeek Harness: ChatGPT OAuth, Codex models, image input, and reliable stream recovery.

description.zh: dsh-codex-approval 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来 Codex 式 AI 自动审批，通过规则与三级风险评估自动放行或拒绝沙箱操作，实现审批自动化。
description.en: dsh-codex-approval brings Codex-style AI approval to DeepSeek Harness, auto-approving or rejecting sandbox operations via rules and three-level risk assessment.

description.zh: Codekin 是 DeepSeek Harness 的收集与三消 RPG 插件，将 DSH 运行结果转化为本地游戏事件，提供捕捉、战斗与养成玩法。
description.en: Codekin is a creature-collection and match-three RPG plugin for DeepSeek Harness, turning DSH runtime outcomes into local game events with capture, battle, and growth mechanics.

description.zh: DSH plugin 原生 Settings → Usage 用量仪表盘：实时余额、官方今日消费、Token 构成与月度趋势，密钥不出本机。
description.en: Native Settings → Usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: real-time balance, official daily spend, token analysis and monthly trends, keys never leave the host.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通过 OpenAI Codex OAuth 接入 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 的 Codex 模型，支持流式、工具调用、推理、自动刷新令牌等能力，无需 Pi 安装。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that brings ChatGPT Plus/Pro Codex models via OpenAI Codex OAuth, with streaming, tool calls, reasoning, and automatic token refresh.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将输入框多行粘贴与已发送长消息折叠为紧凑内联标签，避免聊天记录刷屏，发送内容仍保持完整原文。
description.en: A DSH plugin that collapses multi-line pastes and long sent messages into compact inline chips, keeping chat logs tidy while sending the full original text.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 /code-review 斜杠命令，以多视角并行审查 PR 与本地代码，并输出带置信度与严重度评分的审查报告。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding a /code-review slash command that reviews pull requests and local code through parallel lenses, with confidence and severity scoring.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框提供全屏扩展功能，当内容超过三行时显示扩展按钮，支持三连换行自动扩展，发送后自动折叠，提升长文本编辑体验。
description.en: A DSH plugin that expands the composer to fullscreen when content exceeds three lines, with auto-expand on triple newline and auto-collapse after sending, enhancing long-text editing.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Command Code 余额与配额面板，在输入框下方实时显示 5 小时、每周、每月用量窗口与可用余额。
description.en: A Command Code balance and quota panel for DeepSeek Harness, showing 5-hour, weekly and monthly usage windows plus available balance right under the composer.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可观察、可约束的桌面 Computer Use 能力，通过独立虚拟光标观察屏幕、定位元素并完成点击、输入、滚动与拖拽。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness an observable, guarded Computer Use layer: observe the screen, locate UI elements, and act via an isolated virtual cursor for clicks, typing, scrolling and dragging.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 桌面操作能力：截图、鼠标、键盘、窗口与剪贴板，由内置 Rust 助手完成原生调用。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness agents real Windows desktop control — screenshots, mouse, keyboard, windows and clipboard — powered by a bundled native Rust helper.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于真实数据的会话上下文罗盘：头部徽章、/compass 命令与一览面板，直观判断该继续还是新开会话。
description.en: A real-data context compass for DeepSeek Harness: header badge, /compass command and an overview panel that tell you whether to continue or start a fresh session.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话上下文指示器，实时显示提示词体积、单步成本、缓存命中、上下文分带与压缩阈值、账户余额及峰谷计费，并可一键交接；全程只做测量与计算，不调用模型、不消耗 token。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows a session context chip: prompt size, step cost, cache-hit, context bands, compaction threshold, DeepSeek balance and peak/off-peak tariff, plus a handoff button. It only measures and computes — never calls a model and spends no tokens.

description.zh: DSH 会话上下文守卫插件：读取官方 contextPressure 投影，在会话过长前用徽标与横幅提醒收尾，占用超 45% 时自动生成交接文档。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that watches the official contextPressure projection and warns you to wrap up before a session gets too long — badge plus one-shot banner, and an auto-drafted handoff block once occupancy passes 45%.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供只读的上下文来源账本，标记请求证据为 Observed、Estimated 或 Unavailable，不返回提示文本或原始路径，保护隐私。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing an observe-only provenance ledger, labeling request evidence as Observed, Estimated, or Unavailable without exposing prompt text or raw paths.

description.zh: DSH Context Console 是 DeepSeek Harness 的上下文工作台，集成会话轨迹、Prompt/Skill/MCP/Tools 管理、缓存历史与 sessionlog 修复，并兼容消息锻造台。
description.en: DSH Context Console is a complete context workbench for DeepSeek Harness, integrating trajectory, inventory, cache history, message forge, and session-log recovery.

description.zh: DSH plugin 会话管理插件，提供归档恢复、批量操作、工作区分组、子代理关系、活动详情与安全文件清理，集中管理 DeepSeek Harness 会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin for session management, offering archive/restore, batch operations, workspace grouping, subagent relations, activity details, and secure file cleanup for DeepSeek Harness.

description.zh: 为 DSH 提供会话轮次标记能力，把无效对话标为 invalid，让压缩时将其排除在检查点之外，且不删除任何消息。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets you mark conversation turns as invalid so compaction leaves them out of the checkpoint, without deleting any message.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 内置 GitHub Copilot 通道补上网页设备码登录与注销入口，预置开箱即用的 Provider 路由，并支持模型列表管理，全程免填 API Token。
description.en: Adds web device-code sign-in and sign-out for the GitHub Copilot channel built into DeepSeek Harness, ships a ready-to-use provider route, and manages the model list without any API token.

description.zh: DSH plugin 开发套件：内置 35 条离线 Cordis/DSH 规范，提供脚手架、静态检查、运行时调试与性能门，帮助开发者高质量构建 DeepSeek Harness 插件。
description.en: A DSH plugin development kit with 35 offline Cordis/DSH standards, scaffolding, static checks, runtime debugging, and performance gates for building high-quality DeepSeek Harness plugins.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话头部嵌入实时成本芯片，按桶统计 token 用量、峰谷电价与下次切换倒计时，点击可查看分模型费用明细。
description.en: A DSH plugin that embeds a live cost chip in the DeepSeek Harness conversation header, showing per-bucket token usage, peak/off-peak tariff and a switch countdown, with a per-model breakdown modal.

description.zh: DSH 插件在 Web 聊天中回答前预估 token 与 DeepSeek API 费用，回答后展示实际账单，内置峰谷计价与持续校准。
description.en: A DSH plugin that estimates token usage and DeepSeek API cost before answering in Web chat, then shows actual billing after, with peak/off-peak pricing and continuous calibration.

description.zh: DSH 侧边栏定时任务面板，分区管理 DSH 与系统 crontab 任务，支持自然语言创建、执行日志与失败重试，是 DeepSeek Harness 的实用调度增强插件。
description.en: A DSH sidebar panel for scheduled tasks, managing DSH and system crontab jobs with natural-language creation, execution logs, and retry—a practical scheduler enhancement for DeepSeek Harness.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接管理 CLIProxyAPI 渠道账号：查余额、签到、切号，并自动注册四个渠道的对话模型，装完即用。
description.en: Manage CLIProxyAPI channel accounts right inside DeepSeek Harness — check balances, auto check-in, switch accounts, and auto-register chat models from four channels, ready out of the box.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入任意 OpenAI 兼容图像接口，在对话中直接完成文生图、图像编辑与批量生成，并把原图保存到工作区。
description.en: Adds OpenAI-compatible image generation to DeepSeek Harness: text-to-image, image editing and batch generation rendered right in the conversation, with originals saved to your workspace.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 角色提供持久人设与关系状态，通过事件评价、亲密度与用户信念的积累，让角色跨会话逐渐形成对你的长期认识。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives AI characters persistent personas and evolving relationship state, turning events, intimacy and user beliefs into a long-term model of you across sessions.

description.zh: DSH 插件课程助手：把 PPTX/PDF/DOCX/MD 课程文件拖进面板，自动识别章节目录、逐章提炼知识点与重难点，检索 B 站配套网课并生成可导出 PDF 的 Markdown 学习报告。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns dropped PPTX/PDF/DOCX/MD course files into a chapter outline, per-chapter key points and difficulties, Bilibili course matches, and an exportable Markdown/PDF study report.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可复用的专业子 Agent 管理，通过 delegate_agent 工具一键委派代码审查、文档撰写等角色，无需写代码。
description.en: Provides reusable professional subagents for DeepSeek Harness, enabling one-click delegation of roles like code review and documentation via the delegate_agent tool, no coding required.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让用户在设置页像 Word 一样自定义界面字体、字号、加粗与颜色，所见即所得并自动保存。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets users customize interface fonts, sizes, weights, and colors Word-style in settings, with WYSIWYG and auto-save.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为每个工作区定制独立外观：背景、字体大小、行高、Markdown 间距与渲染偏好，并持久化到 settings.yaml。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives each workspace its own background, font size, line height, Markdown spacing, and font-rendering preference, persisted in settings.yaml.

description.zh: DSH 插件，让当前 Agent 将独立任务委托给本机已登录的 Cursor CLI，通过 ACP 协议执行并返回结果。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets the current agent delegate standalone tasks to the local Cursor CLI over ACP.

description.zh: dsh-crw 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 fastCRW 的 web_search 与 web_fetch 提供者，安全地开启网页抓取能力。
description.en: dsh-crw provides fastCRW-backed web_search and web_fetch providers for DeepSeek Harness, safely enabling web fetching.

description.zh: DSH 数据库 MCP 桥接插件：常驻多源 dbhub 服务，按工作区提供 SQL 工具，支持临时动态连接，未装 dbhub 时自动安装更新。
description.en: DSH plugin bridging DBHub MCP server: persistent multi-source connections, workspace-scoped SQL tools, and ad-hoc dynamic connections, with auto-install and auto-update of dbhub.

description.zh: DSH plugin 深海摸鱼浮窗小游戏：对话 context 越深潜得越深，AI 答完一轮即集镭射海洋生物卡，上班摸鱼摸出收藏。
description.en: A DSH plugin deep-sea slacking mini-game: the deeper your context, the deeper you dive; each AI reply earns a holo ocean creature card.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多 agent 隔离辩论工具：不同立场子 agent 独立取证、交叉辩论、评审收敛，支持后台 job、并行波次与断点续跑。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding a debate tool: isolated subagents with diverse personas research, cross-examine, and converge via judges, with background jobs, parallel waves, and resume support.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在设置-模型-DeepSeek 卡片内集成余额与用量监控，并在输入框工具行显示实时余额 chip，助你随时掌握账户消耗。
description.en: A DSH plugin that embeds balance and usage monitoring into the Settings-Models-DeepSeek card, plus a live balance chip in the composer tool row.

description.zh: DSH 插件在 Web UI 会话头部实时显示 DeepSeek 官方服务状态，支持组件状态、事件与可用率展示，让您随时掌握服务健康度。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows live DeepSeek official service status in the Web UI session header, including component statuses, incidents, and uptime percentages.

description.zh: 将 DeepSeek 网页版会话归档变为 DSH 插件中的可编程只读工具：列会话、下载全文、搜索索引、生成高密度摘要。
description.en: Operate chat.deepseek.com as a programmable agent from inside DeepSeek Harness: list, download, search, and digest your session archive — read-only.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 封装成原生 Windows 桌面客户端的 DSH plugin，装插件即得独立桌面窗口，并注入标准桌面 SDK 供其他插件开原生窗口。
description.en: A DSH plugin that wraps DeepSeek Harness in a native Windows desktop client, giving you a standalone window on install and injecting a standard desktop SDK so other plugins can open native windows.

description.zh: dsh-df-memory 是 DeepSeek Harness 的记忆插件，将 lhdrc-agent-memory 的记忆能力接入 agent 工具面，提供查询、读写、技能注入等记忆工具。
description.en: dsh-df-memory is a DSH plugin that integrates lhdrc-agent-memory's memory capabilities into the agent tool surface, offering memory query, read/write, and skill injection tools.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 创建 Windows 桌面快捷方式，双击即可启动，并附带可拖动的刷新按钮，提升日常使用体验。
description.en: A DSH plugin that creates a Windows desktop shortcut for DeepSeek Harness Web, enabling one-click launch and adding a draggable refresh button to the UI.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自动为子代理调用路由 Flash/Pro 模型：轻任务走廉价 Flash，重任务保持 Pro，支持规则自定义与 /delegate 手动覆盖，并记录每次分派决策。
description.en: A DSH plugin that automatically routes subagent calls between Flash and Pro models: light tasks go cheap, heavy tasks stay strong, with DIY rules and /delegate overrides, plus a decision ledger.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端提供逐轮文件改动卡片：工具行显示 +N −M，轮末汇总本轮改动文件，可展开审 diff、一键撤销，并用系统应用或 VS Code 打开。
description.en: A per-turn file-change card for DeepSeek Harness Desktop: tool rows show +N −M, each turn ends with a summary of edited files, and you can expand diffs, review, revert, or open files in the system app or VS Code.

description.zh: DSH plugin 骰子大作战：在 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 侧边栏一键开启六种晋城传统骰子玩法，单人挑战 AI，中英双语界面。
description.en: A DSH plugin bringing six classic Jincheng dice games to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI sidebar, playable single-player vs AI with bilingual UI.

description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 工作区映射到 Discord 频道，通过 Discord 命令远程查询会话轨迹和实时子代理，并驱动 Agent 运行，无需开放入站端口。
description.en: Map DeepSeek Harness workspaces onto Discord channels, query session trajectories and live subagents, and drive an agent via Discord commands from anywhere without inbound ports.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 提供经典 Dracula 深色主题及 Dracula Soft 变体，完整覆盖界面与代码高亮配色，可在设置中一键切换。
description.en: A Dracula theme for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) with classic and Soft variants, full token coverage for UI and code highlighting, switchable in Settings.

description.zh: 在运行中的 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面里彻底删除会话：同步清理实时存储、工作区记录与磁盘文件，支持单条删除和设置页批量管理。
description.en: A DSH plugin that permanently deletes DeepSeek Harness sessions from the running Web GUI — clearing the live store, workspace records and on-disk artifacts, with single-row and bulk cleanup.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在本地浏览器中逐词审阅 Markdown 文档，支持添加注释、替换建议和删除建议，可处理单个文件或整个目录，审阅结果集中存储供 Agent 读取。
description.en: A DSH plugin that reviews Markdown documents word by word in a local browser, with annotations, replacement and deletion suggestions, supporting single files or whole directories, with annotations stored centrally for agent access.

description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 发送按钮旁加一根 3D 拉杆，拉动后基于模型思维链文本信号触发像素风抽卡演出，纯属娱乐。
description.en: Adds a 3D lever next to the send button in DeepSeek Harness; pulling it triggers a pixel-art gacha show based on the model's reasoning text signals. Just for fun.

description.zh: DSH Dungeon Party 是 DeepSeek Harness 的五智能体编排插件，以坦克/输出/治疗角色分工，提供租约、作用域、检查点、验证与恢复机制，让并行智能体安全可控。
description.en: DSH Dungeon Party is a five-agent orchestration plugin for DeepSeek Harness, using Tank/DPS/Healer roles with leases, scopes, checkpoints, validation, and recovery for safe parallel agents.

description.zh: DSH-dseyes 为 DeepSeek Harness 的纯文本模型装上「眼睛」，在 Web GUI 中粘贴或拖入图片即可作为附件发送，host 端自动调用智谱 GLM 免费视觉模型识别图片内容，DeepSeek 基于文字描述直接回答，无需额外命令或改模型。
description.en: DSH-dseyes gives DeepSeek Harness's text-only models native image upload: paste or drag an image in the Web GUI, and the host automatically uses Zhipu GLM free vision models to recognize it, letting DeepSeek answer based on the text description.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 草稿润色插件，发送前点击 ✨ 一键调用 LLM 润色草稿，结果回填输入框，支持会话上下文。
description.en: Draft polish plugin for DeepSeek Harness: one-click LLM polish of your draft in the composer, rewrites it in place with session context.

description.zh: DSH plugin 电气电子计算插件，以 ElectroLab 模式提供电路、信号与电子学计算，支持复数与单位处理，结果可验证并生成技术文章。
description.en: An electrical & electronics calculation plugin for DeepSeek Harness, offering circuit, signal and electronics math with complex numbers and exact units, plus verifiable results and article generation.

description.zh: Echelon 是 DeepSeek Harness 的挡位式模型路由插件，把众多模型收成自定义挡位，按序调用、失败重试并自动降级。
description.en: Echelon is a tier-based model router DSH plugin that groups many models into named tiers, dispatching in order with retries and automatic failover.

description.zh: 把 DSH 运行错误与编程任务复盘沉淀为本地记忆图谱，教训自动注入上下文，并以 WebGL 星图呈现。
description.en: A local-first DSH plugin that records runtime errors and coding retrospectives as a WebGL knowledge graph and injects reusable lessons back into the prompt.

description.zh: ETeams 是 DeepSeek Harness 的多智能体团队协作插件：领队拆解目标、成员在各自子会话接力执行，进度与决策实时可见，还可为成员分配不同模型。
description.en: ETeams is a multi-agent team plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a lead agent breaks down goals and members execute in their own sub-sessions, with live progress and per-member model assignment.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 everything_search 工具，借助本地 Everything 索引实现毫秒级全盘文件与文件夹搜索，替代逐层 glob 扫描。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds an everything_search tool, using the local Everything index for millisecond whole-disk file and folder search instead of recursive glob scans.

description.zh: T专家为 DeepSeek Harness 带来 22 分类、623 位专家的中文名册，输入 @ 即可召唤专家作为子代理跑一轮并交回结果，还支持自建专家与分类。
description.en: T-expert brings a Chinese-language roster of 623 experts across 22 categories to DeepSeek Harness: type @ to summon an expert as a subagent for one run, with support for custom experts and categories.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供暖色护眼主题，含暖亮、暖暗与系统自适应模式，通过语义化 token 替换冷色界面，保留原生外观设置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings warm light, warm dark, and system-aware eye-care themes to DeepSeek Harness Web, using semantic tokens while preserving native appearance settings.

description.zh: DSH ExpMem 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供长期个人记忆，将习惯、任务经验与工程洞见存储为可检查的本地文件，并支持从 Claude Code 和 Codex 导入记忆。
description.en: DSH ExpMem provides long-term personal memory for DeepSeek Harness, storing habits, task experience, and engineering insights in inspectable local files, with import from Claude Code and Codex.

description.zh: dsh-eyecare 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面一键开启科学护眼模式，豆沙绿配色适配浅色/深色/跟随系统，开关状态自动记忆。
description.en: dsh-eyecare adds an eye-care mode toggle to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, applying a scientifically tuned bean-green palette that adapts to light/dark/system themes and remembers its state.

description.zh: DSH plugin 一键 Git Commit：由当前会话模型将工作区改动拆分为 Conventional Commits 批次，经审查后执行，并自动过滤敏感文件。
description.en: One-click Git commit DSH plugin: the session model splits workspace changes into reviewed Conventional Commits batches, with built-in sensitive-file filtering.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 打造的 F1 赛事控制中心皮肤，内置红牛、法拉利、迈凯伦、梅奔四支车队主题，可一键切换品牌色与赛车摄影背景，并在原生设置面板调节强度。
description.en: An F1 Race Control themed skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, offering Red Bull, Ferrari, McLaren and Mercedes team themes with broadcast racing backdrops and a native settings panel.

description.zh: DSH 插件全家桶引导器，装一个带齐 14 件成员：Git 服务器、WebDAV 挂载盘、知识库、定时任务、自动续跑、界面微调与自动复盘，面板内一键补装与更新。
description.en: A DSH plugin bundle bootstrapper that installs 14 members at once — Git server, WebDAV drive, knowledge base, cron tasks, auto-continue, UI tweaks and auto-retro — with one-click install and update in its panel.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让 DeepSeek Harness 通过飞书或 Lark 机器人对话，基于 WebSocket 长连接，无需公网 URL，每个聊天对应独立 Agent 会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets DeepSeek Harness talk via Feishu/Lark bot over WebSocket long connection, no public URL needed, one agent per chat.

description.zh: DSH plugin 飞书通知插件，在需要用户操作或对话结束时发送飞书机器人提醒，并支持持久化配置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that sends Feishu bot notifications when user action is needed or a conversation ends, with persistent configuration.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让你在 DeepSeek Harness 内按文件名或内容搜索工作区文件，并直接在右侧栏预览或内置编辑器中修改。
description.en: A DSH plugin that searches workspace files by name or content inside DeepSeek Harness, then opens results in the right-sidebar preview or the built-in editor.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端提供聊天区右侧 Explorer 文件面板与 Preview 预览面板，并支持输入框 @ 引用项目文件（树形多选、胶囊与行号），由真实文件系统与 git 驱动。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding right-panel Explorer and Preview panels to the chat area, plus @ file references in the composer with tree multi-select, chips, and line numbers, all driven by the real filesystem and git.

description.zh: 基于 dsh-better-sidebar 的 DSH 统一引用插件，划选文件或消息即可批注引用，引用块带文件路径与行区间，双端折叠并点击跳回原文。
description.en: A unified-quoting DSH plugin built on dsh-better-sidebar: select files or messages to annotate; quote blocks carry path & line range, collapse in chat and history, and jump back to the source on click.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为输入框添加 Codex 式 @ 文件/文件夹引用，支持菜单选择、token 着色与点击预览，让模型零搜索直达文件。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding Codex-style @ file/folder mentions with menu pick, token coloring, and click-to-preview, letting the model reach files directly.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 聊天输出中的文件路径接管右键菜单，可直接用本机应用打开、在文件管理器中定位或复制绝对/相对路径。
description.en: A DSH plugin that takes over right-click on file paths in chat output, letting you open them with local apps, reveal them in the file manager, or copy absolute and relative paths.

description.zh: DSH plugin 语音合成插件：为每条助手回复提供一键朗读与自动朗读，支持 Fish Audio API、自定义音色、加密 Key 与代理，界面中英双语。
description.en: A DSH plugin for TTS: per-reply read-aloud and auto-read toggle, powered by Fish Audio API with custom voices, encrypted key, and proxy support; bilingual UI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可弹出式侧边栏，集成文件树与 Git 未提交变更列表，支持多标签预览代码、diff、图片与 PDF，还能弹出为独立浏览器标签页。
description.en: A pop-out sidebar plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that combines a file tree with a Git uncommitted-changes list, multi-tab previews of code, diffs, images and PDFs, and can detach into its own browser tab.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的烟花庆祝引擎插件，agent 编程时在对话窗口上空放烟花：六类事件触发不同花型，token 用量决定规模，WebGL2 渲染且不挡操作。
description.en: A fireworks celebration engine DSH plugin that sets off fireworks above the chat window while the agent codes: six event types trigger distinct shells, token usage scales the show, rendered with WebGL2 without blocking clicks.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注入「破甲模式」Agent 预设的 DSH plugin，纯声明式补丁，安装后即可在预设选择器启用强化政策正文与自检回执。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a "Free Mode" Agent preset to DeepSeek Harness via a pure declarative patch, enabling reinforced policy text and a self-check receipt from the preset selector.

description.zh: 让 DSH plugin 通过 FreeCAD 读写本机 STEP 模型，支持几何编辑、测量并生成第一角法二维加工图。
description.en: A DSH plugin that reads and edits local STEP models via FreeCAD, measuring geometry and generating first-angle 2D machining drawings.

description.zh: dsh-git-ui 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话头部提供 Git 状态胶囊，展示分支、脏计数、领先/落后、最近提交与变更文件，无需终端即可管理 Git。
description.en: dsh-git-ui adds a Git status pill to DeepSeek Harness session headers, showing branch, dirty counts, ahead/behind, recent commits and changed files, with full Git management without a terminal.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供外置大脑：对话开始自动拉取 GitHub 记忆文件注入上下文，对话结束提取新信息写回仓库并提交，跨设备跨重启保持长期记忆。
description.en: An external brain for DeepSeek Harness: it pulls memory files from a GitHub repo into context at conversation start and writes back new long-term memories at the end, keeping memory alive across devices and restarts.

description.zh: 把 GitHub 官方远程 MCP Server 封装成 DSH 插件，40+ 个 GitHub 工具以 mcp__github__* 形式可用，token 存入 DSH 凭据中心，可对话设置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that wraps GitHub's official remote MCP server, exposing 40+ GitHub tools as mcp__github__*, with the token stored in the DSH credential center and settable from chat.

description.zh: DSH 插件，通过 OAuth 设备码流程连接 GitHub，提供仓库、issues、PR、文件与搜索等 github_* 工具，并带配置页认证卡片。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects to GitHub via OAuth device flow, offering github_* tools for repos, issues, PRs, files, and search, with a config-page auth card.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话级行动档位滑轨，从只读规划到全自动一键换挡，换挡即注入行为约束提示词，并带模型升档审批与手刹硬拦截。
description.en: A session-level gear rail for DeepSeek Harness: switch from read-only planning to full autonomy in one click, injecting behavior prompts per gear, with model upshift approval and a handbrake that hard-blocks tool calls.

description.zh: DSH 插件：在设置页 GitHub MCP 面板随机展示可复制的示例用法与公开仓库星标统计，并提供 gh_repo_stats 模型工具查询星数、fork 与近 14 天克隆量。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a GitHub MCP panel in Settings with copyable random usage examples and public repo star/fork stats, plus gh_repo_stats model tools for stars, forks and 14-day clones.

description.zh: DSH plugin 侧边栏速查二游卡池与活动排期，内置 11 款主流游戏，支持联网刷新与自定义条目。
description.en: A DSH plugin for quick-checking gacha banners and event schedules in the sidebar, covering 11 popular games with auto-refresh and custom entries.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供玻璃拟态主题，支持自定义背景图、裁剪与自动明暗，并可在设置页实时调整透明度、模糊与配色。
description.en: A glassmorphism theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, with custom background images, cropping, auto light/dark, and live controls for opacity, blur, and color.

description.zh: DSH plugin 全局任务库：跨会话持久化任务、生成式 UI 面板与子智能体状态同步，让任务管理贯穿整个 Agent 工作流。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing a global task library with cross-session persistence, a generative-UI panel, and subagent job sync.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面添加 OpenCode Go 订阅余额小部件，在输入框工具行右侧实时显示滚动/每周/每月配额剩余百分比，数据来自官方用量接口，真实非估算。
