description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds an OpenCode Go subscription balance widget to the Web UI, showing rolling/weekly/monthly quota remaining at the right end of the composer tool row, sourced from the official usage API.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 ChatGPT OAuth 登录，通过设备码流程使用 OpenAI 模型，无需 API 密钥，并提供独立登录设置页。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds ChatGPT OAuth login to DeepSeek Harness, enabling OpenAI models via device-code flow without an API key, plus a dedicated settings page.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在底部面板嵌入掼蛋游戏，AI 工作时可来一把，纯前端单机，支持复盘与键盘操作。
description.en: A DSH plugin that embeds a Guandan card game in a bottom panel, letting you play while AI works; pure frontend, supports review and keyboard controls.

description.zh: 为 DSH 提供结构化上下文交接压缩：把陈旧对话整理成可复用的 Context Handoff，保留近期原始尾部，完整历史存入可检索的 SQLite 会话记录，让 16K/32K 小上下文本地模型也能持续长任务开发。
description.en: A DSH plugin that compacts aging conversation into a structured Context Handoff while keeping a recent raw tail and a searchable SQLite session history, so 16K/32K small-context local models can sustain long engineering sessions.

description.zh: 把类 Discord 社区装进 DeepSeek Harness：在 DSH 面板内注册账号、自建或加入社区，实时聊天、@ 提醒、贴图传文件并管理成员权限。
description.en: Brings a Discord-like community into DeepSeek Harness: register an account, create or join guilds inside the DSH panel, chat in real time, get @ mentions, share files and manage member permissions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Headroom 上下文压缩：自动压缩过长历史与大工具输出以省 token，原文可经 headroom_retrieve 取回。
description.en: Headroom context compression for DeepSeek Harness: automatically compacts long history and bulky tool output to save tokens, with originals retrievable via headroom_retrieve.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入官方 Grok Build 账号的 DSH plugin，支持动态模型发现、流式推理、图片输入、工具调用与额度面板。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects DeepSeek Harness to your official Grok Build account, offering dynamic model discovery, streaming reasoning, image input, tool calls, and a quota dashboard.

description.zh: Herald 传令官为 DeepSeek Harness 提供三通道任务通知：页内浮层、浏览器横幅与宿主直发系统通知，即使浏览器关闭也能收到审批与后台任务提醒。
description.en: Herald brings tri-channel task notifications to DeepSeek Harness: in-page toasts, browser banners, and host-direct OS toasts that still land when the browser is closed.

description.zh: DSH plugin 高峰资费提醒：启动时抓取 DeepSeek 官方定价并同步北京时间，处于峰时段即在页面中央弹出提醒窗口，助你错峰调用以节省费用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that fetches DeepSeek pricing and Beijing time on startup, popping up a central alert during peak hours to help you save on API costs.

description.zh: DSH 侧边栏插件，一键启动鸿蒙模拟器，并把 HarmonyOS 应用构建、安装、启动到目标设备，全程输出可见。
description.en: A DSH sidebar plugin that launches the HarmonyOS emulator and builds, installs, and runs your app on it, with live output at every step.

description.zh: dsh-gpu 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 GPU 感知执行层，通过 gpu_status、gpu_exec、gpu_run_bg 工具实现自动选卡、显存监控与后台 GPU 任务管理。
description.en: dsh-gpu provides a GPU-aware execution layer for DeepSeek Harness, offering gpu_status, gpu_exec, and gpu_run_bg tools for automatic card selection, memory monitoring, and background GPU job management.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 桌面控制能力：截屏标注、点击拖拽打字、窗口管理与 UIA 结构化查询，零依赖无常驻服务。
description.en: Windows desktop-control toolkit for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): annotated screenshots, click/drag/type/key/scroll, window management and UI Automation queries, with zero dependencies and no resident service.

description.zh: DSH plugin 热管理工具：在运行中的 dsh web 上直接热安装、卸载、禁用/启用插件 bundle，无需重启，并自带 Web 设置页。
description.en: A DSH plugin for hot-installing, uninstalling, and toggling plugin bundles on a running dsh web instance without restart, with a built-in Web UI.

description.zh: DSH plugin 的 Honcho v3 记忆适配器，自动保存对话、召回上下文与共享知识，并提供七个记忆工具，需自备 Honcho 后端服务。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adapts Honcho v3 memory, auto-capturing conversations, recalling context and shared knowledge, and offering seven memory tools; requires a Honcho backend.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供零 LLM 的确定性上下文压缩：请求超出字节上限时本地毫秒级压缩旧历史，原文逐字保留，并可用 recall 工具精确还原被压缩的工具输出。
description.en: Deterministic, zero-LLM context compaction for DeepSeek Harness: when a request exceeds its byte budget, old history is compacted locally in milliseconds, your own words stay verbatim, and compacted tool output can be restored byte-exactly via the recall tool.

description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness定制ADHD友好输出风格：动作先行、编号步骤、具体时间估算，通过adhd_on/off/status工具实时开关并跨重启持久化。
description.en: ADHD-friendly output shaping for DeepSeek Harness: action-first, numbered steps, concrete time estimates, with live on/off tools persisted across restarts.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面加装侧边栏轻量 IDE：工作区文件树、Agent 改动审阅与撤销、带 diff 的编辑和集成终端。
description.en: A lightweight IDE-in-the-sidebar plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: workspace file tree, agent-change review with undo, diff-based editing, and an integrated terminal.

description.zh: dsh-ide-sidebar 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 插件，将 DSH Web 侧边栏升级为 IDE 式工作区切换器，支持下拉切换、会话过滤、状态灯与搜索管理。
description.en: dsh-ide-sidebar is a DSH plugin that upgrades the DSH Web sidebar into an IDE-style workspace switcher with dropdown switching, session filtering, status lights, and search management.

description.zh: dsh-icon-theme 为 DeepSeek Harness 的设置与侧边栏自动发现并填充统一风格图标，支持用户自定义覆盖，让界面更清晰易辨。
description.en: dsh-icon-theme auto-detects and fills consistent icons for DeepSeek Harness settings and sidebar, with user-customizable overrides for a clearer interface.

description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 接入 QQ 官方机器人，通过私聊/群聊/频道 @ 与完整 agent 对话，支持工具、记忆、子代理、文件系统与审批护栏，与 Web UI 同源。
description.en: Integrate DeepSeek Harness with QQ official bot, enabling full agent interaction via private/group/channel @, with tools, memory, subagents, filesystem, and approval guardrails, same source as Web UI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供完整 REST 客户端与 curl 解析、请求历史对比等 HTTP/API 调试工具集，让 Agent 在对话中直接发送、解析和回放请求。
description.en: A complete REST client and HTTP/API debugging toolset for DeepSeek Harness, enabling agents to send, parse, and replay requests right in chat.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多模态能力，通过可配置的 OpenAI 兼容或 DashScope 端点理解与生成图像，让纯文本主模型也能处理图像。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds multimodal capabilities to DeepSeek Harness, understanding and generating images via configurable OpenAI-compatible or DashScope endpoints, enabling text-only main models to handle images.

description.zh: 让 DSH 侧边栏的图片与 PDF 预览支持 Ctrl+左键拖动平移，并为每个分栏加上独立关闭按钮，方便查看与整理。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets you pan zoomed image and PDF previews in the right sidebar with Ctrl+drag, and adds a per-pane close button for easier viewing.

description.zh: dsh-inbox 是一个 DeepSeek Harness 本地收件箱插件，把随手复制的链接、图片、文本和账密统一归档并自动分类，还能在对话里让助手直接检索取回。
description.en: dsh-inbox is a local inbox plugin for DeepSeek Harness that files copied links, images, text and credentials into one vault with automatic classification, and lets you retrieve them by asking your assistant in conversation.

description.zh: dsh-injection-guard 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于来源的提示注入防护，跟踪不可信上下文并拦截敏感工具调用，以可解释的风险评分阻断恶意指令。
description.en: dsh-injection-guard provides source-aware prompt injection protection for DeepSeek Harness, tracking untrusted context and blocking sensitive tool calls with explainable risk scoring.

description.zh: DSH 行内批注插件：选中助手回复文本即可添加批注，发送时随正文交给模型逐条回应，并支持跨刷新持久化。
description.en: A DSH plugin for inline comments: select assistant text to annotate, send annotations with the message for the model to address, with persistence across refreshes.

description.zh: DSH 原生工具插件，解析增值税电子发票 PDF/图片为结构化 JSON，自动勾稽金额并生成 Markdown/xlsx 报销单，全程本地处理不上传。
description.en: A DSH native tool plugin that parses Chinese e-invoice PDFs/images into structured JSON with amount cross-check, and generates expense reports in Markdown/xlsx, all processed locally.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中驱动 iOS 模拟器的 DSH plugin：提供 21 个原生 ios_* 工具，覆盖工程发现、构建、安装、启动、截图与日志，并附带可实时编辑参数的设置页。
description.en: A DSH plugin that drives the iOS Simulator from DeepSeek Harness with 21 native ios_* tools for project discovery, build, install, launch, screenshots and logs, plus a live-editable settings page.

description.zh: dsh-issue2pr 是运行在 DeepSeek Harness 宿主中的全局插件，将一条 Issue 或需求文档送入 11 阶段流水线，经检索、理解、规划、多智能体编码、真实测试与三维审查，产出可审查、可回滚、可追溯的 PR 说明与完整证据链。
description.en: dsh-issue2pr is a global plugin running in the DeepSeek Harness host that feeds an Issue or requirement document through an 11-stage pipeline—retrieval, understanding, planning, multi-agent coding, real testing, and three-dimensional review—to produce a reviewable, rollbackable, traceable PR description and full evidence chain.

description.zh: DSH Web GUI 对话轮次跳转条插件，在聊天区左侧显示轮次横线，支持悬停预览与一键跳转，提升长对话导航效率。
description.en: A DSH Web GUI conversation jump rail plugin that displays turn indicators on the left side, enabling hover preview and one-click navigation in long chats.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供 Kinich & Ajaw 主题界面，含丛林工作区、角色图层、Ajaw 桌面伴侣与原生设置集成，可调视觉强度。
description.en: A Kinich & Ajaw themed UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web, adding a jungle workspace, character layers, an Ajaw companion and native settings integration with adjustable visual intensity.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 API 密钥与订阅配额实时监控，通过悬浮徽标、输入栏状态与设置卡片展示剩余额度与重置倒计时。
description.en: Real-time API key and subscription quota monitoring for DeepSeek Harness, surfacing remaining limits and reset countdowns via a floating chip, composer bar status and settings card.

description.zh: 知枢 KnowHub 是 DSH 的全局知识中心与项目长期记忆插件，把项目知识沉淀为可检索、可审核、可版本回溯的知识库，并在会话中按工作区自动注入上下文。
description.en: KnowHub is a DSH plugin that serves as a global knowledge hub and long-term project memory, turning project knowledge into a searchable, reviewable, versioned knowledge base and injecting scoped context into sessions.

description.zh: DSH 定时任务调度插件，按 Cron 自动新建会话并注入提示词执行，支持分页历史与一键打开会话。
description.en: Cron scheduler plugin for DeepSeek Harness: creates sessions with your prompt on schedule, with paginated history and open-session.

description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的模型回答不再只是文字，而是直接生成可操作的交互界面，滑块、输入框、图表一应俱全，本地实时重算，沙箱运行更安全。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets the model answer with an operable interface instead of plain text — sliders, inputs, tabs and charts that recalculate locally inside a sandbox.

description.zh: dsh-lan-bridge 为 DeepSeek Harness 注入 crypto.randomUUID polyfill，让手机在纯 HTTP 局域网下正常使用 Web UI，无需证书或代理。
description.en: dsh-lan-bridge injects a crypto.randomUUID polyfill into DeepSeek Harness, enabling mobile access to the Web UI over plain HTTP on LAN without certs or proxy.

description.zh: DSH plugin 集成 Labnana 图片生成，支持文生图、图生图与精准编辑，结果直接显示在对话流并可一键保存到项目。
description.en: A DSH plugin integrating Labnana image generation: text-to-image, image-to-image, and precise editing, with results shown in chat and one-click save to project.

description.zh: dsh-launcher 是一个轻量 DSH plugin，安装后提供 dsh-go 终端命令，一键启动 DeepSeek Harness 并自动打开浏览器，零依赖约 9KB。
description.en: dsh-launcher is a lightweight DSH plugin that installs a dsh-go terminal command to launch DeepSeek Harness and auto-open the browser, zero-dependency at ~9KB.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供工程化项目记忆：以只追加台账记录进展，配合活动日志、三层上下文压缩与跨会话交接单，让 AI 换会话也不忘项目干到哪。
description.en: An engineering-grade project memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: an append-only ledger plus activity logs, three-tier context compaction and cross-session handoff notes keep the AI on track across sessions.

description.zh: DSH 插件，为 GPT openai-responses 路由补齐原生联网搜索、Codex 风格 Web Actions 与 Native V2 压缩能力，保持 DSH 原有入口与生命周期。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds native web search, Codex-style web actions, and Native V2 compaction to GPT openai-responses routes while preserving DSH's original entry points and lifecycle.

description.zh: 把《高性价比人生指南》765 条正文内置为 DSH plugin，注册同名 Skill 与三个检索工具，让模型先查书再回答并注明节条出处。
description.en: A DSH plugin that bundles the 765-entry 高性价比人生指南 book, registering a skill and three lookup tools so the model cites section and item before answering.

description.zh: dsh-light-memory 是 DeepSeek Harness 的轻量记忆系统插件，用四个 Markdown 文件加 append/distill 动作实现零数据库、可定制、可插拔的持久记忆。
description.en: dsh-light-memory is a lightweight memory system plugin for DeepSeek Harness, using four Markdown files and append/distill actions to provide zero-database, customizable, pluggable persistent memory.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供记忆提取侧认知循环：按当前问题 BM25 检索并 LLM 组装「有用素材包」，经 linghun 注入，实现记忆按需供给。
description.en: A DSH plugin that runs a memory-extraction cognitive loop: BM25 retrieval plus LLM assembly of a focused context bundle, injected via linghun so memory is supplied on demand.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 装上记忆体：以事件、事实、规则三型三本体实现记忆完全本体化，配合收口者灵魂卡完成读写沉淀闭环与目标激活检索。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness a full memory body: event/fact/rule tri-ontology storage, a closer soul card, read-write consolidation loops and goal-activated recall.

description.zh: DSH Live Wallpaper 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供动态壁纸与页面主题中心，支持 ShaderToy、视频、图片及多种主题自定义，无需额外依赖。
description.en: DSH Live Wallpaper adds animated wallpapers and a page theme center to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, supporting ShaderToy, videos, images, and extensive theme customization with no extra dependencies.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话视图加入 Live2D 角色舞台，AI 回复经 TTS 实时开口说话并配双语字幕，还支持连续语音输入与免键盘对话。
description.en: Adds a Live2D character stage to the DeepSeek Harness conversation view: AI replies speak aloud via streaming TTS with bilingual subtitles, plus continuous voice input for keyboard-free chat.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Linux 原生桌面集成：写入 XDG 桌面入口，用 Chromium --app 打开无边框独立窗口，并在关窗后停止由它启动的服务。
description.en: Linux native desktop integration for DeepSeek Harness: writes an XDG desktop entry, opens a borderless standalone Chromium --app window, and stops the service it started when the window closes.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自动检测并配置模型能力（推理强度与输入模态），为 llm-pi-ai 补齐官方界面无法设置的字段。
description.en: A DSH plugin that auto-detects and configures model capabilities (reasoning efforts + input modalities), patching fields the official llm-pi-ai UI leaves unconfigurable.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 模型请求提供按提供商（provider）的并发门控，通过 FIFO 队列控制并发数，避免超时。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing per-provider concurrency gating for DeepSeek Harness model requests, using a FIFO queue to avoid timeouts.

description.zh: DSH plugin 复用本地 Codex CLI 与 Claude Code 已持有的 OAuth 令牌作为模型路由，免去单独 API key，并内置订阅用量徽章。
description.en: A DSH plugin that reuses OAuth tokens already held by local Codex CLI and Claude Code as model routes, eliminating separate API keys and featuring subscription usage badges.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 LLM API 提供限流、并发控制、FIFO 队列、令牌预算与自适应 429 冷却，避免代理触发限流错误。
description.en: A DSH plugin that provides rate limiting, concurrency control, FIFO queuing, token budgets, and adaptive 429 cooldown for LLM APIs to prevent provider throttling errors.

description.zh: dsh-local-link 是 DeepSeek Harness 的轻量插件，通过扫码在局域网内配对设备，并在手机等移动端继续当前 Web 会话，同时提供响应式移动界面。
description.en: dsh-local-link is a lightweight DeepSeek Harness plugin for paired LAN access via QR code, letting you continue the current Web session on mobile devices with a responsive Mobile View.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 macOS 计算机操作能力，让 Agent 截屏观察、移动鼠标、点击拖拽、输入按键并打开应用与网址，形成观察—操作—验证闭环。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness computer-use on macOS: agents screenshot the screen, move the mouse, click, drag, type, press keys and open apps or URLs in an observe-act-verify loop.

description.zh: DSH macOS Pet 是一款 macOS 桌宠插件，让宠物跟随 DeepSeek Harness agent 状态变换表情，无需切换窗口即可掌握任务进度。
description.en: DSH macOS Pet is a macOS desktop pet plugin that mirrors your DeepSeek Harness agent's status, letting you track task progress without switching windows.

description.zh: DSH plugin 的版本感知适配器注册表，为第三方 Cordis 插件提供运行时兼容层，解耦内部服务名、路径与 RPC，升级 dsh 时插件无需改动。
description.en: A version-aware adapter registry for DSH plugins, providing a runtime compatibility layer that decouples third-party Cordis plugins from internal service names, paths, and RPC details, so plugins keep working across dsh upgrades.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供俄语本地化的 DSH plugin，翻译界面、桌面客户端与插件市场，并自动适配俄语浏览器。
description.en: A Russian locale plugin for DeepSeek Harness, translating the UI, desktop client, and plugin market, with auto-activation for Russian browsers.

description.zh: DSH plugin，在 dsh 进程内建立 dsh-manager 反向连接，免 dsh-launcher 即可注册实例并远程访问 dsh Web UI。
description.en: A DSH plugin that establishes a reverse connection to dsh-manager within the dsh process, enabling instance registration and remote access to the dsh Web UI without dsh-launcher.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供守护与自愈能力的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：守护进程轮询检测崩溃、回滚到最近可用快照并生成报告，同时自动恢复中断会话、重启后自动刷新浏览器。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that keeps DSH Web resilient: a supervisor daemon polls for crashes, rolls back to the last-known-good snapshot and files a report, while host and client plugins auto-resume interrupted sessions and auto-reload the browser after a restart.

description.zh: dsh-maestro-mobile 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供移动端适配：窄屏下将侧边栏变为抽屉、对话框变为底部弹层，并处理安全区与状态栏，桌面端不受影响。
description.en: dsh-maestro-mobile adapts the DeepSeek Harness Web UI for mobile: below 1024px it turns the sidebar into a drawer and dialogs into sheets, with safe-area handling, leaving desktop untouched.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 markitdown 工具，把 PDF、Word、Excel、PPT、HTML、EPUB 或网址转成模型可读的 Markdown，优先调用真实 MarkItDown，缺失时回退内置转换器。
description.en: A DSH plugin that exposes Microsoft MarkItDown as a `markitdown` tool, converting PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML, EPUB or a URL into Markdown the model can read, driving a real MarkItDown install and falling back to a built-in converter.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的通用应试复习闭环：读取课程材料与笔记库自动出题、批改、再出题，要求每题写出思维链，蒙对不算对，直到每个知识点达到目标正确率并生成考前清单。
description.en: A general exam-revision loop for DeepSeek Harness: it reads your course materials and notes vault, drills you question by question, and grades your reasoning chain before the answer — a lucky guess never counts — until every knowledge point hits your target accuracy, then hands you a pre-exam list.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注入有生物钟与情绪的 AI 伴侣 Persisto Mate，具备真实睡眠、长期记忆与情感状态，并通过工具让模型感知与表达心情。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) bundle that gives your agent Persisto Mate, an AI companion with a body clock, real sleep, persistent memory and feelings, exposed through mate tools.

description.zh: 把 MATLAB 与 Simulink 接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 DSH 插件，让 Agent 直接执行 MATLAB 代码、跑脚本与测试、检查并仿真 Simulink 模型，并注入官方专家技能。
description.en: A DSH plugin that bridges DeepSeek Harness to MATLAB and Simulink, letting the agent run MATLAB code, scripts and tests, inspect and simulate Simulink models, with official MathWorks expert skills injected.

description.zh: MCP Center 是 DSH plugin，让你在设置界面点选即可连接任意 MCP 服务器（HTTP 或 stdio），其工具即刻成为模型可调用的原生工具。
description.en: MCP Center is a DSH plugin that lets you connect any MCP server (HTTP or stdio) via a point-and-click settings UI, making their tools instantly callable by the model.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 MCP 服务器管理：在 Web 设置页或 Agent 工具中增删改启停并测试 stdio 与 Streamable HTTP 服务器，运行时热生效无需重启 DSH。
description.en: MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness: add, edit, enable, test and remove stdio or Streamable HTTP MCP servers from the Web settings page or agent tools, taking effect at runtime with no DSH restart.

description.zh: MedSeek 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供临床文档工具，支持交接班、出院小结、去标识化、完整性检查及带引用的医学查询，仅生成草稿供医生审核。
description.en: MedSeek provides clinical documentation and reference tools for DeepSeek Harness, including handover drafts, discharge summaries, de-identification, completeness checks, and cited medical lookups, draft-only for clinician review.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供提问导航条，零扩窗索引整场对话，支持跳转、全文搜索与收藏，含四种视觉风格。
description.en: A question navigation bar for DeepSeek Harness sessions that indexes the whole conversation without history expansion, with jump-to-turn, full-text search, favorites and four visual styles.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化、可搜索的项目记忆：决策、规则与会话上下文存入 DuckDB，规则注入每次模型请求，并提供 Web 管理界面。
description.en: Persistent, searchable per-project memory for DeepSeek Harness: decisions, rules, and session context in DuckDB, with rules injected into every model request and a full management UI.

description.zh: dsh-memories 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供双账本跨会话记忆：自动提取长期事实与项目进度，并在每次新会话中自动召回，无需重复简报。
description.en: dsh-memories provides dual-ledger cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: auto-extracts long-term facts and project progress, recalled into every new session.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化、可搜索的项目记忆：决策、规则与会话上下文存入 DuckDB，规则注入每次模型请求，并提供 Web 管理界面。
description.en: Persistent, searchable per-project memory for DeepSeek Harness: decisions, rules, and session context in DuckDB, with rules injected into every model request and a full management UI.

description.zh: DSH plugin 按工作区目录限定 MCP 工具注入，让每个项目只见所需服务器，并支持在 composer 中临时切换会话范围。
description.en: A DSH plugin that scopes MCP tool injection per workspace directory, hiding unneeded servers and refusing their calls, with per-session composer switches.

description.zh: dsh-memj 是让记忆跟着项目走的 DeepSeek Harness 记忆插件：以项目为记忆主线沉淀知识，用交接文档压缩上下文，模板与提示词均可在前端编辑。
description.en: dsh-memj is a DeepSeek Harness memory plugin that keeps knowledge tied to projects: it accumulates knowledge per project, compresses context into handoff docs, and lets you edit templates and prompts in the UI.

description.zh: DSH plugin 记忆闸门：检索到≠注入，每次召回经 CBDC 权威门控裁决 use/verify/ignore 后才进入上下文，使用后反馈学习，全程可审计，默认注入≤3条/1200字符，不增加额外模型调用。
description.en: A DSH plugin memory gate: retrieved ≠ injected, every recall passes CBDC authority gating (use/verify/ignore) before entering context, with post-use feedback learning and full audit, bounded to ≤3 claims/1200 chars, no extra model call.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地长期记忆：五轨分层记忆、SQLite+FTS5 知识图谱与自我进化，跨会话不丢上下文，数据全存本地。
description.en: A local long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: five-track layered memory, a SQLite+FTS5 knowledge graph and self-evolution, keeping context across sessions with all data stored locally.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上跨会话长期记忆：纯 Markdown 零依赖存储，注入 L0 记忆目录并提供 5 个记忆工具，后台自动提取偏好与决策。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness a cross-session long-term memory: a zero-dependency Markdown store, an injected L0 memory catalog, five model-facing memory tools, and background extraction of preferences and decisions.

description.zh: DSH plugin 长期记忆插件，桥接 opencode-memory MCP 服务器并强制记忆协议，工具调用前强制 weave、每轮自动存档，防止重复学习。
description.en: DSH plugin for long-term memory, bridging opencode-memory MCP server with a hard protocol gate, enforcing weave before tool calls and auto-ingesting each turn.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex 式跨会话持久记忆，自动提炼事实、偏好与决策，按需分层召回并附来源。
description.en: Codex-style persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness: it distills facts, preferences and decisions across sessions, then recalls them on demand with sources.

description.zh: dsh-mic-dictation 是 DeepSeek Harness 客户端插件，在提问栏 Full access 左侧添加麦克风按钮，用浏览器原生语音识别将中文语音转文字并自动填入提问框，安装即用。
description.en: dsh-mic-dictation is a DeepSeek Harness client plugin that adds a mic button next to Full access, using browser-native speech recognition to transcribe Chinese voice into the input box.

description.zh: DSH web 前端插件，为当前会话提供消息大纲侧栏，左缘横杠悬停展开、点击跳转定位，纯前端零外部服务。
description.en: A DSH web UI plugin that adds a message outline rail to the current session: left-edge bars expand on hover and click to jump, pure frontend with zero external services.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供用户治理的本地记忆空间，可显式共享选定会话，支持可预览、版本化、带溯源的回溯。
description.en: User-governed local memory spaces for DeepSeek Harness, enabling explicit sharing of selected sessions with previewable, versioned, provenance-aware recall.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地优先的长期记忆：把对话整理成本地文本包，按需检索并可回溯原始会话，数据不出本机。
description.en: A local-first long-term memory DSH plugin that packs past conversations into on-disk text bundles, retrieves them on demand, and traces hits back to original session events.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供极简提示词与 PTC 全能力的 Agent 模式，对齐 RL 训练，Windows 自动启用 Git Bash 与持久 PowerShell。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing a minimal-prompt Agent mode with full PTC tools, aligned with RL training, and automatic Git Bash and persistent PowerShell on Windows.

description.zh: DSH 极简模式（网络）preset，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供双工具编码 Agent，并加入网络搜索与 AGENTS.md 加载能力。
description.en: Minimal-mode web preset for DeepSeek Harness: a two-tool coding agent with web search and AGENTS.md loading.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供手机响应式适配与 WireGuard 远程增强，含文件管理、PTY 终端与设置远程可用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings mobile responsive layout and WireGuard remote enhancements to DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, including file manager, PTY terminal, and remote settings.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供手机响应式适配与 WireGuard 远程增强，含文件管理、PTY 终端与设置远程可用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings mobile responsive layout and WireGuard remote enhancements to DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, including file manager, PTY terminal, and remote settings.

description.zh: DSH plugin 手机端 Web UI：在同一局域网用手机浏览全部会话、看流式回复并继续对话，桌面左下角提供二维码入口。
description.en: A DSH plugin that serves a mobile web UI over your LAN, letting you browse all sessions, watch streaming replies and continue conversations from a phone, with a QR entry in the desktop corner.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供移动端响应式 UI 的 DSH plugin，自动检测视口、注入触控友好样式、添加底部导航栏，并暴露 mobileViewport 服务供其他插件订阅。
description.en: A DSH plugin that makes the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI touch-friendly on mobile, with viewport detection, responsive CSS, bottom navigation, and a mobileViewport service for other plugins.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为自定义模型提供思考等级配置、跨会话偏好记忆与渠道重试策略，让 DeepSeek Harness 会话更智能。
description.en: A DSH plugin that manages reasoning effort levels, persists cross-session model preferences, and configures channel retry policies for DeepSeek Harness.

description.zh: dsh-model-preset 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框上方添加一排模型预设快捷按钮，一键切换 provider、model 与 reasoningEffort 组合，并支持在设置中自定义。
description.en: dsh-model-preset adds a row of model preset shortcut buttons above the DSH composer, letting you switch provider, model, and reasoningEffort combinations in one click, with customizable settings.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的模型选择器提供统一显示管理：重命名、分组、排序、隐藏与标签，并支持跨提供商分区。
description.en: A DSH plugin that takes over the model picker's display: rename, regroup, reorder, hide and badge models across providers, with cross-provider partitions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 挂上 OpenAI 兼容的 /v1 接口，把已注册模型反代出去，其他项目用标准 OpenAI 客户端即可调用，并支持密钥与模型分组调度。
description.en: Exposes an OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint for DeepSeek Harness, relaying already-registered models so any standard OpenAI client can call them, with API keys and model-group routing.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供模型定价与能力看板，覆盖约 7250 个模型、213 家提供商，按实际调用路由核算会话成本并归因缓存泄漏，本地运行无需服务器。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a model pricing and capability board covering ~7,250 models across 213 providers, prices session costs by the route you actually called, and attributes cache leaks — all local-first with no server.

description.zh: DSH plugin 按角色路由模型：规划者用 deepseek-v4-pro，委派子代理用 flash，附提示段与 pro-flash-routing 技能，降低推理成本。
description.en: A DSH plugin that routes models by role: planner on deepseek-v4-pro, delegated subagents on flash, with a prompt section and pro-flash-routing skill to cut reasoning costs.

description.zh: DSH plugin 按角色路由模型：规划者用 deepseek-v4-pro，委派子代理用 flash，附提示段与 pro-flash-routing 技能，降低推理成本。
description.en: A DSH plugin that routes models by role: planner on deepseek-v4-pro, delegated subagents on flash, with a prompt section and pro-flash-routing skill to cut reasoning costs.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自动同步 llm-pi-ai 提供商路由的模型目录与 pi.dev 网关，通过官方 settings 接口零补丁写入配置，支持定时刷新与变更报告。
description.en: A DSH plugin that keeps llm-pi-ai provider routes' model catalog in sync with the pi.dev gateway, writing via the official settings seam with zero patches, supporting scheduled refresh and change reports.

description.zh: DSH plugin 模型可见性管理：在设置中新增分区页，按模型或渠道隐藏/显示模型选择菜单条目，零侵入且新模型默认可见。
description.en: A DSH plugin for model visibility: adds a settings section to hide/show models in the selector by model or provider, non-intrusive with new models visible by default.

description.zh: dsh-modellix 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Modellix 媒体生成、LLM 模型与 Web 研究，一个 API Key 即可在会话中完成创作与检索。
description.en: dsh-modellix brings Modellix media generation, LLM models, and Web research into DeepSeek Harness with a single API Key for chat-first workflows.

description.zh: dsh-native-memory 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生、按工作区隔离的长期记忆：审批门控写入、引用溯源、跨会话全文检索，无需外部服务器或额外运行时依赖。
description.en: dsh-native-memory provides native, per-workspace long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: approval-gated writes, cited provenance, and FTS cross-session recall, with no external server or extra runtime dependency.

description.zh: DSH plugin 需求型导购工具，让 agent 听懂自然语言需求，从精选目录中语义匹配最合适的插件并给出安装命令，零网络零 LLM 调用。
description.en: Requirement-driven plugin guide for DSH plugin: matches natural-language needs to curated plugins with reasons and install commands, fully offline.

description.zh: dsh-netassist 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供网络与代理诊断工具集，一键检测 GitHub 连通性、系统代理状态、代理端口存活及 hosts 冲突，全程只读且注入安全。
description.en: dsh-netassist provides network and proxy diagnostic tools for DeepSeek Harness: one-shot GitHub connectivity check, system proxy status, proxy port probing, and hosts conflict scan, all read-only and injection-safe.

description.zh: DSH plugin 每天 21:00 从网易云每日推荐挑 5 首，用 mpv 试听 30 秒后由 DeepSeek 选出 3 首并附推荐理由，推送到 Harness 对话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that picks 5 songs from your NetEase Cloud Music daily recommendations at 21:00, previews each for 30 seconds via mpv, and lets DeepSeek pick 3 with reasons delivered to your Harness chat.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的会话节点着色（按类型/工具名，可配置配色），并提供思考过程显示开关，纯前端增强。
description.en: Colorize conversation nodes in DeepSeek Harness Web GUI by type/tool with configurable palette, plus a thinking visibility toggle.

description.zh: dsh-nl-model-switch 让 DeepSeek Harness 用户用一句自然语言切换当前会话模型，无需离开对话界面，跨 Web、TUI 与 IM 桥接生效，上下文完整保留。
description.en: dsh-nl-model-switch lets DeepSeek Harness users switch the current session's model with a natural-language sentence, without leaving the chat, across Web, TUI, and IM bridges, preserving context.

description.zh: DSH Network 是 DeepSeek Harness 的安全网关插件，让 DSH 绑定本机回环地址，通过认证网关支持局域网、Tailnet 或公网 HTTPS 多路由访问，并提供扫码配对与历史消息精简。
description.en: DSH Network is a DSH plugin that secures DeepSeek Harness by keeping it on loopback and exposing an authenticated gateway for LAN, Tailnet, or public HTTPS routes, with QR pairing and history chunk trimming.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Agent 完成回合、出错或等待审批时，通过桌面、浏览器和 Webhook 发送通知，让你无需紧盯标签页。
description.en: A DSH plugin that notifies you via desktop, browser, and webhook when your agent finishes a turn, hits an error, or awaits approval—so you don't have to watch the tab.

description.zh: DSH plugin 多候选模式插件，通过悬浮球面板配置，让模型并行生成多个候选方案并自动验证选优，提升任务成功率。
description.en: A DSH plugin enabling multi-candidate mode with a floating panel, letting the model run parallel candidates and auto-select the best via verifier.

description.zh: DSH 插件：任务结束或需要用户决策时，通过跨窗口悬浮面板、网页 toast 和系统通知弹窗提醒，类似 Codex / Claude Code 的体验。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pops up cross-window floating panels, web toasts, and system notifications when tasks finish or user decisions are needed, similar to Codex / Claude Code.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地小说文本质量诊断，检测词汇多样性、套话、重复词与重复句，无需 API Key，粘贴章节即可获得风格评分与可复制报告。
description.en: A local novel-writing diagnostics plugin for DeepSeek Harness that flags vocabulary diversity, clichés, repeated words and repeated sentences, scoring style and exporting a copyable report without any API key.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供悬浮小说阅读面板，支持书架、进度记忆与章节预缓存，摸鱼阅读不切窗。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a floating novel reader panel to DeepSeek Harness Web, with bookshelf, progress memory, and chapter pre-caching for seamless reading.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Notion 的 DSH 插件，通过官方 Notion MCP 走 OAuth 2.0 + PKCE 授权，在设置页一键登录即可搜索、读写页面、数据库与评论，无需复制 Integration Token。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects Notion to DeepSeek Harness through the official Notion MCP with OAuth 2.0 + PKCE, letting you sign in from the Settings page and search, read or write pages, databases and comments without copying an Integration Token.

description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的所有 shell 调用都改由 Nushell 执行，禁用 bash/pwsh 执行器，并在系统提示中教会模型 Nushell 语法。
description.en: A DSH plugin that routes every shell call in DeepSeek Harness through Nushell, disables the bash/pwsh executors, and teaches the model Nushell syntax.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供后台观察式记忆：观察器与反思器在会话进行中沉淀决策与约束，压缩时直接渲染记忆，长会话不再丢失上下文。
description.en: Observational memory for DeepSeek Harness: background observers and reflectors distill session work into observations and reflections, so compaction renders ready-made memory instead of losing decisions in long sessions.

description.zh: dsh-on-phone 让手机浏览器通过 Tailscale 私有网络直连电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness，同一份会话与工作区随手可用，无需专用 App 或中转服务。
description.en: dsh-on-phone lets your phone browser reach the DeepSeek Harness running on your computer over a private Tailscale network, sharing the same sessions and workspace with no dedicated app or relay service.

description.zh: dsh-ollama-usage 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，可视化 Ollama Cloud 用量余量，侧边栏双横条常驻显示 5 小时会话与周用量，设置页提供完整面板，支持自动刷新与凭证持久化。
description.en: dsh-ollama-usage is a DSH plugin that visualizes Ollama Cloud usage and remaining quota with persistent sidebar bars and a full settings panel, featuring auto-refresh and credential persistence.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Omarchy 桌面，提供 Omarchy 专用工具、Agent 预设与一键集成，让 dsh TUI 成为系统默认 Agent。
description.en: Wires DeepSeek Harness into Omarchy as a general-purpose agent, adding Omarchy tools, an agent preset, and one-command desktop integration so the dsh TUI becomes the default agent.

description.zh: dsh·通知叮咚插件：当 DSH 出现待人工回答或一轮对话跑完时，弹出浏览器系统通知并播放 Windows 提示音，人不在窗口前也能被叫回来。
description.en: A DSH plugin that fires a browser system notification with a Windows alert sound whenever DSH needs your answer or finishes a run, so you get called back even when you are in another window.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Web 界面会话工具栏添加“在外部应用中打开”按钮，将当前工作目录交给本机 Finder、VS Code 等应用打开。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds an 'Open in external app' button to the session toolbar in the Web UI, opening the current working directory in local apps like Finder and VS Code.

description.zh: 把 OpenClaw 的人格与长期记忆无缝带入 DeepSeek Harness：共享同一 Markdown 工作区，按预算注入上下文，并在 DSH 侧边栏中浏览、编辑与搜索记忆文件。
description.en: Carry your OpenClaw persona and long-term memory into DeepSeek Harness: share one Markdown workspace, inject bounded context, and browse, edit or search memory files from a native DSH Sidebar.

description.zh: DSH 插件：在 dsh web 启动完成后自动用系统默认浏览器打开 Web UI，跨平台且无头安全。
description.en: DSH plugin that automatically opens the Web UI in the system default browser after dsh web starts, cross-platform and headless-safe.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenCode 与 OpenCode Go 两条原生模型路由，支持多账号轮换、配额用量面板与请求热力图。
description.en: Adds native OpenCode and OpenCode Go model routes to DeepSeek Harness, with multi-account rotation, quota panels and a request heatmap.

description.zh: DSH 输入框旁的高峰/空闲计费胶囊，按本机时钟换算北京时间并查节假日表，点开即知当前费率与下次切换。
description.en: A peak/off-peak billing chip in the DSH composer that reads your local clock, converts to Beijing time and checks a holiday table to show the current DeepSeek rate and next switch.

description.zh: 在无 Graph API 权限的公司电脑上，让 DSH plugin 通过 COM 直接驱动本地经典版 Outlook，收发邮件、查日程与会议室，外发动作均需人工确认。
description.en: A DSH plugin that drives your local classic Outlook client via COM on Windows — reading mail, drafting replies, and managing calendar invites with human approval before anything is sent.

description.zh: dsh-perfscope 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一键健康检查与评分，扫描已安装插件并给出 0-100 健康分、问题清单与可撤销的安全修复，全程本地运行。
description.en: dsh-perfscope offers one-click health check & scoring for DeepSeek Harness plugins, scanning installed plugins to deliver a 0-100 health score, issue list, and reversible safe fixes, all locally.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 DeepSeek 高峰时段自动切换原始人式压缩输出，节省 token 成本，并显示状态徽章与切换提示。
description.en: A DSH plugin that auto-switches to caveman-style compressed output during DeepSeek peak hours to cut token costs, with status badge and transition toasts.

description.zh: dsh-paper-design 将 Paper Desktop 的 MCP 服务桥接为 DeepSeek Harness 原生工具，支持截图转发、设计指南注入与 OAuth 认证，让 Agent 直接读写和设计 Paper 文档。
description.en: dsh-paper-design bridges Paper Desktop's MCP server into DeepSeek Harness as native tools, with screenshot forwarding, design guidance injection, and OAuth auth, enabling agents to read and design Paper documents directly.

description.zh: DSH 人设管理插件，可在 DeepSeek Harness 中创建、编辑多份系统人设，并支持全局默认与会话级自由切换。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that lets you create, edit and freely switch multiple system personas, with a global default and per-session overrides.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供个性化设置页，在 DSH 里配置称呼、身份、人设与长期自定义指令，保存即对所有任务与回复生效。
description.en: A personalization plugin for DeepSeek Harness: set nicknames, identity, persona and long-term custom instructions in DSH settings, applied to every task and reply right after saving.

description.zh: DSH 插件，将 openwiki 代码库知识库能力集成到 DeepSeek Harness，一键生成、阅读、更新仓库 Wiki 与溯源知识卡片，复用已配置模型。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings openwiki's codebase knowledge base into DeepSeek Harness, enabling one-click generation, reading, and updating of repo Wiki and grounded claims, reusing configured models.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加一只照片级写实桌面宠物：四种人格、表情动作、主动说话、可选神经语音与独立小聊天框，不写入会话。
description.en: A photo-real desk pet for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: four personas with expressions and actions, proactive speech, optional neural TTS, and a tiny private chat box that never touches your session.

description.zh: DSH plugin 桌面宠物状态灯：以角色表情实时反映模型思考/出错/完成/空闲状态，任务结束或提问时弹出气泡并支持跳转会话，窗口置顶常驻。
description.en: A DSH plugin desktop pet status light: character expressions reflect model states (thinking/error/completed/idle), with chat bubbles on task completion or questions and always-on-top mini-window.

description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 OpenViking 客户端配置管理界面，可读写 ovcli.conf、校验服务连通与身份、临时用 root key 管理账号与用户 Key。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a Web UI for managing OpenViking client config: editing ovcli.conf, checking service health and identity, and using a temporary root key to manage accounts and user keys.

description.zh: dsh-pi-tui 是 DeepSeek Harness 的终端前端，采用 pi 的观感与交互，提供流式 Markdown、thinking 折叠、工具卡片、会话持久化等完整 TUI 体验。
description.en: dsh-pi-tui is a terminal frontend for DeepSeek Harness with pi's look and feel, offering streaming Markdown, thinking folding, tool cards, and session persistence.

description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏新增置顶分区，把运行中、未读和当前打开的会话固定在顶部，方便快速回到活跃会话。
description.en: Adds a pinned section to the DSH Web sidebar that keeps running, unread and currently open sessions at the top for quick access.

description.zh: DSH plugin 用大白话分类、搜索、比较、安装和管理 DeepSeek Harness 插件，在 Web UI 侧边栏提供易用的插件菜单。
description.en: A DSH plugin that categorizes, searches, compares, installs, and manages DeepSeek Harness plugins in plain language, offering an easy-to-use plugin menu in the Web UI sidebar.

description.zh: 把 ChatGPT Codex、Claude、ZCode、Qwen 等厂商订阅套餐经一个本地回环进程桥接进 DeepSeek Harness，在设置页卡片一键接入为独立模型分组，不改核心、零运行时依赖。
description.en: Bridges vendor subscription plans — ChatGPT Codex, Claude, ZCode and Qwen — into DeepSeek Harness model groups through one local loopback process, with a settings-page status card and one-click provisioning, no core changes and zero runtime npm dependencies.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上电商生图能力：主图、详情图、广告图、风格复刻与白底图，Agent 调工具真实出图并落盘到作品库。
description.en: Adds e-commerce image generation to DeepSeek Harness: hero shots, detail pages, ad creatives, style cloning and white-background cutouts, with the agent generating real files into a gallery.

description.zh: DSH 界面语言增强插件，通过运行时 monkey-patch 注入日语、韩语等 19 种第三语言覆盖，并在设置页提供切换 UI，保持 DSH 原生中英文不变。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects 19 third-language overrides (ja/ko/...) via runtime monkey-patch, with a switcher UI in settings, leaving native zh/en intact.

description.zh: DSH plugin 健康审计工具：将 GitHub dsh-plugin 主题同步为本地目录，探测 npm、静态安全扫描、评分并生成网页排行榜，帮助挑选值得安装的插件。
description.en: Health audit for DSH plugins: sync the GitHub dsh-plugin topic into a local catalog, probe npm, static-scan for security, score plugins, and rank them in a web leaderboard.

description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏补上音频预览：注册音频文件查看器，自带支持 HTTP Range 的流式媒体路由，可播放任意大小音频并查看可缩放波形、实时频谱与全曲频谱图。
description.en: An audio preview plugin for the DSH sidebar: it registers an audio file viewer with its own Range-capable streaming media route, so any-size audio plays with zoomable waveform, live spectrum and whole-file spectrogram.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 工作区挂载多个外部目录，支持别名、只读保护与上下文自动注入，让智能体跨仓库协作。
description.en: Mount multiple external directories into a DeepSeek Harness workspace with aliases, read-only guards and automatic context injection for cross-repo agent work.

description.zh: CoAligne 插件为 DeepSeek Harness 带来团队共享项目上下文，通过 MCP 工具与 coaligne-workflow 技能实现协作查询、文件评论与审查请求。
description.en: CoAligne plugin brings shared team project context to DeepSeek Harness, enabling collaboration queries, file comments, and review requests via MCP tools and the coaligne-workflow skill.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多代理仪表盘技能，生成结构化状态报告，跟踪代理运行状态、任务依赖、进度与时间，帮助用户快速掌握团队概览。
description.en: A multi-agent dashboard skill for DeepSeek Harness that generates structured status reports, tracking agent status, task dependencies, progress, and time for quick team overviews.

description.zh: DSH plugin 按会话裁剪上下文注入：用漏斗面板勾选，决定向模型注入哪些 skill、tool 与系统提示词段落，减少无关 schema 与技能描述，其余会话不受影响。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gates context injection per session: use the funnel panel to choose which skills, tools and system-prompt sections reach the model, cutting irrelevant schemas and skill text without affecting other sessions.

description.zh: 将 OpenAI Codex 的技能、指令与配置无缝桥接至 DeepSeek Harness，实现零迁移复用，提升开发效率。
description.en: Bridge OpenAI Codex's skills, instructions, and config into DeepSeek Harness with zero migration, boosting dev efficiency.

description.zh: DSH plugin 成本追踪器，按模型定价计算 token 费用，将成本感知注入系统提示，并提供 CLI 估算工具。
description.en: A DSH plugin that tracks token usage, calculates costs based on model pricing, injects cost awareness into the system prompt, and offers a CLI estimation tool.

description.zh: DSH 讨论模式插件，为复杂思考保持用户意图、控制讨论焦点，将探索收敛为有依据的下一步行动，适合研究、策略与技术路线取舍。
description.en: A DSH plugin that provides a discussion mode for complex thinking, keeping user intent and focus, converging exploration into evidence-based next steps for research, strategy, and technical trade-offs.

description.zh: DSH plugin 一句话部署项目到 Cloudflare 并发布插件到 npm，无账号也能拿临时线上地址，凭据模型不可见。
description.en: A DSH plugin that deploys projects to Cloudflare and publishes plugins to npm with one command, offering temporary URLs without an account and keeping credentials hidden from the model.

description.zh: DSH plugin每日用量统计插件，在输入框下方显示当天Token用量（万/亿简化）与缓存命中率，含余额血条和预计消耗。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows daily token usage (simplified to 万/亿) and cache hit rate below the composer, with balance bar and estimated cost.

description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中配置全局 Prompt，自动注入每次对话与子代理的系统提示词，一次配置全局生效。
description.en: Configure a global prompt in DSH settings, injected into every conversation and subagent system prompt, effective once configured.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一等公民的 Git 工作流工具，涵盖仓库状态、diff、规范提交、历史与分支，全程无裸 shell 调用，安全可解析。
description.en: First-class Git workflow tools for DeepSeek Harness: repo status, diffs, validated commits, history, and branches, with shell-free execFile calls.

description.zh: DSH 侧边栏插件图谱面板，可视化插件依赖关系、技能使用统计与 Token 缓存成本分析，帮助开发者优化插件配置与成本。
description.en: A DSH sidebar panel visualizing plugin dependency graph, skill usage, and token cache cost analysis to help developers optimize plugin configuration and costs.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件引入 Claude Code 风格的生命周期钩子，在模型工具调用前后自动执行 shell 命令，支持阻断或记录。
description.en: Bring Claude Code-style lifecycle hooks to DSH plugins, running shell commands before/after model tool calls, with blocking or logging support.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可视化 Git 工作台，在 DSH 内完成改动查看、暂存提交、分支历史与冲突处理，并可借助模型生成提交信息。
description.en: A visual Git workbench for DeepSeek Harness: review changes, stage and commit, browse branches and history, resolve conflicts, with optional AI-generated commit messages.

description.zh: 为 PerryLink 系列 DeepSeek Harness 插件提供零运行时依赖的共享工具库，抽取可插拔 Provider 注册、失败关闭审批与自适应会话事件门、校验脚本及 sanitize/pricing/judge 纯模块。
description.en: A zero-runtime-dependency shared toolkit for PerryLink DSH plugins, extracting the pluggable Provider registry, fail-closed approval and adaptive session-event gates, verify scripts, and shared sanitize/pricing/judge modules.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供图片/视频壁纸背景，支持 GIF、APNG、动图 WebP、MP4、WebM 自动识别，并可调节压暗、亮度、模糊与界面色调跟随。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness wallpaper plugin that sets image or video backgrounds with auto format detection for GIF, APNG, animated WebP, MP4 and WebM, plus dim, brightness, blur and UI tint controls.

description.zh: DSH 网页插件管理插件，在设置页直接启用/停用已安装插件，切换即时生效并持久化到用户配置层。
description.en: A DSH plugin manager that lets you enable/disable installed plugins directly from the web settings page, with instant effect and persistent patch-layer writes.

description.zh: 给 DSH plugin 页里的插件换图标、中文名与说明，并用文件夹、收藏、拖拽排序和列表/铺陈视图整理，只改显示不动插件文件。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets you rename, re-icon and annotate installed plugins, then organize them with folders, favorites, drag sorting and list or grid views, changing display only.

description.zh: dsh-plugin-pi-bridge 将 Pi Agent 的技能无缝桥接至 DeepSeek Harness，零迁移即可复用已有技能配置，提升 Agent 能力。
description.en: Bridge Pi Agent's skills into DeepSeek Harness with zero migration, enabling seamless reuse of existing skills.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供插件安全审查：审计依赖漏洞、读取源码证据、AI 辅助研判，并支持可回滚的禁用处置。
description.en: Plugin security review for DeepSeek Harness: dependency advisories, source evidence, AI-assisted contextual review, and reversible enforcement.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 reload_plugin 工具，可热重载指定插件条目（如 mcp-client），无需重启宿主即可生效。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a reload_plugin tool to DeepSeek Harness, hot-reloading specific plugin entries (e.g. mcp-client) without restarting the host.

description.zh: DSH 插件安装安全审查守卫，对动态插件源码做静态安全审查并按安全优先策略拦截，提供 plugin_security_review 与 plugin_security_audit 工具。
description.en: A security review gate for DSH plugin installation, statically analyzing dynamic plugin source and blocking based on security-first policy, with plugin_security_review and plugin_security_audit tools.

description.zh: DSH plugin 以 Observational Memory 方式管理上下文，自动压缩历史消息为摘要，并提供 recall 工具回看原始内容。
description.en: A DSH plugin that manages context via Observational Memory, auto-compressing history into summaries and providing recall tools to review original content.

description.zh: DSH plugin 接入 SodaMem 引擎，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供长期记忆：每轮自动注入证据记忆并回写已结束会话，无需模型调用工具。
description.en: A DSH plugin integrating SodaMem to give DeepSeek Harness long-term memory: auto-injects evidence-grounded memory into every turn and ingests closed turns, no tool calls needed.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 图形化技能管理器，在 Web 设置界面即可创建、编辑、导入 ZIP 与删除 SKILL.md 技能，支持全局及多工作区安装，无需手写 YAML。
description.en: A graphical skill manager for DeepSeek Harness, letting you create, edit, import ZIP, and delete SKILL.md skills via the web settings UI, with global and multi-workspace install support.

description.zh: dsh-thread 是 DeepSeek Harness 的会话记忆适配器，通过原生通道无损捕获会话事件，提供带谱系的会话记忆、查询工具与行为契约技能，助力编码代理。
description.en: dsh-thread is a session memory adapter for DeepSeek Harness, capturing session events losslessly via native channels, offering lineage-aware session memory, a query tool, and a behavior-contract skill for coding agents.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件页补上一键升级与版本历史回滚：批量升级全部或选中插件，展开查看各版本并一键切换。
description.en: Adds one-click upgrades plus version history and rollback to the DeepSeek Harness plugin page, letting you batch-upgrade all or selected plugins and switch any plugin to an older release.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件作者提供的升级迁移技能：按目标仓库声明的版本区间自动路由到对应走廊卡片，并用零依赖扫描器定位断裂接缝。
description.en: A plugin-author upgrade skill for DeepSeek Harness: it routes to the matching corridor card from the target repo's declared version band and runs a zero-dependency seam scanner to catch silently broken mounts.

description.zh: dsh-plugin-xquant 将 xquant 量化研究 MCP 接入 DeepSeek Harness，一键安装即可在 dsh Web 中查询因子、策略逻辑与历史数据，辅助量化研究。
description.en: dsh-plugin-xquant integrates xquant's quantitative research MCP into DeepSeek Harness, enabling one-command installation to query factors, strategy logic, and historical data in dsh Web.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 ZERONE 模式与 16 个内嵌技能，以规格驱动开发编排从澄清到审查的闭环，并沉淀项目记忆与知识复利。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds the ZERONE agent preset plus 16 embedded skills, orchestrating a spec-driven loop from clarification to review while compounding project memory and knowledge.

description.zh: dsh-pocket-console 把无人值守 DeepSeek Harness 运行中的工具调用审批与 ask_user_question 提问转成飞书卡片推到手机，桌面端超时未答即可一键批准、拒绝或回答，仅需一条出站长连接。
description.en: dsh-pocket-console turns tool-call approvals and ask_user_question prompts from an unattended DeepSeek Harness run into Feishu cards on your phone, so you can approve, reject, or answer with one tap once the desktop has had its chance — over a single outbound connection.

description.zh: DSH plugin 常驻注入 Ponytail 懒高级工程师规范，精简版系统提示词按会话切换档位，完整规则与 5 个同伴技能落盘为仅用户可调用的 / 技能。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects the Ponytail lazy-senior-engineer ruleset, with a compact always-on system prompt switchable per session and the full ruleset plus 5 companion skills as user-only / skills.

description.zh: DSH plugin 面向 Windows 本地开发，将 TCP 监听端口回溯至进程、会话与工具调用，帮助编程助手安全处理端口冲突。
description.en: A DSH plugin for Windows local development that traces TCP listeners back to processes, Sessions, and Tool Calls, enabling safe port-conflict handling for coding agents.

description.zh: DSH 电源管理插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边栏电源按钮、刷新、重启与关机功能，支持 Web UI 一键操作。
description.en: DSH power control plugin providing sidebar power button, refresh, restart and shutdown for DeepSeek Harness with one-click Web UI.

description.zh: DSH 预设医生插件：装载后自动扫描失效的 Agent 预设声明，机械可修项自动对齐当前版本语法并备份，其余逐条报告文件行号与原因。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that scans broken Agent preset declarations, auto-aligning mechanically fixable ones to the current syntax with backups while reporting the rest with file, line and reason.

description.zh: 把 ntd 的「工艺」工作流模板接进 DSH web，可浏览、编辑、校验、导入导出与 AI 生成，agent 还能用 process_* 工具按工艺分阶段推进执行。
description.en: Brings ntd Process workflow templates into DSH web: browse, edit, validate, import/export and AI-generate them, while agents drive staged execution via process_* tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Multica JSONL 桥接 profile，通过版本化 JSONL 进程协议将 DSH CLI 暴露给 Multica，支持模型发现、会话恢复与 MCP 挂载。
description.en: A DSH plugin profile that bridges the DeepSeek Harness CLI to Multica via a versioned JSONL process protocol, enabling model discovery, session resume, and MCP mounting.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自建提示词库：在设置页编写管理提示词，聊天中一键勾选启用，并自动继承到子代理。
description.en: A prompt library for DeepSeek Harness: write and manage your own prompts in Settings, tick them on per chat, and have subagents inherit the selection.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通过设置面板屏蔽、替换、注入和排序系统提示词段，并隐藏工具，支持预设保存与应用，实时生效。
description.en: A DSH plugin to block, replace, inject, and reorder system prompt segments and hide tools via a settings panel, with preset save/apply support.

description.zh: DSH 分层提示词管理器：条目可按全局、工作区、会话三级投放，内置段落与运行时上下文可禁用或覆盖，并附逐行 diff 与真实装配快照。
description.en: A layered prompt manager for DeepSeek Harness: deliver reusable entries at global, workspace, or session level, disable or override built-in sections and runtime contexts, with line-level diffs and real assembly snapshots.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框提供 Codex 式提示词联想：每轮回复结束后以灰色 ghost text 预测你的下一句话，Tab 采纳、Esc 忽略。
description.en: A DSH plugin that ghosts a Codex-style prediction of your next message into the composer after each reply — Tab to accept, Esc to dismiss.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提示词预设管理工具，在设置中创建、编辑、排序提示词库，并在输入栏一键插入预设到草稿，提升 DeepSeek Harness 写作效率。
description.en: A DSH plugin for managing prompt presets: build a library in Settings, then inject any preset into the composer draft with one click in DeepSeek Harness.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供全局与会话级提示词模板，右侧面板一键插入或发送，基于 node:sqlite 持久化，纯 TypeScript 实现。
description.en: Quick prompt templates for DeepSeek Harness: global and per-session templates, a right-side panel, and pure-TS SQLite persistence.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框提供下一句建议：助手回复后空输入框显示灰色预测，按 Tab 填入、Esc 忽略。
description.en: Adds next-sentence suggestions to the DeepSeek Harness input box: after a reply, a gray prediction appears in the empty box — press Tab to accept, Esc to dismiss.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入火山方舟 Coding Plan 的 DSH plugin，支持文本、图片与 PDF 文档理解，图片走 Files API，密钥粘贴即用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings Volcano Ark Coding Plan to DeepSeek Harness, supporting text, image and PDF understanding with Files API for images and paste-to-use API key.

description.zh: DSH plugin 集成青简写作助手，在对话中起草改稿，右侧宣纸面板逐条审阅后落稿，支持导出与深链回青简客户端。
description.en: A DSH plugin integrating QingAgent, an AI writing assistant that drafts and revises in chat, with a rice-paper panel for staged review and commit, plus export and deep-link to the desktop client.

description.zh: DSH plugin 本地输入暂存工具，为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供分会话的 LIFO 暂存栈，可暂存未发送的提示词，先处理临时问题再恢复原输入。
description.en: A local, per-session prompt stash for DeepSeek Harness Web, letting you stash unsent drafts and restore them later.

description.zh: DSH 网页插件，在侧边栏底部添加二维码按钮，手机扫码即可复用桌面端已认证的启动 URL，快速进入同一会话。
description.en: A DSH web plugin that adds a QR-code button to the sidebar footer, letting a phone scan and reuse the desktop's authenticated launch URL to join the same session.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在设置页生成二维码，手机扫码即可在浏览器中打开当前 DeepSeek Harness 会话，无需手动输入 URL。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows a QR code in Settings so your phone opens the current DeepSeek Harness session in its browser—no URL typing.

description.zh: DSH plugin 对话大纲插件：将 AI 回复中的 Markdown 标题提取为按回合分组的大纲面板，自动跟随高亮并平滑跳转，提升长对话导航效率。
description.en: A DSH plugin that extracts Markdown headings from AI replies into a navigable outline panel, grouped by turns, with auto-follow highlight and smooth scrolling.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 read 工具提供版本令牌校验的进程内结果缓存，长会话重复读文件直接命中缓存，每次命中都对照文件系统版本令牌复核，绝不吐旧内容。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing a version-token-validated in-process result cache for the read tool, so repeated reads in long sessions hit cache while re-validating against filesystem version tokens, never serving stale content.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供常驻悬浮胶囊，实时展示 GLM Coding Plan 与 GitHub Copilot 的额度快照与订阅用量详情，超阈值变色提醒。
description.en: A DSH plugin that keeps a floating capsule on screen showing live GLM Coding Plan and GitHub Copilot quota snapshots and subscription usage details, with color alerts past thresholds.

description.zh: DSH-RAG 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地知识库，通过显式 /rag 检索带来源证据的文档，支持混合检索与离线回退。
description.en: DSH-RAG brings local knowledge bases to DeepSeek Harness, with explicit /rag retrieval and source-backed evidence, hybrid search and offline fallback.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中的 DSV4.1 提供推理增强：先做精简分析，再让完整 Agent 执行，并在交付前验收与修复，兼顾图片与附件处理。
description.en: A DSH plugin that boosts DSV4.1 reasoning in DeepSeek Harness: a lean analysis pass, full-agent execution, and bounded acceptance/repair loops with image and attachment support.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让 DeepSeek 在真实红警2引擎上作战：迷雾下建基地、侦察、调兵、复盘，并把经验带入下一局。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets DeepSeek command a real Red Alert 2 battlefield: build, scout, fight, and learn from defeats under fog of war.

description.zh: dsh-reel 是 DeepSeek Harness 的本地媒体库插件，挂载磁盘目录后在 dsh Web 内浏览图片与视频，支持 HTTP Range 秒播、服务端实时转码与移动端滑动连播。
description.en: dsh-reel is a local media library plugin for DeepSeek Harness: mount disk folders and browse photos and videos inside dsh Web, with HTTP Range instant playback, on-the-fly server transcoding and swipe-to-play on mobile.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话长期记忆：空闲会话自动提炼经验为 Markdown 文件，每次对话注入记忆摘要并按需检索原文。
description.en: Cross-session long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: idle sessions are distilled into plain Markdown files, with a memory summary injected into every prompt and on-demand search of the originals.

description.zh: DSH plugin 声音通知工具，在任务完成或异常终止时播放主题音效并弹出桌面通知，忠实移植自 pi-peon-ping-win。
description.en: A DSH plugin that plays themed sound clips and desktop notifications on task completion or unexpected termination, a faithful port of pi-peon-ping-win.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让远程浏览器（nginx/反代）也能正常使用工作区目录选择器，固定采用浏览器内浏览交互，本地与远程体验一致。
description.en: A DSH plugin that makes the workspace directory picker work from remote browsers (nginx/reverse proxy) by pinning the in-app browse interaction, unifying local and remote experience.

description.zh: 把电脑上的 DSH 与多个 Agent 聚成群聊，用 Android 手机远程继续对话、分配任务、传文件并处理审批。
description.en: Gathers DSH and multiple agents on your computer into group chats, letting you continue conversations, assign tasks, transfer files and handle approvals remotely from an Android phone.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 read_remote、write_remote、edit_remote 三个工具，经 ssh 直接读写远程主机文件，免去在 PowerShell 里套 bash 命令的麻烦。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds read_remote, write_remote and edit_remote tools so the model can read and write files on remote hosts over ssh, without wrapping bash commands in PowerShell.

description.zh: DSH plugin，为DeepSeek Harness注入remote-shell技能，支持SSH/SFTP/Telnet/WinRM远程操作，并内置加密凭据保险库。
description.en: A DSH plugin that bundles the remote-shell skill for secure SSH/SFTP/Telnet/WinRM operations with an encrypted credential vault.

description.zh: DSH Remote 插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边栏入口与远程控制网关，支持手机端管理会话、文件传输和 Token 统计，网关随 DSH 自动启停。
description.en: DSH Remote plugin adds a sidebar entry and remote gateway to DeepSeek Harness, enabling mobile session control, file transfer, and token stats with auto-managed gateway.

description.zh: 把另一台 DSH 实例的工作区接入本地侧边栏，配对后可直接浏览其项目与会话，并在本地中栏内嵌渲染对端真实界面。
description.en: A DSH plugin that federates another instance's workspaces into the local sidebar, letting you browse its projects and sessions and render the peer's real GUI in the local center column.

description.zh: dsh-repo-setup 是 DeepSeek Harness 的仓库体检引导插件，注册只读工具 repo_setup_scan，扫描项目技术栈与卫生状况，并推荐应装的 DSH 技能插件与 MCP 服务器，全程不修改任何文件。
description.en: dsh-repo-setup is a DSH plugin that registers a read-only repo_setup_scan tool to inspect project stack and hygiene, then recommends DSH skill plugins and MCP servers to install—without modifying anything.

description.zh: 把另一台 DSH 实例的工作区接入本地侧边栏，配对后可直接浏览其项目与会话，并在本地中栏内嵌渲染对端真实界面。
description.en: A DSH plugin that federates another instance's workspaces into the local sidebar, letting you browse its projects and sessions and render the peer's real GUI in the local center column.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版提供侧边栏与设置页一键重启入口，安全退出并重新拉起应用，仅限 Windows 桌面环境。
description.en: A one-click restart plugin for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app, adding sidebar and settings entries that safely quit and relaunch the application on Windows.

description.zh: DSH plugin 运行配置管理：像 IDE 一样保存常用 LLM 提示词与 Shell 命令为任务配置，在会话页一键运行。
description.en: Run configuration management for DeepSeek Harness: save reusable LLM prompts and shell commands as run configs, launch with one click in the session page.

description.zh: DSH安全模式插件，通过构建空白profile实现零第三方插件启动，并持续守护profile不被篡改。
description.en: DSH safemode plugin that achieves zero third-party plugin startup by constructing a blank profile, and continuously guards the profile against modification.

description.zh: dsh-save-chat 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，一键把整轮问答存成 Markdown 收藏，并支持模型按需检索个人知识库。
description.en: dsh-save-chat is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that saves a whole conversation turn as Markdown and lets the model search your personal knowledge base on demand.

description.zh: 为 DSH 聊天加入定时发送：消息框内的日期时间选择器、跨会话待发面板，由主机进程按时投递，模型也可自行安排回访。
description.en: Schedule messages into a DSH chat: a date-time picker in the message box, a cross-chat pending panel, and host-side delivery that fires on time even with the browser closed.

description.zh: DSH-SCNet 是 DeepSeek Harness 的社区插件，提供 scnet-hpc 技能与七个工具，用于 SSH 配置、Slurm 作业生成、集群发现与计算节点诊断。
description.en: DSH-SCNet is a community DSH plugin bundling the scnet-hpc skill and seven tools for SSH setup, Slurm job generation, cluster discovery, and compute-node diagnostics.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生 s1 搜索工具集（s1_search、s1_news、s1_crawl 等）及配套技能，让 DSH 模型直接调用 Search1API 完成搜索、抓取与趋势查询。
description.en: Native s1 tools for DeepSeek Harness: s1_search, s1_news, s1_crawl, s1_sitemap, s1_trending plus a bundled skill, enabling in-process Search1API calls.

description.zh: DSH 投屏控制的共用核心插件，提供设备列表、投屏面板与截图、点击、输入等 AI 控制工具，需搭配平台 provider 使用。
description.en: Shared core DSH plugin for scrcpy screen mirroring: device list, mirroring panel, and AI tools for screenshot, tap and text input, used with platform providers.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供文件系统安全防护：执行时拦截危险删除、回收站式安全删除、组合快照回滚及重启前校验，并支持人工审批。
description.en: A filesystem safety harness for DeepSeek Harness: execution-time guard, trash-based safe_delete, composition snapshots & rollback, pre-restart validation, with user-gated approvals.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 实时桌面截图与标注，支持全局热键、窗口识别，并可将图片直接插入对话输入框。
description.en: A Windows live-desktop screenshot and annotation plugin for DeepSeek Harness, with global hotkey, window picking, and direct image insertion into the composer.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话记忆与本地知识库的 DSH 插件，默认只把数据存在本机，云端同步与数据迁移均由你决定。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness cross-session memory and a local knowledge base, keeping data on your machine by default with cloud sync and migration left to your approval.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 DeepSeek Harness git 源码安装的更新流程一键化：后台检查、侧边栏提示、一键拉取构建、失败回滚，并以退出码 75 触发服务重启。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns DeepSeek Harness git-source updates into one click: background checks, sidebar alerts, one-click pull & build, rollback on failure, and exit-code-75 restart.

description.zh: DSH 本地开发服务控制台：发现监听端口、识别服务归属，安全地查看、停止或重启本地开发服务，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一站式服务管理。
description.en: A local development service console for DeepSeek Harness: discovers listening ports, identifies service ownership, and safely inspects, stops, or restarts local dev services.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Web GUI 底部统计条中实时估算当前会话的 DeepSeek API 费用，按命中/未命中/输出分项展示，并自动适配峰谷计价。
description.en: A DSH plugin that estimates the DeepSeek API cost for the current session in the web GUI stats strip, breaking down hit/miss/output and adapting to peak/off-peak pricing.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Cursor 风格的草稿会话：新建会话复用空草稿，避免空占位堆积，草稿以侧边栏行展示并持久化。
description.en: Cursor-style draft chats for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): new sessions reuse empty drafts, preventing placeholder stacking, with drafts shown as sidebar rows and persisted.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏会话菜单补上缺失的删除会话能力，支持强制一步删净日志、缓存与注册表，不留幽灵行。
description.en: Adds the missing Delete session action to DeepSeek Harness sidebar menus, with one-click force delete that purges logs, caches and registry entries without ghost rows.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 Web 界面会话标题自动生成 24×24 单色 SVG 隐喻图标，注入左侧会话列表并带磁盘缓存，让每次新会话标题都配上一枚形象小图标。
description.en: A DSH plugin that auto-generates 24×24 monochrome SVG metaphor icons for session titles in the Web UI, injecting them into the left session list with disk caching.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的会话管理 DSH 插件，可在设置页统一浏览、搜索、归档与删除遗留会话，并把 Claude Code、Codex 的历史会话全保真导入为可续聊的原生会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that unifies session browsing, search, archiving and deletion in the settings page, and imports Claude Code or Codex history as fully resumable native sessions.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在会话停止时发送桌面通知、提示音和标题闪烁，点击通知即可跳转至对应会话，让您不错过任何等待处理的任务。
description.en: DSH plugin alerts you when a session stops—via desktop notification, chime, and title flash—and lets you click to jump to that session.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将会话提升为一等公民，提供生命周期控制与跨会话消息投递，一次安装获得完整会话工具套件。
description.en: A DSH plugin making sessions first-class citizens with lifecycle controls and cross-session messaging—one install for a full session toolkit.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为工作区会话提供输入框历史回填（↑/↓ 切换、可搜索）与右键彻底删除本地日志的能力，删除不可恢复。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds input-box history recall (Up/Down, searchable) and right-click permanent deletion of local session logs for workspace sessions.

description.zh: DSH plugin 会话补全：归档目录、恢复原位、删除、编辑重发，补官方缺口，走公开 slot。
description.en: A DSH plugin for session management: archive directory, restore, delete, edit-and-resend, filling official gaps via public slots.

description.zh: 为 DSH plugin 在 Web 输入框下方实时显示当前会话的人民币费用，按模型单价与峰谷时段计价，并可在设置中编辑价格卡。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows live CNY cost of the current session under the Web composer, priced per model rate card and peak/off-peak windows, with editable pricing in Settings.

description.zh: 把 DSH 会话导出成人读的 Markdown 或自包含 HTML，按 Turn 分组呈现消息、思维链与工具调用，支持全部/交接/简洁/审计四种预设，一键下载或写入工作区。
description.en: Export a DeepSeek Harness session as human-readable Markdown or a self-contained HTML page, grouped by turn with messages, reasoning and tool calls, in full / handoff / readable / audit presets.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏会话菜单补上「停止」与「删除」：先取消运行中的回合、子代理、后台任务与提醒，再彻底清除日志、投影缓存与工作区记录，并在有新版本时提示更新。
description.en: Adds Stop and Delete to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar session menu: it cancels running turns, subagents, background jobs and reminders, then permanently removes the session log, projection cache and workspace record, with a notice when a new release is out.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话的 ⋯ 菜单添加「删除会话」项，确认后彻底清除会话日志、投影缓存与工作区注册记录，释放本地磁盘。
description.en: Adds a Delete session action to the DeepSeek Harness session ⋯ menu, permanently wiping the session log, projection cache and workspace registry entries from disk.

description.zh: 把 DSH 会话存成单个 .dsproj 工程文件，像 Word 一样保存、另存与自动保存，换机器打开即可继续对话。
description.en: Save any DSH session as a single .dsproj project file with Word-style save, save-as and autosave, then open it on another machine to resume.

description.zh: dsh-session-relocate 是 DSH plugin，让你在侧边栏把对话拖到任意工作区完成搬家，正在回答的会话也能就地接管、不中断。
description.en: A DSH plugin that moves conversations between workspaces by drag-and-drop or menu, even taking over live sessions without interrupting the current reply.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为每个对话设置项目状态标签，内置三态与自定义标签，会话列表与头部可见，跨浏览器持久化。
description.en: A DSH plugin that sets project status labels for each conversation, with built-in states and custom labels, visible in session list and header, persisted across browsers.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话侧边栏自动生成「日期｜类型｜主题」格式标题，并支持把暂不使用的会话折叠隐藏，随时一键恢复且不删除任何内容。
description.en: A DSH plugin that auto-names sessions as `date | type | topic` in the sidebar and lets you tuck away unused sessions, restorable with one click and never deleted.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 会话页添加右侧常驻可折叠目录栏，点击条目可跳转定位到对应消息并高亮，提升长会话导航效率。
description.en: Adds a persistent, collapsible right-side table of contents to DeepSeek Harness Web UI session pages, enabling click-to-scroll navigation and highlighting of messages.

description.zh: dsh-session-tree 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供轻量只读的会话谱系视图，展示对话 fork 树并支持在父、兄弟、子会话间跳转。
description.en: dsh-session-tree adds a lightweight read-only session lineage view to DeepSeek Harness, displaying the conversation fork tree and enabling navigation between parent, sibling, and child sessions.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将设置面板中大量插件条目折叠为可收纳的「插件条目」分组，支持书签式自定义分组、AI 自动分类与一键折叠，让设置导航清爽有序。
description.en: A DSH plugin that folds plugin entries in the settings panel into a collapsible group, with bookmark-style custom groups, AI auto-classification, and one-click fold, keeping the settings nav tidy.

description.zh: DSH 会话管理增强插件，为侧边栏工作区提供会话数统计、归档恢复、永久删除与跨工作区拖拽移动能力。
description.en: A DSH plugin that enhances session management with count display, archive restore, permanent deletion, and cross-workspace drag-and-drop.

description.zh: DSH plugin 竖屏短视频墙，贴边竖栏或浮窗播放 YouTube Shorts 与 B站竖屏，支持关键词词库、自动连播与老板键。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing a vertical shorts wall for YouTube Shorts and Bilibili vertical videos, with keyword packs, autoplay, and boss key.

description.zh: DSH Local Share 是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于将选中的会话轮次本地导出为 Markdown、自包含 HTML 或长图，支持隐私脱敏且无需上传。
description.en: DSH Local Share is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that exports selected conversation turns locally as Markdown, self-contained HTML, or long PNG, with privacy-first redaction and no uploads.

description.zh: 鲸迹 · dsh-showreel 是一款 DSH plugin，将最近一次 Agent 任务生成可编辑、隐私脱敏的竖屏战报视频（MP4/WebM 与 PNG 封面），全程本地运行。
description.en: dsh-showreel is a DSH plugin that turns the latest completed Agent turn into an editable, privacy-redacted vertical recap video (MP4/WebM + PNG cover), running fully locally.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在设置页新增「关机」页签，一键优雅关闭 DeepSeek Harness 后台服务，带二次确认与成功反馈，关掉浏览器不再残留进程。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding a Shutdown tab in Settings to gracefully stop the DeepSeek Harness background service with confirmation and success feedback, leaving no lingering processes after closing the browser.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 DeepSeek Harness 任务完成后自动关机 Windows 电脑，按钮武装、倒计时可取消，零依赖。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shuts down Windows after DeepSeek Harness tasks complete, with button-armed, cancellable countdown, zero-dependency.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供右侧 Git 侧边栏，可在会话旁查看改动、暂存提交、同步远端并浏览提交图，底部面板还带文件预览与终端。
description.en: A Git sidebar plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web that puts source control beside your session — review changes, stage and commit, sync with a remote, browse the commit graph, plus a bottom panel with file preview and a live terminal.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏对话行添加整行淡色底、彩色圆点与独立标题字号标记，未标记的对话保持原生外观。
description.en: A DSH plugin that marks sidebar conversation rows in DeepSeek Harness with row tints, colored dots and per-conversation title sizes, leaving unmarked rows untouched.

description.zh: DSH plugin 的 Codex 式多标签侧聊增强，支持整条消息引用、生成中零等待引用与双模式 dock，让侧聊更高效。
description.en: A DSH plugin enhancing side chat with multi-tab support, whole-message quoting, and zero-wait quoting during generation.

description.zh: 为 DSH 官方侧边栏文件预览增强源码视图、原位编辑保存、行号显示、搜索与字号调节，让 Markdown 与文本文件在侧边栏内即可直接查看和修改。
description.en: A DSH plugin that enhances the official sidebar file preview with a source view, in-place editing and saving, line numbers, search, and font zoom, so Markdown and text files can be read and edited right in the sidebar.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供原生右侧边栏旁支会话：选中回答片段即可侧问、Fork 历史回合或仅凭引用新建独立会话，不污染主会话上下文。
description.en: Native right-sidebar sidecar conversations for DeepSeek Harness Web: ask about selected answer text, fork earlier turns, or start reference-only Sessions without cluttering your main context.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设置页添加一键重启按钮，无需回到终端即可重启 dsh web 进程，插件改动立即生效。
description.en: Adds a one-click restart button to the DeepSeek Harness settings page, restarting the dsh web process without returning to a terminal so plugin changes take effect.

description.zh: dsh-sight 为 DeepSeek Harness 文本模型注入视觉能力，内置免费 VLM 预设，支持多图批量分析，无需切换模型。
description.en: dsh-sight adds vision to text-only DeepSeek Harness models with built-in free VLM presets and multi-image batch analysis.

description.zh: DSH plugin：输入 /simplify 让 agent 只审查你刚改动的代码行，提出清晰度、一致性与可维护性改进，并自动运行测试。
description.en: A DSH plugin: type /simplify to have the agent review only the lines you just changed, offering clarity, consistency, and maintainability improvements, and run tests automatically.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 界面添加手绘画板，可手写公式、画示意图或记笔记，并把图片直接附加到消息中发送。
description.en: Adds a drawing board to the DeepSeek Harness interface so you can handwrite formulas, sketch diagrams or jot notes and attach the picture straight to your message.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供技能中心页面，可查看、搜索、开关、新建、按链接安装并删除 DSH 技能，删除进回收站可恢复。
description.en: Adds a Skill Center page to the DeepSeek Harness web client for listing, searching, toggling, creating, link-installing and trash-restoring DSH skills.

description.zh: 把 Claude Code、Codex、ZCode 的技能目录以只读 SkillProvider 形式挂进 DeepSeek Harness，让 DSH 直接复用你已有生态的 agent skills，无需复制迁移、改动即时生效。
description.en: Mounts Claude Code, Codex and ZCode skill directories into DeepSeek Harness as read-only skill providers, so DSH reuses your existing agent skills with no copying or migration and picks up changes live.

description.zh: dsh-skill-importer 是 DeepSeek Harness 的插件，将技能管理带入 Web UI，支持导入、校验、去重与迁移 Agent Skills，并可在不消耗模型 token 的情况下直接调用。
description.en: dsh-skill-importer is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that brings skill management into the Web UI, enabling import, validation, deduplication, and migration of Agent Skills with zero model tokens.

description.zh: DSH plugin，在Web设置页提供Skill管理面板，可启停技能，停用的技能对Agent运行时完全不可见。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing a settings-page panel to enable/disable skills; disabled skills are never discovered by agents at runtime.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页应用提供技能管理面板，支持浏览、搜索、过滤、启用/禁用、卸载技能及分组管理，并集成于设置页与侧边栏。
description.en: A skill management panel for the DeepSeek Harness web app: browse, search, filter, enable/disable, uninstall skills, and manage skill groups from settings and sidebar.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 装上 Superpowers 工程方法论：15 个技能经 dsh 原生技能 provider 注册，并注入常驻引导段，让 DSH agent 在头脑风暴、TDD、调试等任务中自主加载技能。
description.en: Brings the Superpowers engineering methodology to DeepSeek Harness: 15 skills registered through dsh's native filesystem skill provider plus an always-on bootstrap prompt, so the DSH agent loads them on its own for brainstorming, TDD, debugging and more.

description.zh: DSH plugin 技能管理工具，为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端提供技能列表、启用/禁用、删除与添加功能，填补官方技能开关控制的空白。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness desktop that lists, enables/disables, deletes, and adds skills, filling the gap in official skill toggle control.

description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板中统一管理技能与 MCP 服务器，支持全局/项目级分层、工具筛选与一键重连，改完即生效。
description.en: Manage skills and MCP servers from the DSH settings panel, with global/project layering, per-server tool filtering and one-click reconnect — changes take effect immediately.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 设置面板添加只读技能列表页，通过 skill.list 拉取当前会话可调用的技能目录并展示。
description.en: Adds a read-only Skills settings page to DeepSeek Harness Web, fetching the session-scoped skill catalog via skill.list and rendering it as a searchable list.

description.zh: dsh-skills-manager 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供主动技能激活、钩子编排与 GitHub 同步，让 SKILL.md 按需自动加载并支持设置管理界面。
description.en: dsh-skills-manager enables proactive skill activation, hook orchestration, and GitHub sync for DeepSeek Harness, turning SKILL.md files into event-driven capabilities.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Skill 与 MCP 管控面板，按全局与工作区两个粒度一键启停，减少每轮上下文开销与工具误选。
description.en: A Skill and MCP control panel for DeepSeek Harness that toggles capabilities per global and per-workspace scope, cutting per-turn context cost and tool misselection.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 换上 Claude Code 风格皮肤，用暖炭灰与陶土橙配色和等宽终端字体重塑界面，自动适配明暗主题。
description.en: A Claude Code-inspired skin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, restyling it with warm charcoal and terracotta tones plus monospace terminal typography that adapts to light and dark themes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 换上 Windows 2000 经典外观的 DSH 皮肤插件，度量表级配色、1px 浮雕与直角滚动条，装上即生效，可随时一键关闭。
description.en: A DSH plugin that skins the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with a metric-accurate Windows 2000 look: classic grey chrome, 1px bevels, square corners and 16px scrollbars, toggleable anytime.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供 Codex 风格琴键导航，将长对话压缩为可预览、可定位的语义节点，帮助用户快速浏览和切换会话段落。
description.en: A Codex-style piano-key navigator for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, compressing long conversations into previewable, locatable semantic nodes for quick browsing and jumping.

description.zh: dsh-sonarqube 是 DeepSeek Harness 的只读 SonarQube 插件，让 Agent 检查质量门禁、问题、安全热点、覆盖率等指标而不改动 SonarQube 状态。
description.en: dsh-sonarqube is a read-only SonarQube plugin for DeepSeek Harness, enabling agents to inspect Quality Gates, issues, hotspots, coverage, and measures without modifying SonarQube state.

description.zh: dsh-smart-prompt 是一款 DSH plugin，一键把草稿改写成清晰可执行的提示词，并保留路径、数字与代码等关键信息。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns a rough composer draft into a clear, actionable prompt in one click, preserving paths, numbers and code exactly as written.

description.zh: dsh-socrates 是 DeepSeek Harness 的深度研究插件，采用苏格拉底式澄清、自适应多轮研究、交叉验证与引用闭环，产出带证据的报告。
description.en: dsh-socrates is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for deep research, featuring Socratic clarification, adaptive multi-round research, cross-verification, and evidence-closed cited reports.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供分屏工作区，可把多个会话拖入窗格并排与多个 Agent 同时对话，外观与原生对话完全一致。
description.en: A split-screen workspace for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI that lets you drag conversations into panes and chat with several agents side by side, styled exactly like the stock conversation view.

description.zh: DSH plugin 用量面板：按项目统计 Token 消耗、开发时间线与预估费用，并查看账户余额与订阅额度。
description.en: A DSH plugin usage dashboard that tracks token consumption, development timelines and estimated costs per project, plus account balances and subscription quotas.

description.zh: dsh-strata-sync 是一款 DSH plugin，在设置页中把 Strata Server 的模型上下文窗口、输出上限与压缩预算同步到 DeepSeek Harness，并支持预览差异、备份与摘要长度控制。
description.en: A DSH plugin that syncs Strata Server model context windows, output limits and compaction budgets into DeepSeek Harness from one settings page, with change preview, backup and summary-length control.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 输入框加入本地语音识别，点击麦克风说话即自动断句转写并插入草稿，模型可选且按需下载。
description.en: Adds local speech recognition to the DeepSeek Harness Web composer: click the mic, speak, and the auto-ended transcript is inserted into your draft, with on-device models you download only when chosen.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 子代理委派提供模型路由：新增 subagent_model 工具，可指定 provider、model 与输出上限，或用 model:"auto" 策略按任务档位自动选型、失败升级与换路，并保留可审计理由。
description.en: Model-routed subagent delegation for DeepSeek Harness: a subagent_model tool that picks provider, model and output cap per call, or delegates to a model:"auto" policy with task tiers, failure escalation, rerouting and auditable reasons.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 Synthesizer V 官方脚本 API 桥接为 MCP 工具，让 AI 直接检查与编辑工程，实现自然语言调音。
description.en: A DSH plugin bridging Synthesizer V's official script API into MCP tools, letting AI inspect and edit projects for natural-language tuning.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供模型可见性：头部标签显示当前会话所用模型与推理强度，底部标签展示子代理委派模型，侧边栏悬停卡呈现每次对话的实际开销。
