description.en: Model visibility for DeepSeek Harness: a header chip names the model and reasoning effort of the active session, a dock chip shows which models a run delegated to, and sidebar hover cards reveal what each conversation actually did.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自动识别对话中的 A 股名称与代码，生成可点击按钮，在侧边栏展示行情、K 线与资讯。
description.en: A DSH plugin that detects A-share names/codes in chats, turning them into clickable buttons that open quotes, K-lines, and news in the sidebar.

description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 宿主层插件，用一张任务定义表驱动周期性任务，按时间窗与依赖把任务派发成独立会话执行，调度层零大模型介入。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness host plugin that drives recurring work from a single task-definition table, dispatching each due task as an independent session by time window and dependency — with zero model involvement in scheduling.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供任务级 Git worktree 隔离，每个任务独立分支与检出，持久化清单跨会话保留，主工作区不受影响。
description.en: Complete Git worktree support for DeepSeek Harness: task-scoped isolated checkouts on their own branches, recorded in a per-repo manifest that survives sessions and restarts.

description.zh: DSH plugin 桌面启动器，将 Tauri 桌面应用的启停、退出确认与快捷方式联动抽象为 Web 插件，在设置面板一键唤起原生桌面体验。
description.en: A DSH plugin launcher that abstracts Tauri desktop app start/stop, exit confirmation, and shortcut linkage into a web plugin, enabling one-click native desktop experience from settings.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Agent 提供可持久化的会话任务栈，通过 focus_task、focus_complete、read_focus 三个工具与 /focus 命令管理多步任务焦点，状态落盘可跨上下文压缩存活，且零提示词注入。
description.en: A persistent per-session task stack for DeepSeek Harness agents: three tools (focus_task / focus_complete / read_focus) plus a /focus command track multi-step focus, with state stored on disk to survive context compaction and zero prompt injection.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Tavily 联网搜索：注册 ctx.web 搜索 provider，并提供搜索、正文抽取、爬取、站点地图与深度研究五个工具及设置页。
description.en: Adds Tavily web search to DeepSeek Harness: registers a ctx.web search provider plus search, extract, crawl, map and research tools with a settings page.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在遥测数据发送至后端前，自动脱敏凭证、令牌等敏感信息，且不改写原始会话日志，保障隐私安全。
description.en: A DSH plugin that redacts credentials and tokens from outbound telemetry copies before backends receive them, without rewriting canonical session logs.

description.zh: dsh-term-glossary 是 DSH 插件：选中对话里的术语，就地弹出解释框，给出基本含义、用途与用法，并显示本次 token 消耗，不占用会话轮次与上下文。
description.en: A DSH plugin that explains any term you select in a conversation with an inline popup covering meaning, purpose and usage, plus the token cost of that call — without touching the session's turns or context.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供 32 款配色主题、动态/静态壁纸、东方纸纹、分区透明度与文字深浅调节，以及跟随按键的桌宠，让 DSH plugin 界面焕然一新。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web GUI appearance kit offering 32 preset themes, animated/static wallpapers, paper textures, per-zone transparency and text depth, plus a keyboard-following desktop pet.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端与 Web GUI 打造的深紫与琥珀金主题，忠实移植 escook 配色，覆盖侧边栏、聊天气泡等全部界面，支持热切换。
description.en: A premium dark violet & amber gold theme for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI & Desktop, faithfully porting the escook palette with full UI coverage and live hot toggle.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 端注入星露谷物语像素农场主题的 DSH plugin，一键切换聊天气泡、侧栏与昼夜氛围，纯视觉不改功能。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects a Stardew Valley pixel-farm theme into the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, switching chat bubbles, sidebar and day/night ambience with one command—visual only.

description.zh: DSH Testkit 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件提供确定性生命周期一致性测试，无需模型调用即可验证安装、注册、卸载与残留。
description.en: DSH Testkit provides deterministic lifecycle conformance testing for DeepSeek Harness plugins, verifying install, registration, uninstall, and residue without model calls.

description.zh: 智囊团是 DSH 插件，用 161 个经典思维模型从九个视角并行分析你的问题，再由 AI 跨模型汇总出共识、分歧、盲区与行动清单。
description.en: ThinkTank is a DSH plugin that analyzes your question through 161 classic mental models across nine perspectives, then has AI synthesize consensus, disagreements, blind spots and an action list.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 自动读取第三方 API 的模型列表，把各模型真实思考等级同步进 DSH 配置的 reasoningEfforts，免去手写 YAML 的维护负担。
description.en: A DSH plugin that reads each third-party API's own model listing and syncs every model's real thinking levels into DSH's reasoningEfforts, so you never hand-maintain that YAML again.

description.zh: DSH 插件，实时分段总结模型长思考链，边思考边产出摘要，附带实时面板、设置页与历史持久化，让你看清模型当前在想什么。
description.en: A DSH plugin that segments and summarizes long reasoning chains in real time, with a live panel, settings page, and persistent history.

description.zh: 把 DSH 智能体的 todo_write 任务清单映射为常驻可拖拽悬浮球，实时显示完成进度与状态配色，点击即可展开完整任务面板。
description.en: Mirrors the DSH agent's todo_write checklist onto a persistent, draggable floating ball with live progress and status colors, expanding into a full task panel on click.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加无需工作区的临时对话，在侧栏一键开启原生未分组 Session，先聊后选项目。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings workspace-free temporary conversations to DeepSeek Harness, letting you start chatting before choosing a project.

description.zh: dsh-token-data 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 dsh web 界面带来实时 Token 用量仪表盘，展示每日消耗、供应商余额与订阅配额，无需切换多个后台。
description.en: dsh-token-data brings a real-time token usage dashboard to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, showing daily consumption, provider balances, and subscription quotas without switching between backends.

description.zh: DSH 待办事项插件：从对话、通知、公告与邮件中识别关键事项，转为带截止日期的待办，经预览确认后写入，并在左侧栏统一管理。
description.en: A DSH plugin that extracts key items from chats, notifications, announcements and emails into dated to-dos, with preview-confirm and sidebar management.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面添加动态壁纸，支持 GIF/WebP/APNG 动图与 MP4/WebM 视频背景，自动识别格式并提供压暗滑块。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds animated and video live wallpapers to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, supporting GIF/WebP/APNG images and MP4/WebM videos with auto format detection and a dim slider.

description.zh: DSH plugin 会话费用统计面板：自动采集每次 LLM 请求的 token 用量，按内置 16 家厂商 136 个模型价格实时计费，并在输入框旁展示当前模型、余额、会话/今日/本月花费与预算横条。
description.en: A DSH plugin cost panel that meters every LLM request from session events, prices it against a built-in catalog of 136 models across 16 providers, and shows model, balance, session/today/month spend and a monthly budget bar next to the composer.

description.zh: DSH plugin 按提供方/模型配置 token 价格与高峰时段，并在数据栏、浮窗和统计面板实时显示会话费用。
description.en: A DSH plugin to configure per-provider/model token rates with peak windows and display live conversation costs in the status bar, floating widget, and dashboard.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 token 用量分析与模型能力排行榜的 DSH plugin，扫描宿主会话日志，按提供商和模型统计消耗趋势、缓存命中率，并对比可调用模型的能力排名。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for token usage analytics and model capability rankings: it scans the host's own session logs, breaks consumption trends and cache hit rates down by provider and model, and ranks every callable model on a public leaderboard.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 token 用量分析与模型能力排行榜的 DSH plugin，扫描宿主会话日志，按提供商和模型统计消耗趋势、缓存命中率，并对比可调用模型的能力排名。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for token usage analytics and model capability rankings: it scans the host's own session logs, breaks consumption trends and cache hit rates down by provider and model, and ranks every callable model on a public leaderboard.

description.zh: DSH plugin 接入 TokensForce 词元网关，一次登录即可使用模型，自动配置 API Key 与网关，并提供用量仪表盘标签。
description.en: A DSH plugin integrating TokensForce token gateway: one-login onboarding, auto model setup, and a usage dashboard tab.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地 token 用量、API 调用与缓存命中统计面板，在侧边栏直观查看各会话、模型与项目的消耗情况。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows local token usage, API calls, and cache hit statistics in the native sidebar, broken down by session, model, and project.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为纯文本模型提供 generate_image 工具，通过 Antigravity CLI 调用 Gemini 生成图片，持久保存并内联显示在对话中。
description.en: A DSH plugin that equips text-only models with a generate_image tool, using Antigravity CLI to render images via Gemini, persisting them to disk and displaying inline in chat.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 AST 的结构化代码搜索与语法大纲工具，用 ast-grep 精准定位代码结构，比传统 grep 更省 token。
description.en: AST-based structural code search and syntax outline tool for DeepSeek Harness, powered by ast-grep for precise, token-efficient code navigation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入真实语言服务器，提供诊断、格式化、重命名、代码操作与符号导航五类工具，让模型直接调用 LSP 能力。
description.en: An LSP tool surface for DeepSeek Harness that exposes real language-server diagnostics, formatting, rename, code actions and symbol navigation as five model-callable tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏补上不可撤销的「删除会话」操作，确认弹窗会说明日志大小、运行中任务与提醒，确认后彻底移除会话记录。
description.en: Adds an irreversible Delete session action to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, with a confirmation dialog showing log size, running turns and reminders before the session is fully removed.

description.zh: Trajectory Reader 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端新增「轨迹解读」标签页，按用户轮次解读助手行为，并可选生成 LLM 过程叙事，原消息保持不变。
description.en: Trajectory Reader adds a 'Trajectory Reader' tab to the DeepSeek Harness web client, interpreting assistant behavior per user round with optional LLM process narrative, leaving original messages unchanged.

description.zh: DSH plugin 封装 underseal 哈希密封授权协议，为 AI 代理提供类型化工具，实现有界任务委托与可审计证据链。
description.en: A DSH plugin wrapping the underseal hash-sealed authorization protocol, providing typed tools for bounded delegation and auditable evidence.

description.zh: DSH plugin，将Agent执行轨迹自动转为结构化复盘报告，提炼决策点、踩坑与可复用做法，助力开发复盘。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns an agent's execution trajectory into a structured post-mortem report, highlighting decisions, pitfalls, and reusable patterns.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让 AI 翻译文本、文件与截图，第二模型评审打分并自动改写，支持整文件夹批量翻译，人工只需审校。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that translates text, files, and screenshots with AI, then has a second model score and auto-rewrite the draft; batch-translate whole folders and only proofread.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面嵌入可拖拽的 AI 翻译浮窗，支持多语言互译、余额与费用估算，密钥不出浏览器。
description.en: A floating AI translation window for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with multi-language translation, balance and cost estimation, keeping API keys off the page.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 统计每段对话被压缩的次数并常驻悬浮窗，仅在反复压缩且此后又消耗大量 token 时才提醒新开对话，宁沉默不误报。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that counts how often each conversation was compacted, keeps the count in a floating window, and warns you to start a new chat only when compaction repeats and a lot of extra tokens were burned since.

description.zh: dsh-tool-result-trimmer 是 DSH plugin，在工具执行后即时裁剪超大输出，避免会话日志与上下文膨胀。
description.en: A DSH plugin that eagerly trims oversized tool outputs right after execution, keeping session logs and LLM context lean.

description.zh: DSH plugin 静态信任审计工具，零 token 披露插件能力、注入、来源与安装脚本，每条结论附证据，可复现可复核。
description.en: A DSH plugin for static trust auditing, disclosing plugin capabilities, injections, provenance, and install scripts with evidence, zero-token and reproducible.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供按轮次原子编辑、重试、重生成与版本树导航的 DSH plugin，分支日志在进程重启后依然保留。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that enables turn-atomic message editing, retry, reroll, and version-tree navigation, with branch logs surviving process restarts.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏提供「轮次轨迹」tab，把长会话按用户轮次折叠成输入、工具步骤与输出摘要，点击即可跳回对话原位，零 LLM、只读零侵入。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a turn-outline tab to the sidebar, folding long sessions into per-turn input, tool-step and output summaries with one-click jump-back; zero-LLM and read-only.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面中，于每个已完成回合下方显示该轮花费的人民币金额，点击可展开 token 用量与单价明细，改价后历史金额实时重算。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web plugin that shows the CNY cost of each completed turn on its own row, with a click-to-expand breakdown of token usage and unit rates that recalculates past turns when prices change.

description.zh: dsh-turn-doctor 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 诊断插件，能精准定位会话失败原因，并指出是哪个超时或设置导致的，同时给出修复建议。
description.en: dsh-turn-doctor is a diagnostic plugin for DeepSeek Harness that pinpoints why a turn failed and which timeout or setting is responsible, with suggested fixes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 添加对话轮次索引侧边栏，按序列出每轮提问，点击跳转并高亮，滚动时同步定位当前轮次。
description.en: A turn-index sidebar for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: lists each user turn, click to jump with highlight, and scroll-spy keeps the current turn in view.

description.zh: dsh-turn-rail 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供 Codex 风格的自动隐藏会话轨道，悬停边缘即可预览和跳转对话轮次，零依赖、极简设计。
description.en: dsh-turn-rail adds a Codex-style auto-hiding turn rail to DeepSeek Harness Web, letting you preview and jump between conversation turns by hovering the edge—minimal and dependency-free.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供可视化免代码主题定制，在设置面板中即时调整配色、字体、背景与组件样式，并可保存多套方案。
description.en: A visual, no-code theme customizer for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web that instantly applies colors, fonts, background and component styles from the Settings panel, with savable schemes.

description.zh: dsh-ultracode 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 预设，为会话注入 UltraCode 工作模式：深度思考、计划执行验证、并行子代理编排与证据收尾。
description.en: dsh-ultracode is a DSH plugin agent preset that injects the UltraCode working mode into sessions: deep thinking, plan-execute-verify, parallel subagent orchestration, and proof-driven completion.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 UI 截图转换为结构化、可实施的前端规格，帮助 DeepSeek 模型重建响应式网页界面。
description.en: DSH plugin that turns UI screenshots into structured, implementation-grade frontend specs, enabling DeepSeek to recreate responsive web interfaces.

description.zh: dsh-ultracode 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 预设，为会话注入 UltraCode 工作模式：深度思考、计划执行验证、并行子代理编排与证据收尾。
description.en: dsh-ultracode is a DSH plugin agent preset that injects the UltraCode working mode into sessions: deep thinking, plan-execute-verify, parallel subagent orchestration, and proof-driven completion.

description.zh: 在 DSH 右栏提供 SSH 终端、SFTP 文件管理与端口转发的 DSH plugin，密码交由操作系统密码箱保管，并注册 AI 可调用的会话执行工具。
description.en: A DSH plugin that puts SSH terminals, SFTP file management and port forwarding in the right sidebar, keeping passwords in the OS credential store and exposing AI-callable session tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧边栏提供只读版本徽章与发布通道指引，可查看当前 DSH 版本、npm 通道兼容性并复制升级命令，自身不执行任何安装或回滚操作。
description.en: A read-only version badge and release-channel guide for the DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar, showing the running DSH version, npm channel compatibility, and a copy-only upgrade command without ever installing or rolling back.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边栏用量面板，实时显示 API 余额与今日花费，并按官方峰谷定价估算 token 成本。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a sidebar usage widget showing live API balance and today's spend, estimating token cost with official peak/off-peak pricing.

description.zh: dsh-token-usage 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 token 用量与成本分析插件，在 Web 设置面板新增用量统计页，提供汇总卡片、GitHub 风格热力图和官方峰谷价自动换算的预估费用。
description.en: dsh-token-usage is a token usage and cost analytics plugin for DeepSeek Harness, adding a Usage Stats page to the Web settings panel with summary cards, a GitHub-style heatmap, and estimated spend auto-converted at official peak/off-peak rates.

description.zh: dsh-token-usage 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 token 用量与成本分析插件，在 Web 设置面板新增用量统计页，提供汇总卡片、GitHub 风格热力图和官方峰谷价自动换算的预估费用。
description.en: dsh-token-usage is a token usage and cost analytics plugin for DeepSeek Harness, adding a Usage Stats page to the Web settings panel with summary cards, a GitHub-style heatmap, and estimated spend auto-converted at official peak/off-peak rates.

description.zh: dsh-v4-anchor 是 DeepSeek Harness 的极简插件，在 DeepSeek V4 Standard 会话首请求注入 RL-shaped bootstrap，首次工具调用后恢复完整 Standard 能力并重新暴露 Skill。
description.en: dsh-v4-anchor is a minimal DSH plugin that injects an RL-shaped bootstrap into the first request of DeepSeek V4 Standard sessions, then restores full Standard capabilities and re-exposes Skills after the first tool call.

description.zh: DSH plugin 用量统计面板，为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供 GitHub 风格热力图、每日 token 趋势与模型用量饼图，直观掌握使用情况。
description.en: A usage statistics dashboard for DeepSeek Harness Web UI, featuring GitHub-style heatmap, daily token trends, and model usage donut charts.

description.zh: dsh-venv 是 DeepSeek Harness 的项目环境管理插件，自动为每个工作区创建或接管独立 Python venv，并注入 node、go 等运行时环境变量，让 python/pip 永不落到系统环境。
description.en: dsh-venv is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that gives every workspace its own runtime environment: it auto-adopts or creates a project-local Python venv and injects node/go toolchain env vars, so python and pip never fall back to the system interpreter.

description.zh: dsh-verify 是 DeepSeek Harness 的质量门禁，用真实浏览器执行验收测试，为 AI 构建的 Web 应用提供 PASS/FAIL 判定与截图证据。
description.en: dsh-verify is a quality gate for DeepSeek Harness, running real-browser acceptance checks to deliver PASS/FAIL verdicts with screenshot receipts for agent-built web apps.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 对话界面加上胶囊轨道与贴边抽屉目录，可快速跳转上一个/下一个用户问题，告别手动滑动查找。
description.en: Adds a capsule rail and edge drawer index to the DeepSeek Harness chat view, letting you jump to the previous or next user question instead of scrolling manually.

description.zh: dsh-violet-heart 是一款 DSH plugin，向系统提示注入固定规则段：正式交付文档不写私人话语，自留笔记可偶尔留一点心迹。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects a fixed rule section into the system prompt: never write personal words into a formal deliverable, yet occasionally leave a little heart in the notes you keep for yourself.

description.zh: DSH plugin 视觉识别插件：在 Web 编辑器粘贴图片，由主机端调用 GLM-4V 识别，并将结果作为隐藏上下文注入对话，让主模型基于图片内容作答。
description.en: A DSH plugin for vision recognition: paste images into the Web composer, recognize them via GLM-4V on the host side, and inject the result as hidden context so the main model answers based on the image.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让纯文本模型也能读懂图片：粘贴图片时自动调用视觉模型转写为文字，再交给原模型回答，无需切换模型。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets text-only models read images by transcribing them with a vision model before the request reaches the provider.

description.zh: DSH 视觉插件，为纯文本模型提供视觉能力：自动将图片转写为文本，并支持 vision_analyze 工具与视觉模型设置页。
description.en: Vision plugin for DeepSeek Harness: transcribes images to text for text-only models, plus a vision_analyze tool and a settings page.

description.zh: DSH plugin 一键换背景：从本机 Wallpaper Engine 素材库选图或视频应用到界面，并联动深/浅色主题。
description.en: A DSH plugin to switch background from local Wallpaper Engine library with one click, and sync DSH theme.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 添加国内可用的语音输入，基于阿里云 DashScope ASR 将语音实时转为文字填入输入框。
description.en: Adds China-ready voice input to DeepSeek Harness Web, using Alibaba Cloud DashScope ASR to transcribe speech into the input box in real time.

description.zh: dsh-watch 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供流监控工具，可监听命令或文件输出，按正则过滤并批量唤醒空闲 agent，支持无人值守守护进程运行。
description.en: dsh-watch adds stream monitoring to DeepSeek Harness: arm listeners on commands or files, filter lines by regex, and wake the idle agent with batched notices, with a daemon for unattended operation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web GUI 增加密码访问认证，通过登录页与 HttpOnly 签名 Cookie 保护反代暴露的 dsh web，防止未授权访问。
description.en: Adds password-gate authentication to DeepSeek Harness web GUI, using a login page and HttpOnly signed cookie to protect dsh web exposed behind a reverse proxy.

description.zh: DSH plugin 识图插件：保持 DeepSeek 对话，15+ 供应商视觉模型将图片转译为文字，可在设置→插件配置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that keeps DeepSeek as the conversation brain, transcribes images to text via 15+ vision providers, configurable from Settings → Plugins.

description.zh: dsh-web-enhanced 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面增强任务看板、Git 图、工作区面板、余额显示与图像识别，让 DSH 操作更直观高效。
description.en: dsh-web-enhanced brings task dashboards, Git graphs, workspace panels, balance displays, and image understanding to the DeepSeek Harness web interface.

description.zh: DSH Weave 是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，通过 Iroh 加密连接将多台 DSH 节点组成对等网络，实现可信节点发现、会话事件交换与任务交接。
description.en: DSH Weave is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that connects multiple DSH nodes into a peer-to-peer network via Iroh, enabling trusted peer discovery, session-aware event exchange, and task handoff.

description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供可配置、安全的多提供商网页搜索与抓取工具，支持SearXNG、Wikipedia、Tavily、Brave和Gemini等后端，并内置安全边界。
description.en: Configurable and secure multi-provider web search and fetch tools for DeepSeek Harness, supporting SearXNG, Wikipedia, Tavily, Brave, and Gemini backends with built-in security boundaries.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 OpenRouter 兼容网关的联网搜索，让内置 web_search 走你已付费的同一端点与密钥，搜索模型与计费可独立配置。
description.en: Grounded web search for DeepSeek Harness on any OpenRouter-compatible gateway: the built-in web_search tool runs on the same endpoint and key as your chat models, with its own search model and billing.

description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供可配置、安全的多提供商网页搜索与抓取工具，支持SearXNG、Wikipedia、Tavily、Brave和Gemini等后端，并内置安全边界。
description.en: Configurable and secure multi-provider web search and fetch tools for DeepSeek Harness, supporting SearXNG, Wikipedia, Tavily, Brave, and Gemini backends with built-in security boundaries.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供豆包搜索（火山引擎）驱动的 web 搜索能力，通过 ctx.web 接入，独立计费，支持运行时配置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that plugs Doubao Search (Volcengine) into the harness's ctx.web seam, with separate billing and runtime-configurable settings.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册 Codex 搜索提供方，将网页搜索请求发送至 /alpha/search 兼容接口，支持复用 OpenAI 配置或独立 Key。
description.en: Registers a Codex search provider for DeepSeek Harness, routing web search requests to a /alpha/search-compatible endpoint, with support for reusing OpenAI config or a standalone key.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 ctx.web 接入 Tavily 搜索提供者，把内置 web_search 工具改走真实搜索引擎索引，搜索不再消耗模型 token。
description.en: A Tavily-backed WebSearchProvider for the DeepSeek Harness ctx.web seam, routing the built-in web_search tool to a real search index so searches cost no model tokens.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 ctx.web 接入 Tavily 搜索提供者，把内置 web_search 工具改走真实搜索引擎索引，搜索不再消耗模型 token。
description.en: A Tavily-backed WebSearchProvider for the DeepSeek Harness ctx.web seam, routing the built-in web_search tool to a real search index so searches cost no model tokens.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多后端 web_search 与 web_fetch 工具，支持 Exa 和 Firecrawl，无需 API 密钥即可使用，并具备自动故障转移与结果验证功能。
description.en: Multi-backend web_search and web_fetch provider for DeepSeek Harness, supporting Exa and Firecrawl with keyless operation, automatic failover, and result verification.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 ctx.web 搜索能力缝提供 OpenCode 同款搜索 provider，让使用 opencode-go key 的会话无需 DeepSeek 官方 API key 即可直接调用 web_search 工具。
description.en: A DSH plugin that provides an OpenCode-style search provider for DeepSeek Harness's ctx.web seam, enabling web_search for opencode-go key sessions without a DeepSeek official API key.

description.zh: dsh-wecom 将企业微信 AI 机器人接入 DeepSeek Harness，每个会话对应一个持久化、带真实工具的 Agent，支持流式回复、思考卡片与状态面板。
description.en: dsh-wecom wires a WeCom AI Bot to DeepSeek Harness, where every conversation is a persistent, tool-enabled agent with streaming replies, thinking cards, and a live status panel.

description.zh: 墨韵为 DeepSeek Harness 提供五套水墨主题、自定义壁纸与粒子特效，让 DSH 界面呈现东方美学意境。
description.en: MoYun brings five ink-wash themes, custom wallpapers, and particle effects to DeepSeek Harness, adding Eastern aesthetics to the DSH interface.

description.zh: dsh-whale-arcade 是 DeepSeek Harness 的浏览器游戏插件，在等待模型响应时提供五款轻量小游戏，右下角小鲸鱼常驻启动器，关闭即暂停并保留进度，不打断 Agent 运行。
description.en: dsh-whale-arcade is a browser-game plugin for DeepSeek Harness, offering five lightweight games to fill waits for model responses, with a persistent whale launcher and pause-on-close that keeps the Agent running.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供聊天内容宽度档位的 DSH plugin，右下角浮动按钮可切换标准、中等、宽、超宽、全宽五档，解决宽表格被 748px 限制而横向滚动的问题。
description.en: A DSH plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI that adds chat content width tiers — standard, medium, wide, ultra and full — via a floating picker button, lifting the hard-coded 748px column so wide tables no longer need horizontal scrolling.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加「鲸鱼娘」角色 Agent 模式，带分层长期记忆与梦境式整理，让 DSH 对话更有角色感且记得住你。
description.en: Adds a Whale Chan persona Agent mode to DeepSeek Harness, with layered long-term memory and dream-like consolidation so DSH chats stay in character and remember what matters.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 极简 agent preset：一句话 persona、零运行时上下文、三工具、自动压缩，安装即用。
description.en: A minimal agent preset for DeepSeek Harness on Windows: one-line persona, zero runtime context, three tools, auto-compact, installable via dsh plugin add.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows C 盘清理能力：扫描后按五级安全分级生成可视化报告，支持暂存区删除、UAC 提权与跨盘迁移，先量后删、可回滚。
description.en: A DSH plugin that cleans up the Windows C: drive: it scans, grades candidates into five safety tiers, and produces a visual report, with staging-area deletion, UAC elevation and cross-drive migration.

description.zh: DSH 插件，将内置 web_search/web_fetch 代理至自托管 Wigolo 搜索，覆盖搜索/抓取/提取/深度研究/缓存/监控全链路，数据不出域，零查询成本。
description.en: A DSH plugin that proxies web_search/web_fetch to a self-hosted Wigolo daemon, covering search/crawl/extract/research/cache/watch pipeline with full data privacy and zero cost.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 系统托盘鲸鱼控制器，常驻后台，通过托盘菜单一键启动、停止、重启 dsh web 服务并打开界面。
description.en: A Windows system-tray whale controller for DeepSeek Harness, providing resident tray icon with one-click Start, Stop, Restart and Open controls for the dsh web service.

description.zh: 这是一款 DeepSeek Harness 插件，让 Agent 通过本地 Workbench CLI 直接管控阿里云 ECS 实例，内置 9 个工具覆盖列举、诊断、执行、上传与部署全流程，无需公网 IP。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets the Agent control remote Alibaba Cloud ECS instances via the local Workbench CLI, shipping 9 agent-native tools for listing, diagnosing, executing, uploading and deploying without a public IP.

description.zh: DSH plugin，用于生成可编辑的PPTX演示文稿，内置Kimi兼容的创作技能和确定性PPTD验证，无需外部服务即可产出PPT文件。
description.en: A DSH plugin for editable PPTX generation with bundled authoring skills and deterministic PPTD validation, enabling standalone PowerPoint creation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将企业文档变成可对话的知识问答机器人，无需建索引或向量库，直接提问并返回带出处的答案。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns enterprise documents into a conversational Q&A agent, answering with cited sources without index or vector DB.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 Windows 添加 Git Bash / WSL Bash 支持，提供 git_bash、wsl_bash 工具与 shell-select 执行器，统一路由 shell 调用。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding Git Bash / WSL Bash support on Windows, providing git_bash and wsl_bash tools plus a shell-select executor routing shell calls.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供 Windows 桌面通知、可选提示音及 DSH 风格页内卡片，任务完成或需关注时及时提醒，支持多种事件与自定义设置。
description.en: Delivers Windows desktop notifications, optional sounds, and DSH-styled in-page cards for DeepSeek Harness Web, alerting on task completion or attention requests with customizable events.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将本地与远程（SSH）工作区统一管理，支持多工作区会话、跨服务器执行与权限控制，无需在远程安装 DSH。
description.en: A DSH plugin that unifies local and remote (SSH) workspaces, enabling multi-workspace sessions, cross-server execution, and permission control without installing DSH remotely.

description.zh: DSH plugin 工作区中枢，提供分组拖拽排序、内联编辑、消息搜索，以及 Token、花费与 OpenCode 额度的实时统计面板。
description.en: A DSH plugin workspace hub offering drag-and-drop grouping, inline editing, message search, and real-time token, cost, and OpenCode quota analytics.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供审批式工作区记忆：把可复用规则写入 AGENTS.md、稳定事实写入 .dsh-memory.md，改动以 diff 呈现并经确认后落盘。
description.en: An approval-gated workspace memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: reusable rules go to AGENTS.md, stable facts to .dsh-memory.md, with every update shown as a diff before it is written.

description.zh: DSH plugin 编排与工作区隔离管理器：按工作区禁用插件、扫描冲突、多开隔离实例，并提供不依赖 DSH 进程的急救工具。
description.en: A DSH plugin orchestration and workspace-isolation manager: disable plugins per workspace, scan conflicts, launch isolated instances, and rescue a broken DSH without the DSH process.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在会话头部添加分支与 worktree 切换芯片，支持创建 worktree 并作为工作区打开，提升 Git 开发效率。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding a session-header chip to switch branches and worktrees, create worktrees, and open them as harness workspaces.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在会话头部添加分支与 worktree 切换芯片，支持创建 worktree 并作为工作区打开，提升 Git 开发效率。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding a session-header chip to switch branches and worktrees, create worktrees, and open them as harness workspaces.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供工作区文件监测能力，用自然语言即可创建、暂停、恢复定时扫描任务，发现新增、修改或删除文件时汇报变化。
description.en: A DSH plugin that monitors workspace file changes: create, pause and resume polling tasks in natural language, and get reports on added, modified or deleted files.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供会话级 Markdown 写作板，支持起草、预览、AI 局部改写与 Diff 审核，让写作流程不离开对话。
description.en: A session-level Markdown writing pad for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, enabling drafting, preview, AI-assisted rewriting, and diff review within the conversation.

description.zh: dsh-x-connect 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 X API v2 连接器，通过 OAuth 2.0 绑定账号，让 Agent 搜索、阅读、总结并发布推文。
description.en: dsh-x-connect is an X API v2 connector for DeepSeek Harness, binding an account via OAuth 2.0 to enable search, read, summarize, and publish posts.

description.zh: 为 Windows 上的 DSH 提供原生 WSL 执行面：在任意会话中调用 wsl_bash 等 Linux 工具，并可在新建会话时选择 WSL 模式与工作区。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness on Windows a native WSL execution surface: wsl_bash and other Linux tools in any session, plus a WSL session mode with a chosen workspace.

description.zh: dsh-youreyes 为纯文本 DeepSeek Harness 赋予视觉能力，支持粘贴图片、截图或文件路径，模型即可识别并回答相关问题，兼容多种视觉通道。
description.en: dsh-youreyes gives text-only DeepSeek Harness eyes: paste images, screenshots, or file paths, and the model can see and answer questions about them, with support for multiple vision channels.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 增强版工作区目录选择器：WSL 下 /mnt Windows 盘符一键直达、完整面包屑层级、常显路径输入框，替换原生对话框。
description.en: Enhanced workspace directory browser for DeepSeek Harness web UI: one-click access to /mnt Windows drives under WSL, full breadcrumb ancestry, and an always-visible path input.

description.zh: dsh-zhushou 是 DeepSeek Harness 的侧边栏助手插件，在侧边栏管理并选择助手人设，选中后于 DSH 会话内以该人设对话，不选则保持原生会话。
description.en: dsh-zhushou is a DeepSeek Harness sidebar assistant plugin: manage and pick assistant personas from the sidebar, then talk to the selected one inside the DSH session, or stay native when none is selected.

description.zh: Fabric 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Runtime Plugin 内核与下游 SDK，提供插件开发、热加载、迁移与生命周期管理能力。
description.en: Fabric is the runtime plugin kernel and downstream SDK for DeepSeek Harness, enabling plugin development, hot reload, migration, and lifecycle management.

description.zh: DSH plugin 的奥黛塔冰雪梦幻主题皮肤，为客户端提供深/浅双模式 UI 美化，覆盖 13 个官方主题 token，带毛玻璃质感与侧栏小兽开关。
description.en: A Genshin Odette-themed skin for DSH plugin, offering dark/light dual-mode UI beautification, overriding 13 official theme tokens with frosted glass and a sidebar pet toggle.

description.zh: DSH 技能：自动探测代理与镜像路线，分段并发加速下载 GitHub Release 大资产并做 SHA256 校验。
description.en: A DSH plugin skill that probes proxy and mirror routes, then accelerates large GitHub Release downloads with segmented concurrency and SHA256 digest verification.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 ZCode 赠送免费 plan 的 DSH plugin，内置多账号池、bigmodel/zai 双渠道登录与 Web UI 管理面板，零运行时依赖。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings ZCode's free plan into DeepSeek Harness, with a multi-account pool, bigmodel/zai dual-channel login and a Web UI management panel, zero runtime dependencies.

description.zh: DSH 插件 ieee-weekly 按关键词盯住 IEEE Xplore 期刊 Early Access，经 Crossref 抓新收录、LLM 逐篇研判后生成 Markdown 周报并发送邮件。
description.en: A DSH plugin that watches IEEE Xplore journal Early Access by keyword, discovers new DOIs via Crossref, screens each paper with an LLM, and delivers a Markdown weekly digest by email.

description.zh: 为 AI Agent 提供轻量长期记忆后端的 DSH plugin：会话结束提取兴趣点并校验入库，下次会话自动召回注入，仅一个二进制加一个 SQLite 文件。
description.en: A lightweight long-term memory backend DSH plugin for AI agents: it extracts and verifies interest points at session end, then recalls and injects relevant context at the next session start — just one binary plus one SQLite file.

description.zh: iterate-plugin 是 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）桌面端的迭代收敛插件，将多轮代码审查-修复闭环搬进界面，提供并行审查、去重收敛、自动修复验证与只读预演。
description.en: iterate-plugin brings the iterate ecosystem's autonomous closed-loop code iteration into the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) desktop client, with parallel reviews, dedup convergence, atomic fix+verify, and dry-run read-only review.

description.zh: DSH plugin 实现 LLM-as-a-Verifier 的 Best-of-N 验证模式，让 DeepSeek V4 Flash 通过自验证达到前沿模型水平，成本降低约 11 倍。
description.en: A DSH plugin implementing LLM-as-a-Verifier's Best-of-N verification mode, giving DeepSeek V4 Flash test-time scaling to reach frontier-level scores at ~1/11 the cost.

description.zh: DSH plugin 矩阵思维插件，将思考过程渲染为黑客帝国代码雨，提供 CLI 风格对话页，与当前会话双向同步。
description.en: A DSH plugin that renders thinking as Matrix code rain, offering a CLI-style chat page synced with the current session.

description.zh: mermaid2aichat-dsh 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Mermaid 可视化编辑器插件，提供可关闭的右侧面板，画布与代码双向同步，并支持与 AI 对话双向传输图表。
description.en: mermaid2aichat-dsh is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a Mermaid visual editor with a closable right-side panel, two-way canvas-code sync, and bidirectional diagram transfer with the AI chat.

description.zh: ModelTester 是 DeepSeek Harness 网页端模型检测面板，通过结构指纹与 usage 差分，本地零网络判断当前会话像哪家模型并给出证据账本。
description.en: ModelTester is a DeepSeek Harness web panel that fingerprints a session's structural leaks and usage deltas locally, ranking which vendor's model it resembles with a full evidence ledger.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地优先的全双工语音交互，由 Muxiva 编排，在 Mac 上完成 VAD、ASR、TTS 与打断，DSH 保持 Agent 状态。
description.en: Local-first full-duplex voice for DeepSeek Harness, orchestrated by Muxiva, handling VAD, ASR, TTS and interruption on the Mac while DSH stays the stateful Agent.

description.zh: 溜达喵是 DSH plugin，在对话中搜索地点、标记地图并规划比较多种出行路线，提供个性化导航方案。
description.en: Neko Wander is a DSH plugin that searches places, marks them on an interactive map, and plans or compares multiple travel routes right inside the conversation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 tri-agent 预设的简体中文分叉版，含 Atlas 编排与 Prometheus 规划双模式身份及完整编码工具链。
description.en: A Simplified-Chinese fork of the tri-agent preset for DeepSeek Harness, bundling the Atlas orchestration and Prometheus planning dual-mode persona with a full coding toolchain.

description.zh: oh-my-dsh 是 DSH plugin 组合包，为 DeepSeek Harness Web 端一次性带来手机界面、登录、文件与 Git 侧栏、MCP 管理、搜索切换与 Codex 支持。
description.en: oh-my-dsh is a DSH plugin bundle that equips DeepSeek Harness Web with a mobile UI, login, file/Git sidebar, MCP management, search provider switching and Codex support in one install.

description.zh: Agent Modpack 是一款 DSH plugin，像装 Minecraft 整合包一样打包技能、规则与 MCP，并安装到 Claude Code、Codex 等 harness，支持卸载。
description.en: Agent Modpack is a DSH plugin that packs skills, rules, and MCP into a .pack.zip like a Minecraft modpack, installing them into Claude Code, Codex, and other harnesses, with uninstall support.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供 Famicom 红白机像素风皮肤，覆盖官方语义 token，含四套强调色、HP 条状态、GBA 对话窗等 8-bit 界面增强。
description.en: A Famicom-inspired pixel skin for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, covering official semantic tokens with four accent colors, HP-bar status, GBA-style dialogs, and other 8-bit UI enhancements.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供结构化的 Remotion 视频工作流，通过五个工具诊断项目、渲染静态帧与视频并验证输出，让 DSH plugin 轻松生成程序化视频。
description.en: Give DeepSeek Harness a structured Remotion workflow with five tools to diagnose projects, render stills and videos, and verify output, enabling programmatic video generation via a DSH plugin.

description.zh: SecurStack 适配器，让 DeepSeek Harness 通过安全工具执行仓库扫描、策略门禁与诊断，返回结构化 JSON 结果。
description.en: SecurStack adapter that lets DeepSeek Harness run repository scans, policy gates, and diagnostics via safe tools, returning structured JSON.

description.zh: onebox-dsh-bridge 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，将本地 dsh web 桥接到 OneBox 云中继，让 OneBox 安卓应用通过扫码配对、端到端加密隧道远程访问你的 AI 代理。
description.en: onebox-dsh-bridge is a DSH plugin that bridges local dsh web to the OneBox cloud relay, enabling the OneBox Android app to reach your AI agent remotely via scan-to-pair and end-to-end encrypted tunnel.

description.zh: DSH 插件在对话区左缘提供轮次图标列，点击即可平滑定位到每轮用户输入，支持高亮与实时更新。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a left-edge turn rail with clickable icons to locate each user message, with highlighting and real-time updates.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让 agent 在会话内读取其他会话的消息、工具调用与推理过程，支持工具调用与 /sessions 斜杠命令，只读且有界。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets agents read messages, tool calls, and reasoning from other sessions via tools and /sessions commands, read-only and bounded.

description.zh: SideSight 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 CLI 视觉侧车，为纯文本编码代理提供截图、图表、UI 差异和视频的多模态分析能力。
description.en: SideSight is a CLI-first vision sidecar for DeepSeek Harness, enabling text-only coding agents to analyze screenshots, diagrams, UI diffs, and videos via multimodal models.

description.zh: think-like-codex 为 DeepSeek Harness 注入 Codex 风格的决策与规划策略，帮助编码代理避免低效循环、在证据不足时求助用户，并遵循计划-目标-实现的结构化流程处理复杂任务。
description.en: think-like-codex injects a Codex-inspired decision and planning policy into DeepSeek Harness, helping coding agents avoid unproductive loops, ask for help when evidence is insufficient, and follow a structured plan-goal-implementation workflow for complex tasks.

description.zh: DSH plugin 桌面小章鱼宠物，自动识别 AI 回复中的术语黑话，用大白话和比喻解释，支持 AI 深挖与选词解释。
description.en: A DSH plugin featuring a desktop octopus pet that detects jargon in AI replies and explains it in plain language, with AI deep-dive and selection-based lookup.

description.zh: DSH 分层上下文压缩插件，用无损折叠、落盘、软压力、有损摘要四层管线替代一次性摘要，前三层零 LLM 成本，显著节省 token 并避免截断。
description.en: A tiered context-compaction DSH plugin that replaces one-shot summarization with lossless folding, offloading, soft pressure and budgeted summarization, cutting token cost while avoiding truncation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来可批注、可回传 AI 修订、可自行编辑的文档，每次改动生成新版本，并在侧边栏中查看。
description.en: Artifacts-like documents for DeepSeek Harness: comment on them, send comments back to the AI for a new version, edit directly, with every change saved as a version.

description.zh: Tool Guardian 作为 DSH plugin 挡在多个 MCP 服务器前，只暴露三个路由工具，把工具定义从数万 token 压到约 300，并按需拉取完整 schema。
description.en: Tool Guardian is a DSH plugin that fronts your MCP servers with just three router tools, cutting tool schemas from tens of thousands of tokens to roughly 300 and fetching full schemas on demand.

description.zh: 星愿是DeepSeek Harness的愿望与习惯养成插件，通过对话创建愿望、打卡任务、拆解微行动，并带成长体系与统计图表。
description.en: XingYuan is a DSH plugin for wishes and habit tracking, enabling conversational task creation, check-ins, micro-action breakdown, with growth system and charts.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 桌面计算机操作能力，通过统一的 computer 工具控制应用与隔离浏览器会话，支持 MCP、CLI 与技能多种接入方式。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness Windows computer-use capability through a single `computer` tool that drives desktop apps and isolated Chromium sessions, exposed via plugin, MCP, CLI, and skill integrations.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 终端界面（acryl-cli）提供原生 /files 命令，让你不用离开 TUI 就能浏览目录树、查看带行号的只读文件内容。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a native /files command to DeepSeek Harness's terminal surface (acryl-cli), letting you browse the file tree and read line-numbered files without leaving the TUI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 多智能体团队打造的像素修仙宗门大厅：持久化成员、依赖感知任务、质量门禁与十五重境界，本地优先。
description.en: A pixel cultivation hall for DeepSeek Harness multi-agent teams: durable members, dependency-aware tasks, quality gates and 15 realms, local-first.

description.zh: Agent 体检诊所：只读扫描本地 DSH 会话日志，用可逐条复核的证据诊断 token 浪费、死循环、跨会话失忆等问题并开出可执行处方。
description.en: Agent Clinic: a read-only DSH plugin that scans local session logs, diagnoses token waste, loops and cross-session amnesia with verifiable evidence, and prescribes concrete fixes.

description.zh: AnyAudio 是面向 DSH plugin 的音频制作工具包，让 Agent 用采样乐器、TTS 语音、音效与多轨混音，把声音创意直接渲染成成品音频。
description.en: AnyAudio is an audio production toolkit for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that lets agents render sampled instruments, TTS speech, sound effects and multitrack mixes into finished audio files.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 等 AI 编码代理提供可配置的 GitFlow 分支守卫，强制代理遵循集成、预览、生产、归档分支规则，保护敏感合并。
description.en: A configurable GitFlow branch-role guard for AI coding agents like DeepSeek Harness, enforcing integration, preview, production, and archive branch rules to keep sensitive merges in human hands.

description.zh: Beav Creator 将小红书/社媒AI运营带入 DeepSeek Harness，支持选题研究、文案、配图与短视频生成，并通过 DSH plugin 连接 Beav 工作区与审批流。
description.en: Beav Creator brings Xiaohongshu/social-media AI operations into DeepSeek Harness, enabling topic research, copywriting, image and short-video generation via a DSH plugin that connects to Beav workspaces and approvals.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在真实文件系统上应用 git 格式的 unified diff，支持多文件解析、模糊定位、全有或全无应用、dry-run 与反向补丁撤销。
description.en: A DSH plugin that applies git-format unified diffs to the real filesystem, with multi-file parsing, fuzzy hunk location, all-or-nothing application, dry-run, and reverse-patch undo.

description.zh: 让 Windows 上 DeepSeek Harness 仅使用 Git Bash 作为终端工具，通过 bundle patch 与派生预设彻底移除 PowerShell，并附带 bash-only 预设安装脚本。
description.en: A DSH plugin that makes Git Bash the sole terminal tool on Windows, removing PowerShell via bundle patch and derived presets, with install scripts for bash-only presets.

description.zh: Aura Vision 是 DeepSeek Harness 的免费视觉 OCR 插件，支持长文档切块识别、历史管理与多种格式导出，界面采用毛玻璃设计。
description.en: Aura Vision is a free vision OCR plugin for DeepSeek Harness, featuring tile-based long-document recognition, history management, and multi-format export with a frosted-glass UI.

description.zh: DSH plugin 对话式记账插件，通过聊天记录收支、查询、报表、导出 CSV/HTML，并支持月度预算。
description.en: A conversational bookkeeping plugin for DeepSeek Harness: record expenses/income by chat, query, report, export CSV/HTML, and set monthly budgets.

description.zh: BrowserRig 是 DSH plugin，让可信代理通过 Playwright 控制你已登录的 Chromium 浏览器，复用真实会话与扩展，无需浏览器级远程调试审批。
description.en: BrowserRig is a DSH plugin that lets trusted agents drive your signed-in Chromium browser via Playwright, reusing real sessions and extensions without browser-wide remote-debugging approval.

description.zh: Aiscribe 是一款本地优先的 DSH plugin，它从本机各 AI 工具的会话记录中采集数据，按项目分组并生成日报或周报，同时以 MCP 服务形式供任意 AI 客户端调用。
description.en: Aiscribe is a local-first DSH plugin that collects sessions from your local AI tools, groups them by project, and generates daily or weekly reports, exposed to any AI client as an MCP server.

description.zh: Canon 集成插件为 DeepSeek Harness 增加 Canon 消息渠道，支持消息收发、图片附件、审批与运行时信号，扩展 DSH 的交互界面。
description.en: Canon integration plugin adds Canon as a channel inside DeepSeek Harness, supporting messaging, image attachments, approvals, and runtime signals.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 提供只读的会话回放能力，可在原生会话头部一键进入回放，支持暂停、正放、倒放、步进与时间跳转，并通过 ctx.sessionPlayback 供脚本控制，全程不改动源会话。
description.en: Read-only session playback for the DeepSeek Harness WebUI: enter replay from the native session header, pause, play forward or reverse, step events, seek by time, and drive it from scripts via ctx.sessionPlayback without mutating the source session.

description.zh: cn-linebreak 是 DSH plugin，按《中文网页文案断行修复指南》审查并修复孤字行、禁则标点、缺 keep-all 等断行问题，自动插入 <wbr> 供人工复核。
description.en: cn-linebreak is a DSH plugin that audits and fixes Chinese line-breaking issues per the guide, inserting <wbr> at natural breaks for review.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 桌面视觉与模拟操作能力：截图识别、鼠标键盘控制，并内置自进化知识库，让纯文本模型也能操控电脑。
description.en: Adds Windows computer-use vision and simulated input to DeepSeek Harness: screenshot recognition, mouse/keyboard control, with a self-evolving knowledge base, enabling text-only LLMs to operate the computer.

description.zh: 让 Codex 把任务委派给桌面端可见的 DeepSeek Harness 工作区，跟踪执行、读取结果并持续协作，附带作用域凭证与持久会话。
description.en: Lets Codex delegate tasks to desktop-visible DeepSeek Harness workspaces, follow execution, read results and keep collaborating, with scoped credentials and persistent sessions.

description.zh: Convoport 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 插件，自动捕获 DeepSeek 网页对话并本地存储，支持按消息导入为工作区会话，统计节省的 token 数。
description.en: Convoport is a DSH plugin that auto-captures DeepSeek web conversations, stores them locally, imports selected messages as workspace sessions, and tracks token savings.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供机器级定时任务能力，在 Web 设置页配置 cron 表达式，到点由宿主内部驱动自动触发专用会话执行，实现脱手运行。
description.en: A DSH plugin for machine-level cron jobs: configure cron expressions in the web settings page, and the host internally triggers a dedicated session to execute tasks automatically.

description.zh: DACW 是 DSH 插件，用写手、确定性运行机与独立审查者三权分立地写测审代码，最终停在人工闸门，绝不自动合入。
description.en: DACW is a DSH plugin that splits coding into a writer, a deterministic runner and an independent reviewer, always stopping at a human gate before any merge.

description.zh: 把 Cursor 注册为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的 cursor 模型提供方，DSH 保留 agent 循环、工具与权限，Cursor 仅当模型。
description.en: Registers Cursor as the `cursor` LLM provider in DeepSeek Harness (DSH), letting DSH keep the agent loop, tools and permissions while Cursor serves only as the model.

description.zh: DASH 是 DeepSeek Harness 的终端原生前端，作为 DSH plugin 提供全屏 TUI、多模型切换、回滚分叉与技能支持，让 agent 在 shell 中流畅运行。
description.en: DASH is a terminal-native front door for DeepSeek Harness, installed as a DSH plugin, offering full-screen TUI, multi-model switching, rollback forking, and skill support.

description.zh: DeepJIT 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 JIT 编译器插件，自动挖掘重复的 Agent 工作流，编译为可复用的技能与流程模板，无需重启即可热加载。
description.en: DeepJIT is a JIT compiler plugin for DeepSeek Harness that mines recurring agent workflows and compiles them into reusable skills and flow templates, hot-reloading without restart.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供持久化、可配置的定时任务（cron jobs），每次触发在指定工作区启动全新 Agent，支持模型路由、预设与超时控制。
description.en: A DSH plugin for durable, configurable cron jobs that launch fresh Harness Agents in selected workspaces with explicit model routes, presets, and timeouts.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 顶部余额横幅插件，在页面右上角同时显示 USD/CNY 余额，支持负值高亮、60 秒自动刷新及扣款/充值动画。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows a top banner with USD/CNY balance, negative balance highlighting, 60s auto-refresh, and spend/recharge animations.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 官方上下文压缩的可视化配置插件，在 Web 设置页以百分比或绝对 Tokens 调整压缩阈值与保留量，并实时预览。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing visual configuration for official context compaction, letting you set thresholds and retention in percentage or absolute tokens with live preview.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供余额与用量监控的 DSH plugin，在右下角悬浮窗显示账户余额，并提醒高峰/低谷时段价格。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that monitors balance and usage in a floating bottom-right widget, with peak/off-peak price reminders.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供右侧可折叠的文件管理面板，列出、复制并清理 Files API 上传的图片，密钥零暴露，一条命令即可安装。
description.en: A collapsible right-side panel for DeepSeek Harness to list, copy, and clean up images uploaded via the Files API, with zero key exposure and one-command install.

description.zh: Harness Insights 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 非官方插件，在设置页新增本地优先的用量洞察面板，展示 token 活动、模型用量、活跃会话、缓存命中率与常用工具。
description.en: Harness Insights is an unofficial DSH plugin that adds a local-first usage insights page under settings, showing token activity, model usage, active sessions, cache hit rate, and top tools.

description.zh: DeepSee 为 DeepSeek Harness 注入视觉与智能模型路由，让 Gemini 看图、DeepSeek 写码，支持自动与自定义分工、多密钥轮换及交付前视觉检查。
description.en: DeepSee adds vision and smart model routing to DeepSeek Harness: Gemini sees, DeepSeek codes, with Auto/Customize orchestration, multi-key rotation, and pre-delivery visual checks.

description.zh: 将 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 订阅作为 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM 提供商，支持设备码 OAuth 登录、自动刷新令牌与用量限额展示。
description.en: Use your ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscription as an LLM provider in DeepSeek Harness, with device-code OAuth login, auto token refresh, and usage limits display.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 定制的桌宠皮肤包，让标志性大鲸鱼在 Web UI 角落游动，随 Agent 状态实时反应，支持拖拽与多皮肤切换。
description.en: A desktop pet skin pack for DeepSeek Harness, featuring the iconic whale that swims in the Web UI corner and reacts to agent states, with drag and multi-skin support.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话分屏插件，在 Web GUI 中实现 iTerm 风格的多窗格会话管理，支持嵌套分割、拖拽调整与多工作区混排。
description.en: An iTerm-style session multiplexer for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, enabling nested splits, drag-resize, and mixed workspaces in one layout.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在设置页提供全机 token 用量统计：总量、GitHub 风格贡献热力图、连续天数与按模型细分，只读本地会话日志，不估算费用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a Token page in Settings with machine-wide token usage: totals, a GitHub-style contribution heatmap, streaks, and per-model breakdown, folding local session logs read-only with no cost estimates.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 编码会话提供工作区快照与回滚，每轮自动保存，可随时恢复到任意历史状态，且不触碰你的 git 仓库。
description.en: A DSH plugin that snapshots your workspace every turn and restores files to any earlier point in DeepSeek Harness coding sessions, without touching your git repo.

description.zh: 「01门」是装进 DeepSeek Harness 的部门交互面板插件，提供行业 AI 工作台、班组长看板、执行卡与钉钉桥，连接底座即可用。
description.en: Gate-01 is a DSH plugin that adds department interaction panels to DeepSeek Harness — industry AI workbench, team-lead dashboards, execution cards and a DingTalk bridge.

description.zh: DSH 主题管理插件，在设置中提供主题分类，内置森林绿/海洋蓝两套主题，支持上传自定义 JS 主题并一键切换，数据持久化到磁盘。
description.en: A DSH plugin for theme management, offering a theme category in settings with built-in Forest Green and Ocean Blue themes, plus custom JS theme upload and one-click switching with disk persistence.

description.zh: DSH plugin 终端聊天界面，让 DeepSeek Harness 在终端里与智能体持续对话，交互与官方 web 客户端对齐，无需浏览器。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing a terminal chat UI for DeepSeek Harness, enabling continuous agent conversations in the terminal with web-aligned interactions, no browser needed.

description.zh: DLT 是 DeepSeek Harness 的常驻插件，实时显示每轮人民币成本与账户余额，并让模型直接读写 PDF/Word/Excel/CSV，附带右栏预览、环境表与直接编译执行工具。
description.en: DLT is a permanent DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that shows per-turn CNY cost and account balance, lets the model read and write PDF/Word/Excel/CSV directly, and adds right-sidebar previews, an environment registry and direct run/build tools.

description.zh: DragView 是 DSH plugin，支持拖拽本地文件进聊天界面，按配置复制进工作区或解析真实路径，渲染 Codex 风格附件卡片并安全预览，不暴露路径给用户。
description.en: DragView is a DSH plugin for drag-and-drop file attachments with secure in-app previews, copying files into workspace or resolving real paths, rendering Codex-style attachment cards without exposing paths to users.

description.zh: 深知可信办公全家桶 DSH 插件包，聚合咨询、搜索、PPT、公文写作四个 Skill，统一走 MCP 转接，提供可信溯源与本地编译交付。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle aggregating four trusted office skills (consulting, search, PPT, official-doc writing), unified via MCP adapter with credible sourcing and local compilation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在会话头部常驻 DeepSeek 余额徽章，支持余额明细、用量统计、历史回填与官方充值浮窗，并自动刷新与低余额预警。
description.en: A DSH plugin that embeds a persistent DeepSeek balance badge in the session header, with balance details, usage stats, history backfill, and a recharge popup, plus auto-refresh and low-balance alerts.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Windows 主对话每轮完成时弹出系统 toast 通知，让你在等待长回复时放心离开屏幕。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pops native Windows toast notifications when the main conversation finishes a turn, so you can look away during long replies.

description.zh: DSH plugin 内嵌 A股数据源 47 个端点，提供四大选股策略、持仓诊断与强制风控纪律，零依赖开箱即用。
description.en: A DSH plugin embedding 47 A-share data endpoints, offering four stock-picking strategies, position diagnosis, and enforced risk control, zero-dependency and ready to use.

description.zh: DSH 远程访问认证门禁插件，解决公网域名访问时 /api/* 全部 403 的问题，认证后特权接口可用，本机访问不受影响，零残留。
description.en: Remote access authentication gate for DeepSeek Harness, resolving 403 on /api/* via public domains, enabling privileged endpoints after auth, with zero residue.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供屏幕阅读器引导、语义诊断与无障碍阅读视图的 DSH 插件，帮助视障开发者独立完成核心任务。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness companion plugin offering screen-reader guidance, semantic diagnostics, and an accessible conversation reading view so disabled developers can work independently.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏加上活动铃铛：会话跑完即显示红色未读角标，一键把列表切换成按最近结束排序的活动视图，点行即可打开会话。
description.en: Adds an activity bell to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: finished sessions raise a red unread badge, and one click swaps the list to a day-grouped activity view sorted by most recent completion.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供专家顾问群：主模型可通过 ask_advisors 依次咨询多个顾问模型，自动多轮深挖并汇总结论，应对专业、高风险或不确定问题。
description.en: An expert advisor group for DeepSeek Harness: the main model calls ask_advisors to consult multiple advisor models in a sequential multi-round relay, then synthesizes a conclusion for professional, high-risk, or uncertain questions.

description.zh: 把 agent-blackbox 仪表盘装进 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏，实时监视会话、时间轴回放与跨会话成本总览，宿主进程内挂载，不额外起进程或端口。
description.en: Embeds the agent-blackbox dashboard into the DeepSeek Harness sidebar for live session monitoring, timeline replay and cross-session cost overview, mounted in-process with no extra process or port.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏换成固定 2×4 的八席智能体看板，每席显示状态、最新工具调用与推理结果，一眼看清谁在干活、谁在等你；设置里可一键切回原生侧边栏。
description.en: Replaces the DeepSeek Harness sidebar with a fixed 2×4 board of eight standing agent seats, each showing its status, latest tool call, reasoning and result, so you can see at a glance who is working and who awaits you; a settings switch restores the stock sidebar.

description.zh: dsh-agent-hub 是 DeepSeek Harness 的群聊式多智能体协作台，把多个 Agent 组织成群聊房间，由统筹大脑自主拆解、派单、验收与返工，全程可见可追溯。
description.en: dsh-agent-hub is a group-chat style multi-agent collaboration console for DeepSeek Harness, organizing agents into a room where a coordinator brain plans, dispatches, verifies and reworks tasks with full visibility.

description.zh: DSH 插件，让工具描述、模型思考与回复输出三通道语言各自可配：跟随界面语言、强制指定或关闭，以全局 runtime-context 注入，不改任何 preset。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets tool-call descriptions, model thinking, and replies each follow the GUI language, force a fixed language, or turn off, injected as a global runtime-context directive without altering presets.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自进化记忆插件，将会话压缩为可读 Markdown 记忆文件，支持用户画像、项目记忆、纠错学习与梦境整合，实现跨会话记忆进化。
description.en: Self-evolving memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness, compressing sessions into readable Markdown memory files with user profile, project memory, correction learning, and dream consolidation.

description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏以 3D 或像素办公室视图实时展示 Agent Teams 成员状态，点击人物即可查看状态并聚焦，让团队协作一目了然。
description.en: Renders your DSH Agent Teams as a 3D or pixel-art office in the native right sidebar, showing each teammate's live status and letting you click a character to inspect or focus them.

description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供回归基准：在隔离沙箱中运行固定用例，对比两次运行结果，快速定位换模型或改提示词后的能力退化。
description.en: A regression benchmark for DSH agents: run fixed cases in isolated sandboxes and diff two runs to spot capability regressions after model or prompt changes.

description.zh: DSH plugin 学习型智能路由插件：按任务类型与复杂度将请求路由到最合适的模型档位，四专家并行推荐、EXP3 元选择器决策，并依据质量代理信号计算奖励回传，策略越用越准，决策与奖励全部落盘可审计。
description.en: A DSH plugin that routes requests to the most suitable model tier based on task type and complexity, using four expert recommenders and an EXP3 meta-selector, with reward feedback for continuous learning and full audit logging.

description.zh: DSH plugin 驱动的 AI 群像聊天游戏框架，输入行动后多个 NPC 各自反应，支持场景切换、关系变化与本地存档，兼容 SillyTavern 角色卡。
description.en: A DSH plugin-powered AI ensemble chat game framework where multiple NPCs react individually to player actions, supporting scene switching, relationship changes, and local saves, compatible with SillyTavern character cards.

description.zh: 把本机已登录的 Google Antigravity CLI 接入 DeepSeek Harness 作为模型提供方，生成走官方二进制，工具执行与沙箱仍由 DSH 掌控。
description.en: Bridges your locally authenticated Google Antigravity CLI into DeepSeek Harness as a model provider, with generation signed by the official binary while tools, approvals and sandbox stay in DSH.

description.zh: AI 书架是一款 DSH plugin，在侧边栏提供多格式书籍与论文阅读器，支持划词 AI 解释、全文搜索、论文翻译与中英对照。
description.en: AI Book Shelf is a DSH plugin that adds a multi-format book and paper reader to the sidebar, with selection-based AI explanations, full-text search, paper translation and bilingual comparison.

description.zh: DSH plugin 每日 AI 资讯 Agent，自动生成日报/周报/月报，结构化覆盖 9 大板块，支持 web 搜索补充与侧边栏展示。
description.en: A DSH plugin that generates daily/weekly/monthly AI news reports with structured sections, web search enrichment, and sidebar display.

description.zh: 为 DSH plugin 补上 ai-memory 的会话收尾环节：DSH 会话结束时自动执行 finalize-session，把捕获的观察整理成各 harness 都能检索的 wiki 页面。
description.en: A DSH plugin that closes ai-memory's consolidation loop: when a DSH session ends it runs finalize-session so captured observations become wiki pages every other harness can search.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话重命名对话框加 AI 生成按钮，读取真实对话与草稿，一键生成短标题填回输入框。
description.en: Adds an AI-generate button to the DeepSeek Harness session rename dialog, reading the real conversation and your draft to fill in a short title in one click.

description.zh: dsh-air 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件，支持用 ↑/↓ 切换历史发送记录，并通过 /btw 打开停靠式侧边对话，提升输入效率。
description.en: dsh-air is a DSH plugin that lets you recall past messages with ↑/↓ and open a docked side conversation via /btw, boosting input efficiency.

description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 标题栏加一枚置顶按钮，点击即可让窗口始终浮于其他窗口之上，再次点击取消，并记住上次状态。
description.en: Adds a pin button to the DSH Desktop title bar that toggles always-on-top for the window and remembers the state across launches.

description.zh: DSH plugin 安全护栏，拦截粘贴给 Agent 的 API 密钥、追踪泄露事件、拦截密钥写入，并提供首次工作区安全体检。
description.en: A safety belt for DeepSeek Harness that blocks API keys pasted to the agent, tracks leak events, blocks secret writes, and offers a first-run workspace health scan.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让消息状态栏（日期/时间、用时/首 token/tok/s）无需悬停即常驻显示，零配置、安装即生效，卸载后完全恢复原生行为。
description.en: A DSH plugin that keeps message status bars (date/time, duration/first-token/tok/s) always visible without hover, zero-config, install-and-go, and fully restores native behavior on uninstall.

description.zh: dsh-analytics 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent FinOps 插件，将会话 token 用量存入本地 SQLite 账本，按时段定价表核算成本，并通过服务、工具与 JSON API 查询。
description.en: dsh-analytics is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for Agent FinOps: it records session token usage into a local SQLite ledger, prices it with a time-aware pricing table, and exposes queries via a service, an agent tool, and JSON API routes.

description.zh: DSH Web 会话锚点导轨插件，在会话左侧固定导轨展示全部用户问题锚点，悬浮显示名称、点击快速跳转，压缩段自动聚合，长会话定位历史问题更高效。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a session anchor rail on the left side of the chat, showing all user question anchors with hover names and quick jump, aggregating compressed segments for efficient navigation in long sessions.

description.zh: dsh-anywhere 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，可将任意机器（含 NAT 后）纳入工作区，通过 SSH 远程执行文件与命令，实现远程开发。
description.en: dsh-anywhere is a DSH plugin that brings any machine (even behind NAT) into your workspace, enabling remote file and command execution over SSH.

description.zh: Anvil 是 DeepSeek Harness 的输入框增强 DSH 插件，提供一键润色草稿、预测下一句，以及挡位式模型与推理等级选择。
description.en: Anvil is a DSH plugin that enhances the DeepSeek Harness input box with one-click prompt polishing, next-sentence prediction, and a dial-style model and reasoning-level selector.

description.zh: DSH plugin，通过WebSocket连接同一局域网的Android手机，在dsh-web面板或Agent中实现打开应用、点击、滑动、输入、按键、截图及UI树操作，用于移动应用测试。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects to an Android phone over WebSocket on the same LAN, enabling app launch, tap, swipe, text input, key events, screenshots, and UI tree operations from the dsh-web panel or agents for mobile app testing.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Postman 级 API 调试界面与 Agent 原生 HTTP 工具，支持 Postman Collection 导入，人机共用同一请求执行与审计体系。
description.en: A DSH plugin bringing a Postman-grade API debugging UI plus agent-native HTTP tools to DeepSeek Harness, with Postman Collection import and a shared request executor.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地 HTTP API，让其他 AI 代理通过官方 ApiProxy 路由控制 DSH 会话，支持会话管理、发送提示、流式回复等。
description.en: Local HTTP API for DeepSeek Harness, enabling other AI agents to control DSH sessions via official ApiProxy routes, with session management, prompt sending, and streaming replies.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏集中管理本机 API 服务商与技能，查看余额、测试连通并自动注册为 DSH 模型路由。
description.en: Manage local API providers and skills from a DeepSeek Harness sidebar panel: check balances, test connectivity, and auto-register them as DSH model routes.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏启动本地 root 版 AOSP 虚拟机，安装并预览 Android APK，以最高 60 fps 串流画面，支持点击注入与 Agent 自动化调试。
description.en: Boots a local rooted AOSP VM inside DeepSeek Harness to install and preview Android APKs, streaming the display at up to 60 fps with input injection and Agent-driven UI automation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 DSH Web GUI 变成桌面应用，以独立窗口打开，关闭窗口即优雅退出整个 DSH 进程，并支持桌面快捷方式与窗口状态记忆。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns the DSH Web GUI into a desktop app, opening it in a dedicated window and gracefully exiting the DSH process when the window is closed, with desktop shortcut and window state memory.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面提供统一外观设置页，集中管理主题预设、字体字号、会话流密度与液态玻璃效果。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a unified Appearance settings page for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, managing theme presets, fonts, session density and liquid glass.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自动审批沙箱升级请求，用无工具的审查代理生成结构化 allow/deny，替代人工弹窗，适用于无人值守的自动化审批流程。
description.en: A DSH plugin that automatically reviews sandbox escalation requests, replacing interactive prompts with a tool-less reviewer producing structured allow/deny decisions for unattended automation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 的上下文治理插件，在接近输入容量时执行模型驱动、本地可逆的压缩，信息永不丢失，卸载零残留。
description.en: A DSH plugin for context governance, performing model-driven, locally reversible compression near input capacity, ensuring no information loss and clean uninstall.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上归档会话管理中心，可按日期、工作区筛选历史会话，批量取消归档，并用可撤销策略自动清理会话列表。
description.en: Adds an archived-session management center to DeepSeek Harness: browse archived sessions by date or workspace, unarchive in bulk, and run a reversible auto-cleanup policy.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 对话补上收藏、复制 ID+路径、单条删除、超时批量归档与收藏筛选，全部挂在官方插槽上，不改官方文件。
description.en: Adds favourites, copy id+path, per-conversation delete, idle batch archive and a favourites filter to DeepSeek Harness conversations, all via official slots without touching any shipped file.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上归档会话管理中心，可按日期、工作区筛选历史会话，批量取消归档，并用可撤销策略自动清理会话列表。
description.en: Adds an archived-session management center to DeepSeek Harness: browse archived sessions by date or workspace, unarchive in bulk, and run a reversible auto-cleanup policy.

description.zh: DSH plugin 归档会话管理工具：在设置面板查看、恢复、永久删除归档会话，支持按归档时长批量清理，并提供 agent 工具。
description.en: A DSH plugin for managing archived sessions: view, restore, and permanently delete archived conversations from the settings panel, with bulk cleanup by archive age and agent tools.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Web 界面以可拖拽挂件展示火山方舟各模型免费资源包余量，支持筛选、排序与低余量提醒。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows Ark free-quota balances in a draggable widget, with filtering, sorting, and low-balance alerts.

description.zh: DSH plugin 产物浏览器：为 DeepSeek Harness 会话添加产物侧边栏与收藏功能，支持预览 HTML、Markdown、图片、JSON 及源代码。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds an artifact sidebar and bookmarking to DeepSeek Harness conversations, with previews for HTML, Markdown, images, JSON, and source code.

description.zh: DSH 插件，在聊天中展示产物文件卡片，并支持分屏侧边预览 Markdown、代码、CSV、JSON、图片与 HTML。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows produced-file chips in chat and a split-screen side preview for Markdown, code, CSV, JSON, images, and HTML.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 App Store Connect 的 DSH plugin，用自然语言完成 TestFlight 发布、发布就绪检查、反馈分诊与合规审计，写操作先出计划再审批执行。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings App Store Connect into DeepSeek Harness: ship to TestFlight, check release readiness, triage feedback and audit compliance in plain language, with plan-then-approve writes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框加一个「说清楚点」按钮：先复述理解、用可点选项问清需求，再把模糊草稿重写成可执行请求，且绝不代发。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a "Say it clearer" button to the DeepSeek Harness composer: it restates what you meant, asks clickable clarifying questions, then rewrites your vague draft into an actionable request — and never sends it.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 ask-user 提问变为多端竞答路由，一次提问同时弹给所有认领会话的交互面，先答先得，落选端自动收起。
description.en: DSH plugin that routes ask-user questions to multiple surfaces, first answer wins, others auto-dismiss.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上语音能力：聊天框麦克风按钮语音输入转文字，支持智谱、本地 faster-whisper、Gemini、OpenAI 四引擎转写。
description.en: Audio Copilot adds voice input to DeepSeek Harness: a mic button in the composer transcribes speech to text via Zhipu, local faster-whisper, Gemini, or OpenAI engines.

description.zh: DSH 用户授权插件，为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 添加密码、OAuth 2.0 及 Solana/EVM 钱包登录，零依赖核心，纯配置接入。
description.en: DSH auth plugin adding password, OAuth 2.0, and Solana/EVM wallet login to DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with zero-dependency core and pure config integration.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加 auto 权限预设，自动分类工具调用：危险操作执行前拦截，安全操作放行，沙箱升级由分类器决策，无需人工审批。
description.en: Adds an auto permission preset to DeepSeek Harness that classifies tool calls automatically: dangerous operations are blocked before execution, safe ones flow, and sandbox escalations are decided by the classifier without human approval.

description.zh: DSH plugin：关闭Web UI页面后自动以等效Ctrl+C退出CLI进程，免去手动操作。
description.en: DSH plugin: automatically exits the CLI process (equivalent to Ctrl+C) when the Web UI closes, saving manual steps.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自动模式：通过 LLM 审查工具调用，自动批准、阻止或请求确认，减少人工干预。
description.en: DSH plugin auto mode: routes permission-gated tool calls through an LLM review to auto-approve, block, or ask for confirmation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自动模型路由插件，按 L0–L3 四级能力将每次输入路由到最优模型，支持启发式锁定、固定级别与全自动模式，并带成本控制与失败回退。
description.en: A DSH plugin that routes each input to the best model via L0–L3 tiers, with heuristic lock, fixed-level, and fully-auto modes, plus cost control and fallback.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供任务中心：按 cron、间隔或 Webhook 触发任务，自动投递到新会话或已有会话，并附带任务管理 agent preset。
description.en: A Task Center DSH plugin that runs scheduled or webhook-triggered tasks and delivers them into new or existing sessions, with a task-management agent preset.

description.zh: DSH 插件按轮次自动调整推理强度：由 Jev 判定 simple/standard/complex/escalated，只改 effort 不换模型，并支持子代理路由。
description.en: A DSH plugin that auto-tunes reasoning effort per turn: Jev judges simple/standard/complex/escalated, changing only effort — never the model — with subagent routing.

description.zh: DSH 双面插件，在会话区提供消息锻造台：将上下文解析为可编辑卡片，支持动态修改并应用到会话，同时可导入修复 sessionlog。
description.en: A dual-sided DSH plugin adding a message forge tab to sessions: parses context into editable cards, applies edits to live sessions, and imports/repairs session logs.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 web 启动后自动打开独立应用窗口或网页标签页，内置 WebView2 宿主实现轻量桌面化，并支持配置窗口类型与浏览器路径。
description.en: A DSH plugin that auto-opens a standalone app window or browser tab after web startup, featuring a built-in WebView2 host for a lightweight desktop experience, with configurable window type and browser path.

description.zh: DSH plugin：每次启动自动检查已启用插件的新版本，列出并询问是否更新，确认后走官方通道升级。
description.en: A DSH plugin that checks enabled plugins for new versions at every launch, lists them, and updates only after you confirm via the official channel.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为不支持图片输入的模型桥接视觉能力，自动识别粘贴的截图并以折叠上下文条目写入会话，原始消息保持原样，零手动配置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that bridges vision for non-vision models, auto-recognizing pasted screenshots into collapsible context entries while keeping your original message untouched, with zero manual setup.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为不支持图片输入的模型桥接视觉能力，自动识别粘贴的截图并以折叠上下文条目写入会话，原始消息保持原样，零手动配置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that bridges vision for non-vision models, auto-recognizing pasted screenshots into collapsible context entries while keeping your original message untouched, with zero manual setup.

description.zh: AutoCompose 是 DeepSeek Harness 的任务感知插件组装器：描述任务即自动搜索、核验并安装匹配的 DSH 插件，可打开独立客户端继续对话或装入主环境。
description.en: AutoCompose is a task-aware plugin composer for DeepSeek Harness: describe a task and it searches, verifies and installs matching DSH plugins, then opens an isolated client for follow-up chat or installs them into the main profile.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自动备份会话、配置与自定义目录，支持定时或手动打包为 zip 并自动轮换，保障数据安全。
description.en: A DSH plugin that automates backups of sessions, config and custom directories, packing them into zip archives with scheduled or manual runs and rotation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 加上《蔚蓝档案》风格的鼠标点击特效与光标拖尾，左侧边栏竖排入口打开弹窗设置，十项参数实时生效并自动保存。
description.en: Adds Blue Archive style click effects and cursor trails to DeepSeek Harness, with a vertical sidebar entry opening a dialog of ten live, auto-saved settings.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框下方常驻显示当前模型供应商余额，切换供应商时自动重读并隔离各钱包消耗。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows the current model provider's balance beneath the composer in DeepSeek Harness, re-reading it on provider switch and keeping per-wallet usage isolated.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 预置阿里百炼（DashScope）模型目录，内置 36 个文本模型的上下文窗口、输出上限与分族推理强度适配，并自动补全已有百炼路由的方言与容量声明。
description.en: A DSH plugin that presets the Alibaba Bailian (DashScope) model catalog for DeepSeek Harness — 36 text models with context windows, output limits and per-family reasoning-effort adaptation, plus auto-completion of existing Bailian routes.

description.zh: 把 ponytail 极简编码规则集装进 DeepSeek Harness，用 7 级懒人阶梯与 6 个技能让 agent 少写代码、砍掉过度工程，并支持 /ponytail 会话调档。
description.en: Packs the ponytail minimal-code ruleset into DeepSeek Harness: a 7-rung lazy ladder plus six skills that keep the agent from over-engineering, with /ponytail session-level mode switching.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web Composer 提供保留原文的 Markdown 实时呈现、长粘贴转引用芯片与本地补全诊断，不改动 DSH Core 的源码与提交逻辑。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds source-preserving Markdown presentation, paste-to-clip chips, and local completion diagnostics to the DSH Web Composer without taking over Core source or submission.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏实时展示 DeepSeek、Kimi、智谱与 TeamoRouter 的余额与用量，支持按会话自动刷新与插件内更新。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM and TeamoRouter balances and usage in the DSH Web sidebar, with per-session auto refresh and in-plugin updates.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可自由改绑的快捷键管理器：后设组合覆盖先设并告知被顶替者，连发送、换行、互补三键也能重绑。
description.en: A rebindable keyboard-shortcut manager for DeepSeek Harness: later assignments override earlier ones with displacement notices, and even the send, newline and complementary keys can be remapped.

description.zh: DSH 插件，在 better-sidebar 中通过自托管 ONLYOFFICE 文档服务器在线编辑 .docx/.xlsx/.pptx，支持 JWT 签名、原子保存与 AI 编辑实时刷新。
description.en: A DSH plugin that opens and edits .docx/.xlsx/.pptx in the better-sidebar via a self-hosted ONLYOFFICE Document Server, with JWT-signed configs, atomic save-back, and live refresh on AI edits.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框下方提供实时余额读数：用本机 token 消耗推算 API 余额与可用时长，按峰谷分档计价并自动校准。
description.en: A live balance readout for DeepSeek Harness: it projects your API balance and time-to-empty from this machine's own token usage, priced by peak/off-peak tiers with self-calibration.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 顶栏会话标题换成「工作区 / 会话」面包屑，并在顶栏直接切换工作区与会话，纯 UI 增强的 DSH plugin。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns the DeepSeek Harness session topbar title into a workspace/session breadcrumb, letting you switch workspaces and sessions right from the topbar.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供增强统计条：官方 CNY 定价、分模型计费、实时计时器、余额与预算提醒，并支持流式成本估算。
description.en: A richer stats strip for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: official CNY pricing, per-model accounting, live timers, balance and budget alerts, plus streaming cost estimation.

description.zh: DSH 工作台插件，把常用页面与应用 Pin 在侧边栏工作台，提供持久实例、模板与 page/panel/capsule 展示宿主。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pins your favorite pages and apps into a permanent Workbench home, with durable instances, templates, and page/panel/capsule hosts.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 B站直播间：读取实时弹幕、经人工放行后发弹幕，并可选 AI 自动陪聊与语音转写。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects DeepSeek Harness to Bilibili live rooms: read real-time danmaku, send messages after human approval, with optional AI auto-chat and speech transcription.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供计费时段与账户余额徽章，在统计行显示峰谷状态与切换倒计时，点击可查看余额明细。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a billing-season and account-balance pill to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, showing peak/off-peak status with a countdown and a click-through balance panel.

description.zh: DSH plugin 峰谷计费工具，实时统计 token 用量并按 DeepSeek 官方定价计算费用，生成鲸鱼 ASCII 账单小票，在 TUI 状态行显示费用。
description.en: A DSH plugin for peak/off-peak billing, tracking token usage in real time, calculating costs per DeepSeek pricing, and printing whale ASCII receipts with a TUI status line.

description.zh: 为 DSH 开屏动画插件补上视频播放列表管理面板，在设置里添加、排序、勾选与回收开屏视频，支持顺序、随机、单次三种播放方式。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a boot video playlist panel to the boot animation plugin, letting you add, reorder, toggle and recycle startup videos with sequential, random or single playback.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面换上自家品牌（Logo、名称、中央标题、favicon），并给页面与项目文件夹打上「为什么加 · 在干什么」水印。
description.en: Rebrands the DSH web client with your own logo, name, hero title and favicon, and stamps tunable "why added / what job" watermarks on pages and project folders.

description.zh: DSH 浏览器桥插件，让模型直接读取并操作你正在使用的 Chrome 标签页，完成点击、填表、导航等任务，同时保留登录态与 Cookie。
description.en: A DSH plugin that bridges to your own Chrome tabs, letting the model read pages and click, type, and navigate while keeping your logins and cookies intact.

description.zh: 面向 Boss 直聘求职者侧的 DSH plugin：用可见浏览器逐条浏览岗位，为每条 JD 生成专属自我介绍并经文案护栏校验后发给 HR。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for Boss Zhipin job seekers: it browses postings in a visible browser, writes a tailored self-introduction for each JD, and sends it to the HR after guardrail checks.

description.zh: dsh-branchman 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来树状工程走向：一次分叉同时创建 git worktree、继承历史的子会话与可见树边，让多条方案各自独立演进、随时合并或拆除。
description.en: dsh-branchman gives DeepSeek Harness tree-branching engineering directions: one fork action creates a git worktree, a child session inheriting the conversation, and a visible tree edge, so parallel approaches evolve independently and can be merged or dropped anytime.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 底部加一条我的世界像素风骑行带，戴头盔的像素小鸡骑车，带昼夜循环、按铃跳跃与骑行统计。
description.en: A DSH plugin that docks a Minecraft-style pixel strip at the bottom of the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, where a helmeted pixel chicken rides a bicycle with day/night cycle, bell, jumps and ride stats.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 Agent 提供真实 Chrome 浏览器，含十五个浏览器工具、六个免密钥网络搜索工具，并在 DSH Web GUI 中嵌入实时可交互的浏览器面板。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives agents a real Chrome browser with fifteen browser tools, six no-key net search tools, and a live interactive browser pane inside the DSH Web GUI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供内置真实浏览器能力，让 AI 在本机自主打开网页、读取内容、点击输入并截图回传对话，游客隔离模式运行。
description.en: A built-in browser plugin for DeepSeek Harness that lets the AI drive a real local browser — navigate, read, click, type and post screenshots back into the chat, all in an isolated guest profile.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 /btw 侧边问答浮窗，输入框上方即时弹出答案，不打断也不污染主 Agent 循环。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness side-assistant dock that answers /btw quick questions in a floating banner above the composer without interrupting or polluting the main agent loop.

description.zh: BrowserPilot 的 DSH 插件，为 Agent 提供受权限策略控制的本机 Chrome 浏览能力，并集成管理后台入口与连接诊断。
description.en: A DSH plugin for BrowserPilot that gives agents policy-controlled local Chrome browsing, with admin panel access and connection diagnostics.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 /btw 侧边问答浮窗，输入框上方即时弹出答案，不打断也不污染主 Agent 循环。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness side-assistant dock that answers /btw quick questions in a floating banner above the composer without interrupting or polluting the main agent loop.

description.zh: DSH plugin guard 在每次插件加载时捕获重复的 loader entry id，防止启动崩溃，并审计整个插件环境。
description.en: DSH plugin guard catches duplicate loader entry ids on every plugin load, preventing boot crashes, and audits the whole plugin environment.

description.zh: DSH plugin 运行时挂载管理器，通过 Loader API 即时挂载/卸载第三方插件包，无需重启且不修改配置文件，支持命名预设与自愈回退。
description.en: Runtime mount manager for DSH plugin bundles, mounting/unmounting third-party plugins in-process via the Loader API with no restart, named presets, and self-healing fallback.

description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供只读的DWG/DXF工具，可检查、提取并导出CAD图纸，支持SVG/PNG预览和DWG转DXF，不修改源文件。
description.en: Read-only DWG/DXF tools for DeepSeek Harness: inspect, extract and export CAD drawings with SVG/PNG previews and DWG-to-DXF conversion, without modifying the source file.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 底部统计行与 Token 用量弹窗中的缓存命中率原位精化到三位小数，不新增界面元素，也不改变布局与其余读数。
description.en: A DSH plugin that refines the cache-hit readout in the DeepSeek Harness Web composer stats row and token-usage popup to three decimals in place, without adding UI or changing layout.

description.zh: dsh-calendar 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供全局会话日历视图，聚合所有会话的交互事件，实时展示每日活跃会话、时长与事件列表。
description.en: dsh-calendar provides a whole-harness calendar surface for DeepSeek Harness, aggregating interaction events from all sessions with real-time updates and per-day session details.

description.zh: 把 CalibGuard 文件安全审计接入 DeepSeek Harness：本地 CodeBERT 门控给出恶意概率，灰区才上云复核，AI 工具与侧边栏面板均可审计文件。
description.en: Brings CalibGuard file security auditing into DeepSeek Harness: a local CodeBERT gate scores malware probability, cloud review only for gray-zone files, usable via agent tools and a sidebar panel.

description.zh: dsh-camel 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，针对免费模型限流（RATE_LIMIT）提供自适应速率控制、可见重试与配额感知恢复，避免任务被频繁限流中断。
description.en: dsh-camel is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for free-model rate-limit recovery, offering adaptive pacing, visible retries, and quota-aware recovery to keep tasks alive.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通过 headless 调用 Claude Code CLI，以顾问/评审/设计师等角色人设提供外部专家咨询，回复作为参考答案供 Agent 权衡，支持推理等级、模型回退与并行会诊。
description.en: A DSH plugin that headlessly invokes the Claude Code CLI with role personas (advisor/reviewer/designer) to provide external expert consultation, returning reference answers for the agent to weigh, with thinking effort, model fallback, and parallel panel support.

description.zh: 让 DSH 通过 CDP 直接驱动你本机已登录的 Chromium 浏览器，常驻连接只需授权一次，零新增工具 schema、零运行时依赖。
description.en: A DSH plugin that drives the Chromium browser you already use over CDP — one long-lived connection approved once, no new tool schemas, no runtime dependencies.

description.zh: DSH 插件：在 Web 侧边栏实时查看并操控外部 Chromium 浏览器，通过 CDP 像素流与受限交互实现远程可视化。
description.en: A DSH plugin that provides a live CDP view of an external Chromium browser in the sidebar, with pixel streaming and controlled interaction.
