description.zh: dsh-change-budget 为 DeepSeek Harness 的每个 Agent 轮次设置文件修改预算，限制文件数、调用次数与 UTF-8 字节数，防止 AI 编码代理失控改写。
description.en: dsh-change-budget gives every DeepSeek Harness Agent turn a configurable budget for file mutations, limiting files, calls, and UTF-8 bytes to prevent runaway edits.

description.zh: DSH 渠道会话视图插件，在侧边栏注入 Channels 标签页，按渠道分组会话，支持归档折叠与运行状态指示。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects a Channels tab into the sidebar, grouping sessions by channel with archived folding and running indicators.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自动重试失败的第三方 API 请求，支持自定义状态码与错误码，让对话不因限流或服务不可用而中断。
description.en: A DSH plugin that auto-retries failed third-party API requests with configurable status/error codes, keeping conversations uninterrupted.

description.zh: 为 DSH 每个会话注入可切换的角色卡，定义人设、语气、代码风格与硬性约束，支持默认值、会话级覆盖和可视化编辑。
description.en: Switchable character cards for DSH sessions that inject persona, tone, code style and hard constraints per conversation, with defaults, per-session overrides and a visual editor.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将对话中的运行时信息折叠为可展开框，文本回复以聊天气泡呈现，并提供高度自定义的外观设置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that folds runtime activity into expandable boxes, renders replies as chat bubbles, and offers deep customization.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供 ChatGPT 风格的会话历史导航栏，通过侧边条快速跳转到任意用户消息，并支持滚动同步与点击锁定。
description.en: A ChatGPT-style conversation-history rail for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, enabling quick jumps to any user message with scroll sync and click-lock.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 的对话定位条提供可调设置：横线粗细、轨道左右位置、悬停预览行数、字号与宽度，并带曲线长度渐变，让长会话中快速定位某一轮对话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that makes the DSH Web turn rail configurable: tick thickness, rail side, hover preview lines, font size and width, plus a curved length gradient for fast turn location in long sessions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供实时 token 成本统计：按内置多厂商价目表为每个会话、子代理及整棵会话树计价，并写入项目内 JSONL 成本日志。
description.en: Live token cost tracking for DeepSeek Harness: prices every chat, its subagents and the whole session tree from a bundled multi-provider catalog, and appends a JSONL cost log in your project folder.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供每会话提问索引：右侧时间比例圆点窄条加可展开链面板，含分支子会话节点，点击即可跳转并高亮对应提问。
description.en: A per-session question index for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a time-proportional dot rail plus an expandable chain panel covering branch and subagent sessions, with click-to-jump and highlight.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的单个对话提供独立设置：专属系统提示词、按轮数折叠上下文、采样参数覆盖与低 token 纯聊天模式，且不改动全局配置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives each conversation its own system prompt, turn-based context folding, sampling overrides and a low-token pure chat mode, all without touching global settings.

description.zh: dsh-chat-log 是一款 DSH plugin，将原始会话日志中的流式碎片折叠成完整消息，生成干净的聊天记录，并支持 /chat 命令与浏览器下载。
description.en: dsh-chat-log is a DSH plugin that folds streaming chunk fragments into complete messages, producing clean chat logs with /chat command and browser download support.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 对话区提供右键菜单的 DSH plugin，可复制文本与图片、打开文件、在文件管理器中定位，并按会话工作目录解析相对路径。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a right-click menu to DeepSeek Harness conversations, letting you copy text and images, open files, and reveal them in the file manager, with relative paths resolved against the session working directory.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话添加右侧时间线导航轨，悬停即预览问答摘要，一键钉住面板，按天分组并支持重点书签。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding a right-side timeline rail to DeepSeek Harness sessions, with hover Q&A preview, pinnable panel, day grouping, and starred bookmarks.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话消息分享能力：通过 /share 命令或侧边栏菜单，把选定范围的聊天导出为 Markdown、HTML 或纯文本，支持脱敏与图片内嵌。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that shares selected chat messages as Markdown, HTML, or plain text via the /share command or sidebar menu, with redaction and embedded session images.

description.zh: 为 DSH 对话流提供一页排版设置：统一字号、三种角色字体、行距网格与左右留白，让对话阅读更整齐舒适。
description.en: Adds a typography settings page to the DSH chat flow: unified font size, per-role font families, a single line-height grid, and side gutters for cleaner reading.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供版本检查与安全升级：首次打开自动比对 npm 最新版，弹窗一键安排分离式更新，并校验 koffi 完整性。
description.en: Version checking and safe upgrades for DeepSeek Harness: auto-checks the latest npm release on first open, schedules a detached two-stage update from a popup, and verifies koffi integrity.

description.zh: ChatCanvas 是 DeepSeek Harness 的对话画布插件，把富文本消息、可编辑画布、交互 UI 预览、数学绘图与音乐编辑直接搬进对话，让 AI 回复变成可动手修改的工作区。
description.en: ChatCanvas is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns conversations into an editable workspace with rich messages, canvases, interactive UI previews, math plots and music editing.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 会话页新增「诗词」标签页，免 token 搜索 37 万首古典诗词，支持筛选、飞花令、每日一首、收藏与 AI 解读。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a Poetry tab to DeepSeek Harness Web, offering token-free search across 370k classical Chinese poems with filters, Feihua, daily poem, favorites and AI explanation.

description.zh: 为 DSH web 提供本地知识库与记忆开关：在输入框工具行加两个控件、设置页加两个面板，通过 22 条 /dsh/kb/* 路由调度本机「我的知识库」工具链。
description.en: A local knowledge-base and memory switch for DSH web: two composer controls and two settings pages, backed by 22 /dsh/kb/* routes that orchestrate the local 我的知识库 toolchain.

description.zh: dsh-cinematic-workflow 是一个本地优先、人工把关的影视剪辑工作流 DSH 插件，管理素材清单、创意方向、粗剪交付、FCPXML/Resolve 交接及质检记录，确保每个阶段由人类确认后才能推进。
description.en: dsh-cinematic-workflow is a local-first, human-gated cinematic workflow DSH plugin for managing media inventory, creative direction, rough-cut deliverables, FCPXML/Resolve handoff, and QC records, ensuring stages advance only with human approval.

description.zh: dsh-ci-co-pilot 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 GitHub CI 协作能力：审查 PR、修复 CI 失败、分类 issue 并生成发布说明，全部以插件形式实现。
description.en: dsh-ci-co-pilot turns DeepSeek Harness into a GitHub co-pilot for PR review, CI failure fixing, issue triage, and release notes — all as plugins.

description.zh: DSH 更新检查器，在设置页对比 DSH 本体与各插件版本，有新版时导航红点提醒，并给出更新命令。
description.en: DSH update checker that compares versions of DSH core and plugins in settings, shows red dot on nav when updates available, and provides update commands.

description.zh: DSH plugin 引注插件，支持圈选前文加批注、@ 历史会话作只读证据，并将本轮生成的文件钉在回复下方，提升会话追溯与复用效率。
description.en: A DSH plugin for citing: annotate selected text, @-mention past sessions as read-only evidence, and pin generated files under replies.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自包含规则分流代理，内置规则引擎与订阅解析，让 Harness 进程树国内直连、国外走节点，无需外部 Clash 客户端。
description.en: A self-contained rule-splitting proxy plugin for DeepSeek Harness, with built-in rule engine and subscription parsing, routing domestic traffic direct and international via nodes without external Clash.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 Claude Code 的 skills/rules/CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md 等配置一键导入 DeepSeek Harness，支持落点预览、冲突策略与幂等重复导入。
description.en: A DSH plugin that imports Claude Code config assets (skills/rules/CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md) into DeepSeek Harness with destination preview, conflict strategies, and idempotent re-imports.

description.zh: DSH plugin 集成 claude-mem，跨会话记忆查询、项目上下文注入、手动记忆保存与会话摘要，全部经由本地 claude-mem worker 的 HTTP API 驱动。
description.en: A DSH plugin integrating claude-mem: query cross-session memory, inject project context, save memories, and summarize sessions via a local claude-mem worker's HTTP API.

description.zh: DSH plugin 运行时装载器，让 DeepSeek Harness 直接发现并加载 Claude 式组合体插件，注册其 skills 与斜杠命令。
description.en: A DSH plugin runtime loader that lets DeepSeek Harness discover and load Claude-style composite plugins, registering their skills and slash commands.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将编码任务委托给 Claude Code 与 Codex，实时流式展示执行全程，支持自主控制、多账号隔离与 git worktree 自动合并。
description.en: A DSH plugin that delegates coding tasks to Claude Code and Codex, streaming the entire run live with autonomous control, multi-account isolation, and automatic git worktree merging.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 Claw Orchestrator 注册为 ACP 子代理提供者，让 dsh 子代理可调用多引擎委员会（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor）进行协作与规划。
description.en: A DSH plugin that registers Claw Orchestrator as an ACP subagent provider, enabling dsh subagents to delegate to a multi-engine council across Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor.

description.zh: DeepSneak 是 DeepSeek Harness 的摸鱼插件，在 agent 工作时播放 B 站视频，需要你时自动暂停提醒，处理完从原位置精确续播。
description.en: DeepSneak is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that plays Bilibili videos while the agent works, auto-pauses to alert you when needed, and resumes exactly where you left off.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框添加「继续」按钮，上一轮被中断或报错后一键让模型接着完成该轮任务。
description.en: Adds a Continue button to the DeepSeek Harness composer so an interrupted or failed turn can be resumed with one click.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 Claude 的 skills、rules、MCP 与 CLAUDE.md 自动迁移为 DeepSeek Harness 能力，按工作区隔离并内置可折叠配置看板。
description.en: A DSH plugin that migrates Claude skills, rules, MCP and CLAUDE.md into DeepSeek Harness capabilities, workspace-isolated with a collapsible dashboard.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Aqua 玻璃质感主题的 DSH plugin，支持调节模糊与磨砂、流体或壁纸背景与统一圆角，可一键切回原生界面。
description.en: A glassmorphism theme DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness with adjustable blur and frost, fluid or wallpaper backdrops and unified corners, switchable back to the stock UI.

description.zh: 把 VS Code 的 Dracula 配色搬到 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面，重指语义色令牌并顺带调优代码字体与排版，仅作用于深色模式，可整页一键还原。
description.en: Brings the VS Code Dracula palette to the DeepSeek Harness web UI by remapping semantic color tokens, with programmer-oriented typography tweaks, dark mode only and fully revertible.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供全局键盘快捷键的 DSH plugin，内置快捷键注册服务与设置面板，支持录制改键、冲突检测。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding global keyboard shortcuts to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, with a shortcut registry service and settings panel for recording and conflict detection.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 聊天输入框添加 @ 项目文件/目录建议，输入 @ 即可浏览当前项目并插入 @path 引用，让模型直接读取文件。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds @ project file/directory suggestions to the chat composer, letting you browse the current project and insert @path references for the model.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在对话输入框模型选择左侧添加 git 分支选择器，支持模糊搜索、本地/远程分组、新建分支与切换，并展示上游跟踪状态。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding a git branch selector left of the model seat in the composer, with fuzzy search, local/remote groups, branch creation and switching, plus upstream tracking status.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 Web 设置新增按工作区组织的技能管理页，支持搜索、启用/禁用用户级与项目级技能，状态持久化。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding a workspace-organized skill management page to Web Settings, with search and enable/disable toggles for user and project skills.

description.zh: 为 DSH 消息框下方统计栏添加思考 token 统计的轻量插件，展示整段会话的思考 token 总量、占输出比例与思考轮次，并可逐轮查看明细。
description.en: A lightweight DSH plugin that adds thinking-token statistics to the line under the message box, showing a session's total thinking tokens, their share of output, how many turns thought, and a turn-by-turn breakdown.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Cloudflare Zero Trust 远程接入，插件自动管理 Access 应用、访问策略、Tunnel 与 DNS，主机无需公网 IP 或入站端口即可安全访问。
description.en: Cloudflare Zero Trust remote access for DeepSeek Harness: the DSH plugin manages Access apps, policies, Tunnel and DNS so a self-hosted Harness is reachable over HTTPS with no public IP or inbound ports.

description.zh: DSH plugin 监控系统剪贴板，记录多条文本历史，供 Agent 随时检索、回放与写入，实现剪贴板长期记忆。
description.en: A DSH plugin that monitors the system clipboard, records a recallable history of text entries, and lets the agent list, retrieve, and write clipboard content.

description.zh: 面向中国大陆 AI 产品的 DSH 插件，按官方条款逐条自检生成合成内容标识是否落实，扫出显式与隐式标识缺口并给出取证证据。
description.en: A DSH plugin for AI products in mainland China that audits generated-content labeling against official rules, flagging missing explicit and implicit AI labels with evidence.

description.zh: 面向国内应用市场上架的 DSH 插件，提交前自动预检 App 备案、隐私政策、权限、账号注销与上架材料，提前找出会被驳回的问题。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that pre-checks Chinese app store submissions — filing, privacy policy, permissions, account deletion and listing materials — to catch rejection risks early.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Cloudflare 官方 Code Mode MCP，用 search 与 execute 覆盖 2,500+ API，支持 OAuth 2.1 与 API Token 双认证及可视化设置面板。
description.en: Connects Cloudflare's official Code Mode MCP to DeepSeek Harness, letting the AI reach 2,500+ APIs via search and execute, with OAuth 2.1 or API Token auth and a visual settings panel.

description.zh: 面向中国大陆对外内容的合规红线审核 DSH 插件，发布前扫描文案与线上页面，识别网络工具用语、广告法极限词、地图领土、AI 标识等风险，并支持 CI 卡口。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin for mainland-China content compliance review: it scans copy and live pages before publishing to flag VPN wording, advertising-law superlatives, map/territory issues and AI-labeling gaps, with CI-friendly exit codes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供中文公文排版技能，按 GB/T 9704-2012 生成 docx、pdf、txt 并逐项自检格式合规。
description.en: A DSH plugin that formats Chinese official documents per GB/T 9704-2012, generating .docx/.pdf/.txt with built-in compliance self-checks.

description.zh: DSH plugin 画布式多智能体协作插件，通过节点图编排多智能体协作与信息流，支持三种智能体模式与信息流约束。
description.en: A canvas-based multi-agent cooperation plugin for DeepSeek Harness, orchestrating multi-agent collaboration and information flow via a node-graph with three agent modes and flow constraints.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供个人信息保护合规对照技能，扫描 App 权限、第三方 SDK、用户权利入口与隐私政策，逐条比对声明与实现是否一致。
description.en: A DSH plugin skill that audits personal-information compliance by scanning an app's permissions, third-party SDKs, user-rights entry points and privacy policy, then comparing declared promises against actual implementation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 agent 执行 git commit 时自动注入 Co-Authored-By 与 Generated-By 信息，兼容已有 hook，零配置即用。
description.en: DSH plugin auto-injects Co-Authored-By and Generated-By trailers on git commit, compatible with existing hooks, zero-config.

description.zh: DSH plugin 解析 session 日志归因 AI 生成文件，叠加 c8 覆盖率，产出 AI 与人工代码覆盖率对比、高危未测文件清单与信任分。
description.en: A DSH plugin that parses session logs to attribute AI-generated files, overlays c8 coverage, and produces AI vs human code coverage comparison, high-risk untested file list, and trust score.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 装上分支感知的代码知识图谱，Agent 读代码不再盲 grep，可查调用链、影响面与数据流，切分支索引自动跟随，覆盖 158+ 语言。
description.en: A branch-aware code knowledge graph for DeepSeek Harness: instead of blind grep, agents query callers, impact and data-flow paths across 158+ languages, with the index auto-following the checked-out branch.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 聊天提供行内代码胶囊、语法着色与文件标记，并可调色板与字体，让代码融入阅读。
description.en: A DSH plugin that renders inline code as amber pills with VS Code-style syntax coloring, language badges and chat file-path pills, plus customizable palettes and fonts.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的原生代码图谱插件，复用 Code Review Graph 引擎提供 30 个工具、审查工作流与可交互图谱，帮你在会话中完成代码审查、影响分析与安全重构。
description.en: A native DeepSeek Harness code-graph plugin that reuses the Code Review Graph engine to expose 30 tools, review workflows and interactive graphs for code review, impact analysis and safe refactoring inside your session.

description.zh: DSH 输入框代码引用折叠插件：粘贴「路径:行号 + 代码」自动折叠成一行引用 chip，发送时把完整代码快照内联给模型。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness input-box plugin that folds pasted "path:line + code" into a compact reference chip and inlines the full code snapshot to the model on send.

description.zh: dsh-code-taste 是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，它从你的纠正与指令中提炼带置信度的代码品味规则，存成可手改的 markdown，并在每个会话自动注入。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that learns your code taste from corrections and instructions, stores confidence-scored rules in an editable markdown file, and injects them into every session.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来 Cursor 风格的代码编辑器工作台：文件树、多标签页编辑、语法高亮，选中代码即可引用、翻译或备注给 AI。
description.en: A Cursor-style AI code editor workbench for DeepSeek Harness: file tree, multi-tab editing, syntax highlighting, and one-click quote, translate or annotate selected code for the AI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 增加 code_scan 工具，对指定目录运行 semgrep 安全扫描，输出按文件、行号、严重级别分组的中文 Markdown 报告。
description.en: Adds a code_scan tool to DeepSeek Harness agents that runs semgrep security scans on a directory and outputs a Chinese Markdown report grouped by file, line, and severity.

description.zh: 将本机已登录的 CodeBuddy/WorkBuddy 订阅作为 DSH plugin 的原生模型 provider 接入，启用后模型直接出现在 dsh 选择器中供 agent 调用。
description.en: Integrate local CodeBuddy/WorkBuddy subscription as a native model provider for DeepSeek Harness, making its models available in the dsh model picker for agents.

description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 每个会话按自身工作目录自动接入对应仓库的 CodeGraph 索引，多项目各用各的连接，避免静默查错仓库。
description.en: A DSH plugin that binds each DeepSeek Harness session to the CodeGraph index of its own working directory, keeping multi-repo sessions isolated and avoiding silent wrong-repo lookups.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加独立的 Codex 编码模式预设：先勘察再改码，内置终端、整仓检索、后台任务与上下文压缩。
description.en: Adds a dedicated Codex coding-mode preset to DeepSeek Harness: survey before editing, with built-in terminal, repo-wide search, background jobs and context compaction.

description.zh: dsh-codex-keychain 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供非官方 ChatGPT OAuth 登录，将凭据安全存入系统钥匙串，并注册 openai-codex 模型路由。
description.en: dsh-codex-keychain is an unofficial ChatGPT OAuth provider for DeepSeek Harness, storing credentials in the OS keychain and adding the openai-codex model route.

description.zh: dsh-codex-relay 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Codex 模型提供方插件，通过本机 Codex app-server 读取账号可用模型，并将请求交给 Codex 原生 agent loop 执行。
description.en: dsh-codex-relay is a DeepSeek Harness model provider plugin that reads available models from the local Codex app-server and delegates requests to Codex's native agent loop.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 输入框的模型选择器换成 Codex 风格发光推理强度滑块，拖动胶囊轨道即可切换档位，最高档带流光粒子特效。
description.en: Replaces the DeepSeek Harness composer model selector with a Codex-style glowing reasoning-effort slider: drag the pill track to switch effort levels, with drifting motes at the top tier.

description.zh: Codex Switch 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 ChatGPT OAuth 登录、多账号切换与 Codex 模型接入，并展示配额窗口与重置时间。
description.en: Codex Switch brings ChatGPT OAuth, multi-account switching, and Codex models to DeepSeek Harness, with quota windows and reset times.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让 Agent 通过自然语言全自动控制 ComfyUI：加载工作流、改造参数、提交生成、监控进度、下载结果，并支持批量编排与模型文件管理。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets agents fully control ComfyUI via natural language: load workflows, modify parameters, submit generations, monitor progress, download results, and orchestrate batch pipelines.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让模型选择器中的提供商分组可折叠，点击即可展开或收起，简化长列表，专注常用模型。
description.en: A DSH plugin that makes provider groups in the model picker collapsible, letting you fold/unfold models with a click for a cleaner list.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让手机配对桌面端，通过双平面白名单 RPC 安全观察会话并执行少量操作，全程端到端加密，无需暴露完整 Web API。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pairs a phone to the desktop, enabling secure session observation and narrow writes via dual-plane allowlisted RPC with E2EE, without exposing the full Web API.

description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 /compact 使用当前选中的模型生成摘要，而非上一轮作答的旧模型，切换模型后压缩结果更贴合当下选择。
description.en: Makes DeepSeek Harness /compact summarize with the currently selected model instead of the one that finished the last turn, so summaries match your current pick.

description.zh: DSH plugin 实时监测 Command Code 用量，提供侧边栏挂件与仪表盘，展示用量余量、Credits 及每轮对话消耗。
description.en: A DSH plugin that monitors Command Code usage in real time, offering sidebar widgets and dashboards for usage quotas, credits, and per-turn costs.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Reasonix 风格缓存感知压缩后端，替换 compaction-basic，以单一阈值触发结构化检查点，保留近期原文并压缩上下文。
description.en: A Reasonix-style cache-aware compaction backend for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that replaces compaction-basic, triggering one structured checkpoint at a single ratio while keeping a recent verbatim tail.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供键盘优先的命令面板，双击 Shift 即可搜索并打开会话、工作区、设置页面、已装功能与自定义指令，提升操作效率。
description.en: A keyboard-first command palette for DeepSeek Harness, triggered by double Shift to search and open sessions, workspaces, settings, installed features, and custom commands.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供「复杂项目模式」preset，在标准工具栈上写入四文档政策、只记当前状态、未经许可不 commit/push 等纪律。
description.en: A DSH plugin preset for DeepSeek Harness that layers a four-document policy, current-state-only docs, and a no-unrequested-push rule onto the standard tool stack.

description.zh: 把 DSH 输入区变成一整块均匀半透明的毛玻璃面板，覆盖任务清单、回到底部按钮与统计胶囊，可在设置中开关并持久保存。
description.en: Turns the DSH composer into a uniform semi-transparent frosted glass panel covering the task list, back-to-bottom button and stats capsule, toggleable in Settings and persisted.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框提供 ChatGPT 式预测补全：每轮回复后以幽灵文本提示下一句，Tab 采纳、Esc 忽略。
description.en: ChatGPT-style composer predictions for DeepSeek Harness: ghost-text next-message suggestions after each turn, Tab to accept, Esc to dismiss.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框提供 Tab 补全幽灵文本的 DSH plugin：既在回复后流式建议下一条消息，也在你停笔时补全当前句子，全部候选可用键盘切换且绝不代发。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds Tab-completion ghost text to the DeepSeek Harness composer: it streams a suggested next message after each reply and completes the sentence you are drafting, with keyboard-only candidate cycling and nothing ever sent for you.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框提供 Tab 补全幽灵文本的 DSH plugin：既在回复后流式建议下一条消息，也在你停笔时补全当前句子，全部候选可用键盘切换且绝不代发。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds Tab-completion ghost text to the DeepSeek Harness composer: it streams a suggested next message after each reply and completes the sentence you are drafting, with keyboard-only candidate cycling and nothing ever sent for you.

description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框补上方向键历史：空草稿按 ↑ 召回本会话刚发过的消息，↓ 前进、Esc 还原草稿，适配新版 Lexical 输入框。
description.en: Adds arrow-key input history to the DSH composer: press ↑ on an empty draft to recall messages just sent in this session, ↓ to move forward, Esc to restore your draft — built for the current Lexical input.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供只读组合诊断：扫描 Cordis 插件冲突、快照与差异对比，并在升级前做预检演练，全程不改动真实配置。
description.en: A read-only composition doctor for DeepSeek Harness that scans Cordis plugin conflicts, snapshots and diffs profiles, and rehearses upgrades in isolation without touching real configs.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 macOS 原生 computer-use 工具，可截屏并驱动真实鼠标键盘，零依赖零网络调用。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing native macOS computer-use for DeepSeek Harness, enabling screenshots and real mouse/keyboard control with zero dependencies.

description.zh: DSH 插件冲突诊断工具，把「装上了却没生效」变成可执行结论：对齐运行期图谱与磁盘 patch 层，指出谁和谁撞了、为什么静默失效，并给出可直接粘贴的修复 YAML。
description.en: A DSH plugin conflict doctor that turns "installed but silently broken" into an actionable verdict: it aligns the live runtime graph with on-disk patch layers, names who collides with whom, and hands back a paste-ready fix YAML.

description.zh: 把本机 OpenCode 里的免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器，自动筛选零成本模型并复用本地凭据，工具调用仍由 DSH 执行。
description.en: Bridges free models from your local OpenCode into the DeepSeek Harness model picker, auto-filtering zero-cost models while DSH keeps tool execution.

description.zh: 把本机所有 WorkBuddy 登录账号聚合成一个 DSH 模型池，自动发现账号、签到、积分与到期提醒，并可在输入框下方切换账号、查看剩余总积分。
description.en: Aggregates every WorkBuddy account signed in on the machine into one DSH model pool, with auto-discovery, check-in, credit and expiry alerts, plus in-composer account switching and remaining credit display.

description.zh: Connectome 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 DSH 插件，用 canvas 与 d3-force 把工作区文件及其 import 依赖画成可交互的力导向图，点击节点即可在右侧栏预览源码。
description.en: Connectome is a DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that renders your workspace files and their imports as an interactive, canvas-based d3-force graph, letting you click any node to preview its source in the right sidebar.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 建立会话间连接：会话互为节点，可拉取对方工作状态、共享公约盒并按三档紧急度传话，还能在连接上挂载卡片插件提供工具，互不打扰。
description.en: A DSH plugin that links sessions as nodes: pull peer work status, share a conventions box, send messages at three urgency levels, and mount connection-scoped card plugins that expose tools without disturbing either side.

description.zh: DSH 插件 dsh-consent-guard 专查用户同意与授权确认，扫描默认勾选、捆绑同意、无撤回入口等个保法违规点。
description.en: A DSH plugin that audits user consent and authorization flows, flagging pre-checked boxes, bundled consent, and missing withdrawal options under China's PIPL.

description.zh: DSH 内容创作 bundle 插件：截屏、录屏、Markdown 转小红书图文卡片、dev.to/Medium 发布，并带发布前人工审阅闸门。
description.en: DSH content creation bundle: screenshots, screen recording, Markdown-to-Xiaohongshu cards, dev.to/Medium publishing, with human-in-the-loop review.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供外部内容信任边界检查，扫描 agent 是否把网页、文件、邮件里的内容当指令执行，防范间接提示注入风险。
description.en: A DSH plugin that audits the external-content trust boundary, checking whether an agent treats text from web pages, files, or emails as instructions, guarding against indirect prompt injection.

description.zh: 这款 DSH plugin 让你直接改写已定稿的助手回复与思维链，保存后整段对话与后续推理都只认你的版本。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets you rewrite a finalized assistant reply and its reasoning chain in the transcript, so the whole conversation and later reasoning follow your edited version.

description.zh: dsh-context-toolkit 是一个 DSH plugin，用沙箱执行与本地 FTS5 知识库把大段原始输出挡在对话之外，只回传结论、摘录与计数。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness bundle that keeps bulk output out of the conversation: sandboxed execution and a local FTS5 knowledge base return only conclusions, excerpts and counts.

description.zh: dsh-continue 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供安全无人值守的任务继续、网络恢复、推荐答案与决策学习，所有能力默认关闭，确保 fail-closed 安全边界。
description.en: dsh-continue is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for safe unattended task continuation, network recovery, recommended answers, and decision learning, with all capabilities off by default for fail-closed safety.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 添加一键导出会话为整洁 Markdown 的功能，支持导出全部或选择性导出完整对话轮次，便于阅读与 AI 交接。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds one-click export of conversations as clean Markdown to DeepSeek Harness Web, supporting full or selective turn export for reading and AI handoff.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供 ChatGPT 风格的对话迷你地图，支持鱼眼悬停、渐隐和点击跳转，快速导航长对话。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding a ChatGPT-style conversation minimap to the Web GUI with fish-eye hover, edge fade, and click-to-jump for fast long-conversation navigation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏加上 GitHub 提交日历式的方格图，按天统计你发出的提示、活跃会话与 token 消耗。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a GitHub-style contribution calendar to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, charting daily prompts, active conversations and token usage.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供窗口化可逆上下文管理，自动接管原生压缩，支持上下文换窗、历史检索与压缩还原。
description.en: Windowed, reversible context management for DeepSeek Harness: takes over native compaction, with context windowing, historical retrieval and restorable compression.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 对话界面右侧添加一列导航标记，每条对应用户消息，点击跳转、悬停预览，长对话快速定位。
description.en: Adds a column of navigation markers to the right edge of the DeepSeek Harness web conversation view, one per user message, with click-to-jump and hover previews for fast navigation in long chats.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端限制 dsh-auth-* 会话 cookie 的有效期，避免 cookie 累积撑爆请求头、导致 HTTP 431 启动崩溃。
description.en: A DSH plugin that caps the lifetime of desktop dsh-auth-* session cookies, preventing cookie buildup from overflowing request headers and causing HTTP 431 startup crashes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 system prompt 配一位副驾驶：按段摊开提示词结构、写入你自己的家规、点名重复与矛盾，并记录每次改动、随时回退。
description.en: A co-pilot for your DeepSeek Harness system prompt: it lays the prompt out section by section, lets you write your own house rules, flags repeats and contradictions, and logs every change so you can roll back.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 copilot-api 网关的模型提供商插件，默认使用 openai-responses 协议，凭据以引用方式保存，可切换协议与刷新模型。
description.en: A DSH plugin that registers a copilot-api gateway as a model provider, defaulting to the openai-responses protocol with credential references and configurable refresh.

description.zh: dsh-cordis 把 DeepSeek Harness 编码引擎封装为 Cordis 插件，将原生 Agent、持久会话、模型适配器、工具与审批等能力挂载进宿主已有的 Loader 树，可随 Loader 条目移除而干净卸载。
description.en: dsh-cordis packages the DeepSeek Harness coding engine as a Cordis plugin, mounting native agents, durable sessions, model adapters, tools, goals and approvals into a host's existing Loader tree, with clean removal when its Loader entry is withdrawn.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地文件格式转换能力，通过模型工具调用 ffmpeg、pandoc 等 20 条转换链，覆盖 1000+ 格式对，支持矩阵查询与转换器检测。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings local file conversion to DeepSeek Harness: model tools drive 20 converter chains (ffmpeg, pandoc, libreoffice...) across 1000+ format pairs, with matrix queries and converter availability checks.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，在 Web UI 输入框左侧常驻高驰徽章，展示手表型号与累计运动天数，点击展开一句话点评与建议。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that pins a COROS badge beside the Web UI input box, showing your watch model and total workout days, with a tap-to-expand one-line review and advice.

description.zh: Cortex 是 DeepSeek Harness 的多模型编排插件，让大模型规划验收、小模型执行，通过递归任务树、动态路由与质量门控降本保质。
description.en: Cortex is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for multi-model orchestration: a strong supervisor plans and verifies while cheap executor models do the work, cutting costs via recursive task trees, dynamic routing, and quality gates.

description.zh: DSH 插件，本地分析 Token、费用、缓存、余额与模型价格，提供图表与界面扩展。
description.en: A DSH plugin for local analysis of tokens, costs, cache, balance, and model prices with charts and UI extensions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话头部嵌入实时成本芯片，按桶统计 token 用量、峰谷电价与下次切换倒计时，点击可查看分模型费用明细。
description.en: A DSH plugin that embeds a live cost chip in the DeepSeek Harness conversation header, showing per-bucket token usage, peak/off-peak tariff and a switch countdown, with a per-model breakdown modal.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在输入框下方显示可见的会话花费与余额统计条，支持峰谷计费、价格自动同步、设置页与一键还原。
description.en: A DSH plugin that displays a visible cost/balance bar under the input box, with peak/off-peak billing, auto price sync, settings page, and one-click reset.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话头部嵌入实时成本芯片，按桶统计 token 用量、峰谷电价与下次切换倒计时，点击可查看分模型费用明细。
description.en: A DSH plugin that embeds a live cost chip in the DeepSeek Harness conversation header, showing per-bucket token usage, peak/off-peak tariff and a switch countdown, with a per-model breakdown modal.

description.zh: DSH plugin 按真实 token 用量折算 LLM 调用费用，提供调用级、会话级与全局统计页，UI 对齐 CC Switch 风格。
description.en: A DSH plugin that converts real token usage into LLM costs, offering per-call, per-session and global usage dashboards in CC Switch style.

description.zh: DSH plugin 按真实 token 用量折算 LLM 调用费用，提供调用级、会话级与全局统计页，UI 对齐 CC Switch 风格。
description.en: A DSH plugin that converts real token usage into LLM costs, offering per-call, per-session and global usage dashboards in CC Switch style.

description.zh: DSH plugin 控制 DG-LAB Coyote 电刺激设备，提供八个安全受限的工具与网页控制面板，支持波形播放与自动刺激。
description.en: DSH plugin for controlling DG-LAB Coyote e-stim devices, offering eight safety-bounded tools and a web panel with waveform playback and auto-stim.

description.zh: CrabTodo 是 DeepSeek Harness 的持久化待办 DSH plugin：为模型提供增删改查工具，并在 Web 右侧栏提供任务页面，任务跨会话、跨工作区保留。
description.en: CrabTodo is a persistent todo DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness: model-facing CRUD tools plus a web sidebar task page, keeping tasks across sessions, workspaces and restarts.

description.zh: dsh-crew 让 Claude Code 和 Codex 在 dsh 会话中以真实终端面板运行，人类可实时观看并键入，DSH agent 通过五个工具调度它们。
description.en: dsh-crew runs Claude Code and Codex as live terminal panes inside dsh sessions, letting humans watch and type, while the DSH agent orchestrates them via five tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 cpp-opt-audit 技能，按目标工程真实 C++ 标准审查底层代码，覆盖 RAII、移动语义、异常安全、并发与 ABI，默认先出报告再改代码。
description.en: A DSH plugin that ships the cpp-opt-audit skill for reviewing low-level C++ against the project's real C++ standard, covering RAII, move semantics, exception safety, concurrency and ABI — report first, edit only after approval.

description.zh: dsh-cron 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 /cron 斜杠命令，支持按 cron 表达式定时触发循环 Agent 任务，可暂停、恢复并跨重启持久化。
description.en: dsh-cron adds a /cron slash command to DeepSeek Harness for cron-scheduled recurring agent loops, with pause, resume, and persistence across restarts.

description.zh: dsh-cue-bank 是 DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话事件触点记忆插件，自动从对话构建持久触点库，在话题切换时重新注入相关上下文，让 Agent 记忆更接近人类。
description.en: dsh-cue-bank is a cross-session event-cue memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness, auto-building a persistent cue bank from conversations and re-injecting relevant context on topic switches.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 在设置外观下方加一行自定义 CSS 编辑器，样式表以磁盘 .css 文件保存、写完即生效，带补全、校验与元素拾取。
description.en: Adds a custom CSS editor row under Appearance in the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI settings, storing stylesheets as on-disk .css files that apply instantly, with completion, validation and element picking.

description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页管理 $DSH_HOME/.env，保存即热更新 Host 环境变量，并同步到 Windows/macOS 用户环境。
description.en: A DSH plugin that manages $DSH_HOME/.env from Settings, hot-applying values to the Host process and syncing them to the Windows/macOS user environment.

description.zh: dsh-custom-js 让 DSH 用户无需 Fork 即可在 Web UI 中加载、编辑并热重载可信的 JavaScript 与 TypeScript 用户脚本，内置脚本管理器与运行时状态。
description.en: dsh-custom-js lets you load, edit, and hot-reload trusted JavaScript and TypeScript userscripts in the DSH Web UI without forking, with a built-in script manager and runtime status.

description.zh: DSH plugin 品牌定制插件：在设置面板上传两张图，自动替换 favicon 与侧边栏 Logo，免切图、免重启、升级不丢。
description.en: DSH plugin for white-labeling: upload two images in the settings panel to replace favicon and sidebar logo, no cropping, no restart, survives upgrades.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让你在 Web 设置页或 settings.yaml 中配置自定义 LLM 提供商路由与模型目录，支持 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 协议，模型即刻出现在原生选择器中。
description.en: A DSH plugin to configure custom LLM provider routes and model catalogs via Web settings or settings.yaml, supporting OpenAI and Anthropic protocols with models appearing in the native picker.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让你在 Web 设置页或 settings.yaml 中配置自定义 LLM 提供商路由与模型目录，支持 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 协议，模型即刻出现在原生选择器中。
description.en: A DSH plugin to configure custom LLM provider routes and model catalogs via Web settings or settings.yaml, supporting OpenAI and Anthropic protocols with models appearing in the native picker.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自动记录任务、会话与错误，一键生成日报/周报 Markdown，并显示 Web 悬浮摘要卡。
description.en: A DSH plugin that automatically logs tasks, sessions, and errors, generating daily/weekly Markdown reports with a floating web summary card.

description.zh: 面向《数据安全法》第二十一条的 DSH plugin，扫描数据字典与资产清单，检查敏感字段是否缺失分级标注，并输出合规风险报告。
description.en: A DSH plugin for China's Data Security Law Article 21 that scans data dictionaries and asset inventories to flag sensitive fields missing classification labels and report compliance risks.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 工作区添加动态视频背景与半透明输入框的 DSH plugin，开屏结束后才启用，不修改 app.asar。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a looping video background and translucent composer to the DeepSeek Harness workspace, activating only after the splash screen without touching app.asar.

description.zh: DSH 插件，静态扫描项目在数据留存上的空白：有没有写明留存期限、期限是否过长、只写不删，逐条给出文件行号与法条依据。
description.en: A DSH plugin that statically scans a project for data-retention gaps: missing retention policies, over-long periods, and write paths with no purge, each hit citing file, line and legal basis.

description.zh: 为 DSH plugin 提供个人信息权利合规审计，扫描代码中查阅、复制、删除权是否真正落地，识别软删除等个保法 45/47/50 条风险。
description.en: A DSH plugin that audits personal-information rights compliance, scanning code to verify whether access, portability and deletion rights are truly implemented, flagging soft-delete risks under PIPL Articles 45/47/50.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）中连接 SQLite、PostgreSQL、MySQL，通过侧边栏面板与对话内工具直接查询、建表和修改数据。
description.en: Connect SQLite, PostgreSQL, and MySQL inside DeepSeek Harness (DSH) and query, create tables, or edit data directly from the sidebar panel and in-conversation tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供敏感数据发现能力，扫描代码与配置中的身份证、银行卡、手机号，带校验位验证，只报打码片段不泄露原值。
description.en: A DSH plugin for sensitive-data discovery that scans code and configs for ID numbers, bank cards and phone numbers with checksum validation, reporting only masked snippets.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供数据库管理面板，在侧边栏统一管理 SQLite、MySQL 与 Redis，并附带受写保护审批约束的 agent 工具。
description.en: A database management panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, unifying SQLite, MySQL and Redis in one sidebar entry with approval-guarded agent tools.

description.zh: 把 Decision 3.0 决策模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，让 Agent 对文本、图片、视频提出带选项的问题，直接拿回校准概率与置信度，并在 Web UI 中展示概率条与设置页。
description.en: Brings Decision 3.0 decision models into DeepSeek Harness, letting agents ask multiple-choice questions over text, images and video and get calibrated probabilities with confidence, plus a probability-bar card and settings page in the Web UI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent loop 提供结构化裁决层，接入危险门控、产出自检、工具收窄与防循环等自动介入。
description.en: A structured decision layer for the DeepSeek Harness agent loop, adding danger gating, output self-check, tool narrowing and loop prevention.

description.zh: DSH plugin，为AI决策提供持久化记录：通过自然语言或命令将重要决定写入项目内DECISIONS.md，供任何AI读取，解决AI失忆与决策追溯问题。
description.en: A DSH plugin that persists AI decisions: log key choices into a project DECISIONS.md via natural language or commands, readable by any AI to prevent amnesia and ensure traceability.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的 composer 中显示 DeepSeek 平台各币种余额，点击即可查看充值、赠送与总额详情，无需任何配置。
description.en: Shows DeepSeek Platform balance per currency right in the DeepSeek Harness composer, with a click-open panel for topped-up, granted and total amounts — zero configuration.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在输入栏左侧显示绿/红状态点，实时指示 DeepSeek API 高峰/低谷时段，点击可查看倒计时与 24 小时时段图。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows a green/red dot in the composer bar indicating DeepSeek API peak/off-peak times, with a clickable dashboard for countdown and schedule.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边栏实时余额与每轮对话花费显示，点击可展开充值/赠送余额及 token 单价明细。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows your live DeepSeek balance in the sidebar and the cost of each conversation turn, with expandable token and pricing details.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供依赖投毒审计：扫描依赖树中的 install/postinstall 脚本、过宽版本与非 registry 来源，输出分级风险报告。
description.en: A DSH plugin that audits dependency trees for supply-chain poisoning: install/postinstall scripts, loose version ranges, and non-registry sources, with graded risk reports.

description.zh: dsh-design 是 DeepSeek Harness 的设计系统技能与审计插件，通过渲染页面实测对比度、字号、间距、调色板等设计规则，将“看起来不错”变成可量化的指标。
description.en: dsh-design is a design-system skill and audit plugin for DeepSeek Harness that measures rendered pages for contrast, type scale, spacing, palette drift, and more, turning 'looks good' into a number you can argue with.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 macOS 桌面自动化而生，让 agent 直接控制鼠标、键盘、窗口与应用，并整合截图识图定位的视觉闭环，操作非浏览器软件。
description.en: A DSH plugin for macOS desktop automation, enabling agents to control mouse, keyboard, windows, and apps, with a vision closed-loop for screenshot, recognition, and location.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 standard 预设提供可配置覆盖：切换 Bash/PowerShell 执行通道、按行禁用工具、固定 persona 与隐藏框架身份，全部只改内存配置。
description.en: Configurable overrides for the DeepSeek Harness standard preset: switch the Bash/PowerShell execution channel, disable preset rows, pin the persona and hide the harness identity, all in memory only.

description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面端提供重启宿主工具与侧边栏按钮，重启后自动唤醒指定会话继续执行，解决改宿主插件必须重启却会杀掉正在跑回合的麻烦。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for the Windows desktop app that adds a host-restart tool and sidebar button, then automatically wakes the chosen sessions so they keep working after the restart.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在设置页一键生成 Windows 桌面快捷方式，双击启动任意本地服务并自动打开浏览器，可固定任务栏。
description.en: A DSH plugin that creates one-click Windows desktop shortcuts from the Settings page, launching any local service and auto-opening the browser, with taskbar pinning.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在设置页一键生成 Windows 桌面快捷方式，双击启动任意本地服务并自动打开浏览器，可固定任务栏。
description.en: A DSH plugin that creates one-click Windows desktop shortcuts from the Settings page, launching any local service and auto-opening the browser, with taskbar pinning.

description.zh: DSH 桌面通知插件：当所有前端失焦时，把决策、授权、中断与完成事件推送到 Windows 通知中心，点击通知即可切回对应会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pushes decision, approval, interruption and completion events to the Windows notification center whenever every frontend loses focus, and clicking a toast jumps back to the matching session.

description.zh: DSH 环境管理插件：安装即配备桌面窗口（Tauri 宿主自动获取）、运行时一键更新、平台兼容自愈、DeepSeek 官方计费面板与内置代码编辑器。
description.en: A DSH plugin for environment management: desktop window (auto-fetched Tauri host), one-click runtime updates, platform compatibility self-healing, DeepSeek official billing panel, and built-in code editor.

description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 提供分区透明壁纸主题：按屏幕坐标钉住系统壁纸，五个界面区域各自独立调节透明度，让窗口看起来真的透到桌面。
description.en: A per-region translucent wallpaper theme for DSH Desktop that pins the system wallpaper to screen coordinates, letting five UI regions set their own opacity so windows appear to see through to the desktop.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 用户生成类 Spotify Wrapped 的年度编程报告，本地解析 DSH 会话，统计与 AI 结对编程行为并输出可分享的 HTML 卡片。
description.en: Generates a Spotify Wrapped-style yearly coding report for DeepSeek Harness users, parsing DSH sessions locally to summarize AI pair-programming behavior into a shareable HTML card.

description.zh: dsh-devtools 是 DeepSeek Harness 的元数据优先运行时性能分析器，在会话视图的 DevTools 标签页展示模型调用与回合的执行事实，只读不拦截。
description.en: dsh-devtools is a metadata-first runtime profiler for DeepSeek Harness, presenting model calls and turn execution facts in a DevTools tab, read-only.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的诊断式学习运行时插件，在右侧边栏生成诊断地图与课程，边学边测并给出下一步学习建议。
description.en: A diagnosis-first learning runtime plugin for DeepSeek Harness that grows a diagnosis map and lessons in the right sidebar, checking understanding and suggesting the next step.

description.zh: dsh-diary 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供每日 Markdown 日记功能，支持自定义模板、文件管理与网页设置界面。
description.en: dsh-diary is a DSH plugin that adds daily Markdown journaling with custom templates, file management, and a web settings section.

description.zh: dsh-dictate 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Composer 提供上下文感知语音输入，支持实时转写、模型润色和用户控制的自动发送。
description.en: dsh-dictate provides context-aware dictation for DeepSeek Harness Composer, with live transcription, model polish, and user-controlled sending.

description.zh: DSH 声音提醒与对话直达插件：多对话并行时，有回复即出声提醒，点击卡片或系统通知直达对应会话，不错过任何回复。
description.en: A DSH plugin for sound alerts and one-click jump: when conversations reply in parallel, it rings and lets you jump straight to the conversation via card or system notification.

description.zh: dsh-dingtalk-channel 是 DeepSeek Harness 的钉钉 IM 通道插件，通过 Stream 模式将每条聊天消息转化为带工具的 agent，支持会话持久化与审批。
description.en: dsh-dingtalk-channel is a DingTalk IM channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness, turning each chat into a tool-capable agent via Stream mode, with durable sessions and approval.

description.zh: Ditto 是 DeepSeek Harness 的批量自动化插件：先审阅 3 个样本、全量预览并确认后，才把同一标准安全套用到几十个文件，绝不擅自写入。
description.en: Ditto is a review-first batch automation DSH plugin: review 3 samples, preview the whole batch, approve, then apply the same standard safely to dozens of files — nothing is written until you say so.

description.zh: DSH 浮窗工作区目录树插件，拖拽文件路径到对话框、懒加载、搜索过滤，切换工作区自动跟随。
description.en: A DSH floating workspace directory-tree plugin with drag-drop file paths, lazy loading, search, and auto-follow on workspace switch.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供文档路由工具：先探测文件真实格式与 PDF 分栏版式，再选用合适管线提取，多栏论文可保留阅读顺序。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that sniffs a file's real format and a PDF's page layout, then routes it to the right extraction pipeline so multi-column papers keep their reading order.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将对话整理成带封面、摘要统计与章节排版的精美报告，支持导出 PNG、HTML、PDF 与 Markdown，便于分享与归档。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns conversations into polished reports with cover, summary stats and chaptered layout, exportable as PNG, HTML, PDF and Markdown for easy sharing.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框状态栏加一枚可点击徽章，实时显示 CPU、内存与 GPU 占用，采样不进上下文、不外发。
description.en: Adds a clickable badge to the DeepSeek Harness composer status bar showing live CPU, memory and GPU usage, sampled locally without touching the conversation context.

description.zh: DSH 插件通过本地 Doubao Relay 提供 doubao_ask 动态搜索、图片生成与多模态识图工具，并支持粘贴图片转本地路径，增强 DeepSeek Harness 的多模态能力。
description.en: A DSH plugin that provides doubao_ask dynamic search, image generation, and multimodal vision tools via a local Doubao Relay, plus paste-to-path support for images.

description.zh: Dota 2 天梯无 Ban 征召助手，作为 DSH plugin 提供分路英雄池推荐、BP 预测胜率与中文英雄库，并支持对话内 dota2_bp 工具调用。
description.en: A Dota 2 ranked no-ban draft assistant DSH plugin that recommends heroes by role pool, predicts win rates from BP, and ships a Chinese hero library via the dota2_bp tool.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供第三方 Dracula 暗色主题，覆盖全套 CSS 变量与语法高亮，并内置主题切换设置页。
description.en: A third-party Dracula dark theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, covering the full CSS token layer and syntax highlighting, with a built-in theme switcher.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 网页版聊天嵌入 DSH 桌面版主面板，提供侧栏入口与工具栏，并本地备份登录快照。
description.en: Embeds the DeepSeek web chat in a DSH Desktop main panel with a sidebar entry, toolbar, and a local login snapshot.

description.zh: DSH plugin 双模型自动路由：低成本直答与高成本升级切换，并带逃逸学习闭环，自动优化模型选择策略。
description.en: Dual-model auto-routing plugin for DeepSeek Harness: low-cost direct / high-cost upgrade with escape-learning closed loop.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 界面提供带阻尼动效的推理等级滑块，替换官方菜单式档位选择，支持自适应挡位与动态光效。
description.en: A DSH plugin that replaces the reasoning-effort chooser with a compact animated slider, featuring damped motion, adaptive levels, and dynamic glow effects.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 界面提供带阻尼动效的推理等级滑块，替换官方菜单式档位选择，支持自适应挡位与动态光效。
description.en: A DSH plugin that replaces the reasoning-effort chooser with a compact animated slider, featuring damped motion, adaptive levels, and dynamic glow effects.

description.zh: dsh-egress-guard 是 DeepSeek Harness 的本地密钥预检插件，在模型请求出站前扫描并阻断疑似密钥，默认 fail-closed，不联网不改写请求。
description.en: dsh-egress-guard is a local secret preflight plugin for DeepSeek Harness, scanning and blocking likely credentials before model requests egress, fail-closed by default, no network or request rewriting.

description.zh: dsh-ego-browser 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来带记忆的浏览器自动化，让代理记住站点技能、将可用脚本提升为新工具，并支持人工接管。
description.en: dsh-ego-browser brings ego lite browser automation with memory to DeepSeek Harness, recalling site skills, promoting working scripts into new tools, and enabling real human handoff.

description.zh: DSH 插件，基于 imapflow 连接任意 IMAP 邮箱，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供列邮件、读全文、服务端搜索三个工具，支持 OAuth2 与代理。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects to any IMAP mailbox via imapflow, providing email list, read, and search tools for DeepSeek Harness, with OAuth2 and proxy support.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供正确编码的命令执行与乱码恢复工具，解决中文 Windows 下 GBK、UTF-16LE 输出被误当 UTF-8 解码而显示乱码的问题。
description.en: A DSH plugin that runs commands with correct encoding detection and recovers mojibake, fixing GBK/UTF-16LE output misread as UTF-8 on Chinese Windows.

description.zh: DSH 插件 dsh-env-audit 静态审计 .env 等环境配置文件：是否被 gitignore 忽略、权限是否宽于 600、是否明文写密钥、有无 .env.example 模板，并给出可查证依据。
description.en: A DSH plugin that statically audits .env config files: whether they are gitignored, file permissions wider than 600, plaintext secrets, and missing .env.example templates, each finding backed by citable standards.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中一键把草稿改写成清晰具体的提示词，可随时撤销，语言与 @ 引用原样保留。
description.en: A DSH plugin that rewrites your chat draft into a clear, specific prompt with one click, with instant revert and preserved language and @ references.

description.zh: DSH 全局经验插件，自动探测本地环境并沉淀跨会话档案，低开销注入每轮提示，减少重复探测、加快会话、降低 token 消耗。
description.en: A DSH plugin that auto-detects local environment, persists cross-session profiles, and injects low-overhead summaries into prompts to reduce re-probing and token usage.

description.zh: DSH 声音实验室：为会话结束、弹窗、权限请求、停止四个触发事件挑选音效，生成 AI 角色语音，并管理个人音效库；还附带浮窗桌面宠物（安洁莉娜），无需代码即可配置。
description.en: DSH Sound Lab: pick sounds for four triggers (session end, popup, permission, stop), generate AI character voice lines, and manage your own sound library; includes a floating desktop pet (Angelina), all configurable without code.

description.zh: Evidence Arena 是 DeepSeek Harness 的独立工作台插件，在隔离 Git 工作树中并行运行多个模型编码任务，通过确定性门控与独立评审，将经确认的候选结果写回原工作区。
description.en: Evidence Arena is a standalone DeepSeek Harness plugin that runs parallel isolated coding runs with deterministic judging and guarded promotion, writing back only confirmed candidates.

description.zh: ESP Buddy 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 ESP32-S3 桌面伴侣插件，通过 BLE 把会话状态、Token 用量与上下文推送到小屏幕，并支持触摸审批与角色包传输。
description.en: ESP Buddy is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that pushes session status, token usage and context to an ESP32-S3 desktop screen over BLE, with touch approval and role-pack transfer.

description.zh: dsh-fast-pills 是 DSH 插件，把常用话存成胶囊排在 Web 输入框上方，一点即插入草稿并留下本机使用台账。
description.en: dsh-fast-pills is a DSH plugin that keeps your go-to phrases as capsules above the Web composer: one click splices the text into the draft and logs every press locally.

description.zh: DSH plugin 蛋白质组学分析插件，对话式完成归一化、PCA、差异分析、GO/KEGG 富集与 GSEA，自动安装 R 环境并输出解读报告。
description.en: A plug-and-play proteomics analysis plugin for DeepSeek Harness, wrapping normalization, PCA, differential analysis, GO/KEGG enrichment and GSEA behind a conversation, with auto R setup and interpretation reports.

description.zh: 把飞书私聊变成 DSH 的远程操作界面：装一个插件、填一对凭据即可在手机上提问、切会话与模型、答反问、批工具，无需公网入口与内网穿透。
description.en: Turns a Feishu private chat into a remote control surface for DeepSeek Harness: install one DSH plugin, pair once, then ask, switch sessions and models, answer questions and approve tools from your phone — no public endpoint or tunneling.

description.zh: DSH plugin 飞书网关，让你在飞书私聊或群聊中直接与 DeepSeek Harness agent 对话，支持持久会话、/new 新会话、Markdown 回复、流式进度卡片与主动推送。
description.en: A DSH plugin Feishu gateway that lets you chat with your DeepSeek Harness agent from Feishu, with persistent sessions, /new, Markdown replies, streaming progress cards, and proactive push.

description.zh: DSH 飞书桥插件，通过官方 SDK 长连接将飞书机器人接入 DeepSeek Harness 会话，支持流式回复卡片、工具调用面板、审批卡片与多机器人。
description.en: A DSH plugin bridging Feishu (Lark) chats to DeepSeek Harness agent sessions via official SDK long connection, featuring streaming reply cards, tool-call panels, approval cards, and multi-bot support.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Exa 联网搜索与网页抓取，支持免登录、API Key 与账号三种方式，按可用性注册 10 个 exa_* 工具。
description.en: Brings Exa web search and page fetching to DeepSeek Harness via keyless, API key, or account access, registering up to 10 exa_* tools based on availability.

description.zh: 把 DSH 每次 token 花销折成鱼粮币，喂养大肥鱼并解锁 21 件原创穿搭，还能生成饲养报告卡。
description.en: Turns every DeepSeek Harness token spend into fish coins, feeding a virtual whale that unlocks 21 original outfits and shareable care-report cards.

description.zh: Experience Map 是 DSH plugin，把已完成任务沉淀为可校验、可审批、可复用的经验资产，复用前先做适用性预检并留痕。
description.en: Experience Map is a DSH plugin that turns completed DeepSeek Harness work into evidence-governed, versioned Experiences that are preflighted, approved, verified and revisable before reuse.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将文件拖拽到窗口，真实磁盘路径瞬间写入输入框，零内容传输，支持多选与文件夹。
description.en: A DSH plugin that writes real file paths to the input box when you drag files onto the window, with zero content transfer, supporting multi-select and folders.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将任意 URL 流式下载为工作区文件，支持二进制、路径围栏与 200MB 上限，弥补 web_fetch 无法落盘文件的不足。
description.en: DSH plugin that downloads any URL to workspace files with streaming, binary support, path fencing, and a 200MB cap, complementing web_fetch for file retrieval.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供右侧浮动文件树抽屉，展示当前会话工作目录，支持拖拽文件路径插入对话框、双击打开文件或目录，并随会话切换自动跟随工作目录。
description.en: A file explorer plugin for the DSH Web GUI: a floating file-tree drawer on the right showing the current session workspace, with drag-and-drop path insertion into the chat box and double-click to open files or folders.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话内嵌「文件」标签页，直接浏览当前工作区目录并预览 Markdown、图片、PDF 与文本，无需切到系统文件管理器。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a Files tab inside the session, letting you browse the active workspace and preview Markdown, images, PDFs and text without leaving the chat GUI.

description.zh: DSH plugin 统一文件导入：任意后缀文件拖入/粘贴/选择即字节上传附件库，文件清单注入上下文，提供 read_attachment/place_attachment 工具与历史文件气泡。
description.en: DSH plugin for unified file import: any file drag/paste/select uploads bytes to attachment store, file list injected into context, with read_attachment/place_attachment tools and historical file bubbles.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 补上缺失的右键菜单，按点击目标智能提供复制、粘贴、复制路径、在文件管理器中定位与打开文件等操作。
description.en: Adds the missing right-click context menu to the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI, offering copy, paste, copy path, reveal in file manager and open-with actions tailored to whatever you clicked.

description.zh: 把 DSH 对话里的文件与目录路径变成可点击按钮，点一下即可在右侧侧边栏预览，或调用系统默认程序打开，让 AI 提到的文件随手就能查看。
description.en: Turns file and directory paths in DSH chat into clickable links that preview in the right sidebar or open with the system default application.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 聊天输出中的文件路径接管右键菜单，可直接用本机应用打开、在文件管理器中定位或复制绝对/相对路径。
description.en: A DSH plugin that takes over right-click on file paths in chat output, letting you open them with local apps, reveal them in the file manager, or copy absolute and relative paths.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话工作区提供文件管理：在对话区顶部加「文件」tab，树形浏览、预览、上传下载、打包与 @ 文件给 agent 处理。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a File tab to the chat header, letting you browse, preview, upload, download and zip the current session workspace, and @-mention files for the agent.

description.zh: dsh-file-resource 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 输入框增加 attach 入口，本地解析文档并安全读取，图片走原生流程。
description.en: dsh-file-resource adds an attach entry to DeepSeek Harness Web, parsing documents locally with bounded reading while images use native flow.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 每轮对话自动快照工作区文件，在回复下方列出改动并支持一键还原文件、对话或两者，还能从任意一轮开分支。
description.en: A DSH plugin that snapshots your workspace after every turn, lists changed files under each reply, and lets you restore files, conversation, or both — or branch off from any turn.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 原生预览面板添加工作区文件树，可展开目录、点击文件在预览中打开，并支持筛选、刷新与宽度调整。
description.en: Adds a workspace file tree beside the native DeepSeek Harness preview panel, letting you browse directories, open files in the preview, filter, refresh and resize.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加右键菜单：打开文件、在资源管理器中显示、用编辑器打开、复制路径，并支持侧边栏工作区与会话菜单。
description.en: Adds right-click context menus to the DeepSeek Harness web UI: open files, reveal in Explorer, open with editor, copy paths, plus sidebar workspace and session menus.

description.zh: dsh-fingerprint 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM 指纹采集与对比插件，用论文 40-cell 单 token 探针审计 provider/model 路由，判断两条记录是否同一模型。
description.en: A DSH plugin that captures and compares LLM fingerprints using the paper's 40-cell single-token probe battery, auditing configured provider/model routes to judge whether two records come from the same model.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web composer 添加本地文件上传按钮，支持多选、粘贴文件，自动存入工作区 .dsh-uploads/ 目录并生成 @ 引用，全程本地传输。
description.en: Adds a local-file upload button to the DeepSeek Harness Web composer, supporting multi-select and paste, storing files in .dsh-uploads/ with @ references, all over local loopback.

description.zh: dsh-first-prompt-bar 是一款 DSH plugin，在对话顶部固定显示并一键复制会话首条提问，可展开查看全部提问，并提供八种外观主题。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pins the first prompt of each agent session to the top of the chat for instant viewing and copying, with an expandable list of all prompts and eight switchable looks.

description.zh: DSH 测试稳定性插件：重复运行 vitest/jest/pytest/node:test 识别 flaky 用例，历史留档与隔离清单，零运行时依赖。
description.en: DSH plugin for test stability: reruns vitest/jest/pytest/node:test to detect flaky tests, with history, quarantine list, and zero runtime dependencies.

description.zh: DSH 扁平团队插件：让多个 Agent 窗口组成无队长团队，跨窗口派发结构化任务，内置记录员服务与 Web 看板，实时掌握团队进展。
description.en: DSH plugin for leaderless flat agent teams: cross-window structured task dispatch, recorder service, and web dashboard for real-time progress.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供阅读优先的显示优化：自动折叠历史消息与工作步骤、可调输入框与右侧栏宽度，并支持折叠内容搜索。
description.en: A display-only DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that folds older messages and work-step blocks, resizes the composer and right sidebar, and makes folded content searchable.

description.zh: 把当前 DSH 会话的执行过程实时画成四泳道流程图，回合、工具、审批、重试一目了然，子代理发散收敛并可双击下钻子流程。
description.en: Renders the current DSH session as a live four-lane flow chart covering turns, tools, approvals and retries, with fan-out subagents you can double-click to drill into.

description.zh: DSH plugin 字体插件，为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供编辑器与代码字体族及连字控制，在插件配置卡片中设置。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing font family and ligature controls for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, configured via plugin card.

description.zh: DSH plugin 修复 Web 端侧边栏底部多个插件挤成一行的布局问题，支持自由配置上下排列顺序与间距对齐。
description.en: A DSH plugin that fixes the layout issue of multiple footer plugins squeezed into one row, allowing flexible vertical ordering, gap, and alignment.

description.zh: DSH plugin 本地离线语音输入：浏览器采集麦克风，经 FunASR(SenseVoice) 识别后实时填入输入框，全程离线不联网。
description.en: A DSH plugin for local offline voice input: captures microphone in browser, recognizes via FunASR (SenseVoice), and fills the input box in real time, fully offline.

description.zh: DSH plugin 前沿AI雷达与可复现性门禁，聚合多源信号并生成可审计的复现证据包。
description.en: Evidence-first frontier AI radar and reproducibility gate for DeepSeek Harness, aggregating multi-source signals into auditable reproduction bundles.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多智能体成本策略：逐次调用计量，并在花费 token 前用本地熔断器拦截超预算、越权模型与推理强度。
description.en: Multi-agent cost policy for DeepSeek Harness: per-call metering plus a local fuse that blocks over-budget, disallowed-model and excessive-reasoning calls before any token is spent.

description.zh: DSH plugin在agent长时间思考时，将热点新闻或提醒卡片直接注入对话流，低频率不打扰，支持多源新闻与对话内提醒。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects hot-news or reminder cards into the conversation stream during long agent thinking, low-frequency and non-intrusive, with multiple news sources and in-chat reminders.

description.zh: DSH plugin 连接 Garmin Connect，同步运动健康数据，提供 AI 教练分析与训练计划生成。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects Garmin Connect to sync activity and health data, offering AI coaching insights and training plan generation.

description.zh: dsh-gentle-engram 是 DeepSeek Harness 的持久记忆桥接插件，基于 Cordis 构建，将 Engram 生命周期无缝接入 DSH 会话，自动播种上下文并异步保存学习成果。
description.en: dsh-gentle-engram is a persistent memory bridge for DeepSeek Harness, built with Cordis, integrating Engram lifecycle into DSH sessions to seed context and save learnings asynchronously.

description.zh: DSH 平台的 GeoServer 交互插件，提供可视化配置与会话内地图图像输出，让 Agent 能读取 WMS 服务并渲染地图。
description.en: A DSH plugin for GeoServer interaction, offering visual configuration and in-session map image output, enabling agents to read WMS services and render maps.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 界面添加自定义背景（图片/GIF/动态壁纸）的插件，提供开关与本地素材库，兼容官方主题与皮肤中心。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds custom backgrounds (image/GIF/animated wallpaper) to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with an enable switch and local asset library, compatible with official theme and skin center.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为会话界面新增 Git tab，展示仓库概况、文件状态、提交历史、分支图与贡献日历，并支持暂存、提交、推送、拉取及在 macOS 终端打开仓库或启动代理 app。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding a Git tab to the conversation UI, showing repo overview, file status, commit history, branch graph, and contribution calendar, with staging, commit, push, pull, and macOS terminal/agent launching.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为会话界面新增 Git tab，展示仓库概况、文件状态、提交历史、分支图与贡献日历，并支持暂存、提交、推送、拉取及在 macOS 终端打开仓库或启动代理 app。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding a Git tab to the conversation UI, showing repo overview, file status, commit history, branch graph, and contribution calendar, with staging, commit, push, pull, and macOS terminal/agent launching.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 agent 编辑的文件、所用模型与会话记录到 git-ai，通过工具拦截生成检查点，实现代码溯源。
description.en: A DSH plugin that records agent-edited files, models, and sessions into git-ai via tool interception, enabling code attribution.

description.zh: dsh-git-branch 是一款 DSH plugin，在会话输入框显示当前 Git 分支，提供本地/远程分支表与切换，并可查看只读提交图。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows the session's current Git branch in the composer, lists local and remote branches with checkout, and opens a read-only commit graph.

description.zh: DSH Git Commit 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，一键按 Angular 规范分组工作区改动，用当前模型生成提交信息并直接执行 git/svn 提交。
description.en: DSH Git Commit is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that groups working-tree changes by Angular convention, names each group with the current model, and runs the git/svn commit itself.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 Git 工作区管理插件，在 Web UI 输入框旁一键打开面板，完成提交、分支、历史图形、冲突解决与 worktree 管理。
description.en: A Git workspace manager for DeepSeek Harness that opens a panel right from the Web UI composer, covering commits, branches, commit graph history, conflict resolution and worktree management.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 Git 工作区管理插件，在 Web UI 输入框旁一键打开面板，完成提交、分支、历史图形、冲突解决与 worktree 管理。
description.en: A Git workspace manager for DeepSeek Harness that opens a panel right from the Web UI composer, covering commits, branches, commit graph history, conflict resolution and worktree management.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 装上一套自助 Git 服务：HTTP clone/push、工单、PR、wiki、发版与 webhook 全都有，管理页是 dsh 原生界面，账号直接复用 user-management。
description.en: Brings a full self-hosted Git service into DeepSeek Harness: HTTP clone/push plus issues, PRs, wiki, releases and webhooks, all managed from a native DSH UI with user-management accounts.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在会话头部与新会话欢迎页显示当前 Git 分支徽标，支持切换、新建、拉取、推送、删除本地分支，采用 IDEA 风格目录树。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows the current Git branch badge in the session header and new-session hero page, with branch switching, creation, pull, fetch, push, and safe local deletion via an IDEA-style tree.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供可拖拽的 Git 侧边栏，跟随活动工作区展示变更文件，并利用当前模型生成提交信息，支持提交、推送、拉取等操作。
description.en: A draggable Git sidebar for DeepSeek Harness Web that follows the active workspace, lists changed files, generates commit messages with the current model, and supports commit, push, and pull.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 右侧栏新增「版本管理」页，参照 IDEA 的 Git 工具窗提供本地变更、提交、历史、分支、远程与贮藏管理。
description.en: Adds a Version Control tab to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI sidebar, bringing IDEA-style Git tool windows for local changes, commits, history, branches, remotes and stashes.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的仓外只读 Git 工作区看板，DSH plugin 在会话头部展示分支与变更摘要，支持文件列表、分支比较与 unified diff 预览。
description.en: A read-only Git workspace dashboard for DeepSeek Harness, showing branch and change summaries in the session header, with file lists, branch comparison, and unified diff previews.

description.zh: DSH plugin 的 Git 开发工作台：自动注入仓库上下文、会话起始选择分支/工作树、/git 命令与 git_workbench 工具，并带合并清理策略与安全护栏。
description.en: A DSH plugin git workbench: auto-injects repo context, picks branch/worktree at session start, /git commands and git_workbench tool, with merge & cleanup policy and guardrails.

description.zh: 把 GitHub Desktop 风格的 Git 面板装进 DSH 右侧栏，勾选暂存、提交推送、舍弃进回收站、双击看 diff，当前会话工作区即仓库。
description.en: A GitHub Desktop-style Git panel for the DSH right sidebar: tick-to-stage, commit and push, discard into a trash, and diff preview, bound to the current session workspace.

description.zh: 把 Gitee 企业项目管理搬进 DSH 会话：看板卡片、仓库与 WIKI、知识库和固定分析，数据由脚本拉取，模型只拿摘要，上下文占用与数据量解耦。
description.en: Brings Gitee Enterprise project management into DeepSeek Harness sessions: board cards, repos and WIKI, knowledge base and fixed analytics, with scripts fetching data so the model only sees a summary.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 终端桥接，用 Git for Windows 或 MSYS2 的 bash 替换模型侧 pwsh 工具，并保留官方终端契约。
description.en: A Windows terminal bridge for DeepSeek Harness that swaps the model-facing pwsh tool for Git for Windows or MSYS2 bash while preserving the official terminal contract.

description.zh: dsh-gitflow 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Git 状态、差异、日志、提交与分支管理工具，并可选集成 Change Ledger 检查点，安全地执行 Git 操作。
description.en: dsh-gitflow provides Git status, diff, log, commit, and branch tools for DeepSeek Harness, with optional Change Ledger checkpoint integration for safe Git operations.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补齐 GitHub 发布运维能力：管理 release 与 tag、受保护的 API 直通、工作流运行、密钥与净化镜像发布。
description.en: GitHub release operations for DeepSeek Harness: releases, tags, a guarded API pass-through, workflow runs, secrets and sanitized mirror publication.

description.zh: DSH plugin 轮询 GitHub 仓库开放 PR，通过 harness agent 主循环自动发布 COMMENT 评审，支持 GitHub App 认证、工具守卫与持久化会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that polls open PRs in configured GitHub repos and auto-posts COMMENT reviews via the harness agent loop, with GitHub App auth, tool guarding, and persistent sessions.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供 github_trending 工具，抓取 GitHub Trending 热门仓库，并在 web 界面显示可停靠的右侧趋势面板。
description.en: A DSH plugin that exposes a github_trending tool to fetch GitHub Trending repos, plus a dockable trending panel in the web UI.

description.zh: dsh-goodmemory 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自动、持久的跨会话记忆，基于 GoodMemory 在模型步骤前回忆相关上下文，并在回合成功后写回完整对话，让模型始终可重建会话历史。
description.en: dsh-goodmemory provides automatic, durable cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness, recalling relevant context before model steps and writing back completed turns via GoodMemory.

description.zh: DSH 的 GPT/Codex 沙箱提权参数兼容插件，自动删除冗余提权字段，让工具按当前会话策略正常执行。
description.en: A DSH plugin for GPT/Codex sandbox escalation compatibility, stripping redundant escalation fields so tools run under the current session policy.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供公文台账核对工具，按公开公文格式标准检查版头与主体要素，仅提示差异不下定性结论。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that checks official-document registers against published format standards, flagging discrepancies in header and body elements without drawing conclusions.

description.zh: DSH 会话嫁接插件，提供切片读取、导出、分叉与转发等 agent 工具，并可在会话页面点选轮次一键把内容发送到另一会话。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness session-grafting plugin: agent tools to read, export, fork and forward session log slices, plus in-page turn picking to send content into another session.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供 GitHub issue 与 PR 引用功能，点击发送按钮旁的 GitHub 图标即可搜索并插入引用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds GitHub issue and PR references to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, letting you search and insert references via the GitHub icon.

description.zh: 把 GPT Image Playground 原版生图工作台以 DSH plugin 形式装进 DeepSeek Harness，左栏即可用画廊/Agent 双模式、参考图与遮罩编辑、多供应商生图。
description.en: A DSH plugin that vendors the original GPT Image Playground workbench into DeepSeek Harness, adding gallery/Agent image generation, reference images, mask editing and multi-provider support in the sidebar.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供图运行时能力：把 LangGraph 编译图注册为 DSH 工具，并附带图驱动的路由 Agent 自动选图执行。
description.en: Graph runtime for DeepSeek Harness: register LangGraph compiled graphs as DSH tools, plus a graph-driven routing agent that selects and runs graphs.

description.zh: 把 SuperGrok / X Premium 的 Grok Build 订阅接入 DeepSeek Harness，无需 xAI 按量 API Key 即可选模型、切推理档位、带图提问并查看每周额度。
description.en: Brings a SuperGrok / X Premium Grok Build subscription into DeepSeek Harness, so you can pick models, switch reasoning tiers, ask with images and check weekly quota without a metered xAI API key.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）提供完整规则的掼蛋纸牌游戏插件，支持 4 人两副牌、智能机器人、图形牌桌与多人房间，Agent 可调用工具开局出牌。
description.en: A full-featured Guandan card game plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), with 4-player 2-deck rules, smart bots, table UI, and multiplayer rooms, playable via agent tools.

description.zh: Workgroup 是 DSH 右侧边栏标签页，以群聊形式实时展示主代理与各子代理正在做什么、当前工具与预计剩余时间，等待你回复的成员置顶提醒。
description.en: Workgroup is a DSH right-sidebar tab that shows, as a live group chat, what the main agent and each subagent are doing right now, their current tool and estimated time left, pinning members that await your reply.

description.zh: dsh-gzip 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 /api 响应 gzip 压缩插件，把动辄十几 MB 的会话历史响应压到 1MB 左右，解决低速网络下历史加载超时失败的问题。
description.en: dsh-gzip is a DSH plugin that gzips /api responses, shrinking multi-megabyte session history payloads to around 1MB so history loads no longer time out on slow or remote links.

description.zh: DSH plugin 事件驱动的任务守护引擎，通过断言规则、纠正检测与编辑审查队列，实时监控会话并注入提醒，守护任务质量。
description.en: Event-driven mission guardian for DeepSeek Harness: assertion rules, correction detection, and review queue with live reminders.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为沙箱外操作提供独立模型驱动的自动审批，内置 Codex Guardian 策略与熔断机制，失败时安全回退人工审批。
description.en: A DSH plugin that provides independent model-backed automatic approval for out-of-sandbox actions, with built-in Codex Guardian policy and circuit breaker, failing closed to human approval.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的自学习习惯引擎：观察纠正信号、阈值判断、两级人工门控，让模型习惯沉淀为记忆。
description.en: A self-learning habit engine for DeepSeek Harness: observes correction signals, judges with threshold, and settles habits behind a two-level human gate.

description.zh: 豪霸模式是一款 DSH plugin，用聊天框旁的金色开关把当前模型的推理强度与输出预算推到上限，并追加工作纪律提示，用更多 token 换取更完整可靠的交付。
description.en: Haoba Mode is a DSH plugin whose gold toggle pushes the current model to its maximum reasoning effort and output budget, adding a strict work-discipline prompt to trade extra tokens for more thorough, reliable results.

description.zh: DSH 插件，在 DeepSeek Harness 会话之间保存/加载开发交接文档，支持确定性脱敏与 Git 状态捕获，延续开发上下文。
description.en: A DSH plugin to save/load development handoff documents between DeepSeek Harness sessions, with deterministic redaction and Git state capture.

description.zh: Happy Reader 是 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端阅读增强插件，可隐藏输入框与上边栏、调节字号字体宽度行距并一键全屏，还能把选中内容与公式复制为 Markdown。
description.en: Happy Reader is a reading-enhancement DSH plugin for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: hide the input box and top bar, tune font size, typeface, width and spacing, toggle fullscreen, and copy selections or formulas as clean Markdown.

description.zh: Happycoding Everyday 是一款 DSH plugin，读取本机会话日志，把每天的编码活动画成 GitHub 风格年度贡献热力图，全程离线、只读。
description.en: Happycoding Everyday is a DSH plugin that reads your local session logs and renders your daily DeepSeek Harness activity as a GitHub-style yearly contribution heatmap, fully offline and read-only.

description.zh: DSH 运行时看护层插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 API 调用失败自动续接重试、工具调用被吞拉回、只输出思考自动重试等自愈能力，并修复资源管理器无响应、新增 pwsh 后台 job 工具。
description.en: A runtime guard layer for DeepSeek Harness that auto-resumes and retries failed API calls, recovers swallowed tool failures, retries thinking-only turns, fixes the unresponsive file explorer, and adds a pwsh-backed background job tool.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 内置本地知识库的 DSH plugin：解析文档、表格与视频，构建实体图谱与 wiki，提供三路检索、文档读回与知识库面板。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness a built-in local knowledge base: parses documents, spreadsheets and videos, builds entity graphs and wiki entries, and offers three-path retrieval, document read-back and a knowledge-base panel.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供基于哈希锚点的文件编辑工具，通过 hashline_read/replace/undo_last_replace 实现不依赖行号的精准编辑与回滚。
description.en: A DSH plugin offering hash-anchored file editing tools, enabling precise line edits and rollback via hashline_read/replace/undo_last_replace without relying on line numbers.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话页头部加一枚余额芯片，经宿主侧 Remote 用你的 API Key 查询 DeepSeek 账户余额，点击跳转充值，悬停可见赠送与充值拆分，Key 不进浏览器。
description.en: Adds a balance chip to the DeepSeek Harness session header: it queries your DeepSeek account balance host-side with your API key, links to top-up on click, and shows bonus vs. paid breakdown on hover — the key never reaches the browser.

description.zh: dsh-hero-custom 是一款 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件，让您在 Web GUI 中自定义新对话首页标题，支持文字、字号、颜色、字体、光效、动态特效及鲸鱼图标等设置，实时预览并自动保存。
description.en: dsh-hero-custom is a DSH plugin that lets you customize the new chat homepage title in the Web GUI, with options for text, size, color, font, glow effects, animations, and the whale icon, featuring real-time preview and auto-save.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供三级文本钉选：选中的原文在上下文压缩后仍能按需召回、常驻背景或高亮约束，确保模型收到的是原文而非摘要。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that pins selected source text at three levels — recall on demand, resident background, or highlighted constraint — so compaction never replaces it with a summary.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 上的 Hindsight 记忆插件补上 bank 路由：把记忆库身份锚定到远程仓库名而非本地目录名，让同一仓库的各个克隆共享同一份团队记忆。
description.en: A DSH plugin that routes Hindsight memory banks by remote repository name instead of local directory name, so every clone of the same repo shares one team memory bank.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 HOI4 1.19.3 Mod 制作技能，可建 Mod、写国策事件、校验并安装进游戏。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness skill bundle that turns the agent into a HOI4 1.19.3 modder: scaffold mods, write focus trees and events, verify and install.

description.zh: 把 hogwarts-loop 的「计划→构建→评审→提交」流程做成 DSH plugin：每个角色由独立子代理在各自可配置模型上执行，并带客户端设置页。
description.en: Packages the hogwarts-loop plan → build → review → commit discipline as a DSH plugin, dispatching each cast member as a subagent on its own configurable model, with a client settings page.

description.zh: 将本机 Codex 与 Claude Code 历史任务以只读镜像单向导入 DeepSeek Harness（DSH），支持预览、增量同步与按工作目录分组。
description.en: Import local Codex and Claude Code history into DeepSeek Harness (DSH) as read-only mirrors, with preview, incremental sync, and workspace grouping.

description.zh: 为 DSH 提供开机自启能力：自动拉起 dsh web 服务，并在插件内管理 home-hosted 面板与受管服务器的启停、编辑与开机项。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings your dsh web server back after every reboot and lets you manage the home-hosted panel, its supervised servers and the OS boot entry from inside dsh.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供宿主侧 macOS 系统通知：提问、审批与回复完成时提醒并点击唤醒窗口，不受渲染层隐藏丢通知影响。
description.en: Host-side macOS notifications for DeepSeek Harness: alerts on questions, approvals and finished replies, with click-to-focus that survives hidden renderers.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框与答案卡片提供可录制的发送、换行、提交热键，配置存于浏览器 localStorage。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds recordable hotkeys for sending, newline, and answer submission in DeepSeek Harness, with settings stored in localStorage.

description.zh: dsh-hot-reload 让 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件升级后无需重启即可热重载，失败自动回滚并提示手动重启，提升开发效率。
description.en: dsh-hot-reload enables live reload of upgraded DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugins without restarting, with safe rollback and restart notification, boosting development efficiency.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 助手注入压力、精力、爽度三项激素状态，随真实会话事件涨落并随时间衰减，仅在越界时向系统提示写入一句话。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness agents three hormone values—stress, energy and reward—driven by real session events and decaying over time, written into the system prompt only when out of range.

description.zh: dsh-hotplug-engine 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供插件安装、卸载、启停、回滚与审计的服务引擎，市场、agent 与宿主插件均可调用。
description.en: dsh-hotplug-engine provides plugin install, uninstall, toggle, rollback, and audit as a service for DeepSeek Harness, callable by market, agents, and host plugins.

description.zh: DSH plugin 运行时热插拔管理器，在 Web 界面中热启用、停用、重启插件，并自动热挂载 bundle，无需重启 dsh web。
description.en: Runtime hot-swap manager for DSH plugins: hot enable/disable/restart plugins and auto hot-mount bundles from the Web GUI, no dsh restart needed.

description.zh: 为 DSH 会话悬浮卡片补上复制会话 ID、工作区路径与可配置指标块的界面增强插件，让原本只能复制标题的卡片真正好用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that upgrades the session hover card with copy-session-ID and copy-workspace-path icons plus a configurable metrics block, replacing the stock copy-the-title behavior.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供本地优先的用量中心，展示 token 用量、成本估算、配额与趋势，并支持编码订阅 OAuth 与可选回环 API 网关。
description.en: A DSH plugin offering a local-first usage center with token usage, cost estimates, quotas, trends, plus coding-subscription OAuth and an optional loopback API gateway.

description.zh: dsh-i-am-rich 是一个 DSH 插件，每次模型请求都真实发送两份并丢弃第二份，再用 provider 报告的 usage 如实统计今日、本月与累计浪费的 Token。
description.en: dsh-i-am-rich is a DSH plugin that genuinely sends every model request twice, discards the second copy, and honestly reports the wasted tokens per day, month and all time using the provider's own usage data.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中不具备作图能力的模型接上外部生图服务，注册 image_generate 与 image_edit 两个工具，支持多服务商、主备模型自动切换，全部在 Web 界面配置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that bridges image-less models to external OpenAI-compatible image services, registering image_generate and image_edit tools with multi-provider support and automatic primary/backup model failover, all configured in the web UI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Qwen-Image 出图与参考图编辑的 DSH plugin，自带受管本地运行时，无需 ComfyUI 即可跑，也支持 ComfyUI 与官方 API。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for Qwen-Image generation and reference-image editing, with a managed local runtime that runs without ComfyUI, plus ComfyUI and official API backends.

description.zh: DSH 侧栏框选标注插件：在右侧栏拖框圈选内容、逐块写注释，一次性作为一条消息发给 Agent，并附带宿主端冻结截图与坐标，便于精确裁剪。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets you marquee-select regions in the right sidebar, annotate each one, and send them as a single message with a host-side freeze-frame and coordinates for precise cropping.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边栏绘画页与全局图库的 DSH 生图插件，支持对话中直接生图改图，并可自定义服务商端点与代理。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that adds a sidebar painting page and global gallery, letting the agent generate and edit images in chat with custom provider endpoints and proxies.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面换上自定义图片皮肤：可替换窗口背景、侧边栏等大区域，支持 GIF 与循环视频，还能贴可拖拽贴纸。
description.en: An image skin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: replace large regions like the window backdrop and sidebar with your own images, GIFs or looping videos, plus draggable stickers.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 image2_generate 工具，接入你自己的 OpenAI 兼容图片中转站，支持文生图与参考图改图，并在对话中内联预览。
description.en: Adds an image2_generate tool to DeepSeek Harness that calls your own OpenAI-compatible image relay for text-to-image and reference-image edits, with inline previews in chat.

description.zh: DSH 插件：聊天发图自动交给视觉模型分析，把文本描述悄悄喂给纯文本主模型，聊天记录保持原图显示。
description.en: DSH plugin: automatically sends chat images to a vision model, feeds the text description to the text-only main model, keeping original images in chat history.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话注册 /ws 本地文件路由，让 markdown 直接渲染磁盘任意位置的图片与文件，跨盘符、中文路径、NAS 均可显示。
description.en: A DSH plugin that registers a /ws local-file route in dsh web, letting session markdown render images and files from any disk location — any drive, Chinese paths, or NAS shares.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入文生图能力的 DSH plugin：模型可直接调用 generate_image 画图并显示在对话中，输入框按钮还能实时修改接口、模型与 API Key，无需重启。
