description.en: A DSH plugin that brings text-to-image to DeepSeek Harness: the model calls generate_image and images render inline, while an in-composer button lets you edit endpoint, model and API key live without restarting.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供图像分块能力：上传超大截图或文档时先切成多块再送入模型，避免被框架压缩后小字丢失，让模型按原始分辨率读清文字。
description.en: A DSH plugin that tiles oversized images before admission, so DeepSeek Harness sends each region at its own resolution and the model can actually read small text in large screenshots or documents.

description.zh: DSH plugin 一键迁移 Claude Code / Cursor / Codex / cc-switch 的 MCP 服务器与技能到 DeepSeek Harness，在设置页提供可视化导入界面，支持预演与备份。
description.en: A DSH plugin that migrates MCP servers and Skills from Claude Code / Cursor / Codex / cc-switch into DeepSeek Harness with a visual import UI, preview, and backup.

description.zh: DSH 应急证据包插件，自查应急预案、应急联系人、日志证据保全与事件上报流程，帮你在出事前备齐可拿得出的合规证据。
description.en: A DSH plugin that audits incident-response readiness — emergency plans, on-call contacts, tamper-proof log preservation and reporting workflows — so you have evidence before an incident hits.

description.zh: 一只住在 DSH 窗口里的 INFJ 贤者桌宠，会随 Agent 工作、等待与休息切换六种像素姿态，可点击、拖拽并记住位置。
description.en: A pixel-art INFJ sage companion that lives inside your DeepSeek Harness window, switching between six poses as your agents work, wait or rest — clickable, draggable and position-aware.

description.zh: dsh-img 为 DeepSeek Harness 纯文本模型装上眼睛，提供图片问答、OCR、裁剪、像素比对等本地视觉工具链，支持免费 GLM-4V-Flash 等多后端回退。
description.en: dsh-img gives text-only DeepSeek Harness models eyes with image Q&A, OCR, and local pixel tools, supporting free GLM-4V-Flash and multi-backend failover.

description.zh: 文房四宝 · Inkstone 是 DSH plugin 组合包，串联 Trilium 笔记、Zotero 文献、Typst 排版与联合流水线，一键完成文献收集、排版与归档。
description.en: Inkstone is a DSH plugin bundle that chains Trilium Notes, Zotero, Typst typesetting and a joint pipeline to take literature from collection to typeset PDF and archive.

description.zh: DSH plugin 安装前的自动体检：静态读取候选插件代码，比对已装插件的工具名、服务键与 peerDependencies，只在真冲突或缺依赖时提醒，不拦截安装。
description.en: A pre-install health check for DSH plugins: it statically reads the candidate package and compares tool names, service keys and peerDependencies against installed plugins, warning only on real collisions or missing deps without blocking installs.

description.zh: DSH plugin 实时改写你的提问，停下约 2 秒自动优化措辞，保留代码网址原文，让 AI 更懂你。
description.en: A DSH plugin that rewrites your prompts in real time, auto-improving phrasing after a 2-second pause while preserving code and URLs.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 输入框补上终端式输入历史：↑/↓ 直接翻查本会话已发消息，/history 提供可搜索面板，纯客户端、按会话隔离。
description.en: Adds terminal-style input history to the DeepSeek Harness web composer: browse this session's sent messages with ↑/↓, or open a searchable /history panel. Pure client-side and isolated per session.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化 Bash 终端，模型与用户共享同一 PTY，可在 xterm.js 面板中接管模型启动的交互程序。
description.en: Persistent Bash terminals for DeepSeek Harness: the model and user share one PTY, and you can take over model-started interactive programs in an xterm.js panel.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 文档预览面板提供 Jupyter .ipynb 渲染，代码高亮、离线 LaTeX 公式与可缩放图片一应俱全，不再显示原始 JSON。
description.en: A DSH plugin that renders Jupyter .ipynb notebooks in the document preview pane with syntax highlighting, offline LaTeX math, and zoomable figures instead of raw JSON.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为远程浏览器提供设置修改与 Let's Encrypt IP 证书自动 HTTPS，无需域名和 nginx。
description.en: DSH plugin enables remote settings editing and automatic HTTPS with Let's Encrypt IP certificates, no domain or nginx needed.

description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的模型回答不再只是文字，而是直接生成可操作的交互界面，滑块、输入框、图表一应俱全，本地实时重算，沙箱运行更安全。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets the model answer with an operable interface instead of plain text — sliders, inputs, tabs and charts that recalculate locally inside a sandbox.

description.zh: Ivory 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供温暖中性色调的 Claude 风格主题，支持明暗模式与移动端，零遥测、零运行时依赖，让对话界面更安静易读。
description.en: Ivory is a calm, warm-neutral Claude-inspired theme for DeepSeek Harness, with light/dark modes and mobile support, zero telemetry and zero runtime dependencies for a quieter reading experience.

description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的模型回答不再只是文字，而是直接生成可操作的交互界面，滑块、输入框、图表一应俱全，本地实时重算，沙箱运行更安全。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets the model answer with an operable interface instead of plain text — sliders, inputs, tabs and charts that recalculate locally inside a sandbox.

description.zh: 把 Jenkins CI/CD 接入 DeepSeek Harness：AI 可直接触发构建、查日志、跟踪状态，并提供右侧栏可视化面板与失败自动分析。
description.en: Brings Jenkins CI/CD into DeepSeek Harness: AI-invocable build triggers, log queries and status tracking, plus a right-sidebar panel and automatic build-failure analysis.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 引入 Jev 类型化决策做子代理派发：先判定任务类别，再按路由策略推荐由哪个廉价子代理模型接手，从而压低主模型 token 成本。
description.en: A DSH plugin that uses Jev typed decisions to classify each task and recommend which cheap subagent model route should take it, cutting main-model token costs.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 引入 Jev 决策模型：以类型化问答返回带校准概率的答案，并提供风险与循环自动守卫及可审计的验证基准。
description.en: Brings Jev's System One decision model to DeepSeek Harness: typed answers with calibrated probabilities, plus an auditable auto-guard for risk and loop checks.

description.zh: 让 TypeSafe 的 Jev 判断每条提示词需要多深的思考，并把结果写入模型请求的 reasoningEffort，为 DeepSeek Harness 自动匹配推理等级。
description.en: Asks TypeSafe's Jev how deep each prompt needs to think and applies that level to the model request's reasoningEffort in DeepSeek Harness.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Jujutsu (jj) 一等支持的 DSH plugin：自动识别 jj 仓库、注入优先用 jj 的上下文，并提供 13 个 jj_* 原生工具与防误用 git 的守卫。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness first-class Jujutsu (jj) support: it detects jj repositories, injects prefer-jj context, and ships 13 native jj_* tools plus a guard against mutating git commands.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供 Jujutsu 历史面板，直接读取 jj，展示变更图、详情与 diff，并支持 rebase、squash 等原生操作。
description.en: A Jujutsu history panel for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI that reads jj directly, showing the change graph, details and diffs, with native rebase, squash and split actions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话头部的后台任务列表加上停止按钮：悬停运行中的任务行即可点击停止，并在确认弹窗中复核完整命令后终止该任务。
description.en: Adds a stop control to the DeepSeek Harness session-header background-job list: hover a running row, click stop, and confirm in a dialog that restates the full command before the job is killed.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入本地 Joplin 笔记的 DSH 插件，支持搜索、全文读取、创建笔记与笔记本、导入 Markdown 及反向链接，默认只读、零运行时依赖。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects DeepSeek Harness to your local Joplin notes, enabling search, full-text reading, note and notebook creation, Markdown import and backlinks, read-only by default with zero runtime dependencies.

description.zh: 随记（Jot）是 DeepSeek Harness 里的本地笔记插件，可直接写笔记、待办与轻文档，支持搜索、表格、附件与导出，并可选择性让 agent 协作维护。
description.en: Jot is a local-first notes plugin for DeepSeek Harness: write notes, todos and light documents with search, tables, attachments and export, plus optional agent collaboration.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供结构化批量判断能力：一次调用提交一批命名问题，返回 choice、score、是/否概率等校准结果，并带严格校验、审计账本与计量。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness structured batched judgment: send one state with many named questions and get calibrated choice, score, and yes/no probabilities, with strict validation, an audit ledger, and metering.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一键快速对话入口，点击即在独立工作目录中开启原生会话，免去手动选择工作区。
description.en: Adds a one-click quick-chat entry to DeepSeek Harness, opening a native session in its own workspace without manually picking a directory.

description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 在 Jujutsu 工作区中改用 jj：拦截会误导的 Git 命令并给出对应 jj 命令，内置十一个 jj 工具。
description.en: Makes DeepSeek Harness jj-native inside Jujutsu workspaces: it refuses misleading Git commands and returns the matching jj command, plus eleven built-in jj tools.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 聊天区加两个浮动按钮，一键回到本轮提问开头或最新输出结尾，长回答也能从头读。
description.en: Adds two floating buttons to the DSH Web chat area, letting you jump back to the start of the current question or to the latest output with one click.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 换上宫崎骏《起风了》主题：晴空电影壁纸、天蓝毛玻璃界面、自绘红翼飞机徽标与主题化输入卡文案，一条 dsh plugin 命令即可安装还原。
description.en: A Studio Ghibli "The Wind Rises" theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: sky-blue glassmorphism surfaces, cinematic wallpaper, hand-drawn vector logos and themed input placeholders, installed with a single dsh plugin command.

description.zh: 为 DSH 提供密钥保险箱：在设置页集中管理 API key，注入 shell 的 $DSH_* 变量，密钥值永不进入模型上下文。
description.en: A secret store for DSH: manage API keys in a settings panel, inject them into the shell as $DSH_* variables, and keep values out of the model's context.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供密钥与证书轮换合规检查：按文件时间戳识别超期未换的密钥、缺失的轮换制度与跨环境复用风险。
description.en: A DSH plugin that audits key and certificate rotation compliance, flagging stale secrets by file mtime, missing rotation policies, and cross-environment reuse.

description.zh: DSH 会话输入框的极简输入历史插件，空输入框时按 ↑/↓ 翻阅已发送消息，仅此而已。
description.en: A minimal input history plugin for DSH session input box: press ↑/↓ to browse sent messages when empty.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 回复自动添加日式颜文字的 DSH 插件，通过提示词注入让模型按情绪从精选词库原样复制颜文字，支持频率与位置配置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds Japanese kaomoji to DeepSeek Harness replies via prompt injection, letting the model copy curated kaomoji by emotion with configurable frequency and placement.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 内置 web_search 提供免密钥搜索后端，通过 Tavily 与 Firecrawl 的无账号通道直接可用，无需 API Key 或额外配置。
description.en: Gives the DeepSeek Harness built-in web_search a keyless backend via Tavily and Firecrawl no-account access, working with no API key or configuration.

description.zh: 把单个提供商 API key 扩展为可管理的密钥池，为 DSH plugin 提供轮询选键、失败重试与自动切换、冷却恢复，并内置 34 个额外 LLM 提供商。
description.en: Turns one provider API key into a managed pool for DeepSeek Harness, adding round-robin selection, retry with automatic failover, cooldown recovery, and 34 extra built-in LLM providers.

description.zh: DSH 插件：给收到的文件打可回溯的体检得分，从表达、执行、决策三维审查 AI 垃圾与工作空转，并逐条机器复核引文原文。
description.en: A DSH plugin that scores incoming documents for AI slop and work slop across expression, execution and decision dimensions, with machine-verified quotes for every finding.

description.zh: dsh-knj-menu 是 DeepSeek Harness 的第三方菜单管理器，统一收纳插件菜单入口，支持常驻、折叠与固定置顶，让界面更整洁高效。
description.en: dsh-knj-menu is a third-party menu manager for DeepSeek Harness, collecting plugin menu entries with fold/collapse and pinned items for a cleaner UI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地 Markdown 知识库的 DSH 插件，支持混合检索、PDF/Office 导入、MCP 服务与加密多用户访问。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness a local Markdown knowledge base with hybrid retrieval, PDF/Office import, an MCP server, and encrypted multi-user access.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 kubectl 安全闸门：按 kubeconfig context 判断，非本地集群的不可逆操作直接拒绝，可恢复写入先询问，读取与本地集群不受影响。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness policy plugin that gates kubectl by kubeconfig context: irreversible verbs on non-local clusters are denied, recoverable writes ask first, reads and local clusters pass untouched.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话知识库：ctx.knowledge 服务与 knowledge_* 工具，基于 SQLite FTS5 trigram 实现中文子串检索与 L1 查询扩展。
description.en: Cross-session knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: a ctx.knowledge service plus knowledge_* tools, backed by SQLite FTS5 trigram CJK substring search with L1 query expansion.

description.zh: DSH plugin 桌面宠物插件，在 Web 界面右下角显示小坤宠，随 Agent 工作状态切换动作，任务完成时播放「你干嘛~哎哟」语音。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a desktop pet to the bottom-right of the web UI, switching animations based on agent status and playing a voice line when tasks complete.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的鲸鱼娘桌面宠物 DSH 插件，在 Windows 桌面悬浮陪伴，并以九种动画响应 Agent 的工作、审批与完成状态。
description.en: A whale-girl desktop pet DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that floats on your Windows desktop and reacts to Agent work, approval and completion states with nine animations.

description.zh: dsh-laa 为每个 DSH 会话加一个 LAA 开关：DeepSeek 峰时自动停住不发模型请求，谷时再续跑，帮用户把长任务挪到低价时段。
description.en: dsh-laa adds a per-session LAA switch to DeepSeek Harness: it halts runs during DeepSeek peak hours without sending any model request, then resumes them in off-peak windows.

description.zh: dsh-langfuse 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Langfuse LLM 可观测性，将每个 Agent 会话映射为 OpenTelemetry 追踪树，支持反馈评分与子代理血缘追踪。
description.en: dsh-langfuse brings Langfuse LLM observability to DeepSeek Harness, mapping each agent session to an OpenTelemetry trace tree with feedback scores and subagent lineage.

description.zh: DSH plugin 服务管理插件，在独立 broker 进程中监督长驻服务，使 dev server、watcher 等跨会话持续运行，对话结束后不中断。
description.en: A DSH plugin that supervises long-running services in a detached broker process, keeping dev servers, watchers, etc. alive across sessions and after conversations end.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在会话停止工作（等待交互、出错、完成、阻塞、退避、停滞或进程死亡）时，通过 lark-cli 实时发送飞书/Lark 通知，确保每次停止都必达。
description.en: A DSH plugin that sends real-time Feishu/Lark notifications via lark-cli whenever a session stops working—waiting for input, error, completion, blocked, backoff, stalled, or process death—ensuring every stop is notified.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供护眼绿叶皮肤，在官方主题上叠加浅翠绿与深薄荷两套配色，自动适配明暗模式。
description.en: An eye-friendly leafy skin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, layering light emerald and dark mint palettes over the official theme and adapting to light, dark, or system mode.

description.zh: 跑在 DeepSeek Harness 输入区的学习插件，把收集、提炼、关联、升级、沉淀、复用做成带交互引导与审核入库的运行时能力。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin living in the input area that turns collect, distill, relate, upgrade, settle and reuse into a guided runtime workflow with review before any write.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供最小权限检查的 DSH 插件，扫描容器 root/privileged、IAM 通配、CORS 全开与令牌申请 admin 等过宽配置，在入侵前暴露权限放大器。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that audits least-privilege violations—container root/privileged, wildcard IAM, wide-open CORS, and admin-scope tokens—surfacing over-broad permissions before they amplify a breach.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供技能打包盒：把相关技能归入一个根技能，按需加载子技能，避免目录膨胀与上下文污染。
description.en: A DSH plugin that groups related skills into bundle boxes: one root skill exposes sub-skills loaded on demand, cutting catalog bloat and context pollution.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页会话栏添加 Codex 风格左侧消息导航轨，支持悬停透镜、滚动高亮与点击跳转，提升长对话浏览效率。
description.en: Adds a Codex-style left message navigation rail to the DeepSeek Harness web conversation column, with lens hover, scroll-spy highlight, and click-to-jump for efficient long-conversation browsing.

description.zh: DSH 插件 dsh-license-guard 扫描依赖树，揪出 GPL/AGPL 传染与许可未知风险，发布或开源前几秒跑一遍，退出码可直接挂 CI。
description.en: A DSH plugin that scans your dependency tree for GPL/AGPL copyleft contagion and unknown licenses, giving a few-second compliance check before release with CI-friendly exit codes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生工作区界面与外观体验模块，包含左侧菜单、主工作区、会话标签页、右侧面板与设置，主题与动效可逆投影。
description.en: A native DSH plugin that adds workspace surfaces and an appearance experience module to DeepSeek Harness, covering the left menu, main workspace, Session tab, right pane and Settings with reversible theme and motion projection.

description.zh: 星辰会议室让分散在不同会话、彼此看不见的 AI 坐进同一间房开会：主持人开房定题、按序邀请成员逐一发言，轮次用满即收会出纪要，是 DSH plugin 中的跨会话协作方案。
description.en: LittleStar Meeting Room is a DSH plugin that brings isolated AI sessions into one room: a host opens the room, sets the topic, invites members to speak in turn, and closes with written minutes.

description.zh: 琉璃为 DeepSeek Harness 带来 M3 动态取色与壁纸磨砂主题，并附声纹可视化、右侧栏、内嵌浏览器等界面增强。
description.en: Liuli gives DeepSeek Harness an M3 dynamic-color, frosted-wallpaper theme plus voiceprint visualization, a right sidebar and an embedded browser.

description.zh: DSH Live 是 DeepSeek Harness 的移动端伴侣插件，让你在手机上审批或拒绝 Agent 的敏感操作，无需守在电脑前。
description.en: DSH Live is a mobile companion plugin for DeepSeek Harness, letting you approve or reject sensitive agent actions from your phone without staying at your desktop.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 AutoRouter 网关接入 DeepSeek Harness，统一路由、故障转移与模型发现，让所有模型调用经由 AutoRouter 而非直连上游。
description.en: DSH plugin integrates AutoRouter gateway into DeepSeek Harness, providing unified routing, failover, and model discovery for all model calls.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供版本钉选的实时库文档：写代码前自动拉取项目所装版本的官方文档注入上下文，消灭幻觉 API，零配置零 Key。
description.en: Version-pinned live library docs for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): before writing code it pulls the official docs matching your installed version into context to kill hallucinated APIs, with zero config and no API key.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Kiro 模型提供商，自动复用 kiro-cli 凭证并静默刷新，通过 AWS SSO 协议调用模型。
description.en: A Kiro provider for DeepSeek Harness, reusing kiro-cli credentials with silent refresh and calling models over AWS SSO protocol.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 LLM 准入管制：按 provider 限流排队、限流后冷却自愈，并支持 provider 与单模型两级隐藏。
description.en: Adds LLM admission control to DeepSeek Harness: per-provider queueing, cooldown-based self-healing, and two-level provider/model hiding.

description.zh: DSH plugin 模型提供方故障转移插件：遇限流或配额耗尽自动切换备用提供方，支持按提供方配置模型、冷却与永久兜底，并在界面显示切换提示。
description.en: A DSH plugin for provider failover: automatically switches to the next provider on rate-limit or quota errors, with per-provider model mapping, cooldown, and a permanent fallback.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 xAI Grok 订阅 OAuth 登录与 Web 配置界面，支持模型选择、思考强度与订阅用量展示。
description.en: Adds xAI Grok subscription OAuth and web configuration to DeepSeek Harness, with model selection, thinking effort, and usage display.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Kimi K3 模型连接器，注册 kimi-code 路由的 LlmAdapter，支持流式对话与图像输入。
description.en: A Kimi K3 connector plugin for DeepSeek Harness, registering a kimi-code LlmAdapter with streaming and image input support.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为自定义网关（vLLM/LM Studio/自托管 OpenAI 代理）提供 OpenAI-completions 兼容适配器，正确处理 system 角色与思考格式，避免 400 错误。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing an OpenAI-completions-compatible adapter for custom gateways (vLLM/LM Studio/self-hosted OpenAI proxies), correctly handling system role and thinking formats to avoid 400 errors.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自维护 pi-ai 适配层，接管模型选择器与服务商设置页，支持余额配额查询、供应商增删测试与模型能力徽标。
description.en: A DSH plugin that ships a self-maintained pi-ai bridge, taking over the model selector and provider settings page with quota lookups, provider management and capability badges.

description.zh: 把 OpenCode Go 接入 DeepSeek Harness 作为原生模型提供商，自动发现模型、支持三种协议与工具调用，并在侧边栏展示订阅配额。
description.en: Serves OpenCode Go as a native DeepSeek Harness model provider with model discovery, three wire protocols, tool calling, and subscription quota shown in the sidebar.

description.zh: dsh-llmasking 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供传输层数据脱敏，模型只见占位符，会话日志与界面实时还原真实值，保护隐私。
description.en: dsh-llmasking provides transport-layer data masking for DeepSeek Harness: the model sees placeholders while real values are restored live in the stream.

description.zh: dsh-llmwiki 是 DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先、源链接 Markdown wiki 存储与检索插件，提供确定性存储、检索与结构完整性检查。
description.en: dsh-llmwiki is a local-first, source-linked Markdown wiki storage and retrieval plugin for DeepSeek Harness, providing deterministic storage, retrieval, and structural-integrity checks.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上桌面版缺失的代理支持：自动发现本机 HTTP 代理（环境变量或 Windows 系统代理），让 agent 的 web_fetch 与子进程都走代理。
description.en: A DSH plugin that fills the Desktop proxy gap: it discovers this machine's HTTP proxy (env vars or the Windows system proxy) and makes DeepSeek Harness route the agent's web_fetch and child processes through it.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 Web GUI 中“Deep diving...”运行状态替换为轮换的趣味短语与实用提示，保留原有效果与计时，并支持设置面板自定义。
description.en: A DSH plugin that replaces the "Deep diving..." running status in the Web GUI with rotating witty phrases and practical tips, preserving the original effect and timer, with a settings panel for customization.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供西班牙语语言包，通过官方 locale 注册接口把 Español 加入设置的语言列表，未翻译键自动回退英文。
description.en: A community DSH plugin that adds Spanish (es) to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI via the official locale registry, with untranslated keys falling back to English.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面与桌面应用提供韩语语言包，安装后设置中新增「한국어」，菜单、按钮、提示与报错信息全部显示为韩语。
description.en: A Korean language pack for the DeepSeek Harness web UI and desktop app, adding 한국어 to the language list so menus, buttons, hints and error messages all render in Korean.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让 ctx.logger 日志可见：聊天内 /logs 命令查看历史，stderr 实时导出警告与错误，支持过滤与配置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that makes ctx.logger output visible: a /logs chat command for history and a stderr exporter for live warnings and errors, with filters and config.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供运行时日志面板，在设置页实时 SSE 展示日志，并持久化为按日期和大小轮转的 JSONL 文件。
description.en: Runtime log panel for DeepSeek Harness: live SSE log view in Settings plus bounded date/size rotating JSONL files.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话长期记忆与自进化学习能力，基于 SQLite 与 FTS5 实现混合检索、自动提取与规则注入。
description.en: Long-term cross-session memory and self-evolving learning plugin for DeepSeek Harness, with SQLite-backed hybrid recall and rule injection.

description.zh: dsh-loupe 是 DSH 划词解释浮窗插件：选中对话里的词句即弹窗流式讲解，不建会话、不污染主会话，可留档并保存成正式会话。
description.en: dsh-loupe is a DSH plugin that explains any selected word or sentence in a floating window with streaming answers, without creating sessions or polluting the main conversation, and can be archived or saved as a real session.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地优先的长期记忆：SQLite 存储、中文友好分词检索、去重与过期复审，并支持从 dsh-memory 一键迁移。
description.en: Local-first long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: a SQLite store with CJK-aware tokenized search, near-duplicate detection, expiry review, and one-command migration from dsh-memory.

description.zh: DSH plugin 注册 Luna Vision Bridge provider，将原生图片附件经 Codex Luna 转写为文字后交给任意纯文本下游模型，让 DSH 输入框沿用图片交互。
description.en: A DSH plugin registering a Luna Vision Bridge provider that transcribes native image attachments via Codex Luna into text before delegating to any text-only downstream model, preserving native image interactions.

description.zh: 通过 DSH plugin 用本地命令与自然语言操控 maa-cli 完成《明日方舟》日常，日常操作零模型调用，复杂需求才交给模型生成计划。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that drives maa-cli for Arknights dailies via local commands and natural language, with zero model calls for routine tasks and model-built plans only for complex requests.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生 macOS 通知，支持事件专属声音、过滤、合并与 Web 设置页，让任务状态一目了然。
description.en: Native macOS notifications for DeepSeek Harness with event-specific sounds, filtering, coalescing, and a Web settings page.

description.zh: DSH plugin 薄桥接层，将 Govard 工作区/项目工具注册为 DeepSeek Harness 会话工具，支持环境启停、容器命令、数据库转储与调试配置。
description.en: A thin DSH plugin bridge exposing Govard workspace/project tooling as registered tools in DeepSeek Harness sessions, covering environment up/down, container commands, DB dumps, and debug config.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话持久记忆与待办管理，支持全局/用户/项目/关键/每日五轨，确认门控写入与 Git 同步，原地采用 ~/.dsh/memories。
description.en: Provides durable cross-session memory and todos for DeepSeek Harness, with five tracks (global/user/project/key/daily), confirmation-gated writes, Git-backed sync, and in-place adoption of ~/.dsh/memories.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可插拔通知服务，内置 Telegram 传输，支持注册与发送消息，永不抛错。
description.en: Pluggable notifier service for DeepSeek Harness with Telegram transport, never-throw delivery.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通过 Cloudflare 隧道和代理实现 DeepSeek Harness 的远程访问，支持 PIN 认证和 Telegram 通知。
description.en: DSH plugin enabling remote access to DeepSeek Harness via Cloudflare tunnel and proxy, with PIN auth and Telegram notifications.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可插拔的合并请求审查流水线，集成 GitLab 与 GitHub，自动审查代码并生成审查结果。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing a pluggable merge-request review pipeline for DeepSeek Harness, integrating GitLab and GitHub to automate code review and generate findings.

description.zh: DSH 会话管理插件，在侧栏原生界面提供批量归档、恢复与永久删除，卡死会话两段式强停，工作区行一键复制绝对路径，零配置开箱即用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds native sidebar session management: batch archive, restore and permanent delete, two-stage force-stop for stuck sessions, and one-click workspace absolute path copy.

description.zh: 把自托管 Magpie 网关接入 DeepSeek Harness，作为单一模型提供商路由，支持多线路自动故障切换、按上游分组模型、只读用量卡片与会话级快速模式。
description.en: Connects a self-hosted Magpie gateway to DeepSeek Harness as a single LLM provider route, with multi-line failover, upstream-grouped models, read-only usage cards and per-session fast mode.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页聊天补上 LaTeX 渲染：自己发出的消息气泡内 $...$、$$...$$ 等公式就地显示，输入框草稿含公式时上方实时预览。
description.en: A DSH plugin that renders LaTeX in the DeepSeek Harness web chat: formulas inside your own message bubble plus a live preview strip for the composer draft.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 打造的 Matrix 深夜护眼暗色皮肤，近黑绿背景配墨绿等宽字体，低透明度数字雨营造氛围，纯前端零依赖。
description.en: A Matrix-style dark skin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, featuring near-black green background, ink-green monospace text, and low-opacity digital rain; pure front-end with zero dependencies.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可选的高中数学思维老师 Agent 预设，以诊断优先的引导式教学带学生逐步推理，普通会话能力不受影响。
description.en: A selectable high-school math thinking-teacher Agent preset for DeepSeek Harness, guiding learners step by step with diagnosis-first tutoring while ordinary sessions stay unchanged.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供数学排版工具：把 LaTeX 公式渲染成无字体依赖的 SVG/PNG 图片，按声明式规格绘制几何图形，并生成可直接嵌入文档的图片与 Markdown、HTML、LaTeX 片段。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives the agent math typesetting tools: render LaTeX formulas into font-free SVG/PNG images, draw geometric figures from a declarative spec, and emit embeddable snippets for Markdown, HTML and LaTeX documents.

description.zh: DSH 插件：16 型 MBTI 人格评审团并排评审你最近一次 commit，同一份 diff 给出 16 种看见世界的方式，还支持互怼环节。
description.en: A DSH plugin that convenes a 16-type MBTI jury to review your latest commit side by side — one diff, sixteen ways of seeing the world, with an optional rebuttal round.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 MCP 服务器接入 DeepSeek Harness，以单一 mcp 代理工具按需调用，避免上下文窗口被大量 schema 占用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects MCP servers to DeepSeek Harness via a single mcp proxy tool with on-demand calls, avoiding context window bloat from schemas.

description.zh: dsh-mcp-link 是 DSH plugin，集中扫描 Cursor、Claude Code 等客户端的本机 MCP 配置，图形化一键接入当前 profile。
description.en: dsh-mcp-link is a DSH plugin that scans local MCP configs from Cursor, Claude Code and other clients, then links selected servers into the current profile with a GUI.

description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中一键导入 Claude Desktop、Cursor、VS Code 等来源的 MCP 配置，写入前自动做安全审查与风险提示，并管理已装 MCP 服务器。
description.en: A DSH plugin that imports MCP configs from Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, YAML or web pages, runs a safety review before writing, and manages installed MCP servers in Settings.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 MCP 服务器管理：在 Web 设置页或 Agent 工具中增删改启停并测试 stdio 与 Streamable HTTP 服务器，运行时热生效无需重启 DSH。
description.en: MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness: add, edit, enable, test and remove stdio or Streamable HTTP MCP servers from the Web settings page or agent tools, taking effect at runtime with no DSH restart.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 MCP 服务器接入 DeepSeek Harness，以单一 mcp 代理工具按需调用，避免上下文窗口被大量 schema 占用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects MCP servers to DeepSeek Harness via a single mcp proxy tool with on-demand calls, avoiding context window bloat from schemas.

description.zh: DSH Uni Editor 将 MCP Apps 编辑器统一接入 DeepSeek Harness 对话，保留编辑器自身 UI 与工具，实现人机编辑的可验证交接。
description.en: DSH Uni Editor brings MCP Apps editors into DeepSeek Harness chat, preserving their UI and tools with verifiable human-agent handoff.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 审计 MCP 配置的安全插件，揪出 npx -y 未锁版本、明文 http 端点与本地可执行服务，降低供应链投毒风险。
description.en: A security plugin for DeepSeek Harness that audits MCP configs for unpinned npx -y packages, plaintext http endpoints and local executables, cutting supply-chain poisoning risk.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供「设置 → 侧栏」MCP 客户端管理面板，可列出、添加、改写、启停与删除 MCP 服务器行，点保存才写盘且无需重启宿主。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds an MCP client panel under Settings → Sidebar, letting you list, add, edit, enable/disable and delete MCP server rows — written to disk only on save, no host restart.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 MCP 服务器设置页，在 Web UI 里用 JSON 编辑器增删改服务器，保存即挂载 mcp-client 实例并注册工具，无需重启或手改 YAML。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds an MCP servers settings page to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: edit servers as JSON and each saved entry mounts a live mcp-client whose tools register instantly, with no restart or hand-edited YAML.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 MCP 极简管理设置页，列出当前 DSH 实际装载的全部 MCP 服务器及其简介与状态，并可逐个停用或恢复。
description.en: A minimal MCP manager for DeepSeek Harness: a Settings page listing every MCP server the DSH actually loads, with summaries and live state, letting you disable or restore each one.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设置页提供 MCP Servers 管理面板，可新增、编辑、启停 MCP 服务器，并自动把发现的 MCP 工具注册为 DSH 原生工具供对话调用。
description.en: Adds an MCP Servers panel to DeepSeek Harness settings for adding, editing and toggling MCP servers, and auto-registers discovered MCP tools as native DSH tools for use in conversations.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供 Minecraft 主题皮肤，含 6 套主题、像素图标与方块装饰，一键切换主界面风格。
description.en: Minecraft-themed skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, offering 6 themes, pixel-art icons, and block decorations to restyle the main interface.

description.zh: DSH plugin 组合包，在 Web 设置中管理 MCP 服务器：启停、状态监控、表单/JSON 编辑与凭据引用。
description.en: A DSH plugin bundle that manages MCP servers from Web Settings: start/stop, status polling, Form/JSON editing, and credential references.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web/Desktop 增强 Markdown 阅读体验的 DSH plugin：代码块卡片、Mermaid 图形渲染与导出、表格吸顶复制、长内容折叠及显示设置面板。
description.en: A DSH plugin that enhances Markdown reading in DeepSeek Harness Web/Desktop with code block cards, Mermaid rendering and export, sticky table headers with copy, long-content folding, and a display settings panel.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 增加「文档」标签页，把工作区变成可浏览、可跳转、可编辑的轻量 Obsidian，支持双链直达、PDF 跳页与多格式预览。
description.en: Adds a Documents tab to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, turning the workspace into a browsable, linkable, editable lightweight Obsidian with wikilink jumps, PDF page anchors and multi-format previews.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可悬浮/停靠的多标签 Markdown 预览面板及 md_preview 工具，会话中一键预览报告。
description.en: A DSH plugin offering a floatable/dockable multi-tab Markdown preview panel and md_preview tool for one-click report preview in conversations.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册 /media 路由，把工作区图片与文件直接渲染进对话，让 Agent 能展示截图而无需你翻本地文件。
description.en: A DSH plugin that registers a /media route on the GUI's own web server, rendering workspace images and files straight into the chat so the agent can show screenshots without you digging through local files.

description.zh: DSH Medals 是 DeepSeek Harness 的趣味奖牌插件，读取本机会话 token 用量，按规则颁发 25 枚可旋转的 3D 奖牌并陈列于奖牌馆。
description.en: A playful DSH plugin that reads local session token usage and awards 25 collectible 3D medals, displayed in a rotatable medal gallery.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 OpenRouter 的图像、视频与语音生成能力封装为工具，支持图片内联展示与音频转写，无需修改 Harness 核心。
description.en: A DSH plugin exposing OpenRouter image, video, and speech generation as tools, with inline image display and audio transcription, no harness fork required.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化、可搜索的项目记忆：决策、规则与会话上下文存入 DuckDB，规则注入每次模型请求，并提供 Web 管理界面。
description.en: Persistent, searchable per-project memory for DeepSeek Harness: decisions, rules, and session context in DuckDB, with rules injected into every model request and a full management UI.

description.zh: DSH 记忆拟合插件让 Agent 先立靶子再提问：预判 3-5 个意图方向，分批追问并实时展示收敛过程，确认后才动手，避免空转返工。
description.en: A DSH plugin for intent fitting: the agent proposes 3-5 candidate directions, asks in batches, shows how they converge, and only acts after you confirm.

description.zh: DSH plugin 记忆搬家：将 Claude / ChatGPT 历史记忆导入 DeepSeek Harness，逐字证据由代码核对，你逐条批准，全程本地。
description.en: DSH plugin to migrate Claude & ChatGPT memory into DeepSeek Harness with machine-verified verbatim evidence and per-item approval, fully local.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久记忆：自动保留已完成对话、按当前问题召回事实与偏好，并支持可选语义向量与本地实体共现图。
description.en: A persistent memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness that auto-retains finished conversations, recalls facts and preferences for the current question, and supports optional semantic vectors plus a local entity co-occurrence graph.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原文全量记忆引擎的 DSH plugin：对话逐字落盘 SQLite，按坐标溯源回读，按需检索不吞 token。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness a verbatim memory engine: every turn is stored word-for-word in SQLite, retrievable by coordinate on demand without inflating tokens.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 长篇 RP 与陪伴对话提供本地优先记忆：三层记忆会淡忘、来源可追溯、矛盾待审，可选 MemU 向量引擎。
description.en: A local-first memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness long-form RP and companion chats: fading three-layer memory, traceable provenance, pending contradictions, with an optional MemU vector engine.

description.zh: 让 DSH 在开发对话中默认输出 Mermaid 图表：注入提示引导、提供 mermaid_validate 语法校验与输出安全闸，并把图表版本化存入 Mermaid Vault。
description.en: Makes DeepSeek Harness default to Mermaid diagrams in development chats via prompt guidance, the mermaid_validate syntax checker, an output safety gate, and a versioned Mermaid Vault.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地可审计的个人记忆层，自动记录偏好、项目约定、工作流和纠错教训，并在会话间注入，解决 AI 金鱼脑问题。
description.en: A local, auditable personal memory layer for DeepSeek Harness that records preferences, project conventions, workflows, and error lessons, injecting them across sessions to solve the AI goldfish brain problem.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将聊天中的 Mermaid 代码块默认渲染为可缩放平移的 SVG 图表，支持图/码切换、偏好记忆与暗色模式，引擎离线内置，安全可靠。
description.en: A DSH plugin that renders Mermaid code fences in web chat as zoomable, pannable SVG diagrams by default, with per-fence toggle, preference memory, dark-mode support, and a fully bundled offline engine.

description.zh: dsh-meter 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供分时电价计量表，在输入框下方实时显示会话成本、当前费率与切换倒计时，并支持悬停查看费率时钟、缓存经济学与账户余额。
description.en: dsh-meter is a time-of-use cost meter for DeepSeek Harness, showing session cost, current tariff, and countdown under the composer, with hover details on tariff clock, cache economics, and balance.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供带时间轴的金字塔记忆，Agent 自动维护摘要，任意规模下固定读取预算，开局最多只读 96 行。
description.en: Adds timeline-based pyramid memory to DeepSeek Harness: agent-maintained summaries with a fixed reading budget at any scale, reading at most 96 lines at startup.

description.zh: dsh-metrics 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Token 用量与成本看板插件，按模型、供应商、项目与会话统计调用与缓存命中，并接入 OpenRouter 单价估算成本。
description.en: dsh-metrics is a DSH plugin that adds a token usage and cost dashboard, breaking down calls and cache hits by model, provider, project and session, with cost estimates from OpenRouter pricing.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 换上暖白纸面、黑发丝分隔线与衬线正文的纯皮肤插件，深浅两套外壳随产品设置自动切换。
description.en: A pure skin plugin that restyles the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with warm paper tones, hairline dividers and serif body text, with light and dark shells that follow the product theme.

description.zh: MindsEye 为 DeepSeek Harness 的纯文本模型注入视觉能力，支持图像理解、生成与编辑，并可选开启可见浏览器自动化，全程以 DSH 对话为主体验。
description.en: MindsEye gives text-only models on DeepSeek Harness vision capabilities, including image understanding, generation, and editing, with optional visible browser automation, all within the DSH conversation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上缺失的删除能力：在侧边栏会话行提供菜单项、悬停按钮与快捷键，经二次确认后由 Host 鉴权路由永久清除会话日志、缓存与归档标记。
description.en: Adds the missing delete capability to DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar session-row menu item, hover button and shortcut trigger a risk-consent dialog, then an authenticated Host route permanently removes the session log, projection cache and archive marks.

description.zh: DSH plugin 首轮精简工具：让新根会话首轮请求使用 Minimal 预设，移除自动注入内容，随后自动恢复完整预设，并支持全局开关。
description.en: A DSH plugin that makes a root session's first request use the Minimal preset, removing auto-injected content, then restores the full preset, with a global toggle.

description.zh: DSH plugin：当会话频繁触发429 TPM限流时，自动总结并迁移到新会话继续任务，先取消旧会话再启动新会话，确保交接而非并行。
description.en: DSH plugin that automatically summarizes and migrates a session to a new one when it repeatedly hits 429 TPM rate limits, canceling the old session first to ensure handoff, not parallel execution.

description.zh: 面向 DSH 的未成年人保护合规检查插件，扫描代码中不满 14 周岁个人信息处理是否具备监护人同意、专门规则与年龄识别，揪出青少年模式默认开启等个保法 31 条风险。
description.en: A DSH plugin that audits code for minor-protection compliance, flagging missing guardian consent, absent child-specific rules and age detection for under-14 personal data, plus teen mode enabled by default under PIPL Article 31.

description.zh: dsh-moa 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Mixture of Agents 插件，让多个参考模型并行分析同一问题，再由主模型综合总结，适合架构评审、方案对比等多视角交叉验证场景。
description.en: dsh-moa is a Mixture of Agents plugin for DeepSeek Harness that runs multiple reference models in parallel and synthesizes their outputs with the main model, ideal for multi-perspective cross-validation.

description.zh: 让 iPhone/iPad 用 Safari 通过短地址与 8 位配对码安全访问电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness Web，无需装 App，并附带手机端输入与触摸优化。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets iPhone/iPad Safari securely open DeepSeek Harness Web on your Mac or Windows PC via a short address and 8-digit pairing code, with mobile input and touch fixes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上长周期自主任务运行时：把长期目标拆成依赖 DAG，跨会话持久推进、独立验证、失败重规划并支持崩溃恢复。
description.en: A long-horizon autonomous mission runtime for DeepSeek Harness: it turns a long-term objective into a dependency DAG of tasks and advances it across sessions with independent verification, replan-on-failure and crash recovery.

description.zh: 雾墨 Mist Ink 是 DSH 的深色主题插件，把默认近黑底换成石墨灰，并为侧边栏、输入区与弹层加上可调强度的毛玻璃效果。
description.en: Mist Ink is a DSH plugin that swaps the default near-black dark theme for softer graphite tones and adds adjustable frosted glass to the sidebar, composer, and overlays.

description.zh: 为 DSH 提供手机端侧栏适配：窄屏下侧栏收成左上角悬浮方块，展开为覆盖式抽屉，点会话自动收起并压制软键盘顶起页面。
description.en: A mobile-friendly sidebar plugin for DeepSeek Harness: on narrow screens the sidebar collapses into a floating square, expands as an overlay drawer, auto-closes on session tap and suppresses the soft-keyboard focus jump.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供手机响应式适配与 WireGuard 远程增强，含文件管理、PTY 终端与设置远程可用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings mobile responsive layout and WireGuard remote enhancements to DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, including file manager, PTY terminal, and remote settings.

description.zh: DSH plugin 修复 dsh web GUI 在手机视口下的可用性：全宽聊天、抽屉侧栏、手势、安全区 composer 等，纯浏览器端无构建步骤。
description.en: A DSH plugin that fixes mobile-viewport usability for the dsh web GUI: full-width chat, drawer sidebar, gestures, safe-area composer, etc. Pure browser-side, no build step.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供模型检测浮窗，通过数字指纹与糖果题联合检测、响应路由比对，快速判断当前会话背后的模型身份。
description.en: A DSH plugin floating panel that fingerprints the model behind a session via numeric probes, candy tests and request/response routing checks.

description.zh: dsh-model-gate 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供模型禁用门禁，可屏蔽指定提供商或模型，被禁模型从所有发现路径消失，并返回协议内错误。
description.en: dsh-model-gate is a DSH plugin that disables specific models or providers, hiding them from discovery and returning in-protocol errors on dispatch.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 自动修正模型思考模式与能力配置，补全思考档位、视觉、上下文与输出长度，兼容官方 API 与各类中转站。
description.en: A DSH plugin that auto-corrects model thinking modes and capabilities, filling in thinking tiers, vision, context and output limits for official APIs and third-party relays.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于关键词与语义分类的动态模型路由插件，按任务自动选择模型与推理强度。
description.en: A DSH plugin that routes models dynamically via keyword and semantic classification, auto-selecting model and reasoning effort per task.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供统一模型管理层的 DSH plugin，集成提供商登录、模型目录与选择路由，通过回环 /model-hub 通道安全运行。
description.en: A DSH plugin delivering a unified model management layer for DeepSeek Harness, integrating provider sign-in, model catalog, and selection routing over a loopback-only /model-hub channel.

description.zh: dsh-model-accordion 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供按提供商折叠的模型选择器，自动读取推理努力元数据，并支持识图镜像分组。
description.en: Provider-folded model selector for DeepSeek Harness Web, reading reasoning-effort metadata and grouping vision mirrors.

description.zh: DSH plugin 模型管理插件，在设置中管理 OpenAI 兼容模型提供方、默认模型与可见性，并可选将网络搜索路由到 OpenAI Responses。
description.en: A DSH plugin for managing OpenAI-compatible model providers, default model, and visibility in settings, with optional web search routing via OpenAI Responses.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框换上可搜索、按 provider 分组的模型选择器，并把思考档位拆成独立滑杆控件。
description.en: Replaces the DeepSeek Harness input-box model picker with a searchable, provider-grouped list and splits the thinking level into its own slider control.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补全模型参数与定价的 DSH plugin：从 Models.dev 查询上下文窗口、模态与推理档位，支持 USD/CNY 原币种单价编辑、上游模型导入与内置模型覆盖。
description.en: A DSH plugin that completes model metadata and pricing for DeepSeek Harness: query context window, modalities and reasoning tiers from Models.dev, edit USD/CNY unit prices, import upstream models and override built-in entries.

description.zh: DSH plugin 按角色路由模型：规划者用 deepseek-v4-pro，委派子代理用 flash，附提示段与 pro-flash-routing 技能，降低推理成本。
description.en: A DSH plugin that routes models by role: planner on deepseek-v4-pro, delegated subagents on flash, with a prompt section and pro-flash-routing skill to cut reasoning costs.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框上方添加一排模型预设快捷按钮，左键一键切换当前会话的模型与推理强度，右键编辑预设并支持自定义备注，预设保存在本地。
description.en: Adds a row of one-click model preset buttons above the DeepSeek Harness composer: left-click to switch the session's model and reasoning effort, right-click to edit presets with custom labels, all stored locally.

description.zh: dsh-move-to-workspace 是一款 DSH plugin，可从侧边栏把已有会话连同完整历史迁移到另一个工作区，并归档原会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that moves an existing conversation, with its full history, into another workspace from the sidebar and archives the original.

description.zh: DSH plugin 乱码拦截器：在 AI 写入文件前基于特征值检测乱码，要求复查后放行，并审计 pwsh 编码，防止 Windows 批量乱码。
description.en: A DSH plugin that intercepts mojibake before AI writes to files, using feature-based detection with review-then-release, plus pwsh encoding audit to prevent Windows encoding corruption.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 SSH、WSL、Docker 三种远程开发环境，让 agent 的文件读写、命令执行与搜索全部落在远端，本地只保留有界只读镜像。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects DeepSeek Harness to SSH, WSL and Docker remote environments, so the agent's file reads, writes, commands and searches all run remotely while a bounded read-only mirror stays local.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可视化情绪板：在 Web UI 收集参考图、打标签写备注并钉选风格指南，让 DSH plugin 在生成或改版界面前先读取这些视觉基准。
description.en: A visual moodboard for DeepSeek Harness: collect reference images in the Web UI, tag and annotate them, and pin a style guide the DSH plugin reads before generating or restyling UI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏提供多根工作区浏览器：会话按真实工作目录归入目录树，并附带只读资源树可预览文件。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness sidebar plugin that turns the workspace region into a multi-root browser: sessions filed under their real cwd, plus a read-only resource tree with file preview.

description.zh: DSH plugin 只注册一个 shell 工具，让模型每次调用时自行选择 Git Bash、PowerShell 或 WSL 后端执行命令。
description.en: A DSH plugin that registers a single shell tool, letting the model pick Git Bash, PowerShell, or WSL as the backend on each call.

description.zh: DSH 插件实时展示 DeepSeek、GLM、OpenRouter、Kimi 等供应商的额度与用量，侧边栏卡片与设置页图表均取自真实接口数据。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows real-time quota and usage for DeepSeek, GLM, OpenRouter and Kimi providers, with a sidebar card and settings dashboards built on real API data.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供单进程多用户工作区分档：JWT 登录墙、按用户过滤工作区/会话，以及用户管理，实现多人共用一台 dsh 的轻量视图隔离。
description.en: Provides single-process multi-user workspace partitioning for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: JWT login wall, per-user workspace/session filtering, and user management for lightweight view isolation on a shared dsh instance.

description.zh: dsh-multiprovider 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多账户调度、亲和性、健康检查与设置界面，让一个模型身份背后管理多个凭证。
description.en: dsh-multiprovider provides multi-account scheduling, affinity, health, and settings UI for DeepSeek Harness, managing multiple credentials behind one provider identity.

description.zh: DSH 素材浏览插件：在主区「资产」tab 按工作区查看 MUSE AV 素材库与最近出图记录，点一下即可复制素材直链当垫图用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds an Assets tab to browse MUSE AV workspaces, image libraries and recent generation history, copying asset direct links with one click for use as reference images.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让 Cordis 插件可管理、可一键打包为 dsh 安装包与便携包，支持安装卸载与收藏常驻，提升插件开发与分发效率。
description.en: A DSH plugin that makes Cordis plugins manageable, one-click packaging into dsh install packages and portable packages, with install/uninstall and favorites support.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 n8n 工作流运维能力：多实例注册表、15 个 Agent 工具与设置页，凭别名即可驱动任意环境。
description.en: Brings n8n workflow operations into DeepSeek Harness with a multi-instance registry, 15 alias-addressed agent tools and a Settings page.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Neo4j 的长期图记忆，把事件、人物、概念与地点写入知识图谱，并支持语义与实体召回。
description.en: A Neo4j-backed long-term graph memory DSH plugin that stores events, people, concepts and places as a knowledge graph and recalls them by semantics or entity.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供模型感知的推理努力度滑块，以紧凑的 UI 控制模型推理强度，并支持可选的 WebGL 能量场动画。
description.en: A model-aware reasoning effort slider for DeepSeek Harness, offering compact UI control over reasoning intensity with an optional WebGL energy field.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的篮球桌面宠物插件，提供 Curry 30 与 King 23 双角色切换、投篮待机动画及 AI 任务状态提醒，让编程过程充满赛场氛围。
description.en: A basketball desktop-pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness, featuring Curry 30 and King 23 characters, idle shooting animations, and AI task status alerts to bring court energy to coding.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 MV 放映室侧边栏，用你自己的音频或视频作时钟，播放带歌词的 ASCII、Canvas2D 与 WebGL2 音乐视频场景。
description.en: Adds an MV screening-room sidebar to DeepSeek Harness that plays lyric-synced ASCII, Canvas2D and WebGL2 music-video scenes clocked to your own audio or video.

description.zh: 为 DSH plugin 增强 Agent Team 协作：灵活选择模型、强化父子对话通信并限制 Team 请求次数。
description.en: A DSH plugin that enhances Agent Teams with flexible model selection, richer parent-child conversation communication, and per-Team request limits.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地与远程 SSH 终端，危险命令三级护栏、AI 命令须真人确认，密码加密存储不进 AI 会话。
description.en: A protected local and remote SSH terminal for DeepSeek Harness, with three-level command guards, human approval for AI commands, and encrypted credentials kept out of AI sessions.

description.zh: DSH Web GUI 新闻聚合插件：侧边栏入口弹出模态窗，聚合国际/AI/科普/历史 RSS 新闻，支持站内阅读、中英互译与自定义源。
description.en: A news aggregator plugin for the DSH Web GUI: sidebar entry opens a modal aggregating world/AI/science/history RSS news, with in-app reading, bilingual translation, and custom sources.

description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的执行环境（文件、Bash、PTY、LSP）迁移到 gVisor 隔离的云端沙箱，无需 fork，即插即用，支持可选持久化。
description.en: Relocates DeepSeek Harness's execution world — files, Bash, PTY, LSP — into a gVisor-isolated cloud sandbox. Drop-in plugin, no fork, optional persistence.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 桌面通知卡：任务跑完、等你审批或回答时右下角滑出卡片，不抢焦点、不打断操作。
description.en: Windows desktop notice cards for DeepSeek Harness: a non-focus-stealing card slides in when a turn finishes, an approval is pending, or a question awaits your answer.

description.zh: Nexus 是接入 DeepSeek Harness 的个人编码助理插件，把本机 Codex 或 Claude Code 的编码任务安排、跟进与验收串起来，并支持微信、飞书远程协作。
description.en: Nexus is a personal coding assistant plugin for DeepSeek Harness that schedules, tracks and verifies local Codex or Claude Code tasks, with WeChat and Lark remote collaboration.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供通知中心：标签页鲸鱼图标变绿或琥珀状态灯，会话跑完或等待你处理时弹出系统通知与提示音。
description.en: A notification center for DeepSeek Harness: the tab whale icon turns green or amber, and system notifications plus alert sounds fire when a session finishes or awaits your input.

description.zh: DSH 插件：任务结束或需要用户决策时，通过跨窗口悬浮面板、网页 toast 和系统通知弹窗提醒，类似 Codex / Claude Code 的体验。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pops up cross-window floating panels, web toasts, and system notifications when tasks finish or user decisions are needed, similar to Codex / Claude Code.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 AI 需要审批或任务完成时播放中文提示音，让你专注工作、少切屏，听到声音即刻回来接续任务。
description.en: A DSH plugin that plays Chinese audio notifications when AI awaits your input or finishes a task, keeping you focused with fewer context switches.

description.zh: DSH 通知插件，在 Web GUI 设置页新增通知分区，实现事件驱动的声音提醒与企业微信/飞书消息推送。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a notification section to the Web GUI settings, enabling event-driven sound alerts and WeCom/Feishu message push.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供语义化通知声音，区分完成、审批、提问、受阻、错误五种事件，支持浏览器与后端播放，并带 Web 铃铛开关。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds semantic notification sounds to DeepSeek Harness, distinguishing complete, approval, question, blocked, and error events, with browser and backend playback and a Web bell toggle.

description.zh: DSH 通知插件，在 Web GUI 设置页新增通知分区，实现事件驱动的声音提醒与企业微信/飞书消息推送。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a notification section to the Web GUI settings, enabling event-driven sound alerts and WeCom/Feishu message push.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供浏览器系统通知：任务完成、运行出错或等待输入/批准时弹出气泡，点击直达会话。
description.en: Browser system notifications for DeepSeek Harness: popups on task completion, run errors, or pending input/approval, with click-to-open session.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 Nous Portal 免费 Tier 的 Hermes 模型（Hy3、Ox Alpha 等）接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持 OAuth 登录与动态模型发现。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects Nous Portal free-tier Hermes models (Hy3, Ox Alpha, etc.) to DeepSeek Harness, with OAuth login and dynamic model discovery.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web GUI 嵌入小说阅读器：导入 legado 书源即可搜索、加书架、连续滚动阅读，并让 AI 助手用五个工具直接帮你找书读章。
description.en: Adds a novel reader to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: import legado book sources to search, shelve and scroll-read, while the AI assistant gets five tools to find and read chapters for you.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 提供 OpenTelemetry 追踪，将每次 agent 会话导出为 OTLP span 树，支持 GenAI 语义约定属性，可接入任意 OTLP/HTTP 收集器。
description.en: OpenTelemetry traces for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): exports each agent session as an OTLP span tree with GenAI semantic-convention attributes to any OTLP/HTTP collector.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供统一的可观测性（trace/log/metric），注册全局 OpenTelemetry 提供者并导出 OTLP，桥接 dsh 会话遥测，兼容 GenAI 语义约定。
description.en: Unified observability (trace/log/metric) for DeepSeek Harness: registers global OpenTelemetry providers, exports OTLP, bridges dsh session telemetry, GenAI semconv ready.

description.zh: DSH plugin，利用OpenAI订阅OAuth登录，无需API Key即可在DeepSeek Harness中使用ChatGPT模型。
description.en: A DSH plugin that uses your OpenAI subscription via OAuth to access ChatGPT models in DeepSeek Harness without an API key.

description.zh: DSH 插件，用于清理 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面中无用的官方入口，并强制关闭官方模型 API 的 Session Log 上传，让界面更清爽。
description.en: A DSH plugin that strips unused official entries from the DeepSeek Harness Web UI and pins off Session Log upload for the official model API, keeping the interface clean.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧边栏左下角显示 OpenCode Go 用量，常驻剩余百分比角标，悬停可查看高峰时段与用量明细，每 60 秒自动刷新。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows OpenCode Go usage in the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar's bottom-left corner, with a persistent remaining-percentage badge and hover details, refreshing every 60 seconds.

description.zh: 将 OmicVerse/OmicOS 生信分析能力接入 DeepSeek Harness（DSH plugin），提供持久 Python 内核与技能目录搜索，支持账号管理与实时执行可视化。
description.en: Integrate OmicVerse/OmicOS bioinformatics analyses into DeepSeek Harness (DSH plugin) with a persistent Python kernel, capability-catalog search, account management, and live execution visualization.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 GitHub Copilot OAuth 登录与模型路由的 DSH plugin，通过设备码流程登录并注册 github-copilot 模型路由。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that enables GitHub Copilot OAuth sign-in and model routing via device-code flow.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 dsh-TUI 提供 /open 命令，用系统默认程序打开文件、文件夹与 http(s) 链接，并支持路径直达与工作区模糊搜索。
description.en: A DSH plugin for dsh-TUI that adds the /open command, launching files, folders and http(s) links in system default apps, with direct paths and fuzzy workspace search.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话头部「Open In...」按钮组注册 CodeBuddy CN 目标，一键用本机 CodeBuddy CN 打开当前会话的 workspace 目录，仅 Windows 生效。
description.en: A DSH plugin that registers a CodeBuddy CN target in the session header's "Open In..." button group, opening the current session workspace in local CodeBuddy CN with one click (Windows only).

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供 Obsidian 插件开发能力，含脚手架生成、规范校验与版本同步，并配套开发规范 skill。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness agents Obsidian plugin development capabilities: scaffolding, spec validation and version syncing, plus a companion guideline skill.

description.zh: 将 OpenClaw 五件套 Persona 定义（SOUL/IDENTITY/USER/MEMORY/TOOLS）搬进 DeepSeek Harness，侧边栏 Web GUI 直接编辑 Markdown，保存即生效，下一条消息即按新设定应答。
description.en: Reuse OpenClaw persona files (SOUL/IDENTITY/USER/MEMORY/TOOLS) as DSH agent persona, with a Web GUI sidebar editor — edit Markdown and changes take effect on the next request.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中把 opencode 作为 ACP 子代理运行，通过 subagent_opencode 委派任务，并提供设置页与运行历史。
description.en: Runs opencode as an ACP subagent inside DeepSeek Harness, delegating self-contained tasks via subagent_opencode with a settings page and run history.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面插件，在对话输入区直接显示 OpenCode Go 订阅用量与真实花费，弹窗内完成登录配置，无需接触终端。
description.en: A DSH plugin that displays OpenCode Go usage and real cost directly in the chat input area, with in-dialog login and configuration, no terminal needed.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在侧边栏展示 OpenCode GO 订阅配额（滚动5小时/周/月），并支持 /opencode-go 命令查询，助你实时掌握用量。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows your OpenCode GO plan quota (rolling 5h/weekly/monthly) in the sidebar and via /opencode-go command.

description.zh: 将 32 个 OpenGIS GIS 技能打包为可启停的 DSH plugin，覆盖 GDAL、QGIS、GeoServer、PostGIS 等，正文按需加载。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin bundling 32 OpenGIS GIS skills—GDAL, QGIS, GeoServer, PostGIS and more—with on-demand skill loading and easy toggling.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册 12 个 OpenSpec 工作流技能与 /opsx-* 命令别名，让变更提案、实现、归档等流程可直接在 DSH 中调用。
description.en: Registers the 12 canonical OpenSpec workflow skills and /opsx-* command aliases for DeepSeek Harness, so change proposal, apply, and archive flows run natively inside DSH.

description.zh: Origin Bridge 让 DSH 插件用自然语言驱动本机 Origin/OriginPro：导入 dat/csv/Excel 与工作站 bin，绘图、拟合、导出并保存可编辑 .opju。
description.en: Origin Bridge is a DSH plugin that drives your local Origin/OriginPro from chat: import .dat/.csv/Excel and workstation .bin files, plot, fit, export, and save editable .opju projects.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话页头新增「熊猫日历」标签页，离线提供农历干支节气、法定节假日调休、多城市天气、时间戳转换与历史上的今天，免 token 免 API Key。
description.en: A token-free DSH plugin that adds a Panda Calendar tab to DeepSeek Harness Web sessions, offering offline lunar calendar, Chinese statutory holidays, multi-city weather, timestamp conversion and on-this-day history.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供输出展示设置：推理与工具节点自动展开、代码块字号行高、模型输出语言，全部即时生效无需重启。
description.en: An output-presentation settings plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): auto-expand reasoning and tool nodes, code block font size and line height, and model output language — all applied live without restart.

description.zh: 泡泡猫 DSH 插件合集，一条命令即可装齐新手引导、玻璃主题、影视创作、骰子游戏与文件上传等自研插件，让新手开箱即用。
description.en: Paopaocat Suite bundles a set of in-house DSH plugins — onboarding, glass theme, media studio, dice games and file upload — installable with a single command for a ready-to-use setup.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将论文转化为学术汇报：读取全文、按场合分配时长、围绕图表生成幻灯片，并撰写演讲者备注作为讲稿。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns papers into academic talks: reads the full text, budgets the slot per venue, builds the deck around figures, and writes speaker notes as the script.

description.zh: DSH 插件，在 macOS 上复制 Finder 文件或文件夹后，于 DeepSeek Harness 编辑器中按 Ctrl+V 即可插入绝对路径，不干扰普通粘贴。
description.en: A DSH plugin for macOS that lets you paste Finder file paths into the DeepSeek Harness composer with Ctrl+V, without affecting normal paste.

description.zh: Patchouli 是 DeepSeek Harness 的本地记忆与知识中枢插件，提供统一的 update/retrieve/subscribe 服务，集成异构 Agent 数据增强，数据与算法解耦，基于 Rust 后端实现事务性存储。
description.en: Patchouli is a local memory and knowledge hub plugin for DeepSeek Harness, exposing unified update/retrieve/subscribe services, integrating heterogeneous Agent data augmentation with decoupled data and algorithms, and a transactional Rust backend.

description.zh: DSH plugin，让聊天消息中的文件路径和链接支持Ctrl+点击：路径在系统文件管理器中打开所在文件夹，链接在新浏览器标签页打开，提升交互效率。
description.en: A DSH plugin that enables Ctrl+click on file paths and links in chat: paths open their folder in the OS file manager, links open in a new browser tab.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在会话头部显示高峰时段指示灯，实时提示北京时间是否处于 DeepSeek API 高峰，带秒级时钟、倒计时与价格提示。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows a peak-hour indicator in the session header, telling whether Beijing time is in DeepSeek API peak window, with live clock, countdown and pricing hint.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端提供粘贴图片缩略图预览，并在纯文本模型下把图片转为文件附件，让模型仍能通过工具读取图像。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web plugin that shows pasted images as zoomable thumbnails and reroutes them as file attachments so text-only models can still read them via tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按提供商、按模型计算的峰谷费率徽章，在模型选择器与输入框工具行实时显示当前计费状态与切换倒计时。
description.en: Peak / off-peak rate badges for DeepSeek Harness, judged per provider and per model, shown live in the model selector and composer tool row with switch countdowns.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供运行中人格切换的 DSH plugin，可在 TUI、Web UI 或无头会话里用 /persona 命令即时替换 system prompt，无需重启。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that switches the system-prompt persona live from a running session via the /persona command, with no restart needed.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来一只透明动画桌面宠物：待机呼吸、随机动作、拖拽甩抛与本地碎碎念，可多开并住上桌面。
description.en: A floating desktop pet DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness: transparent animations, random actions, drag-and-throw physics, local self-talk, multi-pet and desktop mode.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 UI 级访问闸门与进程级工具刹车：登录一次即可解锁所有 DSH 页面，无人登录时 Agent 无法调用任何工具，60 分钟空闲自动锁定。
description.en: A UI-level access gate and process-wide agent tool brake for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): one login unlocks every open page, while an idle 60-minute lock denies all agent tool calls when nobody is signed in.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可爱的动态桌面萌宠，16 个本地角色，支持中英文问候、主题跟随与个性化设置，让长任务运行更温馨。
description.en: A cute animated desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness, with 16 local characters, bilingual greetings, theme following, and customization to warm up long agent runs.

description.zh: DSH plugin 轻量优化合集，提供自动审核与提示音，拦截危险操作、放行安全操作，并在审批或后台任务完成时提醒，提升使用体验。
description.en: A lightweight DSH plugin bundle offering auto-review and notification chimes to gate risky actions and alert on approvals or background task completion.

description.zh: dsh-pianist 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来一台会弹琴的 Agent，基于真实采样与确定性时间轴，让 AI 弹奏钢琴，既是娱乐也是模型能力考卷。
description.en: dsh-pianist brings a piano-playing Agent to DeepSeek Harness, with sample-based audio and a deterministic timeline, letting AI perform piano as both fun and a benchmark.

description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏新增置顶分区，把运行中、未读和当前打开的会话固定在顶部，方便快速回到活跃会话。
description.en: Adds a pinned section to the DSH Web sidebar that keeps running, unread and currently open sessions at the top for quick access.

description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏新增置顶分区，把运行中、未读和当前打开的会话固定在顶部，方便快速回到活跃会话。
description.en: Adds a pinned section to the DSH Web sidebar that keeps running, unread and currently open sessions at the top for quick access.

description.zh: dsh-pip 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 DSH plugin，一键将 Web GUI 分离为始终置顶的 Document Picture-in-Picture 悬浮窗口，方便边写代码边观察 Agent，再点一下即可返回标签页。
description.en: dsh-pip is a DSH plugin that detaches the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI into an always-on-top Document Picture-in-Picture window, letting you watch the agent while coding, and return to the tab with one click.

description.zh: DSH 插件：在内容喂给 agent 前静态扫描文本，揪出提示注入、隐藏字符与社工话术，只查 agent 会读到的字，不扫代码。
description.en: A DSH plugin that statically scans text before it reaches an agent, flagging prompt injection, hidden characters and social-engineering phrasing in content rather than code.

description.zh: 面向 DSH 的个人信息保护影响评估插件，扫描代码中敏感个人信息与对外提供等处理活动，检查是否按个保法 55 条做过评估、56 条留存三年。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for PIPIA/DPIA compliance: it scans code for sensitive personal information and third-party sharing, flagging missing impact assessments and the three-year retention record required by PIPL Articles 55 and 56.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造像素宗门式多智能体团队运行时：队长带持久成员、依赖感知任务 DAG、独立评审与 15 重境界成长，本地优先。
description.en: A pixel-sect multi-agent team runtime for DeepSeek Harness: a captain leads durable members through a dependency-aware task DAG, with independent review gates and a 15-realm progression, all local-first.

description.zh: Plan Checkup 是 DeepSeek Harness 的计划审查插件，在批准计划前逐步检查每个步骤，把不可撤销、影响工作区外、含糊或缺少验证等风险标记在计划审查卡片上，只提示不拦截。
description.en: Plan Checkup is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that reviews each step of a plan before you approve it, flagging irreversible, out-of-workspace, vague or unverified steps right on the plan review card — advisory only, never blocking.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的学术文献插件，从 arXiv 与 Semantic Scholar 实时检索真实论文，本地生成 GB/T 7714、APA、BibTeX 引用并维护会话文献库，杜绝模型编造文献。
description.en: A DSH plugin for academic literature: it retrieves real papers from arXiv and Semantic Scholar, generates GB/T 7714, APA and BibTeX citations locally, and keeps a per-session library so the model never fabricates references.

description.zh: persona-forge 是一款 DSH plugin，能把导出的聊天记录蒸馏成可扮演的人设，让 AI 用对方的语气说话，并支持直接对话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that distills exported chat logs into a playable persona, letting the AI talk in that person's style and hold conversations with it.

description.zh: DSH plugin 实时显示 DeepSeek API 余额与服务状态的悬浮面板，可停靠顶栏或拖拽浮动，余额敏感开发者的实用工具。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing a dockable/floating HUD that shows DeepSeek API balance and service status in real time, ideal for balance-conscious developers.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 搭建跨模型协作桥梁，支持第二意见审查、对抗性审查、任务委托与非阻塞后台调度，并内置省 token 路由与模型可用工具。
description.en: A DSH plugin bridging DeepSeek Harness with external AI models for second-opinion review, adversarial review, task delegation, and non-blocking background scheduling, with token-saving routing and model-accessible tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自动文档生成技能，可从项目结构、代码签名、git 历史生成 README、API 文档、变更日志和 JSDoc 注释。
description.en: Auto documentation generation skill for DeepSeek Harness, generating READMEs, API docs, changelogs, and JSDoc comments from project structure, code signatures, and git history.

description.zh: DSH 审批/选择方案系统级通知插件，显示工作区名、点击跳转、多语言，确保不遗漏审批。
description.en: DSH plugin for approval & decision alerts with native notifications, workspace display, click-to-jump, and multilingual support.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于模型的自动审批审查，用 Codex Guardian 或 Grok 策略替代人工确认工具调用。
description.en: Provider-backed automatic approval review for DeepSeek Harness, replacing manual tool-call confirmation with Codex Guardian or Grok review policies.

description.zh: DSH plugin 无人值守任务队列：丢入 Markdown 任务，自动派发、重试、结算并归档，全程不打扰前台会话。
description.en: An unattended task queue for DeepSeek Harness: drop in Markdown tasks, auto-dispatch, retry, settle and archive without disturbing foreground sessions.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在会话头部添加余额按钮，实时显示账户余额、token 用量与按官方价目表计算的费用估算。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a balance button to the session header, showing account balance, real-time token usage, and cost estimates based on official pricing.

description.zh: DSH plugin 开发边界技能插件，将平台能力边界规则打包为可加载技能，帮助开发者在开发前判断哪些通道官方支持、哪些未文档化、哪些不可实现。
description.en: A DSH plugin development boundary skill plugin that packages platform capability boundary rules into a loadable skill, helping developers judge which channels are officially supported, undocumented, or impossible before building.

description.zh: DSH 社区插件，驱动无头 Playwright 浏览器，提供渲染页面文本、截图与自动化操作，弥补内置 web_fetch 的不足。
description.en: A DSH community plugin driving a headless Playwright browser for rendered page text, screenshots, and automation, covering what web_fetch can't.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供设置卡片与对话节点渲染的 DSH 插件，在插件详情页展示配置卡片，并在 chat 中渲染对话节点，附带社区插件市场入口。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that renders settings cards on plugin detail pages and conversation nodes in chat, with a built-in community plugin market entry.

description.zh: DSH 选择增强插件：为 ask_user_question/choice 选择卡添加「重新生成选项」与「更多选项」按钮，不满意一键换一批，太少一键补充，纯前端实现。
description.en: Choice enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness: adds 'Regenerate options' and 'More options' buttons to choice cards, letting the model refresh or supplement options on demand, pure frontend.

description.zh: DSH plugin 诊断并修复 ChatGPT/Codex 桌面应用启动后约 60-90 秒崩溃的问题，通过崩溃转储分析、Store 通道检查与代理绕过修复，可回滚。
description.en: A DSH plugin that diagnoses and fixes ChatGPT/Codex desktop app crashes ~60-90s after launch via crash-dump triage, Store channel check, and proxy-bypass fix, with rollback support.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入微信 ClawBot 通道，支持扫码绑定、收发文字图片语音，并可在微信内用 /model 切换会话模型。
description.en: Connects WeChat ClawBot to DeepSeek Harness with QR-code binding, text/image/voice messaging, and in-chat /model switching for the current session.

description.zh: 将 Claude Code 会话导入 DeepSeek Harness 作为可延续上下文，提供 Agent 工具与 Web 一键导入，支持摘要链、任务、文件足迹等。
description.en: Import Claude Code sessions into DeepSeek Harness as continuable context, with agent tools and Web GUI one-click import.

description.zh: DSH plugin Clinic 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供只读健康检查，诊断已装插件的加载、依赖、版本、安装脚本风险与补丁完整性，并输出模型工具、Web 面板与 JSON 报告。
description.en: DSH plugin Clinic is a read-only health checker for installed DeepSeek Harness plugins, diagnosing loader health, dependency integrity, version compatibility, install-script risk, and patch integrity via a model tool, Web dashboard, and JSON reports.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供结构化代码审查技能，覆盖正确性、安全、性能、风格与测试，输出分级审查报告。
description.en: A structured code review skill for DeepSeek Harness, covering correctness, security, performance, style, and testing with prioritized findings.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件与预设提供受控 A/B 对比：复用已有会话或跑基线/候选配对，输出时间线、token 与耗时差异及可分享报告。
description.en: Controlled A/B comparison for DeepSeek Harness plugins and presets: reuse existing sessions or run baseline/candidate pairs, then get timelines, token and time deltas, and shareable reports.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框预测下一条指令，以占位文字呈现，按 Tab 即可采纳为可编辑草稿。
description.en: Predicts your next instruction in the DeepSeek Harness composer, showing it as placeholder text that Tab accepts as an editable draft.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框带来 Shell 式历史回溯：按 ↑/↓ 逐条回填本会话已发送消息，越过最新一条即恢复原草稿。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives the DeepSeek Harness composer shell-style history: press ↑/↓ to walk back through messages sent in this session and restore your draft when you pass the newest one.

description.zh: DSH Plugin Console 是 DeepSeek Harness 的插件管理器，在设置页提供插件商店、安装验证、更新删除及 Harness 一键升级，并支持隔离试运行确保安全。
description.en: DSH Plugin Console is a plugin manager for DeepSeek Harness, offering a plugin store, install verification, update/delete, and one-click Harness upgrade with isolated dry-run for safety.

description.zh: 为 DSH plugin 提供搜索路由切换：在 DeepSeek Search API 与默认账户搜索之间即时切换，失败自动回退，并带设置页与侧边栏开关。
description.en: A DSH plugin that switches the built-in web_search between the DeepSeek Search API and the default account search, with instant toggling, automatic fallback, a settings page and a sidebar switch.

description.zh: DSH plugin 上下文压缩技能，教 Agent 压缩长对话，保留关键信息，生成结构化摘要，节省上下文空间。
description.en: Context compression skill for DeepSeek Harness, teaching the agent to compress long conversations, retain key info, and produce structured summaries.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 聊天界面加装实时账单显示器，每条回复与整场会话的消费、token 用量一目了然，并支持每轮预算限额提醒。
description.en: A real-time cost meter for the DeepSeek Harness chat UI, showing per-reply and per-session spend plus token usage, with per-turn budget alerts.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）接到 Discord：在手机或桌面 Discord 里与任意工作区会话对话、审批工具调用、回答模型提问。
description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness (DSH) into Discord: chat with any workspace session, approve tool calls, and answer model questions from your phone or desktop.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 插件开发者的调试工具集，提供运行时检查器 /debug、隔离调试启动、无需浏览器的宿主契约测试与客户端插槽预览。
description.en: A DevKit for DeepSeek Harness plugin authors: a live runtime inspector (/debug), isolated debug boot, browser-free host contract tests, and client slot preview.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 DIT.ai 模型提供商，支持 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 协议，保留原生运行时与工具。
description.en: Adds DIT.ai as a native model provider for DeepSeek Harness, supporting both OpenAI and Anthropic protocols while keeping the stock runtime and tools unchanged.

description.zh: DSH 插件为手工添加的 OpenAI 兼容模型声明推理档位与图片输入，让对话框出现 Effort 选择器并支持图片附件。
description.en: A DSH plugin that declares reasoning efforts and image input for hand-added OpenAI-compatible models, enabling Effort selector and image attachments in chat.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供四套明暗配色皮肤，含模型运行时的激光扫描与 125% 侧栏字号，装后即换装。
description.en: A DSH plugin that skins the DeepSeek Harness web UI with four light/dark palettes, a laser scan while the model runs, and a 125% sidebar type scale.

description.zh: DSH 插件接入本机 voidtools Everything 索引，让 DeepSeek Harness 智能体一次查询即可全盘秒级定位文件，返回路径、大小与修改时间。
description.en: A DSH plugin that taps the local voidtools Everything index, letting DeepSeek Harness agents locate files across all drives in milliseconds with paths, sizes and modified times.

description.zh: 把 Devin CLI 桥接进 DeepSeek Harness：提供 devin 委派工具、/devin 命令，并注册 devin 模型提供商路由，自动发现账号可用模型。
description.en: Bridges the Devin CLI into DeepSeek Harness: a devin delegation tool, a /devin command, and a devin LLM provider route with automatic model discovery.

description.zh: DSH plugin 融合生成工具，多次采样不同温度生成候选答案，并由评审调用选出最优结果。
description.en: A DSH plugin that samples multiple candidate answers at varied temperatures and uses a judge call to select the best one.

description.zh: DSH plugin 安装安全闸门：60 条静态签名规则扫描插件源码，拦截恶意安装脚本、凭据窃取与网络回传，并阻止危险删除命令。
description.en: Installation safety gate for DSH plugin: 60 static signature rules scan plugin sources to block malicious install scripts, credential theft, and network callbacks, plus destructive-command guards.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在每个新会话开始时用多变措辞问候你，并记住你的名字，让每次问候都个性化。
description.en: A DSH plugin that greets you at the start of every session with varied wording and remembers your name for a personal touch.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一键 Git 提交推送：自动汇总改动、按 Conventional Commits 生成提交信息并推送，斜杠命令零 Token 完成。
description.en: A one-call Git commit-and-push plugin for DeepSeek Harness: it surveys changes, writes Conventional Commits messages and pushes, with a zero-token slash command.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供插件安全体检：静态扫描源码与依赖、AI 在线审计，输出绿黄红三级风险报告面板。
description.en: A security inspector for DeepSeek Harness that statically scans installed DSH plugin source and dependencies, adds an AI audit, and renders a green/yellow/red risk report panel.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供逐轮模型与推理强度路由：每轮由 Jev 选择题决定候选模型，置信度不足自动回退，并留下可零成本回放的路由凭证。
description.en: Per-turn model and reasoning-effort routing for DeepSeek Harness: one Jev choice question picks the candidate each turn, a confidence gate falls back, and every turn leaves a zero-cost replayable receipt.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 prompt 输入框添加终端式历史导航，按 ↑/↓ 切换最近发送的消息，跨会话持久化到 localStorage。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding terminal-style prompt history navigation to the composer: ArrowUp/ArrowDown cycles through recently sent messages, persisted across sessions.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 DeepSeek Harness 内集成插件中心，支持浏览市场、查看排行榜、管理安装与更新，无需离开工作区即可发现并审阅插件。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings the plugin hub into DeepSeek Harness, enabling browsing, rankings, and install management without leaving the workspace.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Knowra：让 DSH 里的 Agent 按主题、作者或日期检索 arXiv 论文，并读取 Scout 报告中的方法、证据与局限，快速判断哪篇值得精读。
description.en: Knowra for DeepSeek Harness lets your DSH agent search arXiv papers by topic, author or exact dates and read Scout reports on methods, evidence and limitations, so you can decide which papers deserve a close read.

description.zh: DSH 插件：在设置页搜索 GitHub 官方插件库，瀑布流浏览并一键安装，支持 AI 调用，让插件发现与安装更高效。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a searchable plugin library tab in settings, with waterfall browsing and one-click install, also callable by AI.

description.zh: DSH 网页插件管理插件，在设置页直接启用/停用已安装插件，切换即时生效并持久化到用户配置层。
description.en: A DSH plugin manager that lets you enable/disable installed plugins directly from the web settings page, with instant effect and persistent patch-layer writes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页设置添加增强版插件列表，按信任层级分组、可折叠，并展示每个插件的完整详情。
description.en: Adds an enhanced plugin list to DeepSeek Harness Web Settings with trust-tiered, collapsible groups and full per-plugin details.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通感编码器，让纯文本 LLM 获得看图能力：调用视觉模型将图片转为结构化空间文字，支持坐标、像素网格与图表分析。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives text-only LLMs vision: it translates images into structured spatial text via vision models, with coordinates, pixel grids, and chart analysis.

description.zh: DSH Plugin Market 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加本地优先的插件市场页面，用于查看和管理当前配置文件中安装的插件，支持安装、更新、启用、禁用和移除。
description.en: DSH Plugin Market adds a local-first plugin manager page to DeepSeek Harness, letting you inspect and manage plugins in the active profile, including install, update, enable, disable, and remove.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加悬浮时间卡片：悬停聊天节点行即可查看开始、结束时间与耗时，支持工具调用、思考、命令等节点。
description.en: Adds hover timestamps to DSH web: hovering a chat node row shows start/end time and duration for tool calls, Think, commands, and more.

description.zh: Noema 是一款 DSH 插件，在每次编码任务后对比圈复杂度、认知复杂度与嵌套深度，帮你快速定位需要重点审查的代码改动。
description.en: Noema is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that compares cyclomatic complexity, cognitive complexity and nesting depth after each coding task, so you can spot which files and functions deserve a closer review.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的小说阅读器 DSH plugin：状态栏悬停速览、侧边栏书架阅读，支持 txt/epub 与老板键。
description.en: A novel reader DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness: hover preview in the status bar and a sidebar bookshelf reader, supporting txt/epub with a boss key.

description.zh: DSH plugin 第三方插件管理器，在设置页列出非官方插件，支持启用、停用、卸载、检查更新与 npm 一键安装升级，状态持久化重启后保持。
description.en: A DSH plugin manager for third-party plugins, listing unofficial plugins in settings and enabling disable, uninstall, update check, and one-click npm install/upgrade with persistent state.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加未分组会话：一键开启不占用任何项目工作区的会话，同时保留 DSH 原生输入区与模型、权限、附件等能力。
description.en: Adds ungrouped, workspace-free sessions to DeepSeek Harness: one click opens a session that occupies no project workspace while keeping DSH's native composer, model, permissions and attachments.

description.zh: DSH plugin 兼容性审计与 Loader 生命周期观察工具，为插件作者提供预安装检查与运行时状态洞察。
description.en: A DSH plugin for compatibility auditing and bounded Loader lifecycle observation, offering pre-install checks and runtime insights for plugin authors.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Ollama 监控与测评能力：agent 侧可查状态、测速、拉取模型与编程评测，设置页内嵌交互面板。
description.en: Adds Ollama monitoring and benchmarking to DeepSeek Harness: agent-side tools for status, speed tests, model pulls and coding evals, plus an interactive panel in the settings page.

description.zh: DSH plugin 迷你仪表盘，在侧边栏设置上方渲染可拖拽悬浮窗，实时汇总会话活动与今日 token 消耗。
description.en: A DSH plugin mini dashboard that renders a draggable float window above the sidebar to summarize live session activity and today's token usage.

description.zh: 这款 DSH 插件把工作区文件夹备份到 RustFS、阿里云 OSS、AWS S3 等对象存储，支持手动、定时与改动自动上传，密钥只从环境变量读取，不落盘不回显。
description.en: A DSH plugin that backs up workspace folders to S3-compatible object storage such as RustFS, Aliyun OSS and AWS S3, with manual, scheduled and on-change uploads while credentials stay in environment variables only.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供插件安装预检：解析锁定版本、校验依赖与配置冲突，并在隔离环境试装试启动，通过后才允许正式安装。
description.en: A pre-install checker for DeepSeek Harness plugins: it resolves and pins versions, validates dependencies and config conflicts, then trial-installs and boots in an isolated environment before allowing the real install.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框加一枚「优化提示词」按钮，一键把草稿改写成目标明确、约束具体的可验收提示词，支持还原、斜杠命令与模型工具，模型不可用时自动回退本地规则。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds an "Optimize Prompt" button to the composer, rewriting rough drafts into clear, verifiable prompts with one click, plus revert, slash commands and model tools, falling back to local rules when the model is unavailable.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Python 快捷执行工具：模型直接传入源码，经 stdin 一步运行，全链路 UTF-8，支持后台作业与沙箱提权。
description.en: A Python quick-execution tool for DeepSeek Harness: the model passes source code directly, runs it via stdin in one step with end-to-end UTF-8, plus background jobs and sandbox escalation.

description.zh: PkgSeek 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Linux 包、命令和 CVE 情报工具，通过 MCP 端点注册原生工具，无需 API 密钥。
description.en: PkgSeek brings Linux package, command and CVE intelligence to DeepSeek Harness as native tools via MCP, no API key required.

description.zh: DSH plugin 划词引用插件，在 DeepSeek Harness 会话中选中文字即可一键引用回复或新窗口回复，提升对话效率。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets you select text in a DeepSeek Harness conversation and quote it into the composer or reply in a new window.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器加上供应商标识，在模型名旁显示 24 个厂商品牌 logo，支持前缀匹配与灰点兜底。
description.en: Adds provider branding to the DeepSeek Harness model selector, showing brand logos for 24 vendors beside model names with prefix matching and a gray-dot fallback.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 增加插件搜索能力，聚合 GitHub 与社区精选清单，合并去重后附上可直接复制的安装命令，断网时自动回退离线索引。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness agents a plugin-discovery tool: it searches GitHub and a curated community list, merges and dedupes results, and returns ready-to-copy install commands, with offline fallback when the network fails.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 增加插件搜索能力，聚合 GitHub 与社区精选清单，合并去重后附上可直接复制的安装命令，断网时自动回退离线索引。
