description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness agents a plugin-discovery tool: it searches GitHub and a curated community list, merges and dedupes results, and returns ready-to-copy install commands, with offline fallback when the network fails.

description.zh: dsh-plugin-rag 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地知识库 RAG，基于 TF-IDF 关键词检索项目文件，无需外部 API 或嵌入模型，帮助 Agent 快速定位相关上下文。
description.en: dsh-plugin-rag provides local knowledge base RAG for DeepSeek Harness, using TF-IDF keyword search over project files without external APIs or embedding models.

description.zh: DSH plugin 跨会话记忆工具：全文检索历史会话（SQLite FTS5），将最强匹配片段带回当前上下文，助模型回忆决策与教训。
description.en: DSH plugin for cross-session memory: full-text search past sessions (SQLite FTS5) and bring strongest matching excerpts into current context.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供模型智能配置：五层级联规则匹配推荐参数，自动适配上下文窗口、推理强度与工具调用能力。
description.en: Smart model configuration for DeepSeek Harness: a five-tier cascading rule engine that recommends parameters and auto-adapts context window, reasoning effort and tool-calling support.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供以 Markdown 文件定义子代理角色的能力，每个角色自带人设、路由说明与工具白名单，主代理可一键委派任务。
description.en: Defines subagent roles as Markdown files for DeepSeek Harness, each carrying a persona, routing description and tool policy, so the parent agent can delegate tasks in one call.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设置界面新增 Sirchmunk 分区，集中查看知识图谱、集群、共享历史与运行指标，并内置跨 100+ 格式的本地知识检索技能。
description.en: Adds a Sirchmunk section to the DeepSeek Harness settings UI for inspecting knowledge graphs, clusters, shared history and runtime metrics, plus a bundled skill for searching local knowledge across 100+ file formats.

description.zh: DSH 聊天表格浮窗插件：长/宽 Markdown 表格一键弹出可滚动浮窗查看，支持复制为 Markdown，纯前端零依赖。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pops up long/wide markdown tables in a scrollable floating window, with copy-as-Markdown support. Pure frontend, zero dependencies.

description.zh: DSH plugin 把仓库从「能跑」推到「敢发布」：8 维 34 项成熟度审计、7 种 README 风格双语草稿、确定性品牌 SVG 与发布前校验。
description.en: A DSH plugin that takes a repo from runnable to release-ready: 8-dimension 34-check maturity audit, 7 README styles with bilingual drafts, deterministic brand SVGs and pre-release verification.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 里玩俄罗斯方块：agent 干活时游戏面板自动浮现，右下角常驻图标随时点开，含 SRS 墙踢、Hold、T-Spin 等完整规则。
description.en: Play Tetris inside the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: the board pops up while the agent works, a corner icon opens it anytime, with full SRS wall kicks, Hold and T-Spin rules.

description.zh: DSH plugin 的可视化插件管理器，在 DSH Web 设置中启停插件、管理搭配并删除第三方插件，无需手改配置。
description.en: A visual plugin manager for DSH Web, enabling plugin toggling, preset management, and third-party plugin removal without manual config edits.

description.zh: DSH plugin 可一键配置任意 OpenAI 兼容 API 并免费获得思考模式，同时修复 developer 角色被拒的 content_filter 问题。
description.en: A DSH plugin to configure any OpenAI-compatible API in one block, enabling thinking mode and fixing the developer-role rejection bug.

description.zh: 为 DSH web 聊天界面添加实时思考 token 徽标，在每条思考行标题上显示 Think(128) 等计数，流式更新并持久保留。
description.en: Adds a live reasoning-token badge to DSH web chat, appending Think(128) style counts to each thinking row title, updating in real time and persisting.

description.zh: DSH plugin 插件开发与发布工具集，提供专家方法沉淀、合规检查、依赖与恶意代码扫描、bundle 校验等技能，助力插件质量治理。
description.en: A DSH plugin toolset for plugin development and publishing, offering expert2skill, compliance checks, dependency/malware scanning, and bundle linting to enforce quality governance.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 GitHub 风格 token 用量热力图，支持日/周/月粒度、按模型细分和今日用量徽章，全程本地只读。
description.en: A DSH plugin that renders a GitHub-style token usage heat map with day/week/month granularity, per-model breakdown, and a today badge — fully local and read-only.

description.zh: dsh-plugin-toolkit 是 DSH plugin 开发工具链：一条 CLI 完成脚手架、测试、热重载与发布，并在侧边栏提供 Plugin doctor 检查。
description.en: A CLI toolkit for DeepSeek Harness plugin development: scaffold, test, hot-reload and release plugins, plus a sidebar Plugin doctor that runs the same checks in-app.

description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 把本地 Obsidian 知识库当作长期记忆：全文与语义检索、会话记忆注入、一键捕获成果，并定期巡检笔记库。
description.en: Lets DeepSeek Harness treat your local Obsidian vault as long-term memory: full-text and semantic search, session memory injection, one-click capture, plus scheduled vault health checks.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供视觉工具箱，让纯文本 Agent 能描述、定位、检测和裁剪图像，并注册为技能。
description.en: Vision toolkit for DeepSeek Harness, giving text-only agents the ability to describe, locate, detect, and crop images, registered as a skill.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册 Tavily 搜索提供商的 DSH plugin，让内置 web_search 工具无需改动模型接口即可由 Tavily 驱动。
description.en: A DSH plugin registering a Tavily WebSearchProvider into DeepSeek Harness, letting the built-in web_search tool be served by Tavily without touching model-facing schema.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供翻译工具包：分句、术语提取、源目标质检、语气指南及持久化翻译记忆，让模型专注翻译，插件负责切分、校验与记忆。
description.en: A translation toolkit for DeepSeek Harness agents: sentence segmentation, glossary extraction, source-target QA, tone guides, and durable translation memory in the session workspace.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Web 侧边栏每个工作区标题下方显示完整目录路径并自动换行，解决同名工作区混淆问题，支持热加载与实时同步。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows the full directory path below each workspace title in the web sidebar with line wrapping, resolving confusion from same-name workspaces, with hot reload and live sync.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供插件守护：扫描并隔离会导致 Web UI 崩溃的损坏插件，支持启用、暂停、卸载与一键自更新。
description.en: A safety-guard DSH plugin that scans and quarantines broken plugins so a faulty plugin can never take the DeepSeek Harness web UI down, with enable, pause, uninstall and one-click self-update.

description.zh: DSH plugin 插件管理器，在 Web GUI 中粘贴 GitHub 链接校验后一键安装，并支持更新、删除、启停及后台自动更新，让插件全生命周期管理更省心。
description.en: A DSH plugin manager that installs plugins from GitHub links with validation, and manages updates, removal, enable/disable, and background auto-updates for installed plugins.

description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 变成个人微信机器人，扫码接入后每条消息由 DSH 的 AI 带工具和记忆回复，支持联网搜索与工作目录配置。
description.en: Turn DeepSeek Harness into a personal WeChat bot: scan to connect, and every message is answered by DSH's AI with tools and memory, supporting web search and workspace configuration.

description.zh: ZenMux 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供模型接入，浏览器 OAuth 登录免 API key，可搜索 150 个模型并自动选择支持缓存的协议。
description.en: ZenMux integrates ZenMux models into DeepSeek Harness with browser OAuth login, a searchable catalog of 150 models, and automatic selection of cache-capable protocols.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Web 对话框右下角显示套餐用量角标，实时展示 OpenCode Go、GLM、Kimi 等套餐的 5 小时、周限、月限用量百分比。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows a plan usage badge at the bottom-right of the web chat, displaying 5-hour, weekly, and monthly usage percentages for plans like OpenCode Go, GLM, and Kimi.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 pnpm 提供代理开关与 registry 切换，含设置页标签和独立 CLI，一键改写 ~/.npmrc。
description.en: A DSH plugin that toggles the proxy and switches registry for pnpm used by DeepSeek Harness, via a Settings tab and standalone CLI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注入 PostgreSQL 专业知识：内置 11 个 Tiger Data pg-aiguide 技能，并接入 MCP 手册检索，避免模型凭记忆写出过时表结构。
description.en: Brings PostgreSQL expertise to DeepSeek Harness: 11 curated Tiger Data pg-aiguide skills registered natively, plus an MCP server for version-exact manual search so the model stops writing outdated schemas.

description.zh: dsh-pocket 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供独立移动端 Web 页面，手机浏览器即可查看会话、实时输出与工具调用，并反向发送指令、处理提问审批。
description.en: dsh-pocket gives DeepSeek Harness a dedicated mobile web UI: browse sessions, live output and tool calls from a phone browser, send prompts back, and answer questions or approvals.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中通过对话直接编辑 PPTX：附件打开于侧边栏，用自然语言增删幻灯片、改文字排版、图表与图片，并即时预览保存。
description.en: Edit PPTX presentations through conversation inside DeepSeek Harness: attach a deck, open it in the sidebar, and change slides, text, tables, charts and images with natural language.

description.zh: 为 DSH 提供「先确认、后执行」的 Agent 预设：模型先把需求拆成子需求，用一次问卷逐题确认后再开始执行。
description.en: A DSH agent preset that confirms requirements first: the model splits a task into sub-requirements, asks a questionnaire, and only executes after you submit.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web GUI 输入卡加上峰谷时段徽标，实时显示当前处于高峰还是空闲时段，并倒计时到下次切换。
description.en: Adds a peak/off-peak pricing badge to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI input card, showing the current billing window and a countdown to the next switch.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的 PDF、Word、Excel 文档预览更换纸张配色，内置纯黑、护眼米黄等多种方案，只改显示不动原文件。
description.en: A DSH plugin that recolors the sidebar document preview for PDF, Word, and Excel files with dark, eye-friendly, and custom paper themes, changing display only, never the files.

description.zh: DSH Postmortem 读取失败的 DeepSeek Harness 会话事件，本地只读地定位失败步骤与证据，并生成脱敏的恢复计划与新会话交接，无需模型即可使用。
description.en: DSH Postmortem reads failed DeepSeek Harness session events locally and read-only, pinpointing the failed step and its evidence, then produces a redacted recovery plan and a lineage-linked fresh session handoff, with no model required.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按 profile 覆盖的配置层：全局 settings.yaml 与各 profile 的 settings.patch.yml 透明叠加，支持递归合并、!unset 删除与热重载，让每个 profile 拥有独立配置。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding a per-profile settings overlay: global settings.yaml plus profiles/<name>/settings.patch.yml, transparently layered under ctx.settings with recursive merge, !unset deletion, and hot-reload.

description.zh: dsh-project-guard 是 DeepSeek Harness 的权限守卫插件，保留你选定的沙箱模式，只对调用额外申请的权限做判定：机器安全操作静默放行，系统改动附后果分析后询问，破坏性操作直接拒绝。
description.en: dsh-project-guard is a DeepSeek Harness permission guard that keeps your chosen sandbox mode and judges only the extra permission a call asks for: machine-safe actions pass silently, system changes ask with a consequence analysis, and destructive ones are refused.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的项目制学习教练插件，以可执行教学协议推进真实项目教学，教学法与学科领域包解耦，可整体替换学科。
description.en: A project-based learning coach plugin for DeepSeek Harness that drives real-project tutoring through an executable teaching protocol, with pedagogy decoupled from swappable domain packs.

description.zh: DSH 项目收件箱插件把散落在各会话中的待答问题、交付物与中断告警汇总到一处，自动归属项目并支持原地处理。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gathers pending questions, deliverables and interrupted turns from every session into one project inbox, auto-assigning them to projects and letting you act in place.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让每个项目通过 .dsh/mcp.json 声明自己的 MCP 服务器，会话自动获得其工具并支持热重载，无需重启。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets each project declare its own MCP servers via .dsh/mcp.json, automatically exposing their tools to sessions with live config reload.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供命名模型配置档：一条命令即可切换默认模型、思考等级与子代理模型覆盖，支持 TUI 与网页端交互配置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives you named model profiles: switch the default model, think level and per-subagent overrides with one command, configured interactively on both TUI and web.

description.zh: DSH plugin 记录项目踩坑与用户编码习惯，在后续对话中自动注入记忆，让 AI 越用越懂你。
description.en: A DSH plugin that records project pitfalls and user coding habits, injecting them into future conversations so the AI gets smarter with use.

description.zh: DSH plugin 记录项目踩坑与用户编码习惯，在后续对话中自动注入记忆，让 AI 越用越懂你。
description.en: A DSH plugin that records project pitfalls and user coding habits, injecting them into future conversations so the AI gets smarter with use.

description.zh: dsh-prometheus 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供隐私友好的 Prometheus 指标与 Grafana 仪表盘，监控会话、代理、LLM 与工具调用等生命周期，并保持指标序列有界。
description.en: dsh-prometheus provides privacy-conscious Prometheus metrics and Grafana dashboards for DeepSeek Harness, monitoring sessions, agents, LLM and tool calls with bounded metric series.

description.zh: 这款 DeepSeek Harness 插件从你的历史会话归纳用户画像，按 token 预算裁剪后注入系统提示，让新会话的 AI 无需重新交代就懂你的偏好与禁忌。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that distills a user profile from your past sessions and injects it into the system prompt within a token budget, so every new session already knows your preferences and what does not work for you.

description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框一键把草稿改写成结构化提示词，支持最多 5 轮续写、逐行对比与历史版本回跳。
description.en: A DSH plugin that rewrites composer drafts into structured prompts in one click, with up to 5 continuation rounds, line-by-line diffs and version history.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在模型选择器旁添加 ✨ 按钮，一键将输入想法改写为高质量、忠实原文、可直接执行的提示词，并支持 ↩ 撤销恢复原文。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a ✨ button beside the model selector to rewrite your draft into a high-quality, faithful, executable prompt, with ↩ undo to restore the original.

description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框旁加一个 ✨ 优化按钮，把草稿改写成结构化提示词，支持 plain、sections、role-task-goal 三种风格，确认后才替换草稿。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a ✨ Optimize control beside the composer, rewriting your draft into a structured prompt in plain, sections, or role-task-goal style before you apply it.

description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框旁加一个 ✨ 优化按钮，把草稿改写成结构化提示词，支持 plain、sections、role-task-goal 三种风格，确认后才替换草稿。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a ✨ Optimize control beside the composer, rewriting your draft into a structured prompt in plain, sections, or role-task-goal style before you apply it.

description.zh: dsh-proof 是 DeepSeek Harness 的验证门插件，在每次编辑后自动运行类型检查、lint 与测试，失败时阻止回合结束并驱动 Agent 修正直至通过。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns typecheck, lint, and tests into a turn-exit gate, blocking the agent from finishing until every check passes.

description.zh: dsh-provenance 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件的安装前供应链预检工具，比对 npm 注册表、上游仓库与实际字节，确认你装的包就是读到的源码。
description.en: dsh-provenance is a pre-install supply-chain preflight for DeepSeek Harness plugins, cross-checking the npm registry, upstream repo and actual bytes so what you install matches the source you read.

description.zh: DSH 输入栏提示词精炼插件，点 ✨ 即把模糊草稿改写成目标/背景/步骤/要求的结构化提示词，并内置成本路由、LRU 缓存与 token 用量统计。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness input-bar prompt refiner: one ✨ click rewrites vague drafts into structured goal/context/steps/requirements prompts, with cost routing, LRU caching and token usage stats built in.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Models 设置页每个 provider 行内显示账户余额，通过 loopback 固定 RPC 通道查询，API 密钥始终保留在主机端，支持按路由刷新。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows the account balance inside each provider row of the Models settings page, queried via a loopback-pinned RPC channel with the API key kept on the host, with per-route refresh.

description.zh: DSH plugin 本地出口代理桥：给只接受无凭据代理地址的消费方一个本地地址，在上游一跳注入账号密码，失败即断联、无直连降级。
description.en: A DSH plugin local egress proxy bridge that gives credential-free proxy consumers a local URL, injects upstream auth on the hop that needs it, and fails closed with no direct fallback.

description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框旁加一个 ✨ 优化按钮，把草稿改写成结构化提示词，支持 plain、sections、role-task-goal 三种风格，确认后才替换草稿。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a ✨ Optimize control beside the composer, rewriting your draft into a structured prompt in plain, sections, or role-task-goal style before you apply it.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地分流代理：只有命中规则的被墙域名走上游代理，其余直连，上游地址与规则在 Web 设置页热生效。
description.en: A local routing proxy for DeepSeek Harness: only rule-matched blocked domains go through the upstream proxy while everything else connects directly, with upstream and rules hot-reloaded from the Web settings page.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按账号分流的网络代理路由插件，同一模型服务商的多个账号可各自选择代理或直连，设置页图形化配置、保存即热生效。
description.en: A network proxy routing plugin for DeepSeek Harness that lets each LLM account of the same provider use its own proxy or go direct, configured graphically in the settings page and applied instantly on save.

description.zh: Publisher Radar 是 DSH plugin，在侧边栏浏览 6,000+ 插件市场，支持搜索、筛选与分页，点开即得安装命令，并提供空位榜与竞品情报。
description.en: Publisher Radar is a DSH plugin that browses the 6,000+ plugin market from the sidebar with search, filters and paging, hands you a copy-ready install command for any plugin, and adds gap and competitor analysis for authors.

description.zh: 把 QQ 群聊接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 DSH 插件，支持 @ 触发、连续对话窗口、表情包与引用图片，并默认只读权限。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings QQ group chat into DeepSeek Harness, with @-mention triggers, follow-up windows, stickers, quoted images and read-only defaults.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：一键 OAuth 2.1 (PKCE) 授权，把启信慧眼 MCP 服务端挂载进 DSH，让模型直接调用企业工商、股权、司法与风险数据工具。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that mounts the Qixin Insight MCP server into DSH via one-click OAuth 2.1 (PKCE), giving the model direct access to enterprise registration, equity, litigation and risk data tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）提供 QQ NT 风格外观的皮肤插件，支持亮暗双模式与五种配色，可热重载并即时生效。
description.en: A QQ NT messenger skin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), featuring light/dark modes and five palettes, with hot reload and instant application.

description.zh: dsh-qq-sounds 让 DSH 在任务完成时响 QQ 好友消息音、需要审批或回答时响系统提示音，可直接读取本机 QQ 音效，未装 QQ 也有内置合成音。
description.en: dsh-qq-sounds plays QQ-style sounds in DeepSeek Harness: a friend-message chime when a task finishes and a system alert when approval or input is needed, reading your local QQ sound files or falling back to bundled tones.

description.zh: 为 DSH 接入的 QQ 机器人补上表情包能力：同步收藏、按情绪检索并发送图片表情，附可视化设置页与梗库查询。
description.en: Adds sticker support to QQ bots connected through DeepSeek Harness: sync favorites, search by mood, and send image stickers, with a visual settings page and meme lookup.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 QQ 官方机器人接入的 DSH plugin，支持消息收发、会话管理、富媒体与审批桥等能力。
description.en: A DSH plugin that integrates QQ official bot into DeepSeek Harness, enabling messaging, session management, rich media and approval bridge.

description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）接入 QQ 私聊与群聊的插件，支持连续消息智能合并与同一轮单条回复修订。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects DeepSeek Harness to QQ private and group chats, with smart merging of consecutive messages and single-message reply revision.

description.zh: dsh-qqchat 是 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的 QQ Bot 插件，支持群聊/私聊接入、会话隔离、记忆系统与权限管理，扫码即可连接。
description.en: dsh-qqchat is a QQ Bot plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), enabling group/private chat, session isolation, memory, and permission management via QR scan.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在会话右侧悬浮展示用户提问的按序列表，点击即可跳转到对应提问位置，支持收起与状态持久化。
description.en: A DSH plugin that floats an ordered list of user questions on the right side of the conversation, with click-to-jump and collapsible panel.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接检索你的 Quberi 知识库：浏览器 OAuth 授权后模型可调用 quberi_search 查找你有权阅读的文档段落，只读且每次检索都记入审计日志。
description.en: Search your Quberi knowledge base right inside DeepSeek Harness: after a browser OAuth sign-in the model can call quberi_search to find passages in documents you can read, read-only and audit-logged.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来 VSCode 式 Ctrl+P 快速打开：索引整个工作区与外部目录，模糊搜文件、跳行号、一键插入会话引用，并补上预览内查找。
description.en: A VSCode-style Ctrl+P quick open for DeepSeek Harness: index the workspace and extra roots, fuzzy-find files, jump to lines, insert conversation references, plus in-preview search.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于持久化 IPython 会话的 CodeAct 代理循环，将工具桥接为可等待对象，支持跨单元格状态保持。
description.en: A CodeAct agent loop for DeepSeek Harness with a persistent IPython session, bridging harness tools as awaitables and preserving state across cells.

description.zh: DSH Quick Replies 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话输入框上方挂载一排可管理的快捷回复芯片，点一下即以普通用户消息发送，空闲时排队、运行中安全转向，不改动草稿。
description.en: DSH Quick Replies mounts a manageable row of one-tap reply chips above the DeepSeek Harness session composer, sending them as ordinary user messages — queued when idle, steered at the next safe boundary — without touching your draft.

description.zh: dsh-quick-view 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页会话页添加右侧浮动导航器，列出所有用户输入，点击即可跳转到对应消息，方便长会话快速定位。
description.en: dsh-quick-view adds a floating right-side navigator to DeepSeek Harness web conversation pages, listing user inputs for quick jump-to-message navigation in long sessions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框添加快捷发送面板，可保存常用短语与 /skill 快捷指令，一键发送到当前会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a quick-send panel to the DeepSeek Harness composer, letting you save frequent phrases and /skill shortcuts and send them to the current session in one click.

description.zh: dsh-quorfloat 是 DeepSeek Harness 的桌面悬浮会话面板，用全局快捷键随时呼出，在其他应用中也能提问、续聊、查看回答并处理工具审批。
description.en: dsh-quorfloat is a floating desktop chat panel for DeepSeek Harness: a global hotkey summons sessions, models and tool approvals while you work in other apps.

description.zh: DSH 插件在界面左下角提供额度监控窗口，实时展示 OpenCode Go 套餐、DeepSeek API 余额与 MiniMax Token Plan 用量，并统计任务 token 消耗与预估费用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a quota monitor window at the bottom-left of the UI, showing OpenCode Go plan, DeepSeek API balance, MiniMax Token Plan usage, and task token consumption with cost estimates.

description.zh: DSH plugin 快捷指令面板：在输入框上方提供一排可点击的指令胶囊，支持占位符高亮、预览编辑、分类管理与会话级记忆，减少重复输入。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a row of clickable prompt chips above the composer, with placeholder highlighting, preview editing, category management, and per-session memory to reduce repetitive typing.

description.zh: 把商汤小浣熊桌面端模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，复用本机登录凭据免填 API Key，支持 DSH 0.2.x 内核。
description.en: Brings SenseTime Raccoon desktop-app models into DeepSeek Harness with zero API keys, reusing local desktop credentials and supporting DSH 0.2.x.

description.zh: DSH plugin为网页界面添加选择工具栏，支持引用消息、临时对话和网页提问，增强会话交互体验。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding a selection toolbar for quote, temp chat, and web ask to enhance session interactions.

description.zh: 把 Raindrop.io 收藏库变成 DSH 侧边栏仪表盘，展示分类、标签、域名与类型分布、月度趋势和待清理项，并提供两个只读 Agent 工具。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns your Raindrop.io library into a sidebar dashboard with collection, tag, domain and type analytics, monthly trends and a cleanup backlog, plus two read-only agent tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的每条回复加上音浪朗读按钮，用微软神经音色逐句朗读并高亮当前句，支持暂停跳句与自动朗读。
description.en: Adds a sound-wave read-aloud button to every DeepSeek Harness reply, speaking sentences with natural neural voices while highlighting the current sentence, with pause, skip and auto-read.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为模型配置输入模态与推理等级，在会话撰写器中侧开模型菜单，支持批量编辑与自定义 wire 值，增强模型推理控制。
description.en: A DSH plugin that configures input modalities and reasoning levels per model, with a side-opening model menu in the composer, bulk editing, and custom wire values.

description.zh: DSH 插件，引导 DeepSeek Harness 的思考过程使用简体中文，并可选翻译层兜底，提升中文推理体验。
description.en: A DSH plugin that steers DeepSeek Harness reasoning to Simplified Chinese with an optional translation fallback.

description.zh: 为 DSH 中所有 pi-ai 第三方网关模型自动补全推理强度选项并注入路由请求头，让用户能在 Web UI 直接选择推理等级，无需手改配置文件。
description.en: A DSH plugin that auto-adds a reasoning-effort picker to every pi-ai gateway model and injects required routing headers, so users can pick reasoning levels in the Web UI without editing config files.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的第三方供应商实测嗅探思考强度档位并自动声明，让模型选择器可像官方供应商一样切换强度。
description.en: A DSH plugin that probes which reasoning-effort levels third-party providers actually accept, declares them, and adds per-provider sniff/strength switches.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏添加一键重启入口的 DSH 插件，以 profile 插件形式安装，应用更新后依然有效（仅限 Windows）。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a one-click restart entry to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, installed as a profile plugin so it survives app updates (Windows only).

description.zh: Recheck 是 DSH 插件，把项目结论绑定到文件依据，依据变动时提醒复核，并提供 recheck 工具与原生侧栏卡片管理。
description.en: Recheck is a DSH plugin that binds project conclusions to evidence files and flags them for review when those files change, with a recheck tool and a native sidebar.

description.zh: dsh-reelsmaker 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，把旁白文本渲染成带神经语音与烧录字幕的 1080×1920 竖屏短视频，无需 API Key、账号或 ffmpeg。
description.en: dsh-reelsmaker is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns narration lines into a finished 1080×1920 vertical reel with free neural TTS and burned-in captions — no API key, account, or ffmpeg required.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中的 Agent 提供发布前自检能力，在发版、上传安装包、切换下载链接或创建 Release 前按清单逐项断言最终结果，拦住「没报错但事情没做成」的发布事故。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness agents a pre-release self-check: before shipping, uploading packages, switching download links or creating releases, it asserts final outcomes against a checklist to catch silent failures that pass CI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 自定义模型提供方补全模型名称、上下文与能力字段，并支持 Headers、User-Agent 覆写和供应商拖拽排序。
description.en: Completes model metadata for DeepSeek Harness custom providers, with header and User-Agent overrides plus drag-and-drop provider ordering.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供成品浮窗，集中预览、筛选、改名并整理 PDF、网页、Office、图片与文本文件。
description.en: A floating deliverables panel for DeepSeek Harness that collects, previews, filters, renames and organizes PDF, web, Office, image and text files in one place.

description.zh: dsh-reload 为 DSH plugin 开发补上热重载开关：改完插件代码点一下即可生效，无需重启进程，会话与任务不中断，必要时还能一键整机重启。
description.en: dsh-reload adds a hot-reload switch for DSH plugin development: apply rebuilt plugin code with one click, no process restart, sessions and tasks stay intact, plus one-click full restart when needed.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 Android 手机与 DeepSeek Harness 主机通过局域网或公网 IPv4 配对，实现远程访问与控制。
description.en: DSH plugin pairs an Android phone with a DeepSeek Harness host over LAN or public IPv4 for remote access.

description.zh: DSH Remote Console 是 DeepSeek Harness 的移动端增强插件，通过 Tailscale 安全地将 DSH 界面提供给手机浏览器，支持状态显示、会话跳转与远程工作区打开。
description.en: DSH Remote Console is a mobile enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness, securely exposing the DSH interface to mobile browsers via Tailscale, with status display, session navigation, and remote workspace opening.

description.zh: DSH plugin，在DeepSeek Harness会话中用@提及服务器，通过SSH远程执行命令，并设有两级审批门控，默认拒绝执行。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets you mention a server with @ in a DeepSeek Harness session and run commands over SSH, behind a two-tier approval gate that fails closed.

description.zh: 把远程主机目录通过 SSH 接入为 DeepSeek Harness 工作区，文件与命令直接在远端执行，无需镜像或同步。
description.en: Open remote SSH folders as first-class DeepSeek Harness workspaces, routing file tools and shell commands straight to the remote host with no mirroring or sync.

description.zh: dsh-remote-wecom 让 DSH plugin 把 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 会话接到企业微信，在手机上收发消息、审批工具调用、切换会话与模型并取回产物。
description.en: A DSH plugin that bridges DeepSeek Harness Desktop sessions to WeCom, letting you send prompts, approve tool calls, switch sessions and models, and fetch artifacts from your phone.

description.zh: 为 DSH 发出的每次模型请求附加自定义参数：OpenRouter 供应商路由、回退模型、推理与采样字段、网关请求头，页面配置、发送前预览、事后可查日志。
description.en: Add your own parameters to every model request DSH sends — OpenRouter provider routing, fallback models, reasoning, sampling fields and gateway headers — configured on a page with live preview and a request log.

description.zh: DSH plugin 隐私安全的请求飞行记录器，捕获 Agent Loop 请求元数据与流式完成信息，提供无内容诊断与 /flight 命令，帮助调试模型请求。
description.en: Privacy-safe request flight recorder for DeepSeek Harness, capturing Agent Loop request metadata and stream completion for content-free diagnostics via /flight command.

description.zh: DSH 回复可视化插件：给每条 AI 回复加「图解」按钮，由模型产出单文件 HTML 与内联 SVG，在右侧栏沙箱 iframe 中渲染成一眼看懂的单页图解。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns each AI reply into a single-page visual: the model writes one HTML file with inline SVG, rendered in a sandboxed iframe in the side panel.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 restart_dsh 工具：两步确认后重启宿主，并自动恢复会话、子代理与待续指令，让 DSH plugin 重启后自己接着干活。
description.en: A DSH plugin exposing a two-step restart_dsh tool that restarts the DeepSeek Harness host and then automatically resumes sessions, subagents and pending instructions so work continues without a human typing "continue".

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，让你编辑已发出的消息后重发：改文字、删图、拖动排序、补图，第一条消息也能编辑，原会话保留并分叉新聊天。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets you edit an already-sent message and resend it — change text, remove or reorder images, add more — even the first message, forking a new chat while keeping the original.

description.zh: DSH Replay Lab 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于请求面回放与 A/B 实验：冻结回合、隔离候选会话，对比请求面、轨迹与成本。
description.en: DSH Replay Lab is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for request-surface replay and A/B experiments: freeze a turn, isolate the candidate session, and compare request surfaces, trajectories, and cost.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供消息撤回：把对话切回某条已发消息之前，隐藏该消息及其后续内容，并将原文回填到输入框，同时把被改动的文件还原到撤回前状态。
description.en: Message recall for DeepSeek Harness: cut the conversation back to before a sent message, hide it and everything after it, restore the original text to the composer, and revert files the recalled turns changed.

description.zh: DSH plugin 并行多角色代码评审：/review 派出安全、正确性、测试、风格四名只读子代理，各自可指定模型，汇总为分级报告。
description.en: A DSH plugin that runs parallel multi-role code review: /review dispatches security, correctness, tests, and style read-only subagents, each with optional model routing, merging into a severity-grouped report.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 对话补上回答署名、修订分支与悬浮大纲：可改写 AI 回答并从提问处新建分支，同时用悬浮目录快速跳转任意轮次。
description.en: Adds answer attribution, revision branching and a floating outline to DeepSeek Harness chats: rewrite an AI reply, fork a new branch from its question, and jump between turns from a floating outline panel.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供瑞克和莫蒂主题皮肤与桌面宠物，宠物能感知 Agent 工作状态并互动，支持多角色与养成进度。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding Rick and Morty theme skins and a desktop pet to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, with agent-aware moods, multiple characters, and progression.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端打造的明日方舟莱茵生命风格主题，重构侧栏、会话流与详情栏视觉语言，随 profile 自动加载生效。
description.en: A Rhine Lab themed skin for DeepSeek Harness Web client, restyling sidebar, conversation flow and detail panel with automatic profile loading.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于角色文件的子代理委派：一个 delegate 工具按角色文件固定子代理人设、模型路由与工具面。
description.en: Role-based subagent delegation for DeepSeek Harness: one delegate tool that fixes each child agent's persona, model route and tool surface from a role file.

description.zh: dsh-rollback 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供文件变更回滚能力，通过检查点与快照记录写入/编辑及 bash 调用前的文件状态，并以 rollback_files 工具和 /rollback 命令实现一键恢复。
description.en: dsh-rollback is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that enables file-mutation rollback by checkpointing pre-images of write/edit operations and snapshotting workspace changes from bash calls, exposing restore via rollback_files tool and /rollback command.

description.zh: dsh-ringcentral 将 RingCentral 团队消息 IM 变为 DeepSeek Harness 的一等前端，接收聊天消息驱动 Agent 循环，并以线程回复形式返回助手消息。
description.en: dsh-ringcentral turns RingCentral Team Messaging IM into a first-class frontend for DeepSeek Harness, driving the agent loop with inbound posts and returning assistant replies as threaded posts.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端带来多 Agent 圆桌会议：成员在同一场会议中讨论、生成并核对任务卡后发布执行，配套成员日志、共享资料与秘书纪要。
description.en: Brings multi-agent round-table meetings to DeepSeek Harness desktop: members discuss in one shared meeting, generate task cards for review before release, with member logs, shared materials and secretary minutes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Root Planner 预设，让根代理专注规划与决策，子代理只读执行并回报摘要，避免上下文膨胀。
description.en: A DSH plugin preset that splits planning from execution: the root agent decides and owns mutations while bounded subagents read, edit and report summaries.

description.zh: 把讯飞 Loomy 云端通道作为 OpenAI 兼容供应商接入 dsh-router，让 DSH 用户直接调用 Loomy 模型并复用路由的选号与冷却能力。
description.en: Adds iFlyTek Loomy as an OpenAI-compatible supplier for dsh-router, letting DSH users call Loomy models while reusing the router's account rotation and cooldown logic.

description.zh: DSH 原生 RSS 订阅监控插件，支持多源订阅、关键词过滤、定时去重检查，并通过 SMTP 发送带缩略图的 HTML 邮件通知，凭据安全存储。
description.en: A native DeepSeek Harness plugin for RSS monitoring: multi-source subscription, keyword filtering, scheduled dedup checks, and HTML email notifications with thumbnails, with secure credential storage.

description.zh: dsh-roam 是 DeepSeek Harness 的移动接入插件，手机扫码即可在浏览器继续电脑上的会话，AI-HUB App 共用同一地址与配对码。
description.en: dsh-roam is a DSH plugin that brings desktop DeepSeek Harness sessions to your phone: scan a QR code to continue chats in the browser, or pair the AI-HUB app with the same address and PIN.

description.zh: 为 DSH 的 dsh-router 注册 Qoder 国内版与国际版两个供应商，支持 PAT 认证、模型列表、对话与积分签到。
description.en: Registers Qoder (China and Global) as two suppliers for DSH's dsh-router, with PAT auth, model listing, chat, quota and daily check-in.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话费用面板：在对话 dock 中以卢布显示当前会话成本、峰谷时段与央行汇率，点击即可展开明细卡片。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows the current session cost in rubles in the conversation dock, with a clickable card for tariff windows, CBR rate and subagent totals.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 /rst 斜杠命令，由进程外启动器重启 DSH，并在原会话补发重启回执。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a /rst slash command to restart DeepSeek Harness via an out-of-process launcher and post a completion receipt back to the original session.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 RunningHub 云端 ComfyUI 工作流，提供 API Key 与工作流设置卡、八个 runninghub_* 工具、媒体上传去重缓存、并发队列与后台任务通知。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings RunningHub cloud ComfyUI workflows into DeepSeek Harness, with a settings card for API keys and workflows, eight runninghub_* agent tools, sha256 upload caching, a concurrency gate and background task notifications.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器添加厂商图标，并依据提供商目录自动同步模型列表，避免手动维护 YAML 导致模型缺失或过期。
description.en: Adds vendor icons to the DeepSeek Harness model picker and keeps the model list in sync with the provider catalog, so manually maintained YAML never hides new models or keeps retired ones.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中把 web profile 的 pwsh 执行器替换为 rtk 改写子类，所有 shell 命令执行前经 rtk rewrite 透明改写，用紧凑输出为每次工具调用节省 token。
description.en: A DSH plugin that swaps the web profile's pwsh executor for an rtk-rewriting subclass, transparently passing every shell command through rtk rewrite to cut token usage with compact output.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供三合一工具台设置页，统一管理 Skills、MCP 服务器与本地 CLI 工具，并支持按会话注入技能。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds one settings page to manage agent skills, MCP servers and local CLI tools, with per-conversation skill injection.

description.zh: dsh-salary-cat 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 右下角添加常驻动画宠物月薪猫，支持长按拖拽、位置记忆与自定义 GIF，为开发界面增添趣味。
description.en: dsh-salary-cat is a DSH plugin that pins an animated salary-cat mascot to the bottom-right corner of the DeepSeek Harness web UI, with drag-and-drop, position memory, and customizable GIF.

description.zh: dsh-safety-net 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自保护护栏：拦截关键路径写入、销毁前自动备份、CLI 自恢复命令，并默认启用严格沙箱模式，让自主 Agent 无法破坏 DSH 自身。
description.en: dsh-safety-net adds self-protection guardrails to DeepSeek Harness: protected-path interception, backup-before-destroy, CLI self-recovery commands, and strict sandbox defaulting, making agent damage impossible by default and reversible by command.

description.zh: DSH plugin 的 Satori 协议适配器，通过 WebSocket 接收事件、HTTP API 回复消息，将 Satori 平台接入 DeepSeek Harness。
description.en: A DSH plugin Satori protocol adapter that receives events via WebSocket and replies via HTTP API, integrating Satori platforms into DeepSeek Harness.

description.zh: dsh-scan-mcp 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows MCP 中心，扫描本地 Claude Code、Codex、CodeBuddy 等 Agent 配置的 MCP 服务器，并真实探测连接状态，支持在 UI 中启停。
description.en: dsh-scan-mcp is a Windows MCP Hub for DeepSeek Harness that scans MCP servers configured in local agents like Claude Code, Codex, and CodeBuddy, probes real connectivity, and lets you toggle them from the UI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 端新增全局 Schedule 标签页，汇总所有对话的定时提醒，支持搜索、筛选与分组，点击即可跳回来源对话。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that adds a global Schedule tab aggregating reminders from every dialog, with search, filters, grouping, and one-click jump back to the source session.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供定时发送：在输入框写好草稿并设定时间，到点由宿主进程以正常用户气泡投递到原会话，关掉浏览器也能照常发送。
description.en: Scheduled send for DeepSeek Harness Web: draft a message, pick a time, and the host process delivers it into the bound conversation as a normal user bubble — even with the browser closed.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 SBOM 物料清单体检：检查项目有没有清单、组件全不全、格式是否合规、是否过期，并逐条给出证据与处置建议。
description.en: An SBOM health checker for DeepSeek Harness: verifies whether a project has a bill of materials, whether components are complete, whether the format is standard, and whether it is stale, with evidence and fixes for each finding.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 交付卡片添加 Download 按钮，让 present 交付的文件直接从浏览器下载到本机，省去 SFTP/SCP 中转，远程或容器环境尤其实用。
description.en: Adds a Download button to DSH Web GUI delivery cards so files delivered with present save straight from the browser to your machine, skipping SFTP/SCP — especially handy on remote or containerized hosts.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供定时任务能力：每个任务绑定 Agent 预设、提示词与 cron 周期，到点自动开启全新会话执行并保留运行记录。
description.en: Adds scheduled tasks to DeepSeek Harness: each task binds an agent preset, a prompt and a cron-style interval, then fires a fresh session on schedule and keeps run history.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供左栏便签面板，支持标签、附件、Markdown 待办与发送到对话，并开放 Agent 读写工具。
description.en: A scratchpad panel for DeepSeek Harness with tagged notes, attachments, Markdown task lists, send-to-chat, and Agent read/write tools.

description.zh: 为 DSH 原生 web_search 与 web_fetch 提供多渠道路由、Key 池轮换与失败切换，并用本地账本记录用量与估算费用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that routes native web_search and web_fetch across providers, rotates API keys with failover, and tracks usage and estimated costs in a local ledger.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可插拔的 SearXNG 网页搜索与 Readability 正文抓取，全部在 DSH Web 设置页完成配置，无需手改 YAML。
description.en: Adapter-first web search and readable page fetching for DeepSeek Harness, with SearXNG search and Readability extraction configured entirely in the DSH Web settings page.

description.zh: DSH plugin 定时任务调度器：支持 cron 及多种周期，跨会话触发、多级通知，纯 UI 操作无需 LLM 工具。
description.en: A DSH plugin for cron-based scheduling with multiple schedule types, cross-session firing, and multi-level notifications, all UI-driven with zero LLM tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 每个新会话注入本地第二大脑的有界时间戳快照，含身份、状态指纹与未决项，只读零写入、零依赖。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects a bounded, timestamped snapshot of your local second brain — identity, state fingerprint and open items — into every new session prompt; read-only and zero-dependency.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供密钥与敏感信息扫描的 DSH 插件，提交或开源前用 7 条规则找出误入仓库的令牌、私钥与凭据文件，输出默认打码并给出轮换优先的处置顺序。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that scans for leaked secrets and sensitive data before you commit or open-source, using 7 rules to catch tokens, private keys and credential files, with masked output and rotate-first remediation guidance.

description.zh: DSH plugin 安全守卫：静态扫描恶意代码与提示词注入、运行时拦截、/scan 命令、Web 面板与白名单，守护 DeepSeek Harness 安全。
description.en: Security guard for DeepSeek Harness: static scan for malicious code and prompt injection, runtime interception, /scan command, web panel and allowlist.

description.zh: DSH plugin：在对话中选中任意片段，一键加入当前消息作为引用，或分叉到侧边栏并行聊天，避免追问污染主线程。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that turns any selected conversation fragment into a citation in your next message, or opens it in a forked side chat.

description.zh: 为项目业务概念维护一份可版本化的 DSH 词表，只读扫描代码中的命名漂移，并把统一命名规则注入每个 Agent 提示词。
description.en: A DSH plugin that keeps one versioned vocabulary of a project's business concepts, scans code read-only for naming drift, and injects the same naming rules into every agent prompt.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来 Semble 语义代码索引，以 search 与 find_related 两个 MCP 工具让 DSH 插件按行为描述定位代码，而非猜测文件名。
description.en: Brings Semble's semantic code index to DeepSeek Harness as two native MCP tools, search and find_related, so a DSH plugin agent locates code by behaviour instead of guessing file names.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 web_search 接入 serper.dev Google 搜索，与原生搜索并行查询后按 2:1 交错合并去重结果，让模型拿到更全的参考资料。
description.en: Adds serper.dev Google search to DeepSeek Harness's web_search, running it in parallel with native search and interleaving deduped results 2:1 for richer sources.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通过 ServerChan 推送通知，将 DeepSeek Harness 事件实时发送到微信，让用户随时掌握任务动态。
description.en: A DSH plugin that sends DeepSeek Harness notifications to WeChat via ServerChan, keeping you updated in real time.

description.zh: DSH 服务面板插件，按 Agent 会话分组展示由哪个对话启动了哪些服务，带健康探测、运行时长、实时日志、礼貌停止与原地重启。
description.en: A docked DSH service panel plugin that groups running services by the agent session that launched them, with health probes, uptime, live log tail, graceful stop and in-place restart.

description.zh: DSH plugin 按活动状态（Hot/Warm/Cool/Cold）组织侧边栏会话，支持焦点模式与智能排序，提升 DeepSeek Harness 会话管理效率。
description.en: A DSH plugin that organizes sidebar sessions by activity (Hot/Warm/Cool/Cold) with Focus mode and smart ordering for DeepSeek Harness.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上归档会话的出口：列出已归档会话，可一键恢复回侧边栏，或彻底删除日志与投影缓存，解决 DSH 只能归档不能删除的痛点。
description.en: Adds a management panel for archived sessions in DeepSeek Harness: list them, restore them to the sidebar, or permanently delete their logs and projection cache — filling the gap left by DSH's archive-only design.

description.zh: 为 DSH 会话提供产物归拢与命名：每个会话一个专属文件夹，收尾按实际内容改名并刷新索引，解决产物散落与事后记不清。
description.en: A DSH plugin that keeps every session's artifacts in one dedicated folder, renaming it by actual content at wrap-up and refreshing an index, so scattered outputs stay findable.

description.zh: 给 DSH 侧栏会话行加右键标色的插件：十色色板加系统取色器自定义，颜色按 sessionId 存 localStorage，刷新不丢。
description.en: A DSH plugin that right-click color-tags sidebar session rows, with a ten-color palette and custom picker, persisted per sessionId in localStorage.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端补上会话删除能力：侧边栏原生「移入回收站」、可恢复回收站管理页与 HTTP API，支持重名防误删、对话预览与定期自动清空。
description.en: Adds native session deletion to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a sidebar "move to trash" action, a recoverable trash management page and HTTP API, with name-collision guard, conversation preview and scheduled auto-purge.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话删除前自动备份、侧边栏多选批量备份/删除与一键恢复的 DSH plugin，备份失败即拒绝删除。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that silently backs up sessions before deletion, adds multi-select batch backup/delete in the sidebar, and restores any backup in one click.

description.zh: 在 DSH 会话标题栏加一个按钮，一键复制会话深度链接、整段对话 Markdown 或工作目录，把三个操作收进一个菜单。
description.en: Adds a single button to the DSH session header that copies a deep link, the whole conversation as clean Markdown, or the working directory from one compact menu.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上删除会话能力：侧栏菜单一键删除，递归清理子会话、日志、投影缓存与搜索索引。
description.en: Adds session deletion to DeepSeek Harness: one-click removal from the sidebar menu that recursively cleans sub-sessions, logs, projection caches and search indexes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏提供会话管理：置顶对话、全文搜索、归档与转录查看，并自动隐藏空白会话。
description.en: Session management for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: pin conversations, full-text search with snippets, period-based archives, transcript viewer and auto-hiding of blank sessions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏会话菜单补上缺失的删除会话能力，支持强制一步删净日志、缓存与注册表，不留幽灵行。
description.en: Adds the missing Delete session action to DeepSeek Harness sidebar menus, with one-click force delete that purges logs, caches and registry entries without ghost rows.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供会话增强：归档与恢复对话、彻底物理删除、跨工作区拖拽迁移、后台会话通知，以及可分支的对话树。
description.en: Conversation enhancement for DeepSeek Harness Web: archive and restore chats, guaranteed physical deletion, drag-and-drop moves between workspaces, background notifications, and a branchable conversation tree.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话内 Ctrl+F 全文查找的 DSH plugin，可搜索对话 store 中的折叠步骤与工具参数，按来源和轮次归类命中并导出 Markdown。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds Ctrl+F find-in-session to DeepSeek Harness, searching the conversation store including collapsed steps and tool payloads, grouping hits by source and turn with Markdown export.

description.zh: dsh-session-insights 是 DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先会话回顾插件，通过 /session-insights 命令将历史会话转化为 HTML 仪表盘与 JSON 报告，帮助分析工作模式与瓶颈。
description.en: dsh-session-insights is a local-first session retrospective plugin for DeepSeek Harness, turning session history into an HTML dashboard and JSON report via the /session-insights command to analyze work patterns and bottlenecks.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话管理：迁移工作区与会话到新目录、导出导入 .dshsess 包，并用 WebDAV 跨机器同步。
description.en: Session management for DeepSeek Harness: migrate workspaces and sessions to new directories, export/import .dshsess bundles, and sync across machines over WebDAV.

description.zh: 把 DSH 会话一键导出为可读 Markdown，仅保留用户与助手对话，丢弃工具调用与思考过程，方便贴进笔记或喂给其他模型。
description.en: Export a DeepSeek Harness session as a readable Markdown file in one click, keeping only user and assistant dialogue while dropping tool calls and reasoning.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏会话菜单加上标记未读、复制会话信息、在 Finder 或 IDE 中打开、永久删除等操作，并提供状态点与悬停卡片详情。
description.en: Adds mark-unread, copy session info, reveal in Finder or open with an IDE, and permanent delete to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar session menu, plus status dots and hover-card details.

description.zh: 让同一工作区内多个用户发起的 DSH 会话互相发消息，协调任务分工、文件写入范围与冲突，无需建立父子子代理层级。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets user-launched sessions in the same workspace message each other to coordinate tasks, declared write scopes, and conflicts without a parent/child subagent hierarchy.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供逐对话增量备份、模糊匹配一键恢复与到期回收站清理的 DSH 插件，只动备份不碰原文件。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that incrementally backs up each conversation, restores them via fuzzy matching, and cleans up expired backups through a recycle bin.

description.zh: dsh-session-port 是 DeepSeek Harness 的会话搬运插件，可把会话连同附件导出为 ZIP，或把导出的会话导入成新会话继续使用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that exports a session with its attachments as a ZIP archive and imports exported sessions back as new conversations.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话救援：回合异常中断时自动续跑、截断续写、待办补跑，并带 429 限流重试与输入框下的重发控制面板。
description.en: A DSH plugin that rescues interrupted turns: auto-resume on transient failures, continue on truncated output, re-run unfinished todos, plus 429 retry and an in-composer retry dock.

description.zh: DSH plugin 会话「看清再动手」外挂：删除/归档前只读预览 Markdown 内容，彻底删除走系统回收站可恢复，零依赖不 patch 官方。
description.en: A DSH plugin for 'see before you act' sessions: read-only Markdown preview before delete/archive, permanent deletion goes to system recycle bin, zero-dependency and no official patching.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供单客户端会话标签栏，复用原生聊天视图与任务服务，保留左右侧栏和底部工作台，支持后台会话运行与标签切换。
description.en: A single-client session tab bar for DeepSeek Harness that reuses native chat views and task services, keeping sidebars and the bottom workbench while background sessions keep running.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上会话彻底删除能力：单条会话菜单可永久删除，切到「仅显示已归档」时可一键清空归档会话，均带二次确认。
description.en: Adds permanent session deletion to DeepSeek Harness: remove a single session from its menu, or purge all archived sessions in one click when the sidebar is filtered to archived only, both behind a confirmation dialog.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置的「日期 | 分类 | 名称」会话标题，支持自动刷新、手动重命名与悬停统计。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness sessions a configurable DATE | CATEGORY | NAME title, with auto refresh, manual retitle, and hover stats.

description.zh: DSH 会话通信插件，支持复制会话 ID、向在线或已保存会话发送消息，并查看 token 用量、计费 token 与缓存命中率，且不引入额外运行时依赖。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness session communication plugin that copies session IDs, sends messages to live or saved sessions, and shows token usage, billed tokens and cache hit rate without vendored runtime dependencies.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上可恢复的会话删除：删除即移入回收站，7 天内可撤销恢复，到期自动清理。
description.en: Adds recoverable session deletion to DeepSeek Harness: deleted sessions move to a trash folder, restorable within 7 days and purged automatically.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上会话回收站：删除会话时连同子会话一起收纳，3 秒内可撤销，之后还能预览、还原或彻底清除日志。
description.en: A session recycle bin for DeepSeek Harness: delete sessions with their subagent trees, undo within 3 seconds, then preview, restore, or permanently purge the logs.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设置面板导航加上长按拖动排序手势，松手即存、跨重启保持，不写 settings.yaml，卸载自动恢复官方原序。
description.en: Adds a long-press drag-to-reorder gesture to the DeepSeek Harness settings panel nav, saving order instantly and persisting across restarts without touching settings.yaml.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设置面板加一个折叠按钮，把 188px 导航栏收成 56px 图标轨道，让手机窄屏下的正文列重新可读。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a toggle to the settings panel, collapsing its 188px navigation into a 56px icon rail so the content column stays readable on narrow phone screens.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件提供统一设置页 UI 套件与浮动面板套件，通过 ctx.settingsUi 服务快速构建风格一致的设置界面，无需手写组件与状态逻辑。
description.en: A unified settings-page UI kit and floating-panel kit for DeepSeek Harness plugins, exposing the ctx.settingsUi service for consistent, polished settings surfaces without hand-rolling components or state logic.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设置面板提供即时搜索框，支持拼音、意图与 AI 联想，快速定位设置页与选项。
description.en: Adds an instant search box to the DeepSeek Harness settings panel, with pinyin, intent, and AI suggestions to quickly locate settings pages and options.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 Agent 生成的网页、文档和文本一键发布为 ShareOne 分享链接，支持密码、水印、评论协作与链接管理。
description.en: A DSH plugin that publishes agent-generated web pages, documents, and text as ShareOne share links, with password, watermark, comments, and link management.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 bash/pwsh 命令卡片提供增强渲染：命令自动折行带行号，并新增独立的复制命令与复制输出按钮，纯展示层不改执行逻辑。
description.en: An enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web that upgrades bash/pwsh command cards with wrapped, line-numbered commands plus separate copy-command and copy-output buttons — purely presentational, no execution changes.

description.zh: DSH plugin 电商助手：批量处理差评回复、生成商品文案、按固定公式评估上架可行性，无需写代码。
description.en: DSH plugin for ecommerce: batch bad-review replies, listing copy generation, and reproducible go/no-go scoring without coding.

description.zh: DSH Side Ask 插件让你在主会话中选中文本即可在右侧栏开启只读分支会话，继承完整上下文并逐字流式回答，且回答绝不污染主会话的模型上下文。
description.en: The DSH Side Ask plugin opens a read-only branch session in the right sidebar when you select text in the main session; it inherits full context, streams answers token-by-token, and never pollutes the main session's model context.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供侧边会话：从当前会话分叉出临时对话，共享同一 agent 与工具，能真实编辑工作区文件而不污染主对话记录。
description.en: A side chat for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI that forks the current session into an ephemeral conversation sharing the same agent and tools, so it can really edit workspace files without polluting the main transcript.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 web 界面（dsh web）添加右侧开发者面板，提供文件浏览、会话历史与 git 状态查看，是提升开发效率的 DSH plugin。
description.en: A right-side developer panel for the DeepSeek Harness web UI (dsh web), offering file browsing, conversation history, and git status with diff viewing.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏底部插件卡片纵向堆叠、统一卡面并支持拖动换序，解决多插件并排被挤窄看不清的问题。
description.en: A DSH plugin that stacks sidebar footer cards vertically, unifies their card chrome, and supports drag-to-reorder so multiple plugins no longer squeeze each other.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏补全文件树管理（新建、重命名、上传、下载、删除），并把文档预览升级为可编辑、可保存的编辑器。
description.en: A DSH plugin that completes the sidebar file tree with create, rename, upload, download and delete, and turns document preview into an editable, savable editor.

description.zh: 把 mobilecli 封装成 DSH 右侧边栏的移动设备面板，实时画面加直接点击操作，一套 API 同时覆盖 iOS 与 Android，并向模型注册 11 个设备控制工具。
description.en: Wraps mobilecli into a live mobile device panel for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar — real-time screen with direct tap and swipe control, one API for both iOS and Android, plus 11 device tools registered for the model.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供独立渲染的浮动侧边栏，侧边栏折叠时鼠标移到窗口左侧即浮出工作区与会话浏览卡片，不触碰官方侧边栏与 grid。
description.en: A DSH plugin that renders an independent floating sidebar overlay: when the sidebar is collapsed, hovering the left edge reveals a workspace and session browser card without touching the official sidebar or grid.

description.zh: 为 DSH 的 better-sidebar 提供浏览器内 .docx 打开与编辑能力，基于 SuperDoc 读写真实 OOXML，支持原子保存、离线自托管与外部改动跟随。
description.en: A DSH plugin that opens and edits .docx files right inside the better-sidebar, powered by SuperDoc's browser-native OOXML engine with atomic saves, offline self-hosting and outside-edit tracking.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 侧边栏提供分组模式快捷切换，按 Alt+R 或点击分组标题即可在工作区分组与平铺会话列表间一键切换。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets you instantly toggle the DeepSeek Harness Web UI sidebar between workspace grouping and a flat session list via Alt+R or by clicking the section header.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 better-sidebar 中嵌入 VS Code Web 工作台，并将编辑器选中代码和资源管理器文件转为原子引用芯片，随消息提交注入模型上下文。
description.en: A DSH plugin that embeds the VS Code web workbench in the better-sidebar and turns editor selections and explorer files into atomic reference chips injected into model context on submit.

description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏管理技能专家，可从输入框或 @ 菜单召唤专家处理专项任务，并支持会话内续接。
description.en: Manage skill experts in the DSH sidebar and summon them from the composer or @ menu for specialized work, with per-chat continuation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一份技能编写规范：涵盖 SKILL.md frontmatter、触发面写法、篇幅拆分，并附静态校验脚本与 A/B 行为验证。
description.en: A DSH plugin that ships one skill for authoring DSH skills: SKILL.md frontmatter rules, trigger-surface descriptions, length and splitting guidance, plus a static checker and A/B behaviour verification.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将思源笔记变为 Agent 的个人知识库，通过 30+ 工具实现文档读写、全文搜索、反向链接与批量导入导出。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns SiYuan Note into an Agent's personal knowledge base, offering 30+ tools for document CRUD, full-text search, backlinks, and batch import/export.

description.zh: DSH plugin 技能管理工具，为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端提供技能列表、启用/禁用、删除与添加功能，填补官方技能开关控制的空白。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness desktop that lists, enables/disables, deletes, and adds skills, filling the gap in official skill toggle control.

description.zh: DSH plugin，在Web设置页提供Skill管理面板，可启停技能，停用的技能对Agent运行时完全不可见。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing a settings-page panel to enable/disable skills; disabled skills are never discovered by agents at runtime.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏底部加一枚技能徽章，实时显示当前会话正在使用的技能，并可勾选一个或多个技能一键注入启用。
description.en: Adds a skill chip at the bottom of the DeepSeek Harness sidebar that shows the skill currently in use and lets you enable one or more skills in a single click.

description.zh: DSH plugin 技能与 MCP 管理中心：在设置中管理 skills 与 MCP 服务器，侧边栏实时显示 MCP 连接状态，热应用无需重启。
description.en: Skill & MCP management center for DeepSeek Harness: manage skills and MCP servers in Settings, with live MCP status in the sidebar, hot-applied without restart.

description.zh: DSH plugin 技能站：在侧边栏扫描 Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini 技能库，一键导入、拖拽安装，并管理全局与项目技能。
description.en: A DSH plugin skill hub: scan Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini skill libraries from the sidebar, one-click import, drag-and-drop install, and manage global and project skills.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置面板中管理已安装技能：浏览完整目录、搜索、停用/启用、删除进可恢复回收站，桌面与 Web 通用。
description.en: Manage installed DeepSeek Harness skills from Settings: browse full catalog, search, disable/enable without uninstalling, and delete to a restorable trash. Works on desktop and web.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注入 writing-plans 技能，让 Agent 在写代码前先产出结构化实现计划，简单任务直接执行，复杂任务再让你选择执行方式。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds the writing-plans skill, making the agent draft a structured implementation plan before coding, run simple tasks inline, and let you pick an execution mode for complex work.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供非官方太空歌剧风格暗色动态皮肤，包含深空背景、黑洞吸积盘、霓虹 HUD 等科幻视觉元素，并注册 galactic-opera 主题。
description.en: An unofficial cinematic space-opera dark skin for the DSH Web GUI, featuring deep-space backgrounds, black-hole accretion disk, neon HUD chrome, and registers the galactic-opera theme.

description.zh: dsh-slide 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 专属幻灯片编辑器插件，将当前会话切换为类似 PowerPoint 的画布，通过注释子代理进行 AI 编辑，并集成工作区持久化。
description.en: dsh-slide is an AI-only slide editor plugin for DeepSeek Harness, switching the current conversation to a PowerPoint-like canvas with annotation subagents and workspace integration.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供皮肤随机轮换：每次启动随机换用一款已安装皮肤，并在设置→皮肤页内提供开关与立即换肤按钮。
description.en: Random skin rotation for DeepSeek Harness: pick a different installed skin on every launch, with an on/off switch and a shuffle button inside Settings → Skins.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 界面右下角加装滑动测梁仪小挂件，拖动角色在标尺上左右滑动即可显示梁神、梁圣等状态，拖到边界触发鲸鱼娘彩蛋，并记住上次位置。
description.en: A slide-gauge widget for the DeepSeek Harness UI corner: drag the character along the ruler to reveal status labels, hit the edges for a whale-girl easter egg, and keep your last position.

description.zh: DSH plugin在侧边栏设置按钮上方显示已安装的dsh版本，并检测npm与GitHub新版本，支持一键更新与设置页管理。
description.en: A DSH plugin that displays the installed dsh version above the sidebar Settings button, checks npm and GitHub for updates, and supports one-click update and settings page.

description.zh: dsh-smart-profile 是一款面向 DeepSeek Harness 的智能项目检测与能力推荐插件，自动识别仓库、裁剪任务、发现并评分插件候选，预览后经显式批准安装并支持回滚。
description.en: dsh-smart-profile is a DSH plugin for intelligent project detection and capability recommendation, automatically detecting repositories, trimming tasks, discovering and scoring plugin candidates, and installing with explicit approval and rollback.

description.zh: DSH plugin 短信转发 Webhook：接收手机短信转发 App 推送，落盘存储，并通过 sms_recent / sms_search 工具让模型读取短信，验证码场景开箱即用。
description.en: DSH plugin SMS forwarding webhook: receives pushes from phone SMS Forwarder apps, stores them, and exposes sms_recent / sms_search tools for the model to read SMS, ready for verification codes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 界面添加自定义背景图与毛玻璃蒙版的皮肤增强 DSH plugin，可调适配方式、蒙版浓度与虚化程度，颜色文字气泡仍沿用原主题。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds custom background images and a frosted-glass overlay to the DeepSeek Harness UI, with adjustable fit mode, mask opacity and blur while keeping the original theme colors.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自动快照文件变更，支持 /rollback 一键回滚，附带侧边栏时间线与配置卡片。
description.en: DSH plugin that auto-snapshots file changes, supports /rollback to restore, with a sidebar timeline and settings card.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供语音播报与语音输入，支持阿里百炼和火山豆包双引擎，云端不可用时自动回退系统音色。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding per-message voice playback, auto-announce, and mic dictation, with cloud TTS/ASR on Alibaba DashScope or Volcengine and graceful fallback.

description.zh: dsh-split-view 将 DeepSeek Harness 主窗口变为可拖拽分屏容器，每个分屏运行完整 DSH 客户端，支持快捷键与自定义设置，告别多会话切换烦恼。
description.en: dsh-split-view turns the DeepSeek Harness main window into a draggable split-view container, each pane running a full DSH client, with shortcuts and customizable settings to end session-switching hassle.

description.zh: dsh-sseye 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM 调试控制台，捕获每次模型调用的完整内容，以 DevTools 风格面板展示，无需代理或证书。
description.en: dsh-sseye is a DSH plugin that captures full content of every LLM call inside DeepSeek Harness and presents it in a DevTools-style viewer, no proxy or extra setup.

description.zh: DSH plugin 稳定性审计工具：扫描已安装插件，按钩子面、启动工作、预检与依赖给出稳定性风险分级与修复建议，支持隔离安装验证。
description.en: A DSH plugin that scans installed plugins and grades stability risk (hook surface, startup work, preflight, deps) with optional isolated install verification.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框添加原生麦克风按钮，支持实时音量显示、手动停止与取消，识别结果写入草稿，不自动发送。
description.en: Adds a native microphone button to the DeepSeek Harness composer with live metering, manual stop/cancel, writing dictation to draft without auto-send.

description.zh: 这款 DSH plugin 会在每条用户消息后自动附上 AGENTS.md 中的规则提醒，让模型始终紧贴最新消息遵守约定，无需额外工具或界面。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that appends the rules from AGENTS.md as a reminder right after every incoming user message, keeping the model aligned with your conventions without adding tools or UI.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为多阶段工作流提供阶段门控治理：创建验收清单、基于证据核验并给出 PASS/BLOCK 结论，状态按会话内存隔离。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding stage-gate governance for multi-phase work: create acceptance checklists, verify with evidence, and get a clear PASS/BLOCK conclusion, with per-session in-memory state.

description.zh: DSH 启动守卫：启动前修复会话日志、预检插件组合、冒烟测试宿主 apply() 并隔离崩溃源，让损坏插件不再卡死 DeepSeek Harness 启动。
description.en: Boot-time guard for DeepSeek Harness: repairs session logs, preflights plugin composition, smoke-tests host apply(), and quarantines crash-causing bundles so startup never bricks.

description.zh: dsh-steer-note 是 DeepSeek Harness 的运行中插话插件，任务执行时可随时发送文字、图片或文件调整方向，未发送草稿在回合结束后自动回到主输入框。
description.en: dsh-steer-note is a DSH plugin for mid-turn steering: send text, images, or files while the agent runs, and unsent drafts are rescued into the main composer when the turn ends.

description.zh: dsh-status-plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供宿主机运行状态监控，通过 HTTP 接口暴露健康指标，并在 Web 界面显示状态徽章与告警。
description.en: dsh-status-plugin provides host runtime status monitoring for DeepSeek Harness, exposing health metrics via HTTP endpoints and showing a status badge with alerts in the web UI.

description.zh: dsh-start 是 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 的一键启停启动器，提供前台/守护/停止/状态四种模式，并可构建 Dock 应用 DSH.app，让 DSH 像普通 macOS 应用一样使用。
description.en: dsh-start is a one-click launcher for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web, offering foreground/daemon/stop/status modes and a Dock-able DSH.app for a native macOS app feel.

description.zh: 一款基于 DeepSeek Harness 的 DSH plugin，协调多个研究角色完成 A 股与美股个股问答、快速与深度研究，并保留数据快照、证据与结构化报告。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that coordinates multi-agent research on A-share and US equities, delivering Q&A, quick and deep research with preserved data snapshots, evidence, and structured reports.

description.zh: dsh-starter-pack 是 DeepSeek Harness 的一键精选插件包，帮助新用户快速安装和配置一批最实用的社区插件，省去从数百个插件中挑选的麻烦。
description.en: dsh-starter-pack is a curated one-click plugin bundle for DeepSeek Harness, letting new users quickly install and configure a set of the most useful community plugins without browsing hundreds.

description.zh: dsh-stockmcp 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供美股行情、财报、SEC 文件与宏观经济数据，通过远程 MCP 服务器动态同步为模型工具。
description.en: dsh-stockmcp is a DSH plugin that delivers US stock quotes, financial statements, SEC filings and economic data, dynamically synced from a remote MCP server as model tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来多人联机剧情房间：AI 主持、共享故事线，支持 Galgame、海龟汤与剧本杀，可导入剧情包与角色卡。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds multiplayer story rooms to DeepSeek Harness — AI-hosted shared storylines for galgame, turtle soup and mystery, with story packs and character cards.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 设置页提供「服务控制」面板：实时展示 PID、内存、CPU 与活跃会话，并支持带确认的优雅终止，避免后台孤儿进程。
description.en: A service control panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web settings page: live PID, memory, CPU and session info plus a confirmed graceful stop, so no orphan host processes are left behind.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入草莓研究数据，可用自然语言检索文献、解析基因、查看多组学上下文并校验导出 FASTA 序列。
description.en: Connects Strawberry Data Hub research data to DeepSeek Harness, letting you query literature, resolve genes, inspect multi-omics context and export verified FASTA sequences in natural language.

description.zh: DSH plugin 零依赖插件，剥离模型工具调用参数中的 sandbox_permissions 与 justification 字段，避免沙箱权限误拒绝，提升 DeepSeek Harness 工具调用稳定性。
description.en: A zero-dependency DSH plugin that strips sandbox_permissions and justification fields from model tool-call arguments, preventing false sandbox escalation errors in DeepSeek Harness.

description.zh: DSH plugin 学习模式：agent 预设先查主题知识库再作答，命中标出处、查不到标未验证，侧边栏带知识库面板。
description.en: A DSH plugin study mode: an agent preset that answers from a topic knowledge base first, citing sources on hits and flagging unverified answers, with a sidebar knowledge-base panel.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 Antigravity 子代理，通过 subagent_antigravity 调用官方 agy CLI 执行一次性编码任务，无需 Gemini API Key。
description.en: Adds an Antigravity subagent to DeepSeek Harness, letting sessions call subagent_antigravity to run the official agy CLI as a one-shot coding agent without a Gemini API key.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 官方子代理工具提供生命周期安全的路由设置层，可在输入框按根会话选择 provider/model/推理强度，并管理角色模板与全局默认路由。
description.en: A lifecycle-safe routing settings layer over the official DeepSeek Harness Web subagent tools, adding per-root-session provider/model/reasoning-effort selection in the composer plus role templates and a global default route.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在后台子代理失败时，将真实失败原因（如 RATE_LIMIT 429）传递给父代理，替代官方通知中缺失的错误信息。
description.en: DSH plugin that delivers the real failure reason (e.g. RATE_LIMIT 429) to the parent agent when a background subagent fails, filling the gap in the official notice.

description.zh: DSH 网页插件，在输入框工具条统计本会话子智能体的 token 用量与人民币花费，并按父会话 turn 分组展示。
description.en: A DSH plugin for the Web UI that tallies subagent token usage and CNY cost in the composer dock, grouped by the parent conversation's turn.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为每个子代理提供可视化手动模型选择器，在会话中直观指定模型与推理强度，覆盖所有子代理路径，与自动路由插件互补。
description.en: A visual, manual subagent-model picker for DeepSeek Harness, letting you choose model and reasoning effort per session with global coverage, complementing auto-routing plugins.

description.zh: DSH plugin 看门狗，当原生可续子代理因 max-tokens 终止时自动续跑一次并停止，无循环无定时器，仅用官方接口。
description.en: A DSH plugin watchdog that auto-continues a native continuable subagent once when it ends with max-tokens termination, then stops—no loops, official seams only.

description.zh: DSH 子代理工具箱插件：按使用批次折叠子代理下拉、行内或整组删除子代理会话，并支持逐任务指定模型、按当前白名单实时校验。
description.en: A DSH plugin that groups the subagent dropdown by usage batch, deletes subagent sessions per row or per group, and lets you pick a model per delegation validated against the live allowlist.

description.zh: 「帮我想想」是一个基于 DSH-better-sidebar 的侧边栏 tab，用你自定义的 system prompt 对主对话最新 AI 回复生成候选回复，点击即可填入输入框。
description.en: A DSH plugin sidebar tab that uses your custom system prompt to generate candidate replies to the latest AI message, click to fill the input.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Tailscale 的安全远程访问运营面板，支持一键健康检查、HTTPS 入口开关、macOS 代理绕过修复、中继运维与 ACL 生成。
description.en: A Tailscale remote-access control panel for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, offering one-click health checks, HTTPS serve toggle, macOS proxy-bypass repair, relay ops and ACL snippet generation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在会话启动时挂载 Superpowers 技能并注入 using-superpowers 方法论引导，让 Agent 通过 skill 工具加载技能。
description.en: A DSH plugin that mounts Superpowers skills and injects using-superpowers methodology guidance at session start, enabling the agent to load skills via the skill tool.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话头部注入「Tasks」标签页，提供三列看板，拖入进行中即真实创建 DSH 会话执行任务并回传进度。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects a Tasks tab into the DeepSeek Harness conversation header, offering a three-column kanban that really executes cards via new agent sessions.

description.zh: DSH plugin 任务看板：将需求细化为分阶段计划，在 git worktree 中串行执行并自动合入主分支，全程可视化。
description.en: A DSH plugin task kanban that refines requirements into phased plans, executes them serially in git worktrees, and auto-merges into the main branch.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供统一的订阅登录控制台，在设置页集中管理 ChatGPT、Claude、Copilot 等第三方 AI 订阅的 OAuth 登录与登出。
description.en: A unified subscription sign-in console for DeepSeek Harness, managing OAuth sign-in and sign-out for third-party AI subscriptions like ChatGPT, Claude and Copilot from one settings page.

description.zh: dsh-task-panel 将 DeepSeek Harness 会话升级为 AI 任务看板，支持排队执行、定时低峰运行、自动复核、验收返工与历史会话关联，一屏闭环管理任务流。
description.en: dsh-task-panel turns DeepSeek Harness sessions into an AI task kanban with queued execution, scheduled low-peak runs, auto review, acceptance/rework, and historical session linking.

description.zh: DSH plugin 按任务为已启用、未启用与市场可安装的插件排序，并给出启用或安装的确切下一步。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that ranks active, disabled and marketplace plugins for your task and prints the exact next step for each.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Telegram 远程控制插件，让手机接入电脑上正在运行的 DSH 会话，实现同一对话双向续聊，并附带俄语界面。
description.en: A Telegram remote-control DSH plugin that lets your phone join an already running DeepSeek Harness session on your desktop, continuing one conversation from both sides, with a Russian UI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供单向 Telegram 通知，回合完成、失败、待回答、待审批时推送到手机，并自带设置页配置 token 与事件开关。
description.en: One-way Telegram notifications for DeepSeek Harness: get pinged when a turn completes, fails, waits for input or needs approval, with a built-in Settings page for token, chat id and event toggles.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加临时任务模式：一键在 DSH 目录下创建隔离的临时工作目录并开会话，用完即弃，不占用长期工作区。
description.en: Adds a temporary task mode to DeepSeek Harness: one click creates an isolated disposable working directory and session, with no long-lived workspace bound.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让工作区可选化，支持免工作区临时会话，每个会话独立目录，侧边栏一键新建临时会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that makes workspace optional, enabling temporary sessions without a workspace, each with an isolated directory and one-click creation from the sidebar.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 会话中内嵌可折叠的交互式终端，每个 tab 对应本机存活 PTY shell，支持多标签、自动重连与快捷命令。
description.en: Embeds a collapsible interactive terminal inside DeepSeek Harness Web conversations, each tab a live PTY shell on host, with multi-tab, auto-reconnect and quick commands.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先遥测插件，记录请求、模型、工具与插件生命周期指标，默认不采集对话内容。
description.en: A local-first telemetry DSH plugin that records request, model, tool and plugin lifecycle metrics without collecting conversation content by default.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供主题画廊的 DSH plugin，一个插件内置多套 JSON 皮肤，装一次即可在侧栏面板点选切换整屏配色，加皮肤无需改代码或重装。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a theme gallery to DeepSeek Harness: one install bundles multiple JSON-defined skins, switchable from a sidebar panel with full-screen recoloring and no code changes or reinstalls.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Microsoft tgrep 三元组索引的极速代码搜索，替换内置 grep 工具，让中大型仓库的重复检索不再反复全量扫描。
description.en: Ultra-fast trigram-indexed code search for DeepSeek Harness, shadowing the built-in grep tool with Microsoft tgrep so repeated searches on medium-to-large repos skip full rescans.

description.zh: dsh-term 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面提供面板式本地终端，基于 node-pty 与 xterm.js 实现多标签真实 PTY 会话，支持工作区目录启动，可热插拔集成。
description.en: dsh-term provides a panel-style local terminal for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, featuring real PTY sessions via node-pty and multi-tab xterm.js rendering, with hot-pluggable integration.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的《疑犯追踪》风格监控终端主题，深蓝黑界面配机器青色点缀，并带实时遥测面板，让 UI 充满超级智能氛围。
description.en: A Person-of-Interest surveillance-terminal theme for DeepSeek Harness, featuring deep blue-black surfaces, machine-cyan accents, and a live telemetry panel for a superintelligence vibe.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中的自动化测试提供置顶点击穿透进度 HUD，实时显示测试步骤与结果，并提示何时可安全收回鼠标键盘控制权。
description.en: An always-on-top, click-through progress HUD for automated tests in DeepSeek Harness (DSH), showing each step and result and telling you when it is safe to take back mouse and keyboard control.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 换上经典麦金塔 System 7 像素主题，含像素字体、Finder 式侧栏与方角控件，安装即常驻生效。
description.en: A Classic Macintosh System 7 pixel theme plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with pixel fonts, a Finder-style sidebar and square-cornered controls that stay active once installed.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web UI 换成泰拉瑞亚像素世界，向导陪你写代码，会话、审批与模型切换全部可用。
description.en: A Terraria pixel-art theme for DeepSeek Harness that swaps the Web UI for a pixel adventure, with sessions, approvals and model switching fully functional.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 4 套配色 × 明暗双模式的 DSH 主题插件，基于 OKLCH 色域钳位与真实承载面对比度求解，重算全量色彩令牌。
description.en: A DSH theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness with 4 palettes × light/dark modes, rebuilding all color tokens via OKLCH gamut clamping and contrast solving on real surfaces.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 移植的鲸鱼娘主题，完整重映射 174 个 --dsw-* 令牌，支持毛玻璃与壁纸实时调节，让 DSH plugin 界面焕然一新。
description.en: A Whale Girl theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, ported with full --dsw-* token remap and adjustable glass & wallpaper, giving your DSH plugin a fresh look.

description.zh: 让 DSH 的思考链对齐 DeepSeek 官方 App：注入推理语言规则使思考跟随提问语言，思考中显示多行滚动预览，展开可看完整推理并独立滚动。
description.en: Makes DSH's chain-of-thought look like the official DeepSeek app: reasoning follows your language, a multi-line scrolling preview while thinking, and an expandable view of the full reasoning.

description.zh: DSH 插件，通过注册全局系统提示词段落，让模型始终用中文进行内部推理与思考，适用于所有会话与子代理。
description.en: A DSH plugin that registers a global system prompt section to force models to think in Chinese, applying to all sessions and subagents.

description.zh: dsh-themes 是 DeepSeek Harness 的外观与主题插件，提供内置调色板、明暗模式、Open VSX 搜索安装与 VS Code 主题导入，并持久化主题库。
description.en: dsh-themes is a DSH plugin for appearance and themes, offering built-in palettes, light/dark modes, Open VSX search install, and VS Code theme import with persistent theme library.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供右上角股票行情悬浮窗，经 Yahoo Finance 实时获取日股、美股、港股、A 股等全球报价，支持自选列表、别名与 16 种界面语言。
description.en: A floating stock ticker for DeepSeek Harness that pulls real-time worldwide quotes from Yahoo Finance — Japan, US, Hong Kong, mainland China and more — with a customizable watchlist, aliases and 16 UI languages.

description.zh: ThunderForge 是 DeepSeek Harness 的一站式插件开发套件，提供脚手架、调试、载荷捕获与技能库，助你快速创建、调试并发布 DSH 插件。
description.en: ThunderForge is an all-in-one plugin development suite for DeepSeek Harness, offering scaffolding, debugging, payload capture, and skills to help you quickly create, debug, and publish DSH plugins.

description.zh: dsh-time-machine 为 DeepSeek Harness 工作区提供影子 Git 快照与即时回滚，支持可视化差异和命令失败自动恢复，是 DSH plugin 的安全网。
description.en: dsh-time-machine provides shadow Git snapshots and instant rollback for DeepSeek Harness workspaces, with visual diffs and auto-heal on command failure.

description.zh: 整洁显示是 DeepSeek Harness 的界面插件，把阅读视图与消息轨合二为一，让长会话可扫读、可定位、可续聊。
description.en: Tidy Display is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that merges a reading view with a message rail, making long sessions easy to scan, navigate and resume.

description.zh: DSH plugin 定时任务插件：在任意对话中配置一次性或每日重复任务，到点自动以 /goal 语义执行预设提示词，支持 Web 界面与斜杠命令。
description.en: DSH plugin for scheduled tasks: configure one-time or daily recurring tasks in any conversation, auto-executing preset prompts via /goal at the set time, with Web UI and slash commands.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页会话在消息区左侧绘制等间距时间轴刻度条，悬浮可预览消息、点击即可跳转，长历史自动加载。
description.en: A message timeline rail for the DeepSeek Harness web chat: evenly spaced ticks beside the conversation let you hover to preview a message and click to jump to it, with full history loaded automatically.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 TinyFish 的免费网页搜索与抓取，让 web_search、web_fetch 直接返回实时结果与干净 Markdown，每次调用零成本。
description.en: TinyFish-backed free web search and fetch for DeepSeek Harness, wiring live results and clean Markdown straight into web_search and web_fetch at $0 per call.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在对话侧边添加迷你目录，支持长程对话导航与一键回退，可恢复代码变更或生成摘要。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a mini outline rail beside conversations for long-session navigation and rewind, with code restore and summarization.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Token 消耗热力图，展示最近 365 天每日用量，悬停日期即可查看当天各模型 Token 明细。
description.en: A DSH plugin that renders a 365-day Token usage heatmap, letting you hover any date to see every model used that day and its Token counts.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在聊天输入框下方实时显示每个任务的 token 用量与成本，支持多币种、峰值/谷值定价及一键分析，帮助用户掌控 DeepSeek Harness 的推理开销。
description.en: A DSH plugin that tracks per-task token usage and cost in real time under the chat composer, with multi-currency support, peak/valley pricing, and one-click analysis to help you control DeepSeek Harness inference spend.

description.zh: DSH 本地 Token 用量统计插件，提供四段 Token 构成、缓存省钱估算、会话下钻与月度预算仪表盘，数据零上传。
description.en: A local token usage & cost dashboard for DeepSeek Harness with 4-segment breakdown, cache savings, per-session drill-down, and budget tracking—zero upload.

description.zh: DSH plugin 用量看板：在设置页集中展示 DeepSeek Harness 账户余额、Token 使用量与三档成本拆分，含整年热力图与分组趋势曲线。
description.en: A DSH plugin dashboard that shows DeepSeek Harness account balance, token usage and three-tier cost breakdown, with a full-year heatmap and grouped trend curves.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供悬浮式 token 仪表盘，用三个表盘实时显示累计 token 用量、解码速度与预估花费，可拖动并记忆位置。
description.en: A floating token gauge for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: three instrument dials showing cumulative token usage, decode throughput and estimated cost, draggable with remembered position.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在新会话界面展示 GitHub 风格 token 用量热力图，支持年份切换、多配色及今日/本月/累计统计。
description.en: A DSH plugin that renders a GitHub-style token-usage heatmap on the new-session screen, with year switching, color schemes, and today/month/all-time totals.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供全局个人待办清单：侧边栏面板与右侧 Dock 管理任务，到期经 SSE 弹富提醒并支持系统通知。
description.en: A global personal to-do plugin for DeepSeek Harness: manage tasks via a sidebar panel and right-edge dock, with due-time SSE rich reminders and native system notifications.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可审计的 token 记账：把会话日志折算成用量账本，重启不丢，并能从原始日志重算比对。
description.en: Auditable token accounting for DeepSeek Harness: folds session logs into a restart-safe ledger and recomputes it from raw logs for diffing.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框提供实时读数：草稿 token 估算（CJK 加权）、会话花费与官方峰谷价、上下文占用，并对照同一用量在其他模型上的花费。
description.en: Live composer readouts for the DeepSeek Harness: CJK-weighted draft token estimate, session spend at official peak/idle rates, context occupancy, and what the same usage would cost on the priciest other model.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框工具行显示当前模型供应商的额度徽标：官方接口给真值，无官方接口的只报本实例实测 token，不折算不估算，零配置自动识别路由。
description.en: Shows a quota badge in the DeepSeek Harness input toolbar for the current model provider: official endpoints report real values, others report only this instance's measured token usage — no credit conversion, no estimation, zero config.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供全局 Token 用量看板，汇总各会话计费 token 并按高峰/低谷估算人民币费用，侧边栏一键打开。
description.en: A Harness-wide token usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness that aggregates billed tokens across sessions and estimates peak/off-peak CNY cost, opened from a sidebar entry.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 token 用量分析与模型能力排行榜的 DSH plugin，扫描宿主会话日志，按提供商和模型统计消耗趋势、缓存命中率，并对比可调用模型的能力排名。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for token usage analytics and model capability rankings: it scans the host's own session logs, breaks consumption trends and cache hit rates down by provider and model, and ranks every callable model on a public leaderboard.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供实时 Token 用量与消费金额仪表盘，按模型、日期、项目统计并绘制趋势图，让成本一目了然。
description.en: A real-time token usage and cost dashboard for DeepSeek Harness, breaking down spend by model, day and project with trend charts.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 token 用量分析与模型能力排行榜的 DSH plugin，扫描宿主会话日志，按提供商和模型统计消耗趋势、缓存命中率，并对比可调用模型的能力排名。
