description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for token usage analytics and model capability rankings: it scans the host's own session logs, breaks consumption trends and cache hit rates down by provider and model, and ranks every callable model on a public leaderboard.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件添加工具调用预审批机制，实现手动模式/询问模式，可配置包含与排除规则，提升 Agent 操作安全性。
description.en: Adds pre-approval to tool calling in DeepSeek Harness, enabling manual/ask mode with configurable include/exclude rules for safer agent operations.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在请求发送前拦截并净化工具调用中无效 JSON 的 arguments，防止一次畸形模型生成导致整个会话被严格 OpenAI 兼容服务器（如 vLLM）封禁。
description.en: A DSH plugin that intercepts and neutralizes tool calls with invalid JSON arguments before they reach the wire, preventing one malformed model generation from bricking a session against strict OpenAI-compatible servers (e.g., vLLM).

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供 diagnose 工具，通过可扩展的检查注册表在进程内实时诊断插件状态、工具可见性等，帮助排查问题。
description.en: A DSH plugin exposing a diagnose tool backed by an extensible check registry, running live introspection inside the process to troubleshoot plugin and tool state.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的工具调用加上由模型填写的步骤说明，让你在对话与工具卡片中看清模型正在做什么。
description.en: Adds model-written step notes to DeepSeek Harness tool calls, so you can see what the model is doing in the conversation and tool cards.

description.zh: 在安装第三方插件前，用 DSH plugin 静态审查其代码能力：是否执行命令、读取凭据、外发数据或带装时钩子，逐条给出文件与行号。
description.en: A DSH plugin that statically vets a third-party package before you install it — flagging command execution, credential reads, outbound traffic and install-time hooks, with file and line evidence.

description.zh: dsh-tool-vision 为 DeepSeek Harness 纯文本 agent 提供本地优先的视觉能力：通过本地 VLM（LM Studio/Ollama）将图片转为结构化 JSON 证据（OCR/版面/语义），零 API 成本，图片不出本机。
description.en: dsh-tool-vision gives DeepSeek Harness text-only agents local-first vision: it turns images into structured JSON evidence (OCR/layout/semantics) via local VLMs (LM Studio/Ollama), with zero API cost and images never leaving your machine.

description.zh: DSH plugin 模块化增强原生 web_search：可附加 SearXNG、RAG 等搜索模块，各模块独立成节，原生行为不变，全部可选。
description.en: A modular DSH plugin that enhances the native web_search: attach SearXNG, RAG and more as separate sections, keeping native behavior unchanged and everything optional.

description.zh: DSH plugin 工具包，一条命令安装 MCP 管理、Skill 管理与 Git 分支徽标三个常用插件，装完即用，设置页自动出现对应分区。
description.en: A DSH plugin toolkit that installs three essential plugins with one command: MCP Manager, Skill Manager, and Git Branch Badge, ready to use right after install.

description.zh: 为 DSH plugin 的官方 workflow 工具补上持久化 saved workflow 库，让跑通的编排脚本存下来、下次一行复跑。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a persisted saved-workflow library to the official workflow tool, so proven orchestration scripts can be stored and rerun in one line.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可拖动悬浮窗，实时显示会话 tok/s 输出速率、本步与累计 token、TTFT 及波形，并支持多会话切换。
description.en: A draggable floating widget for DeepSeek Harness that shows live tok/s output throughput, per-step and cumulative tokens, TTFT and a waveform, with multi-session switching.

description.zh: dsh-top 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 DSH plugin，在 Web GUI 右上角提供悬浮可折叠面板，实时展示 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络及 Top 进程等系统监控数据。
description.en: dsh-top is a DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that adds a floating, collapsible panel to the web GUI's top-right corner, showing live CPU, memory, disk, network, and top processes.

description.zh: DSH 插件，将 Trae 积分/额度转化为本地 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容 API，供 Claude Code、Cursor 等工具调用 Trae 底层模型。
description.en: A DSH plugin that converts Trae credits into a local OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API, enabling Claude Code, Cursor and other tools to call Trae models.

description.zh: DSH plugin 个人通用工具箱，在设置页提供页签式管理：任务完成提示、会话管理、插件开关与更新、应用用量统计、微信接入等多项工具。
description.en: A personal toolbox DSH plugin with tabbed settings for task-done notifications, session management, plugin toggles/updates, usage analytics, and WeChat integration.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 换上近黑纸面与薄荷绿强调色的纯皮肤插件，只改外观不加功能，支持深浅两套外壳与自定义强调色。
description.en: A pure skin plugin that restyles the DSH Web GUI with near-black paper and mint-green accents, changing appearance only with dark and light shells plus a custom accent color.

description.zh: 让 DSH Web 客户端把已认证的受信主机视为 loopback，使反向代理访问时模型设置、首次 API Key 等 Host 相关功能正常可用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that makes the authenticated Web UI count as loopback, so Host-backed settings like Models and the first-run API-key step work behind a reverse proxy.

description.zh: DSH plugin 用于检查 DeepSeek Harness 中插件实际加载状态，并查询 trapstreet.run 上的公开评测板，帮助开发者诊断插件是否真正生效。
description.en: A DSH plugin that checks which DeepSeek Harness plugins actually loaded and looks up public evaluation boards on trapstreet.run.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端提供会话头部重启按钮与 Windows 托盘图标，一键重启应用及宿主进程，无需手动退出。
description.en: Adds a session-header restart button and a Windows tray icon to the DeepSeek Harness desktop app, restarting both the Electron shell and its host process in one click.

description.zh: dshtui 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Ink 终端界面插件，以 opencode 风格接管整个终端，提供流式对话、可折叠工具卡片与对话框，并开放覆盖全部可见界面的贡献注册 API。
description.en: dshtui is an Ink-based terminal UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness that takes over the whole terminal in an opencode-style TUI, offering streaming chat, foldable tool cards, dialogs, and a contribution registry API for every visible surface.

description.zh: dsh-turn-budget 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 fail-closed 的每轮资源治理，独立限制模型步骤、工具调用次数与提供商 token 用量，防止单轮超限。
description.en: dsh-turn-budget is a fail-closed resource governor for DeepSeek Harness, independently limiting model steps, tool calls, and provider token usage per turn.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 对话按轮次着色：同一轮的用户提问与最终回复共享一种背景色，下一轮换色，让多轮对话一目了然。
description.en: Color-codes DeepSeek Harness Web conversations by turn: each user prompt and its final assistant reply share one background color, with the next turn switching to another.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话中彻底删除一整轮对话（提问、回答与工具调用），会话本身保留，删除写入日志刷新后不复活。
description.en: Hard-delete one complete turn (question, answer and tool calls) from a DeepSeek Harness session while keeping the session itself, with the removal logged so it stays gone after reload.

description.zh: dsh-turn-nav 是 DeepSeek Harness 的右侧会话轮次导航栏插件，在多轮长会话中快速定位与跳转任意历史轮次，并自动加载更早历史。
description.en: dsh-turn-nav is a DSH plugin that adds a right-side turn navigation bar, enabling quick location and jump to any historical turn in long multi-turn conversations, with auto-loading of older history.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供对话轮次导航面板，让用户快速跳转浏览历史对话轮次。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a turn navigator panel to the DeepSeek Harness web UI, enabling quick jumping between conversation turns.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话加上视频式进度条，悬停预览、拖拽定位、⌘K 搜索与 Esc 返回，让长对话里那一轮需求秒级找回。
description.en: A video-style progress bar for DeepSeek Harness conversations: hover previews, scrub, ⌘K search and Esc-return make any turn in a long session instantly findable.

description.zh: DSH UI Enhancer 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端增强界面，提供文件工作区、壁纸、桌面宠物与 @file 引用，并保留官方会话与槽位契约。
description.en: DSH UI Enhancer enhances the DeepSeek Harness desktop UI with a file workspace, wallpapers, desktop pets, and @file references while preserving official session and slot contracts.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Turns 标签页，按轮次与步骤逐层展开，显示每步 token 用量与费用估算，让每次对话花销一目了然。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a Turns tab to DeepSeek Harness, breaking each turn and step down to token usage and estimated cost so every conversation's spend is visible.

description.zh: LiteGlass 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 的轻量外观皮肤，支持自定义壁纸、玻璃拟态透明面板与强调色，服务端持久化设置，多设备同步，且不干扰原生明暗模式。
description.en: LiteGlass is a lightweight appearance skin for DeepSeek Harness, offering custom wallpaper, glass-like transparency, and accent color with server-side persistence and multi-device sync, leaving native light/dark mode untouched.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加完成提示音通知的 DSH plugin，支持开关、选音、调音量及后台会话提醒，设置持久化于 localStorage。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds completion sound notifications to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, with toggle, sound selection, volume control, and background-session reminders; settings persist in localStorage.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏加入会话进度看板，用角标与分栏汇总跨工作空间的进行中、已完成未查看会话，并支持筛选与一键跳转。
description.en: Adds a session progress board to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, using badges and columns to summarize running and unviewed finished sessions across workspaces, with filtering and one-click jump-in.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面添加 Git 工作台，提供变更、文件、历史、对比、提交同步及 worktree 仿真，不改动 DSH 本体。
description.en: Adds a Git workbench to DeepSeek Harness's web UI, offering changes, files, history, compare, commit & sync, and worktree simulation without modifying DSH core.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端与桌面端提供 50%~200% 的界面缩放设置，可在设置中拖动滑块、输入百分比或点选预设，缩放值随 profile 保存并在窗口出现前生效。
description.en: Sets the DeepSeek Harness Web UI and desktop app interface scale from 50% to 200% via a slider, percent field or presets, saved per profile and applied before the main window appears.

description.zh: DSH plugin「三体智子」为 DeepSeek Harness 注入产品设计 copilot 内核：五策流程、规模路由与质量闸，不过闸不交付，并带悬浮智子动态皮肤。
description.en: DSH plugin 'Three-Body Zhizi' adds a product-design copilot core to DeepSeek Harness: five-strategy pipeline, scale routing, and quality gate, with floating dynamic skins.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为设置侧边栏添加自定义导航图标，并开放 settings.section.icon 插槽，供第三方插件注入图标。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds custom navigation icons to the Settings sidebar and opens a settings.section.icon slot for third-party icon injection.

description.zh: dsh-up-session 是一款 DSH 插件，在侧边栏新增「置顶」与「最近」两个区，把分散在各工作区的置顶会话和最新会话汇总到一处，并同步显示运行状态。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds Pinned and Recent sections to the sidebar, gathering pinned and latest sessions from every workspace in one place with shared status indicators.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供版本可见性：模型工具、设置页更新检查与周期复查，只报告不升级，升级决策始终由用户掌控。
description.en: Bring version visibility to DeepSeek Harness: a model tool, a Settings update-check page, and periodic re-checks that only report, never upgrade.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供统一命令面板：一键模糊搜索并执行命令、模型、会话与历史记录，结果按确定性相关性排序，界面与 DSH 原生风格一致。
description.en: A unified command palette for DeepSeek Harness Web: one keystroke to fuzzy-search and run commands, models, sessions and conversation history, with deterministic ranking and a native DSH look.

description.zh: DSH 更新助手：追踪 dsh 核心、bundle 与全部 profile 插件（npm+git 双通道），生成变更简报辅助升级决策，仅执行确认过的更新。
description.en: Update copilot for DeepSeek Harness: tracks the dsh core, bundles, and every profile plugin (npm + git dual channel); changelog briefs for agent-assisted decisions; confirmed updates only.

description.zh: dsh-update-notifier 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 插件，每小时自动检查已安装插件的 npm 新版本，并通过一键批准气泡提示升级，确保插件保持最新。
description.en: dsh-update-notifier is a DSH plugin that hourly checks npm for newer versions of your installed plugins and prompts one-click approval bubbles to upgrade them.

description.zh: 为源码运行的 DeepSeek Harness 提供安全更新：核对官方发布、隔离构建候选版本、监督切换，失败时自动回滚原环境。
description.en: A safe updater DSH plugin for source-installed DeepSeek Harness: verify official releases, build candidates in isolation, switch under supervision, and roll back on failure.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 更新检查插件：定时检测新版本，在 logo 上显示 NEW 角标，并提供「关于」Tab 与 GitHub 加速开关。
description.en: A DSH plugin that periodically checks for updates, shows a NEW badge on the logo, and adds an About tab with a GitHub acceleration toggle.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供版本检测、多通道一键升级与服务守护，升级前自动快照备份并预检插件兼容性，避免旧插件导致服务崩溃。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that detects new versions, performs one-click multi-channel upgrades with pre-upgrade snapshots and plugin compatibility checks, and guards the web service.

description.zh: DSH plugin 会话 token 用量净化器，拦截异常指标，修复历史记录损坏，防止会话因 NaN 而永久不可读。
description.en: A DSH plugin that sanitizes session token usage, intercepts malformed metrics, and revives corrupted session history from NaN corruption.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在侧栏底部显示各 Coding Plan 剩余额度，点击弹出详情卡片，支持 OpenCode Go、火山引擎、DeepSeek 官方及自定义套餐。
description.en: A DSH plugin that displays remaining quota for coding plans in the sidebar, with detail cards on click, supporting OpenCode Go, Volcano Engine, DeepSeek official, and custom plans.

description.zh: DSH User Message Minimap 是 DeepSeek Harness 的界面插件，在长对话左侧显示用户消息导航轨，快速定位并跳转历史指令。
description.en: DSH User Message Minimap is a UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness that adds a compact navigation rail to long conversations, enabling quick jump to user messages.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供用户规则设置页，把自定义开发规则注入每个会话的 systemPrompt，编辑即生效无需重启。
description.en: A user-rules settings page for DeepSeek Harness that injects your own development rules into every session's systemPrompt, taking effect on the next turn without a restart.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 加一道保险墙：把指定敏感路径对 agent 伪装成不存在或直接拒绝，规则、审计与配置自身同样受保护。
description.en: A vault wall for DeepSeek Harness that hides or denies chosen sensitive paths from the agent, with rules, audit logs and its own config protected too.

description.zh: dsh-vditor 用 Vditor 即时渲染接管 DSH Web 聊天输入框，实现 Markdown 所见即所得、斜杠命令、@引用文件与附件胶囊，让输入更顺手。
description.en: dsh-vditor takes over the DSH Web chat input with Vditor instant rendering, enabling WYSIWYG Markdown, slash commands, @ file references, and attachment pills for smoother input.

description.zh: 在 DSH 网页版设置页底部显示当前 DeepSeek Harness 版本，并提供检查更新与一键升级到最新版的按钮。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows the current DeepSeek Harness version at the bottom of the web settings dialog, with buttons to check for and install the latest release.

description.zh: 这款 DSH plugin 在设置页浏览 373 个视频制作技能，一键下载并安装到 ~/.claude/skills 或 ~/.dsh/skills。
description.en: A DSH plugin that browses 373 agentic video-production skills in settings and installs a chosen one into ~/.claude/skills or ~/.dsh/skills with one click.

description.zh: 把课程、讲座、会议等视频自动转成结构化学习笔记的 DSH 技能包，借助 ffmpeg 与 Whisper 完成转写、分章与知识地图整理。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness skill bundle that turns course, lecture, and meeting videos into structured study notes via ffmpeg and Whisper transcription, chaptering, and knowledge maps.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让纯文本模型也能读懂图片：粘贴图片时自动调用视觉模型转写为文字，再交给原模型回答，无需切换模型。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets text-only models read images by transcribing them with a vision model before the request reaches the provider.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让纯文本模型也能读懂图片：粘贴图片时自动调用视觉模型转写为文字，再交给原模型回答，无需切换模型。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets text-only models read images by transcribing them with a vision model before the request reaches the provider.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供静默视觉桥接：将聊天图片自动发送至固定视觉模型，生成事实性文本观察，让纯文本主模型也能处理图片，同时保留 UI 原始图片。
description.en: A DSH plugin that silently bridges vision for DeepSeek Harness: routes chat images to a fixed vision model, converts them into factual text observations, and lets text-only main models handle images while preserving UI originals.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化视觉辅助，注册 vision_analyze 工具，让智能体通过可配置的多模态模型分析图片（OCR、截图、图表等），并带 Web 设置页与零依赖设计。
description.en: A persistent vision helper for DeepSeek Harness that registers the vision_analyze tool, enabling agents to analyze images via configurable multimodal models, with a Web settings page and zero-dependency design.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将图片转为 ASCII 艺术，让纯文本 LLM 也能“看见”并猜测图像内容，趣味十足。
description.en: A DSH plugin that converts images to ASCII art, enabling text-only LLMs to 'see' and guess image content—fun and playful.

description.zh: dsh-vision-link 是 DeepSeek Harness 的视觉侧车插件，让多模态模型读取图像，而所选文本模型保持推理与最终回答，实现路由不变的图像理解。
description.en: dsh-vision-link is a route-preserving vision sidecar plugin for DeepSeek Harness, letting a multimodal model see images while your selected text model stays in control of reasoning and final answers.

description.zh: DSH 视觉插件，为纯文本模型提供视觉能力：自动将图片转写为文本，并支持 vision_analyze 工具与视觉模型设置页。
description.en: Vision plugin for DeepSeek Harness: transcribes images to text for text-only models, plus a vision_analyze tool and a settings page.

description.zh: dsh-vision-toggle 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端提供按模型一键启用/禁用图片输入的开关，无需手改配置文件或重启，即时生效。
description.en: dsh-vision-toggle is a DSH plugin that adds a per-model vision toggle to the DeepSeek Harness desktop settings, enabling or disabling image input instantly without editing config or restarting.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让纯文本模型也能“看见”图片：粘贴图片自动改写为文本提示，并通过 analyze_image 工具路由到 Kimi 视觉模型，实现端到端图像理解。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives text-only models vision: pasted images are auto-rewritten into text prompts and routed via the analyze_image tool to a Kimi vision model.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供视觉记忆与主动检查能力：每张图片自动编号归档，可随时回看任意历史图像、裁剪放大局部区域并读取精确像素颜色。
description.en: Visual memory and active inspection for DeepSeek Harness: every image is archived with a stable id, so agents can revisit past visuals, crop and enlarge any region, and read exact pixel colors.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可视化浏览器：Agent 通过编号元素列表驱动真实 Chrome，侧边栏实时显示页面画面与操作时间线，用户可直接接管操作。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives the Agent a real Chrome through a token-light numbered element view, with a live sidebar screencast, an operation log, and a click-through surface you can take over.

description.zh: 为 DSH 网页端提供双向语音：说话即转写进输入框，回复自动朗读，麦克风持续监听。
description.en: A two-way voice DSH plugin for the web app: speak to dictate into the composer, hear replies read aloud, with the mic kept listening.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在输入框底部添加麦克风按钮，利用浏览器 Web Speech API 实时将语音转为文字并填入草稿，零成本零服务端。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a microphone button to the composer, using the browser's Web Speech API to transcribe speech into the draft in real time—zero cost, zero server.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供 btop 风格的实时硬件监控标签页，展示 CPU、内存、温度与 GPU 负载，可独立成页或停靠侧边栏。
description.en: A btop-style live hardware monitor tab for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, showing CPU, memory, temperature and GPU load as a full tab or docked sidebar panel.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供语音对话模式，点麦克风即可边说边听，AI 回复边生成边朗读，支持千问、讯飞与系统语音。
description.en: Adds a voice conversation mode to DeepSeek Harness Web: tap the mic to talk and listen hands-free, with AI replies spoken as they stream, powered by Qwen, iFlytek or system voices.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供语音输入与朗读功能，支持多种语音引擎，提升交互体验。
description.en: Adds voice input and read-aloud to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, with multiple TTS engines for enhanced interaction.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 Web GUI 提供浏览器内置语音输入，按住说话松手转文字，零服务端零 API Key，支持多语言与自动发送。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds browser-based speech input to the Web GUI, converting speech to text on release, with zero server and zero API key, supporting multiple languages and auto-send.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册 wait_subagent 工具，让 Agent 阻塞等待后台子代理结束并直接拿到停止原因与收尾消息，事件驱动、零轮询。
description.en: A DSH plugin that registers the wait_subagent tool, letting an agent block until a background continuable subagent settles and return its stop reason and closing message — event-driven, no polling.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供持久自定义壁纸的 DSH plugin，支持图片与视频、调节透明度与模糊，并固定本地服务端口。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds persistent custom wallpapers to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, supporting images/videos with opacity and blur controls, and a fixed local origin.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让 `dsh web` 启动时自动用系统默认浏览器打开 Web 界面，跨平台支持 Windows/macOS/Linux，无需手动复制网址。
description.en: A DSH plugin that auto-opens the default browser when `dsh web` starts, cross-platform on Windows/macOS/Linux, no manual URL copying needed.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多提供商网页搜索与内容抓取，支持 GitHub、PDF、YouTube 提取，并集成官方 ctx.web 工具。
description.en: Multi-provider web search and content fetching for DeepSeek Harness, with GitHub, PDF, and YouTube extraction, plus optional ctx.web integration.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Web 兼容修复，在非 secure context 下注入 crypto.randomUUID polyfill，解决局域网 HTTP 访问时附件上传崩溃，并新增设置面板。
description.en: DSH plugin provides web compatibility for DeepSeek Harness, injecting crypto.randomUUID polyfill in non-secure contexts to fix attachment upload crashes over LAN HTTP, and adds a settings panel.

description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 web_fetch 在 Clash / mihomo 的 TUN + fake-ip 模式下正常直连，无需设代理或关闭 TUN，同时保留原有 SSRF 防护。
description.en: Makes DeepSeek Harness web_fetch work under Clash / mihomo TUN + fake-ip mode without proxy env vars or disabling TUN, while keeping the original SSRF protection intact.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面补上任意文件上传能力，支持点击、粘贴、拖拽，文件存入会话工作区 uploads 目录并自动带入消息供 agent 读取。
description.en: Adds arbitrary file upload to the DeepSeek Harness web UI, supporting click, paste, and drag; files are saved to the session workspace uploads directory and auto-attached to messages for the agent to read.

description.zh: dsh-web-kimi 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册 Kimi Coding 驱动的网页搜索与抓取双 provider，一个密钥覆盖 ctx.web 两条链路，零配置接入。
description.en: dsh-web-kimi registers Kimi Coding-backed web search and fetch providers into the DeepSeek Harness ctx.web seam, one key covering both pipelines with zero config.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 加一道零依赖密码门：Cookie 认证、首次强制设密、失败锁定 60 秒，并内置访问日志查看器。
description.en: A zero-dependency DSH plugin adding a web password gate to DeepSeek Harness: cookie auth, forced initial password setup, 60s lockout on failures, and a built-in access log viewer.

description.zh: dsh-web-desktop 为 DeepSeek Harness Web Profile 提供 Electron 桌面启动器，复用同一 Web 配置与插件，让浏览器与桌面窗口体验一致。
description.en: dsh-web-desktop provides an Electron launcher for DeepSeek Harness Web profiles, reusing the same Web config and plugins for a consistent desktop experience.

description.zh: DSH plugin 集成 Bocha 网络搜索，注册为 web 搜索提供商，支持新鲜度过滤、摘要和结果计数，并自动配置 API 密钥。
description.en: A DSH plugin integrating Bocha web search, registering as a web search provider with freshness filters, summaries, and result counts, plus automatic API key configuration.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 AnySearch 网页搜索后端，可在插件设置卡片中一键切换官方 DeepSeek 搜索与 AnySearch，保存后下一次 web_search 立即生效。
description.en: An AnySearch-backed web search provider for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that lets you switch the web_search backend between the official DeepSeek endpoint and AnySearch from a Plugins settings card, taking effect on the next call.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 web seam 提供智谱 GLM 搜索提供商，通过 Anthropic 兼容 API 执行原生 web_search，并映射为标准化搜索结果。
description.en: Zhipu GLM search provider for the DeepSeek Harness web seam, executing native web_search via the Anthropic-compatible API and mapping results to normalized sources.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供免密钥的 web_search 工具，单次调用并行扇出 Startpage、DuckDuckGo、Ecosia、Google、Mojeek 五个公共引擎，并按跨引擎共识合并结果。
description.en: A credential-free web_search tool for DeepSeek Harness that fans a query out to Startpage, DuckDuckGo, Ecosia, Google and Mojeek in parallel, then merges results by cross-engine consensus.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 SearXNG 元搜索的网页搜索提供者，无需厂商 API Key 与账号，查询不被单一身份关联。
description.en: A web-search provider that plugs a SearXNG metasearch instance into DeepSeek Harness, requiring no vendor API key or account to tie queries together.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供免账号免 API Key 的联网搜索，并可选在本地文件上建立全文索引检索。
description.en: A keyless web-search provider for the DeepSeek Harness, plus an optional fully local full-text index over your own files.

description.zh: 让 DSH 联网搜索跟随当前会话模型改写检索词，并接入 SearXNG、Tavily、Brave 等自建检索后端，避免官方 token 额度持续计费。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that routes web search through the current session model for query rewriting and a self-hosted retrieval backend such as SearXNG, Tavily or Brave, avoiding official token billing.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为会话添加网页搜索开关，开启后强制模型在回答前调用 web_search，模拟 DeepSeek 网页聊天体验。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding a per-session Web Search toggle that forces the agent to call web_search before answering, mirroring DeepSeek's web chat UI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Z.ai (GLM) 网络搜索的 DSH plugin，复用现有 ZAI_API_KEY，无需新账号或额外配置，一条命令即可启用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that plugs Z.ai (GLM) web search into DeepSeek Harness, reusing your existing ZAI_API_KEY with no new account or extra setup.

description.zh: 把网页版 DeepSeek 接入 DSH 的桥接插件：纯 DOM 自动化收发消息，按别名归档讨论记忆并注入主会话，让本地模型带着上下文调用工具执行。
description.en: A DSH plugin that bridges the DeepSeek web chat into DeepSeek Harness: pure DOM automation drives the web session, archives discussion memory by alias, and injects it into the main session so the local model can act with context.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web GUI 加上账号密码登录门禁，令牌 12 小时有效，过期登出不影响后台任务，重新登录后一切照旧。
description.en: Adds an account-password login gate to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with 12-hour tokens; expiring doesn't affect background tasks, and everything resumes after re-login.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 S3、小米 FDS 与 FTP/FTPS 文件工具，含 8 个 Agent 工具，变更操作需审批，传输支持进度与取消。
description.en: S3, Xiaomi FDS, and FTP/FTPS file tools for DeepSeek Harness: 8 agent tools with approval-gated mutations and cancellable transfer jobs.

description.zh: DSH 插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 的 webfetch 请求按 hostname 规则路由到 HTTP/SOCKS 代理，让 LLM 也能科学上网，并支持通过工具动态维护代理列表。
description.en: A DSH plugin that routes webfetch requests to HTTP/SOCKS proxies by hostname rules, enabling LLM to access blocked sites, with tools to dynamically manage proxy list.

description.zh: dsh-webui-background 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 插件，为 Web UI 提供可配置的背景图，支持上传、预览、深浅色遮罩调节，按 profile 独立保存。
description.en: dsh-webui-background is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides configurable background images for the Web UI, supporting upload, preview, light/dark mask adjustments, and per-profile storage.

description.zh: DSH 微信桥接插件，通过腾讯官方 iLink 协议将手机微信接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持流式回复、扫码登录、会话持久化、定时任务与网页抓取。
description.en: A DSH plugin bridging WeChat to DeepSeek Harness via Tencent's official iLink protocol, enabling streaming replies, QR login, session persistence, cron jobs, and web fetch.

description.zh: 这款 DSH plugin 能把本地文件一键发到微信「文件传输助手」，方便手机远程取用电脑上的报告与截图。
description.en: A DSH plugin that sends local files straight to WeChat's File Transfer Assistant, so you can grab reports and screenshots from your phone while working remotely.

description.zh: 为 DSH 小鲸鱼记账挂件加上喂白米饭、饱食度与干活敲键盘反应，让鲸鱼娘变成会吃白饭的工作伙伴，打发等待时间。
description.en: Adds rice feeding, a satiety meter and keyboard-typing reactions to the DSH whale widget, turning the whale girl into a rice-eating work buddy that fills your waiting time.

description.zh: DSH 等回复时的鲸鱼跳跃小游戏挂件，在对话流下方提供一行入口，点开即可玩 canvas 跑酷，纯本地零依赖。
description.en: A whale-jump mini-game widget for DeepSeek Harness that adds a lightweight entry line under the conversation, opening a local, dependency-free canvas runner while you wait.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在根代理完成任务时，于 Web GUI 底部跃出 DeepSeek 官方鲸鱼喷水庆祝，3 秒后沉入，为枯燥任务增添趣味。
description.en: A DSH plugin that celebrates task completion by showing an official DeepSeek whale spraying water at the bottom of the Web GUI, sinking after 3 seconds.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Windows 上弹出系统 Toast 通知，任务完成、需要输入或审批时提醒用户，零依赖且支持通知中心持久显示。
description.en: A DSH plugin that raises real Windows toasts for task completion, input requests, and approval prompts, with zero runtime dependencies and Notification Center persistence.

description.zh: 这款 DSH plugin 在深度思考指示器旁实时显示输入/输出 token 徽标，自动换算 K/M/G/T 单位，并为每一步操作标注自身消耗，让你看清每轮 token 花在哪。
description.en: A DSH plugin that puts live input/output token badges beside the deep-thinking indicator, auto-scales K/M/G/T units, and tags each operation row with its own step cost so you can see where every turn's tokens went.

description.zh: 为 Windows 上的 DSH pwsh 工具提供真正的 PowerShell 7：检测、校验路径，并从 Microsoft Store 安装，避免静默退回 5.1。
description.en: Gives the DSH pwsh tool on Windows a real PowerShell 7: detect and validate the runtime path, then install it from the Microsoft Store instead of silently falling back to 5.1.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 原生 Toast 通知，任务完成、审批或出错时提醒，点击通知可聚焦窗口并直接跳回对应会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that sends native Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness on task completion, approvals and errors, and clicking a toast focuses the app and jumps straight to that conversation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧栏工作台：工作区与会话管理、文件树浏览、多标签预览、会话置顶与运行状态指示，并增强 @ 文件引用与输入历史召回。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns the native sidebar into a full workbench: workspace and session management, file tree browsing, multi-tab previews, pinned sessions, live run status, plus @ file references and input history recall.

description.zh: Neural Ledger 是一款 DSH plugin，将 AI 协作会话转化为可视化工作账本，提供 token 分析、智能洞察、趋势预测和一键生成日报/周报/月报 Markdown 报告。
description.en: Neural Ledger is a DSH plugin that turns AI collaboration sessions into a visual work ledger with token analytics, smart insights, trend forecasting, and one-click daily/weekly/monthly Markdown reports.

description.zh: 为官方 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供紧凑应用导航的 DSH plugin：56px 应用栏、独立对话列表与侧栏展开收起控制，并可按聊天用途筛选模型菜单。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives official DeepSeek Harness Web a compact app navigation: a 56px app bar, a separate conversation list, sidebar collapse control, and chat-only model menu filtering.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供明暗配色、APTX 胶囊标志与可选展示素材的主题插件，可在设置中切换装饰强度并保留原生明暗模式。
description.en: A DSH plugin that themes the official DeepSeek Harness Web with light/dark palettes, an APTX capsule logo and optional artwork panels, all tunable from settings.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧栏工作台：工作区与会话管理、文件树浏览、多标签预览、会话置顶与运行状态指示，并增强 @ 文件引用与输入历史召回。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns the native sidebar into a full workbench: workspace and session management, file tree browsing, multi-tab previews, pinned sessions, live run status, plus @ file references and input history recall.

description.zh: 把本机已登录的 WorkBuddy 账号通过 DSH plugin 发布为 OpenAI 兼容 HTTP 服务，让 WSL、Windows 上的其他 Agent 工具复用同一份模型额度。
description.en: A DSH plugin that exposes your locally logged-in WorkBuddy account as an OpenAI-compatible HTTP service, so other agent tools on Windows, WSL, macOS or Linux can reuse the same model quota.

description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面端的登录态搜索接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 web_search，无需 API Key 即可返回带引用来源的检索综述。
description.en: Routes DeepSeek Harness web_search through your logged-in WorkBuddy desktop app, returning cited research summaries with no API key required.

description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 或 CodeBuddy CLI 的登录凭据接入 DeepSeek Harness，零配置复用其模型，桌面优先、CLI 兜底。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings WorkBuddy desktop app or CodeBuddy CLI credentials into DeepSeek Harness, reusing their models with zero configuration and desktop-first, CLI-fallback lookup.

description.zh: DSH 侧栏积分面板插件，复用 WorkBuddy 登录态并缓存读取，直观展示余额、到期分布、免费模型与倍率，支持手动刷新。
description.en: A DSH sidebar panel plugin that reuses your WorkBuddy login and cached reads to show credit balance, expiry spread, free models, and per-model rates, with manual refresh.

description.zh: 把 workbuddy2api-panel 的模型、倍率与额度同步进 DeepSeek Harness，在设置页可视化勾选模型并查看用量，免去手写 cordis.patch.yml 的 models 列表。
description.en: Syncs workbuddy2api-panel models, multipliers and quotas into DeepSeek Harness, letting you pick models and view usage from a settings panel instead of hand-writing the models list in cordis.patch.yml.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 加宽聊天视图的 DSH plugin，让对话文本铺满整屏，并限制用户气泡与输入框高度，附带可在设置页调节的选项。
description.en: A DSH plugin that widens the DeepSeek Harness chat view so messages fill the screen, caps the user bubble and composer height, with tunable settings in the General page.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供任务分解与真实部门子 Agent 派发，并在侧边栏「任务进度」面板实时展示每项工作的完成情况。
description.en: A DSH plugin that decomposes tasks into plans, dispatches real department sub-agents, and shows live progress in a sidebar panel.

description.zh: 把本地 workbuddy2api-hub 网关接入 DSH 的插件：同步模型列表与倍率，侧边栏常驻余额与用量徽标，设置页管理连接。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects a local workbuddy2api-hub gateway: syncs models with rates, shows a sidebar badge for balance and usage, and manages the connection in Settings.

description.zh: DSH 插件：自动重建被误删但仍绑定会话的工作区目录，并把失去归属的旧会话折叠成摘要导入新会话，全程只读日志。
description.en: A DSH plugin that recreates a deleted workspace folder still owning sessions and folds stranded sessions into a summary for reuse, without ever rewriting session logs.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 左侧边栏增加工作区行切换：悬停工作区标题点击图标，会话列表即变为该工作区的懒加载文件树，点击文件交给右侧栏打开。
description.en: Adds a workspace-row toggle to the DeepSeek Harness left sidebar: hover a workspace title, click the icon, and its session list turns into a lazy-loaded file tree whose files open in the right sidebar.

description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏隐藏指定工作区，并把其名下会话一并归档，纯本地可逆、不删数据，可在设置页随时恢复显示。
description.en: Hide selected workspaces from the DSH sidebar and archive their sessions along with them — local-only, reversible, nothing deleted, restorable anytime from Settings.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供项目级 MCP 支持：在项目目录放置 .dsh/mcp.json，会话启动即自动挂载该项目的 MCP 服务器，随会话销毁自动断开。
description.en: A DSH plugin that makes MCP project-scoped: drop a .dsh/mcp.json into a repo and each session auto-mounts that project's MCP servers, disconnecting when the session ends.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供工作区增强：⌘K Spotlight 模糊搜索工作区与会话，支持软归档与恢复、自定义图标配色及可拖拽排序的侧边栏。
description.en: A DSH plugin that enhances workspaces: ⌘K Spotlight fuzzy search across workspaces and sessions, soft archive/restore, per-workspace icons and colors, plus a drag-reorder sidebar.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 工作区增加多级目录标签映射，把「标签→绝对路径」表注入 agent 上下文，让跨仓库项目不再手写路径、避免改错文件。
description.en: Adds multi-directory label mapping to DeepSeek Harness workspaces, injecting a label-to-absolute-path table into agent context so cross-repo projects need no hand-written paths and edits land in the right files.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 左侧工作区提供增强侧栏的 DSH plugin，支持收藏、颜色标签、排序置顶、会话状态灯与桌面通知。
description.en: A DSH plugin that upgrades the DeepSeek Harness workspace sidebar with favorites, color tags, sorting and pinning, session status lights, and desktop notifications.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的工作区行加上彩色状态标记，聚合显示等待你处理、运行中与刚完成三种状态，折叠分组也能一眼看到。
description.en: Adds colored status marks to DeepSeek Harness sidebar workspace rows, aggregating waiting, running, and recently finished states so collapsed groups still show activity at a glance.

description.zh: 为每个工作区配置专属提示词的 DSH plugin，写一次即可在该工作区每次会话启动时自动注入模型上下文，重启后依然保留。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets you set a per-workspace prompt once and auto-injects it into the model context at every session start in that workspace, persisting across restarts.

description.zh: dsh-workstate 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供结构化工作状态检查点与安全的 Agent 交接，支持暂停、导出、校验与恢复任务，确保工作区一致。
description.en: dsh-workstate provides structured work-state checkpoints and safe agent handoffs for DeepSeek Harness, enabling pause, export, validate, and resume of tasks with workspace integrity.

description.zh: dsh-write-gate 是 DeepSeek Harness 的承诺写入门禁插件，在工具调用前强制执行操作者设定的约束，通过确定性检查与 LLM 评判双层拦截违规操作，并记录矛盾日志。
description.en: dsh-write-gate is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that enforces operator-authored commitments before tool calls, using deterministic checks and an LLM judge to block violations and log contradictions.

description.zh: DSH plugin 写作工作台：半窗面板管理卷/章正文，将 .dsh-notes 笔记作为资料随时查看引用，内置编辑器与导出功能。
description.en: A DSH plugin writing workbench: half-window panel for volume/chapter management, using .dsh-notes as reference material with editor and export.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注入系统提示词路由，让 Windows 上的命令执行优先走 WSL 而非 pwsh，减少语法翻译与重试，省下 token。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects a system-prompt router so command execution on Windows prefers WSL over pwsh, cutting syntax translation and retries to save tokens.

description.zh: 小D桌宠是一款 DSH plugin：鲸鱼正太女仆装桌宠可拖拽、随对话切换表情，右下角立牌显示每轮 token 与思考时间，并附液态玻璃主题。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a draggable whale-boy maid desktop pet with chat-driven expressions, a corner placard showing per-turn token usage and thinking time, plus a liquid-glass theme.

description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上会话管理器与共同成长助理：看板记待办、秘书/CEO/史官三角色陪你把事做完，数据全留本地。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a session manager and co-growing assistant to DeepSeek Harness: a kanban for todos plus secretary, CEO and historian roles, with all data kept locally.

description.zh: dsh-xray 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供上下文成本透视，逐插件归因 token 消耗、检查条目与依赖级联，帮助开发者优化 LLM 调用成本。
description.en: dsh-xray is a DSH plugin for LLM context-cost observability: per-plugin token attribution, entry inspection, and dependency cascades to optimize your harness.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供选区标注：选中回复或文件中的文字加注，按 Enter 随消息发送，模型按编号逐条回应。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DSH Web that lets you select text in replies or files, annotate it, and send annotations with your message so the model answers each by number.

description.zh: DSH plugin 桥接插件，在 zai-coding-cn 路由上提前暴露最新智谱 GLM-5.3 编码模型，无需升级 DSH 或手改配置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that exposes the newest Zhipu GLM-5.3 coding model on the zai-coding-cn route before the bundled catalog catches up.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 WebSocket 传输开启 permessage-deflate 压缩，不改动 DSH 安装目录，实测重连回放流量减少约 70%。
description.en: Enables permessage-deflate on DeepSeek Harness web's WebSocket transport without touching the DSH install tree, cutting replayed transcript bytes by about 70% in testing.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Web 界面新增「额度」选项卡，实时展示智谱 GLM Coding Plan 的 Token 窗口、MCP 工具额度与模型/工具用量，让额度一目了然。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a Quota tab to the web UI, showing GLM Coding Plan token windows, MCP tool quota, and model/tool usage at a glance.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入知乎的 DSH plugin：包装本机 pyzhihu-cli，提供 18 个 zhihu_* 工具做搜索、热榜、问答与用户查询，写操作默认关闭，并附侧栏「知」球与设置页可视化面板。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that wraps the local pyzhihu-cli into 18 zhihu_* tools for search, hot list, questions, answers and users, with write actions off by default plus a floating 「知」 ball and settings panel.

description.zh: DSHACP 是 DeepSeek Harness 的插件，让 Zed 编辑器通过 ACP 协议直接对话 DeepSeek，支持读写文件、执行命令与风险操作确认。
description.en: DSHACP is a DSH plugin that enables Zed editor to chat with DeepSeek via ACP protocol, supporting file read/write, command execution, and risk confirmation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供高保真 PDF 解析、翻译、格式转换及额度查询等工具，并集成持久化 API 密钥设置与 CLI 配置。
description.en: DSH plugin offering high-fidelity PDF parsing, translation, conversion, and balance tools with durable API-key settings and CLI configuration.

description.zh: DET 是 DeepSeek Harness 的常驻插件，让模型驱动你已登录的浏览器，并支持对话分支编辑重试、项目运行与快照回退、插件与 token 管理。
description.en: DET is a permanent DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets the model drive your already-logged-in browser, branch and retry conversations, run and snapshot projects, and manage plugins and token spend.

description.zh: DSHost 官方 DSH 远程中继插件，让 dsh 实例主动外连 wss 中继，无需公网 IP 或端口映射即可在任意地点用浏览器安全访问自己的 dsh Web UI。
description.en: Official DSHost relay plugin for DeepSeek Harness: your dsh instance dials out over wss to a cloud relay, so you can securely reach its Web UI from anywhere without a public IP or port forwarding.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上 OpenCode Go 路由适配器，实时读取网关模型目录，并提供额度窗口、花费估算与逐模型开关。
description.en: Adds an OpenCode Go route adapter to DeepSeek Harness with a live gateway model catalog, quota windows, cost estimates, and per-model visibility toggles.

description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面端提供基于 SenseVoiceSmall 的本地语音输入，点麦克风说话即把识别文本写入输入框草稿，全程本地 CPU 推理。
description.en: A local voice-input DSH plugin powered by SenseVoiceSmall: click the mic, speak, and the transcript is written straight into the composer draft with fully local CPU inference.

description.zh: file-brief 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 等 Agent 的文件预检技能，将重复的输入文件检查沉淀为任务级、隐私友好的目录，生成 Markdown 说明与 SQLite 索引，供后续会话复用。
description.en: file-brief is a file pre-inspection skill for DeepSeek Harness and other agents, turning repeated input-file checks into task-local, privacy-preserving catalogs with Markdown docs and SQLite indexes for reuse.

description.zh: dshX 是一个基于 DeepSeek Harness 的优化版 TUI 终端编程应用，内置 prefab 预设与 j-space 技能，一条命令启动 Claude Code 风格交互。
description.en: dshX is an optimized TUI terminal coding app built on DeepSeek Harness, bundling prefab presets and j-space skills, launched with a single command for Claude Code-style interaction.

description.zh: 把 DSH 工作区与飞书私有群一一绑定，实现会话与群消息实时双向同步，离开电脑也能在飞书里继续推进任务。
description.en: Binds each DSH workspace to a private Feishu group and syncs messages both ways in real time, so you can keep pushing tasks forward from Feishu.

description.zh: emoking 是 DeepSeek Harness 右下角的虚拟烟挂件，用模拟抽烟顶住烟瘾，减少真实吸烟与二手烟，纯本地运行。
description.en: emoking is a DSH plugin that places a virtual-cigarette widget in the bottom-right corner of DeepSeek Harness, letting you simulate a smoke to curb cravings and cut real smoking and secondhand smoke, all locally.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 FitMeet 真人社交网络的 MCP 与 Skill 插件，经 OAuth 2.1 + PKCE 授权后可找人、发布内容并管理私聊。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects DeepSeek Harness to the FitMeet human network via MCP and a bundled Skill, with per-user OAuth 2.1 + PKCE authorization for people search, publishing, and direct messages.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 等 Agent 提供足球数据 MCP 服务器，支持 18 个欧洲联赛与 8 个杯赛的比赛、积分榜、交锋、赔率及近期状态查询。
description.en: A football data MCP server for DeepSeek Harness and other agents, covering 18 European leagues and 8 cups with matches, standings, head-to-head, odds, and form queries.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中通过 ChatGPT 网页会话或 OpenAI 兼容 API 生成设计图与单文件 HTML demo，本地画廊预览并保存交付稿。
description.en: A DSH plugin that generates design images and standalone HTML demos via ChatGPT web sessions or OpenAI-compatible image APIs, with a local gallery and versioned delivery notes.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供双主题皮肤、本地图片轮播背景与实时 Token 用量面板，增强桌面端视觉与统计体验。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings dual themes, local wallpaper carousel, and a real-time token usage dashboard to DeepSeek Harness desktop.

description.zh: J-Space Harness 将 J-Space 认知套件 V3.6 封装为 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent 预设，提供原生作用域提示、按代理状态隔离与缓存稳定的检查点。
description.en: J-Space Harness packages the J-Space Cognition Suite V3.6 as a DeepSeek Harness agent preset with native scoped prompts, per-agent state isolation, and cache-stable checkpoints.

description.zh: 在 DSH 会话输入框下方展示 JIRA 中指派给当前用户的开启任务面板，支持按工作区配置项目 Key 与 JQL，并在设置页管理地址与令牌。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows a JIRA panel under the chat input listing open tasks assigned to you, with per-workspace project key and JQL configuration plus in-settings URL and token management.

description.zh: LoongPort 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供已验证的 OpenAI 兼容模型路由，支持一键配置 DeepSeek 官方 API 与自定义端点，并附赠 CLI 工具。
description.en: LoongPort brings verified OpenAI-compatible model routes to DeepSeek Harness, enabling one-click setup for DeepSeek official API and custom endpoints, plus a CLI.

description.zh: 为陪伴型 DSH agent 打造的 Hindsight 记忆适配器，每轮对话自动召回并注入记忆，按会话留存完整对话，并提供只读反思工具。
description.en: A Hindsight memory adapter for companion-style DSH agents: it recalls and injects memory on every direct turn, retains one stable session document, and exposes a read-only reflect tool.

description.zh: lazeword 是一款基于 DeepSeek Harness 的单词锚定双语学习插件，通过场景驱动与 FSRS-5 间隔重复，让用户躺着也能高效背单词，并支持 AI 辅导与离线使用。
description.en: lazeword is a word-anchored bilingual learning plugin for DeepSeek Harness, using scenario-driven design and FSRS-5 spaced repetition to make vocabulary learning effortless, with AI tutoring and offline support.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让 agent 经 JumpServer 与 KoKo 堡垒管理资产、执行命令和读写文件，流量不直连资产 IP，保留命令过滤、ACL 与会话审计。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets agents manage JumpServer assets and operate on them through KoKo bastion, keeping traffic off direct IPs while preserving command filtering, ACL, and session audit.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 GitHub 连接器插件，通过 dsh-native 工具审查 PR、分诊 issue、调试 Actions CI 并处理 GitHub 事件。
description.en: A GitHub connector plugin for DeepSeek Harness, providing dsh-native tools to review PRs, triage issues, debug Actions CI, and handle GitHub events.

description.zh: Maglev for DSH 为 DeepSeek Harness 注入 29 个研发技能与 GUI 卡片，实现可控迭代、知识沉淀与降低项目对特定人和 AI 体系的依赖。
description.en: Maglev for DSH injects 29 R&D skills and GUI cards into DeepSeek Harness, enabling controlled iteration, knowledge crystallization, and reducing project dependency on specific people and AI systems.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 GitLab 合并请求自动审查流水线：webhook 接入、编排器调度审查与审计子代理、发现项记录与设置界面。
description.en: An automated GitLab merge-request review pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: webhook intake, an orchestrator running reviewer/auditor subagents, findings tracking, and a settings UI.

description.zh: mimo-vision 是 DeepSeek Harness 的原生视觉插件，注册 describe_image 工具，将图像发送至 mimo-v2.5 多模态模型并返回文本描述，为无视觉能力的主模型提供视觉桥梁。
description.en: mimo-vision is a native DeepSeek Harness plugin that registers a describe_image tool, sending images to a mimo-v2.5 multimodal model and returning text descriptions, acting as a vision bridge for main models lacking vision.

description.zh: NoAtMark 文本卫生插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供净化不可见字符、扫描注入、清理 LLM 格式及转义 CSV 注入等工具，全程本地确定性处理。
description.en: NoAtMark text hygiene plugin for DeepSeek Harness: sanitize invisible characters, scan injections, clean LLM formatting, and escape CSV injection, all deterministic and local.

description.zh: oh-my-dsh 是 DSH plugin 组合包，为 DeepSeek Harness Web 端一次性带来手机界面、登录、文件与 Git 侧栏、MCP 管理、搜索切换与 Codex 支持。
description.en: oh-my-dsh is a DSH plugin bundle that equips DeepSeek Harness Web with a mobile UI, login, file/Git sidebar, MCP management, search provider switching and Codex support in one install.

description.zh: DSH 插件：当模型在知识库目录执行 grep/glob 搜索时，自动补充 QMD 语义检索结果并注入上下文，提升检索准确性。
description.en: DSH plugin that auto-supplements QMD semantic search results when the model greps/globs a knowledge-base directory, injecting them into context.

description.zh: omdp 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件 monorepo，提供 MCP 与技能管理、多密钥轮换、视觉桥接等 DSH 插件，提升 Agent 开发与运行效率。
description.en: omdp is a monorepo of DeepSeek Harness plugins, offering MCP & skills management, multi-key rotation, and vision bridge to boost DSH agent development and runtime.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的论文阅读面板：将 PDF 转为带图表与公式的可选文本，并支持选中提问的对话式论文问答。
description.en: A paper-review panel for DeepSeek Harness: converts PDFs into selectable text with figures and equations, and enables an ask-the-paper dialog.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供逆向工程工具集，可检查二进制、应用、包与网页，并为每个结论附上可验证证据。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness agents reverse-engineering tools to inspect binaries, apps, packages, and web pages, returning verifiable evidence for every conclusion.

description.zh: relay-dsh-plugin-manager 是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件管理器，让用户通过自然语言在对话中搜索、安装、更新、启用、禁用和移除 DSH 插件，无需手动编辑配置文件。
description.en: relay-dsh-plugin-manager is a DeepSeek Harness plugin manager that lets users discover, install, update, enable, disable, and remove DSH plugins via natural language in chat, without manual Profile editing.

description.zh: RoutineKit 把成功的工具调用录制为可审阅、可参数化的例程，在 DeepSeek Harness 中改换输入即可重放，无需模型逐步重建，并支持导出 SKILL.md 与 MCP 复用。
description.en: RoutineKit turns successful tool calls into reviewed, parameterized routines you can replay in DeepSeek Harness with new inputs, no model reconstruction needed, and exports them as SKILL.md or MCP tools.

description.zh: DSH plugin 的 RSS/Atom 聚合摘要工具：订阅管理、定时抓取、去重、LLM 摘要，并生成每日 Markdown 简报。
description.en: A DSH plugin for RSS/Atom aggregation: subscribe, scheduled fetch, dedupe, LLM summaries, and daily Markdown briefings.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 客户端添加流光动效的 DSH plugin，涵盖输入框辉光、发送过渡与流式反馈，支持逐项开关并遵循减少动效偏好。
description.en: A DSH plugin that layers light-based motion onto the DeepSeek Harness client — composer glow, send transitions and streaming feedback, with per-effect toggles and reduced-motion support.

description.zh: SearchSieve 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，逐页评估搜索结果语义相关度，量化覆盖度与冗余，让 AI 检索透明可信。
description.en: SearchSieve is a DSH plugin that evaluates search results page by page, quantifying coverage and redundancy to make AI retrieval transparent and trustworthy.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏添加会话看板，集中展示各会话的当前工作、待办进度与活跃热力图，一键跳回会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a session kanban board to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, showing each session's current work, todo progress and an activity heatmap with one-click jump-back.

description.zh: 让 DSH 模型在安全时机自主压缩上下文，并提供真实 token 用量查询，避免被固定阈值在任务中途打断。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that lets the model compact its own context at a safe point and see real token usage, instead of being cut off mid-task by a blind threshold.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供「先候选、你批准才入库」的本地 Markdown 记忆，召回有回执、可追溯，纯本地不联网。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness approval-gated memory stored as local Markdown, with budgeted recall and visible receipts.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 Web UI 提供真实可交互的终端面板，基于 node-pty 与 xterm.js，支持多标签、停靠与浮动窗口，开箱即用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings a real interactive terminal panel to the Web UI, powered by node-pty and xterm.js, with multi-tab, dock and float modes.

description.zh: Talon 是 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的终端 UI 插件，在终端内提供流式会话、工具审批、用户提问、斜杠命令及跨工作区会话恢复等完整交互体验。
description.en: Talon is a terminal UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), offering streaming transcripts, tool approvals, user questions, slash commands, and cross-workspace session resume in the terminal.

description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Host 与 Client 之间的双向 RPC 能力，基于原生 Connection 与 Typert Gateway 打通浏览器或 Node 对端调用、事件订阅与连接生命周期管理。
description.en: A DSH plugin that enables bidirectional RPC between Host and Client over the native DSH Connection and Typert Gateway, covering peer calls, event subscriptions and connection lifecycle handling.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化的 token 用量统计，按会话、模型和每日活动展示数据，并内置设置页与热力图。
description.en: Persistent token usage statistics for DeepSeek Harness with per-session, per-model, and daily activity views, plus a built-in settings page and heatmap.

description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness Web界面添加一只可拖拽的桌宠小猫托托，支持自定义外观、番茄闹钟与成长系统，零依赖即装即用。
description.en: Add a draggable desktop pet cat Toto to the DeepSeek Harness web UI, with customizable appearance, pomodoro timer, and growth system, zero-dependency and ready to use.

description.zh: UCloud 技能插件将 ucloud-cli 迁移至 DeepSeek Harness，通过 DSH Bash 工具调用官方 CLI，实现对 UCloud 资源的查看、创建、更新与删除等云操作。
description.en: This DSH plugin migrates the ucloud-cli skill into DeepSeek Harness, enabling UCloud resource management via the official CLI through the DSH Bash tool.

description.zh: totoro-pet 是 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的悬浮桌宠插件，以 Q 版龙猫常驻页面右下角，支持喂食、抚摸、玩耍、睡觉等互动养成，并具备拖拽换位、外观自定义与图鉴鉴赏功能。
description.en: totoro-pet is a DeepSeek Harness Web GUI desktop pet plugin featuring a chibi Totoro that floats at the bottom-right corner, supporting feeding, petting, playing, and sleeping interactions with growth mechanics.

description.zh: Touchstone 是运行在 DeepSeek Harness 上的自动化测试平台，让 DSH 代理自动生成并执行测试用例、提交缺陷报告、修复代码并回归验证。
description.en: Touchstone is an automated testing platform for DeepSeek Harness that drives a DSH agent to generate and run test cases, file bug reports, fix code, and re-verify the fix.

description.zh: volens 是一个 DSH plugin，用只增不改的决策日志自动派生并刷新设计文档，让项目文档始终跟随每一次决策，不再手工维护、不再过期。
description.en: volens is a DSH plugin that keeps a project's design doc in step with its decisions: an append-only decision log derives and auto-refreshes the design snapshot, so docs never drift out of date.

description.zh: 通过系统提示词注入，分别控制 DSH 中 AI 的回复语言与思考语言，支持中英切换与自定义提示模板。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects system prompts to control the AI's reply language and thinking language separately, with Chinese/English switching and custom prompt templates.

description.zh: 为 DSH 的 dsh web 加装 HTTPS 登录网关与用户管理：首个注册者即管理员，支持角色、TOTP 两步验证、注册审批、IP 封禁与登录/访问/操作三本审计账。
description.en: Adds an HTTPS login gateway and user management to DSH's dsh web: the first registrant becomes admin, with roles, TOTP two-factor auth, registration approval, IP bans, and login/access/operation audit logs.

description.zh: wallpaper-engine-dsh 将本地 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库变为 DSH Web GUI 的实时动态背景，支持视频/网页壁纸、旋转列表、搜索、资源监控与双语界面。
description.en: wallpaper-engine-dsh turns your local Wallpaper Engine library into live backgrounds for the DSH web GUI, with video/web wallpapers, rotation lists, search, resource monitor, and bilingual UI.

description.zh: XMemo 是 DeepSeek Harness 原生插件，混合本地与 XMemo 云记忆，支持离线写入队列、OAuth 2.1 登录及 16 个记忆工具，实现持久记忆与工作连续性。
description.en: XMemo is a native DeepSeek Harness plugin providing hybrid local and XMemo cloud memory with offline write queue, OAuth 2.1 login, and 16 memory tools for durable recall and continuity.

description.zh: 非官方 DSH 插件，在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页渲染全历史会话的 Token 用量统计，含日历热力图、多模型趋势折线、刻度环仪表盘，支持深浅主题与自定义时间范围，数据纯本地扫描聚合。
description.en: An unofficial DSH plugin that renders full-history token usage stats inside the DeepSeek Harness settings page, with a calendar heatmap, multi-model trend lines and a gauge dashboard, plus light/dark themes and custom ranges — all scanned and aggregated locally.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按工作区保存会话默认值的 DSH 插件，让每个工作区独立记住 Agent 模式、权限、模型与推理强度，新会话自动继承。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that stores session defaults per workspace, so each workspace keeps its own agent mode, permissions, model and reasoning effort for new sessions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框添加一键重启按钮，点击后静默重启 DSH，无窗口弹出，旧标签页自动重连，实现无感重启。
description.en: Adds a one-click restart button to the DeepSeek Harness composer, silently restarting DSH with no popup and auto-reconnect for the old tab.

description.zh: DSH plugin 集成 accurLex 法律工具，提供法律问答、法规检索、合同审查与文书起草等能力。
description.en: A DSH plugin integrating accurLex legal tools for legal Q&A, regulation search, contract review, and document drafting.

description.zh: 把 AGPA 游戏化成就系统接入 DeepSeek Harness：注册 7 个 achievement_* 原生工具，并自动追踪 DSH 会话事件解锁成就。
description.en: Bridges the AGPA gamification engine into DeepSeek Harness: registers 7 native achievement_* tools and auto-tracks DSH session events to unlock achievements.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 A股数据 API 的官方插件，注册 24 个行情、K线、财务、资金与选股工具，其中 5 个免费工具无需 Key 即可直接调用真实数据。
description.en: Official DeepSeek Harness plugin for the A-Share Data API, registering 24 tools for quotes, K-lines, financials, money flow and screening — five of them free with no API key required.

description.zh: DSH plugin 按 preset 选择性接管 AGENTS.md 指令注入，以可配置的四层扫描替代内置发现逻辑，用户可在 GUI 中勾选生效范围。
description.en: A DSH plugin that selectively takes over AGENTS.md instruction injection per preset, replacing built-in discovery with configurable four-layer scanning, with GUI selection of active presets.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话主区加入 Files 标签页，内置文件树、Monaco 编辑器、跨文件搜索替换、Markdown 预览与 Git 状态差异查看。
description.en: Adds a Files tab to the DeepSeek Harness session area with a file tree, Monaco editor, cross-file search/replace, Markdown preview, and Git status/diff.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可拖动的 Agent 模式悬浮窗，一键在会话系统提示词与本机及 13 个编码 Agent CLI 归档提示词间切换。
description.en: A draggable Agent-mode floating window for DeepSeek Harness that switches a session's system prompt between the harness's own prompt and 13 archived coding-agent CLI prompts.

description.zh: DSH 插件：为 DeepSeek Harness 提供魔兽世界风格的背包物品栏，支持粘贴/拖拽添加物品、分类管理，并自动统计所有会话的 token 费用换算成金币。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a WoW-style inventory/backpack to DeepSeek Harness, letting you add items via paste/drag, manage them by type, and auto-track token costs across sessions as in-game currency.

description.zh: DSH plugin 余额卡片：右下角浮窗显示 DeepSeek 账户余额（按档位着色），并实时统计当前对话的 token 用量、缓存命中率与峰谷计价费用。
description.en: A DSH plugin balance card: a floating widget shows DeepSeek account balance with color tiers, plus live per-conversation token usage, cache hit rate, and peak/off-peak cost.

description.zh: balance-dock 是 DeepSeek Harness 的常驻 Web 插件，在会话输入框下方状态条实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，每 60 秒自动刷新并支持手动刷新，安全取数且适配明暗主题。
description.en: balance-dock is a persistent web plugin for DeepSeek Harness that displays your DeepSeek account balance in the status band under the composer, auto-refreshing every 60 seconds with manual refresh, secure credential handling, and theme support.

description.zh: AgentActa 是 DSH 插件形式的本地 AI agent 请求日志面板，聚合 24 家 agent 的会话日志，在侧边栏查看每轮耗时、token、缓存命中与工具调用明细。
description.en: AgentActa is a local AI agent request-log panel shipped as a DSH plugin: it aggregates session logs from 24 agents and shows per-turn latency, tokens, cache hits and tool calls in a sidebar panel.

description.zh: Baleen 是一款 DSH plugin，定时摄取 RSS、B 站与 YouTube 内容，读正文和字幕做本地预筛，每轮输出一份增量图文汇报，帮你滤掉标题党。
description.en: Baleen is a DSH plugin that ingests RSS, Bilibili and YouTube feeds on a schedule, reads full text and subtitles for local pre-filtering, and delivers an incremental digest each round to filter out clickbait.

description.zh: DSH 插件：任务完成、需要人工授权或运行出错时，通过 Bark 把通知推送到 iPhone 与 Apple Watch，让你离开电脑也能及时响应。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pushes Bark notifications to your iPhone and Apple Watch when a task finishes, needs approval, or fails, so you can stay informed away from your desk.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供由 Agent 主动调用的上下文减负工具：把冗长内容导出为文件并留指针，或直接删除无用片段，全程无自动压缩。
description.en: Agent-requested context relief for DeepSeek Harness: export bulky context to files with a pointer, or delete worthless spans outright — never automatically.

description.zh: changestab 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边栏 Changes 视图，可浏览 jj/git 变更历史并按窗口宽度并排或堆叠查看文件 diff。
description.en: changestab adds a sidebar Changes view to DeepSeek Harness, letting you browse jj/git change history and read file diffs side-by-side or stacked to fit the available width.

description.zh: brockdsaver 是 DeepSeek Harness 的启动前救援工具包，可在 DSH 启动前校验 profile 组合、检测损坏插件并提供一键恢复，让 DSH 安全启动。
description.en: brockdsaver is a pre-boot rescue toolkit for DeepSeek Harness that validates profile composition, detects broken plugins, and enables one-click recovery before DSH starts.

description.zh: CodeGraph 是 DSH plugin，让 AI Agent 读取代码并生成可点击跳转源码的流程图、时序图与交互式讲解页，输出单个离线 HTML。
description.en: CodeGraph is a DSH plugin that has your AI agent read code and generate clickable flowcharts, sequence diagrams, and interactive walkthroughs as a single offline HTML file.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供中文用字规范把关：检查繁体、简体、粤语口语与日文汉字，并离线完成繁简互转与语体转换。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that enforces Chinese script policy: it flags Traditional, Simplified, Cantonese colloquial and Japanese-only characters, and converts scripts offline.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的协作画布插件，把长内容搬到人和 AI 共写的 Markdown 文档面上，AI 通过 canvas_* 工具读写，带版本冲突检测、撤销历史与文件持久化。
description.en: A collaborative canvas plugin for DeepSeek Harness that moves long content onto a shared Markdown surface co-written by you and the AI, which reads and writes it via canvas_* tools with version conflict detection, undo history and file persistence.

description.zh: 协作模式是 DSH 插件，实现人机协作认知方法：算法发散、人收敛，通过 13 个工具和三态相位状态机，将低概率输出作为候选交由人裁决，以显影被主流范式排斥的新认知。
description.en: Collaborative Emergent Intelligence is a DSH plugin implementing a human-AI collaborative cognition method: algorithm diverges, human converges, using 13 tools and a three-state phase machine to surface low-probability outputs for human judgment.

description.zh: 为 DSH 装上教学式 CTF 解题技能：边解边讲套路、工具与知识点，收尾在 solves/ 下生成可复现 Writeup。
description.en: A teaching-oriented CTF solving skill for DeepSeek Harness that explains tactics, tools and concepts while solving, then writes a reproducible writeup under solves/.

description.zh: 为未声明超时的 DSH 工具调用挂载部署级截止时间，把静默卡死的调用变成模型可见的 TOOL_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED 错误。
description.en: Mounts deployment-level deadlines on DSH tool calls that declare none, turning a silently wedged call into a model-visible TOOL_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED error.

description.zh: 这款 DeepSeek Harness 插件让 agent 直接驱动 Android 上的 Local Dream 出图，自动管理局域网直连与 USB/adb 回退的设备连接。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets agents drive the Android Local Dream Stable Diffusion app, managing LAN-first connections with automatic USB/adb fallback.

description.zh: 为 DSH 设置页新增插件关系图标签，用可缩放的 Cytoscape 图实时展示已加载插件的依赖、provider 解析与 Loader 嵌套。
description.en: Adds a Plugin graph tab to DSH Settings, rendering a live, zoomable Cytoscape view of loaded plugins, their dependencies, resolved providers and Loader-tree nesting.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框加一个 Agent 模式选择器，从名册中挑选外部 Agent CLI 作为当前会话默认执行体，并自动探测已安装的 CLI。
description.en: Adds an Agent mode picker to the DeepSeek Harness input box, letting you choose an external Agent CLI as the session's default executor, with automatic discovery of installed CLIs.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 CAN DBC 数据库增删改查、校验与对比，并支持 DBC 与 Excel 双向转换的 DSH 插件。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that creates, edits, validates and compares CAN DBC databases, with two-way DBC-to-Excel conversion.

description.zh: DataTally 是 DeepSeek Harness 的数据资产使用记录插件，聚合下载、引用、星标等公开使用信号，为 AI 提供可溯源的数据画像与对比。
description.en: DataTally is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that aggregates public usage signals of data assets — downloads, citations, stars — into one verifiable, source-tagged profile for AI to search and compare.

description.zh: DSH plugin 壁纸主题插件，在设置页上传图片设为 Web UI 背景，支持可读性遮罩、模糊与填充控制。
description.en: Wallpaper theming plugin for DeepSeek Harness: upload images in Settings and use one as the web UI background, with readability veil, blur, and fill controls.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，在侧边栏、设置页和 /balance 命令中显示 DeepSeek API 账户余额，读取官方 GET /user/balance 接口，不注册模型工具、不产生会话开销。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows your DeepSeek API account balance in the sidebar, Settings page, and /balance command, reading the official GET /user/balance endpoint without registering model tools or session events.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化 Playwright 浏览器工具与交互式浏览器面板，支持跨轮次共享登录状态、快照引用操作页面及人工接管控制。
description.en: Persistent Playwright browser tools and an interactive browser panel for DeepSeek Harness, with shared login state, snapshot-based page control, and human takeover.

description.zh: Humanity 是 DeepSeek Harness 的拟人化套件，把人格、三层记忆、技能与自进化梦境收进一个原生 Web 工作台，让 Agent 记得住事、有性格且随时可改。
description.en: Humanity is a personification suite for DeepSeek Harness, bundling persona, three-tier memory, skills and self-evolution with dreaming into one native Web workbench, so your agent remembers and has a character you can edit anytime.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 添加画中画聊天窗口，支持会话切换、流式回复、发送消息，无需离开当前页面。
description.en: Adds a picture-in-picture chat window to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, enabling session switching, streaming replies, and message sending without leaving the current page.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将任意 DeepSeek Harness 会话导出为自包含、可回放的 HTML 转录文件，支持脱敏预览与子代理内联。
description.en: A DSH plugin that exports any DeepSeek Harness session as a self-contained, replayable HTML transcript with redaction preview and inline subagents.

description.zh: DSH plugin 消息桥接插件，将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Telegram 等平台，支持会话管理、模型选择与权限控制。
description.en: A DSH plugin bridging DeepSeek Harness to messaging platforms like Telegram, with session management, model selection, and permission controls.

description.zh: DSH plugin 声明式任务DAG编排工具，验证有向无环任务图并通过工作流引擎执行，支持依赖、子代理与结构化输出。
description.en: A DSH plugin for declarative task-DAG orchestration, validating bounded directed acyclic task graphs and executing them via the workflow engine with subagent support.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置的自动重试与中断会话恢复，处理模型瞬时故障并支持指数退避。
description.en: Configurable automatic retries and interrupted-session recovery for DeepSeek Harness, handling transient model failures with exponential backoff.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 74 款由 awesome-design-md 生成的非侵入式主题，通过原生插件机制安装，无需修改源码。
description.en: Provides 74 non-invasive themes for DeepSeek Harness generated from awesome-design-md, installed via native plugin mechanism without patching source.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏补上永久删除对话的能力，在会话菜单与悬停操作中新增删除入口，并同步清理本地会话日志与缓存记录。
description.en: Adds a permanent delete-conversation action to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, with a menu row and hover trash button that also clean up the local session log and projection cache.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边栏翻译工作台，支持 Bing/Google 自动故障切换、缓存与限流，并向 Agent 暴露 translate_text 工具。
description.en: A translation workbench DSH plugin that adds a sidebar translation page with Bing/Google failover, caching and rate limiting, plus a translate_text tool for the agent.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先用量分析插件，提供 token 用量、模型成本估算、趋势图表与 GitHub 风格活动热力图，帮助用户洞察模型使用情况。
description.en: A local-first DSH plugin for token usage, estimated model cost, trends, and a GitHub-style activity heatmap, giving insights into model usage.

description.zh: DSH 桌宠形态的 Agent 行为守护插件，只读监控加密打包外传、密钥触达与 DNS 外泄线索，告警后经人工确认才终止进程。
description.en: A desktop-pet-shaped DSH plugin that read-only monitors agents for encrypted-package exfiltration, secret access and DNS leak signals, alerting and terminating a process only after human confirmation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供钱包与用量控制中心，实时显示余额、本场花费与峰谷计费时钟，支持多账户加密管理与第三方套餐额度监控。
description.en: A wallet and usage control center for DeepSeek Harness, showing balance, per-session cost and peak/off-peak billing clocks, with encrypted multi-account management and third-party plan quota monitoring.

description.zh: DSH 的 dock 媒体播放器插件，流式播放音频与视频，支持全屏与进度拖拽。
description.en: Media player plugin for the DSH dock, streaming audio and video with fullscreen and seek support.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的任务失败、待处理、完成三种状态镜像到 macOS Atoll 灵动岛，用一枚状态灯提醒你。
description.en: A DSH plugin that mirrors DeepSeek Harness task states—failed, awaiting you, done—onto the macOS Atoll Dynamic Island as a single status light.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 换上 1945 终战史料皮肤，对话区嵌入南京受降油画，加载即生效、卸载即还原。
description.en: A DSH plugin that skins the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with a 1945 historical theme, embedding the Nanjing surrender oil painting in the chat area; applies on load and reverts on unload.

description.zh: Doco 知识库的 DeepSeek Harness 原生插件，提供搜索、精读、大纲与草稿保存等工具，支持块级寻址与来源引用，默认只读并带审批门禁。
description.en: Native DSH plugin for Doco knowledge base, offering search, read, outline and draft-saving tools with block-level addressing and source citations, read-only by default with approval gates.

description.zh: DSH plugin 原生无障碍扫描工具，基于 axe-core 对本地 HTML、构建产物或 URL 执行 WCAG 2.1 A/AA/AAA 检测，输出结构化违规与 Markdown/HTML/JSON 报告。
description.en: A native DSH plugin accessibility scanner that runs axe-core over local HTML, build output, or URLs to detect WCAG 2.1 A/AA/AAA violations and generate structured reports in Markdown/HTML/JSON.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 右栏提供双人密码配对聊天，端到端加密、不落盘，DSH 退出即清空。
description.en: A two-person password-paired chat docked in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar, end-to-end encrypted with nothing written to disk and everything wiped when DSH exits.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 A2A 协议双端能力：可同时托管多个入站 Agent 服务并连接多个出站远端，远端技能直接变成模型工具。
description.en: An A2A dual-end plugin for DeepSeek Harness that hosts multiple inbound agent servers and connects multiple outbound remotes, exposing remote skills as model tools.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Web 界面聊天窗口上方显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，支持悬停查看明细、手动刷新及每 60 秒自动刷新。
description.en: A DSH plugin that displays DeepSeek account balance above the chat window in the web UI, with hover details, manual refresh, and auto-refresh every 60 seconds.

description.zh: dsh-academy 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供学术模式：研究人格、防伪造引用与数据规则、双语写作约定，让 Agent 在学术工作中表现得像研究助理。
description.en: dsh-academy adds an academic mode to DeepSeek Harness: a research persona, anti-fabrication rules for citations and data, and bilingual conventions, making the agent behave like a research assistant.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Web 界面聊天窗口上方显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，支持悬停查看明细、手动刷新及每 60 秒自动刷新。
description.en: A DSH plugin that displays DeepSeek account balance above the chat window in the web UI, with hover details, manual refresh, and auto-refresh every 60 seconds.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供主题成就、勋章与角色抽卡收藏，把真实使用积累转化为十套题材的本地成长手记。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns real usage into themed achievements, badges and gacha character collections across ten local themes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供社区 ACP 桥接，实现 session/load 回放，让客户端重启后能重建完整会话记录。
description.en: A community ACP bridge for DeepSeek Harness that implements session/load replay, letting a client rebuild a full session transcript after restart.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面提供 Android Studio 风格的 ADB logcat 实时查看器，支持设备列表、级别/文本过滤、颜色编码与浮动/停靠布局。
description.en: Android Studio-style ADB logcat viewer for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with live streaming, filtering, color coding, and floating/docked layouts.

description.zh: 把本机已登录的 AI 客户端接入 DeepSeek Harness：一键完成多平台每日签到并汇总余额，同时将其模型注册为 DSH 提供商，附带本地令牌用量面板。
description.en: Connects your locally signed-in AI clients to DeepSeek Harness: runs daily check-ins across platforms with balance summaries, registers their models as DSH providers, and adds a local token-usage panel.

description.zh: dsh-advisor 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供独立模型审查：每步工具调用后由审查模型审计操作，发现风险时注入 [advisor] 指导，帮助 Agent 自我纠正。
description.en: dsh-advisor provides independent-model advisory review for DeepSeek Harness: after each tool step, a reviewer model audits operations and injects guidance when concerns are found.

description.zh: dsh-agent-gateway 是一个 MCP stdio 网关，将本地 AGY、Codex 和 OpenCode CLI 代理以 MCP 工具形式暴露给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH），实现统一调用与结果规范化。
description.en: dsh-agent-gateway is an MCP stdio gateway that exposes local AGY, Codex, and OpenCode CLI agents to DeepSeek Harness (DSH) as MCP tools, with normalized results.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 多代理会话的成本防御插件，用读取账本去重、抗压缩规则与完成门禁，让重复读取与虚报完成变得可见可控。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that defends multi-agent sessions against token waste with a read ledger, compaction-immune rules, a mechanical completion gate and a cheap-model review lane.

description.zh: DSH plugin 审计 Agent harness 稳定性，用 15 项检查定位破坏 agent 循环的故障模式，证据必须真实存在于代码中。
description.en: A DSH plugin that audits agent harness stability with 15 checks for failure modes that break agent loops, refusing findings without code evidence.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供图编排能力：把长任务拆成带依赖的节点，每个节点由独立子代理执行，通过结构化交付与有界返工协议衔接，并写入分层全局账本。
description.en: Graph orchestration for DeepSeek Harness: split long tasks into dependency-linked nodes run by fresh subagents, connected by structured handoffs and bounded rework, all recorded in a layered global ledger.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供事前派发建议：每个 turn 前由 TypeSafe Jev 判断是否该派活、派给哪个已注册 agent，仅给建议不接管委派，无 key 时静默降级。
description.en: Ex-ante dispatch advice for DeepSeek Harness: before each turn, TypeSafe Jev judges whether to delegate and to which registered agent. Advice only, never owning delegation, and silently fail-open without a key.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设置页提供个性化指令编辑器，可读写全局与项目链 AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md 及覆盖层，带字节预算、冲突提示与安全写入校验。
description.en: Adds a Personalization settings page to DeepSeek Harness for editing global and project-chain AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md instruction files and overlays, with byte budgets, conflict warnings, and guarded writes.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供 Agent 观测与安全评测能力，支持便携式评测计划与安全用例执行，帮助开发者验证插件行为与安全性。
description.en: A DSH plugin for agent observability and security evaluation, supporting portable evaluation plans and security case execution to validate plugin behavior and security.

description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 加一只随 Agent 状态换动作的宠物，支持一句话生成 6×8 逐帧精灵表或导入外部图。
description.en: Adds a pet to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that changes pose with your agent's state, with one-sentence 6×8 sprite-sheet generation or external image import.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供 Claw Agent 策略契约与默认配置，统一 policy schema 与 MCP 初始化默认，不拦截工具。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing shared policy schema and defaults for Claw Agent, unifying policy contracts and MCP init defaults without intercepting tools.

description.zh: 为 DSH 本地编码 Agent 提供宿主托管的进程与端口生命周期管理，支持 start/stop/list/logs/wait-ready、端口回收，并带 Processes 侧边栏与 dock 芯片。
description.en: Host-owned process and port lifecycle for local agents in the DeepSeek Harness web UI: start/stop/list/logs/wait-ready, tracked port reclaim, plus a Processes rightbar and dock chip.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供 Claw Agent 策略契约与默认配置，统一 policy schema 与 MCP 初始化默认，不拦截工具。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing shared policy schema and defaults for Claw Agent, unifying policy contracts and MCP init defaults without intercepting tools.

description.zh: 为 DSH 设置页添加「规则与记忆」面板，把长期预设规则集中管理并渲染进 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md，让规则全局生效而不占用系统提示词。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a Rules & Memory settings page, managing long-lived preset rules in one list and rendering them into ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md so they apply globally without occupying the system prompt.

description.zh: DSH 插件 dsh-agent-scope 审计 agent 的工具、文件与网络权限声明，揪出通配符、根目录访问等过宽配置，帮你把爆炸半径压到最小权限。
description.en: A DSH plugin that audits an agent's tool, file and network permission declarations, flagging wildcards and root-path access so you can keep the blast radius at least privilege.

description.zh: Agent Run Logger 是 DeepSeek Harness 的本地 JSONL 运行追踪插件，记录 Agent 运行、模型步骤、工具调用、耗时与 token 用量，并提供实时只读查看器。
description.en: Agent Run Logger is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for local JSONL run tracing, recording agent runs, model steps, tool calls, timings, and token usage, with a live read-only viewer.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 agent 维护的便条纸文件显示在 Web GUI 设置页，让待决策事项与通知不再被对话淹没，远程访问也可见。
description.en: A DSH plugin that renders the agent's sticky-note file as a Settings tab in the Web GUI, keeping pending decisions and notices visible even over remote access.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按命令代理：Agent 用 proxy 前缀决定哪条 shell 命令走代理，插件自动下载并托管 mihomo 内核，无需机器上预装任何代理软件。
description.en: Command-scoped proxying for DeepSeek Harness: the agent prefixes any shell command with `proxy` to route it through a plugin-managed mihomo core, with no pre-installed proxy software required.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多智能体监控面板，在侧边栏嵌入 /agentmonitor 仪表盘，实时展示智能体运行数据。
description.en: A DSH plugin that embeds a multi-agent monitoring dashboard in the sidebar, serving a self-contained /agentmonitor panel for real-time agent data.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让你用 markdown 文件定义子代理和模型，在对话中通过 @提及调用，实现 opencode 风格的自定义 agent。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets you define subagents and models as markdown files, invoked via @mention in chat for opencode-style custom agents.

description.zh: AgentValet 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供受治理的平台访问，通过代理执行授权与审批，无需在机器上存储 API 密钥。
description.en: AgentValet provides governed platform access for DeepSeek Harness, brokering credentials with owner-side approval and no API keys on the machine.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 Agnes AI 图像与视频生成工具，内置跨进程 RPM 限流、429 退避，并用本机 ffmpeg 把视频转成 GIF。
description.en: Adds Agnes AI image and video generation tools to DeepSeek Harness, with cross-process RPM limiting, 429 backoff, and local ffmpeg GIF conversion.

description.zh: DSH plugin 集成 Agora 官方技能，支持语音 AI 智能体、RTC 音视频通话、RTM 消息信令、云录制、CLI 加速与令牌生成，并内置声网（Shengwang）区域适配。
description.en: DSH plugin integrating the official Agora skill for voice AI agents, RTC calls, RTM chat, cloud recording, CLI acceleration, and token generation, with built-in Shengwang region support.

description.zh: DSH 插件，扫描代码中直接执行 AI 输出的高危用法，如 eval、shell、SQL 与路径拼接，帮你在运行时前拦住提示注入导致的任意代码执行。
description.en: A DSH plugin that scans code for unsafe execution of AI output — eval, shell, SQL and path injection — catching prompt-injection-driven code execution before runtime.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来 AI-Suplex 7-7-7 执行循环：规划、执行、捕获、收尾、沉淀，并以本地 markdown 知识库为记录，关键晋升需人工审批。
description.en: Brings the AI-Suplex 7-7-7 execution loop to DeepSeek Harness — plan, run, capture, close, compound — backed by a local markdown vault with a human approval gate.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中的 dsh-agy 提供非侵入式界面增强：净化模型列表、顶栏实时配额徽章与毛玻璃额度浮层。
description.en: A non-intrusive UI companion for dsh-agy in DeepSeek Harness: cleans up the model list and adds a live quota badge with a frosted-glass usage popover.

description.zh: DSH AI钱包插件，以可拖动悬浮球实时显示当前模型的余额与配额，点击展开多供应商余额面板，支持自定义供应商与多主题。
description.en: DSH AI Wallet plugin shows real-time balance/quota of active model in a draggable floating ball, expanding to a multi-provider balance panel with custom providers and themes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供角色扮演能力的 DSH 插件：选卡即启用，把角色卡分层注入系统提示词，并维护日记记忆与可视化角色管理面板，退出即干净卸载。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness roleplay plugin: pick a character card to activate layered persona injection into the system prompt, with diary memory and a visual character management panel that cleanly unloads on exit.

description.zh: 用 AirPods 头部手势控制 DeepSeek Harness：点头允许或确认、摇头拒绝或切换选项，并内置 HeadOrbit 一键安装引导。
description.en: Control DeepSeek Harness with AirPods head gestures: nod to allow or confirm, shake to reject or move to the next option, with a built-in one-click HeadOrbit installer.

description.zh: DSH plugin 预设包，为 AICC 主脑提供委派优先人格、根会话执行门控及可移植 aicc-law 技能，用于任务边界与安全检查。
description.en: A DSH plugin preset for AICC main-brain orchestration, featuring a delegation-first persona, root-session execution gating, and a portable aicc-law skill for task boundaries and safety checks.

description.zh: 把 AIVN 舞台引擎装进 DeepSeek Harness：工作区即一部剧目，剧作家预设写 Stage DSL，会话里的 AIVN tab 实时演出背景、立绘、台词与停止点选项。
description.en: Brings the AIVN stage engine into DeepSeek Harness: a workspace becomes a play, the playwright preset writes Stage DSL, and an AIVN tab renders backgrounds, sprites, dialog and stop-point choices live.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供告警外发审计：检查告警链路是否配置、发往何处、是否把敏感信息一起发出，并给出只发摘要加 trace id 的修正建议。
description.en: An alert-egress audit plugin for DeepSeek Harness: it checks whether alerts are configured, where they are sent, and whether sensitive data leaks into them, suggesting summary-plus-trace-id fixes.

description.zh: dsh-agent-alert 是 DeepSeek Harness 的桌面提醒插件，在任务完成、出错或等待审批时弹出浏览器通知并播放提示音，让你及时回到页面。
description.en: dsh-agent-alert is a desktop alert plugin for DeepSeek Harness that pops browser notifications and plays sounds when tasks finish, error, or await approval.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供算法备案合规检查：扫描代码中算法推荐关闭选项、算法说明公示、备案号与 AI 生成标识是否缺失。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that audits algorithm-filing compliance, flagging missing opt-out options, algorithm disclosures, filing numbers and AI-generated content labels.

description.zh: 把阿里云官方 OpenAPI MCP Server 接入 DeepSeek Harness，填入 AccessKey 后本地代理换取令牌，注册 ECS、OSS、DNS 等上万 OpenAPI 工具。
description.en: Connects the official Alibaba Cloud OpenAPI MCP Server to DeepSeek Harness: enter an AccessKey, a local proxy exchanges it for a bearer token, and tens of thousands of Alibaba Cloud OpenAPIs (ECS, OSS, DNS, and more) are registered as tools.

description.zh: DSH 功能增强插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 补上会话删除、模型请求头注入与模型回退链，均可在 Web 增强设置中开关配置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds session deletion, custom model request headers, and model fallback chains to DeepSeek Harness, all toggleable in the Web enhancement settings.

description.zh: 为运行在容器中的 DeepSeek Harness 补上文件能力：在 Web UI 里直接下载、浏览并编辑宿主机文件，替代失效的本地按钮。
description.en: A DSH plugin that restores file access for DeepSeek Harness running in a container: download, browse and edit host files straight from the Web UI.
