description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页输入框补上 Alt+Enter 换行，把该组合键转成 Shift+Enter 交给输入框处理，不改动 dsh 本体，卸载后不留痕迹。
description.en: Adds Alt+Enter line breaks to the DeepSeek Harness web input box by translating the combo into Shift+Enter, without patching dsh itself and leaving no trace after uninstall.

description.zh: dsh-aloof 将 Aloof 团队资料库与办公审批接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持查待办、列模板、读表单、提单，写操作经审批闸门，是 DSH 原生工具与插件样板。
description.en: dsh-aloof integrates Aloof team knowledge base and office approvals into DeepSeek Harness as native tools, enabling todo lookup, template listing, form reading, and submission, with write operations gated by approval.

description.zh: Amadeus 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来 Galgame Mode：把 Agent 的真实工具调用转译成打字机台词、立绘与选项卡演出，并可通过配套 Android App 扫码配对，在手机上观看电脑端干活全程。
description.en: Amadeus brings a Galgame Mode to DeepSeek Harness: it turns real agent tool calls into typewriter dialogue, character sprites and choice cards, and pairs with a companion Android app over LAN so you can watch your computer work from your phone.

description.zh: DSH 白噪音播放器插件，场景由音频目录驱动，AI 后台从 Wikimedia Commons 分门别类下载氛围音，支持四种播放模式与定时关。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness white-noise player plugin: scenes are driven purely by audio folders, with AI downloading ambient sounds from Wikimedia Commons in the background, plus four play modes and a sleep timer.

description.zh: 基于《弹丸论破：天魔命曲》同人游戏素材的 DSH 皮肤插件，为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供自定义光标、全屏壁纸、左侧栏梯形条等沉浸式主题界面。
description.en: A DSH skin plugin using assets from the fan game Danganronpa: Angels & Demon Fate Symphony, providing custom cursor, fullscreen wallpaper, trapezoid sidebar and more for DeepSeek Harness Web.

description.zh: 为 DSH plugin 接管 HTML 预览的页面批注工具：在右侧栏点选元素、写批注并批量发送给 Agent，由 Agent 按路径直接改源码。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns HTML previews into an annotation surface: pick elements in the right sidebar, write notes, send the batch to the agent, and let it edit the source file by path.

description.zh: DSH plugin 一键追番：从 AnimeGarden 搜索番剧、订阅字幕组，自动经 qBittorrent 下载并按模板归档到番名季目录。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for anime following: search shows on AnimeGarden, subscribe to fansub groups, and let qBittorrent download and archive episodes into templated season folders.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供回答级耗时统计的 DSH 插件，把每轮回答拆成模型思考、首字、生成、工具执行与其它等待，并落盘成可查询的明细数据。
description.en: A DSH plugin that profiles every answer in DeepSeek Harness, breaking each turn into model thinking, first-token, decode, per-tool and other wait time, and persisting queryable timing records.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 workspace-write 会话中由 AI 预先审核模型的提权请求，只给建议不自动放行，避免用户盲目批准。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pre-reviews model privilege-escalation requests in workspace-write sessions, advising instead of auto-approving so users avoid blind approval.

description.zh: DSH 插件：在 Web 侧边栏实时显示 DeepSeek API 余额，并暴露 api_balance 工具供模型查询汇报。
description.en: DSH plugin: display DeepSeek API balance live in the web sidebar and expose an api_balance tool for the model to query.

description.zh: 自动发现 Aperture 网关上的模型，按协议注册成 DSH 插件自带的路由，让它们直接出现在 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器里，只需填一个网关地址。
description.en: Auto-discovers models on your Aperture gateway and registers them as the plugin's own DSH provider routes, so they show up directly in the DeepSeek Harness model picker after you enter just one gateway URL.

description.zh: DSH 插件：在 Web 侧边栏实时显示 DeepSeek API 余额，并暴露 api_balance 工具供模型查询汇报。
description.en: DSH plugin: display DeepSeek API balance live in the web sidebar and expose an api_balance tool for the model to query.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 API 用量与费用账本，在会话、设置、输入框与侧边栏四处展示 token 消耗与成本估算，支持按路由与模型定价及人民币/美元切换。
description.en: An API usage and cost ledger for DeepSeek Harness that surfaces token spend in the conversation, settings, composer and sidebar, with per-route and per-model pricing plus CNY/USD display.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供契约先行的接口设计技能：开新接口、审 OpenAPI、判破坏性变更、定错误契约与版本弃用，让接口决策可复核。
description.en: A contract-first API design skill pack for DeepSeek Harness: author new endpoints, review OpenAPI, detect breaking changes, and define error contracts, versioning, and deprecation so interface decisions stay reviewable.

description.zh: DSH API Revise 是 DeepSeek Harness 的接口回归验收台：改动前后快照 API 响应，逐字段对比差异并逐项人工验收，导出报告。
description.en: DSH API Revise is an API regression and acceptance workbench for DeepSeek Harness: snapshot endpoint responses before edits, diff them field by field after, accept each change, and export a report.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面添加 API3D 站点专属鲸鱼桌宠，实时显示站点余额、今日已用与每轮对话消耗，气泡内容可自由定制。
description.en: A whale desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness web UI that shows your API3D site balance, today's usage and per-turn cost, with fully customizable bubble content.

description.zh: 把 API3D 中转站接成 DeepSeek Harness 的一条 pi-ai 路由，在插件设置页填基础地址与 API Key、勾选模型即可对话，零配置可用。
description.en: Wires the API3D relay into DeepSeek Harness as a pi-ai route: set the base URL and API key in the plugin settings, pick models, and chat — zero-config out of the box.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供通用 HTTP 接口管理：把 api.cfg 中的接口注册成 agent 可用的文档查询与请求调用双工具，范围外请求一律拒绝。
description.en: A generic HTTP API manager for DeepSeek Harness: registers endpoints listed in api.cfg as agent tools for doc lookup and request calls, rejecting anything out of scope.

description.zh: DSH plugin 检测本机所有已安装 Windows/macOS 应用的新版本，从官网下载全量安装包并一键静默更新，无需打开被检测软件。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that scans installed Windows/macOS apps for new versions and silently updates them with the vendor's full installer, without launching the apps.

description.zh: AppPackager 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，把 uni-app x 项目打包成 iOS IPA、Android APK 与 HarmonyOS HAP，提供项目列表、环境体检、平台校验与一键构建四个工具。
description.en: AppPackager is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns uni-app x projects into iOS IPA, Android APK and HarmonyOS HAP builds, exposing four agent tools for listing projects, checking the environment, verifying a platform and building.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供审批台账的 DSH plugin：记录每次审批的工具、理由、风险与结果，gate 模式可拦截高危操作。
description.en: A DSH plugin that keeps an audit ledger of every DeepSeek Harness approval — tool, reason, risk level, decision and outcome — with a gate mode that rejects high-risk actions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注入 codex 风格的 apply_patch 工具，让 GPT 模型能直接调用补丁操作，且全程走 DSH 沙盒系统，安全不越权。
description.en: Injects a codex-style apply_patch tool into DeepSeek Harness, enabling GPT models to apply patches natively, fully sandboxed via DSH.

description.zh: DSH 只读 AppData 分析插件，以资源管理器式下钻浏览目录体积、来源软件与可删建议，支持按需联网查询。
description.en: A read-only AppData analysis DSH plugin that browses folder sizes, source apps and deletion advice explorer-style, with optional online lookups.

description.zh: DSH plugin：会话请求提权审批时弹出 Windows 原生 toast 并播放提示音，清晰告知会话、原因与提权目标，点击可跳转 Web UI。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows native Windows toast with sound when a session requests elevation approval, detailing session, reason, and target, with click-to-open Web UI.

description.zh: DSH plugin：会话请求提权审批时弹出 Windows 原生 toast 并播放提示音，清晰告知会话、原因与提权目标，点击可跳转 Web UI。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows native Windows toast with sound when a session requests elevation approval, detailing session, reason, and target, with click-to-open Web UI.

description.zh: 为 DSH 无人值守审批加有界应答窗口：subagent、定时与 cron 请求在窗口内有人答就用人的答案，超时按 fail-closed 默认落定，turn 不再无限挂起。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a bounded answer window to unattended approvals: subagent, scheduled and cron requests use a human answer if one arrives in time, otherwise fail closed so the turn never hangs.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上归档会话的后半段管理：整页浏览、搜索、恢复、回收站与彻底删除，并开放 Agent 工具调用。
description.en: Completes archived-session management for DeepSeek Harness: a full-page browser with search, restore, recycle bin and permanent delete, plus an Agent-callable tool.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex 式自动审批：由独立复核模型对越界操作裁决放行或拒绝，fail-closed 兜底，并在 Approvals 标签页留下每次决定的完整理由。
description.en: Codex-style auto-approval for DeepSeek Harness: an independent reviewer model rules allow or deny on boundary-crossing actions, fail-closed by default, with a full rationale for every decision in a dedicated Approvals tab.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供归档管理与会话目录快捷入口的 DSH plugin，可在会话菜单直接打开工作区或日志文件夹，并集中搜索、取消归档或永久删除已归档会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that adds archive management and session-folder shortcuts: open a session's workspace or log folder from its menu, and search, unarchive, or permanently delete archived sessions in one place.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上归档会话管理中心，可按日期、工作区筛选历史会话，批量取消归档，并用可撤销策略自动清理会话列表。
description.en: Adds an archived-session management center to DeepSeek Harness: browse archived sessions by date or workspace, unarchive in bulk, and run a reversible auto-cleanup policy.

description.zh: dsh-archive-viewer 是 DSH plugin，为已归档的 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供只读查看：无需取消归档，即可浏览归档列表、阅读完整对话与工具调用。
description.en: dsh-archive-viewer is a DSH plugin that gives read-only access to archived DeepSeek Harness sessions, letting you browse the archive list and read full conversations and tool calls without unarchiving.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的「已归档」页补上会话删除能力：逐条或批量删除、默认进回收站 30 天可恢复，并显示每行磁盘占用。
description.en: Adds session deletion to DeepSeek Harness's Archived settings page: single or bulk delete, a 30-day recoverable quarantine by default, and per-row disk usage.

description.zh: DSH plugin 用于删除已归档会话，并按引用关系回收独占附件与派生缓存，整个过程是一个可回滚事务。
description.en: A DSH plugin that deletes archived sessions along with exclusively referenced attachments and derived caches, all as one reversible, journalled transaction.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在设置界面管理已归档对话：一键取消归档恢复至侧边栏，或二次确认后永久删除，并附带完整归档 API 与批量操作。
description.en: A DSH plugin to manage archived conversations in the Settings UI: unarchive them back to the sidebar or permanently delete with confirmation, plus a full archivedSessions API and batch unarchive.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入火山方舟 Seedream（豆包）文生图能力，说一句「画一张」即可生成图片，自动下载保存到会话工作区并按日期归档，图片直接显示在对话里。
description.en: Adds text-to-image generation to DeepSeek Harness via Volcano Ark Seedream (Doubao): one prompt yields an image that is downloaded into the session workspace, filed by date, and shown inline in the conversation.

description.zh: Artifact Center 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供全局侧边栏产物面板，自动回溯会话历史与工作区快照，索引对话产出的文件并支持筛选、预览与导出。
description.en: Artifact Center adds a global sidebar panel to DeepSeek Harness that backfills session history and workspace snapshots to index files produced by conversations, with filters, previews and export.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供 arXiv 论文搜索工具与技能，让 Agent 用真实文献核验观点，而非依赖自身记忆。
description.en: A DSH plugin that equips the agent with arXiv search tools and a skill to verify claims against published papers instead of memory.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边对话：在右侧停靠栏中分叉当前会话，让你带着完整上下文追问，又不打断主线程。
description.en: A side chat for DeepSeek Harness that forks the current conversation into the right dock, so you can ask follow-ups with full context without derailing the main thread.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将终端/工具输出录制为 asciinema v2（.cast）文件，提供离线内嵌播放器回放与 HTML 导出，对齐 rec/play/cat 三动作。
description.en: DSH plugin records terminal/tool output as asciinema v2 (.cast) files, with an offline embedded player for replay and HTML export, aligning with rec/play/cat actions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一份全局人格档案，名称、语言与人格提示词一次设定，每个新会话的系统提示都自动带上它。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness a global persona profile — name, language and persona prompt set once, prepended to every new session's system prompt.

description.zh: 为 DSH 的 dsh-artifacts 侧边栏补上缺失的后端：在 web server 挂载 /report 端点，输出 artifact 索引 JSON 并回传文件字节，让侧栏不再 404。
description.en: The missing backend for the DSH dsh-artifacts sidebar tab: mounts a /report endpoint on the web server that serves the artifact index JSON and streams artifact bytes, so the sidebar stops returning 404.

description.zh: DSH 插件，在 web composer 中通过 @ 引用工作区文件与跨会话上下文，发送前校验引用有效性。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds @-mention context references in the web composer: workspace file search and cross-session references, with pre-send validation.

description.zh: 为 DSH 原生侧边栏文件树补上 @文件引用按钮、大小与修改时间列、排序和全工作区搜索，不换标签页即可快速引用与定位文件。
description.en: Enhances the native DSH sidebar file tree with @file reference buttons, size and modified-time columns, sorting, and workspace-wide search, so you can reference and locate files without leaving the tab.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 输入框工具栏添加图片按钮，点击即可调用系统文件对话框多选图片，无需拖拽或粘贴，选中的图片直接进入草稿图片栏随消息发送。
description.en: Adds a picture button to the DeepSeek Harness Web composer toolbar, opening the native OS file dialog for multi-image selection — no drag-and-drop or paste needed — and drops the picks straight into the draft-image rail.

description.zh: DSH Atelier 是 DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先工作台插件，用紧凑状态栏展示 token 用量与 API 等价成本，并提供全局提示词库、动态工作文案与可选本地请求审计。
description.en: DSH Atelier is a local-first DeepSeek Harness workbench plugin that shows compact token usage and API-equivalent cost metrics, plus a global prompt library, dynamic activity text, and opt-in local request auditing.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 附件接缝提供 S3 存储后端，内容寻址、一次写入，支持校验读取，一条 dsh plugin 命令即可安装。
description.en: S3 storage backend for the DeepSeek Harness attachment seam: content-addressed, write-once objects with verified reads, installable with one dsh plugin command.

description.zh: DSH plugin，在DeepSeek Harness执行长任务时主动提醒你利用碎片时间进行微活动，将等待变成有产出的时间，并生成碎片利用报告。
description.en: A DSH plugin that proactively reminds you to engage in micro-activities during long-running DeepSeek Harness tasks, turning idle waiting into productive time and generating a utilization report.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供系统音频驱动的界面可视化：可拖拽的 48 段频谱悬浮芯片与随低频脉动的窗口辉光，音频仅在内存中分析。
description.en: A system-audio driven UI visualizer for DeepSeek Harness: a draggable 48-band spectrum chip plus a bass-driven window glow, with all audio analysed in memory only.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里导入 EPUB、PDF、TXT 等书籍，用 Edge 神经语音或离线 Kokoro 朗读，自动记住收听进度。
description.en: A DSH plugin that imports EPUB, PDF, TXT and more, then reads them aloud with Edge neural voices or offline Kokoro while remembering your listening position.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面提供登录认证、会话超时、单点登录与登录历史，并支持 LAN 反向代理访问。
description.en: Authentication plugin for DeepSeek Harness web: sign-in, session expiry, single sign-on, login history, and LAN proxy access.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 Web GUI 提供令牌鉴权反向代理，在 dsh web 前加一道静态登录墙，校验令牌后转发 HTTP 与 WebSocket 流量，零源码改动。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a token-based auth reverse proxy in front of the dsh web GUI, validating tokens and forwarding HTTP/WebSocket traffic with zero source changes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加缓慢流动的生成式极光背景，并支持自定义图片或视频壁纸，可在侧边栏浮动面板中实时调节。
description.en: A DSH plugin that paints a slowly drifting generative aurora behind the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with optional custom photo or video wallpapers tuned from a floating sidebar panel.

description.zh: dsh-authless 是一个 DSH plugin，用于移除本地 DSH Web UI 的启动令牌校验，让页面免 cookie 直接打开、/api 请求不再返回 401。
description.en: A DSH plugin that removes the launch-token check from the local DSH Web UI, so the page opens without a cookie and /api requests no longer return 401.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在设置面板新增「连接应用」区块，作为其他插件自我展示的中央平台，通过子槽位注册卡片实现。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a 'Connected Apps' settings section, a central platform where other plugins surface themselves via child slot registration.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供工具调用拦截与审计：一条审批梯逐级判定，全部事件写入可校验的哈希链审计库，并对结果脱敏。
description.en: An interception and audit frame for DeepSeek Harness: a single approval ladder decides each tool call, every event lands in a hash-chained audit store, and results are redacted.

description.zh: dsh-auto-archive 是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，每晚自动归档已完结且闲置三周的会话，只隐藏不删除，可一键恢复。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that quietly archives finished sessions idle for three weeks, once a night, hiding rather than deleting them.

description.zh: dsh-aurachat 是 DSH plugin 里的 AI 伙伴：有人格、心情与记忆，能看图、发语音、发表情包、写日记逛空间，还会主动找你聊天。
description.en: dsh-aurachat is a DSH plugin that adds an AI companion with persona, mood and memory — it sees images, sends and hears voice, shares stickers, writes diary posts and starts chats on its own.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供单用户远程登录鉴权，用密码、TOTP 与一次性备份码保护浏览器路由、API、流与 WebSocket，并支持会话吊销。
description.en: Single-user remote authentication for DeepSeek Harness, guarding browser routes, APIs, streams and WebSockets with password, TOTP, one-use backup codes and revocable sessions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供回合级自动续接：当对话因 429 限流、配额耗尽或空响应中断时，自动等待并重发 continue，让长任务不再中途停死。
description.en: A DSH plugin that auto-resumes a turn killed by a 429 rate limit, exhausted quota or empty response, resending "continue" so long tasks survive instead of stopping dead.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供回合级自动续接：当对话因 429 限流、配额耗尽或空响应中断时，自动等待并重发 continue，让长任务不再中途停死。
description.en: A DSH plugin that auto-resumes a turn killed by a 429 rate limit, exhausted quota or empty response, resending "continue" so long tasks survive instead of stopping dead.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话自动命名：首条消息自动生成标题，重命名对话框可流式获取 AI 建议标题。
description.en: Automatic conversation naming for DeepSeek Harness: the first prompt titles itself, and the rename dialog streams AI-suggested titles.

description.zh: DSH 插件：重启后自动续跑有活跃目标的会话，无需人工说“继续”，自动恢复 agent 并重新武装目标。
description.en: DSH plugin that auto-resumes sessions with active goals after restart, eliminating the need for manual 'continue' by restoring agents and re-arming goals.

description.zh: 让 DSH 会话的「自动审批」权限预设熬过重启：退出时不再被改写成完全权限，缺集成的会话也能正常打开。
description.en: Keeps the Auto approval preset in DeepSeek Harness sessions across restarts, preventing quit-time rewrites to Full access and letting sessions without the integration reopen.

description.zh: DSH plugin：每次启动自动检查已启用插件的新版本，列出并询问是否更新，确认后走官方通道升级。
description.en: A DSH plugin that checks enabled plugins for new versions at every launch, lists them, and updates only after you confirm via the official channel.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供零 token 按需翻译：悬停或框选才翻译，不自动翻页，默认浏览器内 WASM 离线推理，文本不出本机。
description.en: Zero-token on-demand translation for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: translate only on hover or drag-select, never auto-translate, with in-browser WASM inference so text never leaves your machine.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话头部添加只读「自动化」标签页，集中展示各定时任务的运行状态、上次与下次运行时间及 token 花费。
description.en: Adds a read-only Automations tab to the DeepSeek Harness conversation header, showing each scheduled task's status, last and next run times, and token spend.

description.zh: dsh-autoresearch 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供有界、指标驱动的自动研究工具，在隔离 Git 工作树中运行基线优先的 keep/reject 优化循环。
description.en: dsh-autoresearch provides a bounded, metric-driven autoresearch tool for DeepSeek Harness, running a baseline-first keep/reject optimization loop in an isolated Git worktree.

description.zh: dsh-autovision 为 DeepSeek Harness 中的纯文本模型注入视觉能力：粘贴图片后由你配置的多模态模型自动转录为文本，无需切换模型或内置密钥。
description.en: dsh-autovision gives text-only models in DeepSeek Harness real image support: paste an image and a configured multimodal model transcribes it to text automatically, no model switching or built-in keys.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自动备份会话、配置与自定义目录，支持定时或手动打包为 zip 并自动轮换，保障数据安全。
description.en: A DSH plugin that automates backups of sessions, config and custom directories, packing them into zip archives with scheduled or manual runs and rotation.

description.zh: DSH Automation Center 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可计划、可审计的自动化任务，每次触发创建独立 Result Session，支持跨工作区运行历史与无人值守权限。
description.en: DSH Automation Center provides scheduled, auditable automation tasks for DeepSeek Harness, creating fresh Result Sessions per run with cross-workspace history and unattended permissions.

description.zh: 为深鲸桌面产出的文档与 PR 自动添加「powered by dwh」署名徽章的 DSH plugin，按 skill 说明规范徽章用法与尺寸。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a "powered by dwh" attribution badge to documents and PRs produced with DeepWhale Desktop, with skill guidance on badge usage and sizing.

description.zh: dsh-baize-session 是 DSH 插件，可从当前会话挑选消息迁移到其他会话或新工作区，并集中管理工作区会话的归档、恢复、删除与迁移。
description.en: dsh-baize-session is a DSH plugin that picks messages from one conversation and relocates them into another or a new workspace, and manages a workspace's conversations with archive, restore, delete and move.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框下方提供实时余额读数：用本机 token 消耗推算 API 余额与可用时长，按峰谷分档计价并自动校准。
description.en: A live balance readout for DeepSeek Harness: it projects your API balance and time-to-empty from this machine's own token usage, priced by peak/off-peak tiers with self-calibration.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供插件环境备份与迁移：一条命令扫描各 profile 的插件、配置与本地插件并打包推送到 GitHub 仓库，新机器上一条命令即可还原。
description.en: Backs up and migrates your DeepSeek Harness plugin environment: one command scans every profile's plugins, configs and locally-developed plugins, packs them into a GitHub repo, and restores everything on a new machine.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框下方提供实时余额读数：用本机 token 消耗推算 API 余额与可用时长，按峰谷分档计价并自动校准。

description.en: A live balance readout for DeepSeek Harness: it projects your API balance and time-to-empty from this machine's own token usage, priced by peak/off-peak tiers with self-calibration.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏添加常驻余额栏，自动显示官方账号充值余额，点击即可在 DSH 内嵌官方用量页查询消耗，无需配置 API Key。
description.en: Adds a persistent balance bar to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, showing your official account balance and opening the in-app usage page on click, with no API key required.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框下方提供实时余额读数：用本机 token 消耗推算 API 余额与可用时长，按峰谷分档计价并自动校准。
description.en: A live balance readout for DeepSeek Harness: it projects your API balance and time-to-empty from this machine's own token usage, priced by peak/off-peak tiers with self-calibration.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 主界面右下角常驻余额角标，随时查看账户余额，支持点击刷新与自动轮询。
description.en: A persistent balance badge in the DeepSeek Harness main window corner, showing your account balance at a glance with click-to-refresh and auto polling.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏添加余额看板，可添加多个按量计费或 Token Plan 套餐，同时查询并展示剩余额度与用量百分比。
description.en: Adds a balance dashboard to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, supporting multiple pay-as-you-go or Token Plan accounts with simultaneous balance and usage checks.

description.zh: dsh-balance-display 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，在可折叠面板中展示 DeepSeek API 账户余额，支持手动与自动刷新，并确保 API 密钥安全。
description.en: dsh-balance-display is a DSH plugin that shows DeepSeek API account balance in a collapsible panel with manual/auto refresh and secure key handling.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 在 Web 侧边栏常驻一张余额卡片，随当前会话模型切换显示对应厂商的 API 余额、订阅额度与积分，点击原地展开详情。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pins a balance card in the dsh Web sidebar, following the current session's model to show that provider's API balance, subscription quota or credits, with in-place detail expansion.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 在 Web 侧边栏常驻一张余额卡片，随当前会话模型切换显示对应厂商的 API 余额、订阅额度与积分，点击原地展开详情。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pins a balance card in the dsh Web sidebar, following the current session's model to show that provider's API balance, subscription quota or credits, with in-place detail expansion.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏底部用两行极简文字显示 DeepSeek 余额与当前峰谷时段，零配置复用已存 API Key，每分钟自动刷新。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows your DeepSeek balance and current peak/off-peak window in two minimal lines at the sidebar footer, reusing the saved API key with zero config and refreshing every minute.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的 composer dock 常驻显示账户钱包余额与本会话花费，点击即可刷新，悬停可查看充值明细。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pins your wallet balance and this session's spend in the DeepSeek Harness composer dock, with click-to-refresh and a hover breakdown.

description.zh: DSH plugin，实时查询DeepSeek API Key对应账户余额，以常驻面板展示并自动刷新，支持手动刷新。
description.en: A DSH plugin that queries the balance of your DeepSeek API key account, displays it in a persistent panel with auto-refresh and manual refresh.

description.zh: 这是一款 DSH plugin，在输入框旁显示本次会话预估花费与账户余额，点击可查看 token 明细面板。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows this conversation's estimated spend and account balance beside the composer, with a click-through token breakdown panel.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 在聊天输入框下方展示供应商余额与配额，并支持第三方 JSON 接口监测模型健康、TTFT 与响应时间。
description.en: Shows provider balance and quota below the DeepSeek Harness chat composer, and monitors model health, TTFT and response time via third-party JSON APIs.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 fail-closed 安全基线：拦截网络出口、收紧子代理权限上限，并把每次工具判定与结果写入可校验哈希链。
description.en: A fail-closed security baseline for DeepSeek Harness: policy-gated network egress, a monotonic subagent permission ceiling, and a hash-chained audit log of every tool decision and result.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供上下文窗口逐条归因面板，按消息条目显示 token 占用与摘要，帮你定位窗口被谁占满。
description.en: A per-message context window attribution panel for DeepSeek Harness that shows token usage and summaries for each entry, so you can see what fills the window.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 每个会话自动接入 BaseMind 代码智能 MCP 工具，按工作区解析仓库，无需配置 MCP 行或改动预设。
description.en: A workspace-aware DSH plugin that gives every DeepSeek Harness session BaseMind's code-intelligence MCP tools for the repository it works in, with no MCP row or preset changes.

description.zh: DSH plugin 批量回归统计工具，对同一命令运行 N 轮取中位数和分布，用统计结论替代单次结果，适合性能对比与复现率分析。
description.en: DSH plugin for batch regression stats: run a command N rounds and judge by median/distribution, replacing single-run results with statistical conclusions for performance comparison and flakiness analysis.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内把 Windows 的 .bat/.cmd 启动脚本编译成真正的 .exe 外壳，自动生成图标、C# 包装与快捷方式，脚本逻辑仍可随时编辑。
description.en: Compile Windows .bat/.cmd launchers into real .exe shells from inside DeepSeek Harness, with generated icons, a C# wrapper and optional shortcuts, while the launcher logic stays editable text.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 右侧边栏以可停靠标签页浏览 Beads 议题，支持状态徽章、搜索排序与 Markdown 详情，是终端 bv 的浏览器版。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings Beads issues into the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar as a dockable tab, with colour-coded badges, search, sorting and rendered Markdown details — the browser counterpart of the terminal bv viewer.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的工单批量分诊 DSH 插件：先用确定性规则预筛，规则无法判定的工单一律标记为 needs_review，绝不臆测归类。
description.en: A DSH plugin for batch ticket triage in DeepSeek Harness: a deterministic rule prefilter classifies each ticket first, and anything no rule can place is marked needs_review instead of being guessed.

description.zh: BestUI 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供自适应壁纸与外观定制，支持上传图片背景、透明度与配色调整、方案导出导入，让界面随壁纸明暗自动切换主题。
description.en: BestUI is a wallpaper and appearance studio for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, offering image backgrounds, per-surface opacity, color customization, and scheme export/import with auto theme switching.

description.zh: dsh-better-command 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供斜杠菜单匹配升级，支持分隔符透明和缩写匹配，让 /dshp 等缩写能命中连字符命令与技能。
description.en: dsh-better-command upgrades the slash-menu matching for the DeepSeek Harness web surface, enabling separator-transparent and abbreviation-aware candidate ranking so abbreviations like /dshp hit hyphenated commands and skills.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将对话界面的模型选择器与思考强度选择器拆分为独立控件，模型选择支持搜索与收藏，思考强度改为滑动条，并支持快捷键快速切换。
description.en: A DSH plugin that splits the model selector and thinking-effort selector into separate controls, adding search and favorites to the model picker and a slider for thinking effort, with keyboard shortcuts.

description.zh: DSH plugin 增强模型设置页，提供 provider 管理、每模型思考档位、重试覆盖、拖拽排序与凭据状态，完全替代官方模型设置页。
description.en: A DSH plugin that enhances the Models settings page with provider management, per-model reasoning effort, retry overrides, drag reorder, and credential status, fully replacing the official Models page.

description.zh: 为 DSH 会话正文中的文件引用添加右键菜单，可复制绝对路径、在资源管理器中定位或用指定程序打开文件。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a right-click menu to file references in chat, letting you copy absolute paths, reveal files in the file manager, or open them with a chosen app.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供更强的上下文压缩能力，支持 native、goal、handoff 三种模式，并配有预算控制与可视化设置页。
description.en: A DSH plugin that upgrades context compaction with native, goal and handoff modes, budget controls and a visual settings page.

description.zh: DSH plugin 服务化侧边栏框架，提供文件工作台、真实终端、Git 面板、内嵌浏览器与后台任务，重构为 IDE 布局。
description.en: A DSH plugin service-oriented sidebar framework delivering a full workbench with explorer, editors, real terminal, Git panel, embedded browser and background tasks in an IDE layout.

description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar-jupyter 为 DeepSeek Harness 的侧边栏编辑器提供内联 Jupyter notebook 支持，可运行单元格、流式输出并保存回 .ipynb 文件。
description.en: dsh-better-sidebar-jupyter adds inline Jupyter notebook support to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar editor, enabling cell execution, streaming outputs, and save-back to .ipynb files.

description.zh: dsh-better-plan-reviewer 将 DSH 的 plan 审查卡片改装为悬浮对话框，支持在执行前切换模型与思考强度，并可暂存计划到本地，让计划按新模型执行。
description.en: dsh-better-plan-reviewer transforms DSH's plan review card into a floating dialog, allowing model and reasoning effort selection before execution, and can stage plans locally for later runs.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏叠加工作区主题分组树，支持 emoji 分组、筛选搜索、三级拖拽排序与批量归档、安全永久删除。
description.en: A DSH plugin that overlays a topic-group tree onto the native workspace sidebar, adding emoji groups, filtering, drag-and-drop ordering, batch archive and safe permanent deletion.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Web GUI 中养一只边干活边刷 B 站的鲸鱼监工，任务运行随机播视频陪伴，完成后自动暂停并弹出验收动画。
description.en: A DSH plugin that keeps a Bilibili-watching whale in the Web GUI, playing random videos while tasks run, auto-pausing with a celebration animation when done.

description.zh: 把 B 站直播间或视频设为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 聊天背景的 DSH 插件，支持扫码登录、清晰度选择与模糊遮罩调节。
description.en: A DSH plugin that plays a Bilibili live room or video behind the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI chat, with scan-login, quality picker and blur/scrim controls.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏加入 B 站直播页，以 Niri 风格水平滚动多窗口管理直播，支持分屏、Solo、弹幕与焦点音量闪避。
description.en: Adds a Bilibili Live page to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, managing multiple streams as Niri-style horizontally scrolling windows with split stacking, Solo, danmaku and focus-based volume ducking.

description.zh: 大鲸鱼是 DeepSeek Harness 的三语桌面伴侣插件，带口型同步、表情与待机动作，上下文压缩时还会捧出大碗米饭。
description.en: Big Whale is a trilingual desktop companion DSH plugin with lip sync, expressions and idle motions, and she holds up a giant bowl of rice when your context gets compacted.

description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏底部卡片中显示账户余额、所选模型实时单价与高峰/空闲计费时段倒计时，让费用一目了然。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a sidebar footer card showing your balance, the selected model's live unit prices, and a countdown to the next peak/idle billing switch.

description.zh: BiliMini 是 DSH 侧边栏里的 B 站播放插件，支持推荐流、1080P DASH、实时弹幕、扫码登录与历史同步，全程不消耗 Token。
description.en: BiliMini is a DSH plugin that puts Bilibili in the sidebar, with recommendation feed, 1080P DASH playback, live danmaku, QR login and history sync, all without spending tokens.

description.zh: DSH 插件：在 Web 界面右下角挂一块纯文字计费牌，订阅模型输出流实时估算本轮花费，并显示今日累计、账户余额与峰谷时段。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pins a plain-text billing chip to the bottom-right of the web UI, estimating the current turn's cost live from the model output stream alongside today's total, account balance, and peak/off-peak pricing.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供蛋白质设计工具箱：ProteinMPNN 序列设计、ESMFold 折叠验证、界面分析与候选聚类排序，本机一键自举 19 个工具。
description.en: A protein design toolbox for DeepSeek Harness: ProteinMPNN sequence design, ESMFold folding checks, interface analysis and candidate clustering/ranking, with 19 self-bootstrapping tools.

description.zh: DSH plugin 用二分法快速定位 bug 根因，支持代码、边界、commit 三种模式，每轮砍半搜索范围。
description.en: DSH plugin for bisecting bugs: halve the search space each round to pinpoint root cause via code, boundary, or commit bisection.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的基因组尺度代谢模型构建插件，输入细菌全基因组即可自动完成注释、构建、验证与补洞，输出标准 SBML 模型与模型卡。
description.en: A genome-scale metabolic model builder plugin for DeepSeek Harness: feed in a bacterial genome and it auto-annotates, builds, validates and gap-fills, exporting standard SBML plus a model card.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏中查看 PDB、mmCIF、冷冻电镜密度图与小分子，由 Mol* 渲染，并支持 Agent 通过 bio_open 打开数据库条目。
description.en: View PDB, mmCIF, cryo-EM density maps and small molecules in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, rendered with Mol* and openable by agents via bio_open.

description.zh: DSH plugin 用 tsserver 做语义影响面分析，定位 agent 改动波及的符号与调用点，并标记无测试覆盖的高风险变更，默认只报告不拦截。
description.en: A DSH plugin using tsserver for semantic blast radius analysis, identifying affected symbols and call sites of agent edits, flagging high-risk changes without test coverage, report-only by default.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的 ctx.web 接入博查网页搜索 provider，可在设置中切换博查与官方 DeepSeek 搜索，并在结果中标注实际使用的搜索厂商。
description.en: A DSH plugin that wires Bocha web search into DeepSeek Harness's ctx.web, letting you switch between Bocha and the official DeepSeek search provider and see which one served each result.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 右侧边栏直接预览 Blender .blend 文件，自动导出 GLB 并提供可交互 3D 视口与场景统计信息。
description.en: Preview Blender .blend files right inside the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, with cached GLB export and an interactive 3D viewport plus scene statistics.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可拖动悬浮窗，随机决定三餐并提醒喝水、站立，到点响 3 秒提示音。
description.en: A draggable floating window for DeepSeek Harness that picks meals at random and reminds you to drink water and stand up, with a 3-second chime.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 Blender 生产包，让 agent 以 headless 方式跑 bpy 脚本完成建模、渲染与 glTF 导出，并附建模技法与 5.x 踩坑指南。
description.en: A Blender production pack for DeepSeek Harness that lets agents run headless bpy scripts to model, render and export glTF, with modeling cookbooks and 5.x pitfalls.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 左侧栏添加个人书库的 DSH plugin：导入 EPUB/TXT/Markdown，逐章流式讲解、语音朗读、原文对照与随时提问。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a personal book library to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: import EPUB/TXT/Markdown, get chapter-by-chapter streamed commentary, text-to-speech playback, source cross-reference and on-the-fly questions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供脑形知识关系图：侧边栏一键打开全屏图谱，并内置 Markdown 笔记管线，把笔记文件夹编译成可交互的脑状知识网络。
description.en: A DSH plugin that opens a brain-shaped knowledge graph from the sidebar and ships a Markdown pipeline turning a folder of notes into an interactive brain-shaped network.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 换上官方品牌外观的 DSH plugin：侧边栏鲸鱼标志与字标、会话页标题行均可替换，并提供十种品牌配色与开关设置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that restores DeepSeek's official branding in the Harness web client: whale mark and wordmark in the sidebar, a branded hero title on empty sessions, plus ten color choices and toggle settings.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地长期记忆与可控交流风格的 DSH 插件，自动提取跨会话偏好与工作区事实，支持检索、冻结与回退。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness local long-term memory and a controllable communication style, extracting cross-session preferences and workspace facts with recall, freeze and rollback.

description.zh: DSH 浏览器桥接插件，通过本地 WebSocket 让 DeepSeek Harness Agent 读取和控制真实浏览器，提供标签页管理、DOM 操作、截图等 13 个工具。
description.en: DSH browser bridge plugin enabling DeepSeek Harness agents to read and control real browsers via local WebSocket, offering 13 tools for tab management, DOM operations, screenshots, etc.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供受控浏览器自动化能力，通过 agent_browser 工具驱动 agent-browser CLI 操作 Chromium，并防护失效引用、标签漂移与敏感信息泄露。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness controlled browser automation: an agent_browser tool drives the agent-browser CLI against Chromium, guarding against stale refs, tab drift and secret leakage.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供受控浏览器自动化能力，通过 agent_browser 工具驱动 agent-browser CLI 操作 Chromium，并防护失效引用、标签漂移与敏感信息泄露。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness controlled browser automation: an agent_browser tool drives the agent-browser CLI against Chromium, guarding against stale refs, tab drift and secret leakage.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供内嵌共享浏览器面板：AI 用 browser_panel_* 工具驱动每个会话独立标签页，你可在 DSH Web UI 中实时观看或接管同一标签页，完成扫码、2FA、验证码等登录操作。
description.en: A shared in-host browser panel for DeepSeek Harness: the AI drives each session's own tab via browser_panel_* tools while you watch or take over that same tab in the DSH Web UI to handle logins, 2FA, QR codes and CAPTCHAs.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 装配 playwright-mcp 与 peekaboo-mcp，让 DSH 直接驱动浏览器和 macOS 电脑，并自动完成依赖安装、权限引导与连接自检。
description.en: Wires playwright-mcp and peekaboo-mcp into DeepSeek Harness so DSH can drive a real browser and a macOS computer, with automatic dependency install, permission guidance and MCP health checks.

description.zh: DSH 插件，通过 CDP 操控浏览器：复用 Chrome 登录态、导航、截图、抓取控制台与网络错误、执行任意 JS，并注册为 agent 的 browser_* 工具。
description.en: DSH plugin for browser control via CDP: reuse Chrome login state, navigate, screenshot, capture console/network errors, eval JS, and register browser_* tools for agents.

description.zh: DSH 浏览器工具包，驱动 Chromium 标签页执行脚本并回传截图文本，支持 headless、CDP 连接及 Browser Relay 接管真实 Chrome，为 Agent 提供 open/run/close 三段式浏览器操作。
description.en: DSH browser tool for driving Chromium tabs, executing scripts, and returning screenshots/text to the model, supporting headless, CDP attach, and Browser Relay takeover of real Chrome.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自建浏览器服务：单例 CDP 守护进程加回环代理，让 DSH 的 browser_* 工具在无 root、无 GUI 的容器里也能跑无头浏览器。
description.en: A self-hosted browser service for DeepSeek Harness: a singleton CDP daemon with a loopback proxy that lets DSH browser_* tools drive headless Chromium in rootless, GUI-less containers.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供只读浏览器验证能力：四个工具调用即可打开页面、Mock 接口、断言 DOM 并截图，截图自动进入模型上下文。
description.en: Read-only browser verification for DeepSeek Harness: open, mock, assert and screenshot a page in a few tool calls, with screenshots auto-projected into the model context.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加实时牛熊行情宠物，根据自选股平均涨跌奔跑或翻滚，免费新浪行情，纯属娱乐。
description.en: A real-time bull & bear market pet for DeepSeek Harness: it sprints or tumbles with your portfolio's average move, powered by free Sina quotes. Purely for fun.

description.zh: DSH plugin 硬性预算控制：超支即拦截、自动降级到廉价模型，防止超额调用被计费。
description.en: DSH plugin for hard budget enforcement: blocks over-budget calls, auto-downgrades to cheaper models, preventing billing for excessive usage.

description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面端模型接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 DSH plugin，覆盖国内与国际账号，并自动完成每日签到与积分预警。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings WorkBuddy desktop models into DeepSeek Harness for both CN and global accounts, with automatic daily check-in and credit alerts.

description.zh: DSH Budget View 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 插件，在输入栏和新会话页展示 Codex、OpenCode Go 额度、DeepSeek 余额与峰谷状态，并按官方人民币峰谷价估算会话费用。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that shows Codex and OpenCode Go quotas, DeepSeek balance and peak/off-peak status in the input bar and new-session page, and estimates session cost using DeepSeek's official CNY peak/off-peak pricing.

description.zh: DSH plugin 组合包，通过 butler memory MCP 服务器为 DeepSeek Harness 提供长期与短期分离的记忆管理，并附带用户可查看、审核的 Web 记忆面板。
description.en: A DSH plugin bundle that integrates butler memory MCP server into DeepSeek Harness, providing separated long-term and short-term memory with a user-visible review panel.

description.zh: DSH plugin：LLM成本计量与预算执行，超预算硬拦截模型调用，支持DeepSeek峰谷定价与实时仪表盘。
description.en: DSH plugin for LLM cost metering with budget enforcement (deny/warn) and DeepSeek peak-valley pricing, plus a live dashboard.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框加一排快捷按钮：一键发送「继续」、重发上一条，或自定义文字快速调用技能。
description.en: Adds a row of quick-action buttons to the DeepSeek Harness composer: send "continue", resend your last message, or fire custom saved text to trigger skills in one click.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供零核心改动的视觉能力：注册 describe_image 工具，让纯文本主模型通过多模态路由直接描述本地图片，无需改动 dsh 本身。
description.en: Zero-core-change vision capability for DeepSeek Harness: registers the describe_image tool so a text-only main model can describe local images via a multimodal route, with no changes to dsh itself.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面中的缓存命中率从整数改为两位小数显示，如 42.86%，卸载即恢复原生显示。
description.en: A DSH plugin that replaces the native integer cache-hit percentage in the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with a two-decimal value like 42.86%, and restores the original on removal.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏提供 CAD 3D 模型预览，直接打开 STEP/IGES/BREP 与 STL/3MF/OBJ/PLY 文件，可旋转缩放、看线框与包围盒尺寸。
description.en: A DSH plugin that previews CAD 3D models right in the sidebar — open STEP/IGES/BREP and STL/3MF/OBJ/PLY files with orbit, wireframe and bounding-box readouts.

description.zh: dsh-calendar 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供全局会话日历视图，聚合所有会话的交互事件，实时展示每日活跃会话、时长与事件列表。
description.en: dsh-calendar provides a whole-harness calendar surface for DeepSeek Harness, aggregating interaction events from all sessions with real-time updates and per-day session details.

description.zh: 这款 DSH plugin 把对话视图标签移入 Windows 标题栏、工具收进 42px 右侧栏，为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端腾出一整行垂直空间。
description.en: A DSH plugin that moves conversation view tabs into the Windows caption row and packs utilities into a 42px right rail, reclaiming a full row of vertical space in DeepSeek Harness desktop.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏提供通用日历面板，支持月视图点选、当天事件与接下来一览，事件本地存储，Agent 也能通过 calendar_panel 增删勾选。
description.en: A general-purpose calendar panel for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, with month view, today's events and an upcoming list; events are stored locally and the Agent can add, remove or check them via calendar_panel.

description.zh: DSH plugin 旁路捕获窗：随手丢想法进独立安静新会话，不打断主线上下文，支持 /recall 引擎与三种上下文模式。
description.en: A DSH plugin with a capture window to drop stray thoughts into a separate quiet session without disturbing the main context, featuring a /recall engine and three context modes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏提供卡路里日记面板，内置约 90 条食物热量表，选食物加克数自动算 kcal，并记录当日进度与近 7 天趋势。
description.en: A calorie diary panel for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, with a built-in food calorie table that auto-computes kcal from food and grams, tracking daily progress and a 7-day trend.

description.zh: CapyReporter 是 DeepSeek Harness Web 的水豚任务汇报插件，用页面宠物实时展示会话与工具活动，并可选用置顶透明 Electron 桌宠。
description.en: CapyReporter is a DSH plugin that reports DeepSeek Harness Web task activity through an on-page capybara pet, with an optional always-on-top transparent Electron desktop companion.

description.zh: 深鲸能力清单是一款 DSH plugin，静态扫描代码，列出执行命令、网络请求、写文件、读凭据等能力分布与高风险文件，不联网也不执行目标代码。
description.en: A DSH plugin that statically scans code to map capabilities such as command execution, network access, file writes and credential reads, flagging high-risk files without network access or running the target code.

description.zh: 把 cc-switch 里配置好的模型供应商一键接入 DeepSeek Harness，转成 llm-pi-ai 路由并写入凭据，还附带路由连通性体检。
description.en: Bridges model providers configured in cc-switch into DeepSeek Harness as llm-pi-ai routes with stored credentials, plus a route connectivity health check.

description.zh: DSH plugin 命名风格转换工具，注册 case_convert 工具，支持 camelCase、snake_case、kebab-case 等多种风格互转，自动检测源风格。
description.en: A DSH plugin that registers a case_convert tool for converting between naming conventions like camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case, etc., with automatic source detection.

description.zh: DSH plugin 的 cerrda 暗色主题，为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供 rose/purple 配色、Liquid Glass 玻璃态与 Silk 动态背景，部署级静态加载、免审批。
description.en: A dark theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, featuring rose/purple oklch palette, Liquid Glass effects, and Silk dynamic background, deployed as a static bundle with no approval needed.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供只读 MCP 服务，让 Agent 在推荐或安装插件前查询认证等级、快照日期与五维证据。
description.en: A read-only MCP server for DeepSeek Harness that lets agents look up certification grades, snapshot dates and five-dimension evidence before recommending or installing a plugin.

description.zh: DSH plugin 启动时自动重建 OpenRouter、OpenCode、Fireworks 等模型目录，让模型选择器展示实时模型列表，无需重启或手动添加。
description.en: A DSH plugin that rebuilds model catalogues for OpenRouter, OpenCode, Fireworks, etc., at boot, keeping the model picker live without restarts.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加一只可拖拽的动画猫咪伴侣，它会记住位置，并随 DSH 代理的忙碌状态坐下、入睡或醒来。
description.en: An animated cat companion for the DeepSeek Harness web UI that can be dragged around, remembers its position, and sits, sleeps, or wakes in response to what the DSH agent is doing.

description.zh: 常凯申模式是 DSH 的纯娱乐角色扮演开关，位于设置→通用，打开后 AI 便以蒋介石口吻对话，关闭即恢复原样，切换即时生效。
description.en: Chang Kaishen Mode is a purely for-fun DSH plugin that adds a toggle under Settings → General, making the AI reply in Chiang Kai-shek's persona and reverting instantly when switched off.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供变更影响分析：把代码改动转化为带证据的影响评估与验证计划，输出 CHANGE-IMPACT.md 与 JSON 报告。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns a code change into an evidence-backed impact analysis and verification plan, emitting CHANGE-IMPACT.md and change-impact.json.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供频道网关，把 Telegram 与微信消息统一成一套消息契约，在传输边界完成鉴权并广播 channel/inbound 事件，消费者可经 ctx.channels.send 按原路由回复。
description.en: A channel gateway for DeepSeek Harness that normalizes Telegram and WeChat traffic into one message contract, authorizes it at the transport boundary, emits channel/inbound, and lets consumers reply via ctx.channels.send on the carried route.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 对话中的 Mermaid 代码块提供可缩放全屏预览、平移与主题适配等增强体验。
description.en: A DSH plugin that enhances Mermaid code blocks in DeepSeek Harness Web conversations with zoomable preview, panning, and theme support.

description.zh: Chat First 是 DSH plugin，为会话加入「先聊后做」模式：先讨论方向再执行，减少误判与返工。
description.en: Chat First is a DSH plugin that adds a discuss-first mode to DeepSeek Harness conversations, aligning on direction before the agent acts to cut wrong turns and rework.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness Chat 提供按轮次折叠执行过程的功能，将每轮执行步骤收纳为可展开的「Execution process · N steps」，运行中自动展开、完成后自动折叠。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds per-turn execution folding to the stock DeepSeek Harness Chat, grouping each turn's execution rows behind a collapsible 'Execution process · N steps' that auto-expands while running and folds on completion.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将聊天中 Markdown 图片引用渲染为画廊，支持本地工作区路径、data URL 与标题，加载失败时优雅回退。
description.en: A DSH plugin that renders chat Markdown image references as a gallery, supporting local workspace paths, data URLs, and titles, with graceful fallback on load failure.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供 ChatGPT 风格的会话历史导航栏，通过侧边条快速跳转到任意用户消息，并支持滚动同步与点击锁定。
description.en: A ChatGPT-style conversation-history rail for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, enabling quick jumps to any user message with scroll sync and click-lock.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在对话右侧悬浮输入目录，每条用户输入一根横条，悬停预览、点击跳转、滚动高亮，让长对话导航一目了然。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a floating input index rail on the right side of the chat, with one bar per user message for hover preview, click-to-jump, and scroll highlighting.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让 Agent 把本地 CSV、Excel 或 DuckDB 数据变成可缩放、可筛选、可分组的交互图表，支持百万行数据与 SQL 查询。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets the agent turn local CSV, Excel, or DuckDB data into interactive charts with zoom, filter, and group, handling millions of rows and SQL queries.

description.zh: DSH plugin 对话区宽度调节插件，滑块即时调整消息列与用户气泡宽度，一键恢复默认。
description.en: A DSH plugin to adjust chat area width with sliders for message column and user bubble, instantly effective and resettable.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将本地 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Cursor Agent 的对话实时同步进 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI，方便统一浏览与管理。
description.en: A DSH plugin that live-syncs local Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Cursor Agent conversations into the DeepSeek Harness web GUI for unified browsing.

description.zh: DSH Web GUI 插件，自动折叠/展开聊天窗口，滚动到底部时隐藏早期消息，保持窗口精简，滚动到顶部可逐批追回。
description.en: DSH Web GUI plugin that auto folds/expands the chat window, hiding old messages when scrolled to bottom, keeping the window compact, and allowing retrieval by scrolling to top.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 模型设置提供 ChatGPT 账号 OAuth 登录，并展示 OpenAI Codex 用量与限额。
description.en: Adds ChatGPT account OAuth login to DeepSeek Harness web model settings and shows OpenAI Codex usage and limits.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上归档会话正文阅读与安全永久删除：在官方插槽里浏览、搜索归档对话，并二次确认后清理会话。
description.en: Adds archived-session transcript reading and safe permanent deletion to DeepSeek Harness: browse and search archived chats in official slots, then delete with confirmation.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里用 ChatGPT 账号 OAuth 登录，把 Plus/Pro 方案模型注册成普通 chatgpt provider 路由，直接在选择器里调用。
description.en: Sign in with ChatGPT inside DeepSeek Harness and register ChatGPT Plus/Pro plan models as a normal chatgpt provider route, ready to pick in the model selector.

description.zh: 基于 DSH 的会说话桌宠插件，支持语音聊天、主动闲聊、人格与记忆库，还能刷 B站热门并套用 QQ 群记忆。
description.en: A talking desktop pet DSH plugin with voice chat, proactive small talk, personas and memory, plus Bilibili trending feeds and QQ group memory.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 ChatOnly 预设，抑制工具与工作目录注入，仅保留用户输入和可热更新的系统提示词，便于受控评测。
description.en: A ChatOnly preset for DeepSeek Harness that suppresses tool and working-directory injection, leaving only user input plus a hot-reloaded system prompt for controlled evaluation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加任务完成提示音，后台标签页也能响铃，内置 10 种预设音效并支持自定义导入与音量调节。
description.en: Adds a task-completion chime to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, ringing even in background tabs, with 10 presets, custom sound import, and volume control.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话级清单：Agent 以树状结构跟踪任务，模型每轮都能看到精简摘要，侧边栏只读同步展示。
description.en: Session-scoped checklists for DeepSeek Harness: the agent tracks work as a tree, the model always sees a compact digest, and a read-only sidebar tab mirrors it.

description.zh: dsh-chrome-attach 让 DSH 一键把当前 Chrome 标签页截图连同标题与 URL 写入草稿，模型因此知道在看哪个页面。
description.en: A DSH plugin that attaches the current Chrome tab to your draft as a screenshot plus its title and URL, so the model knows which page it is looking at.

description.zh: 这款 DSH plugin 为主会话和所有子代理注入全局系统提示词，让内部推理与回复统一使用简体中文，无需依赖项目 AGENTS.md。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that injects a global system-prompt policy so the main session and every subagent reason and reply in Simplified Chinese, without relying on a project AGENTS.md.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 CI 工作流安全审计，扫描 GitHub Actions 配置，揪出未锁版本、权限过宽、脚本注入等可被外部利用的供应链风险。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that audits CI workflows, scanning GitHub Actions configs for exploitable supply-chain risks such as unpinned actions, over-broad permissions, and script injection.

description.zh: dsh-cite-lens 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 PDF 阅读插件：在 Files 标签页选中 PDF 文字即可引用或提问，并把模型给出的 [main.pdf p.7 "原文"] 引用变成可点击链接，跳转并高亮原文。
description.en: A DSH plugin for reading papers in the PDF you already have open: select text in the Files tab to quote or ask about it, and turn the model's [main.pdf p.7 "exact words"] citations into links that open the PDF and highlight the passage.

description.zh: dsh-claude-code-local 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，将本地安装的 Claude Code CLI 注册为 LLM 提供商，无需 API key，即可在 DSH 中流式使用 Claude 模型。
description.en: dsh-claude-code-local is a DSH plugin that registers your locally installed Claude Code CLI as an LLM provider, enabling streaming Claude models in DeepSeek Harness without an API key.

description.zh: 通过 Claude Code CLI 把 Claude Pro/Max 订阅接入 DeepSeek Harness 作为模型提供商，让用量走订阅额度而非按 token 计费。
description.en: Bridges a Claude Pro/Max subscription into DeepSeek Harness as a model provider by driving the Claude Code CLI, so usage lands on plan limits instead of per-token billing.

description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Claude 风格 Web 界面皮肤，暖黑画布配陶橙点缀，内置 Anthropic 字体切换与亮暗主题。
description.en: A Claude-style web UI skin for DeepSeek Harness, featuring a warm-black canvas with terracotta accents, Anthropic font switching, and light/dark themes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册 claude-subscription 模型提供商，直接复用 Claude Code 订阅的 OAuth 凭据流式调用 Claude，无需 Anthropic API Key。
description.en: A DSH plugin that registers a claude-subscription LLM provider, streaming Claude through your Claude Code subscription OAuth credentials with no Anthropic API key required.

description.zh: DSH 插件：每轮对话后归档原始工具结果并从上下文清除，减少 Token 消耗，模型可自主读取归档数据。
description.en: A DSH plugin that archives raw tool results after each turn and clears them from context to reduce token usage, with model-accessible retrieval.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话窗口添加文件管理器标签页，提供 VSCode 风格的文件树与预览面板，支持代码高亮、图片预览及会话内缓存。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding a Files tab to the conversation window with a VSCode-style file tree and viewer, supporting syntax highlighting, image preview, and per-session caching.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 Elasticsearch 日志查询能力：在设置中配置连接，通过 es_query_logs 工具按 trace_id 或自然语言检索日志，并自动引导会话使用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds Elasticsearch log search to DeepSeek Harness: configure connection in Settings, query logs via the es_query_logs tool by trace_id or natural language, with auto-guidance.

description.zh: 为 DSH 客户端顶栏加上浏览器式后退、前进与刷新按钮，会话与面板共用一条历史栈，刷新运行中的会话前会先确认。
description.en: Adds browser-style Back, Forward and Refresh controls to the DSH client title bar, sharing one history stack across sessions and panels, with a confirmation before refreshing a running session.

description.zh: 把两个争抢同一模型座位的 DSH plugin 合并为一个控件：Provider 与模型双列卡片、跨供应商搜索、思考强度粒子滑块与双主题外观面板。
description.en: Merges two conflicting DSH plugins into one model-seat control: a provider/model two-column card, cross-provider search, a particle thinking-effort slider and a dual-theme appearance panel.

description.zh: 为 DSH web 编辑器带来终端式提示历史与快速补全，支持历史回看、模糊搜索、自动补全，提升输入效率。
description.en: Brings terminal-style prompt history and fast completion to the DSH web composer, with recall, fuzzy search, and autosuggestions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面打造的泡泡猫奇幻主题皮肤，含月光森林流体背景、彼岸花与小猫装饰，淡雅/蓝色双风格一键切换，并内置背景音乐。
description.en: A fantasy Paopao Cat theme skin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, featuring a moonlit forest fluid background, spider lilies and a sleeping cat, one-click switching between light and blue styles, plus built-in background music.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在网页会话中提供文本选择添加功能：选中文本后浮动“添加到对话”按钮，点击将选中内容填入输入框草稿，供用户确认后发送。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a floating 'Add to conversation' button on text selection in web sessions, prefilling the composer draft for user review before sending.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 客户端全局加粗滚动条，宽度可在插件页 4–20px 间调节，默认 8px，关闭即恢复官方样式。
description.en: A DSH plugin that thickens scrollbars across the DeepSeek Harness client, with an adjustable 4–20px width (default 8px) in the plugin page and instant revert when disabled.

description.zh: DSH plugin 可视化换肤工具，在 DeepSeek Harness Web 设置中一键切换主题、导入导出主题包，刷新不丢失且零闪烁。
description.en: A DSH plugin for visual theming in DeepSeek Harness Web: switch themes, import/export theme packs, with persistence and zero flash on refresh.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话页头展示 Cline / ClinePass 订阅额度、Credits 余额与 token 消耗，并支持多账号切换的 DSH plugin。
description.en: A DSH plugin that surfaces Cline / ClinePass subscription quota, credits balance and token consumption in the DeepSeek Harness session header, with multi-account switching.

description.zh: 把 DSH 客户端的工作区从平铺列表升级为可浏览目录树，提供资源管理器式选择弹窗、多级工作区树与工作区总览，让会话选对工作区。
description.en: Upgrades the DSH client's workspace list into a browsable directory tree, with an explorer-style picker, nested workspace tree and per-workspace overview so sessions start in the right workspace.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 ClinePass 订阅模型，支持用量查看、多账号管理与自动切换备用账号。
description.en: Connects ClinePass subscription models to DeepSeek Harness with usage tracking, multi-account management and automatic fallback switching.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供剪藏功能：一键收藏助手回复，并在会话头部面板中浏览、搜索、复制、删除与导出 Markdown。
description.en: A clipbook for DeepSeek Harness conversations: one click saves any assistant reply, and a session-header panel lets you browse, search, copy, delete and export clips as Markdown.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Cloudflare Workers AI 多媒体能力，提供文生图、语音合成与语音转文字工具，并带图形设置页配置账号与模型。
description.en: Adds Cloudflare Workers AI multimedia capabilities to DeepSeek Harness: text-to-image, text-to-speech and speech-to-text tools, plus a settings page for account and per-capability model selection.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏标签页右键菜单增加「关闭全部标签」，一键关闭当前会话所有内容标签并保留引导页。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a "Close All Tabs" item to the right sidebar tab context menu, closing every content tab in the current session in one click while keeping the docked guide page.

description.zh: DSH 插件 dsh-cn-data-export 扫描代码与配置中的境外数据出口，标记个人信息外发与缺失安全评估说明，帮开发提前发现数据出境合规风险。
description.en: A DSH plugin that scans code and configs for cross-border data exports, flagging overseas PII transfers and missing security assessment notes so developers catch China data-export compliance risks early.

description.zh: DSH plugin 备案公示检查工具，扫描网站或 App 是否标注 ICP 备案号、APP 备案号、隐私政策入口与运营者信息，帮助上线前自查合规风险。
description.en: A DSH plugin that audits websites and apps for ICP filing numbers, app filing numbers, privacy policy links and operator details, helping teams self-check China compliance before launch.

description.zh: 面向国内合规场景的 DSH 插件，检查日志是否开启、是否记录必要字段、留存期是否满足法定 6 个月要求，并输出规则清单与 HTML 报告。
description.en: A DSH plugin for China compliance checks: verifies logging is enabled, required fields are recorded, and retention meets the statutory 6-month minimum, with rule listings and HTML reports.

description.zh: DSH plugin 等保对照工具：按 GB/T 22239-2019 静态扫描代码与配置，找出默认口令、弱哈希、明文传输等上线前可自改的等保问题。
description.en: A DSH plugin for MLPS compliance: statically scans code and config against GB/T 22239-2019 to surface pre-launch fixable issues such as default credentials, weak password hashing and plaintext transport.

description.zh: DSH plugin 会话代码收集器：汇总当前会话模型产出的全部代码块，按语言或文件分组，支持版本历史、搜索、复制与跳转。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gathers every code block from the current session, grouped by language or file, with version history, search, copy, and jump-to-turn.

description.zh: dsh-code-intel 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供符号感知的代码索引与混合搜索，支持代码大纲、词法及向量检索，助力开发者高效定位代码。
description.en: dsh-code-intel provides symbol-aware code indexing and hybrid search for DeepSeek Harness, enabling code outlines and lexical or embedding-assisted retrieval.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex 集成：ChatGPT OAuth 登录、Codex 模型、图片输入与流式恢复，社区维护的非官方 DSH plugin。
description.en: Community Codex plugin for DeepSeek Harness: ChatGPT OAuth, Codex models, image input, and reliable stream recovery.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex 集成：ChatGPT OAuth 登录、Codex 模型、图片输入与流式恢复，社区维护的非官方 DSH plugin。
description.en: Community Codex plugin for DeepSeek Harness: ChatGPT OAuth, Codex models, image input, and reliable stream recovery.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web GUI 内置右侧栏提供搜索面板，可按关键词搜文件名与内容，或用代码图查符号并展开调用关系，点击即跳转到对应行。
description.en: A search panel for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web GUI's built-in right sidebar: keyword search across file names and contents, plus code-graph symbol lookup with caller/callee expansion and click-to-line jumps.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版接入 ChatGPT 订阅，登录账户即可选用 GPT 模型，支持图片理解、Harness 工具调用与 GPT/DeepSeek 会话内切换。
description.en: Brings your ChatGPT subscription into the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: sign in, pick GPT models, and get image input, Harness tool use, and in-session GPT/DeepSeek switching.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 引入 Codex 架构师与只读评审：Codex 负责规划与校验，DeepSeek 负责实现，支持 ChatGPT 登录与文件审批。
description.en: Brings a Codex architect and read-only reviewer into DeepSeek Harness: Codex plans and verifies while DeepSeek implements, with ChatGPT sign-in and explicit file approval.

description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Codex 式长期记忆：自动提取已结束会话，整合成可检索的 MEMORY.md 手册，并在每轮对话前注入精简摘要。
description.en: Codex-style long-term memory for DSH: extracts finished sessions, consolidates them into a searchable MEMORY.md handbook, and injects a compact summary before every turn.

description.zh: DSH 插件：只读本机 OpenAI Codex 项目与会话，生成续作包并一键在 DeepSeek Harness 里接着干活，Codex 限额到点也不丢活。
description.en: A DSH plugin that reads local OpenAI Codex projects and sessions, builds a resume bundle, and lets you continue the work inside DeepSeek Harness with one click.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏与底栏实时显示 ChatGPT Codex 账户的 5 小时与每周剩余额度及重置时间，支持自动刷新与登录授权。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows your ChatGPT Codex 5-hour and weekly remaining quota in the sidebar and composer dock, with auto-refresh and OAuth login.

description.zh: 为 DSH 接入本地 ComfyUI 的生产技能包，提供环境体检、零依赖 API 客户端、工作流改造与崩图排查，让 agent 真正把图跑出来。
description.en: A production skill pack that connects DeepSeek Harness to a local ComfyUI: environment checks, a zero-dependency API client, workflow rework, and broken-image diagnosis so agents can actually generate images.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将多个 Codex 订阅账号汇入本地账号池，请求前按模型额度自动路由，实现订阅额度共享与自动切换。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pools multiple Codex subscription accounts locally and auto-routes requests by model quota for shared usage.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版接入 ChatGPT 订阅，登录账户即可选用 GPT 模型，支持图片理解、Harness 工具调用与 GPT/DeepSeek 会话内切换。
description.en: Brings your ChatGPT subscription into the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: sign in, pick GPT models, and get image input, Harness tool use, and in-session GPT/DeepSeek switching.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供键盘优先的命令面板，双击 Shift 即可搜索并打开会话、工作区、设置页面、已装功能与自定义指令，提升操作效率。
description.en: A keyboard-first command palette for DeepSeek Harness, triggered by double Shift to search and open sessions, workspaces, settings, installed features, and custom commands.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供 /vscode 斜杠命令，一键在 VS Code 中打开当前会话工作区或指定目录，自动探测 CLI，跨平台零依赖。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a /vscode slash command to open the current session workspace or a specified directory in VS Code, with automatic CLI detection and zero runtime dependencies.

description.zh: dsh-codex-select 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供 Codex 风格的代码选择功能，选中代码自动作为引用芯片加入消息，发送时序列化为上下文。
description.en: dsh-codex-select brings Codex-style code selection to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, automatically adding selected code as a reference chip to the message and serializing it into context on send.

description.zh: DSH plugin 实时监测 Command Code 用量，提供侧边栏挂件与仪表盘，展示用量余量、Credits 及每轮对话消耗。
description.en: A DSH plugin that monitors Command Code usage in real time, offering sidebar widgets and dashboards for usage quotas, credits, and per-turn costs.

description.zh: DSH 电商经营驾驶舱插件，提供经营看板、数据完整性校验与规则式问数，支持 Demo 与 CSV 导入两种模式。
description.en: A DSH plugin for ecommerce business cockpit, offering dashboards, data integrity checks, and rule-based Q&A with Demo and CSV import modes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供压缩中间件：按真实 token 预算裁剪摘要请求、被上游拒绝时缩小预算重试，并纠正 pi-ai 的伪造上下文溢出误判。
description.en: A DSH plugin that makes context compaction work on local OpenAI-compatible gateways: trims summary prompts to a real token budget, shrinks and retries on prompt-too-long, and fixes pi-ai's fabricated overflow errors.

description.zh: 这款 DSH plugin 压缩侧边栏顶部：把「插件 / 自动化任务 / 更多」三行并成一行，并把「新会话」收成品牌行右侧图标，为工作区列表腾出约 130px。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that compacts the sidebar top: Plugins / Automations / More merge into one row and New Session becomes a brand-row icon, freeing about 130px for the workspace list.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供键盘优先的命令面板，双击 Shift 即可搜索并打开会话、工作区、设置页面、已装功能与自定义指令，提升操作效率。
description.en: A keyboard-first command palette for DeepSeek Harness, triggered by double Shift to search and open sessions, workspaces, settings, installed features, and custom commands.

description.zh: 把 DSH 本地安全扫描报告整理成自查表、整改说明与合规证明三份可直接交付的文档，并附带边界声明。
description.en: Turns DSH local security scan reports into three deliverable documents — a self-check CSV, remediation notes and a compliance statement — each with explicit scope disclaimers.

description.zh: dsh-completion-guard 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供任务契约与完成认证层，确保任务仅在当前证据匹配当前契约时才能被认证完成。
description.en: dsh-completion-guard is a task-contract and completion-certification layer for DeepSeek Harness, certifying completion only when current evidence matches the current contract.

description.zh: DSH plugin 远程技能提供器，通过 ctx.skills 从 JSON 目录安装跨境合规技能（CCPA/GDPR/HIPAA/COPPA），免手动复制。
description.en: A DSH plugin remote skill provider that installs cross-border compliance skills (CCPA/GDPR/HIPAA/COPPA) from a JSON catalog via ctx.skills, no manual copying.

description.zh: 把 Docker Compose 项目搬进 DeepSeek Harness 右侧边栏：按目录分组展示容器状态，支持启停重启与实时日志流。
description.en: Brings Docker Compose projects into the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: per-directory groups with live container status, start/stop/restart actions and streamed logs.

description.zh: DSH plugin的旧插件兼容层，让Claude Code/Codex插件以原目录与语义在DeepSeek Harness中运行，支持Skill、MCP与Hook。
description.en: A compatibility layer for DSH plugin that lets Claude Code/Codex plugins run in DeepSeek Harness with original structure and semantics, supporting Skill, MCP, and Hook.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页版输入框补上 Markdown 编辑辅助：列表自动续行与重编号、行内代码样式、代码围栏自动闭合，全部走 Shift+Enter，Enter 提交语义不变，发送内容仍是原样 Markdown。
description.en: A pure client-side DSH plugin that adds Markdown editing aids to the DeepSeek Harness web composer: list auto-continuation and renumbering, inline-code styling, and code-fence auto-closing — all on Shift+Enter, with Enter still submitting and the sent text kept as literal Markdown.

description.zh: Composer Rewind 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 记录输入框历史，静默保存文字、附件、引用、指令及当时的 DSH 配置，一键还原完整输入框。
description.en: Composer Rewind is a DSH plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that silently saves composer history — text, attachments, references, commands and the DSH setup used — and restores the full input box in one click.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入框调整提交键位：Enter 换行、Cmd/Ctrl+Enter 提交，兼顾输入法组合输入，不改写 Lexical 方法。
description.en: Remaps the DSH web composer keys: Enter inserts a newline while Cmd/Ctrl+Enter submits, with IME composition left untouched.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页版输入框加一枚实时 token 计数徽标，边打字边显示预计总量与上下文占用率，并展开缓存命中率等明细。
description.en: Adds a live token counter badge to the DeepSeek Harness web composer, showing estimated total tokens and context usage as you type, with a tooltip for cache hit rate and other details.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 桌面操作能力：截图、鼠标、键盘、窗口与剪贴板，由内置 Rust 助手完成原生调用。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness agents real Windows desktop control — screenshots, mouse, keyboard, windows and clipboard — powered by a bundled native Rust helper.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框的加号与斜杠菜单加上 Tab 分页，把指令、我的技能与各插件技能按来源分页，找起来更快更清楚。
description.en: Adds tabbed pages to the DeepSeek Harness composer menus, splitting commands, personal skills and per-plugin skills by source so items are easier to find.

description.zh: DSH plugin 一键备份与恢复 DeepSeek Harness 配置，支持导出为目录包或 AES-256-GCM 口令加密文件，在新机器上安全解密恢复。
description.en: A DSH plugin to back up and restore DeepSeek Harness configuration as portable bundles or a password-encrypted file, with secure decryption on a new machine.

description.zh: dsh-config-form 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件提供统一的声明式设置表单，插件声明字段即可获得渲染页面，无需手写 React 表单、路由或存储。
description.en: dsh-config-form provides a unified declarative settings form for DeepSeek Harness plugins: declare fields and get a rendered page, without hand-writing React forms, routes, or storage.

description.zh: DSH plugin 一键备份与恢复 DeepSeek Harness 配置，支持导出为目录包或 AES-256-GCM 口令加密文件，在新机器上安全解密恢复。
description.en: A DSH plugin to back up and restore DeepSeek Harness configuration as portable bundles or a password-encrypted file, with secure decryption on a new machine.

description.zh: dsh-config-transfer 是 DSH plugin，用于在旧电脑导出、新电脑导入配置，恢复插件、设置、MCP 条目与用户技能，且不导出凭据。
description.en: A DSH plugin that exports a DeepSeek Harness Desktop configuration on one machine and imports it on another, restoring plugins, settings, MCP entries and user skills while leaving credentials out.

description.zh: 把本机已登录的 AtomCode 作为侧边工具台接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供侧边咨询、代码评审与 CodingPlan 额度显示。
description.en: Bridges your locally logged-in AtomCode into DeepSeek Harness as a side toolbench, offering side chat, code review and CodingPlan quota display.

description.zh: 把本机已登录的 MiniMax Code 桌面 App 模型零配置接入 DeepSeek Harness，无需 API Key，模型实时出现在选择器中。
description.en: Brings the models of your locally logged-in MiniMax Code desktop app into DeepSeek Harness with zero configuration and no API key.

description.zh: DSH plugin 把本机 Trae 多账号聚合成一个模型供应商，自动容错换号、签到领积分并显示模型倍率。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pools all local Trae accounts into one model provider, with automatic failover, check-in automation and model multiplier display.

description.zh: 把超算互联网（SCNet）客户端已登录的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，复用客户端自带 API key，无需二次配置即可选用 30 个模型。
description.en: Brings the models already signed in to the SCNet desktop client into DeepSeek Harness, reusing the client's own API key so no extra setup is needed.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供 /web、/tunnel、/ask、/console 等控制台命令，管理 Web 服务、SSH 隧道与一次性问答，助力 DeepSeek Harness 运维。
description.en: A DSH plugin offering /web, /tunnel, /ask, /console commands to manage the web service, SSH tunnel, and one-shot questions for DeepSeek Harness.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 权限菜单添加 CAutoR 模式：先用确定性规则自动放行工作区写入与只读命令，仅把疑难操作交给 LLM 审查。
description.en: Adds a CAutoR permission preset to DeepSeek Harness: deterministic rules auto-approve workspace writes and read-only shell commands, escalating only unclear operations to LLM review.

description.zh: dsh-consult 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供证据优先的多模型咨询检查点，主代理汇总 2–5 个独立模型的匿名意见，提升关键决策质量。
description.en: dsh-consult adds an evidence-first multi-model consultation checkpoint to DeepSeek Harness, where the main agent synthesizes anonymous opinions from 2–5 independently configured models.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通过实测预填充速度、硬上限与提前压缩，将本地模型的上下文控制在 GPU 可承受范围内，避免长会话变慢或显存溢出。
description.en: A DSH plugin that keeps a local model's context within GPU limits by measuring prefill speed, enforcing a hard ceiling, and compacting early.

description.zh: 这款 DSH plugin 在会话输入框下方提供上下文编辑面板，可按时间段筛选并移除已结束轮次，只影响模型可见上下文，聊天记录与日志原样保留。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds an Edit context panel below the composer, letting you filter finished turns by time range and remove them from the model-visible context while the transcript and append-only log stay untouched.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供上下文浏览器面板，在 Web UI 侧边栏以 token 方块网格展示会话实际提交给模型的系统提示、工具 schema 与全部消息。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a Context Explorer panel to the Web UI sidebar, drawing the system prompt, tool schemas and every message a Session sends to its model as a grid of token squares.

description.zh: DSH plugin 请求上下文分析器，对比每次模型请求的变化与缓存复用情况，帮助定位缓存命中率下降的原因。
description.en: A DSH plugin that profiles request context, showing what changed between model requests and how cache reuse shifted.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供上下文快照与轨迹视图的 DSH 插件，在输入框上方与右侧栏展示运行时快照、消息轨迹及最近一次压缩保留了什么。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that surfaces runtime context snapshots and conversation traces, showing what the latest compaction kept in the input bar and right sidebar.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 Agent 注入五维认知图鉴与链协议模式，通过 JSON 快照隐式标记并提取会话链图，提供带归因档案的洞察分析，让模型更懂用户。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects a five-dimensional cognitive map and chain protocol into the agent, implicitly marking responses with JSON snapshots to extract conversation chain graphs and provide attributed insights, making the model understand users better.

description.zh: 为 DSH 会话提供压缩前裁决：判断未落地的工作是否会因压缩而丢失，并给出 safe_to_compact、wait、preserve_first 三种结论。
description.en: A DSH plugin that issues one session-level verdict before compaction, telling you whether unlanded work would be lost: safe_to_compact, wait, or preserve_first.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供轻量上下文窗口提醒的 DSH plugin，每轮向模型注入已用 token 与百分比，由模型自行判断如何安排。
description.en: A lightweight DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that injects a one-line context-window usage reminder each turn, letting the model decide what to do with it.

description.zh: 深鲸合同体检是一款 DSH plugin，扫描合同文本并检查主体、价款、违约等 10 项必备条款是否缺失，帮助用户快速发现合同漏洞。
description.en: A DSH plugin that scans contract text and checks for 10 essential clauses such as parties, price, and breach terms, helping users spot missing provisions quickly.

description.zh: DSH 侧边栏会话清理插件，显示每个会话的文件数与内存占用，可打开、定位或删除生成文件，并彻底删除会话及其本地日志。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness sidebar plugin that shows per-conversation file count and memory usage, lets you open, reveal or delete generated files, and permanently removes conversations with their local session logs.

description.zh: DSH plugin 对话位置导航：右侧悬浮按钮打开暗黑大纲抽屉，列出全部用户消息，点击平滑跳转，Scroll Spy 实时高亮当前可视位置。
description.en: A DSH plugin for conversation navigation: a floating button opens a dark outline drawer listing all user messages, click to jump smoothly, with Scroll Spy highlighting the current position.

description.zh: DSH plugin 对话位置导航：右侧悬浮按钮打开暗黑大纲抽屉，列出全部用户消息，点击平滑跳转，Scroll Spy 实时高亮当前可视位置。
description.en: A DSH plugin for conversation navigation: a floating button opens a dark outline drawer listing all user messages, click to jump smoothly, with Scroll Spy highlighting the current position.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端提供会话全文搜索的 DSH plugin：左侧栏一键搜遍所有会话并跳转到命中语句，对话内 Cmd+F 查找高亮。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds full-text conversation search to the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: search every session from the sidebar and jump straight to the matching line, or use Cmd+F for in-conversation find with highlights.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 增加对话快捷键，如新建对话、切换会话、开关侧边栏，提升操作效率。
description.en: Adds conversation keyboard shortcuts to DeepSeek Harness WebUI, such as new chat, session switching, and sidebar toggle.

description.zh: 为 DSH 会话双方各配一张头像、消息左右分列并给 AI 回复加气泡框，让对话像好友聊天，吸顶位置可调以避开主题状态栏。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives both sides of a conversation their own avatars, splits messages left and right, and wraps AI replies in bubbles, with an adjustable sticky offset to clear themed status bars.

description.zh: DSH 插件在会话列左侧加一条可折叠对话树栏，按工作区、主题、对话组织会话，支持搜索与模型工具读写。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a collapsible conversation tree beside the session list, organizing chats by workspace and topic with search and model tools.

description.zh: DSH plugin 对话位置导航：右侧悬浮按钮打开暗黑大纲抽屉，列出全部用户消息，点击平滑跳转，Scroll Spy 实时高亮当前可视位置。
description.en: A DSH plugin for conversation navigation: a floating button opens a dark outline drawer listing all user messages, click to jump smoothly, with Scroll Spy highlighting the current position.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Computer Use 增强的 DSH 插件：纯 JS 视觉差分、网格位置编码与五态人机共驾授权，让模型看屏、等变化并精准点击。
description.en: A DSH plugin that enhances Computer Use in DeepSeek Harness with pure-JS visual diffing, grid-based position encoding, and five-state human-in-the-loop authorization for precise screen clicking.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按行精确复制的工具插件，可把源文件指定行区间映射到目标行，自动去缩进并支持 dry_run 预览，重构大项目时省 token。
description.en: A DSH plugin that copies exact source line ranges into target lines, stripping common indentation and supporting dry_run diff previews to speed up large refactors with fewer tokens.

description.zh: dsh-convo-cost 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，实时统计当前对话的 token 用量与费用，在会话输入框下方状态行显示，悬停可查看调用次数、输入输出、模型明细等。
description.en: dsh-convo-cost is a DSH plugin that tracks token usage and cost for the current conversation in real time, displaying a status line below the composer with hover details on calls, tokens, and model.

description.zh: DSH plugin 双向桥接 MCP 生态：消费外部 MCP 服务器与 Agent Plugins 1.0 包，并将 DSH 原生工具反向暴露为标准 MCP 服务器。
description.en: A DSH plugin that bridges MCP ecosystems bidirectionally: consumes external MCP servers and Agent Plugins 1.0 packages, and exposes DSH native tools back as a standard MCP server.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 每个会话在 Chat 旁加上 Terminal 标签页，在工作区里直接开真实 shell，各终端独立保存命令历史。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a Terminal tab beside Chat in every session, giving you a real shell in the workspace with per-console command history.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 会话提供费用统计，每轮回答后显示本轮 API 花费并累计整个 Session 花费，点击可展开明细。
description.en: Per-turn and per-session API cost estimation for DeepSeek Harness web sessions, showing each turn's spend and the running session total with a click-to-expand breakdown.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话头部嵌入实时成本芯片，按桶统计 token 用量、峰谷电价与下次切换倒计时，点击可查看分模型费用明细。
description.en: A DSH plugin that embeds a live cost chip in the DeepSeek Harness conversation header, showing per-bucket token usage, peak/off-peak tariff and a switch countdown, with a per-model breakdown modal.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在输入框底部实时显示当前会话估算费用（人民币），点开可查看按缓存命中、输入、输出分项的费用明细与账号余额。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows the current session's estimated cost in CNY in the composer dock, with a receipt-style breakdown of cache hits, input and output tokens plus account balance.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供账户余额与会话用量成本显示，在输入框停靠栏按 token 用量估算费用，价格表可编辑。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows account balance and per-session usage cost in the composer dock, estimating spend from provider-reported token usage with an editable price table.

description.zh: dsh-cost-crystal 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供成本与用量监控：余额卡片、实时速率、峰谷计费与下一条消息费用预测，并自动适配时区。
description.en: dsh-cost-crystal is a DSH plugin that brings cost & usage monitoring to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI — balance card, real-time token rate, peak/off-peak billing, and next-message cost forecast, all timezone-aware.

description.zh: 在 dsh-better-display 阅读页中补上官方 COT 机器翻译的显示适配，让 DSH plugin 的思考过程译文正常呈现。
description.en: Bridges the official COT machine translation into dsh-better-display's reading view so DeepSeek Harness reasoning translations render correctly.

description.zh: dsh-cron 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 /cron 斜杠命令，支持按 cron 表达式定时触发循环 Agent 任务，可暂停、恢复并跨重启持久化。
description.en: dsh-cron adds a /cron slash command to DeepSeek Harness for cron-scheduled recurring agent loops, with pause, resume, and persistence across restarts.

description.zh: dsh-cpa 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 CPA 插件，注册 cpa provider，代理 /v1/chat/completions 并同步模型列表，支持内部/外部 CPA 与用量统计。
description.en: dsh-cpa is a DSH plugin that registers the cpa provider, proxies /v1/chat/completions, syncs model list, and supports internal/external CPA with usage stats.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在聊天中真正渲染图片、SVG 与 CSV/TSV 表格，并内置先预览后落地的预览式工作流，数据不进模型上下文。
description.en: A DSH plugin that truly renders images, SVG, and CSV/TSV tables in chat, with a preview-first workflow where data stays out of model context.

description.zh: dsh-cron-scheduler 是 DeepSeek Harness 的定时任务调度插件，支持 Linux crontab 风格表达式，可定时调用工作流或投递提示词，并具备主动任务建议确认流。
description.en: dsh-cron-scheduler is a DSH plugin for cron-based scheduling, supporting Linux crontab syntax to trigger workflows or deliver prompts, with proactive task suggestion and confirmation flow.

description.zh: 深鲸表格对比是一款 DSH plugin，按关键列比较两份 CSV，列出新增、删除与修改的行，纯本地解析不上传。
description.en: A DSH plugin that compares two CSV files by a key column and lists added, removed, and modified rows, parsing everything locally without uploads.
