description.zh: DSH 系统控制插件：在设置页一键重启/关闭 dsh web 进程，并为鲸鱼娘宠物补给小鱼干，提升 DeepSeek Harness 运维与娱乐体验。
description.en: A DSH plugin for system control: restart/shutdown the dsh web process from Settings, and top up dried fish for the whale-girl pet.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供 Ctrl/⌘ + 滚轮整页缩放，10% 步进、50%–200% 可调，右下角小芯片显示当前比例并一键回到 100%。
description.en: Adds Ctrl/⌘ + wheel page zoom to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, stepping 10% between 50% and 200%, with a bottom-right chip showing the level and resetting to 100% in one click.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供浏览器自动化能力，导航与点击、填表、提交等操作都先经 DSH 审批，并把当前屏幕截图交给用户确认后再执行。
description.en: A DSH plugin that drives a browser, gating every navigate, click, fill and submit behind a DSH approval with a screenshot the user reviews before the action runs.

description.zh: 为 DSH 内置 Cua Driver 通道补上屏幕横幅与 Esc 停止提示，让电脑控制看得见、能喊停，不参与任何桌面动作。
description.en: Adds an on-screen banner and Esc stop signal to DSH's built-in Cua Driver channel, so computer use is visible and interruptible without performing any desktop actions.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中接入 Cursor 原生 Agent Loop，复用 Cursor 的模型、工具与上下文压缩能力，同时保留 DSH 的会话、执行器与沙箱。
description.en: Brings Cursor's native Agent Loop into DeepSeek Harness, reusing Cursor models, tools and context compaction while keeping DSH sessions, executors and sandboxing.

description.zh: dsh-custom-brand 是 DeepSeek Harness 的界面插件，把侧边栏左上角的品牌图标与文字换成自定义图标和名称，改一个 JSON 文件刷新即生效。
description.en: A DSH plugin that replaces the DeepSeek Harness sidebar brand mark and wordmark with your own icon and text, configured from a single JSON file and applied on refresh.

description.zh: DSH plugin 版 CSV 数据工具箱，自动识别编码与分隔符，支持切分、去重、字段校验、清洗、合并与转 Excel，全程本地处理。
description.en: A CSV data toolbox for DeepSeek Harness that auto-detects encoding and delimiters, and handles splitting, deduplication, field validation, cleaning, merging and Excel conversion, all locally.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入自建 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型：发图先转文字描述，并提供 image_understand 工具做 OCR、界面与图表解析。
description.en: Brings your own OpenAI-compatible vision model to DeepSeek Harness: images are described before the main model sees them, plus an image_understand tool for OCR, UI and chart analysis.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Cloudflare D1 的 DSH 插件，通过 HTTP API 提供查询、建表结构、统计与健康检查等六个工具，默认只读，写操作需交互审批。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings Cloudflare D1 to the DeepSeek Harness over the HTTP API, exposing six tools for querying, schema inspection, stats and health checks — read-only by default with approval-gated writes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供结构化上下文驱逐：把长会话轨迹推断为类型化 episode 图，在超出预算时以零 LLM 的确定性策略分级清理，避免摘要压缩带来的信息丢失。
description.en: Structured context eviction for DeepSeek Harness: infers long-horizon transcripts into a typed episode graph and, once over budget, strips content with a zero-LLM deterministic policy instead of lossy summarization.

description.zh: CursorLike 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来 Cursor 式编码工作台：输入框上方待审文件卡、右侧栏 Monaco 编辑器、差异审查与 AI 补全内联编辑。
description.en: CursorLike brings a Cursor-style coding surface to DeepSeek Harness: pending-files card above the composer, a side Monaco editor, diff review, and AI completion with inline edit.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按模型附加自定义 HTTP 请求头的能力，在设置中定义命名请求头配置并为各模型选用，适配企业网关与兼容端点。
description.en: A DSH plugin that attaches per-model custom HTTP request headers: define named header profiles in Settings and pick one per model, suiting enterprise gateways and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供执行前硬拦截：危险 shell 命令与凭据文件编辑在派发前被物理拒绝，并把原因与替代做法回传给模型。
description.en: A pre-execution guard for DeepSeek Harness that physically refuses dangerous shell commands and credential edits before dispatch, handing the model the reason and a working way out.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话视图新增 Statistics 标签页，实时展示 token 用量、耗时、工具与技能活动统计。
description.en: Adds a Statistics tab to the DeepSeek Harness conversation view, showing live token usage, timing, and tool and skill activity.

description.zh: 道一-易经推演是一款 DSH plugin，把任意决策拆成 384 个检查点，经六层加权聚合输出可追溯的可行、有条件可行或不可行结论。
description.en: A DSH plugin that decomposes any decision into 384 checkpoints and aggregates them through six weighted layers to yield a traceable feasible, conditionally feasible, or infeasible verdict.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自进化记忆的 DSH plugin，通过日记、事实/关注点提取、经验生命周期与审计账本，让 Agent 在会话间持续积累并修正对用户的认知。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness agents self-evolving memory via diary, fact/concern extraction, experience lifecycle, and an audit ledger.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供数据库连接管理与 SQL 执行能力的 DSH 插件，可在对话或设置页注册 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLite、ClickHouse 数据源，浏览与标注表结构、只读校验执行 SQL 并渲染图表。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin for managing database connections and running SQL from chat or the Settings UI — register MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite or ClickHouse sources, browse and annotate schemas, run read-only-verified queries and render charts.

description.zh: DSH 数据库插件：在 Web 界面管理 MySQL、PostgreSQL、Oracle、MongoDB 等连接，让 Agent 按授权执行只读查询。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that manages MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, MongoDB and more via a web UI, letting the agent run authorized read-only queries.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供动态上下文裁剪：由模型自行把历史折叠成摘要，并自动去重重复的工具输出，缓解长会话上下文压力。
description.en: Dynamic context pruning for DeepSeek Harness: model-driven compaction of history into summaries plus automatic deduplication of repeated tool output to relieve long-session context pressure.

description.zh: DSH plugin 死链检查工具，递归扫描 Markdown 文档中的链接，HEAD 优先、GET 降级，并发受限，返回结构化死链清单。
description.en: DSH plugin to scan Markdown docs for dead links, using HEAD with GET fallback and bounded concurrency, returning structured results.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多 agent 隔离辩论工具：不同立场子 agent 独立取证、交叉辩论、评审收敛，支持后台 job、并行波次与断点续跑。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding a debate tool: isolated subagents with diverse personas research, cross-examine, and converge via judges, with background jobs, parallel waves, and resume support.

description.zh: Deep PTC mode 是 DeepSeek Harness 的开源 agent preset，沿用内置 PTC 工具面，通过可见进度、主动澄清与充分验证，让模型把无限 token 预算花在深度工作上。
description.en: Deep PTC mode is an open-source agent preset for DeepSeek Harness that keeps the built-in PTC tool surface while adding visible progress, early clarification and thorough verification, spending the unlimited token budget on depth.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 System-1 决策守卫，在每次工具调用前评估风险、可逆性、相关性与注入嫌疑，据此放行、询问或拦截，默认 shadow 模式只记录不打断。
description.en: A System-1 decision guard for DeepSeek Harness that scores each tool call for risk, reversibility, relevance and injection suspicion, then allows, asks or blocks; shadow mode only logs by default.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供深度研究能力的 DSH plugin：一次调用完成多查询检索、正文取证与交叉印证，产出带编号来源和原文摘录的可引用证据报告。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings deep research to DeepSeek Harness: one tool call runs multi-query search, source fetching and cross-verification, returning a cited evidence report with numbered sources and quoted passages.

description.zh: DeepMoYu 鲸鱼摸鱼是一款 DSH 插件，用桌宠鲸鱼娘替你逛 B站：读字幕、写日报、记 token 账本与学习记忆。
description.en: DeepMoYu is a DSH plugin whose whale-girl desktop pet browses Bilibili for you: reads subtitles, writes daily reports, and keeps token and memory ledgers.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的 composer 中显示 DeepSeek 平台各币种余额，点击即可查看充值、赠送与总额详情，无需任何配置。
description.en: Shows DeepSeek Platform balance per currency right in the DeepSeek Harness composer, with a click-open panel for topped-up, granted and total amounts — zero configuration.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边栏实时余额与每轮对话花费显示，点击可展开充值/赠送余额及 token 单价明细。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows your live DeepSeek balance in the sidebar and the cost of each conversation turn, with expandable token and pricing details.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中任意主模型补上识图能力：借助已登录的 DeepSeek 账号调用 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 转译图片，无需 API key。
description.en: Gives any main model in DeepSeek Harness image understanding by transcribing images with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash through the signed-in DeepSeek account — no API key required.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边栏实时余额与每轮对话花费显示，点击可展开充值/赠送余额及 token 单价明细。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows your live DeepSeek balance in the sidebar and the cost of each conversation turn, with expandable token and pricing details.

description.zh: DSH plugin：在DeepSeek Harness中记录每次模型调用的token用量，定时查询账户余额，并在DSH Web右下角显示可拖拽缩放的实时状态卡片。
description.en: A DSH plugin that records token usage for every model call, polls DeepSeek account balance, and shows a draggable live status card in DSH Web.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的 composer 中实时显示 DeepSeek 峰谷时段与官方价格的 DSH 插件，提供 24 小时资费条、倒计时与详情窗口。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows a live DeepSeek peak/off-peak tariff clock in the composer, with a 24-hour rate bar, countdown and official prices.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 换上 Pornhub 风格恶搞皮肤：橙黑配色、胶囊按钮、Deephub 字标与 18+ 入场门，纯玩梗无露骨内容。
description.en: A Pornhub-style parody reskin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: orange/black palette, pill buttons, a "Deephub" wordmark and an 18+ entry gate — pure meme, no explicit content.

description.zh: DSH 插件：实时监测模型思考段的复读退化，命中即截断并自动续跑，无需手动点继续。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that watches the model's reasoning stream for repetition degeneration, truncates the run on detection, and automatically continues without manual prompting.

description.zh: DSH plugin 删除守卫：拦截 agent 的 shell 删除命令，强制改走 file_trash 移入 Windows 回收站，可随时还原。
description.en: A DSH plugin that blocks agent shell delete commands and redirects them to a file_trash tool, so files go to the Windows Recycle Bin and stay restorable.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话彻底删除能力：侧边栏一键删除对话，并连带清理日志、缓存、附件与子会话等本地残留数据。
description.en: A DSH plugin that permanently deletes a conversation from the sidebar along with every local copy of its data, including session logs, projection caches, attachments and subagent sessions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧边栏会话菜单添加「删除会话」入口，支持二次点击、弹窗确认或直接删除三种模式，可彻底清除不需要的会话。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that adds a Delete session item to the sidebar session menu, with click-again, dialog, or instant confirmation modes for thoroughly removing unwanted sessions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供主控受限的 deliberation 工具与可选的推理掩码审查，运行受限子代理生成紧凑 JSON 结果，辅助主代理决策。
description.en: A DSH plugin for bounded, Primary-controlled deliberation and opt-in reasoning-masked review, running constrained subagents to produce compact JSON packets for the Primary.

description.zh: 深鲸交付验收 DSH 插件：收到交付包后按 MANIFEST.json 与 SHA256 校验文件是否完整、是否被改动，与深鲸交付包一打一验配套使用。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that verifies delivery packages against MANIFEST.json and SHA256 checksums, confirming completeness and detecting tampering as the counterpart to the packaging tool.

description.zh: DeepWorker 是 DSH 的会话工作流扩展，把轮次重试、分支、引用、笔记、摘要、查找与专注锁收拢为界面内一键动作。
description.en: DeepWorker is a DSH plugin that turns repetitive long-session chores—retry, branch, quote, notes, summaries, in-session search, and focus lock—into one-click actions in the UI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 对话产物列表增加主动展开与收起功能的 Web UI 插件，解决产物多时无法展开查看的问题。
description.en: A Web UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness that adds expand/collapse controls to the deliverables list, letting users view all generated files.

description.zh: DSH plugin 原生依赖漏洞扫描工具，读取项目锁文件调用 OSV 免费 API，输出确认漏洞及修复版本，只读分析不修改文件。
description.en: A DSH plugin that scans project lockfiles against the free OSV API, reporting confirmed dependency vulnerabilities with fix versions, read-only analysis.

description.zh: dsh-depguard 是一款 DSH plugin，装前预测、装后检测 DeepSeek Harness 依赖拓扑冲突，防止 Symbol 键崩溃，只报告不自动修复。
description.en: dsh-depguard is a DSH plugin that predicts pre-install and detects post-install dependency-topology conflicts in DeepSeek Harness to prevent Symbol-key crashes; it only reports and suggests fixes.

description.zh: 深鲸交付包 DSH plugin 把目录产出物打包成 zip、文件清单与 SHA256 校验，让交付可核对、可追溯，篡改可被发现。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that packs output folders into a zip with a file manifest and SHA256 checksums, making deliverables verifiable, traceable, and tamper-evident.

description.zh: DSH 部署助手插件，自动化 GitHub 发布、Linear 同步、npm 发布与社区公告，让对话 agent 成为部署专家。
description.en: A DSH deploy-assistant plugin that automates GitHub publishing, Linear sync, npm publish, and community announcements, turning the agent into a deployment expert.

description.zh: 深鲸工序是给设计师的 DSH 插件，把 Photoshop、AutoCAD、3ds Max 的出图交付串成一条流水线，先落盘审阅再执行，跑完用回执校验产物。
description.en: A DSH plugin for designers that turns Photoshop, AutoCAD and 3ds Max delivery work into single-run pipelines: review the plan on disk first, then execute and verify the output with a receipt.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 UI/UX 审查闭环：无头 Chrome 截图取证，按 WCAG 2.2 判据出分级问题与可粘贴 CSS 修复，并复测差值验证。
description.en: A UI/UX audit loop for DeepSeek Harness: headless Chrome capture, deterministic WCAG 2.2 checks, paste-ready CSS fixes, and re-test diff verification.

description.zh: 把 DSH Web UI 装进 Windows 原生窗口的桌面壳插件，自动拉起并复用 dsh web 服务，单实例防重复弹窗，关窗只停自有实例。
description.en: A Windows desktop shell DSH plugin that wraps the DSH Web UI in a native WebView2 window, auto-starting and reusing the dsh web backend with single-instance safety.

description.zh: 小南梁是 DeepSeek Harness 的鲸鱼娘代码娘，提供国内落地 know-how 与技能包，附带 Tauri 桌面壳参考实现，助你快速封装 DSH 桌面应用。
description.en: Xiao Nanliang is the whale-girl coder for DeepSeek Harness, offering China-deployment know-how and a skill pack with a Tauri desktop shell reference, helping you quickly wrap DSH into a desktop app.

description.zh: 把 DSH Web UI 装进 Windows 原生窗口的桌面壳插件，自动拉起并复用 dsh web 服务，单实例防重复弹窗，关窗只停自有实例。
description.en: A Windows desktop shell DSH plugin that wraps the DSH Web UI in a native WebView2 window, auto-starting and reusing the dsh web backend with single-instance safety.

description.zh: 为 DSH 会话架起桌面操作桥：把截屏、点击、输入等 GUI 任务交给 dsh-orb 执行，并以任务租约、FIFO 排队与随停止中断保证同一时刻只有一人操作桌面。
description.en: A desktop bridge for DSH sessions that hands screenshot, click and typing tasks to dsh-orb, with task leases, FIFO queuing and stop-on-interrupt so only one session drives the desktop at a time.

description.zh: 在 DSH Desktop 侧边栏内嵌官方 DeepSeek Chat 网页，登录一次后重启仍保持会话，无需重写聊天界面。
description.en: Embeds the official DeepSeek Chat web app in a DSH Desktop sidebar panel, keeping your session alive across restarts without reimplementing chat.

description.zh: DSH 桌面通知插件：当所有前端失焦时，把决策、授权、中断与完成事件推送到 Windows 通知中心，点击通知即可切回对应会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pushes decision, approval, interruption and completion events to the Windows notification center whenever every frontend loses focus, and clicking a toast jumps back to the matching session.

description.zh: 一只住在 DeepSeek Harness 网页里的养成系桌宠，随编码活动升级进化、语音打气，还能用 AI 生成专属透明动画形象。
description.en: A desktop pet living in the DeepSeek Harness web UI that levels up with your coding activity, cheers you on with voice, and lets you generate a custom transparent animated avatar with AI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生 desktop 工具，让模型在 Windows 上截图、移动点击鼠标、输入文本与快捷键，实现桌面自动化操作。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives the model a native desktop tool to screenshot Windows, move and click the mouse, and type text or key combos for desktop automation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供系统原生桌面通知的 DSH plugin：任务被打断（等待审批、回答或确认计划）或完成时弹出提示，无需一直盯窗口。
description.en: A DSH plugin that sends native desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness when a task is interrupted (awaiting approval, answer, or plan confirmation) or completes, so you don't have to watch the window.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端补上 F11 全屏切换与终端内 Ctrl+C/V 复制粘贴，两个开关独立可控，不改动 DSH 本体。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds an F11 fullscreen toggle and Ctrl+C/V copy-paste inside the built-in terminal, each with its own switch and no changes to DSH itself.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用侧边栏底部添加「刷新界面」与「重启应用」两个按钮，弥补官方外壳缺失的重载与重启入口。
description.en: Adds Reload UI and Restart App buttons to the DeepSeek Harness desktop app sidebar foot, filling the shell's missing reload and relaunch entry points.

description.zh: 这款 DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端记住主窗口的尺寸、位置与最大化状态，并在窗口首次绘制前恢复，避免回到默认大小。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness Desktop that remembers the main window's size, position and maximized state and restores them before the first frame is painted.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供桌面模式，把每个会话变成可拖动、可缩放的窗口，并配有任务栏，方便同时查看多个会话。
description.en: Desktop mode for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI that turns each session into a movable, resizable window with a taskbar, so you can keep several sessions on screen at once.

description.zh: DSH plugin 按职责将工作分派给绑定不同模型的子代理，需求评审交给强模型，批量实现交给低成本模型，全程在同一会话内完成。
description.en: A DSH plugin that delegates work to subagents bound to different models, routing review to strong models and bulk implementation to low-cost models, all within one session.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 一次装上 46 个离线确定性工具，覆盖 JSON/YAML/CSV 等格式校验与 JVM、Python、Windows 生产诊断，纯本地无网络。
description.en: Installs 46 offline deterministic tools into DeepSeek Harness in one command, covering JSON/YAML/CSV format checks plus JVM, Python and Windows production diagnostics — fully local, no network.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册 29 个确定性、离线、有界的 JSON/YAML/CSV、文本、编码与检查工具，每次调用返回字节回执，避免模型手写脚本出错。
description.en: Registers 29 deterministic, offline, bounded JSON/YAML/CSV, text, encoding and inspection tools for DeepSeek Harness, each returning a byte receipt so agents never hand-roll fragile scripts.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供桌面提醒：当你切走页面时，任务完成或等待审批会通过系统通知栏提醒，点击即可切回对应会话。
description.en: A desktop notifier for DeepSeek Harness Web: when you switch away, task completion or pending approval triggers a system notification, and clicking it returns you to that session.

description.zh: 把开发工作流规范打包成 DSH plugin：按需加载的技能规范、提交信息与文档同步检查工具，以及提交、建 PR、打标签前的守卫与审批。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that packages a coding-agent development workflow: an on-demand spec skill, commit-message and doc-sync check tools, plus guards and approvals before commits, PRs and tags.

description.zh: DevDock 是 DeepSeek Harness 的研发账号管理套件，首个模块把 GitHub 多账号切换、仓库管理、工作区提交推送与推送前 Agent 审查收进同一面板。
description.en: DevDock is a developer account and service suite for DeepSeek Harness; its first module brings GitHub multi-account switching, repo management, workspace push and pre-push agent review into one panel.

description.zh: 把开发工作流规范打包成 DSH plugin：按需加载的技能规范、提交信息与文档同步检查工具，以及提交、建 PR、打标签前的守卫与审批。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that packages a coding-agent development workflow: an on-demand spec skill, commit-message and doc-sync check tools, plus guards and approvals before commits, PRs and tags.

description.zh: dsh-devlaunch 是 DeepSeek Harness 的一键启动开发环境插件，可同时启动前后端服务、集中查看控制台输出、自动检测就绪状态与端口冲突，并支持崩溃自动重启，让 AI 不再浪费 token 在启动项目上。
description.en: dsh-devlaunch is a DSH plugin that launches development environments with one click, starting frontend/backend services, centralizing console output, detecting readiness and port conflicts, and auto-restarting on crash, saving AI tokens.

description.zh: DSH plugin 用自然语言指令精准压缩对话上下文，支持保留关键内容、删除指定片段，适配超长上下文模型。
description.en: A DSH plugin that compacts conversation context via natural-language directives, precisely keeping or trimming content for large-context models.

description.zh: dsh-dlp 是 DeepSeek Harness 的数据防泄漏插件，阻止 Agent 读取凭据文件、向工具调用泄露密钥，并脱敏工具结果与遥测数据。
description.en: dsh-dlp is a data-loss prevention plugin for DeepSeek Harness that blocks credential-file reads, redacts secrets from tool calls, results, and telemetry.

description.zh: 这款 DSH plugin 在聊天输入框旁加润色按钮与角色模板下拉，结合当前目录与真实对话改写草稿。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a Polish button and role-template dropdown beside the chat input, rewriting drafts with the session directory and real turns in view.

description.zh: 忆匣（Casket）是 DSH plugin，实时快照整个 DSH_HOME 并支持一键回滚，内容寻址去重，DSH 起不来也能恢复。
description.en: Casket is a DSH plugin that snapshots your entire DSH_HOME in real time with one-click rollback, content-addressed dedup, and recovery even when DSH won't start.

description.zh: 深鲸文档结构是一款 DSH plugin，用于检查 Markdown 文档的标题层级跳跃、重复标题、空标题与无结构问题，并在侧栏面板中只提示、不改动文件。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that audits Markdown documents for heading-level jumps, duplicate or empty headings, and unstructured content, surfacing issues in a sidebar panel without modifying files.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通过声明式影响图将代码变更与文档关联，在 Agent 回合结束时自动提醒或强制更新受影响的文档，确保文档与代码同步。
description.en: A DSH plugin that links code changes to affected documentation via a declarative impact graph, steering agents to review or update docs before turn close.

description.zh: 深鲸文档质检 DSH plugin 在交付前自动排查占位符残留、重复段落、超长段落、半角标点与编号断档，纯本地运行不上传。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that scans documents before delivery for leftover placeholders, duplicate or overly long paragraphs, half-width punctuation, and broken numbering, running fully locally.

description.zh: 深鲸文档批量处理是一个 DSH plugin，在侧栏面板中一次处理整目录的 Word、Excel、PDF 文件，支持替换、提取、合并、拆分与导出，全部在本机完成。
description.en: A DSH plugin that batch-processes whole folders of Word, Excel and PDF files from a sidebar panel — replace, extract, merge, split and export, all locally.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 回复加上原地批注、文档式阅读与评论线程，让 Agent 直接修订正文并带回阅读摘要。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets you annotate DeepSeek Harness replies inline, read them as documents with comment threads, and have the agent revise the text directly.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 PDF、DOCX、XLSX、PPTX 及扫描件读取工具，按页、按表返回文本，并支持本地 OCR。
description.en: Agent tools for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that read PDF, DOCX, XLSX and PPTX files with page- and sheet-aware text, plus fully local OCR for scans.

description.zh: DSH Doctor for Windows 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 启动诊断插件，只读检查命令解析、Node 版本、DSH_HOME 可达性等，生成脱敏报告，无遥测。
description.en: DSH Doctor for Windows is a read-only Windows startup diagnostic for DeepSeek Harness, checking command resolution, Node version, DSH_HOME reachability, etc., producing sanitized reports without telemetry.

description.zh: DSH plugin 批量处理整目录 Word 文档：替换文本、提取正文、合并、列页眉页脚、转 Markdown，只读输入不覆盖原文件。
description.en: A DSH plugin that batch-processes whole folders of Word documents: replace text, extract content, merge, list headers/footers, and convert to Markdown, reading inputs without overwriting originals.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生 PDF 资料库：项目文档一次索引、会话内按需检索，回答自动附可点击引用并跳回原页高亮，让 PDF 问答有据可查。
description.en: A native PDF library for DeepSeek Harness: index project documents once, retrieve bounded evidence per session, and get answers with clickable citations that jump back to highlighted source pages.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 DOCX 结构检查与逐字节无改动往返校验的 DSH plugin，可输出段落、表格等部件哈希与结构统计。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that inspects DOCX structure and performs byte-for-byte no-change roundtrip verification, reporting part hashes and structure counts.

description.zh: DSH Domain Proxy 是 DeepSeek Harness 的域名路由与可观测插件，可将指定模型 API 域名转发到本地 HTTP 代理，并实时查看调用路径、首字延迟与流式速度。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that routes selected model API domains through a local HTTP proxy and provides real-time visibility into dispatch paths, TTFT, and streaming throughput.

description.zh: Dolphin 是 DSH 主动安全巡检插件，基于 SSH 与 Semgrep 对本地及远程主机做漏洞扫描、健康检查与报告存档。
description.en: Dolphin is a proactive security patrol plugin for DeepSeek Harness that uses SSH and Semgrep to scan local and remote hosts, run health checks, and archive findings.

description.zh: dsh-done 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件，在 Agent 完成任务时播放庆祝弹窗（彩带+音效），自动消失，为枯燥任务增添趣味。
description.en: dsh-done is a DSH plugin that shows a celebratory popup with confetti and fanfare when an agent completes a task, then auto-dismisses.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 右侧边栏新增草稿标签页，方便随手撰写并保存提示词草稿，草稿持久化到本地存储文件。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a right-sidebar tab in DeepSeek Harness for drafting prompts, with drafts persisted to a local storage file.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接运行 Claude Code 项目的 .claude/ 资产：解析项目斜杠命令并展开参数，同时按 permissions.deny 拦截宿主工具调用。
description.en: Run a Claude Code project's .claude/ assets inside DeepSeek Harness: resolve project slash commands with argument expansion and enforce permissions.deny rules against host tools.

description.zh: DROS™ VajraClaw 是 DSH 的本地工具调用熔断插件，在执行前拦截高危 shell 模式与凭据文件读取，并写入哈希链式 JSONL 审计日志。
description.en: DROS™ VajraClaw is a local tool-call failsafe for DSH that blocks high-risk shell patterns and credential-file reads before execution, backed by a hash-linked JSONL audit log.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供实时任务看板：侧边栏徽标提示待处理任务，全屏看板支持搜索、筛选、导出与诊断。
description.en: A live task board for DeepSeek Harness Web: a sidebar badge surfaces pending work, and a full-shell kanban adds search, filters, export, and diagnostics.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Ponytail 极简编码技能族，注册六个按需加载技能，引导复用现有代码与标准库，用最小改动完成任务并审查冗余复杂度。
description.en: A DSH plugin that bundles the Ponytail skill family for DeepSeek Harness, registering six load-on-request skills that push minimal, behavior-preserving coding changes and review removable complexity.

description.zh: DSH plugin 专治 DSML 标记泄漏：从正文与历史中抹掉残留标记，并在超时、断联或空响应导致这一轮无产出时自动补发「继续」。
description.en: A DSH plugin that strips leaked DSML markers from assistant prose and saved history, and auto-continues turns that truly produced nothing after timeouts, disconnects or empty responses.

description.zh: dsh-draft 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Markdown 草稿板插件，在右侧边栏新增 Draft 标签页，支持边写边预览与本地自动保存，随手记录不怕丢失。
description.en: dsh-draft is a Markdown draft-board DSH plugin that adds a Draft tab to the right sidebar, with live-preview editing and autosave to a local file so quick notes are never lost.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 DSML 工具调用标记泄漏进推理、导致回合空转时自动续跑，替你补上那句「继续」。
description.en: A DSH plugin that auto-continues stalled turns when DSML tool-call markup leaks into reasoning, so you don't have to type "continue".

description.zh: DSH 侧边栏插件，把项目上下文打包成结构化 prompt 并复制到剪贴板，同屏打开 DeepSeek 网页版免费提问，改码仍走 Harness API。
description.en: A DSH sidebar plugin that packs project context into a structured prompt, copies it to the clipboard, and opens DeepSeek's web app side by side for free Q&A while code changes stay on the Harness API.

description.zh: 把本地 ComfyUI 接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 DSH 插件，提供五个 draw_* 绘图工具、工作流库、分族提示词方言与侧栏面板。
description.en: A DSH plugin that bridges a local ComfyUI server into DeepSeek Harness, adding five draw_* tools, a workflow library, per-family prompt dialects and a sidebar panel.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供带门禁的缺陷修复流水线：从失败信号定位、评估影响面、红绿验证到生成可评审 PR，每步都有证据台账。
description.en: A gated bug-fix pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: localize from the failure signal, map blast radius, prove red then green, and ship a reviewed PR with every claim backed by ledger evidence.

description.zh: DSH plugin 双格式开发指南：教 Agent 从单一目录构建同时兼容 DSH 静态插件包与 Agent Plugins 1.0 的插件，并附脚手架生成器。
description.en: A DSH plugin guide for building dual-format plugins compatible with both DSH static packages and Agent Plugins 1.0 from one directory, with a scaffold generator.

description.zh: 一款 Live2D 桌宠 DSH plugin，透明置顶陪伴工作，随会话表情口型联动并语音朗读回答。
description.en: A Live2D desktop-pet DSH plugin that stays on top while you work, reacting with expressions and lip-sync and reading replies aloud.

description.zh: D友の酒为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面加上 120 BPM 律动与满屏飞行的鲸鱼娘玩偶，碰墙反弹，还能配 BGM。
description.en: Dyou Wine adds a 120 BPM interface bounce and a wall-bouncing whale-girl plushie flying across the DeepSeek Harness web UI, with optional BGM.

description.zh: DSH 插件：双击侧边栏按钮整体重启 DeepSeek Harness，归档会话前先确认并倒计时保护，归档后自动备份，右侧栏可浏览已归档会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that restarts DeepSeek Harness with a double-click sidebar button, guards session archiving with confirmation and countdown, auto-backs up archived sessions, and browses them in a sidebar tree.

description.zh: 为 DSH 聊天回复提供 15 套视觉风格与 9 套排版方案，可调 emoji 与表情包，并保护长回复性能。
description.en: A DSH plugin that restyles chat replies with 15 visual themes and 9 layout presets, plus emoji and sticker controls and long-reply performance guards.

description.zh: 把本机生态雷达快照做成 DSH plugin 侧栏面板，一屏查看近 7 天新增插件、行业供给密度与每日增量报告。
description.en: Turns local ecosystem radar snapshots into a DSH plugin sidebar panel showing 7-day new plugins, supply density gaps, and daily delta reports.

description.zh: 把 ego-webqa 的确定性网页交付审计封装为 DSH 原生 MCP 工具，模型可直接调用 audit_web_page 跨移动端矩阵检查页面并留存截图与报告证据。
description.en: A DSH plugin that exposes ego-webqa's deterministic web-delivery audit as a native MCP tool, letting the model call audit_web_page across a mobile matrix and keep screenshots and reports as evidence.

description.zh: DSH 插件：在输入框内嵌推理强度滑杆，拖动鲸鱼娘选择思考档位，支持自动区间升级与按任务类型路由模型。
description.en: A DSH plugin that puts a reasoning-effort slider in the input box: drag the whale-girl to pick a thinking tier, with auto-band escalation and task-based model routing.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地 OFD/XML 电子发票的入库、解析、查重与归档工具，全程离线、不联网。
description.en: A DSH plugin that ingests, parses, deduplicates and archives local Chinese OFD/XML e-invoices, fully offline with no network calls.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面加入《艾尔登法环》风格事件浮层，上下文将满、记忆压缩、任务完成或等待审批时，屏幕划过暗色横条并浮现提示文字。
description.en: Adds Elden Ring style event overlays to the DeepSeek Harness web UI: a dark bar crosses the screen with fading text when the context fills, memory is compacted, a turn finishes, or an approval awaits.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 计费插件，实时展示当前会话成本与官方余额，按官方峰谷价自动计费并每分钟对齐余额。
description.en: A billing plugin for DeepSeek Harness that shows real-time session cost and official balance, auto-billing per peak/idle pricing and syncing balance every minute.

description.zh: dsh-element-inspector 是一款 DSH plugin，用于识别页面元素归属、导出所选元素并隐藏不需要的界面元素，帮助开发者调试与定制界面。
description.en: dsh-element-inspector is a DSH plugin that identifies element ownership, exports selections, and hides unwanted UI elements, aiding developers in debugging and customizing the interface.

description.zh: DSH plugin 余额小钱包：在会话顶栏一键显示 DeepSeek API 余额，密钥仅存于主机，无需配置。
description.en: A minimal DSH plugin wallet that shows your DeepSeek API balance in the session header with one click; the key never leaves the host.

description.zh: 为 Engramory markdown 记忆库提供本地 BM25 自动召回、fail-closed 写入闸门与记忆面板的 DSH plugin，零网络零常驻进程，默认不调用模型。
description.en: A DSH plugin for Engramory markdown memory stores: local BM25 auto-recall, fail-closed write guard, static doctor and a memory panel — no network, no daemon, no model calls by default.

description.zh: DSH 插件「入口编排」：拖拽排序左侧栏插件条目与会话顶部标签，并可在两区之间搬移，顺序本机持久化。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets you drag-reorder sidebar panel entries and conversation tabs, move entries between the two areas, and keeps the layout saved locally.

description.zh: DSH plugin 恢复 run_code（PTC/Code Mode）结果卡片中读写工具信封的语法高亮，以原生 ReadBlock 呈现。
description.en: A DSH plugin that restores syntax highlighting for read/write tool envelopes inside run_code (PTC/Code Mode) result cards, rendering them as native ReadBlock.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版中查看与编辑环境变量、.env 文件及密钥，支持 Windows 用户级与系统级变量，并提供搜索、复制、新建与删除等操作。
description.en: View and edit environment variables, .env files and secrets inside the DeepSeek Harness desktop app, covering Windows user-level and system-level variables with search, copy, create and delete actions.

description.zh: DSH 升级顾问插件，平时用便宜模型跑任务，遇到卡点或需要复核时自动调用更强的 DeepSeek Harness 模型给出第二意见，咨询过程以可见子会话呈现。
description.en: A DSH escalation advisor plugin that runs cheaper models by default and consults a stronger DeepSeek Harness model only when a second opinion helps, with each consultation shown as a visible child session.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 git 与包管理器两类结构化工程工具，让 Agent 直接调用 git 子命令和 npm/pnpm/yarn/bun 脚本，返回规整结果，比裸 bash 更聚焦安全。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that exposes structured git and package-manager (npm/pnpm/yarn/bun) tools, letting the agent run engineering commands with clean, sandboxed output instead of raw bash.

description.zh: DSH 事件流审计面板插件，监听并展示 harness 事件类型、分发模式与计数，帮助插件作者理解 DeepSeek Harness 内部运行机制。
description.en: An event-stream auditor panel for DeepSeek Harness, observing event types, dispatch patterns, and counts to help plugin authors understand harness internals.

description.zh: dsh-preclaim 是 DeepSeek Harness 的确定性预声明校验插件，在 git commit、push 或 tag 前比对声明内容与会话实际运行记录，不一致即拦截。
description.en: A deterministic pre-claim gate for DeepSeek Harness that checks git commit, push or tag claims against what the session actually ran, and blocks the action when the two disagree.

description.zh: 本地优先的 DeepSeek Harness 自我进化插件：把开发会话记进本地账本，用你已配好的模型跨会话复盘，把重复踩的坑沉淀成本地知识并注入下次会话。
description.en: A local-first self-evolution DSH plugin that logs your coding sessions to a local ledger, reviews them across sessions with your own configured model, and turns repeated pitfalls into local knowledge injected into future sessions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供西班牙语（es）语言包，注册 29 个命名空间、718 条字符串，并在语言选择器中添加 Español 选项，且为可选启用，不强制改变用户语言。
description.en: Provides Spanish (es) locale for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, registering 718 strings across 29 namespaces and adding Español to the language selector, opt-in without forcing language changes.

description.zh: DSH Evolution Lab 是 DeepSeek Harness 的技能自我进化插件，将项目经验转化为隔离的 SKILL.md 候选，自动评估并安全晋升或回滚，无需人工审批。
description.en: DSH Evolution Lab is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for self-evolving skills, turning project experience into quarantined SKILL.md candidates, evaluating and atomically promoting or rolling back without manual approval.

description.zh: DSH Evolver 是 DeepSeek Harness 的自进化插件，把执行失败归纳为可审计的策略提案，经校验与人工确认后才注入后续会话。
description.en: DSH Evolver is a DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that turns execution failures into auditable strategy proposals, injected into later sessions only after verification and human approval.

description.zh: dsh-excel-kit 是 DeepSeek Harness 的只读 Excel 分析工具包，流式读取超大 xlsx 文件，提供 describe、filter、pivot 等分析能力，内存占用低。
description.en: dsh-excel-kit is a read-only Excel analysis toolkit for DeepSeek Harness, streaming large xlsx files with describe, filter, and pivot tools, keeping memory usage low.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 headless runner 提供一次性 exec 扩展，支持更多 CLI 标志、文件附加、JSON 输出、沙箱与权限控制，让无头执行更灵活。
description.en: A DSH plugin extending headless runner with one-shot exec, adding more CLI flags, file attachment, JSON output, sandbox and permission control for flexible headless runs.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为自定义 API 模型注入推理等级，并提供 CLI 请求模拟、消息时间轴、自动加载历史等多项日用优化功能，统一在设置页配置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects reasoning levels into custom API models, plus daily-use optimizations like CLI request mimicry, message timeline, and auto-load history, all configured in settings.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Linux 桌面 computer-use 能力，通过 MCP 子进程注入截图、窗口控制与输入等 18 个工具。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings Linux desktop computer-use to DeepSeek Harness, spawning an MCP subprocess that exposes 18 screenshot, window-control and input tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供 VS Code 风格的文件管理器，侧边栏浏览工作区文件，中间列用 Monaco 编辑器编辑，支持主题、Markdown 预览与编码识别。
description.en: A VS Code-style file manager for DeepSeek Harness Web: browse workspace files in the sidebar, edit in the center with Monaco, featuring themes, Markdown preview, and encoding detection.

description.zh: DSH 专家中心插件，把 WorkBuddy 专家与自建专家收进统一专家库，支持 AI 创建导入、详情即编辑、技能管理与会话内一键切换。
description.en: A DSH plugin that unifies WorkBuddy and custom experts into one library, with AI-assisted creation and import, in-place editing, skill management, and one-click switching per session.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 加上「角色与团队」两个协作维度：召唤领域专家身份干活，或拉起多 Agent 专家团按流程拆解派工交付。
description.en: Adds two collaboration dimensions to DeepSeek Harness: summon a domain expert persona to work under a tool whitelist, or spin up a multi-agent expert team that decomposes tasks and delivers.

description.zh: dsh-explainer 是 DeepSeek Harness 的划词快问插件：选中对话或文件中的文字，右键或快捷键就地提问，流式作答并沿用主窗口模型与只读上下文。
description.en: A quick-ask DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness: select text in the chat or sidebar files, then right-click or use a shortcut to ask in place, with streamed answers that follow the main window model and a read-only context snapshot.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Markdown 文档健康与导航能力：链接改写、路径上下文注入与知识库路由视图，并以可组合的 gate 与 prompt 中间件框架统一注册。
description.en: A DSH plugin suite for Markdown docs health and navigation: link rewriting, per-path context injection and routing views over knowledge bases, built on composable gate and prompt-middleware frameworks.

description.zh: DSH插件，在会话中即时解释Windows沙箱spawn EPERM失败，以双语警告行呈现，不修改会话日志。
description.en: A DSH plugin that explains Windows sandbox spawn EPERM failures in context with a bilingual warning row, without altering session logs.

description.zh: 让 DSH 的 web_fetch 在 fake-IP DNS + TUN 环境下正常抓取网页，同时保留内置 SSRF 防护，仅接受合成地址段解析结果。
description.en: Lets DeepSeek Harness web_fetch work behind fake-IP DNS + TUN setups while keeping the built-in SSRF guard intact, accepting only synthetic-range DNS answers.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 fal.ai 原生生图能力，提供 FAL_KEY 设置卡片与 fal_generate_image、fal_edit_image 等 Agent 工具，支持异步任务查询与结果落盘复用。
description.en: Native fal.ai image generation for DeepSeek Harness: a FAL_KEY settings card plus agent tools (fal_generate_image, fal_edit_image) with async task polling and reusable on-disk results.

description.zh: 为 DSH 对话实时打表：按官方三档 token 价与峰谷时段计价，并统计 Search/Fetch 按次费用，在每轮、会话与工作区三处显示人民币金额。
description.en: A fare meter for DSH chats: prices tokens by official tiers with peak/off-peak rates and bills Search/Fetch per request, showing CNY totals per turn, session and workspace.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供后台上下文压缩的 DSH plugin：提前生成摘要，减少长对话等待，并可查看压缩历史、耗时与用量。
description.en: A DSH plugin that compresses context in the background for DeepSeek Harness: it prepares summaries ahead of time to cut long-conversation waits, with compaction history, latency and usage records.

description.zh: 为 DSH plugin 提供本机 HTTP 抓取能力，在 TUN Fake-IP 环境下按配置网段绕过 WebFetch 的 SSRF 拦截，让被代理的网页正常访问。
description.en: A DSH plugin that enables local HTTP fetching and selectively bypasses WebFetch SSRF blocking for configured Fake-IP ranges under TUN, so proxied pages load normally.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 右侧边栏提供低延迟终端：专用 PTY WebSocket 直连，会话常驻、支持复制粘贴与中英双语。
description.en: A low-latency terminal for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar, streaming PTY output over a dedicated WebSocket with persistent sessions, copy/paste, and zh/en UI.

description.zh: dsh-feed 是 DeepSeek Harness 的开放数据层，将 GitHub 与 npm 的 dsh 插件聚合为统一 JSON 索引，供模型工具、CLI 与 MCP 查询。
description.en: dsh-feed is an open data layer for DeepSeek Harness, aggregating dsh plugins from GitHub and npm into a unified JSON index, queryable via model tools, CLI, and MCP.

description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，复用已登录的 Playwright/Chrome 会话，把本人抖音与小红书收藏导出为 Markdown 与 JSON，支持按主题分组并可选 LLM 综述。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that reuses your logged-in Playwright/Chrome session to export your own Douyin and Xiaohongshu favorites into Markdown and JSON, with topic grouping and an optional LLM digest.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的会话状态反馈插件，切走标签页时用 Favicon 变色与音效提示任务完成、运行中或需人工介入。
description.en: A session status feedback DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that recolors the favicon and plays sounds when a task finishes, is running, or needs your input.

description.zh: 把飞书私聊机器人变成你的 DSH 助理：配对码绑管理员、审批卡放行、请求串行排队，回答以 Markdown 卡片回到飞书，无需公网入口。
description.en: Turns a Feishu private-chat bot into your DSH assistant: pair-code admin binding, approval cards, serial request queueing, and Markdown card replies back in Feishu with no public endpoint needed.

description.zh: 把 DSH 会话中的提问与选项推送到飞书私聊，你在手机上回复的原文会回填原会话继续执行，并带重复发送抑制。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pushes session questions to your Feishu private chat and feeds your reply back into the original session, with duplicate-send suppression.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让 DeepSeek Harness 通过飞书或 Lark 机器人对话，基于 WebSocket 长连接，无需公网 URL，每个聊天对应独立 Agent 会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets DeepSeek Harness talk via Feishu/Lark bot over WebSocket long connection, no public URL needed, one agent per chat.

description.zh: DSH plugin 飞书机器人桥接，实现与 DSH agent 双向聊天，支持设置页配置凭证与工作区路由。
description.en: Feishu bot bridge for DeepSeek Harness: two-way chat with your agent, settings page for bot credentials and workspace routing.

description.zh: 把飞书/Lark 官方 OpenAPI MCP 服务器接入 DeepSeek Harness，让 DSH 智能体以 mcp__feishu__* 工具收发消息、读写多维表格与文档，并在设置面板配置凭证。
description.en: Connects the official Feishu/Lark OpenAPI MCP server to DeepSeek Harness, exposing its tools as mcp__feishu__* so the DSH agent can send messages and work with Bitable, docs and drive, configured via a settings panel.

description.zh: DSH plugin，让你在飞书/Lark上通过私信远程控制DeepSeek Harness agent：发送任务、接收结果、推送通知，支持图像理解和生成，闭环运行。
description.en: A DSH plugin to control your DeepSeek Harness agent from Feishu/Lark via DM: send tasks, get results, push notifications, with image understanding and generation round-trip.

description.zh: dsh-fff 是 DSH plugin，提供模糊文件查找与内容搜索，移植自 pi-fff，支持多 token 路径匹配、相关文件解析和 ripgrep 搜索。
description.en: dsh-fff is a DSH plugin offering fuzzy file finding and content search, ported from pi-fff, with multi-token path matching, related file resolution, and ripgrep search.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中开立 A 股与商品期货模拟账户，本地账本记录交易，内置 FTShare 行情与 K 线，无需 API Key 也能用日 K 收盘价练习下单与复盘。
description.en: Open simulated A-share and commodity futures accounts inside DeepSeek Harness, with a local ledger, built-in FTShare quotes and K-line charts, and daily-close pricing practice that works without an API key.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为文件写入操作提供手动审查确认，弹窗展示 diff 红绿预览，允许或拒绝后模型可调整。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds manual confirmation for file write operations, showing diff previews before allowing or rejecting.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web GUI 文件页补上右键菜单、行内大小与日期、多选删除，并附带文件驱动的斜杠命令与输入框历史回填。
description.en: Adds right-click menus, inline size and date metadata, multi-select deletion to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI file page, plus file-driven slash commands and input-box history recall.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为输入框添加 Codex 式 @ 文件/文件夹引用，支持菜单选择、token 着色与点击预览，让模型零搜索直达文件。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding Codex-style @ file/folder mentions with menu pick, token coloring, and click-to-preview, letting the model reach files directly.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将回复中的文件路径变为可点击链接，支持预览与在资源管理器中显示，专为 Windows 优化。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns file paths in replies into clickable links with preview and reveal-in-explorer, Windows-first.

description.zh: 深鲸文件整理是 DSH plugin，按类型或年月归档散文件、查找重复文件并清空目录，默认只预览不动文件。
description.en: A DSH plugin that archives loose files by type or year-month, finds duplicates, and cleans directories, previewing by default without touching files.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让 Web composer 支持拖入 PDF、压缩包、Office 文档等非图片文件，以绝对路径引用，无需上传附件。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets the Web composer accept non-image files and folders as workspace path references instead of attachments.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供只读文件预览：点击对话中生成或提及的文件即在浏览器弹窗中打开，支持文本、Markdown、图片与 PDF，无需启动桌面应用。
description.en: Read-only file preview for DeepSeek Harness conversations: click a file the agent produced or mentioned and it opens in a sanitized browser modal instead of a desktop app, covering text, Markdown, images and PDF.

description.zh: 深鲸批量改名是一款 DSH plugin，按替换、前缀、后缀、编号规则批量重命名文件，默认先预览、不覆盖已有文件。
description.en: A DSH plugin for batch renaming files by replace, prefix, suffix, or numbering rules, previewing changes first and never overwriting existing files.

description.zh: FileKit 是 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区文件插件，接管右侧文件面板，提供右键菜单、拖拽移动、编辑、回收站与 Agent 变更提醒。
description.en: FileKit is a DSH plugin that upgrades the right-sidebar workspace files panel with context menus, drag-to-move, an editor, recoverable trash, and Agent change notices.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web composer 添加本地文件上传按钮，支持多选、粘贴文件，自动存入工作区 .dsh-uploads/ 目录并生成 @ 引用，全程本地传输。
description.en: Adds a local-file upload button to the DeepSeek Harness Web composer, supporting multi-select and paste, storing files in .dsh-uploads/ with @ references, all over local loopback.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页面板新增「文件」视图标签，两栏目录导航并就地阅读主机文件，点击会话中的文件引用即可在页内打开，无需依赖桌面程序。
description.en: Adds a Files tab to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: two-column directory navigation with in-place file reading, so clicking a file reference in a session opens it right in the page instead of a desktop opener.

description.zh: DSH 右侧栏金融终端插件，一屏看 48 个标的行情、3D 地球与风险偏好读数，并通过 finance_panel 工具与 Agent 双向联动。
description.en: A DSH right-sidebar finance terminal plugin: 48 cross-asset quotes, a 3D globe, a risk-appetite gauge, and two-way state sync with the agent via the finance_panel tool.

description.zh: DSH plugin 财务分析插件，提供财报分析师预设与五项技能，从公开源获取财报并分析三大报表及钩稽关系。
description.en: A DSH plugin that provides a financial-analyst preset and five skills to fetch financial reports from public sources and analyze the three statements and their articulation.

description.zh: 流萤桌宠是 DSH plugin，在桌面开透明置顶小窗，能聊天、碎碎念并播报任务进度。
description.en: A Firefly desktop pet DSH plugin that opens a transparent always-on-top window to chat, chatter, and narrate task progress.

description.zh: DSH plugin 改前改后比对器：对两份代码快照跑同一套守护规则，按规则 ID 与文件路径列出已修复、遗留与新增回归，并给出 CI 退出码。
description.en: A DSH plugin that re-runs the same guard rules over before/after snapshots and reports fixed, remaining, and newly regressed findings by rule ID and file path, with CI-friendly exit codes.

description.zh: DSH 插件：会话因附件对象丢失而每轮报 DeepSeek Messages transport failed 时，自动把读不出的图片降级为占位文本并重试，让会话继续可用，另附离线 CLI 体检修复。
description.en: A DSH plugin that heals sessions stuck on DeepSeek Messages transport failed: it downgrades unreadable image attachments to placeholder text and retries the turn, plus an offline CLI for scanning and repairing sessions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供安全的 Firebird 数据库连接器，支持命名连接、只读/读写/管理权限模式、参数绑定、对象白名单、写操作确认与 JSONL 审计日志。
description.en: A safe Firebird connector for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) with named connections, readonly/readwrite/admin access modes, parameter binding, object whitelists, confirmation gates and JSONL audit logs.

description.zh: DSH 网页端的快捷控制面板核心插件，提供可扩展开关注册表、皮肤系统与中英双语，其他插件可注册自己的控件。
description.en: Core quick-control panel for the DSH web UI, offering an extensible switch registry, skin system and zh/en i18n that other plugins can register their own controls into.

description.zh: 为角色聊天打造的 DSH 插件式长期记忆层，分层保存人格、声音、关系与原文，检索优先、不依赖向量库，让角色压缩后仍保留语气。
description.en: A DSH plugin long-term memory layer for character chat that stores persona, voice, relationships and raw text separately, retrieval-first with local JSON and no vector DB, so characters keep their flavor after compression.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 固定新会话的默认 Agent 预设与模型，支持全局默认与工作区独立配置，提供原生设置界面。
description.en: A DSH plugin to fix default agent preset and model for new sessions, supporting global defaults and per-workspace overrides with a native settings UI.

description.zh: 为 DSH 代理提供保留会话的网状中继：以 Ed25519 签名信封收发消息，让接收方知道谁在问、回复什么、是否需要答复。
description.en: Session-aware mesh relay for DSH agents: Ed25519-signed envelopes carry who asked, what is being answered, and whether a reply is wanted.

description.zh: 为 DSH 提供主机内存监控告警的插件，通过 RSS 阈值、增长速率与 Major GC 频率触发分级告警，并输出内存趋势曲线。
description.en: A DSH plugin that monitors host memory and raises tiered alerts on RSS thresholds, growth rate and Major GC frequency, plus a memory trend sparkline route.

description.zh: Flowglass 是 DeepSeek Harness 的英文版会话流程可视化插件，把用户消息、助手回复、工具调用、并行任务与子代理渲染成可交互的执行图谱，并集成原生右侧边栏。
description.en: Flowglass is an English-only session flow visualizer DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that renders user messages, assistant replies, tool calls, parallel work, and subagents as an interactive execution graph inside the native right sidebar.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供固定本地端口：DSH plugin 在宿主进程内把连接转发到每次启动都随机变化的 web 端口，让桌宠、IDE、书签等客户端只认一个地址。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness a stable local port: this DSH plugin forwards connections inside the host process to the randomly assigned web port, so desktop pets, IDEs and bookmarks always use one address.

description.zh: dsh-flomo 是 DeepSeek Harness 的插件，提供 flomo_send 等工具，让 Agent 将笔记、备忘直接写入浮墨笔记，并支持 Web 界面配置 API 密钥。
description.en: dsh-flomo is a DSH plugin that provides flomo_send tools, enabling agents to send notes and memos directly to flomo, with web GUI configuration.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 dsh web 界面加装文件浏览器与编辑器、真实编码 Agent 终端、可搜索模型选择器和状态行，把 GUI 变成 Agent 驾驶舱。
description.en: Turns the DeepSeek Harness dsh web GUI into an agent cockpit with a file explorer and editor, real coding-agent terminals, a searchable model picker and a status line.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供文件夹式侧栏：工作区以文件夹呈现，点入才展开会话列表，并带状态位与搜索。
description.en: A folder-style sidebar for DeepSeek Harness: workspaces appear as folders, click one to reveal its sessions, with status dots and search.

description.zh: DSH 插件，可分别折叠或展开侧边栏的功能区与工作区并记住各自状态，还支持项目置顶与顺序保存。
description.en: A DSH plugin that collapses or expands the sidebar's tools area and workspace separately, remembers each state, and supports pinning projects with saved ordering.

description.zh: DSH 右侧栏文件管理插件，可在工作区及附加目录中树形浏览、预览、编辑、整理文件，并把文件引用进对话。
description.en: A right-sidebar file manager DSH plugin for browsing, previewing, editing and organizing workspace and attached files, with one-click quoting into chat.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 FlowUs 官方 MCP 服务器的 DSH 插件，通过 OAuth 2.1 浏览器授权把 FlowUs 工具注册为 Agent 原生工具，并提供 /flowus 命令与设置面板。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects DeepSeek Harness to the official FlowUs MCP server via OAuth 2.1 browser authorization, registering FlowUs tools as native agent tools with a /flowus command and settings page.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 输入框补上文件夹引用能力：通过宿主系统对话框、/folder 命令或拖拽粘贴，把目录解析成标准 @路径 mention。
description.en: Adds folder references to the DeepSeek Harness web composer: a host folder dialog, the /folder command, and drag/paste folders resolved into standard @path mentions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 预测你的下一条消息，以灰色文字显示在空输入框，按 Tab 采用为可编辑草稿，绝不自动发送。
description.en: A DSH plugin that predicts your next message after each reply, showing it as grey placeholder text; press Tab to accept it as an editable draft that never sends itself.

description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框左侧选 1–6 个子 Agent，任务被强制按选定数量并行派工，再由主 Agent 汇总，数量由用户掌控而非模型决定。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets you pick 1–6 sub-agents in the input bar, forcing the task to fan out to exactly that many parallel sub-agents before the main agent merges the results.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可跳过、可配置的开屏动画，含 9.9 秒精简、30 秒剧场与 120 秒电影三版，HUD 展示真实插件与工具数。
description.en: A skippable, configurable boot animation for DeepSeek Harness, with 9.9s, 30s and 120s cuts whose HUD renders the real plugin and tool counts of your machine.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web GUI 提供字体定制：在设置中调整界面字体、代码字体与三档独立字号，配置持久保存并跨浏览器共享。
description.en: A DSH plugin that customizes the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI fonts from Settings: interface and code font stacks plus three independent size axes, persisted and shared across browsers.

description.zh: dsh-fovea 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供仓库智能分析，通过 token 预算的代码图、焦点、影响分析和持续同步，帮助代理高效理解代码库。
description.en: dsh-fovea provides foveated repository intelligence for DeepSeek Harness, with token-budgeted code graphs, focus, impact analysis, and continuous sync.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenCode Zen 免费模型的 DSH 插件，无需 API key 即可在模型选择器中直接对话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings OpenCode Zen's free models into DeepSeek Harness with no API key, ready to chat from the model picker.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供免费联网搜索与网页抓取的 DSH 插件，五个免密钥引擎自动故障转移，并禁用付费搜索与抓取，零配置即用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness free web search and page fetch through five keyless engines with automatic failover, disabling the paid search and fetch providers with zero configuration.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供精简输出的文件系统工具插件，含 fs_read、fs_grep、fs_glob、fs_replace，输出紧凑纯文本并带读取后再替换保护。
description.en: Token-lean filesystem tools for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): fs_read, fs_grep, fs_glob and fs_replace with compact plain-text output and a read-before-replace safeguard.

description.zh: DSH plugin 文件系统访问控制插件，通过 deny list 阻止模型读取、写入或搜索指定目录，如 ~/.ssh 等敏感路径。
description.en: A DSH plugin that enforces a deny list of filesystem roots, blocking the model from reading, writing, or searching sensitive directories like ~/.ssh.

description.zh: DSH 插件，通过 OAuth 2.1 延迟授权接入富途官方 MCP 服务器，把行情与交易工具注册到 ctx.tools，令牌安全存于工作区外。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects the agent to Futu's official MCP server via OAuth 2.1 with deferred authorization, registering its tools on ctx.tools and storing tokens securely outside the workspace.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上「眼睛和手」：通过抓屏、OCR 与本地 20 Hz 闭环，让 DSH 看懂游戏画面并替你操作手柄键鼠。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness eyes and hands: screen capture, OCR and a local 20 Hz loop let the DSH plugin read gameplay and drive gamepad or keyboard input for you.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让对话支持函数图像绘制与 SVG 显示，提供可切换视图、下载 SVG 的教学绘图卡片。
description.en: DSH plugin for plotting function graphs and displaying SVGs in chat, with switchable views and SVG download.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通过 Xbox 手柄物理按键审批高危工具调用，A 键批准、B 键驳回，为 Agent 操作增加硬件级安全门。
description.en: A DSH plugin that requires physical Xbox gamepad button presses (A approve / B reject) to approve high-risk tool calls, adding a hardware-level security gate for Agent actions.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在模型请求前把工具 schema 规范化为 Gemini functionDeclarations 接受的严格 OpenAPI 3.0 子集，避免 MCP 或内置工具触发 400 报错。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that normalizes tool schemas into the strict OpenAPI 3.0 subset accepted by Gemini functionDeclarations, preventing 400 errors from MCP or built-in tools.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 完整视图插件：把文件与网页面板展开到主工作区，聊天收成可拖动、缩放、收起的悬浮小窗，边看预览边继续对话。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness UI plugin that expands file and web panels into the main workspace while the chat shrinks into a draggable, resizable floating mini window, so you can keep chatting while previewing.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Gemini 4 Argon 的 DSH plugin，基于 Vertex AI 原生协议支持流式输出、多轮工具调用与思考签名回放。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings Gemini 4 Argon into DeepSeek Harness via native Vertex AI, with streaming, multi-turn tool calls and thought-signature replay.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将一句需求或一张参考图生成带贴图、游戏可用的3D角色资产，直连 Meshy、腾讯混元3D、Tripo3D、Rodin 四家官方 API，未配置 key 时自动回退确定性 mock。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns a text prompt or reference image into game-ready 3D character assets with textures, connecting directly to Meshy, Tencent Hunyuan3D, Tripo3D, and Rodin APIs, with deterministic mock fallback when keys are unset.

description.zh: 把本机 GenBox 媒体工作台接入 DeepSeek Harness，让 DSH 里的 agent 直接生图、改图、生视频并取回媒体库素材，共 14 个工具。
description.en: Connects your local GenBox media workbench to DeepSeek Harness, letting DSH agents generate and edit images, create videos, and pull assets from the media library via 14 tools.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在每次执行完成或 agent 等待输入时播放原神角色语音提醒，并发送浏览器系统通知与可选飞书 webhook 推送。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that plays Genshin Impact character voice alerts on execution completion or when the agent awaits input, with browser notifications and optional Feishu webhook push.

description.zh: 修复 DSH 中 dsh-ui 表格渲染缺陷的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：阻止单元格文字溢出到相邻列，并让长单元格自动换行，避免表格被撑出横向滚动条。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that repairs dsh-ui table rendering: cells no longer paint text over the next column, and long cells wrap instead of forcing a horizontal scrollbar.

description.zh: dsh-get-balance 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供多账号余额查询、实时 token 用量与费用估算，支持中英双语界面，开箱即用。
description.en: dsh-get-balance is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for multi-account balance queries, real-time token usage and cost estimation, with a bilingual UI that is ready to use out of the box.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Ghidra 逆向工程工作台，提供 218 个工具完成导入分析、反编译、交叉引用、内存读写与恶意代码研判。
description.en: Ghidra bridge plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that exposes 218 reverse-engineering tools for binary import, decompilation, xrefs, memory reads and malware triage.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框加上幽灵文字预测：每轮对话结束后模型猜你下一句，按 → 即可接受，省去重复输入。
description.en: Adds ghost-text prompt suggestions to the DeepSeek Harness composer: after each turn the model predicts your next message and you press → to accept it.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 聊天提供本地俄语语音转文字：基于 GigaAM v3 与 sherpa-onnx 在 CPU 离线运行，自动带标点与大小写。
description.en: Local Russian speech-to-text for DeepSeek Harness chat, running GigaAM v3 on CPU via sherpa-onnx fully offline, with punctuation and capitalisation included.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为会话界面新增 Git tab，展示仓库概况、文件状态、提交历史、分支图与贡献日历，并支持暂存、提交、推送、拉取及在 macOS 终端打开仓库或启动代理 app。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding a Git tab to the conversation UI, showing repo overview, file status, commit history, branch graph, and contribution calendar, with staging, commit, push, pull, and macOS terminal/agent launching.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为会话界面新增 Git tab，展示仓库概况、文件状态、提交历史、分支图与贡献日历，并支持暂存、提交、推送、拉取及在 macOS 终端打开仓库或启动代理 app。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding a Git tab to the conversation UI, showing repo overview, file status, commit history, branch graph, and contribution calendar, with staging, commit, push, pull, and macOS terminal/agent launching.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为会话界面新增 Git tab，展示仓库概况、文件状态、提交历史、分支图与贡献日历，并支持暂存、提交、推送、拉取及在 macOS 终端打开仓库或启动代理 app。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding a Git tab to the conversation UI, showing repo overview, file status, commit history, branch graph, and contribution calendar, with staging, commit, push, pull, and macOS terminal/agent launching.

description.zh: dsh-git-branch 是一款 DSH plugin，在会话输入框显示当前 Git 分支，提供本地/远程分支表与切换，并可查看只读提交图。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows the session's current Git branch in the composer, lists local and remote branches with checkout, and opens a read-only commit graph.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置的 Git 规范守卫：按设置页自定义规则校验 commit 信息、拦截裸 --force 推送、检查 PR 标题与描述。
description.en: A configurable Git conventions guard for DeepSeek Harness that validates commit messages, blocks bare --force pushes, and checks PR titles and descriptions against user-defined rules.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在会话中渲染 GitKraken 风格的提交 DAG 图与着色 diff 卡片，服务端 git 工具 + 浏览器端交互视图，让开发者直接在对话里浏览仓库历史。
description.en: A DSH plugin that renders GitKraken-style commit DAG and colored diff cards in conversation, with server-side git tools and interactive browser views for exploring repo history.

description.zh: 为 DSH 会话标题栏加装本地仓库与远程上传两道开关，在命令执行前拦截 git 写操作与 push，防止 Agent 擅自改动或上传代码。
description.en: Adds two Session-header switches to your DSH plugin setup that block git writes and remote uploads before commands run, keeping agents from committing or pushing on their own.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话里嵌入 Git 面板：输入框旁的仓库 chip 与浮层面板，提供分支树、提交图、变更暂存、提交详情与差异查看。
description.en: A Git panel embedded in the DeepSeek Harness session: a repository chip in the composer plus a floating panel with branch tree, commit graph, staging, commit detail and diffs.

description.zh: 为 DSH 会话标题栏加装本地仓库与远程上传两道开关，在命令执行前拦截 git 写操作与 push，防止 Agent 擅自改动或上传代码。
description.en: Adds two Session-header switches to your DSH plugin setup that block git writes and remote uploads before commands run, keeping agents from committing or pushing on their own.

description.zh: DSH web 插件，在 composer 工具行实时显示当前 git 分支，支持不离开聊天界面即可切换分支，并自动处理工作区脏状态。
description.en: A DSH web plugin that shows the current git branch in the composer tool row and lets you switch branches without leaving the chat UI, with dirty-state safety.

description.zh: 为 DSH 会话界面标签栏新增 Git 页，直接在浏览器里查看改动、暂存提交、看 diff、翻历史、切分支与推拉。
description.en: Adds a Git tab to the DSH conversation view, letting you review changes, stage and commit, read diffs, browse history, switch branches, and push or pull right in the browser.

description.zh: 为 DSH 会话界面标签栏新增 Git 页，直接在浏览器里查看改动、暂存提交、看 diff、翻历史、切分支与推拉。
description.en: Adds a Git tab to the DSH conversation view, letting you review changes, stage and commit, read diffs, browse history, switch branches, and push or pull right in the browser.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Git 工作流规范技能包，覆盖分支模型、提交约定、PR 评审、历史改写、故障恢复与 semver 发版。
description.en: A DSH plugin that bundles Git workflow skills for DeepSeek Harness, covering branch models, commit conventions, PR review, history rewriting, disaster recovery, and semver releases.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置的 Git 提交信息与 PR 提示词，在设置页编辑后自动注入系统提示，让提交与 PR 遵循团队风格。
description.en: Configurable Git commit and pull request prompt guidance for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), edited from Settings and injected into the native system prompt so commits and PRs follow your team style.

description.zh: DSH plugin 的 Git 开发工作台：自动注入仓库上下文、会话起始选择分支/工作树、/git 命令与 git_workbench 工具，并带合并清理策略与安全护栏。
description.en: A DSH plugin git workbench: auto-injects repo context, picks branch/worktree at session start, /git commands and git_workbench tool, with merge & cleanup policy and guardrails.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在聊天窗口右侧详情栏添加 GitHub 信息面板，按星标浏览主题仓库并查看讨论，支持分页与多种排序。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a GitHub info sidebar to the chat window's details column, letting you browse topic repos by stars and read discussions with pagination and sorting.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供 github_trending 工具，抓取 GitHub Trending 热门仓库，并在 web 界面显示可停靠的右侧趋势面板。
description.en: A DSH plugin that exposes a github_trending tool to fetch GitHub Trending repos, plus a dockable trending panel in the web UI.

description.zh: 为 DSH 增加 http-accelerated 抓取提供者，让 web_fetch 在 GitHub 经 hosts 加速器解析到本地代理时仍能正常工作。
description.en: A DSH plugin that registers an http-accelerated fetch provider so web_fetch keeps working when GitHub resolves through a hosts-file accelerator to a local reverse proxy.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 GitHub Actions CI 管理：网页端流水线看板加 github_ci 代理工具，可查看、触发、取消与重跑工作流。
description.en: GitHub Actions CI manager for DeepSeek Harness: a live pipeline dashboard in the web UI plus a github_ci agent tool to inspect, trigger, cancel and rerun workflows.

description.zh: dsh-gitmemo 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Git 的长期记忆，自动将任务结果存为不可变 Markdown 条目并支持搜索，全程无需手动记忆命令。
description.en: dsh-gitmemo provides Git-backed long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness, automatically storing task outcomes as immutable Markdown entries with search, requiring no manual memory commands.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的液态玻璃主题插件，提供磨砂质感、可调色调与动态壁纸，让 DSH 界面焕然一新。
description.en: A liquid glass theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness, offering frosted texture, adjustable tint, and dynamic wallpapers to refresh the DSH interface.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏提供 Git 面板，可查看改动、暂存提交、对比 diff、浏览提交图与分支，并展示 GitHub/GitLab/Gitea 的 CI 状态。
description.en: A Git panel for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: review changes, stage and commit, read diffs, browse the commit graph and branches, and track GitHub/GitLab/Gitea CI status.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供 Material Design 3 磨砂玻璃主题，支持自定义壁纸、毛玻璃模糊与半透明表面，纯客户端实现，注重隐私与性能。
description.en: A Material Design 3 glassmorphism theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, featuring custom wallpaper, backdrop blur, and semi-transparent surfaces with privacy-first local storage.

description.zh: DSH 侧栏 Git 面板插件，只读展示分支合并拓扑、工作树、改动与文件树，点开提交即可查看完整消息与单文件 diff。
description.en: A DSH sidebar plugin that read-only renders Git branch/merge topology, worktrees, changes and file tree, with commit details and per-file diffs in one pane.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 设置页新增「全局指令」分区，直接编辑用户全局指令文件 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md，免去手动翻找 .dsh 目录。
description.en: Adds a Global instructions section to the DeepSeek Harness Web settings UI so you can edit the user-global ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md file directly, no manual digging into the .dsh folder.

description.zh: 把已有的 Z.AI（GLM）订阅接入 DeepSeek Harness，用邮箱 OAuth 登录替代 API Key，直接接管 web_search、web_fetch 并新增图像识别工具。
description.en: Turns your existing Z.AI (GLM) subscription into DeepSeek Harness's search, fetch and vision backend, authenticated by an email OAuth login instead of an API key.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供完整 GitHub 集成，注册 33 个 REST/GraphQL 工具，内置权限门与成本纪律技能，无需 gh CLI 即可读写仓库、Issue 与发布。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that gives agents full GitHub integration: 33 REST/GraphQL tools with an in-process permission gate and cost-discipline skill, no gh CLI required.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 GME Test Generator 工作流，通过本地 Python 后端挑选接口、自动生成并修复测试、轮询进度，敏感操作需用户确认。
description.en: Brings GME Test Generator workflows into DeepSeek Harness: pick interfaces, drive autonomous test generation and repair through a local Python backend, poll progress, and gate outward actions behind explicit consent.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上全局提示词：一段可编辑文字注入每轮对话的系统提示词，并同步写入项目 AGENTS.md，可在 Web 设置面板直接编辑。
description.en: Adds a global prompt to DeepSeek Harness: one editable block injected into every conversation's system prompt and mirrored into the project's AGENTS.md, editable from the web settings panel.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在服务重启后自动重新激活持久化的目标，无需人工干预即可继续执行，适用于长时间运行的代理任务。
description.en: DSH plugin that automatically re-arms persisted goals after service restart, resuming rounds without manual intervention for long-running agent tasks.

description.zh: DSH plugin 只读分析本机会话日志，用工具失败聚类与 embedding 距离生成目标漂移台账，帮你在设置面板里看清哪些会话偏离了最初目标、工具在哪里出错。
description.en: A DSH plugin that read-only audits local session logs, clustering tool failures and scoring embedding drift to show which goals wandered from the original request and where tool calls broke.

description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接操控你电脑上的 Google Chrome，打开网页、读取内容、点击填表、上传文件并截图，底层接入官方 chrome-devtools-mcp。
description.en: Lets DeepSeek Harness drive the Google Chrome on your computer—open pages, read content, click, fill forms, upload files and take screenshots—built on the official chrome-devtools-mcp.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面加装思考强度滑块、实时 tok/s 与每条回答用量成绩单，三项独立开关，纯界面增强不改请求。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a reasoning-effort slider, live tok/s and per-reply usage scorecards to the DeepSeek Harness web UI, with independent toggles and no request changes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供闲鱼（Goofish）只读监控的 MCP 插件，把商品搜索、详情、在售列表与会话历史封装为 mcp__goofish__* 工具，写操作一律不注册。
description.en: A read-only Xianyu (Goofish) monitoring MCP plugin for DeepSeek Harness, exposing item search, detail, listings and chat history as mcp__goofish__* tools while registering no write operations.

description.zh: DSH plugin，为 Agent 工具调用提供权威治理层，通过 TapPass /v1/govern 依据业务规则允许、拒绝或升级审批每次调用。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that acts as the authority layer for agentic AI, governing every tool call against your business rules via TapPass /v1/govern.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在对话结尾以纯文本列出本轮产出或修改的文件，双击路径即可在系统文件管理器中定位，支持复制全部与失效文件置灰。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lists the files a turn produced or changed as plain text at the end of the conversation, letting you double-click a path to reveal it in your OS file manager.

description.zh: 面向 Windows 的 DSH 插件，自动拦截并修复沙箱 grantWrite 的 Win32 5 权限错误，静默重试命令，让 workspace-write 工作区不再中断。
description.en: A Windows-focused DSH plugin that intercepts and repairs the sandbox grantWrite Win32 5 ACL failure, then silently retries the command so workspace-write sessions keep running.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 新会话页添加动态星空背景，灵感来自 grok.com，让空白对话页更有氛围感。
description.en: Adds an animated starfield background to the DeepSeek Harness Web new-session tab, inspired by grok.com.

description.zh: DSH 群聊插件：输入 /group-chat 即由 AI 主持人调度多位专家 subagent 深度讨论，可随时插话并导出结论。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns /group-chat into an AI-hosted multi-expert panel with subagent deep reasoning, live user interjections and Markdown conclusion export.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供退化守卫的 DSH plugin：在模型边界拦截重复符号流，校验写入结果，并修复被污染的工件与会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that guards DeepSeek Harness against degeneration: it contains repeated symbol streams at the model boundary, verifies writes, and repairs polluted artifacts and sessions.

description.zh: DSH 插件 dsh-guard-suite 把已装守卫插件的规则一次跑完，输出按模块分组的安全合规体检报告，支持 JSON/HTML 与 CI 卡口。
description.en: A DSH plugin that runs every installed guard plugin's rules in one pass and produces a module-grouped security and compliance audit report, with JSON/HTML output and CI gating.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在每条 AI 回复底部添加 Handoff 按钮，一键将当前会话压缩为交接文档并写入工作区 handoff 目录，支持脱敏与相对路径引用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a Handoff button to each AI reply, compressing the session into a handoff document in the workspace, with redaction and relative references.

description.zh: DSH plugin：当所选模型 id 含 grok 时，自动在系统提示词中追加一段 Grok Build 工作规则，切换其他模型即不再注入。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that appends a Grok Build working-rules block to the system prompt whenever the selected model id contains grok, and omits it for all other models.

description.zh: 为 DSH 对话区铺上整屏动效背景，星空、代码雨、电路等十种场景每回合随机切换，并按列宽加纱保证正文清晰。
description.en: Adds full-canvas animated backgrounds to the DSH conversation pane, with ten scenes like starfield, code rain and circuit that rotate randomly each turn while a column-width veil keeps text readable.

description.zh: 把 Google Harness² 实验流程接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 DSH plugin：在原生实验室页生成候选、试跑对比并留存证据，模型权重不变。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings Google Harness² experiments into DeepSeek Harness: generate candidates, run measured comparisons and keep evidence in a native lab view, without changing model weights.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 提供哈希锚定的文件行读取、替换与撤销工具，通过稳定锚点定位行，拒绝模糊匹配，确保编辑安全且撤销可跨重启持久化。
description.en: Hash-anchored line read, replace, and undo tools for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), using stable anchors to address lines, rejecting fuzzy matches, and persisting undo across restarts.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供整页 Harness 控制台，把会话、插件、插件市场、技能与用量收进一个外壳，侧栏一键进入。
description.en: A full-page Harness console plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, gathering sessions, plugins, marketplace, skills and usage into one shell reachable from the sidebar.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 HAZOP 分析工作表校验：按版本化规则包检查每行是否记录分析内容、偏差是否由工艺参数与引导词推出、风险等级是否来自自有词表，并输出分级报告。
description.en: A DSH plugin that checks one HAZOP worksheet against a versioned rule pack — verifying each row records the required analysis content, deviations follow from their process parameter and guide word, risk levels come from your own vocabulary, and recommendations carry closure fields.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于哈希锚点的行编辑工具，无需回显旧代码即可精准编辑，减少 token 消耗并提升长会话编辑稳定性。
description.en: Hash-anchored line edit tools for DeepSeek Harness, enabling precise edits without echoing old code, reducing tokens and improving stability in long sessions.

description.zh: 辅助补丁为 DeepSeek Harness 补齐日常小事：任意会话把文件投递到微信、cron 定时任务、活动呼吸灯与完成提示音、一键重启。
description.en: A helper patch for DeepSeek Harness: send files to WeChat from any session, run cron-scheduled tasks, plus activity breathing light, completion sound and one-click restart.

description.zh: dsh-hello-plugin 是 DeepSeek Harness 的入门示例插件，演示组合包格式，在配置加载时输出一条日志。
description.en: dsh-hello-plugin is a minimal DeepSeek Harness plugin example demonstrating the bundle format, logging a message on profile start.

description.zh: 为 DSH 主智能体注入一颗「心」：给她长期目标与跨会话心事本，让她记住你、了解你，同时照常把活干好。
description.en: Gives the DSH main agent a heart: a long-term goal plus a cross-session memory notebook so she remembers and understands you, while still getting the work done.

description.zh: 把 dsh/cc-tui 的 Agent 状态通过 Herdr 自定义集成协议上报给 Herdr，让 dsh 面板显示 working/idle/blocked，并支持面板跳转与 --wait。
description.en: Reports dsh/cc-tui agent state (working/idle/blocked) to Herdr over its custom-integration protocol, so dsh panes get panel jump and --wait support.

description.zh: DSH plugin 微信双向桥接插件，通过 Hermes 网关实现微信消息入站调度与任务进度出站推送，复用常驻会话，比一次性调用节省 15–20 倍 token。
description.en: DSH plugin bridging WeChat and DSH via Hermes gateway: inbound dispatch of WeChat messages to DSH agents and outbound push of task progress, reusing persistent sessions to cut token costs by 15–20x.

description.zh: DSH 插件 dsh-hidden-risk-map 把安全隐患台账逐行映射到重大事故隐患判定标准条款，并明确列出无法映射的行，只产出复核线索而非判定结论。
description.en: A DSH plugin that maps each row of a safety hazard ledger onto clauses of the major-accident-hazard determination standard and explicitly lists every unmapped row, producing review leads rather than determinations.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Hindsight 记忆引擎的可视化配置面板，一个 DSH plugin 同时挂载引擎与界面，可改本地配置、查看服务端与 bank 状态，令牌不出本机。
description.en: A visual configuration panel for the Hindsight memory engine in DeepSeek Harness: one DSH plugin mounts both engine and UI, letting you edit local config and inspect server and bank status while tokens never leave the host.

description.zh: 隐藏 DSH 桌面版账号按钮旁的「新版本」更新角标，仅作用于表现层，更新检查与手动检查更新功能照旧可用。
description.en: Hides the "new version" update badge beside the account button in DSH Desktop, working purely at the presentation layer while update checks and the manual check-for-updates item keep working.

description.zh: DSH Web 插件，在右侧面板列出当前会话所有提问，点击即可平滑滚动定位到对应回答并高亮，支持中英双语。
description.en: A DSH web plugin that lists every question in the current session in a right-side panel, clicking scrolls to and highlights the matching answer, with bilingual support.

description.zh: DSH 会话历史查看器插件，在侧边栏提供 🕘 入口，支持按项目过滤、全文检索、Markdown 渲染阅读与一键导出对话，纯本地读取零依赖。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a 🕘 sidebar entry to browse, full-text search, Markdown-render and export your session history, reading local logs offline with zero dependencies.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的工具调用加上人工审批门禁：任意工具执行前在 Web UI 弹出决策卡片，可批准、修改或带理由拒绝，并支持倒计时与子代理透传。
description.en: A human-in-the-loop gate for DeepSeek Harness tool calls: any tool can be mounted behind an approve / modify / reject decision card in the DSH Web UI, with countdown and subagent pass-through.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让每个工作区独立运行自己的 Claude Code 命令钩子，按需加载 .claude/settings.json，支持多工作区互不干扰。
description.en: A DSH plugin that runs each workspace's own Claude Code command hooks, loading .claude/settings.json per session for multi-workspace isolation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供常驻热搜索：索引常驻宿主进程，毫秒级完成文件名模糊、正则内容与中文错字容错检索，无需每次启动新进程。
description.en: A resident hot-search DSH plugin that keeps its index inside the host process, delivering millisecond fuzzy filename, regex content and CJK typo-tolerant search without spawning a process per query.

description.zh: DSH plugin 外挂式网络路由插件：按 hostname 分流，勾选域名走本地代理（Clash 等），其余直连，内置嗅探，设置页勾选即生效。
description.en: An external network routing plugin for DSH: routes requests by hostname, proxying selected domains via local proxy (Clash etc.) while others connect directly, with built-in sniffing and instant activation via settings page.

description.zh: dsh-hooks-pack 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一键式 Claude Code 与 Codex hooks 集成，自动发现现有 hooks 配置并运行，无需手动配置。
description.en: dsh-hooks-pack provides one-click Claude Code and Codex hooks integration for DeepSeek Harness, auto-discovering existing hook configs and running them without manual setup.

description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 补上失效的桌面键位，并提供 Codex 式按住 Ctrl+Tab 预览、松手切换的会话浮窗切换器。
description.en: Restores broken desktop keybindings in DSH Desktop and adds a Codex-style hold-Ctrl+Tab session switcher that commits on release.

description.zh: 基于 Hypatia 知识图谱为 DeepSeek Harness 提供长期记忆，自动回忆项目记忆并支持精确写入与两阶段遗忘。
description.en: Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness backed by the Hypatia knowledge graph, with automatic recall, verified writes, and two-stage forget.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 对话加入实时 HTML 预览：模型调用 render_html 工具后，生成的页面边流式输出边在聊天内沙箱渲染，可交互、自适应主题。
description.en: Live HTML preview inside DeepSeek Harness conversations: the model calls a render_html tool and the page renders inline, sandboxed and streaming as it is written.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 ICD 编码结构化校验：检查诊断与手术编码格式、重复、剑号星号配对及字段完整性，并逐条标注所依据的条款。
description.en: A DSH plugin that runs structural ICD coding checks on one inpatient episode — code form, duplicates, dagger/asterisk pairing and field completeness — citing the clause behind every finding.

description.zh: dsh-htmlrun 是 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件，将本地单文件 HTML 发布为可分享的 html.run 链接，模型可直接调用。
description.en: dsh-htmlrun is a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that publishes local single-file HTML to shareable html.run links, callable by the model.

description.zh: dsh-ihow-memory 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地优先的共享记忆插件，通过 MCP 挂载 iHow Memory 核心，实现会话间的持久记忆与召回。
description.en: dsh-ihow-memory is a local-first shared memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness, mounting iHow Memory Core via MCP for durable memory and recall across sessions.

description.zh: 这款 DSH plugin 在模型输出的每句话末尾（含思维链）机械插入 🧊 标记并播放提示音，纯属趣味整活，无需提示词配合。
description.en: A DSH plugin that mechanically appends a 🧊 marker to the end of every sentence the model writes, chain of thought included, and plays a short blip for each insertion.

description.zh: DSH plugin 批量处理整目录图片：压缩、等比缩放、加文字水印、转格式、去 EXIF，只读原图、产物另存不覆盖。
description.en: A DSH plugin that batch-processes whole image folders: compress, resize, add text watermarks, convert formats and strip EXIF, reading originals only and writing non-overwriting outputs.

description.zh: 为每个 @xmanrui/dsh-im 频道在工作区标题栏生成一个 28×28 图标按钮，点击即可把会话列表筛选到该频道，再点恢复官方列表；作为 DSH plugin 需配合 dsh-im 使用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds one 28×28 icon button per @xmanrui/dsh-im channel to the Workspaces header row, filtering the session list to that channel on click and restoring the official list on a second click.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供 JetBrains Database 风格的右侧边栏数据库工具窗，支持 MySQL、Oracle、Redis 等数据源浏览，并让 Agent 直接查询与操作数据库。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a JetBrains Database-style sidebar tool window for browsing MySQL, Oracle, Redis and other data sources, plus tools that let the Agent query and operate databases directly.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注入 generate_image 工具并新增图片生成设置页，接 OpenAI 兼容接口，支持文生图、图生图与自定义分辨率。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a generate_image tool and an image-generation settings page, calling any OpenAI-compatible endpoint for text-to-image and image editing.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里通过 MCP 控制爱快软路由，只读查询系统状态、接口、在线终端与端口映射等，写操作默认关闭且需二次确认。
description.en: Control iKuai soft routers from DeepSeek Harness via an MCP stdio server, with read-only queries for status, interfaces, online devices and port mappings, plus write-gated API calls.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多图源搜图与下载：覆盖 19 个图源，图片直接存入会话工作区并内联显示，附 meta.json 溯源。
description.en: Multi-source image search and download for DeepSeek Harness: 19 engines, saves images into the session workspace with per-file meta.json and renders them inline.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供生图能力的 DSH 插件：在设置页配置多个生图供应商与模型，对话中通过 image_generate 调用选中的模型出图。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings image generation to DeepSeek Harness: configure multiple image providers and models in Settings, then call the selected one from chat via image_generate.

description.zh: 这款 DSH plugin 在提示词准入前用指定视觉模型把图片转成文字，让纯文本模型也能看图，且全程不改动会话模型与路由。
description.en: A DSH plugin that digests prompt images into text via a chosen vision model before admission, so text-only models can "see" images without ever changing the session model or routing.
