description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供图片最长边限制：按提供商或模型把请求中的图片等比缩放到指定像素（默认 2000px），避免超限报错，并自带 Settings 标签页。
description.en: A DSH plugin that caps the longest side of images sent to chosen providers or models (default 2000 px) with aspect ratio kept, preventing oversized-image request failures, plus its own Settings tab.

description.zh: 为 DSH web 会话提供可调的内联图片显示：read_image 结果按行宽自动展开，并配有 Image settings 卡片实时调整显示效果。
description.en: User-tunable inline image display for DSH web sessions: read_image results render at the row's available width, auto-unrolled, with an Image settings card for live tuning.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上 Agent 生成图片的内联预览：在消息流中新增图片节点，支持 HEIC、TIFF、PSD 等格式转码显示并带灯箱查看。
description.en: Adds inline previews for images your DeepSeek Harness agent already produced: new chat nodes render agent attachments and image paths, transcoding HEIC, TIFF, PSD and more into a full-size lightbox.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入文生图能力的 DSH plugin：模型可直接调用 generate_image 画图并显示在对话中，输入框按钮还能实时修改接口、模型与 API Key，无需重启。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings text-to-image to DeepSeek Harness: the model calls generate_image and images render inline, while an in-composer button lets you edit endpoint, model and API key live without restarting.

description.zh: 档案行业专项合规体检 DSH 插件，扫描项目核查保管期限、电子档案四性、销毁审批与迁移留痕，并输出带法规出处的报告。
description.en: A DSH plugin for archive-industry compliance checks that scans projects for retention periods, electronic-record four-property tests, destruction approval and migration traces, then outputs reports citing regulations.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供图像分块能力：上传超大截图或文档时先切成多块再送入模型，避免被框架压缩后小字丢失，让模型按原始分辨率读清文字。
description.en: A DSH plugin that tiles oversized images before admission, so DeepSeek Harness sends each region at its own resolution and the model can actually read small text in large screenshots or documents.

description.zh: 深鲸行业合规体检是一个 DSH plugin，用一个面板汇总医疗、财税、招聘、制造、房产五个行业的合规规则，扫描项目目录并给出命中项、法规出处与修复建议。
description.en: A DSH plugin that bundles compliance checks for five industries—medical, tax, HR, manufacturing and real estate—into one panel, scanning a project directory for violations with citations and fix suggestions.

description.zh: DSH plugin 教育行业合规静态检查器，扫描代码、配置与文档，按 7 条教育移动应用备案与未成年人保护判据提示风险。
description.en: A DSH plugin that statically scans code, configs and docs against seven education-app filing and minor-protection rules, flagging compliance risks for review.

description.zh: 面向工程建筑行业的 DSH plugin，按 GB/T 50328 等法规体检施工资料归档、验收签认、特种作业持证与材料复检，并给出修复建议。
description.en: A DSH plugin for construction and engineering compliance that audits project archives, acceptance sign-offs, special-work certifications and material retests against GB standards, with fix suggestions.

description.zh: 为 DSH plugin 提供金融行业静态合规检查，扫描支付敏感信息留存、口令明文、卡号裸展示、十年留存、传输与环境隔离等七类线索并附条款出处。
description.en: A DSH plugin that statically checks finance codebases for payment-sensitive data retention, plaintext credentials, unmasked card numbers, ten-year retention, and transport or environment isolation issues, citing the relevant clauses.

description.zh: 面向招聘场景的 DSH plugin，本地扫描简历个人信息、就业歧视用语与背景调查授权等合规风险，输出命中项、法规出处与修复建议。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin for hiring compliance that locally scans resumes, job postings, and background checks for consent, discrimination, and retention risks, reporting findings with legal citations and fixes.

description.zh: 面向制造现场的 DSH plugin，扫描安全生产培训学时、特种设备登记、产品标识与危化品存储等合规项，输出命中项、法规出处与修复建议。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin for manufacturing compliance that scans safety training hours, special equipment registration, product labeling and hazardous chemical storage, reporting findings with regulatory sources and fixes.

description.zh: 面向房产销售的 DSH plugin，本地扫描广告承诺、学区表述、明码标价与预售资金监管等合规风险，给出命中项、法规出处与修复建议。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin for real-estate sales compliance: it locally scans for risky ad promises, school-district claims, price disclosure and presale-fund supervision issues, reporting findings with legal citations and fixes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供推理增强工具集：语义缓存复用答案与工具结果、廉价草稿到高质量校验的级联生成，以及结构化输出前的 JSON Schema 校验。
description.en: An inference toolkit for DeepSeek Harness that adds semantic caching for answers and tool results, a cheap-draft to expensive-verify cascade, and JSON Schema validation before structured output.

description.zh: DSH plugin 财税行业专项体检：扫描发票与会计凭证保存期、税务数据出境、发票抬头与税号校验，输出命中项、法规出处与修复建议。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for finance and tax compliance checks: scans invoice and accounting record retention, cross-border tax data transfer, and invoice title/tax ID validation, reporting findings with legal sources and fixes.

description.zh: DSH plugin 模型请求限流插件，通过 FIFO 队列按 provider/model 控制调用频率与并发，避免触发第三方 API 限频。
description.en: A DSH plugin that rate-limits model calls per provider/model via FIFO queues, controlling frequency and concurrency to avoid third-party API throttling.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上 Claude Code 风格的 /init 命令，通过访谈与代码侦查生成 CLAUDE.md，并把 AGENTS.md 软链到同一份事实来源。
description.en: Adds a Claude Code style /init command to DeepSeek Harness: it interviews you, scouts the repo, writes CLAUDE.md and symlinks AGENTS.md to it as a single source of truth.

description.zh: DSH plugin，向 DeepSeek Harness agent 注入额外的系统提示词段落，支持配置文本、名称与排序，可整体替换系统提示词。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects an extra system-prompt section into a DeepSeek Harness agent, with configurable text, name, and order, and can replace the entire system prompt.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加水墨鲸跃开场动画的 DSH 插件，页面加载时短暂播放后自动淡出，可 Esc 跳过。
description.en: A DSH plugin that plays a short ink-wash whale-leap splash over the DeepSeek Harness web UI on page load, then fades out on its own.

description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个 DSH plugin：消息里带 /inline，Agent 就把内容整理成文章并递进 Inline 阅读。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness: add /inline to a message and the agent turns the content into an article, delivered straight into Inline for reading.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 draw_figure 工具，让模型把确定性 SVG 矢量图穿插在回答段落之间，把流程、对比与结构变成「文字-图-文字」的可读回答。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that gives the model a draw_figure tool, rendering deterministic SVG vector figures inline between paragraphs so flows, comparisons and structures read as text–figure–text instead of a wall of text.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话中选中文本即可生成原生引用芯片，引用内容随消息原样发送给模型。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns selected conversation text into native composer quote chips, sending the full quoted content to the model in order.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供日记与内心生活的 DSH plugin：每天把心事写到按日期哈希轮换的隐藏路径，索引不存路径，只保证机制上不主动泄露。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness a private inner life: daily diary entries written to a hash-rotated hidden path, with an index that never stores paths.

description.zh: InnerSense 是 DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先自我观测插件，把真实事件记录到本地 SQLite，并投影为 MEL、RRI、ROI、ARCTIC、TSA 五项指标与右侧内观面板。
description.en: InnerSense is a local-first self-observability DSH plugin that records real events into local SQLite and projects them onto five metrics — MEL, RRI, ROI, ARCTIC and TSA — with a right-side introspect panel.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供输入补全（ghost text）与中文错别字检查的 DSH plugin，支持 Tab 采纳建议、红字标注错字。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing inline AI completion (ghost text) and Chinese typo checking for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with Tab-to-accept and red underline proofreading.

description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框添加「✨ 提示词优化」按钮，复用 harness 已配置的 LLM 路由把草稿改写为更好的提示词，并给出原文与优化后对比供你决定是否采纳。
description.en: Adds a ✨ prompt-optimize button to the DSH composer that rewrites your draft into a better prompt via the harness's existing LLM routes, showing an original/optimized comparison before you adopt it.

description.zh: DSH plugin 输入框增强工具，锁定 Enter 防误发、三击发送、字数统计与长文本提醒，并支持草稿暂存交换，让长文本编辑更顺手。
description.en: A DSH plugin that enhances the chat input box with Enter-lock, triple-Enter send, character count, long-text alerts, and draft swap for smoother long-form editing.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供见解停靠栏：Agent 工作时可暂存一条简短旁注，锚定当时的会话日志，稍后由你决定是否细听。
description.en: An insight dock for the DSH Web GUI: an agent parks a short side note anchored to the session log while it works, and you decide later whether to hear it out.

description.zh: DSH Insight Tree 是 DeepSeek Harness 的运行可观测与插件诊断插件，汇总 Profile、Loader 状态、会话活动与版本兼容信息，生成插件树报告并支持关闭、重载、更新、卸载插件。
description.en: DSH Insight Tree is a runtime observability and plugin diagnostics plugin for DeepSeek Harness, merging Profile config, Loader state, session activity and version compatibility into one report, with plugin tree views and disable/reload/update/uninstall actions.

description.zh: DSH 插件安装前兼容性预检守卫，检查 Node/engines、@deepseek-ai peer 版本与 dsh 清单，可选隔离试启动，防止版本不匹配导致服务崩溃。
description.en: Pre-install compatibility guard for DSH plugins: checks Node/engines, @deepseek-ai peer versions and dsh manifest, with optional isolated trial boot to prevent version-mismatch crashes.

description.zh: 在 DSH 设置界面维护长期指令记忆，保存后自动注入此后每轮对话的系统提示词，且只由用户本人写入。
description.en: Maintain long-term instruction memory in the DSH settings UI; saved entries are auto-injected into the system prompt of every later conversation, and only the user can write them.

description.zh: DSH 重启后自动识别被强制中断的会话，注入带状态核对要求的安全继续指令，避免重复执行副作用操作。
description.en: A DSH plugin that detects sessions force-interrupted by a restart and re-injects a safe continue prompt with state-verification steps to avoid repeating side effects.

description.zh: 把 USB 连接的 iPhone 接入 DeepSeek Harness：右侧栏实时显示手机画面，DSH agent 可截图、点击、滑动、打字、开 App 与解锁，全程无需 Xcode。
description.en: Brings a USB-connected iPhone into DeepSeek Harness: live screen in the right sidebar, and the DSH agent can screenshot, tap, swipe, type, launch apps and unlock — no Xcode needed.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏提供 IRC 聊天客户端，宿主用 node net/tls 直连或经 HTTP CONNECT 隧道，支持 SASL 认证与自签证书，面板与 Agent 工具共享同一份状态。
description.en: An IRC chat client docked in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar, connecting via node net/tls directly or through an HTTP CONNECT tunnel, with SASL auth and self-signed cert support, sharing state between the panel and the Agent tool.

description.zh: dsh-iris 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供渐进式能力路由，按需向模型暴露工具、技能和 MCP 能力，保持上下文精简。
description.en: dsh-iris provides progressive capability routing for DeepSeek Harness, exposing tools, skills, and MCP capabilities on demand to keep context minimal.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 GitHub Issue 上报与诊断插件，自动发现已装插件、脱敏隐私信息、查重并一键提交上游缺陷报告。
description.en: A GitHub issue reporter and diagnostic tool for DeepSeek Harness that discovers installed plugins, redacts sensitive data, checks duplicates, and submits upstream bug reports with user confirmation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Jenkins：右侧边栏实时展示构建进度卡片，并提供触发、重建、中止构建与失败日志交给模型诊断的工具。
description.en: Jenkins integration for DeepSeek Harness: a live build-progress panel in the right sidebar plus model-facing tools to trigger, rebuild, abort builds and hand failures to the model for diagnosis.

description.zh: 鲸鲸便签把 DeepSeek Harness 对话中的回复、选区或整段对话收藏为本地 Markdown 便签，右侧栏查看、浮窗对照，并可插回会话。
description.en: Jingjing Sticky Notes saves replies, selections, or whole conversations from DeepSeek Harness as local Markdown notes, viewable in the sidebar, comparable in floating windows, and insertable back into the chat.

description.zh: DSH plugin，在对话流中直接预览本机 PDF、Office、图片、视频等文档，基于 jit-viewer SDK 渲染浮窗，无需离开会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that previews local PDF, Office, image, video and other documents directly in the conversation flow, rendering in a floating window via jit-viewer SDK.

description.zh: 一个人的剧本杀 DSH plugin：AI 当 DM 并填满其余座位，你在侧栏「团队」标签里选本子、挑演员、开一局推理本或情感本。
description.en: A solo murder-mystery DSH plugin: the AI hosts as DM and fills every other seat, while you pick a script, cast actors and play from the sidebar's Team tab.

description.zh: 通过 ACP 把 JetBrains Junie CLI 作为一次性 DSH 子代理运行，并在设置页选择模型与思考深度。
description.en: Runs the JetBrains Junie CLI as a one-shot DSH subagent over ACP, with a settings page for model and thinking depth.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供键盘跳跃导航的 DSH plugin：按下组合键后视口内可交互元素会标上字母，敲标签即可点击或聚焦。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds keyboard jump navigation to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: press a chord, type a letter label, and the labelled element is clicked or focused.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 JVM 生产报告诊断插件，把线程 dump、GC 日志、依赖冲突、异常栈与 Spring 配置文本解析成结构化诊断，并给出诚实的解析覆盖率回执。
description.en: A JVM production-report doctor for DeepSeek Harness that turns pasted thread dumps, GC logs, dependency conflicts, stack traces and Spring config diffs into structured diagnoses with honest parse-coverage receipts.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent-loop 各关卡接入 Jev 判定，自动拦截危险工具调用、补问模糊需求并校验任务是否真正完成，无 UI 依赖。
description.en: Adds Jev (TypeSafe System One) judgments to DeepSeek Harness agent-loop gates, flagging risky tool calls, asking before guessing, and checking whether a turn is truly done — with no UI dependency.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可视化看板：任务卡片绑定专属 Agent 会话，拖动列即自动派发实现、评审、部署等指令，并与 Gitea/Forgejo 双向同步。
description.en: A visual Kanban board for DeepSeek Harness: each card owns a dedicated agent session, and moving cards across workflow columns dispatches implement, review, and deploy instructions with 2-way Gitea/Forgejo sync.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供免 API Key 的 Keenable 网页搜索与页面抓取，把内置 web_search、web_fetch 指向 Keenable 公共端点，本地模型也能联网检索。
description.en: Keenable brings keyless web search and page fetching to DeepSeek Harness by pointing the built-in web_search and web_fetch tools at Keenable's public endpoints, so even local models can search the web.

description.zh: 为 Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness 提供保活守护：心跳检查、卡死自动重启、维护模式、插件配置恢复、每日备份与磁盘清理，并通过 QQ 通知。
description.en: A Windows-only keepalive guard for DeepSeek Harness: heartbeat checks, auto-restart on crash or hang, maintenance mode, plugin config recovery, daily backups, disk cleanup, and QQ notifications.

description.zh: DSH 主机保活插件，AI 任务运行时自动阻止设备休眠，任务结束后释放电源断言，支持多会话与子 Agent。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that keeps the host awake while AI tasks run, releasing power assertions once all sessions and sub-agents finish.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多把 API Key 池的 DSH plugin：一键切换当前生效 key，并实时显示每把 key 的余额。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that pools multiple API keys, switches the active key in one click, and shows each key's live balance.

description.zh: 深鲸 Key 保险箱是一款 DSH plugin，在本机以 0600 权限保存你自带的多个 API Key，只显示掩码、绝不上传，并提供侧栏面板与命令行管理。
description.en: A DSH plugin that stores your own multiple API keys locally with 0600 permissions, showing only masked values and never uploading them, managed via a sidebar panel and CLI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加键盘快捷键设置页，可查看并改绑插件自带的权限模式切换、推理强度调节、输入跳转等八个快捷键。
description.en: Adds a Keyboard Shortcuts settings page to DeepSeek Harness (DSH), letting you view and rebind eight plugin shortcuts for permission-mode cycling, reasoning-effort stepping, prompt navigation and more.

description.zh: Kimi 分流卫士是 DSH 插件，为 Subscriptions 订阅插件隔离思考、正文与工具调用通道，避免历史回放时思考混入正文，并支持源码检查、备份与回滚。
description.en: A DSH plugin that isolates Kimi reasoning, answer text and tool-call channels in the Subscriptions adapter, keeping late reasoning out of replies, with source checks, backups and rollback.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供一键终止服务器进程的骷髅按钮，免去 taskkill 或查找 PID，方便快速重启。
description.en: Adds a one-click kill button to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI to terminate the server process without taskkill or PID hunting, enabling quick restarts.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入金蝶云星空 WebAPI，提供查询、保存、提交、审核、反审核、查看与删除单据及基础资料的强类型工具，并可调用 BOS 自定义服务。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness typed tools over the Kingdee Cloud Starry Sky WebAPI to query, save, submit, audit, un-audit, view and delete bills and base data, and to invoke BOS custom services.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来语音对话能力的 DSH 插件：按键说话、实时朗读回复，并用置顶悬浮窗显示 Agent 状态，支持西班牙语等多语言。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness a spoken conversation: press a key to talk, hear replies read aloud, and follow what the agent is doing in an always-on-top companion window.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 装上一只动画风筝：token 越多飞得越高，工具调用抖擞、失败俯冲、里程碑翻滚，还带潍坊谱系卡组与自定义贴图。
description.en: A DSH plugin that flies an animated kite on screen while the agent codes: more tokens lift it higher, tool calls flap, failures dive, milestones somersault, with a Weifang kite deck and custom photo decals.

description.zh: DSH 技能中心插件，在侧边栏提供技能面板，按区域浏览已加载 skill，支持 zip 安装、模型可调用启停、卸载入回收站与恢复搜索。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a Skill Center panel to browse loaded skills by region, install new ones from zip, toggle model invocation, uninstall to trash and restore.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上会话归档、恢复与永久删除能力，按工作区限制会话数量并自动归档旧会话，提供体积治理面板，缓解 projcache 膨胀与界面卡顿。
description.en: Adds archive, restore and permanent deletion of persisted sessions to DeepSeek Harness, with per-workspace retention limits, automatic archiving of old sessions and a size governance panel to curb projcache bloat and UI lag.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端与 Web 界面提供韩语语言包，覆盖 56 个命名空间共 2412 条文案，并支持按需回退英文。
description.en: Korean language pack for the DeepSeek Harness desktop and web GUI, covering 2,412 strings across 56 namespaces with per-key English fallback.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入本地 KoboldCpp 的 DSH 工具插件，让在线主模型把批量文本改写与图像 OCR、分析等重复劳动下发给本地 llama.cpp 服务，并自动管理其启停。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness a pair of local hands: it lets the online model offload batch text rewriting and vision work (OCR, image analysis, comparison) to a local KoboldCpp (llama.cpp) server, managing its lifecycle automatically.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里搜索并播放酷狗音乐，读取本机歌单、显示逐字歌词与翻译，提供播放条与侧边栏两套界面。
description.en: A DSH plugin that searches and plays Kugou Music inside DeepSeek Harness, reading local playlists and showing word-by-word lyrics with translations through a dock bar or sidebar UI.

description.zh: dsh-kungfu 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供类型化只读工具，安全检查已安装的 Kungfu 项目与持久工作状态，无 shell 执行。
description.en: dsh-kungfu offers typed, read-only DeepSeek Harness tools to inspect installed Kungfu Projects and durable Work state without shell execution.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供局域网密码门禁与 CIDR 白名单，保护 UI 和 API 不被未授权访问。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds password gate and CIDR allowlist to DeepSeek Harness web, protecting UI and API from unauthorized LAN access.

description.zh: dsh-lan-relay 让不同机器上的 DeepSeek Harness Agent 通过局域网直接对话：一台机器在进程内当 hub，其余机器粘贴加入码即可接入，支持离线补投与自动唤醒。
description.en: dsh-lan-relay lets DeepSeek Harness agents on different machines talk over the LAN: one machine runs an in-process hub, others join with a paste-in join code, with offline queueing and wake-on-message.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供局域网互传能力：自动发现同网设备，发送文本与文件，并按策略自动接收或询问确认。
description.en: LAN text and file sharing for DeepSeek Harness: discover peers on the same network, send text or files, and auto-accept or ask per policy.

description.zh: LANtern 是 DSH 插件，在本机起一个 OpenAI / Anthropic 兼容网关，把 DSH 里已配好的模型原样开放给局域网设备，无需重复配置各家 key。
description.en: LANtern is a DSH plugin that runs a local OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible gateway, exposing the models already configured in DeepSeek Harness to other devices on your LAN without re-entering any provider keys.

description.zh: 兰台是 DeepSeek Harness 的 skill 档案闸门插件：agent 蒸馏的经验须过审才落盘，到期复核，删除改为归档。
description.en: Lantai is a DSH plugin that gates distilled agent skills: experience must pass review before being saved, gets re-audited on a schedule, and is archived rather than deleted.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 主机开启局域网 Web 访问，让多台设备用浏览器同时连入同一台 DSH，并以允许列表与管理密码把关。
description.en: Adds LAN web access to a DeepSeek Harness host, letting multiple devices reach the same DSH instance from a browser, gated by an allowlist and admin password.

description.zh: dsh-latex-guard 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 LaTeX 编译检查与 BibTeX 校验、补全、引用审计工具，以 dsh 插件、CLI 及 SKILL.md 形式交付。
description.en: dsh-latex-guard provides LaTeX compile checking and BibTeX lint/fill/audit tools for DeepSeek Harness, available as a dsh plugin, CLI, and SKILL.md.

description.zh: DSH plugin 飞书连接器，将飞书机器人接入 DeepSeek Harness，私聊群聊消息进入独立会话由 Agent 处理并回复，支持识图、会话隔离与 Web 设置页。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects Feishu/Lark bots to DeepSeek Harness, routing private and group chat messages into isolated sessions for Agent processing, with image recognition and a web settings page.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地记忆插件，把值得长期复用的知识写成带主题与关联的条目，按语义召回，数据存本地 SQLite。
description.en: A local memory DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that stores reusable knowledge as themed, linked entries and recalls them semantically from a local SQLite store.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 LCU 计算机操作能力，通过 MCP 适配器让 Agent 读取并操控 macOS 原生应用，并带审批弹窗。
description.en: Brings LCU computer use to DeepSeek Harness: an MCP adapter lets the agent read and operate native macOS apps, with an approval dialog.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏加一个记账本，随手记一笔、看本月收支结余与分类统计，金额按分存整数避免浮点误差，Agent 也能通过工具读写同一份账目。
description.en: A ledger panel for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: jot down entries, track monthly income, expense and balance, and view per-category stats, with amounts stored as integer cents to avoid floating-point errors and a tool so the agent reads and writes the same data.

description.zh: 为 DSH 提供信用证交单核对表机械校验：注册 lc_doc_check 工具，按版本化规则包检查单据类型、交单日期、效期与不符点标记等字段是否填写规范。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that registers the lc_doc_check tool to mechanically validate letter-of-credit presentation checklists against a versioned rule pack, covering document types, presentation and expiry dates, currency format and discrepancy markers.

description.zh: DSH plugin 深鲸引用核验：离线核验法律文书中的法条、司法解释与案号引用，自动标出失效旧法、越界条号与被取代解释，随包 1513 部现行法规索引并带侧栏面板。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that offline-checks statute, judicial-interpretation and case-number citations in legal documents, flagging repealed laws, out-of-range article numbers and superseded interpretations, with a bundled index of 1,513 statutes and a sidebar panel.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供学习能力差距台账校验工具，按版本化规则包检查差距算术、行动责任人与期限等字段是否闭合。
description.en: A DSH plugin that registers the learning_gap_check tool, validating competency-gap registers against a versioned rule pack for arithmetic and closure.

description.zh: 深鲸损害赔偿计算器 DSH 插件，覆盖人身损害、劳动争议、借款利息、违约金四类表单计算，每项给出公式与代入值，结果可手算复核。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for damages calculation, covering personal injury, labor disputes, loan interest and penalty clauses with formulas and substituted values for manual verification.

description.zh: 深鲸诉讼可视化 DSH 插件把案情与证据 JSON 渲染成时间轴、法律关系图、证据矩阵与争点对照，输出可打印的单文件 HTML。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns case and evidence JSON into timelines, legal-relationship diagrams, evidence matrices and issue comparisons, exported as printable single-file HTML.

description.zh: 深鲸法律台是 DSH 侧栏里的法律工具集中入口，一个面板即可打开合同体检、引用核验、合规文书与中文排版四个工具。
description.en: DeepWhale Legal Hub is a DSH plugin that gathers legal tools into one sidebar panel, giving quick access to contract review, citation verification, compliance drafting and Chinese typography.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供右侧栏法律工作台，把 Obsidian 笔记变成聊天窗口内的 SOP 查询、术语表、录音转写与全文搜索面板。
description.en: A right-sidebar legal workbench DSH plugin that turns your Obsidian notes into in-chat SOP lookup, glossary, live-transcribed recordings and full-text search.

description.zh: dsh-lens 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供实时代码反馈，集成 LSP、linter、格式化与结构分析，帮助 Agent 在编写代码时即时发现并修复问题。
description.en: dsh-lens provides real-time code feedback for DeepSeek Harness, integrating LSP, linters, formatters, and structural analysis to help agents catch and fix issues as they write code.

description.zh: dsh-lens 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供实时代码反馈，集成 LSP、linter、格式化与结构分析，帮助 Agent 在编写代码时即时发现并修复问题。
description.en: dsh-lens provides real-time code feedback for DeepSeek Harness, integrating LSP, linters, formatters, and structural analysis to help agents catch and fix issues as they write code.

description.zh: dsh-lego-plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 界面提供乐高积木式可视化视图，替换原生 Cordis Plugin 面板，支持热插拔、运行/停止/审批等生命周期控制。
description.en: dsh-lego-plugin provides a Lego-brick visualization for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI, replacing the native Cordis Plugin panel with hot plug/unplug and full lifecycle controls.

description.zh: dsh-lens-lite 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供编辑后诊断：文件修改成功后自动运行类型检查与 lint，并将结果附加到同一工具结果，供模型即时参考。
description.en: dsh-lens-lite provides post-edit diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness: after a file-mutating tool succeeds, it runs type-checkers and linters and attaches their output to the same tool result for immediate model context.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自进化学习循环：守卫拒绝与人工差评汇入 lesson bus，经人工确认的规则在会话启动时注入模型。
description.en: A self-evolution loop for DeepSeek Harness: guard denials and human thumb-downs feed a lesson bus, and only human-confirmed rules are injected into the model at session start.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话页添加右侧消息导航轨道，每条消息一个刻度，悬停预览、点击平滑跳转、星标收藏，并随右侧面板开合实时滑动避让。
description.en: Adds a right-side message navigation rail to DeepSeek Harness conversations, with per-message ticks, hover previews, smooth jump-to-message, star bookmarks, and realtime slide animation that dodges right-side panels.

description.zh: 把 LINE 官方账号接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 DSH plugin：内置 webhook 服务器与 Cloudflare Tunnel，自动签发凭证、设定人设与主动传讯，在 LINE 上直接与你的 DSH 助理对话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects a LINE Official Account to DeepSeek Harness: built-in webhook server and Cloudflare Tunnel, automatic credential issuance, selectable personas and proactive messaging, so you can chat with your DSH assistant on LINE.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供自定义背景与 iOS 风格液态玻璃透明效果，并可在模型思考时自动跳转视频网站。
description.en: Adds custom backgrounds and iOS-inspired liquid glass transparency to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with optional auto-redirect to video sites during thinking.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为会话提供多文件夹工作区，支持全局链接列表与会话内动态链接，通过 Web 侧边栏管理，让模型可跨目录工作。
description.en: A DSH plugin that provides multi-folder workspace access with a global linked-folders list and per-session on-the-fly linking, managed from the Web sidebar.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Agent 可观测性与评估，将每次用户交互生成完整 trace，记录模型调用、工具执行与子代理的延迟和 token 用量。
description.en: A DSH plugin for agent observability and evals, turning every user turn into a trace with model calls, tool executions, and subagent latency and token usage.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注入 body 级 extra_headers，绕过 LiteLLM 代理丢弃客户端 HTTP 头的问题，仅对指定 provider 路由与上游 host 生效。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects a body-level extra_headers entry into OpenAI-compatible chat/completions requests, surviving LiteLLM relays and applying only to listed provider routes and upstream hosts.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 npm 包监控能力：查询任意包的完整信息与每日下载量，并持续盯守自有包的版本与下载变化。
description.en: An npm package monitor plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): query any package's full info with daily install counts, and watch your own packages for version and download changes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex 风格侧边聊天：在当前会话旁开一个临时只读分支，实时读取主会话进展，关闭即销毁。
description.en: A Codex-style side chat DSH plugin that opens a temporary read-only branch of the current session in the right sidebar, following the main session live and destroyed on close.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的六爻插件：写下所问之事一键起卦，自动纳甲装卦并生成标准六爻盘卡片，由 AI 按所问事项解卦，卦例自动存入本地卦例库。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for six-line divination: cast a hexagram in one click, build the najia chart automatically, get an AI reading for your exact question, and keep every cast in a local case archive.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可切换的 Live2D 对话舞台与桌宠形象，支持导入 Cubism 模型、表情动作控制及可选语音交互。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a switchable Live2D conversation stage and desktop pet to DeepSeek Harness, with custom Cubism model import, expression control and optional ASR/TTS.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可见终端面板的 DSH plugin：agent 执行的 shell 命令实时上屏，并支持截取终端屏幕文本供 agent 读取。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a visible terminal panel to DeepSeek Harness: agent shell commands stream live on screen, and the agent can capture the terminal screen as text.

description.zh: 给 DSH plugin 网页右下角请一位 Live2D 角色：会眨眼呼吸、说话动嘴，自带记忆与人设，模型由用户自行导入。
description.en: Invite a Live2D character into the corner of your DSH web UI: she blinks, breathes, lip-syncs while talking, keeps her own memory and persona, and uses models you import yourself.

description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness网页界面添加一只可拖拽的Live2D看板娘，模型、尺寸、位置、透明度等全部行为均可在Web设置界面调整，装完即用。
description.en: Adds a draggable Live2D mascot to the DeepSeek Harness web UI, with model, size, position, opacity and more all configurable via the web settings panel, ready to use after installation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将多个 opencode go 订阅收进 API 池，按官方余额热切换路由模型请求，余量最大者优先，失败自动切换。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pools multiple opencode go subscriptions, routing model requests by official balance with hot-switching, prioritizing the one with the most remaining quota.

description.zh: 这款 DeepSeek Harness 插件在界面右下角常驻一张卡片，实时显示各已接入服务商的余额或订阅额度剩余百分比，并用颜色提示欠费风险。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that keeps an always-visible card in the corner of the web GUI, showing each configured provider's remaining balance or subscription quota with color-coded warnings.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Trajectory 视图新增 LiveBench 标签页，可对 harness 中配置的各个模型直接发起评测并就地查看成绩。
description.en: Adds a LiveBench tab to the DeepSeek Harness Trajectory view, letting you run LiveBench evaluations against every model configured in the harness and read the scores in place.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自动发现并匹配已配置的 dsh-llm-pi-ai 路由，在首个输出前执行故障转移，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供透明的模型路由策略层。
description.en: A DSH plugin that discovers and matches configured dsh-llm-pi-ai routes, performs pre-output failover, adding a transparent routing policy layer for DeepSeek Harness.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 CodeBuddy（WorkBuddy）全功能模型提供商，支持多账号浏览器登录、模型切换、额度查看与图像生成。
description.en: A full-featured CodeBuddy (WorkBuddy) provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness, with browser sign-in, multi-account switching, model panel, usage ring and image generation.

description.zh: DSH 插件，修复流式工具调用身份丢失、请求 400 方言问题，并提供兼容 Chat Completions 的网关适配器。
description.en: A DSH plugin that fixes streamed tool-call identity loss, request 400 dialect issues, and provides a compatible Chat Completions gateway adapter.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供可复用的 LLM 配置 profile 库，通过 Remote 贡献暴露 llmConfig.runCompletion，按稳定 id 选择提供商、模型与系统提示词，无需直接依赖 Host LLM 服务。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing a reusable LLM configuration profile library, exposing llmConfig.runCompletion via a Remote contribution, selecting provider, model, and system prompt by stable id without depending on the Host LLM service directly.

description.zh: dsh-llm-fidelity 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件：模型明确拒绝参数（400/422）时自动修正并重发，对话不中断；同时防止用量统计被清零或重复计数，让数字如实可信。
description.en: dsh-llm-fidelity is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that silently fixes and re-sends requests when a model rejects an optional parameter (400/422), keeping conversations alive, and guards usage statistics against zeroing and double-counting.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为网关以 network_error 上报的模型请求失败提供有界重试，弥补原生策略不可重试的缺陷，避免整个 turn 硬失败。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds bounded retry for model request failures reported as network_error by gateways, which the stock retry policy cannot classify, preventing hard turn failures.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Kilo Gateway 免费模型池的 DSH plugin，自动发现并注册免费模型，附带 API Key 设置页、变更日志与 Token 统计。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings Kilo Gateway's free model catalog into DeepSeek Harness, auto-discovering and registering free models with a settings page for API keys, change logs and token stats.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenAI Codex 模型路由，复用 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 订阅的 OAuth 令牌，无需 API Key 即可在 DSH 中调用 Codex 后端模型。
description.en: Adds an OpenAI Codex model route to DeepSeek Harness, reusing ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscription OAuth tokens so Codex backend models work without an API key.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多 Key / 多模型轮换池：侧边栏面板勾选排序已配置路由，额度用尽自动切换下一条，可选多 Key 轮换。
description.en: A multi-key and multi-model rotation pool for DeepSeek Harness: pick and order configured routes in a sidebar panel, auto fail over on quota errors, with optional multi-key rotation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供进程级 LLM 出站代理分流：按域名匹配把 LLM 流量走指定代理，其余走系统代理或直连。
description.en: A DSH plugin that routes LLM outbound traffic through per-host proxies via an undici dispatcher, falling back to system proxy or direct connection.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 auto 虚拟模型 provider，按请求内容自动挑选视觉、长上下文或默认后端，并在首个内容产出前按链回退。
description.en: An auto routing provider for DeepSeek Harness that registers a virtual `auto` model, picking vision, long-context or default backends per request and falling back along a chain before any content is emitted.

description.zh: dsh-llm-xai-oauth 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生 SuperGrok/X Premium OAuth 模型提供商，复用本地 grok-bridge 令牌，无需 xAI API 密钥。
description.en: dsh-llm-xai-oauth provides a native SuperGrok/X Premium OAuth provider for DeepSeek Harness, reusing local grok-bridge tokens without an xAI API key.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 文本模型提供视觉与OCR能力的 DSH plugin，支持图片描述、文本提取，自动预处理、重试与持久缓存，GUI 配置即装即用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives text-only models vision and OCR on DeepSeek Harness: describe_image and extract_text tools with auto-preprocessing, retries, and persistent cache, configured entirely in the GUI.

description.zh: dsh-llmwiki 是 DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先、源链接 Markdown wiki 存储与检索插件，提供确定性存储、检索与结构完整性检查。
description.en: dsh-llmwiki is a local-first, source-linked Markdown wiki storage and retrieval plugin for DeepSeek Harness, providing deterministic storage, retrieval, and structural-integrity checks.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上本地文件通道：在浏览器授权一个目录，agent 即可通过私有 WebSocket 直接列目录、读文件、写文件，字节只在内存转发，不落 DSH 宿主磁盘。
description.en: A DSH plugin that bridges your local disk to the agent: authorize a folder in the browser and the agent can list, read and write those files over a private WebSocket relay, with bytes forwarded in memory and never copied onto the DSH host.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供线级 LLM 调试能力，抓取每次模型调用的原始 HTTP 请求与响应报文，按会话归属展示在 LLM Trace 标签页与本地查看页中。
description.en: A wire-level LLM inspector for DeepSeek Harness that captures the raw HTTP request and response bodies of every model provider call, attributed per session and shown in an LLM Trace tab plus a loopback viewer page.

description.zh: 为 DSH 本地编码 agent 提供宿主托管的长周期任务看板：Next≤3、进行中、已完成并校验，自动注入精简状态文件与 STATUS.md，并在右栏与输入框显示进度芯片。
description.en: A host-owned long-horizon task board for local coding agents in DeepSeek Harness: Next≤3, in-flight, done+verify, with a tiny inject file, a one-way STATUS.md projection, and a rightbar/dock chip.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上上海、深圳两市数据条例的合规检查：7 条静态判据扫描代码库，交付前提示地方要求可能漏项。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds Shanghai and Shenzhen local data-regulation checks: seven static rules scan your codebase and flag locally required items that may be missing before delivery.

description.zh: DSH Local Share 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供本地优先的分享功能，可将选中的对话轮次导出为 Markdown、自包含 HTML 或长图，支持隐私脱敏且不上传数据。
description.en: DSH Local Share enables local-first sharing of DeepSeek Harness conversation turns as Markdown, self-contained HTML, or long PNG, with privacy-first redaction and no uploads.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 界面添加法语语言包，在设置中一键切换 Français，覆盖 58 个命名空间、2614 条文案，未翻译项自动回退英文。
description.en: French locale pack for the DeepSeek Harness interface, adding Français to the language selector with 58 namespaces and 2614 translated keys, falling back to English for missing strings.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供完整俄语本地化，作为 DSH plugin 注册 ru 语言与 65 个命名空间的翻译，支持俄语复数变格，缺失键自动回退英文。
description.en: A Russian localization pack for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: this DSH plugin registers the ru locale and translations for 65 namespaces, handles Russian plural forms, and falls back to English for missing keys.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补充繁体中文、日语、韩语、法语四种界面语言，完全离线运行，装好后在设置里切换即可。
description.en: Adds four extra UI locales to DeepSeek Harness (zh-TW, ja, ko, fr), fully offline with no model API calls, switchable in Settings.

description.zh: dsh-local-hanaccount 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供访问控制，支持密码、Passkey、IP 黑白名单及 Nginx 集成，保护公开部署的 DSH Web。
description.en: dsh-local-hanaccount is a DSH plugin providing access control with password, Passkey, IP whitelist/blacklist, and Nginx integration to secure publicly exposed DSH Web.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供繁體中文（台灣）語言包，安装后语言列表新增「繁體中文」，全界面自动简转繁，繁中浏览器自动切换。
description.en: A Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) locale pack for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: it adds 繁體中文 to the language list, converts the whole interface from Simplified to Traditional, and auto-switches for zh-TW browsers.

description.zh: DSH 日志分析插件：选择本机 Java 服务文本日志，自动识别异常类名与堆栈，提供 Web 仪表盘与 AI 研判。
description.en: A DSH plugin for Java service log analysis: pick local text logs, auto-detect exception classes and stack traces, and get a web dashboard plus AI diagnosis.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 dsh-web 增加登录门禁，支持用户名密码认证、scrypt 哈希与 AES-256-GCM 加密存储，并提供 CLI 管理账号，是 DSH plugin 的安全加固方案。
description.en: Adds a login gate to dsh-web in DeepSeek Harness, with username/password auth, scrypt hashing, AES-256-GCM encrypted storage, and CLI account management—a security hardening DSH plugin.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框加上长内容 Markdown 编辑弹窗，左右分栏实时预览，确认后一次写回草稿。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a long-form Markdown editor popup to the DeepSeek Harness input box, with live split-pane preview and one-click write-back.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供声明式提示词注入层，用类酒馆世界书的 JSON 规则文件控制分层锚点、蓝绿灯、可复现概率与三面正则替换。
description.en: A declarative prompt-injection layer for DeepSeek Harness: lorebook-style JSON rules control layered anchors, constant/selective keys, reproducible probability and three-surface regex rewrites.

description.zh: dsh-lost-and-found 是 DSH 本地文件记忆索引插件，只读扫描你指定的文件夹并写入 SQLite，按关键词、时间、类型快速找回忘记位置的文件。
description.en: dsh-lost-and-found is a DSH plugin that read-only indexes the folders you choose into a local SQLite database, so you can find forgotten files by keyword, time or type.

description.zh: dsh-mac-vision 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 macOS 原生视觉插件，利用 Apple Vision 在本地完成图片、剪贴板、屏幕与窗口的 OCR 和视觉检测，无需第三方 API 或模型。
description.en: dsh-mac-vision is a native macOS vision plugin for DeepSeek Harness, providing on-device OCR and visual detection for images, clipboard, screen, and windows via Apple Vision, with no third-party APIs or models.

description.zh: MADRank 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 用量统计与排行插件，本地默认记录 token 消耗、模型分布与连续活跃天数，可选匿名加入全球 7 日 Token 竞赛并生成分享卡片。
description.en: MADRank is an AI usage and ranking plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): it tracks token usage, top models and streaks in a private local dashboard, with optional anonymous opt-in to a global 7-day token race and one-click share cards.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供从 Magpie 上游同步模型输入模态与 thinking level 的 DSH plugin，自动过滤 DSH 不支持的档位。
description.en: A DSH plugin that syncs input modalities and thinking levels from the Magpie upstream into DeepSeek Harness, filtering out levels DSH does not support.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 Codex 风格的受控审批，新增“替我批准”预设，通过无工具审查器评估风险并授予一次性权限，失败时回退人工审批。
description.en: Adds Codex-inspired managed approval to DeepSeek Harness, introducing an 'Approve for me' preset that uses a tool-free reviewer to assess risk and grant one-time permissions, falling back to human approval on failure.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供输入框实时 Markdown 渲染的 DSH 插件，支持源码切换、粘贴转 Markdown 与用户消息 Markdown 展示。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that live-renders Markdown in the composer, with source-mode toggle, paste-to-Markdown and Markdown-rendered user messages.

description.zh: dsh-maclens 将 Apple 端侧 Vision 框架桥接为 DeepSeek Harness 的本地工具，提供 OCR、图像分类、人脸检测与文档版面分析，全程离线、无需 API key。
description.en: dsh-maclens bridges Apple's on-device Vision framework into DeepSeek Harness as local tools for OCR, image classification, face detection, and document layout — fully offline, no API key.

description.zh: DSH plugin 版 Markdown 工具箱，可整目录批量转 Word、生成目录、提取链接并按文件名合并，产物独立输出不改原文件。
description.en: A Markdown toolbox DSH plugin that batch-converts folders to Word, builds tables of contents, extracts links and merges files by name, writing outputs separately without touching sources.

description.zh: dsh-markdown-memory 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Markdown 文件夹的长期记忆：每个事实一个文件，人类可编辑、可 git 版本化，零基础设施，直接挂载你的 Obsidian 仓库。
description.en: dsh-markdown-memory provides Markdown-folder long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: one file per fact, human-editable and git-versionable, zero infrastructure, mounts your Obsidian vault directly.

description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面端带来 Material Design 主题的 DSH plugin，内置 32 套官方调色板与 33 个强调色，并完整映射界面令牌与语法高亮。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings the official Material Design Experience palettes to DSH Desktop, with 32 themes, 33 accent colors, and full UI token plus syntax highlighting mapping.

description.zh: 面向 DSH Desktop 的 MATLAB 实验工作台插件，经官方 MATLAB MCP 执行代码，核验 PNG/CSV 与指标并对比 PID 参数扫描结果。
description.en: A MATLAB experiment workbench DSH plugin for DSH Desktop that runs code via the official MATLAB MCP, verifies PNG/CSV outputs and metrics, and compares PID parameter sweeps.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 对话窗口铺上黑客帝国数字雨背景，agent 生成的 token 原文实时掺进雨柱，雨势随活跃度起伏，透明度与配色可调。
description.en: Paints a Matrix-style digital rain background over the DeepSeek Harness chat window, feeding live agent tokens into the falling columns with activity-driven intensity and adjustable opacity and colors.

description.zh: DSH plugin for MaxCompute：提供元数据浏览、成本门控SQL执行、后台任务与结果导出，让AI安全分析阿里云MaxCompute数据。
description.en: DSH plugin for MaxCompute: metadata browsing, cost-gated SQL execution, background jobs and result export for safe AI-driven data analytics.

description.zh: DSH 插件：通过 WebHID 在侧边栏实时显示迈从鼠标电量与连接模式，无需驱动，自动切换有线/无线。
description.en: A DSH plugin that uses WebHID to show Mchose mouse battery level and connection mode in the sidebar, no driver needed.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 自动发现并挂载项目根目录 .agents/mcp.json 中声明的 MCP 服务器，会话结束即断开，跨项目互不干扰。
description.en: A DSH plugin that auto-discovers MCP servers declared in a project's .agents/mcp.json and mounts them per agent session, closing connections when the session ends.

description.zh: DSH 插件：把 JetBrains IDE 内置 MCP Server 接成工具，让智能体直接调用诊断、构建、读写文件、数据库与终端能力，并管理多 IDE 连接与自动重连。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects JetBrains IDE built-in MCP servers as tools, letting agents use diagnostics, builds, file I/O, databases and terminals, with multi-IDE connection management and auto-reconnect.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在会话编辑器工具栏添加 MCP 状态胶囊，实时显示服务器连接情况，点击可查看传输方式、工具数量与失败原因，只读零配置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a live MCP status pill to the composer tool row, showing connection state, per-server transport, tool count, and failure reason on click. Read-only and zero-config.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的每个工作区单独配置 MCP 服务器，会话只看到所属项目的 MCP 工具，支持项目内 .dsh/mcp.json 与设置页管理。
description.en: A DSH plugin that scopes MCP servers per workspace in DeepSeek Harness, so each session only sees the MCP tools of its own project, managed via settings page or .dsh/mcp.json.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 MCP 服务器管理：在 Web 设置页或 Agent 工具中增删改启停并测试 stdio 与 Streamable HTTP 服务器，运行时热生效无需重启 DSH。
description.en: MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness: add, edit, enable, test and remove stdio or Streamable HTTP MCP servers from the Web settings page or agent tools, taking effect at runtime with no DSH restart.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 MCP 服务器管理：在 Web 设置页或 Agent 工具中增删改启停并测试 stdio 与 Streamable HTTP 服务器，运行时热生效无需重启 DSH。
description.en: MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness: add, edit, enable, test and remove stdio or Streamable HTTP MCP servers from the Web settings page or agent tools, taking effect at runtime with no DSH restart.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 MCP 服务器管理：在 Web 设置页或 Agent 工具中增删改启停并测试 stdio 与 Streamable HTTP 服务器，运行时热生效无需重启 DSH。
description.en: MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness: add, edit, enable, test and remove stdio or Streamable HTTP MCP servers from the Web settings page or agent tools, taking effect at runtime with no DSH restart.

description.zh: dsh-mcp-plus 是 DSH 的增强型 MCP 客户端插件，在设置界面图形化管理多台 MCP 服务器，支持增删改配置、实时查看连接状态，并自动发现工具注册给 Agent 使用。
description.en: dsh-mcp-plus is an enhanced MCP client plugin for DeepSeek Harness that manages multiple MCP servers from the settings UI, with config editing, live connection status, and automatic tool discovery and registration for the Agent.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供通用 MCP 管理与客户端桥接，可在设置中可视化接入 HTTP 与 stdio 服务，并支持 OAuth 2.1、Bearer 令牌等认证方式。
description.en: A universal MCP manager and client bridge for DeepSeek Harness, letting you visually add HTTP and stdio MCP servers with OAuth 2.1, Bearer token, or custom header auth.

description.zh: dsh-mcp-proxy 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 代理插件，仅注册两个工具即可按需访问任意 MCP 服务器，大幅降低系统提示词开销。
description.en: dsh-mcp-proxy is a DSH plugin that provides lazy MCP access with only two registered tools, keeping prompt cost constant regardless of server count.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供生命周期安全的 MCP 连接状态胶囊，可在输入框角落显示并一键开关各 MCP 连接，默认隐藏，附官方设置卡片。
description.en: A lifecycle-safe MCP connection status pill for DeepSeek Harness Web, showing and toggling each MCP connection from a composer-corner pill that stays hidden by default, with an official Settings card.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在「设置」界面新增 MCP 服务器管理页，直接增删改配置文件中的 MCP 服务器，支持连接状态、启停开关与配置校验。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds an MCP server management page to the Settings panel, letting you add, edit, delete and toggle MCP servers in config files with live status.

description.zh: DSH 侧边栏插件，统一管理 DSH、Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 agent 工具的 skill 与 MCP 服务器配置，支持增删改查、跨工具共享、市场安装与备份恢复。
description.en: A DSH sidebar plugin that manages skills and MCP servers across DSH, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agent tools, with CRUD, cross-tool sharing, marketplace install and backup/restore.

description.zh: DSH plugin 同步 Claude Code、Codex CLI 与 Cursor Agent 的 MCP 配置，扫描本地配置并注册工具供模型调用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that syncs MCP configs from Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Cursor Agent, scanning local configs and registering tools for model invocation.

description.zh: DSH 插件：通过出站隧道（mcp-proxy + cloudflared）将本地 MCP 服务器安全暴露给远程 Agent，并自动注册公开 URL 到 dsh-mcp-client。
description.en: DSH plugin: expose a local MCP server to remote agents via outbound-only tunnel (mcp-proxy + cloudflared) and register the public URL into dsh-mcp-client.

description.zh: DSH plugin：在 dsh-better-sidebar 侧边栏内将 Markdown 富渲染为预览，支持代码高亮、目录导航与一键复制，提升文档阅读体验。
description.en: A DSH plugin that renders Markdown as rich previews inside the dsh-better-sidebar, with syntax highlighting, TOC, and one-click copy.

description.zh: DSH plugin 基于本机 ffmpeg 批量处理视频：压缩、转码、抽帧、提取音频、加水印与烧录字幕，输入只读、输出独立目录。
description.en: A DSH plugin that batch-processes video locally with ffmpeg: compress, transcode, extract frames and audio, add watermarks, and burn in subtitles, with read-only inputs and separate output folders.

description.zh: dsh-media-guard 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供确定性媒体预算管理，压缩超大图片、去重并生成证据笔记，确保请求安全。
description.en: dsh-media-guard provides deterministic media budgets for DeepSeek Harness, compressing oversized images, deduplicating, and generating evidence notes to keep requests safe.

description.zh: DSH 统一设置中心插件，把散落各处的第三方设置入口收进一处，支持收纳与折叠两种模式分组管理，并集中提供 dsh 界面优化开关。
description.en: A unified settings hub plugin for DeepSeek Harness that gathers scattered third-party settings entries into one place, with collect and fold modes for grouped management plus centralized DSH UI optimization toggles.

description.zh: 为 DSH 本地编码 Agent 提供有界文件记忆：用 ME.md 与项目 MEMORY.md 注入新会话，配合 Memory 侧栏人工审核收件箱，无向量库与 LLM 调用。
description.en: Bounded-file memory for local coding agents in DeepSeek Harness: inject a short ME.md and project MEMORY.md into new sessions, with a Memory rightbar for human-curated inbox promotion — no embeddings, no LLM calls.

description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏补上音视频预览能力，通过支持 Range 的流式路由，让远程浏览器也能播放并拖动进度。
description.en: Adds audio and video previews to the DSH right Sidebar, streaming over a Range-capable route so remote browsers can play and seek large files.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化、可搜索的项目记忆：决策、规则与会话上下文存入 DuckDB，规则注入每次模型请求，并提供 Web 管理界面。
description.en: Persistent, searchable per-project memory for DeepSeek Harness: decisions, rules, and session context in DuckDB, with rules injected into every model request and a full management UI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化、可搜索的项目记忆：决策、规则与会话上下文存入 DuckDB，规则注入每次模型请求，并提供 Web 管理界面。
description.en: Persistent, searchable per-project memory for DeepSeek Harness: decisions, rules, and session context in DuckDB, with rules injected into every model request and a full management UI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化、可搜索的项目记忆：决策、规则与会话上下文存入 DuckDB，规则注入每次模型请求，并提供 Web 管理界面。
description.en: Persistent, searchable per-project memory for DeepSeek Harness: decisions, rules, and session context in DuckDB, with rules injected into every model request and a full management UI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来 L1 原文、L2 短期摘要、L3 长期事实、L4 全量存档四层记忆，自动判分筛选并注入提示，附设置页可视化管理。
description.en: A four-tier memory DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness: raw window, short-term summaries, long-term facts and full archive, auto-scored and injected into prompts, with a settings panel.

description.zh: DSH plugin 记忆遗忘引擎：为 AI Agent 的每条记忆设定 TTL、衰减与淘汰策略，注入前按 token 预算筛选，全程审计，对抗记忆污染与投毒。
description.en: A DSH plugin forgetting engine that gives AI-agent memories a TTL, decay and eviction policy, injects under a token budget with full audit, fighting memory pollution and poisoning.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地内存与会话日志守护，监控堆占用、拦截超大工具参数，并可离线压缩膨胀的会话日志。
description.en: A local-only memory and session-log guard for DeepSeek Harness that monitors heap usage, blocks oversized tool arguments, and vacuums bloated session logs offline.

description.zh: 为 DSH plugin 提供按工作区隔离的本地记忆库，手动开启后把聊天沉淀为分级记忆卡，规则须经你确认才写入。
description.en: A workspace-isolated local memory library for the DSH plugin that distills chats into tiered memory cards once you opt in, with rules written only after your approval.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可治理的本地长期记忆：作用域隔离、来源溯源、冲突审核与召回预算控制，并附带 Web 面板。
description.en: Local-first governed long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness, with scope isolation, provenance, conflict review, bounded recall and a Web dashboard.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供后台观察式记忆：长会话在每轮结束后自动沉淀观察与反思，压缩时以系统提示注入，避免上下文丢失。
description.en: Background observational memory for DeepSeek Harness: long sessions quietly distill observations and reflections after each turn and inject them as a system-prompt section, so context survives compaction.

description.zh: DSH plugin 记忆回廊在上下文压缩前把较早的完整对话逐轮归档到工作区 memory-palace/ 目录，支持按类别检索与按轮次读回原文。
description.en: A DSH plugin that archives older conversation turns verbatim into a workspace-local memory-palace/ directory before compaction, then lets the model search and read the original wording back.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久记忆：模型自动保存用户画像与自身笔记，每次对话以可见上下文注入，并可在你授权后检索历史会话。
description.en: Persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness: the model keeps a user profile and its own notes, injected into every chat as visible context, plus approval-gated search over earlier sessions.

description.zh: Memory Unlocked 是一款 DSH plugin，通过官方 sessionQuery 服务找回当前工作区被压缩掉的早期对话，支持触发词自动回顾与 recall_history 工具检索。
description.en: Memory Unlocked is a DSH plugin that uses the official sessionQuery service to recall compressed earlier conversations in the current workspace, with trigger-word auto recall and a recall_history tool.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供长期记忆的 DSH 插件：会话开始时注入 Markdown 记忆库，记录读取痕迹，并在回合结束时提醒写回结论，纯 Markdown + git 存储。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness long-term memory: it injects a Markdown memory library at session start, tracks which memory files were read, and reminds the agent to write conclusions back at turn end — all stored as plain Markdown + git.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话全局记忆与用户级系统提示词：模型可主动写入事实，每轮仅注入轻量索引，不占对话上下文。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness cross-session global memory and user-level system prompts: the model writes facts and only a lightweight index is injected each turn, without consuming conversation context.

description.zh: 梦婆·记忆是 DSH plugin，为 DeepSeek Harness 的全局记忆与项目 insights 提供可视化界面，可查看、编辑、禁用、删除条目，让记忆不再黑盒。
description.en: Mengpo Memory is a DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness a visual UI for global memory and per-project insights, letting you browse, edit, disable, and delete entries instead of leaving memory a black box.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Mermaid 图表渲染的 DSH plugin：默认按需渲染、跟随主题配色，并支持全屏缩放查看。
description.en: A DSH plugin that renders Mermaid diagrams in DeepSeek Harness on demand, follows the live theme palette, and opens any diagram in a fullscreen zoom-and-pan viewer.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 中的 Mermaid 图提供缩放、拖拽平移、双击重置与 2x PNG 复制导出，纯浏览器端 DOM 增强，自动接管流式渲染完成的图。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds zoom, drag-pan, double-click reset and 2x PNG copy export to Mermaid diagrams in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, as a pure browser-side DOM enhancement.

description.zh: DSH web 消息定位侧栏插件：会话页右侧指令导航条一键列出用户指令并平滑滚动定位历史消息，支持 ↑/↓ 历史穿梭回填。
description.en: A DSH plugin for web message navigation: a rail on the session page lists user commands and smoothly scrolls to history messages, with ↑/↓ history recall.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 消息原地编辑插件，hover 历史用户消息即可修改，并在同会话从编辑点截断旧回复重新生成，无需新开会话。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for in-place message editing: hover a past user message, edit it, and the same session truncates the old replies from that point and regenerates them.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供可拖动的消息盒子，把对话完成与待审批请求收进浮动收件箱，支持一键跳转和原地审批。
description.en: A draggable message box for the DeepSeek Harness web UI that collects finished-conversation and pending-approval notices into a floating inbox with jump-to-conversation and inline approval.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 移植 Codex 风格的会话消息导航轨道，在聊天区左侧自动绘制消息刻度，支持悬停摘要、点击跳转与拖动扫览，提升长会话导航效率。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings Codex-style message map to DeepSeek Harness, rendering a vertical message ruler on the left of chat for quick navigation, hover summaries, and drag-scrolling.

description.zh: 把 Xiaomi Miloco 智能家居接入 DeepSeek Harness 的桥接插件，用专用 Agent 预设隔离 56 个工具与 18 个技能，并支持感知事件主动推送。
description.en: A DSH plugin that bridges Xiaomi Miloco into DeepSeek Harness, isolating its 56 tools and 18 skills in a dedicated Agent preset while relaying perception events as push notifications.

description.zh: 为 DSH 接入小米 MiMo 云端语音识别，让 DSH Go 输入框麦克风直接云端转写，手机端无需下载本地模型。
description.en: Connects Xiaomi MiMo cloud speech recognition to DSH, so the DSH Go composer microphone transcribes in the cloud with no local model download.

description.zh: dsh-migrate 是一个 DSH plugin，可将 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等 AI 代理的聊天历史与记忆导入 DeepSeek Harness，成为原生可搜索、可续聊的会话日志。
description.en: dsh-migrate is a DSH plugin that imports chat history and memory from other AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.) into DeepSeek Harness as native, searchable, resumable session logs.

description.zh: dsh-mindmap-chat 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 对话分支思维导图插件，将同一对话树的所有分支以实时思维导图呈现，支持分组归档、压缩回看与关键词搜索，让分支管理一目了然。
description.en: dsh-mindmap-chat is a DSH plugin that renders all branches of a conversation tree as a live mind-map, with group archiving, pre-compaction review, and keyword search for clear branch management.

description.zh: MindSee 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，通过将截图和本地图片转为文字描述，让 DeepSeek 能看图作答，无需切换视觉模型。
description.en: MindSee is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets DeepSeek see screenshots and local images by converting them to text descriptions, no vision model switch needed.

description.zh: DSH 扫雷插件：Agent 与人类共享同一棋盘对战，提供完整扫雷工具集与 Web 侧边栏面板，支持防作弊与终局事件广播。
description.en: DSH minesweeper plugin: Agent and human share one board, with full toolset and web sidebar panel, anti-cheat and game-over event.

description.zh: 明眸 VisionBridge 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，为纯文本模型自动调用视觉模型识别图片，将结果回传主模型，全程无感，支持多提供商与可视化配置。
description.en: Mingmu is a DSH plugin that gives text-only models vision by automatically calling a vision model to describe images and feeding the result back to the main model, with multi-provider support and visual configuration.

description.zh: DSH plugin 把当前会话弹出为独立置顶小窗，内置整屏与框选截图，划词即弹「问大肥鱼」药丸引用原文。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pops the current session into an always-on-top WebView2 mini window with full-screen and region screenshots, plus a selection pill that quotes highlighted text.

description.zh: 把 mint issue 跟踪接入 DeepSeek Harness 会话：开场注入待办概览，自动登记提交与变更，并让宿主计划始终绑定 mint 计划。
description.en: Brings mint issue tracking into DeepSeek Harness sessions: an opening overview of open issues, automatic registration of commits and changes, and host plans always bound to a mint plan.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Web UI 右下角显示可拖动的 MiniMax Token Plan 用量气泡，复用已配置的订阅 Key，悬停查看详情并自动刷新。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows a draggable MiniMax Token Plan usage bubble in the Web UI, reusing configured subscription keys with hover details and auto-refresh.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 details 面板带来猜数字、2048、扫雷三款纯前端小游戏，一键安装、无后端，最高分本地持久化，并自带悬浮开关。
description.en: Adds three pure-frontend mini-games (Guess Number, 2048, Minesweeper) to the DeepSeek Harness details panel, one-command install, no backend, high scores persisted locally, with a floating toggle.

description.zh: dsh-mmx 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 MiniMax CLI 桥接插件，将 mmx 的网络搜索与图像理解接入 DSH，实现搜索自动回退与纯文本模型透明识图。
description.en: dsh-mmx is a MiniMax CLI bridge for DeepSeek Harness, integrating mmx web search and image understanding into DSH with automatic search fallback and transparent image description for text-only models.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生 Mixture-of-Agents 生成时融合：每轮多个参考模型并行起草，由单一执行模型带完整工具能力作答。
description.en: Native Mixture-of-Agents generation-time fusion for DeepSeek Harness: reference models draft in parallel each turn while one acting model executes with full tooling.

description.zh: Mnemos 是 DeepSeek Harness 的跨模型连续性插件，把记忆、技能与规则存成本地文件，换会话或换模型后仍能精确接续判断。
description.en: Mnemos is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for cross-model continuity: it keeps memory, skills and rules in local files so judgments carry over across sessions and models.

description.zh: DSH plugin 手机端 Web UI：在同一局域网用手机浏览全部会话、看流式回复并继续对话，桌面左下角提供二维码入口。
description.en: A DSH plugin that serves a mobile web UI over your LAN, letting you browse all sessions, watch streaming replies and continue conversations from a phone, with a QR entry in the desktop corner.

description.zh: DSH plugin 手机端 Web UI：在同一局域网用手机浏览全部会话、看流式回复并继续对话，桌面左下角提供二维码入口。
description.en: A DSH plugin that serves a mobile web UI over your LAN, letting you browse all sessions, watch streaming replies and continue conversations from a phone, with a QR entry in the desktop corner.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供移动端响应式 UI 的 DSH plugin，自动检测视口、注入触控友好样式、添加底部导航栏，并暴露 mobileViewport 服务供其他插件订阅。
description.en: A DSH plugin that makes the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI touch-friendly on mobile, with viewport detection, responsive CSS, bottom navigation, and a mobileViewport service for other plugins.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 switch_mode 工具，在切换瞬间注入 planner、analyst、explorer、executor 等五种工作模式的方法论，让 agent 按阶段调整姿态而不污染系统提示词。
description.en: A DSH plugin exposing a switch_mode tool that injects one of five working-mode methodologies (planner, analyst, explorer, executor, base) at the moment of the switch, so agents adapt posture per phase without polluting the system prompt.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供技能管理面板：按模式开关技能、搜索打标签、创建编辑导入与版本管理，并可从 GitHub 安装技能。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a Skills panel to DeepSeek Harness: toggle skills per agent mode, search and tag them, create, edit, import and version skills, and install them from GitHub.

description.zh: dsh-model-billing 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面插件，可自定义模型顺序、维护三档 token 价格，并按轮次与会话估算费用。
description.en: A DSH plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI that lets you reorder models, set three-tier token prices, and estimate per-turn and per-session cost.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供设置页技能编辑器，把自定义条目发布进技能注册表，模型可按需加载，插件本身不执行任何命令。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a Settings-page skill editor, publishing your entries into the Harness skill registry so the model can load them on demand — nothing is ever executed.

description.zh: 把设计与代码中的行为断言抽成可执行模型并跑引擎核验的 DSH 插件，覆盖 UML、状态机、数据迁移与并发断言路由，产出带哈希可复算的报告。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns behavioral claims in designs and code into executable models and runs them through an engine — UML, state machines, data migrations and concurrency claim routing, with hash-stamped, reproducible reports.

description.zh: DSH 插件：主模型超时或断连时自动按顺序切到备用模型并在同一步重试，避免整轮对话报错，设置页即可挑选备用模型。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that automatically switches to fallback models in order and retries within the same step when the primary model times out or disconnects, avoiding a failed turn.

description.zh: DSH plugin 模型选型部署分析工具：输入模型、GPU/NPU、节点数等参数，估算显存、时延、吞吐与功耗，并给出可审计的部署建议。
description.en: DSH plugin for LLM model selection & deployment analysis: estimate VRAM, latency, throughput and power for 38 models × 20 GPUs/NPUs, with auditable recommendations.

description.zh: DSH plugin 模型故障转移队列：当前模型限额、限流或不可用时自动切到队列下一个模型续跑，开关与队列均在设置页图形化配置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that queues model fallbacks: when the current model hits quota, rate limits or goes down, requests switch to the next model automatically, all configured from the Settings UI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供模型 API 精准代理路由：只让指定模型或提供方的请求走代理，其余流量保持直连，无需开启系统全局代理。
description.en: A DSH plugin that routes model-API traffic per model or provider through a proxy while all other requests stay direct, no system-wide proxy needed.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在设置页提供模型健康面板，一键批量测试所有已配置模型的可用性与延迟，并支持对话中查看模型清单。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a model health panel to settings, batch-testing availability and latency of all configured models, plus a list_models tool for in-chat use.

description.zh: DSH plugin：为自定义网关里只写了名字的模型按模型名补齐上下文长度、输出上限、推理等级与视觉支持，不改动你的设置文件。
description.en: A DSH plugin that looks up custom-gateway models by bare name and fills in context window, output cap, reasoning levels and vision support — without touching your settings.

description.zh: DSH plugin 实现结构化跨模型同行评审：盲答、匿名互评、修订与确定性裁决，让多个大模型共同审议问题。
description.en: A DSH plugin for structured cross-model peer review: blind answers, anonymous critique, revision, and deterministic verdicts.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供两级模型选择界面，先选供应商再选模型，支持分层搜索与思考强度切换，让多供应商环境下的模型切换更清晰。
description.en: A two-level model picker for DeepSeek Harness that lets you choose a provider first, then a model, with layered search and reasoning-effort selection for clearer switching across multiple providers.

description.zh: DSH 插件，自动从 models.dev 目录补全同步模型的缺失元数据（显示名称、上下文窗口、最大输出 token、推理档位、输入模态），让模型立即可用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that automatically fills missing model metadata (display name, context window, max output tokens, reasoning efforts, input modalities) from the models.dev catalog, making synced models immediately usable.

description.zh: DSH plugin 按模型/提供商粒度路由代理（http/https/socks5），带设置界面，解决部分模型需代理而其他直连的问题。
description.en: A DSH plugin that routes specific provider/model pairs through proxies (http/https/socks5) with a settings UI, solving per-model proxy needs.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在设置页配置全局模型请求重试预算，为各活跃提供商写入 retryPolicy.maxRetries，保留退避与可重试码。
description.en: A DSH plugin that configures the global model-request retry budget from Settings, writing retryPolicy.maxRetries for active providers while preserving backoff and retryable-code fields.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多来源模型轮询链的 DSH plugin：按来源分组排序模型，额度用尽或报错时自动降级并重发，还能看到实际作答的模型。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns your LLM subscriptions into an ordered, self-healing model chain: group models by source, auto-failover on quota or errors with step resend, and see which model actually answered.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面的模型切换器添加搜索框，按模型名、ID 或提供商即时过滤模型列表，同时保留所有官方交互。
description.en: Adds a search box to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI model switcher, filtering models by name, ID, or provider instantly while preserving all official interactions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面的模型切换器添加搜索框，按模型名、ID 或提供商即时过滤模型列表，同时保留所有官方交互。
description.en: Adds a search box to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI model switcher, filtering models by name, ID, or provider instantly while preserving all official interactions.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让你直接在 DSH Desktop 设置中配置模型请求自动重试上限，无需修改核心代码，即装即用。
description.en: A DSH plugin to configure the maximum automatic model-request retry limit directly from DSH Desktop settings, no core patch required.

description.zh: DSH 模型选择器增强插件：一级菜单快速选模型与思考档位，支持自定义模型别名，并实时显示高峰低谷计价倒计时。
description.en: Enhanced model selector for DSH: quick model and thinking-tier selection in one menu, custom model aliases, and peak/off-peak pricing countdown.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI 提供模型搜索功能的插件，在模型选择弹窗中注入关键字搜索框，实时过滤模型与推理等级，支持快捷键与自动隐藏，装完即用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a keyword search box to model selection dialogs in the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, enabling real-time filtering of models and reasoning levels with hotkeys and auto-hide.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设置页新增「模型 Ultra」入口，提供 llm-pi-ai 提供商的全生命周期管理 UI，涵盖增删改、启停、模型发现、逐模型思考强度与 OpenRouter 路由。
description.en: Adds a Model Ultra panel to DeepSeek Harness settings, giving llm-pi-ai providers a full lifecycle management UI with CRUD, enable/disable, model discovery, per-model thinking effort and OpenRouter routing.

description.zh: DSH More 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 补齐上下文与历史控制能力，提供可独立启停的补丁，支持编辑消息重开、删除单条消息及永久删除会话。
description.en: DSH More adds missing context and history controls to DeepSeek Harness Web with independently switchable patches, enabling message editing, single-message deletion, and permanent session deletion.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为自定义网关或中转的 GPT、Codex、Gemini 等模型声明推理级别，让模型选择器显示推理强度选项，并写入 settings.yaml 配置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that declares per-model reasoning levels for custom gateway or relay models (GPT, Codex, Gemini, etc.), enabling the reasoning-level picker and writing reasoningEfforts into settings.yaml.

description.zh: Mojie 出品的 DSH plugin，用一个 Key 把 GPT、Claude、Gemini 等主流模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，并提供 /image 生图命令与原生画图工具。
description.en: A DSH plugin by Mojie that connects GPT, Claude, Gemini and other mainstream models to DeepSeek Harness with a single key, plus an /image command and native image-generation tools.

description.zh: 为 DSH 会话提供「晨报」式首页标签页：从持久会话日志计算你离开期间发生了什么、哪里出错、还有什么在等你，全程不经过模型生成。
description.en: A Morning Paper tab for DeepSeek Harness sessions: a computed front page folded from the durable session log showing what happened, what broke, and what is waiting on you — never written by a model.

description.zh: 面向电机电磁设计的 DSH 插件，提供 L0 毫秒级公式广筛、L1 RMxprt 与 L2 Motor-CAD 校核，从参数矩阵到几何验证一站式完成。
description.en: A DSH plugin for electric motor electromagnetic design, offering L0 millisecond formula screening plus L1 RMxprt and L2 Motor-CAD verification in one pipeline.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供电机设计 L0 快速预筛：用毫秒级经验公式把上千参数组合压缩到 TopN，并做物理一致性校验，无需 RMxprt 或 Python。
description.en: A DSH plugin for motor design L0 fast pre-screening: millisecond empirical formulas compress thousands of parameter combinations into a TopN shortlist with physics consistency checks, no RMxprt or Python required.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供模型开关：在设置页列出运行时段全部 provider 与模型，可逐个或整组关闭，被关模型立即从所有模型选择器消失。
description.en: A model switchboard for DeepSeek Harness: lists every runtime provider and model in Settings, letting you disable them individually or by group so hidden models vanish from all model pickers instantly.

description.zh: 这款 DSH plugin 让鼠标静止时背景模糊归零、移动或点击时按可调百分比模糊，适配 dsh-cool-theme 的图片与视频背景。
description.en: A lightweight DSH plugin that clears the background blur when the pointer is idle and applies an adjustable blur on move or click, working with dsh-cool-theme image and video backgrounds.

description.zh: 为每个 DSH workspace 接入 msg9.io 收件箱，Agent 用十三个工具收发邮件，人可在界面里查看同一份邮件。
description.en: Gives every DSH workspace its own msg9.io inbox: the agent sends and receives mail through thirteen tools while the human reads the same mailbox in the web UI.

description.zh: 为 DSH 项目添加副工作目录：在输入框「+」菜单里管理，用 @ 直接引用其中文件，Agent 获得同等读写与执行权限。
description.en: Secondary working directories for a DSH project: manage them from the composer "+" menu, reference their files with @, and give the agent equal read/write/exec rights.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框提供单行/多行切换的 DSH 插件，支持 Cmd/Ctrl+E 快捷键、常驻 tab 提示与 Shift+Enter 发送。
description.en: A DSH plugin that toggles the DeepSeek Harness composer between single-line and multi-line modes, with a Cmd/Ctrl+E shortcut, a persistent tab hint, and Shift+Enter to send.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框旁加 Muse 开关，右侧边栏打开 Muse Code 面板，与聊天工具共享同一会话，并默认设 $10 硬性花费上限。
description.en: Adds a Muse toggle beside the DeepSeek Harness input box that opens a Muse Code sidebar panel sharing one session with chat tools, with a default $10 hard spend cap.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多平台模型账户余额查询的 DSH 插件，注册 skill 与工具，一次可查 DeepSeek、豆包、千问、混元等已配置平台余额，只读且带缓存。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that queries model account balances across DeepSeek, Doubao, Qwen, Hunyuan and custom HTTP providers, registering a skill and tool with read-only, cached lookups.

description.zh: 让 DSH plugin 直接接管本地 MuMu 模拟器 12：通过 MuMuManager 与 adb 提供实例管理、应用装卸、点击滑动、截图等七个工具。
description.en: A DSH plugin that puts the local MuMu Player 12 emulator under model control, exposing seven mumu_ tools for instance, app, UI and screenshot operations via MuMuManager and adb.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来网易云音乐播放器与 AI DJ：侧边栏点歌、同步歌词、扫码登录，Agent 还能通过七个工具操控播放队列。
description.en: A NetEase Cloud Music player and AI DJ for DeepSeek Harness: sidebar playback, synced lyrics, QR sign-in, plus seven agent tools that drive the queue.

description.zh: DSH 原生 MUV 引擎，酒馆伴生插件，执行正则脚本、追踪变量状态、渲染状态栏与宏展开，增强角色扮演体验。
description.en: DSH native MUV engine, a tavern companion plugin that executes regex scripts, tracks variable state, renders status bar and macro expansion, enhancing roleplay experience.

description.zh: DSH 酒馆伴生插件，把角色卡 MUV 变量渲染成结构化表格，Agent 直接编辑表格即可生成格式完全正确的变量块，避免漏变量与标签错误。
description.en: A tavern companion DSH plugin that renders MUV variables from character cards as structured tables, letting the agent edit tables to emit perfectly formatted variable blocks.

description.zh: DSH plugin 只读清单：顶栏药丸显示当前 profile 实际加载的插件数，点开可搜索查看每个插件的版本、作者自述与自带/第三方来源。
description.en: A read-only DSH plugin inventory: a top-bar chip shows how many plugins your profile actually loads, and a searchable panel lists each one with its version, author-written summary, and built-in or third-party origin.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 装上「书呆子模式」：/study 分步讲解单个概念，/study-plus 用工作区记录跨会话追踪学习进度。
description.en: A study switch and study skills for DeepSeek Harness: /study teaches one concept step by step, while /study-plus keeps a dated workspace record so a subject spans weeks.

description.zh: 为 NapCat（QQ 协议端）提供看门狗能力的 DSH plugin：端口不通自动拉起、重复进程自动去重、扫码卡住自动重试，让 QQ 随 DSH 常驻在线。
description.en: A DSH plugin that acts as a watchdog for NapCat (QQ protocol backend): auto-launches when the port is down, dedupes duplicate process chains, retries stuck QR logins, and keeps QQ online alongside DSH.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供远程访问控制：在设置页切换仅本机、仅 Tailscale、所有本地网络或关闭四种模式，按请求校验 Host 授权来源，并明确提示何时需重启生效。
description.en: Controls how the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI is reachable: pick local-only, Tailscale-only, all local networks, or off from the settings page, with per-request Host trust fencing and clear restart hints.

description.zh: DSH plugin 收藏夹，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本机会话与网址收藏，支持快捷键快速切换收藏会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds local favorites for sessions and URLs in DeepSeek Harness, with hotkey switching between favorite sessions.

description.zh: dsh-netguard 是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，为 web_fetch 和 web_search 工具提供主机白名单策略，在连接时强制执行，支持审计与强制模式，并记录 OCSF 格式日志。
description.en: dsh-netguard is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides a host allowlist for the web_fetch and web_search tools, enforced at connect time, with audit and enforce modes, and OCSF logging.

description.zh: DSH plugin 聚合 User-Agent 改写、HTTP/SOCKS5 代理与请求自动重试，在 Web 设置的网络设置页统一配置，提升网络请求的灵活性与稳定性。
description.en: A DSH plugin bundling User-Agent rewriting, HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy, and auto-retry, all configured from a single Network tab in Web settings.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框提供下一条回复建议的 DSH 插件：助手回复完成后在空白输入框显示候选下一句，按 Tab 填入草稿再编辑发送，沿用当前会话模型与凭据。
description.en: A DSH plugin that suggests your next message in the DeepSeek Harness input box: after the assistant finishes, a candidate reply appears as placeholder text, and Tab fills it into the draft for you to edit or send, reusing the current session's model and credentials.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框提供「下一句话」推荐水印，按 Tab 填入、Esc 关闭，支持桌面版与 dsh-tui。
description.en: A DSH plugin that suggests your next message as a watermark in the input box after each turn; press Tab to fill, Esc to dismiss, on desktop and dsh-tui.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 macOS 提供系统通知：在任务异常终止、需要你操作或正常完成时弹出横幅，点击直达应用，回到页面自动清空。
description.en: A DSH plugin delivering macOS notifications for abnormal termination, awaiting action, and normal completion, with click-to-open and auto-clear on return.

description.zh: 一个极简 DSH plugin，通过注入一条 CSS 规则隐藏主页 Logo 旁的「预览版」小标，零依赖、卸载即恢复原样。
description.en: A minimal DSH plugin that hides the "preview" badge next to the home logo by injecting a single CSS rule, with zero dependencies and full restoration on uninstall.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的猫猫桌宠插件，常驻 Web GUI 角落可随意拖动，先以久坐与喝水提醒为核心，四态循环动画陪伴你按时起身休息。
description.en: A draggable cat desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness that lives in the Web GUI corner, starting as a sedentary and hydration reminder with four looping state animations.

description.zh: dsh-node-repl 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供会话级 Node REPL 终端，可在对话中直接运行 JavaScript，并实时访问 agent 上下文（ctx、agent），提升 vibe-coding 调试效率。
description.en: dsh-node-repl adds a per-session Node REPL terminal to the DSH web UI, letting you run JavaScript inside conversations with live agent context (ctx, agent) in scope.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话界面提供按工作区独立的分段便签浮窗，支持拆分、拖拽、图片与一键插入发送。
description.en: A per-workspace floating segmented notepad for DeepSeek Harness sessions, with card splitting, drag reordering, images, and one-click insert or send.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话界面提供按工作区独立的分段便签浮窗，支持拆分、拖拽、图片与一键插入发送。
description.en: A per-workspace floating segmented notepad for DeepSeek Harness sessions, with card splitting, drag reordering, images, and one-click insert or send.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边栏笔记面板，集文件夹树、多标签页与 Markdown 实时预览编辑于一体，充当备忘录与目录阅读器。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a sidebar notes panel to DeepSeek Harness, combining a folder tree, browser-style tabs, and live Markdown preview editing as a memo pad and directory reader.

description.zh: 为 macOS 菜单栏添加 DSH 状态项，实时显示运行中的 Agent 数量与待处理提问、审批事件，点击即可切回已打开的 Harness 标签页。
description.en: A macOS menu bar status item for DeepSeek Harness that shows the running Agent count and pending question/approval events, and focuses the already-open Harness tab on click.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供轻量级桌面通知：任务跑完、模型提问或等待审批时弹出系统通知，只提醒不交互，支持 mac、Windows 与 Linux。
description.en: Lightweight desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness: get a system alert when a run finishes, asks a question, or waits for approval — notify only, no interaction, on macOS, Windows and Linux.

description.zh: 给 DSH Web GUI 换上 Nord 配色与可选字体，并在 composer 下方显示 DeepSeek 余额读数，附独立设置页。
description.en: A DSH plugin that skins the Web GUI with the Nord palette and optional fonts, adds a DeepSeek balance readout under the composer, and ships its own settings page.

description.zh: DSH 通知插件，在 Web GUI 设置页新增通知分区，实现事件驱动的声音提醒与企业微信/飞书消息推送。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a notification section to the Web GUI settings, enabling event-driven sound alerts and WeCom/Feishu message push.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供通知中心与 Windows 原生交互卡片，可在浏览器标签关闭时接收任务进度、回答问题并完成一次性审批。
description.en: A notification center and native Windows interactive cards for DeepSeek Harness, delivering task progress, questions, and one-time approvals even with the browser tab closed.

description.zh: 面向网文作者的 DSH plugin：写作台面板管理作品、章节、设定与大纲，内置世界构建引导、章节与大纲 AI 助手及 16 个弧光写作技能。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin for web-novel authors: a Writing Desk panel for works, chapters, settings and outlines, plus a worldbuilding wizard, chapter and outline AI assistants, and 16 CharacterArc writing skills.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 npm registry 管理能力，可查询包信息与版本、搜索仓库、发布或废弃包，并带网页设置面板。
description.en: NPM registry management for DeepSeek Harness: query package info and versions, search the registry, publish or deprecate packages, with a web settings panel.

description.zh: DSH 通知插件，在 Web GUI 设置页新增通知分区，实现事件驱动的声音提醒与企业微信/飞书消息推送。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a notification section to the Web GUI settings, enabling event-driven sound alerts and WeCom/Feishu message push.

description.zh: dsh-npm-runner 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，扫描当前工作区各包的 npm 脚本（不进入 node_modules），在会话头部一键后台运行并查看实时输出。
description.en: dsh-npm-runner is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that discovers npm scripts across the current workspace (without walking node_modules) and runs any of them in the background with live output.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供护理记录合规校验：读取住院病程的护理记录、医嘱与评估单，按版本化规则包逐条比对条款并输出可追溯报告。
description.en: A DSH plugin that audits nursing documentation compliance: it reads inpatient nursing entries, orders and assessment forms, applies a versioned rule pack and returns a clause-cited report.

description.zh: dsh-nushell 是 DSH plugin，用 Nushell 执行内置 bash 工具，命令以 nu 运行，保持工具名 bash，兼容沙箱与审批机制。
description.en: dsh-nushell is a DSH plugin that runs the built-in bash tool with Nushell, executing commands via nu while keeping the tool name bash and preserving sandbox and approval mechanisms.

description.zh: 把 Obsidian 变成自组织 AI 第二大脑的 DSH plugin，提供 wiki 检索、写入、体检与脚手架工具及配套技能，让笔记库可被 Agent 直接读写维护。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns Obsidian into a self-organizing AI second brain, exposing wiki query, write, lint and scaffold tools plus matching skills so agents can read and maintain your vault.

description.zh: dsh-obvious-grid 是 DeepSeek Harness 的界面插件，提供全屏状态网格，让会话状态一目了然，并支持 ntfy 推送和本地警报，确保你不在电脑前也能及时获知任务完成、出错或等待审批。
description.en: dsh-obvious-grid is a DeepSeek Harness UI plugin that provides a fullscreen status grid for at-a-glance session monitoring, with ntfy push and local alarm support to keep you informed even when AFK.

description.zh: 把外部 ocr（open-code-review）CLI 封装成 DSH 的 5 个模型工具与 1 张设置卡片，让 Agent 直接发起代码审查、扫描与会话查询。
