description.en: Wraps the external ocr (open-code-review) CLI into 5 DSH model tools plus a settings card, letting the agent run code review, scans and session queries directly.

description.zh: DSH plugin 本地 OCR 视觉桥接：粘贴图片，经 macOS Vision 或 Tesseract 本地识别文字，让纯文本 DeepSeek 模型也能看图作答，无需新密钥或云端调用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that bridges OCR-level vision: paste images, read them locally via macOS Vision or Tesseract, and let your text-only DeepSeek model answer with no new keys or cloud calls.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Octen 搜索与网页抓取，让内置 web_search、web_fetch 直接走 Octen，无需学习新工具。
description.en: Wires Octen web search and page extraction into DeepSeek Harness, routing the built-in web_search and web_fetch tools through Octen with no new tool schema.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 DeepSeek Harness 会话活动标准化为 OCSF 1.9.0 记录，写入本地 spool 并可选转发至 Splunk HEC 或 OTLP/HTTP 收集器，供 SIEM 审计。
description.en: A DSH plugin that normalizes DeepSeek Harness session activity into OCSF 1.9.0 records, writing to a local spool and optionally shipping to Splunk HEC or OTLP/HTTP collectors for SIEM audit.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供办公效率技能专家组，通过标准技能注册表安装 excel2insights 与 sum2slides-pro 两个纯本地技能，无需手动复制文件。
description.en: Provides an office productivity skill suite for DeepSeek Harness, installing excel2insights and sum2slides-pro via the standard skills registry with no manual file copying.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地 OCR 能力，用 Apple Vision 或 tesseract 从截图、照片中提取文字，无需联网与 API Key，并标注低置信度行。
description.en: Local OCR for DeepSeek Harness: extract text from screenshots, photos and scans via Apple Vision or tesseract, with no network, no API key and low-confidence lines flagged.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）在输入框下方加一枚状态胶囊，实时显示当前所选 DeepSeek 或 z.ai 套餐是否处于峰谷半价时段，点击可展开完整计费时间表面板。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that adds an ambient pill under the composer showing whether your selected DeepSeek or z.ai plan is billed at peak or off-peak (half-price) rates right now, with a click-to-open schedule panel.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将会话复盘折叠为可独立打开的办公室动画仪表盘 HTML，含工作日志、产出物、token 统计与动画场景。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns session reviews into a standalone office-animated dashboard HTML with work logs, deliverables, token stats, and animations.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供直连官方视觉 API 的 DSH plugin，注册 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 多模态模型路由，图片直送官方 API，无需第三方模型。
description.en: A DSH plugin bridging DeepSeek Harness to the official vision API, registering the deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp multimodal model route and sending images directly to the official endpoint.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打包的个人生活质量插件：在会话菜单中彻底删除会话（含子会话与关联状态），并新增设置页扩展标签，可把内置 web_search 切到 OpenCode Go 搜索。
description.en: A personal quality-of-life bundle for DeepSeek Harness that permanently deletes sessions (including subagent children and related state) from the session menu and adds an Extend settings tab to route the built-in web_search through OpenCode Go.

description.zh: 这款 DSH plugin 在设置页新增 Ollama Cloud 额度面板，实时显示会话与每周剩余额度、模型请求数和近四周花费，并可直接填写或清除 API Key。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds an Ollama Cloud quota panel to Settings, showing session and weekly remaining usage, per-model request counts and last-4-weeks cost, with an in-page API key editor.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框加上润色、扩写与自动驾驶动作，借用当前会话模型把结果直接写回草稿。
description.en: Adds polish, expand and autopilot actions to the DeepSeek Harness composer, reusing the current session model and writing results straight back into the draft.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 变成 Windows 桌面应用：一键启动器、托盘控制，以及侧边栏按钮让 DSH 与 chat.deepseek.com 并排分屏。
description.en: Turns DeepSeek Harness into a Windows desktop app with a one-click launcher, tray controls, and a sidebar button that splits DSH and chat.deepseek.com side by side.

description.zh: DSH 插件「一个搜索」把内置网络搜索换成可排序的搜索引擎链，每个引擎独立开关、拖动排序，失败自动顺延下一个。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that replaces built-in web search with an ordered, toggleable engine chain that falls back to the next engine on failure.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Ollama Cloud 模型路由的 DSH plugin，支持原生与 OpenAI 兼容双协议、多账号轮换、余额用量统计与配额面板。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds an Ollama Cloud LLM route to DeepSeek Harness, with native and OpenAI-compatible transports, multi-account rotation, balance and usage tracking, and quota panels.

description.zh: dsh-open-in 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，让你从 Web 界面一键在 VS Code、文件管理器或终端等启动器中打开工作区目录，支持自定义启动目标。
description.en: dsh-open-in is a DSH plugin that opens workspace directories in a configurable launcher (VS Code, file explorer, terminal, etc.) directly from the web GUI.

description.zh: 让 DSH 交付卡片点击后直接用系统默认程序打开文件，不再跳进侧边栏内置预览，按住 Shift 仍可保留原预览行为。
description.en: A DSH plugin that makes delivered-file cards open in the system default app instead of the built-in sidebar preview, while Shift-click still keeps the original preview.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Web 界面中一键将当前工作区在本地编辑器打开，自动检测 VS Code、Cursor、Zed 等编辑器，并支持自定义配置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that opens the current workspace in a local editor from the Web GUI, auto-detecting editors like VS Code, Cursor, Zed, and supporting custom profiles.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入官方 OpenAI 账号登录、实时 GPT 模型目录与图像生成，登录全程在 OpenAI 官方页面完成，插件不接触 OAuth token。
description.en: Connects official OpenAI account sign-in, the live GPT model catalog, and image generation to DeepSeek Harness, with login completed on OpenAI's own page and no OAuth token handling.

description.zh: 为 DSH 提供低延迟浏览器工具，直连本地 OpenCLI 守护进程，省去每条命令的 Node 冷启动，把 1.4 秒级调用降到 10 毫秒级。
description.en: Low-latency browser tools for DSH that talk straight to the local OpenCLI daemon, skipping the per-command Node cold start and cutting ~1.4 s calls to ~10 ms.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 OpenAI Codex（ChatGPT 订阅）OAuth 认证与 codex LLM 提供商，支持订阅模型路由，无需 API key。
description.en: Adds OpenAI Codex (ChatGPT subscription) OAuth authentication and a codex LLM provider to DeepSeek Harness, enabling subscription model routing without an API key.

description.zh: 为 DSH Auto review 的 reviewer 请求补上被审会话身份，修复 OpenCode 网关 MissingSessionID 拒绝，让工具调用正常通过审查。
description.en: A DSH plugin that attaches the reviewed agent's session identity to Auto review requests, fixing OpenCode gateway MissingSessionID rejections so tool calls pass review.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenCode Go 与 Zen 实时模型目录，展示 token 费率、零费率过滤、协议选择与会话亲和路由。
description.en: Brings live OpenCode Go and Zen model catalogs into DeepSeek Harness, with token rates, zero-rate filtering, protocol selection and session-affinity routing.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Web GUI 中实时监控 OpenCode Go 套餐用量，展示 5h/7d/30d 用量环与重置倒计时，支持多凭据管理。
description.en: A DSH plugin that monitors OpenCode Go quota usage in the Web GUI, displaying 5h/7d/30d usage rings and reset countdowns with multi-credential management.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 OpenCode Go API 密钥池，按 rolling/weekly/monthly 配额自动切换密钥，并在 Settings 页与输入框徽标中展示用量。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pools OpenCode Go API keys and auto-switches them by rolling/weekly/monthly quota, with a Settings tab and a composer quota badge.

description.zh: DSH 插件自动同步 OpenCode Go 套餐模型清单到 pi-ai catalog，精确标记协议与多模态支持，同步后重启生效。
description.en: DSH plugin that syncs the OpenCode Go model catalog into pi-ai, accurately tagging protocols and multimodal support; restart to apply.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通过本机 OpenCode CLI 桥接 OpenCode 兼容模型，以原生 LlmAdapter 透传，无需 API Key，会话持久续接。
description.en: A DSH plugin that bridges OpenCode-compatible models through your local OpenCode CLI via a native LlmAdapter, with persistent session continuity and no API key.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在输入框下方常驻显示 OpenCode Go 套餐用量，三个窗口（滚动/每周/每月）实时可见，无需设置页。
description.en: A DSH plugin that docks OpenCode Go usage readout under the composer, showing rolling/weekly/monthly windows in real time without settings.

description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页查看 OpenCode GO 套餐额度，三张额度卡展示剩余百分比与重置倒计时，不占用侧栏，并提供 /opencode-go-quota 命令。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows OpenCode GO plan quota in Settings with three quota cards, reset countdowns, no sidebar footprint, plus an /opencode-go-quota command.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 钉住 OpenCode Go 上游路由的 DSH 插件：稳定注入 x-opencode-session，避免模型调用在多个上游间漂移降智，并提供 GUI 路由选择与漂移检测。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pins OpenCode Go upstream routing in DeepSeek Harness by always sending a stable x-opencode-session key, with an in-GUI route picker and drift checks to stop model calls from drifting across providers.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenCode 与 OpenCode Go 两条原生模型路由，支持多账号轮换、配额用量面板与请求热力图。
description.en: Adds native OpenCode and OpenCode Go model routes to DeepSeek Harness, with multi-account rotation, quota panels and a request heatmap.

description.zh: 为 DSH 在 OpenCode 路由上无 sessionId 的请求补上回退会话标识，修复 auto 审查因 400 MissingSessionID 而失败的问题。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects a fallback sessionId into session-less OpenCode requests, fixing auto-review failures caused by 400 MissingSessionID.

description.zh: DSH 插件，在 composer 工具行显示 OpenCode Zen 余额与用量环（5小时/周/月），点击打开用量面板，支持配置编辑与缓存。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows OpenCode Zen balance and usage rings (5h/weekly/monthly) in the composer tool row, with a usage panel and config editor.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框内以紧凑胶囊展示 OpenCode Go 订阅的 5 小时、每周与每月用量，点击可查看重置倒计时详情，零配置。
description.en: Shows OpenCode Go subscription usage (5-hour, weekly, monthly windows) as a compact pill in the DeepSeek Harness composer, with a click-open details dialog and zero configuration.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenCode Go 路由自动补上 x-opencode-session 请求头，修复 400 MissingSessionID 与自动审查失败问题。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects the required x-opencode-session header on OpenCode Go routes, fixing 400 MissingSessionID errors and failed auto-review calls.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenRouter 实时模型列表的 DSH plugin，模型一上线即可选用，并附带真实费用统计与子代理花费追踪。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a live OpenRouter provider route to DeepSeek Harness, so new models appear in the picker immediately, with real spend tracking including subagents.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框内以紧凑胶囊展示 OpenCode Go 订阅的 5 小时、每周与每月用量，点击可查看重置倒计时详情，零配置。
description.en: Shows OpenCode Go subscription usage (5-hour, weekly, monthly windows) as a compact pill in the DeepSeek Harness composer, with a click-open details dialog and zero configuration.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenRouter 真实账单：在输入框下方显示已计费花费，并提供按密钥、按模型的分析与预付余额。
description.en: Brings real OpenRouter billed spend into DeepSeek Harness: a chip under the composer plus per-key, per-model analytics and prepaid balance.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让主 Agent 主动并行调用子 Agent，支持任务拆分、对抗审查、多样性探索与后台收敛，提升多智能体协作效率。
description.en: A DSH plugin that enables the main agent to proactively delegate to subagents in parallel, with task splitting, adversarial review, diverse exploration, and background convergence.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 端会话区补上标签分类与归档管理：悬浮菱形按钮打开整理面板，可按标签分组筛选、归档隐藏与一键恢复，归档状态与原生侧边栏实时联动。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds tag-based grouping and archive management to DeepSeek Harness Web sessions: a floating diamond button opens an organizer panel with tag filters, archive hiding and one-click restore, synced live with the native sidebar.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自动比较 OpenRouter 各供应商的价格、速度、上下文与可靠性，为当前模型推荐 Top 5 线路并一键切换，帮助省钱。
description.en: DSH plugin ranks OpenRouter providers by cost, speed, context, and reliability, recommends top 5 routes for the current model, and switches with one click to save money.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原产地 RVC 台账算术校验工具，检查协定与产品申报、区域价值成分公式、材料原产地及占位符等七项规则。
description.en: A DSH plugin that registers the origin_rvc_check tool to audit origin/RVC ledgers for arithmetic: agreement and product declarations, the RVC deduction formula, material origins, unique material numbers and leftover placeholders.

description.zh: DSH plugin 会话级输出风格插件，通过 /style 命令与 Web 选择器切换表达方式和思考引导，改变模型如何组织答案，不改变模型、工具或权限。
description.en: A DSH plugin for session-scoped output styles, using /style commands and a Web selector to switch expression modes and thinking guides, altering how the model presents answers without changing models, tools, or permissions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供成果登记清单：agent 通过 DSH plugin 工具登记报告、网页、文档、图片等产物，人可在管理页检索预览，脚本也能查询。
description.en: A deliverables registry for DeepSeek Harness: agents register reports, pages, docs and datasets via DSH plugin tools, while humans browse and preview them in-app and scripts query the same list.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供持久化输出风格：在设置页选择内置风格或自建 Markdown 风格，选中后自动注入每个 Agent 的系统提示词，无需重启。
description.en: Persistent output styles for DeepSeek Harness Web: pick a built-in style or create named Markdown styles from Settings, and the chosen style is injected into every agent's system prompt without a restart.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话注入 OwlCoda RunKit 技能，把目标、验证凭证与交付阶段沉淀到项目产物中，而非依赖聊天记忆。
description.en: A DSH plugin that serves the OwlCoda RunKit skill to DeepSeek Harness sessions, keeping objectives, verification receipts and delivery stages in project artifacts rather than chat memory.

description.zh: dsh-palimpsest 是 DSH 宿主插件，让智能体在新会话中按需检索同一工作目录下的历史会话记忆，只读、不落盘、不注入 prompt。
description.en: dsh-palimpsest is a DSH host plugin that lets agents recall past sessions from the same working directory on demand — read-only, no extra storage, no prompt injection.

description.zh: DSH 插件让模型用 show_page 把回答做成一页可交互网页，直接嵌在对话里，跟随深浅色、自动存版本并支持导出。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets the model turn an answer into an interactive web page via show_page, embedded right in the chat with theme sync, versioning, and export.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏底部添加折叠按钮，一键收起或展开全局面板列表，为工作区腾出更多纵向空间，状态按浏览器配置记忆。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a sidebar footer button to collapse or expand the global panel list in DeepSeek Harness, freeing vertical space and remembering state per browser profile.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边栏面板收纳：把官方面板与第三方插件入口聚合到分组启动菜单，支持持久固定/取消固定、紧凑页脚与专属设置页。
description.en: A DSH plugin that tidies the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: it gathers official panels and third-party plugin entries into one grouped launcher, with persistent pin/unpin, a compact footer and a dedicated Settings page.

description.zh: DSH plugin 把一句话创意端到端做成剪纸风格竖版解说短片：脚本、本地配音、逐词字幕、Remotion 渲染与质检，全程原生 Windows 运行。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns a one-line idea into a finished vertical papercut explainer film — script, local TTS, word-timed captions, Remotion render and QA — natively on Windows.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框处理大段粘贴：4–50 KB 折叠成独立 chip，≥50 KB 自动转为真实文件附件并生成可点击卡片。
description.en: Inbound large-paste handling for the DeepSeek Harness composer: 4–50 KB pastes fold into individual chips, while ≥50 KB pastes become real file attachments with a clickable card.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的论文工作台：arXiv 检索入库、本地 PDF 全文抽取，并用 L1/L2/L3 三层结构逼你写下精读笔记。
description.en: A paper workbench DSH plugin: search arXiv, build a local library with PDFs and full text, and force structured L1/L2/L3 reading notes.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 DeepSeek 高峰期自动切换至备用模型，低谷期恢复官方模型，避开高峰定价，支持多时段与手动控制。
description.en: A DSH plugin that auto-switches to an alternate model during DeepSeek peak hours and restores the official model afterward, avoiding peak pricing with multi-window and manual control.

description.zh: DSH plugin 版 PDF 工具箱：一条命令完成合并、拆分、压缩、加水印、提取文本与图片，输入只读、产物独立可核对。
description.en: A PDF toolkit for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): merge, split, compress, watermark, and extract text or images in one command, with read-only inputs and verifiable outputs.

description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness网页界面添加浮动峰谷计费徽章，按北京时间自动显示当前时段（高峰2倍价/低谷半价），零配置，可拖动并记忆位置。
description.en: A floating peak/off-peak pricing badge for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, showing current billing period based on Beijing time with zero config.

description.zh: DSH plugin 主界面信息面板：实时显示 DeepSeek 峰谷价格与余额，支持分级低余额预警和一键充值按钮。
description.en: A DSH plugin info panel for the main web UI: live peak/off-peak pricing, account balance with tiered low-balance alerts, and a top-up button.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在输入框下方显示 DeepSeek 高峰/空闲时段、倒计时及会话实时成本，并支持其他模型固定费率与缓存命中趋势图。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows DeepSeek peak/off-peak periods, countdown, and live session cost under the composer, with flat rates for other models and a cache-hit trend chart.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入卡片上方加一条峰谷状态带，实时显示 DeepSeek 高峰/空闲时段与剩余时长，内置六套马卡龙主题与自定义 CSS。
description.en: Adds a peak/valley status band above the DeepSeek Harness input card, showing DeepSeek peak and off-peak windows with remaining time, six macaron themes and custom CSS.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供对等会话中继工具，让顶层 Agent 跨会话异步提交任务并实时接收结果，支持同工作区协作。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing peer session relay tools, enabling top-level agents to submit tasks across sessions asynchronously and receive results in real-time for same-workspace collaboration.

description.zh: dsh-pelican 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面插件，在右下角显示 SVG 鹈鹕骑行动画，并实时提示任务思考与完成状态。
description.en: dsh-pelican is a DSH plugin that adds a pelican cycling SVG animation at the bottom-right corner, with real-time task status notifications.

description.zh: DSH 峰谷价感知任务执行器：平价时段直接跑 deepseek-flash 任务批，峰价前自动排队并挂定时器，到下一个平价时段再执行，帮你省下约两倍差价。
description.en: A peak/off-peak price-aware task runner for DeepSeek Harness: it runs deepseek-flash batches during off-peak hours and queues jobs before peak pricing, firing them automatically at the next cheap window.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面右下角添加一只鲸鱼时钟，实时显示当前是否处于 DeepSeek API 高峰计费时段，并倒计时到下一个价格窗口切换点。
description.en: Adds a corner whale clock to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI that shows at a glance whether DeepSeek API calls are in peak-priced hours, with a live countdown to the next pricing window.

description.zh: Pelican Cycling 是一个 DSH 恶搞插件：先用当前模型做语义二分类，命中后由本地 Pelican PRO 模型推理生成鹈鹕骑自行车的网页。
description.en: Pelican Cycling is a parody DSH plugin that first runs a semantic binary classification with your current model, then lets a local Pelican PRO model generate the pelican-riding-a-bicycle webpage.

description.zh: 将 pen.dev 桌面应用的 MCP 服务接入 DeepSeek Harness 会话，让模型在实时画布上设计、检查组件并把网页还原为可编辑图层。
description.en: Connects the pen.dev desktop app's MCP server to a DeepSeek Harness session, letting the model design on the live canvas, inspect components, and reproduce web pages as editable layers.

description.zh: dsh-pencil 是 DSH plugin，在助手回复底部加铅笔按钮，编辑后从该回合分叉出新会话版本，原会话完整保留。
description.en: dsh-pencil is a DSH plugin that adds a pencil button to assistant replies; edits fork a new session version from that turn while the original session stays intact.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏保留未发送的会话草稿，标为「待执行」可随时编辑、重命名、归档、发送或删除，重启 DSH 后草稿仍在。
description.en: Keeps unsent DeepSeek Harness session drafts in the sidebar as "pending" entries you can edit, rename, archive, send or delete, surviving DSH restarts.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 生成 AI 叙述的会话报告（日/周/月/自定义日期范围），并支持每 N 天定时提醒与系统通知。
description.en: Generate AI-narrated session reports (daily/weekly/monthly/custom range) for DeepSeek Harness, with every-N-days scheduled reminders and system notifications.

description.zh: DSH Performance Guard 是 DeepSeek Harness 的性能诊断插件，用 60 秒基准测量 Host 与 Web 端卡顿，并通过可回滚的插件隔离实验定位拖慢会话的第三方插件。
description.en: DSH Performance Guard is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that runs 60-second Host and Web benchmarks to diagnose slowdowns, then pinpoints offending third-party plugins through reversible isolation campaigns.

description.zh: 把远程 Linux 或 macOS 目录接入为 DeepSeek Harness 工作区，让 bash、读写、搜索等工具在远端执行，并沿用会话现有的 Permissions 与审批卡片。
description.en: Turns a directory on a remote Linux or macOS machine into a DeepSeek Harness workspace, running bash, read/write, and search tools there while reusing the session's existing Permissions and approval cards.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的角色扮演改写插件：在输入框选一张角色卡，草稿即由当前会话模型改写成该角色口吻，可先审查再发送。
description.en: A roleplay prompt-rewriting DSH plugin: pick a character card in the composer and your draft is rewritten in that persona's voice by the session's current model, ready to review or send.

description.zh: dsh-pet-bridge 是 DSH plugin，把 dsh-pet 桌宠的会话事件与工作状态通过 webhook 推送和回环 HTTP 拉取对外发布，全程 Token 鉴权。
description.en: A DSH plugin that bridges the dsh-pet desktop pet, publishing its session events and work status via token-authenticated webhooks and a loopback HTTP pull service.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来一只透明动画桌面宠物：待机呼吸、随机动作、拖拽甩抛与本地碎碎念，可多开并住上桌面。
description.en: A floating desktop pet DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness: transparent animations, random actions, drag-and-throw physics, local self-talk, multi-pet and desktop mode.

description.zh: DSH plugin 桌面宠物，悬浮于 Web GUI 角落，随 Agent 思考、搜索、执行命令等状态切换姿态，资产目录即配置，热重载无需重建。
description.en: A DSH plugin desktop pet floating in the Web GUI corner, switching poses with agent states like thinking, searching, and running commands; assets directory as config with hot reload.

description.zh: 为 DSH 的 dsh-pet 鲸鱼娘挂件注入人格口吻、中文思考与头顶台词，并每晚自动写日记，让桌面伙伴真正「活」起来。
description.en: Gives the DSH dsh-pet whale-girl widget a persona, Chinese reasoning and on-head quips, plus a nightly auto-written diary, making your desktop companion feel alive.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地非生成式决策层：phocinae_ask 做是/否、单选与评分判断，phocinae_gate 在工具调用执行前做失败即拒的审批拦截。
description.en: A local, non-generative decision layer for DeepSeek Harness: phocinae_ask returns yes/no, single-choice and score judgements, while phocinae_gate screens tool calls with a fail-closed approval gate before they run.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供主动型个人助理内核，记住偏好与个人知识、拆解需求并按时跟进承诺，让 DSH 助手更懂你。
description.en: A proactive personal-assistant kernel for DeepSeek Harness that remembers preferences and personal knowledge, decomposes needs, and follows through on commitments.

description.zh: DSH 插件 dsh-phone-drop 让手机与电脑在同一 Wi-Fi 下扫码直传照片，可选文档模式自动裁边转黑白，全程局域网不绕隧道。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets your phone scan a QR code and send photos straight to your computer over the same Wi-Fi, with an optional document mode that crops and binarizes scans locally.

description.zh: 这款 DeepSeek Harness 插件让手机拍照经局域网一键直传 PC 指定文件夹，无需云盘或 IM，落地目录可在插件面板配置，DSH Agent 随即读取分析。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that sends phone photos over the LAN straight into a folder you pick on this PC — no cloud or IM app — with the landing directory configured in the plugin panel and files immediately readable by the DSH agent.

description.zh: 为 DSH plugin 的桌宠加上局域网联机层，同一 Wi-Fi 下自动发现彼此的桌宠，实时同步动作、气泡与表情包，还能互相打招呼。
description.en: A LAN multiplayer layer for the DSH plugin desktop pet: pets on the same Wi-Fi auto-discover each other and sync animations, bubbles and emotes in real time, with greetings and draggable positions.

description.zh: dsh-pick 是 DeepSeek Harness 的插件选购顾问：说需求即从 2,250+ 候选中按去噪 npm 指标给出首选、备选与不推荐，并可在对话中直接调用工具比较。
description.en: dsh-pick is a plugin advisor for DeepSeek Harness: describe your need and it ranks 2,250+ candidates by denoised npm metrics, returning top picks, alternatives and rejects, with in-chat tools for comparison.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 界面里挂一条可弹奏的钢琴键盘，点键出声、按住横向滑动即刮奏，声音由 Web Audio 实时合成，零采样零依赖。
description.en: A playable glissando piano keyboard inside the DeepSeek Harness UI: tap keys for single notes, drag sideways to glide across them, with all sound synthesized live via Web Audio and zero samples or dependencies.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供确定性单向 PII 匿名化，在 agent 循环入口用固定规则与校验和替换邮箱、电话、密钥等敏感值，真实值仅存内存。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that shields prompts with deterministic, one-way PII anonymization at the start of the agent loop, replacing emails, phones and keys with stable placeholders kept only in memory.

description.zh: dsh-pilot 为 DeepSeek Harness 代理提供自主浏览器操作能力，通过可访问性引用控制页面，权限模型跟随 dsh 会话，并在网络层强制实施。
description.en: dsh-pilot gives DeepSeek Harness agents autonomous browser control via accessibility refs, with a session-following permission model enforced at the network layer.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 macOS 系统通知：回复完成或需要你确认时弹出横幅与提示音，点击即可回到对应会话。
description.en: A minimal macOS notification DSH plugin that alerts you with a banner and sound when a reply finishes or your input is needed, and clicking it returns you to that session.

description.zh: DSH 插件通过 ntfy 把回合完成、审批提问与失败提醒推送到手机，只推送不接收，自动化任务可用 ping_me 按需告警。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pushes turn results, approval requests, questions and failures to your phone via ntfy — push-only, with a ping_me tool for automation alerts.

description.zh: DSH plugin 注册 pkg_info 工具，查询 npm 与 PyPI 包元数据（版本、依赖、发布时间），返回结构化 JSON，供模型与 Code Mode 程序化调用。
description.en: A DSH plugin registering pkg_info tool to query npm and PyPI package metadata (version, deps, release dates), returning structured JSON for model and Code Mode use.

description.zh: 把北大未名教学二号集群接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 DSH plugin：侧边栏输入学号、密码与 OTP 一次登录，即可让 agent 直接提交作业、传输文件、查看队列。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that brings the PKU Weiming Teaching-2 cluster into DSH: log in once from the sidebar with student ID, password and OTP, then let the agent submit jobs, transfer files and check queues directly.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供 21 套原创水果主题，含像素水果插画与完整语义配色，可在设置或会话浮层一键换肤。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings 21 original fruit themes with pixel-art fruit sprites and full semantic color tokens to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, switchable from settings or an in-chat overlay.

description.zh: DSH plugin 的 Plan-and-Execute 编排插件，将复杂任务拆解为可审批、可恢复的步骤计划，支持失败暂停、自愈重试与断点续跑。
description.en: Plan-and-Execute orchestration plugin for DeepSeek Harness, breaking complex tasks into approvable, resumable step plans with failure pause, auto-recovery, and checkpoint resume.

description.zh: dsh-plannotator 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，将计划评审交给官方 Plannotator 应用，支持标注、批准或退回，让 dsh 与评审决策保持同步。
description.en: dsh-plannotator is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that hands plan review to the official Plannotator app, letting you annotate, approve, or send plans back while keeping dsh in sync.

description.zh: DSH plugin 的 MCP 服务管理器，在 Web UI 中搜索、安装、移除 MCP 服务，支持代理配置与安全校验。
description.en: A DSH plugin MCP service manager to discover, install, and remove MCP servers in the Web UI, with proxy support and safe validation.

description.zh: dsh-playwright 让 DeepSeek Harness 与用户共享一个真实浏览器页面，AI 可读取、点击、输入并导航，用户通过 Browser Use 面板实时观看与操作。
description.en: dsh-playwright lets DeepSeek Harness share a real browser page with the user, enabling the AI to read, click, type, and navigate while the user watches and interacts via the Browser Use panel.

description.zh: DSH plugin 的 Skills 管理器，在 Web UI 中发现 GitHub 上的 Agent Skills 仓库，一键安装或移除技能包。
description.en: A DSH plugin Skills manager to discover Agent Skills repos on GitHub and install/remove skill packs with one click in the Web UI.

description.zh: persona-forge 是一款 DSH plugin，能把导出的聊天记录蒸馏成可扮演的人设，让 AI 用对方的语气说话，并支持直接对话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that distills exported chat logs into a playable persona, letting the AI talk in that person's style and hold conversations with it.

description.zh: persona-forge 是一款 DSH plugin，能把导出的聊天记录蒸馏成可扮演的人设，让 AI 用对方的语气说话，并支持直接对话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that distills exported chat logs into a playable persona, letting the AI talk in that person's style and hold conversations with it.

description.zh: persona-forge 是一款 DSH plugin，能把导出的聊天记录蒸馏成可扮演的人设，让 AI 用对方的语气说话，并支持直接对话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that distills exported chat logs into a playable persona, letting the AI talk in that person's style and hold conversations with it.

description.zh: persona-forge 是一款 DSH plugin，能把导出的聊天记录蒸馏成可扮演的人设，让 AI 用对方的语气说话，并支持直接对话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that distills exported chat logs into a playable persona, letting the AI talk in that person's style and hold conversations with it.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自然语言插件检索：一句需求即从 dsh.so 索引匹配插件，返回验证等级、安全状态与安装命令，确认后一键装好。
description.en: Natural-language plugin search for DeepSeek Harness: describe your need and it matches plugins from the dsh.so index, returning verification level, security status and install commands, then installs on confirmation.

description.zh: AdWhispr 让 DSH 用户直接在对话里调研竞品广告、克隆爆款素材，并在 Meta、Google、TikTok 上投放与管理广告系列。
description.en: AdWhispr lets DeepSeek Harness users research competitor ads, clone winning creatives, and launch and manage campaigns on Meta, Google and TikTok right from chat.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 aflare 工作流工具封装为原生工具，支持生成、校验、运行本地优先的确定性工作流，全程本地执行。
description.en: A DSH plugin that exposes aflare workflow tools as native tools for generating, validating, and running local-first deterministic workflows.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供交互式 Agent 终端面板，把 Codex 子任务委派到并行 CLI 会话，并在右侧边栏以标签页或网格实时查看输出。
description.en: An interactive agent terminal panel for DeepSeek Harness that delegates Codex child tasks to parallel CLI sessions and streams their output in the native right sidebar as tabs or a grid.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Agent 任务完成、需要你操作或出错时发送浏览器通知，三种情况可分别设置提示音与音量。
description.en: A DSH plugin that fires browser notifications when an agent task completes, needs your input, or errors out, with a distinct sound and volume for each case.

description.zh: DSH plugin A/B测试工具，在隔离环境中对比插件改动前后的任务表现，生成可审计证据并给出确定性的发布建议，帮助你在发布前验证插件质量。
description.en: A/B test tool for DSH plugins that compares current and candidate versions in isolated environments, producing auditable evidence and deterministic promotion decisions before release.

description.zh: 把 Google ARTEMIS 安卓自动化代理接入 DeepSeek Harness，一句话派发任务即可在真机或模拟器上分步执行，并回传结果、截图与执行轨迹。
description.en: Brings Google ARTEMIS Android automation into DeepSeek Harness: hand it one natural-language task and it drives a real device or emulator step by step, returning results, screenshots and a replayable trace.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端带来仙逆王林修炼伙伴：实时监控 LLM 会话状态驱动打坐、掐诀、御剑等动画，随使用积累修为不断升境，境界越高皮肤越华丽。
description.en: A Wang Lin cultivation companion for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: it watches LLM session state in real time to drive meditation, hand-seal and sword-flight animations, and levels up through seven realms as you work, with fancier skins at higher realms.

description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框底栏新增「账单」胶囊，按官方单价实时折算当前会话花费，并可展开查看四类 token 分桶与逐轮明细。
description.en: Adds a billing capsule to the DSH composer dock that shows the current session's estimated cost at official DeepSeek prices, with token buckets and per-turn breakdown on click.

description.zh: BMAD Sprint Board 是一款 DSH 插件，在会话侧边栏只读展示 BMAD 项目的故事、需求与规格进度，标出与追踪文件的偏差，并给出唯一下一步动作。
description.en: BMAD Sprint Board is a DSH plugin that read-only renders a BMAD project's stories, requirements and specs in the session sidebar, flags gaps against the tracking file, and suggests a single next action.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端自定义品牌图标与名称，替换侧边栏与对话首屏标识并同步 favicon，可在设置卡片中实时修改、无需重建或刷新。
description.en: Custom brand icon and name for the DeepSeek Harness Web client, replacing the sidebar and conversation hero marks plus the favicon, editable live from a settings card with no rebuild or reload.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按包白名单的插件自动更新：定时查 npm 最新版，只升级你勾选的 DSH plugin，失败自动回滚旧版本。
description.en: Automatic per-package updates for DeepSeek Harness: periodically checks npm for the latest versions and upgrades only the DSH plugins you whitelist, rolling back on failure.

description.zh: 为每个已安装的 DSH plugin 自动补上中文功能简介，插件名保持原样，支持内存注入即时生效与磁盘语言包长期保留。
description.en: Automatically adds Chinese descriptions to every installed DSH plugin while keeping plugin names unchanged, via instant in-memory injection and persistent locale files.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供安全优先的浏览器自动化，支持导航、点击、填表、截图等 15 个工具，每次操作均重新校验策略。
description.en: A security-first browser automation plugin for DeepSeek Harness, offering 15 tools like navigation, click, fill, and screenshot, with policy re-checked on every action.

description.zh: DSH 插件目录速查工具，定期抓取 GitHub 上 topic:dsh-plugin 的插件仓库，分类存储并提供 agent 工具和 Web GUI 快速查询。
description.en: A DSH plugin catalog tool that periodically fetches GitHub repositories with topic:dsh-plugin, categorizes them, and provides quick query via agent tools and Web GUI.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将连续的可折叠步骤卡片折叠为一行「+ N steps」，点击可展开或收起，保持对话界面整洁，不改变原有卡片渲染。
description.en: A DSH plugin that folds consecutive collapsible-card steps into a single '+ N steps' row, clickable to collapse or expand, keeping the chat UI tidy without altering original card rendering.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 `/` 菜单加入 /simplify 与 /code-review（别名 /review）两个代码质量命令，前者做不改行为的清理，后者多角度找 bug 并独立验证后按严重度排序。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds /simplify and /code-review (alias /review) to the `/` menu — behavior-preserving cleanups plus multi-angle bug hunting with independent verification and severity ranking.

description.zh: 当模型写满输出上限被截断时，这个 DeepSeek Harness 插件自动替你发送「继续」，并受每会话次数上限、最小间隔与总开关约束。
description.en: When a turn ends because the model hit its output-token limit, this DeepSeek Harness plugin automatically sends a "continue" follow-up, gated by a per-session burst cap, a minimum interval, and an opt-out.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话头部提供实时费用徽标，按请求时间戳区分高峰与低谷时段计价，支持工作日峰谷规则与静默价格同步。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows a live per-session cost badge in the conversation header, pricing each request by its own timestamp with weekday-aware peak and off-peak tiers.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话区加上弹幕效果，把 Agent 的推理、工具调用与任务进度以滚动文字实时飘过，仿哔哩哔哩播放器体验。
description.en: Adds bilibili-style danmu to DeepSeek Harness: the agent's reasoning, tool calls and task progress scroll across the conversation area in real time.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 cron 定时排班：到点向目标会话注入 user 消息触发完整 agent 一轮执行，支持自然语言或侧边栏创建任务。
description.en: A cron scheduler plugin for DeepSeek Harness that injects a user message into a target session on schedule to trigger a full agent turn, with natural-language or sidebar job creation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上真正的删除对话能力：确认后立即移除会话，日志进入 7 天本地回收站，可撤销或恢复，逾期自动永久删除。
description.en: Adds real session deletion to DeepSeek Harness: confirmed removal from the sidebar, with logs kept in a 7-day local recycle bin for undo or restore before automatic permanent purge.

description.zh: DSH 桌面通知插件，在任务完成、等待输入或失败时弹出系统通知并播放音效，还支持手机推送，让你不必盯着聊天窗口等结果。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that fires native desktop notifications with sounds on task completion, waiting-for-input, and failures, plus optional mobile push, so you never have to watch the chat window.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 插件开发的调试工具包，提供 doctor、compose、shadow、shot、snapshot 等命令，帮你验证 profile 组合、启动影子实例并截图排查客户端问题。
description.en: A development kit for DeepSeek Harness plugins: doctor, compose, shadow, shot and snapshot commands verify profile composition, boot a throwaway shadow instance and capture the client half.

description.zh: DSH 插件开发助手通过对话式引导，帮你从零创建、检查、测试并发布 DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供脚手架生成、结构校验与发布指南。
description.en: A conversational DSH plugin development assistant that scaffolds, checks, tests and publishes DeepSeek Harness plugins from scratch, with structure validation and release guides.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件开发者提供一份随装即用的技能，讲清双半包骨架、fork 调试、发布上线与常见坑，帮 DSH plugin 从零到上线。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that registers a skill covering the dual-half package skeleton, fork-based debugging, publishing, and common pitfalls for DSH plugin development.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端补上任务完成、待审批与失败提醒，并在 Dock 图标显示未读小红点，点通知直接跳回对应会话。
description.en: Adds Codex-style desktop notifications and a Dock unread badge to the DeepSeek Harness desktop app, alerting you on completion, pending approval and errors, and jumping straight back to the session on click.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供插件诊断面板，列出加载失败、更新残留与不可管理条目，并附带磁盘扫描脚本排查安装残留。
description.en: A diagnostics panel for DeepSeek Harness plugins that surfaces failed loads, leftover update rows and unmanaged entries, plus a disk scan script for install leftovers.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Windows 桌面应用提供更新与插件管理界面，含侧边栏入口、更新面板与设置分区，可检查、下载、安装、重启与修复。
description.en: A DSH plugin that renders the Windows desktop app's Updates UI — a sidebar entry, an Updates panel and a Settings section — to check, download, install, restart and repair the harness and manage plugins.

description.zh: DSH plugin 教育工具包，为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供教案骨架、测验校验、评分量规、闪卡与可读性分析。
description.en: Education toolkit for DeepSeek Harness agents: lesson-plan skeletons, quiz validation, rubrics, flashcards, and readability levels.

description.zh: 一个约 70 行的 DeepSeek Harness 示例插件，用侧边栏标签页演示双语文案与点击计数，可直接复制作为 DSH plugin 开发起点。
description.en: A ~70-line DeepSeek Harness example plugin: one sidebar tab that greets and counts clicks, built to be read, copied and used as a DSH plugin starter.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 read_document 与 write_document 两个工具，让模型直接读写 Word、PDF 和纯文本文件。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives the model read_document and write_document tools for reading and writing Word, PDF and plain-text files.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册 /commit、/push、/commit-push 斜杠命令，把提交与推送指令带进下一轮请求，由 Agent 自行执行 git 操作。
description.en: Registers /commit, /push and /commit-push slash commands in DeepSeek Harness, injecting commit and push instructions into the next model request so the agent runs git itself.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入飞书 IM 通道的 DSH plugin：扫码创建专属飞书机器人，把任务完成、审批与提问推送到飞书，并可直接在飞书里指挥 DSH 会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a Feishu IM channel to DeepSeek Harness: scan a QR code to create a dedicated Feishu bot, push task results, approvals and questions to Feishu, and drive DSH sessions directly from Feishu.

description.zh: DSH 插件在 Web GUI 作曲者工具行显示当前工作区 Git 状态（分支、变更数、可展开文件列表、自动刷新），并提供 git_status 代理工具。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows current workspace Git status in the Web GUI composer tool row (branch, change counts, expandable file list, auto-refresh) plus a git_status agent tool.

description.zh: DSH Git 工作台插件，把分支切换、差异审查、提交记录、储藏与工作树管理带进 DeepSeek Harness 会话，并支持 AI 草稿协作。
description.en: A Git workbench DSH plugin that brings branch switching, diff review, commit history, stash and worktree management into DeepSeek Harness sessions, with AI draft assistance.

description.zh: 把 Google Calendar 与 Google Tasks 接入 DeepSeek Harness，用自然语言在对话里增删改查日程、待办与忙闲，零第三方运行时依赖。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings Google Calendar and Google Tasks into DeepSeek Harness, letting you manage events, to-dos and free/busy via natural language with zero runtime dependencies.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 已安装插件页添加「我的分组」标签页，支持拖拽分组、彩色标签、中文备注、启停开关与分组锁定，让 DSH plugin 管理更顺手。
description.en: Adds a "My Groups" tab to the DeepSeek Harness installed-plugins page, with drag-and-drop groups, colored tags, Chinese notes, real enable/disable toggles and group locking for tidier DSH plugin management.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内浏览 GitHub Issues、里程碑与关联 PR 状态，并可将 issue 一键交给 agent 新建会话处理。
description.en: Browse GitHub issues, milestones, labels and linked PR status inside DeepSeek Harness, and hand an issue to the agent in a new Session.

description.zh: DSH 侧边栏插件图谱面板，可视化插件依赖关系、技能使用统计与 Token 缓存成本分析，帮助开发者优化插件配置与成本。
description.en: A DSH sidebar panel visualizing plugin dependency graph, skill usage, and token cache cost analysis to help developers optimize plugin configuration and costs.

description.zh: DSH 批注插件：在回答中选中文字即可高亮并写备注，一键把引用与备注放回输入框，批注按会话隔离、仅存本地浏览器。
description.en: A DSH plugin for annotating answers: select text to highlight it and add notes, then send the quote and note back to the input box in one click, with annotations kept per session and stored only in your local browser.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Web 设置页提供「启停管理」标签，一键热启用/停用任意已装插件，立即生效、无需重启，状态持久化。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a 'Plugin Toggle' tab to the Web settings, letting you hot-enable/disable any installed plugin instantly without restart, with persisted state.

description.zh: 一个极简的 DeepSeek Harness 社区插件，注册可被模型调用的 hello 工具，按名字打招呼，是 dsh-plugin 最小完整示例。
description.en: A minimal DeepSeek Harness community plugin that registers a model-callable hello tool to greet by name, serving as the smallest complete dsh-plugin example.

description.zh: 把灵感待办搬进 DSH Web GUI 的看板插件：侧边栏随手记录想法，自动评分排序并走完评审、交付或否决的生命周期。
description.en: An idea-backlog kanban for the DSH Web GUI: capture ideas from the sidebar, score and rank them, and move each card through review, delivery or decline.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自动将对话进度上传至腾讯 IMA，生成每日笔记并同步到 Work 知识库，实现知识沉淀与归档。
description.en: DSH plugin auto-uploads conversation progress to Tencent IMA, creating daily notes and syncing to Work knowledge base for knowledge archiving.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为纯文本 LLM 提供图片输入接管，粘贴或拖拽图片自动转为结构化文字描述并发送，兼容 OpenAI 视觉 API。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives text-only LLMs image input capability, converting pasted or dragged images into structured text descriptions via OpenAI-compatible vision APIs.

description.zh: DSH plugin 图片工具：为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供图片选择卡、回复内嵌图片与盲模型收图，零 token 本地渲染。
description.en: DSH plugin image tools: adds image picker cards, inline reply images, and blind-model image receiving to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, all rendered locally with zero tokens.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供受约束的只读图片路由，让 agent 将工作区图片直接内嵌显示在对话中，无需临时起本地服务器。
description.en: A DSH plugin that exposes a constrained read-only image route for DeepSeek Harness Web, letting agents embed workspace images directly in chat without a local server.

description.zh: DSH plugin 安全安装/卸载/重启助手：自动备份配置、失败回滚、重启并做健康检查，让 agent 通过模型工具无缝管理插件生命周期。
description.en: Safe DSH plugin installer/uninstaller/restarter: auto backup, rollback on failure, restart & health check, enabling agents to manage plugin lifecycle via model tools.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供 OpenAI 兼容的 generate_image 工具，同步调用图像生成 API，将结果保存至会话工作区并附加引用，支持多提供商配置。
description.en: A DSH plugin exposing an OpenAI-compatible generate_image tool that synchronously calls the API, saves outputs to the session workspace, and attaches references for image-capable models.

description.zh: Lion-Skills 的 DSH plugin 版：面向开发者的中文 agent 技能套件，以只读 bundled provider 挂载到 ctx.skills，覆盖代码审查、调试、测试等 11 个工作流技能。
description.en: Lion-Skills as a DeepSeek Harness plugin: a developer-focused Chinese agent skill suite mounted on ctx.skills as a read-only bundled provider, covering 11 workflow skills like code review, debugging, and testing.

description.zh: 把 Google Jules 远程编码代理接入 DeepSeek Harness，通过十个 jules_* 工具派发编码任务、后台跟踪进度、审批计划并取回 diff。
description.en: Brings the Google Jules remote coding agent into DeepSeek Harness via ten jules_* tools, so you can delegate coding tasks, watch them in the background, approve plans, and pull back the diff.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 实时桌面截图与标注的 DSH plugin，支持全局热键、窗口识别、选区调整，并可将图片直接插入对话输入框。
description.en: A Windows live-desktop screenshot and annotation DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness, with global hotkey, window detection, region adjustment, and direct image insertion into the composer.

description.zh: dsh-plugin-llmtr 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册 LLMTR 网关的 170+ 模型路由，一键接入多厂商模型并支持土耳其境内托管模型。
description.en: dsh-plugin-llmtr registers LLMTR gateway's 170+ models as a provider route in DeepSeek Harness, enabling multi-vendor access and Türkiye-hosted models.

description.zh: DSH plugin 本地生活工具集：预算规划、账单分摊、单价折扣计算、单位换算（斤/里/尺、摄氏/华氏）及出行清单，日常算术轻松搞定。
description.en: A DSH plugin local-life toolkit: budget planning, bill splitting, unit-price and discount math, unit conversions (jin/li/chi, C/F), and trip checklists.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地实时语音转写浮窗，边说边出字，基于 Qwen3-ASR 本地推理，音频完全离线不出机器。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a floating real-time speech-to-text window to DeepSeek Harness, transcribing as you speak with fully offline Qwen3-ASR inference.

description.zh: DSH 网页插件管理插件，在设置页直接启用/停用已安装插件，切换即时生效并持久化到用户配置层。
description.en: A DSH plugin manager that lets you enable/disable installed plugins directly from the web settings page, with instant effect and persistent patch-layer writes.

description.zh: DSH 网页插件管理插件，在设置页直接启用/停用已安装插件，切换即时生效并持久化到用户配置层。
description.en: A DSH plugin manager that lets you enable/disable installed plugins directly from the web settings page, with instant effect and persistent patch-layer writes.

description.zh: 把腾讯 CodeBuddy 接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 DSH plugin，注册 codebuddy 模型路由，并展示价格促销、额度与签到。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects Tencent CodeBuddy to DeepSeek Harness, registering a codebuddy LLM route with pricing badges, quota rings and check-in.

description.zh: 面向医学与生命科学的 DSH plugin，可检索 PubMed、Europe PMC、arXiv、bioRxiv、medRxiv，生成多种格式引用并核对开放获取全文。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for medical and life sciences that searches PubMed, Europe PMC, arXiv, bioRxiv and medRxiv, formats citations in multiple styles, and checks open-access full text.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的市场情报分析插件，接入 CaSee 平台 500+ 可信信源，提供六个可调用情报工具、专家人格与深色看板报告规范。
description.en: A market-intelligence plugin for DeepSeek Harness that taps CaSee's 500+ trusted sources, adding six callable intelligence tools, an expert persona and a dark-dashboard report contract.

description.zh: DSH 会议助手插件：在 DeepSeek Harness 中录音、实时转写，并结合项目资料给出追问与回应建议。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that records meetings, transcribes them live, and suggests follow-up questions and answers grounded in your project context.

description.zh: 喵语定制是一款 DeepSeek Harness 插件，在消息显示层按规则替换文本（如“我”变“本喵喵”），仅改界面不改真实对话，支持图形化规则编辑与实时预览。
description.en: Meow Speech is a DSH plugin that applies display-layer text replacement rules (e.g., "I" becomes "Meow") to messages, altering only the UI without touching real conversation content, with a graphical rule editor and live preview.

description.zh: DSH 插件把 Mermaid 流程图转成符合 GB/T 1526-1989（等同 ISO 5807）的国标 SVG，符号合规、正交走线，超 A4/A3 自动分页。
description.en: A DSH plugin that converts Mermaid flowcharts into GB/T 1526-1989 (ISO 5807) compliant SVG with standard symbols, orthogonal routing and automatic A4/A3 pagination.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Nexus 规范研发预设，用 Claude Code 规划评审、Codex 实现测试，通过四个委派工具串起规范驱动开发流程。
description.en: A Nexus spec-driven development preset for DeepSeek Harness that pairs Claude Code planning/review with Codex implementation and testing through four delegation tools.

description.zh: DSH plugin 移动端与 iPad 触控优化插件，解决手势卡死、软键盘误弹、侧边栏抖动等 Web GUI 触控痛点。
description.en: A DSH plugin optimizing touch interactions for mobile and iPad, fixing gesture freezes, keyboard pop-ups, and sidebar jitter in the Web GUI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册免 token 登录入口路由，把进程登录 token 换成浏览器会话 cookie，让首次访问无需再带 ?token= 参数。
description.en: A DSH plugin that registers a token-free login entry route, exchanging the process login token for a browser session cookie so first visits no longer need a ?token= parameter.

description.zh: Ntfyx 让 DSH plugin 把任务通知与富报告推送到手机，并通过按钮或文字回复、经本地 CLI 验证后回传 Agent 继续执行。
description.en: Ntfyx lets a DSH plugin push task notifications and rich reports to your phone, then claim button or text replies verified by the local CLI before the agent continues.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供速记能力的 DSH plugin：通过模型工具、/note 命令与侧边栏面板记录短笔记，并按全局与项目两级分开存放。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds quick notes to DeepSeek Harness: record short notes via model tools, the /note command and a sidebar panel, stored separately at global and project level.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中按需读取 Microsoft OneNote 笔记：登录一次并勾选可读笔记本，插件在 Graph 请求前强制白名单，仅开放四个只读工具。
description.en: Read the Microsoft OneNote notebooks you allow inside DeepSeek Harness: sign in once, tick readable notebooks, and an enforced allow-list gates four read-only tools before any Graph request.

description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 桌面通知插件，在每轮回答结束时自动弹出系统通知，支持子代理提醒、多渠道投递与自定义文案模板。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that posts a desktop notification whenever a turn ends, with subagent alerts, auto-selected delivery channels and customizable text templates.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏提供 orchd 只读面板，按当前会话项目展示任务看板、依赖图、想法与审查时间线，全程无写操作。
description.en: A read-only orchd panel for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar that shows the current session project's task board, dependency graph, ideas and review timeline, with no write operations.

description.zh: DSH plugin 层级提示词注入器，将官方六大注入层收敛为可配置引擎，支持锚定、引导、子代理三态与 Web UI 编辑，开箱即用。
description.en: A DSH plugin prompt injector that consolidates six official injection layers into a configurable engine, supporting anchoring, guidance, subagent modes, and Web UI editing.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可运行时切换的出站代理插件，将 LLM 请求、web_search 与 MCP 流量统一走 HTTP(S) 或 SOCKS5 代理，改配置即生效无需重启。
description.en: A DSH plugin that routes all outbound traffic — LLM providers, web_search/web_fetch and streamable-http MCP — through an HTTP(S) or SOCKS5 proxy, switchable at runtime with no restart.

description.zh: dsh-plugin-prune 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供插件健康体检：统计每个插件工具与技能的真实调用、错误率、延迟与跨会话使用，结合你的价值评分，标记可安全卸载的插件。
description.en: dsh-plugin-prune is a DSH plugin that measures real usage telemetry per plugin tool and skill (calls, error rate, latency, sessions) plus your value ratings, flagging plugins you can safely remove.

description.zh: dsh-plugin-quota 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面实时展示账户余额与 Token 用量，一键接入设置面板，帮助用户监控额度消耗。
description.en: dsh-plugin-quota brings real-time DeepSeek account balance and token usage to the DeepSeek Harness web UI, integrating into the settings panel for easy quota monitoring.

description.zh: DSH plugin 远程访问网关，为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供登录认证与 HTTP/WebSocket 反向代理，并支持交互式远程桌面。
description.en: Remote access gateway for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: login auth plus HTTP/WebSocket reverse proxy, with interactive remote desktop support.

description.zh: DSH 远程访问插件，为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供局域网和公网隧道连接，生成带认证的访问链接，支持从其他设备控制完整 Web UI。
description.en: DSH plugin for remote access, enabling LAN and public tunnel connections to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with authenticated links for control from other devices.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Relvato 托管 MCP 服务器，让 DSH 代理用 52 个工具做网站监控、运行检测并读取健康与性能报告。
description.en: Connects Relvato's hosted MCP server to DeepSeek Harness, giving the DSH agent 52 tools to set up website monitoring, run checks and read health and performance reports.

description.zh: 修复 DSH 界面整体缩放后右侧栏拖拽分隔条错位的问题，让手柄重新贴合面板边缘并扩大命中区域。
description.en: Fixes the DSH right sidebar drag divider drifting under whole-interface zoom, realigning the handle to the panel edge with a wider hit area.

description.zh: 在 DSH 插件页新增搜索标签与 plugin_search 工具，按名字片段检索 npm 上的 DSH 插件并查看下载量、可安装性，一键走内置安装流程。
description.en: Adds a Search tab and a plugin_search tool to DeepSeek Harness, letting you find DSH plugins on npm by name fragment, check downloads and installability, and install via the built-in flow.

description.zh: 逃咪-插件总览为 DeepSeek Harness 提供更友好的插件管理界面：表格视图、状态过滤、热生效启停开关、配置查看复制与中英双语，入口位于设置导航。
description.en: Runcat Plugin Overview offers a friendlier plugin management UI for DeepSeek Harness: table view, status filter, hot-reload enable/disable, config view/copy, and bilingual interface.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多引擎网页搜索的 DSH plugin，免费引擎轮询加冷却，支持 Tavily、Brave、Serper 等付费引擎与图形设置页。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings multi-engine web search to DeepSeek Harness, with free-engine rotation and cooldown plus Tavily, Brave, Serper and other paid engines, configured from a settings page.

description.zh: 为 DSH plugin 的 Agent 提供原生 session_rename 工具，直接调用 Cordis sessionTitle 服务真实重命名当前会话，让标题随状态同步更新。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives the Agent a native session_rename tool backed by the Cordis sessionTitle service, so conversation titles are renamed for real as state changes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 换肤的 DSH 插件：开场动画、自定义壁纸与面板透明度，设置页即时生效。
description.en: A DSH plugin that reskins DeepSeek Harness with an intro animation, custom wallpapers and panel opacity, all adjustable live from its settings page.

description.zh: DSH plugin 体检评分卡：对 dsh-plugin 生态进行质量与安全审计，提供评分、榜单与语义搜索，帮助用户甄别插件风险。
description.en: A DSH plugin health scorecard: quality & security audit, rankings and semantic search across the dsh-plugin ecosystem.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通过注册 sidebar.brand.name 槽位替换侧边栏左上角品牌名与构建徽标，并覆写浏览器标签页标题，配置在 WebUI 插件配置页实时生效。
description.en: A DSH plugin that replaces the sidebar's top-left brand name and build badge via the sidebar.brand.name slot, and overrides the browser tab title, with live configuration in the Plugin Config page.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供技能汉化面板，把 DSH 技能的英文 description 一键译为简体中文并写回 SKILL.md，支持一键还原与批量翻译。
description.en: A DSH plugin that localizes skill descriptions: it translates the English description in SKILL.md into Simplified Chinese, writes it back to disk, and offers one-click restore plus batch translation.

description.zh: 这款 DSH plugin 在侧边栏「In one list」会话列表的标题下方显示所属工作区名称，让用户一眼分辨每个会话来自哪个工作区。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness sidebar plugin that shows the owning workspace name on a second line under each session title in the In one list view, so you can tell at a glance where a session lives.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 DeepSeek Harness 实例暴露为 SlashX 服务端点，支持富媒体、异步回调与完整 token 计量，实现协议兼容的网关集成。
description.en: A DSH plugin exposing DeepSeek Harness as a SlashX service endpoint with rich media, async callbacks, and complete token metering for protocol-compatible gateway integration.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 嵌入 SpreadJS 引擎，让 Agent 通过 sjs_* 工具创建、读取、编辑并导出 XLSX/SSJSON 表格，还能截图校验结果。
description.en: Embeds the SpreadJS engine into DeepSeek Harness so the agent can create, inspect, edit and export XLSX/SSJSON workbooks via sjs_* tools, with screenshot verification.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供 Excel/SpreadJS 编辑器，可直接在右侧文件树中打开、查看并编辑 xlsx、csv、sjs 等工作簿。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin that opens, views, and edits Excel/SpreadJS workbooks (.xlsx, .csv, .sjs) straight from the right-side file tree.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 客户端在输入框上方提供一条通用状态条容器，其它 DSH plugin 可注册状态段，统一展示常驻信息。
description.en: A generic status bar container above the input box for the DeepSeek Harness client, letting other DSH plugins register status segments for always-visible info.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多主机 SSH 工具集：服务器注册表、/ssh 命令、远程执行与文件传输工具，并内置危险命令拦截、密钥脱敏与审计日志。
description.en: A multi-host SSH toolbelt for DeepSeek Harness: server registry, /ssh commands, remote run/put/get tools, plus a destructive-command guard, secret redaction and an audit log.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Stet 个人工作手册，通过 MCP 工具让助手在动笔前回忆你的规则与流程，并随纠正持续学习。
description.en: Brings your Stet working manual into DeepSeek Harness as MCP tools, so the assistant recalls your rules and processes before drafting and learns from your corrections.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面里开真 PTY 终端：侧栏一键打开与对话同级的终端面板，支持多标签、重命名与主题配色，刷新不掉线。
description.en: Open real PTY terminals right inside the DeepSeek Harness web UI: a sidebar entry launches a terminal panel beside chat, with tabs, renaming and theme-aware colors that survive page reloads.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供「任务拆解模式」：主代理拆解大任务、子代理在全新短上下文中并行执行并综合结果，并发与模型可按机器配置。
description.en: A decompose-and-dispatch agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: the main agent splits a task, subagents run it in fresh short contexts in parallel, then results are merged, with concurrency and models configurable per machine.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 读取会话语料并生成离线 token 用量看板，按模型、工作区与会话精确统计输入输出及缓存 token。
description.en: A DSH plugin that reads the host session corpus and generates a self-contained offline HTML token usage dashboard with exact provider-reported accounting.

description.zh: 为 DSH 的每个子代理标注其实际运行的模型路由，在父级目录行与子会话头部同时显示 provider/model 与推理强度。
description.en: A DSH plugin that annotates every subagent with the model route it actually ran on, shown in both the parent catalog row and the child session header.

description.zh: DSH插件开关，在DeepSeek Harness Web设置页中一键启用或禁用第三方插件，支持热重载与状态持久化。
description.en: A DSH plugin toggle that enables or disables third-party plugins from the DeepSeek Harness Web settings page, with hot-reload and persistent state.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 工具调用加装安全防火墙：拦截危险命令、禁止读取敏感文件、限定可操作目录，高危操作走人工审批并全量审计留痕。
description.en: A security firewall for DeepSeek Harness tool calls: blocks dangerous commands, denies sensitive file reads, restricts writable paths, and routes high-risk actions through human approval with full audit logging.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供每日 Token 用量热力图，支持全局与会话双视图、历史回填与实时更新，帮助直观掌握模型消耗。
description.en: A DSH plugin that renders a daily token-usage heatmap in the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with global/session views, historical backfill, and live updates.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 提供零侵入的实时执行轨迹追踪，拆解首包等待与流式生成耗时，让你看清等待时间究竟花在哪里。
description.en: A zero-intrusion real-time trajectory tracker for the DeepSeek Harness WebUI that breaks down first-token wait and streaming generation time, showing exactly where your waiting time goes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供插件依赖图检查能力，把运行中的 Cordis 插件纤维树快照为插件/服务二分图，计算图论指标并导出 JSON、Graphviz DOT 或 SVG。
description.en: A DSH plugin dependency-graph inspector that snapshots the live Cordis plugin fiber tree into a plugin/service bipartite graph, derives graph-theory metrics, and exports it as JSON, Graphviz DOT, or SVG.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补齐 Trellis 工作流强制通道：每轮注入任务状态，并在无任务时把入口路由到 trellis-start，无需 hook。
description.en: Adds the missing Trellis workflow enforcement channel to DeepSeek Harness: per-turn task-state injection plus a trellis-start entry gate, with no hooks required.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供整界面缩放，侧边栏、菜单、弹窗与文字可在 70%–160% 间调整，并补偿布局宽度，缩小后每行显示更多文字。
description.en: A DSH plugin that zooms the entire DeepSeek Harness Web UI — sidebar, menus, modals, icons and text — from 70% to 160%, with layout compensation so zooming out fits more text per line.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面提供字体设置行，可选内置预设、本机已装字体或上传字体文件，选择即时生效并持久保存。
description.en: Adds a Font row to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, letting users pick built-in presets, fonts installed on the host, or uploaded font files, applied instantly and persisted.

description.zh: 这款 DSH plugin 检查 profile 中第三方插件的 npm 新版本，并在右侧栏、插件页与左侧栏红点中一键更新。
description.en: A DSH plugin that checks third-party plugin bundles in your profile against npm and updates them in place, with a right-sidebar page, Plugins tab, and sidebar badge.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 在模型选择器旁加一枚 GLM 套餐额度徽标，悬停即可查看 5 小时、每周与工具调用的剩余明细。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a GLM quota chip beside the model selector in DeepSeek Harness, with a hover popover showing remaining 5-hour, weekly and tool-call usage.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供版本锁定的插件升级技能与零依赖缝隙扫描器，覆盖 0.1.3-alpha.1 到 0.1.5-rc.1 的 20 处静默断裂点，避免误判类型检查通过。
description.en: A version-locked DSH plugin upgrade skill plus a zero-dependency seam scanner covering the 0.1.3-alpha.1 to 0.1.5-rc.1 corridor, catching silent breakage that typecheck alone would miss.

description.zh: DSH 语音插件，通过火山 seed-tts 云端 TTS（自动回退 SAPI 离线）实现语音播报、桌面通知与场景提示音，Windows 原生零 Python 依赖。
description.en: DSH plugin for voice output: cloud TTS via Volcano seed-tts (fallback to SAPI offline), desktop notifications, and scene-based WAV sounds, native on Windows with zero Python dependency.

description.zh: DSH plugin 壁纸插件：在设置中上传并裁剪本地图片，设为 DeepSeek Harness Web 工作区桌面背景，支持实时调节透明度与遮罩。
description.en: A DSH plugin to upload and crop a local image as the DeepSeek Harness Web workspace background, with live opacity and dimming controls.

description.zh: 检查并更新第三方 DSH 插件：对比 npm 最新版本，用精确版本安装绕过 pnpm 观察期，一条命令完成升级。
description.en: Checks and updates third-party DSH plugins by comparing against the latest npm version, using exact-version installs to bypass pnpm's release-age window in one command.

description.zh: dsh-plugin-worktree 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 web UI 带来 Claude Code 风格的 git worktree 支持，让你无需离开浏览器即可创建、切换和删除基于 worktree 的会话。
description.en: dsh-plugin-worktree brings Claude Code-style git worktree support to the DeepSeek Harness web UI, letting you create, switch, and delete worktree-backed sessions without leaving the browser.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 Windows 环境提供防坑守则技能与主动防护，自动检测乱码、拦截危险写命令并修复编码问题。
description.en: A DSH plugin that provides Windows environment guardrails with skills and active protection, auto-detecting garbled text, blocking risky write commands, and fixing encoding issues.

description.zh: TextIn xParse 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供结构化文档解析工具与技能，支持多文档任务、OAuth/AppKey 认证及付费操作审批。
description.en: TextIn xParse provides a structured document parsing tool and skill for DeepSeek Harness, with multi-document tasks, OAuth/AppKey auth, and paid-operation approval.

description.zh: DSH 增强插件，在 web 界面设置中新增视觉、记忆、插件市场与本地模型面板，支持一键重启引擎，提升 DeepSeek Harness 使用体验。
description.en: An enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness that adds vision, memory, plugin marketplace, and local model panels to the web UI settings, with one-click engine restart.

description.zh: 用你自己的 Git 仓库备份、恢复并跨设备同步 DSH 插件与配置，支持双向同步、冲突处理与历史回滚。
description.en: Back up, restore, and sync your installed DSH plugins and configs across devices via your own Git repository, with two-way sync, conflict handling, and history rollback.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的 HTML 预览里左键圈选 DOM 元素、右键框选区域，把选择器与源码行号精确交给 agent，修前端代码不必再描述「那个卡片」。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets you pick DOM elements or drag-select regions inside DeepSeek Harness HTML previews, handing the agent exact selectors and source line numbers so front-end fixes no longer need vague descriptions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供只读安装诊断的 DSH plugin：从本地 npm 包快照能力与风险，比对断言快照并归类安装日志故障。
description.en: A read-only install-doctor DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness: snapshots declared capabilities and risk from local npm tarballs, diffs and asserts snapshots, and classifies install-log failures.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏提供番茄闹钟，专注/休息循环计时只存 endsAt，切 tab 或关面板都不中断，Agent 可通过 pomodoro_panel 工具读写同一份状态。
description.en: A pomodoro timer for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: focus/break cycles store only endsAt, so timing survives tab switches and panel closes, and the Agent can read or write the same state via the pomodoro_panel tool.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供经典 25/5/15 番茄钟，可关联会话任务，自带全年热力图统计与 CSV 导出。
description.en: A Pomodoro timer DSH plugin with classic 25/5/15 cycles, session-task linking, a year heatmap stats panel, and CSV export.

description.zh: DSH 番茄钟宠物插件：侧边栏计时专注、四象限任务与随专注成长的宠物，并让 Agent 帮你开计时、记任务。
description.en: A DSH plugin pairing a pomodoro timer with four-quadrant tasks and a pet that grows as you focus, plus an agent tool to start timers and propose tasks.

description.zh: DSH plugin 常驻注入 Ponytail 懒高级工程师规范，精简版系统提示词按会话切换档位，完整规则与 5 个同伴技能落盘为仅用户可调用的 / 技能。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects the Ponytail lazy-senior-engineer ruleset, with a compact always-on system prompt switchable per session and the full ruleset plus 5 companion skills as user-only / skills.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供置顶模态桌面弹窗，在工具请求授权、模型提问或计划审阅、根 Agent 运行结束时提醒你回到窗口，避免错过关键节点。
description.en: Modal desktop popups for DeepSeek Harness that stay on screen until dismissed, alerting you when a tool needs approval, the model asks a question or submits a plan, or a root agent finishes its run.

description.zh: DSH plugin 常驻注入 Ponytail 懒高级工程师规范，精简版系统提示词按会话切换档位，完整规则与 5 个同伴技能落盘为仅用户可调用的 / 技能。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects the Ponytail lazy-senior-engineer ruleset, with a compact always-on system prompt switchable per session and the full ruleset plus 5 companion skills as user-only / skills.

description.zh: DSH plugin 端口占用处置工具，智能判断 EADDRINUSE 三种情形，提供复用、换端口、精确 kill 三种处置，避免误杀进程。
description.en: DSH plugin for triaging port conflicts, intelligently distinguishing three EADDRINUSE scenarios and offering reuse, switch, or precise kill actions to avoid killing wrong processes.

description.zh: 为 MaiBot、飞书、微信等外部机器人与 CI/CD 提供 DSH 轻量 HTTP POST 调度网关，兼具多账号登录鉴权与 MCP 工具调用能力。
description.en: A lightweight HTTP POST gateway for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that lets external bots (MaiBot, Lark, WeChat) and CI/CD systems dispatch tasks, with multi-account login auth and MCP tool calls.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供番茄钟：侧栏整页专注/短休息/长休息循环，输入框旁倒计时胶囊，支持统计与提示音。
description.en: A Pomodoro timer DSH plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, adding a sidebar focus/break cycle page and a countdown pill beside the composer.

description.zh: DSH plugin 防止系统休眠，在 DeepSeek Harness 运行时保持设备唤醒，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux，可通过对话开关。
description.en: A DSH plugin that keeps your device awake while DeepSeek Harness runs, preventing system sleep on macOS, Windows, and Linux, toggleable via conversation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供电力线损核算工具，读取单期供电量、售电量等数据，按版本化规则包校验电量平衡、线损率、表计合计与三相不平衡，并给出可复核的算式。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that registers a power-loss split tool: it reads one period's supply, sales and meter figures, applies a versioned rule pack, and checks the energy balance, loss rate, meter-list sum and phase unbalance with the arithmetic shown.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页输入框提供 Power Mode 打字特效：光标粒子、连击计数、热度余烬与合成按键音效，支持中英文输入法。
description.en: Power Mode typing effects for the DeepSeek Harness web composer: caret particles, combo counter, heat and embers, and synthesized key ticks, with IME support.

description.zh: DSH plugin 批量处理整目录 PPT：填模板占位符、按形状名换图、提取每页文本、查看结构，只读输入不覆盖原文件。
description.en: A DSH plugin that batch-processes whole folders of PPTX files: fill template placeholders, swap images by shape name, extract per-slide text, and inspect structure — read-only, never overwriting originals.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在侧边栏底部展示开放 PR 的 GitHub Actions 检查状态与进度，按工作区/项目/PR 分组，运行中检查实时更新。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows the status and progress of GitHub Actions checks for open PRs in the sidebar footer, grouped by workspace/project/PR.

description.zh: DSH 原生工具，分析当前分支 diff，自动生成符合 Conventional Commits 的 PR 标题、五段描述与自审清单，并支持确认与直接提 PR。
description.en: A DSH native tool that analyzes the current branch diff to auto-generate Conventional Commits PR title, description and self-review checklist, with confirm and open PR options.

description.zh: dsh-pr-panel 是 DSH plugin，在会话内以浮窗和右列面板展示本会话 PR 的状态、CI、评审意见与合并操作，无需切换浏览器。
description.en: A DSH plugin that surfaces this session's pull requests in an overlay and a right-column panel, showing status, CI, review feedback and merge actions without leaving the browser.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供轨迹视图右键操作菜单与插件版本更新入口的 DSH plugin，支持复制、引用、分叉记录及侧边栏开关。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a right-click action menu to the DeepSeek Harness Trajectory view plus an in-place plugin version updater, with copy, quote, fork and a sidebar toggle.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 运行时动态注册与管理 Agent 预设的 DSH plugin，无需改动任何配置文件，支持自带预设、派生、导入导出与启停。
description.en: A DSH plugin that registers and manages Agent presets at DeepSeek Harness runtime without touching any config files, with bundled presets, derivation, import/export and enable toggles.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按 Agent preset 限制工具可见性的 DSH plugin，通过 ctx.tools.restrict() 屏蔽全局继承的工具，让每个 preset 只暴露该有的能力。
description.en: A DSH plugin that enforces per-preset tool visibility in DeepSeek Harness, masking globally inherited tools via ctx.tools.restrict() so each agent preset only exposes the capabilities it should.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供浏览器端预设显示与排序管理，可在设置中搜索、隐藏、开关并调整 Agent 预设顺序，并同步替换新会话页的预设选择器。
description.en: A browser-side preset visibility and ordering plugin for DeepSeek Harness: search, hide, toggle and reorder Agent presets in settings, with the filtered roster applied to the new-session preset picker.

description.zh: dsh-preview-snip 为 DSH 右侧文档预览加上圈选、标注与引用选中文本三项操作，截图或引文直接落入输入框，方便继续提问。
description.en: dsh-preview-snip adds snip, annotate and quote-selection actions to DSH's right-sidebar document preview, dropping the cropped or quoted result straight into the composer.

description.zh: dsh-preview 为 DeepSeek Harness 代理提供无头浏览器验证工具与内置自检技能，让代理自动打开、检查并修复其构建的前端页面。
description.en: dsh-preview gives DeepSeek Harness agents headless-browser verification tools and a bundled self-check skill, enabling them to open, inspect, and fix what they build.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的右侧栏文档预览补上视频与音频播放能力，支持 HTTP Range 流式读取与桌面端拖动进度条。
description.en: Adds video and audio playback to the DeepSeek Harness right-Sidebar document preview, with HTTP Range streaming and working desktop seek.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 右侧边栏直接预览 STL 网格，浏览器内解析二进制/ASCII 模型并渲染可交互 3D 视图，同时给出尺寸、体积、表面积与封闭性等打印统计。
description.en: Preview STL meshes in the DeepSeek Harness right Sidebar: parse binary/ASCII models in the browser, render an interactive 3D viewport, and report print stats like size, volume, surface area and watertightness.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供官方峰谷定价面板与倒计时，支持在高峰期把消息排队到低谷时段发送，并展示美元/人民币价格与账户余额。
description.en: Adds an official DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing panel and countdown to DeepSeek Harness, letting you queue messages during PEAK for OFF-PEAK delivery, with USD/CNY prices and account balance.

description.zh: DSH 服务面板插件，在 Web GUI 侧边栏查看由哪个对话启动了哪些服务，支持一键停止、日志实时查看与启动参数重放。
description.en: A DSH service panel plugin to see which conversation started which services in the Web GUI sidebar, with one-click stop, live log tail and startup replay.

description.zh: DSH 插件包 dsh-pro-standards 为 AI 编码助手加入「找标准、看场景、查差距」三步判断，在装依赖、调接口、写代码前先按专业规范提醒，而非事后补救。
description.en: A DSH plugin bundle that makes AI coding assistants run a three-step check — find the standard, read the context, spot the gap — before installing deps, calling APIs or writing code, warning up front instead of fixing later.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供项目级 AGENTS.md 加载能力，自动向上查找并注入 .dsh/AGENTS.md 到每个 Agent 的系统提示词，支持自定义路径与实时监听。
description.en: A DSH plugin that loads project-level AGENTS.md files and injects the nearest .dsh/AGENTS.md into every agent's system prompt, with custom paths, size limits and live file watching.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 增加 Processes 标签页，把当前会话的主代理与各子代理并排成实时控制台，逐条展示工具请求、响应、模型与耗时。
description.en: A Processes tab for the DeepSeek Harness web UI that renders the main agent and every subagent of a conversation as live consoles, showing each tool request, response, model and timing.

description.zh: DSH 插件：用节点树把项目进度与决策收进两份 Markdown，右侧栏一键查看、勾选与筛选。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns project progress and decisions into two Markdown files organized by a node tree, with a right-sidebar view for browsing, checking off and filtering.

description.zh: DSH 插件：通过结构化问答将模糊想法梳理为清晰需求、技术路线与维护基准，生成可复用项目文档，降低创作启动门槛。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns vague ideas into clear requirements, tech roadmap, and maintenance baseline through structured Q&A, generating reusable project docs.

description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框上方加一条思维链进度字幕，用一整句话说明当前第几步、在干什么、成没成，让新手不用点开思考过程也能看懂 AI 卡在哪。
description.en: Adds a chain-of-thought progress caption above the DSH input box, stating in one sentence which step it is on, what it is doing, and whether it succeeded, so newcomers can follow along without opening the reasoning trace.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为编码代理提供跨项目的长期记忆，以纯 Markdown 记录目标、下一步与历史，通过技能与工具维护，数据完全由用户掌控。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing long-term, cross-project memory for coding agents, keeping goals, next steps and history in plain Markdown, maintained via skill and tools under full user control.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框旁加一个「优化」按钮，一键把草稿改写成更易执行的提示词，支持三档力度并自带免费模型通道。
description.en: Adds an Optimize button to the DeepSeek Harness composer that rewrites your draft into an easier-to-execute prompt, with three levels and a bundled free model channel.

description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 侧边栏带来 Claude Desktop 式 Projects 分组：把会话归入项目、按会话设置工作目录，并支持拖拽迁移与清理空会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings Claude-Desktop-style Projects to the DSH Desktop sidebar: group conversations into projects, set per-conversation working directories, drag-and-drop migration, and clean up empty conversations.

description.zh: 把常用提示词做成 DSH 输入框上方的胶囊，一键填入草稿，支持占位符与分组抽屉管理。
description.en: Turns your frequent prompts into capsule buttons above the DSH input box for one-click insertion, with placeholders and a grouped drawer.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在发送框左侧加星形按钮，一键把草稿重写为更清晰的提示词，可恢复原文，并支持自定义模板。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a star button beside the composer send action to rewrite your draft into a clearer prompt, with one-click restore and editable templates.

description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框旁加一键增强按钮，把草稿扩写成含目标与可核对要求的完整规格，再点即可还原原文。
description.en: Adds a one-click enhance button beside the DSH composer that expands a rough draft into a full spec with goals and checkable requirements, and restores the original on a second click.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框加一键提示词增强按钮，复用你已配置的模型改写草稿，不外发任何请求。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a one-click prompt-enhance button to the composer, rewriting your draft with your already-configured model and no outbound requests.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页版输入框加上 shell 风格的历史导航：按 ↑/↓ 即可翻出并回填此前提交过的提示词，历史存于浏览器本地并跨会话保留。
description.en: Adds shell-style prompt history to the DeepSeek Harness web composer: press ↑/↓ to recall and refill previously submitted prompts, stored locally in the browser and shared across sessions.

description.zh: 把指定文件注入 DeepSeek Harness 的模型上下文，可按系统提示、每轮对话或 AGENTS 三种模式加载，并支持按工作区限定与提醒设置。
description.en: Injects chosen files into the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) model context, with system prompt, every-turn, and AGENTS loading modes plus per-workspace scoping and reminders.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 聊天输入框加一枚「优化提示词」按钮，一键把草稿交给模型改写并回填，支持风格预设、双模型通路与竞态保护。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a one-click prompt-polisher button to the DeepSeek Harness chat input, rewriting drafts via model and filling them back with style presets, dual model paths and race protection.

description.zh: DSH 提示词优化插件：发送前点一下 ✨，模型结合上下文给出「问题+补丁」式建议，勾选回填输入框，不抢发送权。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness prompt-refinement plugin: click ✨ before sending and the model returns patch-style suggestions based on context, which you tick to merge back into the input box.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供提示词发送前体检：零 token 本地 lint 指出草稿缺失的输出格式、约束、验收标准与上下文，一键只补这些缺口。
description.en: A pre-send checkup for DeepSeek Harness prompts: a zero-token local lint flags missing output format, constraints, acceptance criteria and context, then fills exactly those gaps in one click.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 左栏提供提示词工作台，支持提示词优化、多轮迭代、模板与历史管理，并可一键在新对话中使用。
description.en: A prompt workbench panel for DeepSeek Harness that optimizes prompts, iterates across versions, manages templates and history, and sends results straight into a new chat.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框加上「优化提示词」按钮，结合当前会话历史与工作区文件，把草稿改写为分析式结构提示词，并支持一键撤销。
description.en: Adds an "Optimize Prompt" button to the DeepSeek Harness composer that rewrites your draft into an analytical structured prompt using the current conversation history and workspace files, with one-click undo.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让 Agent 通过 COM 或 UI 双传输控制 Proteus 8/9 交互仿真，启停仿真、读取信号、编辑原理图并可靠保存工程。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets the Agent drive Proteus 8/9 interactive simulation over COM or UI transport — start/stop simulation, read signals, edit schematics and reliably save projects.

description.zh: DSH 用量中心插件，在 Web 界面右下角常驻悬浮卡片，实时显示 OpenCode Go、DeepSeek、Command Code 等提供方的用量与余额，并附带只读本地的 Token 统计。
description.en: A DSH plugin that keeps a floating usage card in the Web GUI, showing live quota and balance for providers like OpenCode Go, DeepSeek and Command Code, plus local-only token statistics.

description.zh: DSH Provider Passport 为自定义 OpenAI 兼容端点做只读预检，在首个任务失败前找出请求方言差异，并给出最小兼容配置与回滚。
description.en: DSH Provider Passport runs a review-first preflight against custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints, surfacing request-dialect mismatches before the first real task fails and proposing minimal compat settings with rollback.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入阿里云 DashScope（百炼）模型提供商，注册 OpenAI 兼容的 aliyun 路由并内置 Qwen 模型目录，随包更新无需手改配置。
description.en: Adds Aliyun DashScope (Bailian) as a model provider for DeepSeek Harness, registering an OpenAI-compatible aliyun route with a bundled Qwen catalog that updates with the package.

description.zh: 把常用提示词存成输入框上方的一排快捷按钮，点击即填入，支持置顶、搜索与自动收纳，是提升 DSH 输入效率的界面插件。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns your frequent prompts into a row of shortcut buttons above the input box—click to fill, with pinning, search, and automatic overflow.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的模型提供商提供订阅登录：用已有的 Claude Pro/Max 或 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 账号完成 OAuth 授权，无需 API Key。
description.en: Sign in to DeepSeek Harness model providers with an existing Claude Pro/Max or ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscription via OAuth, no API key required.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置的出站 HTTP 代理，支持实时探测代理连通性，并在代理无响应时自动回退直连、恢复后自动切回。
description.en: A configurable outbound HTTP proxy for DeepSeek Harness with live reachability probing, automatic no-proxy fallback, and automatic switch-back once the proxy responds.

description.zh: DSH 插件为 PTC 模式下 run_code 内的 edit/write 调用渲染标准 diff 卡片，让嵌套改动也能像标准模式一样展开查看增删内容。
description.en: A DSH plugin that renders standard diff cards for edit/write calls nested inside PTC run_code programs, so nested file changes expand just like in standard mode.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供出站代理一键切换：本地路由器自动判断 Clash 是否在线，在线走 Clash、离线直连，界面即时切换无需重启 DSH。
description.en: An outbound proxy switch for DeepSeek Harness: a local router auto-detects Clash and routes through it or connects directly, switchable in the UI without restarting DSH.

description.zh: DSH plugin 一键发布工具：将 DeepSeek Harness 插件包同时发布到 npm 与 GitHub，提供 /publish-dsh-plugin 命令与 publish_plugin 工具，默认只预览不执行，需显式确认。
description.en: A DSH plugin that publishes a DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle to both npm and GitHub in one flow, via the /publish-dsh-plugin command and publish_plugin tool, fail-closed until explicit confirmation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 反向代理插件，支持公网 IP/nginx 访问并带登录认证，让 DeepSeek Harness 可远程安全访问。
description.en: Reverse proxy plugin for DeepSeek Harness enabling public IP/nginx access with login authentication.

description.zh: dsh-public-proxy 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，将 DSH Web UI 暴露给局域网访问，支持访问密钥与启动令牌绕过。
description.en: dsh-public-proxy is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that exposes the DSH Web UI for LAN access, with access key and launch token bypass support.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 DeepSeek Harness 代理生命周期事件推送至 Bark、飞书、企业微信、钉钉、ntfy 或通用 webhook，支持 /push 命令管理。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pushes DeepSeek Harness agent lifecycle notifications to Bark, Feishu, WeCom, DingTalk, ntfy, or a generic webhook, with /push command management.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面提供原生观感窗口标题栏的 DSH 插件，基于 Window Controls Overlay，让应用自身 header 成为可拖拽标题栏。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives the DeepSeek Harness web app a native-looking window title bar via Window Controls Overlay, turning the app's own header into the draggable title bar.

description.zh: DSH plugin 修复 DSH Desktop 内置 pwsh/shell 空结果 bug，提供自愈补丁与 pwsh_direct 兜底工具，确保 PowerShell 命令正常执行。
description.en: A DSH plugin that fixes the empty-result bug of built-in pwsh/shell in DSH Desktop, offering self-healing patches and a pwsh_direct fallback tool to ensure PowerShell commands run correctly.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 solve_ising 工具，把已建模的 Ising Matrix 提交到玻色量子 SPQC 求解并返回自旋解与哈密顿量。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a solve_ising tool, submitting modeled Ising matrices to QBoson SPQC via Kaiwu CIMOptimizer and returning spin solutions with Hamiltonians.
