description.zh: 把 Python/Django 线上报错原文粘进 DSH，离线解析 traceback、pytest、migrations、N+1 SQL、checks 与 Celery 报告，输出带覆盖率的结构化诊断。
description.en: Paste raw Python/Django production reports into DeepSeek Harness and get deterministic, offline structured diagnoses of tracebacks, pytest, migrations, N+1 SQL, checks and Celery, with explicit parse coverage.

description.zh: 把已在用的 DSH 会话通过 OneBot/NapCat 接到 QQ 个人号，支持 @ 唤醒、白名单与群聊回复。
description.en: Connects an existing DeepSeek Harness session to a QQ account via OneBot/NapCat, with @-mention wake-up, whitelists and group replies.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让 Agent 在对话中经用户确认后发送 QQ 邮件，并向其他插件暴露 ctx.qqEmail 服务。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets the agent send QQ Mail after user approval, and exposes a ctx.qqEmail service for other plugins.

description.zh: 为 DSH 的 QQ 通道旁路采集聊天摘要，滚动生成人物画像、好感度与心情情绪层，并把印象注入对话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that passively summarizes QQ channel chats to build rolling personas, affection scores and a mood layer, then injects those impressions back into the conversation.

description.zh: 把 QQ 接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 DSH plugin：支持 QQ 官方机器人与 OneBot v11 双通道收发消息，关键词规则自动回复，并全量写入审计日志。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects QQ to DeepSeek Harness via the official QQ bot or OneBot v11, with keyword auto-replies and full audit logging.

description.zh: 为 DSH 会话接入 QQ 群聊与私聊的 DSH plugin，基于 OneBot 11 收发消息、查看记录、发表情与戳一戳。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects DeepSeek Harness sessions to QQ group and private chats over OneBot 11, sending messages, reading history, faces and pokes.

description.zh: 为 DSH 的 QQ 机器人插件提供进程内增强补丁，让群聊关键词触发、历史上下文与图片语音附件正常进入 Agent。
description.en: An in-process enhancement layer for the DSH QQ bot plugin, making keyword triggers, chat history context, and media attachments work properly in group chats.

description.zh: DSH 的 QQ 机器人整合包，一次安装即带网关、识图、Edge TTS 语音与 B 站视频工具，让 DeepSeek Harness 直接接入 QQ 群聊。
description.en: A one-install QQ bot bundle for DeepSeek Harness that ships the gateway plus image understanding, Edge TTS voice and Bilibili tools, letting DSH plug straight into QQ chats.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 QQ 邮箱等 IMAP/SMTP 邮箱，注册 qqmail_* 工具让 Agent 收发、搜索、整理邮件，并附 CLI 与 MCP 服务。
description.en: Connects QQ Mail and any IMAP/SMTP mailbox to DeepSeek Harness, registering qqmail_* tools so the agent can read, search, send and organize mail, plus a CLI and MCP server.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏接入 QQ 邮箱面板，可读最近邮件、查看正文并发送纯文本，授权码只读私有文件且发送需二次确认。
description.en: Adds a QQ Mail panel to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar for reading recent messages, viewing bodies, and sending plain text, with credentials read only from a private file and sends gated by confirmation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 添加手机配对二维码悬浮按钮，点击即可在应用内展示配对二维码，无需另开浏览器标签页。
description.en: Adds a floating phone-pairing QR button to the DeepSeek Harness WebUI, letting you view the pairing QR in-app without a new tab.

description.zh: DSH 插件：回合结束质量门禁，当本轮改动代码或配置时自动运行项目自身声明的检查，失败则以修复指令开启新回合，并受会话配额与总预算约束。
description.en: A DSH plugin that acts as a turn-end quality gate: when a turn edits code or config, it runs the checks the project itself declares, and a failure returns as a repair instruction opening a new turn, bounded by per-session quota and total budget.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Quarto Book 章节写作、书主题设计与渲染后 HTML 可发布检查技能，仅在书仓库中按需启用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds Quarto Book chapter authoring, reusable book theme design, and post-render HTML publishability checks, activated only inside book repositories.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 QQ 机器人，支持 OneBot 11 与 QQ 官方开放平台，每个 QQ 会话独立持久 Agent，并挂载完整工具链。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects DeepSeek Harness to QQ bots via OneBot 11 or QQ Official Platform, with per-chat persistent agents and full toolchain.

description.zh: 为每条 DSH 回答做质量体检：动作行显示质量分与话题关联度，报告带证据并给出可复制的提示词改进建议，只观测不改写。
description.en: A quality and topic-coverage radar for every DSH answer: inline score chips, evidence-backed reports, and copy-ready prompt fixes — observational only, never rewriting output.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端提供 ChatGPT 式侧边快速提问面板，用独立轻量会话回答当前话题的小问题，完全不干扰主对话。
description.en: A ChatGPT-style side-chat panel for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI that answers quick questions about the current topic in an isolated lightweight session, leaving the main conversation untouched.

description.zh: DSH plugin 用树形结构记录长对话中尚未搞懂的问题：划词即建节点，问题挂在引用上，右栏随时回看原文，笔记存本地不耗 token。
description.en: A DSH plugin that keeps track of unresolved questions in long chats with a tree: select text to create nodes, attach questions to quotes, revisit sources from the right panel, all stored locally with zero tokens.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 聊天中选中片段即可在右侧临时侧会话里解释，不写入主会话历史与上下文。
description.en: Select any fragment in a DeepSeek Harness chat and get it explained in a disposable side conversation, leaving the main session history and context untouched.

description.zh: DSH plugin 按工作区管理快捷 shell 命令，在会话头部一键运行，实时弹窗显示输出，支持远程 SSH 工作区。
description.en: A DSH plugin that manages quick shell commands per workspace, runnable from the session header with live output popup and SSH remote workspace support.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在输入框旁加一个「增强」按钮，一键把当前草稿原地改写成精确可执行的提示词，失败不动草稿，并可一键恢复原文。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds an Enhance button to the composer, rewriting your current draft into a precise, executable prompt in place, with safe failure and one-click revert.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供 Ctrl+Space 快捷面板，一个输入框即可搜索会话、调用技能、跳转插件与设置并切换外观。
description.en: A Ctrl+Space command palette for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that lets you search sessions, invoke skills, jump to plugins and settings, and switch appearance from one box.

description.zh: DSH plugin 一键快捷输入：在消息输入框旁放一排可自定义的快捷指令按钮，点一下就把预设文字直接发送到当前对话，省去重复打字。
description.en: A DSH plugin that puts a row of customizable quick-send buttons beside the message composer, so one click sends preset text straight into the current conversation.

description.zh: dsh-quicklook 为 DSH 的 better-sidebar 活动文件标签页提供 QuickLook 风格空格键大图预览，支持图片、PDF 和文本即时浮层显示。
description.en: dsh-quicklook adds QuickLook-style space-key large preview for dsh-better-sidebar active file tabs, with instant image/PDF/text overlays.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 官方队列坞内直接拖拽或按钮调整排队消息顺序，装饰而非替换原坞，卸载后界面不受影响。
description.en: Reorder queued messages directly inside the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI's official queue dock via grip-and-drag or move buttons, decorating rather than replacing the dock.

description.zh: DSH plugin 集中监控 DeepSeek、Cursor、Codex 等 14+ 家 AI 服务的额度、余额与用量，提供看板、HUD 悬浮环、时序统计与预警，并注册 Agent Tool 供对话查询。
description.en: A DSH plugin that aggregates quota, balance, and usage monitoring for 14+ AI services like DeepSeek, Cursor, and Codex, featuring dashboards, HUD rings, time-series stats, and an Agent tool for in-chat queries.

description.zh: dsh-quicksight 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件，为纯文本模型补上识图能力，采用本地 OCR 与视觉模型双通道，离线快速识别，零 API 成本。
description.en: dsh-quicksight is a DSH plugin that adds image recognition to text-only models, using a dual-channel approach of local OCR and vision model, offline and fast with zero API cost.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 打造的可拖拽额度/费用面板，整合 OpenRouter 与 DeepSeek 余额及花费，数据来自官方 API 与本地会话日志计价引擎。
description.en: A draggable quota & cost dashboard for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, combining OpenRouter and DeepSeek balances and spend from official APIs and a local session-log pricing engine.

description.zh: DSH plugin 多源配额路由插件，按任务画像选择健康模型源，支持回退、冷却与可观测决策，实现成本可控的模型路由。
description.en: A policy-only multi-source quota router for DeepSeek Harness: routes tasks to healthy model sources with fallback, cooldown, and observable decisions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供统一的实时额度面板，聚合 OpenCodeGo、DeepSeek、OpenRouter、SiliconFlow、Moonshot 等提供商的余额与用量窗口，侧边栏一键查看，密钥仅留在主机端。
description.en: A unified real-time quota dashboard for DeepSeek Harness that aggregates balance and usage windows from OpenCodeGo, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow and Moonshot in one collapsible sidebar panel, with API keys kept host-side.

description.zh: DSH 插件，在极简卡片中实时展示 DeepSeek API 余额、Kimi For Coding 套餐余量及 ChatGPT 订阅限流窗口，含进度条、重置倒计时和波峰/波谷电价提醒，密钥不出主机。
description.en: A DSH plugin that displays DeepSeek API balance, Kimi For Coding quota, and ChatGPT subscription rate limits in a minimal card, with progress bars, reset countdowns, and peak/off-peak pricing reminders; keys never leave the host.

description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中选中文字即可生成临时注释文件并以引用块附到输入框，模型读完本轮后自动回收，零依赖、无需构建。
description.en: Select text in a DSH conversation to turn it into a temporary annotation file attached to the composer as a reference chip, auto-deleted once the turn reads it—zero dependencies, no build step.

description.zh: 把 DSH 左侧栏顶部面板与底部动作合并成一条列表统一排序，支持拖动、重命名、换图标、隐藏与分组，设置页改完即时生效。
description.en: A DSH plugin that treats the whole left sidebar as one rail: reorder, rename, re-icon, hide and group rows across the top panel list and the bottom action row, all from a Settings tab.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 左侧会话栏收起后残留的 56px 空轨道清零，把空间还给对话区，同时保留一键展开侧边栏的能力，纯浏览器端 CSS/DOM 补丁，零依赖装上即生效。
description.en: Zeroes out the empty 56px rail the DeepSeek Harness left sidebar leaves behind when collapsed, returning the space to the conversation pane while keeping the sidebar one click away — a zero-dependency browser-side CSS/DOM patch.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 强化 REA 逆向分析：按矩阵安装校验 13 个分析引擎、固定 MCP 版本并体检能力缺口，设置页一张卡片统管。
description.en: Supercharges REA reverse-engineering inside DeepSeek Harness: a matrix installs and verifies 13 analysis engines, pins the MCP server version, and a doctor card surfaces capability gaps.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的每条回复加上音浪朗读按钮，用微软神经音色逐句朗读并高亮当前句，支持暂停跳句与自动朗读。
description.en: Adds a sound-wave read-aloud button to every DeepSeek Harness reply, speaking sentences with natural neural voices while highlighting the current sentence, with pause, skip and auto-read.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 read_image 产生的 PNG/WebP 附件透明转换为 JPEG，以兼容 LM Studio 的 OpenAI 兼容接口，保持原生多模态流程不变。
description.en: A DSH plugin that transparently converts PNG/WebP attachments from read_image to JPEG for LM Studio compatibility, preserving the native multimodal flow.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 视频阅读插件：用 HTTP Range 只取目标时间附近的字节，让模型按时间戳取帧或取音频，无需下载整片视频。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that reads video by timestamp: HTTP Range fetches only the bytes around the target moment for frame grabs or audio windows, without downloading the whole file.

description.zh: 当 Clash 或 sing-box 返回 fake-ip 时，这款 DSH plugin 会为 web fetch 与 dns.lookup 找回真实公网地址，避免请求被 WEB_BLOCKED_URL 拦截。
description.en: A DSH plugin that recovers the real public address when Clash or sing-box returns a fake-ip, so web fetch and dns.lookup stop failing with WEB_BLOCKED_URL.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为模型配置输入模态与推理等级，在会话撰写器中侧开模型菜单，支持批量编辑与自定义 wire 值，增强模型推理控制。
description.en: A DSH plugin that configures input modalities and reasoning levels per model, with a side-opening model menu in the composer, bulk editing, and custom wire values.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Realtime Avatar 实时数字人：密钥由 harness 托管，公开文档转为按需技能，提供 rta_* 工具与 /rta 引导，让 Agent 直接发起语音视频通话。
description.en: Brings Realtime Avatar to the DeepSeek Harness: the harness holds the API key, public docs load as on-demand skills, and rta_* tools plus a /rta onboarding flow let an agent start live voice and video calls.

description.zh: DSH 插件把过长的模型思考蒸馏成核心内容并在后续请求中重放，节省重复 token，同时报告每个会话的开销与节省。
description.en: A DSH plugin that distills over-long model reasoning into its useful core, replays the compressed version on later requests to save tokens, and reports per-session cost and savings.

description.zh: dsh-reasoning-picker 是 DeepSeek Harness 的输入框按钮插件，发送前用廉价模型评估草稿难度，推荐 Flash 或 Pro 档位与推理强度，确认后才应用。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness composer button that judges your draft with a cheap model and recommends Flash or Pro plus reasoning effort, applying it only after you confirm.

description.zh: 为 DSH 接入的第三方模型服务商补上「思考强度」配置面板，内置 GPT、Claude、Grok、GLM、MiMo 推荐档位，一键套用即可在模型选择器中切换思考强度。
description.en: Adds a reasoning-effort panel for third-party model providers in DSH, with built-in presets for GPT, Claude, Grok, GLM and MiMo so you can switch effort levels right in the model picker.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧边栏增加最近会话与活跃会话区块，并支持折叠、排序与右键定位工作区。
description.en: Adds recent and active session blocks to the DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar, with collapsible lists, drag sorting and right-click workspace jump.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧边栏增加最近会话与活跃会话区块，并支持折叠、排序与右键定位工作区。
description.en: Adds recent and active session blocks to the DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar, with collapsible lists, drag sorting and right-click workspace jump.

description.zh: dsh-recipe 是 DSH plugin 的场景配方工具，将插件打包成可复用的环境配方，支持 list、search、apply、compose 操作，实现一键应用整套插件环境。
description.en: dsh-recipe is a scenario recipe tool for DSH plugins, bundling plugins into reusable environment recipes with list, search, apply, and compose actions for one-click environment setup.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧边栏增加最近会话与活跃会话区块，并支持折叠、排序与右键定位工作区。
description.en: Adds recent and active session blocks to the DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar, with collapsible lists, drag sorting and right-click workspace jump.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供模型请求安全重试的 DSH 插件，通过指数退避与网关恢复，让网络或服务商临时故障不再中断 Agent 任务。
description.en: A DSH plugin that safely retries model requests in DeepSeek Harness with exponential backoff and gateway recovery, so transient network or provider failures no longer interrupt agent turns.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供兼容 Claude Code 的分层指令与持久记忆系统，让所有模型共享同一套完整记忆指导。
description.en: A Claude Code-compatible memory system for DeepSeek Harness, layering CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md instructions with MEMORY.md persistent memory so every model gets the same full guidance.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上会话删除能力：删除即移入可恢复的回收站，子会话随主会话整树处理，支持批量操作与模型工具调用。
description.en: Adds session deletion to DeepSeek Harness: deleted sessions go to a restorable recycle bin, subagent sessions are handled as a whole tree, with batch operations and a model-facing tool.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供插件恢复点与独立应急恢复界面，系统正常时保存快照，崩溃后离线回滚到可用状态。
description.en: Saves plugin recovery points for DeepSeek Harness and offers a standalone emergency recovery UI, so you can roll back offline after a crash.

description.zh: 把 DSH Web composer 的思考强度选择器变成一条极简横线，档位按模型记忆、切换乐观即时，并顺带打磨模型选择器体验。
description.en: Turns the DSH web composer's reasoning-effort picker into a hairline ruler with per-model memory and optimistic switching, plus a streamlined model picker.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 前端提供特效开关设置页，按分类关闭动画、毛玻璃、阴影、渐变等效果，降低浏览器渲染负担。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a settings page to the DSH Web frontend for toggling animations, backdrop blur, shadows and gradients by category, cutting browser rendering cost.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补回页面刷新快捷键的 DSH 插件，让 F5、Ctrl+F5 与 Ctrl+Shift+R 可靠重载页面，并支持强制绕过缓存。
description.en: A DSH plugin that restores page reload shortcuts in DeepSeek Harness, making F5, Ctrl+F5 and Ctrl+Shift+R reliably reload the page, with hard reload bypassing the cache.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为任意会话挂载只读参考库，agent 查证时先检索库内资料，避免凭空猜测或直接搜网，支持可视化面板与跨会话导入。
description.en: A DSH plugin that attaches a read-only reference library to any session, forcing agent verification to search the library first, with a visual panel and cross-session import.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 补上生产版缺失的刷新快捷键，让 F5、Ctrl+R 可软刷新，加修饰键则硬刷新绕过缓存。
description.en: A DSH plugin that restores page-refresh shortcuts in DeepSeek Harness Desktop production builds, binding F5 and Ctrl+R to soft reload and modifier combos to cache-busted hard reload.

description.zh: dsh-release 是 DSH plugin 的一条命令发布流水线：自动完成检查、升版本、测试、推送、npm 发布与验证安装，凭据只读钥匙串且写操作需确认。
description.en: dsh-release is a one-command release pipeline for DSH plugins, handling checks, version bumps, tests, push, npm publish, verification and install, with credentials read only from the keychain and writes gated behind --yes.

description.zh: DSH plugin 把检查报告里的每条问题翻译成可照做的整改清单：具体步骤、改前改后片段、工时与验证命令，并支持有边界的机械修复。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns audit reports into actionable remediation checklists — concrete steps, before/after snippets, effort estimates and verification commands, plus bounded auto-apply fixes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 rembg 图像背景移除工具，模型可直接调用去背景，支持 CPU 与本地 NVIDIA GPU 模式。
description.en: A DSH plugin that exposes a rembg background-removal tool to the LLM, with CPU and local NVIDIA GPU modes.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为本地 DeepSeek Harness 提供局域网、Tailscale 私有远程及可选 Cloudflare Tunnel 公网访问，通过 API 网关统一管控远程入口与安全策略。
description.en: A DSH plugin that exposes local DeepSeek Harness over LAN, Tailscale private remote, and optional Cloudflare Tunnel public access, with an API gateway enforcing remote access policies.

description.zh: DSH Remote 让手机安全访问 Mac 上运行的 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面，需本地明确授权后启动 FRPC 隧道，并在设置中提供二维码配对与逐机撤销。
description.en: DSH Remote lets a phone securely reach the DeepSeek Harness Web UI running on a Mac, starting a verified FRPC tunnel only after explicit local consent, with QR pairing and per-phone revocation in Settings.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中通过 SSH 管理远程服务器，一键部署并启动远端 DSH、建立本机端口隧道，直接打开远程 Web 界面。
description.en: Manage remote servers inside DeepSeek Harness: deploy and launch DSH over SSH, set up a local port tunnel, and open the remote DSH web UI in one click.

description.zh: dsh-remote-deliver 是 DeepSeek Harness 的远程交付插件，让模型修改后的文件与图片在聊天窗口一键下载，告别 SCP 繁琐操作。
description.en: dsh-remote-deliver is a DSH plugin for remote delivery, enabling one-click download of modified files and images from chat, eliminating SCP hassle.

description.zh: 深鲸远程门禁是一款 DSH plugin，在服务上线前扫描监听地址、鉴权开关、CORS 与默认口令等远程暴露风险，并输出分级报告。
description.en: A DSH plugin that scans for remote exposure risks such as 0.0.0.0 listeners, disabled auth, wildcard CORS and default credentials before going live, with graded reports.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏顶部加一个「远程」入口，点击后整页切换为另一台主机的 DSH Web GUI，并用状态点提示远端会话运行与待答情况。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a "Remote" row atop the sidebar, turning the whole page into another host's DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with a session-state badge for that remote.

description.zh: DSH Remote Console 是 DeepSeek Harness 的移动端增强插件，通过 Tailscale 安全地将 DSH 界面提供给手机浏览器，支持状态显示、会话跳转与远程工作区打开。
description.en: DSH Remote Console is a mobile enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness, securely exposing the DSH interface to mobile browsers via Tailscale, with status display, session navigation, and remote workspace opening.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让不同机器上的 Bot 互相传话：借助 ds-harness-remote 的加密通道，把消息投递到对端 Bot 会话，并复用连接降低延迟。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets bots on different machines message each other, relaying messages into the remote bot's session over ds-harness-remote's encrypted channel with connection reuse.

description.zh: DSH Remote 让 Android 手机通过局域网或 ngrok 隧道远程操控电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness，支持会话浏览、流式对话与模型切换。
description.en: DSH Remote is an Android app plus DSH plugin that lets you control DeepSeek Harness on your PC over LAN or an ngrok tunnel, with session browsing, streaming chat and model switching.

description.zh: 让 DSH 通过严格 SSH 在远程主机上运行 agent 会话，复用原生工作区、对话、文件树与终端界面，并自动完成远程常驻运行时部署。
description.en: Runs remote DSH agent sessions over strict SSH while reusing the unchanged native workspace, conversation, file-tree and terminal UI, with automatic resident runtime provisioning.

description.zh: DSH plugin 通过 OpenSSH 在 Linux 主机上运行隔离的 DeepSeek Harness 运行时，提供远程配置、Doctor 检查、隧道、工作区、凭证与会话历史管理。
description.en: A DSH plugin that runs isolated DeepSeek Harness runtimes on Linux hosts via OpenSSH, adding remote profiles, Doctor checks, tunnels, workspaces, credentials, and session history.

description.zh: 为 DSH plugin 提供远端 sudo 密码面板，密码经 stdin 传给 SSH 上的 sudo，不进对话记录、工具参数或磁盘。
description.en: A DSH plugin that prompts for a remote sudo password in the composer and passes it to sudo over SSH stdin, keeping it out of the transcript, tool arguments, and disk.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Remotion Studio 动画工程启动器，通过悬浮面板一键构建、启动、停止服务并管理工程目录与端口。
description.en: A DSH plugin launcher for Remotion Studio animation projects, offering a floating panel to build, start, and stop the service and manage project paths and ports.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供远程主机工具集：主机发现、SSH 终端后端与 remote_search/exec 等模型可调用工具。
description.en: A DSH plugin bundle adding remote-host tooling: host discovery, an SSH terminal backend, and model-facing remote_search/exec tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的会话「…」菜单加上红色“删除会话”，二次确认后从侧栏与磁盘彻底移除该会话记录。
description.en: Adds a red "Delete Session" item to the DeepSeek Harness session "…" menu, permanently removing the session from the sidebar and disk after a confirmation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 主会话在第一轮对话结束后自动总结命名一次，子代理与队友会话不受影响，命名后永久冻结。
description.en: A host-only DSH plugin that names a main session once right after its first turn ends, leaving subagent and teammate sessions untouched.

description.zh: 为 DSH 提供机动车维修工单质检工具，按版本化规则包校验金额、数量、单价与结算总额等算术与完整性，只查数字不判维修是否合理。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that registers the repair_order_qc tool, checking motor-vehicle repair orders against a versioned rule pack for arithmetic and completeness — never judging whether the repair itself was justified.

description.zh: DSH 插件，将 git 状态与仓库规范动态注入 system prompt，让模型自动感知分支、脏文件与最近提交，无需手动重复。
description.en: A DSH plugin that dynamically injects git status and repo rules into the system prompt, keeping the model aware of branch, dirty files, and recent commits.

description.zh: 把「汇报」做成代理间一等交互原语的 DSH plugin：以 append-only 跳流账本记录传递路径，支持回执、结案与修正，并在会话头部提供汇报时间线标签页。
description.en: A DSH plugin that makes reporting a first-class primitive between agents: an append-only hop ledger for delivery paths, receipts, closure and corrections, plus a Reports timeline tab in the session header.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供研究写作组合包：一次安装即得文献检索与引用生成、BibTeX 清理补全、LaTeX 编译与引用审计能力。
description.en: A research writing bundle for DeepSeek Harness: one install brings literature search and citation generation, BibTeX lint/fill, plus LaTeX compile and citation audits.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生文献检索、书目核验、BibTeX 导出与会话快照，由 Field Current 提供事实源，并渲染文献卡片与常驻面板。
description.en: Native literature search, bibliographic verification, BibTeX, and session snapshots for DeepSeek Harness, powered by Field Current, with tool cards and a persistent panel.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一键重启：网页按钮或 dsh_restart 工具把重启交给独立助手进程，页面自动重连，启动失败时在页内与恢复控制台显示报错。
description.en: One-click restart for DeepSeek Harness: a web button or the dsh_restart tool hands relaunch to a detached helper, the page reconnects itself, and boot failures surface in an overlay plus a recovery console.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面在「设置」上方加一个「重启 dsh」按钮，原地重启进程，兼容 systemd、Docker、Kubernetes、pm2、launchd 与终端，零依赖免配置。
description.en: Adds a single Restart dsh button above Settings in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, restarting dsh in place across systemd, Docker, Kubernetes, pm2, launchd and plain terminals, with zero dependencies or configuration.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面左下角添加“重启后端”按钮，一键重启 dsh 后端进程，无需打开终端。
description.en: Adds a Restart Backend button to the bottom-left of the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, allowing one-click restart of the dsh backend process without opening a terminal.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一键重启：网页按钮或 dsh_restart 工具把重启交给独立助手进程，页面自动重连，启动失败时在页内与恢复控制台显示报错。
description.en: One-click restart for DeepSeek Harness: a web button or the dsh_restart tool hands relaunch to a detached helper, the page reconnects itself, and boot failures surface in an overlay plus a recovery console.

description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面端右上角常驻一个重启按钮，优雅关停并重开 Electron 外壳与宿主，有会话在跑时先确认。
description.en: Adds a persistent restart button to the DSH desktop top-right corner that gracefully shuts down and relaunches the Electron shell and host, confirming first when sessions are running.

description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面端右上角常驻一个重启按钮，优雅关停并重开 Electron 外壳与宿主，有会话在跑时先确认。
description.en: Adds a persistent restart button to the DSH desktop top-right corner that gracefully shuts down and relaunches the Electron shell and host, confirming first when sessions are running.

description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框工具栏加一个重启开关，可热重载 Cordis 内核或整体重启 DeepSeek Harness 应用，并显示失败原因。
description.en: Adds a restart switch to the DSH composer toolbar that hot-reloads the Cordis kernel or relaunches the whole DeepSeek Harness app, reporting any failure state.

description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框上方常驻退休倒计时，显示天、时、分、秒，点铅笔即可设置目标日期，明暗主题自动跟随。
description.en: A DSH plugin that keeps a retirement countdown above the composer, showing days, hours, minutes and seconds; click the pencil to set the target date, with automatic light/dark theme support.

description.zh: DSH Retry Guard 监测 DeepSeek Harness 中连续三次相同的工具调用失败，默认仅提示，可选暂停下一步模型动作，便于排查修复。
description.en: DSH Retry Guard watches for three identical tool failures in DeepSeek Harness, notifying by default and optionally pausing the next model step so you can inspect and fix the loop.

description.zh: Reverie 是 DeepSeek Harness 上的只读联想实验插件，可对笔记、JSON 导出或会话历史做开放式漫游，并留下报告与私有笔记。
description.en: Reverie is a read-only association experiment DSH plugin that wanders your notes, JSON exports or session history and leaves behind a report and a bounded private note.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打包 REA 逆向工程与 BAMA 技能包，共 23 项技能，可从二进制或截图出发分析应用并构建原生 macOS 应用。
description.en: A DSH plugin bundling REA reverse-engineering and BAMA skill packs (23 skills) to analyze shipped binaries and build native macOS apps from an idea or screenshot.

description.zh: DSH 局域网反向代理插件，让手机平板等设备在局域网内无缝访问 Web GUI，修复设置面板、WebSocket 等关键问题。
description.en: DSH LAN reverse proxy plugin that enables seamless access to the Web GUI from mobile devices on LAN, fixing settings panel and WebSocket issues.

description.zh: dsh-review 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多智能体对抗式代码审查，并行查找缺陷再由验证者逐一反驳，只报告确认的真实问题。
description.en: dsh-review packages multi-agent adversarial code review for DeepSeek Harness: parallel finders, then a verifier per finding, so only confirmed defects survive.

description.zh: dsh-review 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多智能体对抗式代码审查，并行查找缺陷再由验证者逐一反驳，只报告确认的真实问题。
description.en: dsh-review packages multi-agent adversarial code review for DeepSeek Harness: parallel finders, then a verifier per finding, so only confirmed defects survive.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供倒序阅读布局的 DSH plugin：输入框固定在会话顶部，转写与回合导航条最新在前，向下滚动回溯历史。
description.en: A DSH plugin that flips the DeepSeek Harness conversation layout: the composer pins to the top, and the transcript plus turn navigator render newest-first so you scroll down to go back in time.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 diff 提供持久化、GitHub 风格的评审线程，接管官方 changes-review 面板，支持行级评论、草稿提交与 /review 命令。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings persistent, GitHub-style review threads to DeepSeek Harness diffs, taking over the official changes-review tab with line-level comments, draft submission and /review commands.

description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面端右上角常驻一个重启按钮，优雅关停并重开 Electron 外壳与宿主，有会话在跑时先确认。
description.en: Adds a persistent restart button to the DSH desktop top-right corner that gracefully shuts down and relaunches the Electron shell and host, confirming first when sessions are running.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面叠加 RGB 流光皮肤，输入框、侧栏与 hero 标题带 WebGL bloom 辉光，独立生效不改原皮肤。
description.en: An RGB glow skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, adding WebGL bloom halos to the composer, sidebar and hero title without touching any existing skin.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的会话、任务执行与工作区管理以 MCP 服务器形式开放给任意 MCP 客户端，同时注册为 dsh 原生工具，让其他 Agent 也能创建和操控 dsh 会话。
description.en: Exposes DeepSeek Harness sessions, task execution and workspace management as an MCP server for any MCP client, and registers the same tools natively so dsh sessions can drive themselves.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏标签页加上浏览器式鼠标手势：中键或左键双击即可关闭标签，关闭动作仍走官方 × 逻辑，安全不误伤。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds browser-style mouse gestures to DeepSeek Harness right-sidebar tabs: middle-click or double-click closes a tab, delegating to the official × logic so nothing else breaks.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一套 righthand 工具集：持久 KV 存储、凭据与设置管理、受管控的命令执行与工具守卫，全部基于 DSH 原生服务构建。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that ships a righthand toolset — durable KV store, credential and settings management, governed command execution, and a tool guard — all built on DSH-native services.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 装上 Roboto Mono 字体，并补齐框线与 Nerd Font 图标回退，让代码块和 SSH 终端不再错列缺字。
description.en: A DSH plugin that embeds Roboto Mono with DejaVu and Nerd Font fallbacks, so code blocks and SSH terminals render aligned monospace glyphs and icons.

description.zh: dsh-risk-guard 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供零打扰的 Agent 操作审计与保险丝拦截，记录每次工具调用并阻止不可逆的破坏性操作，全程无 LLM 调用、零额外成本。
description.en: dsh-risk-guard is a zero-interruption audit and fuse blocking plugin for DeepSeek Harness, recording every tool call and blocking irreversible destructive operations with no LLM calls and zero extra cost.

description.zh: dsh-rollback 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供文件变更回滚能力，通过检查点与快照记录写入/编辑及 bash 调用前的文件状态，并以 rollback_files 工具和 /rollback 命令实现一键恢复。
description.en: dsh-rollback is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that enables file-mutation rollback by checkpointing pre-images of write/edit operations and snapshotting workspace changes from bash calls, exposing restore via rollback_files tool and /rollback command.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏提供 RSS 阅读器，订阅源写在配置里，未读与收藏状态双向同步，Agent 也能通过 rss_panel 工具读写条目。
description.en: An RSS reader docked in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: feeds live in config, unread and starred states stay in sync both ways, and the Agent can read or update items via the rss_panel tool.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供完整俄语界面翻译的 DSH 插件，注册 49 个命名空间共 2581 条俄语字符串，在语言选择器中加入「Русский」并在首次运行时自动切换界面语言。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings a full Russian interface to DeepSeek Harness: 2,581 translated strings across 49 namespaces, a Русский entry in the language picker, and automatic switching on first run.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供圆盘式右键菜单，在对话轮次上右键即可就近执行分叉、打断、复制路径、导出日志等常用会话操作。
description.en: A radial right-click menu for DeepSeek Harness: right-click any conversation turn to fork from that turn, interrupt, copy paths, or export logs right at the cursor.

description.zh: DSH plugin 统一管理全局与项目规则，支持 LLM 自动拆分规则为按需加载的技能文件，设置面板一键编辑。
description.en: A DSH plugin to manage global and project rules, with LLM auto-splitting into on-demand skill files, all in one settings panel.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件和工具提供基于证据的运行时营养标签，展示声明的能力与观察到的文件系统、网络及副作用活动。
description.en: Evidence-backed runtime nutrition labels for DeepSeek Harness plugins and tools, revealing declared capabilities and observed filesystem, network, and side-effect activity.

description.zh: 这是一款 DSH plugin，在调用前自动剔除无法放宽当前沙箱模式的 sandbox_permissions 与 justification 参数，避免 GPT 模型因「not strictly wider」报错而白白失败。
description.en: A DSH plugin that strips sandbox_permissions and justification arguments which cannot widen the call's current sandbox mode, so GPT models no longer fail with 'not strictly wider' errors.

description.zh: DSH plugin 修复 pwsh/bash/fs/dsh-sandbox 中 sandbox_permissions 与 justification 字段的 no-op 升级报错，自动打补丁并支持恢复。
description.en: A DSH plugin that fixes no-op escalation errors in sandbox_permissions and justification fields across pwsh/bash/fs/dsh-sandbox, with auto-patching and restore.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加「写时复制」权限预设，让 shell 命令在按工作区隔离的 Sandboxie 沙箱中运行，工作区写入照常落盘，其余改动只留在沙箱副本里，便于误操作回退。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a Copy-on-write permission preset: shell commands run inside a per-workspace Sandboxie box, so workspace writes hit the real disk while all other changes stay in the box copy for easy undo.

description.zh: dsh-safe-web-fetch 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供防 SSRF 的 WebFetchProvider，确保仅访问公网地址，并限制重定向、响应大小与超时，保障 web_fetch 安全。
description.en: dsh-safe-web-fetch provides an SSRF-resistant WebFetchProvider for DeepSeek Harness, ensuring public-only access with redirect, size, and timeout limits for safe web_fetch.

description.zh: 为 DSH 提供「科学家模式」科研 agent preset，集成领域调研、文献检索、PDF 精读与符号推导，让 DeepSeek Harness 直接承担跨学科科研工作流。
description.en: A scientist-mode research agent preset for DeepSeek Harness, bundling domain surveys, literature retrieval, PDF reading and symbolic derivation into one reproducible DSH plugin workflow.

description.zh: dsh-schematic 是 DeepSeek Harness 的插件拓扑可视化工具，以交互式接线图展示已挂载插件、运行时活动与组合工作台，并支持在图上直接编辑配置。
description.en: dsh-schematic is a live plugin-topology viewer for DeepSeek Harness, rendering the wiring diagram of mounted plugins, runtime activity, and a composition workbench for editing on the graph.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面每日轮换唯美山海背景的 DSH plugin，支持每日一图、循环轮播与悬浮控制按钮。
description.en: A DSH plugin that rotates beautiful mountain-sea backgrounds daily for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, featuring daily image, carousel, and floating controls.

description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 的学术文献研究 Agent 预设，集成 Scopus 与 OpenAlex，实现检索、论断查证与下一步调研的完整研究闭环。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness agent preset for scientific literature research, integrating Scopus and OpenAlex to enable a full research loop of discovery, claim verification, and next-step planning.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一键创建临时工作区的 DSH plugin：自动生成独立文件夹与会话，侧边栏面板统一管理，支持安全清理与空闲自动过期。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that creates throwaway workspaces in one click, each with its own folder and session, managed from a sidebar panel with safe cleanup and optional idle auto-expiry.

description.zh: DSH plugin科学计算工具，为DeepSeek Harness提供NumPy/SciPy数学计算能力，模型可通过math_compute工具调用任意运算并返回结构化JSON结果。
description.en: A DSH plugin offering NumPy/SciPy scientific computing capabilities, enabling models to invoke math_compute tool for arbitrary operations with structured JSON results.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Scrapling 网页抓取工具，支持 JavaScript 渲染、CSS/XPath 结构化提取、自愈选择器与后台爬虫。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings Scrapling web scraping to DeepSeek Harness: JavaScript rendering, CSS/XPath structured extraction, self-healing selectors and a background crawler.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供定时任务能力：每个任务绑定 Agent 预设、提示词与 cron 周期，到点自动开启全新会话执行并保留运行记录。
description.en: Adds scheduled tasks to DeepSeek Harness: each task binds an agent preset, a prompt and a cron-style interval, then fires a fresh session on schedule and keeps run history.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将本地屏幕自动化小助手桥接为 Agent 工具，提供截图、OCR、鼠标键盘控制及工作流管理等 30 个工具。
description.en: A DSH plugin bridging the local Screen Automation Helper into Agent tools, offering 30 tools for screenshots, OCR, mouse/keyboard control, and workflow management.

description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面版输入框加「录屏」「截图」按钮，把说不清的界面问题变成可直接发给模型的视频或图片证据，减少人机沟通来回损耗。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds Record and Screenshot buttons to the DSH Desktop composer, turning hard-to-describe UI issues into video or image evidence you can hand straight to the model.

description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框的 + 菜单加入截图入口，在 Mac 上框选区域后直接以图片附件落入对话输入框，并支持先隐藏窗口再截图。
description.en: Adds a Screenshot entry to the DSH composer's + menu, letting Mac users capture a screen region straight into the chat input as an image attachment, with an optional hide-window mode.

description.zh: DSH plugin 像素对比工具，对两张截图生成差异标红的 diff.png 与三联对比图，支持灵敏度调节，辅助视觉回归测试。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pixel-diffs two screenshots into a red-highlighted diff.png and a labeled triptych, with adjustable sensitivity for visual regression testing.

description.zh: dsh-sdd-generator 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，扫描代码库并生成软件设计文档（SDD）大纲，包含模块清单、入口点和逐文件摘要。
description.en: dsh-sdd-generator is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that scans a codebase and generates a Software Design Document (SDD) outline with module inventory, entry points, and per-file summary.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 聊天区右边缘加一条特雷门琴式滚动钢琴竖条，鼠标纵向滑动即按位置发声，并带「我的消息」刻度可点击跳转。
description.en: A theremin-style scroll piano for the DeepSeek Harness chat pane: slide the mouse along the right edge to play notes by vertical position, with clickable "my messages" ticks for jumping.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供结构化网页搜索、单页抓取与一次成稿的研究工具，基于官方 Search/Fetch 接口，返回带 rerank 分与权威度的结果而非原始 HTML。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness structured web search, single-page fetch and one-call research via the official Search/Fetch API, returning rerank scores and authority instead of raw HTML.

description.zh: DSH 右侧边栏插件，实时展示当前会话的 SDD 任务进度与 sdd/progress.md 进度台账，支持 Markdown 渲染与自动刷新。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a right-sidebar tab showing the current session's SDD task progress and the sdd/progress.md ledger, with Markdown rendering and auto-refresh.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供微信式截图按钮的 DSH plugin：点击后桌面冻结成可框选画面，选中区域直接进入输入框，Windows 原生浮层可截取任意窗口。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a WeChat-style screenshot button to DeepSeek Harness: click to freeze the desktop into a selectable overlay and send the chosen region straight into the input box, with a native Windows overlay that can capture any window.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一次性密钥表单链接：模型发起请求，用户在网页表单中填写，密钥直接写入凭据库或文件，不进入会话记录。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness one-time secret links: the model asks, the human types into a web form, and the value lands in the credential store or a file, never in the transcript.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设置页加入网页搜索提供方切换行，动态列出已注册的 provider，选择后下一次搜索立即生效，无需重启。
description.en: Adds a web search provider switcher to DeepSeek Harness settings, dynamically listing registered providers with changes taking effect on the next search without a restart.

description.zh: DSH plugin 决策层插件，自动判断何时需要联网搜索，强制先搜后答并引用来源，本地任务零打扰。
description.en: A DSH plugin that decides when to search the web, enforces search-first answers with citations, and stays out of the way for local tasks.

description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面窗口中划选文字即可就地翻译，调用内置 Bing/Google 免费接口，无需 API key。
description.en: Select text in the DSH desktop window and translate it in place via built-in free Bing/Google endpoints, no API key required.

description.zh: 为 DSH 插件提供隐式自检：在最终回答送达前扣住草稿，交由一次独立的最小上下文模型调用复核，只放行校验后的文本。
description.en: A DSH plugin that holds each final answer before delivery, verifies it with one independent minimal-context model call, and releases only the verified text.

description.zh: DSH 自升级插件，在 Web GUI 设置页添加系统更新区块，一键检查版本并执行升级，支持实时进度与自动重启。
description.en: DSH self-upgrade plugin adds a system update section to the Web GUI settings, enabling one-click version check and upgrade with real-time progress and auto-restart.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供 Windows 下可靠的自助重启能力：提权强杀进程树、释放端口、拉起服务并自动恢复前端，重启后自动发现并续跑中断的会话。
description.en: DSH plugin for reliable elevated restart on Windows: force-kill process tree, release port, restart service, auto-recover front-end, and auto-resume interrupted sessions after reboot.

description.zh: 为 DSH plugin 中的 Agent 提供十种内感受状态：基于文件时间与真实对话做指数衰减与时间积分，让情绪、需求与表达随时间自然变化。
description.en: Gives a DeepSeek Harness agent ten interoceptive senses: exponential decay and time integration over file mtimes and real dialogue, so affect, needs and expression drift naturally over time.

description.zh: DSH 服务器管理面板，无需 SSH 即可在线重启、systemd 保活、安装插件、监控状态并执行命令，是 DeepSeek Harness 的运维利器。
description.en: DSH server admin panel for restart, systemd keep-alive, plugin install, status monitoring and command terminal without SSH—an ops tool for DeepSeek Harness.

description.zh: 把「会记得你的角色」接进 DeepSeek Harness：人格是数据、情绪是状态、记忆是文件，三者可读可改可复算，让角色拥有连续的记忆与情绪。
description.en: Bring a character who remembers you into DeepSeek Harness: persona as data, emotion as state, memory as files — all readable, editable and reproducible, so the character keeps continuous memory and mood.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏提供只读 Linux 服务器监控，通过 SSH 管理多台主机并实时查看 CPU、内存、磁盘、进程与端口状态。
description.en: A read-only Linux server monitor for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: manage multiple SSH hosts and watch CPU, memory, disk, processes, containers and ports in real time.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在审批、计划评审或问答超时未处理时，通过 Server酱向手机发送提醒，无需保持浏览器打开。
description.en: A DSH plugin that sends mobile notifications via ServerChan when approvals, plan reviews, or Q&A time out, without needing the browser open.

description.zh: DSH plugin 守护 DeepSeek Harness 主界面服务：一键重启、实时状态与运行时长，崩溃时看门狗自动拉起，支持开机自启与二次确认。
description.en: A DSH plugin that guards the DeepSeek Harness web service: one-click restart, live status and uptime, with a self-healing watchdog that auto-restarts on crash, plus login autostart.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏会话列表补上右键菜单、双击重命名、复制会话 ID 与永久删除会话，删除时同步清理磁盘存储并通知其他插件。
description.en: Adds right-click menus, double-click rename, session ID copy and permanent deletion to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar conversation list, wiping on-disk storage and notifying other plugins.

description.zh: 为 DSH 会话提供产物归拢与命名：每个会话一个专属文件夹，收尾按实际内容改名并刷新索引，解决产物散落与事后记不清。
description.en: A DSH plugin that keeps every session's artifacts in one dedicated folder, renaming it by actual content at wrap-up and refreshing an index, so scattered outputs stay findable.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏会话行绘制状态：运行中显示估算百分比与流光进度条，完成后整行转橙并保留到你点开为止。
description.en: A DSH plugin that paints status onto each sidebar session row: running sessions show an estimated percentage and a shimmering progress bar, while finished ones turn orange and stay lit until you open them.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话级 LLM 费用估算：按官方价目表把用量分四桶计价，输入框下方显示会话合计、每条回复旁显示本轮花费，纯展示不改行为。
description.en: A session-level LLM cost estimator for DeepSeek Harness: it prices reported usage across four buckets using official rate cards, showing a session total under the input box and per-reply cost beside each response, purely display-only.

description.zh: dsh-session-bridge 是一个 DSH plugin，通过本地回环 HTTP 桥接与 stdio MCP 服务器，让 Claude Code 等 MCP 客户端打开、发送、等待并读取 DeepSeek Harness 会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that bridges DeepSeek Harness sessions to MCP clients: a token-guarded loopback HTTP bridge plus a stdio MCP server let Claude Code open, send, wait on, and read sessions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生归档会话管理面板，可搜索筛选、取消归档，并支持单项或批量永久删除与清空归档。
description.en: A native archived-session management panel for DeepSeek Harness, offering search, filtering, unarchive, and guarded single or batch permanent deletion.

description.zh: Threadloom 是 DeepSeek Harness 的会话管理插件，可跨 workspace 浏览、筛选、查看、批量整理并回收或恢复会话，并提供只读 agent 工具。
description.en: Threadloom is a DSH plugin for session management: browse, filter, inspect, batch-manage and trash or restore sessions across workspaces, plus read-only agent tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端补上会话删除能力：侧边栏原生「移入回收站」、可恢复回收站管理页与 HTTP API，支持重名防误删、对话预览与定期自动清空。
description.en: Adds native session deletion to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a sidebar "move to trash" action, a recoverable trash management page and HTTP API, with name-collision guard, conversation preview and scheduled auto-purge.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏新增带确认弹窗的永久删除会话操作，彻底清除会话目录与注册表记录，弥补归档无法真正移除的缺陷。
description.en: Adds a permanent Delete session action to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, behind a confirmation dialog that fully unlinks the session and releases its id from every registry.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端补上会话删除能力：侧边栏原生「移入回收站」、可恢复回收站管理页与 HTTP API，支持重名防误删、对话预览与定期自动清空。
description.en: Adds native session deletion to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a sidebar "move to trash" action, a recoverable trash management page and HTTP API, with name-collision guard, conversation preview and scheduled auto-purge.

description.zh: 为 DSH 侧栏会话标题按状态染色：未读蓝/绿、置顶黄、后台 shell 任务紫，多状态合成一条渐变，并附「模型更新」排序与未读设置面板。
description.en: Colors DSH sidebar session titles by state — unread (blue running / green done), pinned (yellow), live background shell jobs (purple) — merged into one gradient, plus a "Model updated" sort mode and unread settings.

description.zh: 这是一款 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件，在会话输入框下方状态条实时显示当前会话的 DeepSeek 话费（人民币），点击金额可弹出输入、缓存、输出分类明细。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that shows the current session's DeepSeek spend in CNY on the status bar below the input box, with a click-through breakdown by input, cache and output.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的每个会话设置专属颜色标记，让侧边栏中相似的会话一眼可辨，标记存于 Host 端，跨设备同步可见。
description.en: Give every DeepSeek Harness session its own colour mark so look-alike sidebar rows are instantly recognisable, with marks stored on the Host and visible across devices.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上会话删除能力：以可恢复的软删除把会话移入回收站，并提供归档、置顶与回收站管理面板。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds session deletion to DeepSeek Harness as a recoverable soft delete, plus a session manager panel for archived, pinned and trashed sessions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏会话按自然日分组，显示具体日期与今天/昨天标签，支持日期搜索、归档与运行状态提示。
description.en: A DSH plugin that groups sidebar sessions by calendar date within each workspace, with explicit date labels, date-aware search, archive toggle and live run-status indicators.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏加上置顶栏、最近活动视图、项目 emoji 图标与可折叠分区，让你在一个面板里管理整个工作区而非单个会话。
description.en: A Codex-style sidebar for DeepSeek Harness: pin projects and conversations to one band, switch to a recently-used activity view with answer previews, give each project an emoji icon, and collapse sections you don't need.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏会话菜单补上缺失的删除会话能力，支持强制一步删净日志、缓存与注册表，不留幽灵行。
description.en: Adds the missing Delete session action to DeepSeek Harness sidebar menus, with one-click force delete that purges logs, caches and registry entries without ghost rows.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上跨会话写能力：DSH plugin 可向同一工作区的其他会话发消息、新建顶层会话，并阻塞等待其跑完再继续。
description.en: Adds cross-session write capability to DeepSeek Harness: this DSH plugin sends messages to other sessions in the same workspace, creates new top-level sessions, and blocks until a target turn finishes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 已发生的会话做回溯评分：基于持久化日志生成确定性评分卡，并跨会话对比回归趋势，无需基准集或 LLM 裁判。
description.en: Retrospective grading for DeepSeek Harness sessions: deterministic grade cards from persisted logs plus cross-session regression diffs, with no benchmarks or LLM judges.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话收藏面板，可星标常用对话、按工作区归类、搜索标题并用 @ 引用，让常回访的会话一键可达。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a favorites panel for DeepSeek Harness sessions, letting you star, group, search and @-reference the conversations you return to most.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏会话菜单补上缺失的删除会话能力，支持强制一步删净日志、缓存与注册表，不留幽灵行。
description.en: Adds the missing Delete session action to DeepSeek Harness sidebar menus, with one-click force delete that purges logs, caches and registry entries without ghost rows.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话列表加上可自定义命名的彩色标记，并提供可搜索的侧边栏面板，帮你快速找回重要会话。
description.en: Adds colored, user-named flags to DeepSeek Harness session lists plus a searchable sidebar panel, so you can mark and quickly find the sessions that matter.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 DeepSeek Harness 会话导出为人类可读的 Markdown/JSON 转录或原始日志 ZIP，写入主机路径，支持任意持久化后端。
description.en: A DSH plugin that exports DeepSeek Harness sessions as human-readable Markdown/JSON transcripts or raw log ZIPs to a host path, on any persistence backend.

description.zh: 为 DSH 会话加上焦点标记：一键标记进行中或挂起，工作区折叠时仍能看到计数，并可按状态查看跨工作区完整列表。
description.en: Adds focus marks to DeepSeek Harness sessions: flag what you are working on or park what is waiting, keep counts visible when workspace folders collapse, and browse a cross-workspace list grouped by state.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话历史添加 Codex 风格消息导航条，悬停即可预览并跳转用户消息，提升长会话浏览效率。
description.en: Adds a Codex-style message navigation bar to DeepSeek Harness session history, enabling hover preview and jump to user messages for efficient long-conversation browsing.

description.zh: dsh-session-html 是 DeepSeek Harness 的会话导出插件，可将会话树、子代理、上下文、工具、Markdown 与媒体导出为单个离线 Pi 风格 HTML 文件。
description.en: dsh-session-html is a DSH plugin that exports Session trees, subagents, context, tools, Markdown, and media into a single offline Pi-style HTML file.

description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness Web UI会话头部显示当前会话ID，点击一键复制，支持截断显示与复制反馈。
description.en: Display the current session ID in the DeepSeek Harness web UI header, with click-to-copy, truncation, and copy feedback.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话隔离的输入历史导航：在输入框按 ↑/↓ 即可像 shell history 一样翻出当前会话发过的消息，不落盘、不跨会话污染。
description.en: Session-scoped input history navigation for DeepSeek Harness: press ↑/↓ in the composer to walk through messages sent in the current session, shell-history style, with no persistence and no cross-session bleed.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话管理：按工作区建立分类树，支持拖拽排序、置顶、归档与可撤销删除回收站。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings real session management to the sidebar: workspace-scoped category trees, drag reordering, pinning, an archive section and an undoable delete bin.

description.zh: 为 DSH 最近用过的会话各持一张引用凭据，让同一标签页内切走再切回时直接复用已加载的历史窗口，不再重新拉取首页历史，并以 LRU 上限控制内存占用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that keeps the most recently used sessions resident by holding one extra reference each, so switching back in the same tab reuses the loaded history window instead of re-reading it, with an LRU cap bounding memory.

description.zh: DSH 插件：在 archive-manager 删除会话后，自动清理 billion-context 快照索引与 cost-meter 账本残留，并支持备份恢复。
description.en: A DSH plugin that purges leftover billion-context snapshots and cost-meter ledger entries after archive-manager deletes a session, with backup and restore support.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话状态总览：标题栏状态条、Windows 通知与任务栏红黄绿状态点，一眼看清哪些会话在运行、等待、未读或失败。
description.en: A session status hub for DeepSeek Harness: a title-bar rail, Windows toast notifications and a red-yellow-green taskbar dot that show which Sessions are running, waiting, unread or failed.

description.zh: DSH 插件：只读会话惰性查看器，仅 stat 列出 ~/.dsh/sessions 全部会话，并只解压尾部 zstd 帧快速查看最近事件，零写入。
description.en: A read-only DSH plugin that lists all sessions under ~/.dsh/sessions via stat only and decompresses just the trailing zstd frames to peek at recent events without touching the full file.

description.zh: 为 DSH 会话视图新增可拖拽缩放的会话树径向地图，直观展示对话分支来源，点击节点即可切换会话。
description.en: Adds a draggable, zoomable radial map of the session tree to the DSH conversation view, showing which conversation branched off where and letting you switch sessions by clicking a node.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）会话加锁的 DSH plugin：锁住的会话会被所有归档路径拒绝，侧栏一键上锁，批量归档自动跳过。
description.en: A DSH plugin that locks DeepSeek Harness sessions: locked sessions are refused by every archive path, with a one-click sidebar lock and bulk archiving that always skips them.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端缓存未变更的冷会话列表行，避免每 5 秒重建全部会话行而持续占用 CPU。注意：作者已于 2026-10-05 宣布退役，基准测试未测出可复现收益，不建议安装。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that caches unchanged cold session-list rows so an open page stops rebuilding every stored session every 5 seconds. Note: retired on 2026-10-05 — a controlled benchmark found no measurable gain, so it is not recommended for install.

description.zh: DSH 对话侧边备忘录插件，汇总 GitHub 同步状态、npm 发布状态、项目版本与备忘标签至浮动面板，并与会话状态弱联动。
description.en: A DSH plugin that aggregates GitHub sync status, npm publish status, project version, and memo tags into a floating panel, loosely coupled with session status.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供可搜索的消息浮层：用 Ctrl+S 打开当前会话已加载消息列表，键盘跳转到任意一条消息。
description.en: A searchable message overlay for DeepSeek Harness sessions: press Ctrl+S to list loaded messages and jump to any of them with the keyboard.

description.zh: dsh-session-metrics 是 DSH plugin，把输入框下方的统计栏替换为一行 Token、上下文、缓存与耗时数据，明细悬浮查看。
description.en: A DSH plugin that replaces the composer stats band with a single row of billed tokens, context usage, cache hits and timing, with full details in a hover panel.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供统一会话管理设置页，可生成标题、归档恢复、跨工作区移动与彻底删除，DSH plugin 零模型工具开销。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a unified session manager settings page for DeepSeek Harness: generate titles, archive/restore, move across workspaces, and permanently delete sessions with zero model-tool overhead.

description.zh: DSH plugin 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 工作区之间移动冷会话，保留 SessionId 与事件历史，提供只读预检与安全迁移。
description.en: A DSH plugin to move cold sessions between DeepSeek Harness workspaces, preserving SessionId and event history, with read-only dry-run and safe migration.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 会话的本地优先笔记插件，把对话片段划线引用整理成可搜索、可打标签、可导出的个人知识库。
description.en: A local-first note-taking DSH plugin that turns DeepSeek Harness conversation snippets into a searchable, taggable, exportable personal knowledge base.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 会话提供桌面通知：会话完成、失败、待审批或待回答时通过浏览器通知与 Windows Toast 提醒，点击即可定位到对应会话。
description.en: Desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness Web sessions: browser notifications and Windows toasts alert you when a session completes, fails, needs approval or an answer, and clicking opens that session.

description.zh: 为 DSH 会话补上日志路径与交接能力：一键复制当前会话的日志路径或接续指令，并把多帧 zstd 日志解压成可读文件，让另一个会话直接读取并接着干。
description.en: Adds session log paths and handoff to DeepSeek Harness: copy a session's log path or a paste-ready handoff block, and decompress multi-frame zstd logs into readable files so another session can read and continue the work.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在会话停止时发送桌面通知、提示音和标题闪烁，点击通知即可跳转至对应会话，让您不错过任何等待处理的任务。
description.en: DSH plugin alerts you when a session stops—via desktop notification, chime, and title flash—and lets you click to jump to that session.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏加上未读与待办中枢：红黄双角标区分跑完未看与等待输入，⌘⇧J / ⌘⇧I 顺序定位，⌘⇧K 弹出总览，账本落盘重启不丢。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns the sidebar into an unread and pending hub: red/yellow badges split finished-but-unseen from waiting-for-input sessions, with ⌘⇧J / ⌘⇧I sequential jumps, a ⌘⇧K overview, and a host-side ledger that survives restarts.

description.zh: DSH 宿主插件，把游离（未分组）会话按 cwd 归位到匹配的工作区，只改归属记录、不碰会话文件，支持拖拽与 /reattach 命令且默认 dry-run。
description.en: A DSH host plugin that re-attaches ungrouped sessions to their matching workspace by cwd — ownership bookkeeping only, never rewriting session logs, with drag-and-drop and a dry-run /reattach command.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话全文检索的 DSH plugin，通过 recall 工具让模型搜索历史会话记录，支持持久化索引与中文回退。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness enabling cross-session full-text recall, letting the model search past session transcripts via a recall tool with persistent indexing and CJK fallback.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话的 ⋯ 菜单添加「删除会话」项，确认后彻底清除会话日志、投影缓存与工作区注册记录，释放本地磁盘。
description.en: Adds a Delete session action to the DeepSeek Harness session ⋯ menu, permanently wiping the session log, projection cache and workspace registry entries from disk.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上 AI 自主重命名会话的能力，新增零依赖的 session_rename 工具，让模型按用户语言为当前会话起标题并钉住。
description.en: A zero-dependency DSH plugin that adds the session_rename tool, letting the model title its own current session in the user's language and pin it.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 补上 session_search 工具，让模型直接对历史会话做全文检索，无需重放归档即可找回过往结论与代码片段。
description.en: Adds a session_search tool to DeepSeek Harness agents, letting the model run full-text search over historical sessions and recall past decisions or code snippets without replaying archives.

description.zh: DSH 会话回放插件，按 Turn 与 Step 梳理已完成会话时间线，可在新会话中重放主 Agent 或子代理的某一步骤，且不改动源会话。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that groups a completed session timeline by Turn and Step and replays a chosen main-agent or subagent Step in a new session without touching the source session.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 补上 session_search 工具，让模型直接对历史会话做全文检索，无需重放归档即可找回过往结论与代码片段。
description.en: Adds a session_search tool to DeepSeek Harness agents, letting the model run full-text search over historical sessions and recall past decisions or code snippets without replaying archives.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为每个会话提供独立的工作区可见性层，仅向 Agent 暴露显式选定的目录，实现聚焦且隔离的访问控制。
description.en: A DSH plugin that provides per-session workspace scoping, exposing only explicitly selected directories to agents with focused and isolated enforcement.

description.zh: DSH plugin 可将完整会话树导出为离线 Capsule 文件，供他人导入复用，实现会话的离线分享与迁移。
description.en: A DSH plugin that exports complete session trees as offline Capsules for sharing and importing between Harness installations.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供多会话分屏的 DSH 插件，可在当前会话旁并排最多四个实时会话，各自独立收发消息与审批。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds multi-session split view to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, showing up to four live session panes side by side, each with its own messages and approvals.

description.zh: DSH 插件：上下文压力到阈值时自动把当前工作交接给新会话，机械提取改动文件、工具与近期消息生成可审阅交接包，旧会话仅改名保留。
description.en: A DSH plugin that hands off the current work to a fresh session when context pressure hits a threshold, mechanically extracting changed files, tools and recent messages into a reviewable handoff package while the old session is kept intact.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话对话、目录即队列信箱与「会话中枢」面板，支持会话交棒、导出导入与工作区登记。
description.en: A DSH plugin for cross-session chat, a directory-as-queue mailbox, and a Session Hub panel, with session handover, export/import, and workspace registration.

description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面版提供 Ctrl+Tab 快捷键，在当前会话与上一个会话之间来回切换，像浏览器切标签页一样顺手。
description.en: Adds a Ctrl+Tab shortcut to the DSH desktop app that toggles between the current and previous session, just like switching browser tabs.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供对话窗口间真实消息互发与角色窗口团队编排，按 dsh:// 链接精确寻址，让一个窗口当负责人指挥多窗口分工协作。
description.en: A DSH plugin for real cross-window messaging and role-based window teams, addressed by canonical dsh:// links so one lead window can coordinate multiple worker windows.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上模型可调用的会话标题工具，按你自定义的正则规则设置并钉住标题，避免被自动生成的标题覆盖。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives the model a set_session_title tool so it can rename and pin session titles using your own regex rules instead of auto-generated ones.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上会话删除能力的 DSH 插件，提供斜杠命令与 agent 工具，默认移入回收站、支持永久清理与运行中会话处理。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds session deletion to DeepSeek Harness, offering slash commands and agent tools with trash-by-default safety, purge, and running-session handling.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话工具，让 AI 直接新建会话或给其他会话发消息，免去手动新建与复制粘贴。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives the agent session tools to create new sessions or send messages to other sessions, no manual setup or copy-paste needed.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话新增 Usage 标签页，按模型与轮次展示 token、耗时与缓存命中率，数据取自宿主投影，口径与状态栏一致。
description.en: Adds a Usage tab to DeepSeek Harness sessions, showing tokens, wall time and cache hit share per model and per turn, using host projections so figures match the status bar.

description.zh: DSH plugin 用于清理侧边栏隐藏的会话：列出并删除已归档、空白或日志不可读的会话，并同步清理工作区与归档记录。
description.en: A DSH plugin that surfaces and deletes sessions the sidebar hides — archived, blank, or unreadable logs — cleaning up workspace and archive records too.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏底部常驻六项会话状态读数（运行中、未读、待处理、闲置、未归档、已归档），支持胶囊与比例条两种版式及逐项开关，只读快照、不落盘不联网。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pins six live session counters (running, unread, pending, idle, unarchived, archived) to the sidebar footer, with chips or meter layouts, per-metric toggles, and a read-only, no-network design.

description.zh: DSH 插件装多后设置页导航杂乱难管，这个 DSH plugin 为分区列表加上拖拽排序与自定义分组，排布按浏览器保存，刷新不丢。
description.en: A DSH plugin that tames the crowded settings nav: drag-to-reorder sections and custom groups, persisted per browser so your layout survives refreshes.

description.zh: 为 DSH 设置界面统一设计语言，规范标题、卡片、控件、焦点与动效，让各插件贡献的设置页外观一致，并支持浅色/深色主题与密度、动效偏好。
description.en: Unifies the DSH settings surface under one design language — consistent typography, cards, controls, focus and motion across every settings page, including pages contributed by other plugins, with light/dark theme support.

description.zh: 为整个 DeepSeek Harness 会话按需生成一条新标题，弹窗中可编辑，确认后才写入，取消或 Esc 不留任何改动。
description.en: Generates a fresh title for an entire DeepSeek Harness session on demand, lets you edit the proposal, and only writes it after you confirm.

description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 设置面板变成可自由拖动、缩放并记忆位置尺寸的浮动窗口，DSH plugin 即装即用。
description.en: Turns the DeepSeek Harness web settings panel into a freely draggable, resizable floating window that remembers its position and size.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接管设置面板，把散落各处的第三方插件设置项自动归入可折叠的「扩展设置项」分组，并支持拖拽排序。
description.en: A DSH plugin that takes over the settings shell in DeepSeek Harness, grouping third-party plugin settings into one collapsible section with drag-and-drop ordering.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 web 界面补充 MCP 服务器与技能设置页面，让用户直接管理外部 MCP 服务并上传技能。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds MCP Servers and Skills settings pages to the web UI, enabling management of external MCP servers and skill uploads.

description.zh: dsh-shadow-mind 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供并行认知运行时，在主代理旁运行多个受限工具的影子代理，进行独立审查、事实核查与并行认知工作。
description.en: dsh-shadow-mind provides a parallel cognitive runtime for DeepSeek Harness, running multiple restricted-tool shadow agents beside the main agent for independent reviews, fact-checking, and parallel cognitive work.

description.zh: dsh-share-page 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，一键将任意 DSH 会话导出为自包含只读静态网页，支持时间线、折叠工具调用、默认脱敏与双层 SHA-256 指纹，便于分享留档。
description.en: dsh-share-page is a DSH plugin that exports any DeepSeek Harness session into a self-contained read-only static webpage with timeline, collapsible tool calls, default redaction, and dual SHA-256 fingerprints for sharing and archiving.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供后台安全审计的 DSH 插件，实时扫描代码 diff 中的密钥泄露，并在执行前拦截 rm -rf 等破坏性命令。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds background security auditing to DeepSeek Harness: it scans code diffs for leaked secrets and blocks destructive shell commands before execution.

description.zh: dsh-share-room 是 DeepSeek Harness 的对话分享插件，一键生成免注册邀请链接，让访客在手机或电脑上加入讨论、共同向你的 AI 提问。
description.en: dsh-share-room is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns one conversation into a shared room: guests join from a link with no account, discuss together and ask your AI questions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的多步 shell 命令提供分段进度条，在工具调用卡片内实时显示当前执行到第几步，一眼判断命令是在运行还是卡住。
description.en: A DSH plugin that renders a segmented progress bar inside the tool-call card, showing which step a multi-step shell command has reached so you can tell at a glance whether it is still running or stuck.

description.zh: 深鲸画布是 DSH 插件，把一段文字稿配上素材一键生成横竖双版视频，稿子、素材与成片全部留在本机，不上传不联网。
description.en: DeepWhale Canvas is a DSH plugin that turns a script plus your own assets into ready-to-post videos in both landscape and portrait, with everything staying local and offline.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供统一的 shell 选择：把 PowerShell、cmd、Git Bash、WSL、bash、zsh、fish 等设为部署级设置，所有 Agent 命令都走它，沙箱无法约束时直接拒绝执行。
description.en: A DSH plugin that makes the shell used for agent commands a deployment-level setting — PowerShell, cmd, Git Bash, WSL, bash, zsh, fish or sh — with a Web settings card and a fail-closed refusal when the sandbox cannot confine it.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 下真实 Linux bash 执行环境，每次调用在一次性 Docker 容器中运行，自动集成权限预设。
description.en: Provides a real-Linux bash execution environment for DeepSeek Harness on Windows, running each call in a disposable Docker container with automatic permission preset integration.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来守岸人桌宠：随任务切换表情，自选 GIF、语音与字幕，支持余额显示、锁定穿透和配置迁移。
description.en: A Shorekeeper desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness that reacts to task states with custom GIFs, voices and subtitles, plus balance display, click-through lock and config migration.

description.zh: DSH 插件，在 Settings → Models 中按提供商开关，将超过 64 字符的工具调用 ID 缩短，修复 OpenAI 兼容 Chat Completions 历史报错，且不改动已保存会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shortens tool-call IDs over 64 characters for OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions providers, with a per-provider toggle in Settings → Models, leaving saved sessions untouched.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生侧边对话：从当前会话分叉出独立侧会话，实时继承父会话上下文，可回传结论并统计 token 用量。
description.en: A DSH plugin that opens a native side conversation forked from the active session, inheriting live parent context, relaying results back, and reporting token usage.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供右侧 Git 侧边栏，可在会话旁查看改动、暂存提交、同步远端并浏览提交图，底部面板还带文件预览与终端。
description.en: A Git sidebar plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web that puts source control beside your session — review changes, stage and commit, sync with a remote, browse the commit graph, plus a bottom panel with file preview and a live terminal.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可开关的右侧备忘录面板，支持图文便签、标签筛选、拖拽入对话与 Excel 导入导出。
description.en: A toggleable right-side memo panel for DeepSeek Harness with text and image notes, label filtering, drag-into-chat, and Excel import/export.

description.zh: 深鲸侧栏收纳是一款 DSH plugin，为侧栏全局面板列表限高并支持内部滚动，缓解插件图标过多导致的拥挤，不新增图标也不改插件行为。
description.en: A DSH plugin that caps the sidebar's global panel list height and adds internal scrolling, easing clutter when many plugin icons pile up without adding icons or changing plugin behavior.

description.zh: DSH 极简原生风余额插件：侧边栏常驻 DeepSeek 余额与 OpenCode Go 套餐消耗圆环，磨砂玻璃悬浮卡展示明细，零配置即用。
description.en: A minimalist native-adaptive DSH plugin that pins DeepSeek balance and OpenCode Go usage ring to the sidebar, with a frosted-glass hover card for details.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏增强的 DSH plugin：面板图标长按拖拽排序、一键折叠、置顶会话区、整行高度上限、归档会话下沉与视图标签拖拽。
description.en: A DSH plugin that upgrades the DeepSeek Harness sidebar with long-press drag reordering, one-click folding, a pinned-session section, whole-row height caps, archived-session sinking and draggable view tabs.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供侧边会话：从当前会话分叉出临时对话，共享同一 agent 与工具，能真实编辑工作区文件而不污染主对话记录。
description.en: A side chat for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI that forks the current session into an ephemeral conversation sharing the same agent and tools, so it can really edit workspace files without polluting the main transcript.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来 Claude Code 风格的悬停展开侧边栏，鼠标掠过收起栏即浮层预览，并附带会话历史前进后退箭头。
description.en: A Claude Code-style hover-reveal sidebar for DeepSeek Harness, peeking over content on hover and adding session history back/forward arrows.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）侧栏补上会话删除与工作区管理：可真正删除会话及其本地日志、投影缓存，子会话级联清理。
description.en: Adds real session deletion and workspace management to the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) sidebar — removing local logs, projection cache, and child sessions in cascade.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏提供独立的置顶会话面板，支持悬停钉选、折叠与持久化存储，替代旧版浮动弹窗。
description.en: A self-contained pinned-sessions panel for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, with hover pin buttons, collapsible layout and durable storage replacing the old floating popup.

description.zh: 为 DSH 网页版右侧栏标签页右键菜单增加关闭左侧、关闭右侧与关闭全部三项批量关闭操作，作用范围严格限定在右键所在窗格。
description.en: Adds Close Left, Close Right and Close All bulk actions to the DSH web sidebar tab context menu, scoped strictly to the pane where you right-click.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧栏待办清单入口与主面板，数据由宿主持久化，agent 可通过 personal_todo 工具读写同一份清单。
description.en: Adds a sidebar todo list entry and main panel to DeepSeek Harness, with host-persisted data that the agent can read and write through the personal_todo tool.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供水面折射品牌动效、真实余额与剩余额度、工作说明及本地 Token 用量统计的只读界面插件。
description.en: A read-only DSH plugin adding tidal refraction branding, verified balance and quota display, plain-language work notes, and local Token usage analytics to DeepSeek Harness.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 在消息输入框下方常驻显示 DeepSeek API 余额与当前计费时段（高峰/低谷），点击可查看完整明细。
description.en: A DSH plugin that keeps your DeepSeek API balance and current peak/off-peak billing window in the composer dock, with a click-through breakdown.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Git Worktree 管理：可从会话创建 Worktree、跨工作区集中查看与清理，并在删除时可选一并删除对应 Git 分支。
description.en: A Git Worktree management DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness: create worktrees from sessions, browse and clean them across workspaces, and optionally delete the matching Git branch on removal.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供底部终端抽屉，内嵌真实 PTY（xterm.js）多标签终端，支持 Shell 选择、停靠/浮层模式、主题跟随与刷新保活。
description.en: A bottom terminal drawer plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that docks real PTY xterm.js tabs, with shell picker, docked/overlay modes, theme following and keep-alive sessions.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将思源笔记变为 Agent 的个人知识库，通过 30+ 工具实现文档读写、全文搜索、反向链接与批量导入导出。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns SiYuan Note into an Agent's personal knowledge base, offering 30+ tools for document CRUD, full-text search, backlinks, and batch import/export.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供手动触发的 /teammate 命令，从输入框直接拉起组员，可选全新会话或继承已完成回合的 fork 分支，不进模型上下文、不计 token。
description.en: A manually triggered /teammate command for DeepSeek Harness that spawns a teammate straight from the input box, either fresh with no inherited context or as a fork branch inheriting completed turns — no model context, no token cost.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供技能中心页面，可查看、搜索、开关、新建、按链接安装并删除 DSH 技能，删除进回收站可恢复。
description.en: Adds a Skill Center page to the DeepSeek Harness web client for listing, searching, toggling, creating, link-installing and trash-restoring DSH skills.

description.zh: DSH 插件侧栏收纳：把「新会话」下方的面板行与各插件入口收进一个二级菜单按钮，支持白名单常驻、明暗主题自动跟随，卸载即恢复。
description.en: A DSH plugin that tidies the sidebar: it tucks panel rows and plugin entries below "New Session" into a single secondary-menu button, with a whitelist for pinned entries, automatic light/dark theming, and full restore on uninstall.

description.zh: DSH plugin：在面板里一键真跑官方 creator 六阶段流程创建 Skill，实时展示阶段清单与步骤日志，支持华为云与通用两种模式。
description.en: A DSH plugin that runs the official creator's six-phase pipeline from the Web UI to build skills, streaming live phase checklists and step logs for Huawei Cloud and generic modes.

description.zh: 为 DSH 技能做体检：检查技能能否加载、为何未被模型选中、描述是否被截断，并排查已装插件间的结构性冲突。
description.en: A health-check plugin for DSH skills: verifies whether skills load, why the model skips them, whether descriptions get truncated, and diagnoses structural conflicts between installed plugins.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Web 设置页直接编辑技能 SKILL.md，保存即写盘并热加载，无需重启，安全分级防误改。
description.en: A DSH plugin to edit skill SKILL.md directly in the web settings page, saving to disk with hot reload, no restart needed, with safety levels.

description.zh: Skill Forge 是 DSH plugin，把已解决的对话流程压缩成可复用 SKILL.md，让相似问题直接命中技能，省去重复推理的 token。
description.en: Skill Forge is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that distills a solved conversation into a reusable SKILL.md, so similar requests hit the skill directly instead of re-deriving the answer.

description.zh: 只读的 DeepSeek Harness 技能监控插件，在 Web GUI 侧边栏实时展示活动 Agent 正在调用的 Skill、运行状态与耗时，不写入任何会话状态。
description.en: A read-only DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that shows every skill invocation live in the Web GUI sidebar — which Agents are running, which Skill each calls, its status and elapsed time, without writing any session state.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 设置页新增一页 skill 管理器，列出全部已装 skill 的简介、来源与磁盘占用，并支持逐个移除到可恢复回收站。
description.en: Adds a skill manager page to DeepSeek Harness Web settings, listing every installed skill with its summary, source and disk footprint, and letting you remove any of them into a recoverable trash.

description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页统一管理已安装 skill 的开关，按全局、用户、工作区三层偏好分别禁用，避免误触发。
description.en: Manage installed DSH skills from Settings → Skills, with global, user, and workspace preference layers to disable skills and prevent accidental triggering.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的技能推荐器：读取本地 Codex、Claude 与 DSH 会话记录生成用户画像，再对开源技能目录加权打分排序，按可调匹配指数推荐高相关技能。
description.en: A skill recommender for DeepSeek Harness: it reads local Codex, Claude and DSH session records to build a user profile, then scores and ranks open-source skills with a weighted model gated by a tunable match index.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 RAG 式技能路由：用本地嵌入模型匹配用户任务，自动把最相关的技能正文注入提示词，无需模型往返加载。
description.en: RAG-style skill routing for DeepSeek Harness: embeds each task, matches it against skill routing surfaces with a local embedding model, and auto-injects the most relevant skill bodies into the prompt without a model round-trip.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web UI 的 / 技能菜单提供模糊搜索与描述预览，告别前缀匹配，快速找到技能。
description.en: Adds fuzzy search and description preview to the / skill menu in DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI, replacing prefix matching.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 增加技能管理页，集中查看、下载、上传、重命名、启停与编辑 SKILL.md，并列出插件内置与无文件技能。
description.en: Adds a Skills page to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI for inspecting, downloading, uploading, renaming, enabling and editing SKILL.md files, including plugin-bundled and file-less skills.

description.zh: dsh-skills-ext 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用设置页与侧边栏面板管理预设技能目录，把技能链接或解除链接到用户技能根目录，即时生效无需重启。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that manages preset skill directories and links or unlinks their skills into the user skill root via a settings page and sidebar panel, taking effect instantly without a restart.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供技能管理：Skills 页面可浏览、开关、编辑、新建与删除用户技能，并内置 save_skill 工具供 Agent 编写技能。
description.en: Skill management for DeepSeek Harness: a Skills page to browse, toggle, edit, create and delete user skills, plus a save_skill tool so the agent can author skills.

description.zh: DSH plugin 统一管理多 Agent 平台的 Skills，通过符号链接将中央技能库安装到 Claude Code、Cursor 等工具，一处维护、多处生效。
description.en: A DSH plugin that centrally manages AI Skills across agent platforms, installing from a central library into Claude Code, Cursor, etc. via symlinks—one source of truth, many tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供 Skills 与 MCP 面板，按来源分组、可搜索，并支持不重启进程热切换技能与 MCP 服务器状态。
description.en: A Skills & MCP panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: grouped by origin, searchable, and hot-toggleable without restarting the process.

description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板中统一管理技能与 MCP 服务器，支持全局/项目级分层、工具筛选与一键重连，改完即生效。
description.en: Manage skills and MCP servers from the DSH settings panel, with global/project layering, per-server tool filtering and one-click reconnect — changes take effect immediately.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供多风格皮肤集合，含 9 款主题与侧边栏皮肤管理器，可独立切换皮肤与配色方案。
description.en: A multi-style skin collection for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, offering 9 themes with a sidebar skin manager for independent skin and color scheme switching.

description.zh: DSH plugin 皮肤实验室：为 DeepSeek Harness 皮肤作者提供 token 目录、实时试穿、主题固化与光谱预设的浏览器内开发工具。
description.en: A DSH plugin skin lab: an in-browser dev tool for DeepSeek Harness skin authors with token browser, live try-on, theme freeze, and spectrum presets.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 界面添加自定义背景图与毛玻璃蒙版的皮肤增强 DSH plugin，可调适配方式、蒙版浓度与虚化程度，颜色文字气泡仍沿用原主题。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds custom background images and a frosted-glass overlay to the DeepSeek Harness UI, with adjustable fit mode, mask opacity and blur while keeping the original theme colors.

description.zh: DSH plugin 皮肤中心，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 35 套内置皮肤、一张图自定义换肤及皮肤包导入导出，一行命令安装，不改宿主源码。
description.en: A DSH plugin skin center offering 35 built-in skins, one-image custom themes, and skin pack import/export for DeepSeek Harness with one-command install.

description.zh: DSH plugin 持续探索：给项目一句改进目标，它便自主调查、尝试并比较方案，交付可采用的改动与结果。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for continuous exploration: give a project one improvement goal and it investigates, experiments, and compares options to deliver adoptable results.

description.zh: SLAYER 是 DSH 的赛博包工头插件，提供两套多代理委派预设与调用时工具守卫，把派活、验收、收工写进项目手册。
description.en: SLAYER is a DSH plugin that acts as a cyber foreman: two multi-agent delegation presets with call-time tool guards, plus a project handbook that codifies tasking, review and wrap-up.

description.zh: dsh-sleev 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Sleev 集成插件，用于观测经过外部 Sleev 网关的 LLM 路由，记录 token 用量与上下文优化遥测，并在 Web UI 中配置观测规则。
description.en: dsh-sleev is a DeepSeek Harness plugin integrating Sleev to observe LLM routes through the external gateway, recording token usage and context-optimization telemetry, with Web UI configuration.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 make_slides 工具，将演讲内容生成为自包含 HTML 幻灯片，支持离线全屏演示、演讲者备注与 PDF 打印，并可选输出 PPTX。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives the agent a make_slides tool to turn talks into self-contained HTML decks — offline fullscreen presenting, speaker notes off-screen, PDF printing, and optional PPTX export.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供恒速平滑滚底：流式内容增长时消息列轻柔跟随，装载与回到最新仍保持瞬时，不干扰宿主跟随状态机。
description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness sessions a constant-speed smooth scroll-to-bottom: the message list follows streaming content gently, while loading and jump-to-latest stay instant without disturbing the host follow state machine.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 SOLIDWORKS 的 DSH 插件，可读取、修改、重建、渲染并导出本机或 Windows 虚拟机中已打开的模型，默认只读。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects DeepSeek Harness to SOLIDWORKS, reading, editing, rebuilding, rendering and exporting models open on your PC or in a Windows VM, read-only by default.

description.zh: 这是一款 DeepSeek Harness 提示胶囊插件，把可复用 SOP 与提示片段沉淀在工作区，并在会话输入框一键注入。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that stores reusable SOPs and prompt snippets in the workspace and injects them into the chat input with one click.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏底部嵌入 Spark Scope 迷你卡片，实时显示 DGX Spark 各节点的解码与预填充速率、请求队列、KV 缓存和 GPU 温度功耗，让你工作时一眼掌握集群状态。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pins the Spark Scope mini window to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar footer, showing decode and prefill rates, request queues, KV cache usage and per-node GPU temperature and power for your DGX Spark cluster at a glance.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可验证的重启：进程回归后自动做健康检查，把结论和中断前的会话上下文回传到发起重启的会话。
description.en: A verified restart plugin for DeepSeek Harness: after the process comes back it runs health checks and delivers the verdict plus the interrupted session context back to the requesting session.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 SPC 控制图台账校验工具，按 GB/T 4091 常量表核对控制限、中心线与 Cp/Cpk 定义的一致性。
description.en: A DSH plugin that registers the spc_gbt_adapter tool to audit control-chart ledgers for arithmetic and constant-table consistency against GB/T 4091 coefficients, centre lines and Cp/Cpk definitions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置的语音转文字 provider，支持 OpenAI 兼容 API、本地 whisper 服务或本地命令，并复用宿主已有的模型连接器。
description.en: A configurable speech-to-text provider for DeepSeek Harness, registering OpenAI-compatible API, local whisper server or local command backends, and reusing the host's existing model connector.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供规格驱动开发（SDD）技能包，包含需求、设计、任务三阶段技能，让规格成为唯一事实来源。
description.en: A DSH plugin bundle providing Spec-Driven Development skills for DeepSeek Harness, covering spec creation, implementation, and validation.

description.zh: dsh-squad 是 DeepSeek Harness 的跨工作区多代理编排插件，让一个会话创建并指挥其他项目中的命名 worker 会话，派发任务、后台观察、收集报告并处理升级请求。
description.en: dsh-squad is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for cross-workspace multi-agent orchestration: spawn named worker sessions in other projects, assign tasks, watch them in the background, collect reports and answer escalations from one chat.

description.zh: DSH plugin 本地 SSH 桥接：浏览器输入主机与密码，agent 经 router_exec 在本机执行远端命令，密码不落聊天记录，可独立运行。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing a local SSH bridge: enter host and password in browser, agent executes remote commands via router_exec, password never enters chat, can run standalone.
