description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 对话区提供原生多窗格分屏工作区，支持左右、上下、2×2 与自动网格布局及拖拽重排，每个窗格都是可独立输入的真实会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns the DeepSeek Harness chat area into a native multi-pane workspace with side-by-side, stacked, 2x2 and auto-grid layouts, drag-to-rearrange, and fully interactive real sessions in every pane.

description.zh: DSH 卡顿守卫插件：下载类命令超时自动中止，并把换源重试提示写进工具结果，按类型独立配置超时，不调用模型。
description.en: A DSH plugin that aborts stalled download commands and hands the agent a mirror-switching retry hint, with per-type timeouts and no model calls.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 换上星露谷物语像素风主题：奶油色面板、木质按钮、山谷壁纸与像素字体，通过官方 token 覆盖实现，不替换前端。
description.en: A Stardew Valley pixel-art theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, applying cream panels, wooden buttons, valley wallpaper and pixel fonts via official token overrides without replacing the frontend.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件树做重启前预检：静态语法与配置检查，可选隔离实例真实启动与无头浏览器冒烟，并审计残留实例，提供 plugin_check 工具。
description.en: Pre-flight checks for a DeepSeek Harness plugin tree: static syntax and config checks plus optional isolated real-boot and headless-browser smoke tests, with stray-instance audit, exposed as the plugin_check tool.

description.zh: DSH新手入门包：安装即得欢迎语、0到1学习路径、场景化插件推荐与自查清单，并联动中文教程，帮助新手快速上手DeepSeek Harness。
description.en: A starter pack for DeepSeek Harness beginners: install to get a welcome flow, 0-to-1 learning path, scenario-based plugin recommendations, and a self-check checklist, paired with the Chinese handbook.

description.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件，在 dsh web 启动成功后按 settings.yaml 配置执行用户自定义命令，例如用指定浏览器打开 Web GUI。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that runs a user-defined command from settings.yaml once dsh web has started successfully, e.g. opening the Web GUI in a chosen browser.

description.zh: 为 DSH 提供纯文本会话状态笔记本与任务栈：通过 add_state/read_state/compact_state 持久化工作事实，抗上下文压缩、跨 resume 存活，且零自动注入。
description.en: A plain-text session-state notebook and task stack for DeepSeek Harness: add_state / read_state / compact_state persist working facts across compaction and resume, with zero auto-injection.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供逐步实时计时条，显示当前步骤已运行多久，并保留上一步耗时，弥补内置回合计时器的不足。
description.en: A live per-step elapsed-time bar for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, showing how long the current step has been running and keeping the last step's duration on screen.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供即时便签能力：彩色标签区分急/常/重，支持定时提醒、置顶与三位数密码保护，随时记录随手可查。
description.en: A sticky notes plugin for DeepSeek Harness: color-coded urgent/normal/important notes with timed reminders, pinning, and 3-digit PIN protection for instant capture.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 右侧边栏预览 STL 网格，用无依赖 WebGL 视口展示模型，并给出尺寸、体积、表面积与封闭性等 3D 打印关键数据。
description.en: Preview STL meshes in the DeepSeek Harness right Sidebar with a dependency-free WebGL viewport, reporting size, volume, surface area and watertightness for 3D printing.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏常驻自选股实时报价，点开可看分时图、日周月 K 线与涨跌柱状图，覆盖 A 股、港股、美股，并支持配置方案一键切换。
description.en: A DSH plugin that keeps a live watchlist quote in the sidebar and opens a panel with intraday, candlestick and volume charts for A-share, HK and US stocks, with switchable preference presets.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 输入框提供混合附件上传：图片走官方原生附件管线，代码、PDF、压缩包等则以流式写入会话工作区。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives the Web composer hybrid attachments: images go through the native attachment pipeline, while code, PDFs and archives stream into the session workspace.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 DeepSeek Harness 实时会话事件流桥接为 MCP 进度通知与 ACP 适配，供飞书等客户端实时查看思考与工具调用过程。
description.en: A DSH plugin bridging DeepSeek Harness live session events to MCP progress notifications and ACP adapter, enabling real-time visibility of reasoning and tool calls for Feishu and other clients.

description.zh: dsh-sts2 让 DeepSeek Harness 通过本地桥接直接接管《杀戮尖塔 2》，读取局面、出牌选路、处理事件并自动连续打完一局。
description.en: dsh-sts2 lets DeepSeek Harness take over Slay the Spire 2 through a local bridge, reading the board, playing cards, choosing paths and events, and auto-playing a full run.

description.zh: 为 DSH plugin 补齐 Codex 子代理委派能力，每次调用可单独指定模型与推理强度，绕开官方 provider 无法传参的限制。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds Codex subagent delegation with per-call model and reasoning effort, working around the official provider's inability to pass either field.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供子代理模型管控与 Jev 智能分流，按任务类别自动匹配角色与模型，拦截改写子代理的 provider、model 与推理强度，避免高配算力浪费。
description.en: A DSH plugin that governs subagent model selection with Jev-based routing: it classifies each task and rewrites the subagent's provider, model and reasoning effort, so trivial jobs stop burning high-tier capacity.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Sub2api 账号额度与用量监控，在会话标题栏浮层展示 5 小时、7 天及 Sonnet/Opus 额度窗口、今日请求与费用，支持高比例高亮提醒。
description.en: A DSH plugin that monitors Sub2api account quotas and usage, showing 5-hour, 7-day and Sonnet/Opus quota windows plus today's requests and cost in a session title-bar overlay with high-usage alerts.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Cursor 子代理提供方，一次本地 one-shot 运行即可委派带完整工具的子任务，摘要优先返回结论，支持 CLI 登录态免 Key 与无人值守 Profile Bundle。
description.en: A Cursor-as-subagent provider for DeepSeek Harness: delegate one-shot local Cursor tasks with full agent tools, get summary-first results, and run unattended via a Profile Bundle with CLI login or SDK key.

description.zh: dsh-subagent-grok 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Grok CLI 的一次性子代理提供者，每次委派运行一个 grok 进程，无需 API 密钥。
description.en: dsh-subagent-grok provides a one-shot subagent provider for DeepSeek Harness using the locally authenticated Grok CLI, running a grok process per delegation without API keys.

description.zh: 这是一款 DSH plugin，只提供一份子代理委派技能：教你在何时该派子代理、并行派几个、以及如何验收它们返回的结果。
description.en: A DSH plugin that ships a single subagent-delegation skill: when to delegate, how many subagents to fan out in parallel, and how to verify what they returned.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 子代理会话的输入框左侧添加 subagent 标记，让你一眼分辨当前正在向子代理输入，根会话则保持原样。
description.en: Adds a subagent marker to the left of the composer in DeepSeek Harness subagent sessions, so you can tell at a glance which session you are typing into while root sessions stay unchanged.

description.zh: 把 Pi 作为一等公民接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 DSH 插件：用 /pi-lock 将当前会话直连持久 Pi 会话，支持排队与插队对话、实时中间输出、断线自动重连与图片透传。
description.en: A DSH plugin that makes Pi a first-class citizen in DeepSeek Harness: /pi-lock binds the current conversation directly to a durable Pi session with queued/steered turns, live intermediate output, auto-reattach and image passthrough.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加右侧栏标签页，集中列出所有子代理并支持一键打开，弥补内置子代理界面操作不便的问题。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a right-sidebar tab listing all subagents, letting you open any of them in one click instead of using the built-in subagent UI.

description.zh: 为 DSH 子智能体与团队队友提供手动切换模型与思考强度的入口，并支持主会话一键同步，可救回因模型失败卡死的子代理。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets you manually switch the model and reasoning effort of subagents and team teammates, with one-click sync from the main session to rescue subagents stuck on model failures.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供子代理实时进度面板，在输入框上方以卡片展示每个子代理的动作、进度、卡顿与失败重试，无需点开会话即可掌握全局。
description.en: A live subagent progress dock for DeepSeek Harness that shows each subagent's action, progress, stalls and failure retries as cards above the input box, so you never have to open a transcript.

description.zh: 把已付费的 Kimi Code、Grok、GLM、Antigravity 等订阅通过 OAuth 登录接入 DeepSeek Harness，无需 API Key 即可在模型选择器中使用并查看额度。
description.en: Sign in with your existing Kimi Code, Grok, GLM and Antigravity subscriptions via OAuth to use them as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers — no API keys, with plan quotas in the model picker.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让纯文本主代理通过视觉子代理读取图片，无需切换模型或会话，图片以路径传递，结果以文本返回。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets a text-only main agent read images via a vision subagent in the same session, passing file paths and merging text results back.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在会话启动时挂载 Superpowers 技能并注入 using-superpowers 方法论引导，让 Agent 通过 skill 工具加载技能。
description.en: A DSH plugin that mounts Superpowers skills and injects using-superpowers methodology guidance at session start, enabling the agent to load skills via the skill tool.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 Superpowers-zh 核心工程技能打包为 DeepSeek Harness 技能集，注册头脑风暴、写计划、执行计划、系统调试、TDD、代码评审等八项技能。
description.en: A DSH plugin bundling Superpowers-zh core engineering skills for DeepSeek Harness, registering eight skills like brainstorming, writing plans, executing plans, systematic debugging, TDD, and code review.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将苏黄共阅阅卷控制台接入 Better Sidebar，提供配置、启停与状态展示，实现本机连续阅卷的人工控制。
description.en: A DSH plugin that integrates Suhuang Scroll grading console into Better Sidebar, offering configuration, start/stop and status display for local continuous grading.

description.zh: dsh-surface 是 DSH plugin，让模型在对话里渲染沙箱化 HTML 页面，用于预览、报表与表单，页面可回传结构化答案。
description.en: dsh-surface is a DSH plugin that renders sandboxed HTML pages inside the conversation for previews, reports, and forms, letting pages submit structured answers back to the agent.

description.zh: dsh-sync 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 配置同步插件，可选择性同步设置与 profile，自动排除密钥和本地值，支持逐行审查与冲突处理。
description.en: dsh-sync is a DSH plugin for Git-based sync of settings and profiles, with selective sync, secret exclusion, per-line review, and conflict handling.

description.zh: DSH plugin 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中查看和分析 VCD/FST 波形，提供交互式波形查看器与终端回退。
description.en: A DSH plugin for viewing and analyzing VCD/FST waveforms in DeepSeek Harness, with interactive viewer and terminal fallback.

description.zh: dsh-sync 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 配置同步插件，可选择性同步设置与 profile，自动排除密钥和本地值，支持逐行审查与冲突处理。
description.en: dsh-sync is a DSH plugin for Git-based sync of settings and profiles, with selective sync, secret exclusion, per-line review, and conflict handling.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多语言语法检查：检测 JS/TS/YAML/Python 的括号、隐形字符与语法错误，并支持自动修复。
description.en: A DSH plugin for multi-language syntax checking: detects bracket, invisible-character and syntax errors in JS/TS/YAML/Python, with automatic fixes.

description.zh: DSH 插件把本机 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络、I/O 与温度实时显示在对话顶栏、输入框底部和侧边栏，点开可看系统详情。
description.en: A DSH plugin that surfaces live CPU, memory, disk, network, I/O and temperature in the chat header, input dock and sidebar, with a detailed System panel.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 web 能力接入 Synthetic 搜索提供者，替换内置 DeepSeek 网页搜索，并在设置卡片中管理 API Key。
description.en: A DSH plugin that registers a Synthetic-backed WebSearchProvider for the DeepSeek Harness web seam, replacing the built-in DeepSeek web search with a Settings card for the API key.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 System One 观测插件：在指定环节询问模型 agent 循环在做什么，把每次调用、跳过与回答写入 JSONL 轨迹，只留证据不做裁决。
description.en: A System One seam observer for DeepSeek Harness: it asks a model what the agent loop is doing at chosen points and writes every call, skip and answer to a JSONL trace, producing evidence rather than judgements.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来 T3 Code 风格的会话上下文界面：会话行悬浮卡、状态阶梯、模型提供商标签、头部上下文条与上下文窗口用量环，全部落在 DSH 已有界面上。
description.en: Brings T3 Code's session-context UX to DeepSeek Harness: session-row hover cards, a status ladder, provider/model chips, a header context strip and a context-window meter, all seated in DSH's existing surfaces.

description.zh: dsh-tab-alert 是一款 DSH plugin，当 Agent 回合在后台标签页完成时闪烁标题「New Message!」，切回标签页即自动停止，避免错过回复。
description.en: A DSH plugin that flashes the browser tab title with "New Message!" when an agent turn finishes in a background tab, stopping instantly once you return.

description.zh: DSH 插件 TWb Viewer 让你在浏览器里只读检视 Tableau 工作簿：1:1 仪表板布局、表级数据模型、字段血缘与自定义 SQL 元数据，无需 Tableau Desktop 与数据。
description.en: A DSH plugin that inspects Tableau workbooks (.twb) in the browser — 1:1 dashboard layout, table-level data model, field lineage and custom SQL metadata, with no Tableau Desktop and no data access.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 聊天界面加上 Chrome 式标签页：标签条、标签分组与分屏窗格，让多会话切换更顺手。
description.en: Adds Chrome-style tabs to DeepSeek Harness web chat sessions, with a tab strip, tab groups and split panes for smoother multi-session switching.

description.zh: 把浏览器里所有指向 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的标签页自动收进同一个标签组，并在 DSH 界面内提供状态芯片与开关控制。
description.en: Automatically groups every browser tab pointing at the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI into one tab group, with an in-GUI chip to monitor and control it.

description.zh: dsh-tada 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 插件，在 Agent 完成回合、出错、请求审批或提问时，按你当前所在场景发送应用内提示或系统桌面通知，点击即可直达对应会话。
description.en: dsh-tada is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that raises in-app toasts or native desktop notifications when an agent finishes a turn, errors out, needs approval, or asks a question, and clicking one opens the exact session.

description.zh: DSH plugin 把 Web GUI 一键发布到 tailnet，手机随时远程访问，并向其他插件暴露设备与可达性服务。
description.en: A DSH plugin that publishes the Web GUI to your tailnet for remote access and exposes tailnet devices and reachability as a service for other plugins.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Tako 模型的 DSH plugin，自动同步模型目录、上下文窗口与图片输入能力，并提供浏览器一键登录与控制台面板。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings Tako models into DeepSeek Harness, auto-syncing the model catalog, context windows and vision support, with browser one-click login and a console panel.

description.zh: 探奇是 DSH plugin，为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 动态生成冷知识与奇妙事实，支持逐层深入探索，侧边栏一键开启好奇心之旅。
description.en: Tanqi is a DSH plugin that generates AI-curated trivia and layered deep-dives for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, sparking curiosity from the sidebar.

description.zh: DSH 任务提醒插件：任务完成、失败、截断或等待审批时在页面右上角弹卡片，窗口在后台时额外发 Windows 系统通知，避免错过。
description.en: A DSH plugin that pops a card when a task finishes, fails, truncates, or awaits approval, plus Windows system notifications when the window is in the background.

description.zh: 这是一款 DeepSeek Harness 插件，按每条任务自动判定模型 reasoningEffort 档位，支持显式标记、关键词分类与高峰时段压档省钱。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that auto-selects the model's reasoningEffort per task, with explicit markers, keyword classification and peak-hour cost capping.

description.zh: DSH 任务完成通知器，在对话、子代理、工作流、目标完成或提问时发送跨平台系统通知，无需浏览器权限。
description.en: DSH task-completion notifier sends cross-platform system notifications for turn, subagent, workflow, goal, and question events, without browser permissions.

description.zh: 为 DSH 长时间运行任务提供实时进度：脚本写入结构化进度文件，Web UI 通过悬浮胶囊、右侧边栏标签与设置页即时展示，无需轮询 Agent 或等待命令结束。
description.en: Live progress for long-running DSH tasks: scripts write structured progress to a file, and the Web UI surfaces it in a floating overlay, a right-sidebar tab and a settings page — no polling the agent, no waiting for the command to finish.

description.zh: DSH plugin 把任务看板卡片的结算结果与中途提问送回发起会话，省去人肉轮询，卡跑完消息自己敲门。
description.en: A DSH plugin that relays task-board card settlements and mid-run questions back to the originating session, so you no longer poll for progress.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供三套独立音效：回复结束随机播放完成音、静默倒计时后补响提醒、审批或提问时提示，帮你及时察觉任务状态。
description.en: A DSH plugin that plays three independent chimes: a random sound when a reply finishes, a one-shot reminder after a quiet countdown, and an alert when DSH asks for approval or a choice.

description.zh: DSH plugin 薄壳，将独立 Windows 托盘任务监视器 DshTaskWatcher 打包部署，安装即拉起托盘，并在设置中提供启停开关。
description.en: A thin DSH plugin that bundles and deploys the standalone Windows tray task watcher DshTaskWatcher, launching it on install and providing a start/stop switch in Settings.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Tavily 联网搜索：注册 ctx.web 搜索 provider，并提供搜索、正文抽取、爬取、站点地图与深度研究五个工具及设置页。
description.en: Adds Tavily web search to DeepSeek Harness: registers a ctx.web search provider plus search, extract, crawl, map and research tools with a settings page.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Tavily 联网搜索：注册 ctx.web 搜索 provider，并提供搜索、正文抽取、爬取、站点地图与深度研究五个工具及设置页。
description.en: Adds Tavily web search to DeepSeek Harness: registers a ctx.web search provider plus search, extract, crawl, map and research tools with a settings page.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Tavily 远程 MCP 服务，注册搜索、提取、爬取、站点地图与研究等工具，让 Agent 无需本地进程即可联网检索。
description.en: Connects Tavily's hosted MCP server to DeepSeek Harness, registering search, extract, crawl, map and research tools so the agent can search the web without a local process.

description.zh: DSH plugin 直连 Tavily Search API 提供网页搜索工具，不消耗 LLM token，搜索费用仅走 Tavily 额度。
description.en: A DSH plugin that provides a web search tool via direct Tavily Search API, consuming no LLM tokens and billing only Tavily quota.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Tavily 实时联网搜索，支持多 API 密钥原子轮换与 keyless 兜底，遇限流、配额耗尽或密钥吊销时自动切换，不中断 agent loop。
description.en: Real-time Tavily web search for DeepSeek Harness with atomic rotation across a pool of API keys and keyless fallback, so rate limits, exhausted quotas or revoked keys never break the agent loop.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Tavily 检索与网页抓取能力，注册 tavily_search 与 web_fetch 两个工具，并用多 key 轮询池避免单账号额度耗尽导致工具失效。
description.en: Adds Tavily search and page fetching to DeepSeek Harness via the tavily_search and web_fetch tools, with a multi-key rotation pool so one exhausted account never disables the plugin.

description.zh: 把 agent 生成的 HTML 投影成 DSH 会话内的教学板书面板，支持在板面圈画、截图回传对话，让讲解与追问都在同一块板上完成。
description.en: Projects agent-generated HTML into an in-session teaching board inside DeepSeek Harness, letting you annotate the board and send screenshots back into the conversation.

description.zh: 为 DSH 原生 Agent Teams 提供确定性自动派发：任务就绪时唤醒空闲成员、持有者停摆时回收任务，并在派发时刻把写域重叠升级为软锁，调度决策由代码完成、零 token 消耗。
description.en: Deterministic auto-dispatch for DSH native Agent Teams: wakes idle members when tasks become ready, reclaims tasks from stalled owners, and enforces write-scope overlap as a soft lock at dispatch time — all decided in code with zero token cost.

description.zh: 上传已分件的 3D 模型，在本地渲染拆解视频，内置无人机成品模板，作为 DSH plugin 一键出片。
description.en: Upload a pre-separated 3D model and render teardown videos locally, with a built-in drone template, as a DSH plugin.

description.zh: 为 DSH 页面添加一只可拖拽的 DeepSeek 鲸鱼精灵，点击即可打开轻量临时聊天窗口，对话不写入会话历史，支持自定义 OpenAI 兼容端点。
description.en: A draggable DeepSeek whale elf for your DSH page that opens a lightweight temporary chat window, keeping conversations out of session history and supporting custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

description.zh: 为 DSH 页面添加一只可拖拽的 DeepSeek 鲸鱼精灵，点击即可打开轻量临时聊天窗口，对话不写入会话历史，支持自定义 OpenAI 兼容端点。
description.en: A draggable DeepSeek whale elf for your DSH page that opens a lightweight temporary chat window, keeping conversations out of session history and supporting custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 右侧边栏添加临时便签，支持会话、工作区、全局三种作用域，自动保存、一键复制，并可调用默认模型润色为 Markdown。
description.en: Adds a Temp Note tab to the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar with session, workspace, and global scopes, autosave, one-click copy, and LLM-powered Markdown polish.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加临时工作区：侧边栏一键新建用完即弃的工作区与对话，重启后自动清理，不留痕迹。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds throwaway temporary workspaces to DeepSeek Harness: create a disposable workspace and fresh conversation from the sidebar, auto-cleaned on restart.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 回答加「术语」入口，用内置 330 条离线词典弹出中文解释面板，支持多层钻取，全程不调用模型。
description.en: Adds a Terms action to DeepSeek Harness answers, opening an offline 330-term dictionary panel with Chinese explanations, context and multi-level drill-down — no model calls.

description.zh: 为 DSH plugin 提供 run_tests 工具，自动识别 pytest、jest、vitest、cargo、go 等框架跑测试，把文件、行号与断言失败结构化交给 agent 直接修复。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a run_tests tool: it auto-detects pytest, jest, vitest, cargo, go and npm, then hands structured failures with file, line and assertion details to the agent for direct fixing.

description.zh: 深鲸术语统一是一款 DSH plugin，扫描文档中同一概念的不同写法（如深鲸/DeepWhale），按文件统计出现次数并提示混用，帮助统一术语。
description.en: A DSH plugin that scans documents for variant spellings of the same concept (e.g. 深鲸/DeepWhale), counts occurrences per file and flags mixed usage to keep terminology consistent.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供测试洞察能力：扫描仓库事实与变更风险，生成可评审的 TEST-PLAN.md 测试计划与隔离的测试草稿，定位测试覆盖缺口并排序风险。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns repository facts and change risk into reviewable TEST-PLAN.md test plans and isolated review-only test drafts, mapping test gaps and ranking risk.

description.zh: 面向测试工程师的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，把空文件夹一键生成测试工作框架骨架，并在 AI 会话中强制需求拆模块、版本确认、跨文档关联与环境账密登记。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for QA engineers that scaffolds a test work framework from an empty folder and enforces requirement splitting, version confirmation, cross-doc linking and environment credential logging in AI sessions.

description.zh: dsh-test-plugin 是 DeepSeek Harness 的最小部署插件，注册一个名为 test 的冒烟测试工具，用于验证插件安装是否成功。
description.en: dsh-test-plugin is a minimal DeepSeek Harness deployment plugin that registers a smoke-test tool named test to verify plugin installation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供有界自动测试反馈：文件写入后静默两秒自动跑相关测试，并在同一轮对话内把结果回传给 Agent，避免未验证就宣称完成。
description.en: Bounded automatic test feedback for DeepSeek Harness: after a successful file write it waits two seconds, runs related tests in the background, and returns the result to the agent within the same turn.

description.zh: Acid Noir 是面向 DSH Web 的可选赛博编辑风深色主题包，提供两套高可读配色并集成官方设置项，安装后不强制切换主题，禁用即完全还原。
description.en: Acid Noir is a selectable cyber-editorial dark theme bundle for DeepSeek Harness Web, offering two high-readability palettes with official Settings integration and fully reversible, non-forcing installation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将超长文本渲染成 800×800 图片发送，利用每图 384 token 封顶大幅压缩 LLM 输入 token，降低长上下文成本与窗口占用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that renders long text into 800×800 images to cut LLM input tokens (384/image cap), reducing cost and context usage for long documents.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供纯 token 覆盖的砌砖主题，暖石膏与火烧黏土配色、灰缝线条、单一强调色，零全局 CSS，可在设置中随时开关还原。
description.en: A token-only Brick theme for DeepSeek Harness Web: plaster and fired-clay palette, mortar hairlines, one accent, no global CSS, with a Settings toggle to switch it off.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供新粗野主义与波普艺术主题包，含三套可选配色，让 Shell、Composer 等界面张扬而会话正文保持安静易读。
description.en: A neo-brutalist and pop-art theme bundle for DeepSeek Harness Web, offering three selectable palettes that make the shell and Composer expressive while keeping conversation text calm and readable.

description.zh: DSH plugin 主题中心：精选浅色/深色主题画廊、一键切换、自定义壁纸裁剪调色，并支持 dsh-theme 主题文件的导入导出。
description.en: Theme center for DeepSeek Harness: curated light/dark theme gallery, one-click switching, custom wallpaper with crop/tint editor, and import/export of dsh-theme files.

description.zh: 琉光为 DeepSeek Harness 提供液态玻璃与苏联构成主义两套可即时切换的皮肤，附带个性化面板、投放式皮肤包与鲸鱼娘桌宠。
description.en: Liuguang gives DeepSeek Harness two instantly switchable skins — liquid glass and Soviet constructivism — plus a personalization panel, drop-in skin packs and a whale-girl desktop pet.

description.zh: dsh-theme-library 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可扩展的动画主题库，内置黑烟等动态壁纸主题，支持浅色与深色外观，让界面更生动。
description.en: dsh-theme-library is an extensible animated theme library for DeepSeek Harness, featuring dynamic wallpapers like Black Smoke, with light and dark appearances.

description.zh: DSH plugin 两级式主题管理器：先选文化/场景或国旗，再选具体风格，内置 58 套主题，实时切换并记忆选择。
description.en: Two-level theme manager for DeepSeek Harness Web: pick a culture/scene or flag, then a concrete style. 58 built-in themes with live switching and memory.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web UI 整皮换成星露谷像素农场：祝尼魔对话、农场预设、任务日志 HUD、四季日历、8-bit 音效与桌宠，会话与工具审批全部真实可用。
description.en: A full-skin Stardew Valley theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: Junimo chat, farm-select presets, quest journal HUD, seasonal calendar, chiptune SFX and desktop pets, with real sessions and tool approvals.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面换上 Stripe 风格紫色网格主题，提供白昼紫与午夜蓝两套配色，可在设置中一键切换，并支持恢复出厂外观。
description.en: A Stripe-style theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, offering Day Purple and Midnight Blue palettes with one-click switching in settings and a factory-restore option.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面换上 Neo-Brutalist 硬边零圆角外观，提供白纸与黑板两套主题，设置内一键切换并可恢复出厂外观。
description.en: A Neo-Brutalist theme plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, offering paper and blackboard palettes with hard edges, zero radius, and one-click switching plus factory restore.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供合成波风格主题的 DSH plugin，支持霓虹发光、半透明面板、背景图片轮播与视频，安装即用。
description.en: A synthwave theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web UI, featuring neon glow, translucent panels, background image slideshow and video, ready to use after installation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 定制界面主题的 DSH 插件，提供 12 套预设、自定义强调色、明暗适配、密度与字体切换及自定义 CSS，全部通过官方主题服务写入设计令牌。
description.en: A DSH plugin that restyles the DeepSeek Harness UI with 12 presets, custom accent colors, dark-aware adaptation, density and font controls, plus custom CSS — all written through the official theme service.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供零 token 成本的免费网页搜索，纯 HTTP 抓取 Bing、DuckDuckGo、SearXNG 等引擎，无需 API key，多引擎自动回退。
description.en: A zero-token-cost free web search plugin for DeepSeek Harness that scrapes Bing, DuckDuckGo and SearXNG over plain HTTP with no API key and automatic multi-engine fallback.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 右侧栏加一个思维链标签页，把模型实时思考按 turn → step 聚合成可读结构，看清每步在做什么、调了哪些工具、卡在哪。
description.en: Adds a Chain-of-Thought tab to the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar, aggregating live model reasoning into a readable turn → step structure so you can see what each step does, which tools it calls, and where it stalls.

description.zh: 为 DSH plugin 补齐自定义模型的思考强度声明，按默认、子代理与压缩策略自动选择推理档位，可观测、可回滚。
description.en: A DSH plugin that backfills reasoning-effort declarations for custom models and picks the right thinking level per request, observable and reversible.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供顺滑的思考过程体验：推理时思考行自动展开并平滑跟随滚动，结束后以短动画收起，避免画面跳变。
description.en: A smooth thinking experience for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: think rows auto-expand and glide as reasoning streams, then collapse with a short animation instead of a jarring jump.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 还原初版 Thinking 样式，恢复字号、蓝色流光与思考行扫光，并可选择思考区域语言。
description.en: Restores the original DeepSeek Harness Thinking style with original typography, blue shimmer and sweeping highlights, plus a selectable thinking-area language.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注入系统提示词段落，强制模型内部思考使用简体中文，代码与专有名词保持原样，最终回复仍随用户语言。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects a system-prompt section forcing the model's internal reasoning to Simplified Chinese, while code, paths and proper nouns stay unchanged and final replies follow the user's language.

description.zh: DSH plugin 输入氛围插件：在输入框上方展示 87 键键盘与鼠标并实时高亮，打字喷火焰、输入抖动，AI 回答完成时播放提示音并整页轻震。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds input ambience: displays an 87-key keyboard and mouse above the input box with real-time highlighting, flame particles while typing, input shake, and sound/page shake when AI response completes.

description.zh: dsh-tick 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供本地定时任务：延迟、固定时刻或周期触发时自动注入提示词唤醒模型，并带 Web 面板与 /schedule 命令管理。
description.en: dsh-tick adds session-local scheduled tasks to DeepSeek Harness: inject a prompt into the current session after a delay, at a fixed time, or on a repeating interval, managed via a Web panel and the /schedule command.

description.zh: DSH plugin 双向同步滴答清单任务，基于官方 OAuth 2.0 API，支持拉取、创建、更新、完成、删除及去重同步。
description.en: Two-way task sync with TickTick/Dida365 for DeepSeek Harness via official OAuth 2.0 API, supporting pull, create, update, complete, delete, and dedupe sync.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供分层自动模型路由：注册虚拟 smart 模型，按请求难度与是否含图自动分派到你已配置的模型。
description.en: Tier-based automatic model routing for DeepSeek Harness: registers a virtual smart model that classifies each request by difficulty and vision need, then delegates to your existing models.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供分级自动审查：静态规则安全网拦截不可逆操作，LLM 审查员裁决，人工兜底确认，自动放行安全操作。
description.en: Tiered auto-review for DeepSeek Harness: static-rule safety net blocks irreversible actions, LLM reviewer decides, human fallback confirms, auto-approving safe ones.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为工具副作用提供可逆时间旅行与审计：快照、rewindTo 补偿回滚工作区，内置审计规则引擎落盘 audit-log.jsonl。
description.en: DSH plugin offering reversible time travel and audit for tool side effects: snapshots, rewindTo compensation to roll back workspace, built-in audit rule engine writing audit-log.jsonl.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在发送前评估提问难度，仅建议合适的模型与推理等级，不改动请求本身。
description.en: A DSH plugin that scores each prompt's difficulty before sending and only suggests a model and reasoning level, leaving the request untouched.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本轮对话计时看门狗：clock_elapsed 工具读取已用时间，/set-time 分段注入收尾提示词，并在输入框上方弹卡片显示运行时长。
description.en: A turn timer watchdog for DeepSeek Harness: the clock_elapsed tool reports elapsed time, /set-time injects wrap-up prompts on a schedule, and cards above the composer show run time.

description.zh: 为 DSH 聊天框加定时发送按钮，选好时刻由 Host 到点真正发出，支持对话内排期与 DeepSeek 峰谷时段一键选时。
description.en: Adds a scheduled-send button to the DSH chat box: pick a time and the Host sends the message for real, with in-conversation scheduling and one-click DeepSeek off-peak time picking.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 WebUI 会话消息列渲染竖直时间轴，刻度对应每条用户消息，支持悬浮摘要、点击跳转与逐条导航，深浅色自适应。
description.en: A DSH plugin that renders a vertical timeline in the WebUI conversation column, with ticks per user message, hover summaries, click-to-jump, and step navigation, adapting to light/dark themes.

description.zh: 听懂是一款 DSH plugin，把英文有声书 MP3 或英文文档变成逐句听力课：本机识别、AI 翻译讲解、精听与间隔复习，练到一听就懂。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns English audiobook MP3s or documents into sentence-by-sentence listening lessons with local speech recognition, AI translation and spaced repetition.

description.zh: DSH plugin 自动拒绝超时未应答的权限请求，并注入模型可见的 SYSTEM 提示，让 Agent 在 fail-close 模式下安全继续运行。
description.en: A DSH plugin that auto-rejects unanswered permission requests with a model-visible timeout notice, enabling fail-close safety for agents.

description.zh: 这款 DSH plugin 为每条会话标题自动加上所属项目名前缀，让平铺的会话列表一眼就能看出会话属于哪个 workspace。
description.en: A DSH plugin that prefixes every session title with its project name, so a flat session list shows at a glance which workspace each conversation belongs to.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一键临时工作区：点一下即建临时目录并开启会话，删除时可选是否清理磁盘文件，避免手动建目录与残留污染。
description.en: One-click throwaway workspaces for DeepSeek Harness: create a temp directory and start a session instantly, with optional on-disk cleanup on delete to avoid manual folder juggling and leftover clutter.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供持久、响应的 tmux 控制模式驾驶舱，通过 xterm.js 渲染窗格，跨会话保持可见。
description.en: A persistent, responsive tmux control-mode cockpit for DeepSeek Harness Web, rendering panes via xterm.js and staying visible across chats.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏添加待办清单面板，支持列表与 Markdown 双视图，新建条目自动补齐创建时间、提醒时间与提醒模式，并注册 todo_board 工具供模型操作。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a todo panel to the sidebar with list and Markdown views, auto-filling creation time, reminder time and reminder mode, plus a todo_board tool for the model.

description.zh: DSH plugin 浏览器自动化工具，通过执行任意 JavaScript 操控真实登录浏览器，实现点击、输入、截图、CDP 等无限操作，零配置自愈。
description.en: A DSH plugin for browser automation that runs arbitrary JavaScript in your real logged-in browser, enabling clicks, typing, screenshots, CDP and more with zero setup.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏提供轻量待办清单：一行一件、回车即加、勾掉即完成，Agent 可通过 todo_panel 工具与面板双向读写同一份状态。
description.en: A lightweight todo list docked in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: one line per item, press Enter to add, check to complete, with the todo_panel tool letting the agent read and write the same state as the panel.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供常驻的 todo 账本工作流：11 个原生工具把任务状态与跨会话上下文持久化到仓库 _todo/ 目录，避免每轮重写任务清单。
description.en: A resident todo-ledger workflow for DeepSeek Harness: 11 native tools persist task state and cross-session context in the repo's _todo/ directory, so the task list no longer has to be rewritten every turn.

description.zh: dsh-token-chart 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 插件，采集本机会话 Token 用量，在侧边栏、会话抽屉与每日面板中以 7 种图表和统计形式展示，口径与产品计费一致。
description.en: dsh-token-chart is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that collects local session token usage and renders it in the sidebar, session drawer and daily panel with seven chart styles and stats, matching the product's billing basis.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端提供会话实时花费胶囊，按供应商与模型分列 token 用量与金额，支持峰谷分时定价与自定义价目表。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows real-time per-session token cost in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, breaking usage and spend down by provider and model with peak/off-peak tariffs and editable pricing.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供全局实时 Token 悬浮窗，从流式 chunk 估算所有会话的输出速度、累计 token 与运行状态，不依赖提供方上报 usage。
description.en: A global real-time Token HUD for DeepSeek Harness that estimates output speed, cumulative tokens and session status for all sessions from streaming chunks, without relying on provider-reported usage.

description.zh: DSH plugin 用量看板：在设置页集中展示 DeepSeek Harness 账户余额、Token 使用量与三档成本拆分，含整年热力图与分组趋势曲线。
description.en: A DSH plugin dashboard that shows DeepSeek Harness account balance, token usage and three-tier cost breakdown, with a full-year heatmap and grouped trend curves.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在侧边栏底部展示 API 余额与 Token Plan 用量，支持 DeepSeek Platform 与 OpenCode Go，帮助用户实时掌握模型消耗。
description.en: A DSH plugin that displays API balance and Token Plan usage in the sidebar footer, supporting DeepSeek Platform and OpenCode Go to track model consumption in real time.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Token 用量统计看板与会话树用量分析，含热力图、缓存命中率趋势及子智能体消耗明细。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a token usage dashboard and per-session tree analytics for DeepSeek Harness, covering heatmaps, cache hit-rate trends and subagent consumption.

description.zh: DSH plugin 实时统计今日与近7日 Token 消耗，按模型分桶展示，提供缓存命中率分析与趋势图表，帮助用户掌握模型用量与成本。
description.en: A DSH plugin that tracks today's and last 7 days' token usage, grouped by model, with cache hit rate analysis and trend charts.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 token 用量分析与模型能力排行榜的 DSH plugin，扫描宿主会话日志，按提供商和模型统计消耗趋势、缓存命中率，并对比可调用模型的能力排名。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for token usage analytics and model capability rankings: it scans the host's own session logs, breaks consumption trends and cache hit rates down by provider and model, and ranks every callable model on a public leaderboard.

description.zh: DSH plugin 安全凭证库：令牌永不离机，通过 vault_run 注入子进程环境，供 gh/npm/node/git 使用，杜绝明文与模型上下文泄露。
description.en: Secure credential vault for DeepSeek Harness: tokens never leave the host, injected via vault_run into child-process env for gh/npm/node/git, no plaintext or model exposure.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地 token 用量、API 调用与缓存命中统计面板，在侧边栏直观查看各会话、模型与项目的消耗情况。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows local token usage, API calls, and cache hit statistics in the native sidebar, broken down by session, model, and project.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 accurate_vision 工具，通过任意兼容 OpenAI 的视觉模型实现精确空间推理，输出 0-1000 归一化边界框与标注 SVG，让纯文本 Agent 获得可计算的几何信息。
description.en: A DSH plugin providing the accurate_vision tool for DeepSeek Harness, enabling precise spatial reasoning via any OpenAI-compatible vision model, outputting 0-1000 normalized bounding boxes and annotated SVG for text-only agents.

description.zh: dsh-tokstat 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，实时统计会话日志中的 Tokens、TTFT、TPS 与成本，并提供 Web 面板与 Python TUI 双形态。
description.en: dsh-tokstat is a DSH plugin that provides real-time usage and performance statistics (tokens, TTFT, TPS, cost) from session logs, with both a web panel and a Python TUI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 中的非 DeepSeek 模型提供安全兼容适配层，处理失效升级状态、注入模型族惯例并熔断连续失败。
description.en: A safety and compatibility adaptation layer for non-DeepSeek model families in DeepSeek Harness Web, guarding dead escalation states, injecting model-family conventions and fusing repeated failures.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供交互式聊天卡片，在助手消息内渲染滑块、表单、图表与表格，用户提交后参数快照回传给智能体。
description.en: Interactive chat cards for DeepSeek Harness: render sliders, forms, charts and tables inside an assistant message, then send the parameter snapshot back to the agent on submit.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供面向模型的 Word 文档工具：docx_read 提取 Markdown/JSON，docx_create 从 Markdown 生成 .docx，docx_edit 保留属性编辑内容，全程沙箱化文件读写。
description.en: Model-facing Word (.docx) tools for DeepSeek Harness: docx_read extracts Markdown/JSON, docx_create generates .docx from Markdown, docx_edit edits content while preserving properties, with sandboxed file I/O.

description.zh: dsh-tool-governor 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，拦截重复工具调用、限制每轮调用与步数预算，并切断失败循环，减少 token 浪费。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that intercepts repeated tool calls, caps per-turn call and step budgets, and cuts off failure loops to reduce token waste.

description.zh: 为 DSH 的 bash/pwsh 命令输出与 read 代码结果做分层语法染色，纯前端渲染、零 token 开销，表格与日志保持原样。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds layered syntax highlighting to bash/pwsh command output and read code results, rendered purely on the frontend with zero token cost while leaving tables and logs untouched.

description.zh: DSH plugin 图像生成工具，对接 ToAPIs 异步图像 API，提供文生图、图生图与图片上传，自动下载到工作区并返回本地路径与公开 URL。
description.en: A DSH plugin for image generation via ToAPIs async API, offering text-to-image, image-to-image, and upload tools that save results locally and return URLs.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供后台监听能力：对文件、命令输出或 WebSocket 持续监控，新输出到达即唤醒所属会话，并在 Web 会话头部展示监听列表与输出面板。
description.en: A DSH plugin that watches files, command output, or WebSocket streams in the background, wakes the owning session when new output arrives, and adds a live monitor list with output viewer to the web session header.

description.zh: DSH plugin 零丢失修剪超大工具结果：先落盘完整文本，再以内联头尾预览替换，模型可通过定位符恢复被省略的中间内容。
description.en: A DSH plugin that prunes oversized tool results with zero loss: spills full text to disk first, then replaces with a bounded head/tail preview, letting the model recover elided middles via locator.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生工具搜索的 DSH 插件，按需用 BM25 或 Ollama/OpenAI 向量检索发现内置、插件与 MCP 工具，并动态加载或卸载工具 schema。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness native tool search, discovering built-in, plugin and MCP tools on demand via BM25 or Ollama/OpenAI embeddings and loading or unloading their schemas.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上 terminal_search 工具，让模型按字面或正则在大体量终端回滚日志中直接定位目标行，无需逐页盲翻。
description.en: Adds a terminal_search tool to DeepSeek Harness (DSH) so models can locate lines in large retained terminal scrollback by literal substring or regex instead of paging backward blindly.

description.zh: DSH plugin 控制注入模型上下文的工具清单：提供设置页 UI 与 tool_visibility 管理工具，可隐藏工具 schema 以节省上下文，状态持久化自动恢复。
description.en: DSH plugin to control which tool schemas are injected into the model context: settings UI plus tool_visibility manager tool, hiding tools to save context with persisted state.

description.zh: dsh-toolbox 是 DeepSeek Harness 的工具箱插件，按正则把全局工具分组，用开启、关闭、按需三种状态控制工具是否进入上下文，并提供侧边栏面板增删改分组，减少上下文损耗。
description.en: dsh-toolbox is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that groups globally registered tools by regex and controls their presence in context via open, close, and on-demand states, with a sidebar panel for editing groups to cut context bloat.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的自改造补上评测环节：同一批金标准用例分别跑现状与候选提示词，用规则检查加模型裁判打分对账，好就留、不好就撤。
description.en: Adds the missing evaluation half to DeepSeek Harness self-evolution: run the same golden cases against the current config and a candidate prompt, score with rule checks plus an LLM judge, and keep the change only if it improved.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 交易图表插件，模型调用工具后直接在对话流渲染 K线、技术指标、热点轮动矩阵与连板晋级图，纯自绘 SVG 零依赖。
description.en: A DSH plugin that renders candlestick, line, bar, area charts, technical indicators, heatmap and ladder charts directly in conversation via the trade_chart tool, pure SVG with zero dependencies.

description.zh: DSH plugin 外贸助手：规则驱动的询盘回复与 13 语言产品文案工具，零模型依赖、不烧 token，装上即用。
description.en: A DSH plugin for foreign trade: rule-based inquiry reply and 13-language product copywriting, zero model dependency, no token cost.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 macOS 悬浮窗中实时展示订阅会话的红黄绿灯任务状态，支持订阅管理与拖拽。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows real-time traffic-light status of subscribed sessions in a macOS floating window, with subscription management and drag support.

description.zh: DSH plugin 修复第三方模型 tool call schema 误解析导致的重复失败，并支持跳过长时间卡住的工具调用。
description.en: DSH plugin that fixes schema mis-parsing of tool calls from third-party models and allows skipping stuck tool calls.

description.zh: DSH 插件，提供只读的 Trading 212 投资组合仪表板，支持持仓、历史、风险分析与交易标记，并可在对话中查询。
description.en: A DSH plugin offering a read-only Trading 212 portfolio dashboard with holdings, history, risk, and trade markers, plus in-chat queries.

description.zh: dsh-trail-plugin 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话添加可索引、可跳转、可分叉的历史节点树，让线性对话日志拥有导航层。
description.en: dsh-trail-plugin adds an indexable, jumpable, forkable node tree to DeepSeek Harness sessions, giving linear chat logs a navigation layer.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 每个会话的运行状态以色块形式显示在 GNOME 顶栏，一眼看清哪些在跑、哪些跑完待确认、哪些正等你审批或回复。
description.en: A DSH plugin that mirrors each DeepSeek Harness session's status as colored chips in the GNOME top bar, so you can see at a glance what is running, finished, or waiting on your approval.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏加入双栏翻译页，复用会话模型目录，支持 15 种语言自动识别源语言、可调推理强度与自定义提示词。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a two-pane Translate page to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, reusing the chat model catalog with 15 languages, auto source detection, adjustable reasoning effort and a customizable prompt.

description.zh: 为个人 DeepSeek Harness Web 实例加一道 TOTP 访问验证，用身份验证器的 6 位动态码进入工作区，支持扫码绑定、保护开关、恢复码与一键锁定。
description.en: Adds a TOTP access-verification gate to your personal DeepSeek Harness web instance: enter a 6-digit authenticator code to reach your workspace, with QR binding, protection toggle, recovery codes and one-click lock.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面嵌入可拖拽的 AI 翻译浮窗，支持多语言互译、余额与费用估算，密钥不出浏览器。
description.en: A floating AI translation window for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with multi-language translation, balance and cost estimation, keeping API keys off the page.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面嵌入可拖拽的 AI 翻译浮窗，支持多语言互译、余额与费用估算，密钥不出浏览器。
description.en: A floating AI translation window for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with multi-language translation, balance and cost estimation, keeping API keys off the page.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面嵌入可拖拽的 AI 翻译浮窗，支持多语言互译、余额与费用估算，密钥不出浏览器。
description.en: A floating AI translation window for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with multi-language translation, balance and cost estimation, keeping API keys off the page.

description.zh: DSH 回收站插件：为归档会话提供删除冷静区，支持 7 天内恢复、手动移除与自动清理，永不删除会话日志。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a recycle bin for archived sessions, allowing restore within 7 days, manual removal, and auto-cleanup, without ever deleting session logs.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 系统托盘图标、菜单与气泡通知的 DSH plugin，支持 headless 降级，无需 native 编译。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a Windows system tray icon, menu, and bubble notifications to DeepSeek Harness, with headless fallback and no native compilation.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 OS 进程树与任务账本对账，定位归属、检测泄漏并安全治理，守护 DeepSeek Harness 运行环境。
description.en: A DSH plugin that reconciles OS process trees with task ledgers for attribution, leak detection, and safe governance of the DeepSeek Harness runtime.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在对话视图新增 Trellis 标签页，展示当前任务、验收清单、spec/技能使用与工作区日志，助力 Trellis 任务管理。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding a Trellis tab to the conversation view, showing current task, acceptance checklist, spec/skill usage, and workspace journal for Trellis task management.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 装上 TriBot 五角色团队技能与输入框选角胶囊，一键切换总管、研究员、工程师、管家、审稿人，零配置即用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds the TriBot five-role team skill plus a composer role picker, letting you switch between dispatcher, researcher, engineer, steward and reviewer with zero config.

description.zh: DSH plugin 修复 web 代理下特权 API 方法返回 403 的问题，使受信任主机可正常访问设置、凭据等接口。
description.en: A DSH plugin that fixes HTTP 403 for privileged API methods behind a reverse proxy, allowing trusted hosts to access settings, credentials, and more.

description.zh: DSH Trust Center 是 DeepSeek Harness 的只读信任审计插件，扫描 MCP 工具与 Skills 中的提示注入、隐藏 Unicode、危险能力与上下文成本，并在 Web 面板与 trust_scan 工具中呈现证据。
description.en: A read-only trust audit DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that scans MCP tools and Skills for prompt injection, hidden Unicode, dangerous capabilities, and context cost, surfacing evidence in a Web Trust Center panel and a trust_scan tool.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供声明核验：将 Agent 声称的测试通过、文件已改等结论与 shell/编辑回执比对，默认 shadow 模式仅记录不干预。
description.en: A DSH plugin that verifies coding-agent claims such as tests passed or files edited against shell and edit receipts, defaulting to shadow mode that records without steering.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness CLI 提供交互式终端界面（TUI），覆盖会话、流式对话、工具卡片、审批、任务、子代理、目标、计划模式、模型选择与技能等，通过 dsh --patch 加载。
description.en: An interactive terminal UI (TUI) for the DeepSeek Harness CLI, covering sessions, streaming chat, tool cards, approvals, jobs, subagents, goals, plan mode, model selection, and skills, loaded via dsh --patch.

description.zh: 为 dsh-TUI 提供右侧收件箱侧边栏，按工作区分组展示运行中、未读与最近会话，点击即可跳转。
description.en: A right-side inbox sidebar for dsh-TUI that groups running, unread and recent conversations by workspace, with click-to-jump navigation.

description.zh: DSH 插件在每条 AI 回复下显示真实花费（人民币官方峰谷价），并区分按量、订阅路由，提供会话级与跨对话汇总。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows real per-turn cost (CNY official peak/off-peak rates) under each AI reply, distinguishes pay-as-you-go vs subscription routes, with session and cross-session summaries.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的会话清理插件，用墓碑事件遮蔽指定单轮或多轮对话，让模型上下文变轻，原始日志不改动、可随时审计读回。
description.en: A session-cleaning DSH plugin that tombstones any single turn or range of turns so the model-visible context shrinks, while the original log stays untouched and auditable.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 每个已完成回合上方显示该轮回答所用的模型，一行灰色小字，支持多路由与悬停查看完整供应商/模型名。
description.en: Shows which model answered each completed turn in DeepSeek Harness as a single plain-text line, with multi-route display and hover for the full provider/model name.

description.zh: DSH 回合提醒音乐插件：对话结束时自动播放叮铃铃铃声，把离开屏幕的你叫回来，支持自定义或上传音频，并可随时暂停。
description.en: A DSH plugin that plays a ringtone when the agent finishes a turn, calling you back to the screen; supports custom or uploaded audio and can be paused anytime.

description.zh: dsh-turnsnap 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供零配置的每轮 git 检查点：每次 agent 回合结束自动提交一个 [turnsnap] 标签的 commit，方便回滚。
description.en: dsh-turnsnap provides zero-config per-turn git checkpoints for DeepSeek Harness: after each agent turn, it auto-commits a [turnsnap]-tagged commit for easy rollback.

description.zh: TutorLoop 是 DeepSeek Harness 的通用学习陪练插件，把工作区资料变成小步练习，用原文证据反馈并安排复习。
description.en: TutorLoop is a general-purpose tutoring DSH plugin that turns workspace materials into small practice steps, gives evidence-based feedback from the source text, and schedules later reviews.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中通过访问令牌接入绿联 NAS，把文件、Docker、下载、应用、存储与系统状态变成 59 个可对话调用的工具，支持只读模式与权限边界。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects DeepSeek Harness to UGREEN NAS via scoped access tokens, exposing files, Docker, downloads, apps, storage and system status as 59 conversational tools with a read-only mode.

description.zh: DSH plugin 本地优先的输入统计与软件使用追踪器，记录按键与文本并生成日报周报，注重隐私保护。
description.en: A local-first typing analytics and app usage tracker for DeepSeek Harness, capturing keystrokes and text to generate daily/weekly reports with strong privacy safeguards.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端添加本地图片或视频背景与全界面毛玻璃效果的 DSH plugin，通过覆写官方主题令牌实现，零 DOM 扫描、关闭即还原。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds local image or video wallpapers and full-UI frosted glass to the DeepSeek Harness Web client by overriding official theme tokens, with zero DOM scanning and instant revert on disable.

description.zh: DSH plugin 计费小组件：在 Web GUI 侧边栏底部显示当前会话费用与 API 余额，支持实时刷新与折叠显示。
description.en: A DSH plugin billing widget showing current-session cost and API balance at the sidebar foot of the Web GUI, with live refresh and collapsed display.

description.zh: DSH plugin 浏览器提示音插件：模型完成回合、请求审批或询问用户时播放合成“叮”声，无需音频文件，支持音量调节与预览。
description.en: A DSH plugin that plays a synthesized chime when the model completes a turn, requests approval, or asks the user a question, with volume control and no audio assets.

description.zh: 为 DSH plugin 提供界面配色定制：在设置中调节调色板、语义主题、语法高亮、边框与圆角，让 DSH Web 外观贴合你的 IDE 主题。
description.en: A DSH plugin that customizes the DSH Web client's look: palette spectra, full semantic themes, Shiki syntax colors, borders and radius, so the UI matches your IDE theme.

description.zh: DSH 插件 TypeLens 自动为 DeepSeek Harness 提供有界类型上下文与编辑诊断，让编码 Agent 无需手动调用 LSP 即可理解代码并即时获得 TS/JS 错误反馈。
description.en: TypeLens is a DSH plugin that automatically supplies bounded type context and edit diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness, letting coding agents understand code and get TS/JS errors without manually invoking an LSP.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供会话实时花费显示，按各模型 token 单价计价，在输入框下方以胶囊形式展示累计成本，点击可查看缓存分桶与未定价 token 明细。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows real-time session spend in the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, priced from per-model token rates and rendered as a pill under the composer with a clickable cost breakdown.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为 Web 界面提供折叠行吸顶与滚动补偿，让长内容展开后阅读和折叠更顺手。
description.en: A DSH plugin for the Web GUI adding sticky fold row and collapse scroll compensation, keeping long expanded content easy to read and fold.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供语音输入、工具调用折叠与自定义 CSS 等交互和样式增强的 DSH plugin。
description.en: A DSH plugin that enhances the DeepSeek Harness web UI with voice input, tool-call collapsing, and custom CSS.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 补齐字体设置：在「设置 → 通用」中挑选并排序界面与代码字体，写入 settings.yaml 即时生效。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds font-family controls to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, letting you pick and reorder UI and code fonts from Settings → General.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面换上液态玻璃皮肤，侧边栏、会话栏、输入框等 13 个区域可逐层调节，并按时段轮换壁纸。
description.en: A liquid-glass skin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: 13 glass regions with per-layer controls, time-of-day wallpapers and four theme colours.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端提供界面增强的 DSH 插件，在设置中新增 ui-fortifier 标签页，可逐项开关各功能模块，例如在模型选择器左侧显示当前 provider。
description.en: A DSH plugin that enhances the DeepSeek Harness web UI with a ui-fortifier settings tab for toggling each feature module, such as showing the active provider beside the model selector.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供用户可配置的成本定价：按模型单价与按天时段倍率策略，并在会话中实时显示费用估算，支持手动修正。
description.en: User-configurable cost pricing for DeepSeek Harness: per-model list prices and a per-day time policy with multipliers, plus a live cost projection and composer-dock CostLine for every session's spend.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加任务完成通知能力：当 Agent 结束或等待用户审批时，在页面隐藏时弹出系统级浏览器通知，支持子代理与交互提醒。
description.en: Endows DeepSeek Harness with task-complete alerts: when an agent finishes or waits for approval while the page is hidden, it raises a system-level browser notification, with subagent and interaction options.

description.zh: DSH plugin 界面状态持久化插件，自动保存并恢复侧边栏开合/宽度、详情面板及对话滚动位置，跨重启无缝恢复。
description.en: A DSH plugin that persists UI state, automatically saving and restoring sidebar toggle/width, details panel, and chat scroll position across restarts.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 客户端换上《绝区零》千夏外观的主题插件，内置立绘与影画两套主题，支持图层调节与可拖动 Q 版挂件。
description.en: A Zenless Zone Zero Sunna theme plugin for the DeepSeek Harness client, offering two themes with layered tuning and a draggable chibi widget.

description.zh: dsh-uisketch 将 UI 草图画板编辑器嵌入 DeepSeek Harness Web，侧栏开关全屏画板，支持组件拖拽、属性编辑与 JSON 导出，开箱即用。
description.en: dsh-uisketch embeds a UI sketch canvas editor into DeepSeek Harness Web with a sidebar toggle and fullscreen overlay, supporting drag-drop, property editing, and JSON export out of the box.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 换上保护伞公司风格主题：黑红深色与灰白浅色双配色，覆盖 113 个界面 token，并带旋转伞形水印与 HUD 边框。
description.en: An Umbrella Corporation theme for DeepSeek Harness with black-and-red dark and grey-and-white light schemes, 113 overridden UI tokens, a spinning umbrella watermark and a HUD frame.

description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供命名浏览器配置文件，保留本地登录态：你先在可见浏览器里手动登录，之后 agent 复用该配置执行导航、快照、点击与输入等操作。
description.en: Gives DSH agents named browser profiles that keep their local sign-in state: log in yourself in a visible browser, then let the agent reuse that profile for navigation, snapshots, clicks, and typing.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 convert 工具与「单位换算」Web 视图，覆盖长度、面积、体积、温度等十大类 80+ 单位，支持中英文单位名与温标/温差换算。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding a convert tool and a locale-aware unit conversion view, covering 10 categories and 80+ units with Chinese/English unit names and temperature-scale or delta conversion.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供会话轮次进度轨道，以粘性圆点条展示每轮问题摘要，支持一键加载深层历史，提升长对话导航效率。
description.en: A turn progress rail for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, showing per-turn question summaries on a sticky dot strip with one-click deep-history loading.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Unity MCP 服务器，通过 stdio 桥接启动 Unity 编辑器自带的 unity-ai-relay，将全部工具暴露为 mcp__unity__* 并在 Web GUI 提供配置与状态卡片。
description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the Unity MCP server: it bridges the Unity Editor's unity-ai-relay over stdio, exposes every relay tool as mcp__unity__*, and adds a settings/status card in the Web GUI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 在 Windows 上补上缺失的 bash 能力：新增 winbash 工具，调用用户自装的 Git Bash 并修复 MSYS PATH，命令在文件沙箱外执行。
description.en: Adds the missing bash capability to DeepSeek Harness on Windows: a winbash tool that runs a user-installed Git Bash with fixed MSYS PATH, executing commands outside the file sandbox.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地 Unsloth 双手：将重复文本与视觉（OCR）任务交给本地 Unsloth Desktop 处理，纯客户端工具插件。
description.en: A pure-client tool plugin for DeepSeek Harness that hands repetitive text and vision (OCR) labor to a local Unsloth Desktop.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供 URL 解析、跟踪参数清理、编解码与重定向展开的 url_tool 工具，零依赖纯 ESM，永不抛异常。
description.en: A DSH plugin offering a url_tool for URL parsing, tracking-param cleanup, encode/decode, and redirect expansion, zero-dependency pure ESM, never throws.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 用量徽标 DSH plugin：在侧边栏显示今日 token 与估算费用，并提供多区间用量图表、热力图与官方峰谷定价。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a usage badge to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, showing today's tokens and estimated cost with multi-range charts, heatmaps and official peak/off-peak pricing.

description.zh: dsh-usage 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏注入「用量」按钮，展示 token 账单、余额、缓存命中率、成本曲线与热力图，成本按官方价目估算，数据全在本机解析。
description.en: dsh-usage injects a Usage button into the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, showing token bills, balance, cache hit rate, cost curves, and heatmaps; costs are estimated from official pricing, all computed locally.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在会话头部展示模型厂商余额/用量徽标，内置 DeepSeek、MiniMax、智谱配额，支持告警阈值与进度可视化。
description.en: A DSH plugin that displays model provider balance/usage badges in the session header, with built-in DeepSeek, MiniMax, and Zhipu quotas, supporting alert thresholds and progress visualization.

description.zh: DSH plugin 会话 token 用量净化器，拦截异常指标，修复历史记录损坏，防止会话因 NaN 而永久不可读。
description.en: A DSH plugin that sanitizes session token usage, intercepts malformed metrics, and revives corrupted session history from NaN corruption.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在会话头部显示上下文占用与账户余额，点击可查看明细，余额提供方可替换，密钥不进入浏览器。
description.en: A DSH plugin showing context occupancy and account balance in the session header, with a clickable breakdown and a swappable balance provider that keeps keys out of the browser.

description.zh: DSH plugin 模型用量仪表盘，在设置页新增用量板块，按服务商/模型汇总 token 用量，支持今日、近 7 天、近 30 天趋势图。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a usage dashboard to settings, aggregating token usage by provider/model with today/7d/30d trend charts.

description.zh: DSH plugin 模型用量仪表盘，在设置页新增用量板块，按服务商/模型汇总 token 用量，支持今日、近 7 天、近 30 天趋势图。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a usage dashboard to settings, aggregating token usage by provider/model with today/7d/30d trend charts.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供悬浮用量小窗，实时显示 Claude/Codex 订阅额度与重置倒计时、DeepSeek API 花费与余额，可拖动折叠并跟随 DSH 语言设置。
description.en: A floating usage widget for DeepSeek Harness Web that shows Claude/Codex subscription quotas with reset countdowns plus DeepSeek API spend and balance, draggable, collapsible and following your DSH language setting.

description.zh: DSH plugin 原生侧边栏用量面板，实时展示官方余额与基于会话日志的 token 用量历史，零额外进程与跨域调用。
description.en: A native sidebar usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: live official balance and token usage history from session logs, with zero footprint.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供用量与官方 Plan 配额统计的 DSH 插件，在输入框下方展示 5 小时、每周、每月真实额度窗口，并附 26 周活跃热力图与自定义 HTTPS 余额探测。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that tracks usage and official Plan quotas, showing real 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows under the composer plus a 26-week activity heatmap and optional custom HTTPS balance probes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供用量状态显示：在输入框统计行下方常驻展示当前模型的账户余额或 Coding Plan 额度（5h/7d/30d），零配置自动识别数据源，失败时保留旧值不伪造数据。
description.en: A DSH plugin that keeps your account balance or coding-plan quota (5h/7d/30d) for the model in use always visible right under the composer, auto-detecting the data source with zero config and never faking data on failure.

description.zh: dsh-token-usage 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 token 用量与成本分析插件，在 Web 设置面板新增用量统计页，提供汇总卡片、GitHub 风格热力图和官方峰谷价自动换算的预估费用。
description.en: dsh-token-usage is a token usage and cost analytics plugin for DeepSeek Harness, adding a Usage Stats page to the Web settings panel with summary cards, a GitHub-style heatmap, and estimated spend auto-converted at official peak/off-peak rates.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生用量与费用看板，在设置页集中展示各提供商用量、订阅配额、余额与 API 费用估算。
description.en: A native usage and cost dashboard for DeepSeek Harness, showing provider usage, subscription quotas, balances, and API cost estimates in Settings.

description.zh: dsh-token-usage 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 token 用量与成本分析插件，在 Web 设置面板新增用量统计页，提供汇总卡片、GitHub 风格热力图和官方峰谷价自动换算的预估费用。
description.en: dsh-token-usage is a token usage and cost analytics plugin for DeepSeek Harness, adding a Usage Stats page to the Web settings panel with summary cards, a GitHub-style heatmap, and estimated spend auto-converted at official peak/off-peak rates.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为所有出站 HTTP 请求（LLM API 调用等）改写 User-Agent，可在 Web 设置的 UA 设置 选项卡中实时配置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that rewrites the User-Agent of every outgoing HTTP request (LLM API calls etc.), configurable live from the UA 设置 tab in Web settings.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加常驻自定义提示词，每次对话自动注入，设置页可编辑保存，并支持一键导入 Claude Code 与 Codex 的全局规则。
description.en: Adds a persistent custom prompt to DeepSeek Harness that is injected into every conversation, editable and saved in the settings page, with one-click import of Claude Code and Codex global rules.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供结构化、可审阅的用户画像：逐轮提取证据，归纳九个维度并附置信度，供模型按需调用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that builds a structured, reviewable user portrait from every session, extracting evidence per turn across nine dimensions and exposing it to the model on demand.

description.zh: DSH plugin 用户级配置同步：把技能、插件清单、配置与记忆在设备间对齐，换机一键恢复环境并自动装回插件。
description.en: A DSH plugin that syncs user-level skills, plugin manifests, config and memories across devices, restoring your DeepSeek Harness setup on a new machine in one click.

description.zh: 把 Gillespie《车辆动力学基础》整本书蒸馏成 164 张可执行工程检查单的 DSH 技能，附约 77 处原文缺陷标注，只给页码与判据、不复制原文。
description.en: A DSH plugin that distills Gillespie's Fundamentals of Vehicle Dynamics into 164 executable engineering checklists with ~77 documented source defects, citing page numbers and criteria without reproducing the text.

description.zh: DSH plugin，在设置界面登录Claude Pro、ChatGPT Plus等无API key的AI订阅账号，用自带配额运行模型，免按token计费。
description.en: A DSH plugin to sign in to AI plans without API keys (Claude Pro, ChatGPT Plus, etc.) from the settings UI, running on your own quota.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话头部加上 3-dots 菜单，可按会话切换 Normal/Verbose 阅读模式、自定义 Verbose 展开内容，并显示每轮指标页脚。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a session-header 3-dots menu to switch each chat between Normal and Verbose, choose what Verbose expands, and show a per-turn metrics footer.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在侧边栏设置按钮上方常驻显示 dsh 版本徽标，点击可查看核心包版本、检查更新并一键部署升级。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows a persistent version badge above the settings button in the sidebar, with click-to-expand core package versions, update check, and one-click deploy.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Vercel 的 DSH 插件，通过 OAuth 连接后可管理项目、部署与平台工具，并按需加载官方技能指引。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects DeepSeek Harness to Vercel via OAuth, letting you manage projects, deployments and platform tools while loading official skill guidance on demand.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 的插件设置页新增 Versions 标签，展示当前运行的 DeepSeek Harness 版本与每个已挂载插件的包版本、安装路径和配置摘要，并注册同名工具供会话直接读取。
description.en: Adds a Versions tab to the DSH web UI plugin settings, showing the running DeepSeek Harness version plus each mounted plugin's package version, install path and config summary, and registers the same reading as a tool for sessions.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来 vibe 模式：/vibe 把会话变成导演，只读只监督，由 fast/good 常驻子代理执行编辑与构建并回报结果。
description.en: A vibe mode DSH plugin: /vibe turns the session into a director that only reads and supervises, while persistent fast/good worker subagents do the editing, searching and building and report results back.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在 Agent 运行时于 web 界面右下角弹出拼写单词卡，会话结束自动收起，帮助用户在编码间隙积累词汇。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows spelling flashcards in the web UI while your agent runs, retreating when it finishes, to build vocabulary during coding.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入在线视频生成模型，提供三个模型工具、可跨重启的持久任务账本、聊天卡片与 Videos 面板，并按公开价格源估算成本。
description.en: Brings online-model video generation into DeepSeek Harness: three model tools, a durable task ledger that survives restarts, live chat cards and a Videos panel, plus cost estimates from a public price feed.

description.zh: DSH plugin 用于管理 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 会话页头的视图标签（对话/轨迹），支持启用、隐藏、排序、重命名，并跟随界面语言切换。
description.en: A DSH plugin to manage view tabs (Chat/Trajectory) in the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI session header: enable, hide, reorder, rename, with zh/en locale support.

description.zh: DSH plugin 视觉识别插件：在 Web 编辑器粘贴图片，由主机端调用 GLM-4V 识别，并将结果作为隐藏上下文注入对话，让主模型基于图片内容作答。
description.en: A DSH plugin for vision recognition: paste images into the Web composer, recognize them via GLM-4V on the host side, and inject the result as hidden context so the main model answers based on the image.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加视觉能力的 DSH 插件，支持拖图识别，图片交给视觉模型、文字交给 DeepSeek 推理，聊天入口不变。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds vision capability to DeepSeek Harness, enabling drag-and-drop image recognition with visual models and DeepSeek reasoning.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让纯文本模型也能读懂图片：粘贴图片时自动调用视觉模型转写为文字，再交给原模型回答，无需切换模型。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets text-only models read images by transcribing them with a vision model before the request reaches the provider.

description.zh: 为纯文本的 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 补上图像理解能力：先用 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 把图片转写为文字，再交给 V4-Pro 作答，无需切换模型或额外 API Key。
description.en: Gives the text-only DeepSeek-V4-Pro real image understanding: images are transcribed to text by deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp, then answered by V4-Pro — no model switching, no extra API key.

description.zh: DSH plugin 为纯文本模型提供图像视觉分析，并在会话日志写入前将图像转为文本，彻底避免图像块导致的 400 死锁，还能修复已卡死的会话。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets text-only models see images via vision analysis, rewriting images to text before they enter the session log to prevent 400 deadlocks, and even heals already-stuck sessions.

description.zh: dsh-vision-router 的显示配套插件，将自动识图双胞胎模型折叠为原模型行上的方形图片按钮，点击即可切换视觉路由，不改变路由逻辑。
description.en: Display companion for dsh-vision-router: folds vision twin models into square picture buttons on original model rows, enabling one-click vision route switching without altering routing logic.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中的纯文本模型补上视觉能力：粘贴图片即可问答，支持长截图 OCR、UI 还原与 GUI 视觉任务，并内置视觉工作流 Skill。
description.en: Gives text-only models in DeepSeek Harness real vision: paste an image to ask questions, plus long-screenshot OCR, UI rebuilding, and GUI visual tasks via a bundled Skill.

description.zh: dsh-visual-card 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，把 AI 生成的 HTML 在对话中渲染成可交互卡片，支持点击、键盘操作、全屏、复制与下载。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that renders AI-generated HTML as interactive cards inside conversations, with clickable content, keyboard control, fullscreen, copy and download.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 与桌面端提供壁纸驱动视觉系统，一份 preset.json 即可整体替换配色与背景，支持图片、视频与 CSS 微动。
description.en: A wallpaper-driven visual system for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI and desktop app: one preset.json swaps the whole colour system and background, with image, video and subtle CSS motion support.

description.zh: 为 DSH 网页端提供双向语音：说话即转写进输入框，回复自动朗读，麦克风持续监听。
description.en: A two-way voice DSH plugin for the web app: speak to dictate into the composer, hear replies read aloud, with the mic kept listening.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供语音播报的 DSH 插件，监听会话 turn/end 事件，用中文语音念出会话标题、轮次与结果，并支持流式朗读回复。
description.en: A DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness that speaks each session's title, round number and outcome on turn/end, with optional live reading of streaming replies.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 端加上语音输入与回复播报：点麦克风说话即发送，助手回复自动朗读，纯浏览器实现、零依赖零 API Key。
description.en: Adds voice input and spoken replies to the DeepSeek Harness web UI: speak to send, hear assistant answers read aloud, with zero dependencies and no API key.

description.zh: DSH plugin 语音输入插件：在对话输入框旁添加麦克风按钮，录音后调用本地 SenseVoice 转写并自动填入，首次使用自动下载模型。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a mic button next to the input box, records audio, transcribes via local SenseVoice, and auto-fills the text; downloads the model on first use.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端提供语音交互控制面板，含麦克风六态指示、声纹注册过滤与自动朗读开关，需配合本地语音网关使用。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a voice control surface to the DeepSeek Harness web client, with a six-state mic indicator, voiceprint enrollment and filtering, and auto-speak toggles, backed by a local voice gateway.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 0.2 桌面版带来全双工语音模式：说话流式入草稿、停顿自动发送、按句朗读并显示实时字幕，开口即打断朗读，附带应用内设置页与本地 ASR 纠错词表。
description.en: Full-duplex voice mode for the DeepSeek Harness 0.2 desktop app: streaming speech into the draft, silence auto-send, sentence-by-sentence read-aloud with live captions, and true barge-in, plus an in-app settings page and a local ASR correction dictionary.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地语音唤醒：喊「鲸鱼」听到提示音后说指令，停顿即自动发送到会话，识别全在本机完成。
description.en: A local voice-wake plugin for DeepSeek Harness: say the wake word, hear the chime, speak your command, and it auto-sends to the session — all recognition stays on-device.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框加一个扬声器按钮，一键从最新提问开头朗读回复，长按可选起点，上滑调出页内与系统音量混音台。
description.en: A speaker button for the DeepSeek Harness composer that reads your newest question and its replies aloud, with hold-to-pick start point and a swipe-up volume mixer for page and system audio.

description.zh: DSH 插件 dsh-vscode-connect 让 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端与 VS Code 中的 DSH 扩展互联，在编辑器里接续同一会话，Windows 本机可自动连接。
description.en: A DSH plugin that links DeepSeek Harness Desktop with the DSH VS Code extension, letting you resume the same session inside the editor with automatic local connection on Windows.

description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面改造成 VS Code 风格工作台，内置文件浏览器与 Git 面板，由真实文件系统与 Git 接口驱动。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns the DeepSeek Harness web UI into a VS Code-style workbench with file explorer and Git panel, backed by real filesystem & Git routes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供对抗式审查门，危险工具调用执行前由独立小模型复核，并在面板实时展示每次判定与审计记录。
description.en: An adversary review gate for DeepSeek Harness: an independent small model vets destructive tool calls before they run and surfaces every verdict in a live panel.

description.zh: dsh-warm 是 DeepSeek Harness 的提示缓存保温插件，在工具长时间执行时按提供商 TTL 定时重放会话请求，让缓存前缀保持命中，省下重新预填充的开销与首字延迟。
description.en: A prompt-cache warmer for DeepSeek Harness that re-dispatches the session's last request on a per-provider TTL interval while a tool call blocks, keeping the cache prefix warm to avoid costly re-prefill and TTFT.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面添加一个会眨眼的像素绿皮兽人，将代码输出和运行提示替换为兽人式咆哮，让编程过程充满趣味。
description.en: Adds a blinking pixel ork to the DeepSeek Harness web UI, replacing code output and runtime prompts with orkish roars for a fun coding experience.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 5 套低蓝光护眼配色，通过官方 token 覆盖扩展点热生效，零布局改动、卸载即还原。
description.en: A DSH plugin offering five low-blue-light eye-care color schemes that override semantic tokens via the official theme extension point, applying instantly with zero layout changes and full restore on uninstall.

description.zh: dsh-wallet-pill 是 DeepSeek Harness 的余额胶囊插件，在输入框下方显示账户余额，点开可看峰谷价目与切换倒计时，零配置且不落盘。
description.en: dsh-wallet-pill is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows your account balance as a pill below the input box, with a popover for peak/off-peak pricing and the next switch countdown — zero-config and nothing persisted.

description.zh: DSH plugin 天气工具，自动定位并应用沉浸式天气主题，全屏氛围、换色、鲸鱼宠物与交互卡片，常驻生效无需问答。
description.en: DSH plugin weather tool with immersive theming, auto-location, full-screen ambience, whale pet, and interactive cards—always-on without Q&A.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 内置 web_fetch 工具接入 Decodo 抓取 API，让 Agent 照常调用即可读取被反爬拦截的网页，默认返回 Markdown 正文。
description.en: Routes DeepSeek Harness's built-in web_fetch tool through the Decodo scraping API, so the agent can read bot-blocked pages with Markdown output by default.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web GUI 增加密码访问认证，通过登录页与 HttpOnly 签名 Cookie 保护反代暴露的 dsh web，防止未授权访问。
description.en: Adds password-gate authentication to DeepSeek Harness web GUI, using a login page and HttpOnly signed cookie to protect dsh web exposed behind a reverse proxy.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 左侧栏带来 VS Code 式 Git 面板：分支切换、提交图谱与提交预览，底部常驻分支与最近提交坞随会话联动。
description.en: A VS Code-style Git panel for DeepSeek Harness in the left rail: branch switcher, commit graph and commit previews, plus an always-on footer dock that follows your session.

description.zh: DSH 会话页内置的 VSCode 风格开发工作台插件，提供 Monaco 编辑器、资源管理器、Git 全流程、交互式终端与 ripgrep 全局搜索。
description.en: A VSCode-style development workbench plugin embedded in the DSH session page, offering a Monaco editor, file explorer, full Git workflow, interactive terminal and ripgrep global search.

description.zh: DSH plugin 一键启动 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的桌面鲸鱼图标应用，双击即启动服务器并打开浏览器，省去手动输入命令和 URL 的繁琐步骤。
description.en: A DSH plugin that provides a one-click desktop launcher for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI — double-click the whale icon to boot the server and open the browser, eliminating manual commands and URL typing.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供带多提供商回退链的网页搜索与页面提取工具，内置 Tavily、Firecrawl、Exa 与本地 SearXNG，并在提取时校验 URL 以防御 SSRF。
description.en: Resilient web search and page extract tools for DeepSeek Harness, with a multi-provider fallback chain (Tavily, Firecrawl, Exa, local SearXNG) and SSRF-safe URL validation on extract.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将聊天 Markdown 中的 mermaid 代码块自动渲染为可交互 SVG 图表，完全离线运行，无需改动核心源码。
description.en: A DSH plugin that renders mermaid code blocks in chat Markdown into interactive SVG diagrams, fully offline without modifying core source.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Web Push 通知：任务完成、停止、待审批或需回复时推送到浏览器与 PWA，可自定义通知内容。
description.en: Web Push notifications for DeepSeek Harness: get browser and PWA alerts when a task completes, stops, needs approval, or awaits your response, with configurable content.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供远程访问通道：内网主机主动拨出 SSH 反向隧道，经 Caddy 网关与口令校验，让你在手机或异地电脑安全使用本机 dsh web，无需开放入站端口。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that exposes your local dsh web to any device via a self-hosted relay: the host dials out an SSH reverse tunnel, Caddy terminates TLS behind a gateway password, and no inbound ports are opened.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 ctx.web 提供 Exa/Tavily/Jina 搜索与 Jina/Tavily 抓取的有序兜底链，前一后端失败自动切换。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives ctx.web ordered fallback chains for Exa/Tavily/Jina search and Jina/Tavily fetch, switching automatically when a backend fails.

description.zh: DSH plugin 用于确保或重启 DeepSeek Harness web 服务，通过 WMI 脱管启动，避免自杀式重启，加载即生效。
description.en: A DSH plugin to ensure or rotate the DeepSeek Harness web server via detached WMI launch, preventing self-kill restarts, active on load.

description.zh: DSH 手机/外网远程访问插件，基于 frp 内网穿透，支持局域网直连、token 鉴权、gzip 加速及六大机器人通道。
description.en: DSH plugin for remote access via frp tunneling, supporting LAN direct connection, token auth, gzip acceleration, and six bot channels.

description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供基于Brave Search API的Web搜索提供者，注册到ctx.web接口，使内置web_search工具开箱即用，支持限流与重试。
description.en: A Brave Search API-backed web search provider for DeepSeek Harness, registering a WebSearchProvider into ctx.web so the built-in web_search tool works out of the box.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的网页搜索能力接入 Kagi Search v1，注册 kagi 搜索提供方并支持 API Key、结果条数与安全搜索配置。
description.en: Adds a Kagi Search v1 provider to the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam, registering a kagi WebSearchProvider with configurable API key, result limit and safe search.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 LiteLLM /v1/search 的网页搜索插件，复用现有网关与虚拟密钥，一次搜索即一次 HTTP 请求，无需模型回合。
description.en: A LiteLLM /v1/search-backed web search provider for DeepSeek Harness, reusing your gateway and virtual key, with one search per HTTP request and no model turn.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供免账号免 API Key 的联网搜索，并可选在本地文件上建立全文索引检索。
description.en: A keyless web-search provider for the DeepSeek Harness, plus an optional fully local full-text index over your own files.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多后端网页搜索的 DSH 插件，聚合 Exa、Tavily、TinyFish 并自动故障转移与路由。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness multi-backend web search across Exa, Tavily and TinyFish, with automatic failover and routing.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按模型通道路由的网页搜索插件：官方通道走内置 web_search，第三方通道走自建 Parallel 兼容搜索服务，失败时给出可读原因。
description.en: A DSH plugin that routes web search by active model channel: official DeepSeek route uses built-in web_search, third-party routes use your own Parallel-compatible endpoint, with readable failure reasons.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 AnySearch 网页搜索后端，可在插件设置卡片中一键切换官方 DeepSeek 搜索与 AnySearch，保存后下一次 web_search 立即生效。
description.en: An AnySearch-backed web search provider for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that lets you switch the web_search backend between the official DeepSeek endpoint and AnySearch from a Plugins settings card, taking effect on the next call.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 ctx.web 接入 Tavily 搜索提供者，把内置 web_search 工具改走真实搜索引擎索引，搜索不再消耗模型 token。
description.en: A Tavily-backed WebSearchProvider for the DeepSeek Harness ctx.web seam, routing the built-in web_search tool to a real search index so searches cost no model tokens.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供零 key 联网搜索，无需 API key 或本地服务，聚合 Bing、HN、GitHub、arXiv 等七源并自动路由中英文查询。
description.en: Zero-key web search for DeepSeek Harness: no API key or local service needed, aggregating seven sources like Bing, HN, GitHub and arXiv with automatic Chinese/English routing.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Serper 搜索后端，注册 serper 提供方与 serper_search 工具，让 DSH 具备可配置的联网搜索能力。
description.en: Registers a Serper search backend into DeepSeek Harness's web seam, adding a `serper` provider and a `serper_search` tool for configurable web search.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入自建 SearXNG 作为 web_search 后端，提供设置页配置卡、一键连通性测试与社区实例自动测速选择，无需第三方搜索 API。
description.en: Plugs a self-hosted SearXNG instance into DeepSeek Harness as the web_search backend, with a settings card, one-click connectivity tests, and auto-probed community instance picking — no third-party search API required.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将内置 web_search 工具接入 Token Rhythm 网关的 OpenAI Responses API，复用现有密钥实现真实网络搜索，无需额外账号。
description.en: A DSH plugin that routes the built-in web_search tool through Token Rhythm's OpenAI Responses API, reusing existing keys for real web search without extra accounts.

description.zh: dsh-web-shell 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面添加右侧停靠的 Shell 终端，支持 bash/zsh 切换、宽度调节与折叠，让用户在对话的同时执行 shell 操作。
description.en: dsh-web-shell adds a dockable web shell to the right side of DeepSeek Harness's web UI, supporting bash/zsh switching, resizable width, and collapse, enabling shell operations alongside chat.

description.zh: DSH plugin 把网页 URL、批量链接或 sitemap 抓成带标题、正文、来源与抓取时间的干净 Markdown，单条失败不中断，离线可测。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns URLs, URL batches or sitemaps into clean Markdown with title, body, source and fetch time, continuing past failures and testable offline.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内置浏览器里点选网页元素写批注，一键把带截图的整批意见发进当前对话，无需改动站点代码。
description.en: Annotate web pages in DeepSeek Harness's built-in browser: click an element, leave a comment, and send the whole batch with screenshots into the current conversation without touching site code.

description.zh: WebAsk 是 DSH 插件，把一句话小问题转交 DeepSeek 网页版聊天，避免占用上下文；提供输入框按钮、全局热键面板与历史记录。
description.en: WebAsk is a DSH plugin that hands one-liner questions to DeepSeek's web chat instead of burning your context, with a composer button, global hotkey palette and local history.

description.zh: dsh-webdav-sync 是 DSH plugin，用 WebDAV 在多台电脑间加密同步 profile 的模型、默认模型、插件清单与其余配置，按份三方合并、新者胜出。
description.en: A DSH plugin that syncs your DSH profile across machines over WebDAV, encrypting models, defaults, plugin list and other config before upload and merging each part three-way.

description.zh: 为 DSH WebUI 提供持久化登录认证的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，未认证浏览器无法加载资源、调用接口或建立实时连接，并修复反代 Host 改写下的登录跳转。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin adding persistent WebUI authentication so unauthenticated browsers cannot load assets, call APIs, or open live connections, plus a redirect fix for proxy Host rewriting.

description.zh: dsh-webview-wrapper 是 DeepSeek Harness 的原生桌面封装插件，通过 WebviewJS 将 Web 界面嵌入系统窗口，支持系统托盘与关闭到托盘，贯彻一切皆插件理念。
description.en: dsh-webview-wrapper is a native desktop shell plugin for DeepSeek Harness, hosting the Web surface in an OS-native window via WebviewJS, with system tray and close-to-tray support, in the everything-is-a-plugin spirit.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供微信双向通道的 DSH plugin：在微信单聊中发指令驱动已有会话，并把文字、图片、音视频与文件回传微信。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a bidirectional WeChat channel to DeepSeek Harness: send commands from WeChat chats to drive an existing session, and receive text, images, audio, video and files back.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将 Markdown 一键排版为微信公众号草稿，自动内联样式并上传图片，支持一键发布到草稿箱。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns Markdown into a typeset WeChat Official Account draft, inlining styles and uploading images, with one-click publish to the draft box.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框加上微信式区域截图按钮，框选后直接作为图片附件进入草稿并复制到剪贴板。
