description.en: Adds a WeChat-style region screenshot button to the DeepSeek Harness composer, dropping the selection straight into the draft as an image attachment and copying it to the clipboard.

description.zh: 基于腾讯 iLink Bot API 的微信个人号通道插件，让 DSH 收发微信私聊消息，支持扫码登录、双向文本与图片文件语音视频，并按联系人独立路由会话。
description.en: A personal WeChat channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) built on Tencent's iLink Bot API, letting agents receive and reply to WeChat direct messages with QR login, two-way text and media, and per-peer session routing.

description.zh: 深鲸周报是一款 DSH plugin，可从 git 提交记录自动生成按天分组的周报 Markdown 骨架，并在侧栏面板中只读查看，不修改仓库。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns git commit history into a day-grouped weekly report Markdown skeleton, viewable in a read-only sidebar panel without touching the repo.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 wechat_emoji_analyze 工具，调用 GLM-4V-Flash 看懂微信表情包、梗图与聊天截图，输出情绪与回复建议。
description.en: A DSH plugin that registers the wechat_emoji_analyze tool, using GLM-4V-Flash to read WeChat stickers, memes and chat screenshots and return sentiment plus reply hints.

description.zh: 在 DSH 的 Web 界面里预览、开发并调试微信小游戏，通过日志与截图定位崩溃白屏，还能真机预览与上传版本。
description.en: Preview, develop and debug WeChat Mini Games inside the DSH Web GUI, using logs and screenshots to fix crashes and blank screens, with real-device preview and version publishing.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 账户余额显示成鲸鱼标志里上涨的水面，DSH plugin 提供水位、消耗统计、低余额提醒与充值入口。
description.en: A DSH plugin that renders your DeepSeek account balance as water rising inside the whale mark, with spend stats, low-balance alerts and a top-up link.

description.zh: DSH plugin 提供多会话群聊房间与一夜狼人杀庄家：发牌、夜序、换卡、计票、结算全由确定性代码掌控，支持纯 AI 或真人混局。
description.en: A DSH plugin bundling multi-session group chat rooms with a One Night Werewolf dealer that deterministically handles dealing, night order, card swaps, voting and scoring for all-AI or human-mixed games.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面添加鲸鱼粒子动态背景，支持鼠标光照、主题与 30 FPS 渲染，让界面更灵动。
description.en: Adds a particle whale background to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with cursor lighting, theme support, and 30 FPS rendering.

description.zh: 鲸聊是 DSH 的透明鲸鱼桌宠插件，住在 Web 界面右下角，能聊天、可配置人设，还会自己随机上网带回见闻说给你听。
description.en: A talking whale desktop pet DSH plugin that lives in the corner of the web UI: chat with it, set its persona, and let it wander the web on its own to bring back stories.

description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness Web 装一枚左下角「抓token」按钮，点开即玩两分钟一局的捞鲸鱼小游戏，分数存本机。
description.en: Adds a "catch tokens" button to the bottom-left of DeepSeek Harness Web that opens a two-minute whale-catching mini-game, with scores saved locally.

description.zh: DSH 插件：在鲸鱼娘旁显示毛玻璃余额、今日消费、缓存命中与峰谷状态卡，并发射深蓝扣费弹幕。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shows a frosted-glass card beside the whale girl with balance, today's spend, cache hit rate and peak/off-peak status, plus deep-blue charge barrage.

description.zh: 鲸鱼女孩是 DeepSeek Harness 的桌宠插件，住在 Web GUI 右下角，用游泳、敲玻璃、庆祝等动画实时反映 Agent 状态，还能互动养成。
description.en: Whale Girl is a DeepSeek Harness desktop-pet plugin living in the Web GUI corner, animating the agent's state with swimming, glass-tapping and celebrations, plus interactive bonding.

description.zh: 大肥鱼游戏厅是一款 DSH plugin，在侧栏一键起停本地游戏厅，让你和 DSH 里的 Agent 同桌玩六款小游戏，规则由服务端裁决。
description.en: Whale Arcade is a DSH plugin that launches a local game arcade from the sidebar, letting you play six mini-games against the Agent in your DeepSeek Harness while the server referees.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 挂上一只透明置顶的鲸娘桌宠，实时用表情、动作与气泡反映 DSH 的空闲、忙碌、审批、出错等运行状态。
description.en: A transparent always-on-top whale-girl desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness that mirrors DSH runtime states — idle, busy, approval, error — through expressions, animations and bubbles.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面添加点阵互动背景的插件，粒子可拼成鲸鱼或你上传的透明 PNG 照片，支持鼠标扰动与自动屏保模式。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds an interactive particle-dot background to the DSH Web UI, forming a whale or your uploaded transparent PNG, with mouse disturbance and auto screensaver modes.

description.zh: 把 DSH 思考状态行左侧的小鲸鱼尾巴换成四段轮换动画，为 DeepSeek Harness 的等待过程增添细节趣味。
description.en: Replaces the whale-tail icon in the DSH thinking status line with four rotating animations, adding a playful touch to DeepSeek Harness waiting states.

description.zh: Whale Waker 是一款 DSH plugin，为工作区里的每个目标按各自间隔、静默时段与每日上限定时唤醒，复用同一会话汇总变化并发送简短提示。
description.en: Whale Waker is a DSH plugin that schedules per-target wake-ups in a workspace, each with its own interval, quiet hours and daily cap, reusing one session to gather changes and send a short prompt.

description.zh: DSH 界面右下角的常驻小鲸鱼挂件，实时显示 DeepSeek 余额、今日已用与每轮消耗，泡泡内容可自定义，并支持空闲自动说话。
description.en: A persistent whale widget for the DSH web UI that shows DeepSeek balance, today's spend and per-turn cost, with fully customizable bubbles and idle auto-say.

description.zh: 为 DSH 的 bash 沙箱提供按命令生效的白名单，让 lark-cli、gh 等需写用户目录的命令在沙箱内自动放行，免去 danger-full-access 授权弹窗。
description.en: A per-command allow-list for the DSH bash sandbox that lets CLIs like lark-cli and gh write to home directories inside the sandbox, avoiding danger-full-access approval prompts.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 RDAP 的 whois 工具，模型可调用它查询域名注册数据，无需传统 WHOIS 解析。
description.en: Adds an RDAP-backed whois tool to DeepSeek Harness, letting the model query domain registration data without legacy WHOIS parsing.

description.zh: dsh-wiki 是 DeepSeek Harness 的个人知识库插件，基于 Obsidian 与 git 版本化，让 LLM 编译维护、人类选材审核，实现零数据库的单一事实源。
description.en: dsh-wiki is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for personal knowledge base, leveraging Obsidian and git versioning, where LLM compiles and maintains while humans curate, achieving a single source of truth without a database.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补齐 Windows 正确性判断：编码检测与转换、路径合法性、netstat 解析及有边界的只读磁盘检查，全部只读不写。
description.en: A Windows correctness layer for DeepSeek Harness: encoding detection and conversion, path legality checks, netstat parsing, and bounded read-only disk inspection — never writing to disk.

description.zh: dsh-win-toast 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 原生通知插件，在需要确认、提问或回合结束时由宿主进程直接弹出系统 Toast，标签页切走也不错过。
description.en: A DSH plugin that fires native Windows toast notifications from the host process when DeepSeek Harness needs your approval, asks a question, or finishes a turn—even when the tab is in the background.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 原生 Toast 通知，回答完成、出错、审批与提问时提醒，并可在通知里直接审批或作答。
description.en: Native Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness: get alerted on turn completion, errors, approvals and agent questions, and approve or answer right from the notification.

description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Windows 跨会话提醒：会话完成、待回答、待审批或出错时弹出可点击 Toast、分档提示音与任务栏角标，且只在你没看该会话时提醒。
description.en: A DSH plugin that fires clickable Windows toasts, tiered sounds and a taskbar badge when a session finishes, asks a question, needs approval or errors — only for sessions you are not watching.

description.zh: DSH 工作助理插件自带微信机器人通道，把转发消息记成工作项，自动排优先级、定时提醒、派副手干活，并维护知识库与人员关系图谱。
description.en: A DSH plugin with a built-in WeChat bot channel that turns forwarded messages into tracked work items, auto-ranks priorities, sends scheduled reminders, dispatches subagent helpers, and maintains a knowledge base with a people graph.

description.zh: dsh-wonder-tools 是 DeepSeek Harness 的装配包，一个 DSH plugin 卡片集成删除对话、重新生成、队友命令、跨会话提醒与首轮自动命名五项功能，每行独立开关。
description.en: dsh-wonder-tools is an assembly bundle for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): one plugin card bundles five features — delete conversation, rewind, teammate commands, cross-session alerts and auto-title — each with its own toggle.

description.zh: 为 DSH 网页模式加一个居中木鱼小插件，点击敲击即可功德 +1，并伴随敲击音与「南无阿弥陀佛」语音。
description.en: A DSH plugin for web mode that overlays a centered wooden fish: click to strike it, gain merit +1, and hear a knock plus a spoken blessing.

description.zh: dsh-workflow-designer 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的提示词优先工作流设计 DSH plugin，可视化编排 Skill、Tool 与 MCP Tool，导出稳定 YAML 供代码生成。
description.en: dsh-workflow-designer is a prompt-first workflow design DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness, visually orchestrating Skills, Tools and MCP Tools and exporting stable YAML for code generation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 统一挂载和管理 Office、Blender、Unity、Figma、GitHub、ComfyUI 等工作软件的 MCP 服务器，在设置页按需启用即可让 DSH 直接操控这些工具。
description.en: A DSH plugin that mounts and manages MCP servers for work software such as Office, Blender, Unity, Figma, GitHub and ComfyUI, letting DeepSeek Harness drive them once enabled from the settings page.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 /create-workflow 与 /workflows 斜杠命令，支持保存 JavaScript 工作流、后台监督运行与结果检查，如同 Grok 的构建 CLI。
description.en: Adds /create-workflow and /workflows slash commands to DeepSeek Harness for saved JavaScript workflows, supervised background runs, and retained inspection, like Grok's build CLI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供工作区管理面板，可重命名、删除、重建、合并工作区，并在工作区之间移动单个会话，且不丢失历史。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a workspace management panel to DeepSeek Harness for renaming, deleting, rebuilding, merging workspaces and moving single sessions between them without losing history.

description.zh: 一款 DSH 插件，按日期与工作区统计你的活跃时长与 Token 消耗，提供日历热力图、时刻分析与工作区占比，并可导出可分享的自包含 HTML 报告。
description.en: A DSH plugin that tracks your active time and token spend by date and workspace, with a calendar heatmap, time-of-day analysis, workspace share, and a shareable self-contained HTML report.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在添加工作区时直接唤起原生 Windows Explorer 文件夹选择器，替代应用内目录浏览器，提升桌面端选择文件夹的体验。
description.en: A DSH plugin that opens the native Windows Explorer folder picker when adding a workspace, replacing the in-app directory browser for a smoother desktop experience.

description.zh: 为 DSH plugin 的工作区文件预览添加 Download 链接，通过认证路由把已注册工作区内的文件安全下载到本地。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a Download link to workspace file previews, streaming files from registered workspaces to your machine through an authenticated route.

description.zh: DSH web 插件，在侧边栏添加 Workspace 按钮，输入目录路径即可快速创建或切换工作区，提升开发效率。
description.en: A DSH web plugin that adds a Workspace button to the sidebar, allowing quick workspace creation or switching via directory path.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供审批式工作区记忆：把可复用规则写入 AGENTS.md、稳定事实写入 .dsh-memory.md，改动以 diff 呈现并经确认后落盘。
description.en: An approval-gated workspace memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: reusable rules go to AGENTS.md, stable facts to .dsh-memory.md, with every update shown as a diff before it is written.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供审批式工作区记忆：把可复用规则写入 AGENTS.md、稳定事实写入 .dsh-memory.md，改动以 diff 呈现并经确认后落盘。
description.en: An approval-gated workspace memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: reusable rules go to AGENTS.md, stable facts to .dsh-memory.md, with every update shown as a diff before it is written.

description.zh: 一个 DSH 侧边栏增强插件：当你提交任务时，自动把当前工作区置顶，任务执行期间不再重排，让正在做的项目始终浮在最上面。
description.en: A DSH sidebar plugin that promotes the workspace you just submitted a task in to the top, once per submission, and never reorders while the task is running.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的每个工作区绑定一条自定义系统提示词，新建会话时固化进系统提示词，并可在会话头部弹窗或 Agent 工具中随时管理。
description.en: Attach one custom system prompt per workspace in DeepSeek Harness: it is captured into a session's system prompt at creation time and can be managed from a session-header dialog or agent tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供工作区网格：声明各工作区所在主机，跨已配对 DSH 实例按工作区分发任务并回收结果，执行始终留在本地。
description.en: A workspace mesh for DeepSeek Harness: declare which workspace lives on which host, dispatch tasks across paired DSH instances by workspace, and collect results while execution stays local.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏提供独立的工作区排序，可在 View options 中按最近使用排列工作区文件夹，并附带运行中工作区发光提示与折叠工作区名称快速打开。
description.en: Adds independent workspace-folder ordering to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar via a Workspace order section in View options, plus a running-workspace glow and collapsed-workspace name quick-open.

description.zh: 让 DSH 的 Web 侧边栏按工作区共享，同一工作区内的所有对话共用一份标签与布局，切换对话时侧栏不再跟着变。
description.en: A DSH plugin that shares the Web sidebar per workspace, so all conversations in one workspace keep the same tabs and layout instead of resetting on each switch.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏增加会话总览面板，运行中会话与全部对话按工作区分组展示，支持置顶、重命名、分叉、归档与拖动排序。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a sidebar workspace overview panel to DeepSeek Harness, listing running sessions or all conversations with pin, rename, fork, archive and drag-to-reorder.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 侧边栏工作区树添加状态点，把子会话的等待、完成、运行状态向上聚合到父文件夹，折叠时也能一眼看到哪里需要你。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds aggregated session status dots to workspace-tree folder rows in DSH Web's sidebar, rolling waiting, finished and running states up to parent folders.

description.zh: 这款 DSH plugin 让你从侧边栏隐藏指定工作区及其会话，并通过视图选项开关随时恢复显示，仅改显示、不动任何数据。
description.en: A DSH plugin that hides chosen workspaces and their sessions from the sidebar, with a View options switch to reveal them again — display-only, no data touched.

description.zh: DSH plugin 在会话头部添加分支与 worktree 切换芯片，支持创建 worktree 并作为工作区打开，提升 Git 开发效率。
description.en: A DSH plugin adding a session-header chip to switch branches and worktrees, create worktrees, and open them as harness workspaces.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 git worktree 守卫：以会话根实现写隔离，常开安全网拦截误毁 git 操作，并用带 TTL 的人闸管控主干授权。
description.en: A git worktree guard for DeepSeek Harness: session-rooted write isolation, an always-on safety net against destructive git operations, and a TTL-based human gate for main-branch authorization.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 WPS 金山文档云盘，可在对话中列出、搜索、读写文档表格演示与 PDF，并注册官方 SkillHub MCP 的 558 个工具。
description.en: Connects WPS Cloud Docs to DeepSeek Harness, letting you list, search, read and write documents, sheets, slides and PDFs in chat via the official SkillHub MCP's 558 tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 WPS 365 云文档读写能力的 DSH plugin，可让 agent 直接读取、编辑智能文档与表格，并处理分享链接。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects DeepSeek Harness to WPS 365 cloud docs, letting the agent read and edit smart documents and spreadsheets, including shared links.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏补上工作区按最近活跃排序、过期历史自动折叠、三色状态标记、全局置顶区与可恢复回收站，让会话管理更顺手。
description.en: A DSH plugin that upgrades the DeepSeek Harness sidebar with recency-sorted workspaces, auto-folded stale history, tri-color status dots, a global pinned section, and a recoverable session trash.

description.zh: 这款 DSH plugin 让 Windows 用户从「添加工作区」按钮把 WSL 发行版中的 Linux 目录注册为工作区，侧栏终端直接开在发行版内对应路径。
description.en: A DSH plugin that lets Windows users add WSL distribution folders as workspaces via the Add workspace button, with sidebar terminals opening inside the distro at that path.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 WSL：在设置页管理发行版与配置，并提供 wslx-* 工具在 Linux 发行版内执行命令。
description.en: Brings WSL into DeepSeek Harness with a Settings console for distros and config plus wslx-* tools that run native Linux commands inside a distribution.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 xAI（Grok/X 订阅）原生 OAuth 登录，走设备码授权免 API key，自动刷新令牌并注入 xai 路由。
description.en: Native xAI (Grok/X subscription) OAuth login for DeepSeek Harness: device-code auth with no API key, auto token refresh injected into the xai route.

description.zh: 把 30 个生产级 AI Agent 技能打包成标准 DSH plugin，安装后由会话技能目录自动加载并按需触发，覆盖 token 压缩、极简工程与内容审核。
description.en: Packages 30 production-grade AI agent skills as a standard DSH plugin, auto-loaded by the session skill catalog and triggered on demand — covering token compression, minimalism, and content review.

description.zh: DSH plugin 帮你整目录批量处理 Excel：多文件多 sheet 合并、删空行去重 trim、列级汇总统计、逐 sheet 导出 CSV，只读原表不覆盖。
description.en: A DSH plugin that batch-processes whole Excel directories: merge multi-file multi-sheet workbooks, remove blank and duplicate rows with trimming, summarize columns, and export each sheet to CSV — read-only, never overwriting originals.

description.zh: DSH 交接插件：用 /handoff 把快满的会话整理成结构化交接卡，并自动新建、命名、置顶新会话，上下文接近阈值时还能自动备好下一棒。
description.en: A DSH handoff plugin: /handoff turns a nearly full session into a structured handoff card, then auto-creates, names and pins a fresh session, and can pre-prepare the next one when context nears the threshold.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 变成 Yeelight 智能家居管家：通过官方本地运行时控制灯光、查询状态、执行场景与自动化，并做全屋灯光设计，无需 API Key。
description.en: Turns DeepSeek Harness into a Yeelight smart-home agent: control lights, query state, run scenes and automations, and design whole-home lighting through the official local runtime — no API keys needed.

description.zh: DSH plugin 每天替你刷一轮 YouTube：按频道与关键词取候选，逐条读字幕判断，产出繁体中文日报，可峰谷时段自动运行。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that scrolls YouTube for you daily: pulls candidates from channel RSS and keyword search, judges each by its transcript, and writes a Traditional Chinese daily report on an off-peak schedule.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供项目级长效记忆：注册 save_project_memory 工具并把记忆索引注入 system prompt，让模型在新会话自动读回同一项目的经验教训。
description.en: Project-scoped long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: registers a save_project_memory tool and injects the memory index into the system prompt, so lessons learned in one session are read back automatically in later sessions of the same project.

description.zh: DSH plugin将语雀文档知识库化，对话时自动检索注入相关片段，支持树形目录管理、在线全文搜索与只读安全合规。
description.en: DSH plugin turns Yuque docs into external memory, auto-retrieving and injecting relevant snippets during conversation, with tree directory management and online full-text search.

description.zh: DSH 禅道工作台插件：在左侧栏查看指派给我的任务、Bug 与需求，一键转为对话上下文并自动附带截图附件。
description.en: A ZenTao workbench DSH plugin that lists your assigned tasks, bugs and stories in the sidebar and turns any card into a conversation context with real screenshot attachments.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面新增繁體中文语言包，注册 zh-Hant 语言与 62 个命名空间、2699 条词条，可在设置中一键切换。
description.en: A Traditional Chinese language pack for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI that registers a zh-Hant locale plus 2,699 dictionary entries across 62 namespaces, switchable in Settings.

description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 中的模型在 reasoning 通道用中文思考，通过四段提示注入贴近生成点，并支持开关设置。
description.en: Makes models in DeepSeek Harness think in Chinese on the reasoning channel via four prompt injections placed near the generation point, with a toggle setting.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入智谱 BigModel GLM 模型路由的 DSH plugin，可切换 Coding Plan 与普通 API 双端点，支持模型实时发现、思考等级映射与本地用量统计。
description.en: A DSH plugin that registers Zhipu BigModel GLM as a model-provider route in DeepSeek Harness, with dual-endpoint switching, live model discovery, verified thinking-level mapping and local usage stats.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供《周礼》全文检索工具与「周礼模式」agent 预设，引文皆带篇序坐标可覆按原文。
description.en: A DSH plugin offering full-text search over the Rites of Zhou plus a "Zhouli mode" agent preset, with every citation carrying verifiable chapter coordinates.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 一次装上 46 个纯本地确定性工具，覆盖 JSON/YAML/CSV 校验、编码转换与 JVM、Python、Windows 日志诊断，输出结构化结果。
description.en: Installs 46 fully local deterministic tools into DeepSeek Harness at once, covering JSON/YAML/CSV validation, encoding conversion, and JVM, Python and Windows log diagnostics with structured output.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入知识星球：通过 Cookie 登录把星球列表、主题、搜索与发布评论等能力暴露为 agent 工具，并附扫码登录与 Web 设置面板。
description.en: Brings Knowledge Planet (zsxq) into DeepSeek Harness: a DSH plugin that exposes group lists, topics, search, publishing and commenting as agent tools, with QR-code login and a web settings panel.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话内搜索、列出并获取 1100+ 社区插件的安装命令，无需离开当前会话。
description.en: Search, list, and get install commands for 1,100+ community plugins from inside DeepSeek Harness without leaving your session.

description.zh: dsh2vs 是一个 DSH plugin，通过 MCP 桥让 AI 助手无人值守地加载、编译并断点调试 Visual Studio 的 C++ 工程，无需 VSIX 或打开 VS。
description.en: dsh2vs is a DSH plugin that bridges AI agents to Visual Studio C++ projects over MCP, letting them load, build and breakpoint-debug unattended without a VSIX or a running VS.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话接入工作区语义检索：注册 zg_search / zg_index / zg_status 三个工具，底层调 zg CLI 做 BM25 与向量混合检索，并加 search-first 门禁。
description.en: Adds workspace semantic search to DeepSeek Harness sessions: registers the zg_search / zg_index / zg_status tools backed by the zg CLI's hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval, plus a search-first gate.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏展示精选插件库，12 个插件、八种语言，安装命令一键复制，数据实时来自 dshwiki.com。
description.en: A sidebar panel for DeepSeek Harness listing 12 curated plugins in eight languages with copyable install commands, data fetched live from dshwiki.com.

description.zh: dshX 品牌终端 TUI，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供简洁启动页与工作状态行，支持会话、技能、MCP 等完整功能。
description.en: dshX-branded terminal TUI for DeepSeek Harness, featuring a clean startup page and work status line, with full session, skill, MCP support.

description.zh: DuckFleet 是一个 DSH 插件，装在主控机上即可把多台机器接入同一鸭群，自动为每台机器注册派活工具，让你用自然语言指挥某台、某几台或全部机器并发干活。
description.en: DuckFleet is a DSH plugin installed on one controller machine that herds multiple computers into a single fleet, auto-registering a dispatch tool per host so you can task one, several, or all machines in natural language.

description.zh: DSH 企业合规插件，提供 SOC2/GDPR 自动化自检、敏感信息脱敏、操作审计、文件扫描与数据主体权利管理，并支持阈值报警与策略配置。
description.en: DSH plugin for enterprise compliance: automated SOC2/GDPR self-checks, sensitive data redaction, audit trail, file scanning, and GDPR data subject rights with alerting.

description.zh: 繁界（FanFrame）是一款 DeepSeek Harness 界面精修插件，提供直角外观、聊天富文本层次、克制动效、侧栏布局与插件列表工具。
description.en: FanFrame is a DeepSeek Harness interface-refinement plugin offering sharp corners, readable chat styling, restrained motion, sidebar layout tweaks and plugin-list tools.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久可审计的进化记忆：自动召回历史成功策略、按证据分级评估每轮结果，并让经验在本地会话与 EvoMap 网络间共享。
description.en: Persistent, auditable evolution memory for DeepSeek Harness: it recalls proven strategies, grades each turn on evidence, and shares what it learns across local sessions and the EvoMap network.

description.zh: 为大肥鱼世界人机共生网络社区提供 DSH plugin 组合包，挂载本地 stdio MCP 桥接与可移植技能，让 Agent 直接调用社区工具。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle that mounts a local stdio MCP bridge and portable skill for the Fatfish World human-AI community, letting agents call its tools directly.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏带来思维导图与 Excalidraw 自由画布，支持本地文件预览、独立编辑器与 CLI。
description.en: Adds mind maps and an Excalidraw canvas to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, with local-file previews, standalone editors and CLIs.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面添加背景图片的 DSH plugin：图片由主机保存，提供原图、清晰、平衡、柔和四档效果，并自动适配浅色与深色主题。
description.en: A DSH plugin that paints a background image behind the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, stored on the host with four display effects that adapt to light and dark themes.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中用自然语言驱动 Gaussian 16 计算：从 SMILES 建模生成输入、串行提交任务、解析能量与轨道，并调用 Multiwfn/VMD 出图。
description.en: A DSH plugin that drives Gaussian 16 from natural language: builds inputs from SMILES, submits serial jobs, parses energies and orbitals, and renders figures via Multiwfn/VMD.

description.zh: Galatea-Link 的 DSH plugin，让 dsh 主智能体通过原生工具参加 YGOPro 对局并在游戏内聊天，复用当前模型与对话上下文。
description.en: A DSH plugin for Galatea-Link that lets the DeepSeek Harness main agent join YGOPro duels and chat in-game via native tools, reusing the current model and conversation context.

description.zh: DSH 动态 Cordis 插件，在左侧工作区提供文件浏览面板，支持目录导航、文本预览、一键打开系统资源管理器，并将文件引用添加到聊天。
description.en: A dynamic Cordis plugin for DSH that adds a workspace file explorer in the left sidebar, with directory navigation, text preview, open-in-system-explorer, and file reference injection into chat.

description.zh: 把本地 getnote CLI 封装成 15 个 DSH plugin 工具，让 Agent 直接搜索、保存、整理笔记与知识库。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that wraps the local getnote CLI into 15 tools for searching, saving, and organizing notes, tags, and knowledge bases.

description.zh: 格物审视面是 DSH plugin，让无视觉模型通过视觉子代理完成 HTML 截图、简报契约与源码真值核验的视觉检验流水线。
description.en: Gewu is a DSH plugin enabling vision-less models to perform visual inspection via vision subagents, with HTML screenshots, briefing contracts, and source-code truth verification.

description.zh: 把文字或图片形式的 2D 数学题交给 DSH plugin 解析，自动生成并校验 GeoGebra 交互文件，附验证报告与截图。
description.en: A DSH plugin that turns a 2D math problem from text or an image into a verified interactive GeoGebra file, with a report and screenshot.

description.zh: Ghost Refresh（鬼影提神）为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面注入一只定时飘过的幽灵，提神醒脑防摸鱼，支持速度、透明度、大小与频率调节。
description.en: Ghost Refresh adds a friendly ghost that drifts across your DeepSeek Harness web UI at intervals, with adjustable speed, opacity, size, and frequency.

description.zh: Harness Alchemist 是 DSH plugin 脚手架，一键生成可原生安装到 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Antigravity 与 DeepSeek Harness 的 TypeScript 插件仓库，技能脚本跨框架复用。
description.en: Harness Alchemist is a DSH plugin scaffold that generates a TypeScript plugin repository installable natively into Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Antigravity, and DeepSeek Harness, with portable skill scripts.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 git_exec 工具，让 AI 在文件沙箱之外执行 git 命令，并由用户勾选允许的子命令清单来划定安全边界。
description.en: A DSH plugin that gives the model a git_exec tool for running git outside the file sandbox, bounded by a user-curated allowlist of permitted subcommands.

description.zh: HireSeeker CLI 是一个 DSH plugin，让 AI Agent 与终端直接检索 Telegram 频道和公司招聘站点的职位，支持按职业、地区、工作形式与薪资筛选，并返回结构化 JSON 与职位链接。
description.en: HireSeeker CLI is a DSH plugin that lets AI agents and terminals search job listings aggregated from Telegram channels and company career sites, filtering by profession, location, work format and salary, and returning structured JSON with vacancy links.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供由 HydraDB 驱动的持久跨会话记忆，每轮对话前自动召回相关上下文，并把工作区文档与对话同步入库。
description.en: Persistent cross-session memory for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH), powered by HydraDB: it auto-recalls relevant context before each turn and syncs workspace docs and conversations into HydraDB.

description.zh: DSH plugin 行为艺术插件：本地采集系统信号判定机主身份，非中文环境则终止所有工作流，安装即知情同意。
description.en: A DSH plugin performance-art piece: it inspects local system signals to judge the owner's identity, terminating all workflows on a non-Chinese verdict; installing means informed consent.

description.zh: 墨池为 DeepSeek Harness 会话界面铺上可交互的汉字水墨背景，含莲池、山水等主题，鼠标划过起涟漪、点击落墨，并支持明暗跟随与性能自动降级。
description.en: Inkpond adds an interactive Chinese ink-wash backdrop to the DeepSeek Harness chat UI, with lotus pond and landscape themes, ripple-on-hover, ink-on-click, theme following and automatic performance fallback.

description.zh: DSH插件，将智谱GLM视觉模型接入DeepSeek Harness，提供analyze_image工具，实现图像理解与分析。
description.en: A DSH plugin that integrates Zhipu GLM vision models into DeepSeek Harness, providing an analyze_image tool for image understanding.

description.zh: jolly-dsh-vision 是 DeepSeek Harness 的视觉桥接插件，让纯文本模型借助视觉模型看懂图片，提供 vision 工具与 (ds vision) 孪生模型，支持直接贴图。
description.en: jolly-dsh-vision is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that bridges vision to text-only models, offering a vision tool and a (ds vision) twin model for direct image pasting.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供中文语音合成与短音频识别，把回复中的 TTS 标记块替换为浏览器原生播放器，并支持本地转写用户语音。
description.en: A DSH plugin for Chinese speech synthesis and short-audio recognition: it turns tagged reply blocks into browser-native audio players and transcribes local user voice turns.

description.zh: DSH 插件，只读扫描项目目录，自动构建模块级与文件级知识图谱，助你快速理解项目架构与设计思路。
description.en: A DSH plugin that read-only scans project directories to build module-level and file-level knowledge graphs, helping you quickly understand project architecture and design.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 KnyazevAI API 的 DSH 插件，注册 knyazev-ai 路由与默认模型，支持多款大模型与推理强度配置。
description.en: A DSH plugin that brings the KnyazevAI API into DeepSeek Harness, registering the knyazev-ai route, a default model, and reasoning-effort settings for several LLMs.

description.zh: DSH plugin 让局域网内各 DeepSeek Harness 实例以账号身份互相发现、可靠互发消息，支持私聊送达确认、离线补发、频道与共享文件。
description.en: A DSH plugin enabling DeepSeek Harness instances on LAN to discover each other and chat reliably with account identity, featuring ack, offline delivery, channels, and shared files.

description.zh: DSH 个人工作台插件，把工作、生活与每日事项收进一个玻璃拟态面板，含总览统计、多列看板、资料库与跨天自动归档，一页完成日常交互。
description.en: A personal workbench plugin for DeepSeek Harness that gathers work, life and daily tasks into one glassmorphism panel with overview stats, multi-column boards, a file library and cross-day auto archiving.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中的 Agent 装上「眼睛」：latex_look 工具一次调用即可编译 LaTeX、渲染页面图像、把页面位置映射回源码行并对比上次改动，让排版问题无处可藏。
description.en: Gives a DeepSeek Harness agent eyes for LaTeX: the latex_look tool compiles, renders the page to an image, maps any spot back to its source line, and diffs the last edit — all in one call.

description.zh: 法律之星法规数据 MCP 的 DSH plugin，一键粘贴 API Key 即可在 DeepSeek Harness 中检索法条、调取原文、识别引用并校验幻觉。
description.en: A DSH plugin for LawStar legal-data MCP: paste your API Key to enable semantic search, clause retrieval, citation recognition, and hallucination check in DeepSeek Harness.

description.zh: 这款 DSH plugin 会向系统提示注入「能答就答」的指令，并按工具调用次数逐级提醒，促使 Agent 尽快给出最终答案。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that injects answer-early instructions and escalating reminders as tool calls pile up, pushing the agent to deliver its final answer sooner.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供离线 OCR 工具，调用 macOS Vision 框架读取图片与 PDF 文字及坐标。
description.en: An offline OCR tool for DeepSeek Harness that uses the macOS Vision framework to extract text and line coordinates from images and PDFs.

description.zh: mc-hud 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Minecraft 风格消耗 HUD，以红心显示解码速度、鸡腿显示余额，并支持明暗主题自适应。
description.en: mc-hud adds a Minecraft-style consumption HUD to DeepSeek Harness, showing decode speed as hearts and balance as drumsticks, with light/dark theme adaptation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Meshy 3D 生成与 3D 打印技能，让 DSH 代理通过 meshy-cli 完成文生 3D、贴图、绑定动画与打印文件导出。
description.en: Meshy 3D generation and 3D printing skills for DeepSeek Harness, letting the DSH agent drive meshy-cli for text-to-3D, textures, rigging, animation and print-ready exports.

description.zh: 这是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的周报生成插件，一句「帮我生成本周周报」即可把零散素材整理成固定四模块的 Markdown 周报，内置流水线装上即用。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that turns scattered work materials into a fixed four-section Markdown weekly report from a single prompt, powered by a built-in pipeline.

description.zh: Ming Capability Pack 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用自然语言一键调用原生子代理执行任务，产出真实文件与证据卡，不重复造轮子。
description.en: Ming Capability Pack is a DSH plugin that turns natural language into real execution via native subagents, producing actual files and evidence cards without reinventing the wheel.

description.zh: modelspoke 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，自动发现本地 OpenAI 兼容模型服务器与模型能力，分层解析推理元数据，替代手写 provider 配置。
description.en: modelspoke is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that discovers local OpenAI-compatible model servers and their capabilities, resolving reasoning metadata in tiers instead of hand-written provider blocks.

description.zh: Moqi 是 DeepSeek Harness 的终端 TUI 应用，以 bundle 形式挂载 dsh-base，提供交错式对话记录、模型选择、并发会话与后台代理，键盘优先操作。
description.en: Moqi is a terminal TUI app for DeepSeek Harness, mounted as a bundle over dsh-base with interleaved transcripts, a model picker, concurrent sessions and background agents, all keyboard-first.

description.zh: 为 moqi 提供 /JevLoop 控制面板的 DSH 插件，把 dsh-jev-loop 服务渲染成可切换的开关行与 API Key 掩码输入，状态实时生效并持久化。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds the /JevLoop control panel to moqi, turning the dsh-jev-loop service into toggleable gate rows and a masked API key prompt with live, persisted state.

description.zh: 连接小沐（MuChe 数字生命）的 DSH plugin：在左下角浮层与有持续状态的小沐聊天，并通过反向桥接让小沐调用本机 dsh 执行任务。
description.en: A DSH plugin that connects to MuChe, a persistent digital life: chat with it in a floating panel and let it run tasks on your local dsh via a reverse bridge.

description.zh: mypet 是 DeepSeek Harness 的电子宠物插件，为你的 AI 编程搭档带来会眨眼摇尾的桌面宠物，支持养成、抽皮肤、每日任务与接球小游戏。
description.en: mypet is a DSH plugin that adds a Tamagotchi-style desktop pet to DeepSeek Harness, with living animations, pet care, gacha skins, daily quests, and a fetch mini-game.

description.zh: Notix 是 DeepSeek Harness 的桌面通知插件，在 Agent 需要审批、提问、运行过久、出错或完成时，通过 macOS 与 Windows 系统通知提醒你，纯观察不阻塞。
description.en: Notix is a DSH plugin that delivers native macOS and Windows desktop notifications when the agent needs approval, asks a question, runs too long, fails, or finishes — a pure observer that never blocks the agent loop.

description.zh: 拾光是一款 DSH plugin，把指定笔记文件夹中的关键小节在会话开场注入一次，让记忆全程在场，装完即用、无需再检索。
description.en: Ofttold-memory is a DSH plugin that injects key sections from a chosen notes folder once at session start, keeping your memory present throughout with zero retrieval overhead.

description.zh: OpenHarness Reader 是 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区文件浏览/编辑器插件，提供 VSCode 式标签页、Markdown 预览与冲突保护，让 Web 端直接读写会话工作区文件。
description.en: OpenHarness Reader is a DSH plugin for workspace file browsing/editing, featuring VSCode-style tabs, Markdown preview, and conflict-safe saves in the Web UI.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将浏览器 GUI 与 VSCode 打通：工作区一键打开项目，对话内文件路径点击跳转 VSCode，支持 文件:行:列 精确定位，失败自动回退系统默认打开。
description.en: A DSH plugin bridging browser GUI with VSCode: one-click open workspace in VSCode, click file paths in chat to jump to VSCode with line:column support, falling back to system default on failure.

description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 sdd模式 agent preset，按 L0/L1/L2 复杂度分级并渐进开放技能，引导规格驱动开发流程。
description.en: A DSH plugin that ships the sdd模式 agent preset, triaging task complexity across L0/L1/L2 with progressive skill gating for spec-driven development.

description.zh: DSH plugin 向系统提示注入高优先级指令，强制模型用简体中文回复，并在设置侧边栏显示「中文回复」项。
description.en: A DSH plugin that injects a high-priority system prompt instruction forcing the model to reply in simplified Chinese, and adds a 'Chinese Reply' item to the settings sidebar.

description.zh: OpenWorkProof 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件提供可验证的代理授权、执行证据与离线交付核验，让声明的代理工作可独立审查。
description.en: OpenWorkProof adds verifiable agent authorization, execution evidence, and offline delivery verification to DeepSeek Harness plugins, making declared agent work independently reviewable.

description.zh: OrgX 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 MCP 工具与网关 peer，实现工作台账、治理执行与证明，需 OAuth 认证。
description.en: OrgX adds MCP tools and a gateway peer to DeepSeek Harness for work ledger, governed execution, and proof, requiring OAuth.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 PACT 治理的 DSH plugin，在 agent 步进与工具执行前做门控，支持 observe 审计与 govern 阻断两档。
description.en: A DSH plugin that adds PACT governance to DeepSeek Harness, gating agent pre-step and tool execution with observe-only audit or fail-closed govern modes.

description.zh: pi-cordis 把 Pi 编码代理封装为 Cordis 运行时插件，通过 ctx.piEngine 提供会话开启、事件订阅与提示调用，让 DSH 宿主可挂载、移除或替换 Pi 引擎。
description.en: pi-cordis packages the Pi coding agent as a Cordis runtime plugin, exposing ctx.piEngine for session opening, event subscription and prompting so a DSH host can mount, remove or replace the Pi engine.

description.zh: plane-dsh-plugin 是 DeepSeek Harness 的原生插件，将编码会话中的任务、缺陷、决策等自动同步为 Plane 项目更新，并提供浮动面板管理。
description.en: plane-dsh-plugin is a native DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns coding session events into Plane project updates, with a floating panel for management.

description.zh: project-ai-docs 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供通用项目 AI 文档协议 skill，通过每项目一份 docs/.ai 认知库，让 agent 会话先读索引再动手、改动必回写，防上下文涣散、保项目认知精细。
description.en: project-ai-docs is a DSH plugin providing a generic project AI documentation protocol skill, using a per-project docs/.ai knowledge base to keep agent context focused and project knowledge precise.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 官方 Web UI 添加右侧工作区文件浏览器，可在对话中浏览文件并预览文本，是 DSH plugin 的实用扩展。
description.en: Adds a right-side workspace file explorer to the official DeepSeek Harness Web UI, letting you browse and preview text files within conversations.

description.zh: PriceWin 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 MCP 比价能力，实时查询 Booking.com、Agoda、Trip.com 与 Traveloka 的酒店和机票价格，并支持向合作酒店发起预订与取消。
description.en: PriceWin brings live hotel and flight price comparison into DeepSeek Harness via MCP, covering Booking.com, Agoda, Trip.com and Traveloka, with partner-hotel booking requests and cancellations.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 relay-monitor-author 技能，引导 Agent 发现监控包、按最小权限编写并校验、持久安装。
description.en: A DSH plugin that contributes the relay-monitor-author Skill, guiding the Agent through Monitor Bundle discovery, least-authority authoring, validation and durable installation.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 上的 Relay Monitor Bundle 提供只读、身份安全的进程状态能力，通过会话与项目绑定的不透明 Process Handle 授权访问，避免 PID 泄露。
description.en: A read-only, identity-safe process status capability for Relay Monitor Bundles on DeepSeek Harness, granting access through opaque Session- and project-bound Process Handles instead of exposing PIDs.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Relay 提供 time.deadline 监控类型与 relay_schedule_timer 定时工具，让 Agent 能按截止时间触发提醒与调度。
description.en: Adds the time.deadline Monitor Bundle Type and the relay_schedule_timer tool to Relay on DeepSeek Harness, letting agents schedule and trigger deadline-based reminders.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 conversation-to-skill 技能，把完成的多轮对话提炼成经校验、可复用的 DSH Skill 目录，含需求契约与验证流程。
description.en: A DSH plugin that registers the conversation-to-skill Skill, turning a finished DeepSeek Harness conversation into a validated, reusable Skill bundle with requirement contracts and checks.

description.zh: relay-dsh-plugin-terminal 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加基于 xterm 的底部终端面板，提供浏览器终端界面与执行后端注册表，需配合 workbench 与 provider 插件使用。
description.en: relay-dsh-plugin-terminal adds an xterm-based bottom terminal panel to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, offering a browser terminal surface and a provider registry for execution backends.

description.zh: relay-dsh-plugin-workbench 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web UI 提供可复用的 Workbench 宿主外壳，让其他插件安全注册右侧与底部面板，无需改动 DSH 核心代码。
description.en: relay-dsh-plugin-workbench adds a reusable Workbench shell to the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI, letting other plugins register side and bottom panels without modifying DSH core.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧栏或 1session CLI 中只读浏览、搜索 Claude Code、Codex、Grok 与 DeepSeek Harness 的本地历史会话，原文不动，SQLite 索引加速检索。
description.en: Browse and search local Claude Code, Codex, Grok and DeepSeek Harness session history from the DSH Web sidebar or the 1session CLI, with read-only raw files and a SQLite index for fast search.

description.zh: 将 Codex 会话历史导入 DeepSeek Harness，实现对话无缝延续，支持 CLI 与 /import-codex 命令。
description.en: Import Codex conversation history into DeepSeek Harness for seamless continuity, via CLI and /import-codex command.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 输入框加一个扬声器按钮，单击朗读最新助手回复，按住上拖调出页内与系统音量混音台。
description.en: Adds a speaker button to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI composer: click to read the latest assistant reply aloud, press and drag up for a page/system volume mixer.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置的技能发现服务，支持 cwd/项目/祖先/全局四层扫描，可在 GUI 中按预设接管并编辑父目录，实现灵活的技能目录管理。
description.en: A configurable skill discovery provider for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), offering four-layer scanning (cwd/project/ancestors/global) with per-preset takeover and editable parent dirs via GUI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话自动生成简洁标题的 DSH plugin，复用对话自身的模型与提供商，支持压缩超长提示、标题锁定、批量优化与自定义标题风格。
description.en: A DSH plugin that generates concise automatic session titles for DeepSeek Harness using each conversation's own provider and model, with prompt compression, title locking, bulk optimization and configurable title style.

description.zh: 这是一款 DeepSeek Harness 插件，让 Agent 以人物、任务卡与三级操作模式模拟真实用户测试软件，用录屏截屏取证，零输入注入。
description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that makes the agent test software as a real user would — personas, task cards, three input modes and screen evidence, with zero input injection.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供带来源引用的分层文字记忆，保存用户偏好与项目决定，并在后续对话中按条件自动找回。
description.en: A source-linked layered text memory DSH plugin that stores user preferences and project decisions, then recalls them conditionally in later conversations.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的回复自动注入标准 Unicode emoji，按情绪贴合内容插入，并提供可视化设置卡片，可与 dsh-kaomoji 共存。
description.en: Adds widely-supported Unicode emoji to DeepSeek Harness (DSH) replies, placing them next to the most fitting content, with a visual settings card and coexistence with dsh-kaomoji.

description.zh: TokenLab 模型提供商插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 接入原生协议路由、多模态工具与异步任务，支持 134 个模型与 80 个 MCP 工具。
description.en: TokenLab model provider for DeepSeek Harness, adding native-protocol routes, multimodal tools, and async tasks with 134 models and 80 MCP tools.

description.zh: 把 Trae CN 作为原生 LLM provider 接入 DeepSeek Harness，模型直接出现在模型选择器，并可选挂出 OpenAI 兼容接口。
description.en: Registers Trae CN as a native LLM provider in DeepSeek Harness, surfacing its models in the model picker with an optional OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供代理心跳音效：用 Web-Audio 合成低鸣、滴答与提示铃，让你不看屏幕也能听出代理在运行、输出还是等待你确认。
description.en: An agent-heartbeat sonification plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web surface: procedural Web-Audio hum, tick and chime tones let you hear whether agents are working, streaming output, or waiting on your input.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边栏账户余额徽章，点开即可查看余额、赠送额度、当前模型与平台用量入口，并按余额档位呈现宝石质感。
description.en: A sidebar balance badge for DeepSeek Harness that opens a popover with balance, bonus credit, current model and a platform usage shortcut, styled with gemstone tiers by balance.

description.zh: 小禾画布 DSH plugin，让 DeepSeek Harness 直接操作画布节点与连线，调用模板库和 AI 生成图片、视频、文案，帮电商卖家快速产出带货内容。
description.en: A DSH plugin for Xiaohe Canvas that lets DeepSeek Harness edit canvas nodes and links, browse e-commerce templates, and generate images, videos and copy for product content.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打字过程添加主题特效、萌宠陪伴、连击动画与打字音效，支持中文输入法及深浅色界面。
description.en: Adds theme-matched typing effects, companion pets, combo animations and typing sounds to DeepSeek Harness, with Chinese IME and light/dark UI support.

description.zh: DSH plugin 插件管理器，在设置中查看已安装的第三方插件并支持启用、停用与删除，提供热更新与自删除恢复。
description.en: A DSH plugin manager that lets you view installed third-party plugins in settings, with enable/disable/delete support, hot reload, and self-deletion recovery.

description.zh: yue-token-cost 是一个 DSH 插件兼 MCP 服务器，用来测量中文与粤语在不同 tokenizer 下的 token 成本，并逐项归因解释差异来源。
description.en: A DSH plugin and MCP server that measures what Chinese and Cantonese actually cost in tokens across tokenizers, with per-token attribution explaining why the gap exists.

description.zh: DSH plugin 将零散笔记（文本+图片）保存到语雀知识库，由模型自动分类，图片经 GitHub 图床上传，并附带 PDF 课件整理技能。
description.en: A DSH plugin that saves messy notes (text + images) to a Yuque knowledge base with auto-classification, image hosting via GitHub, plus a PDF-to-notes skill.
